title: An XAI Approach to Deep Learning Models in the Detection of DCIS
summary: The results showed that XAI could indeed be used as a proof of concept to begin discussions on the implementation of assistive AI systems within the clinical community.

AI.tldr: 研究表明，可解释人工智能可作为推动临床辅助人工智能系统实施讨论的概念验证。
AI.motivation: 探索可解释人工智能对临床辅助人工智能系统实施讨论的支持作用。
AI.method: 采用可解释人工智能开展概念验证，摘要未说明具体技术方法。

AI.conclusion: 可解释人工智能可为临床群体讨论辅助人工智能系统的实施提供切入点。

title: Parkinson's Disease Freezing of Gait (FoG) Symptom Detection Using Machine Learning from Wearable Sensor Data
summary: Freezing of gait (FoG) is a special symptom found in patients with Parkinson's disease (PD). Patients who have FoG abruptly lose the capacity to walk as they normally would. Accelerometers worn by patients can record movement data during these episodes, and machine learning algorithms can be useful to categorize this information. Thus, the combination may be able to identify FoG in real time. In order to identify FoG events in accelerometer data, we introduce the Transformer Encoder-Bi-LSTM fusion model in this paper. The model's capability to differentiate between FoG episodes and normal movement was used to evaluate its performance, and on the Kaggle Parkinson's Freezing of Gait dataset, the proposed Transformer Encoder-Bi-LSTM fusion model produced 92.6% accuracy, 80.9% F1 score, and 52.06% in terms of mean average precision. The findings highlight how Deep Learning-based approaches may progress the field of FoG identification and help PD patients receive better treatments and management plans.

AI.tldr: 研究利用Transformer编码器与双向LSTM融合模型，从可穿戴加速度数据中检测帕金森病冻结步态。
AI.motivation: 冻结步态会使患者突然无法正常行走，结合可穿戴传感器与机器学习有望实现实时识别。
AI.method: 构建Transformer编码器与双向LSTM融合模型，在Kaggle冻结步态数据集上区分冻结事件与正常运动。
AI.result: 模型准确率为92.6%，F1分数为80.9%，平均精度均值为52.06%。
AI.conclusion: 深度学习方法有望推进冻结步态识别，并支持帕金森病患者的治疗与管理。

title: Fast Catch-Up, Late Switching: Optimal Batch Size Scheduling via Functional Scaling Laws
summary: Batch size scheduling (BSS) plays a critical role in large-scale deep learning training, influencing both optimization dynamics and computational efficiency. Yet, its theoretical foundations remain poorly understood. In this work, we show that the functional scaling law (FSL) framework introduced in Li et al. (2025a) provides a principled lens for analyzing BSS. Specifically, we characterize the optimal BSS under a fixed data budget and show that its structure depends sharply on task difficulty. For easy tasks, optimal schedules keep increasing batch size throughout. In contrast, for hard tasks, the optimal schedule maintains small batch sizes for most of training and switches to large batches only in a late stage. To explain the emergence of late switching, we uncover a dynamical mechanism -- the fast catch-up effect -- which also manifests in large language model (LLM) pretraining. After switching from small to large batches, the loss rapidly aligns with the constant large-batch trajectory. Using FSL, we show that this effect stems from rapid forgetting of accumulated gradient noise, with the catch-up speed determined by task difficulty. Crucially, this effect implies that large batches can be safely deferred to late training without sacrificing performance, while substantially reducing data consumption. Finally, extensive LLM pretraining experiments -- covering both Dense and MoE architectures with up to 1.1B parameters and 1T tokens -- validate our theoretical predictions. Across all settings, late-switch schedules consistently outperform constant-batch and early-switch baselines.
comment: 34 pages, accepted by ICLR 2026 as a conference paper

AI.tldr: 研究以函数缩放定律分析最优批大小调度，揭示困难任务适宜在训练后期切换至大批量。
AI.motivation: 批大小调度影响优化动态与计算效率，但其理论基础仍缺乏充分理解。
AI.method: 基于函数缩放定律推导固定数据预算下的最优调度，并以最高11亿参数、1万亿词元的模型预训练验证。

title: Giving Meaning to Movements: Challenges and Opportunities in Expanding Communication by Pairing Unaided AAC with Speech Generated Messages
summary: Augmentative and Alternative Communication (AAC) technologies are categorized into two forms: aided AAC, which uses external devices like speech-generating systems to produce standardized output, and unaided AAC, which relies on body-based gestures for natural expression but requires shared understanding. We investigate how to combine these approaches to harness the speed and naturalness of unaided AAC while maintaining the intelligibility of aided AAC, a largely unexplored area for individuals with communication and motor impairments. Through 18 months of participatory design with AAC users, we identified key challenges and opportunities and developed AllyAAC, a wearable system with a wrist-worn IMU paired with a smartphone app. We evaluated AllyAAC in a field study with 14 participants and produced a dataset containing over 600,000 multimodal data points featuring atypical gestures--the first of its kind. Our findings reveal challenges in recognizing personalized, idiosyncratic gestures and demonstrate how to address them using Transformer-based large machine learning (ML) models with different pretraining strategies. In sum, we contribute design principles and a reference implementation for adaptive, personalized systems combining aided and unaided AAC.
comment: To appear in Proceedings of the 2026 CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CHI '26)

AI.tldr: 研究开发AllyAAC，将个性化身体手势与语音生成结合，探索辅助与非辅助沟通方式的融合。
AI.motivation: 身体手势自然快捷但依赖共同理解，语音生成清晰却需外部设备，两者结合仍缺乏探索。
AI.method: 开展18个月参与式设计，开发腕部惯性传感器与手机应用系统，并对14名参与者进行实地研究。
AI.result: 研究产出逾60万个多模态数据点，揭示个性化手势识别难点，并展示不同预训练策略的Transformer模型应对方式。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供设计原则与参考实现，为融合两类沟通方式的自适应个性化系统提供支持。

title: ChartSync: A Benchmark for Visuo-Logical Cascading Chart Editing
summary: Generative image editing models struggle with structured statistical charts when data modifications require geometric synchronization. We formalize this task as Visuo-Logical Cascading Editing (VLCE). However, existing methods remain confined to localized text substitutions and struggle with dependency-aware cascading updates. To systematically evaluate this capability, we introduce ChartSync, an expert-validated benchmark constructed via a programmatic rendering pipeline that guarantees deterministic visuo-logical coupling for the ground truth. ChartSync comprises 870 triplets across 9 chart categories and 4 task types, including 235 geometry-coupled VLCE instances that specifically test cascading text-to-geometry synchronization. We further evaluate these instances via a two-tier framework combining objective visual metrics with a vision-language model judge paradigm to assess low-level fidelity alongside multimodal comprehension and reasoning. Evaluating 14 image editing models and one code-mediated pipeline reveals a nuanced capability gap: most open-source models suffer severe drops in geometric synchronization, while only two frontier proprietary models show emerging VLCE capability, with their residual errors mainly involving semantic isolation and background corruption. Our detailed error analysis deconstructs these failure paradigms to identify core meta-abilities for guiding future multimodal architectures. The ChartSync dataset and code are publicly released at this https URL.

AI.tldr: ChartSync基准用于评估图表编辑中的视觉逻辑级联更新，揭示现有模型在几何同步方面的能力缺口。
AI.motivation: 生成式图像编辑模型难以在修改图表数据时同步更新相关几何结构，现有方法多局限于局部文本替换。
AI.method: 构建含870组三元组、9类图表和4类任务的基准，以客观视觉指标和视觉语言模型评判进行双层评估。
AI.result: 评测14个图像编辑模型与一个代码流程发现，多数开源模型几何同步表现严重下降，仅两个前沿闭源模型初显相关能力。
AI.conclusion: 基准与错误分析揭示级联编辑所需的核心能力，可为未来多模态架构设计提供方向。

title: Manifold-Constrained PET Reconstruction with Learned Flow-Matching Priors
summary: Image reconstruction for positron emission tomography (PET) is an ill-posed Poisson inverse problem. In this work, we introduce an unsupervised, optimization-based reconstruction framework that employs a flow-matching generative model as a learned manifold prior. We train the generative model on high-quality PET images to learn a differentiable ordinary differential equation (ODE)-based transport from a Gaussian latent distribution to the PET image distribution. We incorporate this generator as an explicit manifold constraint into a regularized Poisson likelihood formulation. To solve the resulting problem, we develop an alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) algorithm that integrates an expectation-maximization (EM)-type surrogate update for Poisson data fidelity with gradient-based latent-space optimization. Numerical simulations and in vivo PET experiments demonstrate improved reconstruction accuracy compared with conventional reconstruction methods and recent deep learning-based approaches, particularly in low-count settings, with competitive computational efficiency.

AI.tldr: 研究以流匹配生成模型作为流形先验，提升PET重建精度，尤其适用于低计数条件。
AI.motivation: PET图像重建属于病态泊松逆问题，需要有效先验改善重建质量。
AI.method: 将流匹配生成器作为泊松似然的显式流形约束，采用结合EM型更新与潜空间梯度优化的ADMM求解。
AI.result: 数值模拟与在体实验显示，该方法比传统及近期深度学习方法重建更准确，低计数时尤为明显，且计算效率具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 学习得到的流匹配流形先验可支持准确且高效的PET重建。

title: Sivia: Learning to Draw, Learning to Learn
summary: A paper's overview figure is often the first thing readers see: it must explain the method correctly and look polished. We present Sivia, an overview-figure system that reads the paper, plans its relations, adapts visual organization from recent top-conference papers, and composes a design for image generation. Sivia improves with use through human-guided recursive self-improvement (RSI) at two levels: learning to draw revises its drawing skill from feedback on accuracy and presentation, and learning to learn revises the updater that proposes those revisions. A personal profile adapts presentation to its user's aesthetic preferences while the scientific content stays fixed. A diagnostic study of 1,964 overviews for 445 papers (17,973 relation judgments) shows that most errors are omissions and that source-derived relation plans raise required-relation accuracy (RRA) by up to 19.85 points. On 48 test papers, learning both levels reaches 93.54\% RRA, 15.31, 9.38, and 8.33 points above the initial skill, the Fixed-updater, and the GEPA baselines, while readability and visual quality rise from 3.95 and 4.00 to 4.70 and 4.78 on five-point scales. Learned presentation profiles raise liking from 4.02 to 4.73 and adoption from 34 to 45 of 48 tasks. Code and released artifacts are available at this https URL

AI.tldr: Sivia通过双层人类反馈递归自改进生成论文概览图，同时提升科学关系表达、视觉质量与用户偏好适配。
AI.motivation: 论文概览图既需准确传达方法，又需清晰美观，而现有图示常遗漏关键关系。
AI.method: 系统读取论文并规划关系、组织视觉布局，通过人类反馈同时更新绘图技能及其更新器，并学习个人审美档案。
AI.result: 在48篇测试论文上，双层学习使必要关系准确率达93.54%，可读性与视觉质量分别升至4.70和4.78分。
AI.conclusion: 双层递归改进与个性化呈现可提升概览图质量及用户接受度，同时保持科学内容不变。

title: RoboACE: Adversarial Co-Evolution for Robot Self-Improvement
summary: Robot agents can improve reusable skills, planning procedures, and recovery strategies from execution feedback, yet a fixed practice source leaves the search for new weaknesses unchanged. Useful practice depends on the agent's current capabilities, so the procedure that chooses practice must also be revisable. We present RoboACE (Robot Adversarial Co-Evolution), a framework that jointly evolves curriculum and execution harnesses around frozen foundation models. The curriculum harness uses accumulated capability evidence to propose informative challenges, while the execution harness responds with reusable revisions that expand execution capabilities. Alternating updates hold one side fixed as the other changes, and admitted challenges form fixed snapshots for comparing execution revisions. Starting from a compact set of LIBERO practice conditions, the resulting frozen deployment outperforms the evaluated controllers and agent systems across four LIBERO-family panels. On LIBERO-PRO, it reaches 74.0% success, exceeding the initial deployment by 15.0 percentage points and direct execution by its VLA controller by 13.5 points. Case studies document changes to evidence-guided practice selection, drawer-skill grounding, and controller intervention.

AI.tldr: RoboACE在冻结基础模型的条件下协同演化练习课程与执行机制，提升机器人任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 固定练习来源无法随机器人能力变化持续发现弱点，因此练习选择程序也需要可修订。
AI.method: 交替更新课程与执行机制，利用能力证据提出挑战，并以固定挑战快照比较可复用的执行改进。
AI.result: 最终部署在四组LIBERO系列评测中优于所评控制器与智能体，在LIBERO-PRO上成功率达74.0%，较初始提升15个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 课程与执行机制的对抗式协同演化可在不更新基础模型的情况下促进机器人自我改进。

title: GOOSELoc: A Multimodal Benchmark for Ground-to-Aerial Localization in Unstructured Off-Road Terrain
summary: Cross-view pose estimation estimates a ground camera's geographic pose by matching onboard sensor data with geo-referenced overhead imagery. This is particularly relevant when GNSS is unreliable, for example under forest canopy or in urban canyons. Existing metric cross-view benchmarks, such as VIGOR and cross-view KITTI, are dominated by urban and road scenes with strong human-made structure without off-road terrain. We introduce GOOSELoc, a multimodal benchmark for ground-to-aerial localization in unstructured environments, including forests, fields, and rural tracks. GOOSELoc comprises 9,356 scenes recorded across all four seasons around Munich, Germany, pairing geo-referenced aerial orthophotos with surround-view RGB imagery and 3D LiDAR point clouds. Paved/unpaved labels enable analyzing the impact of terrain structure, while the seasonal recordings allow studying the appearance gap to mostly summer-captured orthophotos. To assess the transferability of existing methods, we adapt and fine-tune four state-of-the-art cross-view localization baselines on GOOSELoc. Despite task-specific fine-tuning, the performance degrades substantially in off-road environments. We therefore propose a multimodal baseline combining surround-view imagery and LiDAR geometry, improving localization performance and providing a stronger reference for future work. Data and baselines are released at this https URL.

AI.tldr: GOOSELoc提供非结构化越野地形的多模态地面到航拍定位基准，并提出融合图像与激光雷达的基线。
AI.motivation: 现有跨视角定位基准以城市和道路为主，难以评估卫星导航不可靠时的越野定位能力。
AI.method: 采集慕尼黑周边四季9356个场景，配对航拍正射影像、环视图像和激光雷达，并微调四种定位基线。
AI.result: 现有方法经微调后在越野环境中仍明显退化，融合环视图像与激光雷达几何信息的基线改善了定位性能。
AI.conclusion: 该基准支持分析地形结构与季节差异，为非结构化环境中的跨视角定位提供研究基础。

title: No Convergence in Learned Eavesdropping-Detection Dynamics for BB84 Quantum Key Distribution
summary: In prior work we showed that a reinforcement-learning eavesdropper can intercept BB84 quantum key distribution while holding the quantum bit error rate below the abort threshold and keeping a usable distillable key. In this paper we ask whether an equally adaptive learning detector can close this stealth window. We cast the interaction as an alternating best-response game between a tabular eavesdropper and a tabular threshold-adapting detector. We measure exploitability, which is the detection rate and distillable key fraction achieved by a fresh attacker best-responding to the final detector. Across three learning rules (Q-Learning, SARSA, Double Q-Learning), three channel-noise levels, and a uniform false-alarm discipline, the dynamics do not settle out to twenty rounds. The exploitability does not approach a fixed point, and its round-to-round swings do not decay. Two controls, one retraining the attacker against a frozen defender and one retraining the defender against a frozen attacker, show that the swings on each side match the variance of the best-response procedure itself. The dynamics fluctuate at the scale of best-response variance rather than converging, with neither player settling to a fixed response. The behavior is noise-dependent, and the stealth window stays open at the low noise where practical QKD operates. The defender contains the attacker on average at intermediate noise without the contest settling, and at high noise the channel rather than the learned policy suppresses the attack. As a candidate mechanism we examine a last-mover information asymmetry, supported by significant anti-persistence at intermediate noise and consistent with best-response noise at low noise. The results suggest that a learned detector cannot be certified from any single round, and that closing the window calls for breaking the information structure rather than out-adapting the attacker.

AI.tldr: BB84窃听者与自适应检测器的交替学习在二十轮内未收敛，低噪声条件下隐蔽窃听窗口仍然存在。
AI.motivation: 研究自适应学习检测器能否阻止强化学习窃听者在不触发中止阈值的情况下攻击BB84协议。
AI.method: 构建表格型窃听者与阈值自适应检测器的交替最佳响应博弈，比较三种学习规则和三档信道噪声。
AI.result: 双方波动与最佳响应过程自身方差相当，低噪声下隐蔽窗口持续存在，中噪声下检测器仅在平均意义上限制攻击。
AI.conclusion: 不能依据单轮表现认证学习检测器，关闭隐蔽窗口可能需要改变信息结构，而非单纯增强适应能力。

title: Check Token: Real-Time Self-Verification and Precise Truncation in LLM Reasoning
summary: ECC memory embeds 8 parity bits for every 64 data bits and automatically detects and corrects errors on each read. The parity bits carry no data and only safeguard integrity, at ~12.5% overhead. Yet the reasoning chains of large language models lack such built-in self-verification: once an error occurs it propagates along the chain, and existing methods can only verify externally after generation completes. We propose the check token, establishing built-in self-verification for language model generation streams for the first time: a functional marker <CHECK> is added to the vocabulary, and the model triggers self-checking (analysis, localization, truncation, rewriting) by outputting it at any position. The check token carries no reasoning content (discarded after triggering) and only safeguards reasoning correctness, directly corresponding to the role of ECC parity bits, also at only ~13% overhead. Speculative forking further eliminates false-positive latency, and segmented reward makes trigger timing end-to-end learnable. Experiments (Qwen3-32B / Qwen3-Next) show that the check token achieves +10.8 pp improvement on HMMT25 at 1.13x overhead, with token efficiency 88x that of Best-of-8, and the precise truncation advantage monotonically increases with chain length.

AI.tldr: 检查令牌使语言模型在生成途中自检并精确截断重写，以约13%的开销提升推理表现。
AI.motivation: 语言模型推理链缺乏内置校验，错误会持续传播，而现有方法通常只能在生成结束后外部验证。
AI.method: 新增触发自检、定位、截断和重写的检查令牌，并以推测分叉降低误触发延迟、分段奖励学习触发时机。
AI.result: 实验在HMMT25上提升10.8个百分点，开销为1.13倍，令牌效率为Best-of-8的88倍。
AI.conclusion: 内置检查可高效改善推理正确性，且精确截断的优势随推理链增长而扩大。

title: A Survey of Image-to-Code Generation for Software Engineering
summary: A large fraction of software intent is expressed visually before it is implemented. A designer hands a screenshot or a Figma mockup to a front-end engineer, an architect sketches a UML diagram or a flowchart, and a bug report ships with a picture of what went wrong. Turning such visual artifacts directly into executable software has therefore become an active problem at the intersection of computer vision and software engineering. The present survey organizes the literature on image-to-code generation for software engineering, defined as the family of methods whose input contains a visual modality and whose output is software an engineer would otherwise write by hand. We deliberately scope the survey to software-engineering code, namely user-interface and front-end code, code recovered from software diagrams such as UML and flowcharts, program repair and test code driven by visual signals, and general software-code targets, and we exclude adjacent code-generation domains whose home communities lie elsewhere, such as chart plotting scripts, vector-graphics programs, hardware description languages, and robot policies. Rather than cataloguing systems in isolation, we introduce a unified processing pipeline of visual understanding, component recognition, layout reasoning, code planning, code generation, and verification, and organize the survey around its stages. We trace five overlapping eras from rule-based reverse engineering to agentic generation, survey each pipeline stage and each software-engineering task in depth grounded in what individual systems actually do, consolidate the datasets, benchmarks, and metrics, and lay out the open challenges of design-system generalization, long-horizon and interactive generation, cross-framework deployment, accessibility, hallucinated components, and unreliable evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该综述以统一处理流水线梳理软件工程中的图像到代码生成研究、评测资源与开放挑战。
AI.motivation: 软件需求常以界面截图、设计稿和软件图表表达，将这些视觉信息直接转为可执行软件具有重要价值。
AI.method: 围绕视觉理解、组件识别、布局推理、代码规划、生成与验证六阶段，梳理五个重叠发展时期及多类任务。
AI.result: 综述整合了数据集、基准和指标，并归纳设计系统泛化、交互生成、跨框架部署、无障碍及评估可靠性等挑战。
AI.conclusion: 统一流水线为理解软件工程图像到代码方法提供框架，并明确了该领域尚待解决的问题。

title: VidEngram: Agentic Long-Term Video Understanding via Structured Hierarchical Memory
summary: Long-video question answering is wasteful and lossy when a multimodal model must re-encode the same video for every query: context limits force sparse sampling or truncation, and no reusable representation remains for later questions. We present VidEngram, an agentic video QA system that builds a persistent hierarchical memory once at ingest and answers later questions from that memory. VidEngram captions video and audio jointly with Qwen2.5-Omni, consolidates segment memories into episode and entity layers, and uses a text-only agentic planner with specialized retrieval tools to produce grounded answers. The web interface makes this process inspectable: users can watch memory formation, inspect retrieval traces, verify cited evidence in the video player, and explore entity relationships. On the full OmniVideoBench, VidEngram with a GPT-5-mini planner outperforms a strong single-pass Qwen2.5-Omni baseline (37.0% vs. 32.3%), with gains concentrated on longer videos where single-pass coverage becomes sparse. Because perception is paid once, subsequent queries use low-cost text-only planning.
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Demo video and code are linked in the paper

AI.tldr: VidEngram一次构建持久化层次视频记忆，通过文本智能体检索回答后续问题，提升长视频问答表现。
AI.motivation: 每次提问都重新编码长视频既浪费计算，也因上下文限制导致稀疏采样或截断，且无法复用表示。
AI.method: 联合生成视音频描述，将片段记忆整合为情节层与实体层，再由文本规划器调用检索工具生成有据可查的回答。
AI.result: 在完整OmniVideoBench上，使用GPT-5-mini规划器达到37.0%，高于单遍基线的32.3%。
AI.conclusion: 持久化层次记忆尤其有利于较长视频，并使后续查询仅需低成本文本规划，同时支持证据检查。

title: Quantize, Qualify, Rerank: A Recipe for Compressing LLMs Without Losing Quality
summary: Compressing large language models lowers serving cost, but a single automatic metric may miss quality loss. For the WMT26 Model Compression constrained track, we compress google/gemma-3-12b-it (24.4 GB in bf16) for three translation directions on one H100. Paired bootstrap analysis exposes metric disagreement on 4-bit quantization; guided by WMT24 human meta-evaluation, we use MetricX24-XXL as primary and CometKiwi-XXL as a cross-check. Removing the unused vision stack and non-task vocabulary and using int8 weights or fp8 activations causes no resolved loss, whereas int4 leaves a small residual. QLoRA healing overfits its calibration domain. A Cometoid best-of-4 reranker at $T=0.3$ improves both the 8-bit and 4-bit systems under WMT25 test set. On post-submission WMT26, both remain competitive with bf16 under reference-free metrics; the small difference between the reranked variants is treated as noise.

AI.tldr: 研究结合量化、多指标质量核查和候选重排序，在降低翻译模型成本的同时维持有竞争力的质量。
AI.motivation: 模型压缩虽能降低服务成本，但单一自动指标可能漏检质量损失。
AI.method: 在单张H100上压缩Gemma-3-12B，裁剪非任务组件，比较量化精度，并结合双指标核查与四候选重排序。
AI.result: 8位权重或FP8激活未出现可辨识损失，4位仍有小幅残余损失；重排序改善两种精度模型，QLoRA修复则过拟合。
AI.conclusion: 压缩质量应通过互补指标审慎核查，重排序后的8位与4位系统在WMT26无参考指标下仍可与BF16竞争。

title: Skill-Latent Rewards: LLM-Guided Reward Formulation for Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
summary: Long-horizon reinforcement learning under sparse and delayed feedback remains an open challenge. Existing return-decomposition methods redistribute episodic rewards to ease credit assignment, but they operate on raw state--action transitions and disregard the subgoal structure that governs meaningful progress in complex tasks. We propose Skill-LR, a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework in which a vision--language model identifies the agent's active subgoal at each timestep and a large language model generates a matching latent reward formulation through a two-stage prompting process. By conditioning reward signals on the currently active subgoal, Skill-LR produces stage-specific credit that evolves with the hierarchical plan, reducing temporal variance and improving sample efficiency. On multi-stage MiniGrid and BabyAI benchmarks, including DoorKey and Unlock-to-Unlock, Skill-LR converges faster and more reliably than sparse environmental rewards and strong credit-assignment baselines such as RUDDER and LaRe, demonstrating that subgoal-aligned latent rewards offer a principled path toward stable, interpretable credit assignment in long-horizon tasks.

AI.tldr: Skill-LR利用视觉语言模型识别子目标、语言模型生成阶段性潜在奖励，改善长时程强化学习的信用分配。
AI.motivation: 稀疏延迟反馈使长时程学习困难，现有回报分解忽略了复杂任务中决定有效进展的子目标结构。
AI.method: 逐时刻识别智能体的当前子目标，通过两阶段提示生成匹配的潜在奖励，使信用信号随层次计划动态变化。
AI.result: 在多阶段MiniGrid和BabyAI任务上，Skill-LR比稀疏奖励及RUDDER、LaRe等基线收敛更快、更可靠。
AI.conclusion: 与子目标对齐的潜在奖励可提高样本效率，为稳定且可解释的长时程信用分配提供路径。

title: Not All Data Leakage Is Equal: A Controlled Benchmark of Evaluation Inflation in Tabular Classification
summary: Data leakage is widely recognized as a threat to trustworthy machine-learning evaluation, yet the phrase covers mechanisms with very different statistical consequences. We present a controlled empirical benchmark that measures the inflation in held-out ROC-AUC caused by five common leakage mechanisms: global standardization, global median imputation, duplicate contamination, supervised feature selection before splitting, and target encoding before splitting. The benchmark spans six public datasets and two synthetic stress tests, three model families, and five repeated stratified train/test splits, yielding 600 paired clean-versus-leaked comparisons. To avoid pseudo-replication, inference is performed on dataset-level effects with cluster bootstrap confidence intervals and Holm-corrected one-sided Wilcoxon tests. Label-dependent or direct data-reuse mechanisms produced systematic optimism: global target encoding increased ROC-AUC by 2.42 percentage points on average (95% cluster-bootstrap CI 0.62--4.89), global supervised feature selection by 1.93 points (0.63--3.39), and duplicate contamination by 1.52 points (0.40--2.80). All three remained significant after multiplicity correction. In contrast, global scaling and global median imputation had near-zero average effects under the i.i.d. settings studied here. A controlled target-encoding stress test further shows that leakage becomes sharply worse as categories become sparse. The results support a severity-aware view of leakage: evaluation pipelines should prevent all held-out-data dependence, but label-dependent transformations and observation reuse deserve especially aggressive auditing.

AI.tldr: 受控基准显示，标签依赖变换和重复样本污染会系统性抬高分类评估，而全局缩放与中位数插补平均影响接近零。
AI.motivation: 数据泄漏涵盖统计后果不同的机制，需要区分其造成评估虚高的严重程度。
AI.method: 在六个公开数据集和两个合成压力测试上比较五类泄漏，以600组配对实验和数据集层级统计推断评估影响。
AI.result: 目标编码、监督特征选择和重复污染平均抬高ROC-AUC各2.42、1.93和1.52个百分点，校正后均显著。
AI.conclusion: 应防止一切测试数据依赖，并优先严格审计标签依赖变换与样本复用，尤其关注稀疏类别下的目标编码。

title: Mechanistic Interpretability of Mambas Selective Gate in Financial Markets: A Leakage-Controlled Study
summary: Selectively gated state-space models (SSMs), notably Mamba, are increasingly used for financial time series, yet how they internally represent market regimes (bull, bear, sideways) remains opaque. This paper applies Mechanistic Interpretability (MI) to a six-layer Mamba trained on approximately twenty-one years of daily data for a point-in-time set of S&P 500 constituents plus macroeconomic and Fama-French factors, decomposing per-layer hidden states with Top-K Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs). Our central contribution is methodological and cautionary. A prior, uncontrolled configuration recovered market regimes from SAE features at F1 = 1.00. Under a controlled protocol that (i) removes the three input features that overlap the HMM label definition, (ii) disables the auxiliary regime-classification head, (iii) uses a point-in-time constituent universe, and (iv) evaluates against labels disjoint from the inputs, the same regime label is recovered at only F1 = 0.398, indistinguishable from a logistic baseline on raw inputs (0.435) and from an SAE trained on a randomly initialized, untrained Mamba (0.364). A 2x2 attribution grid shows the near-perfect result is an interaction of auxiliary supervision and label-defining inputs: neither factor alone exceeds F1 ~ 0.40. Effect sizes with block-bootstrap inference show the residual selective-gate (Delta t) regime effect is statistically detectable but economically negligible and uniform across layers rather than layer-specialized; the apparent polysemanticity gradient disappears under continuous, theory-grounded measures. We contribute a reproducible leakage-control protocol for interpretability evaluation of financial SSMs, a quantified demonstration that previously reported regime structure is a label-contamination artifact, and a modest economically grounded feature subset that genuinely survives the controls.

AI.tldr: 泄漏控制实验表明，Mamba中近乎完美的市场状态识别主要源于标签污染，而非真实内部结构。
AI.motivation: 金融时序模型如何表征市场状态尚不透明，解释性结果也可能受到输入与标签重叠的误导。
AI.method: 用Top-K稀疏自编码器分解六层Mamba隐状态，并控制标签重叠输入、辅助监督及成分股时点信息。
AI.result: 控制后状态识别F1由1.00降至0.398，与原始输入和随机模型基线无明显差异，门控效应经济意义微弱。
AI.conclusion: 金融状态空间模型的解释性评估须严格控制泄漏，仅少量具经济依据的特征经受住了检验。

title: Internal Verdicts Track Evidence: A Template-Controlled Neutrosophic Reading of Epistemic States in Large Language Models via the Jacobian Lens
summary: For twenty-five years, neutrosophic logic has assigned independent degrees of truth (T), indeterminacy (I), and falsity (F) to epistemic states that classical and fuzzy semantics cannot express. Previous applications measured these components on outputs: answers, judgments, expert evaluations. This paper reports, to our knowledge, the first neutrosophic reading of components inside the internal representations of a large language model. Using the recently released Jacobian lens on Qwen3.5-4B, we project intermediate-layer readouts onto lexicons of support, refutation, and hedging, obtaining layer-wise (T, I, F) profiles under conflicting evidence, first-person false belief, and factual control (n = 20 each). A first battery yielded three striking signatures: a surge of refutation mass under conflict, sustained indeterminacy under false belief, and an apparent "verdict collapse" before the output layer. A second, template-controlled battery showed that all three, as initially stated, were largely artifacts of prompt grammar: matched templates with agreeing evidence inflate the same lexicon masses, true beliefs elicit the same hedging, and the model verbalizes its verdict when allowed to generate. What survives the controls is stronger than what died: the neutrosophic verdict balance B = log10(F) - log10(T) tracks evidence polarity under identical templates (about 3 orders of magnitude of separation, Cohen's d = 2.3-2.5, p < 10^-6 in 9 of 9 layers; paired Wilcoxon: median difference +2.4 orders, 19/20 items, p = 3.8x10^-6) and residually discriminates false from true first-person beliefs. We argue that the independence of the neutrosophic components is what keeps the common-mode channel observable, making both the measurement and its self-correction possible, and we distill the two-battery design into a reusable protocol for auditing language model internals with lens-based readouts.
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Published in Neutrosophic Sets and Systems, Vol. 101 (2026). Code, stimuli and data: this https URL

AI.tldr: 模板控制揭示多种内部认知信号是假象，但中智逻辑判决平衡仍能稳定追踪证据极性。
AI.motivation: 既有中智逻辑研究主要测量模型输出，尚缺乏对内部真实性、不确定性与虚假性成分的受控分析。
AI.method: 用雅可比透镜读取Qwen3.5-4B中间层，投影至支持、反驳和犹豫词表，并以匹配模板复核。
AI.result: 初始三类信号多由提示语法造成，但判决平衡在九层均区分证据极性，差异约三个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 独立测量中智逻辑成分并实施模板控制，有助于识别测量伪影并审计语言模型内部表征。

title: One Question, Four Voices: How Advice for Alzheimer's Caregiving Differs Between Caregivers, Clinicians, and Large Language Models
summary: Online caregiver forums are an important source of emotional and informational support for Alzheimer's disease and related dementias (ADRD). We compare responses to 85 real caregiver questions from ALZConnected across four responder groups: peer caregivers, physicians, ChatGPT, and a retrieval-augmented CareGPT grounded in peer discussions. Using 28 measures spanning linguistic form, emotional support, informational support, and topic scope, we examine how these voices differ when answering the same questions. Peers provided time-anchored narratives and community grounding; clinicians offered concise, advice-forward, clinically bounded guidance; and LLMs produced a formal, verbose, highly structured consultation style. CareGPT showed minimal measurable separation from ChatGPT, suggesting that retrieval plus prompt injection alone was insufficient to shift communicative stance. LLM outputs scored higher than peers on politeness and emotion-support markers and were comparable to clinicians on informativeness and physician-alignment measures, but were less narrative and less contextually situated. Topic modeling showed that LLM responses concentrated on advice-oriented themes, whereas peers covered a broader range, including emotional processing, legal and financial concerns, and daily care. These findings suggest that AI can complement, but not replace, human contributions to ADRD caregiver support and motivate hybrid systems that combine structured AI delivery with the distinct strengths of human voices.
comment: Accepted to ACM CSCW 2026. 35 pages, 7 figures

AI.tldr: 阿尔茨海默病照护问答中，大模型擅长结构化建议，却缺乏同伴照护者的叙事与情境支持。
AI.motivation: 在线论坛承担照护者的情感与信息支持，需要厘清同伴、医生及大模型回应的不同价值。
AI.method: 针对85个真实照护问题，以语言形式、情感支持、信息支持和主题范围等28项指标比较四类回应。
AI.result: 大模型回应更正式冗长、偏重建议，同伴主题更广且更具情境性，CareGPT与ChatGPT差异很小。
AI.conclusion: 人工智能可补充但不能替代人类照护支持，混合系统应结合结构化输出与人类声音的独特优势。

title: Syntactic Complexity Convergence in Dialogue: Analysis of the Phenomenon and Application to LLM Detection
summary: We revisit the under-explored phenomenon of syntactic complexity convergence in dialogue. Extending prior topic-level analyses to full conversations, we examine five human-human datasets and a set of human-LLM dialogues. We integrate and evaluate a multidimensional set of syntactic complexity metrics to quantify structural variation in dialogue. Our analyses reveal robust syntactic complexity convergence across human-human datasets, especially in task-oriented interactions, and statistical tests confirm that these effects are not due to chance. In contrast, human-LLM dialogues show no significant convergence under individual metrics; however, linear-CKA uncovers a distinct cross-metric convergence pattern. Motivated by these differences, we use syntactic complexity as a feature for detecting LLM-involved dialogue, achieving 96\% accuracy. Our classification results demonstrate its potential without relying on likelihood-based signals such as surprisal, which require a language model as the estimator.

AI.tldr: 人际对话与人机对话呈现不同的句法复杂度趋同模式，可用于识别大模型参与的对话。
AI.motivation: 对话中的句法复杂度趋同研究不足，既有主题层面分析尚未充分覆盖完整会话。
AI.method: 整合多维句法复杂度指标，分析五个人际对话数据集及人机对话，并以线性CKA和分类实验检验。
AI.result: 人际对话显著趋同，人机对话仅呈跨指标趋同模式；基于句法复杂度的检测准确率达96%。
AI.conclusion: 句法复杂度为大模型对话检测提供了有效结构信号，无须依赖语言模型估计的惊异度等指标。

title: Justification of Emotional Appeal in Computational Argumentation
summary: Emotional appeals (EAs) are often treated as fallacious in computational argumentation, yet they may be justified when warranted by the context. We introduce the task of predicting EA justification and present the first human-annotated dataset for this task, covering 1,176 argument--context pairs. Grounded in philosophical literature, our framework evaluates EA justification along logical and emotional dimensions. Human annotations show that justification criteria form a shared latent judgment space, with evidential proportionality and normative acceptability most strongly associated with overall justification. We further find that EAs without logical support are not always judged fully unjustified, and stronger EAs are not necessarily judged less justified. Finally, LLM experiments show that EA justification prediction remains challenging.

AI.tldr: 研究提出情感诉求合理性预测任务，表明情感诉求并非天然谬误，而大模型对此判断仍有困难。
AI.motivation: 计算论证常将情感诉求视为谬误，却忽略其合理性可能取决于具体语境。
AI.method: 构建包含1176组论证与语境的首个人工标注数据集，从逻辑和情感维度评估合理性并测试大模型。
AI.result: 证据相称性与规范可接受性最关联总体判断；缺乏逻辑支持或情感更强并不必然意味着不合理。
AI.conclusion: 情感诉求应结合语境及多维标准评估，其合理性预测仍是大模型面临的挑战。

title: Understanding Failures in LLM Reasoning by Learning Structured Representations of Chain-of-Thought
summary: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) is central to improving reasoning in large language models, yet existing evaluation methods focus on step-level signals and ignore the underlying structure of reasoning traces. This raises a key question: what aspects of reasoning quality (i.e., correctness, efficiency, and failure patterns) are encoded in the structure of a CoT trace? We introduce \textbf{CoT2Graph}, a framework that represents CoT traces as directed dependency graphs, making relationships between reasoning steps explicit and capturing patterns such as backtracking, branching, and subtask merging. We model these graphs with graph neural networks and use attribution-based explanations to identify structural patterns associated with reasoning quality. CoT2Graph reveals distinct patterns of successful and failed reasoning: correct CoTs place greater importance on early planning, whereas incorrect CoTs are associated with overloaded synthesis steps and dependency violations. We further show that graph-based signals better predict whether a CoT leads to a correct answer, outperforming previous tree-based structural methods by up to 2.5\% and simple length-based baselines by 7.8\%, while also improving Best-of-$N$ selection. Overall, our results demonstrate that reasoning structure encodes rich signals about reasoning quality, motivating a shift from sequence-level evaluation to structural analysis.

AI.tldr: CoT2Graph将思维链转为依赖图，揭示推理成败的结构差异并提升答案正确性预测。
AI.motivation: 现有思维链评估侧重单步信号，忽视推理结构中蕴含的正确性、效率与失败模式信息。
AI.method: 将思维链表示为有向依赖图，以图神经网络建模，并用归因方法分析回溯、分支及子任务合并结构。
AI.result: 正确推理更重早期规划，错误推理伴随综合步骤过载及依赖违规；预测较树结构方法最高提升2.5%。
AI.conclusion: 推理结构包含丰富的质量信号，可改善多候选答案选择，并支持从序列评估转向结构分析。

title: When Helpful Agents Cause Financial Harm: Evaluating LLM Agent Safety in Executable Economic Worlds
summary: As LLM agents become increasingly capable of making consequential economic decisions, their safety under economic pressures remains poorly understood. We introduce EconSafeBench, the first benchmark for systematically evaluating the safety of LLM agents in executable economic environments. EconSafeBench contains 828 cases across five economic scenarios and four categories of safety violations. A key design is the matched evaluation of three sources of safety pressure, including explicit user requests, pressure from other actors, and pressure arising from the agent's own pursuit of a performance objective. We further evaluate safety at both static and dynamic scales through 30-period interactions with persistent memory and matched controls. Across eight LLMs, all evaluated models exhibit safety violations on the static benchmark, with overall violation rates ranging from 8.5% to 40.6%. We further find that violations can occur even without an explicit unsafe request, and that initially compliant agents may begin to violate as performance pressure increases over time. These findings highlight the need for stronger safety alignment and rigorous evaluation before LLM agents are deployed in high-stakes economic environments.
comment: Accepted (Oral) at EMNLP 2026 Workshop on Financial NLP (FinNLP)

AI.tldr: EconSafeBench显示，大模型智能体在经济环境中普遍出现安全违规，绩效压力也可能诱发违规。
AI.motivation: 大模型智能体日益参与重要经济决策，但其面对经济压力时的安全性仍缺乏系统评估。
AI.method: 构建涵盖五类场景、四类违规的828案例基准，匹配三种压力来源，并开展带持续记忆的30期交互。
AI.result: 八个模型的静态违规率为8.5%至40.6%；无明确不安全请求也会违规，部分智能体随绩效压力增加而转向违规。
AI.conclusion: 高风险经济部署前，需要强化智能体安全对齐，并同时评估外部要求与持续绩效压力下的行为。

title: Physics-informed and event-aware forecasting of ammonia emissions in aerobic chicken manure composting bioreactors: A PINN-PatchTST-GPR framework with symbolic dynamic extraction
summary: Predicting ammonia (NH3) concentrations during aerobic chicken manure composting provides critical feedforward signals for intelligent aeration. However, the concurrence of long-term biochemical evolution and intermittent forced-aeration pulses poses significant modeling hurdles across steady baselines, transient surges, and risk quantification. Existing data-driven models lack physical consistency, while mechanistic kinetic models struggle with environmental disturbances. To bridge this gap, we propose PINN-PatchTST-GPR, a physics-informed neuro-symbolic forecasting framework. Validated on a 28-day composting campaign across six vertical bioreactors, the framework couples a channel-independent PatchTST backbone with macroscopic kinetic constraints, dynamic physical bounds, and a Gaussian process regression (GPR) event specialist. Multi-channel sensor streams drive discrete differential equation residuals and non-negativity bounds, strictly ensuring physical plausibility. A block-split conformal prediction module yields nominal 90% distribution-free prediction intervals, while PySINDy and PySR extract low-complexity symbolic equations for quiescent and surge regimes. The model achieves an overall RMSE of 0.8256 +/- 0.0132 ppm, R2 of 0.9817 +/- 0.0006, Epeak of 1.6793 +/- 0.0725 ppm, and Etime of 0.7 +/- 0.2 min. For uncertainty quantification, it attains PICP90 of 99.792 +/- 0.047%, MPIW of 6.951 +/- 0.128 ppm, and IS0.1 of 6.968 +/- 0.128 ppm. Symbolically, PySINDy yields an RMSE of 0.4624 +/- 0.0758 ppm (R2 = 0.9896), while PySR yields 2.4084 +/- 0.0864 ppm (R2 = 0.9523). Biologically, the 20-min aeration strategy minimizes cumulative NH3 emissions. Overall, PINN-PatchTST-GPR harmonizes global forecasting, localized transient responsiveness, and risk quantification for precision composting.

AI.tldr: 研究融合物理约束、时序预测与事件建模，实现鸡粪堆肥氨浓度预测、风险量化及符号规律提取。
AI.motivation: 长期生化演化与间歇曝气脉冲并存，使现有模型难以兼顾氨浓度预测、物理一致性和风险量化。
AI.method: 在六座反应器的28天试验上结合PINN、PatchTST与GPR，并用保形预测量化区间、符号回归提取方程。
AI.result: 总体RMSE为0.8256 ppm、R²为0.9817，标称90%区间覆盖率达99.792%，20分钟曝气策略累计排氨最少。
AI.conclusion: 该框架兼顾全局预测、瞬态响应及不确定性量化，可为精准堆肥与智能曝气提供支持。

title: The Judge Is Not Impartial: Self-Preference in Medical LLM Evaluation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to evaluate model-generated medical content, creating a potential circularity: an LLM judge may favor outputs generated by the same model independently of clinical quality. To characterize LLM judge self-preference in medical settings, we measured same-model affinity in single-turn specialist question answering and multi-turn standardized-patient encounters. We evaluated eight models, two from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Qwen, on 620 real point of care questions from clinicians (Real-POCQi). The same eight models also generated and judged 200 standardized patient-clinician scenarios (MedSP1000) up to 8 visible turns. In total, our analysis spans 13,760 LLM judgments. We define three complementary measures of self-preference. Answer Rank Bias, our primary measure, compared the rank assigned to a fixed response by its own-model judge with its average rank from outside judges. Answer Score Bias made the analogous comparison using rubric scores. Own-Answer Win Rate measured how often a judge ranked its own model's response above a competitor. Higher values across all these measures indicate greater degrees of self-preference. In Real-POCQi, pooled Answer Rank Bias was $+1.22$ positions, and all eight judges favored their own answers. Self-preference persisted both with and without a grading rubric. Revealing generator identities modestly weakened self-preference by an average of $-0.094$ positions. In MedSP1000, pooled Answer Rank Bias ranged from $+0.53$ to $+0.62$ positions, with no clear difference by conversation length ($p=0.17$). LLM judges systematically favored responses generated by their own models across multiple formats. Clinical AI deployments should exercise increased vigilance including multiple evaluation measures and judge panels spanning differing model families when deploying LLM-as-a-judge systems.

AI.tldr: 医疗大模型评审在单轮问答和多轮问诊中均系统性偏爱自身模型生成的回答。
AI.motivation: 大模型评审可能因偏爱同源回答而非临床质量，造成医疗内容评估的循环偏差。
AI.method: 让八个模型生成并评审临床问答与标准化病人对话，以三项自偏好指标分析13760次判断。
AI.result: 单轮问答平均排名偏差为+1.22位，多轮对话为+0.53至+0.62位，且所有评审均偏爱自身回答。
AI.conclusion: 医疗大模型评估应采用多种指标及跨模型家族的评审组合，以警惕自偏好影响。

title: Which Mathematical Context Supports Target-Aligned Conjecture Generation? A Paired Ablation Study
summary: Generating mathematical conjectures from natural-language context is challenging because theorem-relevant information is distributed across multiple forms of mathematical context, including definitions, objects, assumptions, and constructions. We study which of these contextual signals help a model recover the specific claim supported by the surrounding setup, using 61 main theorems from 12 papers across four mathematical domains. For each theorem, we redact the result and represent the remaining setup using six context components. A paired ablation design compares full context, six leave-one-out conditions, and six single-component conditions, yielding 793 generated conjectures. Context components were largely complementary: removing one component usually had little effect, whereas retaining only one substantially reduced expected-theorem alignment. Local Mathematical Objects provided the strongest standalone signal, while Structural Constraints and Conditions produced the largest alignment decrease when removed. These findings suggest that target-aligned conjecture generation depends on combining information that identifies relevant objects with information that constrains admissible claims.
comment: 16 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. To appear in the Proceedings of the 4th Workshop on Mathematical Natural Language Processing (MathNLP 2026)

AI.tldr: 面向目标定理的数学猜想生成依赖相关对象与约束条件等多类上下文的互补信息。
AI.motivation: 定理相关信息分散在定义、对象和假设等上下文中，各类信息对目标猜想生成的作用尚不明确。
AI.method: 对四个数学领域12篇论文中的61个主定理进行六类上下文配对消融，生成793条猜想。
AI.result: 删除单类信息通常影响较小，仅保留单类则显著降低对齐；局部数学对象单独最有效，移除结构约束与条件影响最大。
AI.conclusion: 目标对齐的猜想生成需要结合识别相关对象的信息与限制可成立命题的信息。

title: Evaluating the Robustness of Fact-Checking LLMs on Multilingual Evidence
summary: Automated fact-checking benchmarks typically pair claims with clean, curated evidence in high-resource languages, but real-world evidence is often incomplete, misleading, or written in a language where models are weaker. We evaluate the robustness of fact-checking LLMs for different languages. Building on EuroVerdict, we construct gold evidence sets for 190 claims in each of English, German, Greek, and Romanian, then apply four corruption strategies at two severity levels. We test LLMs on a set of claims, providing them with evidence from the sets above. A rubric-based LLM-as-a-judge scores reasoning quality. Verdict accuracy proves highly sensitive to both factors: Misleading edit cut Llama 3.1 8B's English accuracy from 80.00% to 16.84%, and losses widen as language resource level decreases. Machine-translating Greek and Romanian claims into English recovers much, but not all, of the low-resource gap. Judge scores decline more slowly than accuracy, suggesting that automated reasoning evaluation underestimates degradation. These results caution against deploying LLM fact-checkers on noisy multilingual evidence, and we release our evidence datasets and evaluation code to support future work.
comment: 13 pages, 16 figures Accepted at COLM Sci-FM 2026

AI.tldr: 事实核查大模型对多语言证据污染较为脆弱，而自动推理评分可能低估其性能退化。
AI.motivation: 现有基准多使用高资源语言的整洁证据，难以反映现实中不完整、误导性或低资源语言证据的挑战。
AI.method: 为英、德、希腊和罗马尼亚语各190条声明构建证据集，施加四类两级污染并评估准确率与推理质量。
AI.result: 误导性编辑使Llama 3.1 8B英语准确率从80.00%降至16.84%，且语言资源越少损失越大。
AI.conclusion: 应谨慎将大模型事实核查器用于嘈杂的多语言证据，翻译可缓解但不能消除低资源语言差距。

title: Skill Transfer: Adapting Agent Skills from Strong to Weak Agents
summary: Agent skills are modular bundles of instructions, code, and resources that an agent loads on demand, increasingly authored and validated on frontier models and shared as an open standard. The same skill behaves differently across models: a strong model turns it into a large performance gain, while a weak model realizes little of that gain and sometimes does worse than with no skill at all. Cost and resource constraints, however, often restrict real deployments to exactly these weaker agents. We hypothesize that the strong model silently supplies procedural steps the skill leaves implicit, which the weak model omits, and formalize closing this gap as \emph{Skill Transfer}: holding the skill's capability ceiling and the model's parameters fixed, we adapt the skill so a specific weak agent can execute it well. Our method abstracts strong and weak trajectories into typed execution structures, localizes their structural divergence with a graph edit distance (GED), and repairs the skill through an iterative diagnoser-patcher loop. Across three benchmarks and two model families, Skill Transfer raises pass rate over the unmodified skill significantly and well over other skill-evolution baselines. The adapted skill also improves the strong agent it was never adapted for, and transfers out of distribution to a structurally related, unseen task. Code is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 通过显式补全弱智能体遗漏的执行步骤，技能迁移可在不改变模型参数的情况下提升技能效果。
AI.motivation: 面向强模型编写的技能常隐含执行步骤，弱模型难以补全，甚至可能因使用技能而表现下降。
AI.method: 将强弱模型轨迹抽象为类型化执行结构，以图编辑距离定位分歧，并通过诊断与修补循环改写技能。
AI.result: 在三个基准和两个模型家族上显著提升通过率并优于技能演化基线，还改善强模型及相关未见任务的表现。
AI.conclusion: 针对执行结构差异适配技能，是缩小强弱智能体技能使用差距并实现迁移的有效途径。

title: Ensemble Bounds for Pairwise Dissimilar Decomposition of Deterministic Datasets
summary: In this paper, we study reduced similarity decompositions of \emph{deterministic} datasets using redundancy graphs and obtain \emph{ensemble} bounds for the minimum size of such constrained decomposition. We consider batch decompositions that reduce similarity \emph{across} batches and use the Lovász local lemma to obtain bounds for the minimum size of a decomposition with a given pairwise dissimilarity. We then consider unique batch decomposition with a given relaxation parameter and obtain upper and lower ensemble bounds for the minimum size. Throughout, we use Binomial random graphs to obtain the desired ensemble bounds, by conditioning on the number of similar \emph{pairs} of data points.
comment: Accepted for publication in Springer Proceedings in Mathematics and Statistics, QEDS conference, Ranchi, India

AI.tldr: 研究利用冗余图与随机图工具，为确定性数据集的低相似度分解建立最小规模的系综界。
AI.motivation: 需要刻画给定批次间不相似度或松弛参数时，确定性数据集受约束分解的最小规模。
AI.method: 以冗余图表示相似关系，结合洛瓦兹局部引理及按相似数据对数量条件化的二项随机图推导界。
AI.result: 得到给定成对不相似度的批次分解规模界，以及给定松弛参数的唯一批次分解最小规模系综上下界。
AI.conclusion: 所用概率图方法可为确定性数据集的受约束低相似度分解提供系综层面的规模界限。

title: Interpretability-Guided Auditing for Clinical Language Models for Discharge Prediction
summary: Clinical natural language processing (NLP) models for hospital discharge prediction are vulnerable to explicit discharge-related lexical cues in clinical notes, even when note timestamps are temporally filtered. These cues may act as proxies for future outcomes, leading models to rely on shortcut-like signals rather than clinically meaningful evidence. We propose AuditBERT-Discharge, a lightweight framework that reframes interpretability as a training-time auditing mechanism. Token-level SHAP attributions from an initial BioClinicalBERT model are used to identify highly attributed discharge-related tokens, which are subsequently masked in the training corpus before model retraining. We evaluate the framework on a retrospective cohort of elective spine surgery encounters from a single academic medical center. Qualitative attribution analysis and preliminary evaluation suggest that SHAP-guided auditing reduces reliance on explicit discharge-proxy language and yields more conservative, better-calibrated predictions, although improvements in discrimination are not uniform. These findings demonstrate the potential of interpretability-guided auditing as a practical strategy for identifying and constraining shortcut-like lexical dependencies in temporally sensitive clinical NLP tasks.

AI.tldr: 基于SHAP的训练期审计可减少出院预测模型对显式出院线索的依赖，初步改善预测校准。
AI.motivation: 即使筛选临床笔记时间戳，显式出院词汇仍可能充当未来结局代理，诱使模型学习捷径。
AI.method: 利用初始BioClinicalBERT的词元级SHAP归因识别出院相关高贡献词，遮蔽后重训并在单中心脊柱择期手术队列评估。
AI.result: 定性分析与初步评估显示，模型更少依赖出院代理词，预测更保守且校准更好，但区分能力改善不一致。
AI.conclusion: 可解释性引导的训练审计有望识别并约束时间敏感临床语言任务中的词汇捷径依赖。

title: FlashREINFORCE: Critic-Free Single-Rollout Asynchronous RL for Agentic Language Models
summary: Asynchronous reinforcement learning suits long-horizon agents with irregular rollout times, but group-relative updates require repeated rollouts of each prompt. However, group-based sampling limits prompt coverage at a fixed rollout budget and introduces group synchronization barriers. One rollout per prompt avoids these constraints but removes the variance-reducing group baseline, making updates noisier and more prone to instability on stale, variable-length trajectories. We present FlashREINFORCE, a critic-free, one-pass framework built on One-Batch REINFORCE, a Sequence Trust Region, and Sample-Mean Optimization. These components preserve prompt coverage and signed feedback while controlling policy drift and length-amplified negative updates. In our experiments, FlashREINFORCE remains stable through 6,000 updates on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B at a policy lag of approximately four updates. On Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, it reaches 38.0 mean accuracy across five benchmarks, outperforming the reported GRPO baseline by 1.7 percentage points with half the rollouts (256k versus 512k). Python-tool experiments extend to the 30B MoE model Qwen3-30B-A3B, with stable training at policy lag eight. On Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, FlashREINFORCE maintains tool use where GRPO stops making tool calls and achieves 98.3%/96.5% seen/unseen ALFWorld success.

AI.tldr: FlashREINFORCE以无评论器、每提示单次采样的异步强化学习，在稳定训练的同时提高采样效率。
AI.motivation: 组内重复采样限制提示覆盖并引入同步障碍，而单次采样又缺少组基线，易出现高方差和训练不稳。
AI.method: 结合单批次REINFORCE、序列信赖域和样本均值优化，控制策略漂移及长序列负向更新。
AI.result: 数学五基准平均准确率达38.0%，比所报GRPO高1.7个百分点且采样减半；ALFWorld已见及未见成功率达98.3%和96.5%。
AI.conclusion: 无需评论器或组内重复采样，该框架仍可实现稳定异步训练，并在数学与工具智能体任务中取得良好表现。

title: Minimum cores in lattice graphs: zonotope structure and quartic growth
summary: A core of a graph is a nonempty vertex set in which every member has at least as many neighbours inside the set as outside. We study the minimum size $c_{m,n}$ of a finite core in the graph on $\Z^m$ joining points at sup-norm distance at most $n$. The local majority condition imposes a global geometric constraint: the convex hull of every core has an explicit lattice zonotope $H_n^{(m)}$ as a Minkowski summand. In the plane, this zonotope has width asymptotic to $6\zeta(3)n^3/\pi^2$. We prove that all its lattice points form a core and construct a shell with $O(n^4)$ points. Together with a packing argument, this gives $c_{2,n}=\Theta(n^4)$ and coordinate widths $\Theta(n^3)$ for every minimum core. We determine $c_{2,1}=12$ and $c_{2,2}=96$ by analytic arguments and prove uniqueness up to translation in both cases. Explicit forced-set and deficit certificates determine further minima within the prescribed zonotope hull. We distinguish these restricted results from global optimality and state the remaining geometric conjectures. We also give a direct reduction from \textsc{Clique} showing that the core problem is NP-complete on general finite graphs, which settles a conjecture of Hassanpour in the terms in which it was posed.

AI.tldr: 格点图最小核具有带状多面体几何结构，二维最小核规模随邻域半径呈四次增长。
AI.motivation: 研究局部邻居多数条件如何约束格点图有限核的整体几何形状及最小规模。
AI.method: 证明核凸包含显式格点带状多面体作为闵可夫斯基加数，并结合壳层构造、装填论证及解析证书求界。
AI.result: 证明二维最小核规模为Θ(n⁴)、坐标宽度为Θ(n³)，确定n=1、2时规模为12、96且平移意义下唯一。
AI.conclusion: 局部多数条件可导出强全局几何约束；一般有限图上的核问题为NP完全，部分几何最优性问题仍待解决。

title: Brain AI Scientist: An Evidence-Based Multi-Agent System for Translational Neuroimaging in Precision Psychiatry
summary: Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI) has revealed widespread brain-network alterations in psychiatric disorders, yet translating these findings into individualized clinical decision support remains challenging. Here we introduce Brain AI Scientist, an autonomous multi-agent framework that integrates patient-specific fMRI, clinical information, and scientific evidence through retrieval, verification, and prioritization. Guided by Research Domain Criteria and evidence-based medicine, it builds traceable chains linking phenotypes, anatomical abnormalities, biomarkers, mechanisms, interventions, and validation strategies. In a representative autism case, Brain AI Scientist generated 37 anatomical hypotheses, retained 26 after literature verification, and derived 65 evidence-supported biomarkers from 90 unique publications to generate patient-specific treatment and validation guidance. Across 17 autism spectrum disorder cases, it outperformed GPT-3.5 baselines with and without fMRI impression in evidence grounding, personalization, clinical actionability, and biomarker-treatment reasoning. Brain AI Scientist therefore provides an auditable framework for translating patient-specific neuroimaging into individualized clinical decision support for precision psychiatry.

AI.tldr: Brain AI Scientist通过整合个体脑影像、临床信息与文献证据，为精准精神医学提供可审计的决策支持。
AI.motivation: 静息态功能磁共振揭示了精神障碍的脑网络异常，但这些发现仍难转化为个体化临床决策。
AI.method: 采用自主多智能体框架，通过检索、验证和优先级排序，建立表型至干预及验证策略的可追溯证据链。
AI.result: 代表病例中验证保留26项解剖假设并提取65项生物标志物，17例自闭症病例评估中多维表现优于GPT-3.5基线。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为患者特异性神经影像向个体化临床决策支持的转化提供了可审计路径。

title: Multimodal Fusion with Pre-trained Models for Psychotherapy Outcome Prediction from Emotional Dynamics
summary: In-session emotional dynamics are associated with psychotherapy outcomes but difficult to measure at scale. Pretrained multimodal models provide automated access to facial, vocal, and textual signals, yet clinical datasets remain small. Our research question is how pretrained multimodal representations can best support psychotherapy outcome prediction under data scarcity. Three studies use 106 sessions from 88 patients and nine session-level outcome scales (HSCL-11, EPO-1, POMS). Study 1 asks whether deep learning outperforms classical machine learning: a two-stage deep pipeline, first predicting window-level valence/arousal and then session outcomes, transferred poorly (best single configuration, $r=.078$). Study 2 asks which representation and preprocessing choices work best: statistical pooling of frozen pretrained embeddings with regularized classical models achieved average $r=.406$ across nine scales under per-scale configuration selection, up to $r=.490$ for symptom distress, with complementary modalities and no significant benefit from manual affect annotations or therapist features. Study 3 asks whether deep learning remains inferior under these choices: classical models outperformed an optimized single-stage deep model at the single-configuration level ($r=.281$ vs. $.222$) and on all nine scales under matched per-scale selection ($.406$ vs. $.252$). The results suggest that under clinical data scarcity, pretrained representations with fixed statistical pooling and regularized classical models are more reliable than learned aggregation.
comment: Preprint. 18 pages, 7 figures; 6-page supplementary material as ancillary file. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible

AI.tldr: 在心理治疗小样本预测中，冻结多模态表征结合统计池化与正则化传统模型比深度学习更可靠。
AI.motivation: 治疗过程中的情绪动态与疗效相关，但难以规模化测量，且临床数据稀缺限制了模型训练。
AI.method: 基于88名患者的106次治疗会谈和九项结局量表，开展三项研究比较多模态表征、预处理及预测模型。
AI.result: 逐量表选择配置时，传统模型平均相关系数为0.406，优于优化深度模型的0.252，症状困扰预测最高达0.490。
AI.conclusion: 临床数据稀缺时，固定统计池化与正则化传统模型比学习式聚合更适合利用预训练多模态表征。

title: Predictive maintenance in manufacturing: The operational value of continual machine learning
summary: Predictive maintenance in high-volume manufacturing often faces a domain-incremental learning problem: as new product configurations enter production, prediction models must learn from newly available data while preserving performance on earlier configurations that remain in operation. In this paper, we empirically study the operational value of continual machine learning methods for addressing this challenge in predictive maintenance, using real-world maintenance data from Bosch. The setting at Bosch covers 25 product configurations over five years, which creates a practical challenge for predictive maintenance models, as such models must be updated with data from newly introduced configurations without reducing performance on configurations learned earlier, a phenomenon known as "forgetting". At the same time, retaining all historical sensor data and repeatedly retraining models is often infeasible in high-volume manufacturing since industrial machines generate too large data volumes. To address this challenge, we combine continual machine learning with robust optimization to support predictive maintenance. We then compare continual machine learning with a broad set of baselines, including fine-tuning, domain-adaptation methods, online learning methods, and configuration-specific models. Across experiments, continual machine learning methods achieve stronger predictive performance and lower maintenance costs than the baselines, with a reduction of cost-related indicators of more than 40 % relative to the baselines. Our results demonstrate the operational value of continual machine learning for decision support in maintenance when product portfolios grow over time and historical manufacturing data cannot be fully retained.

AI.tldr: 持续机器学习结合鲁棒优化可改善制造业预测性维护，并在产品配置持续增加时降低维护成本。
AI.motivation: 新产品配置要求模型持续更新，但保留全部历史传感数据不可行，且更新容易遗忘旧配置。
AI.method: 使用博世五年内25种产品配置的维护数据，将持续学习与鲁棒优化结合，并与多类学习基线比较。
AI.result: 持续学习方法的预测性能与维护成本均优于基线，成本相关指标相对基线降低超过40%。
AI.conclusion: 当产品组合不断扩展且历史数据无法完整保留时，持续学习具有维护决策支持的运营价值。

title: ReVision: Selective Intrinsic Reasoning for Tool-Augmented, Reasoning-Intensive VQA
summary: External tools substantially expand what multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can retrieve and compute on reasoning-intensive visual questions, and aggregate accuracy typically improves when tools are available. Our empirical study across six VQA benchmarks shows that aggregate accuracy gains under tool access can coexist with answer reversals: questions answered correctly without tools but incorrectly with tools. Trajectory analysis reveals substantially shorter reasoning turns under tool access, suggesting a shift from intrinsic visual reasoning toward reliance on external outputs. We propose ReVision, a training-free test-time method that registers intrinsic reconsideration as an optional action alongside search and code execution. When invoked, a separate tool-free multimodal call re-examines the original image, integrates accumulated evidence, and returns a revised analysis. The MLLM chooses if and when to use it, without fixed reflection stages or paired rollouts. ReVision improves over standard tool use on all six benchmarks (1.28--7.51\%) and outperforms Dual-Rollout Combine on five, with reasoning-token use comparable to standard tool use.

AI.tldr: ReVision让多模态模型自主调用无工具视觉重审，在保持相近推理开销的同时改善工具增强视觉问答。
AI.motivation: 工具使用虽提升整体准确率，却可能使原本答对的问题变错，并削弱模型自身的视觉推理。
AI.method: 提出无需训练的测试时方法，将独立无工具多模态重审作为可选动作，重新检查原图并整合已有证据。
AI.result: 六项基准上均优于标准工具使用，提升1.28%至7.51%，其中五项超过双轨迹组合，推理令牌消耗相近。
AI.conclusion: 按需启用内在视觉重审，可缓解对外部工具输出的依赖并改善推理密集型视觉问答。

title: GRAFT: Cross-Backbone LoRA Reuse for Continual Language and Multimodal Learning
summary: In continual learning, parameter-efficient fine-tuning enables large language models to acquire new capabilities through lightweight adapters such as LoRA, yet the reuse of pretrained adapters is typically restricted to models sharing the same backbone. This limits the transfer of learned capabilities from language models to multimodal models. We propose GRAFT (Generalist Reuse of Adapters via Feature-space Transfer), a framework for cross-backbone LoRA reuse. GRAFT retrieves the most relevant pretrained LoRA adapter from a modality-aware library and maps it into the target backbone through a learned linear bridge between corresponding source and target feature spaces. We evaluate GRAFT on ten Super-NaturalInstructions text tasks, transferring Qwen2.5 LoRAs to Qwen2.5-VL, and five multimodal tasks, where Qwen2.5-VL LoRAs are directly reused. Compared with randomly initialized LoRA adapters, GRAFT improves performance on most evaluated tasks. These results show that GRAFT provides a simple and effective mechanism for reusing learned capabilities across language and multimodal models in continual learning.

AI.tldr: GRAFT通过特征空间映射跨骨干复用LoRA适配器，支持语言与多模态模型的持续学习。
AI.motivation: 预训练LoRA通常只能在相同骨干模型间复用，限制了已学能力从语言模型向多模态模型迁移。
AI.method: 从模态感知适配器库检索相关LoRA，并用源与目标特征空间之间的可学习线性桥映射至目标骨干。
AI.result: 在十项文本任务和五项多模态任务中，GRAFT在多数评估任务上优于随机初始化LoRA。
AI.conclusion: GRAFT为持续学习中跨语言与多模态模型复用已学能力提供了简单有效的机制。

title: SynthDCB: World Distillation for Scalable Device Control Benchmarking
summary: Scaling device-control evaluation requires scaling both the worlds agents interact with and the tasks they must solve. We introduce SynthDCB, a scalable benchmark for environment awareness and device control built through world distillation. World distillation transforms knowledge of device behaviors, interaction constraints, and environmental effects into modular executable components, which are composed into interactive worlds with explicit states, actions, and temporal dynamics. A unified capability representation connects tool discovery, world execution, and task synthesis, allowing new capabilities to enter evaluation through a shared construction pipeline. SynthDCB instantiates Home, Car, and Phone domains with 114 device classes, 1,166 functions, and 95 events, supporting five task families with 32 subtypes. The stateful design enables task validation and agent evaluation through state correctness and tool-call traces. We evaluate seven models on 2,560 test tasks; the best achieves 68.2% Pass@1. Error analysis reveals challenges in answer delivery, feasibility diagnosis, and temporal coordination. Construction experiments demonstrate scalability across domains and token efficiency: world distillation reduces token consumption by 0.9-66.0% and 46.2-92.5% relative to Codex with low and xhigh reasoning effort, respectively, while achieving broader capability coverage. SynthDCB makes executable world construction the basis of scalable device-control benchmarking, connecting an expanding space of capabilities and interactions to verifiable agent evaluation.
comment: 65 pages, 7 figures, 17 tables. Details and access are available at: this https URL

AI.tldr: SynthDCB通过世界蒸馏构建设备交互环境，为环境感知与设备控制提供可扩展、可验证的评测。
AI.motivation: 设备控制评测的扩展需要同时扩大智能体交互环境及其任务空间。
AI.method: 将设备行为、交互约束和环境效应蒸馏为可执行组件，以统一能力表示连接工具发现、世界执行及任务合成。
AI.result: 七个模型在2560项任务上最高Pass@1为68.2%，世界蒸馏相对两档Codex配置分别节省0.9%—66.0%和46.2%—92.5%的令牌。
AI.conclusion: 可执行世界构建支持跨领域扩展与状态验证，但模型仍面临答案交付、可行性诊断和时序协调挑战。

title: SERAG: SEmantical and Relational approach for Anomaly detection on knowledge Graphs
summary: Knowledge graphs constructed from text can contain facts that are individually plausible yet inconsistent with their relational context. We introduce SERAG, a supervised anomaly detector that combines two complementary plausibility estimates: a semantic score computed from separately encoded subject, relation, and object labels, and a relational score obtained through a relational graph convolutional network. The scores are standardized, calibrated, and fused. We evaluate the method on a subset of ICEWS18 with vocabulary-constrained synthetic anomalies generated by an LLM, using pooled and chronological splits. At 10% anomaly prevalence, SERAG achieves test AUPRCs of 0.321 and 0.258, respectively, compared with 0.159 and 0.146 for the strongest adapted baseline. Fusion improves mean test AUPRC over either branch alone, with a larger gain in the pooled protocol and a smaller validation-selected gain in the chronological protocol. Additional anomaly supervision improves performance. These results support the complementarity of textual and relational signals for detecting synthetic anomalies under the evaluated protocols.

AI.tldr: SERAG融合文本语义与图关系信号，改善知识图谱中表面合理但关系上下文不一致的异常检测。
AI.motivation: 从文本构建的知识图谱可能包含单独看来合理、却与关系上下文不一致的事实。
AI.method: 将主语、关系和宾语标签编码所得语义分数，与关系图卷积网络所得关系分数标准化、校准并融合。
AI.result: 异常占比10%时，混合与时间划分的测试AUPRC为0.321和0.258，优于最强适配基线的0.159和0.146。
AI.conclusion: 在所评估的合成异常及数据划分下，文本和关系信号具有互补性，额外异常监督也能提升性能。

title: HIMX: mixed-format matrix multiplication based on customized HIFLOAT4 representations
summary: 4-bit weight-activation quantization (W4A4) is an important approach for efficient large language model (LLM) inference. Recent hierarchical formats such as HiFloat4 (HIF4) improve the representational range of 4-bit quantization through multi-level scaling. However, the same local mantissa representation in HIF4 may not be equally suitable for weights and activations, which exhibit distinct distribution characteristics. To address this limitation, we propose HiMX, a mixed-mantissa framework built upon the hierarchical scaling structure of HIF4. Our key observation is that the two HIF4-compatible mantissa representations, S1P2 and E2M1, exhibit complementary quantization behavior: the denser S1P2 format provides higher resolution for concentrated weight distributions, while the wider-spaced E2M1 format provides complementary quantization characteristics for activation tensors. HiMX enables operand-tailored mantissa representations while converting heterogeneous mantissas into fixed-point integer operands with operand-specific widths, allowing different operand formats to share a unified integer multiply-accumulate (MAC) array. Block-level analysis on Qwen3-8B shows that HIF4-S1P2 is better suited for weights while HIF4 E2M1 is better suited for activations, and their mixed-format combination achieves lower output MSE than homogeneous configurations. Across multiple benchmarks, HiMX reduces the average end-to-end accuracy loss from 2.38 to 1.77 points on Qwen3-8B and from 2.23 to 1.85 points on Qwen3-30B-A3B, demonstrating the potential benefit of heterogeneous mantissa representations for W4A4 LLM inference.

AI.tldr: HiMX为权重和激活采用不同的四位尾数表示，以共享整数计算阵列并降低大语言模型量化精度损失。
AI.motivation: 权重与激活分布不同，HIF4采用相同局部尾数表示可能无法同时满足两者的量化需求。
AI.method: 沿用HIF4分层缩放，为权重和激活分别选用S1P2与E2M1表示，并转换为可共享整数乘加阵列的操作数。
AI.result: Qwen3-8B和Qwen3-30B-A3B的平均精度损失分别从2.38降至1.77点、从2.23降至1.85点。
AI.conclusion: 按操作数定制异构尾数表示有望改善大语言模型权重与激活均为四位的量化推理。

title: Agents Cannot Hand Over What They Have Not Yet Understood
summary: Agents that work beyond a single context window, or in teams, hand their work to a successor as a short written summary. Evaluation has focused on whether an agent can solve a task, and relatively little is known about how much of what an agent has learned survives being written down. We study this in 56 interactive worlds with hidden rules, where an agent that is told nothing fails and an agent given a 300-character statement of the rules succeeds. We compare one agent that plays eight lives and keeps its whole history with a chain of eight agents that each play one life and inherit a 300-character note. All six models we test learn less in the chain: after eight generations it stands where the single agent stood after about four lives. Controlled variants of the chain decompose this handoff loss into three components: none from changing the agent, a smaller loss from compressing to 300 characters, and a larger loss from compressing repeatedly. When each note is written from the full record of earlier lives instead of from the previous note, the same 300 characters recover 70% to 82% of the loss. The loss is robust across model sizes and is not alleviated by instructing the writer to record evidence, to revise the inherited note, or to keep a structured ledger. In simpler terms, an agent cannot hand over what it has not yet understood: a note holds what its writer has worked out, and a rule that takes several lives to see is lost with the lives that were not passed on.

AI.tldr: 智能体交接中的反复压缩会丢失尚未充分理解的规则，显著削弱跨代学习。
AI.motivation: 现有评估侧重任务完成能力，较少考察智能体学到的知识能否通过书面摘要传承。
AI.method: 在56个隐藏规则世界中，比较保留完整历史的单智能体与通过300字符笔记交接的八代智能体链。
AI.result: 六种模型的八代链仅达到单智能体约四轮水平，基于完整历史写笔记可挽回70%至82%的损失。
AI.conclusion: 交接损失主要来自反复压缩，而非智能体更换，保留原始经历比改进笔记指令更重要。

title: FedFit: Federated Dynamic Sparse Training via Fisher Information scoring
summary: Cross-device Federated Learning (FL) is frequently bottlenecked by the prohibitive memory and communication costs of training deep neural networks on resource-constrained edge hardware. While federated dynamic sparse training aims to alleviate these costs by adjusting sparse structures during training, existing methods rely on magnitude-based heuristics that are fundamentally ill-suited for the non-convergent, heterogeneous environments inherent to FL. To address this challenge, we propose FedFit, a federated dynamic sparse training framework that replaces simple heuristics with optimization-centric criteria for structure adjustment. By leveraging a second-order approximation of the loss landscape via the Fisher Information Matrix, FedFit enables precise and efficient structure adjustment without the overhead of explicit Hessian computation. Empirical evaluations across computer vision and natural language processing benchmarks demonstrate that FedFit significantly narrows the sparse-to-dense accuracy gap, outperforming state-of-the-art methods while maintaining high communication efficiency. Our code is available at this https URL .
comment: The paper was accepted by ICML 2026

AI.tldr: FedFit以费舍尔信息指导联邦动态稀疏训练，在保持通信效率的同时缩小稀疏与稠密模型的精度差距。
AI.motivation: 边缘设备的内存与通信受限，且基于权重幅值的稀疏调整不适合异质、非收敛的联邦训练环境。
AI.method: 利用费舍尔信息矩阵近似损失曲面的二阶信息，指导稀疏结构调整，避免显式计算海森矩阵。
AI.result: 在计算机视觉与自然语言处理基准上，FedFit优于现有先进方法，并保持较高通信效率。
AI.conclusion: 以优化信息替代幅值启发式，可提升联邦动态稀疏训练的精度与效率。

title: Minari: Infrastructure for Collaborative Reinforcement Learning Datasets
summary: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) depends on shared datasets, but sharing them is still hard. Each benchmark ships its own format, documentation is thin, and most datasets cannot be regenerated once the environment code moves on. We introduce Minari, an open-source Python library for creating, sharing, and loading RL datasets. Its API follows Gymnasium, so recording a dataset means wrapping an environment and stepping through it as usual. From there, users can attach metadata, filter, combine, and shuffle datasets, and publish or download them with one command through the HuggingFace Hub. Every dataset stores the environment specification, seeds, applied wrappers, and pinned package requirements needed to rebuild the environment and regenerate the data. TorchRL, AgileRL, and d3rlpy already load Minari datasets natively, so switching datasets in those libraries takes one line of code. Minari also hosts 338 reproducible datasets (350K trajectories, 55M steps) covering robotic locomotion and manipulation, maze and grid navigation, language-conditioned instruction following, Atari, and web navigation, including a full regeneration of D4RL with public generation scripts. We report baseline scores for six offline RL algorithms on the regenerated D4RL and MuJoCo datasets.

AI.tldr: Minari提供统一的强化学习数据集创建、共享与加载工具，并支持环境重建和数据再生成。
AI.motivation: 离线强化学习数据集格式不统一、文档不足，且环境代码更新后往往无法再生成。
AI.method: 采用兼容Gymnasium的接口，记录环境规格、随机种子、包装器和固定依赖，并通过HuggingFace Hub共享。
AI.result: 已提供338个可复现数据集，包含35万条轨迹和5500万步，并报告六种离线强化学习算法的基线分数。
AI.conclusion: Minari通过统一接口与完整再生成信息，为强化学习数据协作和可复现研究提供基础设施。

title: Domino: Joint Unmasking via First-order Markov Chain for Few-Step Masked Diffusion
summary: Masked diffusion models generate a sequence by revealing masked positions over many denoising steps. A few-step sampler has to reveal many positions at once, but the standard reverse kernel draws them independently and primarily ignores the conditional dependence between tokens revealed in the same step. We propose a novel framework called Domino, which models this dependence with a first-order Markov chain over the revealed positions, given the current state. The first revealed position keeps the posterior of a pre-trained masked diffusion model (MDM), and each subsequent position follows a transition given the token of its predecessor. Notably, the resulting step is normalized by construction, contains the factorized step in MDMs as a special case, and has a likelihood in closed form. We implement the Domino transitions via a lightweight module on the hidden states of a pre-trained MDM denoiser with only 2.6% parameter overhead and train by keeping the MDM denoiser frozen. Our extensive evaluations across text, molecules, and images show that Domino lowers the few-step generative perplexity of MDMs by a factor of 1.7 to 3.8 on One Billion Word (LM1B), WikiText-103, and OpenWebText at nearly unchanged sample entropy. It also raises the validity of few-step molecule samples by 1.5x. The source code is available at: this https URL

AI.tldr: Domino用一阶马尔可夫链联合揭示掩码位置，以较小参数开销提升少步扩散生成质量。
AI.motivation: 少步掩码扩散需同时揭示多个位置，但标准反向核忽略同一步内生成词元的条件依赖。
AI.method: 冻结预训练去噪器，以轻量模块建模相邻揭示位置的转移，新增参数仅为2.6%。
AI.result: 文本少步生成困惑度降至原来的约1/1.7至1/3.8，样本熵基本不变，分子有效率提高至1.5倍。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模同一步内的词元依赖，可在轻量适配下改善少步掩码扩散生成。

title: RSIMed: Scaling Medical Foundation Models beyond Limited Clinical Data via Retrieval-Grounded Self-Evolution
summary: Rare diseases are hard to diagnose, and the labeled clinical records needed to train models for them are few, private, and slow to extend, since a specialist must read every case. A model that writes its own training tasks could learn beyond these records, but no program can check a model-written diagnosis, and a wrong answer key corrupts training. To tackle this dilemma between data scarcity and difficulty of data annotations, we introduce RSIMed, Recursive Self-Improvement in Medicine, one of the first self-evolving pipelines in which a task proposer co-evolves in context with a diagnostic solver on real clinical records. Seeded by training admissions, a frozen copy of the solver writes each clinical question from retrieved medical evidence, so its answer rests on a source, and steers topics and difficulty toward what the solver still gets wrong. On rare-disease diagnosis from MIMIC-IV admissions, the accuracy of RSIMed-27B grows linearly with training compute, while a static pool of generated tasks collapses. Without any external model, RSIMed-27B and RSIMed-9B reach 0.516 and 0.488 diagnostic accuracy, above every off-the-shelf GPT-5.6 setting, whose best reaches 0.399 at 38 times the inference cost of RSIMed-27B. Tasks written by four external teachers, including GPT-5.5, train a less accurate diagnostician than the solver's own. Trained only on diagnosis, RSIMed-RL-27B also improves on the physician-written tasks of HealthBench Professional, from 0.291 to 0.303 in adjusted score.

AI.tldr: RSIMed以检索证据支撑自生成临床任务，推动诊断模型在有限临床数据之外持续自我改进。
AI.motivation: 罕见病标注记录稀缺且扩充缓慢，而模型自生成诊断答案难以验证，可能污染训练。
AI.method: 由求解器的冻结副本依据检索医学证据出题，并随求解器弱点动态调整任务主题与难度。
AI.result: 27B和9B模型诊断准确率分别达0.516和0.488，超过摘要所测GPT-5.6配置的最佳值0.399。
AI.conclusion: 基于证据且随能力动态演化的自生成任务，可支持罕见病诊断能力随训练计算量持续提升。

title: Screen Before You Add: Reducing Candidate Inference in Model Ensembles
summary: As new models become available, existing ensembles must be updated to be competitive, making them intrinsically dynamic. Deciding whether to add a candidate model can require inference on an entire annotated dataset. Such a screening becomes prohibitive for models with costly inference especially when they ultimately add no value. Even under simple convex aggregation, relying on benchmark scores can be misleading as strong standalone performance does not guarantee ensemble improvement, and fitted ensemble weights can hurt test performance.
