Across four foundation VLMs, LVRE improves graph accuracy by 8.0-8.5 percentage points over single-pass recognition and by 3.0-3.3 points over fixed local review. In a paired evaluation of 1,000 diagrams using Gemini 3.8 Flash, LVRE achieves 100 successful repairs while introducing only 15 regressive errors, in contrast to global reflection which yields 65 repairs against 30 introduced errors. On this paired set, LVRE introduces half as many errors on initially correct predictions as global reflection.
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at IFTC 2026

AI.tldr: LVRE通过局部视觉检查与可回滚图编辑，提高化学结构识别准确率并减少对原本正确结构的破坏。
AI.motivation: 化学结构识别要求完整图精确匹配，而不受约束的全图重生成容易在修复时引入新错误。
AI.method: 无需训练地联合高分辨率裁剪、全图和局部图邻域提出定点修改，由确定性控制器检查并经视觉复核提交或回滚。
AI.result: 四种视觉语言模型的图准确率提升8.0至8.5个百分点，千图配对评估修复100例且仅引入15例退化错误。
AI.conclusion: 定向检查与事务式可逆编辑比全局反思更能兼顾结构修复和已有正确结果的保护。

title: Editable Video Context: Mid-Context KV-Cache Reuse for Context-Managing Video LLMs
summary: Context Language Models let a model edit its own context, while Suffix Cache Reuse makes edits to text efficient by adjusting the positions of cached keys for surviving tokens. We extend these ideas to video language models with multimodal rotary position embeddings (M-RoPE). We represent a long video as timestamped segments. After viewing a sparsely sampled version, the model selects segments for decoding at 4x the frame rate, and the remaining segments are removed from its context. Our rebuild method reuses the KV cache of surviving segments by rotating their keys with a single offset shared by the temporal, height, and width components of Qwen2.5-VL's M-RoPE. A content-hashed cache also avoids repeating vision-encoder computation for those segments. In preliminary experiments with Qwen2.5-VL-7B on synthetic needle-in-a-video-haystack questions over public-domain films, the method reduces prefill tokens and end-to-end rebuild latency relative to full recomputation while usually producing the same answer. Densifying the segment containing the answer improves accuracy when that segment is known. When the model selects segments itself, accuracy does not improve: it rarely identifies a needle that was absent from the sparse sample. We release the code, raw logs, and scripts used to reproduce the paper's results.

AI.tldr: 通过复用视频片段缓存降低上下文重建成本，但模型自主选择加密片段未提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 视频语言模型编辑长视频上下文时，重新计算缓存和视觉编码带来较高开销。
AI.method: 将视频分段，以共享偏移旋转多模态位置编码缓存键，并结合内容哈希缓存与选择性加密采样。
AI.result: 初步实验减少预填充词元和重建延迟且通常保持答案，但自主选段未改善准确率。
AI.conclusion: 缓存复用可提高视频上下文编辑效率，但发现稀疏采样遗漏的关键片段仍是瓶颈。

title: Acting by Intent, Reacting by Sight: Visual Conditioned Reflexes for Real-Time VLM Agents
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong capabilities as generalist agents that perceive, reason, and act in interactive environments. Yet real-time environments such as video games demand both deliberate control for exploration and split-second reactions to fast-moving hazards. Existing agents struggle to handle both: relying solely on direct VLM actions is too slow for sudden events, whereas delegating execution to fixed scripts leaves the agent blind at the moment of action, leading to frequent misfires whenever the scene shifts. Humans overcome this by pairing normal conscious control with conditioned reflexes-while the mind handles deliberate actions and shapes reflex rules, the reflex itself still relies on live vision to make the final instant decision. Emulating this mechanism, we propose ViCoR (Visual Conditioned Reflex). Alongside normal gameplay actions, the main VLM defines and updates lightweight situational guidance for recurring events, while a fast visual reflex branch (invoking the VLM in no-thinking mode) inspects live local views with motion cues to make the final sub-second action decisions. By offloading 67.8% of high-frequency reactions to the reflex branch (680 ms per check), ViCoR reduces average per-action decision latency by 2.6x (from 14.0 s to 5.4 s) and cuts token consumption by 36.9%. Across 17 diverse 2D and 3D games in the GameWorld benchmark, ViCoR achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving task success rate by +11.8% (from 52.9% to 64.7%) and average normalized progress by +13.9% (from 66.5% to 80.4%) over the strongest deliberative VLM and script baselines. In fast-paced real-time games, ViCoR refines its reflexes across episodes to boost progress by 1.67x, and even with a low-effort main planner, surpasses high-effort deliberative baselines by +8.1% at one-third of the token cost.

AI.tldr: ViCoR将主模型规划与实时视觉反射结合，提高游戏智能体的响应速度和任务表现。
AI.motivation: 直接调用视觉语言模型反应过慢，而固定脚本缺乏动作执行时的实时视觉判断。
AI.method: 主模型更新情境指导，由无思考模式的快速视觉分支结合局部画面和运动线索决定即时动作。
AI.result: 在17款游戏中，成功率从52.9%升至64.7%，平均决策延迟从14.0秒降至5.4秒。
AI.conclusion: 基于实时视觉的条件反射可兼顾审慎规划与快速反应，并降低词元消耗。

title: Detection Is Not the Finish Line: Multiscale Decoding and Constraint-Aware Global Association for Multi-Camera 3D Tracking
summary: A query-based multi-view 3D detector can transfer well to a new calibrated camera network and still produce badly fragmented tracks: on the AI City Challenge 2026 Track 1 validation set, the frozen Sparse4D detector behind the official challenge winner splits each Person identity into a median of eight fragments, and half of the gaps between fragments exceed the horizon of a causal tracker. We show that most of the remaining headroom of such a system lies after detection. Keeping the public detector frozen, we add (i) class-wise source selection between two input scales, which recovers small and distant people from a 0.75x pass while leaving large objects at the scale the detector was trained for; (ii) a geometry-to-appearance bridge that projects every 3D box into all calibrated views, matches it to 2D person detections, and aggregates robust track-level re-identification descriptors; and (iii) constraint-aware consolidation, which combines a causal short-gap stitch with offline centroid-linkage clustering under two hard constraints, temporal exclusion and metric 3D reachability, plus class-aware long-gap stitching for rigid objects. Every association stage changes object identities only. On the challenge evaluation server the system scores 62.3947 3D HOTA (DetA 57.4501, AssA 56.8131, LocA 80.1272), first on the general leaderboard snapshot of 30 October 2026 (second at the time of writing, after a competitor's detector update) and 5.63 points above our reproduction of the official winner; the constrained association stage alone contributes +3.73 HOTA through a +5.49 AssA gain at unchanged DetA. Controlled fixed-box validation studies, a constraint ablation, sensitivity curves, and a catalogue of negative results support the design.

AI.tldr: 冻结检测器后，多尺度解码与约束感知全局关联仍能显著改善多摄像头三维跟踪。
AI.motivation: 三维检测器即使能迁移到新相机网络，仍可能产生大量身份轨迹碎片和长时间断裂。
AI.method: 结合按类别选择输入尺度、三维到二维外观特征桥接，以及受时序和三维可达性约束的轨迹合并。
AI.result: 系统取得62.3947的三维HOTA，较复现的官方冠军高5.63分，约束关联单独贡献3.73分。
AI.conclusion: 检测后的身份关联仍有较大改进空间，硬约束可在不改变检测精度时提升关联质量。

title: Latent Fusion: Channel Stacking for Structure-Preserving Image Editing
summary: Instruction-based image editing models must condition on the source image, either by sequence concatenation, which appends source tokens to the target sequence (FLUX.1 Kontext), or by channel-wise concatenation, which stacks the source latent onto the noisy latent and widens the input projection (InstructPix2Pix, FLUX.1 Fill). The FLUX.1 Kontext report found channel-wise concatenation worse in initial experiments at 1K resolution with a 12B model and a large corpus. We explore channel-wise concatenation as the lower-cost option for a common production regime: structure-preserving edits that change appearance (sky, exposure, foliage, cleanup) but not layout, about 1,400 training pairs, a 4B non-distilled backbone, and 2K frames. It keeps the sequence at its original length, where sequence concatenation doubles it and roughly quadruples attention cost, and needs only single-scale classifier-free guidance (two forward passes per step instead of three). Starting from FLUX.2 Klein 4B base, we widen only the input projection and train both schemes with the same trainer, data, and hyperparameters. Channel-wise concatenation keeps the output pixel-aligned with the source; in our runs sequence concatenation, which must learn the correspondence between 10,880 target and 10,880 source tokens from fewer than 1,500 pairs, displaced structure, an observation we report without claiming a general ranking. On 29 held-out images the editor reaches 20.3 dB PSNR and 0.198 LPIPS against the human edit (unedited source: 15.0 dB), and counterfactual conditioning tests show it largely learned a global grade of the source rather than a selective edit, which we report as the open problem of this recipe. We also compare against an SD3.5-Medium editor trained with the same surgery and report the full training recipe, including failure modes. Code: this https URL
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: 小数据结构保持编辑中，通道拼接可低成本维持像素对齐，但主要学到全局调色而非选择性编辑。
AI.motivation: 序列拼接增加注意力计算成本，且小规模训练下学习源图与目标图对应关系具有挑战。
AI.method: 基于FLUX.2 Klein 4B，仅扩宽输入投影，在相同数据与训练设置下比较通道拼接和序列拼接。
AI.result: 29张留出图像上达到20.3 dB PSNR和0.198 LPIPS，但反事实测试显示主要学到全局调色。
AI.conclusion: 通道拼接适合所测低成本结构保持场景，但选择性编辑仍待解决，不能据此作普遍优劣判断。

title: Wrong with Confidence: Measuring Hallucination, Overconfidence and Identity-Conditioned Behaviour in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models answer underspecified questions readily, and accuracy-only evaluation rewards guessing over abstaining. Observational studies link query underspecification to hallucination, but they cannot separate the effect of missing information from item difficulty, and they rarely ask what the model tells the user. We report a pre-registered, paired behavioural study of five open-weight models (Gemma 3 27B, Gemma 4 31B, gpt-oss-120b, Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B and Nemotron 3 Super). Each of 142 factual questions was posed in a fully specified form and in a referentially underspecified form with the same answer key, and three probes measured identity-conditioned behaviour. Two raters scored 5,620 responses under a fixed rubric; effects were estimated with mixed-effects models. Without the referent, the models sought clarification on 33.7% of prompts and answered the rest. Among attempted answers, the error rate rose from 39.1% to 52.0% (mixed-effects odds ratio 4.12, 95% CI 2.76-6.14), and specialist-domain questions failed more often than general ones in every model. Unelicited verbal uncertainty did not track this risk: 75.3% of wrong answers carried no hedge, wrong answers to underspecified prompts were hedged no more often than wrong answers to clear prompts (27.3% vs 22.3%), and hedging separated correct from incorrect answers only weakly (AUROC 0.56). Gendered pronouns followed occupational stereotypes whenever a model committed to one; any stated user identity lengthened answers by about 45% relative to an anonymous user; claimed expertise did not reduce safety caveats. The models either ask or answer as if the question were well posed, and the wording of a guess does not reveal that it is one. Evaluations should score clarification as a distinct outcome and check label validity as well as rater agreement.
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures. Data and code are included as ancillary files

AI.tldr: 指代不明会增加模型答错风险，但其措辞通常不暴露猜测性质，身份信息也会影响回答行为。
AI.motivation: 仅评准确率会鼓励猜测，既有观察研究难以分离信息缺失与题目难度的影响。
AI.method: 对五个开放权重模型开展预注册配对研究，以明确和指代不明版本提问，并人工评分5620条回答。
AI.result: 尝试回答时错误率从39.1%升至52.0%，75.3%的错误答案没有表达不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 评估应将澄清请求作为独立结果，并检查标签有效性，不能仅凭保留措辞判断回答可靠性。

title: SCALE: Towards whole-slide counterfactual explanations in pathology
summary: Cancer diagnosis relies on histopathological evaluation, where tumor morphology guides disease classification and informs treatment decisions. Deep learning (DL) models excel at predicting diagnostic properties from histopathology images. Unlike typical medical images featuring small critical areas, histopathological images are textural, with relevant texture spanning the entire image; this makes it challenging to explain DL predictions by locating relevant image regions. Counterfactual explanations offer a promising alternative by asking "what changes in the image could have altered the model prediction." To achieve this, we propose SCALE, a framework for generating such counterfactual explanations for histopathological DL models. Across nine counterfactual directions spanning multiple cancer types, SCALE generates whole-slide counterfactual explanations that consistently shift predictions toward the intended target while maintaining biological feasibility. Blinded assessment by six board-certified pathologists showed higher morphological plausibility for SCALE (with a win rate of 91.7% over baselines) and promising counterfactual effectiveness (with a target consistency of 96.7%).

AI.tldr: SCALE生成全切片病理反事实解释，在改变模型预测方向的同时保持较高形态学合理性。
AI.motivation: 病理图像的相关纹理遍布全图，单靠定位局部区域难以充分解释深度学习预测。
AI.method: 提出SCALE框架生成全切片反事实，并在跨癌种的九个反事实方向上评估及开展病理医师盲评。
AI.result: 六名病理医师盲评中，SCALE形态合理性相对基线胜率为91.7%，目标一致性为96.7%。
AI.conclusion: 全切片反事实可作为病理模型解释途径，并展现生物学可行性与目标预测改变能力。

title: ShiftGuard: Evaluating Confidence and Feature Distance for Risk-Controlled Image Classification
summary: A classifier that is usually right still makes confident mistakes, and a deployed system needs some way to decide when to answer and when to abstain. Cheap post-hoc scores such as maximum softmax probability (MSP) and predictive entropy are the standard answer. Distances in feature space are a popular alternative, and fusing several signals into one score is a natural next step. We ask whether adding a feature distance signal to MSP and entropy improves error detection, and whether it increases the share of predictions that can be accepted at a certified error rate when only a small labelled calibration set is available. We train a CIFAR-adapted ResNet-18 from scratch on CIFAR-10 (92.92% test accuracy, one seed) and compare five reliability scores: MSP, entropy, distance to the predicted-class centroid, a logistic fusion of MSP and entropy, and a logistic fusion of all three signals. Acceptance thresholds are chosen on a held out calibration set with Clopper Pearson upper bounds, Bonferroni corrected over a prespecified family of 315 rules at 95% simultaneous confidence. Confidence based scores were best. Error AUROC was 0.9230 for MSP, 0.9233 for entropy and 0.9235 for MSP plus entropy, against 0.8814 for the three signal fusion and 0.8224 for distance alone. At a 5% risk target with 1,000 calibration images, entropy accepted 84.82% of test images with 2.05% observed error, while three signal fusion accepted 80.61% with 2.21%. With 250 calibration images, neither distance nor the three-signal fusion could certify the 5% target at all. The results come from one seed, one dataset and one architecture, with no corruption experiments, so they say nothing about distribution shift detection. Within these limits, the distance signal did not earn its added complexity.

AI.tldr: 在单数据集实验中，加入特征距离未改善错误检测或风险受控分类，反而弱于置信度分数。
AI.motivation: 部署分类器需要决定何时拒答，但小校准集下融合特征距离能否提高可靠性尚不明确。
AI.method: 在CIFAR-10的ResNet-18上比较五种可靠性分数，并用多重校正的置信上界选择接受阈值。
AI.result: 千张校准图像和5%风险目标下，熵分数接受率为84.82%，三信号融合为80.61%。
AI.conclusion: 在单种子、单数据集和单架构范围内，特征距离未体现额外价值，结果不能推及分布偏移检测。

title: LiNO: Lightweight Network for Occupancy Estimation
summary: Occupancy estimation for automated vehicles is a crucial task that builds a 3D map using vehicle sensors. This map allows the vehicle to identify drivable areas and various obstacle classes. The task involves complex subtasks such as depth estimation, object classification, and segmentation to align semantic information with the 3D grid. Moreover, producing these estimations from multiple sensors demands significant computational power and memory, as high-dimensional data fusion requires complex feature extraction and processing. Consequently, most existing methods rely on large and computationally intensive architectures that are not suitable for real-time or real-world applications. We present a real-time, lightweight architecture that leverages camera and radar sensors through a residual multi-stage head. Unlike prior methods that rely on heavy camera-only blocks, our architecture employs camera-radar fusion and lightweight components. Additionally, we introduce a task-specific data augmentation strategy that enhances data diversity and improves generalisation. Our method achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance, attaining 45.7 mean Intersection over Union (mIoU) on Occ3D and 41.9 Ray-level Intersection over Union (RayIoU) (41.9) on OpenOcc datasets, running at 17.2 frames per second (FPS) and using only 5.3 GB of memory, compared with 4.1 FPS and 7.7 GB for STCOcc.

AI.tldr: LiNO以轻量相机雷达融合实现实时三维占用估计，并在两个数据集取得领先表现。
AI.motivation: 现有占用估计依赖复杂高维融合和重型网络，计算与内存开销限制实时部署。
AI.method: 采用相机雷达融合、轻量组件和残差多阶段预测头，并设计任务专用数据增强。
AI.result: Occ3D上mIoU为45.7，OpenOcc上RayIoU为41.9，速度17.2帧/秒，内存占用5.3 GB。
AI.conclusion: 轻量多传感器融合可兼顾占用估计精度、实时速度和较低内存需求。

title: Is It Still There? Place-Registered Verification Makes VLMs Reliable Scene-Change Detectors
summary: A robot that returns to a space must tell which objects were added, removed or moved since its last visit, while its trajectory, viewpoints and lighting differ between the two visits. We find that multi-image vision-language models (VLMs) fail at this task mainly because they cannot find the place where an object was. A VLM recognises what each frame shows but cannot check whether an object is still at its place in the other capture. It therefore reports objects that only one capture shows and misses most removed and moved objects. We propose STILL, which reformulates change detection as object verification at a registered place. 3D geometry registers the place of each change hypothesis in the other capture, and one VLM answers, from a scene view and a local place view, whether the object is still at that place, trained with supervision of the same form. Under the official SceneDiff protocol, STILL raises the main metric obj/sc AP from 24.0 to 37.8, and from 11.6 to 20.6 on the egocentric kitchen subset without any kitchen training data. It improves F1 by more than 21 points over a VLM fine-tuned on the same annotations and adds only about 11% to the runtime.
comment: 23 pages, 13 figures, 11 tables. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: STILL通过配准位置上的对象核验，提高视觉语言模型检测场景变化的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 机器人重访场景时，视觉语言模型难以定位对象原先所在位置，易误报并漏检移除或移动。
AI.method: 利用三维几何配准变化假设的位置，再以场景视图和局部位置视图训练模型核验对象是否仍在原处。
AI.result: SceneDiff主指标由24.0升至37.8，厨房子集由11.6升至20.6，运行时间仅增加约11%。
AI.conclusion: 将变化检测转化为配准位置核验，可改善跨视角场景变化识别，并泛化至未参与训练的厨房场景。

title: AITHER: Authority-Informed Evidence Routing for Mixed-Authority Vision-Language Reasoning
summary: Reliable vision-language reasoning requires a control decision that conventional grounding methods leave implicit: which input is entitled to determine the answer? Auxiliary text may be a defeasible claim about an image, a binding task instruction, or compatible context. Correcting every image-text conflict toward the image therefore repairs false claims but overwrites valid task rules. We formalize this setting as mixed-authority vision-language reasoning and introduce AITHER, an Authority-Informed Text-Image Hierarchy for Evidence Routing. Its final policy, the Semantic-Frame Router, is a training-free black-box control layer that (i) compiles explicit task directives, (ii) recovers standardized spatial frames from metadata-scrubbed pixels, (iii) resolves the semantic polarity of remaining notes, and (iv) routes among frozen observable candidates with fail-closed semantics. This ordered decomposition converts authority arbitration from an unconstrained prompt preference into a reproducible inference program. Across 1,620 MATRIX predictions, AITHER reaches 95.1% accuracy, exceeding the strongest task-and-frame baseline by 9.1 points with a 95% record-cluster interval of 6.8-11.5 points and no harmed records. It further reaches 100.0% on 1,800 controlled FRAME predictions and 93.3% on GQA-MATRIX. The results show that explicit authority routing can simultaneously improve false-claim correction, preserve task-defined answers, and eliminate clean-context overcorrection.

AI.tldr: AITHER通过显式判定图文输入的决策权限，提升混合权限场景下的视觉语言推理。
AI.motivation: 一律优先图像虽能纠正错误文本，却可能覆盖有效任务规则，因此需要区分输入的决策权限。
AI.method: 采用免训练黑盒控制层，依次解析任务指令、恢复空间框架、判定注释语义极性并路由候选答案。
AI.result: MATRIX准确率达95.1%，较最强基线提高9.1个百分点；FRAME达100%，GQA-MATRIX达93.3%。
AI.conclusion: 显式权限路由可兼顾错误声明纠正与任务规则保留，并消除干净上下文中的过度纠正。

title: TyphoonWorld: A Residual Token World Model for Probabilistic Forecasting of Typhoon Imagery
summary: A satellite forecast of a typhoon should give a low-error picture of the next two days, together with an ensemble whose members are coherent fields and whose spread responds to the storm at hand. A small direct regression network already gives the lowest squared error on held-out storms, so a generative model has to earn its cost through the part of the future that the regression smooths away. We present TyphoonWorld, a discrete-token world model that generates only that part. Conditioned on tokens of the regression forecast, the latest frames and the best-track state at forecast time, it samples residual fields lead by lead, and members add these residuals to the regression center. We compare it under one protocol with per-pixel Gaussian networks, a diffusion model of the same residuals, residuals from other storms and an unconditional token world model, on 276 forecast windows from 46 held-out storms of Digital Typhoon. TyphoonWorld matches the squared error of the regression, lowers the CRPS of the area colder than 220 K, a direct measure of deep convection, by 14 to 39% against every other ensemble, and ties its spread to forecast error as closely as the Gaussian network, with a correlation of 0.78 across windows. It uses 56% of the parameters of the unconditional world model.

AI.tldr: TyphoonWorld仅生成回归预报的残差，在保持台风影像预测误差的同时改善概率预报。
AI.motivation: 回归网络虽有较低平方误差，却平滑了未来变化，需要生成连贯且随风暴状态变化的集合预报。
AI.method: 以回归预报令牌、最新影像及预报时刻的最佳路径状态为条件，逐预报时效采样离散令牌残差并叠加至回归中心。
AI.result: 在46场未见风暴上保持回归平方误差，深对流面积CRPS较其他集合降低14%—39%，离散度与误差相关系数为0.78。
AI.conclusion: 条件残差生成能改善台风概率预报，且仅需无条件令牌世界模型56%的参数。

title: Target-Free Autocalibration of Stereo PIV Camera Systems via Persistent-State Motion Representations
summary: Stereo Particle Image Velocimetry (PIV) recovers three-component velocity fields by triangulating tracer particles observed by synchronized cameras. It requires an accurate extrinsic calibration, which is still obtained by inserting a physical target into the flow and must be repeated whenever the rig is moved. We present a target-free method that calibrates a stereo PIV rig directly from particle image sequences. Because tracer particles are visually indistinguishable, we match motion rather than appearance: building on CUT3R, each camera stream is processed by a recurrent transformer whose persistent state accumulates particle motion over time. The state is decoded into per-camera optical flow and queried by a cross-view decoder that regresses bidirectional point correspondences, from which the relative pose is recovered with a five-point RANSAC solver. We train on a new synthetic stereo PIV dataset with ground-truth poses and evaluate on standard PIV optical flow benchmarks and on 200 real rig placements. Our model achieves lower flow error than existing PIV networks, more accurate cross-view correspondences than COTR, and higher pose accuracy than the strongest detector-matcher pipelines on both synthetic and real data, without any calibration target.

AI.tldr: 该方法通过持续状态运动表征，直接从粒子图像序列完成双目PIV相机的无靶标外参标定。
AI.motivation: 双目PIV依赖精确外参，传统标定需将实体靶标放入流场，且设备移动后必须重复操作。
AI.method: 基于CUT3R用循环Transformer累积运动，解码光流和跨视角点对应，再以五点RANSAC恢复相对位姿。
AI.result: 在合成数据和200次真实设备布置上，光流、跨视角对应及位姿精度均优于所比较方法。
AI.conclusion: 以运动而非外观匹配可实现无靶标双目PIV标定，减少对实体标定流程的依赖。

title: Recognizing Events Is Not Enough: Why Streaming VLMs Struggle in Compositional Instruction Triggering
summary: Recognizing individual events does not guarantee correct execution of compositional instructions in streaming video. For example, given the request "Notify me when the pot boils after someone turns on the stove and leaves the kitchen", existing models may recognize the individual events yet notify too early or miss the intended moment, failing to track how their temporal conditions are satisfied over time. To evaluate this gap, we introduce CoTriggerBench, which composes annotated video events into temporally constrained instructions and verifies notification timing and silence through executable event plans and source-event replay. To address this challenge, we propose a real-time VLM agent, TEMPI. TEMPI decomposes instructions into atomic event queries and temporal constraints, and uses Scenario Memory to continuously maintain task progress as event evidence arrives, allowing earlier observations to support subsequent decisions beyond the detector's visual window. Even when no notification is required, relevant events continue to update the scenario state. On CoTriggerBench, TEMPI achieves 44.4% instruction-level success, outperforming the strongest closed-source and fine-tuned open-source VLM baselines by 15.6 (Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash-Realtime) and 18.1 (MOSS-VL-Realtime) percentage points, respectively. To support efficient on-device streaming inference, we further optimize the streaming inference pipeline by overlapping partial visual encoding and LLM prefix prefill with frame arrival. On an 8 GB RTX 5060, our optimized detector implementation achieves a 4.90$\times$ speedup.

AI.tldr: TEMPI借助事件分解和持续场景记忆，提升流式视频中组合时序指令的触发准确性。
AI.motivation: 识别单个事件不足以执行组合指令，模型还需持续跟踪时序条件并在正确时刻通知。
AI.method: 构建CoTriggerBench评测，并用TEMPI分解事件与约束、持续更新场景记忆，同时重叠视觉编码和前缀预填充。
AI.result: 指令级成功率达44.4%，较两类最强基线分别提高15.6和18.1个百分点，优化检测器加速4.90倍。
AI.conclusion: 持续维护任务状态有助于组合时序触发，流式推理流水线优化则支持高效设备端运行。

title: Neural Latent Gaussian Process for 3D reconstruction of Mouse Brain Lipids
summary: We address the problem of reconstructing continuous three-dimensional lipid profiles of the mouse brain from lipid measurements acquired only on a sparse set of two-dimensional tissue sections. Using MALDI-MSI measurements from coronal sections of two densely sampled and six sparsely sampled mouse brains, registered to the Allen Mouse Brain Common Coordinate Framework (CCF), we seek to interpolate the measured hundreds of lipid profiles across the unobserved voxels of the reference brain. We introduce a Neural Latent-Space Gaussian Process (LGP) architecture for this task and critically evaluate its ability to reconstruct spatial lipid distributions, using held-out mouse brain sections to assess generalization. We propose a Gaussian Process prior for the distribution of low-dimensional lipid profiles across the mouse brain (with Matérn or a Riemann manifold kernel). This allows us to encode 3D coordinates in a small number of latent 3D volumes that are then mapped to particular lipids using a multilayer perceptron (MLP). We performed an exhaustive analysis over a range of algorithms from simple linear regression, XGBoost, MLP to state of the art models such as Neural Transcriptomic Field, graph-based SPA3D for spatial omics reconstruction and DEEPSPATIAL. We additionally evaluate GPLFR as an alternative Gaussian-process-based approach. Across 173 measured lipids, LGP outperforms all evaluated baselines, including recent spatial-omics models and GPLFR, achieving a mean correlation of 0.613 and demonstrating the effectiveness of our approach for sparse 3D lipid interpolation.

AI.tldr: 神经潜空间高斯过程从稀疏二维切片重建小鼠脑连续三维脂质分布。
AI.motivation: 脂质测量仅覆盖少量组织切片，需要推断参考脑中未观测体素的数百种脂质分布。
AI.method: 将配准脂质数据建模为带Matérn或黎曼流形核的低维潜空间高斯过程，再用MLP映射至各脂质。
AI.result: 在173种脂质上，LGP平均相关系数达0.613，优于全部受评基线，包括近期空间组学模型与GPLFR。
AI.conclusion: 潜空间高斯过程能有效利用空间结构，实现稀疏切片条件下的三维脑脂质插值。

title: VTG-RAG: Long-Video Reasoning via Query-Adaptive Coarse-to-Fine Sampling and Temporal Graph Retrieval
summary: Long-video reasoning requires a system to localize sparse evidence over extended temporal sequences, preserve temporal structure, and generate answers despite substantial multimodal distractors. Existing video retrieval-augmented generation methods typically build indexes from uniformly sampled video segments. In long-video settings, this design readily introduces irrelevant context and is unreliable for questions with explicit temporal constraints. We propose VTG-RAG, a framework for long-video question answering that combines query-adaptive coarse-to-fine sampling with temporal graph retrieval. First, a two-stage sampling strategy selects core segments with high mean query relevance or high intra-segment relevance variance. The framework then integrates subtitles, speech transcripts, visual descriptions, entities, and relations from these segments into a temporally ordered multimodal graph. Finally, it performs temporally filtered, two-pass retrieval and reasoning across frame, text, and graph evidence spaces. A lot of experiments have proven the effectiveness of the VTG-RAG. Specifically, we evaluate the framework on Video-MME and LongVideoBench. On LongVideoBench, the reported Qwen2.5-VL-32B and 72B results improve from 48.16% to 50.56% and from 52.13% to 53.32%, respectively, with 24 answer-input frames. These correspond to gains of 2.40 and 1.19 percentage points. The ablation experiments of VTG-RAG further support that the contributions of each component are very important.

AI.tldr: VTG-RAG结合查询自适应采样与时序图检索，改善长视频问答。
AI.motivation: 均匀采样易引入无关上下文，难以在长视频中定位稀疏证据并满足明确的时序约束。
AI.method: 按查询相关性均值与方差粗到细采样，构建时序多模态图，并在帧、文本和图空间进行时序过滤的两轮检索推理。
AI.result: LongVideoBench上，使用24帧输入时，32B和72B模型准确率分别提高2.40和1.19个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 查询自适应证据选择与时序图检索有助于长视频推理，消融实验支持各组件的贡献。

title: Video-as-Experience: Learning Computer Use via Audio-Visual Understanding
summary: Multimodal large language models (LLMs) have enabled capable computer-use agents that perceive graphical user interfaces, reason over instructions, and execute actions. However, existing approaches to learning from video demonstrations typically convert videos into screenshot-based action trajectories, rather than directly leveraging their rich audio-visual information. We introduce VEX (Video as EXperience), a framework that uses audio-visual understanding to unify learning from external demonstrations and reflecting on an agent's own behavior. Following a watch-act-rewatch paradigm, the agent extracts procedural guidance from tutorial videos containing visual demonstrations and spoken explanations, executes tasks, and verifies its progress by rewatching its execution as video. We instantiate VEX with video-SALMONN-VEX, a 9B-scale audio-visual computer-use agent built on the video-SALMONN 2 architecture with a Qwen3.5-9B backbone. We further introduce Action-Grounded Guide Optimization (AGGO), a reinforcement learning method that optimizes video-derived guidance for downstream action prediction, and augment AgentNet, OSWorld, and CUA-Gym with over 24K real-world tutorial videos. Experiments on OSWorld and a complementary subset of CUA-Gym demonstrate consistent improvements, with video-SALMONN-VEX achieving a 22% relative increase in task success over its Qwen3.5 backbone on OSWorld. Moreover, its generated guidance improves Gemini-3.5-flash by 10% relatively on OSWorld. These results highlight the potential of audio-visual understanding as a unified interface for procedural learning and self-verification in computer-use agents.

AI.tldr: VEX通过观看教程、执行任务与回看操作视频，统一计算机使用智能体的流程学习和自我核验。
AI.motivation: 现有视频示范学习多将视频转为截图动作轨迹，未充分利用视觉演示和语音讲解。
AI.method: 构建9B视听智能体，以AGGO强化学习优化视频指导，并用逾2.4万段真实教程扩充三个数据集。
AI.result: OSWorld任务成功率较Qwen3.5骨干相对提升22%，生成的指导使Gemini-3.5-flash相对提升10%。
AI.conclusion: 视听理解可作为计算机使用智能体学习操作流程与核验自身行为的统一接口。

title: Feature-Space Latent Forecasting for Endoscopic Surgical Video Understanding
summary: Surgical workflow assistance is inherently anticipatory: systems must reason about how procedures evolve, not just recognize the current frame. However, many prior approaches perform prediction in pixel space by synthesizing future frames, which primarily focuses on appearance fidelity rather than the semantic representations required for downstream reasoning. To address this limitation, we propose a feature-space semantic forecasting framework that models temporal dynamics directly within the representations of a frozen Vision Foundation Model (VFM). Specifically, we build a hierarchical target representation from multi-layer VFM features, replace future-frame feature tokens with learnable \texttt{[MASK]} tokens, and train a masked transformer to forecast the corresponding future latent features from observed context, thereby formulating procedural evolution as masked future feature prediction. Experiments on public laparoscopic benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements in phase anticipation, multi-label tool presence prediction, and remaining-time estimation over RGB-based forecasting baselines, while enabling a plug-and-play representation interface for lightweight downstream heads.

AI.tldr: 通过预测冻结视觉基础模型的未来语义特征，提升内窥镜手术视频的流程预判能力。
AI.motivation: 像素空间的未来帧合成侧重外观保真，未直接针对手术流程推理所需的语义表示。
AI.method: 融合多层视觉基础模型特征构建分层目标，以掩码变换器根据已观察上下文预测未来潜在特征。
AI.result: 在公开腹腔镜基准上，阶段预判、多标签工具存在预测和剩余时间估计均持续优于RGB预测基线。
AI.conclusion: 特征空间预测支持手术流程预判，并为轻量级下游预测头提供即插即用的表示接口。

title: From Hosted Service to Field-Owned Infrastructure: Open, Self-Hosted Real-Time Camera-Trap Alerting with Regional Open-Weight Models
summary: Cellular camera traps can alert field teams within minutes, supporting anti-poaching, threatened-species protection and human-wildlife conflict mitigation. Most systems use central servers, sending images of people and sensitive species locations outside the collecting organisation and often across national borders. We ask whether this capability can run on infrastructure owned by field organisations. Trap Tracker RT is an open-source, self-hosted application that receives images by email or locally via FTP/SFTP, classifies them with a project-specific model and sends alerts through a mail server chosen by the organisation. We evaluated DeepFaune-SSA v1.2, pairing MegaDetector v6 with a DINOv3-based classifier for 33 sub-Saharan taxa, against three open alternatives on 31,131 out-of-distribution images from Kenya, Namibia and Malawi, independent of its training data. DeepFaune-SSA achieved image-level species accuracy of 0.901 (95% CI 0.894-0.908), versus 0.530 for the global SpeciesNet classifier and 0.556 and 0.547 for YOLOv10x and YOLO26x detectors trained on the same regional data. DeepFaune-SSA had the highest recall for all 26 species evaluated. The single-stage detectors missed animals in about a quarter of images; SpeciesNet assigned species labels in only 57%, usually falling back to coarser labels otherwise. In bench tests of the fully local path, alerts were issued about 6 s after upload completion, including with slowed and interrupted uploads. The two-stage pipeline processed 19 images per minute on eight CPU threads without a graphics processor. Trap Tracker RT is used by five organisations in the United Kingdom and Kenya, including for human-elephant conflict mitigation. We discuss how data paths, rather than inference location, determine data sovereignty, the responsibilities of self-hosting and the ethics of real-time monitoring.

AI.tldr: 开源自托管相机陷阱告警系统结合区域模型，实现由野外组织自主管理的快速物种告警。
AI.motivation: 集中式服务常将人员图像和敏感物种位置传出采集组织甚至跨境，引发数据主权问题。
AI.method: 系统通过邮件或FTP/SFTP接收图像并分类告警，在三国31,131张分布外图像上比较四种开放模型。
AI.result: DeepFaune-SSA物种准确率为0.901且26种物种召回率均最高，本地告警约在上传完成后6秒发出。
AI.conclusion: 该系统已被五家组织使用，表明自主管理实时告警可行，但数据主权取决于完整数据路径而非仅推理位置。

title: Conv-Reluplex: A Verification Framework For Convolution Neural Networks
summary: In recent years, machine learning has demonstrated impressive performance in many real-world tasks, especially in computer vision and natural language processing. However, to apply them in safety-critical systems one needs formal guarantees on the neural network outputs. The Reluplex tool is proposed to verify the safety of deep neural networks (DNNs), and in case the DNN fails to give a correct output, can generate adversarial examples. Since the tool can only handle DNNs, it is necessary to extend the tool to process image data. Therefore, in this paper, we propose the Conv-Reluplex framework, which is designed to verify the convolutional layer and pooling layer in convolutional neural networks (CNNs), and generate adversarial examples when classification is misguided. We conduct several experiments on MNIST to evaluate our approaches. The results show that the original CNN is improved using the adversarial examples generated by our tool, and the precision of classification can be increased significantly.
comment: 6 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. Published in SEKE 2021

AI.tldr: Conv-Reluplex将神经网络形式化验证扩展至卷积和池化层，并生成可用于改进分类的对抗样本。
AI.motivation: 安全关键系统需要神经网络输出的形式化保证，而原有Reluplex需扩展才能处理卷积图像模型。
AI.method: 提出Conv-Reluplex验证卷积层与池化层，在分类出错时生成对抗样本，并在MNIST上开展实验。
AI.result: 利用工具生成的对抗样本改进原始卷积网络后，分类精度显著提高，但摘要未报告具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可支持卷积网络的形式化验证，并利用生成的对抗样本改善分类性能。

title: Hybrid quantum learning for imbalanced blood-cell classification: domain adaptation and classifier design
summary: Limited annotated data, class imbalance, and morphological similarity make white blood cell classification challenging. We benchmark hybrid variational quantum classifier heads against an affine baseline on 821 microscopy images across seven morphological classes. Using ImageNet-initialised ResNet34 backbones and repeated stratified five-fold cross-validation, we first compare direct transfer with intermediate adaptation on MLL23, a larger peripheral blood cell microscopy dataset. To guide the head comparison, we explore different encoding strategies, variational depth, and the number of independent circuit blocks. We then compare the classifier performance using the affine head and two hybrid heads across multiple random seeds, under a shared training and evaluation protocol. For this comparison, all backbones share the same MLL23-adapted initialisation. Intermediate adaptation increases mean macro-F1 across all four affine-head fine-tuning configurations. The largest gain occurs with a frozen backbone, where macro-F1 rises from $0.685$ to $0.786$, a relative improvement of approximately $14.7\%$. The shallow two-block hybrid head achieves a mean pooled out-of-fold macro-F1 of $0.865 \pm 0.010$, compared with $0.879 \pm 0.008$ for the affine head. The corresponding balanced accuracies are $0.886 \pm 0.008$ and $0.889 \pm 0.010$, respectively. In the architectural exploration, the two-block hybrid head achieves the highest macro-F1 and balanced accuracy among the evaluated hybrid configurations, while the effect of encoding varies across the considered metrics. Our results help guide the design and evaluation of hybrid classifier heads for imbalanced microscopy by linking architectural choices to overall performance and class-specific precision-recall trade-offs.

AI.tldr: 白细胞分类中，中间域适应提升性能，浅层双块混合量子分类头表现接近但未超过仿射头。
AI.motivation: 白细胞分类面临标注稀缺、类别不平衡及形态相似问题，需要评估域适应与混合量子分类器设计。
AI.method: 在821张七类图像上采用重复分层五折交叉验证，比较MLL23中间适应及不同混合量子头与仿射头。
AI.result: 冻结骨干时域适应使宏F1从0.685升至0.786；双块量子头与仿射头宏F1分别为0.865和0.879。
AI.conclusion: 中间域适应有效，双块结构在所测量子配置中最优，但其整体性能未超过仿射基线。

title: Frame First, Decode Once: Object-Centric Coordinates and Single-Pass Decoding for System-1 World Models
summary: Single-pass primitive decoders such as LocateAnything and VFlash predict all quantized coordinate tokens of a geometric primitive in one forward pass, enabling fast, System-1 visual planning. We study what matters when such a decoder serves as a System-1 world model: a fast action-conditioned predictor that ranks candidate pushes by their predicted outcome. On ManiSkill3 PushT-v1 (512 held-out test families, 8,192 rollouts) and on human demonstrations from lerobot/pusht (2,384 test windows), we compare decoders, training losses, rigid-body projections and coordinate frames, using matched checkpoints, hierarchical bootstrap confidence intervals and Holm correction. Two factors of similar size dominate. First, expressing inputs and outputs in the SE(2) frame of the object's initial pose lowers decision regret by 1.9-2.2x for each of five decoders, and the object-frame model trained on 128 families matches the world-frame model trained on 512. Second, single-pass decoding outperforms iterative decoding: in the object frame, single-pass heads reach 0.020-0.021 regret at 1.6-1.8 ms per decision, against 0.046 for 10-step DDIM diffusion and 0.059 for KV-cached autoregression at 10.3 and 12.9 ms. The choice among single-pass heads has no measurable effect on regret, and our registered hypothesis that the frame effect exceeds the decoder spread is not supported. Soft-token expectation with an end-to-end 2D Kabsch projection gives the lowest trajectory error (11.35 px on ManiSkill3, 3.78 px on lerobot/pusht), exact rigid-body consistency, and lower regret than diffusion at every budget from 4 to 50 DDIM steps, at 3-29x lower latency.
comment: 12 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables. Code, frozen configurations and per-seed results will be released

AI.tldr: 物体中心坐标与单次解码共同改善快速推动规划，降低决策遗憾及推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 作为快速动作条件世界模型时，几何解码器的坐标系、解码方式与训练设计对规划效果的影响尚需厘清。
AI.method: 在仿真推动任务与人类示范上，控制检查点并比较五类解码器、损失、刚体投影和坐标系。
AI.result: 物体坐标系使决策遗憾降低1.9至2.2倍；单次解码仅需1.6至1.8毫秒且遗憾低于扩散和自回归。
AI.conclusion: 物体坐标系与单次解码均有重要收益，但坐标系效应大于解码器差异的预注册假设未获支持。

title: Can a Vision-Language Model Tune Clustering In Context?
summary: Clustering is a widely used unsupervised learning method, but selecting an appropriate algorithm and set of hyperparameters for a specific dataset can require many possible configurations and evaluations. In this work, we investigate whether a Vision-Language Model can instead visually evaluate clustering results and use those decisions to then tune an explicit clustering algorithm. We study this through three progressive experiments using Qwen3.5-27B and five controlled synthetic clustering scenarios. First, we test whether the VLM can distinguish the best clustering result from a pair of plots. Second, we test whether it can assign numerical scores to those plots where a higher score represents a better result. Finally, we use these judgments within an agentic loop in which the VLM scores a k-means clustering and proposes updated hyperparameters that may result in better clustering. Our exploratory results show that the VLM performs well when clear cluster structure is present, while struggling on more ambiguous and noisy settings. In the full agentic experiment, the VLM produces clustering configurations with silhouette scores relatively close to those of grid search and Bayesian optimization, while terminating in much fewer iterations. Overall, these results provide an initial proof of concept that VLM-based visual feedback can be used to autonomously tune an explicit clustering algorithm.

AI.tldr: 视觉语言模型可通过观察聚类图并反馈调整参数，以较少迭代获得接近传统搜索的聚类质量。
AI.motivation: 为特定数据选择聚类算法与超参数通常需要评估大量配置，研究探索视觉反馈能否简化调参。
AI.method: 使用Qwen3.5-27B在五种合成场景中依次测试聚类图成对比较、数值评分及代理循环内的k-means调参。
AI.result: 模型在结构清晰时表现较好，在模糊噪声场景中较弱；其轮廓系数接近网格与贝叶斯搜索且迭代更少。
AI.conclusion: 研究初步证明视觉语言模型的视觉反馈可用于自主调整显式聚类算法，但复杂噪声场景仍具挑战。

title: Gradient-Guided Hardware-Native MIXFP4
summary: Blackwell tensor cores support native inference with 4-bit weights and activations (W4A4), but NVFP4 leaves a perplexity (PPL) gap to BF16. Choosing a format for each 16-element block can improve accuracy, but current matrix multiply instructions cannot execute choices this fine. Applying these rules at hardware-compatible tiles loses most of their benefit. We introduce FlipQuant, which selects E2M1 or E0M3 for each MMA weight tile. It keeps both quantized weight candidates fixed and learns a binary format map from end-to-end gradients of a bucketed KL loss to a BF16 teacher, re-evaluating them after each update. Native kernels execute 16 x 64 tiles on SM120 and 256 x 64 tiles on SM100 with median GEMM overheads of 1.9% and 1.7%, respectively. Across six language models and two corpora, FlipQuant at 16 x 64 closes 42.5% of NVFP4's PPL gap to BF16 on average, compared with 13.3% for FourOverSix. Code is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: FlipQuant通过梯度学习硬件兼容的四位权重格式分配，以较低计算开销缩小与BF16的困惑度差距。
AI.motivation: NVFP4与BF16存在精度差距，而细粒度混合格式选择无法被现有矩阵乘指令直接执行。
AI.method: 固定两种量化权重候选，利用相对BF16教师的分桶KL损失梯度，为每个MMA权重块学习二元格式映射。
AI.result: 16×64配置平均弥合42.5%的困惑度差距；SM120与SM100的GEMM中位开销分别为1.9%和1.7%。
AI.conclusion: 硬件原生块级格式选择可在较小运行开销下改善四位量化精度，效果优于所比较的FourOverSix。

title: AerialOcc: Unified 3D Aerial Perception without Task-Specific Head
summary: Aerial perception systems are increasingly expected to support diverse tasks, yet existing solutions remain fundamentally tied to task-specific outputs. Detection, segmentation, and other perception objectives are usually learned either by separate models or by sharing a backbone with multiple task heads, leaving the model itself unaware of the common structure underlying these tasks. We are interested in asking: can a single perception representation support different levels of understanding without being designed for any specific task? We notice that occupancy is a promising task-agnostic representation for drone perception. By modeling the spatial existence and semantics of the environment, it naturally bridges different perception granularities, from coarse scene understanding to fine-grained object localization. Therefore, we introduce AerialOcc, a unified occupancy-based perception model that enables multiple drone perception tasks from a single inference process, without maintaining task-specific prediction heads. To facilitate this direction, we construct AerialOcc-20K, a large-scale multi-class occupancy dataset for aerial environments. Extensive experiments show that AerialOcc achieves competitive performance across diverse perception tasks while preserving a unified architecture. Our findings demonstrate that occupancy can serve as a universal perception interface, offering a new perspective toward flexible and scalable visual intelligence for autonomous drones from a common 3D scene representation. Models and data are publicly available at this https URL

AI.tldr: AerialOcc以统一三维占据表示支持多种无人机感知任务，无需任务专用预测头。
AI.motivation: 现有航空感知依赖独立模型或多任务头，缺乏能够统一不同任务和理解粒度的通用表示。
AI.method: 构建基于空间存在性与语义的统一占据模型，并建立航空多类别占据数据集AerialOcc-20K。
AI.result: 实验表明，AerialOcc在保持统一架构的同时，在多种感知任务上取得有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 占据表示可作为无人机的通用感知接口，由共同三维场景表示支持灵活且可扩展的多任务理解。

title: Agri-MRAG: Parameter-Enhanced Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Agricultural Visual Question Answering
summary: Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MRAG) has shown promise for Agricultural Visual Question Answering (Agri-VQA), but existing methods still face challenges in retrieving relevant knowledge while avoiding redundancy and in integrating retrieved evidence beyond simple prompt concatenation. To address these issues, we propose Agri-MRAG, a multimodal retrieval-augmented framework for agricultural VQA. Specifically, we first introduce a semantic-consistency-guided clustering mechanism that combines multimodal clustering and weighted relevance scoring to select high-confidence knowledge subsets and adaptively determine the retrieval size $k$. We then design a parameterized knowledge injection strategy, where retrieved agricultural knowledge is encoded into LoRA adapters and merged into the feed-forward network (FFN) layers of the MLLM, allowing external knowledge to influence generation through parameter-level adaptation. In addition, a perplexity-guided (PPL-guided) routing mechanism is employed to switch between implicit parametric reasoning and explicit retrieval-assisted generation according to model uncertainty, balancing inference efficiency and answer reliability. For evaluation, we use PlantVillageVQA as a broad agricultural benchmark and construct PlantVQA, a region-specific forestry and fruit crop VQA dataset containing 7,514 images and 15,028 expert-verified question-answer pairs. Experiments show that Agri-MRAG achieves ROUGE-L scores of 41.21 and 46.58 on the two datasets, outperforming mRAG by 11.70 and 4.51 points, and VisRAG by 8.80 and 3.39 points, respectively.

AI.tldr: Agri-MRAG通过自适应检索、参数级知识注入和不确定性路由提升农业视觉问答表现。
AI.motivation: 现有农业多模态检索增强方法难以兼顾知识相关性、去冗余及超越提示拼接的证据融合。
AI.method: 以语义一致性聚类自适应选择知识，将其编码为LoRA适配器注入前馈层，并按困惑度切换推理路径。
AI.result: 在PlantVillageVQA和PlantVQA上ROUGE-L分别达41.21和46.58，均优于mRAG与VisRAG。
AI.conclusion: 参数级知识融合与自适应检索路由为提高农业视觉问答可靠性和推理效率提供了方案。

title: Vibe synthesis: hierarchical agentic decision-making for intent-driven multistep molecule synthesis
summary: The ability to construct complex molecules underpins advances in medicine and the molecular sciences. Yet long-horizon multistep synthesis requires decisions to be revised as evidence accumulates across chemically dependent operations, a capability not readily supported by artificial-intelligence tools and automated platforms organized around predefined tasks and hard-coded workflows. Here we propose and demonstrate a vibe synthesis system (VibeSyn), an intent-driven architecture in which hierarchical agents translate chemist-defined molecular objectives and accumulating evidence into adaptive decisions executed through computational tools and laboratory automation. We evaluate VibeSyn in three demonstrations of increasing scope and autonomy, progressing from evidence-grounded experimental decisions to adaptive execution of a ten-step total synthesis of catharanthine and structure-to-compound synthesis of cyclic peptides containing unnatural amino acids (uAAs). Across the long-horizon campaigns, active human input and simple confirmation account for less than 7.5% and 5.2%, respectively, of recorded workflow actions and outcomes. VibeSyn points towards a future in which chemists define synthetic intent and agent-directed laboratories autonomously navigate the evolving experimental trajectory required to deliver the target compound.

AI.tldr: VibeSyn以分层智能体将化学家的合成意图转化为可随实验反馈调整的多步分子合成决策。
AI.motivation: 依赖预定义任务和固定工作流的工具难以在长程多步合成中依据持续积累的证据修订决策。
AI.method: 分层智能体结合分子目标与新增证据，通过计算工具和实验室自动化执行自适应合成流程。
AI.result: 系统完成包括十步长春质碱全合成在内的演示，主动人工输入和简单确认占比分别低于7.5%和5.2%。
AI.conclusion: 该系统展示了由化学家定义目标、智能体主导实验室自主推进复杂合成的潜力。

title: Quantum-inspired orthogonal adapters for certifiably robust medical image classification
summary: Medical image classifiers require not only high accuracy but also reliable predictions under small input perturbations. Certified robustness provides mathematical guarantees of prediction stability, but preserving these guarantees when adapting pretrained models to new tasks remains challenging. We propose a fine-tuning approach based on quantum-inspired orthogonal butterfly layers that preserves the Lipschitz bounds of pretrained certified networks. Inspired by quantum circuits of reconfigurable beam splitters, these layers preserve orthogonality by construction using only $\mathcal{O}(n\log n)$ trainable parameters. Their structured design enables efficient classical implementation and offers a path toward future quantum implementations with logarithmic circuit depth under suitable connectivity assumptions. Controlled experiments on MNIST and MedMNIST demonstrate improved certified robustness compared with conventional alternatives and, in the DermaMNIST transfer, greater resistance to the tested attacks than low-rank adaptation (LoRA). We then apply it to trichoscopic image classification for alopecia diagnosis and alopecia areata activity assessment. By adapting a certified ImageNet-pretrained network, butterfly fine-tuning achieves approximately twice the certified accuracy of conventional fine-tuning and LoRA, with comparable classification accuracy on the same backbone and data split and similar empirical resistance to the tested adversarial attacks. Larger robustness guarantees, including certificates covering certain image-processing transformations, can be obtained at the cost of reduced accuracy. These results highlight the potential of quantum-inspired butterfly layers for parameter-efficient adaptation of medical image classifiers while preserving the mathematical guarantees underlying certified robustness.

AI.tldr: 量子启发的正交蝶形适配层可在医学图像模型微调中保留认证鲁棒性并实现参数高效适配。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分类需抵抗微小输入扰动，但预训练模型迁移时难以维持已有的鲁棒性数学保证。
AI.method: 采用构造上保持正交、参数量为O(n log n)的蝶形层微调模型，以保留预训练网络的Lipschitz界。
AI.result: 脱发相关毛发镜分类中，认证准确率约为常规微调和LoRA的两倍，分类准确率相当。
AI.conclusion: 正交蝶形层有助于兼顾参数效率与认证鲁棒性，但扩大鲁棒性保证范围可能牺牲准确率。

title: Third-Place Solution for the UCF UrbanTwin V2X-Real Track at ECCV 2026: Synthetic Point Cloud Generation and Sim-to-Real 3D Object Detection
summary: This report presents a complete technical solution for the UrbanTwin V2X-Real Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge, covering both synthetic point cloud generation and 3D object detection. For data generation, we adopt per-axis quantile calibration. Public V2X-Real training data are used to construct the real reference distribution, and independent one-dimensional quantile mappings are estimated for the x, y, and z axes of the base synthetic point clouds. The calibrated point clouds are then resampled using a fixed random seed and clipped to the valid spatial range, producing 50 frames with 2,000 float32 XYZ points per frame. For detection, we use a two-stage Voxel R-CNN (VoxelRCNN) detector trained with RangeLDM-enhanced synthetic point-cloud data, point clouds downsampled to 50k points per frame, and reconstructed pedestrian data. Training is performed on four NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 GPUs with a global batch size of 16 for 40 epochs. Final testing uses direct single-model inference with the original VoxelRCNN model. On the official evaluation server, the normalized Realism score is 0.7905 and the normalized Detection score is 0.5583, with mAP@0.5 of 0.3908, BEV mAP@0.5 of 0.4219, and mAP@0.7 of 0.1047. According to the official weighting rule, the final combined score is 0.6 x 0.5583 + 0.4 x 0.7905 = 0.6512. This report documents the complete implementation details of data construction, model training, inference, submission formatting, and official evaluation.
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. 3rd place, Track 7 (V2X-Real), UCF UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge, 6th DriveX Workshop at ECCV 2026

AI.tldr: 该报告提出结合逐轴分位数校准和Voxel R-CNN的合成点云生成与仿真到真实三维检测方案。
AI.motivation: 面向UrbanTwin V2X-Real挑战，需要提升合成点云真实感及其训练模型在真实场景中的检测表现。
AI.method: 按真实点云分布逐轴校准合成数据，并用RangeLDM增强点云、降采样数据和重建行人数据训练检测器。
AI.result: 官方评测真实感得分0.7905、检测得分0.5583，最终加权总分0.6512。
AI.conclusion: 报告提供了从数据构建、训练和单模型推理到提交与官方评测的完整可复现实施细节。

title: Setting Optimal Reserve Prices using Fine-Tuned Language Models
summary: Online auction houses must set reserve prices for highly differentiated products whose unstructured descriptions contain valuable demand information. Existing approaches generally require managers to specify product attributes in advance. We ask whether a language model can instead learn from listing descriptions and historical bids to set item-specific reserve prices before bidding begins. We fine-tune a pretrained text embedding language model using the structural likelihood of auction bids as its training objective. This directs representation learning toward the valuation distribution that determines the reserve decision. We show that consecutive upper bids identify the tail information needed to set an optimal reserve without observing or modeling the number of potential bidders. A split-sample estimator learns the representation on one half of the data and conducts structural estimation and inference conditional on that representation on the other. We apply the method to approximately 65,800 online used-vehicle auctions. With seller values calibrated to match the sale rate among listings, the model implies a counterfactual net increase of $165.8 million, representing a 14.6% increase above the incumbent reserve policy. The framework translates a listing description and a seller's value into an item-specific reserve recommendation without constructing a product taxonomy or requiring a bid history for the item being priced. It provides an approach to adapting language models for operational decisions in marketplaces where products are heterogeneous and demand-relevant information is recorded in text.

AI.tldr: 研究以拍卖出价的结构似然微调语言模型，从商品描述中学习并推荐个性化最优保留价。
AI.motivation: 差异化商品的文本描述包含需求信息，而现有定价方法通常要求管理者预先定义商品属性。
AI.method: 用结构似然训练文本嵌入模型，利用相邻高位出价识别估值尾部，并分样本开展表示学习与结构估计。
AI.result: 在约6.58万场二手车拍卖中，校准卖方估值后，模型推算反事实净增益1.658亿美元，较原策略提升14.6%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架无需商品分类体系或待定价商品的历史出价，即可由描述和卖方估值生成保留价建议。

title: RouteDiff: Low-Dose CT Denoising via Fidelity-Refinement Routing and Hypergraph State Regulation
summary: Diffusion models have become a strong prior for low-dose computed tomography (LDCT) restoration. However, existing samplers apply one structure-detail trade-off to the whole image, set the restoration emphasis of each step by the timestep, and derive each next state recursively from the current one, carrying its errors forward. We propose RouteDiff, a state-aware dual-route diffusion framework that routes detail to where it can be trusted, regulates each reverse step by the state it has reached, and re-enters the trajectory from an anchored estimate. Fidelity-Refinement Routing (FRR) equips one shared U-Net with a conservative fidelity route and a detail-oriented refinement route, fuses them pixel-wise with a confidence map, and exposes their disagreement as route evidence. Hypergraph State Regulation (HSR) organizes the current features and this evidence into a state hypergraph, whose soft hyperedges group scattered regions in the same state. Its readout yields an ordered stage judgment that modulates the bottleneck, and its incidence guides feature interaction in the skip connections. Estimate-Anchored Re-entry (EAR) re-projects a route-aware anchor onto the trajectory at a fixed step and hands the new state back to HSR to be judged again. With the ten network evaluations of its baseline, RouteDiff achieves the best peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) and structural similarity index (SSIM) on four datasets with inserted, real and simulated noise (40.95 dB and 95.13% on Mayo 2020; 45.18 dB and 97.23% on Mayo 2016). It also generalizes to unseen doses of real scans and yields the highest Dice (80.92%) in downstream segmentation.
comment: 16 pages, 10 figures, 7 tables. Submitted to Knowledge-Based Systems

AI.tldr: RouteDiff通过双路径路由、超图状态调控和锚定重入改善低剂量CT扩散去噪。
AI.motivation: 现有采样器对整幅图像使用统一结构细节权衡、依赖时间步调控，且递归更新会传播误差。
AI.method: 以置信图融合保真与细化路径，用超图判断并调控当前状态，再以锚定估计重新进入去噪轨迹。
AI.result: 十次网络评估下，四个数据集PSNR和SSIM均最佳，Mayo 2020达40.95 dB和95.13%，分割Dice达80.92%。
AI.conclusion: 状态感知路由在维持基线评估次数的同时提升恢复质量，并能泛化至未见真实扫描剂量。

title: Personalized and Adaptive Federated Learning for Canine Cardiomegaly Keypoint Prediction
summary: In the field of medical imaging, limited data and cross-institutional heterogeneity remain major challenges for training robust deep learning models. Federated learning (FL) has emerged as a promising approach that enables collaborative training across institutions while preserving data privacy by keeping datasets local. In this work, we propose a structure-aware personalized and adaptive federated learning framework, PAFL, for automatic vertebral heart score (VHS) estimation and cardiomegaly classification from canine thoracic X-rays. Our method treats the task as anatomical keypoint prediction followed by geometry-based VHS computation, introducing implicit structural consistency and improving interpretability. To address cross-institutional heterogeneity, we adopt a parameter-decomposed architecture that separates shared feature representations from client-specific adaptation modules. Furthermore, we introduce an adaptive, quality-aware aggregation strategy that dynamically weights client contributions based on both dataset size and model quality, thereby enhancing robustness to non-IID data distributions. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed PAFL framework improves models' predictive performance compared to isolated training and to conventional and existing personalized federated learning (PFL) methods. Our results demonstrate the potential of integrating structure-aware modeling with PFL for reliable and interpretable medical image analysis.

AI.tldr: PAFL结合结构感知关键点预测与个性化联邦学习，支持犬心脏大小评分及心脏增大分类。
AI.motivation: 医学影像数据有限且跨机构分布异质，需在数据留存本地的条件下实现可靠协作建模。
AI.method: 由解剖关键点几何计算椎体心脏评分，分离共享与客户端适配参数，并按数据量和模型质量自适应聚合。
AI.result: PAFL的预测表现优于独立训练、传统联邦学习及已有个性化联邦学习方法。
AI.conclusion: 结构感知建模与个性化联邦学习结合，有望提高医学图像分析的可靠性和可解释性。

title: Same Evidence, Different Verdicts: Delivery of CT Images and DICOM Metadata Changes VLM Quality-Control Decisions
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are being proposed as automated checks on clinical imaging inputs, where a scan and its DICOM metadata can disagree; a truncated CT series wrongly admitted to volumetric follow-up, such as lung-nodule growth assessment in screening, biases the measurement. A natural safeguard is to let the model judge the image before it sees the metadata. We find this backfires. On 60 NLST chest CT pairs with coverage defects whose ground truth is computed from scan geometry, a false header that Claude Haiku 5.5 resisted when shown with the image (2% of its detections overruled) overturned 91% of them when it arrived after the model's answer (Nemotron-3.5-VL 43% to 100%). With the order reversed, the image overturned 98-100% of the header's errors (Claude models): whichever source came second won. This is not generic sycophancy: a neutral "please confirm" reversed 0 of 1,072 correct refusals, and the effect persisted when the header arrived as a tool result, as in agentic pipelines. One warning sentence cut sequential reversal to at most 9%, and the pattern held on 24 real mismatched pairs. Contributions: (i) evidence that VLM input-check decisions on identical evidence depend on delivery; (ii) a testbed with exact geometric ground truth; (iii) a validation protocol for clinical VLM input checks. Code, prompts and all call logs: this https URL
comment: 4 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Submitted to IEEE ISBI 2027

AI.tldr: 相同CT图像与DICOM元数据的呈现顺序会显著改变视觉语言模型的质控判断，后到证据往往占优。
AI.motivation: 临床图像与元数据可能冲突，需检验先看图像再看元数据是否能保障自动质控可靠性。
AI.method: 在60对具有几何真值的缺损CT上比较证据呈现顺序，并检验工具返回、提醒及24对真实错配病例。
AI.result: Claude Haiku 5.5的检出被错误头信息推翻比例由同时呈现的2%升至后到的91%，警告可将顺序逆转降至9%以内。
AI.conclusion: 临床视觉语言模型质控应验证证据递送方式的影响，不能将先图像后元数据视为天然安全措施。

title: From Retouched Images to Paired Videos: A Synthetic Benchmark for Face Video Retouching
summary: Paired unretouched/retouched face videos are costly to produce because professional editing must remain consistent over time, while releasing identifiable face footage raises privacy, consent, and governance concerns. We present DeepVFR, an initial controlled synthetic benchmark-not a new retouching architecture-for paired face video retouching. Starting from paired synthetic DeepFRR images, Wan2.2 generates mild-motion source clips, and backend-specific face transfer constructs synchronized proxy retouching targets, followed by automatic validity screening and manual visual inspection. DeepVFR contains 1,024 pairs of 150-frame clips at 30 fps, evaluated under an identity-disjoint protocol with explicit frame correspondence; release metadata will record the construction route. Within-benchmark baselines, external checkpoints applied to DeepVFR, qualitative analysis, and a 17-participant ranking study establish reference behavior in the controlled domain. The constructed targets exhibit a substantial low-preference tail in the human study. Because both streams inherit synthetic content and the targets additionally inherit commercial-API or face-transfer artifacts, the benchmark neither replaces artist-retouched captured video nor establishes synthetic-to-real generalization. DeepVFR provides a starting point for paired supervision and controlled evaluation. Data, individual study rankings, and training logs will be made publicly available upon acceptance. Broader motion coverage and real-video validation remain future work.

AI.tldr: DeepVFR是配对人脸视频修饰的受控合成基准，为配对监督与评估提供起点。
AI.motivation: 真实配对修饰视频制作成本高，且可识别人脸视频的发布涉及隐私、同意与治理问题。
AI.method: 从配对合成人脸图像生成轻运动视频，经后端特定的人脸迁移构建同步目标，并实施自动筛查与人工检查。
AI.result: 基准包含1024对150帧视频，基线评估与17人排序研究显示，构建目标存在显著的低偏好长尾。
AI.conclusion: 该基准不能替代艺术家修饰的实拍视频，也未证明合成到真实的泛化，仍需扩展运动覆盖并验证真实视频。

title: Hybrid Compression for Memory-Efficient Matrix-Vector Multiplication
summary: Iterative machine-learning algorithms repeatedly access large real-valued matrices through matrix-vector products, and their performance is limited by memory bandwidth rather than arithmetic throughput. Lossless compression schemes that support computation directly over the compressed data reduce both the data moved and the memory footprint of these workloads. The mm-RePair framework [11] follows this approach by applying the RePair grammar compressor to the Compressed Sparse Row/Value (CSRV) representation of a matrix and performing matrix-vector multiplications directly on the compressed data. Its effectiveness, however, degrades on matrices that are dense or contain many distinct values. In this paper we present a hybrid strategy for the mm-RePair framework that combines grammar and entropy compression. The CSRV sequence is partitioned into a grammar-compressible component, formed by the entries that mm-RePair can compress effectively, and an entropy-compressible component holding the remaining entries, which is encoded with the ans-fold coder [24]. Compression improves further by sorting and delta encoding the entries of each row in the CSRV representation, and by remapping the alphabet to a contiguous range. Experiments on real-valued machine-learning matrices, including word embeddings and transformer hidden states, show that our hybrid strategy is more compact than the original \mmRepair on every input and reduces the peak memory of multiplication, with the largest gains on dense matrices with many distinct values, at competitive multiplication times. It also outperforms the column-reordering variant of \mmRepair on most of the matrices, and combining the two is even more compact on the sparse ones, at the cost of a much longer compression time. Finally, our strategy scales with the number of threads as well as the original \mmRepair does.

AI.tldr: 混合语法与熵压缩改进mm-RePair，降低矩阵向量乘法的存储与峰值内存开销。
AI.motivation: 矩阵向量乘法常受内存带宽限制，而原mm-RePair对稠密或取值多样的矩阵压缩效果下降。
AI.method: 将CSRV序列划分为语法压缩与熵压缩部分，并结合行内排序、差分编码及连续字母表重映射。
AI.result: 混合策略在所有测试输入上比原版更紧凑、乘法峰值内存更低，运行时间有竞争力且保持线程扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 混合压缩尤其适用于取值多样的稠密矩阵，与列重排结合可进一步压缩稀疏矩阵，但压缩耗时显著增加。

title: Multimodal Fusion: A Review of Breast Cancer Advanced and Traditional Modalities
summary: Purpose: Multimodal medical imaging fusion (MMIF) is an increasingly important approach to breast cancer detection (BCD), as different imaging modalities rely on different physical principles and provide complementary information. No single modality can capture all the structural, functional, and biological information needed for accurate diagnosis and characterization. Methods: This review examines more than 15 imaging modalities used in breast cancer detection, including conventional techniques such as mammography, ultrasound, and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), as well as emerging approaches such as thermal imaging, photoacoustic imaging, microwave imaging, and multimodal microscopy. Results: Mammography, ultrasound, and MRI remain among the most widely used modalities, providing complementary structural and functional information. Recent AI advances have enabled fusion at the data, feature, and decision levels, with applications in detection, classification, segmentation, prognosis, and personalized cancer management. Multimodal approaches increasingly combine imaging data with clinical, histopathological, and genomic information. However, important challenges remain, including limited availability of large and diverse multimodal datasets, variations in imaging protocols, missing modalities, limited external validation, and the need for interpretable and clinically reliable AI models. Conclusion: MMIF offers promising opportunities to improve breast cancer detection and characterization by combining complementary imaging and non-imaging information. Future research should prioritize robust fusion strategies, standardized and diverse datasets, multicenter validation, explainable and privacy-preserving AI, and the integration of imaging with clinical and molecular data to facilitate reliable translation into clinical practice.

AI.tldr: 综述乳腺癌检测中的多模态融合，强调互补信息的价值及临床转化挑战。
AI.motivation: 单一成像模态无法完整提供乳腺癌准确诊断与表征所需的结构、功能及生物学信息。
AI.method: 回顾超过15种传统与新兴成像模态，以及人工智能支持的数据、特征和决策层融合方法。
AI.result: 多模态融合已用于检测、分类、分割及预后，但仍面临数据不足、协议差异、模态缺失与外部验证有限等问题。
AI.conclusion: 未来应优先发展稳健融合、标准化多样数据、多中心验证、可解释与隐私保护人工智能及临床分子信息整合。

title: An LLM-assisted theoretical model for aeroengine installation noise scattering
summary: A theoretical model is developed for the canonical problem of aeroengine fan noise impinging on, and scattering from, a nearby semi-infinite rigid plate. The model chains two Wiener--Hopf problems in different coordinate systems. The first stage solves the duct-radiation problem analytically in axisymmetric cylindrical coordinates. The second stage expands the field incident on the plate into a double angular spectrum of plane waves: the axial spectrum is inherited from the first stage, while the spanwise spectrum is generated by a Weyl--Sommerfeld expansion of the cylindrical harmonics. Each spectral component is then scattered by the plate. The mathematical crux is the coordinate transformation between the axisymmetric duct frame and the Cartesian plate frame. The core physical insight--that the Weyl--Sommerfeld identity provides an exact spectral bridge between these systems--originates entirely with the authors. The heavy algebra of translating between the two spectral representations, together with the associated numerical verification, was carried out with the assistance of a large language model (LLM), under strict human oversight and independent numerical cross-checking. This division of labour enables the LLM to handle tedious symbolic manipulation without compromising rigour. Results are presented for spinning modes radiating from a cylindrical duct with a subsonic jet into a quiescent ambient. The case study demonstrates that, under systematic verification, LLMs can accelerate tedious algebra in theoretical fluid mechanics, contributing a concrete empirical example to the broader discussion on AI's role in theoretical research.

AI.tldr: 建立航空发动机风扇噪声经邻近刚性板散射的理论模型，并展示受监督大语言模型辅助代数推导的作用。
AI.motivation: 求解管道噪声与邻近板的耦合散射，需要连接轴对称管道坐标系与笛卡尔板坐标系中的谱表示。
AI.method: 串联两个Wiener–Hopf问题，以Weyl–Sommerfeld恒等式连接谱表示，并在人类监督和独立数值核查下使用大语言模型。
AI.result: 模型给出亚声速射流中圆柱管道旋转模态的辐射散射结果，案例表明经系统验证的大语言模型可加速繁琐代数工作。
AI.conclusion: 核心物理洞见由作者提出，大语言模型可在严格监督与独立验证下辅助理论流体力学研究。

title: Accelerating Variational Cone-Beam CT Reconstruction with Learned Warm Starts
summary: Variational reconstruction provides a rigorous framework for cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) by combining an explicit acquisition model with image priors. However, iterative optimization remains computationally demanding, particularly under severe noise and sparse-view conditions. Although learning-based methods achieve high reconstruction quality, they often replace the original variational formulation with learned optimization schemes or nonlinear equilibrium models. We propose a neural network-guided warm-start framework that accelerates variational reconstruction while preserving its original formulation. Projection data are first reconstructed using the Feldkamp-Davis-Kress (FDK) algorithm, and the resulting image is refined by an image-domain neural network. The network output is used solely to initialize the subsequent model-based optimization, leaving the forward model, data-fidelity term, regularization, and optimization scheme unchanged. A pre-regularization step further improves compatibility with the variational priors. Experiments on pelvic CT images from the SynthRAD2025 challenge show a more than threefold reduction in reconstruction time while maintaining comparable image quality.

AI.tldr: 神经网络暖启动在保留原始变分模型的同时，将锥束CT重建时间缩短至原来的三分之一以下。
AI.motivation: 变分锥束CT重建在强噪声和稀疏视角下计算昂贵，而部分学习方法会改变原始变分形式。
AI.method: 以神经网络细化FDK重建结果，经预正则化后仅用于初始化优化，保持前向模型、损失、正则项与优化方案不变。
AI.result: 在SynthRAD2025骨盆CT图像上的实验显示，重建速度提升超过三倍，同时保持相当的图像质量。
AI.conclusion: 学习式初始化能够加速模型驱动重建，而无需替换原有变分框架。

title: Actuarial-Informed Neural Networks: Constrained Deep Learning for Sex-Specific Multi-Population Longevity Forecasting
summary: We introduce Actuarial-Informed Neural Networks (AINN), a constrained deep learning framework for sex-specific multi-population longevity forecasting that embeds actuarial knowledge into LSTM training through differentiable penalty terms. Applied to a high-longevity 6-country cluster (Switzerland, Sweden, Norway, West Germany, Netherlands, Japan; 1956-2020), the framework is a challenger to the Li-Lee benchmark and unconstrained neural approaches. Our central finding is that monotonicity constraint intensity lambda functions as a continuous governance dial with a quantifiable accuracy-stability trade-off. At lambda = 0.01, 30-year forecast confidence intervals narrow by 6.5% at zero RMSE cost. At lambda = 0.1, they narrow by 25% at only +0.84% RMSE cost. This trade-off is invisible to standard hyperparameter optimizers, which select lambda by minimizing one-step RMSE, the wrong metric for structural constraints in recursive forecasting. The framework adds three contributions: (i) residual-calibrated process noise that eliminates double-counting in the dual uncertainty framework, reducing confidence intervals by 53-60%; (ii) a 5-seed model ensemble with a coefficient of variation of 1.06%; and (iii) a time-varying credibility weight Z(t) = exp(-alpha t) connecting to Buhlmann credibility theory for blending neural and actuarial predictions. A 10-year out-of-sample backtest (trained on 1956-2010, validated against observed HMD life expectancy for 2011-2020) yields a mean absolute error of 0.38 years, with 11 of 12 country x sex combinations within the 90% confidence interval. The model produces regulatory-grade outputs including Solvency Capital Requirements under the Swiss Solvency Test (ES 99.0%: +1.91 years, CHE Male) and Solvency II, reverse stress testing, and model-based stability verification (amplification ratio 1.02x).

AI.tldr: AINN将精算约束嵌入LSTM，实现分性别多群体寿命预测中的精度与长期稳定性权衡。
AI.motivation: 仅以单步预测误差选择约束强度，无法体现递归寿命预测中结构约束对长期稳定性的价值。
AI.method: 利用可微惩罚约束LSTM，结合残差校准噪声、五种子集成及随时间变化的可信度加权融合。
AI.result: 约束强度0.1使30年预测区间缩窄25%，RMSE仅增0.84%；十年样本外回测平均绝对误差为0.38年。
AI.conclusion: 单调性约束强度可作为连续治理调节参数，量化预测精度与稳定性的权衡，并支持监管相关输出。

title: Clustering-Based Artificial Tree Ensembles for Random Forest Approximation
summary: Random Forests (RFs) offer strong prediction performance but are difficult to interpret. Most representative trees (MRTs) and artificial representative trees (ARTs) provide surrogate explanations, but a single tree may miss patterns within a forest. We investigate benefits and limitations of clustering-based representative tree ensembles for RF surrogate modeling and assess the contribution of similarity-based clustering relative to random tree partitions. Using linear and nonlinear simulations and regression benchmarks, we evaluate fidelity, prediction accuracy, complexity, and prediction stability against equally sized ensembles of top-ranked MRTs and randomly selected trees. Increasing ensemble size generally improves fidelity, accuracy, and prediction stability. ART ensembles show higher fidelity in simulations and often greater prediction stability for small ensembles. Compared with random tree partitions, similarity-based clustering generally improves ART fidelity in simulations and often on benchmarks. On benchmark datasets, MRT-based ensembles generally achieve higher fidelity and prediction accuracy, whereas ART ensembles have fewer terminal nodes. ART ensembles provide compact surrogates when reduced complexity matters and their fidelity and prediction accuracy meet application requirements. These findings clarify both the trade-offs of representative tree ensembles as RF surrogates and the contribution of similarity-based clustering beyond random clustering.

AI.tldr: 聚类式人工代表树集成可紧凑近似随机森林，但保真度、预测精度与复杂度之间存在权衡。
AI.motivation: 随机森林难以解释，而单棵代表树可能遗漏森林内部的多样模式。
AI.method: 在线性与非线性模拟及回归基准上，对比聚类代表树集成、随机划分及同规模代表树和随机树集成。
AI.result: 相似性聚类通常改善人工树保真度；基准上原始代表树集成通常更准确，人工树集成则终端节点更少。
AI.conclusion: 当应用重视低复杂度且保真度与预测精度满足要求时，人工代表树集成可作为紧凑替代模型。

title: Recovered or Memorized? Investigating Dynamical Consistency and Faithfulness in World Model Latents
summary: World models develop internal simulators that can learn the structure and dynamics of an environment. It has been demonstrated that their internal representations are both meaningful and causal, but are these representations faithful to the governing dynamics of the environment they are learning? We introduce Anchored Recovery Certification (ARC), a procedure that utilizes a discrete Fréchet distance calculation with ground truth to evaluate dynamical consistency on candidate world models up to an affine gauge. We use the procedure on TD-MPC2 (decoder-free world model) that has learned the pendulum swing on an observation lift under varying hyperparameters at k = 5, 10, 25 steps. The model is then steered within a PCA-derived intervention subspace and compared against a ground-truth simulator using relative error to investigate dynamical faithfulness. ARC sufficiency held for TD-MPC2 most consistently at k = 10, with six of seven constraints statistically significant after Holm-Bonferroni correction, while the relative error between the simulator and the causal latent remained substantial. Further research could be conducted with decoder world models such as DreamerV3 (reconstruction loss) to investigate whether the results differ.
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Interpretability for Discovery (Interp4Discovery)

AI.tldr: ARC检验世界模型潜变量的动力学一致性，发现通过恢复认证仍不意味着动力学忠实。
AI.motivation: 世界模型的内部表示虽可具有意义和因果作用，但是否忠实遵循环境动力学仍不明确。
AI.method: 以离散Fréchet距离检验仿射等价下的动力学一致性，并对TD-MPC2潜变量实施干预，与真实模拟器比较相对误差。
AI.result: TD-MPC2在10步条件下最稳定地满足ARC充分条件，七项约束中六项校正后显著，但潜变量动力学相对误差仍较大。
AI.conclusion: 表示恢复的一致性证据不足以保证动力学忠实性，后续可检验带重建损失的解码式世界模型。

title: LEAP-LLM: Preserving lead-time structure for question-conditioned ECG interpretation
summary: The electrocardiogram (ECG) records cardiac electrical activity across multiple leads and is used for detecting cardiac abnormalities. Recent ECG-language models enable large language models (LLMs) to interpret cardiac signals and answer clinically relevant questions. However, existing ECG-language models typically encode the ECG independently of the clinical question, forcing the ECG representation to retain broad and potentially irrelevant signal information. Moreover, these models often aggregate information across leads which can obscure lead-specific details needed for a particular question. To tackle these limitations, we introduce LEAP-LLM, an ECG-LLM architecture for Lead-aware ECG Alignment with Prompt conditioning. LEAP-LLM uses the clinical question to guide ECG feature extraction while preserving explicit lead and temporal structure. Task-trained instruction representations distill information from the question and guide two complementary branches. The Lead branch captures question-relevant temporal patterns within each ECG lead, while the Temporal branch summarizes relevant information across leads at each temporal position. Together, they provide the LLM with compact, question-relevant ECG information while preserving lead and temporal structure.
