LEAP-LLM reduces modality-token count by 89.0% and prefill FLOPs by 7.2x on average relative to other ECG-LLMs baselines. Across four ECG benchmarks, LEAP-LLM achieves better performance, including a 3.4-percentage-point improvement in G12EC over the strongest prior ECG-specific method. We further show that the model adaptively emphasizes the clinically relevant anatomical lead groups for different cardiac abnormalities, with lead importance patterns consistent with established diagnostic knowledge, providing interpretable evidence that the predictions are supported by clinically meaningful ECG structure.

AI.tldr: LEAP-LLM以临床问题引导心电特征提取，在保留导联与时间结构的同时提高解读性能和效率。
AI.motivation: 现有心电语言模型通常独立于问题编码信号，且跨导联聚合可能掩盖问题所需的局部细节。
AI.method: 利用任务训练的指令表征引导导联分支与时间分支，提取紧凑且与问题相关的心电信息。
AI.result: 模态词元减少89.0%，预填充计算量平均降低7.2倍，四个基准性能更优且G12EC提升3.4个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 问题条件化的结构保留机制兼顾性能与效率，导联重要性模式也与既有临床诊断知识一致。

title: CARET: Clinical Assertion-Aware Residual Calibration for Medical Image-Text Alignment
summary: Medical vision--language models align radiographs with free-text reports, but radiology language distinguishes explicit findings, negation, uncertainty, and omission. Treating these report states as interchangeable during feature adaptation can change image predictions without supporting visual evidence. We introduce CARET, a parameter-efficient image-side adaptation method that retains pretrained image and text encoders and uses paired positive and negative clinical statements to define a low-dimensional semantic correction space. A bounded residual adjusts image features along these directions, while assertion-aware supervision distinguishes explicitly present and absent findings from uncertain or unmentioned ones. At inference, the adapter requires only an image; textual references remain fixed. In zero-shot classification, CARET achieves 67.80\% accuracy on CheXpert 5$\times$200 and 65.20\% on RSNA. These scores exceed the published CLEFT-LoRA results by 1.06 and 0.27 percentage points, respectively. Comparisons to literature baselines are informative but not controlled for differences in pretraining and evaluation protocols. Ablations across eight components identify the four-state distinction and assertion objective as major contributors, with task-dependent effects for nonmention preservation and pair alignment.

AI.tldr: CARET通过断言感知的残差校准，以参数高效的图像侧适配改善医学图文对齐。
AI.motivation: 混同报告中明确存在、明确不存在、不确定和未提及的状态，可能导致缺乏视觉证据的预测变化。
AI.method: 固定预训练编码器，以成对正负临床陈述构建低维校正空间，并用断言感知监督约束有界图像残差。
AI.result: CheXpert与RSNA零样本准确率分别为67.80%和65.20%，较已发表CLEFT-LoRA高1.06和0.27个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 四状态区分与断言目标是主要贡献因素，但与文献基线的比较未控制预训练和评估协议差异。

title: RescueVLM: Model-Agnostic Vision-Language Framework for Rescue Drone Imagery
summary: A single unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) mission over an incident site produces hundreds of images, far more than a rescue commander can review under time pressure, and human screening of destruction imagery carries a documented psychological cost. The two obvious remedies both fail in search and rescue (SAR) practice: cloud vision-language model (VLM) services are excluded because the imagery must not leave the incident network under GDPR and German civil-protection (BOS) rules, and fine-tuned specialist detectors age quickly while retraining and re-certifying them exceeds most SAR organizations resources. We present RescueVLM, an open-source, training-free and model-agnostic triage tool built on SketchVLM: a general-purpose open-weight VLM runs fully on-premise and is swapped for a newer model through a simple dropdown selection, so triage quality grows with the underlying models because all task knowledge lives in prompts and an output contract rather than in trained weights. One natural-language query over a mission folder returns a ranked shortlist with per-image justifications, editable SVG overlay annotations, and a GPS map of the hits. In a qualitative evaluation on German fire-brigade field data from three real deployments and a live fire exercise, a single query condenses an entire survey mission into a handful of annotated frames that a commander can review at a glance.

AI.tldr: RescueVLM是本地运行、无需训练且模型无关的救援无人机图像筛选工具。
AI.motivation: 救援影像数量庞大且人工筛查有心理负担，而隐私合规限制云服务，专用模型维护成本也较高。
AI.method: 基于SketchVLM用提示词和输出规范驱动可替换的开放权重模型，生成排序图像、解释、可编辑标注及GPS地图。
AI.result: 在三次真实部署和一次实火演练的定性评估中，单次查询可将整次任务影像压缩为少量带标注画面。
AI.conclusion: 该框架展示了无需专门训练、在现场网络内辅助指挥员快速审阅救援影像的可行性。

title: Trajectory-Based Bayesian Discovery of a Host-Pathogen Model from Quasi-Steady-State Observations
summary: System identification of nonlinear dynamical systems becomes challenging when the measured data come from a nearly settled state. We study this situation in the case of a bistable host-pathogen interaction model with a cubic term, whose seven true mechanisms are hidden among twenty candidate terms. The data are from one noise-free trajectory on a quasi-steady-state observed window and the initial state. In this situation, classical sparse identification approaches fail to identify the correct mechanisms as the candidate library becomes ill-conditioned along the quasi-steady-state trajectory. To address this, we propose an alternative approach in which sparse Bayesian learning and $\ell_{0}$ iterative hard thresholding with pursuit provide a good start, and a two-swap climb on the Bayesian evidence of the candidate ODE solutions recovers the true model. Our results show successful model recovery, i.e., correct identification of its support and accurate estimation of its coefficients, as validated by exhaustive scoring.

AI.tldr: 该研究以轨迹级贝叶斯证据搜索，从准稳态观测中恢复双稳态宿主—病原体动力学模型。
AI.motivation: 准稳态轨迹使候选项库病态，导致经典稀疏辨识方法难以找出真实动力学机制。
AI.method: 以稀疏贝叶斯学习和ℓ₀迭代硬阈值追踪初始化，再对候选微分方程解的贝叶斯证据进行双交换爬山搜索。
AI.result: 在单条无噪声轨迹及初始状态的设定下，成功从20个候选项恢复7个真实机制并准确估计系数，经穷举评分验证。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹级贝叶斯证据搜索可在该准稳态观测设定中克服经典稀疏辨识的失效问题。

title: Foundation Model Fine-Tuning with Attention-based Multi-View Fusion for Multi-Task Cardiac Function Assessment
summary: In cardio-oncology, left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) is the standard biomarker for monitoring cardiac function during cancer therapy. However, its estimation from echocardiography is highly operator dependent, and clinically meaningful declines are often detected only after myocardial injury has progressed, motivating automated methods for standardized assessment and earlier detection of LV dysfunction. To address this need, we propose a multi-task framework integrating cardiac cycle-based temporal standardization, multi-view spatiotemporal feature extraction, and joint optimization for LVEF estimation and LV dysfunction classification. Apical four- and two-chamber echocardiographic sequences are temporally standardized by sampling a clip over an estimated cardiac cycle before being processed by the EchoPrime foundation model, which is fine-tuned end-to-end within the proposed architecture. View-specific features are fused through an attention-based aggregation module to generate a patient-level embedding, from which two task-specific prediction heads estimate continuous LVEF and binary LV dysfunction. To broaden the LVEF distribution encountered during training, samples from the MIMIC-IV-ECHO dataset are incorporated using a balanced sampling strategy. Evaluated on the EchoRisk-MICCAI Challenge, our method achieves an MAE of 4.003 for LVEF estimation (Task 1) and an AUC of 0.764 for LV dysfunction detection (Task 2) on the validation set, demonstrating the effectiveness of foundation model fine-tuning with attention-based multi-view fusion for automated cardiac function assessment in cardio-oncology.
comment: 9 pages, 1 figure. Original pre-peer-review manuscript. Accepted for publication in the MICCAI 2026 Satellite Events (Workshops and Challenges) proceedings. The accepted version includes methodological revisions and is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 该研究结合基础模型微调与注意力多视图融合，同时估计左室射血分数和识别左室功能障碍。
AI.motivation: 超声射血分数估计依赖操作者，且有临床意义的下降常在心肌损伤进展后才被发现。
AI.method: 按心动周期标准化双视图序列，端到端微调EchoPrime，以注意力融合和双任务预测头联合训练并引入平衡采样。
AI.result: 在EchoRisk-MICCAI验证集上，射血分数估计MAE为4.003，左室功能障碍检测AUC为0.764。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持基础模型微调与注意力多视图融合用于心脏肿瘤学中的自动化心功能评估。

title: What to Practice Next? Latent Profile-Guided Task Selection for Skill-Evolving LLM Agents
summary: Task selection shapes the experiences available for skill evolution in LLM agents, yet fixed practice schedules overlook differences in skill requirements and evolving task value. Most existing methods, however, rely on fixed schedules or scalar measures of progress, leaving nonstationary skill demands unaddressed. We propose SPG-Select, a framework for allocating limited practice budget using a multidimensional profile inferred from binary outcomes via MIRT. The framework predicts surrogate progress, defined as the difference between consecutive profile estimates, and prioritizes progress in dimensions with larger estimated proficiency gaps. Our SPG-Select-R policy combines these predictions with uncertainty-based exploration and periodic restarting to accommodate nonstationarity. We evaluate SPG-Select on ALFWorld and WebShop with three skill-evolution backends. In the reported runs, SPG-Select-R achieves higher mean held-out terminal success than uniform sampling in all six backend-benchmark combinations, with gains of 1.49-13.18 percentage points on ALFWorld and 0.93-3.13 points on WebShop. Under a predictable linear surrogate model and boundedness assumptions, we establish a high-probability dynamic pseudo-regret bound for surrogate task allocation in terms of parameter path variation.

AI.tldr: SPG-Select依据潜在多维技能画像分配练习预算，提升技能演化型语言模型智能体的任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 固定练习计划和标量进步指标难以反映不同任务的技能需求及其随训练变化的价值。
AI.method: 以多维项目反应理论从二元结果推断技能画像，预测进步并优先补足短板，结合不确定性探索与周期重启。
AI.result: 六种后端与基准组合均优于均匀采样，ALFWorld提升1.49—13.18个百分点，WebShop提升0.93—3.13个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 技能画像引导的任务选择可改善有限预算下的练习分配，并在指定假设下具有高概率动态伪遗憾界。

title: LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.6 Technical Report
summary: Recent advances in audio-driven avatar video generation have enabled increasingly realistic synthesis, yet achieving precise lip-audio synchronization, natural, human-like motion, and visual consistency over long sequences remains challenging. We present LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.6, which builds on LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.5 to improve expressive naturalness and reduce error accumulation during extended generation, e.g., exaggerated lip movements and overly red, temporally unstable lip coloration, enhance the naturalness of facial expressions and coordinated head and body movements. These improvements are driven by a refined post-training pipeline that integrates reinforcement learning, improved classifier-free guidance strategies for DMD-based few-step distillation, long-video rollouts, and on-policy distillation. Together, these refinements improve expressive realism and enable the generation of videos exceeding 10 minutes while maintaining visual quality and temporal consistency. Arena evaluations show that LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.6 outperforms its predecessor and competing commercial audio-driven avatar models, demonstrating the effectiveness of the improved post-training pipeline.

AI.tldr: LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.6改进后训练流程，提升音频驱动数字人的表现自然度与长视频一致性。
AI.motivation: 音频驱动数字人仍面临唇音同步、自然运动及长序列视觉一致性难题，且持续生成会累积误差。
AI.method: 融合强化学习、面向DMD少步蒸馏的改进无分类器引导、长视频展开及在策略蒸馏。
AI.result: 模型可生成超过10分钟且保持视觉质量与时序一致性的视频，竞技场评估优于前代及参评商业模型。
AI.conclusion: 改进的后训练流程能够增强表情与动作真实感，并缓解长时生成中的误差累积。

title: Identification and external validation of the sets of 4-, 6-, 8-, 12-, and 24-hour CGM motifs
summary: There is growing interest in using CGM for purposes other than those initially intended. Recent work of Lobo et al. identified $\Omega$: a set of motifs such that almost any daily CGM profile (the 24-hour CGM time series starting at midnight) can be classified - matched to a motif in $\Omega$. This work generalizes the prior work by identifying sets of motifs for 4-, 6-, 8-, 12-, and 24-hr CGM profiles where an $x$-hr CGM profile does not have to be 24 hours in length, and does not have to start at midnight. The prior work methods are modified to identify the five new sets of motifs using data from the same 6 studies in the original work. The newly identified sets were subjected to rigorous external validation using a data set comprised of data from 21 studies (3,455 subjects, 289,592 days of CGM data). The external validation data set has both temporal and geographic transportability and addresses limitations of the data set used to define the five new sets of motifs. The results of the external validation indicate that the prior work generalizes well: the performance of each $x$-hr set of motifs on the external validation set is almost identical to that obtained for $\Omega$. The generalization of the original work broadens the potential use cases of the framework to include short term predictions (e.g., impending hypoglycemia) and diagnostics which rely on detecting changes in CGM time series which are less than 24 hours in length.

AI.tldr: 该研究建立并外部验证多种时长的连续血糖监测模式集，将全天模式框架扩展至灵活时间窗口。
AI.motivation: 原有模式框架仅针对午夜起始的24小时血糖序列，限制了短时预测与诊断用途。
AI.method: 利用原有6项研究建立4、6、8、12和24小时模式集，再以21项研究中3455名受试者的289592天数据验证。
AI.result: 各时长模式集在具有时间与地理迁移性的外部数据上，表现均与原全天模式集几乎相同。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可推广至非午夜起始及不足24小时的血糖序列，为短期预测和变化检测诊断拓展潜在用途。

title: Multi-Assay Antibody Developability Prediction with Shared Structure-Language Representations
summary: Early assessment of antibody developability is critical in drug discovery, but computational approaches remain limited by the scarcity of experimental data. We explore two strategies for working within that limit. First, we designed per-residue physicochemical descriptors encoding the local structural environment, including new terms such as directional charge asymmetry and screened electrostatic potential. These feed a convolutional network, combined with protein language model (PLM) embeddings in a two-stream architecture: the two are encoded and predicted independently and merged only at the prediction stage. Second, a shared trunk with per-assay heads passes information between related assays. Both are implemented in the Multi-Assay Developability Model (MADM) and evaluated on eight assays: HIC, heparin affinity (HAC), AC-SINS, and polyspecificity ELISA against BVP, dsDNA, insulin, ovalbumin and soluble membrane proteins (SMP), with labels from 29 open sources. Structural descriptors match or exceed PLM embeddings (AbLang2, ESM2) on several assays; combining the streams gives a small but consistent gain in accuracy and reduces seed-to-seed variance. Multi-assay training raises Spearman rho for ovalbumin and SMP by about 0.1, where assays correlate and share sequence space. Under cluster-split cross-validation the strongest results are for HAC, ovalbumin, insulin, SMP and HIC (rho = 0.70-0.82); AC-SINS, BVP and dsDNA are weaker (0.50-0.55). In these three, sequence clusters largely coincide with data source, so a held-out fold measures transfer to differently calibrated measurements as well as to new sequences. On the 80-antibody GDPa3 hold-out, performance falls by rho around 0.1 for all but SMP (0.22). Transfer to the VHH panel of Ginkgo GDPa5 gives comparable results, and scFv validation against binary SMP labels yields F1 = 0.89, AUC = 0.95.

AI.tldr: MADM融合结构描述符与蛋白质语言模型表征，通过多测定共享学习提升抗体可开发性预测。
AI.motivation: 抗体可开发性的早期评估对药物发现至关重要，但实验数据稀缺限制了计算预测。
AI.method: 采用结构描述符与语言模型嵌入的双流预测融合，并以共享主干和测定专属预测头联合学习八类测定。
AI.result: 五类测定的聚类划分验证相关系数达0.70—0.82，独立抗体集表现下降，scFv验证AUC为0.95。
AI.conclusion: 结构与语言表征互补，多测定共享可改善相关任务，但数据来源差异仍限制跨数据集泛化。

title: Scaling Channel-Adaptive Self-Supervised Learning
summary: Recent advances in self-supervised pre-training of foundation models for natural images have made them a popular choice for various visual systems and applications. Self-supervised strategies are also promising in non-RGB scientific imaging domains such as in biology, medical and satellite imagery, but their broader application is hampered by heterogeneity in channel composition and semantics between relevant datasets: two datasets may contain different numbers of channels, and these may reveal distinct aspects of an object or scene. Recent works on channel adaptive strategies report substantial advantages for those that account for variable channel compositions without sacrificing the ability to jointly encode channels; yet, how these strategies behave at scale remains unclear. We here show that, surprisingly, trained across large-scale datasets, independent-encoding of channels outperforms joint-encoding methods by a substantial margin. We validate this result along an extensive set of experiments on various datasets from cell microscopy to geospatial imagery. Our DINO BoC approach sets a new state-of-the-art across challenging benchmarks, including generalization to out-of-distribution tasks and unseen channel combinations. We open-source code and model weights for a new general-purpose feature extractor for fluorescent microscopy.

AI.tldr: 大规模训练下，独立编码通道的DINO BoC优于联合编码方法，并提升科学图像表征泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 科学影像数据的通道数量和语义差异阻碍自监督模型通用化，现有通道自适应策略的规模化表现尚不明确。
AI.method: 采用独立通道编码的DINO BoC，在细胞显微至地理空间影像的多个数据集上开展大规模实验。
AI.result: 独立编码显著优于联合编码，DINO BoC在包括分布外任务和未见通道组合的挑战基准上达到最佳水平。
AI.conclusion: 大规模科学影像预训练可受益于独立通道编码，研究同时开放了荧光显微通用特征提取器的代码和权重。

title: KUDEX: A Zero-Shot Decompositional Framework for Logical Analysis in Natural Language
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at generating fluent text, they often struggle with multi-step logical reasoning with inferential connections among statements. We introduce KUDEX (Knowledge-Upward-Downward Reasoning Extension), a novel zero-shot, decompositional framework for analyzing and verifying logical relationships in natural language. Unlike traditional approaches that rely on surface-level entailment checks, KUDEX leverages LLMs to decompose reasoning into atomic primitives and constructs transparent reasoning graphs that serve both as execution traces and audit logs. Our framework includes a general prompt adaptation pipeline that adapts to diverse reasoning tasks without additional fine-tuning or domain-specific pipelines. Through comprehensive experiments on benchmarks across four domains, we demonstrate that KUDEX provides superior performance compared to existing methods, offering a more granular and robust framework for assessing logical relationships between statements.

AI.tldr: KUDEX以零样本分解和透明推理图增强自然语言逻辑关系的分析与验证。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型虽能生成流畅文本，却常难以处理语句间具有推断联系的多步逻辑推理。
AI.method: 利用大语言模型将推理分解为原子单元并构建可审计推理图，通过通用提示适配不同任务而无需微调。
AI.result: 四个领域的基准实验显示，KUDEX优于现有方法，并提供更细粒度、更稳健的逻辑关系评估。
AI.conclusion: 零样本推理分解与透明推理图为跨任务逻辑分析提供了有效且可审计的框架。

title: Technical Report of Auriga's 1:10 Scale Autonomous Vehicle Robot
summary: This report presents the design and implementation of Auriga Robotics' 1:10 scale autonomous vehicle, developed at Shahid Beheshti University's Robotics and Intelligent Automation Laboratory. The platform integrates a custom mechanical chassis, a distributed embedded system based on ESP32 microcontrollers, and a Jetson Orin NX module for high-level perception and control. The embedded layer manages sensor interfacing, real-time data acquisition, and actuator control, while the Jetson handles environment perception through deep-learning--based lane, sign, and traffic light detection, as well as decision-making and trajectory control. System communication is achieved via structured UART links, ensuring synchronized operation between perception and control subsystems. The vehicle's software stack incorporates ROS, modular firmware design, and multiple control algorithms---Stanley, PID, and Pure Pursuit---to achieve stable autonomous navigation in structured driving scenarios. The overall system demonstrates robust performance and reliability in urban-like environments, serving as a modular research platform for future autonomous driving studies.
comment: 62 pages, 32 figures, 11 tables, 1 algorithm. Technical report of Team Auriga's 2025 1:10 scale autonomous vehicle platform (Robotics and Intelligent Automation Laboratory, Shahid Beheshti University)

AI.tldr: Auriga构建了融合分布式嵌入式控制与深度学习感知的1:10比例自动驾驶研究平台。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在开发可在结构化驾驶场景自主导航、支持后续自动驾驶研究的模块化车辆平台。
AI.method: 集成定制底盘、ESP32、Jetson Orin NX、ROS及UART通信，并结合深度学习感知与多种轨迹控制算法。
AI.result: 系统在类城市环境中表现出稳健性和可靠性，并在结构化驾驶场景实现稳定自主导航。
AI.conclusion: 该软硬件协同设计可作为模块化研究平台，支持未来自动驾驶系统研究。

title: Self-Improvement Memory Enables Continual Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Harness optimization is often studied with a fixed policy model and benchmark. When either changes, the optimizer must decide which parts of an evolved harness to reuse or revise, but the harness alone may not explain why earlier edits were made or how they performed. In this work, we study Continual Recursive Self-Improvement (CRSI), a setting for continuing existing harness-optimization methods across compatible benchmarks or policy models. We propose Self-Improvement Memory (SIM) for the harness optimizer, rather than the task-solving policy. SIM groups edits by recurring harness problem and records their rationale, predicted and observed outcomes, and evaluation context. New attempts extend this history as optimization continues. In our experiments across four domains, SIM achieves higher final scores than harness-only and root-cause-only continuation in cross-dataset and pairwise cross-model comparisons. Across ten independent source runs in coding, paired continuations with SIM improve final scores by an average of 2.36 points over harness-only continuation ($p=0.003$).

AI.tldr: 自改进记忆SIM记录优化编辑的依据与效果，提升跨数据集和跨模型的持续递归自改进表现。
AI.motivation: 基准或策略模型变化时，仅有优化后的运行框架不足以解释历史修改依据，妨碍有效复用与修订。
AI.method: 为框架优化器建立按重复问题组织的记忆，持续记录编辑理由、预期与实际结果及评估情境。
AI.result: 四领域实验中SIM优于两类延续基线，编码任务十次配对实验平均较仅保留框架提高2.36分。
AI.conclusion: 保存优化过程的解释与评估历史，有助于在兼容任务和模型之间延续自改进。

title: Exstill: The Most Efficient Single-Chip Processor for the Next Token
summary: Generating a token with a language model requires a fixed amount of arithmetic, whose energy sets a floor beneath any hardware. For Qwen3-1.7B at a 16K-token context, gate-level measurements at 5 nm place this floor at 0.89 mJ per token, yet an NVIDIA B300 spends 391-1,120x that. The excess is the price of generality, software layers, programmable hardware and moving weights and key-value (KV) caches from external memory, and it widens with each process generation. We present a co-design approach that brings token generation close to this floor and then lowers the floor itself, optimizing silicon and model together in a gate-level search loop. Fixing one model architecture in the datapath, with weights still loadable, and holding weights and every conversation's KV cache on-die, a pre-silicon 5 nm design brings an unchanged Qwen3-1.7B token to 3.4x its floor. Co-designing the model with the circuits at fixed quality lowers the floor to 0.29 mJ and the token to 0.52 mJ, 1.8x the new floor and less than the baseline model's arithmetic alone, while on-die capacity grows from one user to twelve. Against a measured B300 serving the same twelve users, the design decodes each user's tokens 110x faster at 690x lower energy. To show that one fixed architecture can serve, as a co-processor, the latency-critical workloads around a frontier model, we introduce Polyglot-DC (1.7B and 4B, each with its own design), specialized for each job by distillation and task-specific training into its own weights. As a drafter it speeds single-user speculative decoding of large open models by up to 6.6x at the maximum reasoning effort. Its guard returns multilingual verdicts in a millisecond or less, within a point of the strongest open guard. Its agent and financial-reasoning models lead comparable open models on established benchmarks, with a reasoning turn falling from seconds to tens of milliseconds.
comment: 62 pages plus references (72 total), 16 figures, 22 tables. Technical report

AI.tldr: Exstill通过固定架构、片上存储和模型电路协同设计，大幅降低语言模型解码的能耗与延迟。
AI.motivation: 通用硬件、软件层和片外数据搬运使词元生成能耗远高于算术运算所需的能耗下限。
AI.method: 在门级搜索中协同优化模型与电路，将可加载权重及KV缓存保留片上，并训练专用Polyglot-DC模型。
AI.result: 5纳米流片前设计实现每词元0.52毫焦，服务12用户时较实测B300解码快110倍、能耗低690倍。
AI.conclusion: 架构专用化与软硬件协同设计可逼近并降低算术能耗下限，为前沿模型的低延迟辅助任务提供协处理方案。

title: Guided Group Featurizers (GGF): Improving Block-Sparse Featurizers with Object-Guided Learning
summary: Block-sparse featurizers (BSFs) use groups of learned directions to capture the multidimensional structure of visual concepts. However, grouping alone does not ensure that information about a concept is consolidated within a single group. We introduce Guided Group Featurizers (GGF), a novel object-guided extension that uses object annotations for initialization and training while preserving the BSF architecture. We assess whether each group's strongest response regions share an object type, part or material across images. Blinded reviews give GGF groups an average semantic coherence score of $94.1\pm0.9$%, versus $83.0\pm1.9$% for SLiCS and $65.3\pm2.2$% for supervised Vanilla BSF. GGF's consolidation advantage extends to unguided categories: one selected group per category covers $65.6\pm2.4$% of target-containing crops, versus $58.2\pm2.2$% for supervised Vanilla BSF, at approximately 5% false-positive rates for both. Across COCO and VOC, GGF also improves single-group object Capture and localization over Vanilla BSFs, SLiCS and Concept-SAE. Its groups produce more focused and reproducible object responses while supporting recognition and retaining associations under rotation, scale and brightness changes. GGF also uses fewer learned parameters than Concept-SAE and shorter recorded VOC training loops than both supervised alternatives. These findings support object guidance for organizing more interpretable BSF groups and show that response concentration extends to categories excluded from guidance.

AI.tldr: GGF以对象标注引导块稀疏特征分组，使视觉概念响应更集中、更可解释，并泛化至未引导类别。
AI.motivation: 块稀疏特征化器虽能用方向组捕捉多维视觉概念，却不能保证同一概念的信息集中在单组内。
AI.method: 保持块稀疏架构，以对象标注引导初始化和训练，并通过盲评及COCO、VOC实验评估语义一致性和定位。
AI.result: GGF语义一致性达94.1%，高于SLiCS的83.0%和监督Vanilla BSF的65.3%，且改善未引导类别覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 对象引导能形成更集中、可复现且可解释的特征组，其优势可扩展至未参与引导的类别。

title: FiReIQ: Field-Level Confidence Estimation with Reasoning and Image Quality in Document Extraction
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in structured document extraction, yet their deployment in high-stakes applications requires reliable confidence estimates for individual fields. Existing uncertainty estimators often aggregate signals across an entire generation, obscuring field-specific reasoning uncertainty while overlooking visual degradations that may lead to confident extraction errors. To address these limitations, we introduce FiReIQ, a field-level confidence estimation framework that combines field-aligned reasoning signals from a single VLM generation with local and global image-quality features through quality-conditioned visual fusion. To facilitate systematic evaluation, we further introduce FiReIQ-Bench, a benchmark spanning financial receipts and legal contracts. Experiments with two reasoning VLMs show that FiReIQ consistently improves confidence discrimination, selective prediction, and probabilistic accuracy over existing estimators. These gains extend to private financial service data, where FiReIQ improves AUROC by 6.8% and coverage at 95% precision by 10.6% over an existing baseline. Together, these results highlight the potential of FiReIQ to reduce manual review while enabling more reliable document automation.

AI.tldr: FiReIQ融合字段推理信号与图像质量特征，提升文档抽取的字段级置信度估计。
AI.motivation: 现有估计器常汇总整段生成信号，掩盖字段特有的不确定性，并忽略视觉退化引起的高置信错误。
AI.method: 将单次视觉语言模型生成中的字段对齐推理信号与局部、全局图像质量条件融合，并构建FiReIQ-Bench。
AI.result: 两种推理模型实验均获改善，私有金融数据上AUROC提升6.8%，95%精确率下覆盖率提升10.6%。
AI.conclusion: 融合推理与图像质量的字段级估计有望减少人工复核，提高高风险文档自动化的可靠性。

title: Découpage: Directorial Audio-Visual Control for Long Multi-Shot Video Generation
summary: In cinematic storytelling, sound and visual transitions do not always coincide in lockstep: dialogue frequently bridges across cuts to reveal reactions or introduces new scenes via J- and L-cuts, while deliberate silences pace the scene. Existing audio-visual generative frameworks, however, lack explicit mechanisms to coordinate independent visual and acoustic timing over extended horizons. As narrative duration and shot complexity scale, these systems struggle to maintain long-range dialogue pacing, often hallucinating speech during intended silences or erroneously driving mouth movements on silent listeners. To enable fine-grained cinematic control, we present DECOUPAGE, a screenplay-driven framework for long-form, multi-shot, and multi-character joint audio-video generation. Rather than coupling modality boundaries by default, DECOUPAGE uncouples generation into independently bounded visual and acoustic tracks governed by persistent character identities. DECOUPAGE builds on a joint audio-video diffusion model with dual-schedule temporal cross-attention, incorporating a directorial Lip-sync mechanism that selectively decouples speech conditioning from visual facial dynamics during off-screen dialogue. On multi-shot conversational benchmarks, DECOUPAGE achieves precise control over shot transitions, audio timing, and visibility-aware lip synchronization, directing 15- to 60-second screenplay-driven audio-video generation with multimodal coherence.

AI.tldr: DECOUPAGE通过独立控制视听时间轨道，实现剧本驱动的长时多镜头音视频生成。
AI.motivation: 现有框架难以协调独立的视听节奏，易在静默时生成语音或驱动倾听者嘴部运动。
AI.method: 基于联合音视频扩散模型，结合双调度时间交叉注意力、持久角色身份与选择性口型解耦机制。
AI.result: 在多镜头对话基准中，实现15至60秒生成的镜头切换、音频时序及可见性感知口型同步控制。
AI.conclusion: 独立视听轨道与导演式口型控制支持兼具精细时序控制和多模态连贯性的长视频生成。

title: SLICES: A Benchmark and Evaluation Framework for Self-Supervised Learning on Sparse ICU Time Series
summary: Self-supervised learning (SSL) results for intensive care unit (ICU) time series are hard to compare when data processing, encoders, and adaptation vary together. We present SLICES, a benchmark and evaluation framework for comparing and extending SSL methods under a shared clinical setup. It fixes 24-hour value and observation-mask inputs, a Transformer encoder, patient-level splits, four endpoints, two adaptation protocols, and five matched seeds across MIMIC-IV, eICU-CRD, and their pooled union. Masked autoencoding (MAE), joint-embedding prediction (JEPA), and contrastive learning provide reference implementations. Among these objectives, MAE leads mean AUPRC in all nine frozen classification comparisons, also under converged probes, and in seven of nine fine-tuning comparisons. Fine-tuned MAE leads hospital mortality at full labels and scores higher than a supervised Transformer of the same architecture at every label fraction, and SSL fine-tuning gives the lowest length-of-stay error. Supervised baselines remain strong elsewhere: GRU-D leads 24-hour mortality and XGBoost leads acute kidney injury in all three regimes. Rankings depend on the adaptation protocol, the comparator set, and whether the probe loss matches the metric. A two-seed MIMIC-IV rerun with the maintained code stays within two across-seed SDs of the reference in all 48 downstream runs. The code repository supports new objectives, shared downstream evaluation, and regeneration of the reference results, so new SSL methods can be compared with these references under the same conditions. Generalization to unseen hospitals is not tested here and is the natural next extension.
comment: Accepted at the Machine Learning for Health (ML4H) Symposium 2026, Proceedings track (PMLR 346). 28 pages, 8 figures, 21 tables. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: SLICES统一稀疏ICU时序自监督学习评测条件，揭示方法表现对适配协议和任务的依赖。
AI.motivation: 数据处理、编码器和适配方式同时变化，使ICU时序自监督学习结果难以公平比较。
AI.method: 在三个数据设置中固定输入、编码器、患者划分及评测协议，比较掩码自编码、联合嵌入预测与对比学习。
AI.result: 掩码自编码在九项冻结分类比较中全部领先，在九项微调比较中七项领先，但部分任务仍由监督基线占优。
AI.conclusion: 统一条件有助于可靠比较自监督方法，但排名依赖评测设置，且尚未测试对未见医院的泛化。

title: UnSPAD: Uncertainty-aware Single Photon Burst Photography
summary: We introduce UnSPAD, an uncertainty-aware burst photography framework capable of fusing and denoising arbitrarily long sequences of binary single photon avalanche diode (SPAD) measurements. Unlike prior methods that require fixed burst lengths or rely on powerful generative priors, UnSPAD combines learned motion estimation with uncertainty-informed measurement fusion and denoising to produce temporally consistent, hallucination-free reconstructions. UnSPAD first forms an initial scene estimate by averaging flow-aligned binary frames. UnSPAD then uses per-pixel uncertainty maps to perform uncertainty-aware denoising; the denoiser is informed about which regions accumulated the fewest observations (and thus contain the most relative shot noise) due to motion, occlusion, or alignment errors. This two-step reconstruction pipeline helps mitigate hallucinations---outside of the structure implicitly introduced by the flow estimates, the initial scenes estimates are entirely prior-free. Experiments on real and simulated SPAD and quantum image sensor (QIS) benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art reconstruction quality, improved temporal consistency, and superior color fidelity relative to the state of the art.
comment: Accepted at The Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV) 2027

AI.tldr: UnSPAD利用运动估计和不确定性感知融合去噪，重建任意长度的单光子二值连拍序列。
AI.motivation: 既有方法受固定连拍长度或强生成先验限制，难以兼顾重建可靠性与时间一致性。
AI.method: 先对光流对齐的二值帧求均值得到初始场景，再利用逐像素不确定性图指导去噪。
AI.result: 在真实及模拟SPAD和QIS基准上取得最先进重建质量，并改善时间一致性与色彩保真度。
AI.conclusion: 基于观测融合与不确定性建模的两步流程，可减少生成幻觉并提升单光子连拍重建质量。

title: The opposing informational effects of AI trading
summary: Better artificial intelligence (AI) can improve individual forecasts without making prices better at revealing new information. In a competitive market with resource-constrained forecasting, more capable algorithms can substitute analysis of public records for private observations, reducing the private information aggregated into prices. The same trades can convey sophisticated public-data analysis to investors unable to perform it themselves. We establish conditions under which these effects coexist and the private benefit of further computation falls. Numerical equilibrium calculations and finite-data neural-market experiments exhibit corresponding patterns. Out-of-sample earnings forecasts and controlled language-model tasks show related patterns of information substitution. In the neural experiment, wider adoption increases the predictive value of price for limited observers, reduces it for advanced observers, and lowers the benefit of upgrading by 44\%. Retraining by investors who did not upgrade can amplify the loss of private-information precision. The informational consequences of AI trading depend on what prices reveal and who can use them.

AI.tldr: AI交易可传播公共数据分析，却因替代私人信息采集而削弱价格中的私人信息含量。
AI.motivation: 个体预测能力提升未必使价格更有效地揭示新信息，需要区分不同观察者获得的信息收益。
AI.method: 构建资源受限预测的竞争市场模型，并结合数值均衡、神经市场实验及预测和语言模型任务验证。
AI.result: 神经市场中，更广泛采用AI提高有限观察者的价格预测价值、降低高级观察者的价值，并使升级收益下降44%。
AI.conclusion: AI交易的信息效应取决于价格揭示何种信息及谁能利用这些信息，而非仅取决于预测能力。

title: Passage-Focused Soft Coordination for Hierarchical Multi-Robot Navigation in Bottleneck Environments
summary: In multi-robot navigation, rigid global schedules are sensitive to execution deviations, while local methods lack long-horizon coordination. We propose a passage-focused framework combining soft global coordination with flexible local execution. A passage-induced graph of convex sets supports priority-ordered planning with two levels of soft coordination. Passage-aware route selection accounts for passage usage and traversal directions, while route-restricted continuous space-time planning penalizes temporal conflicts. The resulting references guide a model predictive path integral controller that avoids collisions online. Adaptive temporal and geometric tracking accommodates execution deviations, while selective replanning maintains coordination without rigid trajectory reservations. Across 1,200 instances in 4 different environments with 5-30 robots, the framework achieves a near-perfect success rate and outperforms evaluated baselines in makespan and flowtime. Hardware experiments with 8 robots demonstrate successful completion of all trials without collisions. These results highlight the effectiveness of passage-focused coordination in balancing long-horizon cooperation with flexible execution.
comment: 9 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters

AI.tldr: 面向瓶颈环境的通道聚焦软协调框架，兼顾多机器人长期协作与局部灵活执行。
AI.motivation: 刚性全局调度易受执行偏差影响，而局部导航方法缺乏长时域协调能力。
AI.method: 利用通道诱导凸集图进行软协调规划，结合模型预测路径积分控制、自适应跟踪与选择性重规划。
AI.result: 在四种环境的1200个实例中成功率接近百分之百，完工时间和总行程时间优于基线，八机器人实测全部无碰撞完成。
AI.conclusion: 通道聚焦软协调无需刚性轨迹预留，即可有效平衡长时域协作和执行灵活性。

title: Label-Free Detection of Structural Bias in LLM-Based Recommender Systems via Randomized Paraphrasing: The Case of Verbosity
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as recommenders in e-commerce and conversational shopping systems, where they select a product from a set of retrieved candidates described in natural language. Their decisions should depend on relevance to the user query, but may also be influenced by surface-level properties of the descriptions, such as their length. Detecting such structural biases is difficult because relevance labels are rarely available. We propose a label-free framework to audit LLM-based recommender systems for structural bias. Candidate descriptions are rewritten by randomly assigned paraphrasing models and presented in random order. We prove that, if the recommender's choice is invariant to these rewritings, every paraphraser is selected with equal probability, yielding a statistical test that requires no relevance labels. A four-step statistical pipeline tests this property and quantifies the contribution of each description feature while controlling for query-product relevance. We apply the framework to verbosity bias on 20{,}000 product queries and nine recommender LLMs from five model families. After controlling for the measured relevance signals, description length has a positive effect on selection in all nine models, increasing the odds of selection by up to 38% per standard deviation of length. Relevance remains the primary driver of recommendations, while verbosity acts as a consistent secondary signal whose strength depends on the model family. Since the framework needs only black-box access and no annotations, it can be run as a routine audit of deployed shopping assistants, and we provide an auditing protocol with cost and sample-size guidance.

AI.tldr: 随机释义支持无标签审计，并揭示九种大模型推荐器均存在偏好较长描述的倾向。
AI.motivation: 推荐应依据查询相关性，但描述长度等表面属性可能干扰选择，且通常缺少相关性标签。
AI.method: 随机分配释义模型并打乱候选顺序，基于选择不变性构建统计检验，控制相关性后量化描述特征影响。
AI.result: 在两万条商品查询和九个模型中，描述长度均正向影响选择，每增加一个标准差，选择优势比最高增加38%。
AI.conclusion: 相关性仍是主要推荐因素，但冗长构成稳定的次要信号，该框架可用于黑盒购物助手的常规审计。

title: RAVEN-Bench: A Paired EO-IR Video QA Benchmark for Aerial Multimodal Understanding
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced rapidly in image and video understanding, yet their ability to reason over paired aerial electro-optical and infrared (EO-IR) videos remains poorly understood. Such video poses a harder test than standard RGB video QA: targets are often small, evidence may appear only briefly, viewpoints change with the platform, and useful cues may appear in only one stream. We introduce RAVEN-Bench (Reasoning over Aerial Videos with EO-IR aligNment), a paired EO-IR video QA benchmark for low-altitude aerial multimodal understanding. RAVEN-Bench contains 100 temporally aligned EO-IR video pairs and 1,200 human-authored four-way multiple-choice questions, each independently audited for answer keys, modality requirements, evidence intervals, and group validity. It supports EO-only, IR-only, and paired EO+IR evaluation, and uses hierarchical capability levels and structured question groups to diagnose paired-input gain beyond the stronger unimodal condition, unimodal reliance, target consistency, and evidence-chain coherence. We evaluate frontier, open-weight, and remote-sensing MLLMs, showing that aggregate accuracy can overstate evidence-supported EO-IR reasoning. RAVEN-Bench provides controlled modality conditions and group-level diagnostics for auditing whether progress on RGB video benchmarks transfers to aerial cross-spectral understanding. Code and data are available at this https URL and this https URL.
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Datasets and Benchmarks Track)

AI.tldr: RAVEN-Bench以配对可见光与红外航拍视频问答，评估跨光谱理解及证据支持的推理能力。
AI.motivation: 航拍视频目标小、证据短暂且跨模态分布不均，现有模型对配对可见光与红外视频的推理能力尚不清楚。
AI.method: 构建100对时间对齐视频和1200道人工审查选择题，提供单模态与配对评测及分组诊断。
AI.result: 对前沿、开放权重和遥感多模态模型的评测表明，总体准确率可能高估有证据支持的跨光谱推理能力。
AI.conclusion: 受控模态条件和组级诊断有助于检验RGB视频理解进展能否迁移至航拍跨光谱场景。

title: SPLICE: Structured Prompt Local Iterative Combinatorial Evolution
summary: Natural language optimization (NLO) improves an agent by having a model critique and rewrite its natural language policy parameters: system prompts, tool instructions, reasoning directives, few-shot demonstrations. These artifacts are multi-section documents in which some sections encode contracts (safety clauses, tool schemas, output formats) that must not drift, while others are legitimate optimization targets. Most iterative NLO methods treat the artifact as a single editable string, producing three recurrent failure modes: unsafe global rewrites, beam collapse onto a single lineage, and unchecked bloat, none addressed by formal guarantees. We introduce SPLICE, a unified NLO framework that poses optimization as constrained combinatorial search over an edit graph of block-structured, selectively-mutable states. We map each failure mode to a matched guarantee: (i) per-block mutability preserves contract text verbatim, with a price-of-freezing bound; (ii) elitist beam search with diversity slots never lets the leader regress on validation, bounds regression under noisy re-evaluation by an exponential tail, and keeps a competitive candidate from a different parent whenever one exists; (iii) a ratio length regularizer comes with an explicit accuracy-length bias bound. Candidates are proposed from dual section-local textual gradients; under a proposer-competence condition whose proxy we measure, edit-graph reachability and a convergence rate bound how quickly improving children arrive. Across seven public benchmarks under five reproduced protocols, SPLICE wins on four and matches the strongest prior method on three. On a production-style contract stress test it keeps the contract clauses that unconstrained optimizers trade away to raise the proxy metric, and ablations attribute gains to critique and elitist search.

AI.tldr: SPLICE以分块约束编辑和多样化精英搜索优化自然语言策略，同时保留契约文本并抑制膨胀。
AI.motivation: 现有自然语言优化常将文档整体改写，导致契约漂移、搜索谱系坍缩和文本无节制增长。
AI.method: 将优化建模为分块编辑图上的受约束组合搜索，结合局部文本梯度、多样性槽位及长度正则化。
AI.result: 在七个公开基准上四项获胜、三项追平最强既有方法，并在契约压力测试中保留契约条款。
AI.conclusion: 结构化可变性约束与精英搜索可在保护契约的同时提升优化表现，并提供有条件的理论保证。

title: We Have All the Cards: Securing Agent Cards at the Operational Trust Boundary of the Agent2Agent Protocol
summary: AI agent interoperability protocols enable orchestrators to discover and invoke external agents using machine-readable metadata. In the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol, Agent Cards contain attacker-controllable natural-language fields that may influence agent selection before a provider is invoked, creating a pre-invocation trust problem. We characterize this discovery-time attack surface through a taxonomy of ten Agent Card manipulation attacks and present SECCARD, a layered validation framework combining protocol checks, deterministic analysis, and LLM-based semantic reasoning. We measure the emerging public A2A ecosystem by probing 36.1 million Internet domains and collecting 310 deployed Agent Cards. Two annotators independently label the corpus with 96.8% agreement. We then construct a 660-card real-card perturbation benchmark with matched benign controls and a 260-card synthetic adversarial benchmark spanning all ten attack categories. On controlled attacks injected into real Agent Cards, the strongest semantic judge achieves 97.0% security recall at a 1.7% false-positive rate. Across nine LLM judges on the synthetic benchmark, security recall ranges from 25.8% to 92.3%, demonstrating substantial model-dependent variation. These results show that SECCARD effectively identifies Agent Card manipulations spanning all ten discovery-time attack classes while preserving benign Agent Cards, but also reveal that its effectiveness depends critically on the choice of the underlying LLM judge.
comment: To be published at the Workshop on Agentic AI in Offensive and Defensive Cyber Operations (AIDC'26) proceedings co-located with the IEEE Annual Computer Security Applications Conference (ACSAC)

AI.tldr: 提出分层验证框架SECCARD，识别A2A协议中调用前的Agent Card操纵攻击。
AI.motivation: Agent Card中攻击者可控的自然语言字段可能干扰代理选择，形成调用前信任风险。
AI.method: 建立十类攻击分类，结合协议检查、确定性分析与大模型语义判断，并构建真实及合成评测集。
AI.result: 真实卡片受控攻击中，最强语义判别器的安全召回率为97.0%，误报率为1.7%。
AI.conclusion: SECCARD能识别十类发现阶段攻击并保留良性卡片，但效果高度依赖底层大模型判别器。

title: Benchmark Factory: Agentic Benchmark Creation via Dataset Curation and Label-Free Quality Anchors
summary: Teams deploying coding agents need benchmarks built from their own code, but curating and validating them by hand is resource intensive, and an unvalidated benchmark can mislead silently. We present Benchmark Factory, an autonomous meta-agent loop with human checkpoints: an LLM agent writes sourcing queries over landed production code changes, runs models of known relative strength on each candidate, diagnoses why a candidate fails, and repairs it by editing its queries, prompts, and configuration until it clears quality anchors that need no per-task human labels. We used Benchmark Factory to build benchmarks for five developer cohorts at our organization. Engineering raters scored a 5% sample 2.3 for task quality and 2.6 for grader verdicts on a 1-to-3 scale. On configurations never used to build them, the benchmarks ranked Claude Opus~4.7 at high reasoning effort above low effort (60.6% vs. 54.4% of tasks passed, $p=0.002$) and GPT-5.5 above GPT-5.4 (65.8% vs. 60.5%, $p=0.004$); 9 of the 10 per-cohort comparisons pointed the same way. A deliberately trivial benchmark failed the anchors; five broken graders failed them, even under a relaxed rule fixed in advance that the real grader passes; and with model labels shuffled so that no true ordering existed, random redraws of a candidate passed in at most 1.4% of simulations. The anchors are necessary, not sufficient, conditions for a valid benchmark, designed to focus human review on what the loop cannot repair.
comment: 5 pages, prepared for submission to AGENT 2027

AI.tldr: 提出Benchmark Factory，以带人工检查点的自主代理循环构建并验证组织内部编程基准。
AI.motivation: 手工整理和验证内部代码基准成本高，而未经验证的基准可能悄然误导模型评估。
AI.method: 代理从生产代码变更中筛选任务，利用已知模型强弱关系和无需逐任务人工标签的质量锚点迭代修复基准。
AI.result: 五类开发者基准在未参与构建的模型配置上区分出性能差异，十项分组比较中九项方向一致。
AI.conclusion: 质量锚点是基准有效性的必要而非充分条件，可将人工审查集中于自动循环无法修复的问题。

title: Bring Back Language to Actions: Restoring VLM capabilities in VLA Models via Parameter Merging
summary: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) are obtained by fine-tuning pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on robot demonstration data, enabling action prediction from visual observations and language instructions. However, this fine-tuning induces catastrophic forgetting, substantially degrading the semantic and visual grounding capabilities of the original VLM. We address this by merging the parameters of a VLM and its VLA derivative without retraining either model. Concretely, we extract the task vector (the difference between VLA and VLM weights) and decompose it via Singular Value Decomposition. For each component, we learn a scalar mixing coefficient controlling how much of the VLA adaptation is retained, optimised to jointly preserve action prediction and vision-language capabilities. Experiments show that our merged model performs well on both axes simultaneously, consistently outperforming established merging baselines.

AI.tldr: 通过参数合并恢复VLA的视觉语言能力，同时保留动作预测能力。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型经机器人示范微调后会发生灾难性遗忘，削弱语义理解和视觉定位能力。
AI.method: 对VLA与原始VLM的权重差进行奇异值分解，学习各分量混合系数，无需重新训练两个模型。
AI.result: 合并模型同时保持良好的动作预测和视觉语言能力，并持续优于已有参数合并基线。
AI.conclusion: 对任务向量分量进行可学习混合，可缓解机器人微调造成的视觉语言能力遗忘。

title: CISyn: Human Mesh Recovery in Close Interactions with Physics-Simulated Synthetic Data
summary: 3D human mesh recovery (HMR) in close-interaction scenarios is hindered by the lack of large-scale, accurately annotated training data: real capture is expensive, and existing synthetic datasets rarely include physical contact. We introduce CISyn, a large-scale synthetic dataset purpose-built for close human-human interactions, generated via physics simulation and Blender-based rendering. By simulating collision dynamics between SMPL-X-rigged humanoids, CISyn naturally produces the contact, mutual occlusion, and pose entanglement that characterize close-interaction scenes, with no manual annotation effort. The released set provides 25,000 sequences with accurate 3D annotations. We further propose an uncertainty-aware loss that allows models to learn more effectively from the heavily occluded examples in our data. Augmenting state-of-the-art HMR training with CISyn and replacing the regression loss with our uncertainty-aware variant yields consistent improvements on close-interaction benchmarks, validating CISyn as a scalable complement to real-world data. The dataset, generation pipeline, and code are available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 提出物理仿真合成数据集CISyn及不确定性感知损失，改善近距离人体交互中的三维网格恢复。
AI.motivation: 近距离人体交互缺少大规模精确标注数据，真实采集昂贵，现有合成数据又鲜少包含物理接触。
AI.method: 通过SMPL-X人体碰撞仿真和Blender渲染生成接触及遮挡场景，并设计不确定性感知损失。
AI.result: 发布含精确三维标注的25000段序列，结合所提损失增强训练后，在近距离交互基准上持续提升表现。
AI.conclusion: CISyn为真实交互数据提供可扩展补充，不确定性感知学习有助于利用严重遮挡样本。

title: Lasso: Towards Sustainable AI-Generated Media Detection with Intel QAT On-Chip Compression
summary: Synthetic text, images, and video are rising. Software-only detectors are power-hungry, too slow, and costly, and do not scale with demand. When software cannot scale, historically hardware often comes to the rescue. We perform the first reverse engineering of a compression accelerator--Intel QuickAssist Technology (QAT) microarchitecture and--find different amount of time on each, a novel data structure-dependent property. Using this information, we then build Lasso, a low-cost, high-performance detector for AI-generated content that turns the accelerator into a measuring instrument. For text detection, Lasso achieves 100% accuracy on original DetectRL text and retains 92% average accuracy after paraphrasing, compared with 78% for Binoculars and 55% for DetectGPT. Across original, paraphrased, and perturbed text, it achieves 82% average accuracy, outperforming all five baselines. With topic, length, and formatting matched, accuracy reaches 95% for instruction-tuned generators, including when the tested generator is unseen. On RAID, accuracy averages 82% when trained on one generator and tested on another, and 74% across eight held-out domains. Detection takes 0.74 microseconds, a speedup of at least 83,784x across five baselines. At the same time, Lasso consumes over 99% less energy per document than both Binoculars and DetectGPT. At the same time, Lasso detects AI-generated videos, software code, and images with 67.5%, 70% and 78% accuracy, respectively, with low latency and power opening avenues for practical real time and edge device detection of multimodality AI artifacts for the first time. No other compared technique supports detection across all four modalities: text, video, images, and code.

AI.tldr: 提出Lasso，利用Intel QAT压缩加速器的时延特性实现低能耗、高速的AI生成内容检测。
AI.motivation: 纯软件生成内容检测器耗电、缓慢且成本高，难以满足不断增长的多模态检测需求。
AI.method: 逆向分析QAT微架构，利用依赖数据结构的压缩耗时差异，将硬件加速器转化为检测测量工具。
AI.result: 原始DetectRL文本准确率达100%，检测耗时0.74微秒，单文档能耗较两种基线降低超过99%。
AI.conclusion: Lasso兼顾低延迟和低能耗，并支持文本、视频、代码与图像检测，展现实时及边缘部署潜力。

title: Learn Locally, Extend Globally: Koopman Eigenfunctions and the Basin of Attraction
summary: Koopman eigenfunctions associated with the Jacobian eigenvalues of a stable equilibrium are Lyapunov functions defined exactly on its basin of attraction. We turn this into a computational procedure for power systems. Eigenfunctions estimated by extended dynamic mode decomposition (EDMD) are written as functions of the state, made to vanish at the equilibrium by centering the lifted variable $\cos\delta$, and verified on a grid with the model: two Lyapunov candidates from the EDMD spectrum certify up to 66\% of the basin of a single-machine infinite-bus system from data in the linear region. The Koopman semigroup property then extends the EDMD-Lie eigenfunction to the whole basin, recovered at the grid resolution with its isostables and isochrons.

AI.tldr: 将局部数据学习的Koopman特征函数扩展至整个吸引域，用于电力系统稳定性分析。
AI.motivation: 稳定平衡点相关Koopman特征函数具有吸引域上的Lyapunov性质，需要将该理论转化为计算方法。
AI.method: 用EDMD估计并中心化特征函数，经模型网格验证后，利用Koopman半群性质向全吸引域扩展。
AI.result: 仅用线性区域数据即可认证单机无穷大母线系统至多66%的吸引域，扩展后在网格分辨率下恢复整个吸引域。
AI.conclusion: 局部学习结合半群扩展可恢复全局吸引域及其等稳态面和等相位面。

title: Factorized Self-Supervised Speech Tokenization
summary: Speech tokenizers convert audio into discrete units, enabling language models to process and generate speech. The goal is to learn compact, text-like representations while preserving enough detail to reconstruct a speaker's voice and delivery. We propose Facto: a factorized tokenizer that disentangles time-varying information (content and prosody) from static components (speaker identity and recording conditions). We build on a recent linear factorization method for self-supervised features, extending it to handle unseen speakers. Then, we cluster the factorized space and train a lightweight decoder to reconstruct audio from the resulting tokens. By removing the static components before clustering, our tokens are more robust to small noise perturbations. We validate this by testing token stability under various noise conditions. Next, we theoretically analyze Facto's convergence and scaling properties, quantifying how the factorization improves with the number of training speakers. Finally, we evaluate Facto on a range of downstream tasks. We show that greater token stability translates into improved text-to-speech performance and competitive results in voice conversion and spoken language modeling. Code and checkpoints at this https URL and demo page at this https URL.
comment: 26 pages, 6 figures, 16 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026

AI.tldr: 提出因子化语音分词器Facto，分离动态与静态信息，提高离散语音单元的稳定性。
AI.motivation: 语音离散表示需兼顾紧凑性与声音重建能力，同时降低说话人、录音条件和噪声带来的干扰。
AI.method: 扩展自监督特征线性分解以支持未见说话人，移除静态分量后聚类，并训练轻量音频解码器。
AI.result: 所得语音单元对噪声扰动更稳定，改善文本转语音表现，并在语音转换和口语语言建模上取得竞争性结果。
AI.conclusion: 分离静态因素能提升语音单元稳定性并惠及下游任务，理论分析还刻画了随训练说话人数增加的改进。

title: Ask Precisely, Assume Wisely: Interactive Evaluation of Ambiguity Resolution in Large Language Models
summary: Ambiguity is a core challenge in human--AI interaction, where models must decide when to make assumptions and when to seek clarification. Existing approaches to ambiguity evaluation largely focus on coverage over multiple interpretations using static metrics, offering limited insight into how efficiently a model converges toward a single user-intended interpretation through interaction. We introduce a preference-grounded simulated user framework for controlled, multi-turn evaluation of ambiguity resolution, grounding simulator responses strictly in user disambiguation preferences to avoid hallucination and over-disclosure. Alongside this, we define three observable dissatisfaction signals --- incorrect assumptions, repeating clarifications, and irrelevant clarifications --- that characterize interaction quality beyond task accuracy. Our analysis reveals a clear trade-off: models that frequently seek clarification tend to over-clarify and prolong interactions, while assumption-driven models are more prone to misaligning with user intent. We demonstrate that system prompts optimized on these dissatisfaction signals achieve a Pareto-optimal balance across all three metrics, reducing overall error rates by up to 7.65%, underscoring the value of our framework in designing agents that ask precisely and assume wisely.
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: Evaluation of Interactive Agents

AI.tldr: 提出基于用户消歧偏好的多轮评估框架，衡量大模型在主动澄清与合理假设之间的平衡。
AI.motivation: 静态歧义评估难以反映模型通过交互高效收敛到用户真实意图的能力。
AI.method: 构建严格遵循用户偏好的模拟器，以错误假设、重复澄清和无关澄清三类不满信号评估并优化系统提示。
AI.result: 频繁澄清与主动假设存在权衡，优化提示实现三指标的帕累托最优平衡，总体错误率最多降低7.65%。
AI.conclusion: 基于用户不满信号的交互评估有助于设计既能精准提问、又能合理假设的代理。

title: MemeEconomy: Do LLM Agents Trade Ethics for Survival?
summary: Alignment-trained large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in autonomous, multi-round settings where ethical compliance can come into direct tension with task success. While safety literature extensively documents failure modes like sycophancy and reward hacking, it largely overlooks a critical vulnerability: how agents behave under simulated existential economic pressure. We introduce MemeEconomy, a multimodal agentic market simulation in which LLM agents act as meme investors. Agents select content from a five-tier harm taxonomy and target communities under low-pressure and high-pressure (survival) environments. Each decision is logged in a Belief-Desire-Intention (BDI) schema that we use as a diagnostic instrument, externalizing the agent's event understanding, declared priorities, and harm acknowledgment. Across ten models from four frontier model families, harmful selection rates remain consistently high and rise by +15 percentage points on average under an economic survival incentive. Frontier alignment-trained models commit to harm-tolerant selection at initialization while suppressing the explicit harm acknowledgment that previously accompanied it. In competitive tournaments, ethical agents finish higher overall, yet moderation penalties fail to suppress harm: harmful selection rates remain elevated in rounds following a removal, indicating the moderation mechanism does not function as a deterrent. We further train MemeAgent, a 2B-parameter verifier on the simulation's BDI logs, which outperforms zero-shot frontier verifiers on in-distribution audits (97.5% vs. 63-74% accuracy on the Pass vs. Block decision) and generalizes to external multimodal harm benchmarks (78% vs. 50-56% on Hateful Memes). The same logs that surface the failure mode also help train the model that detects it.
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Project page : this https URL

AI.tldr: MemeEconomy发现经济生存压力加剧大模型代理的有害选择，其决策日志可用于训练危害检测器。
AI.motivation: 现有安全研究较少关注自主大模型代理在模拟生存经济压力下如何权衡伦理与任务成功。
AI.method: 构建多模态投资市场模拟，以BDI日志记录十个模型的决策，并训练20亿参数验证器MemeAgent。
AI.result: 生存激励使有害选择率平均上升15个百分点；验证器在分布内审核和外部基准上均优于零样本前沿模型。
AI.conclusion: 经济压力暴露了对齐模型的伦理脆弱性，审核惩罚未形成有效威慑，但决策日志有助于检测危害。

title: Quantifying Membership Inference Risks in Genomic Data Sharing: The Role of Attacker's Auxiliary Information
summary: Genomic data sharing is essential for biomedical research but introduces significant privacy risks, including membership inference attacks, in which an adversary determines whether a specific individual's data was used in a study. Existing privacy protections are typically applied after a release format has already been chosen, leaving researchers without a principled method to assess dataset-specific risk beforehand. We propose a server-assisted, principal component analysis-based pre-release auditing framework that maps genomic data into a shared low-dimensional space, applies epsilon-local differential privacy via the Laplace mechanism with a formally derived sensitivity for principal component analysis scores, and estimates membership inference attack power at a controlled 5% false-positive rate using a distance-threshold attack. A membership-neutrality diagnostic based on Unbiased Reconstruction Robustness is reported alongside attack power, precision, and recall. Experiments using the openSNP and 1000 Genomes Project datasets across multiple dimensionalities and privacy budgets show that separation between the researcher's dataset and public auxiliary data in principal component analysis space is a dominant determinant of attack success, exceeding the effect of perturbation level alone. Comparison against a genome-wide association study-style likelihood ratio test baseline further contextualizes the measured risk. This framework enables researchers, data repositories, and institutional review bodies to quantify dataset-specific membership inference risk before genomic data publication, supporting more informed and privacy-aware biomedical data-sharing decisions.

AI.tldr: 提出基因组数据发布前审计框架，发现研究数据与攻击者辅助数据的分离程度主导成员推断风险。
AI.motivation: 现有隐私保护通常在发布格式确定后实施，缺少事前评估特定基因组数据集风险的原则性方法。
AI.method: 通过服务器辅助PCA构建共享空间，施加拉普拉斯局部差分隐私，并在5%假阳性率下评估距离阈值攻击。
AI.result: 两个基因组数据集的实验显示，PCA空间中的数据分离程度对攻击成功的影响超过单独扰动强度。
AI.conclusion: 该框架支持在发布前量化数据集特定的成员推断风险，为基因组共享提供隐私决策依据。

title: How Much Do Foundation Models Add to Gradient Boosting on Financial Event Sequences?
summary: Foundation models pretrained on raw transaction sequences are proposed for credit, fraud and churn modeling, with reported gains over gradient boosting, but the data and baselines behind these gains are rarely public. We measure how much the pretraining and adaptation recipes of these models add to a baseline of point-in-time window aggregates and LightGBM, and we propose TBS (Temporal Boosting-Sequence ensemble), which averages the ranks of a boosting model enriched with label-free event-transition features and of a pretrained sequence network fine-tuned jointly with the aggregates. On a synthetic credit-card dataset, the public MBD-mini banking dataset and two proprietary datasets of trade credit and B2B churn, we compare 27 methods at three label budgets with five seeds and paired bootstrap intervals, using sequence models of about 0.4 million parameters pretrained per dataset. Frozen self-supervised embeddings rarely improve the baseline, and a fine-tuned sequence network alone clears it in 9 of 21 target-budget cells. TBS clears it in 19 of 21 cells (18 after FDR adjustment), with a median gain of +1.8 AUC points, and the controls suggest that combining boosting with the pretrained network is the main source of the observed gain. Gains shrink as labels grow and with rich tabular data: with both, the gain on the proprietary datasets is +0.7 and +0.8 points, the latter with an interval including zero. We also re-examine two benchmarks. On IBM TabFormer, the test follows a change in the fraud pattern and the published baseline has no history; with the training period the vendor states, our history-aware LightGBM and our own foundation model stay below the published scores of a commercial model. On IBM AML, a simulation artifact lets a date rule reach F1 0.482, and a point-in-time LightGBM reaches the F1 of graph neural networks whose test graph includes later transactions.

AI.tldr: 金融事件序列中，预训练表征单独增益有限，与梯度提升集成的TBS取得更稳定但受数据条件影响的提升。
AI.motivation: 金融序列基础模型宣称优于梯度提升，但相关数据与基线往往不公开，实际增益来源尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在四个数据集、三种标签预算下比较27种方法，并提出融合增强梯度提升与微调预训练序列网络的TBS。

title: The Human Side of ML Engineering: Analyzing the Collaboration and Communication Skills in ML Job Postings
summary: Studies of Machine Learning (ML) practice highlight the importance of combining technical expertise with interpersonal capabilities, particularly collaboration and communication. However, evidence on how ML job postings express these skills is scarce, and prior work largely relies on keyword-based analyses that overlook implicit expression. We analyze demand for these skills in ML job postings across regions, industries, and seniority levels, and compare it with software engineering (SE) roles. We collected 1,000 postings (500 ML, 500 SE) from five continents via a semi-automated pipeline. For annotation, we synthesized a taxonomy of collaboration and communication sub-categories from prior work and used an LLM as a third annotator alongside two humans, enabling detection of context-dependent and implicit skill references. Collaboration appeared in 88.6% of ML postings and communication in 72.2%, far above prior keyword-based estimates for AI roles. Roughly one in five collaboration and one in four communication requirements were expressed only implicitly. Decomposing these requirements into the taxonomy's sub-categories reveals what aggregate figures conceal. Collaboration is demanded predominantly as integration across role boundaries rather than team membership. Communication is mostly required in generic terms, with fewer than half of the postings requiring it naming whom the candidate must communicate with. ML and SE postings demand interpersonal competence at statistically indistinguishable levels but orient it differently, SE toward team practices and ML toward presentation and audience-facing interaction. Within ML, the advertised role separates interpersonal profiles more sharply than any other dimension, including the contrast with SE.

AI.tldr: 机器学习招聘广泛要求协作与沟通，隐含表达使关键词分析低估需求，具体要求随岗位而异。
AI.motivation: 机器学习岗位如何表达协作与沟通能力的证据不足，既有关键词分析难以识别隐含要求。
AI.method: 收集五大洲各500条机器学习与软件工程招聘信息，基于能力分类由两名人工及一个大模型共同标注。
AI.result: 机器学习招聘中88.6%要求协作、72.2%要求沟通，其中约五分之一和四分之一的要求仅以隐含方式表达。
AI.conclusion: 两类岗位的人际能力需求水平无显著差异但侧重点不同，机器学习内部的岗位类型最能区分能力画像。

title: Simplify, Agree, Distill: Label-Free Self-Distillation with Stepping Stones
summary: Can a language model teach itself to reason without labels? On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) uses the model as its own teacher, but strengthens that teacher with a ground-truth solution. The natural label-free substitute, voting over the model's attempts, fails precisely on hard problems: attempts disagree, and their most common answer is often wrong. We propose STONE, a label-free alternative that moves agreement to easier related problems. The model writes these stepping stones, keeps those it solves consistently, and shows the teacher their worked solutions, with final answers removed; the student sees only the original problem. No step reads a label, and inference needs no extra context or model calls. Across five math benchmarks, the proposed method achieves the highest average accuracy for Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B in thinking mode. Without thinking mode, it gains 13.2 and 22.7 points, 2.5 and 2.7 times the gains of OPSD with ground-truth solutions.

AI.tldr: STONE借助模型稳定解答的较简单关联问题，实现无需标签、且不增加推理开销的自蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 现有自蒸馏依赖真实答案增强教师，而直接对模型答案投票在困难问题上常因分歧与错误共识失效。
AI.method: 模型生成关联的简单问题并筛选一致解答，将去除最终答案的解题过程提供给教师，学生仅见原题。
AI.result: 在五个数学基准上，两种规模模型思考模式平均准确率最高，非思考模式分别提升13.2和22.7个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 将一致性筛选转移到较简单的关联问题，可在完全无标签且不增加推理上下文或调用的条件下增强推理。

title: Correcting Persistent Failures in Point-Cloud Grasping Policies using Human Demonstrations in Virtual Reality
summary: Robots in homes, warehouses and farms must pick up objects they have never seen, usually without a 3D model or a category label. A grasping policy that works directly on the point cloud from a depth sensor needs only the geometry the robot observes, so it applies to any new object. Offline grasp generators such as Contact-GraspNet work this way, but they rank grasps by learned plausibility rather than by whether the grasp actually lifts the object. Reinforcement learning (RL) can optimize for that directly and make a point-cloud grasping policy much better on average, yet it leaves specific grasps persistently unsolved. We present a human-in-the-loop failure loop that targets those grasps: situations an RL policy keeps failing are mined automatically, sent to a virtual-reality application where a person picks the object up with their own hands, and returned to training as two grasp points. The person contributes only where to grasp; the robot chooses its own approach. In simulation, RL raises success on unseen objects from 55% with Contact-GraspNet to 83%. Adding 58 human demonstrations nearly doubles success on the hard cases RL kept failing, from 24% to 45%, and recovers performance that RL alone loses on similar cases that were never demonstrated, without reducing success on unseen objects.

AI.tldr: 自动挖掘强化学习持续失败的抓取案例，再用少量虚拟现实人类示范定向修正，可改善顽固失败。
AI.motivation: 点云抓取强化学习虽能提高平均成功率，却仍存在持续失败的特定抓取情境。
AI.method: 自动筛选失败案例，在虚拟现实中采集人类抓取位置，并将两个抓取点送回训练，由机器人自主选择接近方式。
AI.result: 仿真中强化学习将未见物体成功率从55%提高至83%，加入58次示范使困难案例成功率从24%升至45%。
AI.conclusion: 少量定向人类示范可修复持续失败并恢复未示范相似情境的表现，同时不降低未见物体抓取成功率。

title: Dependable Voice Command for Multi-UAV Swarms Using Small Language Models
summary: Supervisory control of multiple autonomous unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) imposes high visual and cognitive demands on human operators, particularly when communicating mission objectives and system constraints. Voice command provides a natural interaction modality that can reduce operator workload; however, its reliability is affected by environmental noise, speech variability, and recognition errors. This paper presents a dependable voice command framework for multi-UAV swarm supervision using Small Language Models (SLMs). The proposed architecture integrates an Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) module with an SLM-based semantic processing layer to transform spoken operator commands into structured task definitions for downstream multi-UAV planning and execution. To evaluate robustness, an end-to-end assessment pipeline is developed using a Probabilistic Context-Free Grammar (PCFG) to generate synthetic supervisory commands, which are converted into audio samples with varying operator accents and environmental signal-to-noise ratios (SNR). The resulting speech signals are processed by the ASR module, and the SLM performs contextual interpretation and phonetic correction of transcriptions when required. The evaluation isolates the resilience of the voice command pipeline under acoustic degradation and speech variation, demonstrating reliable task generation for multi-UAV supervision in challenging operational conditions.

AI.tldr: 结合语音识别与小语言模型的框架，可在噪声和口音变化下为多无人机集群生成可靠任务指令。
AI.motivation: 多无人机监督控制认知负担较高，而语音指令的可靠性容易受到环境噪声、语音差异和识别错误影响。
AI.method: 串联语音识别与小模型语义处理，利用概率上下文无关文法生成指令，并在多种口音和信噪比下端到端评估。
AI.result: 评估表明，该管线在声学退化与语音变化等挑战条件下仍能可靠生成多无人机监督任务。
AI.conclusion: 小语言模型的上下文理解与必要的语音纠错，可支持复杂运行条件下可靠的多无人机语音监督控制。

title: Privacy-Preserving Clustering Algorithm and Parameter Selection for Collaborative Population Stratification Using Distributed PCA
summary: We propose a privacy-preserving selection layer for collaborative population stratification workflows, enabling an honest-but-curious server to recommend a strong clustering algorithm-hyperparameter configuration from privacy protected shares. Instead of using a fixed workflow such as PCA followed by K-Means with a preset number of clusters, the framework compares multiple clustering methods and parameter settings under privacy constraints. To avoid relying on a public reference basis, we construct a shared low-dimensional representation through a distributed-PCA (DPCA) procedure in which each party computes local top-$r$ principal-component information and the server aggregates only low-rank summaries to recover a global basis. Building on this representation, the framework supports three LDP-protected pipelines: PCA then Noise, Noise then PCA, and Noise-Only. The server evaluates clustering methods and parameter settings using internal validation metrics and recommends a top-performing configuration from the perturbed data; this step is pure post-processing. Experiments on openSNP and 1000 Genomes show that the server-side selection layer reliably identifies strong settings from LDP-protected data. Across both datasets, the PCA-based pipelines outperform Noise-Only in clustering utility, communication cost, and runtime, and show lower membership-inference attack (MIA) power at small privacy budgets. Overall, they provide the best utility--scalability trade-off in our setting.

AI.tldr: 利用分布式PCA与局部差分隐私，可从受保护的基因组数据中选择优质聚类算法及参数。
AI.motivation: 协作群体分层不宜固定采用预设聚类流程，需要在隐私约束下比较算法与超参数配置。
AI.method: 聚合各方低秩PCA摘要构建共享空间，比较三条局部差分隐私管线，并由服务器依据内部指标推荐配置。
AI.result: 两个数据集上均能可靠选出较优配置；PCA管线的聚类效用、通信和运行成本优于仅加噪管线。
AI.conclusion: PCA管线在本研究中提供最佳效用与可扩展性权衡，并在较小隐私预算下降低成员推断攻击能力。

title: Between Rigor and Reality: How AI Safety Benchmark Developers Understand Benchmark Use and Maintenance
summary: Safety benchmarks are cited as the primary tool to understand the risks posed by generative AI (GenAI) systems, yet growing evidence suggests they often fail to meet the needs of real-world safety evaluation. We present findings from five interviews with AI safety benchmark developers in academia and industry. We find a disconnect between perceptions of the intended usefulness of safety benchmarks and their practical usefulness in safety evaluations of deployed systems. Our participants offered perspectives on two challenges contributing to this disconnect: (1) the difficulty of achieving inter-rater reliability on safety constructs, and (2) a lack of clarity regarding how to address persistent threats to external validity. Based on our analysis, we argue that safety benchmarks must not only be grounded in deployment contexts, but actively integrated with them. To facilitate this, we outline pathways for more transparent communication between academic and industry AI safety stakeholders.
comment: Poster at the Eval Eval Workshop at ACL 2026. 11 pages. this https URL

AI.tldr: 访谈揭示AI安全基准的预期用途与部署评估实用性脱节，需更紧密融入部署情境。
AI.motivation: 安全基准虽是生成式AI风险评估的主要工具，却常难满足真实部署需求。
AI.method: 访谈五位来自学界与业界的AI安全基准开发者，分析其对基准使用与维护的认识。
AI.result: 受访者指出，安全概念的评分者间一致性难以实现，外部效度威胁的应对方式也不明确。
AI.conclusion: 安全基准应主动融入部署情境，并加强学界与业界安全利益相关方的透明沟通。

title: OverclusterDRG: a Deterministic, LP-Free Heuristic for Robust $k$-Center
summary: The $k$-center problem is a fundamental formulation for metric clustering. However, its min-max objective is highly sensitive to outliers, motivating the Robust $k$-Center (R$k$C) formulation which permits excluding up to $z$ points as outliers. Existing algorithms for R$k$C suffer from scalability issues: LP rounding relies on fractional relaxations that scale poorly, known combinatorial approximation algorithms are computationally expensive due to radius guessing, and scalable randomized heuristics require exponential trial multipliers to guarantee success. We present OverclusterDRG, a deterministic, LP-free heuristic for R$k$C. The algorithm leverages the theoretical insight of farthest-point oversampling -- adding exactly $z$ extra candidates to the center set to absorb outliers -- followed by a forward-greedy initialization and a $1$-swap local search. Evaluations across real-world datasets show that OverclusterDRG attains a mean approximation ratio of 1.147 against fractional LP lower bounds on the UCI Adult dataset, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines in both clustering quality and speed. By avoiding subset-guessing and exponential trial multipliers, it scales smoothly to $n=10^5$ points where LP solvers and theoretical algorithms become intractable.

AI.tldr: OverclusterDRG以确定性、无须线性规划的启发式方法实现高效鲁棒聚类。
AI.motivation: 鲁棒k中心现有算法受线性规划、半径猜测或随机试验成本限制，难以扩展。
AI.method: 通过最远点过采样增加恰好z个候选中心，再结合前向贪心初始化与单交换局部搜索。
AI.result: 在UCI Adult上相对分数线性规划下界的平均近似比为1.147，质量与速度优于基线，并可扩展至十万点。
AI.conclusion: 避免子集猜测与指数级试验倍数，可提升鲁棒k中心聚类的实用可扩展性。

title: Geometrically Disentangling Concept Learning from the Language Modeling Loss
summary: Language models acquire a vast array of concepts and abilities from next-token prediction alone. We introduce an interpretability framework that exposes how this single loss relates to the development of different concepts at different points during pretraining. We propose Concept Energy, a measure of the concept-specific alignment between a concept subspace and the average gradient outer product (AGOP) of the next-token-prediction loss. The concept subspace captures where the concept currently lives in the model's representation; AGOP captures the directions to which the loss is most sensitive. Across 19 checkpoints of Pythia-410M and -1B and 12 lexical, syntactic, and semantic concepts, we find that the first peak in Concept Energy generally occurs at or before the steepest increase in probe decodability. Furthermore, whereas probe performance usually increases monotonically throughout training, Concept Energy is not confined to a single peak; some concepts exhibit sustained or repeated engagement across pretraining, suggesting that concept learning may require continual reinforcement or occur at multiple points. Our results indicate that the loss contributes to concept learning in a myriad of ways that simple probe performance alone cannot reveal.

AI.tldr: 概念能量从几何角度揭示语言建模损失在预训练不同阶段对概念学习的参与。
AI.motivation: 仅观察探针性能，难以解释单一下一词预测损失如何推动不同概念的形成。

title: Optimal Operating-Point Selection for Single-Linearization Trajectory Planning of Nonlinear Robot Manipulators
summary: Single-point linearization provides a computationally efficient basis for optimization-based trajectory planning of nonlinear robot manipulators. However, planning performance depends on the selected linearization point. This paper presents an offline performance-driven approach that treats the location of a single linearization as an optimization variable. Candidate operating points are sampled from a common cubic seed trajectory, and each corresponding affine model is used to solve an identical constrained finite-horizon quadratic program (QP). The resulting control sequences are executed on the original nonlinear dynamics, and the operating point minimizing the nonlinear trajectory objective is selected through grid search and bounded refinement. Evaluation on four point-to-point motions of a three-degree-of-freedom UR5 manipulator yields optimal normalized operating-point locations between 0.325 and 0.935, demonstrating trajectory-dependent selection. Compared with the best-performing conventional initial, midpoint, or terminal linearization, the proposed approach reduces the nonlinear trajectory objective by 17-18%, 21-22%, 37-38%, and 7-8% across the four tasks, respectively. Additional nonlinear execution with identical PID feedback correction confirms that the performance advantage persists for a representative task. These results demonstrate that systematic operating-point selection can substantially improve single-linearization trajectory planning while preserving a fixed affine planning model.
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures. Accepted for presentation at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Advances in Computing (IEEE ICAC 2026)

AI.tldr: 离线优化单点线性化位置，可在保持固定仿射规划模型的同时改善机械臂轨迹性能。
AI.motivation: 单点线性化规划计算高效，但性能依赖线性化工作点的选择。
AI.method: 沿三次种子轨迹采样工作点，分别求解约束二次规划，再以非线性执行目标进行网格搜索与有界细化。
AI.result: 三自由度UR5的四项任务中，相比最佳常规工作点，轨迹目标分别降低17—18%、21—22%、37—38%和7—8%。
