title: Learned Regularization for Sparse-View CT: Accuracy, Lesion Detectability and Distribution Shift of a Plug-and-Play Prior against Tuned Total Variation
summary: Learned image priors are often proposed to replace hand-crafted regularizers in sparse-view computed tomography (CT), yet they are usually judged by PSNR on data resembling their training set. We evaluate one noise-conditioned DnCNN denoiser used as a Plug-and-Play prior against filtered back-projection (FBP), Tikhonov and total-variation (TV) regularization, with every method tuned on validation data and all differences paired. On synthetic 28x28 digit images, the prior beats box-constrained TV by about 3.4 dB at moderate noise (sigma = 0.05, 20 angles), but the advantage shrinks at low noise and reverses under distribution shift: an MNIST-trained prior is 3.1 dB (Fashion-MNIST) and 4.3-4.6 dB (Shepp-Logan phantom) below TV, whereas a Fashion-MNIST-trained prior beats TV by 2.2 dB on Fashion-MNIST, consistent with prior mismatch rather than a failure of PnP itself. In a lesion-insertion test the prior detects lesions worse than TV in distribution despite its higher PSNR, and under mismatch it produces more lesion-like false blobs than box-constrained TV for seven of eight lesion types. On real LoDoPaB-CT slices (patient-disjoint split; 30, 60 and 120 angles; three dose levels; 40 test patients), the prior does not consistently outperform a well-tuned TV in PSNR (-0.93 to +0.33 dB) and has lower SSIM in eight of nine conditions. Its lesion-detection AUC is higher than this TV's in all nine conditions (significant in six) but never significantly higher than that of Hann-filtered FBP, which the PSNR-tuned TV falls below in detection in all nine conditions (seven significant). On non-anatomical phantoms its PSNR falls below TV in all six conditions. PSNR and lesion detectability thus rank the methods differently. Our conclusions concern one small denoiser, and the CT analysis was developed after seeing results, without pre-specified primary comparisons.

AI.tldr: 单个DnCNN即插即用先验对调优TV的优势并不稳定，且PSNR与病灶可检测性排序不同。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角CT学习先验常仅在接近训练分布的数据上以PSNR评价，忽视分布偏移与病灶检测。
AI.method: 在合成图像与真实CT上，将噪声条件DnCNN先验与验证集调优的FBP、Tikhonov及TV进行配对比较。
AI.result: 真实CT中其PSNR较TV为−0.93至+0.33分贝，检测AUC均高于TV，但均未显著高于Hann滤波FBP。

title: Effects of Conventional, Adaptive, and AI-Powered Upscaling on the Legibility of License Plates
summary: Small details in digital images -- a face, a street sign, a license plate -- are routinely upscaled in hopes of making them interpretable. Upscaling options now range from conventional interpolation, whose operations are spatially invariant and fully explainable, to AI-powered methods that synthesize detail potentially absent from the source. Here, we ask which of these techniques most reliably helps human readers. In two online experiments, we measured legibility of 255 US license plates ranging in resolution from 128 to 8 pixels tall, as well as their legibility after upscaling by eight different methods. Legibility of the un-upscaled plates collapsed from ceiling to floor across a narrow band of plate heights (32 to 10 pixels). Conventional upscaling techniques (bilinear, bicubic, and Lanczos interpolation) gave modest gains of about 5-9 percentage points within this range. Nearest-neighbor interpolation, however, was harmful, rendering unreadable many plates that were readable without any upscaling. Advanced methods diverged: SwinIR, an open-source AI enhancer, raised performance by up to 38 points relative to no upscaling, while an adaptive denoiser-based image prior and commercial AI upscaler tended to impair legibility. We found no strong evidence of consistent character hallucinations across methods. Decomposing the task, conventional interpolators mainly helped readers count characters, whereas SwinIR alone made the characters themselves more identifiable.

AI.tldr: 车牌放大能否提升可读性高度依赖算法，SwinIR明显有效，而部分增强方法反而有害。
AI.motivation: 图像放大可能帮助识别细节，也可能合成原图不存在的信息，其对人类阅读的实际作用尚不明确。
AI.method: 开展两项在线实验，测量255张不同分辨率美国车牌在原图及八种放大方法下的可读性。
AI.result: 常规插值提升约5—9个百分点，SwinIR最高提升38个百分点，最近邻及部分高级方法降低可读性。
AI.conclusion: 常规插值主要帮助计数字符，只有SwinIR进一步改善字符识别，且未发现一致字符幻觉的强证据。

title: Coordinating Distributed AI Servers with Industrial Loads to Reduce Grid-Interconnection Needs
summary: We show that co-locating distributed AI servers with industrial demand and coordinating AI workloads with production loads can substantially reduce the additional grid interconnection that AI computing requires. Grid interconnection is increasingly constraining the expansion of large AI data centers. Factories already have grid connections sized for their peak production loads, and we propose hosting AI servers during production valleys. We formulate a joint optimization that sizes CPU and GPU servers, schedules deadline-constrained tasks, and routes tasks among factories, and use it to compare three factory-site architectures with new large data centers serving the same demand. Applying this framework to 31 Chinese manufacturing industries, we find that AI demand and production loads often do not peak together. As a result, AI servers placed at factories and scheduled according to production peaks need about 60% less additional interconnection capacity than new large data centers, and 98% less when tasks are routed among a group's factories.
comment: Submitted to IEEE PES General Meeting 2027. Code and data: this https URL

AI.tldr: 将分布式AI服务器部署于工厂并协调负载，可显著降低新增电网接入容量需求。
AI.motivation: 电网接入限制大型AI数据中心扩张，而工厂既有接入容量在生产低谷时存在利用空间。
AI.method: 联合优化CPU与GPU服务器规模、限期任务调度及跨厂路由，并在31个中国制造业行业比较部署架构。
AI.result: 相较新建大型数据中心，按生产峰谷调度的工厂AI部署减少约60%新增接入容量，跨厂路由时减少98%。
AI.conclusion: 利用AI需求与工业负载峰值错位，并协调跨厂计算任务，可缓解AI扩张的电网接入约束。

title: From Language-Specific to Cross-DSL: Semantic-Role-Guided Model Completion with LLMs
summary: The rapid emergence of large language models (LLMs), trained on vast and diverse corpora, has positioned them as a promising source of domain knowledge to assist modelers. However, leveraging LLMs for model completion remains challenging: suggestions must respect both the syntax of a domain-specific language (DSL) and the intended domain semantics, while remaining consistent with an evolving model. This paper presents RAFiC, an LLM-based approach for iterative domain model completion that generalizes across DSLs. It drives completion using metamodel information to ensure syntactic validity and enriches prompts with semantic-role annotations to better capture the intended modeling role of DSL elements. The approach provides context-aware, incremental guidance during model construction. We evaluate RAFiC through an ablation-based comparative study over three DSLs and two scenarios per DSL to isolate the contribution of syntactic and semantic guidance. Across these six scenarios, semantic role guidance improves contribution rate in every case, and RAFiC improves completion effectiveness over weaker prompting configurations in most of them. The largest gains occur for DSLs that are less represented in LLM training data. In these cases, iterative guidance leads to earlier and more stable accepted suggestions, while semantic role guidance improves their relevance.

AI.tldr: RAFiC结合元模型与语义角色指导，实现跨领域专用语言的迭代模型补全。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型补全领域模型时，须同时满足语言语法、领域语义及不断演化的模型上下文。
AI.method: 以元模型约束语法，并在提示中加入语义角色标注，在三种DSL各两个场景中开展消融比较。
AI.result: 语义角色指导在六个场景均提升贡献率，RAFiC在多数场景改善补全效果，低训练代表性DSL收益最大。
AI.conclusion: 结合语法与语义指导可提升跨DSL补全，迭代指导有助于更早、更稳定地产生被接受的建议。

title: Supercharging Olmo-core for Efficient and Scalable MoE Training
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models add parameters without proportionally increasing per-token compute. However, training cost also depends on bytes moved, memory held, and kernels launched, and many of those costs follow total parameter size rather than active compute. On infrastructure built for dense models, this mismatch is costly: in early baselines, throughput fell as stored expert parameter size grew, even though the useful work per token stayed nearly fixed. To close this gap, we present a redesigned training stack in Olmo-core, built for efficient, scalable MoE training. We replace the Fully Sharded Data Parallel (FSDP) of earlier Olmo-core versions with an architecture built on Distributed Data Parallel (DDP), and add Expert Parallelism (EP), Pipeline Parallelism (PP), a distributed optimizer, and activation recompute. We propose NVSHMEM-based rowwise EP, which writes each token directly into its expert's buffer, avoiding dispatch and combine permutation overhead. We make EP fully synchronization-free by keeping routing metadata on the GPU and using device-scheduled grouped GEMMs. Closely integrated MXFP8 cuts compute, activation-memory, and transport costs, and topology-agnostic checkpoints let the parallel layout change between runs. On NVL8 B300 nodes, the stack supports training configurations from 12.9 billion to 1.2 trillion total parameters on up to 512 GPUs, reaching 858 useful-model TFLOP/s/GPU at 1.2 trillion with MXFP8 and per-layer recompute; an experimental capacity test with the optional DeepEP v2 backend reaches 2.38 trillion. We also explain each design choice and share findings for other training systems; for example, we identify a failure pattern we call Token Gerrymandering, in which the MoE router can learn to hack the load-balancing loss, and find that overlapping communication with computation can slow the overlapped kernels by more than it hides.
comment: 169 pages. Web version and video: this https URL

AI.tldr: 重构Olmo-core训练栈，降低MoE通信与内存开销，支持万亿参数规模训练。
AI.motivation: MoE虽减少每词元计算，但通信、内存与内核开销随总参数量增长，拖累训练吞吐。
AI.method: 以DDP替代FSDP，整合专家与流水线并行、无同步路由、MXFP8和分布式优化器。
AI.result: 在最多512张GPU上训练1.2万亿参数模型，达到每卡858有效模型TFLOP/s。
AI.conclusion: 面向MoE重构训练系统可提升扩展性，但需警惕路由损失投机及通信计算重叠的负效应。

title: Dual-Stage Channel-Posterior Integration for MLM-Aided Token Communications
summary: Token transmission over conventional digital modulation is vulnerable to channel impairments, leading to bit errors that cause received tokens to become contextually inconsistent. This paper proposes a receiver-side dual-stage channel-posterior integration framework for masked language model (MLM)-aided token reconstruction. In the proposed framework, the receiver detects unreliable token positions from channel reliability and constructs a vocabulary-level channel-posterior. In particular, within the receiver, Posterior-Weighted Input Embedding (PWE) injects this posterior into the MLM input, while Adaptive Output Logit Fusion (AOF) reuses it at the output with a channel-adaptive weight. Consequently, multiple unreliable tokens can be reconstructed in a single bidirectional MLM inference without retransmission, transmitter-side encoding, or additional MLM training. Experiments over noisy channels show up to a $67.2$\% improvement in cosine similarity over context-only MLM reconstruction, with consistent gains across different MLM architectures and existing language-model-aided methods.
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures, This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible

AI.tldr: 在MLM输入与输出两阶段融合信道后验，提高噪声信道中的词元重建质量。
AI.motivation: 数字调制传输中的信道损伤会引发比特错误，使接收词元与上下文不一致。
AI.method: 根据信道可靠性定位不可靠词元，将词表级后验用于输入嵌入加权和自适应输出融合。
AI.result: 相较仅依赖上下文的MLM重建，余弦相似度最高提升67.2%，且跨架构保持增益。
AI.conclusion: 该框架无需重传、发送端编码或额外训练，即可通过一次双向MLM推理重建多个不可靠词元。

title: Accelerating Atomistic-Continuum Simulations of Multilayer 2D Materials with Functional Principal Component Analysis-Based Machine Learning
summary: Atomistic-continuum simulations of complex wrinkling deformations in large-area multilayer two-dimensional (2D) materials are computationally expensive. To accelerate these simulations, this work presents a machine-learning (ML) framework that first constructs a low-dimensional representation of the deformation field, then learns the deformation in this reduced space. Dimensionality reduction of deformed 2D membranes is challenging because of the extremely high dimensionality of discretized deformation fields, the need to preserve surface continuity and prescribed geometric constraints, the stochastic nature of wrinkling patterns, and the limited availability of training data. We address these challenges using two-dimensional functional principal component analysis (FPCA). The proposed FPCA representation reduces deformation fields containing millions of degrees of freedom to latent spaces with only tens of dimensions while preserving the continuity of the deformed surface. In addition, prescribed homogeneous boundary constraints are satisfied exactly through an appropriate choice of basis functions in the FPCA representation. A neural network is then trained to predict the principal components from the system and loading parameters. The resulting ML-predicted deformation fields are used as high-quality initial configurations for the atomistic-continuum solver, which subsequently performs energy minimization to obtain equilibrium solutions. The framework is demonstrated for multilayer graphene subjected to uniaxial compression, biaxial compression, and combined biaxial compression and simple shear. For the most computationally intensive large-strain cases, the proposed approach achieves speedups of at least 6.8 times while converging to final energies comparable to, and in some cases lower than, those obtained using conventional atomistic-continuum initialization.

AI.tldr: 通过函数主成分分析与神经网络预测初始形变，加速多层二维材料的原子—连续体模拟。
AI.motivation: 大面积多层二维材料的褶皱模拟成本高，形变降维还需兼顾连续性、边界约束及有限数据。
AI.method: 用二维函数主成分分析压缩形变场，再由神经网络预测主成分，为能量最小化提供初值。
AI.result: 高计算成本的大应变案例至少加速6.8倍，最终能量与常规初始化相当或更低。
AI.conclusion: 保留表面连续性并精确满足齐次边界约束的低维表示，可有效加速多层石墨烯平衡态求解。

title: SpecRelay: Amortize or Avoid the Round Trip in Edge-Cloud Speculative Decoding
summary: Edge-cloud speculative decoding moves autoregressive drafting to an edge device while a larger cloud model verifies draft tokens in parallel, so that edge drafting and cloud verification overlap under a synchronous draft-verify schedule. Beyond low-latency local networks, however, the next verification request of that schedule can be sent only after the previous reply arrives, so every round still waits out a full round trip, and throughput falls as the network RTT grows. To recover this loss, we present SpecRelay, an edge-cloud LLM inference system that addresses this cost at two levels: it amortizes round trips when cloud verification is necessary and avoids them when local reasoning suffices. For cloud-bound queries, an asynchronous verification pipeline keeps fixed-budget draft trees in flight while earlier replies are still outstanding, and the cloud rejects stale requests before the target-model forward pass (the asynchronous schedule). At the query level, an RTT-conditioned router (the Latency-Aware Router) estimates quality and completion latency for three on-device modes (direct generation, Chain-of-Draft, and full reasoning) and cloud speculative decoding, selecting among them under a configurable accuracy-latency objective without adding latency during inference, since the router runs concurrently with the draft-model prefill. The asynchronous schedule alone improves decoding throughput by up to 50% over a reproduced synchronous baseline across multiple benchmarks. At matched target-model accuracy and 250 ms of added round-trip latency, the full system with the router delivers 1.95x and 1.55x the throughput of the same baseline on SPROUT and OlympiadBench, respectively, while sending only 47% and 39% of the queries to the cloud.

AI.tldr: SpecRelay结合异步云端验证与时延感知路由，缓解边云推测解码的往返时延瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 同步草拟—验证流程每轮均需等待完整网络往返，导致高时延网络中的吞吐下降。
AI.method: 以异步流水线摊薄验证往返成本，并依据准确率与时延目标选择本地推理或云端验证。
AI.result: 额外往返时延250毫秒且准确率匹配时，两项基准吞吐分别达基线1.95倍和1.55倍。
AI.conclusion: 异步验证与查询级路由能够减少云端请求，并改善高网络时延下的边云推理效率。

title: Context Matters: Improving LLM-Based Code Summarization with Hierarchical Information
summary: Source code documentation plays an important role in software quality activities, such as code review, program comprehension, maintenance, and bug fixing. However, it is often fragmented across individual code elements and focuses on local implementation details, providing little information about their surrounding context. This limits both developers' understanding of software systems and the effectiveness of Large Language Models (LLMs), whose reasoning is constrained by finite context windows. Enriching documentation with hierarchical context has the potential to improve software comprehension and support downstream, quality-related tasks for both developers and LLM-based tools. In this paper, we present an in silico study that showcases the impact of augmenting context on the generation of code-level documentation, using a variety of LLMs. By varying the function, class, and module hierarchy visible to the LLMs, we assess whether this variation produces a significant difference in the resulting code documentation compared with the existing documentation, which serves as a proxy for developer intent. Our results show that Documentation-Aware prompts with class or module-level context consistently yield summaries that are closest to the original documentation. Adding surrounding documentation yields statistically significant improvements over the baseline across models, with effect sizes ranging from negligible (DeepSeek) through weak (GPT-4o-mini) to medium (Gemini). We restrict the study to this immediate hierarchical context; call-graph traversal and cross-module dependency context fall outside our scope and are left to future work. These findings provide a clear path to improve automated documentation tools and enhance LLMs' ability to reason about codebases for downstream tasks, such as code retrieval.
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, 10 tables. Accepted and presented at the Brazilian Symposium on Software Quality (SBQS 2026), Technical Track. Replication package: this https URL

AI.tldr: 为大语言模型提供类或模块级上下文及周边文档，可生成更接近原始文档的代码摘要。
AI.motivation: 代码文档常局限于局部实现细节，缺少层级上下文，限制开发者理解与模型代码推理。
AI.method: 改变多种模型可见的函数、类和模块信息，以现有文档作为开发者意图的代理进行比较。
AI.result: 加入周边文档在各模型上均显著优于基线，效应量从可忽略到中等不等。
AI.conclusion: 直接层级上下文可改善自动文档生成，但调用图及跨模块依赖信息的作用仍待研究。

title: Contextual Non-Convex Bandit Optimization with Two-Point Feedback
summary: We study a non-stochastic contextual bandit problem with Lipschitz losses. At every round, the learner observes the context then picks two actions, observes the difference between their losses, and incurs their mean. The aim is to minimize the regret against a generic non-parametric comparator class of policies mapping contexts to actions; for example, Lipschitz policies and Hölder-smooth policies. We show how relying on a hierarchical discretization technique allows us to improve upon the regret rates achievable under one-point feedback, and even recover the full-information rate in some cases; notably, for sufficiently smooth policy classes or low-dimensional instances. Additionally, for Lipschitz policies, we present an algorithm whose per-round computational complexity is only logarithmic in the time horizon.

AI.tldr: 通过层级离散化利用两点损失差反馈，改善非随机上下文非凸老虎机问题的遗憾率。
AI.motivation: 研究如何利用两点反馈，在通用非参数策略比较类下取得优于单点反馈的遗憾保证。
AI.method: 每轮依据上下文选择两个动作，观察损失差并承担平均损失，结合层级离散化优化策略。
AI.result: 所得遗憾率优于单点反馈，部分情形达到全信息速率，且Lipschitz策略算法每轮复杂度为时域对数级。
AI.conclusion: 对足够光滑的策略类或低维问题，两点反馈能够实现全信息情形的遗憾率。

title: Three Invisible Failure Modes in Speech-Based Age Estimation for Child Safety
summary: Child safety in AI depends on the accurate identification of minor users. Young children tend to talk rather than type when interacting with AI, so in practice this identification requires predicting age from speech. We evaluated whether three audio-capable large language models can predict a child's age from their speech across five studies using two speech corpora of children under the age of 13. Models classified children as over 13 on 2.5% to 42.5% of audio responses, and every model that answered placed some 5- to 11-year-olds over 18. While measuring these rates, we uncovered three distinct failure modes. A client library silently double-encoded speech samples, leading one model to classify children aged 5 to 10 years old as being in their thirties and forties with hallucinated explanations. A second model's endpoint was replaced by a successor that refused nearly every age-related question and never produced an age. Every model sometimes placed the same speech sample under 13 and over 18 years of age, but a third model went further, giving threshold answers that contradicted its own numeric estimates. None of these failure modes produced a warning, a status code, or a change in output format, so they would all pass standard monitoring. These results demonstrate why child-safety claims about age assurance should be evaluated at the level of the pipeline rather than the model. We describe the reporting practices that would make such failures detectable.
comment: Non-archival poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Child Safety in AI

AI.tldr: 儿童语音年龄估计存在监控难以察觉的管线故障，可能削弱基于年龄识别的儿童安全保障。
AI.motivation: 幼童常通过语音与AI交互，儿童保护因此依赖可靠的语音年龄识别。
AI.method: 使用两个13岁以下儿童语音语料库，通过五项研究评估三个具备音频能力的大语言模型。
AI.result: 儿童被判为超过13岁的比例为2.5%至42.5%，并发现双重编码、端点替换和回答矛盾三类故障。
AI.conclusion: 年龄保障应在完整管线层面评估，并采用能揭示静默故障的报告规范，而非仅评估模型。

title: Bilateral Log-Linear Attention
summary: Sequence models represent past context at different resolutions, using token-level keys and values, fixed-size recurrent states, or hierarchies of compressed summaries. Full attention supports strong associative recall but requires quadratic work during training and prefill and a linearly growing key-value cache during inference. Linear attention and state-space models reduce these costs through fixed-size recurrent memory, but this compression can limit recall. Log-linear attention offers a middle ground by maintaining logarithmically many state matrices. However, its hierarchy favors finer resolution near the current query while compressing earlier context into coarser summaries. To complement this allocation of resolution, we introduce bilateral log-linear attention, which pairs the existing hierarchy with a second hierarchy anchored at the sequence origin. By combining their reads, the two branches provide finer access to both early and recent context while remaining causal. We derive recurrent and chunkwise parallel formulations for the added branch, preserving log-linear training and prefill work, logarithmic decoding work per token, and logarithmic persistent state storage at fixed feature dimensions and chunk size. In multi-query associative recall, this design raises mean overall test accuracy from 76.37% to 96.12% over forward log-linear attention across multiple training seeds. For pretrained language models under approximate parameter matching, it raises the mean score on six selected RULER needle-in-a-haystack tasks from 26.97% to 50.03% at a context length of 6144 tokens. In the same setting, bilateral attention also outperforms forward log-linear attention on seven of eight downstream retrieval tasks, including question answering and information extraction.

AI.tldr: 双向锚定的对数线性注意力兼顾早期与近期上下文，提高召回能力并保留低复杂度。
AI.motivation: 既有对数线性注意力偏重近期细节，对早期上下文的粗粒度压缩可能限制召回。
AI.method: 在原有层级之外增加锚定序列起点的因果分支，融合两支读取并推导递归及分块并行形式。
AI.result: 关联召回准确率从76.37%升至96.12%，六项RULER任务均分从26.97%升至50.03%。
AI.conclusion: 双分支设计保留对数线性训练及对数级解码和状态开销，并在八项下游检索任务中改善七项。

title: TMA: Sim-to-Real Forceful Humanoid Manipulation via Tactile-Driven Motor Adaptation
summary: Recent humanoid loco-manipulation in articulated environments has largely focused on geometry-dominant interactions, where success is primarily determined by geometric alignment and motion execution. In contrast, forceful multi-finger manipulation requires the robot to adapt to real-world uncertainties in contact and interaction dynamics. We present Tactile-Driven Motor Adaptation (TMA) and an integrated whole-body system for zero-shot sim-to-real forceful humanoid manipulation, and study round-doorknob opening as a challenging benchmark requiring stable multi-finger frictional grasping, sufficient torque generation without slip, force-regulated pushing, and whole-body stability. TMA structures policy learning around interactions observable through tactile feedback, uses cone geometry as an inductive bias for multi-finger contact representation, and adapts motor behavior online from tactile history. An upper-body manipulation policy is trained alongside a pretrained general locomotion controller to coordinate dexterous interaction and whole-body stabilization. Trained entirely in simulation, TMA transfers zero-shot to a Unitree G1 humanoid with BrainCo Revo2 multi-fingered hands and substantially outperforms standard Rapid Motor Adaptation (RMA) and reactive tactile policy baselines across four commercial round doorknobs in the real world.

AI.tldr: TMA通过触觉驱动的在线运动适应，实现人形机器人用力操作的零样本仿真到现实迁移。
AI.motivation: 多指用力操作需要应对真实接触动力学的不确定性，单靠几何对齐与动作执行难以保证成功。
AI.method: 以锥体几何表征多指接触，根据触觉历史在线适应动作，并结合上身策略与预训练行走控制器。
AI.result: 纯仿真训练的TMA在真实G1机器人操作四款商用圆形门把手时，显著优于RMA和反应式触觉策略。
AI.conclusion: 围绕触觉可观测交互学习策略，可支持兼顾灵巧操作与全身稳定的零样本现实迁移。

title: Bayesian Learning of Uncertain Linear System Behaviours
summary: We present a Bayesian approach to learning uncertain behavioural representations of linear dynamical systems from noisy input-output data. In behavioural systems theory, the finite-horizon behaviour of a linear system is represented by a subspace. We quantify uncertainty in this subspace through probability distributions on the Grassmann manifold. This leads to a geometric formulation of Bayesian inference over the Grassmannian. We derive the posterior distribution under Gaussian measurement noise and discuss how uncertainty in the inferred behaviour can be propagated to trajectory predictions, with a view towards data-driven control.

AI.tldr: 提出贝叶斯方法，从含噪输入输出数据中学习线性系统行为子空间及其不确定性。
AI.motivation: 线性系统有限时域行为可由子空间表示，但从含噪数据推断该子空间时需要量化不确定性。
AI.method: 在格拉斯曼流形上定义概率分布，构建几何贝叶斯推断，并推导高斯测量噪声下的后验分布。
AI.result: 推导了行为子空间的后验分布，并讨论如何将其不确定性传播至轨迹预测。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为面向数据驱动控制的系统行为学习与预测提供了不确定性表征。

title: Probing Where Surprise Happens: Localized Violation-of-Expectation Evaluation of Video World Models
summary: Violation-of-expectation (VOE) benchmarks evaluate intuitive physics in video world models by testing whether physically impossible events produce greater prediction errors than matched possible events. However, conventional VOE evaluations aggregate prediction errors across space and time, making it unclear whether successful discrimination reflects model's understanding of physical violations at the locations and time where they occur. To address this limitation, we introduce localized VOE evaluation, a framework that measures prediction error differences between possible and impossible events within spatial regions and temporal intervals associated with physical violations. We compare global, temporally localized, and spatiotemporally localized evaluations of V-JEPA models pretrained on developmental egocentric videos or large-scale natural video datasets. Our results reveal that global and localized judgments can diverge in both directions: global aggregation can either obscure correct localized discrimination or produce apparent discrimination without corresponding localized evidence. During continued pretraining on developmental egocentric videos, agreement between global and localized judgments changes non-monotonically, while confidence in localized judgments increases despite modest improvements in accuracy. Together, these findings establish localized VOE evaluation as a complementary diagnostic for assessing intuitive physics in video world models and demonstrate that global prediction errors do not necessarily reflect the spatiotemporal evidence of physical violations.

AI.tldr: 局部化预期违背评估揭示，视频世界模型的全局误差未必反映物理违背发生处的证据。
AI.motivation: 传统评估在时空上聚合预测误差，无法判断模型是否在物理违背发生的位置和时刻正确区分事件。
AI.method: 提出局部化预期违背评估，比较不同预训练数据下V-JEPA的全局、时间局部和时空局部判断。

AI.conclusion: 局部化评估可作为视频世界模型直觉物理能力的补充诊断，不能仅凭全局误差判断其理解能力。

title: Robot Demonstration Videos Should Include Transparency Disclosures
summary: This paper argues that the robotics and AI community should adopt disclosure standards for demonstration videos. As physical and financial constraints limit direct public access to embodied AI, public dissemination of progress in robotics is mainly through curated demonstration videos rather than direct experience with the technology. In a large-scale (N=9,341), pre-registered experiment across six countries, we find that the general public struggles to discern both the visual authenticity (e.g., distinguishing real footage from CGI) and behavioral authenticity (e.g., distinguishing autonomy from teleoperation) of robot demonstration videos. The omission of these details distorts public perception, leading people to overestimate the ability of robots to perform tasks and navigate real world environments. Using evidence from behavioral science, we design a disclosure intervention and demonstrate that the inclusion of clear disclosures in robot demonstration videos significantly improves discernment of visual and behavioral authenticity, as well as understanding robots' capabilities. We propose the adoption of disclosure standards for robot demonstration videos to accurately calibrate public expectations and promote transparency in robotics research.

AI.tldr: 跨六国实验表明，机器人演示视频中的清晰披露有助于公众辨别真实性并理解机器人能力。
AI.motivation: 公众主要通过精心编排的视频了解机器人，缺少真实性与自主性信息可能导致能力高估。
AI.method: 开展覆盖六国、9341人的预注册实验，并基于行为科学设计披露干预。
AI.result: 公众难以辨别画面及行为真实性，而清晰披露显著改善辨别能力与对机器人能力的理解。
AI.conclusion: 机器人与人工智能社区应采用演示视频披露标准，以校准公众预期并促进研究透明度。

title: AGI: Agility Index for Power Systems Dynamic Performance, Inspired by Reynolds Number
summary: Multiple established metrics and indices exist to quantify the dynamic performance of power systems. With the growth of inverter based resources, these mostly conventional metrics and indices may not encompass all important elements and variables that hold information about the grid performance, especially the damping properties. This paper proposes the Agility Index (AGI), which is a Reynolds number-inspired metric for power system dynamics relating the ratio of inertia to damping. With the current trends towards high-power inverter assets and reduced-inertia grids, explicit attention is necessary in monitoring inertia and damping together. This paper shares insights the AGI presents about the dynamic performance of power systems.

AI.tldr: 提出受雷诺数启发的敏捷性指数AGI，以惯量与阻尼之比刻画电力系统动态性能。
AI.motivation: 逆变器资源增加与电网惯量降低，使传统动态性能指标可能遗漏阻尼等重要信息。
AI.method: 借鉴雷诺数构建关联惯量与阻尼比值的AGI，并讨论其对电力系统动态性能的启示。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体结果。
AI.conclusion: 在高功率逆变器与低惯量电网发展背景下，应联合监测惯量和阻尼。

title: Large language models as oncology world models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can synthesize cancer patient cases, but their internal representation of oncology, or world model, has not been explored systematically. By only specifying tumor type, we show that LLMs tend to generate similar patients per cancer, with on average 81.0% to 93.2% of a cancer's patients sharing the most frequent value of each baseline feature. By systematically varying patient features in 12 clinical scenarios, we show that they follow biomarker and treatment logic in 29 of 36 model-scenario assessments, against 1 of 12 when previous treatment or frailty matters. Continuing real patient trajectories, an LLM predicted 89.9% 12-month survival, and 79.2% with similar patients as examples, against 72.2% observed. To represent these trajectories, we developed the Clinical State Space, a dynamic representation framework that we also applied to real patients. Despite the limits we show, improved world models may support digital twins, which our framework can evaluate.

title: Revealing the Biases of Large Language Models By Inferring Prior Distributions
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been known to exhibit a wide range of social biases including name-nationality associations, occupation-gender associations and racial stereotypes. Existing approaches to evaluating these biases typically involve measuring surface-level behavior where a model is fed a dataset of prompts and its outputs are scored relative to ground-truth answers. Inspired by prior elicitation in cognitive science, we propose a different perspective that reconstructs latent bias as a prior underlying the model's behavior. We formulate the problem as a Bayesian inverse problem where, given prompt-response observations on a bias benchmark dataset, we infer a low-dimensional latent distribution that summarizes the model's stereotyping tendencies. This paper develops the mathematical foundation, a practical reconstruction algorithm, and experiments using the Bias Benchmark for QA (BBQ) benchmark to infer the prior distributions of LLMs over responses in ambiguous social contexts.

AI.tldr: 提出通过贝叶斯逆问题重建潜在先验分布，以刻画大语言模型的社会刻板印象倾向。
AI.motivation: 现有偏见评估主要对提示响应进行表面评分，难以揭示支配模型行为的潜在偏见。
AI.method: 从偏见基准的提示响应推断低维潜在分布，建立数学基础与重建算法，并开展BBQ实验。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体结果。
AI.conclusion: 潜在先验重建为理解大语言模型在模糊社会情境中的偏见提供了不同于表面评分的视角。

title: Model Maps: A Documentation Framework for Tracing Foundation Model Ancestry and Understanding AI Entanglement
summary: The development of foundation models incorporates pre-existing AI artifacts like models, datasets, and benchmarks. These relationships, as part of the broader AI supply chain, produce "entangled" webs in which properties of artifacts upstream can influence the outputs of a foundation model downstream - a phenomenon known as AI entanglement. Without visibility into these connections, a black-box model can inherit upstream properties that result in security vulnerabilities, hallucinations, or biased predictions, yet developers are left with no recourse to identify or mitigate the root issue. To address these concerns, we introduce model maps as a conceptual documentation framework for tracing model ancestry that builds on previous documentation frameworks like ecosystem graphs, datasheets, and model cards. A model map for a given foundation model is a detailed knowledge graph that represents the relationships between artifacts that influence the resulting foundation model. Our framework incorporates a taxonomy of 13 dependency mechanisms including model fine-tuning and synthetic data generation. We apply this framework to construct model maps of 15 closed and open-weight foundation models to illustrate the complexity of AI entanglement in current model development practices. From our model maps, we record 2,778 unique dependencies and trace artifacts that are located up to 9 hops away from a resulting foundation model. Our findings suggest that AI transparency requirements should extend beyond individual models and training-data disclosures to encompass upstream dependencies, which would enable more effective risk assessment, auditing, and accountability across the AI supply chain. To help developers, regulators, and researchers understand and analyze the interactions that can influence the behavior of a foundation model, we release these these model maps at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 提出模型地图，以知识图谱追溯基础模型的上游依赖，支持理解人工智能供应链纠缠。
AI.motivation: 上游模型、数据与基准可能传递漏洞、幻觉及偏见，但依赖不可见使问题溯源与缓解困难。
AI.method: 构建包含13类依赖机制的模型祖先文档框架，并为15个闭源及开放权重基础模型绘制知识图谱。
AI.result: 模型地图记录了2778项独特依赖，追溯到距最终模型最远9跳的上游产物。
AI.conclusion: 人工智能透明度要求应覆盖上游依赖，以支持供应链风险评估、审计与问责。

title: Agent-ZTA: A chain-Aware Zero Trust Model for Bidirectional Security-State Propagation and Runtime Containment in Multi-Agent Delegation
summary: Multi-agent systems increasingly delegate tasks and permissions across chains of autonomous agents that invoke protected tools. Although agent identities and delegated credentials may remain valid throughout a workflow, the security condition of any agent along the chain can deteriorate during runtime execution-either through upstream compromise or downstream ingestion of untrusted inputs. Authorization models based solely on the immediate caller and its static delegated scope fail to account for these mid-execution state changes. This paper develops Agent-ZTA, a chain-aware Zero Trust authorization and containment model that links runtime security-state changes across multi-agent delegation graphs. The model distinguishes an agent's path-specific delegated authority bound from the effective permissions currently exercisable under trusted policy. It defines an architecture featuring independently enforced policy decisions, authenticated delegation provenance, a dynamic chain-state view, and explicit fail-safe handling of missing or stale authorization signals. Furthermore, Agent-ZTA defines bidirectional security state propagation, allowing downstream security events to affect relevant upstream workflow states, and specifies adaptive branch-scoped containment through restricted permissions and a sandbox ("jail") execution mode where an isolation boundary is available. The deterministic decision procedure, five stated security properties, and worked authorization traces show how accepted security-state changes constrain affected operations while preserving original delegation bounds and separating unrelated workflow branches under the defined policies. Finally, the paper states its trust assumptions and the exact scope of its security properties.

AI.tldr: Agent-ZTA通过双向传播运行时安全状态，实现多智能体委托链的动态授权与分支隔离。
AI.motivation: 仅依赖直接调用者身份和静态委托范围的授权，无法应对委托链中途发生的安全状态变化。
AI.method: 区分路径委托权限上界与当前有效权限，结合独立策略决策、委托溯源、双向状态传播及沙箱约束。
AI.result: 确定性决策过程、安全性质及授权示例表明，模型可约束受影响操作，同时保持委托边界并隔离无关分支。
AI.conclusion: 在明确的信任假设和策略范围内，链感知零信任模型可支持运行时动态授权与局部安全遏制。

title: Lie Group Structure of Six Degree-of-Freedom Rigid-Body Uncertainty Representation and Propagation
summary: For six-degree-of-freedom rigid-body motion, the choice of Lie-group structure affects both how well the group-theoretic mean and covariance represent the state distribution and how accurately these moments are propagated. A quaternion-based, left-trivialized semidirect-product formulation of the velocity phase space is developed for the actuated body-frame dynamics, with closed-form group operations and Jacobians that avoid matrix-group embeddings. We derive the controlled stochastic dynamics and establish that the direct- and semidirect-product formulations describe the same physical process under the specified noise model. Since the semidirect exponential coordinates account for frame changes between body twists at different poses, they capture pose--twist coupling more naturally. A lunar powered-descent experiment assesses low-order moment representations of uncertainty and propagation performance under the proposed group structure using two distinct algorithms. Compared with direct-product formulations and a linearized baseline, the proposed structure improves the representation of the banana-shaped body-velocity distribution using group-theoretic moments, yields more consistent propagated moments, and produces distribution approximations that agree more closely with the Monte Carlo reference. In this experiment, changing the group structure accounts for most of the observed improvement, highlighting the practical value of the proposed semidirect-product formulation.

AI.tldr: 基于四元数的半直积李群表示改善了六自由度刚体不确定性的矩描述与传播。
AI.motivation: 李群结构的选择影响刚体状态分布的均值、协方差表示及其传播精度。
AI.method: 构建左平凡化半直积速度相空间，推导群运算、雅可比和随机动力学，并用两种算法开展月球动力下降实验。
AI.result: 相比直积表示和线性化基线，该结构更好刻画香蕉形速度分布，传播矩更一致，且更接近蒙特卡洛参考。
AI.conclusion: 实验中大部分改进来自群结构变化，表明半直积表示对捕捉位姿与速度耦合具有实际价值。

title: AdaMenu: Query-Adaptive Menus for Decision Models over Large Label Spaces
summary: Decision models such as Jev return probabilities over caller-defined options and are increasingly used for classification. Large label spaces challenge both accuracy and scalability: larger menus can impair decisions, increase input costs, and exceed option limits. Hierarchical classification reduces menu size but introduces serial calls and error propagation. We propose AdaMenu, which builds a compact candidate menu from retrieved labeled examples and makes a single decision-model request. Its candidate labels adapt to the query, and its default setting also adjusts menu size using aggregated retrieval scores. We evaluate AdaMenu with open and closed decision models on four label sets containing up to 1,016 labels. It outperforms TypeSafe's beam-search baseline on all 16 model and label-set pairs where both methods run, improving accuracy by 16.6-34.3 percentage points. Relative to the full menu on the three smaller label sets, accuracy differences range from -0.5 to +7.2 percentage points, while input token usage falls by factors of 3.2-22.9. AdaMenu also runs when option limits exclude the full menu, including settings where the hierarchical baseline is unavailable.

AI.tldr: AdaMenu根据查询检索候选标签，以单次决策模型调用兼顾大标签空间分类的准确率与成本。
AI.motivation: 大标签菜单降低决策准确率并增加成本，层次分类则引入串行调用和错误传播。
AI.method: 从检索到的带标签示例构建查询自适应候选菜单，并默认根据聚合检索分数调整菜单大小。
AI.result: 在全部16组可比配置中较束搜索基线提升16.6—34.3个百分点，较完整菜单减少输入词元3.2—22.9倍。
AI.conclusion: AdaMenu在接近或优于完整菜单准确率的同时降低输入成本，并可运行于完整菜单受选项上限限制的场景。

title: Role-Separated Diffusion Transformers: Global Rule Isolation and Deterministic Sampling Manifold Compression
summary: We present Role-Separated Diffusion Transformers (RoSeDiT), a new diffusion transformer architecture that isolates the global rule from the image tokens. RoSeViT showed in visual reasoning that a vanilla ViT spreads a shared rule over all $L$ tokens at an entropy of order $Ld$, whereas an enforced controller route reduces it to order $d$. In class-conditional DiT and SiT, the class and the noise level are explicitly conditioned by adaLN, so a RoSeViT-style controller channel on the ViT side is insufficient to establish the full role separation. By introducing the adaLN listening mechanism, which makes adaLN compute under the controller's command, RoSeDiT brings the entropy theorem and role separation into the latent diffusion domain. Under the same SiT training and evaluation protocol at the same level of parameter count, RoSeDiT surpasses SiT at all four model scales at 400K steps, and RoSeDiT-L/2 even surpasses SiT-XL/2's 17.2 FID with 15.34 and 32% fewer parameters. RoSeDiT-XL/2 surpasses SiT-XL/2's 7M-step FID of 8.3 at 1.4M steps with 7.98, using one-fifth as many training steps. We further observe that models with the same denoising loss can have a large FID gap, which indicates a misalignment between the denoising objective and the image manifold. We formalize this phenomenon into Deterministic Sampling Manifold Compression (DSMC), a two-stage training schedule with which RoSeDiT-XL/2 surpasses SiT + REPA's 4M-step FID of 5.9 at 2.4M steps with 5.84.

title: Taking Band-Limited Maximum Likelihood to High Dimensions: Linear Memory, the Parametric Rate, and a Self-Tuning Cut-off
summary: Band-limited maximum likelihood (BLML) estimates a density as the square of a band-limited function. The estimate is non-negative, and when the square root of the true density is band-limited its error falls at the parametric rate $n^{-1}$. Its algorithm bins the data, which is fast only in one or two dimensions: from three on every point has its own bin, the kernel system is dense, and memory grows as $n^2$, 40 GB at $10^5$ points. Whether the rate survives in higher dimension, where kernel estimators slow down, had not been tested. We study dense data, densities that fill their space, not data near a low-dimensional manifold. We show that the binned equations are the stationarity condition of a strictly convex objective and minimise it by block coordinate descent without forming the kernel matrix: memory is linear in $n$, a sweep costs $O(n^2 d)$ and a fit takes about ten, and one A100 GPU fits $10^6$ points in eight dimensions in about ten minutes. On band-limited truths the error then decays as $n^{-1}$ in every dimension we tested, up to eight, while the slopes of kernel estimators flatten from -0.67 to -0.28, and it is 2 to 18 times lower than a neural spline flow's. A streaming fit learns the cut-off, BLML's only tuning parameter, from analytic gradients of the held-out likelihood, for about the cost of one more fit. On real data BLML is the strongest nonparametric estimator we tested: it leads kernel and nearest-neighbour estimators on electricity prices by 0.27 to 0.47 nats per hour, and a tuned kernel estimator on the full POWER and GAS benchmarks by 0.39 and 1.58 nats per point, placing it between early and recent normalizing flows. It loses on densities with a kink.

AI.tldr: 线性内存优化使带限最大似然密度估计扩展至八维，并在带限真分布上保持参数收敛率。
AI.motivation: 原有带限最大似然算法在高维需二次内存，其参数收敛率能否延续到高维尚未验证。

title: MemoryLane: Supporting Reminiscence Conversations Between Older Adults with Mild Dementia and Lay Caregivers Using a Simulated AI Agent
summary: Reminiscence Therapy (RT) is a non-pharmacological intervention that invites patients to discuss and review past life experiences and memories to improve their emotional and mental well-being. In practice, many reminiscence conversations are led by lay caregivers, such as spouses and adult children. While traditional RT often relies on personal photographs, curating them can be tedious and difficult. In addition, caregivers who lack shared life experiences with the patient may struggle to facilitate engaging reminiscence conversations. This paper presents MemoryLane, an AI-integrated tool that helps lay caregivers facilitate reminiscence conversations without curated photographs. MemoryLane supports a triadic conversation among the patient, the caregiver, and a simulated AI agent that acts as the patient's peer. A shared interface shows the agent and AI-generated images of the memories being discussed, while a private smartphone interface lets the caregiver control the behavior of the simulated AI agent and moderate the AI-generated images. A preliminary focus group study with five dementia-care stakeholders suggested the value of MemoryLane's AI agent as a peer companion and of AI-generated images, as well as the feasibility of having caregivers moderate images and control the AI agent.

AI.tldr: MemoryLane利用模拟同龄AI伙伴和生成图像，辅助非专业照护者与轻度失智老人开展回忆对话。
AI.motivation: 回忆疗法所需的个人照片整理繁琐，缺乏共同经历的照护者也难以引导有吸引力的对话。
AI.method: 设计患者、照护者和模拟AI的三方对话，配合共享图像界面及供照护者控制代理和审核图像的手机界面。
AI.result: 五名失智照护相关人士的初步焦点小组研究提示，AI伙伴和生成图像具有价值，照护者调控方案具可行性。
AI.conclusion: 初步研究支持该工具的设计潜力，但尚未提供其改善患者情绪或心理健康的效果证据。

title: Match and Correct: A Repeated Computational Motif in Evoformer Layers
summary: Triangle attention and triangle multiplicative updates form key components of the Evoformer, and were introduced specifically to encourage consistency with the triangle inequality. Yet whether representational changes over layers reduce triangle inequality violations has not been tested. We probe the pair representation at each of OpenFold's 48 Evoformer layers, decoding final C$_\alpha$-C$_\alpha$ distances with four probe families (a shared linear probe, per-protein linear probes, a sequence-separation-gated linear probe, and XGBoost) and reconstructing intermediate 3D structures from the decoded distances via multidimensional scaling. Across a cohort of 552 CAMEO and ECOD proteins, distance decodability ($R^2$) and reconstruction quality (TM-score) rise in early layers, plateau in the middle of the network, and rise again in late layers. Directly measuring triangle-inequality violations in the decoded distances reveals a similar, more exaggerated pattern: violations rise to a peak, fall to a trough, rise to a second peak, and only then decline, revealing two distinct episodes of decreasing normalized triangle violations rather than one continuous improvement. Cumulative forward and reverse layer-wise ablations of the Pair Transition, MSA Transition, and triangle mechanisms localize the regions in which specific Evoformer components become essential. The two stages of geometric refinement coincide with the use of the Pair Transition MLP and the triangle mechanisms. These results characterize how distance information and decoded geometric consistency evolve across layers, and motivate hypotheses about the computations behind their trajectories.
