title: Averaged-Cost Control with Shared Feedback under Model Uncertainty
summary: This paper studies the shared-feedback design problem for finite-horizon averaged-cost control under model uncertainty represented by a joint law over the model parameter and initial state. One feedback map is shared across all realizations and uses only time and the current state as online inputs. We develop two methods: the nonlinear adjoint method combines forward closed-loop solves, backward adjoints, and joint-law policy gradients, while the linear moment method gives exact cost and gradient formulas for a homogeneous linear-quadratic design model by propagating conditional second moments. Numerical studies compare averaged and nominal designs for time-dependent neural feedback and static linear feedback in nonlinear Van der Pol and Stuart-Landau systems; the static gains are designed from oscillator linearizations and evaluated on the original nonlinear systems. Averaged design has lower cost in most comparisons.

AI.tldr: 针对模型不确定性设计共享状态反馈，可在多数数值比较中获得低于标称设计的平均代价。
AI.motivation: 模型参数和初始状态不确定时，需要仅依赖时间与当前状态、且适用于所有实现的统一反馈。
AI.method: 提出结合前向闭环求解与反向伴随的非线性方法，以及传播条件二阶矩以精确计算代价和梯度的线性方法。
AI.result: 在Van der Pol和Stuart-Landau非线性系统的神经反馈与静态线性反馈实验中，平均设计在多数比较中代价更低。
AI.conclusion: 利用参数与初始状态的联合分布优化共享反馈，在所测系统中通常优于仅依据标称模型设计。

title: Advancing the Calibration-Compute Frontier of LLM Classifiers via Asymmetric Duos
summary: The importance of reliable uncertainty estimation in large language models (LLMs) has become increasingly pronounced, yet modern models remain poorly calibrated and frequently overconfident. In this study, we address this by proposing an efficient method for LLM classifier calibration using the Asymmetric Duos framework. Our approach combines a strong base model with a smaller sidekick model via logit-space fusion, utilizing global scaling parameters optimized on a validation set. Across diverse benchmarks, this Asymmetric LLM Duo consistently achieves best or second-best performance on expected calibration error and negative log-likelihood, without degrading predictive accuracy. More importantly, these gains are realized at a fraction of the computational cost of more complex baselines, placing our method on the calibration-compute Pareto frontier. We further demonstrate that our method acts orthogonal to various established calibration-aware techniques, meaning it can be easily combined with them to consistently boost their performance. Finally, our analysis of the logit-space behavior illustrates how asymmetric fusion successfully mitigates base model overconfidence. Overall, our findings demonstrate that the benefits of an asymmetric fusion successfully transfer to the language domain, providing a simple, highly cost-efficient approach to improving uncertainty estimation in LLM classifiers.

AI.tldr: 通过大小模型的非对称融合，以较低计算成本改善大语言模型分类器的置信度校准。
AI.motivation: 现代大语言模型常过度自信，需要兼顾校准质量与计算效率的不确定性估计方法。
AI.method: 在逻辑值空间融合强基础模型与小型辅助模型，并在验证集上优化全局缩放参数。
AI.result: 多项基准上的预期校准误差和负对数似然均居最佳或次佳，且不损害预测准确率。
AI.conclusion: 非对称融合可缓解基础模型过度自信，并与现有校准技术结合，以较低成本提升校准效果。

title: Distance-Certified Safe Control in Unknown Environments via Spatio-Temporal Composition of Gaussian Processes
summary: In this paper, we propose a distance-certified safety control framework for unknown and dynamic environments. The proposed strategy relies on a spatio-temporal composition of Gaussian Process (GP) barriers from environment point clouds. A point-cloud-dependent covariance kernel is constructed to smoothly combine individual GP representations, yielding a continuously differentiable posterior mean and a diagonal observation Gram matrix that avoids dense covariance inversions. We then derive a closed-form calibration of the GP length scale accounting for spatial approximation errors and finite point-cloud coverage, guaranteeing a prescribed minimum distance from the true obstacle boundary. To handle moving obstacles and updated observations, the scan-based barriers are certified over finite validity horizons and smoothly combined into a time-varying Control Barrier Function (CBF). Under problem feasibility conditions, the associated CBF-based safety control guarantees forward invariance of the certified safe set, thereby ensuring the prescribed distance from the obstacles. Unicycle simulations with static and moving obstacles illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

AI.tldr: 通过高斯过程屏障的时空组合，为未知动态环境中的控制提供可认证的障碍距离保障。
AI.motivation: 未知动态环境中的安全控制需要处理点云覆盖有限、空间近似误差及障碍物运动。
AI.method: 构建点云相关协方差核并闭式校准长度尺度，将有限有效期的扫描屏障平滑组合为时变控制屏障函数。
AI.result: 在可行性条件下证明认证安全集前向不变，独轮车静态及动态障碍仿真展示了方法有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在问题可行时可保证与真实障碍边界保持预设最小距离，并避免稠密协方差矩阵求逆。

title: HeteroWear: Sensor-Aware Self-Supervised Learning for Heterogeneous Wearable Activity Recognition
summary: Self-supervised learning for wearable sensing is usually confined to a single dataset or device family, leaving open whether representations transfer across heterogeneous sensor configurations and whether gains come from pretraining rather than architecture or richer sensor input. We present HeteroWear, a sensor-aware self-supervised framework pretrained on an eight-dataset wearable corpus (173 subjects, 358,261 windows) spanning inertial and physiological signals across body locations, devices, and sampling rates. HeteroWear separates within-sensor temporal modeling from cross-sensor relational modeling using sensor-context embeddings, temporal and cross-sensor Transformers, and latent cross-attention fusion. Training combines structured sensor dropout, cross-configuration consistency, and per-axis masked sensor modeling; missing sensors are omitted rather than reconstructed. Under leave-one-dataset-out pretraining and subject-disjoint evaluation on PAMAP2, WISDM, HHAR, HARTH, and UCI-HAR, HeteroWear improves mean macro-F1 from 0.688 to 0.724 over the identical architecture trained from scratch, with the largest gain on HHAR (0.823 versus 0.741), and achieves the highest macro-F1 on four of five benchmarks relative to single-accelerometer supervised baselines. Held-out-device evaluation yields a mean +0.066 macro-F1 improvement. Under 50% test-time channel removal, HeteroWear retains 73.8% of full-channel performance versus 64.1% for the same architecture trained from scratch without sensor dropout. Ablations show that structured sensor dropout primarily drives robustness, while cross-configuration consistency and sensor-context encoding contribute to transfer.
comment: Extended version of a paper accepted at IEEE BigData 2026. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: HeteroWear通过传感器感知自监督预训练，提升异构可穿戴活动识别的迁移能力与缺失传感器鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 既有可穿戴自监督学习多局限于单一数据集或设备，跨传感器配置迁移及预训练收益尚不明确。
AI.method: 在八数据集语料上预训练，结合传感器上下文、时序与跨传感器建模、结构化丢弃及一致性和掩码学习。
AI.result: 平均宏F1由同架构从头训练的0.688升至0.724，移除半数通道时保留完整通道性能的73.8%。
AI.conclusion: 结构化传感器丢弃主要提升鲁棒性，跨配置一致性与传感器上下文编码有助于迁移。

title: SurveyWeave: An Agentic Framework for Automated Survey Generation
summary: Surveys help researchers keep up with fast-moving fields, but they take weeks to months to write. Automated survey generation (AutoSurvey) can alleviate this situation, but it is challenging to draw on hundreds to thousands of precisely scoped papers, choose among many valid structures, and stay faithful to its sources while offering insights. We present SurveyWeave, an agentic architecture that decomposes the problem into four tasks coordinated by three agents, each reviewing others' work and conducting revisions based on feedback. We also introduce WeaveEval, a five-dimension evaluation grounded in prior surveys. A comprehensive comparison shows that SurveyWeave outperforms Codex by 8 points and the strongest AutoSurvey baseline by 6 points.

AI.tldr: SurveyWeave以多智能体协作和交叉审查自动生成综述，并优于所比较的基线。
AI.motivation: 人工撰写综述耗时数周至数月，自动化生成则面临文献筛选、结构选择和来源忠实性挑战。
AI.method: 将综述生成分解为四项任务，由三个智能体协调、互审并修订，同时提出五维评估体系WeaveEval。
AI.result: 综合比较中，SurveyWeave比Codex高8分，比最强自动综述生成基线高6分。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体协作与反馈修订为自动综述生成提供了有效方案。

title: Refinement vs. Replanning: Inference Compute Allocation in Robot Policies
summary: A frozen chunked robot policy can spend deployment-time inference compute in two coupled ways: more work within each policy call to refine a predicted action chunk, or more frequent policy calls to replan from fresh observations. We study this allocation without updating model weights. Our evaluation procedure reports success with both nominal compute rate and complete attempt cost, selects comparisons on discovery tasks, and tests prespecified comparisons on held-out tasks. Comparisons added after inspecting the held-out results only summarize observed patterns. We demonstrate the procedure with one frozen SmolVLA checkpoint in synchronous LIBERO simulation, using denoising count as the refinement control and fixing chunk length at K=50. Arithmetic and latency characterize cost differently: at d=10, 82.1% of counted arithmetic is independent of denoising, whereas a descriptive affine fit to fixed-input host time assigns 17.7% to its intercept. At h=2, d=2 succeeds on 139/160 attempts versus 122/160 for d=5 (+10.6 percentage points; task-conditional 95% interval: +4.4 to +16.9), while using 5.9% less arithmetic per control step. Executing h=5 rather than h=2 at d=2 yields 138/160 versus 139/160 successes and 60.7% lower arithmetic per attempt; equivalence is not established. The case study shows why deployment adaptation must evaluate generation effort and feedback frequency jointly; it does not define a universal setting.
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Post-Training Adaptation of Robot Foundation Models

AI.tldr: 冻结机器人策略的推理计算分配需联合权衡动作细化与基于新观测的重规划频率。
AI.motivation: 部署计算既可用于细化单次动作块，也可用于增加重规划，但二者收益与成本相互耦合。
AI.method: 在同步LIBERO仿真中固定SmolVLA权重及动作块长度，调节去噪次数和执行步数，并区分发现与留出任务。
AI.result: 每次执行2步时，去噪2次较5次成功率高10.6个百分点且每步运算少5.9%，改为执行5步则每次尝试运算少60.7%。
AI.conclusion: 部署适配应联合评估生成投入与反馈频率，案例结果不构成通用设置或成功率等效证明。

title: The Critic Can Hurt: On the Safety of Critics in LLM-Guided AutoML Search
summary: LLM critics increasingly steer iterative search in agentic AutoML, prompt optimization, and self-refinement--evaluated for whether they help, but rarely for whether they can hurt. We isolate the critic's marginal effect through a four-arm audit and characterize the loop's tolerance through controlled fault injection. We show a naive 8B critic drives search below the no-critic random-search floor on 7 of 8 tabular datasets, losing up to 0.245 AUC in the worst case; the magnitude varies strongly with dataset, frontier, and budget. When: stronger critics attenuate the loss on the evaluated suite, without establishing a universal capability threshold. Why: controlled fault injection shows that non-directional errors are nearly costless under best-so-far search, whereas directional errors consume finite search opportunities; an idealized effective-sample calculation yields a necessary condition, $q(m-1) > \beta$, not a deployment certificate. How: a simple observable validation gate and a learned detector can reduce realized loss, but neither is guaranteed to preserve the full-budget no-critic baseline. We will release CRITFAULT, to our knowledge the first benchmark for detecting harmful critic feedback in AutoML. A critic is not a free addition: audit before trusting, and gate when capability or verification is insufficient.

AI.tldr: 大语言模型批评器可能使自动机器学习搜索劣于无批评器随机搜索，使用前需要审计与门控。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多评估批评器是否有益，却很少检验其能否损害迭代搜索。
AI.method: 通过四组审计隔离批评器边际效应，注入受控错误，并评估验证门控与学习型有害反馈检测器。
AI.result: 朴素8B批评器在八个表格数据集中的七个上低于无批评器基线，最差AUC下降0.245。
AI.conclusion: 方向性错误会消耗有限搜索机会，更强批评器和门控虽可减轻损失，但不能保证不低于无批评器基线。

title: Understanding the Role of Reasoning Data in Pretraining
summary: Reasoning data expose models to multi-step reasoning, but reasoning traces may cover only a subset of the available facts. How should pretraining balance atomic facts with reasoning traces? We study this question by constructing a setting in which every fact provides an atomic training signal, while only a subset appears in reasoning supervision, enabling us to measure generalization to transitions observed atomically but never used in training traces. For a linear transformer, we derive the weight assigned to atomic training signals that minimizes held-transition squared error and show that its leading-order optimum increases with reasoning-chain length and decreases with the fraction of facts held out from reasoning traces. These trends persist in a full transformer layer with an MLP, softmax attention, and cross-entropy loss. We further validate the role of reasoning complexity and data coverage in two natural-language settings: controlled multi-hop reasoning and mathematical pretraining. Together, our results provide a principled view of how reasoning-chain structure and data coverage should shape the allocation of training data during pretraining.

AI.tldr: 预训练中原子事实与推理轨迹的配比，应随推理链长度和推理监督中的事实覆盖率调整。
AI.motivation: 推理轨迹可能只覆盖部分事实，需要理解如何平衡原子事实学习与多步推理监督。
AI.method: 构造全部事实均有原子监督、仅部分进入推理轨迹的任务，推导线性Transformer最优权重并扩展验证。
AI.result: 最优原子监督权重的主导项随推理链变长而增大，随未进入推理轨迹的事实比例上升而减小。
AI.conclusion: 完整Transformer及自然语言实验支持相关趋势，说明推理复杂度与数据覆盖应共同指导预训练数据分配。

title: More Context, Mixed Results: Evaluating LLMs for Identifier Recovery and Code Deobfuscation
summary: Source code is often obfuscated through identifier renaming, incentivizing reverse engineers to develop techniques for recovering meaningful names. To assess how LLMs compare with these techniques, we evaluate 4 traditional baselines and 3 LLMs (Qwen, OLMo and DeepSeek) on identifier detection and semantic recovery across 51 recent Java projects, 3 obfuscators, and 6 context/retrieval settings. LLMs generally outperform traditional techniques on both tasks, but benefit from different forms of context and settings: agentic retrieval yields the strongest detection results, reaching 91.56% $F_1$, while enclosing-class context generally improves semantic recovery at a higher token cost. Despite these gains, exact recovery peaks at 16.42% overall (under one-hop context) and 32.93% for field names (under repository retrieval), which are the easiest to recover. Class identifiers are the hardest to detect, with a mean detection $F_1$ of 48.48% across models, settings and obfuscators. More context is not always beneficial: larger methods hinder semantic recovery. Beyond identifier renaming, our experiments show that control-flow obfuscation degrades both tasks more than string encryption. Our findings provide useful ad hoc insights for reverse engineers choosing models and context strategies to deobfuscate code snippets.

AI.tldr: 大语言模型通常优于传统标识符恢复方法，但上下文收益因任务而异，精确恢复仍受限。
AI.motivation: 标识符重命名妨碍代码理解，需要评估大语言模型及不同上下文策略对检测与语义恢复的作用。
AI.method: 在51个近期Java项目、三种混淆器和六种上下文或检索设置下，比较四种传统基线与三种大语言模型。
AI.result: 智能体检索的检测F1达91.56%，整体精确恢复率最高仅16.42%，类标识符平均检测F1为48.48%。
AI.conclusion: 应按任务选择上下文策略，更多上下文并非总有益，且控制流混淆比字符串加密造成更大性能下降。

title: Hard or Mislabeled? Failure Screens Enrich Vision Benchmarks for Label Errors
summary: Hard vision benchmarks often keep images that strong classifiers get wrong. Since a classifier is also marked wrong when the label is wrong, such failure screens may collect label errors. We measure this on ImageNet's twice-relabeled validation set with 103 classifiers. Among the 1,892 images that all 66 supervised classifiers get wrong, 61% have a wrong label, versus 11.1% overall. The fewer images a screen lets through, the more of them are mislabeled, along approximately one curve. Fit on one model family, this curve predicts the screens of two held-out model families with a mean error of 2.4 percentage points, and replays of ImageNet-D's and ImageNet-Hard's screens within 0.1 and 6.3 points. On new pools, ImageNet-V2 and CIFAR-10, enrichment at the strictest screens is stronger than the curve predicts: on ImageNet-V2, by human relabeling, 67% of the images that all 66 classifiers get wrong are mislabeled, against 46% predicted. Screens that let models choose among only some of the classes, as ImageNet-A's does (200 of 1,000), fall below the curve. By ReImageNet, 32% of ImageNet-Hard's ImageNet images have no correct label. ScreenAudit, which comprises an audit tool, a script that rebuilds corrected answer sets for the 5,464 decided ImageNet-Hard images (of 5,646) from ReImageNet's gated release, and per-image audits of 1,198 benchmark images, will be released later.

AI.tldr: 按分类器失败筛选高难视觉样本会富集标签错误，且筛选越严格，错标比例通常越高。
AI.motivation: 高难视觉基准常保留强分类器误判的图像，但误判也可能源于标签错误而非任务困难。
AI.method: 利用103个分类器分析两次重标注的ImageNet验证集，并跨模型家族及数据集检验错标富集规律。
AI.result: 66个监督分类器均误判的1892张图像中，61%标签错误，远高于总体的11.1%。
AI.conclusion: 失败筛选可能把错标当作难度，构建和使用高难视觉基准时需审计标签质量。

title: Model-Free UPS Control Tuning for Improved Low-Voltage Ride-Through in AI Data Centers
summary: Voltage sags can trigger protection trips in uninterruptible power supply (UPS) systems, abruptly reducing the power that AI data centers draw from the grid. This paper improves the low-voltage ride-through (LVRT) capability of AI data centers equipped with double-conversion UPS systems by tuning their existing converter controls. We formulate a bound-constrained optimization problem to maximize the ride-through area, defined as the integral of ride-through time over a range of retained grid voltages. To solve this problem, we develop a batched projected zeroth-order optimization algorithm with adaptive moment estimation (BPZO-Adam). The algorithm evaluates candidate control settings using only simulated ride-through times, making it suitable for vendor-supplied black-box models. Simulations using the TAMU-ERCOT electromagnetic transient (EMT) AI data center model show that tuning converter control parameters increases the ride-through area by 10.6\%. In a separate study, tuning the controls yields a larger ride-through area than increasing the DC-link capacitance tenfold.

AI.tldr: 仅调优现有UPS变流器控制参数，即可提升AI数据中心的低电压穿越能力。
AI.motivation: 电压骤降可能触发UPS保护跳闸，使AI数据中心从电网吸取的功率突然下降。
AI.method: 以穿越时间对保留电压的积分为目标，使用仅依赖仿真评估的BPZO-Adam求解有界优化问题。
AI.result: 仿真中穿越面积提高10.6%，另一项研究中控制调优效果优于将直流母线电容增大十倍。
AI.conclusion: 无需修改UPS硬件或访问模型内部，黑箱控制调优即可改善数据中心低电压穿越性能。

title: Certify, Then Select: Viability-Aware Runtime Steering of Frozen Diffusion Policies
summary: Diffusion policies, which generate short action sequences by denoising random noise, are a leading way to learn robot skills from demonstrations. Once deployed, they meet constraints the demonstrations never contained, and retraining for each is impractical. A safety filter edits the policy's action to satisfy them, but the edit ignores the task, and a large edit can leave the policy where it cannot continue. We propose CAST (Certified Action Selection at Test time): draw a few action chunks from the frozen policy, certify each with a barrier condition, and execute the certified chunk that a learned value ensemble ranks highest. We prove that a certified step is safe whatever the critic does; that, whenever a certified sample exists, the executed chunk stays within log N nats of the policy conditioned on feasibility, while a safety-filter projection can be singular to it; and that an exact closed-loop identity splits the gain of ranking into availability, spread and the critic's target. Certifying the next chunk is not enough: a generative controller can have safe actions available now and none later. We characterise the safe control authority of a frozen policy under finite sampling, and CAST-V preserves it through a policy-conditioned viability, estimated with a model under a finite-sample guarantee or learned from the controller's own logs (CAST-VL). On robomimic manipulation, a planar quadrotor, a MuJoCo humanoid and a unicycle, with frozen policies, CAST raises joint task-and-constraint success above the output filter in nearly every setting; certifying before ranking is decisive where a filter's edit is large, and viability removes most dead ends that one-step certification cannot see. Project page: this https URL.

AI.tldr: CAST先认证再排序冻结扩散策略的候选动作，并通过可行性维护减少安全执行中的死路。
AI.motivation: 部署时新增约束难以逐一重训练，而安全过滤器的大幅动作修改可能破坏任务延续能力。
AI.method: 对采样动作块进行屏障认证并用价值集成排序，进一步估计策略条件可行性以保留未来安全控制能力。
AI.result: 四类机器人任务中，CAST几乎均优于输出过滤器，可行性维护消除了多数单步认证无法发现的死路。
AI.conclusion: 将安全认证、任务排序和未来可行性维护结合，可更可靠地引导冻结扩散策略完成受约束任务。

title: SPARC: Evidence-guided adaptive model composition for materials discovery
summary: Closed-loop experimentation requires more than selecting the next experiment. It must also determine which existing measurements and model-derived relationships are sufficiently supported to influence that decision. Here we introduce SPARC (Sparse Predictive Aggregation of Regression Components), a framework that continually revises this support as experimental evidence accumulates. Competing model families are evaluated through out-of-fold predictions, so that each model is tested on observations not used in its corresponding fit. Sparse posterior composition assigns model influence according to predictive contributions supported by the out-of-fold evidence, retaining complementary contributions from several model families. Candidate-dependent predictive dispersion and residual variability define trust, which modulates exploration alongside the predicted response. Independent diagnostics also prioritize existing measurements for prospective verification, with model-derived trust reported alongside them. Across eight published materials datasets, SPARC achieved higher $R^2$ than the corresponding literature-reported values in six, with relative gains of up to 77% without the density-functional-theory- or experiment-derived descriptors used by several published pipelines. In an automated alkaline oxygen-evolution-reaction campaign, 8 of 11 SPARC-selected experiments reached overpotentials below 300 mV, with a best value of 242 mV, compared with 18 of 125 initial experiments. Measurements prioritized for verification before repetition subsequently deviated by 76 mV on average, compared with 27 mV for matched controls. SPARC therefore turns experimental evidence into a basis for revising model influence, directing exploration and identifying measurements that warrant verification.
comment: 52 pages, 5 figures; main text with Supplementary Information

AI.tldr: SPARC依据不断积累的实验证据调整模型组合，同时指导材料探索和可疑测量复核。
AI.motivation: 闭环实验不仅要选择下一次实验，还需判断哪些测量及模型关系足以支持决策。
AI.method: 通过折外预测和稀疏后验组合分配模型影响，以预测离散度和残差变异调节探索并独立筛查待复核测量。
AI.result: 八个数据集中六个的R²超过文献值；析氧实验中11次选点有8次过电位低于300毫伏，最低242毫伏。
AI.conclusion: 实验证据可同时用于修正模型权重、引导探索，并识别值得进一步验证的测量。

title: High-dimensional limit theorems for adaptive variants of SGD I: Ballistic limits
summary: We develop the high-dimensional effective dynamics for adaptive, momentum-based variants of Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD). These effective dynamics are given by a Markov process. They key observation is that the non-Markovianity in the algorithm due to the exponential moving average and preconditioning can be treated using the method of averaging. Our approach applies to a broad class of algorithms including to Adaptive momentum estimation (ADAM), Momentum orthogonalized by Newton-Schultz (MUON), and its variants. It also applies to a broad class of learning tasks, such at tensor PCA, Gaussian projective models, teacher-student networks, and a multi-layer neural network trained on the XOR problem using a hybrid of MUON and ADAM as commonly done in practice. We demonstrate how to this technique can give precise, quantitative comparisons between algorithms. In particular, we find interesting phenomena, such as the cross-over phenomenon where online SGD has better generalization than ADAM early in training until the learning curves cross and ADAM dominates. Furthermore, we prove a version of the Edge of Stability phenomenon. In particular, we introduce an analogue of the infinity Laplacian that sharply characterizes the Edge of Stability.

AI.tldr: 该研究建立自适应动量SGD的高维有效动力学，用于定量比较算法并刻画稳定性边缘。
AI.motivation: 指数移动平均与预条件引入非马尔可夫性，使自适应优化算法的高维动力学分析复杂化。
AI.method: 采用平均化方法处理非马尔可夫性，以马尔可夫过程描述ADAM、MUON等算法的有效动力学。
AI.result: 发现在线SGD早期泛化优于ADAM、随后被反超的交叉现象，并证明一种稳定性边缘现象。
AI.conclusion: 该框架适用于多类学习任务，并可用无穷拉普拉斯算子的类似物精确刻画稳定性边缘。

title: Large Language Models for AI Infrastructure
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to design, optimize, and operate the infrastructure behind AI training and serving, yet the literature remains fragmented across hardware design, machine learning systems, electronic design automation, and high-performance computing. We present a comprehensive survey of LLM-assisted AI infrastructure across its lifecycle, from accelerator design and kernel engineering to compilation, deployment, operations, data management, and energy optimization. We organize the literature by the primary resource the LLM manages: artifact-centric methods for computational artifacts, operational-centric methods for deployment context and system state, and resource-centric methods for data and energy. These categories span the lifecycle and cover AI-specific concerns such as distributed-training configuration, inference serving, GPU-cluster scheduling, and data loading. Building on this taxonomy, we conduct a cross-study quantitative synthesis of reported results. Because studies adopt heterogeneous benchmarks, baselines, hardware, and metrics, we compare methods only where evaluation conditions permit and align results along common dimensions: functional correctness, execution performance, throughput, resource and energy consumption, operational outcomes, and optimization cost, keeping each result's native metric, baseline, and setting rather than collapsing them into a single score. This comparison reveals where LLM-driven methods yield consistent gains, how reported gains in workload orchestration depend on the evaluation environment, from simulators to real clusters and production, and where evidence is still lacking. Together, the taxonomy, lifecycle perspective, and quantitative evaluation provide an evidence-grounded reference for LLM-driven engineering of AI infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 该综述按资源管理对象梳理大语言模型辅助AI基础设施的研究，并进行保留评估条件的定量综合。
AI.motivation: 相关研究分散于硬件设计、机器学习系统、电子设计自动化和高性能计算，缺乏统一视角。
AI.method: 按计算产物、运行状态及数据能源三类组织全生命周期文献，仅在评估条件允许时进行跨研究比较。
AI.result: 比较揭示了收益较一致的领域、工作负载编排收益对评估环境的依赖，以及现有证据缺口。
AI.conclusion: 分类体系、生命周期视角和条件敏感的量化比较，为大语言模型驱动的基础设施工程提供循证参考。

title: Policy Optimization With Multiple Verifiers via Pareto Rankings
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become an important approach to improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models. In tasks such as code generation and instruction following, multiple verifiers evaluate whether a response satisfies different requirements. Their outcomes provide detailed feedback about partial success, yet this feedback is commonly aggregated into a scalar reward for policy optimization. Rewarding only complete success discards distinctions among partial solutions, while counts and weighted sums impose comparisons between responses that satisfy different subsets of requirements. We introduce Partial-Order Likelihood Policy Optimization (POLPO), which learns from the comparisons established by verification without first constructing an aggregate reward. Pareto dominance identifies responses that satisfy additional requirements without losing any already satisfied, while leaving responses with conflicting outcomes incomparable. POLPO extends the listwise likelihood underlying Direct Preference Optimization by maximizing the total probability of all complete rankings consistent with these partial orders. This objective provides supervision from verified improvements even before complete solutions are available, without requiring a prescribed ordering of incomparable responses. Experiments on code generation and instruction following demonstrate improved learning efficiency and higher rates of complete requirement satisfaction compared with scalar-reward training. These results support partial-order likelihood as an effective approach to learning from multiple verifiers.

AI.tldr: POLPO直接从多个验证器形成的帕累托偏序学习，避免将部分成功压缩为标量奖励。
AI.motivation: 只奖励完全成功会丢失部分进展，而计数或加权求和会强行比较满足不同要求的回答。
AI.method: 以帕累托支配建立偏序，扩展直接偏好优化的列表似然，最大化所有符合偏序的完整排序的总概率。
AI.result: 代码生成和指令遵循实验显示，相比标量奖励训练，POLPO学习效率更高且完全满足要求的比例更高。
AI.conclusion: 偏序似然可利用多验证器确认的局部改进，而无需预先排序相互冲突的回答。

title: A Fast Algorithm for the Familywise Loss
summary: The familywise (FW) loss for multiclass classification, introduced by Duchi, Ruan, and Khosravi, achieves universal equivalence to the 0-1 loss, and thus has stronger theoretical properties than cross entropy (CE). Prior work, however, left open whether FW is as computationally efficient as CE. First, on the theoretical side, we prove that the FW gradient can be computed in $O(K)$ time, where $K$ is the number of classes. Second, on the practical side, we develop optimized kernels for computing the forward and backward passes of FW which outperform CE in terms of speed on both CPU and GPU.

AI.tldr: 该研究为多分类FW损失提出线性时间梯度算法，优化实现的运行速度超过交叉熵。
AI.motivation: FW损失与0-1损失具有普遍等价性，但其计算效率能否匹敌交叉熵尚未解决。
AI.method: 证明类别数为K时FW梯度可在O(K)时间内计算，并开发优化的前向与反向计算内核。
AI.result: 优化后的FW计算内核在CPU和GPU上的速度均超过交叉熵。
AI.conclusion: FW损失不仅具有较强理论性质，也能通过高效实现获得有竞争力的计算性能。

title: Nahual: A Sequence Model for Language and Atoms
summary: Generative models play a rapidly growing role in the design and simulation of molecules. The most widely used applications of generative models are in large language models (LLMs), owing to the natural flexibility of language for specifying and answering queries. However, generalist LLMs do not effectively handle large sets of 3D coordinates, whereas specialist generative models of 3D molecules cannot reach the controllability afforded by language. To bridge these capabilities, we propose Nahual, a decoder-only autoregressive diffusion model for any sequence of text and 3D molecules. To enable expressive autoregression on continuous coordinates, we propose next-token diffusion, whereby a causal transformer denoises each token while attending to the clean tokens before it, without increasing context size. We train Nahual on a curated set of twelve 3D chemistry tasks ranging from microsolvation to molecular conformer search to adsorption on metal surfaces, with associated evaluation metrics and baselines. The result is a single set of end-to-end-trained weights that simultaneously performs all tasks and surpasses state-of-the-art models specialized for crystal structure prediction and property-conditional molecule generation. Our results demonstrate the viability of scaling generalist decoder-only models for native multimodal understanding and generation across language and chemistry. Code is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: Nahual统一建模文本与三维分子，在多项化学任务中实现通用生成与预测。
AI.motivation: 通用语言模型难以处理大量三维坐标，而专用分子生成模型缺乏语言控制能力。
AI.method: 采用仅解码器自回归扩散模型，以逐词元扩散处理连续坐标，并在十二项三维化学任务上训练。
AI.result: 单套权重完成全部任务，并在晶体结构预测和属性条件分子生成上超越专用最先进模型。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持扩展通用仅解码器模型，以实现语言与化学的原生多模态理解和生成。

title: Job-Level Workload Allocation for Data Centers Under Flexible Interconnections
summary: Flexible interconnections allow data centers to connect to the grid sooner without upgrading the grid infrastructure, if they accept limits on their grid power during periods of grid stress. When a limit is reached, the data center must slow some of its computing jobs. This choice sets the cost of flexibility, because the work done by a job is worth far more than the energy it uses. This paper models how jobs respond when their power is reduced, and proposes a real-time method that shares the available power among jobs according to their value. It also gives grid planners a simple measure of how much power a data center can reduce, and for how long. A one-year case study of a 100-MW data center shows that the proposed method lowers the cost of meeting grid limits, and that on-site generation and storage lower it further.
comment: Submitted to IEEE PES General Meeting 2027

AI.tldr: 按计算作业价值实时分配电力，可降低数据中心接受灵活并网功率限制的成本。
AI.motivation: 灵活并网要求数据中心在电网紧张时降功率，而作业价值远高于其耗电成本。
AI.method: 建模作业降功率响应，按价值实时分配可用电力，并提供可降功率及持续时间的简明指标。
AI.result: 对100兆瓦数据中心的一年案例研究显示，该方法降低限电成本，现场发电与储能可进一步降本。
AI.conclusion: 作业级价值感知调度有助于降低灵活并网成本，并为电网规划提供灵活性度量。

title: TokenFormer V2: Breaking the Resolution-Complexity Dilemma in Unified Recommendation
summary: Industrial recommendation faces a resolution--complexity dilemma: dense interactions make detailed modeling of long behavior histories expensive, while compact history summaries restrict the evidence available to prediction. A unified backbone must preserve rich behavioral details within strict serving budgets. We introduce \textbf{TokenFormer V2}, a unified architecture that explicitly decouples \emph{representation resolution} from \emph{interaction density}. Its group-wise token layout jointly encodes behavior segments with non-sequential context, expands interaction ranges via hierarchical group merging, and coordinates distributed groups through \emph{NS Fusion} and \emph{Global Sync} modules. Through this \emph{local--global decomposition} paradigm, computation is concentrated on structured interactions while preserving fine-grained evidence, ensuring that every encoded event remains directly accessible to the \emph{Full-Resolution Readout} module. On the Tencent Advertising Algorithm Competition 2026 (TAAC 2026) benchmark, TokenFormer V2 achieves top-ranking accuracy among unified recommendation baselines while using \textbf{5.1$\times$ fewer FLOPs} than leading baselines, sustaining its advantage across long histories and imbalanced behavior domains. Furthermore, in billion-parameter evaluations on WeChat Channels advertising, it consistently outperforms state-of-the-art industrial baselines, yielding up to a \textbf{+0.07 pp} overall AUC gain. In live online A/B testing against the production model, TokenFormer V2 delivers a statistically significant \textbf{2.33\% increase in GMV}. These results establish TokenFormer V2 as a battle-tested blueprint for scalable, full-resolution behavior modeling in industrial recommendation.

AI.tldr: TokenFormer V2解耦表征分辨率与交互密度，实现高效的全分辨率推荐建模。
AI.motivation: 长行为序列的细粒度交互计算昂贵，而压缩历史又会限制预测可用的信息。
AI.method: 通过分组词元、层次合并、局部与全局协同及全分辨率读出，保留细粒度证据并控制交互计算。
AI.result: TAAC基准计算量较领先基线降低5.1倍，工业评估AUC最高提升0.07个百分点，线上GMV提升2.33%。
AI.conclusion: 该架构兼顾推荐精度与计算效率，支持工业场景中可扩展的全分辨率行为建模。

title: SearchChord: Prompt Preselection and Field Recomposition for One-Step Image Editing
summary: Finding effective prompts and seeds for one-step image editors requires balancing edit fidelity, source preservation, and computational cost. To address this challenge, we explore a large collection of candidate edits, where each candidate is defined by a unique prompt-seed pair, and generate corresponding images on demand. We present SearchChord, a training-free framework that leverages a large pool of such candidates, combining text-based preselection, image verification, and latent-field recomposition. Our ablation studies across pool sizes up to 200 candidates show that a pool of 100 offers a cost-effective operating point. Compared with feeding all 100 candidates into recomposition, TextSim preselects a subset of 10 candidates. Rather than uniform averaging, we incorporate image-verifier scores to weight each candidate during recomposition. Experiments on PIE-Bench and the proposed CropWeed-EditBench reveal a trade-off: candidate selection improves target-text alignment, while recomposition better preserves unmodified source content. The oracle verifier achieves the best performance in both preservation and target-text alignment. Practical verification partially recovers semantic alignment, but recomposition still compromises edit fidelity, including in agricultural image edits. These results motivate text-first preselection and stronger verification to balance preservation, fidelity, and cost. Code and data will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: SearchChord通过文本预选与潜在场重组探索一步图像编辑的保真、保留与成本权衡。
AI.motivation: 为一步图像编辑器选择提示词和随机种子，需要兼顾编辑忠实度、原图保留及计算成本。
AI.method: 构建无需训练的框架，从提示词与种子候选池中进行文本预选、图像验证和验证分数加权重组。
AI.result: 百候选池较具成本效益；选择改善文本对齐，重组更好保留原内容，但仍损害编辑忠实度。
AI.conclusion: 文本优先预选与更强验证有望改善原图保留、编辑忠实度和计算成本之间的平衡。

title: Assume/Guarantee Contracts for the Compositional Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning of Heterogeneous Teams
summary: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) problems for heterogeneous teams require agents to collaborate to complete team tasks while making the best use of diverse agent capabilities. We introduce assume/guarantee contracts for heterogeneous multi-agent systems (AGC-MAS) and Iterative Heterogeneous Assignment for MARL (IHA-MARL). AGC-MAS contracts are compositional objects that encode the assumptions provided to, and the guarantees required of, each subtask contributing to the overall team task. We formulate contracts as tuples that specify a subtask, an automaton, timeout and success-probability requirements, and dispatch behavior. The automaton tracks an agent's high-level progress through the subtask associated with its contract and provides a natural mechanism for synchronization across contracts. Our abstraction enables robust interaction across heterogeneous low-level subtask implementations, allows heterogeneous agents to substitute for one another in satisfying contracts, and supports reuse of previously satisfied contracts in new team contexts. Having defined our theoretical framework, we develop a decomposition algorithm that breaks down a team task into a set of contracts. We then propose an iterative algorithm for task assignment and MARL that alternates between assigning contracts representing subtasks to individual agents, training the assigned agents to satisfy their contracts, and assessing their resulting capabilities to inform the next round of task assignments until the team's success probability meets the desired threshold. Our experimental results demonstrate the versatility of contracts in enabling agent substitution and contract reuse. Across three benchmarks with five seeds each, IHA-MARL achieves observed $100\%$ final evaluation success. In CPU timing pilots, comparable baselines required approximately $7$--$11\times$ more training-loop time.

AI.tldr: 以假设／保证契约分解异构团队任务，并迭代分配和训练智能体以提升协作成功率。
AI.motivation: 异构多智能体协作既需完成团队任务，也需充分利用不同智能体的能力。
AI.method: 用含自动机及超时、成功率要求的契约描述子任务，交替执行任务分配、强化学习与能力评估。
AI.result: 三个基准各五个种子的最终评估均观察到100%成功率，CPU试验中基线训练循环耗时约为其7至11倍。
AI.conclusion: 契约支持智能体替换与既有能力复用，为异构团队提供可组合的协作学习机制。

title: Using machine learning approaches to classify false-positives generated by static analysis tools - An empirical study using small datasets
summary: Static Code Analysis (SCA) tools are vital for software development to reduce the cost and time required for manual code reviews. It was established in our previous study that the best tools reported in the software engineering community return high false-positive and false-negative rates when used for code analysis. Several approaches have been taken in existing studies to identify false-positive alarms generated by SCA tools, in helping to enhance the utility of these tools. However, existing studies reveal several limitations, chiefly among which is the tendency to focus on a limited number of alarm types or failing to evaluate a large breadth of Machine-Learning (ML) techniques comprehensively. This study has addressed this opportunity. We identified the best Code Representation Learning (CRL) techniques and ML algorithms for identifying false-positives, where results show that performance outcomes vary based on the characteristics of the training datasets and the goal of the model building. Given the evidence established in this study, we recommend further investigations targeting specific configurations of advanced CRLs and ML Algorithms, including simple ML models.

AI.tldr: 研究比较代码表征学习与机器学习方法识别静态分析误报的表现，发现效果依赖数据和建模目标。
AI.motivation: 静态分析误报削弱工具实用性，既有研究常局限于少数告警类型或缺乏全面算法评估。
AI.method: 在小数据集场景中评估代码表征学习技术与机器学习算法，用于分类静态分析工具产生的误报。
AI.result: 不同表征与算法的性能随训练数据特征及建模目标变化，摘要未给出具体性能数值。
AI.conclusion: 应进一步研究先进代码表征与机器学习算法的特定配置，并纳入简单模型。

title: RoboCoEvo: Expanding Robot Capabilities through Agent-Policy Co-Evolution
summary: Integrating MLLM-based agents with robotic foundation models has attracted increasing attention as a means of enhancing robotic capabilities. However, the improvement of such integrated systems remains largely decoupled across their agent and model components, with advances in one component not necessarily benefiting the other, substantially limiting the capabilities of the combined system. As both MLLMs and robotic foundation models become increasingly capable, fully realizing their combined potential calls for co-evolution, an iterative process in which improvements in agents and robotic foundation models reinforce one another. We propose RoboCoEvo, a failure-guided co-evolution framework that couples the refinement of the agent's explicit and reusable executable knowledge with parameter learning in robotic foundation models, such as vision-language-action (VLA) models. Through a code-as-policy formulation, the agent develops and refines executable failure-detection and recovery programs, generating targeted corrective experience. Post-training consolidates the resulting corrective behaviors into the robotic model's end-to-end policy, improving autonomous task execution. Changes in the updated policy's failure distribution, in turn, guide subsequent revisions to the agent's programs. Experiments on BEHAVIOR-1K, RoboCasa, and RoboTwin demonstrate sustained improvements in autonomous VLA task performance across successive co-evolution rounds.

AI.tldr: RoboCoEvo通过失败引导的智能体与机器人策略协同进化，持续提升自主任务执行能力。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型智能体与机器人基础模型通常独立改进，限制了集成系统的能力提升。
AI.method: 智能体编写并改进失败检测和恢复程序，生成纠正经验用于策略后训练，再由新失败分布指导程序修订。
AI.result: 在BEHAVIOR-1K、RoboCasa和RoboTwin上，多轮协同进化持续提升VLA模型的自主任务表现。
AI.conclusion: 将可复用执行知识与策略参数学习闭环耦合，可促进智能体与机器人模型相互增强。

title: CONTEXT-PCa: Evaluating the role of clinical context in MRI-based AI for detecting clinically significant prostate cancer (study protocol)
summary: The objective of this study is to investigate the role of clinical variables - their breadth, source, and quality - in the development, utility, and generalisability of an AI system for bi-parametric MRI (bpMRI)-based diagnosis of clinically significant prostate cancer (csPCa). Clinical context is added to the published PI-CAI-2B image-only model, whose weights are fixed. The study cohort comprises 6,022 biparametric MRI cases from 4,540 patients at University College London Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust (2019-2024), of which 4,834 cases (3,632 patients) are held out for internal testing. Forty-three clinical variables are drawn from structured health records, clinical letters, MRI reports, and automated image measurements. The primary endpoint is the difference in the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) between the image-context and image-only models on the internal test set. Secondary analyses compare combining strategies, the contribution of individual variables, and performance across subgroups. All models are further tested on five external cohorts from primary diagnosis and population-based screening.

AI.tldr: CONTEXT-PCa研究方案拟评估临床背景信息对MRI前列腺癌诊断AI的增益与泛化影响。
AI.motivation: 需明确临床变量的范围、来源与质量如何影响具有临床意义的前列腺癌AI诊断。
AI.method: 固定PI-CAI-2B权重并融合43项临床变量，在内部留出集比较AUROC，另于五个外部队列测试。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体结果。
AI.conclusion: 该方案将检验临床信息相对纯图像模型的诊断增益，并分析变量贡献、亚组表现与外部泛化。

title: DynaDFlash: Dynamic Feature Projection for Block Diffusion Speculators
summary: DFlash trains a parallel draft model on hidden features from its target model. Inspired by the previous work of DFlare that introduced per layer combinations of target hidden states, we test whether context dependent weighting of these states helps improve acceptance length of block diffusion speculators. We trained both a DFlash baseline for the Qwen 3 of block size 16, and a dynamic model that computes gates for each layer to affect the magnitude of hidden features before projection. While mean acceptance length between the dynamic model and the DFlash baseline didn't significantly differ, we notice that the dynamic model excels for drafting in the context of math. In an evaluation of 700 prompts from the MetaMathQA and Orca-Math datasets, the mean accepted length improves by 5%. We also found this lead to a 4.1% higher throughput for a subset of the same dataset in the context of speculative decoding.
comment: Code and trained models available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 动态特征投影未显著改变整体接受长度，但提升了数学任务中的推测解码表现。
AI.motivation: 探究按上下文动态加权目标模型各层隐藏状态，能否提升块扩散草稿模型的接受长度。
AI.method: 以Qwen 3训练块大小为16的DFlash基线，并引入逐层门控调节投影前的隐藏特征幅度。
AI.result: 整体平均接受长度无显著差异，但700条数学提示上提升5%，其中部分数据吞吐量提升4.1%。
AI.conclusion: 动态层门控的收益具有任务依赖性，在数学场景中可改善草稿接受长度与解码吞吐量。

title: Reliable Conditioned Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability via Subsolution Learning on Exact Local Windows
summary: Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) reachability computes the maximal safe set and a safety filter for a given obstacle configuration, but it must be re-solved whenever the obstacles change, which a deployed robot cannot afford. Learning a single value function conditioned on the obstacle set removes the re-solve, yet it sharpens the central weakness of learned reachability: one network must now cover a whole family of safety problems, and its approximation error carries no preferred sign, so rare obstacle configurations silently produce false-safe states. To address these challenges, we present a conditioned reachability model designed so that the remaining error falls on the conservative side. Specifically, our method caps the obstacle margin, which makes the value function provably local, in the sense that obstacles farther than a known threshold cannot affect it, so the model reads only a body-frame window, trains on small scenes, and transfers to scenes of any size with millisecond per-scene preparation. Moreover, the output structure builds the value bound into the model. By training with counterexample mining over the finite-dimensional window configuration space, we maximize the claimed safe volume subject to the HJ inequality, so the learned set grows toward the true safe set from the conservative side. Across all tested obstacle settings, ours is the only method that combines recovery comparable to per-scene DeepReach training with near-zero rollout collisions. We also extend the method to a 10D quadrotor, again with markedly lower collision rates than the baselines.

AI.tldr: 通过精确局部窗口与次解学习，构建误差偏保守的障碍条件化HJ可达性模型。
AI.motivation: 障碍变化要求重新求解安全集，而条件化神经模型可能将不安全状态误判为安全。
AI.method: 限制障碍裕度以保证局部性，将值界嵌入输出结构，并通过反例挖掘在HJ不等式约束下扩大安全集。
AI.result: 所有测试障碍设置中，安全集恢复能力接近逐场景DeepReach且轨迹碰撞近零，10维四旋翼碰撞率也更低。
AI.conclusion: 局部化与保守约束可兼顾跨场景复用、安全集恢复能力及低碰撞风险。

title: FDAM: A Frequency-Direction-Aware Multi-Task Framework for Pavement Crack Grid Localization
summary: Pavement crack grid localization remains challenging for thin and tiny cracks due to weak visual cues and background interference. Box detection often misses these cracks, while supervised semantic segmentation faces limited pixel-wise annotations and high labeling costs. In this paper, we propose a Frequency-Direction-Aware Multi-Task framework (FDAM) with box detection and grid classification branches. The core grid classification branch comprises Frequency-Domain Enhancement (FDE) and Directional Feature Refinement (DFR). FDE adaptively weights spectral bands and fuses reconstructed features with spatial features. DFR captures thin crack patterns through multi-scale strip convolutions, direction-sensitive modulation, and feature recalibration. Sparse positive cells and ambiguous local predictions motivate adaptive grid supervision. Adaptive Importance Reweighting emphasizes uncertain predictions and local label transitions, with focal supervision for all cells. Our contribution is to couple the box detection and grid classification branches through shared feature learning for pavement crack grid localization. We validate FDAM on our RoadDistress2026 dataset of thin and tiny cracks and further evaluate it on public datasets Crack500 and DeepCrack. The code is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: FDAM结合频域与方向特征，通过框检测和网格分类协同定位细小路面裂缝。
AI.motivation: 细小裂缝视觉线索弱且易受背景干扰，框检测容易漏检，而像素级标注成本较高。
AI.method: 共享框检测与网格分类特征，结合频域增强、方向细化、自适应重要性重加权和焦点监督。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体结果。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为细小裂缝网格定位提供多任务方案，并在自建及两个公开数据集上开展验证。

title: DEFDVO: Deformable Deep Visual Odometry for Equirectangular Images
summary: Omnidirectional ($360^\circ$) cameras capture the full surrounding scene in every frame, providing a strong advantage for visual odometry (VO) over pinhole sensors with a limited field of view. However, their equirectangular projection (ERP) introduces latitude-dependent distortion, an artificial seam at the image border, and a sampling bias toward the poles. Existing $360^\circ$ VO methods address these challenges only partially. DEFDVO closes this gap with a patch-based deep VO method that operates directly on ERP imagery, combining spherically initialized deformable feature extraction, end-to-end seam-aware estimation, and spherical-gradient patch selection. The deformable feature extractor combines spherical geometric priors with learned sampling offsets, while seam-aware processing preserves ERP continuity, and spherical-gradient selection reduces polar sampling bias. Trained exclusively on synthetic TartanAirV2 ERP imagery, DEFDVO improves the best prior average absolute trajectory error (ATE) by $4.8\times$ (0.201 m to 0.042 m) on the TartanAirV2 evaluation set defined by 360DVO and achieves the lowest average ATE on both splits of the real-world 360DVO benchmark. Code is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: DEFDVO直接处理等距柱状全景图像，显著降低视觉里程计轨迹误差。
AI.motivation: 全景图像存在随纬度变化的畸变、边界接缝和极区采样偏差，现有方法处理不充分。
AI.method: 结合球面初始化的可变形特征提取、接缝感知估计和球面梯度图块选择，仅用合成数据训练。
AI.result: TartanAirV2平均ATE由0.201米降至0.042米，真实360DVO两个划分的平均ATE均最低。
AI.conclusion: 融合球面几何先验与接缝连续性处理，可提高全景视觉里程计精度并迁移至真实数据。

title: Instructor-designed AI improves learning in a randomized trial across 19 universities
summary: Universities are alarmed by recent evidence that artificial intelligence (AI) can undermine learning, with students prescribed generic chatbots or centrally designed AI tools performing worse. In a pre-registered randomized controlled trial across 7,200 students at 19 universities over three semesters, we tested whether AI designed by frontline instructors can improve learning. We encouraged instructors to design AI solutions they believed would best help their students. Drawing on their unique knowledge of their classes and students, the instructors created a wide array of innovations. We show that these instructor-designed AI innovations improved student learning, measured by AI-proof assessments (proctored, in-person examinations). We found no change in student engagement, measured by course activity records, or satisfaction, measured by course evaluations. Our findings demonstrate that AI can improve student learning when its adoption is frontline-driven, with instructors empowered to design and refine AI solutions for their own classrooms.

AI.tldr: 覆盖19所大学的随机试验表明，教师自主设计的AI工具能够改善学生学习。
AI.motivation: 通用聊天机器人或集中设计的AI工具可能损害学习，因此需检验教师主导设计的效果。
AI.method: 开展跨三个学期、涉及7200名学生的预注册随机对照试验，以线下监考考试评估学习成效。
AI.result: 教师设计的AI改善了考试衡量的学习表现，但课程活动参与度与课程评价满意度未发生变化。
AI.conclusion: 赋予一线教师设计和迭代课堂AI方案的自主权，有助于让AI促进学习。

title: Leaning Over to Reach Far-Away Objects
summary: We study supported reaching to extend a humanoid robot's workspace by bracing against the environment for stabilization using a straightforward yet capable whole-body model predictive control (MPC) approach, exclusively with local sensing and fiducial markers. While typical solutions for whole body humanoid control aim at avoiding or accommodating contact, contact is explicitly required to reach objects placed on surfaces far out of normal reach. We employ sampling-based MPC for whole-body leaning, bracing, reaching, and recovery on a Unitree H1-2 humanoid. The controller runs in real-time at 34 Hz on a laptop, transfers sim-to-real, extends reach by about 50 cm beyond the unbraced standing workspace, and sustains the loaded posture for over four minutes, before pose estimation drifts. The controller reaches the commanded target in 89% of trials and completes the full reach-and-recovery cycle in 81%, across 54 trials spanning six targets and three table heights. We further characterize why such a small real-time sampling budget is sufficient, finding that temporal persistence of sampled actions and exploration scale strongly govern success, while CEM provides the widest operating region over planning rate and model mismatch. These results establish a real-world baseline for online, contact-rich humanoid manipulation. Code, videos, and full hardware details are available at this https URL
comment: 8 pages, 9 figures, 1 table. Under review at ICRA 2027. Videos and code at this https URL

AI.tldr: 人形机器人通过倚靠环境支撑扩大触及范围，并实现实时伸手与恢复控制。
AI.motivation: 常规站姿限制远处物体的可达性，需要主动利用环境接触稳定身体并扩展工作空间。
AI.method: 在Unitree H1-2上采用采样式全身模型预测控制，仅依赖局部感知和标记完成倾身、支撑及恢复。
AI.result: 控制频率34赫兹、触及范围扩展约50厘米；54次试验中到达目标成功率89%，完整循环成功率81%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法建立了在线接触密集型人形操作的实机基线，动作时间持续性与探索尺度显著影响成功率。

title: A predictive, per-engine energy roofline of the Apple Neural Engine
summary: The Apple Neural Engine (ANE) is in over a billion devices, but is characterized indirectly via CoreML. Using a CoreML-free fused-graph dispatch path, we measure the ANE, along with the Apple GPU and CPU on the same device, with per-engine energy accounting. The consumer-available roofline does not predict the ANE in practice. A critical correction is that the ANE sees two effective memory bandwidths: a slow activation path and a fast weight-stream path. Two roofline ridges follow, and the weight-stream ridge is below that of the GPU. The ANE single-operand compute peak decreases instead of plateauing. Its weight stream is byte-bound in fp16 but limited by the dequantizer's element rate in int8. As a result, int8 compression saves energy at unchanged throughput and an int4 lookup-table stream raises throughput and efficiency at a cost of 2.55 points of ImageNet top-1. The corrected roofline identifies the lower-energy ANE paths and bounds it from below. A constructed device map reproduces across four unique ANE generations. Results show that operators should be placed by arithmetic intensity and fused for optimal performance.
comment: 40 pages, 5 figures, 36 tables (including a 28-table supplement as appendices). Accepted to ACM Transactions on Architecture and Code Optimization (TACO). Code and data: this https URL

AI.tldr: 修正后的逐引擎能耗屋顶线揭示苹果神经引擎的双带宽瓶颈及低能耗执行路径。
AI.motivation: 现有公开屋顶线难以预测苹果神经引擎表现，且通过CoreML间接测量限制了硬件特性分析。
AI.method: 采用绕过CoreML的融合图调度与逐引擎能耗核算，区分激活和权重流带宽并构建设备映射。
AI.result: int8压缩在吞吐不变时节能，int4查表流提高吞吐和效率但损失2.55个百分点ImageNet首选准确率。
AI.conclusion: 算子应按算术强度分配并融合执行，修正模型的设备映射可在四代不同神经引擎上复现。

title: Can Agentic LLMs Write Task-Based Parallel Code? A Study of OpenMP Tasking, HPX, StarPU and TTG
summary: Task-based programming offers more expressive power than loop-level parallelism, but the runtimes providing it differ widely in API style, maturity, and the amount of public code to learn from. This paper asks how well LLM agents write C++ for four of them: OpenMP Tasking, HPX, StarPU, and TTG. Instead of single one-shot prompts, we use an agentic workflow in which the model edits files, compiles, and runs its kernels until it reproduces a reference output. Five locally hosted open-weight LLM implement seven HPC kernels, including matrix multiplication, Cholesky and LU factorization, in all four frameworks and a serial baseline to verify their understanding of the problem in general. Every kernel is evaluated independently for correctness at each concurrency level, strong scaling, and peak memory. Model capability dominates the outcome: three models produce correct, genuinely task-parallel kernels in 57-82% of the cases, while two models rarely compile their own code and almost never succeed. For the capable models, OpenMP Tasking and HPX are handled most reliably, StarPU is close behind, and TTG trails. The best generated GEMM and factorization kernels match or exceed the multithreaded OpenBLAS/LAPACK reference. However, correctness overstates parallel quality: several "parallel" kernels contain no parallelism at all; and serialized task graphs and unsuitable task granularity remain common.

AI.tldr: 智能体式大模型可生成高性能任务并行代码，但正确性并不保证真正有效的并行。
AI.motivation: 任务并行运行时的接口、成熟度和公开代码量差异较大，模型跨框架编程能力尚不明确。
AI.method: 让五个本地开放权重模型通过编辑、编译和运行，在四种框架及串行基线上实现七个高性能计算内核。
AI.result: 三个模型在57%—82%的案例中生成正确且真正任务并行的内核，另两个模型几乎无法成功。
AI.conclusion: 模型能力主导结果，最优内核可媲美或超过参考库，但串行化任务图与不当任务粒度仍常见。

title: Knowledge-Guided Local-to-Global Anomaly Learning for Longitudinal Medication Trajectories
summary: Detecting suspicious deviations in longitudinal medication trajectories requires distinguishing knowledge-consistent treatment variations from anomalous changes and linking local deviations to account-level decisions. We propose a knowledge-guided local-to-global (L2G) anomaly learning framework that addresses both challenges. It constructs proxy supervision at three granularities: medication occurrences, treatment episodes, and contiguous visit segments. Knowledge-consistent medication and episode replacements provide plausible negatives, while cross-category and cross-account perturbations provide suspicious proxies. A medication-multiset encoder and causal visit-sequence encoder feed a shared scoring head that produces visit-level anomaly logits. Top-\(\alpha\) aggregation derives account-level scores from these logits, while account-level classification and class-balanced visit-localization objectives jointly optimize the same visit-level evidence. Experiments on two city cohorts compare L2G with native and proxy-adapted anomaly methods. On City-A, L2G outperforms the strongest comparators. Cross-city results show more consistent gains in localization than in account-level detection.

AI.tldr: L2G利用医学知识和多粒度代理监督，将局部用药异常关联到账户级异常检测。
AI.motivation: 纵向用药异常检测需区分合理治疗变化与可疑偏离，并将局部证据汇总到账户层面。
AI.method: 构造三粒度代理监督，以药物多重集和因果就诊序列编码器联合优化账户分类与就诊定位。
AI.result: L2G在City-A优于最强对照方法，跨城市实验中定位增益比账户检测增益更稳定。
AI.conclusion: 知识引导的局部到全局学习有助于用药异常识别，但跨城市账户级检测收益仍不够稳定。

title: Guiding AI Agents to Generate Conjectures by Encoding How Theorems Build on One Another
summary: Recently, LLMs have been making headlines, and headway, in mathematical research. Much of this work focuses on proving existing open conjectures. Deciding what to prove is harder and less studied, because of the lack of a clear criterion for what makes a conjecture worth pursuing. We present a method for conjecture generation that builds on the observation that mathematical theorems build on one another: new theorems can modify the setting or hypotheses of earlier theorems, strengthen their conclusions, or extend their scope. We encode these relationships in a new kind of graph, the Theorem Evolution Graph (TEG), which we instantiate as an online search method for LLM agents. An agent builds a TEG in two steps: (1) identifying relevant theorems from papers found by following citations backward and forward from a seed paper; and (2) comparing those theorems to record how one builds on another. LLM judges and an expert mathematician preferred TEG-generated conjectures over those from an unconstrained baseline. LLM judges favored TEG conjectures for significance, ambition, and insight, and favored baseline conjectures for plausibility. Ablations suggest a benefit from constructing and using a TEG even when the available papers are fixed.

AI.tldr: 定理演化图通过编码定理间的承接关系，引导语言模型生成更受评审青睐的数学猜想。
AI.motivation: 现有数学人工智能多关注证明，而如何选择值得研究的猜想仍缺乏明确标准。
AI.method: 智能体沿种子论文的双向引用检索定理，构建定理演化图并据此生成猜想。
AI.result: 语言模型评审和数学专家更偏好图引导猜想，但语言模型认为基线猜想更具可信性。
AI.conclusion: 编码定理演化关系有助于猜想生成，消融实验表明固定文献集时构图和用图仍有收益。

title: ST-GAT: A Leakage-Free Spatio-Temporal Graph Attention Framework for Robust Network Intrusion Detection
summary: Intrusion detection systems are a central defence in modern networks. Deep learning models report strong anomaly-detection results, but evaluations on standard benchmarks such as CSE-CIC-IDS-2018 are often inflated by two methodological problems: temporal leakage from overlapping sliding windows, and contamination from preprocessing fitted before the train/test split. Per-flow classifiers also ignore the spatio-temporal dependencies across sequences of network flows. We propose a Spatio-Temporal Graph Attention Network (ST-GAT) that represents traffic as a sequence of graph snapshots. It builds k-Nearest Neighbour (k-NN) edges within each window, applies multi-head Graph Attention Network (GAT) layers for spatial aggregation, and uses a Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) network with temporal attention for sequence modelling. To prevent leakage, we use non-overlapping temporal windows (stride equal to window length) and fit all preprocessing on the training split only. We compare three class-imbalance strategies: inverse class-frequency weighting, dynamic balanced sampling, and few-shot metric prototyping. Across three random seeds, ST-GAT with inverse class weighting reached a Macro-F1 of 96.65% (+/- 0.87) and an accuracy of 99.14%. This is 14.3 percentage points higher in Macro-F1 than a per-flow Random Forest baseline (82.34%). Balanced sampling reduced Macro-F1 by 2.3 points (to 94.37%) relative to loss weighting. This suggests that aggressive resampling of small, noisy minority classes can hurt detection in heavily imbalanced traffic.

AI.tldr: ST-GAT在避免数据泄漏的评估中，以时空图建模提升网络入侵检测效果。
AI.motivation: 重叠窗口和划分前预处理会夸大检测性能，逐流分类还忽略流量间的时空依赖。
AI.method: 采用非重叠窗口和仅训练集拟合预处理，结合近邻图、多头图注意力及双向长短期记忆网络。
AI.result: 逆频率加权下宏F1为96.65%、准确率99.14%，宏F1较随机森林高约14.3个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 无泄漏时空建模能改善检测，而对少量含噪少数类进行激进重采样可能降低效果。

title: CLEAR: Legible and Steerable Recommendation via Grounded Natural-Language Interests
summary: Modern recommenders keep learned preferences in representations people cannot inspect or change. We present CLEAR (Controllable and Legible End-to-end Architecture for Recommendation), an end-to-end system deployed at Meta and built around an editable natural-language interest layer. CLEAR makes a ranked subset of inferred interests readable and stores accepted additions and suppressions as authoritative preference state. Behavioral grounding maps each inferred interest back to supporting events in the user's own history. The resulting interest object is also a serving address: its label and profile-conditioned rewrites drive lexical retrieval, its supporting events seed behavioral retrieval, its projection queries an embedding index, and its stable identity supports ranking, attribution, and exposure control. A fresh user declaration may precede behavioral support, so it enters through the same serving identity and initially draws candidates from topical retrieval. Ranking makes those candidates competitive, while a delivery controller observes attributable exposure and replenishes underexposed interests. Direct user review found that users rated about 88.5% of displayed interests accurate. In an offline benchmark using a shared evaluation protocol, the Specialized 3B generator reached 0.3967 mean-user F1@10, compared with 0.3633 for Gemini 2.5 Pro and 0.1911 for the prior generator. For a newly declared interest, a user-randomized cumulative ablation measured same-day delivery losses of 8.7 percentage points for added-interest ranking terms, 11.1 for reserved top-slot insertion, and 13.7 for interest-conditioned candidate sourcing, conditional on the tested removal sequence. CLEAR components have operated in production for over one year; the system spans four surfaces on Instagram and Facebook, with an interest layer people can inspect, correct, and use to direct recommendations.

AI.tldr: CLEAR以可编辑、可追溯的自然语言兴趣层，让用户查看并引导推荐。
AI.motivation: 现代推荐系统将偏好隐藏在用户无法检查和修改的学习表征中。
AI.method: 将兴趣关联个人历史证据并统一用于多路召回、排序和曝光控制，同时保存用户增删偏好。
AI.result: 用户认为约88.5%的展示兴趣准确，专用3B生成器平均用户F1@10达0.3967，优于两项对照。
AI.conclusion: CLEAR已在四个产品界面运行逾一年，展示了可读、可纠正且可引导的推荐兴趣层的可行性。

title: Conditional Endorsement: Simulating How Adults with Different Skills Evaluate Canada's National AI Strategy
summary: Canada's 2026 national AI strategy, AI for All, commits to free AI training for everyone and to expanding business AI adoption, yet it is difficult to anticipate whether these policies will reach adults with uneven skills and circumstances. We ask how adults with diverse skills might rate these policies on support, effectiveness, and personal benefit, how their skills and circumstances shape these evaluations, and what implementation conditions they raise. We built 3,200 generative agents from a weighted sample of the Programme for the International Assessment of Adult Competencies (PIAAC) Cycle 2 respondents, collected their ratings and explanations for 20 policies, and analyzed dialogues between agents with contrasting ratings. The agents supported nearly every policy but were far less confident that they would improve adult AI literacy or benefit them personally. This gap widened as digital technology use declined: agents modeled on adults who had never used a digital device still endorsed the policies but rarely expected to benefit. Agents traced the gap to participation costs, hard-to-exercise rights, and limited community control, and their dialogues specified these conditions rather than resolving disagreement. We describe this pattern as conditional endorsement and argue that AI literacy policy should be designed and evaluated for adults with the fewest digital skills.
comment: This research was funded by the Future Skills Centre, and an earlier version of this pre-print was submitted as a report to them

AI.tldr: 生成式智能体模拟显示，对加拿大人工智能政策的广泛支持并不意味着相信自身能够受益。
AI.motivation: 全民人工智能培训与企业采用政策能否惠及技能和处境不同的成年人尚难预判。
AI.method: 基于PIAAC加权样本构建3200个智能体，收集20项政策评价并分析意见相异者的对话。
AI.result: 智能体普遍支持政策但对成效和个人收益信心较低，数字技术使用越少，这一差距越大。
AI.conclusion: 这种模拟中的有条件支持提示，人工智能素养政策应优先围绕数字技能最弱的成年人设计和评估。

title: Learning inadequacy of Bayesian neural operators for PDE-constrained inference and design
summary: Partial differential equations (PDEs) underpin predictive modeling across science, engineering and medicine. Their use in digital twins, parameter inference and optimal design requires repeated solutions across parameters and scenarios. For nonlinear, transient and multiphysics systems, these calculations can make numerical simulation prohibitively expensive. Here we introduce the residual-informed Bayesian neural operator (RI-BNO), which learns operator inadequacy using a posteriori error estimates from the governing PDEs and incorporates its correction and uncertainty into Bayesian training and prediction. We establish local error bounds for the residual-informed estimates under stability and smoothness assumptions. We demonstrate RI-BNO on a non-linear reaction-diffusion benchmark with DeepONet and latent-subspace architectures, Markov chain Monte Carlo inference of glioma parameter fields from magnetic resonance imaging, and Monte Carlo risk-averse optimization of three-dimensional thermal breaks in building envelopes under manufacturing uncertainty. Across the evaluated examples, RI-BNO improves agreement with finite element (FE) reference predictions, parameter posteriors and optimized designs while using half as many full nonlinear or transient training simulations as the vanilla Bayesian neural operator (vBNO). For thermal break design, online optimization time decreases from 178 hours with the FE model to 18 minutes with RI-BNO. These results demonstrate the value of explicit inadequacy modeling in neural operators for reliable PDE-based inference and design.

AI.tldr: RI-BNO显式学习神经算子误差及其不确定性，提高偏微分方程推断与设计的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 数字孪生、参数推断与优化设计需反复求解复杂偏微分方程，计算成本可能难以承受。
AI.method: 利用方程后验误差估计学习算子不足，将修正及不确定性纳入贝叶斯训练预测，并建立局部误差界。
AI.result: 训练模拟次数减半时仍更贴近有限元参考，热桥在线优化耗时由178小时降至18分钟。
AI.conclusion: 在所评估案例中，显式建模算子不足可兼顾计算效率与推断、设计结果的可靠性。

title: A Hybrid State Space-Attention Architecture for Forecasting the Trajectories of Battery Degradation
summary: Early-life battery degradation trajectory forecasting aims to predict a battery cell's full state-of-health (SOH) trajectory from its initial charge-discharge cycles, potentially reducing cell qualification and evaluation time from months to days. Despite recent advances, accurate forecasting remains challenging for emerging battery chemistries, data-scarce domains, and cells exhibiting degradation behaviors beyond those observed during training. Existing state-of-the-art approaches increasingly rely on model scaling, large language model-derived aging-condition embeddings, and extensive fold-specific hyperparameter tuning, raising concerns about computational efficiency, reproducibility, and generalization. This work introduces DecayFormer, a compact hybrid state-space and attention architecture designed for early-life degradation trajectory forecasting. DecayFormer combines cycle-level selective recurrence, using a single scalar state per channel, with an attention mechanism queried by the recurrent state. It further incorporates state-of-charge (SOC) interval statistics and a master curve head that jointly estimates a scalar lifetime and a monotonically non-increasing SOH profile parameterized by normalized lifetime. We evaluate DecayFormer on the BatteryLife benchmark using all 22 aging-condition-exclusive folds, with a single run per fold and one fixed configuration across all folds, without fold-specific tuning. DecayFormer achieves mean test MAPE values of 2.25% on Li-ion, 2.76% on CALB, 0.95% on Na-ion, and 7.19% on Zn-ion. These results demonstrate the potential of compact sequence models to deliver accurate early-life degradation forecasts across diverse battery chemistries and aging conditions, without relying on extensive model scaling or per-fold optimization.

AI.tldr: 紧凑的DecayFormer融合状态空间与注意力机制，从早期循环预测多种电池的完整退化轨迹。
AI.motivation: 新电池化学体系、稀缺数据及未见退化模式使预测困难，模型扩张和逐折调参也增加成本。
AI.method: 结合逐通道标量递归、状态查询注意力与荷电区间统计，以主曲线头联合预测寿命和单调健康轨迹。
AI.result: 锂离子、CALB、钠离子及锌离子测试平均MAPE分别为2.25%、2.76%、0.95%及7.19%。
AI.conclusion: 固定配置覆盖全部22折的结果表明，紧凑模型无需大规模扩张或逐折调参也有望准确预测退化。

title: Latency, Speech Recognition and Turn-Taking in Voice Agents for Spanish Phone Negotiation: An Externally Measured Comparison of Pipecat, LiveKit and GPT-Live
summary: A voice agent that negotiates by phone must answer quickly, understand spoken amounts and cope with a caller who talks over it. We compared three architectures for such an agent, negotiating freight rates in Spanish: two cascades (speech recognition, language model and speech synthesis) orchestrated by Pipecat and by LiveKit Agents, and GPT-Live, an OpenAI speech model that listens and speaks without separate stages. A program played the carrier with the same 47 recordings of one speaker for all agents, without the telephone network, in 77 calls per architecture over five negotiation scenarios, and measured latency on the listener's side with a validated instrument. Median latency to the content response was 2,616.0 ms (Pipecat), 3,090.0 ms (LiveKit) and 2,444.8 ms (GPT-Live); the confidence interval of GPT-Live's 171.2 ms advantage over Pipecat includes zero. According to its own timestamps, GPT-Live began to answer 800 ms after the end of the line, close to the 0.8 s published by OpenAI; most of the remaining wait, about 1,367 ms and nearly constant, is the audio's round trip through OpenAI's service. A tool call added 0.9-1.1 s in every architecture, more than any difference between them, and the frameworks' self-reported latency fell short of the listener's wait by 9% (Pipecat) and 22% (LiveKit). Word error rates were low (6.03, 4.93 and 1.47%), but the error on amounts was 13.01% and 12.61% in the cascades, against 2.86% in GPT-Live. With default settings, Pipecat and LiveKit stopped at almost every backchannel and often took it as the carrier's answer: an "ok" spoken over the agent ended in a registered agreement in 3 of 15 Pipecat calls, 2 of 15 LiveKit calls and no GPT-Live call (descriptive counts, not tested). Latency should therefore be measured on the listener's side, and a cascade needs safeguards for spoken amounts and backchannels.

AI.tldr: 西班牙语运价谈判测试显示，语音智能体需从听者端评估延迟，并防范金额及附和语误判。
AI.motivation: 电话谈判智能体既要快速响应，也要准确理解金额并妥善处理用户插话。
AI.method: 在无电话网络条件下，以同一说话者录音对三种架构各测试77通谈判，并从听者端测量延迟。
