title: DecoEdit: Beyond Flat Control for 3D-Aware Unified Image Editing
summary: While recent advances in multimodal image editing have achieved impressive results, current frameworks remain largely confined to ``flat" 2D controls (e.g., text prompts, bounding boxes, or masks). Precise 3D-aware geometric manipulation -- such as coordinating an object's location, physical scale, and 3D orientation while strictly preserving its fine-grained identity -- remains an elusive challenge, typically suffering from severe detail degradation or requiring expensive per-instance fine-tuning. In this paper, we present DecoEdit, an all-in-one image editing framework that goes beyond flat control by seamlessly integrating 1D textual, 2D spatial, and 3D volumetric inputs under a unified architecture. First, to power this unified model, we establish a data curation pipeline and curate a large-scale dataset, namely DecoDataset, containing 1.6 million samples, encompassing diverse multi-dimensional (1D/2D/3D) tasks and their complex compositions. Furthermore, we establish a comprehensive image editing benchmark named DecoBench to systematically evaluate multi-task editing performance. Finally, to address the fundamental trade-off between complex spatial transformations and identity preservation, we propose a novel decoupled pipeline: DecoEdit factorizes the editing process by utilizing structural guidance from SAM-3D to anchor the target geometry, scale, and spatial orientation, while concurrently leveraging a detail-preservation path to lock in high-fidelity textures. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DecoEdit achieves state-of-the-art results. Notably, on the challenging 3D spatial pose and orientation control tasks, DecoEdit significantly outperforms leading closed-source models such as Seedream 5.0 in both geometric accuracy and identity consistency.

AI.tldr: DecoEdit统一多维输入，实现兼顾几何精度与身份一致性的三维感知图像编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有编辑多局限于二维控制，精确三维操控易损失细节或依赖昂贵的逐实例微调。
AI.method: 构建160万样本数据集与评测基准，并解耦SAM-3D结构引导和细节保留路径。
AI.result: 实验达到最先进水平，三维姿态与朝向控制的几何精度和身份一致性显著优于Seedream 5.0。
AI.conclusion: 统一多维控制与结构细节解耦可兼顾复杂空间变换和精细身份保留。

title: Agent-Guided Process Verification for Mathematical Self-Correction
summary: Large language models have made substantial progress in mathematical reasoning, yet in complex multi-step reasoning, an error at any step may propagate along an incorrect path, and the resulting solution may omit necessary branches. Existing natural-language reflection methods often struggle to locate critical errors precisely, while outcome verification typically checks only whether the available candidate answers satisfy the problem conditions and can therefore overlook necessary branches. To address these limitations, we propose Agent-Guided Process Verification (AGPV) for mathematical self-correction. AGPV decomposes the current solution into an ordered sequence of key claims, verifies them individually while invoking a shared mathematical toolbox when needed, and stops upon detecting the first error. A summarization agent converts the failure evidence into a diagnosis that guides a correction agent to re-derive the subsequent solution from that point; AGPV then adapts the next verification iteration to the revised solution. AGPV also verifies solution completeness. We further prove that AGPV guarantees solution correctness and completeness when key claims provide sufficient coverage and local verification is reliable, provided that all key claims pass verification. The implementation compresses long working contexts and reuses successful tool results within each problem. We evaluate AGPV on five challenging mathematical reasoning datasets with four models from DeepSeek, Qwen, and GPT. AGPV achieves an average accuracy of 63.8%, outperforming the strongest among the representative baselines evaluated (50.3%) by 13.5 percentage points, with higher repair coverage than the programmatic-verification baselines.

AI.tldr: AGPV通过逐项验证关键论断并定位首个错误，支持数学解答自我纠正与完整性检查。
AI.motivation: 多步推理错误会传播且可能遗漏分支，而自然语言反思和结果验证难以充分识别这些问题。
AI.method: 将解答拆为有序关键论断，调用工具逐项验证，再由诊断和纠正智能体引导后续重推。
AI.result: 在五个数据集和四个模型上平均准确率达63.8%，较最强参评基线提高13.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 在关键论断覆盖充分且局部验证可靠时，全部通过验证可保证解答正确且完整。

title: Beyond Plain MCP: Do Decision Models and Code Mode Make Tool Use Cheaper and Faster?
summary: Model Context Protocol (MCP) gateways manage tool catalogs for language model agents using two primary paradigms: code mode where agents write scripts against tool stubs and decision layers which are cheap routers that preselect tool subsets. Using a controlled harness across 12 servers, up to 1,958 distractor tools, and three open-weight agents including Qwen, Gemma, and Nemotron, we present a preregistered evaluation on a sealed test split to determine when each approach succeeds. Code mode substantially outperforms plain MCP, cutting token usage by 70 to 90 percent while significantly boosting utility. Declaring return-shape hints in code mode stubs is a first-order variable, swinging success by up to 39.5 points for lower-performing agents, an effect larger than adding a router. The central hypothesis that a decision layer in front of code mode beats code mode alone is not confirmed, showing minor, statistically non-significant improvements for weaker agents and a slight cost for the strongest. We publicly release our harness, a finetuned 4B tool selection model, and all evaluation traces to support robust community experimentation on local AI privacy and agent architectures.
comment: 16 pages, 11 tables. Code, harness, and models available at this http URL this https URL

AI.tldr: 受控评测显示，代码模式显著降低MCP工具调用成本，但额外决策层未带来显著收益。
AI.motivation: 工具目录扩张使智能体调用成本增加，需要厘清代码模式与工具预选决策层各自的价值。
AI.method: 在12个服务器、最多1958个干扰工具和三个开放权重智能体上开展预注册封闭测试。
AI.result: 代码模式减少70%至90%的词元用量并提升效用，返回结构提示最多影响39.5个百分点的成功率。
AI.conclusion: 代码模式及其返回结构提示是关键因素，增加决策层优于单独代码模式的假设未获支持。

title: ANCHOR: A Port-Hamiltonian Model for Forecasting Team Dynamics in Human-in-the-Loop Systems
summary: Cyber-physical-human systems close a loop around people by sensing human behavior, predict it and act on it. Human teams are a natural target, because collaboration breaks down in ways that a timely prompt could prevent. Collaborative mixed reality makes this loop practical, since each headset senses who speaks, where its wearer looks and who stands together, and it can deliver a light prompt. In this loop, the headsets are sensors, the prompts are actuators and the team is the plant. Closing the loop needs a plant model that is small enough to learn from few teams, safe to iterate and readable by a designer. We propose ANCHOR, which models a team as a ball in an energy bowl. The bottom of the bowl is where the team rests, and it is set by the team's recent behavior, its own history and other teams. Formally, ANCHOR is a switched port-Hamiltonian system with 52 parameters, and each part stands for a testable claim from team psychology. Because of this structure, for any fitted parameters, a forecast moves away from rest only when task progress or a prompt pushes it, and prompts of bounded size that are spaced in time move it a bounded distance. On \nGroups{} four-person teams held out from training, a team that drifts from its usual behavior returns most of the way within half a minute. After 32 s, about 24% of the deviation remains, and ANCHOR predicted 30%. Forecasts are clearly better when the resting point blends its three sources than when it uses one. ANCHOR matches the accuracy of a black-box baseline with about 40,000 parameters. It anticipates conversation collapse with an AUROC of 0.85. In simulation under assumed prompt effects, it removes 2.2 times as much breakdown time per prompt as periodic prompting.

AI.tldr: ANCHOR用52参数的可解释动力学模型预测团队行为，为人机闭环干预提供基础。
AI.motivation: 混合现实团队干预需要可用少量团队数据学习、可安全迭代且易于解释的动态模型。
AI.method: 以切换端口哈密顿系统描述团队状态，并融合近期行为、自身历史和其他团队确定平衡点。
AI.result: 预测精度匹配约4万参数的黑箱基线，对话崩溃预测AUROC为0.85。
AI.conclusion: 模型兼顾可解释性与预测精度，在假定提示效果的仿真中每次提示消除的失效时长为周期提示的2.2倍。

title: AI Inference-Aware Optimal Power Flow: Converting Token Requirements into Grid Flexibility
summary: The rapid growth, temporal variability, and geographic concentration of electricity demand from artificial intelligence (AI) inference can aggravate transmission congestion near data centers (DCs). The spatial and temporal flexibility of inference workloads offers an opportunity to alleviate this congestion: requests can be routed across DCs or deferred within users' quality-of-service (QoS) requirements. However, inference routing primarily considers graphics processing unit (GPU) availability, leaving this flexibility underused in grid operation. Using GPU measurements, this paper models inference latency and DC power consumption to quantify the flexibility available under users' time-to-first-token (TTFT) and inter-token latency (ITL) requirements. These models are then incorporated into an AI inference-aware optimal power flow (OPF) that coordinates inference routing and power system operation among DC operators, the transmission system operator, and inference users. By linking user requests, token generation at DCs, and electricity delivery through the transmission network, the formulation schedules inference workloads subject to both users' QoS requirements and transmission constraints. Simulations on the PJM system show that, compared with computing-based routing and with electricity price-based routing, coordinating inference routing with network operation enables growing DC electricity demand deliverable to be met at lower cost.

AI.tldr: 将推理服务时延要求纳入最优潮流，可把数据中心负载的时空灵活性转化为电网调节能力。
AI.motivation: AI推理用电增长加剧局部输电拥塞，而主要依据GPU可用性的路由未充分利用负载灵活性。
AI.method: 基于GPU测量建立时延与功耗模型，将首词元和词元间时延约束纳入推理感知最优潮流。
AI.result: PJM系统仿真表明，相比计算资源路由和电价路由，协同调度能以更低成本满足增长的用电需求。
AI.conclusion: 联合协调推理路由与电网运行，可在满足服务质量和输电约束的同时降低供电成本。

title: Empowering Masked Diffusion Models to Self-Correct with Leave-One-Out Transformers
summary: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for language modeling, enabling parallel token generation with competitive performance. Yet standard MDMs suffer from two fundamental limitations: (1) inability to revise tokens, and (2) sparse training signal. We revisit hollow transformers, which address both limitations by predicting each token from its surrounding context, independently of the input at that position. We introduce the Leave-One-Out Transformer (LOOT), a more efficient and expressive architecture that advances hollow transformers through two complementary advances. First, we redesign the merging mechanism to enable frequent interaction between left and right contexts, substantially improving predictive performance over prior hollow transformers. Second, we derive a lower-variance estimator of the MDM NELBO that supervises all tokens and improves validation perplexity. Together, these advances yield a competitive standalone diffusion language model capable of effective self-correction during inference. On LM1B, LOOT matches the strongest dense-supervision MDM baseline in validation perplexity. On OpenWebText, LOOT achieves higher MAUVE and better generation quality-diversity tradeoffs than prior remasking methods, using $8\times$ fewer forward evaluations and $3.5\times$ fewer inference FLOPs.

AI.tldr: LOOT改进空心Transformer，使掩码扩散语言模型获得高效的推理时自我纠正能力。
AI.motivation: 标准掩码扩散模型无法修订已生成词元，且训练监督信号稀疏。
AI.method: 增强左右上下文交互，并推导监督全部词元的低方差负证据下界估计器。
AI.result: LM1B困惑度持平最强密集监督基线；OpenWebText生成质量更优，前向次数和推理计算量分别减少8倍和3.5倍。
AI.conclusion: 高频上下文融合与全词元监督可同时改善扩散语言模型的自我纠正能力和生成效率。

title: Wireless Edge-Assisted Adaptive Latent Reasoning for Vision-Language-Action Models in Physical AI
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable embodied artificial intelligence (AI) by translating visual observations and language instructions into robotic actions. Emerging use cases in physical AI are expected to drive the need for efficient inference and communication, as the computational demands of the VLA models pose challenges for real-time control with limited onboard resources. Test-time scaling through latent reasoning allows these models to refine hidden representations without generating explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) tokens, but introduces a trade-off between task success, inference latency, and energy consumption. In this paper, we address the efficient collaborative inference under a realistic communication scenario. We propose a wireless edge-assisted framework for adaptive latent reasoning (WEALR) that augments onboard computation with edge computing. A decision-making agent jointly selects the execution location and latent-reasoning convergence threshold. We formulate this joint adaptation as a constrained Markov decision process (CMDP). A Lagrangian-constrained deep reinforcement learning (CDRL) approach, namely trust region policy optimization Lagrangian (TRPO-Lag), learns to balance task performance and resource consumption under varying wireless conditions and task requirements. We evaluate the framework using LIBERO manipulation tasks, profiled VLA inference costs, and ray-traced wireless channels. Experimental results demonstrate that TRPO-Lag achieves up to 23% higher feasibility-weighted task success rate compared to benchmark CDRL methods.
comment: 6 pages, 6 figures, submitted to IEEE ICC

AI.tldr: WEALR联合选择推理位置与潜在推理阈值，提升无线边缘辅助机器人推理的资源利用效率。
AI.motivation: 机载资源受限和无线条件变化，使VLA潜在推理面临任务成功率、时延与能耗的权衡。
AI.method: 将联合自适应建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程，使用TRPO-Lag学习执行位置和收敛阈值策略。
AI.result: 基于LIBERO任务、实测推理成本和射线追踪信道，TRPO-Lag的可行性加权成功率较基准最高提升23%。
AI.conclusion: 约束强化学习可在变化的无线条件和任务需求下协调任务表现与资源消耗。

title: The Race between Protection and Control: Fast Reactive Reserves Against Overvoltage Cascade
summary: In an overvoltage cascade, each relay trip removes reactive power absorption and raises the voltage at other plants, often faster than controls can act. This paper determines how much fast reactive power to hold, where, and how fast, so that no contingency trips a plant. A trip certificate allows a relay to pick up if it resets before its delay expires, making the sizing a linear program. A necessary condition identifies the relays that only preventive action can protect, and the reserve of one control decreases with the relay delay and increases with its latency. In nonlinear simulations of four systems, the corrective actions prevent every trip within the analysis window for relays without reset hysteresis, and each plant's own set point is the most effective reserve. A 2\% hysteresis or a small error in the relay voltage can change the reserve as much as the relay delay.

AI.tldr: 通过考虑继电保护与控制响应的竞速关系，优化快速无功备用以阻止过电压级联跳闸。
AI.motivation: 过电压跳闸会减少无功吸收并推高其他电厂电压，传播速度可能超过控制响应。
AI.method: 构建允许继电器在延时内复归的跳闸判据，将备用容量、位置及响应要求转化为线性规划。
AI.result: 四个系统的非线性仿真中，无复归滞环继电器均在分析窗口内避免跳闸，电厂自身设定值调节最有效。
AI.conclusion: 备用配置需同时考虑保护延时、控制时延及滞环，部分继电器只能依靠预防措施保护。

title: How Much Determinism Can Fine-Tuning Buy? Margin Regularisation Against Batch-Induced Token Flips
summary: Greedy decoding at zero temperature is widely assumed to be deterministic, although the exact same prompt may yield different tokens depending on the number of other prompts sharing the batch for inference. The currently available solutions operate during inference, trading determinism for throughput. Can we train a model in such a way that fewer decoding steps would be susceptible? We characterize the perturbation empirically across six model families and three numerical precisions and observe two empirical facts about the measurement: the perturbation depends exactly on the representable precision (8.00x for bfloat16 vs float16, 8192.0x for float16 vs float32, in line with predictions based on mantissa bits) and the batch invariance happens accidentally at certain tensor shapes, allowing a practitioner to achieve zero nondeterminism merely by setting the sequence length. Then we apply hinge penalization of the model's top-1 / top-2 logit gap, scaled to twice the measured noise quantile. On GSM8K dataset it leads to a 35% reduction in token flips and divergence from 53.8% to 38.1%, at the cost of 1.3 - 2.9 accuracy points, increasing monotonically with the margin size. It does not affect the gap threshold sufficient for determinism: the logit gaps of surviving flips are unchanged (median 0.125 for all arms), as the hinge is a soft penalty and the largest hardware perturbation remains the same. We reject seven hypotheses, including a per-model viability diagnosis, holding on six models and falsified on the seventh.

AI.tldr: 通过微调扩大候选词元的分数间隔可减少批次引起的输出翻转，但会牺牲准确率且无法保证确定性。
AI.motivation: 零温贪心解码仍会因推理批次变化而输出不同词元，现有推理期解决方案则牺牲吞吐量。
AI.method: 跨六个模型家族和三种数值精度测量扰动，并以两倍噪声分位数为尺度惩罚前两名词元的分数间隔。
AI.result: GSM8K词元翻转减少35%，分歧率从53.8%降至38.1%，但准确率损失1.3至2.9个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 间隔正则化能降低翻转频率，却不改变实现确定性所需的间隔阈值，且部分张量形状可意外消除非确定性。

title: SuperGlance: Driving at a Glance with a Vision-Language Model
summary: Autonomous driving is turning to vision-language-action models (VLAs). They answer and plan by decoding, one step at a time. Each step is another forward pass, so a plan can take over a second of GPU time. Embodied AI often pairs such a slow, reasoning System 2 with a fast System 1 that acts. Human drivers plan at a glance, with System 1. Faster designs usually put System 1 outside the vision-language model (VLM), in a planner without its abilities. Yet before a VLM writes its first token, it has already read the scene into one hidden state. We show that, once trained, this hidden state is enough to drive and to answer questions about what the model sees. SuperGlance reads it to turn a decoder-only VLM into an encoder-style driving policy. Its linear head scores a fixed set of 5,273 candidate trajectories. With the set fixed, rewards are computed offline, so supervised targets can be reward-weighted and reinforcement learning maximizes the exact expected reward. Before and during policy training, multiple-choice training keeps the VLM's visual abilities in one pass, so the policy still answers questions about driving scenes. Training questions are built against shortcuts. Each must be answered right in two option orders. Against drift, a KL term keeps each stage near its starting model. One pass offers VLAs a more plausible path to System 1. SuperGlance answers visual multiple-choice questions as well as its base VLM does by decoding. It plans in 84 ms of GPU time, six times faster than Qwen-Drive-1.0, and at least as well on NAVSIM, PAI-AV and WOD-E2E. In AlpaSim closed loop, km per at-fault incident holds for both planners up to a 300-ms delay and drops beyond. With GPU time charged as delay, SuperGlance's lead over Qwen-Drive-1.0 grows from 2.8 to 3.9 times. Delayed by 1.2 s, our model falls below Qwen-Drive-1.0 at its own 518 ms.

AI.tldr: SuperGlance利用视觉语言模型单次前向传播的隐藏状态，实现兼顾视觉问答能力的快速驾驶规划。
AI.motivation: 自回归驾驶模型逐步解码耗时较长，而外置快速规划器通常无法保留视觉语言模型的能力。
AI.method: 用线性头为5273条固定轨迹评分，结合离线奖励训练、多选问答训练和KL约束保留视觉能力。
AI.result: 规划耗时84毫秒，较Qwen-Drive-1.0快六倍，在三个评测上至少相当，并保持基础模型的视觉多选问答水平。
AI.conclusion: 单次前向规划为快速驾驶策略提供了可行路径，但闭环驾驶表现仍受较大延迟影响。

title: When the Mythical Man-Month Meets Agentic Web Systems: Structured Coordination for Scalable Development
summary: As agentic systems are increasingly deployed to support complex Web tasks, multi-agent architectures offer greater parallelism, specialization, and task coverage. However, increasing the number of agents does not necessarily improve system performance, as communication, synchronization, redundant work, and coordination overhead may offset the benefits of additional agents. This presents a fundamental scaling challenge for agentic Web systems: how can agent populations be organized to balance task performance and coordination costs? To address this challenge, we systematically investigate the relationship between agent population size, per-agent token consumption, and coordination overhead in collaborative agentic systems. Experiments on complex Web-oriented software development tasks reveal a non-linear scaling pattern: per-agent token consumption initially decreases as the agent population grows, but eventually exhibits diminishing returns. Motivated by these findings, we introduce the Surgical Team Model (STM), a structured coordination framework that organizes agents through role specialization, constrained inter-agent communication, and coordinator-mediated task aggregation. Experiments on full-stack Web application development tasks show that STM achieves competitive task completion quality and comparable token consumption relative to representative baselines, while incurring higher execution latency.

AI.tldr: 研究揭示多智能体开发的非线性扩展规律，并提出以角色分工和受限通信控制协调成本的STM框架。
AI.motivation: 增加智能体数量可能被通信、同步及重复工作的开销抵消，难以持续提升复杂Web任务表现。
AI.method: 分析智能体数量、单体词元消耗与协调开销，并通过角色专门化、受限通信和协调者汇总组织开发。
AI.result: 单体词元消耗随规模扩大先下降后收益递减，STM质量与词元消耗接近代表性基线，但执行延迟更高。
AI.conclusion: 结构化协调能取得有竞争力的任务质量，但尚未消除多智能体开发中的延迟代价。

title: Puzzle: One Pass Is Not Enough for Open-Vocabulary Remote Sensing Segmentation
summary: Open-vocabulary remote sensing image segmentation (OVRSIS) enables the segmentation of unseen classes without additional annotation or retraining. By analyzing the predictions of existing OVRSIS methods, we find that many misclassified patches coexist with visually similar, correctly classified patches of the same class within the same image. Unfortunately, most of these methods stop after a single inference rather than using their predictions to guide further inference. Motivated by this observation, we propose \textbf{Puzzle}, a plug-and-play iterative re-inference framework that combines prediction history with a visual-similarity prior to progressively refine patch-level attention. Puzzle employs a lightweight history-conditioned controller to regulate each patch's contribution as an information source and its reliance on visually similar patches, while an adaptive stopping rule determines when to stop. It keeps the segmentation model frozen and reuses the same controller across different models and datasets without retraining. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent performance improvements across diverse OVRSIS models and datasets, highlighting the strong transferability of Puzzle. Moreover, Puzzle can further improve the performance of SOTA methods.

AI.tldr: Puzzle通过结合预测历史与视觉相似性的迭代推理，提升开放词汇遥感图像分割表现。
AI.motivation: 同幅图像中常有外观相似的正确与错误分类图块，而现有方法通常未利用这些预测继续推理。
AI.method: 冻结分割模型，以历史条件控制器调节图块信息贡献及相似图块依赖，并采用自适应停止规则。
AI.result: 在多种模型和数据集上均获得一致提升，且同一控制器无需重训即可迁移并进一步增强先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 利用预测历史开展迭代细化，是可插拔且具有较强迁移性的遥感分割改进途径。

title: HDR-DTCP: High-Dynamic-Range Differential Tissue-Coupled Wireless Powering for Tunable Biphasic Stimulation in Injectable Implants
summary: Next-generation implantable neurostimulators require efficient wireless power delivery in smaller, less invasive form factors, yet variations in tissue coupling, implantation conditions, and stimulation loads can alter received power (or requirements) and degrade energy-harvesting performance. This work presents high-dynamic-range (HDR) differential tissue-coupled powering (DTCP), termed HDR-DTCP, a body-coupled architecture in which noninvasive differential electrodes establish an AC electric field in tissue and a thread-like implant extracts power from the longitudinal potential gradient for on-chip harvesting and stimulation. Distributed coupling along the implant length, rather than receiver cross-section, enables minimally invasive injectable geometries, with harvested power scaling with implant length. A 65-nm complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) prototype integrates a reconfigurable four-stage energy harvester with automatic stage selection and a tunable constant-current biphasic stimulator, achieving 63.5\% peak power-conversion efficiency (PCE) at $-16.3$ dBm and $>50\%$ PCE over a 9-dB input-power range. Preliminary in-vivo validation of DTCP was done with a second application-specific integrated circuit (ASIC) on an injectable flexible substrate, capable of being delivered through a 14-gauge needle adjacent to the sciatic nerve of Sprague-Dawley rats (n=4). External copper-pad DTCP powering evoked repeatable hind-limb twitches and electromyography (EMG) response; ultrasound confirmed sub-millimeter nerve proximity, video-based paw-tip tracking captured the response, and 8-day post-implant dissection verified placement along the sciatic-nerve trajectory. Overall, this work provides an integrated wireless powering, energy-harvesting, and stimulation platform toward fully battery-free injectable neuromodulation implants.

AI.tldr: HDR-DTCP将组织耦合无线供电、宽动态范围能量采集与可调双相刺激集成于面向可注射植入物的平台。
AI.motivation: 微型植入式神经刺激器需要高效无线供电，但组织耦合、植入条件和刺激负载变化会损害能量采集。
AI.method: 通过体外差分电极在组织内建立交流电场，由细长植入物采能，并集成自动级数选择采集器与双相刺激器。
AI.result: 原型峰值转换效率达63.5%，在9分贝输入范围内超过50%，另用芯片在四只大鼠中诱发重复肢体及肌电响应。
AI.conclusion: 该平台为完全无电池的可注射神经调控植入物提供了集成方案，并获得初步体内验证。

title: MarineSparkLM-4B: A Lightweight Language Model for Marine and Offshore Engineering Built by Parameter-Efficient Adaptation
summary: Marine and offshore engineering text is spread across preprints, open-access journals, encyclopedias and institutional documents, and the amount of it is small by pretraining standards. We ask how far a lightweight language model for marine and offshore engineering can be taken with parameter-efficient adaptation on a single workstation-class device. Starting from the 4-billion-parameter OceanGPT-basic-4B-Instruct, we train two independent LoRA adapters, each updating 33.0 million of 4.06 billion parameters (0.81%). Training took 4 hours 40 minutes for the first adapter and 10 minutes for the second on one NVIDIA DGX Spark. The first adapter is trained by next-token prediction on a 61.6-million-token corpus covering ten engineering themes. The corpus was built from 13,879 source documents, of which 7,069 were retained after deduplication and a two-tier keyword filter that removes cross-domain lexical collisions. Its validation loss falls from 2.082 to 1.976 over 1,500 steps. Direct testing showed that this adapter could still drift off topic on a retrieval-grounded ballast-water prompt, so we trained a second adapter on 2,295 question-answer pairs (114 hand-written and 2,181 generated by the base model from corpus passages) with the loss restricted to answer tokens. On 20 held-out prompts scored by hand for accuracy, topicality and specificity (maximum 120), the plain base model, the continuation adapter, the instruction adapter and the instruction adapter with retrieval scored 42, 56, 84 and 88. Absolute accuracy stays low (14 of 40 without retrieval and 20 of 40 with it). We report the full pipeline, two negative results (a reverted keyword fix and an instruction run that overfit within 100 steps), and the limits of the evaluation, which uses one small prompt set, no inter-rater agreement measure and model-generated reference answers.

AI.tldr: MarineSparkLM-4B以单设备LoRA适配提升海洋工程问答表现，但绝对准确性和评估规模仍有限。
AI.motivation: 海洋与海上工程文本分散且规模有限，需要探索轻量模型在单台工作站级设备上的领域适配能力。
AI.method: 基于OceanGPT训练两个独立LoRA适配器，分别使用6160万词元领域语料和2295组问答进行适配。
AI.result: 20个提示的人工总分由基础模型42分升至指令适配84分、结合检索88分，但准确性分项仍低。
AI.conclusion: 参数高效适配可改善领域相关性与问答表现，但小样本评估及较低绝对准确性限制了结论强度。

title: ImpedanceMimic: Learned Impedance as Action Space for Force-Accurate Motion Imitation
summary: Recovering the forces behind a motion is ill-posed: different controllers can reproduce the same movement while generating different contact forces. Physics-based motion imitation resolves this ambiguity through simulation, but relies on fixed-gain proportional-derivative (PD) control. We show that fixed gains impose a trade-off between motion and force tracking, as contact and swing place conflicting demands on joint stiffness and damping. We introduce ImpedanceMimic, a reinforcement-learning policy that modulates per-joint stiffness, damping, and position setpoints from motion and force measurements, but requires only motion at inference. Across 129 participants and six activities, ImpedanceMimic outperforms matched fixed-gain PD under every integration scheme, direct-torque, muscle-actuated and existing imitation controllers in kinematic and force fidelity, approaching a dedicated motion-to-force regressor. By expressing gains as multiples of inertia-scaled priors, a single policy controls subject-specific biomechanical models without explicit anthropometric input and transfers zero-shot to unseen humans and a humanoid robot. The learned impedance forms a low-dimensional representation of motor state, shared across bodies, that generalizes to withheld activities: stiffness scales with load, and damping anticipates unloading.
comment: 39 pages, 13 figures, 28 tables. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: ImpedanceMimic以学习式关节阻抗为动作空间，同时提升动作模仿的运动学与接触力精度。
AI.motivation: 相同动作可对应不同接触力，固定增益控制又因接触与摆动阶段需求冲突而难以兼顾运动和力跟踪。
AI.method: 强化学习策略根据运动和力测量调节关节刚度、阻尼与目标位置，推理时仅需运动输入，并采用惯性缩放先验。
AI.result: 在129名参与者和六类活动中，运动及力保真度优于多类控制基线，并零样本迁移至未见人体和人形机器人。
AI.conclusion: 学习阻抗形成跨身体共享的低维运动状态表示，可泛化至未参与训练的活动并反映负载变化。

title: From zero-target transfer to target-site personalization: multi-source training across fall-detection models
summary: Video-based fall detection could support timely assistance when a person cannot call for help. Unfamiliar cameras and scarce local labels challenge deployment. We examine whether joint training improves cross-dataset detection and subsequent local training. We analyze 2,697 clips from eight OmniFall datasets and one AI-Hub dataset. Positive clips contain a fall or collapse transition, while negative clips do not. We hold out each dataset in turn, training on the other eight. We evaluate three vision-language models (VLMs), Qwen, LLaVA, and InternVL, and three visual baselines, CLIP-temporal, VideoMAE, and Pose-TCN. We evaluate the stored source model without target data for training or selection. For each label budget, we update a separate copy using labeled clips from the held-out target dataset. We call this target-site personalization. We compare the Source-initialized model with Target-only, which skips source training but uses identical target clips and updates. Across nine targets, source training raises mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) from frozen-model values of 0.821 to 0.912 for Qwen, 0.883 to 0.947 for LLaVA, and 0.939 to 0.962 for InternVL. With five target examples per class and 26 updates per run, 95% confidence intervals for the AUROC benefit over Target-only lie above zero for Qwen, CLIP-temporal, VideoMAE, and Pose-TCN. With full-target training, they lie above zero only for Qwen and LLaVA. Separate VLM analyses reveal threshold sensitivity and post-fall false detections. The benefit varies by model and label budget.

AI.tldr: 多源训练可改善跌倒检测的跨数据集迁移及部分本地适配效果，但收益依模型和标注预算而异。
AI.motivation: 陌生摄像头与稀缺本地标注阻碍视频跌倒检测部署，需要检验多源训练对迁移和后续个性化的价值。
AI.method: 在九个数据集的2697段视频上，对六种模型开展留一数据集测试，并以不同本地标注预算比较适配效果。
AI.result: 三种视觉语言模型的平均AUROC均提升，少样本适配时四种模型显著受益，全量适配时仅Qwen与LLaVA受益。
AI.conclusion: 多源初始化具有条件性的迁移价值，部署仍需关注阈值敏感性、跌倒后误报及模型与标注预算差异。

title: FundingClaw: Automated Grant Proposal Writing Agents System
summary: Grant proposal writing remains a manual, labor-intensive bottleneck: proposals must satisfy rigid, agency-specific templates, and the same intellectual content must be repeatedly re-encoded into incompatible formats across funding organizations. We introduce FundingClaw, a multi-agent framework built on template-driven skill selection, where a Template Parser ingests any agency's specification and selects the appropriate writing skills for each stage, so that one research brief can produce compliant proposals for NSFC, NSF, KAKENHI, or ERC without modifying generation logic. A blueprint-skeleton strategy drafts a structured outline before any prose is written, mitigating the semantic drift that plagues long-form generation. Three sequential stages produce the rationale, research content, and research foundation sections, with multi-source verification of the PI's record and optional PDF-grounded extraction of representative works. Optional human feedback checkpoints and a closed-loop self-review complete the pipeline. Evaluated on ten research topics with an eight-dimension rubric, FundingClaw outperforms the baseline, narrowing the gap with human level for laborious funding proposal. The code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: FundingClaw通过模板驱动的多智能体流程，将同一研究简报转化为不同资助机构的合规申请书。
AI.motivation: 基金申请依赖人工撰写，且同一研究内容需反复适配不同机构的严格模板。
AI.method: 解析机构模板并选择写作技能，先生成结构骨架，再分阶段撰写，结合资料核验、可选人工反馈与自审。
AI.result: 在十个研究主题的八维评价中，FundingClaw优于基线，并缩小了与人类水平的差距。
AI.conclusion: 模板驱动的多智能体流程有助于自动化跨机构基金申请写作，减少重复性劳动。

title: Mean-field Token Steering
summary: We consider stochastic token steering through a deep stack of transformer layers as a mean-field control problem for an interacting particle system on the unit sphere, where interactions arise from the attention mechanism. In the mean-field limit, the token population evolves via a controlled integro-partial differential equation where the feedback control acts as a corrective vector field guiding the population toward an aggregate configuration of tokens in the representation space. We deduce the minimum effort control to accomplish this task over a fixed time horizon interpreted as normalized layer depth. We show that the resulting controlled dynamics for the token population can be understood as a mean-field Schrödinger bridge adapted to the sphere geometry. Building on this, we propose a novel generalization of the dynamic Sinkhorn recursion to compute the consistent token evolution. Numerical experiments confirm that the proposed approach achieves exact steering of the token population.

AI.tldr: 该研究将Transformer中的随机词元引导建模为球面平均场控制，并实现词元群体的精确引导。
AI.motivation: 研究如何在固定层深内，以最小控制代价将受注意力交互影响的词元群体引导至目标构型。
AI.method: 推导受控积分偏微分方程，将动力学解释为球面平均场薛定谔桥，并推广动态Sinkhorn递推。
AI.result: 数值实验确认，所提方法能够实现词元群体的精确引导。
AI.conclusion: 球面平均场控制为Transformer词元群体的最小代价引导提供了理论与计算框架。

title: From Sensors to Silicon: Causal Cross-Layer Self-Healing Edge AI for Secure and Energy-Adaptive IoT Systems
summary: The migration of artificial intelligence from centralized cloud infrastructure to resource-constrained Internet-of-Things (IoT) devices reduces communication latency and improves data locality, but it also tightly couples sensing quality, inference behavior, microarchitectural activity, hardware reliability, security, and energy management within the same physical node. Existing edge-intelligence solutions predominantly address these dimensions in isolation, making it difficult to determine whether an observed degradation originates from sensor malfunction, data-distribution shift, malicious execution, hardware faults, or resource and thermal stress. This paper presents a causal cross-layer self-healing Edge-AI framework that continuously observes synchronized telemetry spanning sensor health, inference uncertainty, processor hardware-performance counters, accelerator and memory activity, power and thermal state, and communication conditions. A temporally informed causal reasoning engine estimates the most probable origin of abnormal behavior and quantifies diagnostic uncertainty, including under concurrent perturbations.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出因果跨层自愈边缘AI框架，结合多层遥测定位物联网节点异常来源。
AI.motivation: 现有边缘智能方法割裂处理传感、推理、硬件、安全与能耗，难以区分性能退化的根因。
AI.method: 持续采集同步跨层遥测，利用时序因果推理估计异常来源，并量化并发扰动下的诊断不确定性。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体结果。
AI.conclusion: 该框架旨在通过跨层因果诊断，为资源受限物联网节点的自愈提供基础。

title: LABEL: Literature Asymmetry between Efficacy and Limits in Drug Knowledge and Language Models
summary: Every medication comes with two types of medical facts: indications, which describe what conditions the drug treats (benefits), and contraindications, which describe who must avoid it to prevent serious harm (safety limits). Although contraindications are critical for patient safety and FDA regulations require listing them as rigorously as indications, we find that contraindications are far less documented than indications in general prose. In this paper, we measure how often these texts contain both facts across 574 drugs from PrimeKG by comparing a drug's indications against its own contraindications. Across Wikipedia articles and PubMed abstracts, we find that reference prose names a drug's benefits about twice as often as its safety limits (within-drug odds ratio 2.19). We call this documentation gap LABEL (Literature Asymmetry between Efficacy and Limits). Language models mirror this gap. As we scale Qwen2.5 from 0.5B to 14B, accuracy on indications rises by 18.3 points, whereas accuracy on contraindications remains flat near random guessing. However, when we provide models with a retrieved passage that states the answer, they use safety facts just as effectively as benefits. Furthermore, routing safety questions to official FDA labels boosts accuracy by 15.8 points whenever the label states the fact. Overall, our findings show that models fail on medication safety not because they cannot reason about risk, but because free-text corpora lack safety facts. Clinical AI systems should therefore route medication-safety questions to official regulatory labels and structured databases rather than relying on general public records. Code and data are available at this https URL.
comment: 27 pages (9 main + supplementary material), 8 figures, 7 tables

AI.tldr: 药物文献对疗效与禁忌的记录不均衡，语言模型也呈现这一差距，而官方标签检索可改善安全问答。
AI.motivation: 药物禁忌对患者安全至关重要，但其在通用文本中的覆盖程度及对模型的影响尚不明确。
AI.method: 比较574种药物在维基百科与PubMed中的适应证和禁忌记录，并评估模型规模及检索供证的影响。
AI.result: 疗效提及优势比为2.19；模型扩规模后禁忌准确率仍近随机，标签含答案时准确率提升15.8个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 药物安全问答应优先使用官方监管标签与结构化数据库，而非仅依赖通用文本。

title: Executable Archaeology: Reanimating the Logic Theorist
summary: The Logic Theorist (LT), created by Allen Newell, J. C. Shaw, and Herbert Simon in 1955--1956, is regarded by some as the first artificial intelligence program. It was originally simulated by hand and written in a pseudocode called the Logic Language (LL), which was later called Information Processing Language One (IPL-I). LT was revised many times. The first machine-executed version was written in IPL-II and ran on the JOHNNIAC, and a late version was published in 1963 by Einar Stefferud as a pedagogical document and written in IPL-V, the only version of IPL that was formally released to the public. We describe a reanimation of both the IPL-I (LL) version of LT and the 1963 IPL-V version. Comparing the two reanimations illuminates the process of the invention of early AI algorithms and computer languages.
comment: This paper builds upon a previous ArXiv paper of a similar name: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2603.13514. This paper is NOT a mere rehash of the previous paper; appropriate citations and comparison are provided in the discussion. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible

AI.tldr: 该研究复现逻辑理论家程序的两个历史版本，通过比较考察早期AI算法与编程语言的演变。
AI.motivation: 逻辑理论家经历多次语言与程序修订，复现不同版本有助于理解早期人工智能的发展过程。
AI.method: 分别复现以IPL-I（LL）编写的早期版本和1963年以IPL-V编写的版本，并进行比较。
AI.result: 两个版本的复现与比较揭示了早期AI算法及计算机语言的发明过程。
AI.conclusion: 可执行复现为理解早期AI程序及其语言设计演进提供了研究途径。

title: EviRef: Evidence-Specific Memories for Logical Anomaly Detection across Capture Conditions
summary: Logical anomalies arise when every component looks normal but their combination violates the scene rules. In practical inspection, these rules must hold under varying backgrounds, illumination, and imaging quality, with only a few dozen normal images per scene, whereas existing methods couple normality with appearance and merge different constraints into one reference. We model logical normality as decomposable constraints and propose EviRef, a training-free method that builds a separate reference memory for each family of evidence. Component prototypes built once per scene parse images under any capture condition into one label space, on which occupancy and relation constraints are verified. Semantic constraints are verified with whole-image embeddings independent of parsing, and additional evidence such as text is admitted through a task-level gate without modifying existing memories. On VID-AD, EviRef attains a mean image-level area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 92.1% (88.9% with visual evidence alone), the highest among the compared methods under each of five capture conditions, with a standard deviation of 0.5. Even with memories built from only 20 normal images per task, it surpasses all compared methods that use 50 normal images per task.

AI.tldr: EviRef以分证据记忆进行免训练逻辑异常检测，在多种拍摄条件和少量正常样本下表现领先。
AI.motivation: 逻辑异常检测需在外观变化下识别组合违规，而现有方法混淆正常性与外观，并合并不同约束。
AI.method: 为不同证据建立独立记忆，以组件原型统一解析并验证占用和关系约束，另用整图嵌入验证语义约束。
AI.result: VID-AD平均图像级AUROC达92.1%，五种拍摄条件均领先，且20张正常图像建库仍优于使用50张的对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 分解逻辑约束并分离证据记忆，可提升跨拍摄条件下逻辑异常检测的稳健性与样本效率。

title: When Does Confidence Reveal Problem Difficulty?
summary: While confidence signals are commonly evaluated for their ability to predict a model's own correctness, their relationship with problem difficulty remains less understood. In this work, we investigate a wide range of confidence-related signals and whether they can serve as indicators of problem difficulty across various task domains. We find that perturbation inconsistency, semantic entropy, and solution length exhibit strong associations with population difficulty than token-level uncertainty. Notably, these relationships persist even when restricting the analysis to problems correctly answered by the focal model, suggesting that such signals capture information about difficulty beyond their ability to predict the model's own correctness. We further explore applications of these signals, illustrating the potential and limitations of using confidence-related signals to guide inference-time decisions. Our findings highlight the utility of model-specific signals as imperfect but informative proxies for population-level problem difficulty.

AI.tldr: 扰动不一致性、语义熵与解答长度可作为题目群体难度的不完美但有效的代理指标。
AI.motivation: 置信度常用于预测模型自身是否答对，但其与题目群体难度的关系仍不清楚。
AI.method: 跨任务分析多类置信度相关信号与群体难度的关系，并考察仅答对题目及推理时决策应用。
AI.result: 扰动不一致性、语义熵和解答长度比词元级不确定性更关联群体难度，且在模型答对的题目中仍成立。
AI.conclusion: 模型特定信号包含超出自身正确性预测的难度信息，但用于推理时决策仍存在局限。

title: Isolating Perception for Multi-View Planning under Occlusion-Induced Partial Observability
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are beginning to saturate visual planning benchmarks, yet they fail to resolve depth ambiguity and degrade sharply with problem size under occlusion-induced partial observability (PO). We introduce BW-PO based on the Blocksworld domain, a controlled benchmark that reduces existing VLM planners and formalizers to near-zero performance, and propose VLM-as-perceiver, a paradigm that narrows the VLM's role to local perception while delegating cross-view evidence reconciliation and plan generation to external solvers. Across model-specific challenging subsets of BW-PO, this raises plan success from 1% to 97% for Gemma-4-31B, 0% to 95% for Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, and 3% to 84% for Gemini-3.1-Pro. Isolating perception in this way separates two bottlenecks that are otherwise entangled: reconciliation under depth ambiguity, and completeness of visual extraction under scene density.

AI.tldr: 将视觉语言模型限定为局部感知器，并由外部求解器整合多视图与规划，可显著改善遮挡场景规划。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在遮挡导致的部分可观测环境中难以消解深度歧义，且随问题规模增大性能急降。
AI.method: 构建积木世界基准BW-PO，由视觉语言模型提取局部信息，外部求解器负责跨视图协调和计划生成。
AI.result: 在各模型的挑战子集上，Gemma、Qwen和Gemini的规划成功率分别由1%、0%、3%升至97%、95%、84%。
AI.conclusion: 隔离感知可解耦深度歧义下的证据协调与密集场景中的视觉提取完整性两类瓶颈。

title: WA-JEPA: Goal-Aware Predictive Feedback Action Refinement for a World-Action Model
summary: JEPA-based world models predict action consequences in latent space, but representative planning approaches rely on candidate-action search, requiring repeated evaluation of action sequences and incurring substantial online computational cost. Direct action generation avoids this search, yet how to leverage latent predictions to guide action generation given task goals remains a key challenge in translating learned physical dynamics into effective decisions. We introduce WA-JEPA, a world-action model that couples action generation, action-conditioned latent prediction, and goal-aware feedback. The model first generates an action proposal and predicts the resulting future scenes and proprioceptive states, then refines the proposal through two complementary feedback paths, using the task goal as a reference. Goal-discrepancy residual feedback (GDRF) uses differences between the latent representations of predicted scenes and the task goal to guide chunk-wise action refinement. Future-scene context feedback (FSCF) preserves fine-grained predicted scene representations to guide subsequent action refinement. Jointly learned from offline demonstrations, this process iteratively updates the same plan before execution, making future predictions directly participate in action generation without candidate-action search. We evaluate short-horizon goal reaching, long-horizon tasks, and full-task execution. The results show that goal-aware predictive feedback supports competitive task performance while maintaining a compact model and low online computational cost. Code is available at this https URL.
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, including supplementary material. Code available at this https URL

AI.tldr: WA-JEPA通过目标感知的预测反馈迭代优化动作，无需候选动作搜索即可实现高效决策。
AI.motivation: 候选动作搜索在线计算成本高，而直接动作生成难以利用潜在预测与任务目标指导决策。
AI.method: 联合学习动作生成与潜在预测，通过目标差异残差和未来场景上下文两条反馈路径优化动作计划。
AI.result: 在短期目标到达、长期任务及完整任务执行中，模型保持紧凑和低在线计算成本，并取得有竞争力的表现。
AI.conclusion: 目标感知预测反馈可让未来预测直接参与动作生成，减少对候选动作搜索的依赖。

title: Do VLMs Really Look at the Road? A Diagnostic Evaluation for Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly being evaluated for autonomous driving through question-answering benchmarks, yet high benchmark accuracy does not necessarily reflect visually grounded reasoning. We present a diagnostic evaluation framework that systematically probes whether VLMs base safety-critical driving decisions on visual evidence or instead rely on language priors, answer biases, and dataset regularities. Our benchmark comprises two task categories, Adverse Weather and Junctions \& Intersections, with a nuScenes spatial reasoning extension, and evaluates open-source (general, driving, and spatial-reasoning) VLMs along four diagnostic protocols: image versus no-image evaluation, counterfactual weather sensitivity, linguistic robustness under paraphrasing and negation, and spatial reasoning. All ground-truth labels are derived programmatically from BDD100K and DriveLM annotations, enabling reproducible evaluation without manual labeling. Across all models, we find that competitive overall accuracy conceals systematic failure modes, including strong affirmation bias, limited sensitivity to counterfactual scene changes, near-chance performance on negated questions despite high paraphrase consistency, and confident driving decisions even without visual input. These results demonstrate that current open-source VLMs remain insufficiently grounded for safety-critical autonomous driving and underscore the need for diagnostic evaluation beyond aggregate accuracy.

AI.tldr: 自动驾驶诊断评估表明，视觉语言模型的高准确率可能掩盖对视觉证据的依赖不足。
AI.motivation: 现有问答基准的总体准确率无法充分反映模型是否依据视觉证据作出安全关键驾驶决策。
AI.method: 利用现有标注生成真值，从有无图像、反事实天气、语言鲁棒性和空间推理四方面诊断开源模型。
AI.result: 模型普遍存在肯定偏差、反事实敏感性不足、否定问句表现接近随机及无图像时仍自信决策等问题。
AI.conclusion: 当前开源视觉语言模型的视觉 grounding 不足，安全关键自动驾驶评估需超越总体准确率。

title: A Unified Control Framework, Mathematical Model, and Five-layer Closed-loop Case Study for Embodied Intelligence Control Systems
summary: Embodied intelligence holds that an agent develops cognition and behavior through real-time body-environment interaction, so its control system must tightly couple perception, decision making, learning, optimization, constraints, and physical execution. This report asks whether a unified framework exists, how its mathematical models unify, and how the framework is realized computably. Four conclusions emerge. (1) No single framework is accepted, but the field converges on a common skeleton: from operational-space and whole-body control to MPC, reinforcement learning, active inference, and diffusion/flow policies, all reduce to constrained sequential decision making on the configuration manifold. (2) Two languages describe it-deterministic optimal control (Euler-Lagrange plus constrained OCP, reduced in real time to a QP) and probabilistic inference (MDP/POMDP plus free-energy minimization)-rigorously bridged by control as inference and KL/path-integral control. (3) Engineering unification is already achieved by constrained optimization; the new frontier is cross-morphology, cross-task shared representation. (4) The hardest gap is provable stability and safety, the entry point for spectral, geometric, differentiable-optimization, and safe-learning methods. A single-link manipulator then runs through all five layers: L4 parses the instruction into a reference, L3 identifies a Koopman lifted linear world model, L2 solves a receding constrained QP, L1 adds torque saturation and a CBF, and L0 is the true nonlinear plant. Closed-loop tracking RMSE is 0.0218 rad with all constraints satisfied and a world-model error near 5 x 10^-6 rad, reported with curves and a 3D animation.

AI.tldr: 报告将具身控制归纳为受约束序贯决策，并用五层单连杆闭环案例展示其计算实现。
AI.motivation: 具身控制需紧密耦合感知、决策、学习与执行，但其统一框架、数学联系和计算实现尚待厘清。
AI.method: 梳理最优控制与概率推断的联系，并构建涵盖指令解析、世界模型、约束优化和安全执行的五层系统。
AI.result: 单连杆案例跟踪均方根误差为0.0218弧度，满足全部约束，世界模型误差约为5×10⁻⁶弧度。
AI.conclusion: 约束优化已实现工程层面的统一，跨形态共享表征及可证明的稳定性与安全性仍是关键挑战。

title: Calibrating the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Monocular Depth without Labels
summary: Self-supervised monocular depth networks can predict a per-pixel uncertainty, which is mainly evaluated by how well it ranks pixels according to their error. Such metrics are insensitive to the magnitude of the uncertainty, so an uncertainty half as large as the actual error obtains the same score. In this paper, we investigate whether the predicted uncertainty is as large as the depth error, both on average (scale) and across confident and uncertain, near and far pixels (shape). On KITTI, the scale is miscalibrated for every uncertainty estimate we evaluate, and the error of MonoProb is nearly twice its predicted uncertainty. We propose MonoCal, which corrects both the scale and the shape without ground-truth depth. Scale calibration multiplies the uncertainty by a single constant measured from stereo pairs, requiring no retraining, and this constant closely matches the one fitted with ground truth. Since a constant cannot change the shape, we further retrain the uncertainty to predict where the depth of the network disagrees with that of a second self-supervised network. Experiments on KITTI show that MonoCal achieves better calibration across uncertainty levels and depth ranges than rescaling with ground truth, while still using a single image at inference. Code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: MonoCal无需真实深度标签即可校准自监督单目深度不确定性的尺度与形状。
AI.motivation: 现有不确定性排序指标忽略数值大小，无法判断预测不确定性是否匹配实际深度误差。
AI.method: 利用立体图像对估计缩放常数，并以两个自监督网络的深度分歧为目标重训不确定性预测。
AI.result: KITTI上所有受测估计均存在尺度失准，MonoCal跨不确定性水平和深度范围的校准优于真值缩放。
AI.conclusion: 无标签的尺度与形状联合校准能够改善不确定性可靠性，且推理仍仅需单张图像。

title: Distilling Safety Filters for Filter-free Multi-agent RL
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) can teach robot teams to navigate shared spaces, but trial and error causes collisions that real robots cannot afford. Control barrier function (CBF) safety filters prevent these collisions by correcting unsafe actions, yet in a team the filter becomes a centralized optimization whose number of constraints grows quadratically with the team size. We propose an approach that builds the filter's safety into the RL policy and examine how such a system behaves during filter-free deployment. However, the filter that keeps training safe also hides what the policy must learn: it masks the cost of unsafe actions, which actor-critic methods then overvalue, and it keeps near-collision states out of the training data. Our approach therefore learns only from executed safe actions with implicit Q-learning and distills the filter into the policy at synthetic near-collision states. We prove that filter distillation loss bounds the policy's constraint violation and hence how far agents can cross their safety margin, so errors never accumulate. When distillation states cover deployed states, the loss also bounds the collision probability at every step. Without a filter and acting only on local observations, our policies have no collisions in 1,800 test episodes with multiple agents. A policy trained with three agents transfers zero-shot to teams of twenty at constant per-agent computation and stays collision-free with up to eight agents. We test our policies on Crazyflie quadrotors with up to five flying at the same time.

AI.tldr: 通过安全滤波器蒸馏，多智能体强化学习策略可仅凭局部观测在部署时无需滤波器运行。
AI.motivation: 集中式安全滤波约束随团队规模平方增长，且会掩盖危险动作代价并造成近碰撞训练数据缺失。
AI.method: 以隐式Q学习仅学习已执行的安全动作，并在合成近碰撞状态蒸馏滤波器，推导约束违反界。
AI.result: 无滤波策略在1800次测试中零碰撞，三智能体策略可迁移至二十智能体，且八智能体以内保持无碰撞。
AI.conclusion: 蒸馏可降低部署计算负担并约束安全裕度违反；部署状态被蒸馏状态覆盖时，还可界定逐步碰撞概率。

title: Ref-MIL: Plug-and-Play Posterior Refinement for Multiple Instance Learning in QSM-Based Brain Disease Classification
summary: Quantitative susceptibility mapping (QSM) is a novel quantitative MRI contrast for studying tissue susceptibility changes in brain disorders, including Parkinson's disease (PD) and multiple sclerosis (MS). However, small cohorts and the lack of local annotations make developing deep learning models for QSM-based diagnosis challenging. In this work, we propose PoRef-MIL, a weakly supervised multiple instance learning (MIL) framework combining iterative slice relabeling and network retraining with a plug-and-play posterior refinement module (PRM). During training, a 2D dual-branch diagnosis network and a subject-level classifier were alternately trained for five rounds. The classifier was used to update slice pseudo-labels for retraining the diagnosis network. The PRM was applied during inference to refine slice probabilities through bidirectional posterior inference and calculate entropy-derived confidence from the refined probabilities, which was then used in sliding-window scoring to obtain subject-level predictions. PoRef-MIL was evaluated on an in-house PD cohort of 287 participants and a public MS cohort of 150 participants. Compared with eight classification methods, PoRef-MIL achieved the highest mean areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.942 and 0.872, and accuracies of 0.926 and 0.833, for PD and MS classification, respectively. Ablation experiments were conducted to validate the effectiveness of iterative relabeling and PRM, and the plug-and-play feature of the proposed PRM was also evaluated using four state-of-the-art MIL models. Overall, PoRef-MIL offers a promising approach to QSM-based disease classification in small cohorts without manual slice annotations.

AI.tldr: PoRef-MIL结合迭代伪标签与后验细化，实现小样本、无切片标注的QSM脑疾病分类。
AI.motivation: QSM脑疾病诊断面临队列规模小、缺乏局部标注等深度学习建模困难。
AI.method: 交替训练双分支诊断网络和受试者分类器，并在推理时通过双向后验细化及熵置信度聚合切片预测。
AI.result: 在287人帕金森病和150人多发性硬化队列上，平均AUC分别为0.942和0.872，均优于八种对照方法。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为无需人工切片标注的小队列QSM疾病分类提供了有前景的方案。

title: Generalization Testing of Grid Foundation Models for Power Flow and Optimal Power Flow
summary: There is growing interest in foundation models (FMs) for power grids, particularly for power flow and optimal power flow. Their usefulness depends on generalization accuracy, which existing works test on their own benchmarks. We propose a three-axis framework to test their generalization limits: changed admittance matrices of training grids, load levels, and unseen grids. We test GENCO, LUMINA and GridSFM against the DC baseline, alongside their reported limitations, and discuss theoretical reasons for their failures. Experiments reveal that adding a line degrades all FMs more than removing one, and longer lines eventually make LUMINA and fine-tuned GENCO worse than DC. All three degrade beyond their training load range, where the loading-voltage curve steepens. On unseen grids, LUMINA degrades sharply even inside its training range, and GridSFM fails on the grid farthest from it. Thus, beyond training conditions, FMs behave more like meta-models requiring test-time fine-tuning data and compute.

AI.tldr: 三轴泛化测试揭示，电网基础模型在拓扑、负荷或电网超出训练条件时性能明显下降。
AI.motivation: 电网基础模型的实用性依赖泛化精度，但现有研究多使用各自基准，缺乏统一的边界测试。
AI.method: 从导纳矩阵变化、负荷水平和未见电网三个维度，将GENCO、LUMINA及GridSFM与直流基线比较。
AI.result: 新增线路比删线影响更大，超训练负荷均导致退化，部分线路及未见电网条件下模型明显失效。
AI.conclusion: 超出训练条件后，这些模型更像需要测试时微调数据和计算资源的元模型。

title: Ego2Sim2Humanoid: Agentic Real-to-Sim for Learning Loco-Manipulation VLAs without Robot Demonstrations
summary: Imitation learning for visuomotor policies typically relies on teleoperated robot demonstrations, which are costly because every episode requires a trained operator controlling a physical robot in real time through teleoperation interfaces and wearable body-tracking hardware. Egocentric glasses capture human demonstrations without a robot or handheld grippers, yet they track only the head and in-view human hands, and directly copying human motion to a robot with different stature, arm reach and hand morphology fails to produce feasible contacts. \method{} converts egocentric glasses recordings into physically verified robot training trajectories. An agentic real-to-sim stage reconstructs collision and textured visual assets from the recorded RGB-D and head streams, completes unseen surfaces when needed, and predicts target contact bands on the manipulated objects. During motion adaptation, a grasp planner turns each contact band into a feasible robot wrist pose and finger closure, bilevel stance optimization plans collision-free standing postures that keep hand targets reachable, and a whole-body motion generator synthesizes lower-body locomotion and out-of-view arm motion. Two-stage motion correction then blends visibility transitions kinematically and trains a reinforcement-learning tracking policy in physics simulation under agent-designed semantic rewards, completing manipulation phases even when the object leaves the camera view. Rendering the reconstructed scene through the robot's onboard camera along the optimized rollout yields synchronized robot-view images, proprioception and verified action labels. Fine-tuned exclusively on this converted dataset, without real-robot demonstrations, GR00T N1.7 performed loco-manipulation tasks autonomously on a Unitree G1. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: Ego2Sim2Humanoid将眼镜采集的人类示范转为物理验证的机器人轨迹，无需机器人示范训练移动操作策略。
AI.motivation: 遥操作机器人示范成本高，而直接复制第一视角人类动作难以适应机器人的形态与接触约束。
AI.method: 从第一视角数据重建场景，结合抓取与站姿优化、全身动作生成和仿真强化学习修正，生成训练数据。
AI.result: 仅用转换数据微调的GR00T N1.7无需真实机器人示范，即可在Unitree G1上自主执行移动操作任务。
AI.conclusion: 第一视角人类示范经场景重建与物理运动适配，可支持无需真实机器人示范的移动操作策略学习。

title: Self-Calibrating Vision-Agent-Action: Deploying Pick-and-Place to New Robot Cells without Demonstrations or Fine-Tuning
summary: In simulation, Vision-Agent-Action (VAA) performs pick-and-place in robot cells with gripper or base-frame changes without robot demonstrations or fine-tuning. It uses pre-trained vision-language and language models for interpretation, measures the command map and camera geometry from its own motion and fingertips, estimates lens distortion, and plans grasps from measured object depth. A controlled study of eight public LIBERO-fine-tuned vision-language-action models (VLAs) varies robot hardware, camera geometry, appearance, and base frame. Gripper and frame changes dominate their losses in the tested fractional design. Across 18 cells with these changes, frozen VAA achieves 230/360 successes (64%), the refined VAA 268/360 (74%), and the strongest released VLA on this subset 76/360 (21%). Paired ablations support the self-calibration bundle, lens estimation under compounded changes, and the measured-depth pipeline. On a two-step LIBERO-Goal chain with object state carried between instructions, VAA completes 54/60 chains in changed cells, while four evaluated VLAs complete none.
comment: 7 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables; supplementary video in ancillary files

AI.tldr: VAA通过自主校准，在无需机器人示范或微调的情况下实现仿真中新机器人单元的抓放迁移。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言动作模型在夹爪、基座坐标系及相机等配置变化下容易出现性能下降。
AI.method: 利用预训练模型解释任务，并通过自身运动与指尖测量校准控制映射、相机几何及畸变，依据实测深度规划抓取。
AI.result: 18个变化单元中，冻结与改进VAA成功率为64%和74%，最强对照为21%；两步链任务完成54/60。
AI.conclusion: 实验支持自主校准与实测深度流程对机器人配置变化下抓放迁移的有效性。

title: What Moves a LoCoMo Score? Memory Context, Answer Prompts and Judges
summary: LoCoMo is a widely reported benchmark for long-term conversational memory, but published scores mix memory quality with choices of answer prompt, judge and baseline layout that are rarely reported together. We measure how much these choices move a score, and evaluate Becos, a team memory system for coding agents, as a black box under all of them: ten conversations (1,540 questions), two answer models (gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4.1-mini), two answer prompts and three LLM judges, against a whole-conversation baseline rerun under identical conditions. Changing only the judge moves a score by up to 7.2 points and changing only the answer prompt by up to 9.3. A blind human check of 150 answers finds the judges reliable when they agree, and the primary judge's errors on disputed answers working against Becos rather than for it. Becos answers from a context with 90% fewer characters than the whole conversation. Its configuration was developed on LoCoMo itself, so there is no held-out set. With gpt-4o-mini answers it scores clearly higher than the whole conversation (79.7 vs 73.0 with the short prompt, paired 95% interval for the difference +3.8 to +9.5; 88.8 vs 77.5 with a step-by-step prompt). With gpt-4.1-mini answers the two score about the same (83.2 vs 83.1; 92.5 vs 92.1). We release every answer and verdict and the scoring script.
comment: 13 pages, 2 figures. Answers, judge verdicts, human-check grades and scoring script: this https URL

AI.tldr: LoCoMo分数显著受回答提示与评审选择影响，Becos的优势取决于回答模型且未获留出集验证。
AI.motivation: 现有LoCoMo报告常混合记忆质量、回答提示、评审与基线设置，难以明确分数来源。
AI.method: 在十段对话的1540道问题上，组合两种回答模型、两种提示及三种评审，与同条件全文基线比较。
AI.result: 仅更换评审或提示最多改变7.2或9.3分；Becos上下文字符少90%，在两种回答模型下分别领先或持平。
AI.conclusion: 记忆评测需统一并公开提示、评审和基线条件，且Becos结果因无留出集而需谨慎解读。

title: LogT: Logically Think with Images for Visual Search
summary: Thinking with images empowers vision-language models (VLMs) to use an external Zoom-in tool for fine-grained visual search. Recent works employ supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) with tool-specific designs to enable such capabilities. However, achieving logical reasoning alongside accurate and efficient tool use remains a significant challenge. To address this, we shift the focus away from increasing RL complexity and instead identify SFT data quality as a key bottleneck. We then propose LogT (short for Logically Think with Images), a fully automated SFT data engine that explicitly enforces logic-chain-guided reasoning. LogT generates an SFT dataset featuring challenging, visually grounded questions and structured tool-use traces with human-like logic. We validate our approach by fine-tuning two base models, Qwen2.5-VL-7B and InternVL3.5-8B, on the dataset and evaluating them across seven benchmark test sets. We show that LogT-SFT based on Qwen2.5-VL-7B outperforms the state-of-the-art trained with both SFT and RL, despite using 3.1$\times$ less data and $>120\times$ fewer GPU hours. Furthermore, applying a simple RL recipe without tool-specific design on LogT-SFT yields a model that surpasses prior methods with complex RL setups by a substantial 9.59-point margin. In addition to strong performance gains, our model exhibits higher tool-use accuracy and efficiency, as well as more structured and logically consistent reasoning traces, directly validating the effectiveness of our approach.

AI.tldr: LogT以自动生成的逻辑链监督数据提升视觉搜索，在减少训练资源的同时超越既有方法。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型调用放大工具时，仍难兼顾逻辑推理、工具使用准确性与效率。
AI.method: 自动生成视觉扎根难题与逻辑链引导的工具轨迹，微调两个基础模型，并进一步采用简单强化学习。
AI.result: LogT-SFT以约三分之一数据和不足1/120的GPU时长超越既有最优方法，加入简单强化学习后领先9.59分。
AI.conclusion: 高质量逻辑链监督数据是提升视觉搜索推理与工具使用表现的有效途径。

title: On-policy distillation as a Backdoor Propagation Channel
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) is emerging as an important paradigm for the post training of large language models, improving student models by leveraging supervision generated online by teacher models. However, whether this process also transfers latent security risks from teacher models to student models remains insufficiently studied. In this work, we reveal a new security risk in which an attacker first implants a conditional backdoor into the teacher model through supervised fine tuning (SFT), after which OPD can transfer the backdoor to the student model with only an extremely small proportion of trigger prompt exposure. More concerningly, we find that such backdoor transfer is substantially stronger under OPD than under conventional distillation methods, suggesting that OPD may provide an efficient channel for propagating backdoors across models. Our mechanistic analysis shows that the backdoor signal is primarily transmitted through anomalous differences in the conditional probabilities produced by the teacher model for triggered and clean inputs, and is gradually internalized into the internal representations of the student model during training. Furthermore, we investigate how to suppress such anomalous conditional probability signals at the source of distillation supervision and, based on this analysis, propose an OPD training method tailored to this conditional backdoor propagation setting to mitigate the risk of backdoor transfer induced by untrusted teacher supervision.

AI.tldr: 在策略蒸馏可能高效传播教师模型的条件后门，即使学生仅接触极少量触发提示。
AI.motivation: 在策略蒸馏能提升学生模型，但是否同时传递教师模型的潜在安全风险尚不清楚。
AI.method: 向教师植入条件后门，比较不同蒸馏方式的传播，分析概率信号与学生表征，并提出针对性抑制方法。
AI.result: 在策略蒸馏的后门传播显著强于传统蒸馏，异常条件概率差异会逐渐被学生内部表征吸收。
AI.conclusion: 不可信教师监督可能成为后门传播渠道，需针对蒸馏源头的异常概率信号进行防护。

title: Site-Specific Cell Shaping: An Agentic Framework
summary: An agentic framework is proposed for cell shaping in future sixth-generation (6G) wireless network planning. Cell shaping controls the coverage and interferences of base stations (BSs) through antenna parameters configuration, providing an important means of improving coverage. In contrast to conventional approaches that reply on costly performance evaluations, the proposed framework achieves intelligent and efficient antenna configuration through a perception-reasoning-reflection loop. Specifically, a Configuration Agent combines scene information, evaluation history, and reflection feedback to generate antenna configuration proposals. Then, a ray tracing(RT)-based evaluator assesses these proposals and returns a structured performance summary. Next, a Reflection Agent interprets these results to diagnose site-specific performance deficiencies, recommend feasible configuration adjustments, and accumulate conditional experience. Through this iterative process, the framework accumulates site-specific experience and progressively refines antenna configurations without human-in-the-loop intervention. Simulations in real-world urban scenarios demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves lower outage probabilities than the considered benchmark methods, highlighting the effectiveness of agentic reasoning and reflection in translating site-specific performance feedback and accumulated experience into adaptive antenna configuration decisions.

AI.tldr: 面向6G小区塑形的智能体框架通过感知、推理与反思循环，自主优化站点天线配置。
AI.motivation: 小区塑形可改善覆盖与干扰，但传统天线配置方法依赖成本高昂的性能评估。
AI.method: 配置智能体生成方案，射线追踪评估器反馈性能，反思智能体诊断问题并积累站点经验以迭代调整。
AI.result: 真实城市场景仿真中，该框架的中断概率低于所比较的基准方法。
AI.conclusion: 智能体推理与反思能够将站点反馈和累积经验转化为自适应天线配置决策。

title: Incremental Learning of Vision-Language Models via Task Subspace Projection and Dynamic LoRA
summary: Recent pre-trained vision-language models often encounter a Multi-Domain Task-Incremental Learning (MTIL) scenario in practice, where a set of classes of multi-modal tasks arrive incrementally. Due to privacy concerns and memory constraints, MTIL with pre-trained models encounters forgetting of knowledge from old tasks, degradation of zero-shot transfer capability, and underfitting of new-task knowledge. To overcome these challenges, previous MTIL methods attempt to learn a discriminative cross-task identification (CTI) module and an effective new-task adaptation (NTA) module. However, current CTI modules suffer from severe task confusion between seen and unseen tasks, and NTA modules cannot adaptively balance the performance and parameter cost while incorporating task-specific knowledge. To alleviate the above dilemmas, we propose an effective and efficient TSP-DLoRA method for MTIL, which consists of Task Subspace Projection (TSP) and Dynamic Low Rank Adapter (DLoRA) modules. Specifically, our TSP module includes a task identifier classifier based on task-specific subspaces and a feature projection strategy that can determine the identifier associated with samples from both seen and unseen tasks. Our DLoRA improves the knowledge adaptation from new tasks by dynamically assigning Low Rank Adapter (LoRA) across transformer layers based on the task distributions. Experimental evaluations across 11 datasets, using three performance metrics, demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method. Code is available at this https URL.
comment: Pre-peer-review version of an article accepted for publication in the International Journal of Computer Vision (IJCV)

AI.tldr: TSP-DLoRA结合任务子空间投影与动态低秩适配，改善视觉语言模型的多领域任务增量学习。
AI.motivation: 现有方法面临旧知识遗忘、零样本能力下降、任务混淆及新任务适配性能与参数成本难平衡等问题。
AI.method: 通过任务特定子空间和特征投影识别已见及未见任务，并按任务分布动态分配各层LoRA。

AI.conclusion: 任务子空间识别与动态低秩适配为兼顾任务区分和高效知识适配提供了有效方案。

title: STaSBO: LLM-Guided Strategy Planning and Configuration Selection for Bayesian Optimization
summary: Bayesian optimization (BO) enables sample-efficient search for expensive black-box problems, but its performance depends strongly on surrogate-acquisition configurations whose suitability varies across problems and optimization states. We take a significant step toward LLM-driven strategic management of BO with STaSBO, a task-agnostic meta-controller that plans search behavior and jointly selects surrogate-acquisition configurations, while numerical BO retains responsibility for probabilistic modeling and candidate generation. STaSBO comprises two coordinated stages: strategy planning and strategy-guided configuration selection. A structured memory system connects prior plans, configuration selections, and candidate behaviors to optimization states, allowing the controller to revise its trajectory summary and behavioral plans during planning. To navigate the large joint configuration space, the selection stage shortlists configurations using surrogate fit evidence. Prospective BO-action diagnostics then expose the candidate behaviors, supporting final joint selection against the behavioral plans. Across 12 synthetic mathematical and 10 scientific and engineering application tasks, STaSBO achieves the best average rank against 11 baselines: 2.17 and 2.60, compared with 4.08 and 4.10 for the strongest baseline in each suite, respectively.

AI.tldr: STaSBO利用大语言模型规划搜索策略并联合选择代理模型与采集函数配置，改善贝叶斯优化表现。
AI.motivation: 贝叶斯优化性能高度依赖代理模型与采集函数配置，而合适配置随问题和优化状态变化。
AI.method: 以结构化记忆连接策略规划与配置选择，结合代理拟合证据筛选配置，再依据候选行为诊断完成选择。
AI.result: 在12项合成与10项应用任务中，平均排名为2.17和2.60，优于各组最强基线的4.08和4.10。
AI.conclusion: 由语言模型管理策略与配置、数值优化负责建模和候选生成的分工可提升跨任务优化表现。

title: Mem2Fair: Online Fairness Control for Text-to-Video Generation via Fair Memory
summary: Text-to-video (T2V) generation models can produce systematically unfair demographic outcomes when prompts leave protected attributes unspecified. For example, prompts describing nurses without specifying gender may disproportionately generate videos depicting female nurses. Mitigating unfairness in T2V generation is particularly challenging: training-based methods that modify model internals require architecture-specific access and risk disrupting temporal consistency, while sampling-based methods often incur costly pre-deployment video generation. We present the first conditional online approachability formulation of attribute-level fairness for T2V generation. Building on this formulation, we introduce Mem2Fair, a plug-and-play framework that maintains concept-conditioned Fair Memory. Using generated videos at inference time as feedback, Mem2Fair selects prompt-level attribute interventions based on the deviation from each concept's prescribed fairness target, without training or separate pre-deployment sampling. Experiments demonstrate that Mem2Fair consistently improves fairness over the unmodified generator and existing baselines across multiple demographic attributes, prompt settings, and target distributions, while maintaining comparable prompt-video alignment and video quality. We further demonstrate its effectiveness on commercial black-box T2V models.

AI.tldr: Mem2Fair通过推理时公平记忆与提示属性干预，无需训练或部署前采样即可改善文生视频人口属性公平性。
AI.motivation: 文生视频在未指定受保护属性时可能产生群体偏差，而现有方法存在模型访问限制或采样成本。
AI.method: 建立属性公平性的条件在线可接近性形式化，以概念条件公平记忆跟踪生成反馈并据目标偏差选择提示干预。
AI.result: 多属性、提示和目标分布实验中，公平性持续优于原生成器及基线，且对齐与画质相当，也适用于商业黑盒模型。
AI.conclusion: 基于在线反馈的提示级干预可在不修改模型的情况下改善文生视频公平性，并保持生成质量。

title: Neural Dual Bounds: Valid-by-Construction JGLP Warm-Starts for MAP and Constrained MAP
summary: We present Neural Dual Bounds, a calibration-free framework that produces deterministic upper bounds for MAP inference in probabilistic graphical models using a single neural-network forward pass. The framework trains a network to output the edge messages of a mini-bucket style upper bound on a given join-graph decomposition in a self-supervised manner by directly minimizing a smooth dual objective. The output of this network can be used at test time to warm-start a standard JGLP optimizer. Across diverse benchmarks, this warm start yields dual gaps that are orders of magnitude tighter than those from zero initialization, with the largest gains in the early-iteration regime. We also apply our framework for the constrained MAP (CMPE) task, where neural warm starts with test-time adaptation are comparable to the adaptive baseline on Bayesian networks and achieve the tightest dual gaps, by one to two orders of magnitude, on the grid and segmentation families.

AI.tldr: 提出神经双界框架，以单次网络前向计算生成确定性MAP上界，并显著改善JGLP热启动。
AI.motivation: MAP及约束MAP推断需要有效上界，而零初始化优化在早期迭代中界限较松。
AI.method: 自监督最小化平滑对偶目标，预测连接图上小桶式上界的边消息，并用于JGLP热启动。
AI.result: 热启动使对偶间隙缩小多个数量级；约束MAP在网格和分割任务上缩小一至两个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 神经预测可在保持上界有效性的同时加速优化，收益在早期迭代尤其明显。

title: Revisiting What Makes a Good Context Subset: A Sparse Latent Basis Perspective
summary: Selecting context subsets is increasingly important in modern LLM inference, yet what makes a subset effective remains unclear. We study this question in the controlled setting of few-shot demonstration selection. We examine a hypothesis that demonstrations should collectively provide task-relevant information needed by a target query. Assuming that the query representation provides a useful proxy for these requirements, we formulate selection as sparse reconstruction and instantiate it with Residual Explanation Search (RES), a Matching-Pursuit-style diagnostic procedure. Across seven benchmarks and eight open-weight LLMs, no retrieval objective is universally best. RES outperforms MMR in 34 of 56 model--dataset pairs, with its clearest advantage on sentiment tasks, suggesting that query-conditioned collective reconstruction may capture useful complementarity that pairwise dissimilarity misses. Relevance-based retrieval remains strong on template-heavy reasoning benchmarks, while all retrieval methods underperform zero-shot prediction on average on StrategyQA, where a solution-reconstruction analysis is consistent with the query not exposing the required external knowledge. Target-model hidden states further show that retrieval objectives interact differently with representation spaces: middle-layer representations generally favor similarity retrieval, whereas last-layer representations are often stronger for residual- and diversity-based selection. These findings support a conditional, representation-dependent account of context subset quality rather than a universally superior selector.
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures. The format of ACL rolling review

AI.tldr: 将少样本示例选择视为稀疏重构，发现上下文子集质量依赖任务与表示空间。
AI.motivation: 上下文子集选择日益重要，但哪些示例组合有效及其原因尚不清楚。
AI.method: 以查询表示代理任务需求，提出匹配追踪式残差解释搜索，并在七个基准和八个模型上评估。
AI.result: RES在56组模型与数据集组合中的34组优于MMR，但不存在普遍最优的检索目标。
AI.conclusion: 有效示例选择应考虑查询条件下的集体互补性、任务知识需求及模型表示层。

title: Temporal Attention-Enhanced Mixture-of-Experts Guidance for Multi-Revolution Low-Thrust Rendezvous
summary: Multi-revolution low-thrust rendezvous requires both long-duration orbital transfer and precise terminal control. This paper proposes a temporal attention-enhanced mixture-of-experts guidance law trained by deep reinforcement learning. A far-range expert acts on modified equinoctial elements, a terminal expert acts on the relative state in the target's local frame, and a learned gate blends their thrust commands. The terminal expert encodes its observation history with a Transformer to address partial observability, and the gate uses a separate encoder to account for the resulting history-dependent command. The experts are pretrained separately, the gate is trained with both experts frozen, and the complete guidance law is then fine-tuned end to end. On 600 test missions, it achieves rendezvous in every case at tolerances of 10 m and 1 m/s, reduces mean flight time and delta-v by 50.6% and 44.5% relative to distance-based hard switching, and remains successful without retraining under navigation errors, unmodeled orbital perturbations, eclipse-induced thrust outages, and thrust loss.
comment: 27 pages, 11 figures. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Aerospace and Electronic Systems

AI.tldr: 提出时序注意力增强的混合专家制导，实现多圈低推力交会的高效精确控制。
AI.motivation: 多圈低推力交会需兼顾长时间轨道转移、精确末端控制与部分可观测性。
