title: Can an Agent Rethink What It Knows? Selective Scene Memory Updates in a Changing World
summary: Task configurations in factories, warehouses, and everyday physical environments change over time. Physical AI systems therefore need to incorporate new facts into scene memory while preserving valid information about equipment, objects, and operating constraints. We study updates to this parametric semantic-memory layer and present a joint evaluation of correction and preservation under finite update budgets. At fixed current fact count and memory parameter count, the protocol combines independent single-fact updates, budget trajectories, old-to-new answer diagnostics, and first stable success. Using a frozen 4B language model with late-layer LoRA, we evaluate seven preparation conditions and six update budgets on four-field synthetic semantic configurations. In two exposure-matched history conditions, increasing the budget from eight to 32 updates raises joint success from 6.25% to 94.79% and 91.15%, respectively, while exact obsolete-value outputs fall from 174/192 and 166/192 to zero. Constant32, which matches preparation steps but repeatedly trains on unchanged content during the first 32 events, achieves higher early joint success at eight steps (53.65%); at 32 steps, it reaches 85.42%, below both changing-history conditions. These results distinguish rapid correction under a small budget from simultaneous correctness of the new fact and the other three facts after further training. For both changing histories, most cases remain jointly correct at all subsequent measured points from step 16 onward. Output analysis shows that short-budget failures primarily retain the old value; repeated training on the new fact together with the other current facts progressively replaces these obsolete answers.

AI.tldr: 研究动态场景中的参数化记忆更新，揭示快速纠错与同时保留其他事实需要不同训练预算。
AI.motivation: 物理环境事实不断变化，智能体必须更新过时信息，同时保留仍然有效的场景知识。
AI.method: 使用冻结4B模型和后层LoRA，在固定事实数与参数量下比较七种准备条件和六档更新预算。
AI.result: 两种变化历史条件下，预算从8增至32次使联合成功率由6.25%升至94.79%和91.15%。
AI.conclusion: 短预算失败主要源于保留旧值，联合训练新事实与其他当前事实可逐步实现纠错和知识保留。

title: CompoundingKernel: Self-Improving from Zero to First
summary: We present CompoundingKernel, a self-improving agent system that writes GPU kernels by search. As of 2026-11-11, its generated kernels rank #1 on the public L1, L2 and Quantization boards of SOL-ExecBench (NVIDIA B200). They have held #1 on L1 since 2026-10-27, albeit a short loss on 2026-11-07. All 235 problems have a site-verified correct kernel; on the 209 public-board problems they are 4.40x faster than the benchmark's reference baseline. The search starts from zero: agents get each problem's PyTorch definition but no reference kernels or official scores. A per-problem archive outside the model holds every correct kernel and its lineage. An LLM controller reads it, picks a parent or a new design, and gives each parallel child agent one direction. Checks outside the model decide correctness. At equal wall time, it beat a coded UCB style tree on 35 of 38 problems by making 2.4x as many correct attempts. Over a thousand agents ran at once, and one warm restart fix raised their evaluation rate 3.6x. We find that the rate of reliable measurements, not the number of agents, limits how far such a search scales. Our code and kernels are available on URL.
comment: 47 pages, 23 figures, 6 tables. URL: this https URL

AI.tldr: CompoundingKernel通过可追溯搜索自我改进GPU内核，在公开基准榜单取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 探索无需参考内核或官方分数的智能体搜索，如何可靠生成并持续优化GPU内核。
AI.method: 由LLM控制器读取外部正确内核及谱系档案，指导并行子智能体搜索，并由外部检查验证正确性。
AI.result: 235题均有验证正确的内核，209道公开题较参考基线快4.40倍，并位列三个公开榜单第一。
AI.conclusion: 可靠测量的速率而非智能体数量是扩展内核搜索的主要限制。

title: Beyond Alignment: Supervising the Generator for EEG-to-Image Reconstruction
summary: Visual brain decoding translates neural activity into human-interpretable images. While recent EEG-to-image reconstruction methods rely on aligning EEG signals with pretrained visual embeddings to condition an image generator, we empirically demonstrate that stronger cross-modal alignment do not translate into comparable gains in reconstruction quality. This indicates that improving the input condition alone is insufficient; the generative process itself requires explicit supervision. Although Representation Alignment (REPA) offers a solution by guiding diffusion transformers with pretrained vision encoder features, we find that EEG-conditioned generators struggle to follow these fixed targets. To address this mismatch, we introduce generation-derived supervision (GDS): an image-conditioned teacher that translates static image-encoder features into the internal representation space of a diffusion transformer. Our EEG-conditioned student generator closely tracks these dynamic targets during denoising, discarding the teacher at inference. Evaluated on THINGS-EEG and THINGS-MEG, our approach consistently outperforms conditioning-centric baselines, achieving state-of-the-art reconstruction fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出生成衍生监督，直接指导EEG条件生成器的去噪过程，提高脑信号到图像的重建保真度。
AI.motivation: 增强EEG与视觉嵌入的对齐并未带来相应重建提升，生成器也难以跟随固定视觉监督目标。
AI.method: 用图像条件教师将静态视觉特征映射为扩散Transformer内部动态目标，训练EEG学生并在推理时移除教师。
AI.result: 在THINGS-EEG和THINGS-MEG上持续优于侧重条件对齐的基线，达到最先进的重建保真度。
AI.conclusion: 脑信号图像重建不仅需要改善输入对齐，还需为生成过程提供适配其表示空间的显式监督。

title: Auditable Authorization for LLM Agents: Empirical Evidence Across Model, Harness, and Workflow Layers
summary: Human approval provides effective control only if rejected work stops and authorized work completes. We formalize refusal safety and bounded authorization completeness, and audit three execution boundaries: the model selects a call, the harness schedules and resumes it, and the workflow routes the decision to a protected effect. Paired decisions, exact traces, and native business-state witnesses support experiments with three models, five prompt arms, four runtime approval designs, two additional framework replays, and 100 public workflow sources. The paired model panel leaves seven of 300 approvals unfinished despite zero denied effects; parallel confirmation loses an approved branch in three tasks per model, restoration omits 336/672 CrewAI approvals, and four of 59 comparable n8n workflows execute after Reject. Comparing intent, generated calls, dispatch, and native effects identifies the first observable divergence and its repair target. This yields a practical audit contract that makes both refusal safety and authorization completeness independently verifiable, converting human approval from a procedural formality into an enforceable control boundary between intent and real-world effect.

AI.tldr: 提出可审计的智能体授权框架，同时检验被拒工作是否停止及获批工作是否完成。
AI.motivation: 人工审批只有同时阻止拒绝操作并完成授权操作，才能构成有效控制边界。
AI.method: 形式化拒绝安全与有界授权完备性，结合配对决策、执行轨迹和业务状态审计模型、运行框架及工作流。
AI.result: 模型面板300次批准中7次未完成，恢复流程遗漏336/672次批准，59个可比工作流中4个拒绝后仍执行。
AI.conclusion: 应分别验证拒绝安全和授权完备性，并通过定位意图至实际效果间的首个偏差确定修复层。

title: Continuous Lower-Limb Joint-Angle Estimation from sEMG and IMU: The Conditional Value of Cross-Activity and Cross-Subject Data under Update-Matched Controls
summary: Intent-driven exoskeleton control needs a continuous, causal estimate of the wearer's joint kinematics and an answer to a second question: whose data should train the estimator for a new user? Borrowing the user's recordings of other activities, or other users' recordings of the same activity, is usually evaluated as "more data" versus "less data," which confounds the information a source carries with the optimizer updates it adds and hides negative transfer behind averages. We separate these effects for hip, knee, and ankle angle estimation from high-density sEMG and an IMU across six locomotion activities on all ten participants of a public dataset. A compact residual causal TCN-GRU decoder is frozen, and an update-matched replay control prices every added source against the same number of updates on the user's own data. A user's own other activities raise $R^2$ from 0.722 to 0.788, of which +0.048 is information beyond replay; stair descent is a reliably harmful donor and sit-stand-walk a reliably beneficial one. Other users' same-activity data help while the user has only the target activity ($G_\mathrm{T} = +0.053$) and half as much once own other-activity data exist ($G_\mathrm{W} = +0.028$); at full calibration, donor value collapses after one to two target records. Per-target gains from the two sources correlate, and leave-one-participant-out gates recover most of the cross-subject value only at low calibration. Data value is hierarchical, state-dependent, and directional; the bottleneck is deciding, without test labels, when to transfer.
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)

AI.tldr: 通过更新次数匹配对照，揭示下肢关节角估计中跨活动与跨受试者数据的条件性价值。

title: Agentic On-Policy Distillation Implicitly Reshapes LLMs' ReAct Patterns
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers specialized capabilities to language-model agents, but its cross-domain effects on interaction remain unclear. We investigate how OPD reshapes ReAct interaction patterns across mathematics, ALFWorld, and $\tau^2$-bench, focusing on reasoning, actions, and observation acquisition. General-reasoning supervision reduces mathematical tool attempts from 70.4% to 14.4% while increasing accuracy from 16.7% to 38.0%; code-interpreter supervision improves household actions and retail queries. In contrast, ALFWorld supervision reduces $\tau^2$-bench accuracy from 41.5% to 6.6%, accompanied by frequent tool calls that violate user-information dependencies. To address negative transfer using only source-domain training trajectories, we explore selective OPD guided by teacher preference changes before and after domain-specific RL. Retaining the top 95% of positions raises $\tau^2$ accuracy from 11.5% to 29.9% with a source-learning trade-off.

AI.tldr: 智能体同策略蒸馏会跨域重塑推理与工具交互模式，既可促进迁移，也可能造成严重负迁移。
AI.motivation: 同策略蒸馏可迁移专门能力，但其对跨域交互模式的影响尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在数学、ALFWorld和τ²-bench分析蒸馏影响，并依据教师强化学习前后的偏好变化选择蒸馏位置。
AI.result: 通用推理监督使数学准确率从16.7%升至38.0%，选择性蒸馏使τ²准确率从11.5%升至29.9%。
AI.conclusion: 蒸馏监督会改变工具使用及信息依赖模式，选择性蒸馏可缓解负迁移，但存在源域学习权衡。

title: Integrated Co-design Framework for High-Efficiency Assembly and Integration of Small Satellites
summary: The rapid growth of small-satellite constellations has increased the need for higher manufacturing throughput, lower production costs, and shorter turnaround times. This makes efficient assembly, integration, and testing (AIT) increasingly important. Building on our prior work, this paper presents an integrated design-for-AIT approach for the 65 kg Lumelite-5 satellite. The integrated approach incorporates co-designing the satellite configuration, structural interfaces, subsystem placement, harness routing, and ground support equipment to facilitate efficient AIT. Service interfaces are centralized on one satellite side to simplify electrical ground support equipment access and routing. Skeletal support interfaces are developed to retain mounted components and service interfaces when removable enclosures are opened to expose internal harness-routing paths for inspection, troubleshooting, and rework. Defined mechanical references further support controlled removal and reinstallation of sensors and components. A removable double hinge ground-support mechanism allows the top deck to open up to 180 degrees relative to the bottom deck while accommodating interconnecting-harness articulation, without introducing permanent hinge mass and complexity to the satellite. Finally, dedicated harness-routing and tie-down provisions provide predefined yet adjustable restraint locations to accommodate as built routing variations and maintain controlled harness articulation during top-deck rotation. Through this work, we demonstrate how co-designing satellite architecture and AIT processes from the early development stages can support more scalable, repeatable, and efficient constellation production.
comment: To be published in IEEE Aerospace Conference, Big Sky, MT, USA, 6-12 March, 2026

AI.tldr: 针对65千克Lumelite-5卫星，提出协同设计卫星架构与装配集成测试流程的一体化方案。
AI.motivation: 小卫星星座快速增长，要求提高制造吞吐量、降低生产成本并缩短周转时间。
AI.method: 协同设计布局、结构接口、线束及地面设备，结合集中服务接口、骨架支撑和可拆双铰链机构。
AI.result: 顶板可相对底板打开至180度，并保持线束受控运动，无需为卫星增加永久铰链质量与复杂性。
AI.conclusion: 从研发早期协同设计卫星架构与装配集成测试流程，可支持更高效、可重复和可扩展的星座生产。

title: GameWM: Toward Next-Generation Video Games with Interaction-Centric World Models
summary: For more than half a century, video games have pursued better graphics, more natural interaction, and more engaging gameplay. Generative video models (VMs) now bear on all three. Neural networks already draw most of the pixels in shipped games, and recent world models let a lightweight game engine keep the world state while a VM turns the engine's coarse proxy video into final frames. These systems, however, treat the VM as a renderer that only restyles motion the engine has already authored, which leaves most of its generative capacity unused and limits the diversity a game can offer. We present GameWM, a design for next-generation games built on a clear division of labor. The GameWM-engine keeps what must be exact: rules, state, camera, and the layout of the world, which also spares the video model from having to remember it. The GameWM-VM generates what is expensive to author by hand: the look of the world and the detail of the player's interactions. One game mechanic can then be realized in many visually and physically distinct ways, while its outcome stays exactly as the engine computed it. To realize this division of labor, we build GameWM as a complete system: a data engine centered on interactions rather than exploration, an interface through which authored character sheets, scene art, and skill descriptions enter the model, and a model family from 5B to 33B parameters with a real-time causal variant for play. Together they give every player a fresh version of the same game: each player's own character, world, and skills turn the same engine mechanics into a new experience, while every event keeps the timing and outcome the GameWM-engine computed.

AI.tldr: GameWM将精确游戏逻辑交给引擎，将外观及交互细节生成交给视频模型，以支持个性化游戏体验。
AI.motivation: 现有游戏世界模型仅重绘引擎预设运动，未充分利用生成能力，限制了游戏多样性。
AI.method: 构建交互中心数据引擎、角色与场景等内容接口，以及含实时因果版本的50亿至330亿参数模型族。
AI.result: 系统可将同一游戏机制呈现为不同外观与交互细节，同时保持引擎计算的事件时序和结果。
AI.conclusion: 明确划分引擎与视频模型职责，可在保持规则精确性的同时扩展游戏内容与交互的生成空间。

title: Size-Matched Nulls Reveal What Block Ablation Measures in MambaVision
summary: Hybrid vision backbones interleave Mamba state-space mixers with self-attention, and a block's role is usually probed by removing it and measuring the damage. We test what that measurement means in MambaVision. On all 50,000 ImageNet validation images and three model sizes, every block ablation is paired with a size-matched null, the same perturbation with its channels shuffled or their signs flipped. In top-1 accuracy and in true-class rank, real and null damage are nearly indistinguishable in absolute terms: pooled over the blocks of MambaVision-T, the content effect lies within [-0.044,+0.016] percentage points (90% interval). Two attention-only controls show that the test detects content, with real ablations worse than their nulls by up to 4.2 points in DeiT-Small and 1.0 point in Swin-T. Part of MambaVision's near-equivalence reflects how little damage its blocks do (0.11--0.34 points on average, against 1.7 and 2.1). Scaled by damage, its content share is comparable to Swin-T's in accuracy, lower in rank, and far below DeiT-Small's: single-block damage in MambaVision is small and mostly positional. Ablation also hides what blocks carry together: removing all blocks of one type compounds damage to 3.7--8.4 times the sum of single effects, far more than size-matched nulls, including nulls that keep the alignment between the blocks' perturbations; for adjacent pairs, aligned nulls reproduce most of it. Freezing input-dependent selection in all Mamba mixers shows that it accounts for 20--32% of the Mamba contribution, mainly through the B and C projections. We turn these results into a protocol for causal attribution in hybrid networks.

AI.tldr: 尺寸匹配零对照表明，MambaVision单块消融损伤较小且主要来自位置效应，但多块存在协同贡献。
AI.motivation: 混合视觉骨干常用移除模块衡量其作用，但消融损伤是否真正反映内容贡献仍不明确。
AI.method: 在三种模型规模和全部ImageNet验证图像上，将块消融与通道打乱或符号翻转的尺寸匹配零对照比较。
AI.result: 同类块整体移除的损伤为单块损伤总和的3.7至8.4倍，输入依赖选择占Mamba贡献的20%至32%。
AI.conclusion: 混合网络因果归因应结合尺寸匹配零对照与联合消融，区分位置、内容和跨块协同效应。

title: Learning Graph-Conditioned Predictors in Weight Space
summary: The same node attributes can imply different labels in different structural contexts. Yet fast graphless models typically treat topology as additional evidence supplied to a globally shared predictor. This assumes that structure augments the available information, rather than determining how node attributes should be interpreted. We introduce SCOPE (Structure-COnditioned PrEdictor), in which a small generator maps each node's cached structural fingerprint to coefficients over a shared low-rank basis, producing a context-specific update to a global weight matrix. The base predictor, basis, and generator remain shared across all nodes, while the resulting transformation adapts how attributes are processed in each relational environment. Once fingerprints are cached, inference requires only a forward pass and no online message passing. This design combines context-specific specialization with global parameter sharing, compact low-rank adaptation, and message-passing-free inference. On two large OGB node-classification graphs, conditioning the weights with raw positional signals yields clear gains over supplying the same signals through input concatenation. Further results under a structure-transductive held-out-node protocol and in teacher-free graph classification show that the mechanism extends beyond a particular distillation setting. These findings establish graph structure not only as predictive evidence, but as context that determines the predictor used to interpret that evidence.

AI.tldr: SCOPE以图结构指纹生成节点特定的低秩权重更新，在无需在线消息传递时实现结构条件化预测。
AI.motivation: 相同节点属性在不同结构环境中可能对应不同标签，仅将拓扑作为附加输入难以体现这种差异。
AI.method: 小型生成器将缓存结构指纹映射为共享低秩基的系数，为全局权重矩阵生成节点特定更新。
AI.result: 在两个大型OGB节点分类图上，权重条件化明显优于拼接相同位置信号，并扩展至留出节点和无教师图分类。
AI.conclusion: 图结构不仅是预测证据，也可作为决定如何解释节点属性的预测器上下文。

title: Physics-Informed Causal Reasoning for Nonstationary Robot Dynamics
summary: Reasoning about what an action will cause requires internalizing how a system behaves. As conditions seldom stay fixed, this must often happen within a few interactions. Yet systems that look identical in a snapshot can respond differently to the same action, depending on physical conditions the snapshot hides. Context-based models capture this separation by summarizing recent transitions into a latent context, but do not specify how that context should change the equations of motion. Physics-informed neural networks build those equations into the model, but describe only a single system and cannot recognize when it has changed. We present Physics-Informed Causal Reasoning (PICR), which bridges the two. Only a context, re-inferred from recent interactions, is updated; it conditions a fixed physics-informed network that determines the robot's inertia and potential energy, so the robot adapts to new physical conditions from its own experience without retraining or a hand-specified robot model. On a Franka Panda arm in NVIDIA Isaac Sim, PICR predicts motion under changing and unseen payloads, reducing error on the latter by 1.6-3.8x over baselines, and extends to counterfactual queries under alternative torques. Our analysis shows that the context, inferred solely from interaction, encodes payload physical properties, tracks their changes, and governs the arm's response. The gravity and inertia terms induced by the context further demonstrate its physical validity, each agreeing with the simulator at the level of individual Lagrangian components.
comment: 22 pages, 6 figures. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: PICR用交互推断的上下文调节固定物理网络，使机器人无需重训练即可适应变化的动力学。
AI.motivation: 隐藏物理条件使相同状态下的动作后果不同，现有上下文模型与物理网络难兼顾快速适应和物理约束。
AI.method: 从近期交互重推断潜在上下文，并以其条件化固定网络所确定的机器人惯性和势能。
AI.result: 在仿真Franka Panda机械臂上，未见载荷预测误差较基线降低1.6至3.8倍，并支持替代力矩反事实查询。
AI.conclusion: 仅由交互推断的上下文可编码并追踪载荷属性，其诱导的重力与惯性项具有物理一致性。

title: Exploration as Feedback in Model Predictive Path Integral Control
summary: This paper investigates how exploration affects closed-loop stability in model predictive path integral (MPPI) control. With a warm start, MPPI optimizes a control sequence by sampling candidates around the previous solution, and their covariance, the exploration covariance, is typically tuned to balance solution quality and computational cost. Small exploration is attractive because most samples then contribute to the solution, and existing stability analyses treat reduced exploration only as a bias toward the previous solution. Whether insufficient exploration can destabilize the closed loop has therefore remained open. We show that, for linear quadratic (LQ) problems with infinitely many samples, the exploration covariance also determines the feedback gain, i.e., how strongly MPPI updates the previous solution in response to the current state. With small exploration at a fixed temperature, MPPI nearly repeats the previous solution and fails to stabilize an exponentially unstable plant. Because a single covariance governs both exploration and feedback, stability and sample efficiency are in structural conflict: stabilization requires large exploration, which leaves few samples that contribute to the solution. To resolve this conflict, we propose Stabilizing Subspace MPPI (SS-MPPI), which computes the control inputs required for stabilization and samples only the rest. For LQ problems, SS-MPPI remains stable with small exploration and is thus sample-efficient. Simulations of an inverted pendulum and a quadruped robot confirm the analysis, showing that MPPI fails under small exploration, whereas SS-MPPI remains stable even with few samples.
comment: 20 pages, 3 figures. Submitted to the 9th Annual Conference on Learning for Dynamics and Control (L4DC 2027)

AI.tldr: 探索协方差同时控制MPPI反馈强度，过小探索可能致失稳，SS-MPPI通过分离稳定控制与采样化解冲突。
AI.motivation: 减少探索有利于采样效率，但探索不足是否会破坏MPPI闭环稳定性尚不明确。
AI.method: 分析无限样本线性二次问题，提出先计算稳定所需控制、仅对其余部分采样的SS-MPPI。
AI.result: 理论与倒立摆、四足机器人仿真表明，小探索下MPPI可能失稳，而SS-MPPI即使少样本也保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 探索与反馈共用协方差使稳定性和采样效率产生结构性冲突，稳定子空间分离可缓解该冲突。

title: dit.xpu : Taming DiT Sparse Inference on Mobile SoCs
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) enable on-device image generation and editing but incur high attention costs at high resolutions. Existing sparse attention reduces computation, yet dynamic sparsity introduces preprocessing and irregular data accesses that poorly fit mobile NPUs. We present this http URL, a sparse DiT inference framework for heterogeneous mobile SoCs. this http URL combines tile-aligned sparse attention with anchor-based error compensation by exploiting slowly varying dense-sparse output residuals across denoising steps. Heterogeneous XPU collaboration overlaps NPU dense attention with GPU sparse calibration, while mask-guided dataflow reduces data transfers and layout conversion by overlapping data movement with computation. Across five DiT models on two Snapdragon smartphones, this http URL achieves up to 1.56x end-to-end denoising speedup over the Hexagon-NPU backend and 11.5x attention-kernel speedup over the fastest alternative, while preserving generation quality close to dense attention. Code is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: dit.xpu通过稀疏注意力、误差补偿与异构协作，加速移动芯片上的扩散Transformer推理。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率DiT注意力开销大，而动态稀疏的预处理与不规则访存难以适配移动NPU。
AI.method: 结合分块对齐稀疏注意力、锚点误差补偿、NPU与GPU并行协作及掩码引导数据流。
AI.result: 在两款骁龙手机的五个DiT模型上，端到端去噪最高加速1.56倍、注意力核最高加速11.5倍，质量接近稠密注意力。
AI.conclusion: 联合优化稀疏算法与移动异构执行，可在保持生成质量接近稠密注意力的同时提升端侧推理效率。

title: Distributed Shaping of Robot Swarms Through Spatial Moments of Arbitrary Order
summary: This paper shapes a swarm into a target pattern, such as a figure taken from an image, by controlling its spatial moments. The image is sampled into a reference configuration whose centroid and covariance set the position and principal spreads of the formation, while its higher-order moments, expressed in covariance-normalized (whitened) coordinates, encode the remaining shape. In contrast with geometric formation control, which prescribes distances, bearings, or relative positions between specific agents, this specification concerns the swarm as a whole and assigns no agent to a particular place. The key mechanism is orthogonalization in the swarm's own empirical inner product: projecting negative-gradient velocities onto the complement of low-degree polynomials sampled at the agents makes every higher-order correction preserve all lower-order moments exactly. The resulting hierarchical controller has lower triangular error dynamics and converges locally exponentially for any positive gains, so orders can be added without undoing those already achieved. A joint alternative regulates the higher moments together through a regularized Gauss--Newton step while preserving the centroid and covariance dynamics. We give bounds on the number of agents and sufficient conditions for regularity. Both controllers admit a distributed implementation that uses only relative positions and neighbor communication and retains local exponential convergence when estimation is sufficiently fast. In a distributed simulation on a sparse graph, 350 agents form an airplane from an unstructured swarm through moments up to order ten; the hierarchy reaches the full specification, while the joint law approaches it with smaller velocities.

AI.tldr: 通过任意阶空间矩控制与分布式通信，使机器人群在无需个体位置指派的情况下形成目标图案。
AI.motivation: 传统几何编队依赖特定个体间的约束，难以直接描述群体整体形状并逐阶细化。
AI.method: 在群体经验内积下正交投影梯度，构建保持低阶矩的分层控制器及联合高阶矩调节方案。
AI.result: 两种控制器均具局部指数收敛性，350个体通过十阶矩形成飞机图案，联合方案速度更小。
AI.conclusion: 空间矩可支持无需个体位置指派的分布式群体塑形，且新增高阶目标不破坏已实现的低阶目标。

title: HospitalBench: Diagnosing Where and Why Embodied Agents Fail on Long Hospital Task Chains
summary: Long-horizon embodied tasks fail in ways that end-task success cannot see. HospitalBench is a diagnostic benchmark of ten hospital chores in NVIDIA Isaac Sim, each two unscored warm-up steps followed by a causal chain of five scored sub-tasks in one continuous simulation: the state one step leaves (an object pose, a choice, a fact seen once) determines what the next step must do, unlike benchmarks that place sub-tasks side by side. Vision-language agents act through skill-level tools from camera images. A scripted robot that makes only the calls a model gets is the solvability check of a chore. From each trajectory the benchmark reads where a chain breaks, what the agent did after a failed call, and how far its own position estimate drifts from the true one. This version reports first results only: 15 of 60 planned runs (three models at high effort, one run each on chores T1 and T10 from both start states and T3 from one), with scripted-robot proofs on three of the ten chores. Of the 15 runs, 2 passed all five sub-tasks. Runs still going after sub-tasks 1 to 5 were 15, 8, 4, 2, 2. Of 189 failed calls, 168 were followed by a different call and 111 by a call that did not fail. These are first results and not a full benchmark. We will release the scenes, task chains, scripted robot, evaluation harness and trajectories.

AI.tldr: HospitalBench通过连续医院任务链，诊断具身智能体的失败位置、失败后行为与定位漂移。
AI.motivation: 仅以最终任务成功率衡量长时程具身任务，无法揭示子任务间状态传递导致的失效。
AI.method: 在Isaac Sim中构建十项医院任务，每项含两个热身步骤和五个因果相连的计分子任务。
AI.result: 已完成的15次运行中仅2次通过全部子任务，189次失败调用后有111次调用未失败。
AI.conclusion: 该基准提供任务链级诊断，但当前仅报告计划60次运行中的15次初步结果，尚非完整评测。

title: Beyond Clumsy Agentic Tool Calling: How Cueing and Spotting Make the Difference
summary: LLM-based task-oriented agents depend on tools to interact with their environments, but may overlook execution feedback, repeat ineffective calls, or persist with unproductive strategies. These behaviors can hinder agents' ability to use tools autonomously and sustain task progress. We characterize tool-use symptoms at two temporal granularities: local clumsy tool-use behaviors and tool-use detours spanning multiple interactions. Towards greater autonomy in tool use, we present ToolPulse, an online middleware supporting autonomous tool use through cueing and spotting. ToolPulse tracks execution state and temporal interaction patterns, monitoring proposed calls before dispatch and inspecting execution feedback prior to the agent resumes reasoning. It combines state-based rules, semantic sequence analysis, and interaction-feature similarity to identify intervention opportunities and provide verbal reminders, structured feedback, or context-specific advice from auxiliary models. Our process-oriented evaluation distinguishes trigger validity, behavioral cessation, and substantive correction alongside task outcomes and resource costs. Using SWE-agent with three backbone models, we evaluate 1,350 trajectories on 90 Python, C++, and Java bug-fix tasks, comparing unassisted execution with four assistance strategies. Substantive responses follow 61.6-90.9% of valid triggers for tool-use detours. Concise reminders achieve the highest observed aggregate substantive-response rate; more elaborate assistance offers symptom-dependent benefits and can be less effective. Aggregate repair outcomes remain close to baseline, with token savings in selected settings. These findings support proactive runtime assistance for autonomous tool use. The gap between behavioral adjustment and aggregate repair gains calls for careful decisions on intervention timing and assistance strategy in autonomous agents.
comment: The code of reference implementation and instructions for reproducing the experiments are available in the following repositories: this https URL and this https URL

AI.tldr: ToolPulse通过在线监测和提示改善智能体工具使用行为，但总体代码修复收益有限。
AI.motivation: 任务型智能体可能忽略执行反馈、重复无效调用或持续采用低效策略，阻碍自主推进任务。
AI.method: 结合状态规则、语义序列分析和交互特征相似度，在调用前后识别干预机会并提供分级辅助。
AI.result: 1350条轨迹中，绕行行为有效触发后的实质响应率为61.6%—90.9%，总体修复表现接近基线。
AI.conclusion: 主动运行时辅助能改善工具使用，但行为调整未必转化为任务收益，需审慎选择时机与策略。

title: ReCALM: A Residual-enhanced Crowdsourced Analytic Learning Mechanism for Distributed Continual Service Construction
summary: Crowdsourcing has emerged as a promising paradigm for constructing AI services by harnessing the collective capabilities of distributed workers. As consumers' demands continually evolve, service models must acquire new knowledge while retaining previously learned information. However, due to the inherited reliance on gradients for backpropagation, existing approaches typically suffer from catastrophic forgetting during continual model updates on heterogeneous data. Recent studies have introduced analytic learning, a gradient-free paradigm that achieves invariance through recursive closed-form solutions. Nevertheless, existing analytic methods are typically constrained by single-layer linear networks, which tend to suffer from underfitting due to their inability to perform deep representation learning. To address this issue, we propose ReCALM, a Residual-enhanced Crowdsourced Analytic Learning Mechanism that achieves deep nonlinear invariance for distributed continual service construction. Inspired by the success of ResNet, we develop gradient-free residual blocks for ReCALM with closed-form solutions. To implement distributed continual training for ReCALM, we further devise a cross-recursive strategy via least squares. Both theoretical and experimental analyses verify ReCALM's dual superiority in heterogeneity invariance and deep representation. With 20 residual layers, ReCALM improves accuracy by 8.85%-9.83% over the single-layer analytic baseline, while reducing computational costs by over 94% compared with gradient-based baselines.

AI.tldr: ReCALM以无梯度残差解析学习支持分布式持续服务构建，兼顾深层表示与异质性不变性。
AI.motivation: 梯度式持续更新易产生灾难性遗忘，而单层线性解析学习缺乏深层表示能力并易欠拟合。
AI.method: 设计具有闭式解的无梯度残差块，并通过基于最小二乘的交叉递归策略开展分布式持续训练。
AI.result: 20层残差模型较单层解析基线准确率提高8.85%—9.83%，较梯度基线计算成本降低逾94%。
AI.conclusion: 理论与实验分析支持ReCALM在异质性不变性和深层表示方面的优势。

title: LC-ISP Benchmark: Learning Advanced ISP with Live and Capture Streams
summary: High-quality paired RAW-to-sRGB datasets are essential for data-driven ISP, yet existing datasets often rely on cross-device collection, causing misalignment and failing to faithfully reflect real capture conditions. We therefore introduce LC-ISP, a large-scale benchmark built from the intrinsic gap between a camera's live preview and offline capture streams. LC-ISP contains 53.9k spatially aligned groups, each comprising live RAW/live sRGB and multi-frame fused RGB/capture sRGB, and covers day, night, indoor, outdoor, and HDR scenes. It also provides capture-stream intermediates for modular supervision. We further develop a compact two-stage baseline that uses these intermediates as auxiliary targets. Under a 2.5-GFLOP budget for 448$\times$448 RAW inputs, it outperforms the strongest single-frame baseline by over 2 dB PSNR while improving texture, denoising, and color reproduction. LC-ISP supports realistic benchmarking, the design of supervision strategies, and the development of lightweight ISP models.

AI.tldr: LC-ISP利用相机预览流与拍摄流构建对齐数据集，并以中间结果监督轻量两阶段ISP模型。
AI.motivation: 现有RAW到sRGB配对数据常依赖跨设备采集，存在错位且难以忠实反映真实拍摄条件。
AI.method: 采集5.39万组涵盖多场景的空间对齐双流数据，并利用拍摄流中间结果辅助监督两阶段模型。
AI.result: 在448×448 RAW输入、2.5 GFLOP预算下，模型较最强单帧基线PSNR提高逾2 dB。
AI.conclusion: LC-ISP可支持真实条件下的ISP评测、监督策略设计与轻量模型开发。

title: Generate, Align, and Restore: MLLM-Empowered Diffusion for Generalizable Low-light Image Enhancement
summary: Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) is essential to numerous vision applications operating under adverse illumination. Despite substantial advances, real-world nighttime enhancement remains challenging due to the scarcity of strictly aligned day-night pairs and complex degradations involving extreme darkness and heterogeneous artificial light sources, leading to fragile generalization. To overcome these challenges, we propose MrLIE (MLLM-empowered reference Low-light Image Enhancement), a novel reference-based unsupervised LLIE framework that synergizes the generative and reasoning capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) with conditional diffusion. MrLIE employs the MLLM as a high-fidelity reference synthesizer and diagnostic critic, iteratively generating, diagnosing, and correcting normal-light references directly from degraded nighttime observations. Based on this, our method governs the enhancement process through two complementary mechanisms, in which a confidence offset module rectifies spatial-geometric inconsistencies for reference reliability and a structure-anchored injection scheme harmonizes aligned reference cues, low-light structural constraints, and ControlNet additive anchoring during the denoising process. Extensive experiments on diverse benchmarks demonstrate that MrLIE achieves superior perceptual quality, natural appearance, and robust generalization.

AI.tldr: MrLIE融合多模态大模型与条件扩散，通过生成并对齐正常光参考图像增强低光图像。
AI.motivation: 严格对齐的昼夜图像稀缺，极暗环境及复杂人工光源退化使夜间增强模型泛化脆弱。
AI.method: 以多模态大模型迭代生成和校正参考图像，再通过置信偏移与结构锚定注入引导扩散去噪。
AI.result: 多项基准实验显示，MrLIE在感知质量、外观自然度与泛化稳健性方面表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 生成、诊断和对齐参考图像可为无监督低光增强提供有效引导。

title: VLN-Flash: Parallel Action Decoding with Adaptive Execution for Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: When a vision-and-language navigation policy generates an action sequence autoregressively, the robot waits for a chain of dependent predictions. A small discrete action vocabulary makes it possible to score all short-horizon plans in parallel. We introduce VLN-Flash, a training-free decoder that evaluates the complete action-prefix tree in a single forward pass. Branch-specific attention and matched token positions preserve the original policy's conditional action distribution for each prefix in exact arithmetic. We use the score margin between the stepwise-greedy prefix and its strongest alternative at each depth to decide how many actions to execute. The robot then executes the plan with the highest joint score at the chosen depth before observing again. On matched inputs, VLN-Flash achieves a nearly $3\times$ speedup in action decoding over native autoregression on Uni-NaVid and StreamVLN. Compared with the native autoregressive decoders, it improves success rate and success weighted by path length (SPL) on R2R-CE and RxR-CE, with success gains up to 2.7 percentage points. On a Unitree GO2, VLN-Flash improves navigation success and cuts the mean wait between actions by about 160 ms after subtracting network transmission time.

AI.tldr: VLN-Flash以无需训练的并行解码和自适应执行，减少视觉语言导航等待并提高成功率。
AI.motivation: 自回归生成导航动作需要连续依赖预测，导致机器人在执行前等待较长时间。
AI.method: 单次前向计算完整动作前缀树，以分支注意力保持条件分布，并依据分数间隔选择执行深度。
AI.result: 动作解码近3倍加速，导航成功率最高提高2.7个百分点，实机平均动作等待缩短约160毫秒。
AI.conclusion: 并行短程规划与自适应执行可在不训练策略的情况下改善导航效率和表现。

title: Zero-Shot Weight-Space Programming for Prediction and Classification of Target Variables in Structured Datasets
summary: Weight-space programming fixes every parameter of a feed-forward network by hand, with no gradient descent anywhere in the construction. Every demonstration so far starts from a target function handed to the model as a rule system, making it a compilation problem. A supervised dataset withholds that specification, so the procedure must do the statistical inference itself and then express the result in the parameterisation it was given. We ask whether a large language model can do both. It is shown a small dataset in full, with the architecture of a feed-forward network, and writes out every weight and bias as a literal number, with no optimizer, no gradient, no code execution, and no chance to evaluate it first. Each construction is sealed and pre-registers its expected score. The graded suite runs from two toy problems, through nine synthetic problems disguised by a hidden rotation, to the classical benchmarks and one real engineering regression. The frozen network matches the closed-form optimum wherever that optimum is linear, reaches the irreducible error of the generating process on three rungs where it is not, and beats every fitted baseline on two of those, including the same architecture trained by gradient descent. It fails on two rungs, both times because the structure to be found is oblique to the coordinates it analysed. Three further constructors separate two failure modes a single score conflates: one returns no parameter vector at all on the hardest rungs, another delivers everywhere while writing networks worse than predicting the mean. One of those failures proves avoidable: another constructor solves the oblique-hinge rung by a margin that survives multiple-comparison correction. What predicts whether the hidden layer earns its keep is the training error of a linear separator, which the composite complexity index misses.

AI.tldr: 研究检验大语言模型能否仅凭小型数据集推断规律，并直接写出前馈网络全部参数。
AI.motivation: 既有权重空间编程依赖已知规则，尚未解决从监督数据推断统计结构并编码为网络参数的问题。
AI.method: 提供完整小数据集与网络架构，要求模型不优化、不执行代码且不预评估地输出并封存参数。
AI.result: 部分任务达到线性最优或生成过程的不可约误差，两项胜过所有拟合基线，但两项因斜向结构失败。
AI.conclusion: 直接参数构造在部分任务可行，但受结构识别限制，线性分隔器训练误差可预测隐藏层是否有益。

title: Where Mixture Recognition Fails: An Ingredient-Level Audit of Unseen Combinations in SmellNet
summary: An electronic nose must name every ingredient of a mixture, including combinations it has never measured. SmellNet, a public benchmark for this task, scores ingredients with a hit rate that is told how many each sample contains. We audit what this protocol hides. We hold out ingredient combinations from the SmellNet training data, evaluate four architectures (MLP, CNN, LSTM and a Transformer encoder) without revealing the ingredient count, and repeat the evaluation once on the official unseen split. Under the count-informed protocol, 90-96% of mixtures receive an ingredient that is absent, on our folds and on the official split alike. On our folds, every model identifies one ingredient reliably but the second rarely, and it completes the pair with a familiar training partner about twice as often as chance. On the official split, even the first-ranked ingredient is correct in only 29-46% of binary mixtures, often because a frequent training ingredient that is absent from every test pair is ranked first, and on its combinations that are truly absent from training no model names both ingredients in more than 1.2% of them. The failures fall on the same ingredients for every architecture, and a frequency correction only moves errors between ingredients. Mixture recognition is therefore limited by ingredients the models cannot separate and by a preference for frequent ingredients, not by the architecture, and it should be evaluated with set-level errors and without oracle cardinality.

AI.tldr: SmellNet审计发现，未见混合物识别主要受成分混淆和频率偏好限制，而非模型架构。
AI.motivation: 已知成分数量的命中率评估可能掩盖电子鼻识别未见成分组合时的错误。
AI.method: 留出训练成分组合，在不提供成分数量时评估四类架构，并在官方未见划分上复验。
AI.result: 已知成分数时90%—96%的混合物被误报成分，官方真正未见组合的双成分全对率不超过1.2%。
AI.conclusion: 混合物识别应采用集合级错误指标，并避免提供真实成分数量。

title: NetBreaker: Benchmarking Network Dismantling across Objectives, Scales, and Toplogoies
summary: Network dismantling seeks to fragment a network with as few node removals as possible, which is widely applied in vulnerability analysis, epidemic containment, and infrastructure protection. Although learning-based methods have become increasingly prominent, their progress remains difficult to assess because existing studies differ in method coverage, datasets, evaluation criteria, and experimental protocols. Thus, we introduce NetBreaker, a comprehensive benchmark designed for the learning era of network dismantling. NetBreaker organizes 30 methods (18 non-learning and 12 learning-based) under a common taxonomy and evaluates them on 185 networks from eight unified domains, ranging from 14 to 1.69 million nodes. To enable fair comparison, heterogeneous method outputs are converted into node removal sequences and assessed under a unified execution protocol. The evaluation covers four complementary dimensions: target-based effectiveness, trajectory-based effectiveness, structural diagnostics, and applicability & computational efficiency. Extensive experiments show that current learningbased methods do not consistently outperform strong non-learning approaches, while exposing substantial differences in effectiveness, scalability, and efficiency across network conditions and evaluation perspectives. NetBreaker provides a reproducible basis for measuring progress and developing reliable, scalable, and computationally efficient network dismantling methods.

AI.tldr: NetBreaker统一评估网络拆解方法，发现学习方法并未稳定优于强非学习基线。
AI.motivation: 现有研究的方法覆盖、数据集和评估协议不一致，难以可靠衡量网络拆解进展。
AI.method: 将30种方法的输出统一为节点移除序列，在八个领域的185个网络上进行四维评估。
AI.result: 学习方法未持续胜过强非学习方法，各方法的效果、可扩展性和效率随网络条件明显变化。
AI.conclusion: NetBreaker为开发可靠、可扩展且计算高效的网络拆解方法提供可复现基准。

title: Staged Semantic Distillation: Preserving Free-Form Semantics in a Low-Compute Non-LLM Surrogate of a Staged LLM Agent
summary: Staged LLM agents make market and social simulators realistic, but one 102-day run of a 200-agent, ten-index market simulator issues 203,100 language-model calls and returns one realization. Conventional low-compute distillation drops their free-form intermediate state. We present staged semantic distillation, a low-compute method that preserves non-structured semantics in a non-LLM student trained from one recorded trace. A frozen encoder maps each teacher output to a 1024-d vector; the student sees typed stage-tagged vectors with stage-specific visibility, is jointly supervised, and trains with scheduled self-history. One TwinMarket trace yields a 13.2M-parameter deterministic student that trains in 1,658 seconds on one 8-GB GPU and runs with zero teacher or decoder calls and no text generation (0.14 ms per decision). Its analysis stays close to the teacher (cosine 0.943), and swapping semantic inputs between agents moves 64.7% of decisions against 12.8% for a matched donor, so the channel is preserved and live. We use the surrogate to study what the transfer carries. It reaches 0.8347 balanced accuracy on the teacher-forced replay and 0.7783 [0.766,0.791] on the deployment decoder; the five-seed gain over a no-semantic retrain is +2.2 [1.21,3.14]. Against the teacher's own re-sampling level, round-one R is 97.1% [95.8,98.4] and 92.3% [89.0,95.4]; R is a diagnostic, not an accuracy. A five-seed content-by-schedule study isolates the gain: scheduled self-history carries it (+2.2 [1.21,3.14]); shuffled and constant content controls reproduce it, while content matters teacher-forced. The design rule: invest in the deployment schedule, let content earn its place at the teacher-forced operating point. A 20-seed, 200,000-decision sweep takes 12 minutes with zero LLM calls, versus three hours for the teacher. The paper is a method-and-case-study contribution on one simulator and trace.
comment: Main text 7 pages; 18 pages total; 3 figures, 16 tables

AI.tldr: 分阶段语义蒸馏将单条大模型智能体轨迹压缩为低算力学生，部署增益主要来自自历史训练调度。
AI.motivation: 分阶段大模型仿真调用成本高，而传统低算力蒸馏会丢失自由形式的中间语义状态。
AI.method: 用冻结编码器生成带阶段标签的语义向量，联合监督非大模型学生，并采用调度式自历史训练。
AI.result: 学生每次决策耗时0.14毫秒且无需大模型调用，部署平衡准确率为0.7783，消融显示增益主要来自训练调度。
AI.conclusion: 单一仿真器与轨迹的案例提示，应优先优化部署调度，并在教师强制条件下验证语义内容价值。

title: Does Lifestyle Information Improve Hypertension Prediction? A Leakage-Controlled Evaluation on NHANES
summary: Does readily available lifestyle information improve machine-learning prediction of hypertension beyond routine demographic and anthropometric data? On NHANES 2017-March 2020, five model families (Logistic Regression, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, Bagged Decision Trees, and XGBoost) were evaluated with fold-local preprocessing and paired bootstrap confidence intervals. Adding physical activity, alcohol use, smoking, and sleep information showed no consistent detectable improvement in held-out discrimination: every paired ROC-AUC confidence interval included zero, including under a stricter measured-blood-pressure phenotype and without synthetic oversampling. Mean cross-model SHAP rank agreement fell from 0.873 to 0.806 over all encoded columns, but this decline was largely attenuated over the 19 baseline columns shared by both arms (0.873 vs. 0.863), and likewise under both robustness checks; attribution-agreement comparisons across feature sets of different sizes therefore require a matched comparison space. In exploratory analysis of untreated adults (measured-blood-pressure outcome), all five models showed small positive differences, two with unadjusted intervals excluding zero, meriting confirmation. These results do not imply that lifestyle factors are clinically unimportant; within this cohort, the evaluated lifestyle block added little incremental discrimination beyond an already-informative baseline.
comment: Accepted to the Machine Learning for Health (ML4H) 2026 Symposium, Findings Track. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: NHANES泄漏受控评估显示，生活方式信息未稳定改善基于常规人口及体测数据的高血压预测。
AI.motivation: 检验易获取的运动、饮酒、吸烟和睡眠信息能否提供额外高血压预测价值。
AI.method: 在NHANES数据上以折内预处理评估五类模型，结合配对自助置信区间与稳健性检验。
AI.result: 所有配对ROC-AUC差值置信区间均含零，匹配共同特征后SHAP排序一致性下降明显减弱。
AI.conclusion: 该队列中生活方式特征的增量区分能力有限，但不能据此否定其临床重要性。

title: A Backdoor Trigger Is Legible in Fine-Tune Weights
summary: A backdoored language model behaves normally until a trigger phrase appears in its input. Every published method for recovering such a trigger runs the model. We show the trigger is legible in the weights alone: a static statistic reads a fine-tuned checkpoint with no forward pass of the suspect, no data, no labelled population of poisoned models and no prior knowledge that a backdoor exists, and names one of the tokens of the trigger phrase as the single highest-ranked candidate in the vocabulary.

AI.tldr: 研究表明，无需运行可疑模型，仅凭微调权重即可将触发短语中的一个词元排至候选首位。
AI.motivation: 现有后门触发词恢复方法均需运行模型，研究探索能否直接从权重读取触发信息。
AI.method: 使用静态统计量分析微调检查点，无需前向传播、数据、投毒模型标签或后门存在先验。
AI.result: 该统计量将触发短语中的一个词元列为整个词表中排名最高的单一候选。
AI.conclusion: 微调权重本身可暴露后门触发词元，为无需执行模型的后门分析提供路径。

title: Macro Control and Capability Evaluation of Black-Box World Models: A Two-Regime Framework for LLM-Agent Markets
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can be organized into multi-agent markets that act as world models, mapping macro information to emergent macro dynamics while the evaluator observes only macro inputs and outputs. This paper separates a model's capability into two stages that a single aggregate score cannot separate: information simulation, from macro information to micro behavior, and macro emergence, from micro behavior to the macro outcome. We introduce a soft macro-control method that announces a public reference path day by day without touching individual decisions, orders, or matching, and a two-regime evaluation framework that measures both stages from macro observations alone. In the reference-only regime the symmetric true and flipped references share a common level R, which measures realization under the announced reference, while their paired gap B measures structural bias; in the information-injection regime external information dilutes the reference, so only the true-flipped gap Delta remains interpretable. On five single-index LLM-agent markets, announcing a target path shifts the realized path toward the announced target on both announced references under both information conditions. Relative to the no-reference path, the tracking score is higher by 0.306 and 0.415 without news and by 0.183 and 0.329 with news; within the stock/cash scan structural bias is lowest at 70/30 (B=0.042); realization peaks at a 3:7 technical share (R=0.894 versus 0.358 for technical-only); and Delta is 0.0341 with fundamental data and 0.0487 with news. Both stages use the same two observable scores, each read in the regime where it is interpretable.

AI.tldr: 研究以软宏观控制和双情境评估，从宏观观测区分大模型智能体市场的信息模拟与宏观涌现能力。
AI.motivation: 单一汇总分数无法区分宏观信息到微观行为、微观行为到宏观结果这两个能力阶段。
AI.method: 逐日公布参考路径而不干预个体交易，在仅参考与信息注入情境中解释真实及翻转参考的配对指标。
AI.result: 五个市场均向公布目标移动，无新闻时跟踪分数提升0.306和0.415，有新闻时提升0.183和0.329。
AI.conclusion: 宏观可观测指标可支持两阶段能力评估，但须在各自具有可解释性的情境下使用。

title: SAR-TopoGuard: Training-Free, Speckle-Aware Topological Verification for Structure-Preserving SAR-to-Optical Translation
summary: SAR-to-optical translators often synthesize detail that the radar measurement does not support, and pixel metrics alone cannot reveal it. We propose SAR-TopoGuard, a training-free inference-time layer for frozen generators: a stochastic sampler draws K candidates (Monte Carlo dropout for GANs, seed variance for diffusion), a speckle-aware verifier ranks them by gradient-magnitude correlation with the SAR input and a hallucination-frequency index, and a SAR-guided frequency gate admits high-frequency detail only where SAR edges support it. With all five hyperparameters frozen and three training seeds, we evaluate on 500 scene-disjoint SEN1-2 test patches, 500 patches of a held-out summer scene, and 200 cross-dataset SEN12MS winter pairs. The layer improves Pix2Pix by +0.060, +0.012, and +0.077 dB PSNR and by +0.0034, +0.0057, and +0.0135 SSIM, respectively (Wilcoxon p < 1e-6), and it improves CycleGAN and CUT on all three sets (+0.013 to +0.076 dB). It raises edge precision at the cost of edge recall (edge F1 -1.3% on the test set). On the latent diffusion model COP-GEN, it adds +0.33 dB (base) and +0.16 dB (Beta) on the winter set, the only set with dual-polarization SAR. An ablation shows that the gate produces the gain for MC-dropout GANs, whose candidates are nearly identical, whereas verifier selection contributes up to +0.26 dB for diffusion, whose samples differ. The layer has zero trainable parameters and adds 0.4 ms per patch beyond the K=5 generator passes.
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables. Accepted manuscript of the article published in IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Letters (2026). \c{opyright} 2026 IEEE. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: SAR-TopoGuard无需训练即可减少SAR转光学图像的无依据细节，但边缘精度提升伴随召回损失。
AI.motivation: SAR转光学生成器可能合成雷达观测不支持的细节，单纯像素指标难以揭示此类问题。
AI.method: 对冻结生成器采样多个候选，以散斑感知验证器排序，并用SAR引导频率门控限制高频细节。
AI.result: Pix2Pix在三组数据上的PSNR提升0.012—0.077分贝，扩散模型冬季集提升最高0.33分贝，但测试集边缘F1下降1.3%。
AI.conclusion: 该零参数层可小幅改善重建并抑制幻觉，但需权衡边缘召回，且收益来源随生成器类型不同。

title: Residual Reinforcement Learning for Visual Servo Control with Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Transfer
summary: We address tracking a moving object on a conveyor with a Franka Emika Panda robot arm, despite an imprecise digital twin, measurement errors, and noise. Our novel approach augments a loop-shaped inverse-Jacobian PI controller with a residual policy learned via Soft Actor-Critic in the digital twin. A delay-compensated Kalman filter fuses out-of-sequence camera measurements to provide latency-aware moving target position estimates. We compare the achieved performance to a performance bound for a class of model-based controllers derived from a frequency-domain sensitivity analysis, quantifying the minimum achievable error imposed by uncertain kinematic model mismatch. Simulation and hardware experiments indicate that our residual policy drives tracking error below the bound. Across conveyor speeds (27.9-41.8 mm/s), our method reduces mean tracking errors from 1.1-1.4 mm (baseline inverse-Jacobian PI) to 0.3-0.7 mm. These results show that learning residual corrections in a limited-fidelity simulator, combined with delay compensation, can substantially improve model-based control under modeling and measurement uncertainties while maintaining reliable sim-to-real transfer.
comment: This manuscript is currently under review in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)

AI.tldr: 残差强化学习结合延迟补偿，使机械臂在不精确仿真训练后实现零样本迁移并提升运动目标跟踪精度。
AI.motivation: 数字孪生误差、测量误差与延迟噪声限制机械臂对传送带运动物体的视觉跟踪性能。
AI.method: 用软演员评论家学习逆雅可比PI控制器的残差策略，并以延迟补偿卡尔曼滤波融合乱序相机测量。
AI.result: 仿真与硬件实验中误差低于所分析控制器类别的性能界限，平均跟踪误差由1.1—1.4毫米降至0.3—0.7毫米。
AI.conclusion: 有限保真仿真中的残差学习配合延迟补偿，可在模型与测量不确定性下改善控制并可靠迁移至实机。

title: Hardening Agentic Web Populations Through Multi-Criterion Competitive Co-Evolution: Lessons from Wargame Strategy Optimization
summary: Agents on the open web will face adversaries that keep adapting, so a defense that is only tested once will eventually be found and broken. We propose treating jailbreak attacks and safety guardrails as two populations that evolve against each other, rather than as a fixed attacker probing a fixed defense. This idea comes directly from wargame strategy optimization, where two-population competitive co-evolution with alternating evolution cycles and cross-play evaluation has already been shown to produce strategies that are robust to a moving opponent, and where a companion line of work has shown that the same machinery can measure how much competitive pressure a population must absorb. However, real-world applications can never rely on a single criterion as a key performance indicator, rather must use multiple conflicting criteria, such as, cost and efficiency. We describe how this mechanism transfers to language model safety, argue why the resulting multi-criteria, competitive and coevolutionary arms race is a genuinely networked, population-level problem rather than a two-agent toy setting, and lay out the open problems that stand between the wargame version of this idea and an agentic web version of it.
comment: Accepted at the 1st NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Agentic Web: Decentralized, Continually-Adapting Agent Ecosystems (this https URL)

AI.tldr: 提出让越狱攻击与安全护栏进行多准则竞争协同进化，以应对开放网络中持续适应的对手。
AI.motivation: 一次性测试的防御难以抵御持续演化的攻击，实际应用还需兼顾成本与效率等冲突目标。
AI.method: 借鉴兵棋策略优化，将交替进化与交叉对战评估迁移至攻击和防御种群，并纳入多准则考量。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体结果。
AI.conclusion: 智能体网络安全应视为网络化的种群级问题，该框架从兵棋迁移至开放网络仍有待解决的挑战。

title: Generation of protein conformations using a simple inverted transformer
summary: Molecular dynamics is an extremely powerful approach for studying protein behavior, but it requires enormous computational resources to obtain an adequate sampling of possible conformations. Recently, thanks to successes in predicting three-dimensional protein structures, there has been an explosion of research exploring the opportunities offered by deep learning to address the problem of protein conformational landscape. In this work, an artificial intelligence system based on a variant of the Transformer architecture is introduced and applied to the problem of determining the ensemble of three-dimensional structures that a protein can access and their statistical weight. After being trained on a dataset of conformations of a particular protein obtained using classical all-atom molecular dynamics, this neural network is able to directly generate physically plausible protein conformations similar to those obtained both through molecular dynamics and experimentally. The ordered sequence of conformations obtained as output of the neural network rapidly converges towards the most populated regions of the protein's conformational landscape, suggesting that the system may have learned not only the protein's three-dimensional organization but also the thermodynamic weights of the various feasible conformations. These features, combined with its simplicity and low computational load, make this Transformer variant an ideal candidate for the development of systems capable of performing generative molecular dynamics.

AI.tldr: 一种简单的倒置Transformer可低成本生成物理合理的蛋白质构象，并可能学习其热力学权重。
AI.motivation: 分子动力学充分采样蛋白质构象需要巨大算力，亟需更高效地刻画构象空间及统计权重。
AI.method: 使用特定蛋白质的经典全原子分子动力学构象数据，训练Transformer变体生成三维构象。
AI.result: 生成构象与模拟及实验所得构象相似，输出序列快速趋向构象空间中占比最高的区域。
AI.conclusion: 该模型结构简单、计算负担低，有望用于开发生成式分子动力学系统。

title: The Data Debt of Stockouts: Partial Identification and Minimax-Regret Inventory Control
summary: Problem definition: Inventory decisions select which demand enters sales logs. Unrecorded forecasts can leave demand frequencies unidentified even when stocking levels are recorded. We study which multistage ordering decisions these logs can justify and what finite samples can guarantee. Methodology/results: Nested stockout thresholds yield exact sets of compatible demand laws and finite representations for policy evaluation. We choose one deterministic inventory rule to minimize its largest expected cost gap from the informed optimum under the same law. This population value is data debt for the specified information and policy class. Under independent demand, carryover can create positive debt despite common optimal actions in every isolated period. Finite samples add learning error above debt. The required sample count grows linearly with the selection bound, with upper and lower orders matching up to logarithmic factors. This rate requires fixed demand and cost bounds, sufficient revelation, and a uniformly positive probability of clearing all feasible stock across the confidence sets. Controlled and semi-synthetic studies separate policy improvements from tighter guarantees. Managerial implications: More records can tighten guarantees while debt persists. Deeper revelation can establish common optimality without fully identifying demand. Using these guarantees requires validated logging, a credible selection range, and a regret tolerance in cost units. Information acquisition must distinguish tighter assurance from operating savings.

AI.tldr: 研究缺货日志下的需求部分识别与最小最大遗憾库存控制，区分信息不足造成的数据债与学习误差。
AI.motivation: 库存决策会选择性地决定哪些需求被记录，缺失预测信息可使需求频率无法识别。
AI.method: 利用嵌套缺货阈值刻画相容需求分布集合，并选择相对知情最优策略最坏期望成本差最小的确定性规则。
AI.result: 跨期库存结转可产生正数据债；特定条件下，样本需求随选择界线性增长，上下界仅差对数因子。
AI.conclusion: 增加记录可收紧保证却未必消除数据债，信息获取应区分保证改善与实际运营节省。

title: MARS: Dynamic Routing of Reinforcement-Learned Atomic Skills for Multi-Stage Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong capabilities in multi-task robotic manipulation. However, they still face limitations in control precision and execution stability during critical manipulation stages, such as object grasping, alignment and insertion. To combine general-purpose manipulation capabilities with task-specific fine-grained control, while enabling effective coordination between generalist and specialized policies throughout multi-stage manipulation tasks, this paper proposes MARS (Modular Atomic-skill Routing System), a dynamic routing framework for reinforcement learning-based atomic skills. MARS integrates a frozen generalist VLA policy with multiple independently trained atomic skill policies. Using a shared RL Token state representation and the reference action of VLA, specialized control policies are optimized through reinforcement learning for different cr`itical manipulation stages. For high-level policy selection, we develop a dynamic router that integrates temporal context and skill semantics. The router employs Mamba-based recurrent encoding and a historical feature window to capture state evolution during manipulation. Skill descriptions of candidate policies are encoded into semantic queries, and attention mechanisms are used to establish correspondences between skill semantics and temporal state features. Experimental results show that MARS achieves an average Macro-F1 score of 90.47% across four LIBERO task suites under fixed-trajectory evaluation, outperforming an MLP-based router by 7.08 percentage points. In the simulated Tube Transport task, the full-task success rate increases from 20.04% to 85.67%. These results demonstrate that stage-specific reinforcement learning and temporal state-aware dynamic policy routing can improve multi-policy coordination and overall task execution performance in multi-stage robotic manipulation.

AI.tldr: MARS通过动态路由协调冻结通用VLA策略与强化学习原子技能，提升多阶段机器人操作表现。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在抓取、对齐和插入等关键阶段仍存在控制精度和执行稳定性不足。
AI.method: 结合共享状态表示、独立强化学习技能及基于Mamba时序编码和技能语义注意力的动态路由器。
AI.result: 四套LIBERO固定轨迹评估中Macro-F1达90.47%，管道运输仿真成功率由20.04%升至85.67%。
AI.conclusion: 阶段专用强化学习与时序状态感知路由可改善多策略协同和多阶段任务执行。

title: Unlocking Fine-Grained Cell Representations via Soft-Interior Rim Dense-Grid Pooling in Pathology Foundation Models
summary: Fine-grained cell representations are essential for characterizing cellular heterogeneity and tissue organization in computational pathology. Pathology foundation models (PFMs) provide powerful pretrained features for transferable tissue analysis. HoVer-Net uses task-trained segmentation and typing, whereas CellViT++ averages native-grid tokens assigned to detected nuclei. However, the former requires cell-specific training; the latter ignores fractional nuclear coverage and can mix nuclear content with neighbouring tissue. Therefore, we propose SRDP, short for Soft-interior Rim Dense-grid Pooling, a training-free geometry-aware readout. We apply the frozen patch projection at half stride, interleave four offset lattices, map the cell mask to fractional coverage weights, and concatenate whole-cell pooling with two inner boundary pools. Across four datasets and six frozen encoders, SRDP improves mean balanced accuracy by 5.68 percentage points over native token averaging across 24 settings, including 11.22 points on average for CoNIC and Lizard. SRDP converts a coarse frozen PFM lattice into a mask-aligned, fine-grained cell representation without updating the encoder.

AI.tldr: SRDP无需训练或更新病理基础模型，即可从粗粒度特征网格提取掩膜对齐的细粒度细胞表示。
AI.motivation: 现有方法或需细胞专项训练，或忽略细胞核的部分覆盖，导致核内容与邻近组织混合。
AI.method: 以半步长冻结投影交织四组网格，将细胞掩膜转为覆盖权重，并拼接全细胞与两个内边界池化特征。
AI.result: 四个数据集、六个编码器的24种设置中，平均平衡准确率较原生词元平均池化提高5.68个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 几何感知的无训练读出可在保持编码器冻结的同时改善细粒度细胞表示。

title: Gradient-Based Co-Design of Systems and Reinforcement Learning Policies with Differentiable Simulators
summary: Co-design is the problem of jointly optimizing the design of a system and the policy that operates it. Neither can be chosen independently: a system design is only as good as the policy trained for it, and the optimal policy changes with the design. When that policy is learned by reinforcement learning (RL), evaluating a candidate design requires a full policy training run, and the design is usually optimized by black-box search such as Bayesian optimization (BO) or evolution strategies (ES). These methods scale poorly with the design dimension and ignore the differentiable structure of modern simulators and, in particular, the sensitivity of the optimal policy with respect to the design. We instead derive a gradient-based co-design method, where the design gradient decomposes into a direct effect of changing the design at a fixed policy and an indirect effect through the design-dependent optimal policy. The indirect effect requires the sensitivity of the converged policy to the design, which we obtain by applying the implicit function theorem to the stationarity condition of the policy gradient. Based on this sensitivity, we develop a proof-of-concept co-design algorithm with stochastic value gradient (SVG)-style policy optimization, prove that it converges to an approximately stationary design, and demonstrate on a differentiable networked-system benchmark with high-dimensional design spaces that it consistently outperforms BO and ES.

AI.tldr: 提出利用可微模拟器和最优策略敏感度的梯度协同设计方法，联合优化系统设计与强化学习策略。
AI.motivation: 系统与策略相互依赖，而黑盒设计搜索需反复训练策略，难以扩展至高维且忽略可微结构。
AI.method: 将设计梯度分解为直接与策略介导的间接效应，通过隐函数定理求策略敏感度，并结合随机值梯度优化。
AI.result: 证明算法收敛至近似驻点设计，并在高维可微网络系统基准上持续优于贝叶斯优化和进化策略。
AI.conclusion: 显式利用最优策略对设计的敏感度，可有效支持高维系统与控制策略的联合优化。

title: Benchmarking the State of AI for Crop Yield Forecasting: A Global Assessment Across Modeling Paradigms
summary: Accurate crop yield forecasting is essential for food security, agricultural policy, and commodity markets. Although statistical, process-based, and machine learning approaches have all been proposed, their relative strengths remain poorly understood due to the lack of large-scale, standardized comparisons. We address this gap through a comprehensive benchmark of five modeling paradigms -- statistical baselines, process-based models, conventional feature-engineered machine learning, deep sequence models, and tabular foundation models -- using the CY-Bench benchmark spanning 63 country-crop datasets (>12,000 administrative regions) across six continents. Beyond conventional pooled accuracy metrics, we introduce a multi-dimensional evaluation framework that separately quantifies overall, spatial, temporal, and anomaly prediction skill. Across multiple crops and countries, feature-engineered machine learning and tabular foundation models achieve the strongest overall predictive performance. Data-driven models reduce NRMSE in 72% of countries growing maize and 78% of countries growing wheat, with median reductions of 8.8% and 11.9%, respectively. Across all modeling paradigms, spatial prediction is substantially easier than temporal and anomaly prediction. While data-driven models markedly improve temporal and anomaly prediction over statistical baselines, accurately forecasting year-to-year yield variability remains challenging. These findings suggest that future progress in large-scale crop yield forecasting will depend on the improved characterization of the environmental and management factors driving inter-annual yield variability, founded on effective representations for crop yield forecasting systems that support agricultural decision-making, early-warning applications, and food security planning
comment: 11 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Accepted for publication in Proceedings of the 33rd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining (KDD '27), August 2027, San Jose, CA, USA. Code is available at this https URL and an interactive results dashboard is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 全球作物产量预测基准显示，特征工程机器学习和表格基础模型整体最强，但年际波动预测仍困难。
AI.motivation: 缺乏大规模标准化比较，使统计、过程模型和机器学习方法的相对优势尚不清晰。
AI.method: 在覆盖六大洲63个国家作物数据集的CY-Bench上比较五类模型，分别评估整体、空间、时间和异常预测。
AI.result: 数据驱动模型在72%的玉米国家和78%的小麦国家降低NRMSE，中位降幅分别为8.8%和11.9%。
AI.conclusion: 未来进展需更好表征驱动作物产量年际变化的环境与管理因素，尤其加强时间和异常预测。

title: NI-ACT: A Neural Intent Interface for Brain-Embodied Manipulation
summary: Intracortical brain-computer interfaces can drive robotic arms, but they keep the user inside the fast sensorimotor loop: every approach, correction, and grasp must be neurally specified. Whether intracortical population activity can instead serve as a task-level condition for a learned embodied policy, without symbolic commands or hand-designed skill libraries, remains unknown. NI-ACT addresses this question with a hierarchical brain-embodied framework: a brief motor-cortical signal is read once as a persistent intent, and a visuomotor policy then closes the perception-action loop from vision and proprioception. In a counterfactual grasping task where the scene cannot specify the target, the neural intent alone determined which object the robot grasped; replacing the intent changed the behavior accordingly. Passing the full population latent as a dedicated intent token, rather than a one-hot decoded direction, raised grasp completion from 69% to 81% over 132 held-out scenes, whereas a continuous direction alone did not improve on a one-hot label. Where the signal was read also mattered: in one dual-array session, with the readout window matched, premotor (PMd) intent completed more grasps than primary motor (M1) intent (77% vs. 53%), and the conventional post-cue M1 readout reached 42%. Preparatory activity was itself sufficient: in a center-out task, intent read only from PMd before the go cue (that is, before any movement) drove complete grasps, and in one recording it completed more grasps than the same animal's post-cue readout. These results show that how a neural signal is represented, and where and when it is read, jointly determine how effectively it conveys movement goals to an embodied agent.

AI.tldr: NI-ACT将短暂皮层信号转为持续任务意图，使视觉运动策略自主闭环完成机器人抓取。
AI.motivation: 传统颅内脑机接口要求用户持续指定动作，神经群体活动能否直接条件化具身策略尚不明确。
AI.method: 分层框架单次读取运动皮层信号为意图词元，再由视觉与本体感觉驱动策略执行，并比较信号表示与读取时空。
AI.result: 132个留出场景中，完整群体潜变量使抓取完成率由69%升至81%；单次双阵列记录中PMd为77%、M1为53%。
AI.conclusion: 神经信号的表示方式、读取脑区与读取时机共同影响目标传递效果，运动前准备活动也可支持完整抓取。

title: From Mutation to Medication: Characterizing Failures of Clinical LLMs to Respect Genomic Resistance
summary: Language models are increasingly proposed to support molecular tumour boards, but may recommend cancer therapies despite genomic evidence of resistance. We evaluated ten models on 1,464 resistance cases from five curated oncology knowledge bases, collecting 58,910 judgments. Models endorsed resisted therapies in 21.8-81.4% of cases. However, raw rates can reflect a tendency to agree rather than an ability to distinguish resistance from drug sensitivity: one open-weight model endorsed 81.4% of resistance cases and 82.3% of sensitivity controls. We therefore compared endorsement within matched gene and evidence-level groups. This analysis is exploratory because it was specified after the pre-registered analysis, which yielded null-to-weak results. Measured failures depended strongly on the reference knowledge base and evidence strength. When a second source independently confirmed resistance, four models across three vendors endorsed at most 2.4% of cases; at weaker evidence tiers, discrimination was not measurable. Models sometimes acknowledged resistance yet recommended the therapy. Repeating a model's own resistance conclusion reduced endorsement to 0.0-3.5% on cases where it had stated resistance. Falsely attributing the opposite conclusion increased endorsement above baseline for all seven hosted models, reaching 95.2% for GPT-4o; an instruction without an attributed conclusion changed endorsement by only 0.9 percentage points. Providing the correct curated evidence reduced unqualified strong recommendations to 0.3-3.5%, testing evidence use under an oracle condition rather than retrieval.
comment: Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the Machine Learning for Health (ML4H) 2026 Symposium

AI.tldr: 临床大模型可能无视基因组耐药证据推荐治疗，其失误率受证据强度、知识库与结论归因影响。
AI.motivation: 分子肿瘤委员会使用大模型辅助决策时，需要识别其违背基因组耐药证据推荐药物的风险。
AI.method: 在五个肿瘤知识库的1464个耐药病例上评估十个模型，并进行匹配比较及证据与结论干预。
AI.result: 耐药治疗认可率为21.8%至81.4%；提供正确证据后，无保留强推荐率降至0.3%至3.5%。
AI.conclusion: 模型有时承认耐药仍推荐治疗；匹配分析属探索性结果，正确证据干预也不代表真实检索能力。

title: A Think Block Is Conditioning, Not a Plan
summary: Generative models increasingly write a chain of thought before drawing, and report large gains from doing so. We ask what that text contributes, by substitution rather than ablation: holding the generator, sampler and seeds fixed, we replace the think block with controlled alternatives and measure the image. Across a unified model with a think mode, a reinforcement-learned reasoning generator, and a planner driving a frozen diffusion model, the same picture emerges. Content-free prose of matched length is worth nothing or less ($-0.05$ to $-0.15$). One sentence from an unrelated 8B model, naming the subject and a few identifying details, matches the generator's own plan in three to six times fewer conditioning tokens. The value sits where the referent is in doubt: writing down a name is worth $+0.33$ when it is right and $+0.05$ when it is wrong, and where the generator already succeeds the whole effect is $-0.07 \pm 0.07$. Cutting a plan at the text encoder's window leaves 272 of 286 images byte-identical, and a plan rewritten to fit that window ties a bare identification ($+0.003 \pm 0.044$), so a plan contains nothing the identification does not already supply. Field-level interventions find only colour executed reliably, and a control writing the same sentences into the user prompt shows that limit belongs to the generator rather than to the planning channel. Two judges and two annotators replicate the central contrasts. A think block earns its keep as a specification of what to draw, not as a plan that is carried out.

AI.tldr: 图像生成前的思考文本主要用于明确绘制对象，而非提供可执行的生成计划。
AI.motivation: 生成模型常声称思维链能提升绘图表现，但文本究竟提供何种有效信息仍不清楚。
AI.method: 固定生成器、采样器和随机种子，在三类生成架构中用受控文本替换思考块并评估图像。
AI.result: 简短对象描述以少三至六倍的条件词元匹配原计划表现，截断计划后286张图中272张字节不变。
AI.conclusion: 收益主要来自消除对象歧义，而非复杂规划；字段级干预中仅颜色能被可靠执行。

title: OmitEHR: Scalable Omission Detection in LLM-Generated Clinical Summaries
summary: Health systems increasingly rely on large language models (LLMs) to draft summaries of patient medical records, yet evaluations now find omissions, the absence of clinically important information, to be the most common failure mode. Detecting omissions in an LLM-generated summary requires knowing which facts in the record are salient, a signal that existing methods hand-specify, ignore, or recompute at inference with costly LLM judges. We present OmitEHR, a reference-free omission detector that learns clinical salience from historical clinician-written summaries predating widespread LLM use. OmitEHR learns to predict which source-note sentences clinicians include in their summaries, then surfaces high-salience sentences not covered by an LLM-generated summary as candidate omissions. We apply OmitEHR to brief hospital course (BHC) summarization using 5,000 admissions from a large academic medical center. On held-out admissions, OmitEHR outperformed all evaluated baselines at predicting salient source sentences, including a prompted LLM judge. The full omission detection pipeline took 17.7 to 19.5 seconds and cost \$0.03 to \$0.13 per summary depending on the base model, 1.6 to 1.7 times faster and 5.6 to 6.7 times cheaper than scoring every source sentence with an LLM judge. In a blinded review of 25 admissions, two board-certified clinicians confirmed a mean of 5.6 clinically meaningful omissions per summary surfaced by OmitEHR, compared with 3.3 for a full LLM pipeline, counting candidates confirmed by at least one clinician. The efficiency and validity of OmitEHR make it a practical tool for health systems to flag omissions before a summary reaches the clinician.
comment: 21 pages, 6 figures, 15 tables. Accepted at Machine Learning for Health (ML4H) 2026

AI.tldr: OmitEHR从历史医生摘要学习临床重要性，以较低成本发现大模型临床摘要中的遗漏。
AI.motivation: 临床摘要遗漏普遍，而现有检测方法缺乏可靠的重要性信号或依赖昂贵的大模型逐句评审。
AI.method: 利用5000次住院记录训练源句重要性预测器，将高重要性且未被生成摘要覆盖的句子标为候选遗漏。
AI.result: 每份摘要耗时17.7至19.5秒、成本0.03至0.13美元；盲评平均确认5.6项遗漏，对照为3.3项。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在重要句预测上优于所有受评基线，可为医疗机构提供高效的摘要遗漏预警。

title: Delay-Aware Reinforcement Learning for O-RAN Control under Stochastic Reward Feedback
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly employed for real-time control in Open Radio Access Networks (O-RANs). However, the asynchronous nature of O-RAN feedback introduces stochastic delays between actions and their observable rewards, leading to misaligned credit assignment and unstable training. This letter formulates the O-RAN control problem as a Markov decision process (MDP) with delayed and stochastic rewards, where the true reward corresponding to an action is received after an unknown delay. To address this, we propose a delay-aware deep RL framework that integrates a long short-term memory (LSTM)-based delay predictor and a temporal reward realignment module within an off-policy learning pipeline. Using empirical delay traces collected from the Open AI Cellular (OAIC) testbed, we demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves faster convergence and significantly reduces latency violations and packet drops compared to conventional RL methods that ignore feedback delay. The results confirm that reward-delay compensation is critical for reliable AI-driven O-RAN control.

AI.tldr: 延迟感知强化学习通过预测反馈延迟并重对齐奖励，改善开放无线接入网的实时控制。
AI.motivation: 开放无线接入网的随机异步奖励延迟会造成信用分配错位与训练不稳定。
AI.method: 将控制建模为随机延迟奖励的马尔可夫决策过程，在离策略学习中结合LSTM延迟预测与奖励重对齐。
AI.result: 基于OAIC测试平台实测延迟轨迹，该方法比忽略延迟的强化学习收敛更快，并显著减少时延违规与丢包。
AI.conclusion: 补偿奖励反馈延迟是实现可靠人工智能驱动开放无线接入网控制的重要条件。

title: Information Limits of Replay-Free Recurrent State Migration
summary: When a recurrent model is replaced, its old state may not determine what the new model would compute from the same history. We characterize the information that must be retained before the replacement is known. For a time-invariant affine linear family, the minimum continuous causal memory for order-$k$ local migration equals the reachable dimension of a lifted coefficient system minus the information in the anchor state. A controllable $d$-state model with scalar input needs at most $kd$ additional real coordinates, even when arbitrary matrix replacement directions are revealed only after streaming. A single rank-one direction can already require all $kd$. Conditional singular values and auxiliary-bit bounds distinguish this local information law from recovery at a fixed tolerance. We also give invariant-subspace and future-output constructions. Controlled experiments compare the resulting representations. In a small language model, equal-memory cubic interpolation improves mean state fidelity over third-order coefficients but provides no meaningful predictive gain. An analytic history basis preserves useful adaptation more economically in a coupled identification task. With repeated slow poles, eight history coordinates meet normalized output error $10^{-4}$ across five fitted seeds despite substantial full-state error. Splitting the poles raises the smallest tested successful width to 64.

AI.tldr: 研究刻画循环模型无需重放历史即可迁移状态时必须预先保留的信息量及其适用边界。
AI.motivation: 替换循环模型后，旧状态未必足以恢复新模型对相同历史的计算结果。
AI.method: 对时不变仿射线性模型推导局部迁移的最小连续因果记忆，并以受控实验比较不同历史表示。
AI.result: 可控d维标量输入模型至多需额外kd个实坐标，单个秩一替换方向即可达到该需求。
AI.conclusion: 精确局部迁移的信息需求不等于固定容差下的恢复需求，面向输出的历史表示可能更节省记忆。

title: Attention U-Net Cellular Automata for Multi-Class Land Use and Land Cover Change Simulation in Lucknow, India: Evaluation Against Null and Classical Baselines
summary: Convolutional networks are often used to learn the transition rules of land-use cellular automata (CA), yet their predictions are seldom compared with a null model that predicts no change. We built AttentionUNet-CA, which reads a 32 x 32 neighbourhood of land-cover states with four drivers (elevation, distance to major roads, distance to the central business district (CBD) and population density) and predicts the state of each cell ten years later.
