We tested it on Lucknow, India, with GLC_FCS30D land cover for 1990, 2000, 2010 and 2020, a 30 m series mapped consistently over time, and compared its built-up class with GHSL and ESA WorldCover. AttentionUNet-CA was trained on 1990-2010, selected on held-out spatial blocks and evaluated once on 2010-2020, with three seeds. Baselines were the null model, a random-forest CA (RF-CA) and a U-Net CA without attention; each network was trained with and without class weights. Only 8.1% of the study area changed in the test decade, so no model matched the overall agreement of the null model (91.9%). On change, measured by the figure of merit, the class-weighted networks scored highest (U-Net CA 22.0 +/- 1.2%, AttentionUNet-CA 21.0 +/- 1.4%), ahead of RF-CA (20.3%), but by margins comparable to seed-to-seed variation; the networks estimated the amount of change better than RF-CA. The attention gates did not improve accuracy. Population density and distance to the CBD were the most useful drivers. Projected to 2030, built-up land grows by 22-35%, mostly at the city edge.

AI.tldr: 勒克瑙土地变化模拟中，注意力门未提高精度，所有模型总体一致率均低于不变基线。
AI.motivation: 土地利用元胞自动机常使用卷积网络学习转移规则，却很少与预测无变化的基线比较。
AI.method: 结合土地覆盖邻域与四类驱动因子训练AttentionUNet-CA，在2010至2020年测试并比较三类基线。
AI.result: 不变基线总体一致率为91.9%；加权U-Net与注意力版变化评价得分分别为22.0%和21.0%。
AI.conclusion: 类别加权有助于变化预测，但注意力无额外收益且模型差距接近种子波动；2030年建成区预计增长22%至35%。

title: SMELL: Sparsity-aware Memory Efficient Federated Fine-tuning for Long-context LLMs
summary: Federated fine-tuning enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to collaboratively adapt to distributed private data. However, long-context fine-tuning on resource-constrained devices faces substantial challenges arising from excessive activation memory, heterogeneous token-importance patterns across clients, and communication overhead. To address these challenges, we propose SMELL, a Sparsity-aware and Memory-Efficient federated fine-tuning framework for Long-context LLMs. SMELL integrates three complementary mechanisms: Local Sparse-Forward Adaptation (LSFA), Consensus-Anchored Sparsity Coordination (CASC), and Communication-Efficient Progressive Update Recovery (CPUR). These mechanisms jointly enable memory-efficient local adaptation, heterogeneity-aware sparsity coordination, and lightweight model-update transmission. Experiments on OPT-350M and LLaMA2-7B demonstrate that SMELL reduces peak memory consumption by up to 88.35% compared with conventional fine-tuning and 13.25% compared with forward-only LoRA fine-tuning at a 16K context length. Furthermore, SMELL improves fine-tuning performance under certain non-IID settings and supports compact update transmission with progressive reconstruction, demonstrating its potential for resource-efficient federated long-context LLM adaptation.

AI.tldr: SMELL通过稀疏适配、跨客户端协调与渐进更新恢复，降低长上下文大模型联邦微调的资源开销。
AI.motivation: 资源受限设备上的长上下文联邦微调面临激活内存过高、客户端词元重要性异质和通信负担。
AI.method: 联合局部稀疏前向适配、共识锚定稀疏协调及通信高效的渐进更新恢复机制。
AI.result: 16K上下文下，峰值内存较常规微调最多降低88.35%，较仅前向LoRA微调降低13.25%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在部分非独立同分布设置下改善性能，并支持紧凑更新传输，适用于资源高效联邦适配。

title: HongguoTrending: A Longitudinal, Multimodal Archive of Trending Videos and Topics on a Leading Micro-Drama Platform
summary: Micro-dramas (duanju) are reshaping digital production and consumption, yet a lack of longitudinal data connecting series to their platform visibility persists, limiting our understanding of the emerging medium. We introduce HongguoTrending, a longitudinal, multimodal dataset of hourly snapshots from seven trending lists of Hongguo, China's largest micro-drama platform. Collected through a two-stage asynchronous pipeline, the archive links 63,200 ranking entries across 632 web list-hours and 157 client hours (889 distinct series) to metadata, cover images, sampled episode videos, and audience engagement metrics. Exploratory analyses show distinct turnover rates between web and mobile trending lists, production-driven mainstream values alongside kinship-centered synopses, genre-specific cover palettes, and strong associations between user sharing and next-day rank gains. Accessible via a RESTful API, this dataset supports empirical research on algorithmic gatekeeping, popularity dynamics, and multimodal digital culture.

AI.tldr: HongguoTrending提供红果短剧平台热榜的纵向多模态档案，连接作品内容、榜单曝光与受众互动。
AI.motivation: 缺乏连接短剧作品与平台可见性的纵向数据，限制了对短剧生产、传播及流行机制的理解。
AI.method: 通过两阶段异步管线采集七类热榜的小时快照，并关联元数据、封面、抽样剧集视频和互动指标。
AI.result: 档案包含63200条排名记录与889部剧，探索分析发现用户分享与次日排名提升存在强关联。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集通过RESTful API开放访问，可支持算法把关、流行动态与多模态数字文化研究。

title: A Comparative Evaluation of BERT-Based and LLM-Based Models for Indic Sentence Similarity
summary: The relative effectiveness of BERT-based encoders and large language model (LLM)-based embeddings for Indic semantic textual similarity remains insufficiently characterized. We compare eight BERT-based and five LLM-based models on the 1,500-pair STS Benchmark development set translated into ten Indic languages and on the native Marathi MahaSTS test set. IndicSBERT achieves the highest Pearson correlation in all ten translated language sets, with a macro-average of 0.843, followed by BGE-M3 at 0.792. Harrier-270M is the strongest LLM-based model on translated STS-B, with a macro-average of 0.751. On MahaSTS, IndicSBERT and Bhasha-Embed-v0 achieve Pearson correlations of 0.901 and 0.900, respectively, while EmbeddingGemma leads the LLM-based models at 0.871. The highest-scoring BERT-based model thus exceeds the highest-scoring LLM-based model in both settings, although the magnitude of the difference varies across benchmarks. These findings indicate that LLM-derived embeddings do not uniformly improve Indic sentence similarity over established encoders and motivate evaluation that accounts for language coverage, task supervision, and benchmark construction.

AI.tldr: 在印度语言句子相似度评测中，最佳BERT编码器在两类基准上均优于最佳大语言模型嵌入。
AI.motivation: BERT编码器与大语言模型嵌入在印度语言语义相似度任务上的相对效果尚不明确。
AI.method: 在译为十种印度语言的1500对STS-B开发集及原生马拉地语MahaSTS测试集上比较13个模型。
AI.result: IndicSBERT在翻译集的平均相关系数为0.843，在MahaSTS上为0.901，均居首位。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型嵌入并非普遍优于既有编码器，评测需考虑语言覆盖、任务监督与基准构建。

title: RETR: A Structure-Preserving RGB-Event Transformer for Robust 3D Lane Detection
summary: Robust 3D lane detection requires accurate metric road geometry recovery from visual inputs, yet conventional RGB-based approaches suffer from fragile lane evidence under adverse illumination, motion blur, and long-range perspective compression. Event cameras offer complementary high-temporal-resolution, high dynamic-range structural cues that are robust to these challenges, but their sparse, motion-dependent responses cannot be directly fused into consistent 3D geometry. In this paper, we present the first attempt to introduce event cameras into 3D lane detection. To enable systematic research, we first build two multimodal benchmarks with metric 3D lane annotations: DSEC-3DLD (real-world sequences) and Ev-OpenLane (large-scale simulated sequences). We further propose RETR, a structure preserving transformer that converts complementary RGB and event observations into coherent 3D lane geometry. RETR first aligns modality consistent evidence through Reciprocal Context Flow Fusion, then preserves thin and uncertain lane structures with Uncertainty Aware Structural Consolidation, and finally decodes ordered lane hypotheses using a Geometry State Decoder with proposal conditioned initialization, reference conditioned query evolution, and diversified geometric inquiry. Extensive experiments show that RETR achieves state-of-the-art performance on both benchmarks, especially showing strong improvements in challenging lighting and complex road geometry scenarios. Code and dataset will be available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: RETR融合RGB与事件相机信息，在两个新建三维车道检测基准上取得最先进性能。
AI.motivation: RGB车道检测易受光照、运动模糊及远距离透视压缩影响，而事件信号难以直接融合为一致三维几何。
AI.method: 构建两个多模态基准，并以跨模态融合、不确定性感知结构整合及几何状态解码实现三维车道检测。
AI.result: RETR在两个基准上均达到最先进水平，尤其在困难光照与复杂道路几何场景中提升明显。
AI.conclusion: 事件相机的互补结构信息与保结构融合有助于提高三维车道检测的鲁棒性。

title: One Run Is Not Enough: Reminding a small Gemma 4 coding agent of its last finding made no measurable difference in a paired test
summary: When a coding agent runs out of room, its earlier findings are cut and it forgets them. We tested a simple fix: automatically putting the agent's last finding back in front of it. We fixed the rules in advance and ran 98 paired coding tasks with and without this reminder, using Gemma 4 31B (QAT, 4-bit) in the Gemma 4 Developer Agent harness. The reminder made no measurable difference: across all 98 tasks, 47 were solved with it and 48 without (-1.0 points, 95% interval [-8.3, +6.3], exact McNemar p=1.0). The primary outcome (a documented deviation from our preregistration), the first 48 pairs, was 29/48 with memory against 25/48 without (+8.3 points, [-2.1, +18.3], p=0.22); the extension of 50 tasks, decided after that result, pointed the other way (18/50 against 23/50, -10.0 points, p=0.125), so the sign did not replicate. With 19% of tasks flipping between two identical no-memory runs, the combined interval excludes harms larger than about 8 points and gains larger than about 6, and the design had 80% power only for effects of about +-12 points or more. The model almost never wrote notes (2 of 16 and 4 of 32 runs), and memory cost context: the first request is larger and something was injected at only 47% to 65% of compactions. The registered secondary, repeated actions per compaction, was also null. Two directional hypotheses found on Modal did not replicate on Kaggle. We also report an A/A calibration and a validity funnel (129 tasks, 105 valid). Together these results show that single-run memory claims on task sets of this size sit inside run-to-run noise. The treatment is a harness mechanism and does not test agent-written memory.
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures. Code, data and the commit history of the pre-registration: this https URL

AI.tldr: 98组成对编码任务显示，向Gemma 4代理重新注入上次发现未带来可测量的性能变化。
AI.motivation: 编码代理在上下文压缩后会遗忘早期发现，但简单提醒机制的实际收益缺乏可靠验证。
AI.method: 使用Gemma 4 31B进行有无自动提醒的成对测试，并开展重复运行与A/A校准。
AI.result: 提醒组解决47项任务，对照组48项，差异为−1.0个百分点，95%区间为[−8.3，6.3]。
AI.conclusion: 此规模任务集上的单次记忆收益可能落在运行噪声内，且该实验不检验代理自行撰写的记忆。

title: XLSAR-Bench: Towards Extremely Large SAR Imagery Understanding of MLLMs
summary: The rapid development of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) has highlighted the need for comprehensive benchmarks to assess their capabilities and limitations in remote sensing (RS). However, evaluating MLLMs in large-size synthetic aperture radar (SAR) scenarios remains challenging, as understanding complete scenes requires both global semantic interpretation and fine-grained target perception. Existing SAR benchmarks predominantly rely on small image patches, limiting their ability to assess these capabilities jointly. To address these limitations, we present XLSAR-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating the perception and reasoning capabilities of MLLMs in large-scene SAR imagery. XLSAR-Bench comprises 405 images with an average size of 7153$\times$7153 pixels, ten tasks spanning visual question answering, visual grounding, and detailed image captioning, with all evaluation samples meticulously annotated manually, assisted by a semi-automatic captioner. Experimental results from general-purpose and domain-specific MLLMs reveal persistent challenges in understanding large SAR scenes and accurately perceiving small targets. We have open-sourced XLSAR-Bench to support further research in developing more powerful MLLMs for complete large SAR scenes.

AI.tldr: XLSAR-Bench评测多模态大模型对超大幅SAR影像的理解，揭示其全景理解与小目标感知不足。
AI.motivation: 现有SAR基准主要使用小图块，难以同时评估完整场景语义理解与细粒度目标感知。
AI.method: 构建含405幅平均7153×7153像素影像、涵盖问答、定位及详细描述等十项任务的人工标注基准。
AI.result: 通用及领域专用多模态大模型均在大幅SAR场景理解和小目标准确感知方面面临持续挑战。
AI.conclusion: 已开源的XLSAR-Bench可支持面向完整大幅SAR场景的多模态大模型研究。

title: Enforcing Ellipsoidal Constraints in Neural Networks with a Polynomial Safety Layer
summary: Often the output of a learned mapping must satisfy prescribed constraints. In the control of autonomous systems, for example, the chosen action must keep the system within a collision-free region. We consider the case in which a proposed output is corrected by projection onto a safety ellipsoid. Computing this projection amounts to solving a quadratically constrained quadratic program (QCQP). We construct a neural-network safety layer by unrolling a feasibility-preserving polynomial penalty iteration. The unrolled structure allows the loss gradient to propagate from the feasible output through the safety layer to the network parameters during training. We show how to choose the layer parameters so that every iterate is feasible and give a computable bound on its distance to the exact projection at any prescribed depth. We illustrate the method by training a LiDAR-based policy to control an unmanned aerial vehicle. A privileged model predictive control expert uses the map and the measured vehicle state to generate the training data. In the simulated narrow mazes, the filtered policy avoided wall contact at every tested stage of training, including at initialization, when every unfiltered flight hit a wall. A representative build of the learned policy and its safety layer for an Arm Cortex-M4F microcontroller occupies about 36 KiB of flash, with a RAM budget below 5 KiB.

AI.tldr: 通过展开保持可行性的多项式罚迭代，构建可微椭球安全层，并在无人机仿真中避免碰墙。
AI.motivation: 学习模型的输出常需满足安全约束，而将输出投影至安全椭球需要求解二次约束二次规划。
AI.method: 展开保持可行性的多项式罚迭代，允许梯度贯穿安全层，并给出参数选择及投影误差界。
AI.result: 过滤策略在所有测试训练阶段均未碰墙；代表性微控制器实现占约36 KiB闪存、低于5 KiB内存。
AI.conclusion: 该安全层能保证各迭代输出可行，并以可计算误差界近似投影，且可用于资源受限设备。

title: $β$-number and Its Applications to Data Science
summary: In this paper, we introduce a novel metric, $\beta$-number, designed to measure the "$p$-th order $d$-dimensional oscillation degree" of a set. For a given set $K$ in the Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^n$, $\beta$-number is computed by identifying an optimal $d$-dimensional plane $L$ that minimizes the average $p$-th order distance of all points in $K$ to $L$. This metric serves as a versatile tool in data science, functioning both as a dimensionality reduction technique to find the optimal $p$-th order $d$-dimensional subspace and as a measure to characterize data oscillation for classification. We conduct a thorough exploration of $\beta$-number through theoretical analysis and numerical experiments. Initially, we establish the upper and lower bounds of $\beta$-number for any set $K$, along with its scaling law. We then elucidate the relationships between $\beta$-number and its related parameters. A key finding of this study is that in discrete settings, when $p=2$, the $d$-dimensional plane determined by $\beta$-number coincides with that obtained via Principal Component Analysis (PCA), positioning $\beta$-number as a generalization of PCA. Furthermore, we propose two algorithms for calculating $\beta$-number in both continuous and discrete settings. We validate our theoretical results through a series of numerical experiments in low-dimensional cases. Finally, we demonstrate the potential of $\beta$-number in practical data analysis through a dimensionality reduction task and an image classification task.

AI.tldr: 提出衡量集合振荡程度的β数，并证明其在离散情形下以p=2推广主成分分析。
AI.motivation: 数据降维与分类需要刻画集合相对于低维子空间的偏离和振荡程度。
AI.method: 通过最小化点到最优d维平面的平均p阶距离定义β数，研究其性质并提出连续与离散计算算法。
AI.result: 建立β数上下界及缩放律，并证明离散情形下p=2时所得平面与PCA一致，低维实验验证理论。
AI.conclusion: β数可作为PCA的推广，为降维与基于数据振荡特征的分类提供工具。

title: Test-Time Constraint-Aware Diffusion Predictive Control
summary: Diffusion models can learn multimodal distributions over finite-horizon state-input sequences, providing a way to generate candidates for predictive control. However, sequences generated by a pretrained model may violate safety constraints introduced at deployment, for example when obstacles are added or repositioned. Retraining whenever these constraints change limits the usefulness of learned predictive controllers. In this paper, we propose Test-Time Constraint-Aware Diffusion Predictive Control (TCA-DPC), an algorithm for adapting the sampling distribution of a pretrained diffusion controller to newly introduced safety constraints without retraining. We treat the pretrained model as a prior over finite-horizon sequences and define an adapted distribution through exponential tilting based on a constraint-violation penalty. The tilt strength is adjusted online using the fraction of generated sequences that fail constraint verification. We approximately sample the adapted distribution using the Metropolis-adjusted Langevin algorithm in the Gaussian noise space of the pretrained diffusion sampler.

AI.tldr: TCA-DPC在不重新训练的情况下调整预训练扩散控制器的采样分布，以适应部署时新增安全约束。
AI.motivation: 预训练扩散控制器生成的轨迹可能违反部署时变化的安全约束，而反复重训限制实用性。
AI.method: 以约束违反惩罚进行指数倾斜，按验证失败比例在线调节强度，并在噪声空间用MALA近似采样。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体结果。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提供了无需重训、通过测试时分布适配处理新增安全约束的预测控制方案。

title: AcousticBEV: Acoustic BEV Object Localization for Intelligent Vehicles
summary: Modern autonomous driving and driver assistance systems rely predominantly on cameras, radars and LiDARs for environmental perception. However, these modalities face different environmental limitations, including poor illumination for cameras and adverse weather for LiDAR. Acoustic sensing, particularly using microphone arrays, could provide complementary perception capabilities for autonomous driving, but has remained largely underexplored. In this work, we design a horizontally arranged microphone array that functions as the "ears" of a vehicle, enabling localization of nearby moving vehicles in a bird's-eye view (BEV) representation that captures both their relative direction and distance. Using this array, we collect a real-world driving dataset, AcousticScenes, which contains 2,117 static and 2,863 dynamic samples with synchronized spatial acoustic signals, LiDAR point clouds and 3D bounding box annotations. Building on this dataset, we propose AcousticBEV, a learning-based method for acoustic BEV object localization, which estimates the center locations of moving traffic participants in BEV from the microphone-array signals, conditioned on the ego vehicle's own speed. Experimental results demonstrate that AcousticBEV outperforms both classical signal-processing baselines and other learning-based methods, achieving F1 scores of $47.7 \pm 1.2$% on "Easy" scenarios and $45.1 \pm 1.4$% on "Difficult" cases. Our findings demonstrate that acoustic signals from a low-cost, vehicle-mounted microphone array can localize nearby moving vehicles in both azimuth and distance.
comment: Ziang Liu and Shiming Wang have equal contributions. Shiming Wang is the project lead

AI.tldr: AcousticBEV利用车载麦克风阵列定位周围移动车辆，同时估计其方位与距离。
AI.motivation: 摄像头和激光雷达受光照或天气限制，声学感知作为自动驾驶补充手段尚未充分探索。
AI.method: 设计水平麦克风阵列并采集AcousticScenes数据集，结合自车速度学习声学信号到鸟瞰图目标中心的映射。
AI.result: 其F1在简单和困难场景中分别为47.7±1.2%和45.1±1.4%，优于信号处理及其他学习基线。
AI.conclusion: 低成本车载麦克风阵列能够同时提供附近移动车辆的方位与距离定位信息。

title: Generalization Bounds for Neural Networks with Sparse Connectivity
summary: Empirical evidence suggests that large neural networks rarely make effective use of all available parameters, with learned solutions exhibiting pronounced sparsity. Despite this ubiquity, existing generalization theory only partially explains how such sparsity influences statistical performance. In this paper, we derive non-asymptotic generalization gap bounds for deep neural networks whose layer-wise weight matrices are restricted by $\ell_p$ quasi-norm ($0<p\leq 1$) constraints. Our analysis gives rise to a novel result that interpolates between classical norm-based generalization guarantees and parameter-counting bounds. Remarkably, in the extreme sparsity limit as the quasi-norm order $p$ approaches zero, our analysis reveals a transition to a square-root dependence on the number of \emph{active} (non-zero) parameters, resulting in bounds that are strictly tighter than existing parameter-counting approaches. Experiments demonstrate that our bounds exhibit a milder dependence on initial architectural choice at the over-parametrization regime, effectively capturing the generalization benefit of the sparsity arising from training on natural data.

AI.tldr: 本文建立稀疏连接神经网络的泛化界，揭示有效参数数量对泛化性能的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有泛化理论尚未充分解释大型神经网络训练所得稀疏性如何影响统计性能。
AI.method: 对各层权重施加ℓp拟范数约束，推导连接经典范数界与参数计数界的非渐近泛化界。
AI.result: 当p趋近零时，界呈有效参数数量的平方根依赖，且实验显示其对过参数化架构选择更不敏感。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏性感知泛化界可比现有参数计数方法更紧，并捕捉自然数据训练产生的稀疏性收益。

title: Does a completed simulation run mean a usable urban wind result for AI agents?
summary: AI agents based on large language models (LLMs) can now configure and run computational fluid dynamics (CFD) solvers, but a completed run does not ensure that delivered metrics can be recomputed from raw outputs. This gap was examined for urban wind simulation, where multi-case comparisons must hold non-target conditions fixed and reported values must be traceable to raw samples. UrbanWind-AgentBench, comprising 200 tasks and 367 cases in 10 engineering task families, was constructed. Public task contracts specify variable factors, fixed conditions, numerical thresholds and deliverable requirements, and two-layer scoring separates a structural score for deliverables, run provenance and raw evidence from a numerical score obtained by independent recomputation against references. WindPilot was then proposed as an execution framework that incorporates contract parsing, execution provenance, deterministic verification and bounded acceptance review into the LLM execution loop. On 30 OpenFOAM tasks with independent references, at least the structural maximum of 60 points was reached by a base agent on 28 tasks, but numerical credit was obtained on only 6. With the same model name and budget, WindPilot increased the number of tasks with numerical credit to 17, full-score tasks from 0 to 3 and the mean task score from 62.5 to 72.5. Mean action steps fell from 130.4 to 104.9, and mean token consumption decreased by 12.9%. The mean gain for atmospheric boundary layer (ABL) tasks was 18.5 points. A completed simulation run is therefore not sufficient for a usable urban wind result; usability depends on checks that tie reported metrics to raw evidence during execution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出城市风场智能体基准与WindPilot框架，强调仿真完成不等于结果可用。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型智能体虽能运行流体仿真，但交付指标未必可由原始输出复算。
AI.method: 构建含200项任务的双层评分基准，并将契约解析、执行溯源、确定性验证及有限验收审查纳入执行循环。
AI.result: 30项任务中，获得数值分的任务由6项增至17项，均分由62.5升至72.5，平均令牌消耗下降12.9%。
AI.conclusion: 城市风场结果的可用性依赖执行过程中将报告指标与原始证据关联的检查。

title: Long-Horizon Causal Inertial Odometry in Multistory Buildings
summary: In indoor 3D localization inside multistory buildings, an elevator or an escalator accelerates for a few seconds and then cruises at constant velocity for tens of seconds. Gait excitation disappears, the specific force degenerates into a constant gravity reaction, and instantaneous velocity becomes unobservable within a 1-2 s window. The output of short-window learned inertial odometry consequently degrades toward the conditional mean of the training set, and vertical displacement is systematically underestimated. We propose Local-Token Causal Attention (LTCA), a long-horizon architecture that compresses each 1 s inertial window into a 1 Hz motion token and sustains, over a bounded 60 s causal cache, the motion state established at the onset event. We further introduce a pluggable barometer branch that, when online, supplies a direct elevation constraint to the vertical channel through local differential height observations, and we train it with paired online/fallback conditional training so that the barometer also regularizes the representation shared by the two modes during training. On MSIO, our benchmark of nine buildings, the RoNIN and TLIO instances reach 3D trajectory errors (ATE-3D) of 2.83/4.18 m and 2.44/5.12 m on the Seen and Unseen splits, respectively, with the barometer online. With the barometer disabled at inference, the same weights fall back to pure inertial inference and reach 3.24/4.28 m and 2.64/5.23 m, still below every native short-window baseline. We further validate the framework on the public RoNIN and TLIO benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文以长时域因果注意力和可选气压计分支，改善多层建筑中的惯性里程计定位。
AI.motivation: 电梯或扶梯匀速运行时，短窗口内速度不可观测，导致学习式惯性里程计系统性低估垂直位移。
AI.method: 将每秒惯性窗口压缩为运动令牌并保留60秒因果缓存，结合可插拔气压分支与在线及回退配对训练。
AI.result: 在九栋建筑的MSIO基准上，两种实例关闭气压计后仍优于所有原生短窗口基线。
AI.conclusion: 长时域运动记忆与气压辅助训练有助于提升多层建筑定位，并支持同一权重回退到纯惯性推断。

title: SARGO: Agreement-Gated Reinforcement and Suppression via On-Policy Self-Guidance for Visual Hallucination Mitigation
summary: Vision-language models remain susceptible to visual hallucinations, often mixing grounded information with unsupported claims in the same response. Response-level reinforcement learning assigns a shared advantage to all tokens in a response, causing negative updates to suppress correct information alongside unsupported claims. To reduce hallucination while preserving useful visual information, we introduce SARGO (Self-guided Advantage-Routed Grounding Optimization), a post-training framework for selective reinforcement and suppression through on-policy self-guidance. Direct and reciprocal weighting gives better-supported tokens stronger reinforcement on positive updates and weaker penalties on negative updates. Agreement between overall and hallucination-specific advantages selects when to apply this guidance. At the response level, a reference-calibrated reward couples factuality with the retention and expansion of grounded information, discouraging lower hallucination scores obtained through omission. Experiments on Qwen3-VL-4B, Qwen3-VL-8B, and Gemma3-4B demonstrate that SARGO outperforms the evaluated mitigation baselines across Obj-Hal, AMBER, THRONE, and SHR evaluations. SARGO achieves these gains while preserving useful visual information and general multimodal capabilities.

AI.tldr: SARGO通过选择性强化与抑制，减少视觉语言模型幻觉并保留有用视觉信息。
AI.motivation: 响应级强化学习对所有令牌分配相同优势，可能在惩罚幻觉时同时压制正确内容。
AI.method: 以整体和幻觉专属优势的一致性门控令牌加权，并用参考校准奖励兼顾真实性与有依据的信息保留及扩展。
AI.result: 在三种模型及Obj-Hal等四项评测中，SARGO优于所比较的缓解基线，并保留有用视觉信息及通用多模态能力。
AI.conclusion: 基于在策略自指导的优势路由可缓解视觉幻觉，避免仅靠省略信息降低幻觉评分。

title: Pixel-KWS: Rendered-Glyph Representations for Orthographically Robust Open-Vocabulary Keyword Spotting
summary: Open-vocabulary keyword spotting (KWS) allows users to enroll arbitrary keywords at inference time. However, character and phoneme-based text encoders rely on fixed symbol vocabularies learned during training, limiting their ability to handle unseen or visually similar symbols such as homoglyphs, l33tspeak substitutions, and accented characters. We propose PIXEL-KWS, an open-vocabulary KWS framework that represents characters through rendered glyphs rather than learned embedding lookups. We render each character as a grayscale image and encode it with a lightweight CNN, enabling the text encoder to generalize from visual form rather than a fixed vocabulary. On LibriPhrase, PIXEL-KWS and its matched character-based counterpart achieve 9.57% and 9.55% EER on LibriPhrase-hard, 0.43% and 0.41% EER on LibriPhrase-easy, outperforming all published baselines without pre-training or synthetic data. PIXEL-KWS provides substantially greater robustness to both homoglyph and l33tspeak symbol-level perturbations. These results highlight glyph-based representations as a simple and effective approach for robust open-vocabulary KWS in practical settings.

AI.tldr: PIXEL-KWS以渲染字形替代字符嵌入，提高开放词汇关键词检测对符号扰动的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 依赖固定符号词表的字符和音素编码器难以处理未见字符、同形异码字符及数字替字。
AI.method: 将每个字符渲染为灰度图像，再用轻量卷积网络编码，使文本表示基于视觉形态泛化。
AI.result: LibriPhrase难集与易集等错误率为9.57%和0.43%，接近字符对照且对同形异码及数字替字扰动更稳健。
AI.conclusion: 字形表示无需预训练或合成数据，即可为开放词汇关键词检测提供实用的正字法鲁棒性。

title: Detecting Small Space Objects for Space Situational Awareness with Collaborative Edge AI
summary: With the rapid growth of space activities, near-Earth space is becoming increasingly congested, leading to a higher risk of spacecraft collisions and space debris generation. Recent close-proximity encounters and collision incidents necessitate efficient and cost-effective onboard systems for space object detection (SOD) and collision avoidance. While deep learning (DL) enabled Edge AI using low-cost vision sensors on single or multiple satellites has shown promises for SOD, significant challenges remain, including limited datasets, small SOD, and the lack of comprehensive performance assessments. This paper presents a collaborative Edge AI framework for multiview SOD and systematically benchmarks DL models and fusion strategies. Results show that higher image resolution significantly improves small SOD. For multiple views, image-level fusion reduces the combined communication and inference latency by 30.13% and 32.80% on average compared with feature-level and attention-based fusion across the evaluated inter-satellite link (ISL) bandwidth. For larger view sets, feature-level and attention-based fusion achieve better detection accuracy at the cost of analysis in the sensing-communication pipeline, revealing that multiview collaboration introduces minimal latency overhead under ISL constraints when reception capacity is not exceeded. Our work provides valuable design insights for future collaborative satellite network design, supporting the emerging space situational awareness and space traffic management requirements.

AI.tldr: 本文评估协同边缘人工智能的多视角小型空间目标检测，揭示融合策略的精度与时延权衡。
AI.motivation: 近地空间拥挤加剧碰撞风险，而低成本星载视觉检测仍面临数据有限、小目标难检及评估不足等挑战。
AI.method: 提出多视角空间目标检测协同边缘框架，系统比较深度学习模型及图像级、特征级和注意力融合。
AI.result: 图像级融合较特征级和注意力融合平均降低通信与推理总时延30.13%和32.80%，后两者在更多视角下精度更高。
AI.conclusion: 提高分辨率有益于小目标检测，且接收容量未超限时，多视角协作可仅引入很小的时延开销。

title: Optimal Coordination of Multiple Ancillary Service Provisions in Active Distribution Networks
summary: We propose a multi-rate model predictive control (MPC) framework for coordinating primary frequency control (PFC), automatic generation control (AGC), and voltage control (VC) in active distribution networks. The framework allocates distributed energy resource (DER) flexibility among these three ancillary services while retaining their different update rates. To account for the intertemporal flexibility of electric vehicle aggregations and aggregations of buildings with thermostatically controlled loads (TCLs), we incorporate time-varying power-energy envelopes into our multi-rate MPC formulation. These constraints couple the combined PFC and AGC response to the demand-side flexibility available later in the prediction horizon. Furthermore, the input-multirate structure enables coordinated ancillary service provision by DERs with different response dynamics. The controller optimizes the three services together, allowing fast regulation to be coordinated with the developing slow response within the available DER flexibility. We demonstrate the coordinated provision of the three ancillary services through closed-loop simulations on a modified IEEE 33-bus system using a nonlinear differential-algebraic model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多速率模型预测控制框架，协调主动配电网的一次调频、自动发电控制和电压控制。
AI.motivation: 分布式能源需在不同更新速率和响应动态下，为多种辅助服务分配有限且跨时段耦合的灵活性。
AI.method: 在输入多速率模型预测控制中加入电动车及温控建筑聚合的时变功率—能量包络，联合优化三类服务。
AI.result: 基于非线性微分代数模型的改进IEEE 33节点系统闭环仿真，展示了三类辅助服务的协调提供。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够在可用分布式能源灵活性约束内，协调快速调节与逐步发展的慢速响应。

title: Confidence Without Cause: Predicting and Localizing Physics-Shortcut Sensitivity in Language Model Hidden States
summary: A language model's confidence on a physics problem deserves trust only if it ignores details irrelevant to the answer. We introduce DECOY (Distractor-Embedded Certified cOunterfactuals for phYsics): 155 families of four prompts differing in one irrelevant detail. A symbolic solver certifies that each edit preserves the answer. Families are labelled by the largest drop in the model's log-probability of the certified answer, using a threshold fixed before probe training. Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct is sensitive on 50.0% of the 140 families yielding labels, and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct on 22.9%. Effects are largest when distractor values lie numerically close to the answer. A linear probe on Qwen's layer-18 hidden state, averaged over four renderings, predicts sensitivity before generation at AUROC 0.760 with whole families held out. A separately tuned single-rendering probe reaches 0.747. A frozen layer-16 probe reaches 0.820 pooled AUROC on 15 families built after training, though within-cue-type AUROC is lower (0.667-0.6875). Under a paired family bootstrap, the probe performs on par with a fitted token-entropy baseline (AUROC 0.727) and achieves the lowest Brier score among tested predictors (0.204 versus 0.214). Knocking out four attention heads at layer 16 cancels sensitivity on a 20-family panel, localising it to a narrow mechanism. These results show that Qwen's confidence can track irrelevant details, that this failure is detectable before generation, and that targeted intervention can suppress it. DECOY provides certified ground truth and paired-tested baselines for evaluating hidden-state monitors.

AI.tldr: 本文用经认证的物理反事实提示，检测并定位语言模型置信度对无关细节的敏感性。
AI.motivation: 物理问题中的无关细节可能改变模型对正确答案的置信度，因此需要可验证的检测与机制定位。
AI.method: 构建155组经符号求解器认证的DECOY提示，结合隐藏状态线性探针、成组评估和注意力头消融。
AI.result: Qwen与Llama在140组可标注样本上的敏感比例为50.0%和22.9%，Qwen第18层探针AUROC为0.760。
AI.conclusion: Qwen的无关细节敏感性可在生成前检测，且在20组测试中移除四个注意力头可消除该敏感性。

title: Switching Structure and Finite-Event Optima for One-Orbit Minimum-Fuel In-Plane HCW Maneuvers
summary: Under in-plane Hill$\unicode{x2013}$Clohessy$\unicode{x2013}$Wiltshire dynamics with independently bounded radial and along-track thrust, we prove that every target reachable within one orbit has a fixed-time minimum-fuel control with at most ten switches. We first show that regular optima have at most four radial and six along-track switches, coupled through a shared costate. Of the 35 candidate count pairs, 11 require minimum durations, one cannot be optimal, and 23 are attainable at arbitrarily short durations. We then convert singular-arc optima into bang/off optima with at most five switches by preserving terminal moments. We demonstrate terminal accuracy and whole-arc Pontryagin consistency through 55,296 numerical transfers.

AI.tldr: 证明单轨道周期内可达目标均存在切换次数不超过十次的平面HCW定时最省燃料控制。
AI.motivation: 明确径向与沿轨推力独立受限时，单轨道周期内最省燃料机动的切换结构。
AI.method: 利用共享协态分析常规最优控制，并通过保持终端矩将奇异弧转换为推力开启或关闭的控制。
AI.result: 常规最优控制径向至多切换四次、沿轨至多六次，且55,296次数值转移验证了终端精度与庞特里亚金一致性。
AI.conclusion: 单轨道周期内的定时最省燃料解可由有限次切换实现，奇异弧最优解可转换为至多五次切换的控制。

title: SplatFlow3D: Learning Scene Flow via 3D Motion Feature Splatting
summary: Considering the motion continuity and stability of 3D objects over short inter-frame intervals, introducing multi-frame settings in scene flow estimation can potentially address occlusion. In this paper, we propose a two-frame backbone, SimpleFlow3D, which integrates dense information from the image plane and sparse information from the depth dimension in a decoupling-followed-by-coupling manner by hierarchically constructing the 3D motion feature. SimpleFlow3D achieves SOTA results with minimal parameters. We also propose a weight-sharing multi-frame framework to splat the previous 3D motion feature to the current estimation process. The framework unifies the first and non-first frame inference by constructing pseudo inputs. After combining the proposed framework and backbone, the newly born multi-frame method SplatFlow3D further advances the state of the art. It achieves lower errors than the two-frame backbone, with fewer parameters than current methods. On both KITTI and Spring, SplatFlow3D ranked 1st over all published and submitted methods. Experiments show that SplatFlow3D improves occlusion handling, non-rigid motion estimation, and generalization to real-world scenes. Code is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: SplatFlow3D通过共享权重传播历史三维运动特征，以较少参数提升多帧场景流估计。
AI.motivation: 利用三维物体短时间内的运动连续性与稳定性，缓解场景流估计中的遮挡问题。
AI.method: 构建融合图像稠密信息与深度稀疏信息的双帧骨干，并将历史运动特征泼溅至当前帧估计。
AI.result: SplatFlow3D在KITTI和Spring上位居已发表及已提交方法首位，并改善遮挡、非刚性运动估计及真实场景泛化。
AI.conclusion: 历史三维运动特征复用可在保持较少参数的同时，进一步提高场景流估计精度。

title: PMR: MoE Routing with Shared Prototypes and Congestion Pricing
summary: Conventional linear routers in sparse mixture-of-experts models select experts directly from token-expert matching scores, coupling input matching with expert allocation. We propose Prototype-Mediated Routing (PMR), a two-stage router with shared prototypes. PMR first computes each token's distribution over prototypes, then uses it to mix prototype-conditioned expert distributions according to the law of total probability. This formulation models input matching and expert allocation separately, explicitly represents many-to-many associations between prototypes and experts, and provides separate interfaces for context adaptation and load regulation. Within this framework, short-term states summarize preceding tokens to adapt the prototypes, while congestion prices updated from dispatch feedback achieve loss-free load balancing by adjusting the conditional expert distributions. We use a two-pass blockwise approximation to accelerate short-term state processing, achieving over 20 times the training throughput of the eager tokenwise PMR implementation while maintaining high agreement in routing decisions. Across three pretraining configurations with 0.43B, 1.18B, and 0.48B total parameters, PMR improves mean zero-shot accuracy on seven benchmarks over linear routing baselines with matched expert architectures by 1.54, 2.65, and 1.45 percentage points (pp), respectively. The corresponding gains on ARC-Easy are 6.71, 5.80, and 3.92 pp. In parameter-efficient fine-tuning of 7B-8B backbones, PMR's improvements over MixLoRA vary across backbones, with gains of up to 1.76 pp in mean accuracy across four tasks.

AI.tldr: PMR以共享原型解耦输入匹配与专家分配，通过上下文适配和拥塞定价改善混合专家路由。
AI.motivation: 传统线性路由耦合词元匹配与专家分配，限制了上下文适配和负载调节的独立设计。
AI.method: 先计算词元的原型分布，再混合原型条件专家分布，并以短期状态和拥塞价格调节路由。
AI.result: 三种预训练配置的平均零样本准确率提升1.54、2.65和1.45个百分点，分块实现训练吞吐量超过逐词元实现的20倍。
AI.conclusion: 原型中介路由在所测预训练配置中改善性能，其参数高效微调收益随骨干而异。

title: Do Pretraining Optimizer Gains Transfer to KL Distillation?
summary: Matrix-structured optimizers can improve language-model pretraining, but it is unclear whether these gains transfer to short-horizon KL distillation from an instruction-tuned initialization. We compare AdamW and diagonal AdaGrad with two tractable Shampoo reductions, SOAP, and All-2D Muon across four dense Qwen student-teacher pairs under a common forward-KL objective and fixed training budget. Across scales, none of the evaluated matrix-structured recipes consistently improves the quality versus trainer-time trade-off over the elementwise references: AdamW generally attains the lowest validation KL, while AdaGrad can be slightly faster at larger scale. SOAP often tracks AdamW in KL but incurs substantial trainer-time overhead, and the two Shampoo reductions reverse ordering across model pairs, showing that conclusions depend on the feasible recipe. These results suggest that pretraining optimizer gains do not transfer automatically to KL distillation and should be re-established for the target objective and systems regime.

AI.tldr: 矩阵结构优化器在预训练中的优势未能稳定迁移至短周期前向KL蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 检验从指令微调初始化开展短周期KL蒸馏时，预训练优化器收益是否仍然成立。
AI.method: 在四组稠密Qwen师生模型上，以统一前向KL目标和固定预算比较逐元素与多种矩阵结构优化器。
AI.result: 矩阵结构方案均未持续改善质量与训练时间权衡，AdamW通常获得最低验证KL，AdaGrad在较大规模下略快。
AI.conclusion: 优化器在预训练中的收益不能自动推广至KL蒸馏，应针对目标任务与系统条件重新验证。

title: Federated versus Centralized PV Capacity-Factor Forecasting: A Non-Inferiority Study Across Seven Stations in North Macedonia
summary: Background: Photovoltaic (PV) forecasts inform energy commitments by PV operators and aggregators and guide charge-discharge scheduling in solar-plus-storage systems. Federated learning enables collaborative model training through model updates when local operators cannot pool raw operational data. This study evaluated whether federated training was non-inferior to centralized training for PV capacity-factor prediction across seven stations in North Macedonia. A common multilayer perceptron was used in an offline forecasting comparison with a 24-hour timestamp lag. Exploratory validation compared local, centralized, Federated Averaging, and Federated Proximal (FedProx) training. FedProx (E = 1, mu = 1) was selected for a confirmatory comparison under a protocol fixed before test evaluation. The comparison used past-only offline inputs, five paired training seeds, macro-averaged mean absolute error (MAE), a prespecified non-inferiority margin of 0.005, and a paired day bootstrap with 10,000 repetitions over 49 test dates. Results: FedProx achieved a macro-MAE of 0.128397, compared with 0.133405 for centralized training. The paired difference (FedProx minus centralized) was -0.005008 (95% confidence interval: [-0.009926, -0.000537]). The upper confidence bound was below the prespecified margin, satisfying the non-inferiority criterion. All five seed-specific differences favored FedProx, and its mean MAE was lower at six of the seven stations. Post hoc calendar sensitivity analyses did not change the conclusion. Conclusions: These findings support further evaluation of federated forecasting for collaboration under data-pooling constraints. The study demonstrates predictive non-inferiority within the evaluated setting. Benefits for energy commitments and battery scheduling remain potential applications requiring operational evaluation.
comment: Submitted to Energy, Sustainability and Society

AI.tldr: 北马其顿七座光伏站的离线预测中，FedProx满足相对集中训练的预设非劣效标准。
AI.motivation: 评估无法汇集原始运营数据时，联邦训练能否维持集中式光伏容量因子预测的精度。
AI.method: 采用统一多层感知机、五组配对种子和配对日自助法，按预定0.005非劣效界值比较FedProx与集中训练。
AI.result: FedProx与集中训练的宏平均绝对误差分别为0.128397和0.133405，差值95%置信区间上界低于非劣效界值。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持在数据汇集受限场景继续评估联邦预测，但能源承诺和储能调度收益仍需运营验证。

title: Fault Diagnosis and Fault-Tolerant Operation Strategy for Triple-Port Hydrogen Production System
summary: The multi-port converter offers significant advantages in sustainable energy-based hydrogen production, such as high energy density and wide application potential. As the core energy hub in these systems, the multi-port hydrogen converter demands high reliability. However, its numerous switches and complex operation increase the risk of failure. Currently, there are no effective fault diagnosis or fault tolerance solutions for these systems. Current fault diagnosis methods for two-port and multi-port converters rely on many sensors, have low accuracy, and cannot handle multi-switch faults. Additionally, existing fault tolerance strategies fall short in maintaining stable power for the electrolyzer and do not allow capacity sharing among ports. This paper proposes a fault diagnosis method for open-circuit faults in a triple-port hydrogen converter and a corresponding fault-tolerant operating strategy. By optimizing a random forest algorithm with a sparrow search algorithm, high-precision multi-switch fault diagnosis is achieved using only three current sensors. Fault-tolerant operation of the system is achieved through an auxiliary switch after a failure. Additionally, power sharing between output ports can be realized. This ensures the efficient and stable operation of the hydrogen production system. The effectiveness of this solution has been validated through simulations and experiments.

AI.tldr: 提出仅用三个电流传感器诊断三端口制氢变换器多开关开路故障并实现容错运行的方案。
AI.motivation: 现有诊断方案传感器多、精度不足且难处理多开关故障，容错策略也难保障电解槽供电与端口容量共享。
AI.method: 以麻雀搜索算法优化随机森林诊断开路故障，并通过辅助开关实现故障后容错运行及输出端口功率共享。
AI.result: 仿真与实验验证了方案有效性，可实现高精度多开关故障诊断、故障后运行及端口间功率共享。
AI.conclusion: 所提诊断与容错策略有助于保障三端口制氢系统的高效稳定运行。

title: Memorization Lives in a Few Attention Heads: Mitigating Memorization in Diffusion Models via Projection-Based Suppression
summary: Diffusion models can memorize and reproduce training samples during inference, raising serious privacy and copyright concerns. Existing inference-time mitigation methods often suppress conditional information globally, which may reduce memorization but can also harm semantic alignment and image quality. In this paper, we revisit memorization from the perspective of cross-attention heads. Through systematic analysis and targeted ablation, we find that memorization is mainly driven by a small subset of shallow-layer attention heads with abnormally strong semantic control, rather than by the entire cross-attention mechanism. Motivated by this finding, we propose Projection-based Top-k Attention Head Suppression, a targeted inference-time mitigation method. Our method first identifies the top-k attention heads most related to memorization using a semantic-control score, and then removes their condition-specific components through directional projection between conditional and unconditional representations. This design selectively weakens memorization-related features while preserving useful semantic information. Extensive experiments on different diffusion models and datasets show that our method effectively reduces memorization and achieves a better trade-off between memorization mitigation and image quality than existing approaches.

AI.tldr: 扩散模型的记忆主要集中于少数浅层注意力头，定向投影抑制可兼顾记忆缓解与图像质量。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型复现训练样本引发隐私与版权风险，而全局抑制条件信息可能损害语义对齐和图像质量。
AI.method: 按语义控制分数识别最相关的若干注意力头，并通过条件与无条件表示间的方向投影去除条件特异分量。
AI.result: 多模型与多数据集实验显示，该方法有效减少记忆，并较现有方法取得更好的记忆缓解与图像质量权衡。
AI.conclusion: 针对少数记忆相关注意力头进行推理时干预，比全局抑制更有利于保留有效语义信息。

title: Hydrogen in Practice: A Global Review of Demonstration Projects from Production to Integration
summary: Hydrogen technology has the potential to address various challenges related to integrating low- and zero-carbon energy sources, as well as achieving carbon neutrality. It provides valuable solutions for transitioning to net-zero emission energy systems on a global scale. The implementation of hydrogen production and integration demonstration projects has received significant attention around the world and strong support from governments, highlighting the crucial role of such initiatives in the advancement of hydrogen energy. However, research in this area remains limited, particularly in terms of comprehensive and systematic reviews of industrial practices under real-world conditions. To bridge this gap, this article provides an in-depth review of hydrogen production, storage, and industrial applications, summarizing key features of thirteen exemplary hydrogen demonstration projects from around the world. The goal is to offer insights and guidance for the large-scale deployment of hydrogen energy while identifying potential technological pathways for the future.

AI.tldr: 综述全球十三个氢能示范项目，梳理制氢、储氢与工业应用实践，为规模化部署提供参考。
AI.motivation: 氢能示范项目受到广泛支持，但对真实工业条件下实践的全面系统综述仍然不足。
AI.method: 深入回顾氢气生产、储存和工业应用，并总结全球十三个代表性示范项目的关键特征。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体结果。
AI.conclusion: 综述旨在为氢能大规模部署提供见解与指导，并识别未来潜在技术路径。

title: Prepare Lighter and Faster for Open-Vocabulary Queries: A Query-Wise 3D Segmenter for Gaussian Splatting
summary: Open-vocabulary 3D understanding aims to localize and segment arbitrary objects beyond predefined categories. However, existing approaches based on Gaussian Splatting often rely on expensive preprocessing and lengthy training, limiting their applicability when fast and lightweight solutions are desired. We propose a lightweight, training-free framework for query-driven 3D instance segmentation on Gaussian Splatting. Instead of conventional mask-wise CLIP embeddings, we use dense pixel-level CLIP features to preserve fine-grained semantic information and enable flexible text-driven localization without relying on predefined instance proposals. Given a text query, we identify a high-quality target region in a carefully selected pivot view and propagate it across views using a video segmentor, providing consistent and comprehensive coverage of the target instance. We then lift the resulting 2D tracklets to 3D Gaussians through a novel visibility voting strategy, yielding accurate 3D segmentation masks with clean object boundaries. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on LERF-OVS, ScanNet, and ScanNet++, competitive results on 3D-OVS, and significant speedups over existing open-vocabulary 3D segmentation methods. These results highlight the effectiveness of our framework for efficient open-vocabulary 3D understanding without per-scene training.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的查询驱动三维分割框架，在高斯泼溅场景中实现快速、轻量的开放词汇实例分割。
AI.motivation: 现有高斯泼溅开放词汇理解方法依赖昂贵预处理和长时间训练，难以满足轻量快速应用需求。
AI.method: 利用像素级CLIP特征定位目标，经视频分割器跨视角传播，再通过可见性投票映射至三维高斯。
AI.result: 在LERF-OVS、ScanNet和ScanNet++上达到最优水平，在3D-OVS上具有竞争力，且显著加速。
AI.conclusion: 无需逐场景训练，也能实现边界清晰且高效的开放词汇三维实例分割。

title: Do Rule-Based Tools Help LLMs Translate Endangered Uralic Languages in the Prompt or over MCP?
summary: Komi-Zyrian, Moksha, Erzya and Udmurt have mature rule-based resources, among them finite-state analysers, constraint grammars and bilingual dictionaries, which language models do not use. We ask whether giving a model access to these resources improves machine translation from the four languages into English, and whether it matters how the access is provided: as analyses computed in advance and written into the prompt, or as tools that the model calls itself through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). We evaluate manually: an expert linguist read every English output of the strongest model under three conditions, 816 sentences in all, accepted or rejected each one, and named the main error in every rejected translation. With the analyses in the prompt, the number of accepted translations rises from 13 to 43 out of 272; with the tools attached it rises to 55. The gain comes from the bilingual dictionary. For Udmurt, whose dictionary has no English side, the prompt-based condition brings no gain at all, while for the other three languages an English gloss reaches the prompt for 74 to 80% of the source words. Tool calling is also much harder to get working than prompt injection. Of 31 open-weight models, 14 never call a tool, 11 of them because they cannot produce a usable call, and half of the calls that are made name a language the toolkit does not support. We release the data set, every model output and all tool-call logs.
comment: Accepted at the 11th International Workshop on Computational Linguistics for Uralic Languages (IWCLUL 2026), Munich. 9 pages plus appendices, 1 figure, 10 tables. Data and all model outputs: this https URL

AI.tldr: 规则资源可改善四种濒危乌拉尔语言的英译，主要收益来自双语词典，但模型自主调用工具仍困难。
AI.motivation: 这些语言已有成熟规则资源，但语言模型尚未有效利用，且不同资源接入方式的翻译收益不明。
AI.method: 比较提示中预置分析与MCP工具调用，由语言学专家评审最强模型三种条件下共816句译文。
AI.result: 每272句的合格译文由13句增至提示接入的43句和工具接入的55句，但31个开放权重模型中14个不调用工具。
AI.conclusion: 双语词典是翻译改善的主要来源，工具接入收益较高，但可用调用的实现难度也更大。

title: Few-Shot Visual Concept Extraction for Steering Diffusion Transformers
summary: Image steering aims to provide fine-grained control over concepts in generated images, enabling targeted and continuous manipulation without broadly altering the generation process. Recent steering methods for diffusion models primarily focus on the text-conditioning space or rely on costly auxiliary training. Deviating from that, we here propose a novel steering approach that extracts visual concept directions directly from the image-side activations of Diffusion Transformers. Specifically, we showcase few-shot concept extraction in the activation space using a simple difference-of-means estimator over intermediate residuals. We observe (a) scene-level concepts such as lighting, weather, and style are distributed across image tokens, as well as (b) local concepts such as object colors, textures, materials, and facial attributes are concentrated in specific regions. Towards controlling both concepts, we introduce a new unified training-free framework that uses global difference-of-means for (a) distributed concepts and masked difference-of-means for (b) local concepts, preventing local signals from being diluted by global averaging. Notably, using only a handful of positive and negative prompt pairs, our method identifies and extracts reusable concept directions that can be injected at inference for continuous steering. Quantitatively, our method outperforms text-encoder steering and training-free activation-editing baselines, as well as is competitive with specialized editing models. Our results suggest that as concept directions can be applied at patch level, our method enables precise targeted and compositional steering, manipulating multiple concepts in the same image.

AI.tldr: 从扩散Transformer图像侧激活中少样本提取概念方向，无需训练即可连续控制全局与局部视觉属性。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型控制方法主要操作文本条件空间或依赖昂贵辅助训练，难以兼顾精细性与低成本。
AI.method: 以少量正负提示对计算中间残差的均值差，对全局概念直接聚合，对局部概念采用掩码后在推理时注入。
AI.result: 定量表现优于文本编码器控制和免训练激活编辑基线，并可与专用编辑模型竞争。
AI.conclusion: 图像侧概念方向可复用并按图像块施加，支持同一图像内多个概念的精确组合控制。

title: Architectures and KV Replay for Depth-Recurrent Language Models
summary: Depth recurrence increases effective model depth by repeatedly applying a fixed computation block. However, sharing attention parameters does not share the key-value (KV) states generated at different recurrence iterations, which causes memory growth with recurrence depth during autoregressive decoding. We study how to reduce this memory cost through architectural and cache-sharing approaches within a common depth-recurrent framework. We first study a looped hybrid that repeats a stack of Transformer layers, with recurrent mLSTM or Gated DeltaNet blocks replacing most attention layers and periodic Transformer attention anchors retained. We then restrict recurrence to a dedicated recurrent workspace in a Parcae-style architecture and test its stabilising adapter as a wrapper for the looped hybrid. Finally, we train a looped Transformer with recurrent KV replay, where only selected recurrence iterations write KV states that later iterations reuse. This trains the model to operate with the same shared KV topology used during inference. We find that looped hybrids require sufficiently frequent attention anchors, with performance depending strongly on the recurrent mixer. For cross-iteration KV sharing, recurrent KV replay allows multiple recurrence iterations to reuse the same KV states while retaining performance close to the full looped Transformer with separate KV caches for each iteration.

AI.tldr: 研究深度循环语言模型的架构与KV共享，利用循环KV重放降低缓存开销并保持接近完整模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 共享注意力参数并不共享各循环轮次的KV状态，导致自回归解码内存随循环深度增长。
AI.method: 比较混合循环层、专用循环工作区及稳定适配器，并训练仅由指定轮次写入、后续轮次复用KV的Transformer。
AI.result: 混合模型需要足够密集的注意力锚点；循环KV重放共享缓存后，性能仍接近各轮独立缓存的完整循环模型。
AI.conclusion: 在训练时匹配推理阶段的KV共享拓扑，可有效缓解深度循环模型的缓存增长问题。

title: CLEW: Log-Anchored Backward Tracing for Root-Cause Code Localization
summary: Failures in industrial software systems may involve multiple components and be difficult to reproduce outside the production environment. Root-cause code localization therefore often relies on issue descriptions and runtime logs. However, log evidence may be noisy or incomplete, and the code reporting a symptom may differ from the code containing the underlying defect. These conditions make it challenging to identify relevant log evidence and determine which functions could have caused the reported failure. To address this gap, we introduce CLEW, an agentic approach that combines rule-based log-to-code anchoring with LLM-guided backward code tracing. CLEW organizes selected observations into diagnostic states, guides source exploration from anchored symptom functions, and returns ranked candidate functions, an affected module, and an explanation comprising a proposed mechanism path and associated log events. For evaluation, we construct LogLoc, a benchmark comprising 192 real-world issue and fault-injection cases. Against three baselines, CLEW records the highest observed Acc@1 (77.3%) and MRR (81.3%) on LogLoc-Issues and matches the leading baselines at 97.6% Acc@1 on LogLoc-Airflow. Averaged over all 192 cases, CLEW's wall-clock time is approximately 73% lower than LocAgent's at a similar average inference cost. No aggregate degradation is observed under the tested perturbations, with modest changes in Acc@1 and MRR across the evaluated seeds and base models. These results suggest that CLEW can combine function-level localization with evidence links and runtime efficiency under the evaluated conditions.

AI.tldr: CLEW结合日志锚定与大模型引导的逆向代码追踪，实现带证据解释的高效根因函数定位。
AI.motivation: 工业故障难以复现，日志可能噪声大或不完整，且报告症状的代码往往不同于缺陷所在代码。
AI.method: 将规则式日志代码锚定与诊断状态组织结合，从症状函数逆向探索，输出候选函数排序、模块和机制路径。
AI.result: 在LogLoc-Issues上Acc@1为77.3%、MRR为81.3%，全192例耗时较LocAgent约低73%。
AI.conclusion: 在评测条件下，CLEW兼顾函数级定位、证据关联与运行效率，测试扰动未导致总体性能下降。

title: Efficient and Accurate Causal Validation of Training Data Attribution
summary: Causal validation of training data attribution (TDA) methods is costly, since evaluation involves retraining a model on many different subsets of the original training set. For example, the Linear Datamodeling Score (LDS), which has become a standard metric for evaluating TDA methods, measures the correlation between TDA predictions and expected retrained model outputs. In this paper, we reduce the amount of computation needed to estimate the LDS along three axes: the number of sampled training subsets, the number of retraining seeds per subset, and the number of models in the attribution ensemble. Each of these factors induces a form of bias in the LDS estimation, and removing these sources of bias significantly reduces the number of retrainings needed to match the same accuracy in LDS estimation. On ResNet-9/CIFAR-10, finite-subset debiasing achieves $3.2\%$ relative RMSE with as few as $4$ subsets, and $32$ subsets match the accuracy of ordinary Spearman using $96$ subsets, measured against a 300-subset reference. On ResNet-9/CIFAR-10, BERT/QNLI and GPT-2/WikiText-2, estimating the training-noise variance allows us to reproduce the standard five-seed LDS at the same accuracy with $2$--$5\times$ fewer retrainings.

AI.tldr: 通过校正训练子集、重训随机种子及归因集成规模引入的偏差，降低训练数据归因因果验证成本。
AI.motivation: 训练数据归因的线性数据建模分数评估依赖大量子集重训，计算昂贵且有限采样会引入偏差。
AI.method: 分析并消除三类有限采样偏差，同时估计训练噪声方差，以更少重训准确估计线性数据建模分数。
AI.result: ResNet-9/CIFAR-10上32个子集达到普通Spearman用96个子集的精度，多任务重训次数减少2至5倍。
AI.conclusion: 偏差校正和训练噪声估计可在保持分数估计精度的同时，显著减少因果验证所需重训。

title: Predicting, Fast and Slow: SSD Already Knows Which Guess Is Wrong
summary: Heimdall, a learned controller, calls slow on 52% of an SSD's reads when 30% are slow. Uncertainty estimators, the remedy prescribed for its wrong guesses, cannot find them: nine of them do no better than a coin. The drive can. On one trace, 2% of the reads of 4 to 8 KiB that found less than 4 KiB outstanding while the drive was answering came back slow, and Heimdall called 96% of them slow. A 4,096-entry table of how the drive's recent reads came back, untrained and 21 ns a decision, ranks the wrong guesses at a median AUROC of 0.68 on 57 held-out traces, where the nine sit at 0.46 to 0.52, and it predicts slow reads better than Heimdall itself.

AI.tldr: 利用SSD近期读取结果构建的小型无训练表，比通用不确定性估计器更能识别Heimdall的错误预测。
AI.motivation: Heimdall过度预测慢读取，而九种不确定性估计器识别错误的表现接近随机，需利用设备自身信息。
AI.method: 构建含4096个条目的近期读取结果表，无需训练，以每次21纳秒的开销评估预测错误。
AI.result: 在57条留出轨迹上，错误识别AUROC中位数为0.68，九种估计器为0.46至0.52，慢读取预测也优于Heimdall。
AI.conclusion: SSD近期行为提供了通用不确定性估计器未能捕捉的有效信号，可低成本改善读取延迟预测。

title: Program Distillation: Transferring LLM Capability from System 2 to System 0
summary: Recent studies leverage large language models (LLMs) to construct executable programs through environment interaction, feedback analysis, and code revision. However, prior work has mainly treated LLMs as optimizers, overlooking their ability to transfer knowledge across system levels. We propose Program Distillation (PD), a framework that formalizes the transfer of abilities from System 2 to System 0. During learning, the LLM provides task knowledge and draft strategies; at deployment, a student program executes the resulting policy. We show that this approach can improve performance while reducing inference time. We introduce PDBench, a benchmark comprising 27 discrete- and continuous-control tasks with fixed initial policies, and PDMetaHarness, a model-harness-independent meta-system for monitoring and guiding the learning process. The strongest model achieves a normalized mean score of 0.728, surpassing PPO (0.656) and Jev-like decision models (0.239), while running exclusively on CPUs and reducing inference costs. Our analysis shows that performance is largely driven by the first breakthrough during learning, and structural modifications have a slightly lower success rate than parameter modifications but typically yield larger gains. We further introduce style distillation, which enables interpretable stylistic control over the learning process. Overall, we present an analytical framework for PD and demonstrate its practical viability.

AI.tldr: 程序蒸馏将大模型的推理能力转移至可执行策略程序，在控制任务上提高性能并降低部署推理成本。
AI.motivation: 既有研究主要将大模型视为程序优化器，忽略其向不同系统层级转移任务知识和能力的潜力。
AI.method: 由大模型提供知识与初始策略、学生程序负责部署执行，并构建27任务PDBench及学习监控引导元系统。
AI.result: 最强模型归一化均分为0.728，高于PPO的0.656和Jev类决策模型的0.239，且仅用CPU执行。
AI.conclusion: 程序蒸馏具备实践可行性，首次学习突破贡献较大，结构修改成功率略低但通常收益更高。

title: Semantics First, Pixels Later: Mission-Driven Event Streams for Drone Video over Bandwidth-Starved Links
summary: A surveillance drone on a bandwidth-starved link cannot send the video its operator would need, yet the operator's questions are often not about pixels: did three people converge, when, and where? We study what should cross a link of 1 Mbps down to 1 kbps instead, and in what order. BPS, a behavior-primitive stream, sends semantics first and pixels later: it runs a detector and a tracker onboard and sends short records (25 bytes on average) of multi-frame events selected by a mission card of 16-125 bytes, ahead of positions and pictures. We measure it by what a ground-side language model answers from it, under a preregistered protocol with a held-out set, against H.265 read by the vision fine-tune of the same model, H.265 on which the ground runs our own perception, a stream of quantized tracks, and onboard captions. On the development set (84% of questions about convergence, mostly one location) the event stream answers 74.3% of questions at 0.13 kbps. A reader that receives nothing answers 57.4%, and the video reader 59.6% at 100 kbps and 64.7% on the source frames. When the ground instead runs our perception on the video, video matches the stream at 100 kbps, about 800 times the stream's rate, and falls behind at 64 kbps and below. A track stream matches it at 96 times the bytes and loses 0.03 at 17 times. On held-out data the result is weaker: with events taken from annotated tracks, an oracle, the stream beats H.265 at 100 kbps (+0.13), but with onboard perception it does not (+0.01 [-0.04, +0.06]) and is no better than receiving nothing. Sent alone through emulated links the event records answer 0.739 at 1 Mbps and still 0.724 at 0.3 kbps; an every-frame track stream holds down to 1 kbps and video with ground-side perception down to about 100 kbps. On a Jetson Orin Nano the unchanged pipeline runs at 4.5 fps and misses most events.
comment: 20 pages, 3 figures; includes the supplementary material as an appendix; a demonstration video is attached as an ancillary file

AI.tldr: 无人机语义事件流可大幅节省传输带宽，但留出集效果受机载感知误差限制。
AI.motivation: 带宽匮乏时难以传输监控视频，而操作员往往只需了解任务相关事件。
AI.method: BPS在机载检测跟踪后，按任务卡优先发送多帧事件记录，并以地面模型问答评估。
AI.result: 开发集在0.13 kbps下答对74.3%，但真实感知下留出集不优于无输入，机载运行漏掉多数事件。
AI.conclusion: 语义优先传输具有带宽优势，但实际收益仍依赖感知可靠性与机载处理速度。

title: VAST: Compiling Grounded Vulnerability Scenarios into Verifiable, Multi-Step Environments for Evaluating LLM Red-Team Agents
summary: Evaluating Large Language Model (LLM) security agents requires reproducible environments whose workflow difficulty can be varied and whose failures can be diagnosed. We present VAST (Verifiable Adversarial Scenario Training & Evaluation), a declarative range compiler separating vulnerability scenarios from a compiler-introduced workflow-hardening layer. Following a post-hoc code and AST audit across all topics, the main benchmark retains 109 seed edges (45 with strict upstream CVE annotations), 72 family identifiers (62 under shared-HMAC relay grouping), 81 topic configurations (76 core plus 5 bounded execution models), and 1,387 instances (359 canonical four-gate-revalidated specs plus 1,028 seed variants) in a 42:39 partition. On the TopicServer compiler stratum, a budget-matched 270-episode prompt contrast across 10 compiled mechanism-family clusters (30 P2/P3/P4 instances, 40 turns, temperature 0.0) shows that glm-5.3, grok-4.7, and deepseek-v4-pro solve 12/90 instances under contract_only and 14/90 under generic_hint (cluster sign p=1.00), whereas supplying the shared workflow protocol in full_guide lifts completion to 76/90 (28/30, 23/30, 25/30; cluster sign p<=0.00391). On the separate ranges_v2 ledger, a 126-episode evaluation across 6 non-TopicServer workflows and multi-container Docker/Linux stacks solves 88/126 (69.8%) (28/42, 31/42, 29/42), while an 18-episode intervention on asynchronous Redis worker chaining (v2_02) lifts solves from 0/18 to 18/18 (100%) in 4-6 turns when installed worker modules are disclosed in GET /sched/directory. Finally, a three-seed (s in {42, 1024, 2025}) LoRA recipe comparison on Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct across 37 lineage-disjoint families (231 episodes on 33 held-out instances) yields 0/33 for Base, 1.67 +/- 2.89 / 33 for Golden SFT, and 4.67 +/- 2.31 / 33 for Header-Recovery SFT, with all solves on v2_03.
comment: 28 pages, 2 figures, 13 tables, including Appendices A.1-A.7

AI.tldr: VAST将漏洞场景编译为可验证多步环境，揭示工作流信息对安全智能体评估的重要影响。
AI.motivation: 评估大模型安全智能体需要可复现、难度可调且失败原因可诊断的环境。
AI.method: 以声明式编译器分离漏洞场景与工作流强化层，并开展提示对照、信息干预和LoRA训练实验。
AI.result: 主对照中完整工作流指南将完成数从12/90提升至76/90，Redis模块披露将成功数从0/18提升至18/18。
AI.conclusion: 工作流协议披露显著影响任务完成率，评估应区分漏洞能力与工作流信息障碍。

title: Successive Convexification in Learned World Models for Safe Offline Planning
summary: World models learned from offline data allow an agent to plan without further interaction with the environment, but the sampling-based planners used with them handle safety constraints only by scoring or rejecting sampled action sequences. We instead pose safe planning in the latent space of a learned world model as a successive convex program (SCP), in which a learned discrete-time control barrier function is imposed as a constraint at every step of the horizon. SCP requires smooth dynamics, so we build the networks from smoothed MaxMin activations and spectrally normalised layers, and bound the resulting linearisation error in terms of the Lipschitz bound and the smoothing width. As SCP is a local method, we start it from a sampled plan. On two Safety-Gymnasium navigation tasks with offline data, this planner has fewer violations than MPPI and CEM drawing 128 times as many samples at equal wall-clock time in our main comparison, though not significantly, and earns greater return at longer horizons, and is much safer than SCP without a sampled start. SCP converged more often on Lipschitz-bounded models. Unlike sampling, it also reports at each step whether its plan is a feasible, first-order optimal KKT point of the planning problem in the model, or that no feasible plan was found nearby. Our implementation is publicly available at this https URL.
comment: 28 pages, 13 figures. Under review at L4DC 2027

AI.tldr: 研究在离线世界模型中通过序列凸化显式约束安全，并报告模型内规划可行性。
AI.motivation: 现有采样式世界模型规划器仅通过评分或拒绝动作序列处理安全约束。
AI.method: 采用平滑激活与谱归一化构建动力学，以采样计划初始化序列凸规划并逐步施加控制屏障约束。
AI.result: 两项导航任务中违规少于同耗时采样基线但差异不显著，长时域回报更高，模型Lipschitz受限时更易收敛。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可提供模型内可行性与一阶最优性报告，但安全优势尚未达到统计显著。

title: Representing Differential Inclusions as Monads: A Framework for Compositional Controller Synthesis
summary: Sequential composition of safety-certified controllers for hybrid and non-smooth robotic systems is well studied piecewise. Yet no existing framework reduces this question to a single algebraic condition. We construct a \emph{trajectory monad} for Filippov-regular differential inclusions. Its Kleisli category treats controllers as morphisms and sequential execution as trajectory concatenation. Control Barrier Function (CBF) certification, a guarantee of forward invariance, corresponds to a sub-monad of this category. Joint safety of composed controllers then follows from one algebraic condition. All controllers must land in a common sub-monad, which is closed under the monad multiplication. The sub-monad condition recasts recasts existing CBF composition practice categorically. It explains why a smooth intersection of multiple barriers supports safe composition, while enforcing barriers phase by phase does not. For the phase-by-phase case, we derive a closed-form Bernoulli model of the failure rate. We validate it over a randomized sweep of 3{,}000 instances. The same sweep shows that the standard baseline degrades under constraint conflict as the barrier count grows. This baseline enforces all barriers simultaneously as constraints in a single quadratic program (QP). We instantiate the framework on a four-mode piecewise-affine system and on a unicycle reduced-order model over heterogeneous terrain.

AI.tldr: 研究用轨迹单子统一描述非光滑系统控制器组合，并以共同子单子条件保证安全。
AI.motivation: 混合与非光滑系统的安全控制器顺序组合缺乏统一的代数判据。
AI.method: 为Filippov正则微分包含构建轨迹单子，将控制屏障认证对应为对子单子封闭的条件。
AI.result: 3000个随机实例验证了分阶段屏障失效率模型，并显示同时约束QP基线随约束冲突和屏障数增加而退化。
AI.conclusion: 共同且对单子乘法封闭的安全子单子可保证组合安全，逐阶段执行屏障则未必安全。

title: Interpreting Random Forests: Comparing Surrogate Models and Rule Extraction Methods
summary: Random forests (RFs) often achieve high prediction performance, but their ensemble structure can be difficult to interpret. Surrogate models and rule extraction methods offer interpretable approximations, yet guidance on selecting an appropriate method for a specific research question remains limited. We compared 12 methods for interpreting RFs, with a decision tree as a prediction-oriented reference, across 11 simulation settings and 67 benchmark datasets for regression and classification. Evaluation addressed prediction and structural similarity to the RF, model complexity, prediction performance, and runtime. Simulations additionally assessed explainability using known effect and noise variables. No method performed best across all objectives. For regression, SLIM provided the strongest general performance for prediction similarity or performance on test data, while a linear model offered a simpler global interpretation of linear effects when performance was comparable. For classification, inTrees achieved the strongest overall benchmark performance, with CTree and OC-CART providing useful alternatives. ART consistently produced the most compact representations. NH and SIRUS offered strong structural similarity for regression, while MRT most closely reproduced RF variable usage in the classification simulations, illustrating that prediction-oriented rankings do not necessarily identify the best structural explanation. Outcome-type restrictions, runtime limits, and method-specific failures reduced result availability for several approaches and should be considered alongside performance when selecting a method. Method selection should therefore be guided by the outcome type, anticipated data structure, and intended interpretability objective. Prediction similarity alone is insufficient for explaining an RF and should be considered jointly with structural similarity and model complexity.

AI.tldr: 随机森林解释方法不存在全面最优者，应结合预测一致性、结构一致性与复杂度选择。
AI.motivation: 随机森林难以解释，而针对具体研究问题选择替代模型或规则提取方法的指导不足。
AI.method: 在11种模拟设置和67个基准数据集上比较12种方法，评估预测、结构、复杂度与运行时间。
AI.result: 回归中SLIM总体预测表现最强，分类中inTrees总体最佳，ART最紧凑，结构解释优势因方法而异。
AI.conclusion: 方法选择应考虑结局类型、数据结构和解释目标，不能仅依赖预测相似度。

title: InvarOrd: Self-Supervised Ordinal Knowledge Distillation with Rank-Invariant Alignment for Label-Efficient Cross-Species Hyperspectral Fish Freshness Assessment
summary: Hyperspectral models of fish freshness rarely transfer between species, and labelling a new species is slow and destructive. Freshness is also ordinal, and standard domain alignment can erase that order. We present InvarOrd, which adapts to a new species from 30 labelled cubes (5 per rank) in three stages: self-supervised spectral pretraining on unlabelled source cubes, cross-species alignment by a shrinkage covariance discrepancy computed only within matched ranks, and ordinal distillation into a compact student. The alignment term is provably invariant to the rank means, so it gives no incentive to collapse the ordinal axis. On paired salmon and cod data (800 cubes each, 16 days), a source-trained teacher reaches 1.6 to 1.9 days mean absolute error (MAE) on the other species, with quadratic weighted kappa (QWK) below zero. The 423K-parameter student, 2.54 times smaller than its teacher, attains the lowest MAE (1.476 days) and highest within 1-day accuracy (56.1%) among 14 configurations, matching the best of six ImageNet-pretrained backbones (ConvNeXt-T, 1.503 days) at 66 times fewer parameters, 1.44ms per cube on a GPU and 5s re-adaptation. InvarOrd beats target-only training by 0.29 days (p = 0.031). Among alignment objectives, rank-invariant alignment retains the most ordinal structure (embedding rank correlation 0.183, QWK 0.112), whereas global discrepancy lowers the rank correlation to 0.049 and QWK to zero at only 0.014 days higher MAE.

AI.tldr: InvarOrd以少量标签实现跨鱼种高光谱鲜度评估，并通过秩不变对齐保留序数结构。
AI.motivation: 鱼类鲜度模型跨物种迁移困难，新物种标注代价高，常规域对齐还可能破坏鲜度顺序。
AI.method: 采用自监督光谱预训练、匹配等级内协方差对齐和序数蒸馏，仅需目标物种30个标注数据立方体。
AI.result: 42.3万参数学生模型MAE为1.476天、一天内准确率56.1%，较仅目标域训练降低0.29天误差。
AI.conclusion: 秩不变对齐有助保留序数信息，紧凑蒸馏模型可实现标签高效的跨物种适配。

title: StyleJudge: A Human-Validated, In-Context-Learning Vision-Language Evaluator for Artistic Style Transfer
summary: Automatic evaluation of artistic style transfer remains an open problem: existing metrics score an image pair in isolation, without seeing an example of the intended style transformation, and correlate poorly with human judgment. We introduce StyleJudge, a compact vision-language evaluator conditioned on a small set of reference source-to-stylized pairs before scoring a query pair, mirroring how a human rater calibrates to a style before judging a candidate. On a human-annotated benchmark of 878 rated pairs across 12 artistic styles (728 from 10 training/validation styles, 150 from 2 unseen styles), our efficient 0.8B-parameter StyleJudge reaches a Pearson correlation of 0.291 (Spearman 0.325) with human ratings on seen styles and 0.381 on unseen ones. On seen styles, it achieves the highest positive correlation among tested metrics: Gram-matrix style loss and CLIP similarity correlate weakly ($r=0.041$, $r=0.168$), while LPIPS (scored higher when closer to the source) correlates negatively ($r=-0.404$). We achieve this by distilling evaluation knowledge from a 72B-parameter vision-language teacher used only during training, which reaches $r=0.327$, confirming that most of its human alignment survives compact distillation. For training, we build a dataset of source-to-stylized pairs across the 12 styles via LoRA-adapted diffusion, densified with graded intermediate examples from a high-resolution image-morphing pipeline so the evaluator recognizes partial and complete stylization. On two held-out validation styles, StyleJudge reaches 28.2% exact-match agreement with its teacher's structured scores versus 1.1% for the untuned base model, with 67.8% shorter reasoning traces, and scores a pair in 39 s (median) using 2.5 GB of GPU memory on one NVIDIA T4. We release the human-rating benchmark, annotation guideline, SDXL-adapted FreeMorph code, and model weights.

AI.tldr: StyleJudge通过参考风格转换示例校准评分，以小型视觉语言模型提升与人类评价的一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有艺术风格迁移指标缺少目标转换示例，与人类判断相关性较弱。
AI.method: 以少量原图到风格图参考对为上下文，并结合72B教师蒸馏及渐进风格化样本训练0.8B评估器。
AI.result: 878对人工评分基准上，已见和未见风格的Pearson相关分别为0.291和0.381，已见风格优于所测指标。
AI.conclusion: 参考示例校准与知识蒸馏能在紧凑模型中保留较多人类评价一致性，并支持未见风格评估。

title: Grokking Can Be Steered: Selecting Desirable Solutions By Choice Of Learning Rule
summary: During grokking, a network transitions from memorization to generalization, yet what shapes the neural implementation (circuit) of the generalizing solution and specifically the number of participating neurons (its size) remains unclear. We find that the learning rule, the combination of credit assignment algorithm and optimizer, controls this: On modular addition, every learning rule we study that groks recovers the same Fourier-based algorithm, yet implemented by circuits that differ in size. Why? A neuron stays in use when its credit is large relative to the non-gradient term of its own update, and this single condition unifies three routes to unused neurons: the coupled weight decay, Adam's $\epsilon$ and the decay of a trainable per-neuron gain. Equalizing the magnitude of credit assigned to each neuron, or scaling each neuron's weight decay by its credit, expands the effective circuit size, measured from the outgoing weights, from 60% to 99% of the layer's neurons at similar training and test accuracy. We vary which neurons share one equalization factor, from the whole layer to individual neurons, and find that the circuit stays concentrated for groups of eight or more and fully distributes only when every neuron has its own factor. Credit magnitudes are usually set by the normalization of standard optimizers: Nero, which normalizes per neuron, distributes the computation, whereas Adam and seven others, including RMSProp, Muon, and Shampoo, use other normalization schemes and retain small, concentrated circuits. Distributed circuits tolerate neuron deletion better, while concentrated circuits can be pruned further and transfer about twice as fast to a task that recombines the same features, largely by recruiting their unused neurons. Learning rule choice thus steers circuit size, trading robustness against compressibility and transfer speed without changing the learned algorithm.

AI.tldr: 学习规则可在不改变模加法傅里叶算法的情况下，调控顿悟后神经回路的规模。
AI.motivation: 顿悟使网络从记忆转向泛化，但泛化回路规模由何决定仍不清楚。
AI.method: 比较信用分配与优化器组合，通过逐神经元信用均衡和信用相关权重衰减分析回路形成。
AI.result: 信用调节将有效神经元占比从60%提高至99%；分布式回路更耐删除，集中式回路迁移约快两倍。
AI.conclusion: 学习规则可调节回路分布，在鲁棒性、可压缩性与迁移速度之间形成权衡。

title: Probing SAM Perturbations Through Statistical Replay
summary: Sharpness Aware Minimization (SAM) updates model parameters using gradients evaluated at adversarially perturbed weights, but it remains unclear which aspects of this procedure are sufficient to reproduce its generalization behavior. In our ResNet 18 experiments on CIFAR 10, simple curvature regularizers based on the Hessian trace and largest eigenvalue remain below SAM in validation accuracy, motivating a direct examination of its perturbations. We introduce statistical replay, a diagnostic that summarizes perturbations from reference SAM trajectories using elementwise means and standard deviations over local windows and constructs new perturbations during independent SGD training. Pure replay uses only these summaries, whereas mixed replay adds isotropic Gaussian noise. Pure replay does not reproduce SAM's validation behavior, while mixed replay and pure isotropic perturbations can approach its validation performance at selected scales without reproducing its training dynamics. An equal radius random direction within SAM performs similarly to SGD, and source, temporal, and layer interventions further suggest that replay behavior depends on perturbation construction. Together, these preliminary results weaken several simple explanations of SAM while leaving an important part of its mechanism unexplained.
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: AXIOM - Foundations of Efficient Deep Learning

AI.tldr: 统计回放实验表明，部分随机扰动可接近SAM的验证性能，但仍无法解释其训练机制。
AI.motivation: SAM中哪些扰动特征足以复现其泛化行为尚不明确，简单曲率正则化也未达到其验证精度。
AI.method: 在CIFAR-10上使用ResNet-18，统计SAM局部扰动的均值和标准差，并在独立SGD训练中回放。
AI.result: 纯回放未复现SAM表现，混合回放及各向同性扰动在特定尺度下可接近其验证性能，但未复现训练动态。
AI.conclusion: 初步实验削弱了若干关于SAM的简单解释，其机制仍有重要部分尚未厘清。

title: UACS: Uncertainty-Aware Clustering and Sparse Parameter Estimation for Multi-Condition Wheel Center Force
