summary: Accurate wheel center force (WCF) estimation is important for vehicle durability analysis and condition monitoring, whereas direct measurement requires dedicated transducers and increases instrumentation cost and complexity. As a result, soft sensors have attracted considerable attention as a practical alternative. However, developing reliable soft sensors remains challenging due to varying working conditions, unknown condition relationships, and high-dimensional model representations. This paper proposes an uncertainty-aware clustering and sparse parameter estimation framework (UACS) for WCF signal estimation under diverse and unlabeled working conditions. A MISO-FIR model is first constructed using easily accessible sensor signals to estimate the unmeasurable force signal. The uncertainty of estimated parameters is quantified through confidence ellipsoids, and pairwise hypothesis testing is developed to identify statistically similar working conditions. Based on these uncertainty-aware comparisons, working conditions are grouped in an unsupervised manner, and sparse parameter estimation is performed within each cluster. The UACS framework simultaneously reduces the number of required models and active parameters while maintaining estimation accuracy. Experiments using real-world vehicle data demonstrate that the UACS framework achieves estimation accuracy comparable to condition-specific models while substantially reducing the number of required models and outperforming conventional distance-based clustering approaches.

AI.tldr: UACS利用不确定性感知聚类与稀疏参数估计，在多种无标签工况下精简轮心力软测量模型。
AI.motivation: 轮心力直接测量成本高，而工况变化、未知工况关系和高维模型使可靠软测量难以实现。
AI.method: 构建MISO-FIR模型，通过参数置信椭球与成对假设检验聚类工况，再在簇内进行稀疏参数估计。
AI.result: 真实车辆数据实验中，UACS保持了与逐工况模型相当的精度，显著减少模型数量，并优于传统距离聚类方法。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性感知的工况分组可在维持轮心力估计精度的同时减少所需模型和有效参数。

title: PALIN: Pixel-Aligned LiDAR-NIR Multimodal 3D Object Detection with Benchmark
summary: 3D object detection is critical for intelligent transportation systems. LiDAR has been widely adopted for accurate geometric measurements; however, purely geometric representations remain ambiguous under sparse observations and occlusions, while cross-sensor multimodal fusion suffers from calibration and synchronization errors. To overcome these challenges, we leverage an Ouster LiDAR to construct PALIN (Pixel-Aligned LiDAR-NIR), a large-scale intrinsically pixel-aligned multimodal dataset jointly capturing geometry and NIR intensity, comprising approximately 8,000 annotated frames from static urban intersections and diverse mobile suburban scenes. Building upon this dataset, we propose CMambaFusion, a novel fusion framework consisting of a four-directional Cross-Mamba module for bidirectional cross-modal interaction and a Gated Concat-Mamba module for joint feature refinement. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PALIN enables effective multimodal learning, and CMambaFusion achieves superior accuracy-efficiency trade-offs over both LiDAR-only and representative fusion baselines.

AI.tldr: 研究构建像素级对齐的激光雷达与近红外数据集PALIN，并提出CMambaFusion提升三维检测表现。
AI.motivation: 纯几何检测易受稀疏观测和遮挡影响，跨传感器多模态融合又存在标定与同步误差。
AI.method: 利用Ouster激光雷达采集约八千帧标注数据，并以四方向Cross-Mamba和门控Concat-Mamba实现融合。
AI.result: 实验表明PALIN支持有效多模态学习，CMambaFusion的精度与效率权衡优于纯激光雷达及代表性融合基线。
AI.conclusion: 内在像素对齐的几何与近红外观测结合所提融合框架，有助于改善三维目标检测。

title: Beyond Paired Inputs: Learning to Leverage RGB-T Cross-Modal Relations in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: RGB and thermal infrared (TIR) sensors provide complementary observations, yet their distinct sensing characteristics make effective cross-modal coordination challenging. Although existing multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can process paired RGB-T inputs, they often fail to translate cross-modal relations into effective task-specific decisions, leaving the potential of these relations to improve task performance and robustness largely untapped. Motivated by this observation, we introduce RelMLLM, an RGB-T MLLM that explicitly learns to exploit cross-modal relations in task-specific decision making. It represents modality reliability, the cross-modal relation, and the dominant modality as a verifiable decision state. We derive task-grounded supervision for this state by comparing RGB-only, TIR-only, and paired RGB-T task outcomes. A hierarchical relation-guided reward supervises modality-specific evidence, relation-state prediction, and the final task output, while encouraging consistency across evidence, relation, and decision. We evaluate RelMLLM on natural RGB-T grounding, RGB-T visual question answering, and held-out sensor degradation. RelMLLM improves grounding accuracy and degradation robustness over its Qwen3-VL baselines while preserving performance on general RGB-T reasoning benchmarks. These results demonstrate that effectively exploiting cross-modal relations leads to more accurate and robust RGB-T decisions. Code and model weights are publicly available.

AI.tldr: RelMLLM显式学习RGB与热红外之间的关系，提升任务定位精度和传感器退化下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型虽能处理配对RGB与热红外输入，却难以将跨模态关系有效用于任务决策。
AI.method: 将模态可靠性、跨模态关系和主导模态表示为决策状态，并用任务结果监督及分层关系奖励训练。
AI.result: 相较Qwen3-VL基线，RelMLLM提高了定位精度和退化鲁棒性，同时保持通用RGB-T推理基准表现。
AI.conclusion: 显式利用跨模态关系可支持更准确、更稳健的RGB-T任务决策。

title: Vegetation Health Classification for Low-Data and Edge Hardware Deployment
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) equipped with cameras are popular, viable tools for vegetation and environmental health monitoring. However, existing image classification methods are incompatible with UAV implementation for independent practitioners in remote, resource-constrained environments due to large dataset requirements, GPU hardware, inflexible retraining, and low interpretability. This paper presents a lightweight, interpretable vegetation classification algorithm operating with as few as five reference images per class, without GPUs or heavy machine learning frameworks. It uses a 2D hue-saturation histogram feature representation and Earth Mover's Distance or Quadratic Form Distance, paired with a log-likelihood probability score, to classify images into three vegetation health categories. We evaluated six systems: three custom pipelines and three established models across low-data scenarios ($n = 5, 10, 25$) and a full-data regime of 2,172 drone images from 28 South American locations. Our custom pipelines achieve competitive Top-1 accuracy (81--85\%) under low-data constraints, maintaining sub-1ms inference times that enable real-time classification and subsequently tasks such as seeding and watering. The algorithms also support incremental retraining without full model reconstruction. We validate edge feasibility by deploying the QFD variant on an ESP32 microcontroller, achieving 82.8\% accuracy with 1.01\% heap memory utilization (45kb), demonstrating that effective vegetation classification is achievable on low-cost, low-power embedded hardware without cellular connectivity.

AI.tldr: 轻量植被健康分类方法仅需每类少量参考图像，无需GPU即可在低成本微控制器上运行。
AI.motivation: 偏远地区无人机监测受限于数据、算力和连接条件，现有分类方法还存在重训练不灵活及可解释性不足。
AI.method: 使用二维色相—饱和度直方图，结合推土机距离或二次型距离与对数似然评分，区分三类植被健康状态。
AI.result: 低数据下准确率达81%—85%、推理低于1毫秒；ESP32部署准确率为82.8%，堆内存占用1.01%。
AI.conclusion: 可解释、支持增量重训练的轻量方法能够在无蜂窝连接的低功耗边缘硬件上实现有效植被分类。

title: Do Probing and Steering Favor the Same Directions Within and Across Language Models?
summary: A direction in a language model's hidden state can be used to probe whether a concept is present or to steer the model toward it. Although probe directions are often reused for steering, the direction that best detects a concept need not be the one that best changes it. We study this distinction in three instruction-tuned models from different families. We construct a one-parameter family of directions ranging from a covariance-adjusted discriminant to the mean difference, and evaluate probing and additive steering, which adds the direction to the hidden state, along the family at a fixed side effect. For truthfulness and sentiment, in every model, the best probe is not the best steering direction: steering consistently favors directions closer to the mean difference. This separation holds across 59 of 60 layer-model-concept combinations in a layer sweep, with matched probe and steering texts in all six model-concept combinations, and under a rotation-based steering operator. The exact steering optimum is less stable: for sentiment, an intermediate direction produces a 27-56% stronger steering effect than the mean difference, but this gain shrinks or disappears with matched texts and depends on the layer and the operator. The two roles also transfer differently across models. A probe transferred by a linear map fitted on neutral text retains 81-91% of the target model's above-chance probing performance, while the transferred mean difference retains less of its steering effect in 11 of 12 model pairs. This is a consistent tendency, although our predefined criteria classify only three pairs, and nine remain inconclusive. Finally, as an application on PopQA, steering toward "unknown" increases abstention by 18-44 percentage points on uncertain errors, versus 2-5 on confident errors, while rarely correcting errors in cases where a correct answer is reachable.
comment: Accepted at the Workshop on Unifying Representations in Neural Models (UniReps) co-located with NeurIPS 2026.(arXiv preprint)

AI.tldr: 语言模型中最适合探测概念的方向通常并非最佳操控方向，两者的跨模型迁移能力也不同。
AI.motivation: 概念探测方向常被直接用于操控模型，但最能识别概念的方向未必最能改变模型行为。
AI.method: 在三个模型中构造从协方差校正判别方向到均值差的方向族，在固定副作用下比较探测、操控及跨模型迁移。
AI.result: 60个层—模型—概念组合中有59个呈现探测与操控最优方向分离，操控更偏好接近均值差的方向。
AI.conclusion: 探测和操控应分别选择方向；具体操控最优点依赖文本、层和算子，跨模型迁移差异仍有不确定性。

title: Evaluating and Improving Natural Language Autoencoders
summary: Natural language autoencoders (NLAs) are a method for generating natural language explanations of LLM activations. We develop evaluations based on auditing tasks that test the ability of NLAs to surface latent knowledge, identify whether a model was misled by a hint, and catch a silent fabrication. We also develop extensions to NLAs that let them use activation information from multiple layers and positions, let us apply them more effectively to long transcripts, and reduce the number of false claims they make. These extensions result in improvements on both our auditing evaluations and auxiliary evaluations adapted from prior work. We also use the evaluations to study how different auditing capabilities change over the course of NLA training, and find that although every evaluation improves early in training, extended training can hurt performance on some of our auditing evaluations.

AI.tldr: 研究提出自然语言自编码器的审计评估与改进方法，增强其解释模型激活的能力。
AI.motivation: 需要检验自然语言自编码器能否揭示潜在知识、识别提示误导并发现隐蔽捏造。
AI.method: 构建审计任务，并扩展自编码器以利用多层多位置激活、更有效处理长对话及减少错误陈述。
AI.result: 这些扩展改善了审计与辅助评估表现，但延长训练会损害部分审计任务的性能。
AI.conclusion: 多源激活利用与解释纠错有助于提高审计能力，但训练更久并不保证审计表现持续提升。

title: DBHiCo: Dual-Branch Hierarchical Contrastive Learning for MRI Image Classification
summary: Automated Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) image classification provides a crucial non-invasive approach for neurological diagnosis, yet it is fundamentally challenged by inherent acquisition noise and high inter-subject structural similarity, which obscure subtle pathological variations, thereby limiting the performance of deep neural networks. While contrastive learning (CL) offers a promising mitigation strategy, existing paradigms rely on rigid binary partitions that ignore negative sample heterogeneity, and they fail to capture the cross-view structural consistency vital for fine-grained anatomical alignment. To address these barriers, we propose Dual-Branch Hierarchical Contrastive Learning (DBHiCo), a novel framework explicitly designed to collaboratively enforce structural consistency and semantic discrimination. Specifically, DBHiCo leverages a natural anatomical multi-view pair (original and skull-stripped MRI scans), processing them through a dual-branch architecture to seamlessly integrate holistic structural robustness with localized intracranial details. Crucially, we introduce a hierarchical contrastive loss that discards conventional binary constraints in favor of a margin-ranked similarity hierarchy. This mechanism explicitly orders positive and negative pairs based on their structural and semantic difficulty, thereby amplifying the fine-grained semantic discriminability of the learned representations. Extensive experiments across three diverse neurological datasets demonstrate that DBHiCo achieves state-of-the-art performance, consistently outperforming existing MRI multi-view representation learning and advanced contrastive fine-tuning methods.

AI.tldr: DBHiCo通过双分支层次对比学习，同时增强MRI分类中的结构一致性与语义区分能力。
AI.motivation: MRI噪声与个体间结构相似性掩盖细微病变，现有对比学习又忽视负样本差异及跨视图结构一致性。
AI.method: 以原始和去颅骨MRI构成双分支输入，通过按结构与语义难度排序的间隔式层次对比损失学习表示。
AI.result: 在三个神经系统疾病数据集上，DBHiCo达到最先进表现，持续优于现有MRI多视图表示学习及先进对比微调方法。
AI.conclusion: 结合解剖多视图与层次化样本关系，可增强细粒度MRI表示并改善分类性能。

title: Over-the-Air Semantic Alignment via Dual Stacked Intelligent Metasurfaces
summary: Semantic communications enable task-oriented information exchange, but suffer from latent-space mismatch when transmitter and receiver employ heterogeneous machine learning models. Existing semantic alignment methods rely on digital processing, introducing computational and latency overhead. This paper proposes a dual stacked intelligent metasurfaces (dual-SIM) architecture that performs semantic alignment entirely in the wave domain. By jointly exploiting programmable metasurfaces at both ends of a link and the wireless channel, the proposed architecture realizes an end-to-end linear transformation between heterogeneous latent spaces. We show phase-only multilayer SIM can approximate both supervised linear aligners and zero-shot Parseval-frame equalizers. We investigate single-SIM, disjoint asymmetric and symmetric dual-SIM, and jointly optimized dual-SIM configurations, considering channel equalization and constructive channel exploitation. For joint design, we develop an alternating projected gradient algorithm with convergence guarantees to first-order stationary points. We further introduce a deep-unrolled network that unrolls gradient-based iterations to reduce computational cost of SIM reconfiguration under channel variations. Numerical results with heterogeneous vision transformer encoders show accurate semantic alignment from moderate to high signal-to-noise ratios. The joint and symmetric disjoint dual-SIM designs achieve the highest accuracy over compact channels, the joint design leads at shallow stack depths, and the advantage over single-SIM designs diminishes at equal depth.

AI.tldr: 双堆叠智能超表面利用无线传播在波域实现异构模型间的语义对齐。
AI.motivation: 异构机器学习模型存在潜在空间失配，而数字语义对齐引入计算和时延开销。
AI.method: 联合优化链路两端超表面与信道，采用交替投影梯度及深度展开网络实现线性对齐。
AI.result: 中高信噪比下对齐准确，紧凑信道中联合与对称分离设计最优，同等堆叠深度下相对单端设计的优势缩小。

title: Equilibrium measures for anisotropic exponential interaction energies with applications to transformers
summary: We study the minimization of anisotropic exponential interaction energies over probability measures on the sphere, motivated by mean-field models of self-attention in transformer architectures. For every symmetric positive definite interaction matrix, we relate the minimizer to a corresponding anisotropic Brownian motion and use the Feynman--Kac formula and elliptic regularity theory to show that it admits a smooth, strictly positive density on the sphere. We further show that it is the only stationary measure with full support for the dynamics considered. We use the stochastic viewpoint to derive an algorithm for sampling from the minimizer. In dimension two, we also propose a numerical scheme for approximating its density based on a Mathieu series expansion.

AI.tldr: 研究球面各向异性指数相互作用能的极小测度，证明其密度光滑且严格为正。
AI.motivation: 受变换器自注意力均场模型启发，需要刻画各向异性相互作用下的平衡测度。

title: Geometric Stability and Sample Complexity for Compositional Function Priors
summary: We study when compositional structure yields dimension reduction in supervised learning. We frame learning as empirical risk minimization with a function-space prior: a regularization functional selects a subset of functions with favorable approximation and metric entropy. The models are compositions $f(x)=g(Ax+\Delta h(x))$, where $A\in\mathbb{R}^{k\times d}$ is a linear base map, $\Delta h$ is a nonlinear correction, and $g$ is an outer function; that is, $f$ is an arbitrary smooth function of a $k$-dimensional representation of the input that is linear up to a correction. We prove covering-number bounds showing that the statistical complexity of this class interpolates between an intrinsic regime, parametric in the $kd$ entries of the linear map and nonparametric only in the representation dimension $k$, and an ambient $d$-dimensional nonparametric rate; the interpolation is controlled by the correction size $\varepsilon=\|\Delta h\|$. We then connect $\varepsilon$ to data geometry. If the data lie in a small tube around a $k$-dimensional manifold and the regression target depends on the input only through its nearest point on that manifold, then locally the target factorizes exactly as $g(Ax+\Delta h(x))$ with $A$ a tangent chart and a correction whose Sobolev norm scales linearly with curvature at the localization scale. Patching such local models over an atlas gives a finite-sample excess-risk bound for a least-squares estimator over a finite net of local models, whose ambient term vanishes with curvature. For a one-dimensional model problem we also prove a converse: on curved data, every affine compositional predictor faces an error floor unless its correction budget scales with curvature, while the matching curved model class attains the intrinsic rate. The correction size $\varepsilon$ is thus the effective-dimension parameter linking curvature to statistical complexity.

title: Objectify, Don't Delete: Complaint-Derived Evaluation of Ambient Clinical Notes
summary: Evaluating the quality of AI-generated clinical notes is hard: standard metrics like ROUGE measure lexical similarity to reference notes, while expert checklists encode what committees believe matters. Neither captures what clinicians actually complain about. Recent work has shown that evaluation criteria can be mined from user feedback and filtered to criteria that LLM judges can reliably enforce. We argue that this is where much of the value is lost. The criteria that fail enforceability are disproportionately the ones clinicians raise most often, because high-frequency complaints are stated as several questions glued together. No yes/no judgment can grade such composites as posed. We introduce an objectification step that rewrites such criteria into sets of scoped, determinate decisions. We demonstrate the approach through an evaluation pipeline that mines criteria from complaints, objectifies them, and deploys LLM judges against both planted defects and production notes. Across eleven defects planted into ACI-bench reference notes, objectified judges localize violations with median recall of 0.95, while reference metrics change by at most 0.037. Given the complaint as one broad question, the same judges still find every planted defect, but they also flag 70% of the unperturbed reference notes; one section-pair question per call raises Youden's J from 0.30 to 0.72 (by 0.19 to 0.26 with prompt effort matched). We release ACI-Defect, a perturbation benchmark; clinician-reviewed instance-level labels showing quality gaps in the ACI-bench gold standard (32 of 40 notes contain hallucinations; 40 of 40 omit discussed facts); and grounding-judge verdicts. On 1,446 production notes, mean instance-rate burden falls at every clinician-rating step (rho=-0.15), a small association. Defect counts have to be kept per span rather than collapsed into one pass/fail bit per note.

title: PathLoop: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Reasoning for Evidence-Grounded Whole-Slide Image Analysis
summary: Analyzing whole-slide images (WSIs) requires combining evidence across tissue regions and spatial scales. Multi-agent systems offer a promising approach to this task. However, existing systems make limited use of molecular evidence, often select visually prominent but less representative regions while overlooking global context, and struggle to reuse experience from previous cases. To address these challenges, we present PathLoop, a self-evolving multi-agent framework that integrates omics data for evidence-grounded WSI analysis. Specifically, PathLoop coordinates visual and omics interpreters across slide, patch, and pixel levels, using molecular signals to guide region selection and combining local tissue details with global slide features. A judgment agent then checks the consistency of the collected evidence against Pathology-Wiki, a knowledge base built from 48 entries across 24 organ systems, and triggers re-examination when the evidence is inconsistent. To reuse past experience, a four-level memory stores reasoning trajectories, practical tips, skills, and tools to guide future cases, forming a loop of evidence collection, review, and memory update. We evaluate PathLoop on four TCGA cohorts with biomarker prediction, survival prediction, and subtype classification. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of PathLoop across these tasks and support its use for evidence-grounded WSI analysis.

title: Ultra-CAN: A Lightweight Blind ISAC Receiver for Chaos-Based Telemetry and Local-Seed Ranging in the Internet of Drones
summary: The Internet of Drones (IoD) needs secure telemetry and proximity sensing within the SWaP-C constraints. We show that a single blind neural receiver driven by one chaos-based waveform performs both functions without a separate radar transceiver. In telemetry mode it decodes a peer's burst blindly; in radar mode it regenerates the per-burst chaotic reference locally and ranges the echoes of its own transmission. Ultra-CAN pairs a shared $64$-dimensional representation with two ultra-light backbones, an attention-pooled Conv1D network and a multi-head QKV network ($27.6$k--$44.2$k parameters), feeding communication and sensing heads. Both ship as int8 TensorFlow Lite Micro firmware; the Conv1D receiver decides a burst in $16.9$ ms on a $240$ MHz microcontroller with $24.2$ KiB of activations, a measured energy of $2.2$-$3.4$ mJ per burst, and float-equivalent decisions, sustaining up to $59$ bit/s of telemetry or a $7.4$ Hz range track. The two variants rank first and second among learned demodulators in four aerial swarm scenarios, with a pooled BER down to $4.6 \times 10^{-4}$ on the single-echo link ($2.4 \times 10^{-3}$ with three echoes). Its sensing head identifies true obstacles in $66.8\%$ of peer-laden bursts (vs $42\%$ matched filtering, $44\%$ OFDM-ISAC, $48\%$ peak-picker ceiling). A peer-exclusion gate cuts peer reports from $4.4\%$ to $0.02\%$ of answered bursts, answering $23.5\%$ of total bursts ($75\%$ on the exact tap) with $0.70$ m/s velocity tracking. In-domain refitting recovers telemetry BER by up to three orders of magnitude under 3GPP channels, jamming-aware training restores the link, and frequency agility adds a $6$--$9$ dB margin against partial-band jamming.

title: LLM Trading Agents Earn Beta, Not Alpha: A Look-Ahead-Free Benchmark
summary: Large language model (LLM) trading agents now trade stocks for their users, and benchmarks rank models by their agents' returns. Yet a single run's return says little about skill. In our study, two runs of the same model that differed only in the random seed ended 5.2 points apart on average, so telling skill from luck takes many backtests across markets, models and seeds. However, live arenas trade each day only once, and backtests either use the few months after a model's training cutoff or run on years the model may remember, often with news joined to prices by calendar date. In this paper, we present rta-bench-1, a backtest over three US markets (a rally, a bear market and a crash). It shows each headline only after its publication minute, plays each period blind and named, and checks every run for look-ahead. It also splits each return into factor exposure and alpha and scores every decision against random choices of the same day and sector. In 91 runs of six models from four vendors, no alpha was significant, market and style exposure accounted for a median 78% of the return, and the decisions did no better than random stocks of the same sector. The agents bought the stocks with the most positive news, yet in ablations they earned as much without their headlines. Still, the agents carried out rules reliably, since a single cash rule in the prompt cut a GPT-based agent's share in stocks by 30.3 points in all six pairs. Builders should therefore supply the edge themselves and report exposures and alpha, and benchmarks should replay news by publication time.

title: Depth-Aware Path Planning and Collision Avoidance for Robotic Nursing Assistants Using Real-Time 3D Vision
summary: This paper presents a depth-aware path planning and collision avoidance framework for the safe navigation of robotic nursing assistants in cluttered environments with low-height obstacles. Conventional LiDAR-based navigation systems, while accurate for mapping and localization, fail to detect transparent or low-height obstacles, whereas vision-based systems are prone to noise and occlusion. The proposed framework integrates RGB-D depth sensing, rule-based obstacle avoidance, and the NavfnROS global path planner to drive the robot from an initial point to a goal point. The proposed approach is implemented on the Husky A200 robot, equipped with a Kinova Gen3 arm, to form a complete setup for a robotic nursing assistant. This system features a multi-layer architecture for global planning, perception fusion, and real-time control in the ROS-Gazebo environment. Experimental evaluations in a simulated cluttered environment demonstrate up to 40\% higher success rate and 35\% improvement in minimum clearance compared with single-sensor baselines. Furthermore, real-world experimental results validate the proposed approach as a computationally efficient and safety-aware navigation solution for autonomous healthcare robots.

title: Cooperative Gradient Estimation for Multi-Robot Source Seeking with Heteroskedastic Measurements
summary: This paper proposes a novel approach for localizing the source of a three-dimensional scalar field using a team of heterogeneous cooperative mobile robots. Each robot measures the field intensity at its location and shares the information within the team. Measurement noise is explicitly considered, and heterogeneity arises from robot-dependent sensing accuracies, leading to heteroskedastic data. The proposed framework combines a weighted centroidal Voronoi tessellation-based formation strategy, defined on a spherical surface and parameterized by sensor noise variances, with a Weighted Least Squares estimator to compute the field gradient at the formation center. By explicitly accounting for sensor heterogeneity in both formation design and estimation, the method achieves robust gradient estimation under noisy measurements. In particular, we show analytically that this construction is nearly optimal. The covariance of the gradient estimate is derived in closed form, providing a lower bound on the attainable estimation variance for any formation on the sphere, and the proposed tessellation is shown to asymptotically satisfy the conditions under which this bound is attained. The estimated gradient is then exploited within a gradient-ascent strategy to guide the team toward the source location. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach compared to alternative strategies and highlight its intrinsic ability to reconfigure online in response to robot failures, thereby enhancing its adaptability.

AI.tldr: 通过噪声感知队形与加权最小二乘估计，异构机器人可协同估计三维场梯度并寻找源头。

title: Agent Authenticator: Passkey-Grade, Hardware-Bound Authentication for AI Agents
summary: AI coding agents now push code, publish packages, call model APIs and operate cloud resources on behalf of developers. They authenticate to these services with the same bearer secrets humans use, personal access tokens, API keys and package-registry tokens, stored where the model, its subprocesses and any co-resident malware can read them. Incidents in 2025 and 2026, including prompt-injection attacks on coding agents and self-propagating supply-chain worms, show that this arrangement fails in predictable ways. Passkeys solved the analogous problem for humans, but they require a human gesture on every use and cannot be operated by an autonomous process. We present the Agent Authenticator, a design that gives agents passkey-grade authentication properties: per-service hardware-bound keys, no shared secrets, origin binding enforced by the runtime rather than the model, normalized attestation of the execution environment, human-signed scoped mandates, and cross-device human approval for high-risk actions. The same protocol serves agents on developer laptops and in cloud enclaves, and it deploys as a profile over existing mechanisms, MCP authorization, OAuth token exchange including the Identity Assertion JWT Authorization Grant, git and SSH, rather than as a new identity system. The authenticator also produces a signed, hash-chained record of each action it authorizes. We analyze the design against a threat model centered on prompt injection and same-host compromise, map it onto five documented incidents, and discuss its limits.

AI.tldr: Agent Authenticator为自主智能体提供硬件绑定、服务隔离且具人类授权约束的认证设计。

title: Continuation-Guided LLM Evolution of Program Policies and Goal Compilers in Craftax
summary: Coding agents can synthesize and optimize code-based policies from simulator feedback, allowing the resulting program to act with zero inference model calls. But for long horizon tasks, two challenges arise: local improvements can hurt final success and switching to a new objective requires another expensive synthesis run. We propose a framework that first develops competence by refining the policy through a feedback cascade, moving from episode returns to hierarchical goals and belief updates which can be scored densely from simulator. In the Craftax game, a partially observed and procedurally generated environment, refinements via episode level feedback stall at <1% final-level arrival, whereas with the feedback cascade the optimized policy reaches the final stage 50% of time (28% final boss defeats). Furthermore, to make this competence reusable towards new goals, we factor the previous controller into an environment interpreter $I$ (models, memory, skills) and a rule program $p_0$, and we show that coding agents can optimize a reusable goal compiler $C_{\theta}$ that maps structured tasks $g$ into new rule programs $p_g$. Across five independent compiler searches trained only on short tasks, the resulting compilers successfully transfer zero-shot to longer tasks without any task-specific tuning nor inference-time LLM calls: continuation-scored feedback and a fixed machine with an editable program together turn a single-task competent policy into a reusable one. AI.motivation: 长时程任务中局部改进可能损害最终成功，且切换目标通常需要昂贵的重新合成。

title: Func-JEPA: Learning a Sobolev Space of Functions as Latent Vectors
summary: Pretraining an encoder once and reusing it across tasks is a widespread approach in vision and language. However, neural symbolic mathematics still trains a dedicated sequence-to-sequence model for each task, so that no representation of a function is shared. In this work, we propose the Function Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (Func-JEPA, abbreviated f-JEPA): an encoder of mathematical functions, pretrained on their symbolic form, whose latent space imitates the Sobolev space H^1 and in which differentiation is a learned latent operator. The norm of a latent is computed exactly from the function, whereas its direction is learned to match Sobolev angles. The frozen encoder is then reused by lightweight modules for decoding, composition, integration, and regression from samples. The representation and four downstream tasks are evaluated within and outside the pretraining distribution. f-JEPA recovers exact formulas from noisy samples more often than the compared symbolic-regression methods, whereas computer algebra and task-specific models remain stronger on standard integration and differential-equation benchmarks.

title: Evidence-Conditioned Completion and Synthesis of Electronic Health Records
summary: Patient information can guide electronic health record (EHR) generation, but how its amount shapes predictive utility and disclosure risk remains poorly characterized. Here we present EHRDiB, which unifies visit completion and synthesis by distinguishing original missingness from withheld inputs and combining a shared multimodal representation with an evidence-conditioned latent diffusion bridge. We compared EHRDiB with three completion and eight synthesis methods on MIMIC-IV and numerical and discretized Duke Health representations. Evaluation covered downstream predictive utility, generative diversity, and distributional fidelity for both tasks, and disclosure risk for synthesis. EHRDiB achieved the smallest utility gaps from real-data-trained classifiers in seven of eight completion comparisons. In synthesis, AUPRC gaps were 45.2% smaller for ten MIMIC-IV principal-diagnosis targets and 53.3% smaller for numerical Duke Health data relative to the best comparator. Synthesis with calibrated thresholding yielded the lowest marginal distribution error across all three datasets, with Coverage above 0.95 for both output rules. Across twelve evidence-fraction intervals in MIMIC-IV synthesis, membership-inference AUROC increased from 0.516 to 0.598 as the mean target evidence fraction rose from 0.20 to 0.50; utility gaps narrowed relative to the lowest evidence configuration but did not decrease monotonically. Our study provides a unified framework and empirical foundation for EHR generation that considers both its utility for clinical analysis and its information disclosure risk.

AI.tldr: EHRDiB以证据条件潜扩散桥统一电子健康记录补全与合成，并量化输入证据对效用和披露风险的影响。
AI.motivation: 患者信息可指导记录生成，但信息量如何影响预测效用与披露风险尚不清楚。
AI.method: 区分原始缺失与主动隐藏输入，结合共享多模态表示和证据条件潜扩散桥，在MIMIC-IV及Duke数据上评估。
AI.result: 八项补全比较中七项效用差距最小，合成AUPRC差距降低45.2%和53.3%，更多证据也伴随成员推断风险上升。
AI.conclusion: 该框架改善记录生成效用与分布保真度，同时表明增加证据并不保证效用单调提升且可能增加披露风险。

title: Random Cut Forests, Games and Diffusion over Approximately Nested Anisotropic Local Geometry
summary: Just as the data in a dynamic stream changes, questions asked of the stream also change in intent: what to hold constant, which counterfactuals to consider, and so forth. Energy-based learning has been celebrated for its uniform approach to losses and estimation, but interpretability remains challenging. Tree-based methods, on the other hand, offer high interpretability but often rely on bespoke, disjointed estimators. Neither paradigm readily supports changing questions on streaming data. In this paper we take a step towards combining energy, interpretability, and streaming. Random cut forests retain an evolving geometry of the data. We study this geometry as the basis for diffusion dynamics, prediction, explanation, and games. We show that several existing scores are escape probabilities of random walks on the trees. The induced affinity is realized exactly by a sparse electrical network on each tree, giving a single energy calculus, a Hamiltonian, maintained along one path per update. This connects an estimate, its supporting evidence, and the response to intervention through the same boxes, gaps, masses, and paths. Different questions correspond to different clamp decisions on the energy. Fixing observed values gives harmonic prediction with Gaussian uncertainty. Fixing a partition gives normalized cuts whose cost is attributed exactly to oriented faces. Releasing clamps gives coalition games, in which collusive displacement measures the field response. With noise, the same energy gives diffusion dynamics whose relaxation rates are read from the boxes. Axis-parallel cuts localize at a rate set by affine rather than ambient dimension, and this control passes to the averaged energy. Across a forest the boxes are only approximately nested; common reference observations align the trees. A rotating star with added noise illustrates the measurements.

AI.tldr: 以随机切割森林的动态局部几何构建统一能量框架，连接流数据上的预测、解释、干预与扩散。
AI.motivation: 能量模型难以解释，而树方法估计器分散，两者都难以适应流数据中不断变化的问题。
AI.method: 将树上亲和性精确表示为稀疏电网络，通过不同固定约束得到调和预测、归一化割、联盟博弈与扩散动力学。
AI.result: 证明若干已有评分等于随机游走逃逸概率，且轴平行切割的局部化速率由仿射维度而非环境维度决定。
AI.conclusion: 随机切割森林可用同一套几何与能量结构关联估计、证据和干预响应，并支持动态更新。

title: Beyond Prompts: Runtime Contracts for Coding Agents
summary: Coding agents act on repositories through shell commands and file edits, and teams steer them with written engineering rules. Industrial settings expect such rules to be enforced and their application to be evidenced, and a rule given as prompt text provides neither. We test whether executable contracts enforced while the agent works reduce rule violations compared with the same rules in the prompt, retrieved as guidance, or checked only after generation. Violations are scored by an oracle whose methods differ from the in-loop checks, and the oracle is validated by two human reviewers and a model reviewer. Across three studies on two model families (240, 112 and 108 runs), enforcement during execution produced no oracle-detected violation in 104 paired runs, against 21 to 55% of runs without rules, and no loss of functional correctness in the two confirmatory studies. In the confirmatory study on tasks aimed at known failure situations (Study 3, protocol hashed before the first run), enforcement lowered the share of violating runs by 31 percentage points relative to no rules (Holm-adjusted p = 0.014); the 17-point difference from prompted rules was not significant (p = 0.12), and neither was any contrast in Study 2, where only 3 of 14 tasks produced a violation. Prompted rules removed some violation types but not recursive deletes of scratch directories, and checks after generation repaired file edits but not commands that had already run. That enforcement satisfies the rules it enforces is expected by construction; what the data add is where prompting falls short, the absence of a functional cost, and the limits of the rules and of the oracle themselves. The studies use low-cost models and one small fixture.
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 8 tables. Code, data and run logs: this https URL

AI.tldr: 编码智能体执行期间的可执行契约可减少规则违规，但相较提示规则的优势尚未获得一致显著证据。
AI.motivation: 文字工程规则无法保证执行合规或提供证据，事后检查也无法撤销已执行的危险命令。
AI.method: 在两类模型的三项研究中比较运行时契约、提示规则、检索指导与事后检查，并用独立且经审核的判定器评分。
AI.result: 运行时执行的104次配对运行未检出违规，研究3较无规则降低31个百分点，但较提示规则差异不显著。
AI.conclusion: 运行时契约可弥补提示和事后检查的部分缺陷且未见功能代价，但证据受小型任务环境与判定器边界限制。

title: Lesion-Aware Explainable AI for Diabetic Retinopathy Grading from Fundus Images
summary: Post-hoc explanations of deep-learning models for diabetic retinopathy (DR) grading are difficult to trust because different attribution methods highlight different retinal regions for the same image, and a visually plausible heatmap does not show that the highlighted pixels drive the prediction. We propose the Consensus-Calibrated Explanation Map (CCEM), which fuses Grad-CAM++, Ada-SISE, and SmoothGrad Integrated Gradients (SG-IG) using image-specific weights derived from annotation-free reliability cues: deletion sensitivity, inter-method agreement, compactness, retinal containment, and peak structure. CCEM explains a frozen ordinal grader, an EfficientNet-B7 with CBAM and a scalar regression head, pre-trained on EyePACS 2015 in Stage 1 and fine-tuned on APTOS 2019 in Stage 2 with quadratic weighted kappa (QWK)-optimized thresholds; it reaches a QWK of 0.920 on the hidden Kaggle test set and 0.559 on the external MAPLES-DR cohort. Explanations are evaluated on MAPLES-DR, 198 MESSIDOR images with expert pixel-level lesion annotations that are never used for training, threshold fitting, or fusion. On the 193 images with annotated lesions, CCEM obtains the highest Soft Pointing Game score (69.61%; 95% CI 63.7-75.3), defined as the ratio of the strongest lesion-supported saliency to the global map maximum rather than a lesion detection rate, together with the lowest deletion AUC (0.570) and the best deletion-insertion balance (0.115); each gain is significant against the strongest single explainer on paired tests. Annotation-free, per-image reliability weighting therefore turns three disagreeing explainers into one map whose peak evidence is more lesion-supported and more faithful to the model than that of any single explainer.
comment: 12 pages, 6 figures, 9 tables. Truong Thinh Nguyen and Hai Phong Nguyen contributed equally. Corresponding author: Truong Thinh Nguyen

AI.tldr: CCEM依据逐图可靠性线索融合三种解释方法，使糖尿病视网膜病变分级热图更符合病灶且更忠实于模型。
AI.motivation: 不同归因方法对同一眼底图像关注区域不一致，视觉合理的热图也未必反映真正驱动预测的像素。
AI.method: 以删除敏感性、方法间一致性、紧凑性等无标注线索加权融合三种归因图，解释冻结的序数分级模型。
AI.result: 在193张含标注病灶图像上，软指向得分为69.61%、删除AUC为0.570，相关指标显著优于最强单一解释器。
AI.conclusion: 无标注逐图可靠性加权可提升解释峰值的病灶支持度与模型忠实度，但软指向得分并非病灶检出率。

title: Inquest: Log-Guided Root-Cause Code Localization with a Staged Agent
summary: When a production issue is reported, engineers get a description and some logs, but no failing test and no way to reproduce the fault. The logs show where the failure was noticed, not where it was caused: in 49% of the real reports we study, the text names none of the files that the fix later changed. We built a benchmark for this setting from two public datasets and 27 open-source projects (Apache, Red Hat, MongoDB, MariaDB, Qt and Sakai). It holds 38,001 resolved issue reports with their pasted logs, the code as it was while the bug was still present, and the files the fix changed. We present INQUEST, an agent that finds the faulty code using a 27B open-weights model. Code, not the model, controls the procedure. It first gathers the evidence, including the files fixed in similar past issues that were resolved before the report was filed. The model then makes only three bounded decisions: which files to open, what role each file plays in the failure, and how to rank them. On 26,544 evaluation reports, INQUEST ranks a changed file first for 68.6% and in the top five for 85.9%, names the correct module for 90.2%, and ranks a changed function first for 53.8%. On the reports that name no faulty file, it reaches 52.8% and 73.6%. A free agent loop with the same model and tools finds files equally well, but names the faulty function 14 points less often. On a 1,000-report sample, INQUEST beats our reimplementations of two published agents by 7 and 20 points of top-1 accuracy (4 and 16 counting only the reports those agents answered), and the same model used as a re-ranker by 6. We report the cost of every system and the results that go against us, and we release the benchmark, both systems and every run transcript.
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to the ICSE 2027 Industry Challenge track. Benchmark: this https URL ; code, results and run transcripts: this https URL

AI.tldr: INQUEST通过日志引导的分阶段智能体，在无法复现故障时定位根因代码。
AI.motivation: 生产故障通常缺乏失败测试与复现条件，且日志所示位置未必是故障根因。
AI.method: 构建含38001份报告的基准，由代码控制流程，让27B模型仅负责选文件、判断角色和排序。
AI.result: 在26544份评估报告中，修复文件首位及前五命中率为68.6%和85.9%，函数首位命中率为53.8%。
AI.conclusion: 受控分阶段流程能有效定位故障，并在文件定位相当时比自由智能体更准确地识别故障函数。

title: Steering Bayesian Inference and Decisions through Data Poisoning
summary: Adversarial machine learning has revealed that statistical models can be manipulated through poisoned data, and Bayesian inference is no exception. Earlier work has shown that subtle poisoning attacks can drive the posterior toward a distribution of the attacker's choosing. Such posterior attraction attacks require a fully specified target posterior; however, attackers typically care about only a few posterior quantities or, more consequentially, about a downstream decision. Herein, we study how an attacker can alter Bayesian inference and decisions by deleting or replicating a few observations, chosen to minimize the maximum mean discrepancy between the resulting posterior and a target distribution. A suitable kernel lets the attacker steer selected posterior moments without specifying the rest of the target. Because Bayes actions depend on the posterior only through expected utilities, which are themselves posterior moments, the same approach can target a decision directly. We construct the attacks with a gradient-based heuristic that requires only posterior samples, and analyze its convergence. Experiments with regression and hierarchical models compare moment-based and full-posterior attacks, and illustrate how deleting a handful of observations can flip a Bayesian decision.

AI.tldr: 通过删除或复制少量观测，攻击者可操纵贝叶斯后验的指定矩乃至下游决策。
AI.motivation: 既有后验吸引攻击要求完整指定目标分布，但攻击者往往只关心少数后验量或最终决策。
AI.method: 选择合适核函数最小化后验与目标的最大均值差异，并用仅需后验样本的梯度启发式构造攻击。
AI.result: 回归与层次模型实验表明，删除少量观测即可翻转贝叶斯决策。
AI.conclusion: 无需指定完整目标后验，数据投毒也能通过操纵后验矩直接影响贝叶斯决策。

title: ResWAM: Learning What Changes, Not What Stays, for World-Action Models
summary: World-action models (WAMs) augment vision-language-action policies (VLAs) with future prediction so that the policy can anticipate how its actions will affect the physical world. Existing WAMs supervise complete future observations. However, observations typically change little over an action chunk, so the future loss is dominated by copying static background content rather than learning task-relevant robot and object motion, limiting policy learning. Moreover, existing WAMs rely on large video generation models or separate world models, incurring heavy training and inference compute that hinders closed-loop deployment. To improve policy performance, we propose visual residual learning, supervising only the feature change from the current frame to the future frame in a frozen DINOv3 space. Compared with complete future features, this residual learning target yields a higher feature rank with richer and more diverse representations of scene changes, and spatially concentrates on the robot arm and manipulated objects rather than the background. To further improve computational efficiency, we present ResWAM, a residual world-action model with 2.3B parameters in total, including a lightweight 0.5B dual-branch DiT that jointly trains an action branch and a residual branch via conditional flow matching. Without robot pretraining (i.e., pretraining on external robot action trajectories beyond the benchmark demonstrations), ResWAM achieves top average success rates on LIBERO-Plus (81.1%), RoboTwin 2.0 (93.8%), and RoboDojo (9.40% success, 13.41 score) at the lowest training (2.7-4.0 TFLOPs) and inference compute (1.0-1.4 TFLOPs), and leads real-robot Open, Put, and Stack (80.0% average, +10.0% over $\pi_{0.5}$) at 92.7 ms latency.

AI.tldr: ResWAM以视觉残差替代完整未来观测预测，兼顾机器人策略性能与计算效率。
AI.motivation: 完整未来预测易被静态背景主导，而大型生成模型或独立世界模型增加闭环部署成本。
AI.method: 在冻结DINOv3空间监督帧间特征变化，以轻量双分支DiT通过条件流匹配联合学习动作与残差。
AI.result: 无额外机器人预训练时，LIBERO-Plus与RoboTwin成功率达81.1%和93.8%，实机平均80%，延迟92.7毫秒。
AI.conclusion: 聚焦机器人与物体变化的残差学习，可减少背景干扰并以较低计算成本提升控制表现。

title: SemMask: Semantic-Prioritized Progressive Masking for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) are designed to enable globally parallel generation. However, in practice, they often exhibit pseudo-autoregressive behavior and a function-word-first bias, which undermines their performance on tasks such as text writing and code generation that benefit from global planning and parallel decoding. To address this, we propose SemMask, a novel fine-tuning paradigm that leverages a semantic-prioritized progressive masking strategy to encourage the model to decode high-information semantic tokens early and globally, thereby enhancing its global planning and parallel generation capabilities. Specifically, we first use the gradients of the original DLM with respect to each token to identify semantic tokens. During masking, these semantic tokens are preserved with priority, establishing a progressive generation order in which semantic tokens are decoded prior to function tokens. Meanwhile, we adjust the loss weight for semantic tokens to further reinforce their early prediction. Experimental results show that SemMask achieves quality comparable to strong autoregressive baselines on both text writing and code generation tasks, while providing superior semantic coherence. Notably, SemMask achieves higher accuracy with substantially fewer decoding steps, indicating that the early establishment of semantic structure improves the efficiency--accuracy trade-off.

AI.tldr: SemMask通过语义优先渐进掩码微调，增强扩散语言模型的全局规划与并行生成。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型存在伪自回归行为和功能词优先偏差，限制文本写作与代码生成表现。
AI.method: 利用原模型的词元梯度识别语义词元，优先保留并调整其损失权重，促进语义先行解码。
AI.result: 文本与代码生成质量可媲美强自回归基线，语义连贯性更佳，并以显著更少解码步数取得更高准确率。
AI.conclusion: 优先建立语义结构有助于改善扩散语言模型生成效率与准确率之间的权衡。

title: Read, Then Shade? How Visual Evidence Changes Incentive-Driven Misreporting in Vision-Language Advisors
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly read a scene and report it to someone who acts on the report, sometimes under objectives that differ from that person's. We ask whether a stated incentive moves what a VLM reports, and whether this changes when the value must be read from pixels rather than given as text. In seeded synthetic scenes, a model reads the position of a target on a labelled axis and reports one integer to a fixed receiver; it is paid, in simulation, for accuracy or for a report a few units to one side, and every scene is also presented with the true value as text. Across a pilot and three follow-up studies with hash-frozen protocols, four small open VLMs from three families, and 15,170 held-out trials, a stated payoff moved reports in both modalities, and exact compliance at three units was significantly lower with the image than with text for three of four models; Qwen2.5-VL 7B showed no reliable difference. Adding the true value as text to the image prompt removed the gap in every model. For InternVL3 the gap vanished on scenes it read correctly when it wrote its reading first; for Gemma 3 it persisted. For Qwen2.5-VL 3B, which read every scene correctly, the gap held in four of five payoff paraphrases, nearly vanished when the model wrote its reading before its report or when the prompt stated that the client wants the truth, vanished with an unpaid goal, and persisted when the model reported before stating its reading; how often it shaded at all, even with text, depended strongly on the wording. When told that the client wants the true value, three of four models still shaded every text report. Visual input did not make these advisors reliably more truthful; it made compliance with a stated incentive depend on whether the read value is made explicit and on output order, a dependence that text-only evaluations and mean-shift metrics do not reveal.

AI.tldr: 视觉输入并不保证视觉语言顾问更诚实，其激励性误报受读数显式化与输出顺序影响。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型可能在与接收者利益不一致的激励下报告场景信息，视觉证据的影响尚不明确。
AI.method: 在合成坐标场景中，对四个开放模型开展15170次留出试验，比较图像与文本条件下的激励性报告。
AI.result: 激励在两种模态下均改变报告，四个模型中三个在图像条件下的精确服从率更低，补充真实文本值后差距消失。
AI.conclusion: 视觉证据对激励服从的影响依赖提示措辞、读数呈现和输出顺序，纯文本评估可能遗漏这些差异。

title: Sharp First-Hit Identification from Finite Depth Samples
summary: Which depths in a new camera view are determined by finitely many source-depth measurements? Pointwise uncertainty bounds do not answer this question: unobserved geometry between samples can change which surface is encountered first. We study a bounded Lipschitz class of continuous source inverse-depth fields with interval observations and known camera pose. Building on classical Lipschitz envelopes, we characterize the exact set of attainable first-hit depths and construct a globally admissible scene for every value in that set. The set can be disconnected. We also give a necessary and sufficient test for several proposed depths to be first hits of one shared scene. An epipolar reduction uses scalar cone inequalities without enumerating surfaces. In a rectified model with source spacing $h$, interval half-width $\varepsilon$, baseline $b$, and slope bound $L$, we prove a sharp worst-case inverse-depth diameter of $\max\{Lh+2\varepsilon,2\varepsilon/(1-bL)\}$ when $bL<1$, subject to sufficient depth and domain range for attainment. Exact samples still give the sharp bound $Lh$ at $bL=1$, while above this threshold ambiguity need not vanish as sampling becomes arbitrarily dense. Any positive measurement uncertainty can destroy uniform stability at the critical threshold. We provide constructive examples, an exact rational validation oracle, and a frozen ten-scene evaluation using reference, stereo, and learned-depth observations. The experiments separate solver correctness under the scene assumptions from failure of those assumptions: fixed learned-depth bands often yield narrow but incorrect sets. The results identify what a specified scene class permits; they do not infer a continuum regularity or physical-scene guarantee from sampled predictions.
comment: 36 pages, 9 figures. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible

AI.tldr: 研究精确刻画有限源深度观测能够确定的新视角首次命中深度集合及其稳定性界限。
AI.motivation: 逐点不确定性界无法处理采样间未观测几何对首次可见表面的影响。
AI.method: 在有界Lipschitz逆深度场与区间观测下，利用包络和极线标量锥约束刻画可达集合并构造场景。
AI.result: 可达深度集合可能不连通，基线与斜率乘积超过1时，加密采样也未必消除歧义。
AI.conclusion: 首次命中深度的可辨识性取决于场景正则性与测量误差，窄预测区间不代表真实场景保证。

title: Behavioral Assurance for Socially Deployed AI Agents
summary: AI agents are increasingly deployed in socially consequential settings, yet existing evaluations provide limited assurance that they behave consistently with their intended characteristics across diverse interactions. We introduce an evaluation framework for measuring the behavioral consistency of socially deployed AI agents. The framework operationalizes agent behavior along five measurable axes and uses a standardized evaluation battery spanning six socially salient interaction settings to assess behavioral differentiation, consistency, and drift. Controlled persona configurations serve as experimental anchors, enabling systematic testing of whether intended behavioral differences persist across contexts rather than appearing only as stylistic variation. Preliminary analyses demonstrate measurable differentiation across configurations and suggest associations between behavioral profiles and interaction outcomes. By shifting the focus from persona design to behavioral assurance, this work provides a foundation for evaluating whether socially deployed AI agents behave as intended, consistently and measurably, across the situations in which users encounter them.

AI.tldr: 提出面向社会性部署AI智能体的行为保障框架，评估其跨互动情境的一致性与漂移。
AI.motivation: 现有评估难以保证智能体在多样且具有社会影响的互动中持续符合预期行为特征。
AI.method: 沿五个可测行为轴，在六类社会互动情境中使用标准化测试，并以受控人格配置作为实验锚点。
AI.result: 初步分析观察到不同配置间可测的行为差异，并提示行为画像与互动结果存在关联。
AI.conclusion: 评估应从人格设计转向行为保障，系统检验智能体能否跨情境持续表现出预期行为。

title: Bellman Residual Bracketing: Resolving the Sample Complexity of Discounted and Average-Reward RL
summary: We study the sample complexity of the empirical planning or plug-in approach for reinforcement learning (RL) with a generative model. We show the discounted plug-in approach finds an $\varepsilon$-optimal policy with $O(SA (1-\gamma)^{-3} \varepsilon^{-2} \log(SA/\delta))$ samples, where $S, A, \gamma, \delta$ are the state and action sizes, discount factor, and failure probability, respectively. In the average-reward setting, we show that discounted plug-in and direct (undiscounted) plug-in achieve $O(SAH\varepsilon^{-2}\log(SA/\delta))$ and $O(SAD\varepsilon^{-2}\log(SA/\delta))$ complexities, respectively, where $H$ upper-bounds the optimal bias span and $D$ is the diameter. Combining with our lower bounds for nonadaptive generative models, these results resolve the minimax sample complexity of discounted RL and average-reward RL --- in both the span- and diameter-based classes --- up to constant factors. Our main technical contribution is a novel Bellman residual bracketing technique which improves the efficiency of prior absorbing-MDP-based concentration analyses.

AI.tldr: 贝尔曼残差夹逼技术使折扣与平均奖励强化学习的极小极大样本复杂度精确至常数因子。
AI.motivation: 需要厘清生成模型下经验规划在折扣及平均奖励设定中的最优样本复杂度。
AI.method: 提出贝尔曼残差夹逼技术，改进基于吸收马尔可夫决策过程的集中分析，并建立非自适应采样下界。
AI.result: 折扣情形获得与SA(1−γ)⁻³ε⁻²成正比的样本界，平均奖励界分别依赖偏差跨度H或直径D，均含对数因子。
AI.conclusion: 结合非自适应生成模型下界，结果在折扣及跨度、直径约束的平均奖励类别中达到常数因子最优。

title: Learning from Mutants: Teaching Small Language Models to Synthesise Loop Invariants
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have proven promising for synthesising loop invariants, a long-standing obstacle to automated program verification. Yet, frontier LLMs are typically accessible only through third-party APIs, hampering reproducibility and local deployment. Small language models (SLMs) sidestep these obstacles but require task-specific fine-tuning, for which high-quality training data is needed. We present a failure-driven data curation method for fine-tuning language models to synthesise loop invariants. Inspired by mutation testing, our approach applies semantic mutation operators to ground-truth invariants, producing semantic mutants that induce verification failure. Each mutant is paired with verifier feedback and its ground-truth counterpart, yielding training examples for feedback-guided invariant refinement. Whereas the vast space of mutants is a long-standing burden in mutation testing, it becomes an asset when generating training data, multiplying the examples obtainable from a fixed set of verified programs. We implement our approach for Dafny, augmenting an existing synthetic dataset of verified programs, and introduce a framework that iteratively refines candidate invariants using verifier feedback. On 472 DafnyBench programs, our best-performing fine-tuned Gemma-4-E4B configuration verifies 50.8% of programs zero-shot, compared to 8.1% for the base model, a 6.3$\times$ improvement. Higher-order mutants prove more effective as training data than first-order mutants, and adding mutation-based examples to direct synthesis examples, in which invariants are removed rather than mutated, improves performance under iterative refinement. Our approach also transfers to Qwen3.5-4B, whose zero-shot verification rate rises from 9.3% to 53.6%.

AI.tldr: 通过语义变异构造失败样例，可有效训练小语言模型合成并修正循环不变量。
AI.motivation: 前沿大模型依赖第三方接口，而可本地部署的小模型缺乏高质量循环不变量训练数据。
AI.method: 对正确不变量施加语义变异，将失败样例、验证器反馈与正确答案配对训练，并迭代修正候选。
AI.result: 在472个DafnyBench程序上，Gemma零样本验证率由8.1%升至50.8%，Qwen由9.3%升至53.6%。
AI.conclusion: 变异驱动的数据扩充有效提升小模型验证能力，高阶变异及与直接合成数据结合更有优势。

title: Spectral Steering: Local Inverse Geometry for Frozen Diffusion Generators
summary: A frozen diffusion generator may need to change several output properties while preserving others. We study when guidance faithfully realizes such a structured request and whether local inverse correction improves its direction. Our account links this benefit to the interaction between the request and the objective-specific remaining-sampler Jacobian: conditioning alone is insufficient. Spectral steering combines a request-specific cosine-gain predictor with damped inverse correction and fixed-time relinearization for finite edits. Scalar nulls and matched-movement controls test the predicted mechanism. Across 8,923 instances in a retrospectively identified local regime, predicted and realized gains correlate at Spearman 0.79, versus -0.11 for condition number. Experiments span images, audio, robotics, and control and planning, including complex character motion generation. On 50 paired inpainting cases, four corrections improve unobserved-pixel PSNR over Adam by 3.25 dB at equal total derivative traversals. Together, the analysis and controls connect request-dependent geometry to directional gains and establish where these gains translate into downstream performance.

AI.tldr: 谱引导利用请求相关的局部逆几何，改善冻结扩散生成器多属性编辑的方向。
AI.motivation: 冻结扩散模型需改变部分输出属性并保留其他属性，但仅凭条件数无法判断引导是否忠实执行请求。
AI.method: 结合请求特定的余弦增益预测、阻尼逆修正与固定时间重新线性化，并设置机制对照实验。
AI.result: 局部区间内预测与实际增益的秩相关为0.79；50组修复任务中，等导数遍历量下PSNR较Adam高3.25分贝。
AI.conclusion: 请求与剩余采样器雅可比的交互决定方向收益，局部逆修正可在适当条件下改善下游表现。

title: Risk-Averse Decision-Focused Learning: Minimizing CVaR of Regret
summary: Many combinatorial optimization (CO) problems involve parameters that are uncertain when the problem must be solved. In such settings, the parameters have to be predicted from correlated contextual information before a solution can be computed. \emph{Decision-focused learning} (DFL) addresses this by training the predictive model to produce predictions that optimize downstream decision quality. Most existing DFL methods are risk-neutral and minimize the expected regret. In high-stakes applications this can lead to undesirable outcomes, because decision-makers must also account for the tail risk of decision quality. Prior risk-sensitive approaches typically model uncertainty explicitly and solve a stochastic or robust optimization problem at inference time, which increases computational complexity. We instead propose a DFL framework that achieves risk-sensitive behavior while retaining point predictions and deterministic optimization at inference time. Starting from the dual representation of the Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) and adding entropy regularization, we derive a smooth surrogate for the CVaR of regret. Its gradient induces an instance-dependent reweighting within each minibatch that emphasizes high-risk outcomes, so the approach can turn existing surrogate-loss DFL methods, including the SPO+ loss, into risk-sensitive variants. When instantiated with SPO+, the resulting objective admits a generalization bound on the CVaR of the true regret. Experiments on knapsack, portfolio, shortest-path, and energy-aware scheduling problems show substantial reductions in tail regret when the uncertain parameters exhibit heterogeneous tail behavior.

AI.tldr: 通过优化遗憾的条件风险价值，使决策导向学习降低尾部风险而不增加推理阶段的优化复杂度。
AI.motivation: 现有决策导向学习多最小化平均遗憾，难以满足高风险应用需求，而显式不确定性优化增加推理成本。
AI.method: 从条件风险价值的对偶形式出发加入熵正则，构造平滑损失，并通过批内实例重加权强调高风险结果。
AI.result: 在背包、投资组合、最短路径及节能调度任务中，参数尾部行为异质时尾部遗憾显著降低。
AI.conclusion: 该框架保留点预测与确定性推理，并可将SPO+等现有方法扩展为具备泛化保证的风险敏感变体。

title: Consistency-Aware Map Generation at Multiple Zoom Levels Using Aerial Image
summary: The multi-level tiled map service is widely used and serves as a kind of digital infrastructure. These map tiles are usually rendered from vector data, whose update needs to walk or drive with professional equipment to check every points of interest. This leads to inconvenience and expensive cost in timely updating maps. Compared with vector data, aerial images are much easier and cheaper to obtain. In this paper, we propose a novel multi-level map generation framework that can automatically generate accurate and consistent maps with multiple zoom levels from aerial images. It consists of a level-aware map generator and a consistency-aware map generator. The level-aware map generator is able to generate accurate initial maps with realistic details for each zoom level. The consistency-aware map generator regards initial maps at each zoom level as a sequence and builds the connection between them, so as to guarantee content consistency between maps at different zoom levels. Furthermore, we collect a large-scale high-quality dataset called Multi-Level Map (MLM) for map generation at multiple zoom levels. Experiments on our MLM dataset show that our method outperforms previous state-of-the-art map generation methods on both comprehensive quantitative metrics and perceptual quality.

AI.tldr: 利用层级感知与一致性感知生成器，从航拍图像生成跨缩放层级一致的地图。
AI.motivation: 传统地图依赖专业设备实地更新矢量数据，成本高且不便，而航拍图像更易低成本获取。
AI.method: 先按缩放层级生成初始地图，再将各层地图作为序列建立关联，并构建多层级地图数据集MLM。
AI.result: 在MLM数据集上，该方法在综合量化指标与感知质量方面均优于此前最先进的地图生成方法。
AI.conclusion: 分层生成与跨层关联建模能够提升航拍图像生成多缩放级地图的准确性和内容一致性。

title: EndoComparer: Comparative Surgical Video Question Answering with Pseudo-Siamese Visual Adaptation and Perceive-then-Compare Reasoning
summary: Purpose: Surgical training benefits from explicit comparison between cases: in patient condition, in technique and in skill proficiency. Surgical vision-language models (VLMs) offer a promising and flexible interface for this purpose. Yet current VLMs typically see one video at a time, and they often fall short when asked to compare videos. Methods: We propose EndoComparer, a VLM for comparative surgical video question answering with two components. (a) A Pseudo-Siamese Visual LoRA (PSVL) gives each video slot its own low-rank adapter over a shared frozen vision encoder, separating the two videos in the visual pathway at the cost of a single encoder pass. (b) A Perceive-then-Compare chain of thought (PtC-CoT) trains the model to first state what each video shows, then derive the answer from these statements. We further curate EndoDiffVQA, a benchmark of nearly 11K multiple-choice questions on video-pair over cholecystectomy and gastric bypass procedures, covering anatomy, tool, action and skill. Results: EndoComparer outperforms strong generalist and surgical VLMs on detecting and specifying difference between videos. Ablations show that two proposed components contribute complimentarily, and the model remains more robust under a video-swap control that exposes confusion between the two videos. Conclusion: Providing a dedicated visual reasoning path through PSVL and PtC-CoT makes cross-case comparison of surgical videos more robust for VLMs. EndoDiffVQA and EndoComparer provide a benchmark and a strong baseline for this task. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: EndoComparer通过独立视觉适配与先感知后比较推理，提升手术视频对比问答能力。
AI.motivation: 手术训练需要跨病例比较，但现有视觉语言模型通常面向单视频，难以可靠区分两个视频。
AI.method: 采用共享冻结编码器上的伪孪生视觉LoRA和先感知后比较训练，并构建近1.1万题的EndoDiffVQA。
AI.result: 模型在视频差异检测与描述上优于强通用及手术模型，两组件互补，且视频交换测试下更稳健。
AI.conclusion: 专用视觉路径与分阶段比较推理增强跨病例比较稳健性，并为该任务提供基准和强基线。

title: SLiDE: Structured Linear Dynamics for Forecasting with Exogenous Inputs
summary: Accurate time series forecasting with exogenous inputs is critical across domains, including energy and retail, yet modern deep learning models often overfit to correlations that do not generalize under shifts in these inputs. We propose SLiDE, a Koopman-inspired architecture for forecasting with exogenous inputs that imposes structure on latent temporal dynamics. SLiDE approximates nonlinear system evolution using a learned linear operator in a latent space, combining (i) a history encoder that reconstructs the current latent state from past targets and inputs with (ii) a shared linear rollout driven by future exogenous variables. By enforcing a common linear recurrence across encoding and prediction, SLiDE aligns how past information is encoded with how future states evolve, reducing parameterization and preventing reliance on spurious correlations in the input history. Empirically, SLiDE achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on real-world benchmarks, including electricity price forecasting and retail demand, while maintaining a computational footprint comparable to lightweight MLP architectures. SLiDE is especially effective at generalizing to shifted exogenous inputs, reducing MSE by 20% on electricity price samples with out-of-range exogenous values and MAE by 30% in a synthetic transfer setting where the same dynamical system is driven by an unseen exogenous process. Ablations confirm the importance of both the structured history encoder and the linear latent rollout, suggesting that structured latent linear dynamics provide a useful inductive bias for forecasting with exogenous inputs.

AI.tldr: SLiDE以结构化潜在线性动力学提升含外生输入的时间序列预测及分布偏移泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有深度预测模型容易依赖外生输入中的伪相关，在输入分布变化时泛化不足。
AI.method: 历史编码器重建潜在状态，并以未来外生变量驱动共享线性递推，统一历史编码与未来演化。
AI.result: 真实基准达到最先进精度；电价越界输入样本MSE降低20%，合成迁移任务MAE降低30%。
AI.conclusion: 结构化历史编码与潜在线性递推提供有效归纳偏置，以接近轻量MLP的计算成本改善预测泛化。

title: Explicit Regularization for Flow Matching
summary: Learning the underlying probability distribution from samples is a core problem in statistics and applied mathematics. Generative models based on diffusion and flow matching learn a velocity field whose flow transports a known distribution to the data distribution. They produce novel, realistic samples, although the empirical learning problem is ill posed near the data distribution. Its minimizer transports the samples onto the training data, and small perturbations of the data change the velocity field strongly near the end of the flow. The observed generalization is often attributed to implicit regularization by the network parameterization, early stopping of the training, and the time integration during sampling. Explicit regularization has advanced the theory and computation of many inverse problems and has recently been proposed to prevent memorization in generative models. With a regularizer on the magnitude of the velocity, however, the field approaches the memorizing velocity unless the regularization parameter grows to infinity fast enough, and it then stays bounded by a constant that is small only for large parameters. We show that penalizing the derivatives of order $k$ of the velocity renders the $D$-dimensional empirical problem well posed uniformly in time if $2k > D$ and the training points are in general position. Our experiments in one and two dimensions discretize the velocity with splines and use direct solvers for the regularized least-squares problems to exclude optimization error. Refining the discretization in space and time changes the error of the Hessian-regularized flows only marginally, whereas without the regularizer the error tends to that of memorization. These flows generalize, with errors comparable to or lower than those of well-tuned kernel density estimates.
comment: 40 pages (main text pp. 1-24, references pp. 24-26, appendices A-C pp. 27-40), 4 figures, 11 tables

AI.tldr: 对流匹配速度场施加高阶导数正则，可使经验学习问题适定并抑制训练样本记忆。
AI.motivation: 流匹配经验目标在接近数据分布时不适定，仅惩罚速度幅值难以充分避免记忆。
AI.method: 证明一般位置样本在2k>D时采用k阶导数惩罚可获得时间上一致适定性，并用样条和直接求解器验证。
AI.result: 一二维实验中，Hessian正则流的误差对离散加密不敏感，且与调优核密度估计相当或更低。
AI.conclusion: 导数正则为流匹配提供明确的适定性条件，并在低维实验中实现稳定泛化而非样本记忆。

title: PBit1: One Programmable P-Bit per Parameter - A Finite-Control Representation of Pretrained Networks
summary: We introduce PBit1, a finite-control representation of pretrained neural networks that assigns one programmable p-bit to each learned parameter. A 12-bit command sets its probability, a shared affine range maps that probability to the weight domain, and temporal observations reconstruct the weight for inference. Operator-aware range grouping and sensitivity-based sampling allocation adapt the representation to the network. Across five independent weight draws at 32,768 observations per scalar, selected configurations preserve task quality in GPT-2, DistilBERT, and LFM3-1.7B with every learned scalar converted and no fine-tuning. GPT-2 and LFM3 perplexity increase by approximately 0.66% and 0.26%, respectively, while DistilBERT accuracy changes from 87.51% to 87.49%. A sensitivity-based policy reduces GPT-2 reconstruction observations by 41.7% while retaining the quality criterion. Complete-model evaluations reuse reconstructed weights in BF16 inference, and THRML operator experiments examine native sampling and spatial-temporal tradeoffs. Together, these results establish PBit1 as a concrete construction for studying finite-control weight representation and temporal reconstruction in pretrained networks.
comment: 7-page main paper with 3 figures, plus a 12-page supplement

AI.tldr: PBit1以每参数一个可编程概率比特表示预训练网络，并通过时间采样重建推理权重。
AI.motivation: 研究预训练网络权重的有限控制表示，以及时间采样重建对任务质量和资源开销的影响。
AI.method: 以12位指令设置概率，经共享仿射范围映射权重，并结合算子感知分组和敏感度采样分配。
AI.result: GPT-2与LFM3困惑度约增0.66%和0.26%，DistilBERT准确率降0.02个百分点；敏感度策略减少41.7%采样。

title: Learning Spatially Aware Audio-Visual Features from Videos with Mono Audio
summary: Comprehensive audio-visual perception requires both semantic and spatial reasoning. Existing spatial models suffer from poor generalization due to data scarcity, while semantic-only models fail to capture spatial characteristics completely. We introduce a model capable of jointly reasoning over binaural audio and vision on semantic and spatial tasks with improved generalization. To overcome the shortage in real-world data, we develop an automatic pipeline that localizes the sound source in a video, estimates its relative 3D trajectory, and renders binaural audio. We then use this to spatialize VGGSound, allowing us to train at a much larger scale. We demonstrate improved performance and generalization on spatial reasoning tasks while still remaining competitive on semantic tasks compared to semantic-only models.

AI.tldr: 提出利用单声道视频构造空间音频数据的模型，联合提升视听语义与空间推理能力。
AI.motivation: 空间模型受数据稀缺限制而泛化不佳，纯语义模型又难以充分捕捉空间特征。
AI.method: 自动定位声源并估计其相对三维轨迹，渲染双耳音频以空间化VGGSound并训练联合模型。
AI.result: 模型改善了空间推理表现与泛化能力，同时在语义任务上保持与纯语义模型相当的竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 自动生成空间化音视频数据可扩大训练规模，支持兼顾语义与空间的视听感知。

title: Synthetic Neurosymbolic Task Generation with Controlled Constraint Complexity
summary: We introduce NeSySy, a synthetic generator for neurosymbolic learning tasks that jointly produces logical constraints and consistent datasets. Unlike existing benchmarks, NeSySy provides fine-grained control over key properties such as constraint structure, tightness, input dependence, and data generation and alignment strategies. In particular, it allows the use of rich constraints over infinite domains, and uses solvers to ensure that the constraints are meaningful and that generated samples satisfy the constraints. We design NeSySy to support both learning with declarative constraints and learning from distant supervision. Across a range of constraint families, we provide evidence that its parameters induce systematic and largely independent effects on task difficulty. Using NeSySy, we study constraint-aware learning methods, identifying regimes where explicit constraint enforcement is beneficial and where expressive unconstrained models can instead learn constraint structure directly from data. Our results establish NeSySy as a controlled testbed for analysing the interaction between learning and logical structure. NeSySy is built around a pipeline that incorporates solvers. Satisfiability checkers (CNFgen and Z3) generate and certify constraints. Constrained optimizers (RC2 for MaxSAT, Z3 for OMT) compute optimal repairs that guarantee every generated sample is consistent.

AI.tldr: 提出NeSySy生成器，通过可控逻辑约束与一致数据构建神经符号学习测试平台。
AI.motivation: 现有基准难以精细控制约束属性，限制了对逻辑结构与学习难度关系的系统研究。
AI.method: 联合生成约束与数据，以求解器验证约束并最优修复样本，控制约束结构、紧致度及输入依赖等属性。
AI.result: 参数对任务难度产生系统且大体独立的影响，并揭示显式约束与无约束模型各自适用的情形。
AI.conclusion: NeSySy为分析学习与逻辑结构的交互提供了可控测试平台。

title: AC Assessment of DC Power Flow Screening for Data Center Hosting Capacity and Siting
summary: A screening procedure based on direct current (DC) power flow estimates the data center hosting capacity of a candidate bus, termed the DC-screened capacity, and selects the generator commitment that supports it. This paper assesses that estimate under the alternating current (AC) network model. With the selected commitment fixed, an AC optimal power flow reoptimizes dispatch and voltages to find the largest data center load the bus can carry, termed the AC-assessed capacity. On a synthetic Texas system with 123 buses, the DC-screened capacity exceeds the AC-assessed capacity at 113 buses. Across all 123, the ratio of DC-screened to AC-assessed capacity has a median of 143% (a 43% overestimate) and a maximum of 1,070%. At these 113 buses, the DC-screened capacity violates a branch apparent power limit or a generator reactive power limit in the AC model, two limits the DC model omits. The overestimate changes decisions: a 1-GW project passes DC screening at every bus but exceeds the AC-assessed capacity at 37, and the bus ranked first by DC screening has 205.5 MW less AC-assessed capacity than the bus ranked second. Reporting the AC-assessed capacity beside each DC-screened capacity lets planners reject oversized projects or choose better sites.
comment: 5 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Submitted to the 2027 IEEE PES General Meeting

AI.tldr: 交流潮流评估表明，直流筛查可能显著高估数据中心接入容量并误导选址。
AI.motivation: 直流潮流忽略部分交流约束，其估算的数据中心承载能力需要验证。
AI.method: 固定直流筛查选出的机组组合，以交流最优潮流重新优化调度与电压，评估123节点系统。
