title: NAP-Wave: A Neural Adaptive Plane-Wave Architecture for High-Frequency Helmholtz Problems
summary: Training neural networks to simulate highly oscillatory wavefields presents optimization challenges, often hindered by spectral bias and poorly conditioned physics-based loss landscapes. To address these challenges and enhance convergence, we propose NAP-Wave, a joint neural architecture and training strategy that expands the target scattered wavefield in an adaptive neural plane-wave basis. The basis functions are extracted from all hidden layers and modulated by trainable plane-wave carriers, embedding the high-frequency oscillatory physics directly into the network's trial space. NAP-Wave is trained on a physics-informed loss built from the Lippmann-Schwinger integral equation, so no differentiation of the network with respect to its input is required. We develop a decoupled optimization strategy in which Adam updates the parameters of the neural plane-wave basis, while the linear combination coefficients are computed exactly by a least-squares (LS) solver. We couple this with an adaptive-depth training strategy in which the network starts shallow and grows progressively layer-by-layer. At each growth step, we avoid the loss spikes typical of dynamic network growth using the LS-computed coefficients, the warm-started parameters, and the preservation of the first- and second-order optimizer moments of the previous stage. Ablation studies confirm that the plane-wave basis, the exact coefficient solve, and the progressive schedule independently accelerate convergence and improve accuracy. Validated on exact-solution benchmarks, NAP-Wave achieves relative L2 errors of order 1%. On highly heterogeneous geophysical benchmarks, it achieves relative errors of 5%, 9%, and 10%, significantly outperforming published PINN methods in both accuracy and convergence time. To ensure reproducibility, the code is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: NAP-Wave结合自适应神经平面波基与分阶段训练，提高高频Helmholtz问题的求解效率和精度。
AI.motivation: 神经网络拟合高频振荡波场时受到谱偏置与病态物理损失的阻碍。
AI.method: 采用无需输入微分的积分方程损失，以Adam更新平面波基、最小二乘求系数，并逐层增加网络深度。
AI.result: 精确解基准相对L2误差约1%，非均匀地球物理基准误差为5%、9%和10%，优于已发表PINN方法。
AI.conclusion: 物理嵌入基、精确系数求解与渐进训练均有助于提升高频波场求解的收敛速度和精度。

title: Impact of Wind-Solar-Battery Growth on Electricity Prices: Reserve Scarcity and Transmission Congestion
summary: This paper asks whether sequential wind, solar, and battery storage additions that eliminate unserved energy also remove modeled reserve scarcity and transmission congestion. Thirty-one cumulative portfolio states are evaluated on a modified IEEE 24-bus system for a constructed stressed day using a 24-hour day-ahead unit commitment model with network constraints, co-optimized energy and upward reserve, chronological battery storage, and an approximation of the Electric Reliability Council of Texas operating reserve demand curve. The thermal baseline has 106 MWh of unserved energy, whereas 450 MW of wind is sufficient to serve all demand. However, with 1,500 MW of wind, the hourly modeled reserve scarcity price still reaches \$5,000/MWh because wind output declines after the system peak. Adding 1,800 MW of solar reduces the load weighted daily average modeled reserve scarcity price from \$1,136.2/MWh to \$101.2/MWh and confines modeled reserve scarcity to three evening hours. Adding 250 MW/1,000 MWh of battery storage further lowers the average to \$4.3/MWh and reduces wind curtailment from 631 MWh to 306 MWh. Transmission congestion nevertheless remains: all residual wind curtailment occurs at bus 21, wind capture prices at buses 21 and 23 differ by \$31.8/MWh, and identical battery storage plants yield normalized net energy market revenues of \$201/(MW$\cdot$day) and \$121/(MW$\cdot$day) at buses 19 and 21, respectively. These results show that unserved energy, modeled reserve scarcity, and locational congestion effects measure distinct operating conditions and should be evaluated separately but interpreted together.
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to IEEE GECA 2027

AI.tldr: 风光储扩容虽可消除失供电量并缓解备用稀缺，但输电拥塞和区位收益差异仍可能存在。

AI.method: 在修改的IEEE 24节点系统上，采用联合优化电能与向上备用的日前机组组合模型评估31种累计配置。
AI.result: 450兆瓦风电即可消除失供；继续配置光储使日均备用稀缺价格降至4.3美元/兆瓦时，但拥塞仍存。
AI.conclusion: 失供电量、备用稀缺和区位拥塞反映不同运行状态，应分别评估并结合解释。

title: Before the Word: Name Information in Description-Derived States of Small Language Models, With and Without Naming Failure
summary: The tip-of-the-tongue (TOT) state, knowing an object but not its name, motivates this study as an analogy only. We ask whether small language models form a name-predictive state from a name-free description, and whether it differs when naming fails but description selection succeeds. In an internally pre-registered study (a frozen document, no external registry) of Qwen2-0.5B, SmolLM2-1.7B and Phi-3-mini with 200 items, we combine a similarity read-out, a Patchscopes-style read-out and activation patching with matched controls. H1 (name information in the state) was supported in all nine model-by-description-type combinations; the agreement rule was met by the similarity measure together with patching, while Patchscopes stayed near chance. Post-hoc robustness checks after internal review (logit lens, single-position patch, manipulation check) temper this reading: name information in middle layers is clearest under the multi-position patch and the similarity measure, and weak under single-position patching at 50% depth. H2' (description-paraphrase consistency of name-free states not lower in failure items) is mixed: the SmolLM2 deficit test is significant under the pre-registered specification but not robust; Phi-3 non-inferiority holds across margins and a word-overlap covariate, although its bootstrap interval includes zero; Qwen2-0.5B is inconclusive. A capacity explanation remains untested. We report vehicle-level signals only, not meaning.
comment: 22 pages, 9 tables. Code and data: this https URL

AI.tldr: 小语言模型可从无名称描述形成名称预测信息，但命名失败时的状态差异证据不一致。
AI.motivation: 检验模型是否在看到名称前形成名称预测状态，以及命名失败但描述选择成功时该状态是否不同。
AI.method: 对三个小语言模型的200个条目开展内部预注册研究，结合相似度读出、Patchscopes读出与激活修补。
AI.result: 九种模型与描述组合均支持名称信息存在，但读出方法证据强弱不同，失败条目的描述改写一致性结果混合。
AI.conclusion: 发现仅涉及表征载体层面的信号，不证明意义存在，容量解释仍未检验。

title: A Hierarchical Statistical Framework for Evaluating Agent Reliability
summary: Agents operating in complex scenarios often face uncertainty due to incomplete information about the environment they operate in, ambiguous user queries, complex business rules and the inherently stochastic dynamics of the governing policy. Several new benchmarks have been proposed to evaluate LLM-based agents on complex tasks in multi-tool environments, including settings with policy constraints and varying levels of intent ambiguity. These conditions make it important to evaluate agentic systems systematically and quantify their performance under different conditions to assess their reliability in production. This need is evident in the recently introduced Thinkingbox benchmark, where even the strongest models struggle to perform consistently across diverse business scenarios. This paper presents a statistical framework for evaluating uncertainty and reliability in agentic systems. We define a hierarchy of scenarios, instances, and samples to assess model performance and variability systematically. We apply this framework to common metrics found in the literature: mean pass rate, $pass@k$, and $passhat^k$, with uncertainty estimates for each metric. Aggregating metrics at different levels of the hierarchy reveals different structures and properties of the policy model; we connect this hierarchical aggregation with the known process of \emph{coarse-graining} as intended in the physics and statistical literature. We independently derive exact finite-sample expressions for the sampling variances of the unbiased $pass@k$ and $passhatk$ estimators; related results also appear in recent submissions. Our central contribution is a constructive derivation of hierarchical uncertainty propagation, making explicit its correspondence with coarse-graining and separating execution noise from task heterogeneity.

AI.tldr: 提出智能体可靠性的分层统计框架，区分执行噪声与任务异质性并传播评估不确定性。
AI.motivation: 复杂环境、意图歧义和随机策略使智能体表现不稳定，需要系统量化其可靠性。
AI.method: 建立场景、实例和样本三级结构，为平均通过率、pass@k及passhat^k推导不确定性与层级聚合。
AI.result: 推导了无偏估计量的精确有限样本方差及层级不确定性传播，并明确其与粗粒化的对应关系。
AI.conclusion: 分层聚合可揭示不同层面的策略特征，为区分任务差异与执行随机性提供统计依据。

title: Towards Probabilistically Safe Reinforcement Learning: Theory and Deployment on Humanoid and Aerial Robots
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) enables robots to acquire complex skills, but standard RL formulations do not guarantee that learned policies satisfy safety constraints, which limits their use in safety-critical settings. Existing safe RL methods with provable guarantees typically support only restricted classes of constraints and require unbiased estimators of the objective and constraint functions, which prevents their direct integration with state-of-the-art algorithms such as proximal policy optimization (PPO). In this paper, we extend the recently introduced robust safe gradient flow-based reinforcement learning (RSGF-RL) framework to overcome these limitations. Our formulation accommodates a general class of trajectory-level safety constraints, including chance constraints such as collision avoidance with a prescribed probability, and our analysis allows for biased value and gradient estimators. We show that, with high probability, the constraint violation throughout training is bounded by the estimator bias plus a term that vanishes as the number of rollouts grows, and decays to this level if the initial policy is unsafe. We also establish the convergence properties of the iterates to approximate KKT points of the original safe RL problem. Finally, we show that RSGF-RL implemented with PPO-style estimates enables zero-shot sim-to-real deployment of whole-body control policies on a Unitree G1 humanoid and collision-free waypoint navigation on a Crazyflie drone.

AI.tldr: 扩展RSGF-RL以支持一般轨迹安全约束和有偏估计，并实现人形与飞行机器人零样本仿真到现实部署。
AI.motivation: 标准强化学习缺乏安全保证，现有可证明安全方法的约束与无偏估计要求又限制了其与PPO结合。
AI.method: 扩展鲁棒安全梯度流框架，纳入概率约束和有偏价值及梯度估计，并采用PPO式估计实现。
AI.result: 证明高概率约束违反界与近似KKT收敛性质，并在G1人形机器人和Crazyflie无人机上完成部署。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将可分析的概率安全约束与实用策略优化结合，为安全关键机器人控制提供路径。

title: Toward Planning Representations That Separate Task Structure from Visual Content
summary: Effective planning requires representations that preserve task-relevant geometry and object identity while ignoring visual variation that does not alter the task. Existing evaluations of visual generalization often change several factors simultaneously, making the source of a failure difficult to identify. We introduce a controlled evaluation of object-goal navigation (ObjectNav), the task of reaching an instance of a named object category, in procedurally generated ProcTHOR houses. Training and evaluation houses share floor plans, object locations, goals, and start states, while visual factors are changed individually or in combination. Across model-free reinforcement learning (RL), model-based RL, and agents using frozen pretrained visual representations, our results show that appearance changes impair navigation, but their effects differ sharply by factor. Surface material changes account for most of the average change in success, whereas clutter and lighting have little effect. The magnitude of a global image statistics shift does not reliably predict performance: changing only the goal object's appearance can substantially impair an end-to-end agent despite a small image-level change. We found that a model based agent that plans over frozen features from the pretrained DINOv2 image encoder achieves the highest success (0.83) under the full shift, but remains sensitive to surface appearance. Our experiments reveal an important requirement for planning representations: they must separate invariant spatial task structure from appearance.

AI.tldr: 受控导航实验表明，规划表征需要将不变的空间任务结构与视觉外观分离。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉泛化评估常同时改变多个因素，难以定位导航失败的来源。
AI.method: 在ProcTHOR住宅中固定布局、目标与起点，分别改变视觉因素并比较多类导航智能体。
AI.result: 表面材质变化影响最大，基于冻结DINOv2特征规划的模型在完整变化下成功率最高，为0.83。
AI.conclusion: 整体图像统计变化不能可靠预测导航性能，规划表征仍需降低对表面外观的敏感性。

title: Data-Driven Heuristic-Guided Business Process Redesign
summary: Business process redesign (BPR) has a long-standing catalog of best-practice redesign heuristics, yet, applying them remains a mostly manual task that requires extensive domain knowledge. Despite recent advances using Large Language Models (LLMs) for conversational process model redesign, limitations remain. For example, redesign is user-driven instead of data-driven and is not guided by best practices such as the redesign heuristics. Moreover, only one change can be handled at a time. To address these limitations, given an event log and a BPMN model, we present the DH-BPR framework to realize data-driven heuristic-guided BPR using LLMs. To design DH-BPR, we first conducted an analysis of which redesign heuristics can be automatically detected and applied given information contained in an event log such as the fraction of cases that bypass an activity. Based on this, DH-BPR detects and validates heuristic candidates through a combination of rule-based techniques and an LLM. After that, DH-BPR jointly designs and records an application plan for valid candidates, before finally yielding a redesigned BPMN model and an updated resource model (the way resources execute the process). Evaluation based on simulation using a synthetic benchmark and two real-world event logs shows that the framework's redesign reduces the mean case completion time by up to 61.5%.

AI.tldr: DH-BPR结合事件日志、重设计启发式与大语言模型，自动生成业务流程重设计方案。
AI.motivation: 现有流程重设计依赖人工和领域知识，且大语言模型方法缺乏数据与最佳实践引导。
AI.method: 结合规则与大语言模型检测并验证启发式候选，联合规划后输出新BPMN模型及资源模型。
AI.result: 基于合成基准及两个真实事件日志的仿真评估显示，平均案例完成时间最多减少61.5%。
AI.conclusion: 数据驱动的启发式联合应用能够有效改善业务流程的执行效率。

title: Well-Log Reconstruction with Pre-trained Geological Knowledge: A Knowledge-Conditioned Large-Language-Model Generative Agent
summary: Missing well-log intervals make subsurface reconstruction ill-posed. Existing numerical regression models lack geological prior knowledge to constrain ambiguous inverse mappings. We propose GeoLog-Agent, a knowledge-conditioned generative agent using pre-trained large language models (LLMs) as a source of geological priors. A universal Geo-Harness translates LLM stratigraphic reasoning into formation-anchored petrophysical trajectories, feature-wise linear modulation, and conditional adversarial constraints. On the Norwegian North Sea benchmark, GeoLog-Agent achieves a mean $R^2$ of 0.9307 and a peak $R^2$ of 0.9713. It exceeds the nine-baseline average $R^2$ of 0.8387 by 0.0920, with a 30.97% average RMSE reduction, and exceeds the strongest baseline by 0.0274--0.0498 in $R^2$, with 16.25%--24.05% lower RMSE. Ablations confirm the effectiveness and synergy of geological prior reasoning, multi-scale dilated generation, and conditional adversarial modules. Transferring the coupling mechanism to six conventional deep learning models improves their $R^2$ by 0.0162--0.0789 with cross-well stability. These results demonstrate how foundation-model domain reasoning can constrain deep generative reconstruction of missing petrophysical measurements.

AI.tldr: GeoLog-Agent利用预训练大语言模型的地质先验，提高缺失测井区间的重建精度。
AI.motivation: 测井缺失使地下重建成为不适定问题，传统回归模型缺乏约束歧义映射的地质先验。
AI.method: 通过Geo-Harness将地层推理转化为地层锚定轨迹、特征线性调制与条件对抗约束。
AI.result: 挪威北海基准上平均R²为0.9307，较九个基线平均值提高0.0920，平均RMSE降低30.97%。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型的领域推理可约束深度生成式测井重建，耦合机制也能改善常规深度模型。

title: Robust Well-Log Reconstruction Across Point Gaps and Whole Wells via Boundary-Gated Soft-Thresholding Kalman Fusion
summary: Missing wireline logs hinder subsurface characterization. Deep reconstruction networks suffer from gap-boundary steps and cross-basin shifts, while interpolation and Gaussian smoothers struggle with long intervals and outliers. We propose boundary-gated soft-thresholding Kalman fusion (ST-KF), unifying multiresolution wavelet shrinkage, distance-gated residual prior learning, and closed-form robust Kalman smoothing with learning--inference decoupling. Across two public benchmarks totaling 263 wells in the Norwegian North Sea and New Zealand's Taranaki Basin, ST-KF ranks first over 0.15--100-m anchored gaps with 0.09% parameter overhead. Against the strongest of nine baselines, pooled RMSE falls by 5.0%--8.3% for bulk density and 6.4%--15.6% for compressional slowness; against the four strongest baselines, reductions are 0.7%--4.1% for neutron porosity and 1.3%--2.9% for photoelectric factor. Ablations and sensitivity analyses confirm operator synergy and stable performance: removing state-space fusion increases short-gap errors by up to 58.8%, while zero-shot transfer cuts anchored errors by 14%--68%. The results show that local borehole continuity transfers across basins whereas cross-property mappings shift with regional geology, supporting measurement-guided log reconstruction.

AI.tldr: ST-KF融合边界门控、软阈值处理与卡尔曼平滑，提升跨缺口和跨盆地测井重建的稳健性。
AI.motivation: 深度重建存在缺口边界跳变与跨盆地偏移，插值和高斯平滑难以处理长缺口及异常值。
AI.method: 将多分辨率小波收缩、距离门控残差先验与闭式稳健卡尔曼平滑结合，并解耦学习与推断。
AI.result: 在两项共263口井的基准上，ST-KF在0.15至100米锚定缺口中排名第一，参数开销仅0.09%。
AI.conclusion: 局部井眼连续性可跨盆地迁移，但属性间映射随地质变化，支持测量引导的测井重建。

title: Where slide-level foundation-model classifiers fail on atypical breast lesions
summary: Whether a ductal breast lesion is called atypical hyperplasia or low-grade carcinoma in situ increasingly determines surgery. However, slide-level classifiers built on pathology foundation models (PFMs) perform worst on these lesions. Using four PFMs, cross-validation on BRACS and preregistered hypotheses, we studied where the classification of atypia fails. Because slides are labelled with their most severe lesion, only 39% of the slides with annotated atypical ductal hyperplasia (ADH) were labelled ADH. Attention ranked the lesion high but rarely first, and showing the model only the lesion helped little, whereas classifiers trained per decision with lesion-level labels improved all four atypical boundaries. ADH regions inserted into benign slides raised the probability of malignancy more than that of atypia. In a hospital with pathologist-labelled single-subtype slides and in HISTAI, benign slides were scored closer to lesions and triage specificity fell from 0.48-0.53 to 0.00-0.07 and 0.22.

AI.tldr: 乳腺非典型病变分类失败不仅源于病灶定位，也与切片级标签及分类决策方式有关。
AI.motivation: 非典型增生与低级别原位癌的区分影响手术决策，但病理基础模型分类器在此类病变上表现最差。
AI.method: 用四种病理基础模型开展BRACS交叉验证、预注册假设检验及病灶标签和外部数据评估。
AI.result: 仅39%的含ADH标注切片被标为ADH；病灶级分决策训练改善全部四个非典型分类边界。
AI.conclusion: 仅提供病灶区域改善有限，外部数据中特异度明显下降，提示需重视标签设计与泛化风险。

title: Multi-Objective Causal Bandits: Minimal Intervention Space and Policy-Level Learning
summary: Many decision-making problems involve multiple objectives, where actions affect several performance metrics, fairness criteria, or safety constraints. We study multi-objective causal bandits with multiple reward nodes, where actions correspond to interventions on subsets of variables in a causal graph and performance is evaluated through Pareto optimality. Existing approaches to multi-objective bandits often rely on pairwise Pareto dominance or optimize a fixed scalarization. However, pairwise comparisons alone can fail to identify actions dominated by randomized policies, whose expected reward vectors lie in the convex hull of action-level rewards. Thus, an intervention may be suboptimal even if no single intervention dominates it, because it can be dominated by a randomized policy over other interventions. We formalize this policy-level phenomenon and show that it has consequences for both causal action-space reduction and online learning. First, we provide a necessary-and-sufficient graphical characterization of possibly Pareto- optimal minimal intervention sets. Our characterization yields a minimal, sound, and complete candidate intervention family from the graph alone, correcting prior formulations that may include intervention sets that are never Pareto-optimal under any compatible structural causal model. Second, over this reduced intervention space, we design an online UCB-style algorithm that eliminates actions using dominance tests against convex combinations of other actions, and prove logarithmic gap-dependent Pareto regret. Finally, we study constrained multi-objective causal bandits, where feasibility and optimality may be realized only with randomized policies, and develop an online UCB-style constrained bandit algorithm with sublinear regret and constraint-violation guarantees.
comment: To appear in Proceedings of NeurIPS 26

AI.tldr: 研究将随机策略层面的帕累托支配引入多目标因果老虎机，改进干预空间缩减与在线学习。
AI.motivation: 动作间两两比较会遗漏被随机策略支配的动作，固定标量化也难以充分处理多目标决策。
AI.method: 建立最小候选干预集的图论刻画，并设计基于凸组合支配检验及约束处理的UCB式算法。
AI.result: 证明候选集刻画的充要性及对数级间隙依赖帕累托遗憾，并给出约束情形的次线性遗憾与违约保证。
AI.conclusion: 多目标因果决策需在策略层面判断最优性与可行性，不能仅依赖单个干预之间的比较。

title: ROUNDS: Source-Framed Diagnostic Revision after Multi-Turn Clinical Evidence
summary: Large language models (LLMs) achieve high scores on medical benchmarks, but does this performance translate into reliable diagnosis as a conversation unfolds? In diagnostic conversations, users can provide clinical findings across multiple turns, ask for a diagnosis without supplying answer options, and introduce opinions from others. Models must therefore form diagnoses from the available evidence and decide how to respond to subsequent advice. We introduce ROUNDS, a framework that evaluates these abilities after a fixed sequence of clinical evidence delivered over multiple turns. ROUNDS compares diagnosis with and without answer options, presents the same incorrect diagnosis under clinician and lay framing, and varies support for competing diagnoses in written five-clinician panels. Across seven models and 1,035 cases from five datasets, average accuracy was 76.9% with answer options and 57.0% without them. Clinician-framed misleading advice produced lower final accuracy than lay-framed advice in every model, with differences of 4.6 to 38.2 percentage points. Initially correct diagnoses more often became incorrect answers than abstentions, and many adopted the suggested disease. Conversely, accuracy increased as more panel members supported the correct diagnosis, including when the majority opinion remained unchanged. These findings reveal a gap between medical benchmark performance and reliable diagnosis in conversation: models respond to external opinions, but remain vulnerable to abandoning correct diagnoses without new clinical evidence.
comment: Accepted at Machine Learning for Health (ML4H) 2026, Proceedings Track; to appear in Proceedings of Machine Learning Research (PMLR). 17 pages

AI.tldr: ROUNDS显示，大语言模型在多轮诊断中容易受外部意见误导，即使没有新增临床证据。
AI.motivation: 医学选择题高分未必意味着模型能在多轮、无选项且夹杂他人意见的对话中可靠诊断。
AI.method: 在五个数据集的1035例病例上评估七个模型，比较选项、错误建议来源及专家小组支持比例。
AI.result: 有选项与无选项的平均准确率为76.9%和57.0%，医生框架误导较普通人框架低4.6至38.2个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 模型会响应外部意见，却可能无新证据地放弃正确诊断，暴露基准成绩与对话可靠性之间的差距。

title: Floorplan-Context-Aware Cross-Environment Human Activity Recognition from mmWave Radar Point Clouds
summary: Human activity recognition (HAR) models based on mmWave radar point clouds and trained in controlled open spaces often experience performance degradation when deployed in furnished rooms. We propose a Floorplan-Context-Aware (FCA) HAR enhancement method that augments the input with subject-furniture relative position information to improve cross-environment performance. Because existing mmWave point-cloud datasets lack registered floorplans, we introduce a pseudo-landmark augmentation strategy for training the FCA model. In cross-environment evaluation on the mm-ADL-Home dataset, FCA achieves 77.70% accuracy and 65.49% macro-F1, improving upon the point-cloud-only direct-transfer baseline by 10.73 and 10.05 percentage points, respectively, and exceeding the strongest evaluated adaptation baseline by 7.37 and 6.27 percentage points. At deployment, FCA requires only a one-time registration of furniture landmarks, with no target-domain activity annotations or model weight updates.

AI.tldr: FCA利用人体与家具的相对位置，提升毫米波雷达点云活动识别的跨环境表现。
AI.motivation: 在受控开放空间训练的毫米波活动识别模型，部署到有家具房间时性能常下降。
AI.method: 将人体与家具相对位置加入输入，并用伪地标增强弥补训练数据缺少配准平面图的问题。
AI.result: 在mm-ADL-Home跨环境评估中，准确率达77.70%、宏F1达65.49%，较直接迁移提高10.73和10.05个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 仅需部署时一次性登记家具地标，无需目标域活动标注或权重更新，即可改善跨环境识别。

title: Beyond the Training Cameras: Coverage-Controlled Probes of Viewing Direction in Frozen Vision Models
summary: Vision models are trained on 2D images of a 3D world. Do their hidden features encode the direction from which the camera views a scene, and if so, in what form? We study the relative viewing direction $\alpha$ of two objects in rendered scenes where both object centres stay at fixed pixels while the camera moves, so that perspective, shading and shadows change but the projected layout does not. In eight pretrained models, from diffusion models to self-supervised and image-text encoders, $\alpha$ is encoded in a strikingly simple form: a single two-dimensional plane in the hidden space, shared across scenes, in which the difference between the two objects' features traces $(\cos\alpha, \sin\alpha)$. The plane keeps its orientation when lighting, colours, floors and object shapes change. This encoding is more than a summary of a few visible measurements: readouts fitted on one set of camera paths stay accurate at camera positions outside their range in seven of the eight models, whereas decoders of the measured object and shadow geometry, equally accurate within that range, fail there. In the diffusion transformer PixArt-$\alpha$, the plane forms abruptly at a single block and carries direction information to later blocks, yet editing it changes the objects rather than the generated viewpoint. We also examine how this encoding carries over to scanned real objects.

AI.tldr: 八种预训练视觉模型均以跨场景共享的二维特征平面编码相对观看方向。
AI.motivation: 探究视觉模型是否编码三维场景的观看方向，以及这种编码能否超越训练相机范围。
AI.method: 固定渲染场景中物体的像素中心并移动相机，对冻结模型进行方向解码、泛化测试与特征编辑。
AI.result: 八种模型均出现正余弦式二维编码，其中七种的方向读出可泛化至拟合范围外的相机位置。
AI.conclusion: 视觉特征包含稳定且超越所测几何线索的方向表征，但编辑该表征未必改变生成视角。

title: SG-LegalClarify: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Legal Reasoning and Ambiguity Recognition in Singapore Law
summary: Singapore offers a distinctive testbed for legal reasoning by large language models (LLMs). Its legal system combines inherited English common law with jurisdiction-specific statutes, requiring models to distinguish local doctrine from generic common-law intuition. This setting also highlights the challenge of recognizing underspecification in lay legal queries, because the facts material to a legal outcome depend on the governing doctrine. Yet legal benchmarks rarely cover Singapore law or test this form of ambiguity recognition. To address these gaps, we introduce SG-LegalClarify, a large-scale benchmark for open-ended legal reasoning and ambiguity recognition in Singapore law. SG-LegalClarify contains 1,100 lawyer-authored source questions spanning 10 legal domains, including 340 fully specified and 760 underspecified questions. Each underspecified question has a fixed hidden-fact assignment and a fully specified counterpart, yielding 1,860 evaluation instances. Responses are graded with lawyer-authored Issue, Rule, Application, and Conclusion (IRAC) rubrics. We evaluate 19 LLMs, closed-book and with web search, using a multi-turn pipeline in which models decide whether to answer or clarify, and a user simulator reveals hidden facts only when asked. We find the benchmark far from saturated: the best models satisfy only 69.8% of mandatory rubric items closed-book (average 53.8%) and 77.8% with web search (average 63.0%). Models also struggle to recognize when clarification is necessary. We will release the public split of our benchmark, the model outputs on it, and the evaluation pipeline to support future research.

AI.tldr: SG-LegalClarify评测新加坡法律推理与歧义识别，揭示大模型在法律作答和主动澄清上的不足。
AI.motivation: 现有法律基准较少覆盖新加坡法律，也缺乏对法律问题事实不充分时澄清能力的评测。
AI.method: 基于律师编写的1100道问题构建1860个实例，以IRAC评分标准和多轮用户模拟评测19个模型。
AI.result: 最佳模型闭卷与联网的必需评分项满足率分别为69.8%和77.8%，且模型难以识别澄清需求。
AI.conclusion: 该基准仍有显著提升空间，可支持新加坡法律推理与事实澄清能力研究。

title: LoopFill: Pipelined Multi-Token Speculative Decoding for Looped Transformers
summary: Looped Transformers improve parameter efficiency by repeatedly applying the same Transformer layers. During autoregressive decoding, however, generating each token requires several sequential passes through these layers, leading to high decoding latency. Pipelined self-speculative methods use shallow-loop predictions to process tokens at different loops in the same batch, but each token must reach the drafting depth before the next can enter the pipeline. We introduce LoopFill, a training-free speculative decoding algorithm for looped LLM that combines multi-token suffix drafts with shallow-loop predictions in a single draft tree. Both drafters contribute to one tree, so a suffix lookup can immediately extend a shallow prediction and several future tokens can enter the pipeline together. The shared block computes the highest-scoring draft candidates at different loop depths in one batch, and full-depth verification preserves the model's autoregressive output distribution. Across seven benchmarks, LoopFill's average speedup over greedy autoregressive decoding is $5.85\times$ on Ouro-2.6B and $5.13\times$ on Huginn-3.5B. The speedups exceed those of LoopAhead, the strongest baseline, by \(40\%\) on Ouro-2.6B and \(25\%\) on Huginn-3.5B.

AI.tldr: LoopFill融合多词元后缀草稿与浅层循环预测，在保持输出分布的同时加速循环模型解码。
AI.motivation: 循环Transformer逐词元多次串行计算延迟高，现有流水线方法仍受草稿深度限制。
AI.method: 将后缀检索和浅层预测合入同一草稿树，批量计算不同循环深度的候选并进行全深度验证。
AI.result: 七项基准上，两模型平均加速5.85倍和5.13倍，较LoopAhead分别提升40%和25%。
AI.conclusion: 免训练的多词元联合草稿能提高流水线利用率，并保持原模型的自回归输出分布。

title: With the Right Representation, Classical Machine Learning Rivals Deep Models for Olfactory Mixture Similarity
summary: Modeling olfactory mixtures remains a critical challenge in machine olfaction because the task requires reasoning over relationships between sets of odorants rather than over individual molecules in isolation. However, prior comparisons between deep and classical approaches also varied how the relationship between the two mixtures was represented, since the classical baselines primarily relied on weak representations that described each mixture independently and provided little direct signal about how the mixtures differed. In this work, we revisit classical learning using explicit symmetric comparison features on unordered pairs of mixtures, evaluating these representations with XGBoost and kernel ridge regression (KRR). We find that XGBoost with explicit comparison features achieves performance competitive with specialized deep mixture models on the main benchmark. Ablation studies show that coordinate-wise absolute differences alone provide strong predictive performance, while combining them with sums and products yields further improvements. KRR also benefits substantially from explicit comparison features, with further gains from appropriate kernel choice and preprocessing. Overall, these results suggest that explicitly encoding how two mixtures differ is an important ingredient for classical machine learning in low-data olfactory mixture prediction.

AI.tldr: 显式表示混合物间差异后，经典机器学习在嗅觉混合物相似性预测上可媲美专用深度模型。
AI.motivation: 以往经典与深度方法的比较混杂了表示差异，经典基线缺少混合物间的直接比较信号。
AI.method: 为无序混合物对构建对称比较特征，使用XGBoost与核岭回归评测并开展特征消融。
AI.result: XGBoost在主基准上具有竞争力，绝对差特征已较强，加入和与积进一步改善性能。
AI.conclusion: 显式编码两种混合物的差异，是低数据嗅觉混合物预测中经典方法取得良好表现的重要因素。

title: A Geometric Understanding of Denoising Autoencoder with Applications to Image Denoising
summary: Denoising autoencoders have shown strong empirical performance in recovering clean data from their noisy observations, yet their underlying statistical behavior remains underexplored. In this paper, we study denoising autoencoders under the manifold hypothesis, assuming that clean data are supported on low-dimensional smooth manifolds embedded in a high-dimensional ambient space, while noisy observations are generated by isotropic Gaussian noise. We establish generalization guarantees in three geometric scenarios: a single manifold, a pairwise separated finite union of manifolds, and a finite union of intersecting manifolds. Using local chart representations, partitions of unity, and neural network approximation, we derive upper bounds for the expected squared reconstruction error for denoising autoencoder. In the single-manifold and separated-union scenarios, the error consists of a sample-dependent statistical term of order $n^{-2/(d+2)}\log^4 n$, a residual term of order $d\sigma^2/D$ caused by tangential noise, and an exponentially small tail term associated with failure of the manifold projection. Here $D$ is the data ambient dimension, $d$ is the intrinsic dimension of the clean-data manifold, and $\sigma^2$ is the expected squared noise magnitude. In the scenario of intersecting manifolds, we further identify an additional ambiguity term determined by the probability mass near the intersection neighborhood. Numerical experiments on synthetic manifolds and real image datasets support the predicted sample-size scaling law and illustrate the additional reconstruction ambiguity near manifold intersections.

AI.tldr: 研究从流形几何出发建立去噪自编码器误差界，并揭示流形交叉带来的额外重建歧义。
AI.motivation: 去噪自编码器虽有良好经验表现，其统计行为及数据几何结构对误差的影响仍不充分明确。
AI.method: 在流形假设与各向同性高斯噪声下，利用局部坐标、单位分解和神经网络逼近分析三类几何场景。
AI.result: 单流形与分离并集的统计误差项为n^{-2/(d+2)}log⁴n，交叉并集另有歧义项，实验支持预测规律。
AI.conclusion: 重建误差受样本量、切向噪声及流形交叉共同影响，几何分析可解释去噪性能与局限。

title: BadGCL: Towards Persistent Backdoor Attack on Graph Continual Learning Systems
summary: Backdoor attacks pose a persistent security threat to machine learning systems, yet their behavior under graph continual learning (GCL) remains underexplored. Conventional graph backdoor attacks often lose effectiveness as models are updated across successive tasks, creating the impression that continual updates naturally weaken malicious associations. This work reveals a contrasting vulnerability: knowledge-preservation mechanisms in GCL can also preserve early injected backdoors when the poisoned update is compatible with the clean-task signal being retained. For graph data, this risk is amplified by structural triggers, which are embedded into the message-passing paths of graph neural networks (GNNs) and can induce stable representation shifts across tasks. To expose this risk, we propose BadGCL, a model-agnostic framework for persistent backdoor attacks under a strict early-stage intervention setting. BadGCL learns topology-aware structural triggers using a gradient mutual-information objective that couples poisoned gradients with clean-task optimization signals, together with a propagation consistency objective that stabilizes trigger-induced effects through graph message passing. We provide theoretical analysis showing that gradient compatibility and propagation stability jointly support long-term backdoor persistence under benign continual updates. Extensive experiments across task-IL and class-IL protocols, four GCL benchmarks, and diverse victim systems show that BadGCL achieves persistent attack effectiveness with limited clean-utility degradation, substantially outperforming graph and continual-learning backdoor baselines and remaining robust against representative defenses.

AI.tldr: BadGCL表明图持续学习的知识保持机制也可能长期保留早期注入的结构后门。
AI.motivation: 现有图后门常随持续更新而衰减，但图持续学习中的长期后门风险尚未充分研究。
AI.method: 在仅早期干预的条件下，以梯度互信息和传播一致性目标学习拓扑感知结构触发器。
AI.result: 四个基准及多种受害系统上，BadGCL持久攻击效果优于基线，干净效用损失有限且能抵抗代表性防御。
AI.conclusion: 与干净任务兼容的梯度和稳定的图传播效应，可使后门在良性持续更新中长期存留。

title: Mesoscale Neural Operators: Learning Nonlinear Constitutive Laws from Molecular Dynamics for Scalable Fracture Predictions
summary: Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations can capture the nanoscale physics of fracture at the atomistic level, but their computational cost prohibits predictions at the length scales and time scales needed for many applications. Machine learning approaches, on the other hand, have been proposed as heuristic surrogates for material fracture, yet they cannot guarantee the physical consistency of the predicted response. To address this shortcoming, we propose the mesoscale neural operator (MNO): a data-driven nonlocal constitutive model that is learned directly from MD loading and displacement data. After training, it can be used in continuum fracture simulations on much larger domains and grid sizes. The key idea of the MNO is to exploit the built-in characteristic length of a nonlocal model, called the horizon, to travel across scales. Physical consistency across scales is obtained by building two structural ingredients into the MNO: a normalized kernel that renders the strain energy density invariant under horizon rescaling, and a rescaled critical bond stretch that keeps the energy release rate consistent across scales. Through tests on synthetic data, we show that the MNO and its learning workflow indeed discover the nonlocal continuum multiscale model in the form of the nonlocal kernel and the nonlinear constitutive relation. We then apply the framework to coarse-grained MD data and find that in a test problem, the learned model matches the MD strain energy density and critical energy release rate within 3%. It also predicts the peak transmitted forces within 6% in out-of-distribution tension tests. As a further demonstration, the model is applied to a plate with 4000 times the area of the training specimens and containing an initial defect. In this problem, the model reproduces the main features of dynamic brittle fracture, including branch and cascading branch networks.

AI.tldr: 介观神经算子从分子动力学数据学习非局部本构关系，实现保持物理一致性的跨尺度断裂预测。
AI.motivation: 分子动力学难以扩展至应用尺度，而现有机器学习断裂替代模型缺乏物理一致性保证。
AI.method: 构建非局部神经算子，以归一化核和重标定临界键伸长维持跨尺度应变能密度与能量释放率。
AI.result: 测试中两项能量指标误差不超过3%，分布外峰值力误差不超过6%，并复现4000倍面积板的断裂分支。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可将原子尺度数据转化为可扩展的连续体断裂模型，并保留关键跨尺度物理性质。

title: PSK: A Matrix-Free Single-Loop Method for K-Level Physics-Based Control
summary: Physics-based control is central to robot learning, but differentiating through implicit physics steps typically requires Hessian or Karush--Kuhn--Tucker (KKT) linear solves; we ask whether gradient steps suffice. Each simulation step minimizes an energy under many contact and collision constraints. Without constraints, we view control over $K$ steps as $K$-level optimization with strongly convex lower levels, recast as one min--max problem. Our Penalized Single-loop $K$-level method (PSK) uses only gradients and a projection, updates all levels in parallel, and reaches an $\epsilon$-stationary control in $O(\epsilon^{-3})$ iterations, with a $K$-independent exponent but a $K$-dependent constant. Contact-rich constraints, however, typically violate a constraint qualification (CQ). We replace each constraint by a smooth wall that acts on a band of constant width. Under mild assumptions that need no CQ, every exact solution of the banded lower levels is then feasible and banded Fritz--John, and PSK keeps the $O(\epsilon^{-3})$ complexity. Without a CQ that is uniform in the band width, however, a shrinking band loses the $K$-independent exponent: with width $\epsilon$ and fixed $K\geq2$, deterministic zero-respecting methods need $\Omega(\epsilon^{-(K+3)/4})$ calls on a hard instance whose control dimension grows with $1/\epsilon$. We prove our assumptions for smoothed kinematic and dynamic multi-robot navigation among segment obstacles. In navigation experiments, PSK, tuned per case, reaches every goal with sixteen levels and, at equal time, reaches a lower loss than tuned unrolling in 17 of 18 cases, while implicit differentiation is lower in 10.

AI.tldr: PSK仅用梯度和投影求解多层物理控制，避免隐式微分所需的海森或KKT线性求解。
AI.motivation: 物理控制的隐式求导成本高，且接触碰撞约束常不满足约束资格条件。
AI.method: 将K层控制改写为极小极大问题，并行更新各层，以固定宽度平滑障壁处理接触约束。
AI.result: 固定带宽下迭代复杂度为O(ε^{-3})；导航实验中，同等时间下17/18例损失低于调优展开法。
AI.conclusion: 固定带宽下可无需约束资格条件获得层数无关的复杂度指数，但收缩带宽时这一优势可能丧失。

title: When AI Agents Should Repair, Replan, or Abandon: A Threshold Theory of Plan Commitment
summary: AI agents often discover mid-execution that their plan is broken, for example when an action fails or a tool is withdrawn. Deployed systems use conventions such as retry loops or "always replan," and a recent benchmark finds no fixed strategy dominates. This paper derives the optimal policy. In the model, a disruption destroys the causal support of part of a plan; repair is a partial reset that preserves the plan's structure, replanning is a full reset, and changing a plan is costly because others have conditioned on it. The optimal policy is a threshold in effective disruption depth: repair shallow damage, replan after deep damage, and abandon the goal when even a fresh plan is not worth its cost. Depth depends on plan structure. In expectation, a single broken action forces 1+R(G)/n actions to be revalidated, where R(G) counts the pairs of actions joined by a dependency path; to first order, a fully serial plan switches to replanning at raw damage about w times smaller than a plan of w parallel chains. A closed-form stability-price threshold determines when a worse repaired plan should be kept over a better fresh one. As language-model planners push replanning costs toward zero, the stability price becomes the only force sustaining plan commitment. Under repeated disruptions, revision frictions make commitment hysteresis optimal: the agent keeps executing a plan it would never choose fresh, and each repair adds patch debt until the debt outweighs repair's cost advantage and the agent rebuilds. A value-of-diagnosis result states when measuring damage is worth its compute and shows that "always replan" is optimal when damage is predictably deep and replanning is the better fallback. A separately implemented numerical checker tests each proposition (zero violations; 1.6 million static-model evaluations), and the model's regime map reproduces that benchmark's regime flips qualitatively.

AI.tldr: 提出计划承诺的阈值理论，解释智能体何时应修复、重规划或放弃目标。
AI.motivation: 计划执行受扰后，固定重试或始终重规划策略无法在不同情境下保持最优。
AI.method: 将修复与重规划建模为不同程度的重置，并纳入依赖结构、变更成本及重复扰动。
AI.result: 最优策略依有效扰动深度分区，数值检查覆盖160万次静态模型评估且未发现命题违例。
AI.conclusion: 计划承诺取决于损伤深度与稳定性代价，重复修复积累的补丁债务最终可能促使重建。

title: Low-Voltage Ride-Through in AI Data Centers via Coordinated Battery and Computing Load Control
summary: The ability of large AI data centers to ride through grid voltage sags is critical to power system stability and reliability. This paper frames data center low-voltage ride-through (LVRT) as a DC-link power balance problem. Once the rectifier reaches its current limit, the power drawn from the grid decreases in proportion to the grid voltage. The DC-link capacitor can supply the resulting power deficit only briefly before the DC-link voltage falls low enough to trigger undervoltage protection tripping. To address this issue, this paper proposes effective control strategies for coordinating uninterruptible power supply (UPS) battery and computing load curtailment to offset the power deficit and enable LVRT at minimum control cost. Three control scenarios are studied: UPS battery support alone, computing load curtailment alone, and the coordinated use of both resources. Electromagnetic transient (EMT) simulations using the TAMU-ERCOT AI data center model demonstrate that battery support and the coordinated strategy achieve LVRT for all tested sags, including a near-zero-voltage fault, while load curtailment alone rides through moderate voltage sags.

AI.tldr: 通过协调UPS电池与计算负载削减，提升AI数据中心的低电压穿越能力。
AI.motivation: 电网电压骤降使整流器供电不足，直流母线电容难以持续补偿缺口，可能触发欠压脱网。
AI.method: 将低电压穿越建模为直流母线功率平衡问题，比较电池、负载削减及二者协调控制。
AI.result: 电磁暂态仿真中，电池及协调策略穿越全部测试电压暂降，单独削减负载仅穿越中度暂降。
AI.conclusion: 电池支持及其与负载削减的协调控制可增强数据中心对严重电压暂降的耐受性。

title: Architecting the Corporate AI Infrastructure: The Evolving Roles of AI Governance Committees and Chief Ethics Officers
summary: The accelerating integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into core business operations has created an urgent need for robust corporate governance infrastructures capable of managing complex ethical, legal, and operational risks. While organizations have increasingly adopted high-level AI ethics principles, a critical implementation gap persists: fewer than half of organizations that cite AI governance as a boardroom priority have a formalized governance framework in place. This paper addresses that gap by proposing a structured corporate AI governance architecture (CAIGA) centred on two mutually reinforcing pillars. First, it examines the evolving mandate of specialized C-suite roles, specifically Chief Privacy Officers (CPOs) and Chief Ethics Officers (ChEOs), in formalizing accountability for AI usage across the enterprise. Second, it argues that cross-functional AI Governance Committees, uniting representatives from legal, technology, data science, cybersecurity, and business units, are the essential organizational mechanism for translating ethical principles into operational decisions, including strategic go/no-go approvals for new AI initiatives. Drawing on a conceptual review of peer-reviewed governance literature, regulatory frameworks including the EU AI Act, and documented industry practice, this paper contributes a replicable governance architecture that embeds clear accountability policies, structured risk management workflows, and an organization-wide ethical AI culture. The framework is illustrated through application to the financial services sector. The findings have direct implications for corporate leaders, risk professionals, and policymakers navigating the rapidly evolving global AI regulatory landscape.
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Published in Procedia Computer Science 292 (KES 2026, 30th International Conference on Knowledge-Based and Intelligent Information & Engineering Systems)

AI.tldr: 提出以高管问责与跨职能AI治理委员会为支柱的企业AI治理架构。
AI.motivation: 企业AI伦理原则与实际治理机制脱节，亟需应对伦理、法律及运营风险的组织架构。
AI.method: 概念性梳理治理文献、监管框架与行业实践，并以金融服务业说明架构应用。
AI.result: 提出涵盖明确问责政策、结构化风险管理流程与全组织伦理文化的可复用治理架构。
AI.conclusion: 专责高管与跨职能委员会的协作可为企业将AI伦理原则落实为运营决策提供组织路径。

title: Score-Based Stochastic Closure Modeling via Offline Indirect Learning and Online Data Assimilation
summary: Stochastic closure modeling is an emerging area in reduced-order modeling of large and complex (e.g., multiscale, multi-physics) systems, for which the computationally affordable reduced-order physical descriptions (e.g., digital twins for additive manufacturing, world models for AI agents) in numerical simulations inevitably lead to information losses that cannot be well addressed by classical deterministic closures. However, learning stochastic closures typically requires closure data that are difficult to obtain from measurements or often prohibitively expensive to compute using first-principles simulations. In this work, we develop a stochastic closure modeling framework that builds on score-based diffusion models, leveraging indirect offline training and online data assimilation without requiring the direct data of closures. Numerical experiments on two-dimensional turbulent flows demonstrate that indirect offline learning captures key closure statistics and improves predictions of system state. In addition, combining the learned closure with known physical dynamics leads to better generalization capability across different regimes than purely data-driven models that directly predict system state. Compared to standard data assimilation methods with a Gaussian assumption, the posterior-score assimilation better represents non-Gaussian features of the learned closure, and its combination with state-level data assimilation further improves prediction of the system state. The proposed framework enables stochastic closure modeling in realistic and challenging scenarios of complex dynamical systems in mechanics and engineering problems, where non-Gaussian statistics of model-form uncertainties are non-negligible (e.g., due to the nonlinearities of the system dynamics and/or the observations) and true closure data are not available, for both offline learning and online assimilation.

AI.tldr: 结合得分扩散模型、离线间接学习与在线同化，在无直接闭合数据时学习随机闭合。
AI.motivation: 复杂系统降阶模型存在信息损失，而随机闭合所需的直接数据难以测量或昂贵难算。
AI.method: 以得分扩散模型进行间接离线训练，并结合后验得分同化、物理动力学与状态级同化。
AI.result: 二维湍流实验显示，该方法捕捉关键闭合统计并改善预测，跨工况泛化优于纯数据驱动模型。
AI.conclusion: 该框架适用于缺乏真实闭合数据且模型不确定性具有显著非高斯特征的复杂动力系统。

title: Attacker Diversity Reduction in Adaptive LLM Red Teaming
summary: Reinforcement learning can make automated red-teaming more successful while narrowing the attacks it produces. Co-training an attacker and a defender with group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) has been reported to reduce attacker diversity. This experiment reproduces attack diversity reduction using three runs with a Qwen2.5-14B attacker and a Phi-4-mini defender trained by direct preference optimization (DPO). The attacker receives a success-only reward and uses a length-unbiased loss, bounded updates, warm-up and ratio clipping. The attacker is evaluated on 26 AdvBench behaviors. Training ended after 12 rounds, following a decision based on development checkpoints, so the reported intervals are nominal. Attack Diversity Retention (ADR) compares the within-behavior of the trained attacker spread with the untrained attacker. In order for an attack diversity to be consider as having been reduced, a criterion requires the ADR to be below a 0.75 target with a 95% confidence interval together with continued attacker effectiveness. Therefore, if an attacker narrows its attack vector by 25% consistently its considered less diverse. After 24 attacker and 12 defender LORA-based updates, ADR for the three runs were 0.63, 0.61 and 0.63, respectively. Each run met the criterion at round 12; the earlier checks at rounds 4 and 8 fell short. Despite attacks being less diverse, attack success continued to improve as the attacker was updated after each training run.

AI.tldr: 自适应大模型红队训练可在提升攻击成功率的同时显著降低攻击多样性。
AI.motivation: 需检验攻击者与防御者共同训练时，攻击有效性提升是否伴随多样性下降。
AI.method: 开展三次攻击者与防御者训练，在26类AdvBench行为上以多样性保留率及攻击有效性评估。
AI.result: 第12轮三次运行的多样性保留率为0.63、0.61、0.63，均达下降判据，攻击成功率仍提高。
AI.conclusion: 仅以成功为奖励的训练可能收窄攻击模式，且基于开发检查点的停止决策使报告区间仅具名义含义。

title: RIFT: Reward Improvement Field Transfer for Cross-Domain Offline RL
summary: Learning from limited target data is a central challenge in cross-domain offline reinforcement learning. Abundant source data can help, but dynamics differences can make direct transition reuse unreliable. We propose Reward Improvement Field Transfer (RIFT), which instead learns how low- and high-reward source transitions differ. RIFT encodes source and target transitions in a shared latent space, pairs low- and high-reward source transitions using optimal transport, and fits an affine field to their displacements. It applies this field to low-reward target anchors and decodes the results to augment the target dataset. The approach builds on the hypothesis that related domains can share useful low-to-high reward structure despite different dynamics. We bound synthesis error under shared class geometry, identify conditions favoring target anchoring over source-high transplant, and derive a conditional connection to downstream return. Experiments on dense-reward locomotion tasks under gravity, morphology, and friction shifts show improved aggregate performance over existing baselines.
comment: 39 pages, 4 figures, 17 tables (10 pages main text; remainder references and appendices)

AI.tldr: RIFT迁移源域从低奖励到高奖励的变化结构，以增强跨域离线强化学习的目标数据。
AI.motivation: 目标域数据有限，而源域与目标域动力学差异使直接复用源域转移不可靠。
AI.method: 在共享潜空间中以最优传输配对源域转移，拟合仿射改进场并作用于目标域低奖励锚点。
AI.result: 推导合成误差界及条件性回报联系，并在重力、形态与摩擦变化的运动任务上提升总体表现。
AI.conclusion: 相关域可能共享低到高奖励结构，借助目标域锚点迁移该结构可改善跨域数据利用。

title: Inequality-Constrained Optimization via Sliding Mode Control
summary: We present COSMIC (Constrained Optimization via Sliding Mode for Inequality Constraints), a continuous-time solver for inequality-constrained optimization. COSMIC couples primal gradient-flow dynamics with multiplier dynamics derived from sliding mode control laws on a manifold defined by the smoothed Fischer-Burmeister function. We prove that COSMIC's trajectories reach this manifold in finite time from any primal initial point, after which the dynamics reduces to the gradient flow of a logarithmic barrier function. This yields a control-theoretic interpretation of barrier methods while allowing infeasible initialization. For strongly convex problems, we further establish exponential convergence to the minimizer. To address the numerical stiffness that arises in discretization, we develop a modified discrete-time algorithm. We validate COSMIC across various machine learning applications, demonstrating its ability to solve optimization problems accurately while scaling effectively to high-dimensional settings.

AI.tldr: 提出滑模控制驱动的不等式约束优化求解器COSMIC，允许从不可行初始点启动。
AI.motivation: 需要兼顾不可行初始化、收敛保证与高维可扩展性的约束优化方法。
AI.method: 将原变量梯度流与滑模乘子动力学耦合，并设计修正离散算法缓解离散化刚性。
AI.result: 证明轨迹有限时间到达约束流形、强凸时指数收敛，并在机器学习应用中验证精度与扩展性。
AI.conclusion: COSMIC为障碍方法提供控制论解释，并将不可行初始化与可证明的收敛性质相结合。

title: Early Readability of Trajectory Quality in Diffusion Driving Planners
summary: Diffusion-based driving planners can generate multiple trajectories for the same scene, but these candidates vary in quality. Can their internal states reveal which candidate will be better before denoising is complete? We systematically study this question in three pretrained planners: Alpamayo, ReCogDrive-IL, and HDP, using linear probes to predict final trajectory quality from intermediate states and evaluating candidate ranking and selection on held-out scenes. Across all three planners, we observe that states from the first denoiser evaluation already support informative selection, while further denoising does not consistently improve selection quality. Further analyses show that readout depends on the representation and reader, and that selection can coexist with limited overall ranking accuracy. These findings motivate an early-selection method that selects after the first denoiser evaluation and completes only the chosen candidate. This reduces computation relative to fully denoising every candidate and improves open-loop trajectory quality over random selection across all three planners. In particular, it reduces Alpamayo's average displacement error by 17.8% and 13.4% in one- and four-camera configurations, respectively. Closed-loop evaluations also show higher mean driving scores and progress.

AI.tldr: 扩散驾驶规划器首次去噪的内部状态已可用于选择优质轨迹，从而减少候选生成计算。
AI.motivation: 同一场景的候选轨迹质量不同，需判断能否在去噪结束前识别更优候选。
AI.method: 在三种预训练规划器上用线性探针预测最终质量，并仅对首次去噪后选中的候选完成生成。
AI.result: 三种规划器均优于随机选择；Alpamayo单、四相机位移误差分别降17.8%、13.4%，闭环表现亦改善。
AI.conclusion: 早期选择可降低完整去噪全部候选的计算成本，但选择有效并不意味着整体排序准确。

title: Elicited Adaptation: Auditable Localized Fairness via Pairwise Queries
summary: How much must a predictor's scores change when a community's elicited fairness standard changes? Similarity and tolerance judgments define protected comparisons and acceptable score gaps. We study minimum uniform score movement on a fixed pool of $n$ profiles. For scores satisfying a source standard, we characterize the exact cost of retaining that standard during adaptation: runs of consecutive target constraints along shortest paths determine the optimal amplification factor. Its sharp worst case is $\lfloor n/2\rfloor$, and a full cost curve describes finite target-only repair budgets. Committing before the target is known can cost $n-1$ times the worst repair after revelation, even within one fixed convex ball of two-dimensional Mahalanobis metrics. Positive edge-budget floors cap both factors; bounded geometry also limits the commitment cost. At two interior targets of the construction attaining the $n-1$ bound, similarity queries alone yield a feasible $2$-approximate repair for tolerance $\eps\le1/[2(n-1)]$, reducing movement relative to common repair by a factor linear in $n$. Feasible $(1+\alpha)$-optimal repair on this family has worst-case tolerance-query complexity $\Theta(\alpha^{-2}n^2\log(1/\delta))$ under a fixed-slope logistic model. The analysis separates the information needed for a substantial adaptation benefit from the precision needed for nearly optimal movement. Elicitation studies and training comparisons examine tolerance choice and the relation between numerical compliance and predictive utility.

AI.tldr: 研究社区公平标准变化时预测分数的最小调整代价，并刻画约束保留与偏好查询的成本。
AI.motivation: 社区公平标准会变化，需要明确如何以最小分数改动适应新标准及所需查询信息。
AI.method: 以成对相似性和容忍度判断定义公平约束，通过最短路径分析调整代价并研究查询复杂度。
AI.result: 保留原标准的最坏放大因子为⌊n/2⌋，预先承诺代价可达事后修复的n−1倍。
AI.conclusion: 获得显著适应收益所需的信息与实现近最优调整所需的精度不同，应分别分析。

title: Physics-Grounded STL Monitoring from Image Observations
summary: Robotic manipulation missions must satisfy timed and conditional requirements that can be expressed in signal temporal logic (STL). While a practical means of monitoring these requirements is from camera images, this is challenging because STL robustness depends on physical margins, such as distances and clearances, that are not directly observed. Rather than learning a separate visual monitor for each formula, we learn a shared latent representation from multi-view images and decode physically meaningful margins for individual predicates. Co-training the encoder with predicate decoders increases the certification rate from 58.7% to 96.3% compared with a frozen encoder, despite nearly unchanged predicate sign accuracy. STL semantics then compose these margins into robustness estimates for any bounded formula over the trained predicates, without retraining. We further calibrate the decoding errors of selected STL clauses using conformal prediction, yielding two-sided intervals that certify both satisfaction and violation and propagate through interval STL to any formula composed from the clauses. In simulated kitchen missions (LIBERO), our monitor correctly predicts satisfaction or violation in 98.9% of 4662 evaluations across 18 unseen formulas. For missions lasting up to 17 min, calibrated bounds establish satisfaction or violation for 96.9% of missions without incorrect conclusions. A single calibration also provides simultaneous 91.0% coverage across all 255 conjunctions of eight clauses, allowing new formulas without recalibration.

AI.tldr: 从多视角图像学习物理裕量，并结合保形预测，实现可认证且支持新公式的时序逻辑监测。
AI.motivation: 图像无法直接提供距离和间隙等物理裕量，导致机器人时序逻辑任务难以可靠监测。
AI.method: 联合训练共享视觉编码器与谓词裕量解码器，用保形预测校准子句误差并传播区间。
AI.result: 联合训练将认证率从58.7%提升至96.3%，在18个未见公式的4662次评估中判断准确率为98.9%。
AI.conclusion: 物理裕量解码与区间组合支持无需重训的新公式监测，并可认证长时任务的满足或违反。

title: MathaMAGICal: Validating Trajectory Data Attribution During Capability Acquisition
summary: Influence-function-based methods like MAGIC provide exact first-order scores for trajectory data attribution, yet only retraining indicates whether those scores accurately predict data removal. We evaluate MAGIC on $86$M- and $152$M-parameter GPT-2-style models learning multistep arithmetic from scratch on filtered web text and four synthetic math families. Full-run attribution at $86$M suffers from numerical overflow, and even with metagradient clipping, scores correlate near chance with retraining (linear datamodeling score, LDS, $0.17$--$0.22$). In contrast, short checkpoint windows yield stable, accurate predictions at both scales (LDS $0.86$--$0.99$ across four $100$-step windows at $152$M), whereas a single-checkpoint gradient-dot baseline shows near-zero correlation. Rankings of individual training blocks predict retraining only within that single run and do not transfer across seeds or hyperparameters ($\rho \le 0.09$), whereas format-level patterns replicate across runs. Two data families, worked examples and primitive facts, occupy $2.1$--$2.6\times$ their corpus share in both the helpful and harmful $5\%$ score tails, reflecting strong bidirectional local sensitivity distinct from net benefit under multi-epoch family deletion. These results show that trajectory attribution is reliable within short, validated windows and yields family-level insights that generalize across runs.

AI.tldr: 重训练验证表明，MAGIC在短训练窗口内归因可靠，但单次运行的数据块排名难以跨运行迁移。
AI.motivation: 影响函数提供的一阶归因分数，仍需通过重训练检验其对删除训练数据效果的预测能力。
AI.method: 在两种规模的GPT-2式算术学习模型上，以重训练验证全程和短窗口MAGIC归因。
AI.result: 86M模型全程归因LDS仅0.17—0.22，152M模型短窗口达0.86—0.99，跨运行排名相关性不超过0.09。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹归因应限于经验证的短窗口，其数据类别层面的洞见比单个训练块排名更具可迁移性。

title: Data Attribution Should Steer Pretraining
summary: Pretraining data curation decides what a model learns from, yet what makes a document worth learning from depends on what the model already knows. Influence-driven selectors already rank documents to improve one run; we argue that training-data attribution should steer pretraining by identifying testable data properties that become reusable curation criteria, evaluated on new data against cheaper selectors at matched total cost, discovery included. A document ranking is consumed by the run it was computed for, whereas an explained data property can be tested across corpora and checkpoints, especially where familiar quality signals diverge from measured usefulness. Because historical contribution, an understandable explanation, and future data value require distinct evidence, we specify a feedback loop that interprets attributed sources, tests candidate data changes, and states for five claim types what evidence each requires and what none establishes. We close with a falsifiable comparison against perplexity, classifier, and mixing baselines at equal total compute.
comment: Accepted to the 3rd Workshop on Attributing Model Behavior at Scale: Data Attribution and Provenance (ATTRIB 2026) at NeurIPS 2026, Idea Track. 4 pages main text, 13 pages total, 1 figure, 2 tables

AI.tldr: 主张用训练数据归因发现可检验、可复用的数据属性，而不只为单次预训练排序文档。
AI.motivation: 文档价值随模型知识变化，单次运行的影响排序难以直接转化为可复用的数据筛选准则。
AI.method: 提出解释归因来源、检验数据改动的反馈闭环，并为五类主张明确证据要求。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体结果。
AI.conclusion: 应计入发现成本，在相同总算力下与困惑度、分类器和混合基线比较归因驱动筛选。

title: Where Should LLM Agents Adapt at Test Time? In Context, in Weights, or Both
summary: LLM agents operating repeatedly in the same environment, such as a code repository, a database, or an application suite, encounter tasks that share latent structure. Experience can reveal this structure, allowing agents to reuse environment knowledge and learn from environmental feedback. Agents can adapt at test-time using this experience through two channels: retaining it in context and updating their weights. These channels are usually studied separately, leaving unclear what each contributes and when they complement each other. We compare in-context learning (ICL), reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards using GRPO, and self-distillation using SDPO, alone and in combination, using a shared online protocol and modular framework. Agents encounter matched task streams, are evaluated on each task before adapting to it, and learn only from their own attempts and environment feedback. We evaluate 14 adaptation mechanisms and a stateless baseline with Qwen3.5-9B on 109 tasks from four environments drawn from SWE-bench Verified, AppWorld, ScienceWorld, and BIRD-Critic-SQLite, using five task orders per environment. ICL provides the largest standalone gain: its best policy raises mean success across environments from 28.8% to 49.4%. Adding GRPO to this policy achieves the highest mean success, 51.6%. While adding GRPO improves the overall mean under every ICL policy, SDPO has mixed effects. Trace analyses show fewer lookups and shorter attempts under ICL, consistent with reusing knowledge of the shared structure. However, ICL also frequently skips inspection and verification for the current task. Adding GRPO to ICL helps restore these behaviors while preserving its reduced environment lookups. These observations suggest that reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards can refine how agents use retained experience, motivating the joint study of context management and weight updates.

AI.tldr: 智能体测试时适应中，上下文学习带来最大独立收益，结合GRPO进一步提高平均成功率。
AI.motivation: 上下文保留经验与权重更新通常分开研究，两者对共享环境任务的贡献和互补性尚不清楚。
AI.method: 用统一在线协议，在四类环境109项任务上比较Qwen3.5-9B的14种适应机制与无状态基线。
AI.result: 最佳上下文策略将平均成功率从28.8%提升至49.4%，加入GRPO后达到51.6%，SDPO效果不一。
AI.conclusion: 可验证奖励强化学习可改善经验使用方式，支持联合研究上下文管理与权重更新。

title: Multiaccuracy as an Error Benchmark for Learning with Distribution Shift
summary: Agnostic learning has a well-developed theory of computational and statistical complexity. For learning with distribution shift, even the choice of an appropriate error benchmark remains challenging. Testable learning with distribution shift (TDS) was introduced to develop computational foundations for this setting: using labeled training data and unlabeled test data, the learner must either produce a predictor with low test error or detect distribution shift. However, standard agnostic TDS guarantees allow a constant-factor amplification of the optimum error even when the training and test distributions coincide. They therefore do not directly recover the guarantee of classical agnostic learning. We introduce shift multiaccuracy, a stronger error benchmark inspired by multiaccuracy from algorithmic fairness. This yields a TDS formulation that becomes equivalent to multiaccuracy when there is no shift. Using a recent nontrivial reduction from agnostic learning to multiaccurate prediction from prior work, we obtain the first TDS framework that formally generalizes agnostic learning through an efficient reduction preserving the training marginal. The framework retains existing algorithmic upper bounds and inherits computational lower bounds from agnostic learning. Moreover, we establish a direct connection between our model and identity testing, yielding the first statistical characterization of agnostic TDS learning, in terms of Rademacher complexity. More broadly, we argue that shift multiaccuracy might be of independent interest in unsupervised domain adaptation, as it leads to sharper out-of-distribution generalization guarantees, and can be minimized directly, since its definition does not involve the unobserved test labels.

AI.tldr: 提出分布偏移多重准确性基准，使可测试分布偏移学习通过高效归约推广不可知学习。
AI.motivation: 现有分布偏移学习保证即使在无偏移时也允许最优误差被常数倍放大，无法恢复经典保证。
AI.method: 引入分布偏移多重准确性，结合既有归约与恒等检验建立计算和统计理论框架。
AI.result: 框架保留现有算法上界并继承不可知学习计算下界，首次给出基于Rademacher复杂度的统计刻画。
AI.conclusion: 该基准无需未观测测试标签即可直接最小化，并可能为无监督域适应提供更紧的泛化保证。

title: Minimax Estimation of Discrete Distributions under Hockey-stick Divergence
summary: We initiate the study of estimating a discrete distribution with respect to the hockey-stick divergence from independent samples. We provide non-asymptotic upper and lower bounds on the minimax expected loss in terms of the alphabet size, the number of samples, and the divergence parameter. The upper bounds are achieved by add-constant estimators, while the lower bound is derived via a Bayes risk argument. Both upper bounds and lower bounds reveal a transition between polynomial and exponential regimes as the parameters of the problem vary.

AI.tldr: 研究曲棍球杆散度下的离散分布估计，给出极小极大风险界并揭示两类衰减区间。
AI.motivation: 需要刻画利用独立样本估计离散分布时，曲棍球杆散度损失下的最优统计风险。
AI.method: 用加常数估计器建立非渐近上界，并通过贝叶斯风险论证推导下界。
AI.result: 上下界刻画了风险对字母表大小、样本量和散度参数的依赖，并揭示多项式与指数区间的转变。
AI.conclusion: 该散度下的估计难度随问题参数变化呈现不同区间，加常数估计器可实现所给上界。

title: Real-Time Air Pollution Monitoring and Tracking via Adaptive Density-Driven Multi-UAV Coordination
summary: Accurate and timely air pollution monitoring and tracking are critical for protecting public health and supporting effective environmental management. This paper presents an adaptive Density-Driven Control (D$^2$C) framework for coordinating multiple unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to track and map dynamically evolving pollutant distributions. The proposed framework extends the D$^2$C strategy to guide UAV trajectories based on predictive pollutant propagation and dynamically updated reference densities. A sensor-driven surrogate plume update mechanism is employed, in which reference samples are propagated using locally sensed concentration gradients and wind estimates through gradient attraction, wind advection, inter-sample repulsion, and stochastic diffusion, enabling UAVs to maintain an accurate spatio-temporal representation of the pollution field. The framework utilizes a coordinated structure where individual UAVs share their local measurements with a central coordinator to maintain a unified set of reference samples, facilitating systematic target allocation and trajectory planning. Simulation results under both mild and strong wind conditions demonstrate that the proposed method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in terms of Sinkhorn distance. Specifically, in scenarios where the plume drifts beyond a fixed monitoring domain under high-velocity, time-varying wind fields, the tested baseline methods fail to maintain tracking, whereas the proposed D$^2$C framework successfully adapts to the evolving distribution. These findings highlight D$^2$C as an efficient and resilient solution for atmospheric monitoring in dynamic environments.

AI.tldr: 提出自适应密度驱动多无人机协同框架，在动态风场中持续追踪和绘制污染物分布。
AI.motivation: 污染羽流会随风场移动甚至离开固定监测域，需要及时且稳健的多无人机监测方法。
AI.method: 融合局部浓度梯度与风估计更新参考样本，由中央协调器共享测量并分配目标和规划轨迹。
AI.result: 仿真中该方法在弱风和强风下的Sinkhorn距离均优于基线，并在基线失去追踪时保持跟踪。
AI.conclusion: 自适应更新参考密度可增强多无人机在动态环境中追踪污染分布的效率与韧性。

title: Cache or Denoise Less? Residual Reuse in a Flow-Matching World Action Model
summary: Flow-matching robot policies generate each action chunk through repeated network evaluations, one per denoising step. Cross-cycle caches such as C$^3$ache reuse computation from earlier replanning calls, but whether they beat simply taking fewer steps is unclear. We compare the two in Fast-WAM, a 6B-parameter world action model, on LIBERO-Goal. Two uncached steps keep the success of ten: on all 500 initial states they are non-inferior within two percentage points, for one checkpoint and noise seed. Under PyTorch's default compile mode, they also cut a replanning call on an RTX A6000 from 202 to 92 ms. This leaves little room for caching. A cache that keeps two fresh steps cannot be faster than two uncached steps: every call still encodes the images, runs the video expert and computes those two steps. Caching the first of two steps, refreshed every fourth call, saves at most 11--14% of a call by our cost model. Cached policies are also fragile. Their losses tracked the share of the flow path the cached steps cover: under Fast-WAM's current time shift, C$^3$ache's eight cached steps cover 80% of the path instead of 44%, and the cached policy succeeds on 63% of states against 95% uncached. Resampling the noise on every call cost caches covering 60% or more of the path 14--40 points. These results argue for fewer-step baselines and for testing reuse under the deployed sampler and noise settings. We release our evaluation harness, logs and a checklist.
comment: Honorable Mention at the CoRL 2026 Workshop on Efficient Foundation Models for Real-Time Embodied AI (EEAI). Code and data available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 在Fast-WAM上，直接减少去噪步数可保留成功率并显著提速，而跨重规划周期缓存收益有限且脆弱。
AI.motivation: 跨周期缓存是否优于直接减少去噪步数尚不清楚，需要比较其速度收益与策略成功率。
AI.method: 在LIBERO-Goal上比较Fast-WAM的少步无缓存策略与缓存策略，并分析计算成本、流路径覆盖及噪声设置。
AI.result: 单检查点与噪声种子下，500个初态中两步较十步的成功率非劣界为2个百分点，耗时由202降至92毫秒。
AI.conclusion: 应采用少步无缓存基线，并在实际部署的采样器与噪声设置下检验计算复用。

title: Joint Learning of Factual and Counterfactual Worlds for Causal Prior-data Fitted Networks
summary: Estimating treatment effects is central to science across many disciplines and requires counterfactual reasoning about alternative worlds. In the real world, however, each unit reveals its outcome only under the factual world. Thus, the factual and counterfactual outcomes can never be jointly learned by any model trained on real data. The problem is therefore tractable only in synthetic settings, where both worlds can be generated. Recent progress on prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) has shown that models pre-trained purely on synthetic data can transfer to real-world prediction. This paradigm has since carried over to causal effect estimation. Despite this fully synthetic setup, existing causal PFNs carry the real-world constraint into their training objective, confining learning to a single world's outcome per unit. The dependence between the two worlds is thereby lost, and the density of the treatment effect relies by default on independence, which is implausible in practice. We therefore propose joint learning, a training setup in which a causal PFN learns the joint distribution of the factual and counterfactual outcomes of each unit. From the joint distribution, we obtain both the response and the individual treatment effect densities, and at inference, we apply optimal transport across units to obtain an approximation of the average treatment effect density. Ours is therefore the first causal PFN approach to provide all three densities together while accounting for the cross-world dependence. We apply joint learning and optimal transport to existing causal PFNs and evaluate it across semi-synthetic, synthetic, and real benchmarks spanning diverse causal scenarios. The jointly trained models significantly improve upon their baselines in point estimation and uncertainty quantification in most settings, indicating that joint learning is a preferable training setup for causal PFNs.

AI.tldr: 通过联合学习事实与反事实结果，因果PFN可建模跨世界依赖，并改善效应估计与不确定性量化。
AI.motivation: 现有因果PFN虽以合成数据训练，却只学习单个世界的结果，丢失跨世界依赖并默认处理效应独立性。
AI.method: 联合学习事实与反事实结果分布，推导响应和个体处理效应密度，并以跨个体最优传输近似平均处理效应密度。
AI.result: 在涵盖多种因果场景的半合成、合成及真实基准中，联合训练模型在多数设置下显著改善点估计与不确定性量化。
AI.conclusion: 联合学习可同时提供三类密度并考虑跨世界依赖，是更可取的因果PFN训练方式。

title: Behavioral Denoising: A New Perspective on Nonlinear Behavioral Control Inspired by Closed-Form Diffusion Policies
summary: Diffusion policies have become a dominant approach to imitation learning in robotics. Recent work suggests that, in the low-data regime, they largely retrieve or combine the demonstrated actions, which the closed-form diffusion policy does explicitly. This closely resembles behavioral control, where future inputs are formed as linear combinations of recorded trajectories. In this work, we make this connection precise: we show that the weights with which the closed-form diffusion policy combines the demonstrated actions are the unique solution of a regularized behavioral control problem. Building on this connection, we propose an algorithm, termed $\chi^2$-projected behavioral denoising, which is a training-free method that combines nearby trajectory data with a limit on extrapolation when the data offer little support. It shows encouraging results on four nonlinear control tasks compared to recent nonlinear behavioral control methods. We hope that this connection offers a useful perspective for understanding both data-driven control and diffusion policies. Code and more visualizations can be found at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 研究揭示闭式扩散策略与正则化行为控制的联系，并提出无需训练的χ²投影行为去噪算法。
AI.motivation: 低数据条件下扩散策略对示范动作的检索组合与行为控制相似，但二者的理论联系尚需明确。
AI.method: 证明闭式扩散策略的动作组合权重是正则化行为控制问题的唯一解，并据此组合邻近轨迹、限制低支持区域外推。
AI.result: χ²投影行为去噪算法在四项非线性控制任务中，相较近期非线性行为控制方法展现出积极表现。
AI.conclusion: 这一联系为理解数据驱动控制与扩散策略提供了统一视角。

title: An Interpretable Acoustic Coordinate System for Japanese Consonant Morae in Dysarthric Speech
summary: Dysarthria reduces speech intelligibility, requiring self-directed rehabilitation based on fine-grained feedback to capture gradual articulatory changes. For Japanese speakers, such feedback is naturally provided in mora units due to its distinct moraic timing and consonant-vowel structure. While recent visualization methods have explored distance-based feedback, most are limited to vowels. Extending them to consonants is challenging, as generative embeddings often smooth transient spectral structures. We propose a visualization system for Japanese consonant morae that maps articulatory deviations onto a two-dimensional space defined by temporal and spectral distances from healthy reference speech. Experiments show consistent geometric separation of consonant categories, with Silhouette Coefficients exceeding 0.5 and origin-based ROC-AUC scores above 0.86. Furthermore, evaluations using real dysarthric speech achieved a high ROC-AUC of 0.897 in screening for unclear pronunciations. Perturbation tests confirm orthogonal temporal and spectral shifts, yielding a physically interpretable mapping for rehabilitation.

AI.tldr: 提出面向构音障碍日语辅音拍的二维声学坐标系统，以可解释方式呈现发音偏差。
AI.motivation: 构音障碍康复需要细粒度反馈，而现有可视化多限于元音，难以保留辅音的瞬态频谱结构。
AI.method: 以相对健康参考语音的时间距离和频谱距离构建二维空间，并通过真实构音障碍语音与扰动测试评估。
AI.result: 辅音类别轮廓系数超过0.5、基于原点的ROC-AUC超过0.86，真实语音不清晰发音筛查ROC-AUC达0.897。
AI.conclusion: 系统可区分时间与频谱方向的偏差，为康复提供具有物理可解释性的发音反馈。

title: Set-based State Estimation for Unknown Dynamical Systems from Noisy Output Data with Probabilistic Guarantees
summary: We develop a methodology for set-based state estimation from noisy input-output trajectories, without a predefined model structure for the unknown state dynamics or access to training state measurements. We derive a bound on the state set diameter that depends on the sensor map and leverage it as a surrogate to formulate a tractable linear program balancing state set tightness against output trajectory coverage. Combining this certificate with deterministic or probabilistically certified measurement noise sets and leveraging the results from scenario optimization with relaxation, we provide joint a posteriori probabilistic guarantees for state inclusion and state set diameter. Numerical simulations corroborate our developed theoretical guarantees.

AI.tldr: 提出无需预设动力学结构或训练状态测量的集合状态估计方法，并提供状态包含与集合直径的概率保证。
AI.motivation: 未知动力系统的状态估计需要在仅有含噪输入输出轨迹时，兼顾估计集合紧致性与可靠覆盖。
AI.method: 推导依赖传感器映射的状态集直径界，构造线性规划，并结合认证噪声集与带松弛的场景优化。
AI.result: 获得状态包含与状态集直径的联合后验概率保证，数值仿真支持所推导的理论保证。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可在缺少动力学结构与训练状态测量的条件下，实现具有概率保证的集合状态估计。

title: Found, but Not Fixed : From Software Vulnerability Discovery to Fixes with Iterative LLM Pipelines
summary: Software vulnerabilities persist as a critical threat despite the deployment of sophisticated detection tools and AI assistants. While detection has advanced, the subsequent code repair phase remains a primary bottleneck; manual intervention is inherently slow, costly, and prone to introducing secondary regressions and issues. In this paper, we investigate whether an iterative, LLM-based pipeline can provide a robust solution for the automated repair of vulnerable functions in real-world code. We propose a generalized framework that leverages the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) through a multi-stage feedback loop. We benchmark this approach against state-of-the-art models, including GPT-4o, GPT-5.1, and Gemini 3 Flash, demonstrating that such a pipeline can achieve high-quality code repair. To support the broader security community, we provide our evaluation framework, fine-tuned weights, and comprehensive experimental dataset on our website: this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出多阶段反馈的迭代式大语言模型流水线，用于自动修复真实代码中的漏洞函数。
AI.motivation: 漏洞检测持续进步，但人工修复仍缓慢、昂贵，且可能引入回归与次生问题。
AI.method: 构建利用大语言模型推理能力的多阶段反馈框架，并与GPT-4o、GPT-5.1及Gemini 3 Flash等模型进行基准比较。
AI.result: 基准评估表明，该迭代流水线能够实现高质量代码修复，但摘要未报告具体量化指标。
AI.conclusion: 迭代式大语言模型流水线有望缓解漏洞修复瓶颈，研究同时提供评估框架、微调权重与实验数据。

title: Sim-to-Real Room-Mediated Object-Goal Navigation with ROS 2 and Nav2
summary: Although object-goal navigation (ObjectNav) approaches are usually evaluated in simulation, which offers scale and repeatable environments, real-world deployments are rarely examined beyond feasibility demonstrations. This paper presents the deployment of Room-Mediated Co-occurrence, an ObjectNav policy that reasons over Room Probability Vectors (RPVs), on two robotic platforms (Boston Dynamics Spot and Clearpath Robotics TurtleBot 4) through a robot-agnostic ROS 2 bridge.
