We study how these semantic priors generalise to physical environments and describe the adaptations required to transfer RPV from simulation to hardware, covering sensing, localisation, and the action interface. Across 66 trials on Spot, searching for 11 object categories from two starting positions in a university postgraduate research facility, RPV achieves a raw Success Rate (SR) of 0.455. Our analysis identifies undetected glass walls, entry into off-limits areas, limited usable depth range, target size, and mismatch between the room lexicon and physical layout as plausible contributors to the 8.4 percentage-point gap between the real-world SR and the reported simulated SR of 0.539. Code is available at this https URL.
comment: 9 pages. Accepted to ACRA (Australasian Conference on Robotics and Automation) 2026

AI.tldr: 通过ROS 2桥接将基于房间语义先验的目标导航策略部署到两类机器人，并量化其真实环境表现。
AI.motivation: 目标导航研究多在仿真中评估，缺少对真实部署性能及语义先验迁移能力的系统检验。
AI.method: 将基于房间概率向量的策略部署至Spot与TurtleBot 4，适配感知、定位和动作接口，并在Spot上开展66次试验。
AI.result: Spot搜索11类物体的原始成功率为0.455，比已报告的仿真成功率0.539低8.4个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 玻璃墙漏检、禁入区域、有效深度范围、目标尺寸及房间词汇与布局不匹配，可能共同造成仿真到现实的性能差距。

title: AlphaTruck: A Platform for High-Speed Off-Road Autonomy on Unstructured Terrain
summary: Progress in autonomous navigation in off-road environments requires not only advances in algorithms, but also robust and capable physical platforms suited to both development and deployment. Today, off-road autonomy is typically developed and tested at one of two extremes of vehicle scale, each with different drawbacks. Full-size vehicles are capable but expensive, require large logistic infrastructure for deployment and maintenance, and expensive when pushed beyond their limits. RC-scale vehicles are small and inexpensive, but limited in the terrain they can traverse and the payload that they can carry, which includes their sensors and compute. We present the AlphaTruck platform, which leverages recent advances in compact sensing and compute to integrate multimodal sensing, embedded CPU-GPU compute, and an onboard autonomy stack for high-speed, off-road navigation, all integrated into a large-scale, 1/5th RC vehicle chassis. AlphaTruck is designed as both a research testbed and a field-deployable platform for commercial and defense missions such as survey, search and rescue, and agriculture, with the capacity to carry task-specific payloads. At 1/5 scale, the autonomy stack, sensors, and batteries all compete for the same mass, power, and cooling budget, so the platform must balance five needs: mobility over rough terrain, rich sensing, onboard computation, payload capacity to carry the autonomy stack while leaving room for task-specific equipment, and practical operation and repair. Thus, AlphaTruck navigates off-road environments autonomously at 6-10 m/s using only onboard sensing and compute.

AI.tldr: AlphaTruck在五分之一比例遥控车底盘上集成感知、计算与自主导航，支持高速非结构化越野。
AI.motivation: 全尺寸越野平台成本与运维负担高，小型遥控平台则受地形通过性和载荷能力限制。
AI.method: 集成多模态传感器、嵌入式CPU-GPU与车载自主系统，在质量、功耗和散热约束下平衡机动性、载荷及可维护性。
AI.result: AlphaTruck仅依靠车载感知与计算，即可在越野环境中以每秒6至10米的速度自主导航。
AI.conclusion: 该平台兼顾研究测试与现场部署，并可搭载测绘、搜救及农业等任务所需的专用载荷。

title: Cooperative Transport of Unknown Objects by Distributed Effort Regulation in Multi-agent Systems
summary: A distributed multi-robot object transportation strategy is proposed for objects of unknown shape, size, geometry, mass and mass distribution without any prior knowledge about the object or number of robots involved in the transportation process. Robots follow the boundary of the object and dynamically determine viable pushing points. A novel object-model-free heading-error-driven pushing effort regulation method is proposed to promote goal-directed object motion; robots regulate their pushing effort using individual and collective heading errors. Robots dynamically relocate around the object boundary if a pushing point is lost or the required pushing effort exceeds its capability to correct its heading. The proposed method is validated using simple and complex shapes with convex and non-convex boundary regions and dynamically changing weight distribution of objects. Detailed analysis on the effects of robot distribution and initial object pose on the transportation performance in terms of required time and path efficiency is also presented. Scalability analysis revealed that object transportation time is dependent on the number of pushing surfaces available which in turn depends on the object size, shape, and set inter-robot safety distance. The proposed system yielded highly efficient object paths with consistent elapsed transport times over several trials robust to external disturbances such as non-uniform friction between contacting surfaces and robot wheel slip.
comment: 9 pages, 12 figures; supplementary video available at this https URL submitted to ICRA 2027

AI.tldr: 提出无需物体先验信息的分布式多机器人搬运策略，通过航向误差调节推力实现稳健运输。
AI.motivation: 解决物体形状、质量及质量分布和参与机器人数量未知时的协同搬运问题。
AI.method: 机器人沿物体边界寻找推点，根据个体与集体航向误差调节推力，并在必要时重新定位。
AI.result: 实验获得高效运输路径和稳定运输时间，并能抵抗非均匀摩擦与轮滑等扰动。
AI.conclusion: 该策略适用于复杂边界及动态重量分布，运输时间受可用推动面数量影响。

title: Topology-Transferable Detection of Deep-Learning False Data Injection Attacks Through Residual-Energy Separation
summary: Deep learning (DL) false data injection (FDI) attacks can evade both bad data detection (BDD) and data-driven (DD) detectors in AC power system state estimation (SE), and DD detectors lose effectiveness after a topology change unless they are retrained. We argue that BDD fails in its decision rule, not in its statistic. A reconstruction-based DL generator pursues stealth by fitting the measurements closely, and because such a generator tends to act as a denoiser, the attacked residual energy can fall into the lower tail that BDD never inspects. The weighted-least-squares (WLS) residual applies the same projector construction to the noise and to the attack error, and under a spectral suppression condition we prove that the expected residual energies of normal and attacked measurements are separated by a topology-independent margin. Empirically, a rule learned on the residual energy at one topology transfers without retraining and keeps mean cross-topology F1 above 0.98 on the IEEE 14-bus, 39-bus, 57-bus, and 118-bus systems, while a raw measurement DD detector collapses.

AI.tldr: 利用残差能量分离检测深度学习虚假数据注入攻击，实现电网拓扑变化后的免重训迁移。
AI.motivation: 传统坏数据检测会漏检低残差攻击，而数据驱动检测器在拓扑变化后通常需要重训。
AI.method: 分析攻击生成器的去噪效应，并在谱抑制条件下证明正常与攻击残差能量存在拓扑无关间隔。
AI.result: 在四种IEEE电网系统上，单一拓扑学得的规则跨拓扑平均F1超过0.98，无需重训。
AI.conclusion: 残差统计量仍具检测价值，调整判决规则可实现对所研究攻击的跨拓扑检测。

title: Sample-Efficient Ensemble Reinforcement Learning at Scale
summary: Ensemble methods such as MeanQ have been shown to improve the sample efficiency of relatively small model-free deep reinforcement learning (RL) architectures, including DQN and similarly sized variants such as Rainbow. However, to our knowledge, the effects of ensembling on large-scale architectures such as Bigger Better Faster (BBF) have not been studied. In this work, we present MeanQ-BBF, a hybrid model-free algorithm that combines the principles of MeanQ and BBF. Through statistically rigorous evaluation on the Atari 100K benchmark, we show that in contrast to naive scaling of the network size of BBF, which degrades performance, MeanQ-BBF is able to leverage the increase in model capacity to improve performance over BBF. Moreover, MeanQ-BBF does this in a computationally efficient way by organizing the added parameters into largely independent learners. Finally, we discuss the performance-cost tradeoff in the context of practical sample-efficient RL.

AI.tldr: 提出集成强化学习算法MeanQ-BBF，利用增加的模型容量提升大规模架构的样本效率。
AI.motivation: 集成方法对小型强化学习架构有效，但其在BBF等大规模架构上的作用尚未充分研究。
AI.method: 结合MeanQ与BBF，将新增参数组织为基本独立的学习器，并在Atari 100K上严格评估。
AI.result: 直接扩大BBF网络会降低性能，而MeanQ-BBF能利用额外容量超越BBF，并保持计算效率。
AI.conclusion: 集成提供了比单纯扩大网络更有效的扩容路径，但实际应用仍需权衡性能与计算成本。

title: From Cloud to Edge: A Fully Local Pipeline for Pothole Risk Assessment and Driver Warning Generation
summary: Vision-language models can turn road images into clear, geometry-aware pothole warnings, but current systems depend on commercial cloud services. Our earlier five-stage pipeline needed two cloud calls per scene, taking about 20 s and USD 0.105, and could not run offline. We rebuild every stage to run on a single local GPU and evaluate it with the same data, prompts, and protocol. Segmentation keeps the original Segment Anything weights but runs them in half precision with graph compilation, which makes it 2.7x faster without changing any downstream risk class; five lightweight variants could not match its masks on small road defects. Severity is graded by six ConvNeXt students distilled from 3092 cloud labels. They reach Cohen's kappa = 0.268 against human consensus at 28 ms per pothole, close to the cloud model's 0.321, within the camera setup they were trained for. A local 8-billion-parameter vision-language model writes the warnings under a grammar that admits only in-lane maneuvers. Three blind, independent raters scored these warnings safer than the cloud warnings (4.18 vs. 3.65 of 5; p = 0.001; 50 scenes) and equally clear, whereas an automated LLM judge ranked them the other way. The complete pipeline runs at 1.27 s per scene, 16x faster than the cloud system, offline and at no per-scene cost.
comment: 23 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables. And submitted to MDPI Sensors

AI.tldr: 将坑洞风险评估与驾驶警告生成全流程迁移到本地GPU，实现离线运行并显著提速。
AI.motivation: 原有流程依赖商业云服务，单场景耗时约20秒且需付费，无法离线使用。
AI.method: 加速原分割模型，以云标签蒸馏严重度分类器，并用受语法约束的本地视觉语言模型生成警告。
AI.result: 全流程每场景1.27秒，提速16倍；人工盲评安全性为4.18分，高于云端的3.65分，清晰度相当。
AI.conclusion: 本地方案消除了逐场景服务费用，但严重度模型受训练相机设置限制，自动评分与人工判断存在分歧。

title: Relax-and-Sparsify Approximation Algorithms for Sparse Ridge Regression
summary: This paper studies sparse ridge regression in the low-rank, high-dimensional setting that often arises when data collection is expensive. By exploiting the low-rank structure, we develop approximation algorithms within a relax-and-sparsify framework: solve a convex relaxation and then sparsify its solution to satisfy the original sparsity constraint. Specifically, we establish a tight rank-dependent sparsity bound for the convex relaxation by decomposing its support into two parts. This decomposition in turn motivates two approximation strategies, parameter reduction and binary redistribution, each exploiting a different part. Experiments on synthetic and real datasets show that the binary redistribution algorithms outperform the benchmarks in most instances.

AI.tldr: 针对低秩高维稀疏岭回归，提出先凸松弛再稀疏化的近似算法。
AI.motivation: 数据采集昂贵时常出现低秩高维数据，需要利用其结构求解带稀疏约束的岭回归。
AI.method: 分解凸松弛解的支持集，建立紧致的秩相关稀疏度界，并设计参数缩减与二元重分配策略。
AI.result: 合成与真实数据实验表明，二元重分配算法在多数实例中优于基准方法。
AI.conclusion: 低秩结构与支持集分解可为稀疏岭回归提供有效的近似求解路径。

title: Where the Error Lives: Separating Lid-Edge and Body-Induced Error in Neural Pressure Prediction for 3D Cavity Flow
summary: Can a pressure surrogate score much better globally without better resolving the pressure around immersed bodies? We test this in a three-dimensional lid-driven cavity with an unregularized lid and centered pressure at native $128^3$ resolution. On 60 cases from 12 unseen geometries, with predictions sealed before the CFD truth existed, adding a body-free, Reynolds-conditioned reference correction to the same frozen $64^3$ surrogate lifted to $128^3$ lowers the mean full-volume relative $L_2$ error from 20.6% to 7.5%. In the post hoc regional analysis, the lid-edge junction occupies 1.5% of the fluid but holds 69% of the truth pressure energy and 95% of the uncorrected surrogate's squared error. Interior error changes by just +0.16% relative, and object-local peak error and recall change little on average. Retrospective ablations locate the learned term's contribution in the interior and near the bodies; rebasing on the reference lowers global error further with little change in cohort-mean near-body metrics. Reference-relative body-response error remains about 25% in the interior near-body band. Grid-refinement, lid-regularization and convergence checks delimit the numerical scope. In this benchmark, a large global gain chiefly reflects correction of a shared boundary field, not better resolution of the body response. We recommend reporting regional truth-energy and model-error shares alongside near-body and reference-relative body-response errors.

AI.tldr: 三维腔流压力预测的全局误差大幅改善，主要源于共享边界场校正，而非物体周围预测改善。
AI.motivation: 检验压力代理模型全局评分提升是否真正反映其对浸没物体周围压力的解析能力。
AI.method: 对冻结代理模型添加无物体、雷诺数条件化参考校正，并开展区域误差分析及回溯消融。
AI.result: 60个未见几何案例中，全体积相对L2误差由20.6%降至7.5%，但近物体指标平均变化很小。
AI.conclusion: 应同时报告区域能量与误差占比、近物体误差及参考相对物体响应误差，避免仅凭全局指标判断。

title: Exploration of Reinforcement Learning in Generative Recommendation Models
summary: Traditional cascaded recommender systems balance accuracy and efficiency over large item spaces, but misaligned stage-wise objectives hinder end-to-end optimization. Generative recommendation unifies these stages in an autoregressive framework, providing a natural interface for reinforcement learning (RL) to optimize the entire generation process. However, directly applying RL often leads to unstable optimization and degraded recommendation quality. We revisit Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and other ratio-based objectives through a unified logit-gradient view. We identify three issues: (i) clipped surrogates create dead-gradient regions, under-utilizing samples; (ii) negative-advantage updates can become effectively unbounded as importance ratios grow, allowing a small subset of negatives to dominate optimization; and (iii) ratio-based control lacks sensitivity to absolute policy confidence, so updates on high-confidence cases may fail to vanish. Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose \emph{Gradient-Bounded Policy Optimization} (GBPO), a simple objective with stop-gradient normalization that is simultaneously (a) fully gradient-active, (b) sign-symmetrically bounded for both positive and negative updates, and (c) explicitly confidence-weighted under current policy probabilities. This ensures that updates gracefully vanish for $\pi\!\to\!1$ positives and $\pi\!\to\!0$ negatives. Across the evaluated settings, GBPO achieves competitive recommendation performance with more stable training than competing RL methods.

AI.tldr: 提出梯度有界策略优化GBPO，提高生成式推荐中强化学习训练的稳定性。
AI.motivation: 直接应用强化学习易导致推荐质量下降，现有比率目标存在梯度失活、负更新失控及置信度不敏感问题。
AI.method: 采用停止梯度归一化构造全梯度活跃、正负更新对称有界且由当前策略置信度加权的目标。
AI.result: 在所评估设置中，GBPO取得有竞争力的推荐性能，训练稳定性优于其他强化学习方法。
AI.conclusion: 从梯度行为出发设计目标，可缓解生成式推荐中现有策略优化方法的训练不稳定问题。

title: TIVS: Mapping the Sensitivity Landscape of Visual Token Transformations in MLLMs
summary: Recent efforts to improve the efficiency of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have explored visual token pruning, quantization, and feature compression. However, the properties that determine whether transformed visual tokens remain usable by a frozen decoder are not well characterized. We introduce \textbf{TIVS (Token Identity Versus Statistics)}, a training-free intervention framework that separately studies sequence permutation, token retention, numerical precision, and statistical replacement under controlled conditions. On 192 POPE questions, three token permutations change TinyLLaVA accuracy by only $-0.17$ percentage points on average, while changing 4.69\% of individual predictions. Diagonal and rank-64 Gaussian replacements decrease accuracy by 25.0 and 28.1 points on the same subset. Further experiments with exact moment constraints, quantization error, token retention, and additional visual tasks reveal how strongly the effects depend on the original feature values and the evaluation setting. These findings provide an empirical basis for assessing visual token transformations in frozen MLLMs and designing more reliable multimodal interfaces.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架TIVS，分析视觉令牌变换对冻结多模态模型的影响及其评估依赖性。
AI.motivation: 视觉令牌剪枝、量化与压缩日益普遍，但决定变换后令牌能否被冻结解码器使用的性质尚不明确。
AI.method: 在受控条件下分别干预令牌排列、保留比例、数值精度和统计替换，并结合多种视觉任务评估。
AI.result: 192道POPE题上，排列使准确率平均下降0.17个百分点，两种高斯替换分别下降25.0和28.1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 变换效果高度依赖原始特征值与评估设置，为可靠多模态接口设计提供了实证依据。

title: Event-based object detection under adverse lighting and motion: lessons for construction sites
summary: Vision-based monitoring on construction sites fails at night, at dawn and dusk, in tunnels and under floodlights, when conventional RGB cameras under- or over-expose. Event cameras record per-pixel brightness changes with microsecond latency and over 120 dB of dynamic range, but their benefit for site-relevant object detection has not been quantified on real data. We compare three recent event-based detectors (SMamba, SATE and EvRT-DETR) with an RGB detector trained on the same data, using the pixel-aligned PEOD dataset. On low-light frames (70% of the test set) the best event detector reaches 27.2 AP against 21.3 AP for RGB, and a training-free late fusion of both sensors is the best option in every lighting condition (33.3 AP). An object-level analysis of 53,091 objects shows that brightness has little effect on event detectors, whereas fast motion matters: above 20 pixels per frame RGB finds 11-19% of medium-size objects and EvRT-DETR 39-60%. Activation patching locates the damage caused by losing events at the 1/16-resolution features, with small objects depending on the finest scale, and shows that event detectors fail when few signal events meet added noise. A model-agnostic pruning study keeps about 95% of accuracy with 60% of the input but halves small-object recall. On rendered construction sites, used zero-shot, dimming the floodlights drops RGB to near zero while the event detector keeps most of its AP50. We close with camera-placement guidance for construction sites.

AI.tldr: 事件相机在低光照与快速运动下优于RGB检测，相机晚期融合进一步提升性能。
AI.motivation: 施工现场的极端照明使RGB监测失效，而事件相机的实际检测收益尚未量化。
AI.method: 在像素对齐数据上比较三种事件检测器与RGB检测器，并分析融合、运动、噪声和剪枝影响。
AI.result: 低光照下最佳事件检测器达27.2 AP，RGB为21.3 AP，晚期融合达33.3 AP。
AI.conclusion: 事件相机适合恶劣照明与快速运动场景，但少量信号叠加噪声及小目标检测仍是弱点。

title: How Far Is Too Far? Object Recognition Declines Monotonically with Semantic Distance
summary: Vision models are sensitive to object-background context, yet it remains unclear how recognition changes as the semantic distance between objects and backgrounds increases. We introduce ImageNet-OOC1k, a benchmark enabling graded control of object-background relationships along a continuous consensus visual-semantic dissimilarity axis. This formulation reveals a highly consistent monotonic decline in recognition accuracy across 35 models spanning convolutional neural networks, Vision Transformers, and vision-language models. Internal analyses of Vision Transformers reveal patterns consistent with aggregation failure, where object evidence is present at the patch level but not consolidated into the final prediction. Using this characterization as a diagnostic probe, a simple spatial re-ranking strategy recovers a subset of these errors and improves in-sample accuracy by up to 5.7 percentage points. These results establish context sensitivity as a continuous and predictable property of modern vision systems, with Vision Transformer analyses suggesting that aggregation limitations may contribute to some failure types even when object evidence remains available.

AI.tldr: 物体与背景的语义距离越大，视觉模型识别准确率越低，部分错误可能源于证据聚合失败。
AI.motivation: 视觉模型依赖背景上下文，但识别能力如何随物体与背景语义距离变化尚不明确。
AI.method: 构建连续控制语义距离的ImageNet-OOC1k，评测35种模型并分析视觉Transformer内部表征。
AI.result: 35种模型的准确率均随语义距离单调下降，空间重排序使样本内准确率最高提升5.7个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 上下文敏感性是现代视觉系统连续且可预测的属性，聚合局限可能导致部分识别失败。

title: SEAT: Sign-Type Evidence-Audited Transport for Multi-Label Tongue Diagnosis
summary: Automated tongue-sign recognition can improve the consistency of non-invasive examinations that otherwise rely on subjective visual judgment. A single tongue image often exhibits multiple coexisting signs characterized by heterogeneous evidence, including localized morphology, global chromaticity, and inter-label dependence. However, existing methods typically rely on shared representations and uniform multi-label heads, making it difficult to verify whether predictions stem from clinically relevant evidence rather than spurious visual correlations. We propose SEAT, an evidence-audited framework that matches distinct evidence types with dedicated prediction and evaluation mechanisms. Built on frozen DINOv2 patch features, SEAT couples mask-guided sign-specific attention for localized morphology, a semi-relaxed optimal transport pathway over LAB/HSV color prototypes to enhance pale-tongue recognition, and a co-occurrence-aware transport regularizer to shape the batch-level predicted label marginal. These components are evaluated through audits matched to their evidence types. On the TongueDx benchmark, SEAT achieves a mean macro-F1 of 72.59 with a standard deviation of 1.04 across six random seeds, with a six-model ensemble reaching 74.15. The ensemble outperforms a backbone-matched baseline and a larger, domain-specialized vision-language model by 8.06 and 2.99 percentage points, respectively. Our results demonstrate that aligning dedicated prediction pathways and audits with sign-specific characteristics improves multi-label accuracy while offering more targeted evidential grounding than uniform post-hoc spatial explanations. Code is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: SEAT按舌象证据类型设计预测与审计路径，提升多标签识别准确率及证据针对性。
AI.motivation: 现有共享表征与统一多标签头难以验证预测是否依赖临床相关证据而非伪相关。
AI.method: 基于冻结DINOv2特征，结合掩膜引导注意力、颜色原型最优传输及共现感知正则化。
AI.result: TongueDx上平均宏F1为72.59，六模型集成为74.15，较匹配骨干基线高8.06个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 将专用预测路径及审计与舌象特征对齐，可改善多标签准确率并提供更有针对性的证据依据。

title: StaleBench: Isolating Stale Retrieval in Agent Memory, and Pricing the Fix
summary: An agent that stores facts over time eventually stores several versions of the same fact. Asked a value-agnostic question - "which team does X play for now?" - a similarity retriever cannot prefer the current version, because every version matches the entity the query names. StaleBench isolates this stale-retrieval failure on 892 real updating facts, with currency labels from the source (Wikidata validity years via TempLAMA), never from a retrieval score. Our central result is that retrieval metrics can rank memory policies backwards: a retention policy and its retain-everything control return the identical statement at rank 1 for every test query, yet differ by 29.5 and 65.6 points in reader accuracy on two readers when no date is shown. Contamination@5, the metric we add, ranks them correctly where current@1 and current@5 do not. Withdrawing the lexical anchor that statements carry costs deployed keying mechanisms tens of points of freshness; entity resolution on both the write path and the query recovers most of the loss. Three deployed systems (Mem0, Graphiti, LangMem) and a reimplemented ERASE each handle supersession differently, and no single scoring convention describes all four. We release the data, a frozen evaluator, and reference baselines.
comment: Accepted to Findings of EACL 2027. 39 pages, 3 figures. Code and data: this https URL

AI.tldr: StaleBench揭示智能体记忆中的过时检索问题，传统检索指标可能误判记忆策略优劣。
AI.motivation: 同一事实的多个版本都匹配实体查询，单靠相似度检索难以优先返回当前版本。
AI.method: 利用892个真实更新事实构建基准，引入Contamination@5并评测实体解析及多种记忆系统。
AI.result: 两策略所有查询的首位结果相同，但无日期时两种阅读器的准确率分别相差29.5和65.6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 评估记忆时效性应考虑过时信息污染，写入与查询两端的实体解析可恢复大部分时效性损失。

title: Learning Autoregressive Neural Operators on Solver-Defined Physical Constraint Manifolds
summary: Autoregressive neural operators approximate time-dependent PDE solvers by repeatedly composing a learned transition, although the resulting states need not remain feasible under the discrete constraints of the numerical problem. We study this issue for incompressible flow, where each velocity state must satisfy solver-level incompressibility together with prescribed boundary values. We formulate autoregressive operator learning as a map between solver-defined affine feasible sets and introduce PCM-NO, a projected-residual realization of this feasible-transition principle. The neural backbone predicts a candidate state increment, a fixed tangent projection extracts its admissible component, and a metric retraction maps the advanced state to the prescribed feasible set. With exact affine constraint solves, the resulting transition is closed on the feasible set, while an affine identity separates admissible-update parameterization from state-level closure. With approximate solves, tangent-only residuals admit a cumulative upper bound, whereas per-step retraction resets feasibility to the residual achieved by the current solve. Experiments on periodic Navier--Stokes flow and lid-driven cavity flow demonstrate the superiority of PCM-NO in preserving solver-level constraints over long autoregressive rollouts and under parameter, boundary-value, and resolution shifts, while achieving lower rollout errors and better flow-specific diagnostics across both in-distribution and stress settings.

AI.tldr: PCM-NO通过投影与逐步回缩，使自回归神经算子在长期流场预测中更好保持求解器约束。
AI.motivation: 自回归神经算子反复推进后可能违反不可压缩条件和规定边界值等离散物理约束。
AI.method: 将学习表述为求解器定义的仿射可行集间映射，对候选增量作切空间投影并进行度量回缩。
AI.result: 在周期Navier–Stokes流和顶盖驱动腔流中，PCM-NO更好保持约束并降低多种分布条件下的滚动误差。
AI.conclusion: 精确求解可保证状态留在可行集，近似求解时逐步回缩可将可行性误差重置为当前求解残差。

title: Input-Space versus Feature-Level Conditioning for Robust Facial Expression Recognition
summary: Facial expression recognition (FER) degrades sharply when illumination, exposure or resolution departs from the training distribution. Two remedies dominate practice: enriching the input signal, or conditioning intermediate features on an estimated image quality. The two are rarely compared under matched backbones, training budgets and condition annotations, and their cost is seldom reported. We present a controlled comparison on RAF-DB. Input-space conditioning uses four deterministic, label-free views (logarithmic stretching, inverse-logarithmic stretching, down-up resampling and identity), each processed by a shared backbone with a branch-specific BatchNorm and linear head, with the branch logits averaged. Feature-space conditioning is implemented as FiLM and Conditional BatchNorm under an identical protocol. Across six backbone architectures the input-space variant improves top-1 accuracy on every one (mean +0.94 percentage points; bootstrap interval [0.51, 1.63]; sign test p = 0.016), with a seed-controlled estimate of +0.42 percentage points on ResNet-18, whereas feature-level conditioning yields +0.10 and +0.03 percentage points. We attribute the gap to the information content of the heuristic condition label rather than to the conditioning mechanism. The gain costs 4.00x FLOPs, 4.18x latency and 3.79x training time, i.e. 0.26 percentage points per additional GFLOP, and we state an explicit rule for when the trade is worth making.

AI.tldr: 受控比较显示，输入空间条件化较特征层条件化更能提升表情识别，但计算成本明显增加。
AI.motivation: 表情识别易受光照、曝光及分辨率变化影响，两类条件化方案缺少公平比较与成本报告。
AI.method: 在RAF-DB上统一训练协议，比较四种确定性输入视图与FiLM、条件批归一化。
AI.result: 输入方案在六种骨干上平均提升0.94个百分点，但FLOPs和延迟分别增至4.00倍和4.18倍。
AI.conclusion: 性能差距被归因于启发式条件标签的信息量而非条件化机制，应用时需权衡精度与成本。

title: Drift-Conditioned Structural Replay for Continual Cardiac Ultrasound Segmentation
summary: Conventional experience replay typically applies fixed preservation constraints to historical exemplars, overlooking variations in how learned representations, predictions, and anatomical structures change during sequential training. To address this limitation, we propose Drift-Conditioned Structural Replay Loss (DCSRL), an exemplar-adaptive supervision mechanism that regulates anatomical preservation according to source-referenced knowledge drift. DCSRL operates within a reliability-guided replay framework that selects informative historical exemplars using anatomical content and boundary characteristics while adaptively regulating replay during training. For each retained exemplar, DCSRL constructs a frozen source-task reference signature and subsequently measures changes in feature representations, class probabilities, boundary responses, and predicted anatomical structures. These complementary drift measurements are aggregated and normalized to generate bounded, exemplar-specific coefficients that dynamically adjust boundary and structural replay losses without modifying the underlying memory-selection policy. We evaluate DCSRL under sequential learning across CAMUS, CardiacNet, and EchoNet-Dynamic, comparing its performance with regularization-, distillation-, and replay-based continual-learning approaches. Experimental findings indicate that DCSRL improves overall final segmentation performance and anatomical boundary preservation, particularly under heterogeneous imaging conditions, although trade-offs remain in knowledge transfer across tasks. These findings suggest that source-referenced multidimensional drift conditioning offers a promising direction for adaptive anatomical knowledge preservation in continual cardiac ultrasound segmentation.

AI.tldr: DCSRL根据历史样本的多维知识漂移动态调节回放约束，改善持续心脏超声分割。
AI.motivation: 固定回放约束忽视历史样本在表征、预测及解剖结构上的变化，限制知识保持效果。
AI.method: 以冻结源任务签名衡量特征、概率、边界与结构漂移，生成样本级系数调节边界和结构回放损失。
AI.result: 在三个心脏超声数据集的顺序学习中改善最终分割与解剖边界保持，但跨任务知识迁移仍存在权衡。
AI.conclusion: 基于源参考的多维漂移条件化，为异质成像条件下自适应保持解剖知识提供了有前景的方向。

title: Spatiotemporal Reconstruction of Auroral Precipitations with Neural Fields
summary: Auroras provide remote optical observations of energetic electrons precipitating into the upper atmosphere, and whose energy distribution encodes key information about large scale magnetospheric processes. Recovering the underlying electron precipitation field from ground-based camera images of auroras remains a challenging inverse problem. Existing auroral tomography techniques are often limited to simplified static settings, discrete spatial and energy grids, or strong assumptions on the electron energy spectrum. We propose to model the dynamic auroral electron precipitation field via a temporally conditioned neural network. The state of the precipitation field at each frame is represented by a per-frame latent code driven by learned discrete dynamics. A shared decoder maps horizontal positions and latent states to electron energy spectra. The predicted flux is converted to multi-wavelength volume emission rates and rendered into camera images accounting for delayed emissions. We evaluate the method on synthetic dynamic auroral sequences and real multi-view auroral videos, showing that the proposed representation produces temporally coherent precipitation reconstructions and image projections consistent with the observations.
comment: Accepted to the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV 2027). Camera-ready version with supplementary material. 17 pages, 15 figures

AI.tldr: 时序条件神经场可从多视角极光视频重建时间连贯的电子沉降场。
AI.motivation: 从地面极光图像反演电子沉降场困难，现有方法常受静态设置、离散网格或强能谱假设限制。
AI.method: 用学习离散动力学驱动逐帧潜码，共享解码器预测能谱，并考虑延迟发光渲染多波长图像。
AI.result: 合成动态序列与真实多视角视频实验显示，重建具有时间连贯性，图像投影与观测一致。
AI.conclusion: 该神经表示支持动态极光电子沉降的时空重建，并能生成与观测相符的投影。

title: When Does an AUROC Comparison Survive a Change in Population Mix?
summary: Does an AUROC comparison survive a change in the proportions of tasks, populations, or image corruptions? A pooled-AUROC ranking of failure detectors or uncertainty scores describes one particular mix of groups. We study two fixed scores for a common binary target under mixtures of fixed group-conditional laws. Using the cross-group AUC decomposition, we prove that every rational symmetric quadratic comparison geometry is realizable by finite scalar-score distributions. Universal dominance is thus coNP-hard, and even exhaustive checks of every mixture on fewer than $K$ groups can miss a $K$-group reversal. A grid bound gives a dimension-uniform approximation certificate with sharp $1/m$ order. Common score marginals across groups make the comparison numerator linear, with an error envelope for imperfect alignment. These results yield exact finite-bank audits, explicit reversal mixtures and distances, and simultaneous population statements. For failure detection with a frozen ResNet-50 on ImageNet-C, 15 of 18 confidence-score comparisons win in every corruption family on a discovery split, and all 15 are finite-bank certified over all family mixtures on a held-out split; over all 15 corruption types, of 14 discovery winners the corrected grid certifies 10, leaves 3 unresolved, and finds one confirmation reversal of at least 0.05 AUROC. An audit of all 11,019 released Stable LM 2 12B outputs and 35 uncertainty methods finds 66 confirmation-set comparisons that win within all four tasks yet reverse under mixing. Discovery-fitted marginal rank alignment removes all 66; an alignment-error envelope certifies 83 comparisons. Label checks also change several selected reversals. The findings distinguish robustness of frozen scores from robustness after calibration; they do not establish human-error detection, robustness to unseen corruptions, or generalization beyond the evaluated banks.
comment: 30 pages, 5 figures. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible

AI.tldr: 研究揭示组内均占优的AUROC比较仍可在群体混合后反转，并提出有限样本库审计证书。
AI.motivation: 汇总AUROC排名依赖群体构成，需判断评分比较在混合比例变化后是否仍成立。
AI.method: 利用跨组AUC分解研究二次比较几何，构建网格近似证书、反转审计及边际对齐误差界。
AI.result: ImageNet-C中15项比较获全家族混合认证；语言模型审计发现66项组内占优但混合反转的比较。
AI.conclusion: 冻结评分的稳健性不同于校准后的稳健性，结论不涵盖未见扰动或评估样本库之外的泛化。

title: Ambiguous Examples Help, But Full Data Wins: Revisiting Dataset Cartography for Extractive Adversarial QA
summary: Dataset cartography argues that training dynamics can reveal regions of a dataset that matter differently for learning: easy-to-learn examples aid optimization, hard-to-learn examples often expose annotation problems, and ambiguous examples contribute strongly to out-of-distribution generalization. A striking implication of the original work is that a model trained on only 33% ambiguous examples can outperform full-data training on several OOD evaluations, including a QNLI reformulation of SQuAD evaluated on Adversarial SQuAD. We revisit this claim in a stricter setting: open-ended extractive question answering, where models must predict answer spans rather than classify question-sentence pairs. For each encoder family, we compute clean-source SQuAD training dynamics, train on full, random, easy-ranked, ambiguous-ranked, and hard-ranked subsets, and evaluate robustness on adversarial-only AddSent and AddOneSent rows. Ambiguous-ranked 33% subsets beat random 33% subsets on exact-match accuracy in all 14 model-evaluation cells and on F1 in 12/14 cells. However, full-data training beats ambiguous-ranked training in 12/14 exact-match cells and 12/14 F1 cells, with mean full-minus-ambiguous gains of 3.40 EM and 4.10 F1. The most thoroughly replicated ELECTRA-small panel is also the main exception to the ambiguous-over-random F1 gains. These results show that clean-source cartography remains useful for reduced-data selection, but its OOD advantage does not carry over as a general replacement for full-data training in extractive adversarial QA.
comment: 37 pages, 30 figures, 20 tables. Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EACL 2027. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: 歧义样本有助于抽取式对抗问答的数据筛选，但通常不如使用全部训练数据。
AI.motivation: 检验仅用33%歧义样本优于全量训练的既有结论能否推广到开放式答案片段预测。
AI.method: 基于SQuAD训练动态构建随机、易学、歧义和难学子集，并在两种对抗问答集上评估。
AI.result: 歧义子集在14项精确匹配比较中均胜随机子集，但全量训练在12项中更优，平均高3.40分。
AI.conclusion: 数据地图适合有限数据下的样本选择，但不能普遍替代抽取式对抗问答的全量训练。

title: M-CROSS: A Multisensor Simulation Dataset for SLAM across Water--Land Transitions
summary: Water--land cross-domain robots require continuous localization across land, transition and underwater phases, where sensor characteristics and availability change abruptly. Existing datasets and conventional metrics are not designed to capture transition-induced degradation and failures. We present \textbf{M-CROSS}, to the best of our knowledge, the first multisensor simulation dataset and benchmark for SLAM across continuous water--land transitions. It provides synchronized LiDAR, sonar, stereo camera, IMU, DVL, and depth measurements; 6DoF pose ground truth; sensor-wise medium-state annotations; and medium-dependent sensor degradation models. We establish a transition-aware protocol comprising the Trajectory Completion Rate (TCR), Piecewise Absolute Pose Error (PW-APE), Transition End Error (TEE), and Transition Survival Period (TSP), which measure trajectory completion, single-domain accuracy, transition-induced error, and localization survival under prolonged partial immersion, respectively. Experiments with 6 representative SLAM systems show that existing methods fail to maintain both localization accuracy and trajectory continuity across the full set of water--land transitions, exhibiting transition-induced drift, trajectory discontinuities, and tracking failures. M-CROSS is publicly available this https URL

AI.tldr: M-CROSS提供连续水陆转换的多传感器SLAM仿真数据与转换感知评估基准。
AI.motivation: 水陆转换会骤变传感器特性与可用性，现有数据集和指标难以捕捉相关定位退化。
AI.method: 同步提供六类传感器数据、位姿真值和介质标注，并设计完成率、分段误差及转换生存指标。
AI.result: 六种代表性SLAM系统均无法在全部水陆转换中同时维持定位精度与轨迹连续性。
AI.conclusion: 水陆转换仍是现有SLAM的薄弱环节，M-CROSS为分析转换漂移、轨迹中断和跟踪失败提供基准。

title: PISG: Constraint-Aligned Signal Amplification for Diffusion-Based Combinatorial Optimization
summary: Diffusion-based solvers have become a prominent approach to neural combinatorial optimization. At inference time, they assign each decision variable a prediction score. A greedy decoder ranks candidates by these scores and checks hard constraints to ensure feasibility. Top-ranked candidates should be both promising and jointly feasible, making prediction-constraint alignment critical. When this alignment is weak, greedy decoding skips constraint-violating candidates and falls back to lower-ranked alternatives, degrading solution quality. Existing test-time methods improve search, sampling, or decoding, but do not directly strengthen this alignment before decoding. We observe that trained denoisers already carry constraint-aligned structural signals. Building on this observation, we propose Perturbed Instance-Structure Guidance (PISG), a training-free method that amplifies these signals at test time. At each denoising step, PISG constructs a structure-degraded prediction and extrapolates the unperturbed prediction away from it. The resulting guided prediction improves candidate rankings before constrained decoding. Signal analysis shows that this guidance concentrates on constraint-critical variables rather than uniformly rescaling scores. Under greedy decoding and without downstream refinement, PISG improves all 16 TSP solver-scale pairs across DIFUSCO, T2T, FastT2T, and StruDiCO, and all four MIS-ER solvers, with MIS-ER solved-cost gains up to +4.8%. The gains persist on most large-scale settings after 2-opt, and a preliminary study extends PISG to a Transformer-based solver. These results identify prediction-constraint alignment as an effective test-time enhancement direction for diffusion-based combinatorial optimization. Code is available at this https URL.
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (poster). 32 pages. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: PISG无需训练即可在扩散去噪阶段强化约束对齐信号，改善组合优化的候选排序。
AI.motivation: 预测排名与硬约束不一致会使贪心解码跳过高分候选，降低最终解质量。
AI.method: 每步构造结构退化预测，再将原预测沿远离退化预测的方向外推，强化约束关键变量信号。
AI.result: 无后续精修时，PISG改善全部16组TSP配置和四种MIS-ER求解器，后者收益最高达4.8%。
AI.conclusion: 预测与约束的对齐是有效的测试时增强方向，多数大规模配置在2-opt后仍保留收益。

title: Exact Sparse Assignment with Costly Target Embeddings: Fixed-Realization Certificates and an Empirical Audit
summary: Embedding-based one-to-one association is common in vision and data integration: detections are associated with tracks and records are linked across databases. Such pipelines often solve a sparse optional assignment whose edge scores add a cheap term to an inner product of neural embeddings. When target embeddings are costly, one can acquire them selectively and stop once a certificate proves that the current assignment is optimal. We give such a certificate for unit-norm embeddings. It bounds the unknown part of every reassignment by a support function and maximizes the resulting robust gains with a second sparse assignment; a shared owner-centred bound dominates any fixed-centre triangle bound. We make precise what is certified when network features are not batch-invariant: the realized values of the acquired rows and every unit-ball completion of the rest, not a second forward pass in a different batch. Auditing against a separately batched cache tests a different property; on our first pilot it produced a spurious $2.49\times10^{-6}$ objective failure. We audit the corrected protocol on four public text entity-matching benchmarks with two frozen encoders; no image data is used. All 96 certificate simulations and 120 online selective timings were exact on their own realization (largest objective gap $6.82\times10^{-13}$). At group size 8 the shared certificate acquires on average 60% of candidate-active targets, against 74% (mean centre), 69% (MEB) and 60% (zero centre): it beats the mean and MEB centres but not the zero centre, and savings concentrate in one benchmark (7% acquired). The prespecified runtime claim is contradicted: selective execution is +0.510 s slower per run (dataset-cluster 95% interval [+0.248, +0.772]). Uniform-microbatch re-encodings preserved the optimum in only 5 of 8 encoder-dataset cells, and 45 of 120 online runs disagreed with an eager cache at near-ties.

title: JEPA4R: Embodied JEPA World Models with 4D Point Planning
summary: Joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) world models predict future embeddings instead of pixels and plan in latent space. Two challenges remain: 2D images leave the metric geometry that manipulation acts on implicit and entangled with appearance, and what these models imagine stays hidden, as they are mostly judged in simulation by short-horizon latent planning. We present JEPA4R, a JEPA world model that observes single-depth-camera point clouds, predicts and plans in their latent space, and acts through a policy head on its frozen latents; we call this 4D point planning. A decoder on the frozen world model shows what it imagines as 4D point clouds, with a mean point error within 1.1 cm over 200 steps. Under the policy-learning protocols of OGBench and CortexBench, JEPA4R leads pixel JEPA models on OGBench Cube-Single, Cube-Double, Cube-Triple and Scene, and ranks first on MetaWorld and Adroit Relocate with 98.4% and 88.0%, above the runner-up, R3M, at 96.0% and 65.3%. Trained only in a digital twin, JEPA4R and its policy heads run zero-shot on the real arm with both a gripper and a dexterous hand.

title: Tight Sequential Confidence Intervals for Online Kernel Regression
summary: We characterize, in the worst case over kernels, the sharp minimax width of online confidence intervals for elements of a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS). This resolves the open problem posed by Vakili et al. (2021) in its original discrete-time form. A learner observes $y_i=f(x_i)+\epsilon_i$ at adaptively chosen points, with $\|f\|_{\mathcal H_k}\le B$ and i.i.d. $R$-sub-Gaussian noise, and reports the interval $|f(x)-\mu_n(x)|\le\rho_n(\delta)\sigma_n(x)$, where $\mu_n$ and $\sigma_n$ are the posterior mean and standard deviation of a surrogate Gaussian process model with regularization parameter $\lambda$. Writing $\rho_n^*(\delta)$ for the minimax confidence width for a fixed kernel, we show that, for the sum of a linear kernel and a periodic Sobolev kernel, all sufficiently large $n$, and all $\delta\in(0,1/4]$, $\rho_n^*(\delta)\asymp B+(R/\lambda)\sqrt{\gamma_n+\log(1/\delta)}$, where $\gamma_n$ is the maximal information gain and grows polynomially in $n$. Building on Lattimore (2023), we construct an adaptive design on a fixed two-dimensional domain for which, under Gaussian noise, the normalized error at a prespecified point is $\Omega(B+(R/\lambda)\sqrt{\gamma_n})$ with constant probability. This rules out the conjectured polylogarithmic width in the worst case over kernels and online designs.

AI.tldr: 研究确定在线核回归置信区间在最坏核情形下的尖锐极小极大宽度，否定多对数宽度猜想。
AI.motivation: 自适应采样下RKHS函数的在线置信区间究竟能有多窄，仍存在未解决的理论问题。
AI.method: 针对线性核与周期Sobolev核之和，在固定二维域上构造自适应设计并证明归一化误差下界。

title: SemLite-GS: Semantic-Selective Parallel Gaussian Splatting for Lightweight Building Reconstruction from UAV Oblique Imagery
summary: Lightweight 3D building models support urban spatial analysis, but their production often requires dense scene reconstruction, building extraction, and mesh simplification. Although 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is more efficient than conventional multi-view stereo, existing large-scale methods lack semantic selection and parallel instance-level training. We present SemLite-GS, a building-centric framework that reconstructs lightweight building meshes from large-scale UAV oblique imagery. First, an orthographic reference map establishes globally consistent building identities, which are propagated to oblique views to form camera-instance pairs and regions of interest. Second, semantic-selective parallel PGSR training jointly processes multiple pairs within relevant image regions while updating only target Gaussians; contextual Gaussians remain fixed to preserve visibility. Third, architectural planes extracted from rendered depth, opacity, and normal maps guide signed distance field optimization, producing meshes with adaptive polygon allocation and well-defined structural boundaries. Experiments on multiple large-scale UAV datasets demonstrate that our SemLite-GS substantially reduces building reconstruction time compared with representative full-scene 3DGS methods. With comparable polygon budgets, SemLite-GS achieves superior preservation of dominant planar structures and sharp architectural transitions compared with conventional dense reconstruction followed by mesh decimation. The source code is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: SemLite-GS通过语义选择与实例级并行高斯训练，高效重建结构清晰的轻量建筑网格。

title: When Backdoors Can Be Switched Off: Suppression-Aware Backdoor Attacks on Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models map visual observations, robot states, and natural-language instructions to robotic actions, but their multimodal interfaces introduce new security risks. Existing VLA backdoor attacks primarily study trigger-based activation and stealthy action manipulation, leaving conditional suppression of malicious behavior underexplored. We investigate suppression-aware backdoors, which combine conjunctive trigger activation with instruction-conditioned suppression. We instantiate this design through three variants: Cross-Modal Trigger, combining robot-state and spatially separated visual triggers; Self-Suppressing Trigger, requiring a state trigger and a [DISRUPT] instruction token for activation, with [RESTORE] token suppressing the attack; and Multi-Trigger, additionally requiring a visual trigger while retaining suppression even when physical triggers persist. We evaluate these attacks using SmolVLA on two SO-100 manipulation datasets against four baselines: State Backdoor, BadVLA, TabVLA, and SilentDrift. Self-Suppressing and Multi-Trigger reduce Isolation Forest detection from 96--98% to 1--18% and action-space l divergence by 10--14X, achieving 63--71% attack success rates with perfect clean-task performance. Experiments with OpenVLA on LIBERO further show that the attacks transfer to a 7B-parameter policy, evading STRIP and action-distribution-shift detection. Our findings establish conditional suppression as an important dimension for evaluating backdoor threats in VLA policies.

AI.tldr: 研究可由指令抑制的视觉语言动作模型后门，在保持正常任务性能的同时规避检测。
AI.motivation: 现有后门研究侧重触发激活与隐蔽动作操纵，较少关注恶意行为的条件性抑制。
AI.method: 设计跨模态、自抑制和多触发器三类后门，结合联合触发条件与指令控制的攻击抑制。
AI.result: 两种可抑制后门将检测率从96—98%降至1—18%，攻击成功率达63—71%，正常任务性能保持完美。

title: Recovery-Guided Model-Based Diffusion for Safety-Critical Legged Locomotion
summary: Safety-critical high-speed legged locomotion requires motion planners to balance safety foresight with online computational efficiency. Although short prediction horizons reduce rollout costs, they provide limited safety foresight, and strict safety constraints severely restrict the feasible trajectory space. We propose a recovery-guided model-based diffusion (MBD) framework for safety-critical legged locomotion. It incorporates a learned terminal recovery critic into short-horizon trajectory optimization. Specifically, the critic approximates the worst-case future clearance margin along rollouts of a designated recovery policy. We introduce a feasibility-guided refinement strategy that combines within-horizon constraints and terminal recoverability at each sampling stage, while retaining feasible elites to mitigate sampling-support loss. Across 50 paired randomized Unitree Go2 obstacle-avoidance trials, our approach achieves zero collisions and 98% strict-clearance success, while requiring substantially less computation than long-horizon MBD baselines. A project page is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 提出恢复引导的模型扩散规划，以较低计算成本实现安全关键足式运动。
AI.motivation: 短预测时域缺乏安全前瞻，而严格安全约束又显著压缩可行轨迹空间。
AI.method: 将学习得到的终端恢复评价器融入短时域优化，结合可行性引导采样细化与可行精英保留。

title: Read Before You Fit: Text-Derived Constraints for Discovering Differential Equations from Noisy Biological Data
summary: Large language models are increasingly used for scientific equation discovery. However, most existing methods are strongly data-driven and assume sufficiently clean and representative observations. This assumption is problematic in biological systems, where individual-level measurements are often sparse, noisy, heterogeneous, and expensive to obtain. While the underlying mechanisms are extensively described in scientific text, they are not explicitly used for the LLM based modeling of such systems. We introduce P2C, an agentic framework that translates textual descriptions of biological systems into a typed set of formal constraints, and use these constraints to restrict candidate ordinary differential equation (ODE) structures before numerical fitting. P2C consists of five stages: Text2Constraint extraction, ODE discovery, symbolic verification, parameter fitting, and model scoring. We evaluate P2C on four published ODE systems of acute inflammation and immune regulation, under clean and noisy observations. By progressively degrading the numerical evidence, we isolate when textual domain knowledge contributes beyond regression alone. Across the four systems, adding Text2Constraint reduces the worst form error from 1.397 to 0.499 on clean data and from 13.096 to 1.095 for data perturbed with Gaussian noise of $\sigma=0.1$; P2C also achieves lower form error and trajectory error than several LLM-based baselines over the tested noise range.

AI.tldr: P2C将生物学文本转为形式约束，在拟合前限制微分方程结构，提升噪声数据下的方程发现质量。
AI.motivation: 生物观测常稀疏且含噪，现有数据驱动方法未充分利用科学文本中的机制知识。
AI.method: 依次执行文本约束提取、常微分方程发现、符号验证、参数拟合与模型评分。
AI.result: 四个系统中最差结构误差在干净数据上从1.397降至0.499，在σ=0.1噪声下从13.096降至1.095。
AI.conclusion: 文本领域约束可补充数值回归证据，并在所测噪声范围内优于多个大语言模型基线。

title: A Threshold-Free Visual-Semantic Matching Metric for Evaluating Consistency in Subject-Driven Image Generation
summary: In subject-driven text-to-image generation, quantitatively evaluating localized visual consistency across varying poses and environments remains a major challenge. Existing metrics either rely on global image embeddings (CLIP, DINO) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) that pool spatial representations and miss fine-grained textural artifacts, or depend on scalar threshold-gated dense metrics such as Visual-Semantic Matching (VSM) that suffer from point-alignment dropouts, severe threshold sensitivity, and score instability. To overcome these limitations, we propose TF-VSM, a fully continuous, threshold-free visual-consistency metric paired with an extended feature-disentanglement retraining schedule for dual-branch ResNet feature-aggregation networks. Rather than enforcing rigid binary cutoffs $(T_s,T_v)$, TF-VSM weights every object point by a non-linear semantic match confidence $w_j=ReLU(\hat{s}_j)^2$ and continuously integrates visual similarity over all consistency levels $r\in[0,1]$, yielding a closed-form confidence-weighted score without any hand-tuned hyperparameters. On a controlled 100-pair benchmark with ground-truth inpainting oracles, TF-VSM attains Pearson $0.638$ and Spearman $0.674$ oracle correlation, improving over the pretrained VSM baseline ($0.454/0.589$) by $+0.171/+0.116$ after retraining, and drastically outperforming CLIP ($-0.052/-0.004$), DINO ($0.087/0.121$), and VLMs ($0.096/0.003$). Six diagnostic ablations confirm that smooth confidence weighting is the right mechanism, that hard semantic gating is brittle (dropping to $0.533$ Pearson at $T_s{=}0.8$), and that the threshold-free metric is essentially invariant to the training-time loss balance $\alpha$ that the thresholded metric still depends on.

AI.tldr: TF-VSM以连续语义置信度加权替代硬阈值，提高主体驱动图像生成的局部一致性评估质量。
AI.motivation: 全局特征指标易漏掉细粒度缺陷，而阈值化密集匹配存在对齐丢失和分数不稳定问题。
AI.method: 结合双分支网络的扩展解耦重训，以非线性语义置信度加权并连续积分视觉相似度。
AI.result: 在100对受控样本上，与真值参照的Pearson和Spearman相关性分别达0.638和0.674。
AI.conclusion: 平滑置信度加权优于脆弱的硬语义门控，且无阈值指标对训练损失权重基本不敏感。

title: Conditional Asset Pricing Transformer
summary: In this paper, we propose a conditional asset pricing transformer (CAP-T) that captures nonlinear interactions among firms through attention to forecast excess returns. In the first stage, a transformer estimates conditional expected returns, and kernel-weighted principal component analysis of its residuals estimates the local factor loading space. Projecting the conditional mean onto this space separates factor risk compensation from conditional mispricing. Then, in the second stage, separate transformers learn these two components, whose predictions are combined to forecast returns. As a result, the proposed framework decomposes returns into conditional mispricing, factor risk compensation, a centered factor component, and an unpredictable innovation. We establish approximation and generalization bounds and characterize how first-stage prediction errors propagate through local factor estimation and component learning, providing statistical guaranties for conditional mispricing, factor loadings, and factor risk premia. Finally, simulations and empirical studies demonstrate the predictive and interpretive benefits of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: CAP-T利用注意力建模企业间非线性交互，并分解风险补偿与条件性错误定价以预测超额收益。
AI.motivation: 资产收益预测需要刻画企业间非线性关系，并区分风险补偿与条件性错误定价。
AI.method: 先用Transformer预测条件收益并从残差估计局部因子空间，再分别学习风险补偿与错误定价。
AI.result: 建立近似与泛化界及误差传播保证，模拟和实证研究显示预测与解释优势，但未给出具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为条件性错误定价、因子载荷和风险溢价提供统计保证，并增强收益预测的可解释性。

title: How Should Parallel Langevin Chains Share Noise?
summary: Parallel Langevin sampling usually draws an array of independent Gaussian vectors, one row per chain. The average row drives the ensemble mean, with variance $1/K$ per coordinate for $K$ chains. Yet the unadjusted Langevin algorithm (ULA) specifies only each row's distribution. Subtracting the column means and rescaling, as in classical antithetic sampling, makes that variance zero. Each chain keeps its ordinary ULA path law for any finite run. For quadratic targets we derive the joint covariance of linear estimates computed from the ensemble mean, including coefficient estimates, time averages and predictions. The identity separates contributions from initial states and Gaussian draws. The coupling changes the second through one scalar, which is zero whenever the draws sum to zero across chains. For nonquadratic targets we bound the remaining variance. Centering has a price: for a quadratic form in the mean-subtracted Gaussian state, the ensemble average has variance $1/(K-1)$ relative to one chain, compared with $1/K$ under independent draws. On three tempered logistic posteriors, eight centered chains reduced the variance of the posterior-mean estimate, summed over coordinates, by two to three orders of magnitude compared with eight independent chains. They also beat 128 independent chains on variance and on variance times sampling time. Under Metropolis correction the reduction shrank to about three- to eightfold: rejected draws no longer balance accepted ones. The measured variance ratios were consistent with a leading-order prediction from rejection frequency and noise energy.

title: DynLimit: A Simulation Benchmark for Dynamics-Critical Planning and Control
summary: Experiments near vehicle handling limits must keep three questions apart: what a maneuver requests, what the closed-loop system executes, and whether the task is completed. We present DynLimit, a simulation platform that organizes this process end to end. Scenarios are composed from road, friction, obstacle, and reference objects; planners and controllers attach through a shared observation and control interface; a vehicle adapter runs either a license-free four-wheel model or an external dynamics solver; and synchronized records feed task evaluation, replay, and response inspection. The platform carries a task-oriented evaluation method that pairs a prescribed reference demand with a sampled passing set and event-aligned diagnosis. Across eight task families, three friction environments, and three reference-assisted baseline chains we executed 450 runs: 360 nominal, 18 locally refined, and 72 with prescribed initial offsets. Method differences depend on the task family, equal aggregate pass counts arise from different passing cells, and local refinement narrows two sampled transitions without locating a continuous boundary. Two case comparisons show why sideslip or tire-utilization peaks cannot replace task constraints. The three views therefore stay distinct in every reported run: an outcome can be traced from the prescribed demand, through the executed response, to the task rule that decided it. Code is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: DynLimit提供面向车辆动力学极限的仿真评测平台，区分机动需求、闭环响应与任务完成情况。
AI.motivation: 极限操控实验需要避免将参考机动要求、实际执行表现和任务成败混为一谈。
AI.method: 统一场景构建、规划控制接口和车辆动力学适配，以采样通过集合及事件对齐诊断评估任务。
AI.result: 完成450次运行，发现方法表现依赖任务类型，且相同总通过数可对应不同通过区域。

title: Fine-Grained RLAIF for Visual Safety: Learning to Zoom into Hazards for Multimodal Safety Alignment
summary: Recent multimodal safety alignment heavily relies on a text-centric paradigm, assuming risks are explicit in language or globally prominent in images. However, real-world hazards are often visually subtle or peripheral, causing existing models to fail due to their reliance on coarse, global visual representations. In this work, we study fine-grained visual safety alignment and introduce a challenging 1,200-sample benchmark across four domains, where hazards necessitate localized inspection. To address this, we propose Fine-Grained RLAIF (FGR), a reinforcement learning framework that casts image zoom-in as a learnable perception policy. FGR employs a decomposed reward design to jointly align three core safety behaviors: (i) where to look via a visual evidence reward, (ii) when to act via a tool-formatting constraint, and (iii) how to reason via visually grounded safety explanations. FGR achieves accuracy ranging from 86.71% to 93.00%, consistently outperforming strong multimodal and agent-based baselines.

AI.tldr: 细粒度RLAIF将图像放大检查学习为感知策略，提升多模态模型对局部隐蔽危险的识别能力。
AI.motivation: 以文本和全局视觉表示为中心的安全对齐容易漏掉细微或边缘位置的真实危险。
AI.method: 构建覆盖四领域的1200样本基准，并以视觉证据、工具格式约束和视觉扎根解释奖励训练放大策略。
AI.result: FGR准确率达到86.71%—93.00%，持续优于强多模态模型及智能体基线。
AI.conclusion: 将局部视觉检查纳入可学习策略，有助于提升细粒度视觉安全对齐效果。

title: Distance-Certified Polyak-type Stepsizes for Subgradient Methods under Hölder Growth
summary: In this paper, we consider nonsmooth convex optimization under a H{ö}lder growth condition, with quadratic growth and weak sharp minima as two important special cases. Existing subgradient methods often employ predetermined decaying stepsize schedules, whereas the classical Polyak stepsize selects its stepsize adaptively but requires knowledge of the optimal value. We introduce a new distance-certified subgradient method (\DCSG) that follows a one-step optimization principle analogous to that underlying the Polyak stepsize, without requiring the optimal value. Specifically, \DCSG{} maintains a valid upper certificate for the current squared distance to the solution set. The method selects each stepsize by minimizing the worst-case upper bound on the next squared distance over all distances consistent with this certificate. We show that the resulting minimax problem admits a closed-form solution, yielding an explicit adaptive stepsize update. Under uniformly bounded subgradients, \DCSG{} improves upon the convergence rate of the classical subgradient method and matches the state-of-the-art rates for Lipschitz convex optimization under H{ö}lder growth. In particular, it achieves linear convergence under sharp growth. Numerical experiments illustrate the performance of \DCSG.

AI.tldr: 提出无需最优值的距离认证自适应次梯度法，在Hölder增长条件下达到先进收敛速率。
AI.motivation: 传统次梯度法常依赖预设递减步长，而经典Polyak步长需要已知最优值。
AI.method: 维护到解集平方距离的有效上界证书，通过闭式求解最坏情形下一步距离界来选择步长。
AI.result: 在次梯度一致有界时，方法优于经典次梯度法并匹配先进速率，且在尖锐增长下线性收敛。
AI.conclusion: 距离证书可在无需最优值的情况下支持具有收敛保证的自适应步长选择。

title: PIRanNN: Random-Feature Pricing and Calibration under Jump-Diffusion and Stochastic-Volatility Models
summary: We study a random-feature method for pricing and calibrating European options under jump-diffusion (Merton, Kou) and stochastic-volatility (Heston, SABR) models. The network has one hidden layer with a probit activation and fixed random inner weights, so fitting it to the pricing equation, the payoff and the boundary conditions is a single regularised least-squares problem, with no iterative training. For Merton and Kou the jump integral of each feature is explicit, so no quadrature is needed. One factorisation of the least-squares matrix gives the price at every state and time, its Greeks, and the exact derivatives of the prices with respect to the model parameters for gradient-based calibration. For the jump models, subtracting the Black-Scholes price removes the payoff kink and reduces the pricing error by about two orders of magnitude. The method is then about as accurate as a standard Crank-Nicolson finite-difference scheme at the same run time, although a finite-difference scheme that also subtracts the Black-Scholes price is about two orders of magnitude more accurate still. On the test problems of a recent physics-informed neural network study, the method matches that network's accuracy in seconds instead of about half an hour. The calibration experiments show that a solver can fit the quotes and still return wrong parameters when its pricing error is not small compared with the effect of the parameters on the prices: without the subtraction the solver misses the jump parameters by up to 50%, and with it they are recovered to within 3%. For Heston and SABR, used as an applicability study with boundary conditions that need no reference prices, pricing errors are about one percent and the calibrated parameters are within about 15% of the true values.
comment: 29 pages, 4 figures, 14 tables. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出随机特征期权定价与校准方法，以单次正则化最小二乘拟合替代迭代训练。
AI.motivation: 期权模型需要高效定价与参数校准，而定价误差可能导致报价拟合良好却参数失真。
AI.method: 采用固定随机权重的单隐层网络拟合定价方程及约束，并解析计算跳跃积分和参数导数。
AI.result: 跳跃模型减去Black-Scholes价格后误差降低约两个数量级，参数误差从最高50%降至3%以内。

title: IANN: A Unified Framework for Equivariant InterAtomic Neural Networks with User-Friendly Implementation
summary: Machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) now approach density functional theory (DFT) accuracy at a fraction of its cost, but the practical benefit is limited by software fragmentation: each state-of-the-art architecture is released as a separate codebase, with its own data format, configuration system, training loop and molecular-dynamics interface. Comparing two architectures on the same dataset, or moving a trained model into a production simulation, therefore requires substantial re-engineering. We introduce IANN (InterAtomic Neural Network), an open-source PyTorch framework that reimplements equivariant graph neural networks - PaiNN, NequIP, MACE, Allegro, EquiformerV2, EquiformerV3 and UMA - behind a unified data object, a unified trainer and a single deployment route, so that the architecture is a one-word change in a configuration dictionary. Forces, stresses and virials are obtained for every architecture from one analytic differentiation of the energy with respect to the edge vectors of the atomic graph, exact under periodic boundary conditions. Distributed training is configured automatically from the SLURM, PBS or MPI environment, so the same script runs unchanged from a workstation to a multi-node GPU allocation. Self-describing checkpoints serve directly as ASE calculators, as ensembles reporting uncertainties, or as TorchScript models run inside LAMMPS through bundled C++ pair styles with single- and multi-GPU inference. Trained on a common dataset of millions of structures, the architectures can be compared under identical conditions. We further release PaiNN foundation models trained on 41.9 million curated DFT structures from MPtrj, Alexandria, OMat24, MatPES, OC20, OC22, OC25, MPr2SCAN and MatPESr2SCAN, spanning the PBE, RPBE and r2SCAN functionals. Additionally, IANN provides an agent interface to facilitate integration with autonomous agents.

AI.tldr: IANN以统一接口整合多种等变原子神经网络，简化训练、比较与分子动力学部署。
AI.motivation: 原子间机器学习势的软件碎片化使架构比较和生产模拟部署需要大量重复工程。
AI.method: 统一数据对象、训练器及部署流程，以能量对边向量的解析微分计算力、应力和维里。

title: Eliciting Research Taste in LLMs through Future Research Direction Choice
summary: Research taste is increasingly discussed in the context of AI scientists, yet remains little studied or measured in LLMs. This judgment matters especially in open-ended research, where a direction must be chosen before a verifiable objective is available. We operationalize research taste through one task of the scientific workflow: choosing which future research direction to pursue given a research goal and current results. Rather than predicting downstream scientometric metrics or treating author choices as objectively correct, we evaluate models against human-authored future-work directions and report author alignment, stable divergence, and unstable choice as behavioral measures of research-direction preference. We construct an order-controlled evaluation of 80 pairwise comparisons from 19 ML papers published between December 2025 and February 2026 across four subdomains. Each query presents a research goal, hypotheses tested with key results, and two candidate future directions: one author-recommended direction and one plausible distractor sampled from a similar paper. Across eight LLMs, author alignment ranges from 45.0% to 67.5%, while stable divergence ranges from 15.0% to 36.2%. These divergences largely persist under similarity controls, prompt ablations, and an author-preference framing check, and inter-model agreement suggests that some non-author preferences are shared across models. We characterize what models diverge toward using transition-category labels and selected reasoning examples, finding recurring movement toward scaling/generalization and trade-offs between methodological and infrastructure/data extensions. We view this as an early descriptive evaluation for eliciting research taste profiles in LLMs, and as a step toward understanding and steering their research preferences as they take on more autonomous roles in novel open-ended scientific discovery.
comment: Accepted at the LM4Sci Workshop at COLM 2026. 23 pages, 7 figures, 18 tables. Code and data: this https URL

AI.tldr: 通过未来研究方向二选一任务刻画大模型的研究品味，并区分作者一致、稳定偏离与不稳定选择。
AI.motivation: 开放式研究需在可验证目标出现前选择方向，但大模型的研究品味仍缺乏测量。
AI.method: 从19篇机器学习论文构建80组顺序受控比较，评估八个模型对作者推荐方向与干扰方向的选择。
AI.result: 作者一致率为45.0%至67.5%，稳定偏离率为15.0%至36.2%，且偏离在多种控制下大体持续。
