title: Lossless First-Action Menus for Linear-Reward Planning
summary: We study sequential decision making where an agent reserves a minimum menu of initial actions before multi-objective trade-offs are revealed, followed by unrestricted continuation planning once linear reward weights arrive. We prove that a menu preserves the unrestricted optimal return across all linear scalarizations if and only if its reachable continuations cover all vertices of the full feature polytope. This geometric equivalence yields an output-sensitive algorithm that is fixed-parameter tractable in the vertex count, combining scalar backward induction with oracle-based facet identification. On explicitly layered graphs with unit feature increments, menu verification is coNP-complete and synthesis is complete for the second existential level of the polynomial hierarchy, even under additive loss strictly below one. In fixed dimensions two and higher, verification is polynomial whereas synthesis remains NP-complete, while one-dimensional instances admit polynomial-time solutions.

AI.tldr: 以可达延续覆盖特征多面体全部顶点刻画无损首动作菜单，并给出算法与复杂性界限。
AI.motivation: 智能体需在线性奖励权重揭示前预留尽量少的初始动作，同时保留后续规划的最优收益。
AI.method: 建立菜单无损性的几何充要条件，结合标量反向归纳与基于预言机的面识别构造算法。
AI.result: 算法对顶点数固定参数可解；分层图上验证为coNP完全，合成为多项式层级第二存在层完全。
AI.conclusion: 首动作菜单压缩具有明确几何结构，但最小菜单合成在固定二维及更高维时仍为NP完全。

title: The Sense Paradigm for World Models
summary: Latent world models predict the future in an embedding space rather than in pixels. An encoder trained only to predict collapses and maps every observation to the same point, so existing models add a mechanism against collapse, such as a target network, a variance penalty or a distribution penalty. These mechanisms keep the embedding from collapsing, but they leave its distances without meaning, and the model cannot tell a reversible transition from an irreversible one. We propose Sense, a single cross-entropy loss over the directed distance $d(x\to y)=\sum_i \mathrm{ReLU}(y_i-x_i)$ that replaces these mechanisms. The loss avoids collapse on its own, and since the encoder no longer needs the predictor, the predictor is fitted afterwards to fixed embeddings by plain regression. On four pixel environments, the return distance learned by Sense detects irreversible transitions with an AUC between 0.95 and 1.00, where LeWorldModel stays between 0.39 and 0.59. On TwoRoom, the navigation benchmark of LeWorldModel, planning with Sense reaches the goal in 100% of episodes against 91% for LeWorldModel. As the goal moves farther away, the planning failure rate of every baseline grows, while that of Sense stays near zero in Cup, Cliff and Sokoban and is the lowest of all methods in Pendulum.

AI.tldr: Sense以有向距离交叉熵学习不坍缩且可识别不可逆性的世界模型表征，改善目标规划。
AI.motivation: 现有防坍缩机制虽能维持表征多样性，却未赋予距离明确含义，也难以区分可逆与不可逆转移。
AI.method: 使用基于逐维正向差之和的有向距离构造单一交叉熵损失，再对固定嵌入回归拟合预测器。
AI.result: 四个像素环境中不可逆性检测AUC为0.95至1.00，TwoRoom目标到达率为100%，基线为91%。
AI.conclusion: 具有方向意义的表征距离可同时支持防坍缩、不可逆性识别及更稳健的远距离规划。

title: Barron Approximation and locally optimal weight densities for shallow neural networks
summary: Mean field theories provide optimization results for shallow neural networks by analyzing the weight distribution in infinite width limits. Corresponding results for finite sized networks are obtained by particle approximations, for which sharp quantitative bounds are still an open problem. In this paper, we consider a modified mean field loss, which allows a more fine grained control over finite sized networks. We prove convexity and equidistribution properties, which directly lead to Barron type approximation results for networks sampled from local loss minimizers. We demonstrate that particle approximations of the new loss function naturally lead to gradient descent methods with dropout type regularization.

AI.tldr: 通过修改均值场损失，推导局部最优权重分布采样网络的Barron型逼近结果。
AI.motivation: 无限宽均值场理论向有限网络转化依赖粒子逼近，而其精确量化界限仍未解决。
AI.method: 设计可更精细控制有限网络的均值场损失，证明其凸性与等分布性质并分析粒子逼近。
AI.result: 得到从局部损失极小分布采样网络的Barron型逼近结果，粒子逼近自然导出类dropout正则化梯度下降。
AI.conclusion: 修改均值场损失为有限宽浅层网络的逼近分析与正则化优化建立了联系。

title: Multi-Branch Transformer
summary: Transformer language models are commonly scaled by making their blocks wider or stacking them deeper. In this work, we explore a complementary path: branching, the parallel composition of full Transformer blocks. We introduce the Multi-Branch Transformer (MBT), which processes the input through shared initial layers, executes independently parameterized branches of sequential blocks in parallel, and fuses their outputs before shared final layers. At comparable training compute, we study three MBT variants: Wide-Shallow preserves block width, Narrow-Deep preserves sequential depth, and Balanced interpolates between them. In controlled pretraining experiments at four mixture-of-experts scales (0.8B to 2.1B total parameters), 2-branch Wide-Shallow MBTs consistently outperform sequential Transformers under matched parameter and training-compute budgets. Balanced MBTs improve further and retain comparable quality as the number of branches increases. To improve inference efficiency at long contexts, we introduce Joint-KV, which constructs a shared KV cache from branch representations at each depth. Our final recipe combines Balanced MBTs with Joint-KV, supported by an inference engine that exploits branch grouping and shared-cache reuse. Fitted scaling curves indicate that standard Transformers require up to 1.26x as much training body compute to match our final models' validation loss. These models reduce full-model KV-cache storage by up to 34% and deliver up to 51.4% higher decoding throughput on a single H200 GPU. Ablation studies show that branching yields gains beyond changes in width and depth, enables an effective KV-sharing strategy (Joint-KV), remains robust across fusion functions, and performs best in the middle layers. These findings show that branching offers a practical path for scaling language models toward both better modeling quality and faster inference.

AI.tldr: 多分支Transformer结合共享KV缓存，在相近训练预算下改善语言建模质量与推理效率。
AI.motivation: 现有Transformer主要通过加宽或加深扩展，需要探索兼顾建模质量和推理效率的互补路径。
AI.method: 在共享首尾层之间并行执行独立Transformer分支，并用Joint-KV在同深度构建共享缓存。
AI.result: 最终方案使标准模型匹配损失所需计算量最高达其1.26倍，缓存最多减34%，解码吞吐最高增51.4%。
AI.conclusion: 分支结构的收益超出宽深调整本身，为语言模型提供兼顾质量与推理效率的实用扩展方向。

title: Pros4D: Modeling Evolving 4D Worlds in Latent Space for Dynamic Spatial Reasoning
summary: Dynamic spatial reasoning from monocular video enables vision-language models (VLMs) to understand how 3D environments evolve over time, supporting physical world understanding and embodied intelligence. Existing efforts primarily address observed-dynamics understanding, whereas agents in dynamic environments also require future-dynamics prediction beyond the observation boundary. Moreover, external geometric processing and textual descriptions can increase inference complexity or lose information when representing continuous dynamics. These limitations motivate a shared internal state that preserves observed dynamics and remains predictive beyond the input video. Accordingly, we present Pros4D, a framework for modeling evolving 4D worlds in latent space that unifies retrospective understanding of observed-dynamics with prospective reasoning for future-dynamics prediction. Specifically, Pros4D-Engine derives geometry-grounded supervision and constructs paired examples for both tasks, while Pros4D-Bench evaluates them across eight spatial task categories spanning dynamic cameras, objects, and scenes. At the model level, Pros4D compresses observed dynamics into latent observed states and autoregressively rolls them forward into latent future states. 4D Latent Alignment (4DLA) grounds these states through complementary visual-semantic and geometric supervision, while joint language supervision connects them to task reasoning. Experiments across benchmarks show consistent improvements over strong baselines in both capabilities.

AI.tldr: Pros4D在潜在空间建模动态四维世界，统一已观测动态理解与未来动态预测。
AI.motivation: 现有方法偏重已观测动态，且外部几何处理或文本表征会增加推理复杂度或损失连续动态信息。
AI.method: 构建几何监督与八类任务基准，将观测压缩为潜在状态并自回归预测，以视觉语义、几何和语言联合监督。
AI.result: 多项基准实验表明，Pros4D在已观测动态理解和未来动态预测上均持续优于强基线。
AI.conclusion: 共享且具几何依据的潜在状态有助于统一动态世界的回溯理解与前瞻推理。

title: MAPS: A Multimodal Agentic Framework for POI Data Production Based on Crowdsourced Street-view Imagery
summary: Point-of-interest (POI) databases support location-based services, yet urban changes quickly make their records stale and manual maintenance is costly. Crowdsourced street-view images provide timely visual evidence, but converting them into database actions requires separating multiple POIs and irrelevant text in each image, then resolving incomplete observations against ambiguous records. We study Street-view Image-based POI Data Production and propose MAPS, the first framework to integrate structured POI extraction with database maintenance from such imagery. MAPS contains two cascaded modules. SPICE progressively adapts a lightweight vision-language model to reconstruct and filter text, group entries belonging to the same POI, and classify their semantics and completeness. RIMA retrieves candidate records, performs evidence-grounded POI matching and attribute-level reasoning, and selectively acquires complementary visual, geospatial, or external-source evidence when necessary. In human-reviewed full-task evaluation, MAPS outperforms the strongest baseline by 21.8\%. MAPS has also been deployed in Kuaishou's large-scale POI production pipeline, reducing average processing time by 76.9\% relative to manual annotation. These results demonstrate the effectiveness and practical value of MAPS for scalable POI maintenance.
comment: Accepted for presentation at the 33rd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining (KDD 2027), Cycle 1

AI.tldr: MAPS利用众包街景图像提取兴趣点并维护数据库，提高兴趣点数据生产效率。
AI.motivation: 城市变化使兴趣点数据库迅速过时，而街景中的多目标、无关文本和不完整观测增加自动维护难度。
AI.method: SPICE结构化提取兴趣点，RIMA检索匹配记录并进行属性推理，必要时补充视觉、地理或外部证据。
AI.result: 人工审核的全任务评估中，MAPS较最强基线提升21.8%，部署后平均处理时间较人工标注减少76.9%。
AI.conclusion: MAPS在评估和大规模生产部署中展现了可扩展兴趣点维护的有效性与实用价值。

title: Reasoning in the loop: antibody lead optimization by probing mechanism and measurement
summary: Lab-in-the-loop systems, in which a model proposes molecules, automated assays measure their properties and the results retrain the model, are a popular approach to antibody lead optimization. These systems optimize for a specification defined with metrics computed from instrument signals, so their success depends on how well those metrics serve as proxies for the properties a drug candidate needs. When a metric is a poor proxy, neither a better model nor more data will fix it, and identifying the problem usually requires expert review. We report two campaigns run on BigHat Biosciences' Milliner platform, one on an anti-albumin nanobody (VHH) and one on an anti-mesothelin single-chain variable fragment (scFv), in which a research team and a general-purpose AI agent, Claude, brought scientific reasoning into the loop. Over seven rounds and about 1,010 design variants we built libraries from antibody lineage, structure and biophysics, and found from the raw curves that on each scaffold one thermal metric did not measure what its name implied. The libraries were built as controlled comparisons, so the results also show what each mutation contributes to each property. We fit a physical model of the curves, used it to choose metrics suited to each scaffold, and changed the experimental protocol, varying protein concentration and heating rate, to test the model against pre-registered predictions. Both leads improve on their parents in affinity, thermal stability and aggregation while improving or maintaining yield and purity.

AI.tldr: 研究团队与通用AI智能体通过机制推理和测量验证，改进两类抗体先导物并纠正误导性热学指标。
AI.motivation: 抗体闭环优化依赖测量指标，当指标不能代表目标性质时，改进模型或增加数据也无法解决问题。
AI.method: 开展七轮约1010种变体实验，以受控比较、曲线物理建模及浓度和升温速率干预测试预注册预测。
AI.result: 两种骨架均发现一项名不副实的热学指标，两种先导物的亲和力、热稳定性和聚集表现改善，产量与纯度改善或保持。
AI.conclusion: 将科学推理、测量审查和机制验证纳入实验闭环，有助于选择合适指标并优化抗体性质。

title: Conditional Optimal Transport and Triangular Maps for Imitation Learning
summary: We introduce a unified formulation of imitation learning from demonstrations as a conditional sampling problem solved by triangular transport: a policy is the second block of a triangular map that transports a reference distribution to the conditional distribution of the action chunk given the observation history. Unlike in Diffusion Policy, where it is a fixed Gaussian, the reference becomes a design variable; we take it to be the empirical distribution of the demonstrated action chunks and introduce three instances of the formulation: an optimal transport policy (OTP), a flow matching policy (FMP), and a stochastic interpolant policy (SIP). On the Push-T and robomimic Square tasks, the three policies are competitive in task performance with Diffusion Policy and Consistency Policy while using considerably smaller networks and shorter training, and the informative reference accounts for a substantial part of their performance when few network evaluations are used. The three instances offer different trade-offs rather than a single best method: OTP generates an action chunk with a single evaluation of the smallest network (0.23 million parameters on Push-T) and is suitable for settings in which inference time and model size matter, whereas SIP attains the highest scores among the proposed policies at a higher cost.

AI.tldr: 研究以条件采样和三角输运统一模仿学习，并提出三种具有不同效率与性能权衡的策略。
AI.motivation: 固定高斯参考分布并非唯一选择，利用示范动作分布可能提升少量网络评估下的策略表现。
AI.method: 以示范动作块的经验分布为参考，通过三角映射构建最优输运、流匹配和随机插值策略。
AI.result: 三种策略在两项任务上以更小网络和更短训练获得与基线相当的表现，OTP可单次评估生成动作，SIP得分最高但成本更高。
AI.conclusion: 信息丰富的参考分布贡献显著，三种策略应按推理时间、模型规模与任务性能需求选择。

title: Drone Navigation for Fast, Safe Emergency Response
summary: In 2025, there was a total of 358 weather-related disasters worldwide affecting millions of people. For unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to autonomously aid these people, they need to be able to navigate around complex obstacles and reach their destinations to deliver supplies or quickly locate survivors in disaster-stricken areas. Our research addresses this need by providing a method to compute minimum-time trajectories in real time while providing guarantees of obstacle avoidance along the trajectory. Previous approaches treat the problem of computing time-optimal trajectories without considering obstacle avoidance. Our work not only includes obstacle avoidance constraints, but also improves overall mission time for navigation. We define mission time as the sum of planning time and traversal time. In time-sensitive emergencies, rapid trajectory planning is essential to ensure the prompt delivery of critical medical aid. As such, we consider the combined planning and traversal time as the key metric for how quickly the vehicle can reach a survivor. We show a sample mission in Fig. 1 where the quadrotor navigates through multiple canyon-like obstacles to deliver aid; during most of this trajectory, it is applying the near-maximum thrust.
comment: Submitted to the 2027 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)

AI.tldr: 研究面向应急无人机导航，实时规划具有避障保证的最短时间轨迹，并兼顾规划与飞行耗时。
AI.motivation: 灾害救援需要无人机快速穿越复杂障碍，既有时间最优轨迹方法未充分考虑避障与规划耗时。
AI.method: 将避障约束纳入实时最短时间轨迹计算，并以规划时间与飞行时间之和衡量任务耗时。
AI.result: 摘要报告该方法改善整体任务时间，并展示四旋翼穿越多处峡谷状障碍送援的示例，但未提供量化结果。
AI.conclusion: 同时考虑规划速度、飞行时间和避障约束，更契合时间敏感的无人机应急救援需求。

title: Hermitian Positive Definite Neural Networks for Matrix-CFAR Geometric Signal Detection in Nonhomogeneous Clutter
summary: Matrix information geometry (MIG) detectors exploit the Riemannian geometry of Hermitian positive definite (HPD) matrices to achieve robust object detection in nonhomogeneous clutter. The matrix constant false alarm rate (matrix-CFAR) method is a representative MIG detector that relies on the geometric structures with respect to specific metrics. In most cases, computing representative HPD covariance matrices requires numerical methods, typically involving computationally intensive iterative optimization algorithms. Although explicit formulas are available for certain cases, such as the log-Euclidean (LE) mean, they are generally unavailable for many other matrix means and medians. To address this challenge, we propose integrating the Hermitian positive definite neural network (HPDNet) into the matrix-CFAR framework, replacing conventional numerical optimization procedures with a learned, geometry-preserving mapping that directly estimates representative HPD covariance matrices from data. In the simulations, the framework is evaluated for MIG detectors using both means and medians associated with the affine-invariant Riemannian metric, the LE metric, and the Bures--Wasserstein metric, on both simulated compound-Gaussian clutter and real IPIX sea clutter. In both cases, the HPDNet is trained solely on simulated data to assess its applicability to the study of real data. The results show a significant reduction of computational cost in testing, while maintaining detection performance and robustness.

AI.tldr: HPDNet以保持几何结构的神经映射替代矩阵CFAR中的数值优化，降低检测计算成本。
AI.motivation: 矩阵几何检测所需的代表性协方差矩阵通常缺乏显式公式，迭代求解计算开销较大。
AI.method: 将HPDNet嵌入矩阵CFAR，仅用模拟数据训练，并在多种几何度量、模拟杂波和真实海杂波上评估。
AI.result: 在模拟杂波与真实IPIX海杂波上，该框架显著降低测试计算成本，同时保持检测性能和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 保持几何结构的学习映射可高效估计代表性正定矩阵，并具备应用于真实杂波数据的潜力。

title: GraphPass: A Study of Graph Neural Networks for Compiler Pass Selection
summary: Compiler pass selection is usually governed by fixed pipelines (-O2, -O3) or hand-written heuristics. We study whether a graph neural network (GNN) over a program's control-flow graph (CFG) can select among a fixed menu of five pass sequences in a single forward pass. GraphPass encodes each CFG with a graph attention (GAT) or graph convolutional (GCN) encoder and classifies it into one of the five sequences. On a synthetic benchmark of 5,000 generated CFGs in five program families, both encoders agree with the benchmark's reference label on about 92% of held-out programs, versus 68.4% for a hand-written rule-based heuristic and 85% for a flat MLP. An edge ablation indicates that this gain comes from per-block processing rather than from CFG edges: a GCN given the same basic-block features with all edges removed scores 95.0%, versus 92.2% with the true CFG. In this benchmark the label is determined by the program family, so the task amounts to family recognition. Real-compiler speedup is not measured. Inference costs O(|V| + |E|) per CFG, measured at 1.7 ms for a typical program and about 0.8 s for a 100,000-block graph on one CPU core.

AI.tldr: GraphPass在合成基准上以图神经网络选择编译优化序列，但其优势并非来自控制流图边结构。
AI.motivation: 编译优化序列通常依赖固定流水线或人工规则，研究探索能否通过一次图网络前向计算完成选择。
AI.method: 用图注意力或图卷积编码控制流图，将程序分类至五种优化序列，并开展去边消融与推理耗时测试。
AI.result: 两种编码器准确率约92%，高于规则基线68.4%与MLP的85%；去边GCN达95.0%，高于保留边的92.2%。
AI.conclusion: 该基准实质衡量程序家族识别，收益主要来自基本块处理，尚未测量真实编译器加速效果。

title: The Flip Test: Video World Models Fail to Learn the World State
summary: Video world models promise to predict the future of a scene from its present. Do current models keep this promise? We probe this question counterfactually. When a small change to the present flips the future, such as a box resting a few millimeters before or past a table edge, a model that tracks the state of the world must flip its prediction too. We build FlipTest, a three-level hierarchy of increasingly strict tests over 1,680 initial frames from 10 simulated and 15 real-world tasks. At the base, visual minimal pairs, two nearly identical frames whose true futures differ, test whether predictions change across the boundary; matched controls go further and test whether they change only where the future does; and dense sweeps, the strictest level, locate exactly where they change. All 11 video world models we evaluate fall short. The best averages 18.3% pair accuracy over real and simulated scenes, below the 25% of random guessing. Models flip as often on steps that leave the future unchanged as on steps that change it, and their response stays flat across the sweeps. On the same frames, a vision-language model is selective and traces a near S-shaped curve near the boundary, and a coding agent that measures the image comes close to the true boundary. This implies that the deciding information is in the frame, and video models just miss it. We therefore urge the community to rethink world modeling as pure video prediction. Next-frame prediction must do more than draw plausible pixels; it must also identify the causal states that control future dynamics.

AI.tldr: FlipTest发现，受测视频世界模型难以识别决定未来变化的细微状态边界。
AI.motivation: 逼真的视频预测不等于理解世界状态，需要检验模型能否随决定未来的微小变化而改变预测。
AI.method: 基于25项模拟及真实任务的1680帧，构建最小视觉对、匹配对照和密集扫描三级反事实测试。
AI.result: 11个视频模型均表现不足，最佳平均配对准确率仅18.3%，低于随机猜测的25%，且无法选择性响应状态边界。
AI.conclusion: 未来预测需识别控制动态的因果状态，而不能仅生成可信像素，纯视频预测范式值得重新审视。

title: EfficientSkill: Learning Skills for Token-Efficient Multi-Turn Agents
summary: Reflective skill optimizers improve multi-turn LLM agents by revising instructions from failed and successful rollouts, yet accumulating edge-case rules bloats prompts, inflates token use, and pushes agents into long, error-prone loops. We introduce EfficientSkill, a two-step framework that first discovers a reliable skill without token penalties, and then warm-starts accuracy-guarded pruning from that skill to compress instructions, bound agent turns, and offload reusable code into workspace utilities with zero implementation prompt cost. Across four frontier, mid-tier, and open-weight models on MATH-500, ALFWorld, and SpreadsheetBench, EfficientSkill cuts output tokens over unconstrained EvoSkill on 11 of 12 configurations (by up to 80%) while raising mean accuracy on every benchmark, including +14.3 and +17.5 percentage-point gains on SpreadsheetBench with Gemini 3.8 Flash and Grok 4.1 Fast by replacing stalled loops with compact workflows. By shrinking both generated tokens and replayed history, EfficientSkill lowers total token usage and serving cost across every evaluated configuration, with or without full-prefix KV caching.

AI.tldr: EfficientSkill通过先学习可靠技能再压缩指令，降低多轮智能体的令牌成本并提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 反思式技能优化不断累积规则，导致提示膨胀、令牌消耗增加及冗长易错的交互循环。
AI.method: 先无令牌惩罚地发现技能，再以准确率为约束裁剪指令、限制轮次并将可复用代码移至工作区工具。
AI.result: 相较无约束EvoSkill，12种配置中11种的输出令牌减少、最高达80%，且各基准平均准确率均提升。
AI.conclusion: 压缩生成内容与重放历史可在有无完整前缀缓存时均降低总令牌用量及服务成本。

title: Foundation Pareto Flow Policy for Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning
summary: The overarching goal of reinforcement learning (RL) is to efficiently optimize the agent's policy for various environments, tasks, dynamics, and even user preferences, which often consist of multiple and potentially conflicting rewards/objectives. This necessitates the learning of Pareto-optimal policies that can navigate different trade-offs among objectives. However, existing multi-objective RL (MORL) methods, whether trained online or offline, are typically limited to task- or objective-specific policy learning and do not address generalization of learned trade-offs to unseen tasks/objectives. In this work, we propose the Foundation Pareto Flow Policy (FP2) for offline MORL in continuous robotic control, inspired by the pre-mid-post-training paradigm underlying recent foundation models. Specifically, we instantiate FP2 as a multi-modal diffusion transformer equipped with a likelihood-free flow matching loss, enabling unified, scalable, and instructable learning of diverse trade-off trajectories. We further develop a three-stage training pipeline to gradually optimize the policy: (1) pre-training on a large-scale MORL dataset, (2) mid-training on a carefully curated high-quality dataset, and (3) post-training on few collected trajectory data from new tasks and trade-offs. Empirical results demonstrate that FP2 outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods on most tasks of the D4MORL benchmark, achieving superior zero-shot interpolation and extrapolation on complex Pareto manifolds as well as efficient few-shot adaptation of the learned trade-off prior to new continuous-control tasks. Code is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: FP2通过三阶段训练学习多目标控制策略，支持未见任务与目标权衡的泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有多目标强化学习通常局限于特定任务或目标，难以将已学权衡迁移至新情境。
AI.method: 采用配备无似然流匹配损失的多模态扩散Transformer，依次进行大规模预训练、优质数据中训练和少样本后训练。
AI.result: FP2在D4MORL多数任务上优于既有最先进方法，并实现零样本权衡插值、外推及新任务少样本适应。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型式训练流程可形成可迁移的目标权衡先验，提升离线多目标连续控制的泛化能力。

title: Where Is Rank-1 DiM Refusal Intervenable in Multimodal LM Derivatives?
summary: Open-weight model hubs now ship not only chat checkpoints but a long tail of derivatives---fine-tunes, safety guards, vision--language models (VLMs), audio wrappers, and generative heads---yet residual-stream safety audits still often intervene at a single site, usually the text decoder $T$. We ask a localization question under one shared mean / rank-1 difference-in-means (DiM) extract$=$intervene protocol, with matched-norm random and empty-rate controls: does causal chat attack lift concentrate at $T$, or do perceptual encoders, projectors, and fusion paths ($E$/$P$/$F$) supply a comparable bypass? On the mixed-input settings we stress-test---HADES adversarial images paired with harmful text prompts, and spoken AdvBench via text-to-speech (TTS) or silence---text DiM at $T$ raises attack success rate (ASR) while the same mean DiM at $E$/$P$/$F$ does not; attacks track harmful text rather than image or audio content. Margin-rank and leverage probes on a Vision leaf show that this recipe is extremal at $T$ and near chance at $P$/$E$, which pressures a weak-extractor reading of those flat cells for the DiM family we study. Catalog breadth and mapper-free base$\to$derivative transfer when residual widths match provide supporting coverage under the same gates; generative U-Nets are a separate band under generation judges. The primary claim is this recipe-scoped $T$ vs.\ non-text intervenability asymmetry---intervention accessibility under mean / rank-1 DiM, not a claim that refusal is absent or fully represented outside $T$ (text vs.\ perceptual contrasts and pooling differ by site). On VLGuard Unsafe prompts ($n{=}200$; Llama-Guard), the same $T$ vs.\ $P$/$E$ directionality holds at modest absolute ASR ($0.030{\to}0.150$ at $T$). An intervention-oriented Class$\times$site ledger records where this protocol still hooks as supporting coverage, not as a universal multimodal bypass.

AI.tldr: 在所测均值与秩一DiM干预协议下，多模态模型的拒答绕过主要可在文本解码器处实现。
AI.motivation: 现有安全审计常仅干预文本解码器，尚不清楚感知编码器、投影器及融合路径能否提供相当的绕过效果。
AI.method: 统一提取与干预协议，结合等范数随机及空输入率对照，在图文和语音场景比较各模块的攻击成功率。
AI.result: 文本解码器干预提高攻击成功率，非文本模块未呈现相同效果；VLGuard测试中文本端成功率由0.030升至0.150。
AI.conclusion: 该不对称性仅适用于所测DiM干预方法，不能据此断言非文本模块不存在或完整承载拒答表征。

title: When Does Reusing Layers Help Multimodal Embeddings?
summary: We ask whether a compact universal multimodal embedding models can produce better search embeddings by running the same layers again. Looped transformers add computation with nearly unchanged model size, making them an appealing alternative to a larger encoder. Their success in language-model reasoning and recent use for retrieval motivate the idea, but higher retrieval scores alone do not reveal what an extra pass contributes. We study eleven loop designs and training variants on three checkpoints of one vision-language architecture. Our protocol distinguishes whether a model uses its extra pass, whether its image states respond to the query, and whether those updates improve retrieval. We prove that an image placed before the query remains query-independent through repeated layers when information only travels forward. We then open a query-to-image path in three ways, including order-alternating recurrence, which places the query first on the next pass. Each path produces query-sensitive image states. For bidirectional attention and order alternation, freezing later visual updates does not lower accuracy. On all 78 datasets of the Massive Multimodal Embedding Benchmark version 2 (MMEB-V2), a standard added loop loses 0.46 points against its trained control; an intermediate generative stage changes the effect to +0.36. A model pretrained with recurrence gains +4.23 points over its own loop-removed control and benefits from query-conditioned image updates when answering visual questions or locating objects from text.

AI.tldr: 多模态嵌入中的层复用并非必然改善检索，其收益取决于训练方式及查询条件化更新的有效性。
AI.motivation: 循环Transformer可在参数规模近乎不变时增加计算，但检索分数不足以说明额外计算的具体作用。
AI.method: 在同一视觉语言架构的三个检查点上比较11种循环设计与训练变体，并分析查询到图像的信息路径。
AI.result: MMEB-V2上普通额外循环下降0.46分，而循环预训练模型较移除循环的自身对照提升4.23分。
AI.conclusion: 开启查询到图像的路径虽能产生查询敏感状态，但只有部分训练条件下这些更新才改善检索。

title: PRISM: Primitive-Integrated Separable Modulation with Priority Visual Memory Queue for Compositional Zero-Shot Learning
summary: Compositional Zero-Shot Learning (CZSL) recognizes unseen attribute--object pairs by recombining primitives from seen compositions. Existing methods stop sharing evidence at deployment: fixed prototypes cannot exploit unlabeled test streams, while composition-wise refinement cannot propagate corrections across pairs sharing a primitive. We introduce PRISM, an online CZSL framework that extends primitive sharing to test-time adaptation. Its Hierarchical Knowledge Accumulation Module (HiKAM) factorizes prototype migration into composition-, attribute-, and object-level residual banks. A Priority Visual Memory Queue (PVMQ), initialized by Prototype Queue Initialization (PQI), grounds text updates with bounded visual evidence. The same adaptive core supports exhaustive Full PRISM and recall-calibrated Adaptive PRISM-Lite, which selects candidate budgets from held-out ranks. Comprehensive closed- and open-world experiments on UT-Zappos, MIT-States, and C-GQA demonstrate the state of the art, with Full PRISM achieving the best open-world AUC and harmonic mean on all three benchmarks and the best closed-world results on UT-Zappos and C-GQA. Fine-grained long-tail and non-stationary primitive-block evaluations reveal gains on under-supported concepts and stable adaptation under prolonged skew. Adaptive PRISM-Lite further delivers substantial efficiency gains in the full open-world space with only a small accuracy cost. PRISM thus combines primitive-shared online adaptation, multimodal grounding, and candidate-aware inference.

AI.tldr: PRISM将基元共享扩展至测试时在线适应，改善组合零样本识别并提供高效推理版本。
AI.motivation: 固定原型无法利用无标签测试流，按组合独立细化又难以在共享属性或对象的组合间传播修正。
AI.method: 通过组合、属性和对象三级残差库更新原型，以优先视觉记忆队列提供视觉依据，并按召回校准候选预算。
AI.result: 完整版在三个基准均取得最佳开放世界AUC与调和均值，轻量版以较小精度代价显著提高效率。
AI.conclusion: 基元共享在线适应与视觉依据相结合，可改善长尾概念识别并在持续偏斜的数据流中保持稳定适应。

title: Beyond Vehicle-Centric Data: Scaling Autonomous Driving through Roadside-to-Vehicle Generation
summary: Training autonomous driving models requires large and diverse datasets, collected primarily by vehicles. Scaling them entails investment in fleet operation, data processing and annotation. Road infrastructure records traffic and multi-vehicle interactions, yet the viewpoint gap between roadside and onboard sensors limits its direct use for training. Here we introduce AnyR2V, a framework that transforms multimodal roadside observations into seven-camera surround-view videos for different vehicle perspectives. It aggregates sequential observations into a shared scene representation of geometry and road-user motion, then renders appearance, depth and layout conditions along target-vehicle trajectories. Supervised by spatiotemporally aligned roadside-vehicle pairs, AnyR2V generates surround-view videos guided by scene structure and road-user motion. Existing roadside 3D bounding boxes are transformed into target-vehicle coordinates and paired with generated images, allowing one traffic recording and its annotations to yield training data from multiple vehicle perspectives. We construct R2V360, a dataset of 89 real traffic sequences at an urban intersection, with aligned multimodal roadside data and onboard surround-view videos. AnyR2V outperforms six scene reconstruction methods in image fidelity and in depth and semantic agreement between generated and real onboard images. We further evaluate generated videos along other vehicles' trajectories by adding them to real training data. Adding generated frames equal to 50% of the original real training frame count improves mean average precision (mAP) by 3.3-3.4 AP-points across three 3D object detectors on the real onboard test set, relative to real-data-only baselines. These results demonstrate that roadside traffic records can provide training data from multiple vehicle perspectives, offering a new data source for autonomous driving.

AI.tldr: AnyR2V将路侧观测转换为多车辆视角的环视视频，为自动驾驶扩充训练数据。
AI.motivation: 车载数据规模化采集成本高，而路侧与车载传感器的视角差异阻碍路侧交通记录的直接利用。
AI.method: 聚合时序路侧观测形成共享场景表示，沿车辆轨迹生成七相机视频，并将现有三维框转换至目标车辆坐标。
AI.result: 加入相当于原真实训练帧数50%的生成帧后，三种三维检测器在真实测试集上的mAP提升3.3至3.4点。
AI.conclusion: 路侧记录及其标注可复用于多个车辆视角，成为自动驾驶训练数据的新来源。

title: ProTTS: End-to-End Prominence-aware Natural and Controllable Text-to-Speech via Automatic Word Stress Discovery
summary: Natural speech conveys meaning not only through words, but also through the prominence on a few words. Yet most text-to-speech (TTS) systems remain prominence-unaware, existing prominence-aware TTS require external stress annotations, while unsupervised stress detectors operate in isolation, disconnected from synthesis. This creates a fundamental gap no existing system can automatically discover where stress should be placed, realize it as natural-sounding prosody, and offer user control over emphasis placement, all within a single model. To circumvent this, we propose ProTTS, a unified framework where stress detection emerges from the TTS model itself and, in turn, guides it to synthesize more natural and controllable speech. We incorporate a clustering head into the variance adaptor of FastSpeech_2 that discovers word stress directly from aggregated prosodic features. The discovered stress then drives emphasis variance predictors that modify pitch, energy, and duration for stressed words. The framework is trained end-to-end: TTS reconstruction and clustering losses jointly shape a stress-discriminative feature space without requiring stress labels at any stage. At inference, the same architecture also supports user-controllable emphasis by accepting a custom stress mask. We evaluate ProTTS on ISLE (non-native), LibriTTS, VCTK (native training), and three evaluation benchmarks (Tatoeba, TinyStress-15k, EmphAssess). Listeners prefer ProTTS over the baseline with a MOS of 3.96 vs. 3.12 and 83.5% preference rate. For stress detection, ProTTS achieves 0.839/0.861 F1 on ISLE (German/Italian L2), outperforming unsupervised (0.70) and supervised (0.82) baselines, and 0.933 F1 in zero-shot transfer to Tatoeba.

AI.tldr: ProTTS无需重音标签即可联合学习词重音发现与语音合成，并支持用户指定强调位置。
AI.motivation: 现有系统难以在单一模型内同时实现自动重音发现、自然韵律合成和用户可控强调。
AI.method: 在FastSpeech 2方差适配器中加入聚类头，以重建和聚类损失联合训练，再由重音驱动音高、能量及持续时间预测。
AI.result: ProTTS的MOS为3.96、基线为3.12，听众偏好率达83.5%，零样本迁移至Tatoeba的重音检测F1为0.933。
AI.conclusion: 端到端联合学习可在无需重音标注的情况下兼顾自然语音、重音检测与可控强调。

title: AGPF: Dynamic Source Selection for Feature Pyramid Fusion
summary: Feature pyramids provide dense predictors with features at several spatial resolutions. However, it remains largely unexplored which pyramid levels each output location should aggregate information from. We investigate this question by allowing each output location to attend to features from every pyramid level and measuring how attention is distributed across scales. Surprisingly, locations on the finest output grid allocate approximately 75\% of their attention to features two levels coarser, rather than to the current or adjacent levels. Even on the same output grid, the balance shifts toward coarser features as object size increases. These observations motivate Asymmetric Global Pyramid Fusion (AGPF), a neck that preserves the original output grids while allowing each location to dynamically select its contextual sources across scales. Each location interacts with a multiscale memory whose features are aligned in image coordinates, enabling flexible cross-scale aggregation without altering prediction resolutions. Compared with FPN, AGPF improves all 19 object detection and all seven instance segmentation configurations evaluated on COCO. A single fusion block improves Cascade Mask R-CNN by 1.7 box AP and 2.3 mask AP, and the gains consistently transfer to semantic and panoptic segmentation.

AI.tldr: AGPF允许各输出位置动态选择跨尺度信息来源，在保持预测分辨率的同时改善多种密集预测任务。
AI.motivation: 特征金字塔中各位置应从哪些尺度聚合信息尚不明确，最细网格的注意力却约75%投向粗两级特征。
AI.method: 构建按图像坐标对齐的多尺度记忆，使各位置跨金字塔层动态聚合上下文，同时保留原有输出网格。
AI.result: AGPF在COCO全部19种检测和7种实例分割配置中优于FPN，单块使Cascade Mask R-CNN提升1.7框AP及2.3掩码AP。
AI.conclusion: 动态跨尺度来源选择有助于特征融合，其收益还能迁移至语义分割与全景分割。

title: Passable for Whom? Few-Shot Personal Calibration of Sidewalk Accessibility Perception
summary: Whether a sidewalk is passable depends on who is trying to pass: people who use the same mobility aid disagree about the same image, so one label per scene, or per aid, is wrong for many of them. We introduce few-shot personal accessibility perception: from K answers of a person never seen before, predict their judgment of sidewalk scenes never seen before. PassCal separates a shared description of the scene from the person's interpretation of it. The description comes from the internal state of a frozen vision-language model (VLM) and from barrier type, severity and context properties predicted by a detector trained on 14.9k public audits; the interpretation, a calibration of the person's response style and a weighting of the properties, is fit from their answers. On 8,883 judgments in which each of 135 verified mobility-aid users rated the same 50 sidewalk scenes, with people and scenes both held out, eight answers lower the Brier score from 0.550 to 0.479. The same VLM prompted with those answers reaches 0.562, and the same calibration without the scene 0.521. Conformal risk control turns predictions into passable, blocked or "depends on you" statements with a bounded expected rate of wrong statements over people; at 5%, eight answers raise the share of decisive scenes from 27% to 42%. Audit-supervised properties improve all sixteen vision and VLM encoders we test and outperform attributes from a sidewalk navigation VLM.

AI.tldr: PassCal仅用少量个人回答，即可校准不同助行器使用者对人行道通行性的判断。
AI.motivation: 即使使用相同助行器，不同人对同一场景的通行判断也不同，统一标签难以适用。
AI.method: 融合冻结视觉语言模型特征与审计监督的障碍属性，再以个人回答校准响应风格和属性权重。
AI.result: 八次回答使Brier分数从0.550降至0.479，并在5%风险约束下将明确判断比例从27%升至42%。
AI.conclusion: 分离场景描述与个人解释可改善个性化通行判断，并支持具有风险界限的预测声明。

title: Grounding Language Models in Speech Does Not Fix "AI Flavor": Calibrated LLM Judges, Goodhart Traps, and a Preference-Tuning Fix
summary: Chinese outputs of large language models carry a perceptible "AI flavor": formulaic sentence frames, stacked written-register connectives, repetition loops, and layout leakage. A popular hypothesis blames text-only training for the missing inner-speech layer of human writing; injecting speech or prosody signals should therefore reduce it. We test it with controlled interventions on a 0.6B model; all three fail: (i) phoneme-interleaved continued pretraining yields no spokenness gain under text-matched controls while raising repetition (+0.13 [+0.03, +0.23]); (ii) prosody-plan conditional generation reaches an adherence of only 0.257 against a pre-registered 0.50 gate; (iii) a rule-based reward built on TTS prosody-feature distance is imperceptible in double-blind evaluation by both humans (8/16) and a calibrated LLM judge (9/16). A root cause is evaluation: single-rater blind evaluation at n~20 only detects extreme (>=85%) preferences. We therefore build a calibrated LLM-judge protocol: the judge passes catch trials on known-answer pairs (16/16; single-text 22/24, same-topic pairs 24/24, versus 0.75 for the human rater), then annotates with two independent judges under A/B swapping, counting disagreement as a tie. Using the judge's agree labels directly as DPO pairs (no reward model), we obtain the first positive result: held-out blind win rate 0.833 [0.699, 0.972], repetition 0.114 to 0.000, unchanged MMLU. We further identify a Goodhart channel: the judge's length preference transduces into output-length collapse via pairwise DPO (median 75 chars vs a 300-char prompt); an SFT-anchor repairs it (w is a style knob: w=0.1 preserves gains, w=0.3 does not). Scaling preference data from 89 to 240 pairs yields no additional judge-visible gain. We release RA-Eval v0.1: a three-layer Chinese AI-flavor evaluation framework with 382 judge-annotated preference pairs.

title: Asking the right question is key to AI discovery in a chain of hypotheses
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) scientists pursue discovery through a chain of hypotheses, fitting candidate models to existing observations and often choosing experiments where those models disagree most. Yet when early data miss a narrow feature, model selection favors simple curves that agree across the unmea- sured gap, so disagreement-guided search has no reason to look where the new phenomenon lies. When we tested two frontier AI scientists, Claude Sonnet 5.5 and GPT-6.1-Sol, across 32 closed-loop trials with a narrow peak omitted from the starting data, both sampled inside the peak region less often than random search. Surprisingly, the agent that followed model disagreement more closely missed the peak in all 32 trials, whereas discovery succeeded when experiments probed the unmeasured gap early and followed up across the anomaly. Asking the right question, rather than testing only where current models disagree, is therefore key to AI discovery in a chain of hypotheses.

AI.tldr: 仅按候选模型分歧选择实验可能错失新现象，主动探索未测空白更有利于发现。
AI.motivation: 初始数据遗漏狭窄特征时，简单模型可能在未测区域一致，导致分歧驱动搜索失灵。
AI.method: 让两个前沿AI科学家在初始数据缺失窄峰的条件下开展32次闭环试验。
AI.result: 两者采样峰区的频率均低于随机搜索，更遵循模型分歧的智能体在全部32次试验中漏掉峰值。
AI.conclusion: AI科学发现需要尽早探查未测空白并追踪异常，而不能只检验现有模型的分歧。

title: A phase diagram for training and inference in language models
summary: A language model is a complex system whose behavior is determined jointly by the Transformer and the corpus, yet how the representation geometry in the Transformer relates to the actual behavior of language models remains open. We analyze how the representation geometry changes along the forward propagation of actual language models and characterize the representation geometry of a document at a given layer by two collective coordinates, document distinguishability and document dimension. On the phase diagram spanned by these collective coordinates, inference is represented as a flow along depth. We find that, for untrained models, depending on their initialization scale, most of the 156 inference flows move toward the collapse and noise regions of the phase diagram. By contrast, the inference flows of 8 trained models from 5 architecture families all enter and reside in the central region of the phase diagram. Describing the evolution of the flows with a discrete Langevin equation, we find that the difference between the inference flows of untrained runs and those of trained models reduces to whether the effective force on the flows in this region is of saddle or stable-node type. On Pythia-1.4B, we interpret the training process as a phase transition. These results give a unified gateway to the relation between representation geometry and language-model behavior.

AI.tldr: 以文档可区分性和维度构建相图，揭示语言模型训练前后表征传播动力学的差异。
AI.motivation: Transformer内部表征几何与语言模型实际行为之间的关系仍不明确。
AI.method: 用两个集体坐标刻画逐层推理流，并以离散朗之万方程分析其演化及训练过程。
AI.result: 156条未训练推理流大多趋向坍缩或噪声区，五类架构的八个已训练模型均进入并停留于中央区。
AI.conclusion: 训练前后的差异可归结为中央区有效力从鞍点型转为稳定节点型，训练可呈现相变特征。

title: NoLBERT-Calls: Reading Earnings Calls Without Hindsight
summary: Language models are now a standard tool for measuring what managers say on earnings calls, but the encoders behind these measures were usually pretrained on text from the same years a backtest covers. Holding out a test period does not remove that hindsight, because it sits in the features. We adapt NoLBERT, an encoder pretrained only on text published between 1976 and 1995, to earnings calls without letting it read anything dated after 31 December 2023. The calls supply the training signal themselves: every analyst question is followed by management's answer, and the model learns to pick that answer out from the other answers of the same call. We test on every US call from January 2025 to October 2026 (20,323 calls, 254,575 questions) and make every modeling choice on calls from 2024. The adapted model, NoLBERT-Calls-2023, ranks the true answer first for 78.0% of questions (95% interval 77.8-78.2; chance 8.0%), against 26.3% before adaptation. It is 1.0 point ahead of a call-adapted ChronoBERT, 3.4 points ahead of a call-adapted FinBERT, and 18.7 and 19.8 points ahead of the best off-the-shelf retriever and BM25. A year-by-year test over 2013-2026 finds no look-ahead premium: relative to a model adapted only through 2012, the released model does no better on the years it was trained on than on years it never saw. The price of the cutoff is compute: under one shared 150-minute recipe NoLBERT adapts least well of four encoders, and its lead comes from a longer, staged adaptation of about 13 GPU-hours.

AI.tldr: NoLBERT-Calls通过严格限制训练文本日期，在避免前视信息的同时提升财报电话会问答检索。
AI.motivation: 常用编码器的预训练语料可能覆盖回测年份，仅留出测试期无法消除特征中的前视信息。
AI.method: 将仅用1976至1995年文本预训练的编码器适配于截至2023年的电话会，学习同场问答匹配。
AI.result: 在20,323场测试电话会上，正确答案首位率由适配前26.3%升至78.0%，逐年测试未见前视溢价。
AI.conclusion: 时间截断编码器经充分适配可获得强检索表现，但其优势依赖更长的分阶段训练。

title: Sharp Gaussian Approximation for Q-Learning
summary: Gaussian approximation provides a foundation for online statistical inference in reinforcement learning. We establish sharp non-asymptotic Gaussian approximation rates in Wasserstein distance for asynchronous Q-learning with Polyak-Ruppert averaging. We prove an upper bound of $\widetilde{O}(n^{-1/4})$, where $n$ is the number of iterations, together with a matching lower bound up to logarithmic factors. Q-learning is more challenging to analyze than linear stochastic approximation due to the nonlinearity of the Bellman operator. Asynchronous updates introduce further challenges due to Markovian noise. Our analysis separates the errors from Bellman nonlinearity, Markovian noise, and the finite-sample covariance discrepancy. In particular, we show that Markovian noise induces an unavoidable bias even when the Bellman operator is linear. The trade-off between this bias and the covariance discrepancy determines the convergence rate. We further extend our analysis to the synchronous setting and establish a sharp rate of $\widetilde{O}(n^{-1/2})$.

AI.tldr: 研究给出平均化Q学习的尖锐高斯近似速率，揭示异步更新下马尔可夫噪声偏差的关键作用。
AI.motivation: 强化学习在线统计推断需要有限样本高斯近似，而贝尔曼非线性和马尔可夫噪声增加分析难度。
AI.method: 在Wasserstein距离下分解非线性、马尔可夫噪声及有限样本协方差误差，并证明上下界。
AI.result: 异步平均化Q学习达到忽略对数因子的n^(-1/4)匹配上下界，同步情形达到n^(-1/2)速率。
AI.conclusion: 即使贝尔曼算子线性，马尔可夫噪声仍产生不可避免的偏差，其与协方差误差的权衡决定速率。

title: Sparse Stabilization of Continuous-Time Linear Dynamical Systems
summary: Efficient use of communication resources is crucial for stabilizing a networked control system. Employing \emph{sparse inputs} and event-triggered control are efficient ways to utilize communication resources in networked control systems. This work considers the problem of stabilizing a continuous-time linear dynamical system (LDS) using $s$-sparse inputs. For this purpose, we consider \emph{switched} linear feedback control, where we construct a finite number of feedback matrices with at most $s$ nonzero rows. Using switched systems theory, we show that there exists an $s$-sparse input for any sparsity level $s \geq 1$ that ensures stability when the continuous-time LDS is stabilizable. In addition, using our approach, we can compute the required feedback matrices with minimal overhead even if the sparsity budget $s$ varies over time. We also minimize the maximum Frobenius norm of the feedback matrices, yielding sparse inputs with reduced control energy. We show that an upper bound on the control energy required for stabilization using an $s$-sparse input is inversely proportional to $s^2$, while maintaining the same exponential stability rate. Finally, we combine the design of the \emph{sparse inputs} with the event-trigger rule to further reduce communication resource consumption. Our sparse and event-triggered control strategy ensures that any stabilizable continuous-time LDS can be stabilized using $s$-sparse inputs under both state feedback and output feedback, for any $s\geq 1$. We illustrate our theoretical results for the task of stabilizing a mass-spring system.

AI.tldr: 切换稀疏反馈结合事件触发控制，可在任意正稀疏预算下稳定可稳定化的连续时间线性系统。
AI.motivation: 网络控制系统需要减少通信资源消耗，同时保证稳定性并降低控制能量。
AI.method: 构造至多含s个非零行的有限反馈矩阵，优化最大Frobenius范数并结合事件触发机制。
AI.result: 证明任意s≥1均可实现稳定，同一指数稳定速率下控制能量上界与s平方成反比。
AI.conclusion: 该策略在状态反馈和输出反馈下均保证稀疏稳定控制，并支持时变稀疏预算与低通信开销。

title: PanDWM: Panoramic 4D Driving World Models
summary: Driving world models usually generate videos from six pinhole cameras with separate optical centres and small overlaps, and must learn to keep these views consistent. We present PanDWM, which stitches them into one $360^\circ$ panoramic band. Camera boundaries then fall inside one image, so keeping the views consistent means keeping the image continuous, and each pixel still records its camera ray. Conditioned on layouts, a causal student generates the band window by window in four steps; it is distilled from a causal teacher and trained on its own rollouts. A feed-forward decoder lifts each frame along these rays into 3D Gaussians, and static Gaussians from neighbouring frames complete them into 4D scenes. On nuScenes, scored in one stitched $360^\circ$ view, PanDWM has lower FID and FVD than the multi-camera baselines at $8$-$46\times$ their speed, and keeps its 50-step teacher's FID while lowering FVD by 22-25%.

title: Bridging the Terminology Gap: A Data-Centric Alignment Framework for Multilingual Translation in Cross-Border Corporation
summary: As globalization accelerates the demand for seamless cross-border enterprise collaboration, multilingual translation remains bottlenecked by insufficient domain-specific terminology, rigid terminology translation, weak instruction-following capabilities, and high inference latency in long-instruction scenarios. To overcome these barriers, we propose Bridging the Terminology Gap (BTG), a data-centric framework. First, BTG mines cross-lingual term alignments from domain documents and leverages LLMs to synthesize terminology-rich parallel corpora. Second, a hybrid filtering strategy combining heuristics and XCOMET scoring ensures high data fidelity. Third, a two-stage training paradigm employs supervised fine-tuning (SFT) for targeted terminology injection, followed by reinforcement learning (RL) to refine output preferences, effectively balancing domain knowledge integration with model reliability. Extensive offline evaluations (e.g., XCOMET, GEMBA, Acc@T) and online human assessments demonstrate significant improvements in terminology accuracy and instruction-following capabilities, validating the effectiveness of our framework, which is now deployed on our cross-border collaboration platform.

AI.tldr: BTG通过术语数据构建与两阶段训练，提升跨境企业多语翻译的术语准确性和指令遵循能力。
AI.motivation: 跨境企业翻译面临领域术语不足、术语处理僵化、指令遵循弱及长指令推理延迟高等问题。
AI.method: 挖掘跨语言术语并合成平行语料，经启发式与XCOMET过滤后进行监督微调和强化学习。
AI.result: 离线评测与在线人工评估显示术语准确性和指令遵循能力显著提升，框架已部署于跨境协作平台。
AI.conclusion: 以数据为中心的术语对齐与分阶段训练可改善领域翻译，并兼顾知识融入和模型可靠性。

title: When Facts Change, Which Decisions Break? Dependency-Aware Context Graphs for Agents
summary: When an observed fact changes, an agent must identify and repair the decisions that depend on it while preserving unaffected outputs. We investigate the reliability-cost trade-off of field-level dependency graphs extracted from actual agent read traces. A controlled benchmark spans three executable workflow domains and four successive updates, with independent imperative and expression-based references. Across 120 workflows, two models and two repeated runs, we compare full recomputation, rolling summary memory, lexical retrieval, trace-extracted dependencies and verified dependency upper bounds. Trace-derived graphs reduce reviewed decisions and estimated total cost, but omitted alternative supports and missing repair context can reduce complete-plan correctness. Paired ablations isolate the effects of edge deletion, spurious edges, transitive propagation and context scope. An exploratory enhancement supplies the existing record ID/field directory during extraction without revealing unread values or reference edges. We evaluate this enhancement on 60 fresh workflows with two repeats per model. On this fresh set, the directory-aware graph matches observed full-context complete-plan correctness for gpt-6.1-sol (100%) with an estimated 4.0% total-cost reduction, but reaches only 84.8% versus 99.6% for gpt-6-luna. The results distinguish potential dependency impact from actual decision invalidity and show why selective repair must be evaluated with both executable correctness and full memory-processing cost. The evidence concerns explicit procedural workflows; broad real-world agent-memory generalization remains untested.

AI.tldr: 基于智能体读取轨迹的依赖图可降低选择性修复成本，但依赖遗漏可能损害完整计划的正确性。
AI.motivation: 事实变化后，智能体需修复受影响决策并保留无关输出，同时平衡可靠性与处理成本。
AI.method: 在三个可执行工作流领域比较多种重算与记忆策略，并消融依赖边、传播和上下文范围。
AI.result: 新测试集上，目录增强图使一模型正确率达100%且估计节省4.0%成本，另一模型仅达84.8%。
AI.conclusion: 选择性修复应同时评估可执行正确性和完整记忆处理成本，其真实场景泛化仍未经验证。

title: Local Order Matters: A Lightweight CPU-Trainable CNN for Website Fingerprinting on Defended Tor Traffic
summary: Website fingerprinting (WF) attacks let a passive adversary infer which site a Tor user visits from the encrypted cell sequence. On undefended traffic, hand-crafted-feature attacks are already near-ceiling, so deep learning offers only a marginal advantage there. We show that the decisive regime is defended traffic: against the FRONT padding defense, which injects dummy cells that corrupt the volume and count features feature attacks rely on, a compact 95,103-parameter 1-D convolutional network trained on the raw cell-direction sequence, on CPU only, stays robust while three implemented direction-only feature baselines degrade. On the closed-world WFlib FRONT set (95 sites), our model reaches 54.2% top-1 accuracy versus 38.5% for the strongest implemented feature baseline (k-FP-style RF), a gain of 15.7 percentage points (3 seeds; seed-0 paired-bootstrap 95% CI [+14.5, +17.0] pp on per-trace correctness, excluding zero). On undefended traffic the CNN reaches 94.1% versus 92.3% for k-FP-style RF. A controlled order-ablation permutes only nonzero traffic cells within each trace, preserving direction counts, retained length, and trailing zero-padding positions while destroying traffic order. This collapses the CNN below every feature baseline (from 54.2% to 7.6%, a 46.6 pp drop), showing that the model depends strongly on order-derived information under FRONT.

title: Max-Min Throughput in RSMA-Aided SWIPT for Sustainable Internet of Underground Things: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-enabled wireless-powered underground sensor networks (WPUSNs) allow underground devices (UDs) to harvest radio-frequency energy from a UAV via wireless energy transfer (WET) techniques, enabling sustainable Internet of underground things (IoUT) applications. This paper integrates rate-splitting multiple access (RSMA)-aided simultaneous wireless information and power transfer (SWIPT) into UAV-enabled WPUSNs to deliver information and energy to UDs. Within this framework, we investigate a max-min fairness problem that jointly optimizes the UAV transmit power, power allocation and message splitting, power-splitting ratios, and time allocation, aiming to maximize the minimum uplink throughput across UDs subject to per-UD downlink throughput requirements and a UAV energy-consumption constraint. To address this non-convex problem under dynamic underground environments, we develop an off-policy deep reinforcement learning approach based on the primal-dual truncated quantile critics (PD-TQC), where a TQC-based reward critic evaluates the fairness objective, cost critics estimate constraint costs, and an actor learns the resource-control policy with adaptive dual-variable updates. Simulations using in-situ soil volumetric water content measurements from a center-pivot irrigation farm demonstrate that PD-TQC achieves the highest annual average minimum uplink throughput compared with four benchmarks while satisfying the per-frame constraints in over 96% of the evaluated frames, and that this throughput advantage is preserved under different Rician factors, numbers of UDs, and downlink throughput thresholds.

AI.tldr: PD-TQC强化学习联合控制无人机辅助地下传感网络资源，提高最弱设备的上行吞吐量并满足约束。
AI.motivation: 动态地下环境中，需在下行吞吐量和无人机能耗约束下兼顾设备供能与上行吞吐量公平性。
AI.method: 融合RSMA与SWIPT，采用原始对偶截断分位数评论家联合优化功率、消息划分、功率分流和时间分配。
AI.result: 基于实测土壤含水量的仿真中，年均最小上行吞吐量优于四种基线，超过96%的帧满足逐帧约束。
AI.conclusion: 该策略在不同莱斯因子、设备数量和下行吞吐量门槛下均保持吞吐量优势。

title: HalluProbe: Exploiting VLM Hallucinations for Backdoor Detection
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are vulnerable to backdoor attacks introduced through data poisoning, making effective backdoor detection a critical security challenge. In this paper, we uncover a novel connection between VLM hallucinations and backdoor behaviors and exploit this connection for backdoor detection. Our key insight is that poisoned training data induces strong language priors toward the backdoor target token, while such priors are also a major source of hallucinations. This suggests that enhancing hallucinations can expose hidden backdoor-related priors. Specifically, backdoored VLMs tend to hallucinate backdoor target tokens more frequently across diverse inputs, while the hallucinated tokens of clean VLMs are largely random and exhibit no stable target-specific bias. Based on this observation, we propose HalluProbe, which enhances hallucinations during output decoding and measures the distributional consistency of hallucinated tokens to identify backdoored VLMs. We evaluate HalluProbe against six representative VLM backdoor attacks across three models. Experimental results demonstrate that HalluProbe can effectively detect backdoored VLMs with an accuracy exceeding 90%, outperforming existing backdoor detection methods.

AI.tldr: HalluProbe通过增强视觉语言模型幻觉并检测词元分布的一致性，识别隐藏后门。
AI.motivation: 数据投毒可为视觉语言模型植入后门，而有效识别此类后门仍是重要安全挑战。
AI.method: 利用投毒产生的目标词元语言先验，在解码时增强幻觉并衡量幻觉词元的分布一致性。
AI.result: 在三个模型和六类代表性后门攻击上，检测准确率超过90%，优于现有后门检测方法。
AI.conclusion: 后门目标特异性的幻觉偏置可作为视觉语言模型后门检测的有效信号。

title: Interactive Structured Environment Scaling for Large Language Model Agentic Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning via environmental interaction is a cornerstone post-training paradigm for evolving large language models into autonomous agents capable of multi-turn tool use and exploration. Because the environment defines what the policy observes and how actions are verified, its structure directly bounds the capabilities an agent can acquire. Yet existing structured and retrieval environments rely on upstream pre-filtering---extracting a compact subgraph around the gold answer or retrieving fixed passages before the policy acts. We show that such pre-filtering introduces a fundamental measurement confound: because per-question subgraphs enclose ground-truth paths, they compress the candidate space by orders of magnitude and leak answer locations via local topology, allowing a question-blind degree heuristic to surface gold answers far above chance. To restore path selection, candidate pruning, and optimal stopping as genuine policy decisions, we propose RISE (Interactive Structured Environment), which transitions structured reinforcement learning from static subgraphs to full-scale interactive databases along two coupled axes. First, Decision-Space Scaling exposes the unpruned knowledge graph via a five-stage graph-agnostic typed intent adapter under a bounded call budget and a multiplicative grounding reward gate. Second, Learning-Frontier Scaling overcomes within-group variance collapse under group-normalized objectives by uniting model-independent structural tier progression with a self-evolving competence-frontier bandit. Across nineteen benchmarks and three model backbones, RISE substantially advances in-domain and unseen-schema knowledge-graph reasoning, transfers zero-shot to open-domain passage retrieval, and significantly enhances out-of-domain mathematical and logical deduction.

AI.tldr: RISE以完整交互式知识图谱和自适应学习前沿训练智能体，缓解预筛选环境的答案位置泄漏。
AI.motivation: 围绕正确答案预筛选子图会压缩候选空间并泄漏拓扑线索，混淆对智能体推理能力的测量。
AI.method: 通过类型化意图适配器开放未裁剪图谱，并结合调用预算、依据奖励门控、结构分层和能力前沿老虎机。
AI.result: 在十九个基准和三种模型骨干上提升域内及未见模式图谱推理，并迁移至检索、数学和逻辑任务。
AI.conclusion: 扩大决策空间并动态推进学习前沿，有助于将路径选择、候选剪枝和停止判断交还给策略。

title: Who Writes the Codebook? An Eight-Step Framework for Auditing LLM-Generated Category Systems
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly create the categories through which qualitative evidence is interpreted. Existing coding benchmarks often hold these categories fixed. We propose the Qualitative Variance Audit Framework, an eight-step method that compares codebook creation, repeated application and code distributions under controlled inputs. It combines model-owned and shared-reference codebooks to distinguish variation in the overall pipeline from application differences within a common category system. An application to 668 organisational interviews, 13,166 text units and eight models from five vendors yields 48 codebooks and 270 coding runs. Models create markedly different category structures; mean within-model reliability ranges from .76 to .92, whereas between-model agreement on the shared codebook is about .69. The framework complements LLM-assisted grounded theory by exposing model dependencies before substantive interpretation. It assesses reliability and representational consequences, not interpretive validity or the quality of resulting theory.

AI.tldr: 八步定性差异审计框架揭示大模型生成编码体系及应用过程中的模型依赖与一致性差异。
AI.motivation: 大模型日益参与定性分析类别的创建，但固定类别的现有基准难以揭示类别构建带来的差异。
AI.method: 结合模型自建与共享参考编码本，在受控输入下比较编码本创建、重复编码及编码分布。
AI.result: 八模型在668份访谈上生成48份编码本；模型内平均可靠性为0.76至0.92，共享编码本间一致性约0.69。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可在实质解释前揭示可靠性及表征差异，但不评估解释有效性或理论质量。

title: Let Execution Do the Teaching
summary: Improving a coding model is a sequence of decisions: find the limiting behavior, create useful practice, and determine which attempts deserve reinforcement. We investigate a practical way to make those decisions increasingly repeatable by grounding feedback in execution. Starting from GLM-4.7-Flash, the work combines whole-file supervised fine-tuning, targeted C++ repair curricula, group-relative reinforcement learning, and verifiers that turn program behavior into structured rewards. Compiler errors and failing tests provide specific contexts for repair practice, while executable checks score the resulting programs. We evaluate the trained models on 26 C++ coding tasks, measuring both initial success and completion after test feedback. The strongest reported post-training configuration achieves 45.2% success in the first test round and 61.5% within two rounds. These results come from an assisted development suite with evolving prompt contracts; the strongest configuration uses four selected evaluation trials and includes six tasks also used in training. The study describes an execution-guided workflow for improving coding models, including how repair tasks are constructed, how program behavior determines rewards, and how the resulting models are evaluated.

AI.tldr: 研究以执行反馈指导代码模型训练与修复，但所报性能来自含训练重叠任务的辅助开发评测。
AI.motivation: 改进代码模型需要可重复地识别能力短板、构建练习并判断哪些生成尝试值得强化。
AI.method: 基于GLM-4.7-Flash结合整文件监督微调、定向C++修复课程、组相对强化学习及执行验证奖励。
AI.result: 26道C++任务上最强配置首轮成功率45.2%、两轮内61.5%，但含六道训练任务并选用四次评测。
AI.conclusion: 执行反馈可组织代码模型的训练与评估流程，但提示契约变化、试验选择及任务重叠限制结果解释。

title: Large Language Model-based Optimization for Wireless Communication: A Survey
summary: The growing complexity and dynamism of modern wireless communication frameworks have made real-time optimization essential for efficient resource allocation. Traditional optimization and machine-learning techniques often struggle with generalization, adaptability, stability, and scalability in heterogeneous, time-varying environments. Large language models (LLMs) have recently emerged as powerful tools capable of reasoning over structured prompts and generating context-aware decisions in real time without domain-specific retraining. This survey provides a comprehensive review of LLM-driven optimization techniques applied to wireless communication problems such as power control, bandwidth allocation, task offloading, and intelligent surface configuration. We introduce a functional taxonomy of LLM-enabled wireless resource management strategies and analyze the prompt engineering methodologies employed in recent literature. Furthermore, we develop a generalized analytical framework that categorizes LLM-based optimization architectures, including direct solution generation, closed-loop optimization with external verifiers, and representation encoding within trainable neural pipelines. To demonstrate practical applicability, we present representative case studies on LLM-assisted beam prediction for millimeter-wave systems and adaptive wireless resource allocation. Finally, we discuss emerging hybrid AI approaches for wireless networks.

AI.tldr: 本文综述大语言模型驱动的无线通信优化，梳理资源管理策略、提示工程与优化架构。
AI.motivation: 传统优化与机器学习方法难以适应异构时变无线环境中的实时资源分配需求。
AI.method: 建立功能分类与通用分析框架，并以毫米波波束预测和自适应资源分配案例说明应用。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体结果。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为理解大语言模型无线优化架构提供系统框架，并讨论混合人工智能的发展方向。

title: Recovery Gone Too Far: Understanding and Repairing Risky Fallback in LLM Agents
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents interact with their environments through tools, reading repositories, running builds, and pushing code. When a tool fails with an ordinary error, such as a rate limit or a timeout, the agent can fall back to a substitute tool and still complete the task. However, the same fallback that completes a task in one environment can cross an action boundary in another. For example, after a push is rejected, a forced push in one repository replaces only the agent's own commits, while in a different repository it also removes another author's commits. We call such a fallback a risky fallback. To understand this phenomenon, we conduct an empirical study on 304 scenarios that span eight domains and cover 55 real CVEs. All four mainstream models we evaluate exhibit risky fallback, with action-boundary violations in up to 96.8% of risky scenarios. We further evaluate three mainstream mitigations and find that none of them is effective against risky fallback. We then present nrepair. At each call to the substitute tool, nrepair scores the agent's context with a monitor whose threshold is calibrated on normal runs alone; when the monitor triggers, it withholds the call once and returns the decision to the agent. nrepair reduces action-boundary violations on all four models, by up to 76.0% (from 67.5% to 16.2%), at a negligible runtime cost. On most models, the normal success rate drops by less than 7%. We also evaluate nrepair on two production agents, Claude Code and Codex, and find that it is equally effective on both.

AI.tldr: 研究揭示智能体在工具失败后可能通过替代操作越界，并提出nrepair降低此类风险。
AI.motivation: 相同的工具回退操作在不同环境中可能产生不同后果，任务完成并不意味着行动安全。
AI.method: 在涵盖八个领域和55个真实漏洞的304个场景中评测，并用正常运行校准监控器以暂缓可疑调用。
AI.result: 四种模型的越界率最高达96.8%，nrepair将其中一项从67.5%降至16.2%，运行开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 三种主流缓解措施均无效，而nrepair在四种模型及两个生产级智能体中均能减少风险回退。

title: First-order smoothed exact-penalty methods for equality-constrained regularized nonconvex optimization
summary: We consider regularized nonconvex optimization over a closed convex set $\mathcal{X} \subseteq \mathbb{R}^d$, which involves a convex nonsmooth regularizer $r$ in the objective and $n$ smooth equality constraints. To find a near-KKT point of the problem, we propose a prox-linear first-order method, named as SEPi-Prox, based on a smoothed exact-penalty formulation. At each outer iteration of SEPi-Prox, a strongly convex prox-linear subproblem is formed and solved inexactly to a sufficient accuracy. Under a local non-singularity condition that is weaker than some other commonly used regularity conditions or constraint qualifications, SEPi-Prox finds an $\epsilon$-KKT point within $O(\epsilon^{-2})$ first-order oracle calls, matching the lower bound for unconstrained smooth nonconvex optimization. We employ Nesterov's accelerated proximal-gradient method (APG) and a dual cutting-plane method (DCP) for the prox-linear subproblems. Let $\mathcal{C}_{\mathrm{FO}}$ and $\mathcal{C}_r$ denote the numbers of arithmetic operations of evaluating one first-order oracle and one proximal mapping of $r$ over $\mathcal{X}$, respectively. Then SEPi-Prox requires $\widetilde{O}(\mathcal{C}_{\mathrm{FO}}\epsilon^{-2} + (dn + \mathcal{C}_r)\epsilon^{-5/2})$ and $\widetilde{O}((\mathcal{C}_{\mathrm{FO}} + dn^2 + n\mathcal{C}_r + n^{3.373})\epsilon^{-2})$ total arithmetic operations to produce an $\epsilon$-KKT point, respectively by using APG and DCP as the subsolver. The latter result is preferable when $n$ is small and nearly matches the optimal dependence on $\epsilon$. Numerical experiments on instances of the multi-class Neyman-Pearson classification demonstrate the efficiency of SEPi-Prox with both subsolvers.

AI.tldr: 提出平滑精确罚一阶方法SEPi-Prox，高效求解带等式约束和非光滑正则项的非凸优化。
AI.motivation: 需要在较弱正则性条件下，以较低计算复杂度寻找约束非凸问题的近似KKT点。
AI.method: 通过平滑精确罚构造强凸近端线性子问题，并用加速近端梯度法或对偶切平面法近似求解。
AI.result: 局部非奇异条件下，一阶预言机复杂度为O(ε⁻²)，分类实验验证了两种子求解器的效率。
AI.conclusion: 该方法的一阶预言机复杂度匹配无约束光滑非凸优化下界，约束较少时对偶切平面方案更有利。

title: Illusion of Explainability: A Sanity Check for Spectral Band Attribution in Satellite Time-Series Crop Classification
summary: Attribution methods are commonly validated through convergence across methods and consistency with domain knowledge, yet neither criterion establishes whether identified features are necessary for a task. This limitation is particularly relevant in multispectral remote sensing, where overlapping spectral information makes individual bands potentially substitutable. We investigate this gap in crop-type classification using GradientSHAP, Shapley sampling, and Occlusion on a U-TAE segmentation model trained on Sentinel-2 time series from the PASTIS benchmark. All three methods identify vegetation-sensitive spectral regions consistent with domain knowledge, while Shapley and Occlusion exhibit strong ordering sensitivity in deletion and insertion tests. However, these properties do not reliably predict retraining performance. Aggregate attribution consensus masks substantial per-class disagreement, with pairwise mean Spearman correlations ranging from 0.09 to 0.79. Models retrained from scratch using the five lowest-ranked bands perform comparably to or better than those using the five highest-ranked bands. Furthermore, attribution rankings from an independently trained model with identical configuration and seed identify a different top-five subset that yields better retraining performance. Analysis of all 252 five-band subsets reveals consistently low effective dimensionality (1.35 to 2.62), suggesting substantial spectral redundancy. These findings demonstrate that plausible and apparently faithful attribution rankings do not necessarily identify task-relevant bands for improved retrained performance, highlighting the limitations of band-level feature attribution in spectrally redundant input spaces.
comment: Accepted at the 4th Computer Vision for Earth Observation (CV4EO) Workshop at WACV 2027

AI.tldr: 卫星时序作物分类实验表明，看似合理且忠实的波段归因并不保证筛选出重训练表现更好的波段。
AI.motivation: 归因方法间的一致性及其与领域知识的吻合，不能证明所识别特征对任务必要。
AI.method: 在PASTIS上的U-TAE模型中比较三种归因方法，并重训练评估全部252种五波段组合。
AI.result: 最低排名五波段的重训练表现不逊于最高排名组合，各组合有效维度仅为1.35至2.62。
AI.conclusion: 光谱冗余会削弱波段归因的特征选择价值，归因合理性不应直接等同于重训练效用。

title: EasyNav: A Modular Architecture for Real-Time Navigation Across Heterogeneous Robot Environments
summary: Most robot navigation stacks implicitly bind mapping, localization, planning, and control to specific representations and data flows, yielding architectures hard to extend, compare experimentally, or reason about end-to-end timing. This is critical in heterogeneous scenarios, where multiple spatial representations, sensing modalities, and coordinate frames coexist and evolve at different rates. This paper presents a navigation architecture centered on an explicit, shared navigation state that serves as the sole interaction interface between modular components. Constraining mapping, localization, planning, and control to operate over this shared state enables interchangeable, representation-agnostic pipelines under explicit compatibility and timing contracts. We realize this architecture as EasyNav, an open source ROS 2 framework, and validate it through real-robot experiments, including indoor navigation with laser sensing and large-scale indoor-outdoor navigation with GPS and 3D LiDAR across multi-level routes. Compared with Nav2 under matched conditions, EasyNav reduces reaction latency from 377 to 33 ms indoors and from 71 to 8 ms outdoors, while also using less CPU and memory.
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: EasyNav通过显式共享导航状态解耦导航模块，在异构机器人场景中实现低延迟导航。
AI.motivation: 现有导航栈将模块绑定于特定表示和数据流，难以扩展、比较实验及分析端到端时序。
AI.method: 将共享导航状态设为模块间唯一接口，明确兼容性与时序契约，并实现开源ROS 2框架。
AI.result: 相比Nav2，室内反应延迟从377降至33毫秒，室外从71降至8毫秒，CPU与内存占用也更低。
AI.conclusion: 实机实验表明，共享状态架构支持跨表示的模块化导航，并改善系统响应与资源效率。

title: LoopSkim: Lossless Multi-Depth Speculative Decoding for Looped Language Models
summary: Looped language models such as Ouro and Raven apply one weight-shared block several times per token, so autoregressive decoding (AR) runs every loop of every token in sequence. Pipelined self-speculative decoders overlap these loops by drafting tokens from shallow readouts and verifying them at full depth. Yet every loop of a looped LM ends in a readout of the next token, and draft tokens pass through every depth anyway, so each depth can check them without an extra pass. We introduce LoopSkim, in which the depth of the pipeline is the verifier. Draft tokens copied from the context, as in prompt lookup decoding, enter after the first loops, any later readout that contradicts one replaces it at that depth, and only full-depth readouts commit tokens. LoopSkim fixes the random draws of every position in advance, so each check compares two tokens and decoding stays lossless in exact arithmetic under sampling for any number of checks and draft chains. Without training, its speedup over AR averages 1.73x that of LoopSpec across greedy decoding and sampling, and its checks between the first loops and full depth speed it up on every model. An optional draft head adds a second chain and raises this average to 1.99x.

AI.tldr: LoopSkim利用循环语言模型的多层深度读出验证草稿，实现无需训练的无损推测解码加速。
AI.motivation: 循环语言模型逐词逐层执行成本高，而现有流水线推测解码未充分利用中间深度的验证机会。
AI.method: 从上下文复制草稿，在后续深度替换不一致词元，仅由完整深度提交，并预先固定各位置随机抽样。
AI.result: 相对自回归解码的平均加速比为LoopSpec的1.73倍，加入可选草稿头后达到1.99倍。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在精确算术下保证采样无损，中间深度检查在所有受测模型上均带来加速。

title: HIVE-ECIA: Identity-Aware Historical Evidence Acquisition for Bandwidth-Efficient Multi-Object Tracking
summary: Panoramic multi-object tracking (MOT) requires reliable identity association across a 360° field of view, yet bandwidth-constrained operation forces a trade-off between low-resolution (LR) identity ambiguity and costly high-resolution (HR) transmission. We propose HIVE-ECIA, an identity-aware framework that selectively retrieves historical HR evidence to recover fragmented identities without modifying detection boxes or the underlying tracker. An ECIA Base-Guided query policy determines when additional HR evidence is warranted; HIVE ranks historical LR observations to select an informative retrieval timestamp; and ECIA Full integrates the retrieved HR crop through learned gated fusion and conservative identity safeguards. We further introduce DualPano-MOT, a real-world dual-fisheye panoramic evaluation dataset featuring controlled pedestrian interactions, panorama-seam challenges, and occlusions, with model-assisted, manually verified tracking annotations. On held-out QuadTrack sequences and zero-shot DualPano-MOT, HIVE-ECIA improves identity association across four MOT trackers without tracker-specific retraining. Across these trackers, identity switches decrease by up to 21.8% and 23.4%, while the largest IDF1 gains reach 3.81 and 6.74 percentage points, respectively. Under an offline JPEG-based acquisition model, our framework reduces encoded data volume by 89.2% and 79.3% relative to continuous Full-HR acquisition.

AI.tldr: HIVE-ECIA按需检索历史高分辨率证据，在低带宽全景多目标跟踪中改善身份关联。
AI.motivation: 全景跟踪需要可靠身份关联，但低分辨率易混淆身份，持续传输高分辨率图像成本高。
AI.method: 按身份需求触发查询、选择历史时刻并门控融合高分辨率裁剪，同时构建DualPano-MOT数据集。
AI.result: 两数据集身份切换最多减少21.8%和23.4%，离线JPEG模型下数据量减少89.2%和79.3%。
AI.conclusion: 无需修改检测框或针对跟踪器重训练，该框架即可跨四种跟踪器改善身份关联并降低传输量。

title: Remember, Replay, Adapt: Learning from Past Experience in Online Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Existing feedback-based methods for online vision-and-language navigation (VLN) primarily learn from current episode outcomes, leaving previously acquired feedback underutilized. Inspired by human episodic memory, we propose R2A, an online VLN adaptation framework that continually reuses successful and failed navigation experiences for policy learning. Specifically, Success-Failure Memory (SFM) retains successful and failed navigation episodes with acquired feedback and retrieves task-relevant experiences based on incoming instructions, enabling historical feedback to guide subsequent navigation. Prior-Anchored Adaptation (PAA) learns from these experiences by reinforcing successful trajectories and suppressing failed ones relative to a frozen pretrained policy, while regularizing behavioral drift. Together, these modules enable continual feedback reuse and stable policy adaptation without source-domain data or expert supervision. Extensive experiments across three benchmarks, REVERIE, R2R, and R2R-CE, and five navigation backbones demonstrate consistent performance gains. On the REVERIE validation unseen split, R2A improves DUET's SR from 46.98% to 69.84% and SPL from 33.73% to 50.98%.

AI.tldr: R2A持续检索并复用成功与失败导航经验，实现稳定的在线视觉语言导航适应。
AI.motivation: 现有反馈式在线导航主要利用当前回合结果，未充分复用历史反馈。
AI.method: 以成功失败记忆检索相关经历，并相对冻结预训练策略强化成功轨迹、抑制失败轨迹和约束漂移。
AI.result: REVERIE未见验证集上，DUET成功率由46.98%升至69.84%，SPL由33.73%升至50.98%。
AI.conclusion: 在无需源域数据或专家监督的条件下，R2A在三个基准和五种导航骨干上均带来性能提升。

title: Dynamic Spatio-Temporal Graph Attention Networks with Nested Clustered Optimization for Multi-Asset Portfolios
summary: Nested Clustered Optimization (NCO) insulates asset allocation from Markowitz covariance ill-conditioning. However, classical tree clustering relies on static pairwise Pearson correlation, failing to capture time-varying, asymmetric downside risk contagion across multi-asset markets. We propose a unified deep graph machine learning architecture: Dynamic Spatio-Temporal Graph Attention Networks with Nested Clustered Optimization (ST-GAT-NCO) for multi-asset tactical allocation. The framework extracts temporal momentum and downside risk dynamics via causal dilated 1D-convolutions, then deploys a multi-head Graph Attention Network (GAT) over dynamic market topologies to learn latent spatial node representations. These learned embeddings define an angular metric distance space that guides two-stage downside NCO optimization under institutional constraints and turnover smoothing.
