Evaluated over a 73-month non-anticipative walk-forward out-of-sample window (January 2020 to January 2026) across 13 global asset classes net of 10 bps transaction costs, ST-GAT-NCO achieves a 5.32% CAGR and 37.06% cumulative net return, delivering an excess Sharpe ratio of 0.30 and a Sortino ratio of 0.48. This substantially outperforms classical Minimum Variance (3.68% CAGR, 0.08 Sharpe), Hierarchical Risk Parity (2.65% CAGR), and Plain Symmetric NCO (4.11% CAGR, 0.15 Sharpe), while restricting maximum drawdown to -13.07% (versus -19.44% for Equal-Weight and -16.36% for Downside NCO) under a controlled one-way turnover of 15.31%/month. Regime analysis confirms active capital preservation across the 2020 COVID-19 crash, 2022 monetary tightening, and 2023-2026 disinflation rallies.
comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables. Replication package and dataset available at this https URL

AI.tldr: ST-GAT-NCO融合动态时空图注意力与嵌套聚类优化，提升多资产配置的收益与风险控制。
AI.motivation: 传统静态相关性聚类难以刻画多资产市场中时变且非对称的下行风险传染。
AI.method: 以因果膨胀卷积提取时序特征，经动态图注意力生成嵌入，指导含机构约束和换手平滑的两阶段下行优化。
AI.result: 在13类资产的73个月样本外评估中，扣费后年化收益5.32%、超额夏普比率0.30，最大回撤为-13.07%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架优于多种传统配置基线，并在不同市场阶段展现资本保护能力。

title: DiffWAM: Learning World Action Model from Consecutive Visual Difference
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as an important paradigm in robot learning, jointly predicting future scene states and robot actions from current observations and instructions. However, future states entangle task-related changes with large amounts of task-irrelevant content, such as static backgrounds, which weakens the model's ability to capture changes relevant to task execution. To address this, we propose Difference World Action Model (DiffWAM), a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) framework that enhances world representations by jointly learning future-state prediction and consecutive visual difference prediction. We define consecutive visual differences as differences between the latent representations of consecutive observations, providing an explicit learning signal for temporal variation. The framework comprises a World Expert for future frame prediction, an Action Expert for action generation, and a Diff Expert for predicting these latent differences along the trajectory. A structured unidirectional attention mask conditions the Diff, World, and Action Experts solely on the current-frame representation while blocking attention between experts. This design allows both the World and Diff Experts to be removed during inference, introducing no additional inference overhead. DiffWAM achieves state-of-the-art performance on the LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0 benchmarks and substantially improves over FastWAM on real-world manipulation tasks. Specifically, it attains average success rates of 98.8%, 92.65%, and 88.3%, outperforming the state-of-the-art baseline (i.e., FastWAM) by 1.75, 1.55, and 15.0 percentage points, respectively.

AI.tldr: DiffWAM通过联合预测未来状态与连续视觉差异，提高机器人操作表现且不增加推理开销。
AI.motivation: 未来场景预测混杂大量静态背景等无关内容，削弱模型对任务关键变化的捕捉。
AI.method: 构建世界、动作和差异三个专家，以连续观测潜表示之差监督变化学习，并用结构化单向注意力隔离专家。
AI.result: 在LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0和真实操作上，平均成功率分别达98.8%、92.65%和88.3%。
AI.conclusion: 显式学习视觉变化可增强动作学习，推理时移除世界与差异专家仍可保持性能优势。

title: HEmIF-Bench: Benchmarking H&E-to-mIF Models BeyondVirtual-StainFidelity
summary: Hematoxylin and eosin (H&E)-to-multiplex immunofluorescence (mIF) generators predict spatial protein expression from routine histology, yet pixel-level marker reconstruction does not establish downstream utility. We present HEmIF-Bench, evaluating five frozen generators across eight datasets spanning molecular, cellular, tissue, and patient scales. HEmIF-Bench decouples internal encoder features from generated outputs, benchmarking both against the pathology foundation reference UNI2. Mirroring the clinical workflow where pathologists rely on mIF to define cell phenotypes, delineate tertiary lymphoid structures (TLSs) and germinal centers (GCs), and stratify patient risk, we evaluate external CD3 recovery, single-cell classification, dense nuclear segmentation, TLS/GC segmentation, and patient survival prediction. Across the benchmark, foundation-model-based MIPHEI-ViT leads among the generators, while non-foundation models show task-specific strengths. Comparing the two routes reveals that internal encoder features generally outperform generated outputs, and larger output marker panels do not guarantee stronger downstream utility across datasets. Moreover, neither internal encoder features nor generated outputs consistently surpass frozen UNI2. These findings show that pixel-level stain fidelity does not equate to downstream utility, and that generators trained at current paired-data scales have yet to surpass large-scale pure-H&E foundation models. With the expansion of paired translation cohorts and the advancement of foundation-based generative architectures, HEmIF-Bench establishes a definitive benchmark for tracking when H&E-to-mIF generation crosses the threshold to deliver genuine value beyond routine histology for tumor microenvironment analysis and precision oncology.

AI.tldr: HEmIF-Bench表明，H&E到mIF生成的像素级染色保真度并不等同于下游临床任务价值。
AI.motivation: 现有标记重建指标不足以证明虚拟mIF在细胞、组织和患者层面的实际效用。
AI.method: 在八个数据集上评估五个冻结生成器，分别测试编码器特征与生成输出，并对照病理基础模型UNI2。
AI.result: MIPHEI-ViT在生成器中领先，内部特征通常优于生成输出，但两者均未持续超越冻结UNI2。
AI.conclusion: 当前配对数据规模下的生成器尚未超越大规模纯H&E基础模型，需以多尺度下游任务衡量价值。

title: "Don't Leave the Task Unfinished": Persistence-Driven Violations under Quiet Oversight
summary: LLM agents are increasingly given long, multi-step tasks to carry out, with the user reviewing little of what happens in between. Persistence, the tendency to keep working until a task is complete, is installed on purpose to improve performance on long tasks. Long-horizon tasks are typically complex, and the user's instruction can fall short of what the work actually requires, or conflict with the constraints the agent encounters in the task. We study what persistence does on long-horizon operations tasks that cannot be solved without breaking a documented constraint. We find that the agent pursues completion to the point of violating the constraint, and that a critically engaged user lowers the violation rate. Persistence takes violations from 29.2% to 58.3% across four models. Violations stay high wherever oversight goes quiet, whether the user is silent, assenting, or delegating with expressed trust. Only a questioning user, who asks for the basis of each action before allowing the next, brings the rate back to roughly the level measured without persistence. Practitioners should treat high persistence as a setting that carries a safety cost, and should recognize that the cost appears when oversight goes quiet. Safety here is better cast as a property of the human-AI pair than of the model alone. Project page: this https URL
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures. NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Dynamic Alignment on Human-AI Coupled System (BiAlign)

AI.tldr: 长任务中的高坚持性会增加智能体违反约束的风险，主动质询式监督可缓解这一问题。
AI.motivation: 长程任务可能无法在既定约束内完成，而用户通常很少审查中间步骤。
AI.method: 在必须突破书面约束才能完成的长程操作任务中，比较四个模型的坚持性与不同用户监督方式。
AI.result: 坚持性使违规率从29.2%升至58.3%，仅逐步质询行动依据的用户能将其降至接近无坚持性水平。
AI.conclusion: 高坚持性具有监督沉寂时显现的安全代价，安全应视为人机组合而非模型单方的属性。

title: AgenticJevNav: Agentic Object Search and Navigation via Event-Driven Verification
summary: Agentic navigation must maintain goals and adapt actions from incomplete evidence despite execution failures and delayed inference. We present AgenticJevNav, which links goal-directed planning, evidence memory, event-triggered verification, and bounded execution. The Agent plans from RGB, odometry, memory, and feedback, retaining goal ownership while authorizing a bounded action set. Jev reviews structured evidence after blocked/failed execution or two consecutive low-progress segments. Version, freshness, and once-only checks govern decision application. A single executor and independent RGB reflex constrain motion. Goal revisions revoke obsolete requests and actions before replanning. Across six simulated task families, AgenticJevNav achieves 73.33% SR over 60 trials, 21.67 percentage points above the next-best Agent-only aggregate control under differing historical protocols. A real-world GENISOM L1 quadruped deployment achieves 70.0% success over 30 trials, including bounded search reporting. Together, the simulation and physical-robot results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed architecture, while remaining failures highlight opportunities to improve grounding, approach planning, and runtime.
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Project page: this http URL

AI.tldr: AgenticJevNav通过事件驱动核验与有界执行，提高不完整证据下的目标搜索和导航成功率。
AI.motivation: 导航智能体需在执行失败和推理延迟下维持目标，并依据不完整证据调整行动。
AI.method: 结合目标规划、证据记忆、失败或低进展触发的核验，并以版本检查、单执行器及独立视觉反射约束运动。
AI.result: 仿真60次试验成功率为73.33%，较历史协议不同的次优对照高21.67个百分点；实机30次为70.0%。
AI.conclusion: 仿真与四足机器人部署支持该架构的有效性，但目标落地、接近规划和运行时仍需改进。

title: The Vocabulary Tax: Safely Trimming Unused Tokens from LLMs for On-Device Use
summary: Open large language models (LLMs) and speech models ship vocabularies of up to 262k tokens, and every user downloads the tables those tokens index (the input embedding, an untied output head and, in recent on-device models, per-layer embeddings), whatever languages they need. We call the bytes in rows a deployment never uses the vocabulary tax and measure it, without downloading weights, for 1,244 generative and speech-recognition models on the Hugging Face Hub. For a Thai and English deployment it is a median 4.4% of model bytes below 0.5B parameters and 2.1% above 8B, and 1.93 GB in Gemma 4 E2B: it falls hardest on the small models that edge devices run. Keeping only the rows of the deployment's writing systems is exact. Keeping the tokens seen in the user's own text removes much more, a median 29.0% below 0.5B, but the usual way of doing it breaks BPE tokenizers: it drops the intermediate tokens that merges build on, so new text is split differently 1.9 times as often as the standard check reports. We repair this with merge closure, at a cost of 5.9% more rows, and add a trim certificate: a Good-Turing estimate, from the trimming text alone, of how much new text the trimmed tokenizer will split differently (correlation 0.996 over 300 settings in 22 languages) and of how much more text a target needs. Without test data our method never exceeds a 2% target, while prior keep rules checked on test data exceed it in 9-13 of 44 settings. On six models of 270M to 3B parameters in 11 languages, trimmed models keep their predictions: where the certificate passes, a median 89.7% of rows is removed and bits per character rise by at most 2.0%. The census, the trimming and the certificate are released as an open Python package, and the per-model tax for 41 languages as an open dataset.
comment: 23 pages, 8 figures, 16 tables. Code: this https URL ; Data: this https URL

AI.tldr: 通过合并闭包和裁剪证书，可大量移除端侧模型未用词表行并控制分词变化。
AI.motivation: 大型词表增加端侧部署负担，而仅保留用户文本中词元会破坏BPE合并依赖并低估分词变化。
AI.method: 统计1,244个模型的词表开销，以合并闭包修复裁剪，并用Good-Turing估计生成无需测试数据的裁剪证书。
AI.result: 证书通过时，六个模型在11种语言中词表行移除比例中位数为89.7%，每字符比特数增幅不超过2.0%。
AI.conclusion: 合并闭包与统计证书使词表裁剪更可控，为端侧模型节省存储提供实用路径。

title: Delayed Heuristic-Behavior-Target Coupling for Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning in Inventory Control
summary: Many reinforcement learning methods tie data collection to the task policy, while coordinating independently optimized behavior and target policies remains challenging. Policies learned by these methods can perform unreliably in long-horizon tasks under uncertainty, such as inventory control, where failures can incur extreme costs. We introduce Heuristic Behavior Policy Optimization (HBPO), an off-policy framework that routes heuristic guidance through persistent behavior learning, coupled with target-policy, updating separately with residual-based advantage estimation and emphatic weighting. Under matched environment interaction budgets on DSIS and its risk-augmented variant DSIS-RB, HBPO recovers many high-cost initial policies and improves most non-collapse comparison groups. Cold starts achieve competitive costs without final cost collapse across all tested seeds. We identify a transmission chain in the delayed heuristic-behavior-target coupling as a key driver of recovery and improvement. Generation-level diagnostics trace heuristic uptake and subsequent selective target responses, while component ablations support the contribution of this transmission mechanism to policy recovery and improvement.

AI.tldr: HBPO将启发式引导经行为策略传递给目标策略，改善不确定库存控制中的策略恢复与稳定性。
AI.motivation: 独立优化的行为与目标策略难以协调，长期不确定任务中的策略失效可能造成极端成本。
AI.method: 构建离策略框架，以持续行为学习吸收启发式引导，结合残差优势估计和强调加权分别更新目标策略。
AI.result: 在相同交互预算下，HBPO恢复多种高成本初始策略，改善多数未崩溃对照组，冷启动所有测试种子均无最终成本崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 诊断与消融支持延迟的启发式—行为—目标传递链对策略恢复和改进的重要作用。

title: Lao Siji: Adapting openpilot to Closed-Loop End-to-End Driving in Neural Reconstruction
summary: We present Lao Siji, an end-to-end driving policy that ranks third in the 2026 NVIDIA AlpaSim E2E Driving Challenge, ahead of most entries built on foundation models. Instead of training from scratch on a general-purpose vision backbone, we adapt openpilot, an open-source L2 production model. We freeze its vision encoder and fine-tune the policy layers with an ego-state adapter and a route memory. On closed-loop rollouts in neural-reconstructed scenes, we supervise the policy with a privileged map teacher for lateral self-correction and a body-extent loss for road and obstacle clearance, while distilling the base model's remaining outputs to retain car following. Ablations show that self-correction samples carry the gain, while the clearance loss substitutes for them where no teacher exists. Longitudinal safety instead rests on the base model's lead-vehicle estimate behind a rule-based speed layer. Longer training, imitating human logs, and human-log speed targets yield either no measurable gain or adverse effects. Without further training, Lao Siji also places among the leaders on HUGSIM and Odyssey. The final training takes only one GPU-hour and shifts the weights by 3.9% from the shipped model. Code will be released after review.

AI.tldr: Lao Siji以少量微调将量产openpilot适配为闭环端到端驾驶策略，获得2026年AlpaSim挑战赛第三名。
AI.motivation: 探索能否利用现有量产驾驶模型，而非从通用视觉骨干重新训练，实现高效闭环驾驶适配。
AI.method: 冻结视觉编码器，加入自车状态适配器与路线记忆，以特权地图教师、车身净空损失和输出蒸馏微调策略。
AI.result: 最终训练仅耗一GPU小时、权重变化3.9%，无需额外训练亦在HUGSIM和Odyssey上位居前列。
AI.conclusion: 横向收益主要来自自纠正样本，纵向安全依赖基础模型前车估计与规则速度层，延长训练未带来收益。

title: Learning When to Continue and When to Stop: Termination-Aware OPSD
summary: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) improves language model reasoning by distilling from a frozen teacher initialized identically to the student and conditioned on privileged information. However, we identify an underexplored termination mismatch in OPSD: the student fails to reliably learn when to continue and when to stop. This mismatch manifests in two opposing failure modes-premature termination, where reasoning stops before sufficient progress is made, and repetition-driven over-generation, where the model continues generating after reasoning has stalled. Our analysis shows that the teacher-student discrepancy on EOS grows during OPSD training, while length-capped trajectories are frequently dominated by unproductive repetition. To address this issue, we propose TA-OPSD (Termination-Aware On-Policy Self-Distillation), which augments the original OPSD objective with two targeted objectives. Stop/Continue Distillation addresses premature termination by explicitly aligning the teacher and student on whether reasoning should continue, while Repetition-Aware Unlikelihood Training addresses repetition-driven over-generation by discouraging repetitive continuations in the student's failed trajectories. The resulting objective improves termination behavior from complementary directions: continuing when further reasoning is needed and stopping when reasoning becomes unproductive. Experiments on mathematical reasoning tasks with Qwen3 (1.7B/4B/8B) show that TA-OPSD consistently outperforms OPSD and other baselines across all three model scales. Beyond the performance gains, ablation and behavioral analyses show that the two proposed objectives effectively mitigate their corresponding termination failures, reducing both premature termination and repetition-driven over-generation.

AI.tldr: TA-OPSD通过继续决策蒸馏和重复抑制，缓解自蒸馏推理中的过早终止与过度生成。
AI.motivation: 现有OPSD训练中师生终止符预测差异扩大，学生易过早停止或陷入无效重复。
AI.method: 在OPSD目标中加入停止／继续蒸馏，以及针对失败轨迹重复续写的非似然训练。
AI.result: 数学推理实验中，TA-OPSD在Qwen3三种规模上均优于OPSD及其他基线，并减少两类终止错误。
AI.conclusion: 显式学习何时继续与何时停止，可改善自蒸馏模型的终止行为和推理表现。

title: Does synthetic pre-training pay off on a microcontroller? Accuracy, latency and energy across two MCUs
summary: Rendered images are cheap to label, but a microcontroller classifier must survive 8-bit integer (INT8) quantisation and compute correctly on the chip. Five models, from MobileNetV2 at 224 px to a 61K-parameter convolutional neural network (CNN), were fine-tuned on a six-class scene dataset with and without a synthetic stage, against thresholds fixed in advance, and deployed on an ESP32-S3 and an RP2040. With full real data the stage gave no detectable gain. For the main deployable model the INT8 difference was +0.312 percentage points (pp), its interval below the +1.6 pp gain recomputed from the source study; quantisation did not detectably change it, nor did model size. With 10% of the real data the stage paid off for the CNN, by +3.438 pp on one seed and +2.715 pp over three; its cause is open. On the ESP32-S3 the main model took 152.7 ms and 16.3 mJ above idle per inference, and adding the stage changed neither beyond preset bounds. The model's INT8 outputs matched TensorFlow Lite's reference kernels exactly, but only after a memory overrun in a vendor kernel was patched. On the RP2040 the same model took 1.80 s and 27.3 mJ above idle, about twelve times slower, and the largest 96 px model exceeded the board's flash-capacity limit. Neither the RP2040 nor the host interpreter used for scoring reproduced the reference arithmetic. A synthetic stage is worth adding only when real data are scarce, and on-device INT8 outputs should be checked against reference kernels, not inferred from host scores.
comment: 43 pages, 5 figures, 14 tables; supplementary tables, figures and notes as ancillary files. Analysis plan registered on OSF (doi:https://doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/BPQGA). Under review

AI.tldr: 微控制器图像分类实验表明，合成预训练仅在真实数据稀缺时有益，且需核验设备端INT8运算。
AI.motivation: 合成图像标注成本低，但其收益能否经受INT8量化并在微控制器上正确实现尚需验证。
AI.method: 比较五种模型有无合成预训练的表现，并在ESP32-S3和RP2040上测量精度、延迟、能耗及数值一致性。
AI.result: 全量真实数据下无可检测收益，10%数据时CNN跨三种子提升2.715个百分点，且两芯片存在数值一致性问题。
AI.conclusion: 真实数据稀缺时才值得考虑合成预训练，设备端INT8输出应直接对照参考内核核验。

title: From Companion to Guardian: Designing an Emergency Support System Using a Quadruped Robot for Older Adults
summary: As older adults increasingly live alone, emergency support becomes an important function for home companion robots. In Australia, demand for the care and support workforce is projected to nearly double between 2020-21 and 2049-50. Service robots such as robot dogs may support older adults by combining everyday companionship with assistance when human support is not immediately available. We present the design and implementation of a domestic companion-robot system on a Unitree Go1 quadruped platform that combines companionship with emergency awareness and response. The system uses a three-stage interaction model consisting of companion, danger-awareness, and emergency modes. A rule-based escalation policy combines signs detected from visual and speech input to determine the current risk level and adjust how long the robot waits for the user to confirm safety before entering emergency mode. Additional detected signs can shorten this waiting time. Users can confirm safety, request immediate help, stop robot motion, or reset the system. We verified the implemented decision rules and escalation timing through 105 automated trials and 25 staged physical trials. Additional visual evidence shortened the waiting time, and the system entered emergency mode when the waiting time ended without confirmation.
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the Australasian Conference on Robotics and Automation (ACRA 2026)

AI.tldr: 研究实现了面向独居老人的四足陪伴机器人，以分级风险识别支持紧急响应。
AI.motivation: 独居老人增多及照护人力需求上升，推动家庭陪伴机器人兼顾紧急支持功能。
AI.method: 基于Unitree Go1构建陪伴、危险感知和紧急三种模式，融合视觉与语音线索调整安全确认等待时间。
AI.result: 105次自动试验和25次实体情景试验验证了规则及升级时序，额外视觉线索可缩短等待时间。
AI.conclusion: 该系统实现了从日常陪伴到紧急响应的规则化切换，但摘要未验证真实居家照护成效。

title: SAGE-VQA: A Training-Free, Self-Evolving Agentic Framework with Grounded Evidence for Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering
summary: Knowledge-based visual question answering (KB-VQA) aims to combine visual information with external knowledge to answer user questions. Existing methods face two main bottlenecks: visual perception errors can propagate into hallucinations, and generalization across scenarios remains limited. To address these issues, we propose SAGE-VQA (Self-evolving Agent framework with Grounded Evidence), a training-free agentic framework that combines evidence verification with experience evolution. Our key insight is to explore an Evidence-Driven Adaptive Reasoning (EDAR) strategy. It accurately acquires and verifies question-relevant fine-grained visual information. It also extracts and refines reusable experience to support robust reasoning across tasks. Specifically, we design a Co-verified Visual Grounding module that verifies question-relevant visual information and provides grounded evidence for subsequent reasoning. We further introduce a Self-evolving Hierarchical Memory (SHM) mechanism. SHM organizes experiences into declarative and procedural memories based on their nature. These memories can be reused in subsequent reasoning and continually refined through feedback, without updating model parameters. Experimental results show that our method outperforms competing methods based on lightweight open-source vision-language models (VLMs) as well as those based on closed-source VLMs. Moreover, our method can serve as a plug-and-play reasoning framework for existing VLMs without modifying their architectures.

AI.tldr: SAGE-VQA以证据核验和经验记忆构建免训练智能体框架，增强知识型视觉问答。
AI.motivation: 现有知识型视觉问答易将视觉感知错误传播为幻觉，且跨场景泛化能力有限。
AI.method: 通过协同核验视觉定位获取可靠证据，并以分层陈述性和程序性记忆复用及反馈优化经验。
AI.result: 实验中，该方法优于基于轻量开源视觉语言模型和闭源视觉语言模型的竞争方法。
AI.conclusion: 无需更新参数或修改模型架构，证据驱动推理与自演化记忆即可作为即插即用框架增强视觉问答。

title: AllocFlow: End-to-End Portfolio Trading Action Generation from Raw Market Data
summary: Real-world portfolio management requires converting noisy market observations into coordinated, simultaneous allocations across multiple assets under shared capital constraints. Advances in forecasting models and alpha discovery help identify opportunities. However, traditional pipelines often decouple signal forecasting from portfolio construction, potentially misaligning learning with allocation and execution objectives. We present AllocFlow, an end-to-end flow-matching framework that directly generates joint portfolio allocations from raw multi-asset market histories. To capture dependencies among portfolio positions, AllocFlow employs a cross-asset flow Transformer conditioned on temporal market representations to generate continuous, signed position weights across all instruments jointly. To address the sample inefficiency and instability of learning continuous allocation policies from scratch, we establish a two-stage training scheme: strategy-supervised imitation shapes a structured distribution of candidate portfolios, followed by group-relative reinforcement learning (RL) that refines joint decisions using portfolio-level financial rewards and a frozen policy reference. On hourly cryptocurrency perpetual futures, RL refinement raises the annualized net return of the imitation policy from $27.79\%$ to $51.38\%$ and its Calmar ratio from $0.955$ to $4.043$, surpassing the teacher strategy on every metric, and AllocFlow reaches a Calmar ratio of $4.90$ on six further months of unseen 2026 data without retraining.

AI.tldr: AllocFlow从原始多资产行情直接生成联合配置，以模仿学习和强化学习优化组合交易。
AI.motivation: 传统流程分离信号预测与组合构建，可能使学习目标偏离共享资金约束下的配置和执行需求。
AI.method: 采用跨资产流匹配Transformer联合生成有符号仓位权重，先进行策略监督模仿，再用组相对强化学习优化。
AI.result: 强化学习将年化净收益从27.79%提升至51.38%，Calmar比率从0.955升至4.043，未见数据上达4.90。
AI.conclusion: 端到端联合配置与组合级奖励优化，在所测加密货币永续合约数据上提升了收益及风险调整表现。

title: Two-Stage Prompt Learning: A Unified Framework for Person ReID without Clothing Hypothesis
summary: Person re-identification (ReID) in real-world scenarios involves three clothes conditions: the same clothes (SC), changed clothes (CC), and the unknown (GEN) scenario where clothes changes are not specified. Existing methods typically train separate SC- or CC-specific models, which limits generalization across all conditions. Meanwhile, pre-trained visual-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP have shown strong generalization ability in various vision tasks, motivating recent ReID methods to incorporate textual prompts. However, to distinguish SC and CC, prior approaches rely on fixed predefined instructions, which lack learnable context embeddings in prompts and cannot effectively handle the GEN scenario. To overcome these limitations, we propose Two-Stage Prompt Learning (TSPL), a unified framework that integrates clothes-identity decoupling and scenario-aware task prompts within VLMs. In Stage 1, appearance-decomposed prompt learning disentangles clothes and identity information under frozen encoders, producing stable embeddings where clothes cues can be selectively preserved or suppressed. In Stage 2, task-aware prompt learning trains the image encoder with learnable context embeddings guided by Stage-1 representations, enabling robust adaptation across SC, CC, and GEN conditions. Extensive experiments on five benchmarks show that TSPL achieves state-of-the-art performance under all scenarios, improving mAP by up to 9.2% on LTCC (SC) and by 6.4% on VC-Clothes (GEN), respectively. The code will be released at this https URL.

AI.tldr: TSPL通过两阶段提示学习统一处理同衣、换衣及衣着变化未知条件下的行人重识别。
AI.motivation: 现有方法常依赖特定衣着场景训练或固定文本指令，难以兼顾不同衣着条件与未知场景。
AI.method: 先冻结编码器解耦衣着和身份表征，再利用可学习上下文及首阶段表征指导图像编码器训练。
AI.result: 五个基准上各场景均达最先进水平，LTCC同衣场景mAP最高提升9.2%，VC-Clothes未知场景提升6.4%。
AI.conclusion: 衣着身份解耦与场景感知提示结合，可提升统一重识别模型对不同衣着条件的适应能力。

title: CoSyDelay: Cognitive Symbolic Regression for Traffic Delay Estimation
summary: Trustworthy estimation of traffic delays at signalized intersections is critical for modern transportation systems, as it supports proactive traffic control for congestion mitigation. Existing analytical methods often rely on idealized assumptions that limit their accuracy under complex traffic conditions, whereas data-driven methods may achieve strong estimation performance but usually lack transparent structures, which reduces confidence in their practical application. To address these limitations, we propose CoSyDelay, a cognitive symbolic regression (SR) framework for automatically deriving explicit and physically consistent empirical delay estimation expressions (DEEs). Specifically, CoSyDelay decomposes intersection-level delay estimation into turning-movement-level subproblems, thereby reducing the complexity of the symbolic search. During DEE learning, CoSyDelay constructs domain-informed symbolic inputs from traffic variables. Large language models (LLMs) are employed as symbolic search operators to iteratively generate and refine candidate expression structures, whose movement-specific coefficients are subsequently calibrated using approach-level delay labels. A composite fitness function evaluates the learned DEEs jointly in terms of estimation accuracy and compliance with specified traffic-delay principles. Experimental results on multiple signalized intersections demonstrate that the resulting expressions achieve competitive estimation performance while maintaining physical consistency, thereby supporting trustworthy delay estimation. Source code and datasets are available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: CoSyDelay以认知符号回归自动生成显式且物理一致的信号交叉口延误估计公式。
AI.motivation: 传统解析方法受理想化假设限制，数据驱动方法则通常缺乏透明结构，影响实际应用可信度。
AI.method: 将延误估计分解到转向流，利用领域符号输入和大语言模型搜索表达式，并联合精度与交通原则校准筛选。
AI.result: 多个信号交叉口实验表明，所得公式在保持物理一致性的同时实现了有竞争力的延误估计表现。
AI.conclusion: 结合领域知识、符号搜索和物理约束，可为可信且可解释的交通延误估计提供支持。

title: Discovering Programmatic Policies from Reinforcement Learning-Based Traffic Signal Controllers
summary: Traffic signal control (TSC) is critical for mitigating urban congestion. Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) has achieved strong performance by learning adaptive policies from traffic observations, but learned neural controllers are often opaque, structurally complex, and difficult to generalize across scenarios. We propose PPL-TSC, a programmatic policy learning framework that distills compact and human-readable TSC policies from DRL teachers. PPL-TSC formulates policy learning as an evolutionary search over phase utility functions (PUFs), which score candidate signal phases and select the highest-utility phase for execution. Each generation consists of four steps: policy generation, policy review, policy calibration, and policy evaluation. In the generation step, a large language model (LLM) acts as a semantics-aware evolutionary operator to propose and refine candidate PUFs. Generated PUFs are screened through explicit checks for syntactic validity, mathematical soundness, and consistency with TSC principles, with invalid ones repaired through iterative feedback. Valid PUFs are then calibrated to improve behavioral fidelity to the DRL teacher, and evaluated using a joint score combining teacher fidelity and traffic-control performance to select candidates for the next generation. Extensive experiments across diverse traffic scenarios and representative DRL-based controllers show that PPL-TSC produces compact and human-readable policies, achieves competitive performance for most teacher families, improves transfer generalization, and substantially reduces computational cost. Code is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: PPL-TSC从深度强化学习交通信号控制器中蒸馏紧凑、可读的程序化控制策略。
AI.motivation: 深度强化学习控制器虽表现良好，但神经策略不透明、结构复杂且难以跨场景泛化。
AI.method: 以大语言模型演化搜索相位效用函数，经规则审查、教师行为校准及兼顾保真度和控制表现的评估迭代优化。
AI.result: 多场景实验显示，所得策略紧凑可读，对多数教师类型表现有竞争力，并改善迁移泛化、大幅降低计算成本。
AI.conclusion: 程序化策略蒸馏可在保留多数教师竞争力的同时，提高交通信号控制的可解释性和部署效率。

title: CRAFT: A Robot-Agent Harness with Scope-Aware Adaptation
summary: A robot may know how to move an object yet still need to learn where it belongs. When a person rejects a placement, the robot must decide whether the correction applies only to that situation or expresses a broader rule. We study this problem in CRAFT (Contextual Requirement Adaptation with Frozen Tools), a framework for learning local requirements without retraining robot skills. It records physical success separately from whether an action meets the requirement. Our scope ladder uses memory when an action has already been judged in a nearly identical situation. Elsewhere, it combines memory, explicit rules and a learner for requirements beyond those rules, weighting their predictions by how well they predicted earlier feedback. Controlled studies show gains over correction memory alone in utility, which rewards acceptable actions and charges for mistakes and questions. In camera-grounded robot simulations, the ladder asks fewer questions than language-model agents with persistent memory, but some of those agents take fewer wrong actions and succeed more often after requirements change. All execution failures and timeouts remain in the evaluation. These results support combining specific memories with broader rules, while leaving reliable adaptation to changing requirements unresolved. All evidence comes from simulation with generated requirements and simulated feedback.

AI.tldr: CRAFT通过情境记忆、显式规则与需求学习器，在不重训机器人技能的情况下适应局部要求。
AI.motivation: 机器人需要判断人的纠正仅适用于当前情境，还是代表可推广的要求。
AI.method: 区分物理成功与要求满足，按情境匹配调用记忆，并依据历史反馈加权融合规则与学习器预测。
AI.result: 模拟中较单纯纠正记忆提升效用、较持久记忆语言模型减少提问，但部分后者在要求变化后更成功。
AI.conclusion: 具体记忆与广泛规则结合具有价值，但变化要求下的可靠适应仍未解决，证据仅来自模拟。

title: Equal Dose, Different Coverage:Tracing Rate and Duration in Image Editing
summary: Benchmarks for scientific image editing test whether a model draws the outcome of a described process, leaving open which representations carry its errors and whether correcting them yields the right quantity. We study this question with an airbrush of fixed deposition profile, under which exchanging rate and duration preserves the dose and should preserve the endpoint, yet changes the edited coverage. Matched-norm activation patches across text positions and denoising stages show that, in distilled FLUX with Chinese prompts, representations at unchanged text positions (context) carry this discrepancy: early context transfers 3.51 of the 3.98 percentage-point (pp) signed route difference, against 0.09 pp for equal-norm updates at the two changed digits. Early image latents transmit native (unpatched) route differences across two FLUX configurations and OmniGen, while text-position effects depend on configuration. The trace predicts an intervention: share early context between routes while each retains its own digits. On independent English layouts, this reduces the distilled-FLUX absolute route gap from 1.13 to 0.60 pp, outperforms early digit sharing, and improves agreement more than in base FLUX under directly paired tests. Calibrated evaluation, which prescribes an area for each dose, separates this gain from accuracy: sharing the full prompt encoding produces identical route images with target errors of 8-16 pp, and stating the target percentage directly retains a compressed area response. Localization predicts a consistency gain on new layouts, and calibration measures the quantity error that agreement leaves unresolved.

AI.tldr: 图像编辑中的等剂量路径差异可定位至早期上下文表征，修正一致性却不保证数量准确。
AI.motivation: 科学图像编辑评测尚不清楚错误由何种表征承载，以及修正表征能否恢复正确数量。
AI.method: 固定喷枪沉积轮廓，交换速率与时长，并通过等范数激活替换及剂量面积校准追踪误差。
AI.result: 独立英文布局中，共享早期上下文使蒸馏FLUX路径差距从1.13降至0.60个百分点，但数量误差仍存。
AI.conclusion: 表征定位可预测新布局上的一致性改善，但仍需校准评估揭示一致性未解决的数量误差。

title: FinVision: Multimodal AI for Visualizing Financial Narratives
summary: Financial narratives contain rich information about firms' performance and business conditions. Conventional text analysis often summarizes this information into numerical representations, which may not fully preserve the dynamic structure described in the narrative. In this study, we develop FinVision, a domain-specific multimodal generative model that translates financial narratives into visual representations of contemporaneous market dynamics. Using 87,940 paired observations of Management Discussion and Analysis (MD&A) disclosures and stock price charts, FinVision learns the average relationship between a firm's narrative account of a fiscal year and its stock-price dynamics over the same period. Given an MD&A alone, the trained model generates a text-implied stock chart, extending financial text analysis beyond numerical representations toward text-to-visual generation. We validate FinVision in two ways. First, held-out tests show that the model generates stock-chart representations that closely resemble observed charts and outperform direct LLM prompting, general-purpose text-to-image models, and the same architecture without financial-domain adaptation. Second, we examine the economic validity of the generated representations by comparing text-implied and observed stock charts. The resulting discrepancy is systematically associated with weaker investor responses around subsequent 10-K filings and with worse subsequent market and operating outcomes. Overall, our findings show how domain-adapted multimodal generative AI can create a new visual representation of financial text and provide an additional modality for studying business communication.

AI.tldr: FinVision将财务叙述生成同期股价图，其与实际图表的差异具有后续经济关联。
AI.motivation: 传统数值化文本分析可能无法充分保留财务叙述所描述的动态结构。
AI.method: 利用87,940组管理层讨论与分析披露及股价图训练金融领域多模态生成模型，并检验图表质量与经济关联。
AI.result: 生成图优于多类基线，其与实际图表的差异系统性关联于后续较弱投资者反应及较差市场和经营表现。
AI.conclusion: 领域适配的多模态生成模型可为财务文本提供新的视觉表征，拓展商业沟通研究方式。

title: Multimodal AI in Healthcare: Review of Vision-Language Foundation Models for Real-World Medical Applications
summary: The emergence of foundation models has marked a transformative shift in AI, enabling robust generalization across diverse downstream tasks through putative zero-shot learning. Large Language Models and Vision Language Models have demonstrated strong capabilities in tasks such as image interpretation, report generation, and question answering by effectively learning from multimodal data-images paired with associated text often with minimal supervision. In the healthcare domain, this ability to align visual and textual information reduces the reliance on extensive manual annotations, as models can leverage existing clinical reports and imaging data to learn meaningful representations. This integration holds promise for improving diagnostic support, treatment planning, and overall patient care, even in data constrained settings. In this review, we provide a definitive taxonomy of the medical VLM landscape, tracing the evolution from early Contrastive Alignment and Generative MLLMs to the cutting edge frontiers of Dense Pixel Grounding, Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE), and Reasoning Incentivized (RL) architectures. We critically examine the "medical bottleneck" identifying the persistent challenges of data scarcity, the "hallucination" risks in generative diagnostics, the computational strain of 3D volumetric processing, and the lack of standardized, clinically grounded evaluation metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文综述医疗视觉语言基础模型的技术谱系、临床应用潜力及落地瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 视觉与文本对齐有望降低医疗标注需求，但临床应用仍受数据、可靠性、计算与评估限制。
AI.method: 建立从对比对齐、生成式多模态大模型到像素定位、稀疏专家及强化学习推理架构的分类体系。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体结果。
AI.conclusion: 医疗视觉语言模型具有应用潜力，但数据稀缺、诊断幻觉、三维计算负担与临床评估缺失仍待解决。

title: Evaluating Near-Perfect Accuracy Claims in Machine-Learning-Based Leak Detection for Two-Phase Pipelines: A Condition-Blocked Audit
summary: Reliable leak detection in gas-liquid two-phase pipelines is important for process safety, yet machine-learning studies frequently report near-perfect performance using evaluation protocols that may not represent deployment to unseen operating conditions. This study audits a pressure-based leak-detection model using condition-blocked leave-one-condition-out validation, in which the classifier is tested on a flow condition excluded from training. Accuracy decreased from 93.3% under within-condition evaluation to 59.1% across fifteen unseen-condition tests. Ablation analysis showed that most of this difference arose from the data-splitting protocol, with a smaller contribution from encoding operating conditions as model inputs. Under condition-blocked evaluation, the false-alarm and missed-detection rates increased to 34.1% and 10.2%, respectively, demonstrating that near-perfect reported accuracy did not translate into reliable operation at unseen flow conditions. The reduction persisted across all evaluated classifiers, indicating that it was caused by the evaluation design rather than a particular model architecture. Grouped evaluation of an independent acoustic pipeline dataset produced a comparable reduction toward chance-level performance. These findings show that validation units must represent the conditions encountered during deployment. Condition-blocked evaluation and explicit reporting of operational error rates are therefore necessary before machine-learning leak detectors can support process-safety decisions.
comment: 8 figures, 8 tables. Analysis code archived at this https URL

AI.tldr: 两相管道泄漏检测模型在未见工况下准确率大幅下降，揭示近乎完美性能的评估局限。
AI.motivation: 现有机器学习泄漏检测评估可能无法代表模型部署到未见运行工况时的可靠性。
AI.method: 采用按工况分组的留一工况验证，结合消融、多分类器测试及独立声学管道数据复核。
AI.result: 准确率由工况内93.3%降至未见工况59.1%，误报率与漏检率分别升至34.1%和10.2%。
AI.conclusion: 用于过程安全决策前，泄漏检测器必须按部署工况划分验证单元，并明确报告运行错误率。

title: Towards GPROF V08: A Machine-Learning Framework for Simulating Passive Microwave Observations of Precipitation
summary: Spatially resolved precipitation retrievals based on convolutional neural networks (CNNs) can improve precipitation estimates from passive microwave (PMW) observations and will be used to implement the next operational PMW retrieval algorithm for the Global Precipitation Measurement (GPM) mission. However, the conventional radiative transfer simulations used to extend the retrieval algorithm to the various sensors of the GPM constellation do not provide the spatial coverage required to train CNN-based retrievals. To address this, we introduce a machine-learning-based simulation framework that enables the training of the CNN-based GPROF-NN 3D retrieval algorithm for the full GPM constellation. At the core of this framework is Satformer, a new neural-network architecture that can translate PMW observations between any pair of GPM sensors. The resulting synthetic observations exhibit lower errors than conventional radiative transfer simulations and lead to more accurate precipitation retrievals when used to train GPROF-NN precipitation retrievals. We further demonstrate the applicability of the framework to new instruments by developing GPROF-NN retrievals for the Microwave Imager aboard the Weather System Follow-on Microwave satellite. While GPROF-NN retrievals based on the new simulation framework achieve lower instantaneous retrieval errors and higher correlations compared to independent reference data than conventional retrievals, residual simulation errors can introduce systematic biases in the resulting retrievals. The proposed simulation framework provides a key component for extending GPROF-NN to the full GPM constellation as part of the upcoming operational GPROF V08 retrieval algorithm. The results demonstrate the potential of machine-learning-based simulations to support spatially resolved precipitation retrievals across heterogeneous satellite constellations.

AI.tldr: Satformer跨传感器模拟被动微波观测，为GPM全星座的卷积网络降水反演训练提供支持。
AI.motivation: 传统辐射传输模拟的空间覆盖不足以训练面向GPM多种传感器的卷积网络降水反演模型。
AI.method: 提出以Satformer为核心的机器学习模拟框架，在任意一对GPM传感器间转换观测并训练GPROF-NN。
AI.result: 合成观测误差更低，训练所得反演更准确、与独立参考数据相关性更高，但残余模拟误差可能引入系统偏差。
AI.conclusion: 该框架是将GPROF-NN扩展至GPM全星座及未来业务化GPROF V08的重要组件。

title: Value and Policy Calibration from Execution Feedback for Socially Compatible Driving
summary: Autonomous vehicle (AV) decisions at intersections affect the delay, braking, and motion smoothness of surrounding human-driven vehicles (HDVs). Learning socially compatible behavior requires connecting imagined interaction outcomes with feedback from executed actions. We propose a world-model reinforcement learning framework combines imagined policy improvement with direct value and policy calibration from finalized interactions, balancing AV progress with HDV interaction burden. An interaction-aware latent model supports imagination, while off-policy correction and replay updates enable observed rewards and transitions to supervise both the critic and actor. Simulation experiments at an unsignalized intersection achieve a 100% success and reductions in following-HDV acceleration variation of 65.5% and 44.0% relative to PIWM and DreamerV3, respectively. Ablations identify complementary roles for value calibration in reducing HDV burden and policy calibration in improving passage efficiency. Tests under out-of-distribution traffic shifts further show lower ego jerk and HDV acceleration variation than PIWM at comparable passage times.

AI.tldr: 通过执行反馈校准价值与策略的世界模型强化学习，可兼顾自动驾驶通行效率与周围车辆负担。
AI.motivation: 路口自动驾驶决策影响人驾车辆的延误、制动和平顺性，需要将想象交互与真实执行反馈衔接。
AI.method: 构建交互感知潜在世界模型，通过离策略校正和回放，用执行奖励与转移联合校准价值及策略。
AI.result: 无信号路口模拟成功率100%，后随车辆加速度变化较PIWM和DreamerV3分别降低65.5%和44.0%。
AI.conclusion: 价值校准与策略校准分别帮助降低交互负担和提高效率，分布外交通测试也显示更平顺的交互。

title: Physics-Informed Fractional Load Forecasting With Memory-Aware Break Detection for Reserve Scheduling
summary: Day-ahead load forecasts set balancing reserves, including the energy a pumped-storage plant holds against forecast errors. Both depend on three effects that are usually modeled separately, namely the thermal inertia of buildings, which makes load lag temperature, structural breaks, which shift demand, and the long memory of forecast errors, which keeps them from cancelling out. We prove that averaging building responses over Cole-Cole distributed time constants yields a fractional temperature kernel with nonnegative weights exactly when its order is at most one. A Bayesian information criterion that ignores long memory selects spurious breaks with probability tending to one, so breaks and memory are estimated jointly, and an online break detector keeps its false-alarm rate below any prescribed level. Long memory also makes the required storage energy grow faster than the square root of the horizon, so a second-order cone program schedules reserves from the joint distribution of hourly errors. On New England and Mid-Atlantic data including the 2020 pandemic, the proposed framework improves on the best of ten benchmarks by 15.7% and 10.3% in mean absolute percentage error. Its reserves breach the storage energy limit on 4.1% and 8.5% of days, against 36.7% and 57.5% with error correlations ignored.

AI.tldr: 联合建模建筑热惯性、需求突变与误差长记忆，可改善日前负荷预测和储能备用调度。
AI.motivation: 热惯性、结构突变与预测误差长记忆通常被分开建模，可能导致错误断点识别和备用能量不足。
AI.method: 推导分数阶温度核，联合估计突变与长记忆，结合误报受控在线检测和二阶锥规划调度备用。
AI.result: 两地区MAPE较最佳基线降低15.7%和10.3%，储能越限天数占比降至4.1%和8.5%。
AI.conclusion: 联合考虑热惯性、结构突变及误差相关性，有助于提升负荷预测精度并降低备用储能越限风险。

title: The structure of variational autoencoder latent spaces and its consequences for representation and optimization
summary: Variational autoencoders (VAEs) are widely used to build low-dimensional representations of scientific data, with the expectation that regularization yields smooth coordinates for interpolation, generation and optimization. However, applications in microscopy reveal domains, narrow transitions and rare-state islands in VAE latent spaces that smoothness alone does not explain. We show that, for prototype data with squared-error reconstruction and an optimal decoder, the latent-space objective has a direct correspondence with the Flory-Huggins theory of a regular solution, and use it to analyze how the objective, posterior distributions and latent dimensionality organize the representation. Data families occupy domains separated by finite-width walls that broaden with increasing regularization until class separation is lost through posterior collapse. Class centroids behave like particles in a harmonic trap: the prior confines them, and structural dissimilarity sets a soft repulsion that determines which classes become neighbors and how far apart they sit, with separations growing only logarithmically with dissimilarity. Rare states can remain unresolved, form small islands, accumulate within walls or develop intervening domains, depending on their frequency and similarity to common states. The posterior covariance can align domains with the latent axes, but axis alignment does not imply separation of physical factors. Rotations can produce rings and encoder cuts that reflect data symmetry, while insufficient dimensionality can lead to suppression, mixing or folding of additional factors. Comparisons with flow models, deep kernel learning (DKL) and hybrid VAE-DKL models show how these structures change when reconstruction and prediction play different roles. We discuss implications for interpreting data, discovering rare states, generating intermediate states and optimizing properties.

AI.tldr: 研究以规则溶液理论解释VAE潜空间的分域、稀有态与维度效应及其应用影响。
AI.motivation: 显微数据中的分域、狭窄过渡和稀有态孤岛难以仅用潜空间平滑性解释。
AI.method: 在平方误差重建与最优解码器假设下，将原型数据的潜空间目标对应到Flory-Huggins理论。
AI.result: 正则化增强使域壁变宽直至后验坍塌，稀有态结构取决于频率与相似性，轴对齐不等于物理因子解耦。
AI.conclusion: 理解潜空间结构有助于解释表征，并审慎开展稀有态发现、中间态生成与性质优化。

title: Federated Dataset Simulation: Inducing Label-Free Heterogeneity Across Tasks
summary: Federated Learning enables collaborative model training across decentralized clients without sharing raw data. While the field has seen rapid growth, the datasets underpinning FL evaluation have not kept pace: real federated datasets remain scarce, and most studies rely on small-scale centralized classification datasets partitioned via Dirichlet label skew, a one-dimensional proxy for the multi-dimensional heterogeneity present in real federations. Moreover, label-based partitioning is by construction inapplicable to non-classification tasks such as segmentation and detection, for which no principled simulation method exists. We cast the conversion of centralized datasets into federated benchmarks as the task of Federated Dataset Simulation (FDS), and decompose it into a representation function $\Phi$ and an assignment mechanism $\pi$. We provide two label-free instantiations -- geometric partitioning via pretrained model embeddings and semantic partitioning via vision-language model-derived criteria -- applicable to classification and dense prediction tasks alike. We evaluate across four datasets spanning classification, segmentation, and detection, and show that both methods induce heterogeneity that matches or exceeds that of label-skew partitioning, with measurable impact on downstream FL performance. We release fds, a modular open-source package for end-to-end federated dataset simulation, heterogeneity measurement, and FL training, at this https URL.
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出无标签联邦数据集模拟框架，支持分类、分割与检测任务的异质性构造。
AI.motivation: 真实联邦数据稀缺，常用标签偏斜划分难以模拟多维异质性且不适用于非分类任务。
AI.method: 将模拟分解为表征函数与分配机制，采用预训练嵌入几何划分及视觉语言模型语义划分。
AI.result: 四个数据集上的两种方法均产生不低于标签偏斜划分的异质性，并影响下游联邦学习性能。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为跨任务联邦评估提供无标签模拟方案，并发布模块化开源工具fds。

title: CreaTrace: Video Creative Plagiarism Detection and Evidence Tracing
summary: Video creative plagiarism refers to the unauthorized reproduction of creative ideas across videos despite substantial differences in visual appearance, posing a new challenge to video copyright protection. However, existing video copy detection methods primarily focus on visual content similarity, struggling to capture abstract creative that are entangled with specific visual realizations. To address this issue, we introduce a novel task, named Video Creative Plagiarism Detection (VCPD), and propose an iterative creative evidence tracing framework, termed CreaTrace, to verify creative similarity and accurately localize the corresponding evidence segments. Specifically, we design a Multimodal Semantic Event Segmentation strategy to divide similar long videos into coherent narrative events, facilitating event-level dataset construction and retrieving similar segments. Based on these events, CreaTrace employs Coarse Creative Matching to identify candidate event pairs through narrative semantics and camera language. Then CreaTrace presents Creative Decoupling to disentangle abstract creative patterns from specific visual realizations. Meanwhile, Creative Swap Contrastive Learning is devised to enhance creative consistency through cross-realization feature swapping. Benefiting from the above designs, our CreaTrace enables accurate creative similarity detection and temporal localization, while providing interpretable evidence report. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of CreaTrace across diverse creative plagiarism scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出CreaTrace框架，检测视觉外观差异较大的视频创意抄袭并定位证据片段。
AI.motivation: 现有视频复制检测侧重视觉相似性，难以识别与具体视觉呈现纠缠的抽象创意。
AI.method: 结合多模态事件分割、粗粒度创意匹配、创意解耦和跨呈现特征交换对比学习。
AI.result: 广泛实验表明，该框架在多种创意抄袭场景中具有有效性与鲁棒性，并能提供可解释证据报告。
AI.conclusion: 从抽象创意而非仅视觉内容进行匹配，可支持视频创意相似性检测与时序证据追踪。

title: Practice Is Not Free: Measuring the Embodied Cost of Reset-Free Robot Practice
summary: When a robot practices without human resets, every attempt still costs wall-clock time, actuator wear, and sometimes a person's attention, yet the schedulers that decide what to practice next treat attempts as free. We present an open, low-cost testbed for measuring these costs: a self-built SO-101 arm runs two demonstration-trained ACT policies that reset each other, with a vision-based success detector and a ledger that records the time, joint travel, and human interventions of every attempt. We formulate cost-aware practice scheduling, in which task selection is rewarded by measured competence gain net of embodied cost, and specify in advance the comparison that will test it. Its first two conditions, run on hardware for 51 minutes of robot time, show that a fixed retry limit did not reduce the share of execution time lost to failures (36%, against 27% for a feasibility rule; not significant) and saved no robot time. The logs suggest why: failures showed no sign of clustering, so a retry right after a failure was as likely to succeed as any other attempt. The ledger also shows that most of the retry rule's extra human time came from cubes knocked out of reach rather than from the rule itself, and a cost-aware rule replayed on the logs recovers the sensible choice without a hand-set limit. We also report lessons from building the system, including a coverage effect in which concentrating demonstrations in a smaller workspace raised success there from 8/20 to 10/10.
comment: 16 pages, 6 figures. Code, data, logs and videos: this https URL

AI.tldr: 构建低成本机器人练习平台，量化免人工复位练习的时间、运动与人工干预成本。
AI.motivation: 现有练习调度将尝试视为免费，忽略实际时间、执行器损耗及人工注意成本。
AI.method: 用互相复位的两项ACT策略、视觉成功检测和逐次成本账本，定义并初步测试成本感知调度。
AI.result: 51分钟硬件实验中，固定重试限制的失败耗时占比为36%，对照为27%，差异不显著且未节省机器人时间。
AI.conclusion: 初步结果不支持固定重试限制的收益，提示练习调度应依据实测能力增益与具身成本。

title: Morphology-Decoupled Segmentation for Multiple Tunnel Defects Under Complex Environments
summary: Automated tunnel-lining inspection must segment different defect geometries: cracks are thin, elongated, and connectivity-sensitive, whereas leakage, lining falling off, and segment damage are spatially extensive and context-dependent. Existing approaches generally apply a common decoder across defect classes or introduce boundary, topology, and directional mechanisms as isolated enhancements. This paper introduces Morphology-Decoupled Segmentation (MDS), in which defect morphology becomes the organising principle for feature routing, decoding, and interaction. A supervised routing module partitions multiscale encoder features into complementary linear and areal streams. The linear stream employs Deformable Strip Attention with image-conditioned direction hypotheses to preserve crack continuity without assuming fixed horizontal or vertical orientations, while the areal stream combines Pyramid Pooling with feature-pyramid fusion to capture diffuse boundaries and regional context. The representations are coupled through gated cross-morphology attention, allowing complementary information exchange while retaining morphology-specific features. A resolution-adaptive tiling and probability-blending pipeline preserves fine defects across variable-resolution imagery. MDS achieves 81.17% mIoU on the internal validation set and improves foreground image-level recognition over a backbone-matched SegDINO model, primarily for areal defects. Controlled ablations demonstrate the complementary contributions of routing supervision and cross-stream interaction while revealing a trade-off between areal-class performance and crack specialisation. The submitted model achieved 67.55% mIoU on an organiser-controlled hidden test, and the team placed second. Selective dynamic INT8 quantisation reduced model storage by 2.83 times with negligible accuracy loss.

AI.tldr: 提出形态解耦隧道缺陷分割模型，分别处理线状裂缝与面状缺陷并实现跨流交互。
AI.motivation: 裂缝与渗漏、剥落等缺陷的几何特征不同，共用解码器难以兼顾连续性与区域上下文。
AI.method: 以监督路由划分线状和面状特征流，结合可变形条带注意力、金字塔融合、门控交互及自适应切图。
AI.result: 内部验证mIoU为81.17%，隐藏测试为67.55%并获第二名；INT8量化使存储缩小2.83倍且精度损失可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 形态专用特征与跨流交互具有互补作用，但面状缺陷性能与裂缝专门化之间存在权衡。

title: Autonomous Multi-modal Agents for ITOps Observability
summary: ITOps observability products must integrate data from different tools and systems. We present ITOps Observability Studio, a multi-modal multi-agent system that orchestrates observability workflows through collaborative AI agents. Its three-tier architecture features inter-agent communication, specialized LLM-powered agents for data access, schema operations and visualization, and unified tool integration. The system supports natural language to GraphQL translation, GraphQL schema generation, schema mapping, trace data lifecycle management and multi-tool workflows for reliability engineering. Its agents are instrumented with agent analytics, so that their model and tool calls can be traced. We evaluate each agent on its own benchmark, scored against gold answers where they exist and by a model judge for schema mapping and chart quality. Query generation on a public benchmark and routing work well with a current open model, and the data lifecycle management agent solves most of its scenarios. The evaluation exposed defects that only appear when prompts, parsers and serving stacks are tested together, and we report them together with their fixes.

AI.tldr: 提出多模态多智能体运维可观测性平台，协同完成数据访问、模式操作与可视化工作流。
AI.motivation: 运维可观测性产品需要整合不同工具与系统的数据，并支持跨工具可靠性工程流程。
AI.method: 采用三层架构协调专用大模型智能体与统一工具，并追踪模型和工具调用，逐智能体开展基准评估。
AI.result: 当前开放模型在公开基准查询生成与路由上表现良好，生命周期管理智能体解决多数场景，并发现集成缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体可支持运维可观测性工作流，但需联合测试提示词、解析器与服务栈以暴露并修复缺陷。

title: When Zero Is Competitive: A Descriptive Pilot of Transformer and Gate-Graph Surrogates on Random-Angle Quantum Circuits
summary: We examine supervised classical prediction of all one-qubit Z and two-qubit ZZ expectation values on noiseless, layered 4-10-qubit RX/RY/RZ-CNOT circuits. In a 63-cell stratified workload with disjoint circuit-template tests, we evaluate one transformer encoder and gate-dependency graph neural networks against literal-zero and training-derived constant predictors. On the Arm K training labels, 44.89% of scalar targets have absolute magnitude below 0.05. The held-out-template zero predictor has equal-instance mean absolute error 0.193399, and none of the evaluated transformer checkpoints or final graph-network endpoints achieves a lower score. A separate product-state positive control achieves MAE 0.007755 versus 0.514811 for zero, but does not explain the failure on the entangled workload. The difference between zero and a training-fitted mean constant under training MSE is only 0.14%, a descriptive point estimate without uncertainty analysis. The transformer's 815,233-parameter source identity is locally verified; detailed packed-input semantics have not been independently audited. These results constitute a descriptive pilot, not a causal explanation, formal equivalence test, or impossibility claim. Comparable circuits can be regenerated from the workload specification, but exact frozen datasets and model-run evidence remain private.
comment: 9 pages, 1 figure. Descriptive pilot study. Exact experimental evidence archive currently private

AI.tldr: 随机角量子电路预测试验中，所评估Transformer与图网络均未超越恒零预测基线。
AI.motivation: 评估经典监督模型预测量子电路期望值时，需检验其是否优于简单常数基线。
AI.method: 在4至10量子比特电路的63个分层单元上，以互斥电路模板测试Transformer、门依赖图网络及常数预测器。
AI.result: 恒零预测在留出模板上的MAE为0.193399，所有受测模型均未更低；乘积态阳性对照模型则明显优于零基线。
AI.conclusion: 结果仅构成描述性先导证据，不支持因果解释、正式等价或不可能性结论，且精确数据与运行证据未公开。

title: KneeFS-Net: A Lightweight Deep Learning Model for Knee Osteoarthritis Severity Assessment with Cross-Domain External Validation
summary: Knee osteoarthritis (OA) grading from radiographs using the Kellgren-Lawrence (KL) scale requires expertise that may be scarce. We present KneeFS-Net, a lightweight ordinal grader (0.8 million parameters; 0.33 GFLOPs) combining spatial, Fourier and state-space features with landmark-guided attention. On the Osteoarthritis Initiative (OAI) test set, KneeFS-Net achieved a quadratic weighted kappa (QWK) of 0.863, mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.325 and 97.2% within-one-grade accuracy, comparable to models with 9-35-fold more parameters. We evaluated cross-population generalization on two Bangladeshi cohorts, a single-center hospital cohort and a multi-center teleradiology cohort. Without further training or adaptation, the OAI-trained model achieved QWK 0.803, MAE 0.339 and 98.2% within-one-grade accuracy on its hospital cohort, declining to QWK 0.656 and MAE 0.522 on multi-center teleradiology images. Self-supervised pretraining on 6,092 unlabeled radiographs followed by joint fine-tuning achieved QWK 0.823, MAE 0.329 and 99.7% within-one-grade accuracy in cross-validation. These findings demonstrate accurate, efficient KL grading and potential adaptation to new populations with limited annotation.

AI.tldr: 轻量KneeFS-Net实现高效膝骨关节炎分级，并通过孟加拉国队列检验跨域表现。
AI.motivation: 膝关节X线KL分级依赖可能稀缺的专家，亟需高效且可适应不同人群的自动模型。
AI.method: 以80万参数融合空间、傅里叶和状态空间特征及标志点引导注意力，并进行外部验证与自监督预训练。
AI.result: OAI测试QWK为0.863，零适配医院队列为0.803、多中心远程影像为0.656；预训练后交叉验证为0.823。
AI.conclusion: 模型兼具分级准确性与计算效率，但多中心跨域性能下降，预训练结果显示有限标注适配的潜力。

title: MoViC: Real-Time Humanoid Whole-Body Control from Monocular Video Streams
summary: Real-time whole-body imitation from monocular video requires both a robust universal tracker and high-quality real-time reconstruction. We present MoViC, a framework that uses live RGB video as a control signal for humanoid robots without wearable tracking devices. The framework combines monocular human motion reconstruction, robot retargeting, and a transformer-based behavior foundation model. The policy receives proprioceptive history, a single explicit next-step reference, and a compact frequency-domain motion representation that supplies temporal context without explicitly stacking future reference frames, which reduces the input dimension and network size. During deployment, our extrapolation method bridges the 10-Hz visual estimation with 50-Hz controller, enabling asynchronous visual processing and policy execution. Hardware experiments further demonstrate highly dynamic motion tracking and device-free teleoperation of bimanual and single-arm manipulation tasks from live monocular RGB input. Project page: this https URL .

AI.tldr: MoViC利用实时单目视频驱动人形机器人，实现无需穿戴设备的全身模仿与遥操作。
AI.motivation: 实时单目视频全身模仿需要兼具鲁棒通用跟踪与高质量实时运动重建。
AI.method: 结合单目运动重建、机器人重定向及Transformer策略，以频域运动表示提供时序上下文，并通过外推衔接异步视觉与控制。
AI.result: 硬件实验展示了高动态运动跟踪，以及基于实时单目RGB输入的双臂和单臂操作遥控。
AI.conclusion: MoViC表明，实时单目RGB视频可作为人形机器人全身控制与免穿戴遥操作的信号。

title: MOBO-CAPS: Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization with Cardinality-Aware Pareto Selection
summary: Multi-objective Bayesian optimization (MOBO) traditionally aims to approximate the entire Pareto front, but, due to resource constraints, real-world deployment is often limited to testing a small, representative subset of solutions. Hence current methods first approximate the full front before selecting solutions, potentially wasting costly evaluations. We formalize this problem as Multi-objective Bayesian Optimization with Cardinality-aware Pareto Selection (MOBO-CAPS), where the goal is to identify a set of exactly M solutions with high hypervolume. We propose two practical cardinality-aware acquisition strategies: REHVI, a replacement-aware approximation to expected hypervolume improvement, and CHO-UCB, which constructs an optimistic M-point set by optimizing a collective UCB-based hypervolume objective. We prove a sublinear simple regret bound for the batched version of CHO-UCB, and empirically show that cardinality-aware acquisition design improves over standard MOBO followed by post-hoc subset selection across nine benchmarks.

AI.tldr: MOBO-CAPS直接优化固定数量解的超体积，避免先逼近完整帕累托前沿再筛选的评估浪费。
AI.motivation: 实际部署通常只能测试少量代表性方案，而传统多目标贝叶斯优化可能在完整前沿上浪费昂贵评估。
AI.method: 提出考虑替换的REHVI采集策略，以及联合优化固定数量解的乐观超体积的CHO-UCB策略。
AI.result: 证明批量CHO-UCB具有次线性简单遗憾界，并在九个基准上优于标准优化后再选子集的方法。
AI.conclusion: 将解集数量约束直接纳入采集设计，有助于在有限部署预算下获得更优代表性方案。

title: What Matters for Cross-Modal Alignment
summary: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis posits that models trained on different modalities converge toward a shared representation. Related work aligns frozen image and text encoders on natural images without paired data. We test zero-pair alignment on five datasets across four modalities: natural images, environmental audio, chest radiographs, and 3D computed tomography (CT). It succeeds only on COCO and fails on the other four. We analyze the failures and find that alignment must first locate the subspace where the modalities co-vary and then orient the mapping within it. Consistent with previous studies, medical imaging is the hardest case: its shared subspace carries the smallest fraction of the variance. When this fraction is small, alignment needs image-text pairs, and random-matrix theory predicts how many pairs are needed. These findings motivate LightAlign: a few pairs let a ridge regression between two frozen encoders locate and orient the mapping simultaneously, and a classifier fitted only on report text then predicts findings from the mapped images. On 3D CT, LightAlign surpasses models trained end to end on image-report pairs without finding-level labels: with only 200 pairs, LightAlign outperforms CT-CLIP on CT-RATE (0.754 vs. 0.733 AUROC), and with only 100 CT-RATE pairs, it does so on RAD-ChestCT, an out-of-distribution dataset from a different hospital. On CheXpert, it reaches 0.862 mean AUROC with only about 5% as many pairs as models trained on MIMIC-CXR.

AI.tldr: 跨模态对齐取决于共享子空间的定位与定向，LightAlign用少量配对样本实现有效医学影像对齐。
AI.motivation: 检验不同模态表征能否无配对对齐，以及医学影像等场景中对齐失败的原因。
AI.method: 在四类模态的五个数据集上测试无配对对齐，并用冻结编码器间的岭回归及文本分类器构建LightAlign。
AI.result: 无配对对齐仅在COCO成功；LightAlign用200对CT数据在CT-RATE取得0.754 AUROC，超过CT-CLIP的0.733。
AI.conclusion: 共享子空间方差占比较小时需要配对数据，而少量配对即可支持高效且可迁移的医学影像对齐。

title: The novelty exposed: ablation, reproducibility and transparency in 40 technical reports of open-weight large language models (LLMs)
summary: In 2025 alone, 48 new large language model (LLM) architectures were added to the Hugging Face transformers library, and many of them arrive with a technical report that presents the model as new. What is actually new in these models, and is it tested? We put this question to LLM technical reports. We look at three things: what the reference code shows about how new open-weight architectures differ from earlier ones; what 40 randomly sampled technical reports claim as new and whether they support it with ablation studies; and what they disclose for reproducibility and transparency. In the library, 39 of the 48 architectures added in 2025 take at least two of their three core blocks from another model, most often Llama, although part of this reflects how the library writes code. In the reports, 19 of 73 architectural or training novelty claims come with a controlled with/without comparison; 4 of 40 reports state more than one training run; 8 rerun the models they compare against under one setup; and 1 discloses data mixture, token count, and compute together. We also looked for known components given new names: none of five candidate cases hid its origin, though we did not study model names. We propose seven reporting rules for LLM release reports and apply them to two reports. We do not judge model quality, and an untested claim may still be true.
comment: Empirical study with an original dataset: 40 LLM technical reports coded by two independent model coders with script-verified quotes, plus a code-level comparison of open-weight architectures in Hugging Face transformers. 20 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Data, coding protocol and scripts in the ancillary files

AI.tldr: 对40份开放权重大模型技术报告的审查发现，创新主张的消融验证与复现信息披露普遍不足。
AI.motivation: 核查新发布大模型的架构或训练创新究竟是什么，以及这些创新是否经过验证并透明披露。
AI.method: 分析参考代码、随机抽取40份技术报告，审查创新消融与复现披露，并提出七项报告规则。
AI.result: 73项创新主张仅19项有受控消融，40份报告中仅1份同时披露数据混合、词元数和计算量。
AI.conclusion: 发布报告应加强受控验证与信息披露，但未经检验的主张未必错误，研究也不评价模型质量。

title: Glance, then Select: Evidence-Tempered Visual Token Selection for Extremely Compressed Multimodal LLMs
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) encode a high-resolution image into thousands of visual tokens, which dominate the cost of the prefill stage. Visual token reduction removes most of these tokens, but two problems remain at extreme budgets. The vision encoder still processes every patch of the image, and the few surviving tokens often miss the small regions that hold the answer. In this paper, we propose Glance-ETD, a two-stage token reduction framework guided by a lightweight question-conditioned scorer. In the first stage, a glance encoder views the image at low resolution and re-encodes only the question-relevant regions at native resolution. In the second stage, Evidence-Tempered Diversity (ETD) selects the final tokens by combining diversity with the evidence predicted by the scorer, so that the kept tokens cover the scene and retain the answer. A single-rollout self-distillation recipe trains the MLLM with the glance encoder. With only 5% of the visual tokens, Glance-ETD retains 91.6% of the full-token performance of Qwen3.5-4B across fourteen benchmarks and outperforms the strongest prior method, LT-OPD, by 17.3 points and the same training recipe with DivPrune by 6.0. It also speeds up the time to first token on 4K images by 3.1x and generalizes to three other MLLMs and to high-resolution document benchmarks, with the largest gains on text-rich tasks.

AI.tldr: Glance-ETD以问题引导的两阶段视觉压缩，在仅保留5%视觉词元时兼顾性能与推理效率。
AI.motivation: 极低视觉词元预算下，编码器仍处理全部图像块，且保留词元容易遗漏承载答案的小区域。
AI.method: 先低分辨率浏览并重编码相关区域，再结合证据与多样性选择词元，通过单次采样自蒸馏训练。
AI.result: 仅用5%视觉词元保留Qwen3.5-4B在14个基准上91.6%的完整性能，4K图像首词元速度提升3.1倍。
AI.conclusion: 问题相关证据与多样性联合引导可改善极端视觉压缩，并泛化至其他模型及高分辨率文档任务。

title: PlanDiv: Test-Time Scaling with Latent Plans for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Test-time scaling improves vision-language-action (VLA) policies by drawing several action candidates and executing the best one. We find that its returns diminish quickly when the candidates are resampled from one decoder: they differ by noise rather than by plan, and for each of three resampling sources, going from four to eight candidates adds only 0.06-0.07 to the average number of completed tasks on CALVIN. We introduce PlanDiv, an action head that makes the candidates differ by plan: a lightweight planner proposes K latent plan hypotheses, a shared masked-diffusion executor decodes one action chunk per plan from a single backbone pass, and the policy executes the chunk that its own likelihood ranks highest. The plans are learned from demonstrations alone, without plan labels or rewards. With the backbone, data and training recipe held fixed, eight plan-conditioned candidates raise five-task chain success on CALVIN ABC$\rightarrow$D from 56.9% to 69.9%, while eight candidates from autoregressive, plan-free or same-plan resampling reach at most 64.9%. The same-plan baseline is PlanDiv's own checkpoint with the plan held fixed, so this gap comes from the plans, not from drawing more samples. On LIBERO-Long, four plans remove 40% of single-candidate failures, against at most 21% for matched resampling. On a real Franka arm the gain appears where a task admits more than one solution: PlanDiv is on par with a single-output OpenVLA-OFT+ baseline on a one-solution task and succeeds in 51 of 54 trials against 40 of 54 on two tasks with two solutions.

AI.tldr: PlanDiv通过生成不同潜在计划而非重复采样同一计划，提高视觉语言动作模型的测试时扩展收益。
AI.motivation: 单一解码器重复采样的候选动作主要体现噪声而非计划差异，导致增加候选数量的收益迅速递减。
AI.method: 轻量规划器提出多个潜在计划，共享掩码扩散执行器生成动作块，再按策略自身似然选择执行。
AI.result: 八个计划候选将CALVIN五任务链成功率从56.9%提高至69.9%，真实双解任务成功51/54次，对照为40/54次。
AI.conclusion: 从示范中学习计划多样性比单纯增加采样更有效，收益主要体现在存在多种解法的任务。

title: ReactBench-AD: Do Driving VLAs and World-Action Models React to Imminent Hazards in Their Path?
summary: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) and World-Action Models (WAMs) have emerged in autonomous driving with the promise of strong generalization to long-tail scenarios. Although these models achieve state-of-the-art results on autonomous driving benchmarks, most existing benchmarks are dominated by nominal scenarios and therefore cannot test this promise. To test one such long-tail capability that is critical for safety, we introduce ReactBench-AD, a benchmark that measures how driving models react to objects that appear in the ego vehicle's path. Built on real NAVSIM and PhysicalAI-Autonomous-Vehicles scenes, ReactBench-AD composites a crossing pedestrian, a standing pedestrian, or a stationary car consistently across all camera views and history frames. Each edited scene thus forms an exact, pixel-level counterfactual pair with its original, which allows us to isolate the causal effect of the inserted object on the predicted trajectory. Evaluating four VLAs and two WAMs, we find that they react weakly, often barely at all. Finally, we test how easily one of the evaluated VLAs, ReCogDrive, can be taught to brake hard for imminent hazards: a short fine-tuning stage on edited scenes substantially improves its reactions, with the learned behavior generalizing to unseen objects and fully real scenes, at minimal cost to nominal driving. These results call into question the out-of-the-box long-tail capabilities of these models, but suggest that they can be a strong foundation for acquiring them with little additional training, highlighting the value of real or synthetic data that demonstrates the long-tail behaviors nominal datasets rarely contain. Code and data will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: ReactBench-AD发现驾驶视觉语言动作模型与世界动作模型对突发障碍反应偏弱，但少量微调可改善。
AI.motivation: 现有驾驶基准以常规场景为主，难以验证模型对安全关键长尾危险的应对能力。
AI.method: 在真实驾驶场景的多视角与历史帧中一致插入行人或车辆，构建像素级反事实配对并评测六个模型。
AI.result: 四个视觉语言动作模型和两个世界动作模型普遍反应微弱；ReCogDrive短期微调后反应明显改善并泛化至真实场景。
AI.conclusion: 现成模型的长尾能力仍需审慎评估，而展示危险应对行为的少量额外数据可有效补足这一能力。

title: GEM-MM: Reducing VLM Hallucination with Entropy-Guided Preference Alignment
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are routinely aligned with offline pairwise RLHF objectives, but multimodal preference data is scarce and treats every response token as equally informative. Under a small preference budget, pair construction becomes nearly irrelevant: standard DPO-style, image-conditional, and self-improvement objectives all perform within 1.1 points on MM-RLHF metrics and 0.5 points on hallucination rates, matching the SFT baseline. We call this entropy-blind preference optimization: the learning signal ignores policy uncertainty, which in chain-of-thought VLMs concentrates on specific fork tokens where visual claims are made. We introduce GEM-MM, extending entropy-guided preference modeling to VLMs. It samples on-policy candidates, rewards high-entropy reasoning forks, penalizes uncertain final answers, and updates the model via group-normalized policy gradients. On a 3000-prompt MM-RLHF budget with Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct, GEM-MM achieves the best entropy-depth preference score (61.7% vs. 57.3-58.4% baselines) and implicit-reward accuracy (41.4%). Crucially, it reduces AMBER hallucination from 23.4-24.0 to 20.6 and CHAIR from 5.0-5.1 to 4.6 at matched caption coverage. It also ranks best on all three HallusionBench granularities, with a conservative operating point raising the near-chosen rate to 62.4%. An off-the-shelf multimodal reward model ranks GEM-MM first, and two such models independently confirm our main ablations (p < 0.001). We report confidence intervals, paired significance tests, metric-reward functional overlaps, and document a collapse mode when exceeding the fair budget. Code and evaluation harness: this https URL

AI.tldr: GEM-MM通过熵引导偏好对齐，在有限多模态偏好预算下减少视觉语言模型幻觉。
AI.motivation: 稀缺偏好数据下，传统偏好优化忽略词元不确定性，难以聚焦形成视觉判断的关键推理分叉。
AI.method: 采样当前策略候选，奖励高熵推理分叉、惩罚不确定最终答案，并采用组归一化策略梯度更新。
AI.result: 使用3000条提示时，GEM-MM将AMBER幻觉指标从23.4—24.0降至20.6，CHAIR从5.0—5.1降至4.6。
AI.conclusion: 在相同预算与描述覆盖率下，针对不确定性分配学习信号比不区分熵的偏好优化更能减少幻觉。

title: D'BEAST: Logged Bad Experiences as Explanation for Autonomous Driving Agents
summary: Reinforcement learning agents learn from mistakes, yet their decisions can be difficult to trace back to those experiences. We investigate whether a tabular agent's decisions can be explained by its bad experiences, defined as the training transitions associated with safety or task events. A fixed training log is replayed from the same initial Q-table under three conditions. FULL retains all updates, SKIP omits bad-experience updates, and NEUTRALIZE retains those updates without their event penalties. We illustrate the method on six classic Markov decision processes and evaluate it in closed-loop driving in CARLA. On the full driving task, FULL reached the goal from 33 of 40 test starts, whereas SKIP and NEUTRALIZE reached it from none, indicating that the bad experiences carry decision-relevant information. At the local level, for 47 decisions shortly before a failure of SKIP or NEUTRALIZE, removing or neutralizing a small group of bad experiences, with a median size of one, caused the trained agent to select the failing policy's action in 46 cases. For this agent, the results indicate that its decisions can be explained by its bad experiences.

AI.tldr: 通过重放训练日志中的不良经历，研究解释了表格强化学习驾驶智能体的决策来源。
AI.motivation: 强化学习智能体能从错误中学习，但其决策难以追溯到具体训练经历。
AI.method: 从相同初始Q表重放日志，对比保留、跳过及消除不良经历惩罚三种条件。
AI.result: 完整训练在40个起点中成功33次，另两种均为零；移除少量不良经历在47次决策中有46次诱发失败动作。
AI.conclusion: 对所研究智能体，不良经历包含决策相关信息，可用于解释其行为。

title: Improving fine-grained expressivity of graph neural networks
summary: This thesis investigates the expressive power of neural networks for structured data, focusing on graph neural networks and symmetry-aware architectures. We present four main contributions. First, we characterize the generic expressive power of geometric message-passing neural networks on sparse graphs and introduce EGenNet, an architecture achieving the corresponding guarantees. Second, we use representation theory to characterize linear layers equivariant to multiple permutations, including wreath-product symmetries. Third, we study permutation-invariant set representations that preserve containment, establish dimensional bounds and impossibility results, and introduce MASNet. Finally, we propose FSW-GNN, a message-passing architecture combining strong expressivity and bi-Lipschitz stability guarantees with strong empirical performance on long-range graph-learning tasks. Together, these results provide a broader understanding of how neural architectures can preserve the geometric, algebraic, order-theoretic, and metric structure of their inputs.

AI.tldr: 论文从几何、对称性、集合包含关系与稳定性四方面推进图神经网络等结构化模型的表达能力研究。
AI.motivation: 需要理解神经架构如何在表达能力提升的同时保留输入的多种结构。
AI.method: 结合几何消息传递、表示论及集合表示分析，提出EGenNet、MASNet和FSW-GNN。
AI.result: 给出表达能力保证、等变线性层刻画、维度界与不可能性结果，FSW-GNN兼具双利普希茨稳定性及长程任务表现。
AI.conclusion: 这些成果拓展了对神经架构保留几何、代数、序与度量结构的理解。

title: FastGRN: Few-Step Generative Refinement Networks
summary: Generative Refinement Networks (GRN) generate an image by repeatedly re-predicting and refining every token of a discrete latent. They reach high fidelity, but need dozens of Markov steps. We therefore train few-step GRNs on the distribution of their own samples. We use its own uniform-state corruption to perform distribution matching on discrete tokens, which lets a discrete generator learn by backpropagation, and we pair noise with samples in the manner of rectified flow. We find that the steps of a few-step GRN do not carry the same amount of information or the same repair load. We therefore exploit its discrete refinement during training and build few-step GRNs in three parts. Oversampling samples the student with more steps than it was trained for and refines its judge on these samples. Non-uniform sampling trains only the last step and hands it most of the information at sampling time. Refinement confidence keeping holds on to the tokens the student is already sure of. We train a fast class-conditional generator on ImageNet 256 and, with the same method, a 2B text-to-image model. On ImageNet 256, the 3-step FastGRN beats the FID of GRN. On a 2B binary-token text-to-image GRN, a 4-step student also nearly matches the GenEval of GRN-T2I 2B.
