AI.tldr: FastGRN通过自身样本上的分布匹配和离散细化训练，以少量步骤实现高质量图像生成。
AI.motivation: 生成式细化网络虽能生成高保真图像，但通常需要数十个马尔可夫步骤。
AI.method: 结合均匀状态扰动分布匹配、类整流流噪声配对、过采样、非均匀采样及高置信词元保留。
AI.result: 三步FastGRN在ImageNet 256上的FID优于GRN，四步20亿参数文生图学生模型的GenEval接近原模型。
AI.conclusion: 利用各细化步骤的信息量与修复负担差异，可显著减少生成步数并保持较强质量。

title: acuSimNet: Multi-View Self-Occlusion-Awared Visibility Learning for Cranio-Cervical Acupuncture Points
summary: The localization of acupuncture points (acupoints) in Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) presents unique challenges since they are defined by abstract principles rather than distinct anatomical landmarks. Existing approaches are typically constrained to single view or rely on indirect calculations of relative positions with respect to other landmarks, thereby overlooking human anatomical variations. Furthermore, acupoint visibility assessment, which determins whether points are occluded by human itself, hair, clothing, or other objects, has received limited attention in practical applications. Acupoint localization itself does not require 3D reconstruction, but inferring their occlusion relationships with anatomical surfaces does, which adds computational cost and limits real-time inference. In this work, we introduce acuSimNet, an efficient hierarchical multi-task learning architecture for multi-view, self-occlusion-aware visibility prediction of acupoints, achieving 99.97% accuracy on the validation set. Our approach also addresses the challenges of high-dimensional classification (174 acupoints in cervicocranial region), negative convergence issues for visible acupoints, and inter-task scheduling optimization, resulting in substantially accelerated convergence. We improved the training efficiency from the exisiting methods of 3000 epochs to achieve 99% validation accuracy, to our optimized framework achieving 90% accuracy in 39 epochs and 99% accuracy in 86 epochs. This architecture overcomes the limitations of existing methods, could enable practical applications in acupoints detection and visualization, advancing the automation of TCM.

AI.tldr: acuSimNet以分层多任务学习高效预测多视角颅颈部穴位的自遮挡可见性。
AI.motivation: 现有穴位方法受单视角和间接定位限制，且对遮挡判断及其计算成本关注不足。
AI.method: 构建面向174个颅颈部穴位的分层多任务架构，优化可见穴位收敛问题与任务调度。
AI.result: 验证准确率达99.97%，39轮达90%、86轮达99%，而已有方法达到99%需3000轮。
AI.conclusion: 该架构提升了穴位可见性学习效率，有望支持穴位检测、可视化及中医自动化应用。

title: The Grid's Own Language: A Common Information Model Layer for LLM Grid Assistants
summary: Assistants built on large language models (LLMs) are entering power system operation. Current designs delegate computations to validated solvers, but the agent still infers the type, role and state of each element from its name and tool-specific formats, and errors propagate to every study. The Common Information Model (CIM), the IEC standard in which operators already exchange network models, defines unambiguously what each element is and how it connects. We propose a CIM layer for LLM grid assistants and implement it in CONDUCTOR, an open-source assistant. Both the agent and its power-system studies read the layer. It labels the provenance of each fact (stated in the data, suggested only by a name, or inferred from topology), loads operators' CGMES models directly, and builds in $\leq$1\,s on the 9,241-bus PEGASE network. Deterministic checks compare every answer with solver results and the layer. On 37 tasks about the CIGRE medium-voltage and IEEE 30-bus networks, the agent gets right 97\,\% of the graded facts with the layer, such as a unit's energy source or a switch's normal state, against 55\,\% without it. We argue that a CIM layer should be a default component of grid assistants.

AI.tldr: 为电网大模型助手加入公共信息模型层，可显著提升设备语义与状态相关回答的准确性。
AI.motivation: 助手依靠名称和工具格式推断电网设备属性，容易将语义错误传播到后续分析。
AI.method: 在CONDUCTOR中实现CIM层，直接加载CGMES模型、标注事实来源，并用求解器及模型层核验回答。
AI.result: 37项任务的事实正确率由55%升至97%，9241节点网络的模型层构建耗时不超过1秒。
AI.conclusion: 作者主张将CIM层作为电网助手的默认组件，以提供明确一致的设备与连接语义。

title: Towards Agentic Scientific Discovery in Distributed Systems
summary: We investigate when adaptive tool selection helps identify a shared equation across clients with different input coverage. Query-ATLAS (query-conditioned Agentic Tool-based Learning for Aggregating Symbolic Equations) uses an LLM to guide symbolic search from client errors and previous proposals in a simulated distributed system. A four-architecture comparison reveals task-dependent opportunities: relative to fixed PySR-LLM, validation acceptances rise from 3/12 to 7/12 on CRK3 and from 11/12 to 12/12 on oscillator2, while MatSci3 favors the fixed workflow. Across 72 settings in a post-hoc six-task subset of eight development tasks, Query-ATLAS achieves 64 validation and 64 in-distribution passes, versus 62 and 59 for the fixed workflow; both pass 47/60 eligible out-of-distribution tests. The fixed workflow retains lower median errors and cost. Broader query coverage emerges as a promising benefit, motivating task-aware tool selection and client-aware fitting for scientific agents.

AI.tldr: Query-ATLAS利用大模型自适应选择工具，在分布式符号方程发现中呈现任务依赖的收益。
AI.motivation: 需要明确自适应工具选择何时有助于从输入覆盖不同的客户端识别共享方程。
AI.method: 在模拟分布式系统中，根据客户端误差和历史提案引导符号搜索，并比较四种架构。
AI.result: 72组设置中验证及分布内通过数均为64，固定流程为62和59；分布外通过数相同，固定流程误差及成本更低。
AI.conclusion: 自适应选择有望扩大查询覆盖，但应结合任务特征与客户端差异设计搜索和拟合策略。

title: U-HamGNN: a universal model for magnetic Hamiltonians conditioned on spin and Hubbard U
summary: The electronic structure of a magnetic crystal depends jointly on its spin configuration and the on-site Hubbard correction U, requiring a separate DFT+U calculation for each combination. We introduce U-HamGNN, an equivariant network that takes these two inputs directly and predicts spin-resolved Hamiltonians across diverse crystal chemistries. A spectral-hybrid optimizer that weights each update direction by how consistently the gradient points along it reaches 8% lower Hamiltonian error than Muon and 26% lower than AdamW in a ten-epoch benchmark. The predicted bands reproduce U-dependent gap opening and altermagnetic spin splitting within the trained window and beyond it; exchange couplings and magnetic-order calls derived from the Hamiltonian agree with DFT+U on a calibration set. This universal model provides a new tool for magnetic research.

AI.tldr: U-HamGNN以自旋构型和Hubbard U为条件，统一预测多种磁性晶体的自旋分辨哈密顿量。
AI.motivation: 磁性晶体电子结构同时依赖自旋与U，传统方法需为每种组合分别进行DFT+U计算。
AI.method: 构建以自旋和U为输入的等变网络，并采用依据梯度方向一致性加权更新的谱混合优化器。
AI.result: 十轮基准中哈密顿量误差较Muon和AdamW分别低8%与26%，并复现能隙变化及交错磁性自旋劈裂。
AI.conclusion: 模型导出的交换耦合与磁序判断在校准集上符合DFT+U，可为磁性材料研究提供工具。

title: Machine Learning for Near Real-Time Identification of Wildfire Burned Areas
summary: In this article, we present a near real-time method that estimates burned probability anywhere in the world using satellite images. Our approach takes advantage of the state-of-the-art pix2pix model to translate a preprocessed index calculated from Landsat 8/9 images into an approximate of USGS Burn Probability indicating per pixel burn probability. Since this is a machine learning-based approach, it can be automated with a minimum amount of human intervention with significantly less time delays and geographic restrictions compared to other contemporary methods. We include results from our experiments and compare our approximation with the USGS Burn Probability using RMSE score.

AI.tldr: 研究利用卫星影像和pix2pix模型，近实时估计全球任意地点的逐像素火烧概率。
AI.motivation: 现有火烧区域识别方法存在时间延迟、地域限制及人工干预需求。
AI.method: 将Landsat 8/9影像预处理得到的指数输入pix2pix，生成USGS火烧概率的近似值并用RMSE评估。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体结果。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可在较少人工干预下实现自动化，并减少火烧区域估计的延迟与地域限制。

title: Security of Deep Research Agents: Attack Surface, Defenses, Benchmarks, and Agenda Seeding against Research Planning
summary: Deep research and agentic search agents autonomously retrieve content from the open web and generate reports with citations, and their outputs are often taken directly as research conclusions. This paper systematizes security research in this area along four stages, namely retrieval, planning, evidence integration, and report generation. We present a unified threat model, a taxonomy of attacks and defenses, and a review of evaluation benchmarks, and we align the area dimension by dimension with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) poisoning, prompt injection, and generative engine optimization (GEO). Coding 34 primary studies shows that only 26.5% of them involve the planning stage, and none performs an end-to-end poisoning evaluation on commercial products. To address this gap, we propose the agenda seeding attack, in which the attacker writes no instructions and only introduces a fictitious evaluation metric. Across 3,520 sandboxed research runs under the same budget, GEO and prompt injection are nearly ineffective, whereas agenda seeding makes the attacker's target the top pick in 16% to 28% of reports. Injection detection and query anchoring fail against it, verification prompting hurts utility, and our proposed provenance tagging preserves utility but can be bypassed by multi-site bait. Finally, we propose eight research directions.

AI.tldr: 研究梳理深度研究代理的安全风险，并发现无指令的议程植入攻击可有效操纵推荐。
AI.motivation: 现有安全研究较少关注研究规划阶段，且缺乏商业产品的端到端投毒评估。
AI.method: 系统编码34项研究，并在3520次沙盒研究中测试虚构评估指标的议程植入攻击及防御。
AI.result: 议程植入使目标在16%至28%的报告中获首推，来源标记保留效用但可被多站点诱饵绕过。
AI.conclusion: 研究规划存在传统注入防御难以覆盖的攻击面，需要加强来源追踪与端到端安全评估。

title: The Frontier Must Grow - Self-proposed, interpreter-labelled training roughly doubles a 4B model's accuracy on a fresh exam as its verified frontier grows
summary: A model can learn from problems it poses itself when an executable oracle supplies the answers. Qwen3-4B proposed Lua 5.1 programs; those it predicted wrong at least once in four samples joined a pool labelled by the interpreter, each round adding twice as many programs as the last (300, 900, 2100 in total), and each round trained a fresh adapter from the base on the pool. On the original exam the procedure met its registered criterion, an item-level test of each adapter against its predecessor. On a 2340-item exam drawn afterwards, accuracy rose from 8.3% to 16.7%; that follow-up's registered criteria were not met because round 1 gained nothing, while rounds 2 and 3 added 5.0 and 2.9 points on average, both intervals above zero. One fit on the same amount of base-proposed frontier data reached 14.6%, so the rounds' 2.1-point advantage is inconclusive. Three earlier registered series met no per-lineage criterion, and the same loop showed no gain on repository tasks or for a 27B agent in those configurations.

AI.tldr: 模型自拟程序并由解释器标注的训练使新考试准确率约翻倍，但迭代优势尚不确定。
AI.motivation: 探索模型能否借助可执行判定器，从自身提出且容易答错的问题中持续学习。
AI.method: Qwen3-4B自拟Lua程序，筛选四次采样中曾答错的题，逐轮扩充解释器标注池并训练新适配器。
AI.result: 新考试准确率从8.3%升至16.7%，但未达后续预注册标准，且比单次训练高2.1点的优势不确定。
AI.conclusion: 自拟题训练在该程序任务上有效，但早期系列、代码库任务及27B代理配置未显示相应收益。

title: Clinician Assessment of Laryngeal Disease with Auditory AI before Laryngoscopy: A Paired Reader Study
summary: Background: Before laryngoscopy, clinicians assess the likely cause of hoarseness and whether to suspect a precancerous or malignant lesion. Whether voice-based artificial intelligence (AI) supports pre-laryngoscopic categorization is unknown. Methods: We developed an auditory large language model that generates a patient-level assessment card (provisional category, voice-quality ratings, and rationale) and a prespecified malignancy alert from voice recordings, patient information, and acoustic measures obtained before laryngoscopy at one center. We evaluated both in a held-out test set and a later cohort. In a sequential reader study, 32 otolaryngology clinicians categorized held-out cases without AI and, 1 to 2 weeks later, reviewed their initial categories with the card (without the alert). Results: Across 800 paired assessments, reader accuracy was 49.8% before and 56.8% after review (difference, 7.0 percentage points; 95% CI, 1.7 to 13.5; P < 0.001); 99 categories changed from incorrect to correct and 43 from correct to incorrect (ratio, 2.30; 95% CI, 1.22 to 5.31). Accuracy rose 14.7 points when the model was correct and fell 8.7 when incorrect. Provisional-category accuracy was 72% in held-out testing and 67% in temporal validation. The malignancy alert flagged 85.7% and 86.8% of precancerous or malignant lesions. Sensitivity for precancerous or malignant lesions increased from 53.9% to 75.0% after AI-assisted review (difference, 21.1 percentage points; 95% CI, 4.3 to 42.0). Conclusions: In this single-center study, clinicians' pre-laryngoscopic categorization accuracy was higher after reviewing the AI assessment card, although the sequential design cannot fully separate AI assistance from reassessment; gains depended on model correctness without clearly selective adoption. Randomized and external evaluations, including of the malignancy alert, are needed.

AI.tldr: 单中心配对阅片研究显示，查看听觉AI评估卡后，医生喉镜前分类准确率提高但受模型正确性影响。
AI.motivation: 尚不清楚基于声音的AI能否辅助医生在喉镜检查前判断嘶哑病因及癌前或恶性病变风险。
AI.method: 开发生成评估卡与恶性预警的听觉大模型，并让32名耳鼻喉科医生间隔一至两周复评病例。
AI.result: 800次配对评估中准确率由49.8%升至56.8%，癌前或恶性病变敏感度由53.9%升至75.0%。
AI.conclusion: AI辅助复评有潜力，但顺序设计无法完全排除重新评估效应，仍需随机及外部验证。

title: SWAN-Rx: Efficient and Bandwidth-Scalable Neural Reception for MIMO-OFDM
summary: We present a Scalable Windowed Axial-attention Neural Receiver (SWAN-Rx) for multiple-input multiple-output orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (MIMO-OFDM) systems. The receiver improves reception accuracy and reduces forward-pass computation while supporting frozen-weight reuse across bandwidth allocations and channel conditions. It combines a common resource-element representation of received observations and pilot context with alternating time-axis and local frequency-axis attention. Shared parameters and relative positional information permit soft detection across allocation lengths without inference-time parameter updates. At fixed subcarrier spacing, model configuration, and symbol count, bounded frequency neighborhoods give linear growth of forward-pass computation with bandwidth. Evaluations compatible with the 5G New Radio physical layer reuse weights trained on four physical resource blocks (PRBs) at up to 273 PRBs and on unseen channels. At the training bandwidth, SWAN-Rx achieves lower pre- and post-decoding bit error rates than the implemented three-step neural receiver (NRX) and DeepRx-MIMO baselines, with 16.9% and 39.7% fewer parameters and 56.3% and 35.7% fewer forward-pass operations, respectively. The same weights achieve lower pre-decoding error rates than these baselines throughout the evaluated bandwidth-extrapolation and 16-PRB channel-transfer tests, with an estimated 0.4-0.9 dB signal-to-noise ratio reduction relative to NRX at a pre-decoding error rate of $10^{-2}$ in the 16-PRB tests.
comment: This work has been submitted to IEEE for possible publication

AI.tldr: SWAN-Rx以窗口轴向注意力降低MIMO-OFDM接收误码率和计算量，并支持跨带宽复用权重。
AI.motivation: 神经接收机需要兼顾接收精度、计算效率，以及对不同带宽配置和信道条件的适应性。
AI.method: 融合接收观测与导频信息，交替应用时间轴和局部频率轴注意力，并共享参数及相对位置信息。
AI.result: 4个PRB训练的权重可复用于273个PRB，训练带宽下较两基线运算量减少56.3%和35.7%且误码率更低。
AI.conclusion: 局部频率注意力使计算量随带宽线性增长，并支持无需更新参数的带宽外推和信道迁移。

title: Communication-Efficient Distributionally Robust Federated Averaging with Multi-Source Data
summary: Federated learning trains a shared model from distributed client data. The deployment risk is typically specified through two approximations: each unknown local distribution is replaced by its empirical distribution, and the unknown deployment mixture across clients is replaced by empirical or prescribed training weights. Existing robust methods usually address one approximation at a time through local distributional ambiguity sets or worst-case client mixtures. However, joint treatment of both approximations remains underexplored. To address this gap, we construct a global ambiguity set formed by admissible mixtures of client-wise Wasserstein ambiguity sets, yielding a distributionally robust optimization formulation. The construction allows client-dependent ambiguity radii, preserves client-wise separability of the objective function, and yields a high-probability out-of-sample guarantee for the resulting robust problem. We then introduce a penalty-based approximation of this formulation and develop a communication-efficient algorithm called BiDRO-FedAvg, for which we establish a convergence guarantee. We validate the proposed framework through a market-demand prediction simulation.

AI.tldr: 提出BiDRO-FedAvg，同时处理客户端分布与部署混合权重的不确定性，并给出理论保证。
AI.motivation: 现有鲁棒联邦学习通常只处理本地分布误差或客户端混合权重误差，缺乏联合建模。
AI.method: 以客户端Wasserstein模糊集的允许混合构造全局模糊集，并设计惩罚近似与通信高效算法。
AI.result: 建立鲁棒问题的高概率样本外保证及算法收敛保证，并通过市场需求预测仿真验证框架。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在保留客户端目标可分离性的同时，统一处理两类分布不确定性。

title: Decode Early, Verify Late: Streaming Offline Speech Recognizers Without Accuracy Loss
summary: Voice agents need accurate transcripts soon after a user stops speaking. We propose Decode Early, Verify Late (DEVL), a training-free framework for streaming inference with offline ASR models. The server keeps partial transcripts as drafts and verifies the latest against the complete audio in one forward pass at turn end. Under stated input and decoding conditions, the final equals the model's greedy offline output in exact arithmetic. We adapt DEVL to four model families. In our five-recognizer comparison, 95-100% of final transcripts are byte-identical to the offline transcripts, WER stays within 0.13 points of offline, and single-stream time to final falls 1.5-7.3x. Serving Qwen3-ASR-1.7B on one A100, DEVL returns finals a median 22-26 ms after turn end at up to 64 streams, 2.7-3.9x sooner than the official streaming mode. It is the only system we tested that meets a 100 ms p99 target, up to 80 streams on Pipecat-STT and 64 on WildASR.

AI.tldr: DEVL无需训练即可将离线语音识别器用于流式推理，显著缩短最终转写延迟且基本保持精度。
AI.motivation: 语音代理需要在用户停止说话后迅速获得准确转写，而离线识别模型的响应延迟较高。
AI.method: 将部分音频转写保留为草稿，并在话轮结束时用完整音频的一次前向计算验证最新草稿。
AI.result: 五种识别器中95%至100%的最终转写与离线结果逐字节相同，单流最终输出耗时缩短1.5至7.3倍。
AI.conclusion: 在规定条件及精确算术下可保证输出等同离线贪心解码，并在测试中兼顾低延迟与高并发。

title: MARLIN: Multiscale And Directional Sparse Representation Learning for Imbalanced SAR Ship Classification
summary: Despite recent progress in SAR maritime monitoring, ship classification remains challenging due to limited labeled data, class imbalance, large intra-class variability, fine-grained inter-class similarity, and variations in target scale, orientation, and backscattering structure. To address these challenges, this paper proposes MARLIN, a class-frequency-aware framework with directional sparse and hierarchical multi-scale feature extraction for ship type classification in SAR images. The proposed architecture first constructs two complementary representations of each input image, where each views are processed by parallel encoder branches. Each branch begins with a directional sparse convolutional stem designed to capture elongated and orientation-dependent ship scattering patterns, followed by customized hierarchical multiscale feature extraction blocks. To improve learning under imbalanced class distributions, we introduce a class-frequency aware objective. The proposed objective combines margin-based classification with class-frequency-weighted prototype compactness and class-pair frequency weighted margin separation. This formulation shapes the embedding space by encouraging samples from the same class to form compact clusters while enforcing stronger separation for class pairs involving underrepresented ship categories. Extensive experiments on three complementary datasets demonstrate that in addition to being lightweight and parameter efficient, MARLIN improves both overall accuracy and class-balanced metrics, confirming its effectiveness for robust SAR ship-type classification under limited and imbalanced training conditions. The codes are available at this http URL.

AI.tldr: MARLIN结合方向稀疏特征、多尺度建模和类别频率感知目标，改善不平衡SAR舰船分类。
AI.motivation: SAR舰船分类受标注稀缺、类别不平衡、类内差异及尺度方向变化等因素制约。
AI.method: 以双分支编码互补图像表示，结合方向稀疏卷积、多尺度模块和频率加权的原型紧致及间隔分离目标。
AI.result: 在三个互补数据集上，MARLIN兼具轻量和参数高效特点，并提升总体准确率与类别均衡指标。
AI.conclusion: 方向与多尺度特征结合类别频率感知学习，有助于有限且不平衡训练条件下的鲁棒舰船分类。

title: Kolmogorov-Arnold Lookup Table Demappers for Amplitude Phase-Shift Keying over Nonlinear Satellite Links
summary: Next-generation high-throughput satellites increasingly demodulate and decode on board, so the per-symbol cost of the receiver constrains payload power and throughput. Soft demappers for nonlinear satellite links must therefore produce accurate bit log-likelihood ratios (LLRs) at low cost. We introduce a KAN-LUT demapper, a two-layer Kolmogorov--Arnold network (KAN) whose learned univariate edge functions are stored as 128-entry lookup tables (LUTs), so that inference needs only table reads, linear interpolation, and additions. We bound the LLR error introduced by the tables and evaluate the demapper on amplitude phase-shift keying (APSK) links with low-density parity-check (LDPC) coding and a nonlinear traveling-wave-tube amplifier. For 16-, 32-, and 64-APSK, KAN-LUT stays within 0.2 dB of a per-cluster Gaussian log-MAP (LogMAP-CG) demapper, while its cost relative to LogMAP-CG falls from 87% to 27% as the order grows. It matches or slightly exceeds multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) at about one fifth of their cost, remains competitive under operating-point mismatch, and needs only tens of kilobytes of tables. KAN-LUT is therefore a low-cost candidate demapper for regenerative payloads.

AI.tldr: KAN-LUT以查找表实现非线性卫星链路软解映射，在接近参考精度的同时降低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 星上解调解码受载荷功耗和吞吐量约束，需要低成本且准确的比特对数似然比估计。
AI.method: 将两层KAN的单变量边函数存为128项查找表，推理仅需查表、线性插值及加法，并界定近似误差。
AI.result: 16至64阶APSK下距LogMAP-CG不超过0.2 dB，相对成本由87%降至27%，约为MLP的五分之一。
AI.conclusion: KAN-LUT仅需数十千字节表存储，且在工作点失配下仍具竞争力，是再生载荷的低成本候选方案。

title: Consensus-based Economic Dispatch for Self-organized Local Energy Communities
summary: The increasing penetration of distributed energy resources (DERs) is transforming traditional distribution networks into dynamic, decentralized systems, creating a pressing need for scalable, autonomous coordination mechanisms that do not rely on centralized control or full system observability. In particular, local energy communities need to self-organize and coordinate energy schedules while respecting network constraints, especially voltage limits, despite lacking detailed knowledge of the distribution grid's topology and parameters. Existing distributed optimization approaches either neglect such physical constraints or assume perfect knowledge of the network model. This paper addresses the Voltage-Constrained Economic Dispatch (VCED) problem in a fully decentralized, consensus-based manner, without any coordinating entity. We use sparse-group LASSO regression to learn a linear surrogate of nodal voltages from local power and voltage measurements alone. The surrogate serves a dual purpose: it enters each agent's local problem as a voltage penalty and induces the communication graph over which the agents reach consensus. We provide a theoretical bound on the optimality loss caused by the surrogate voltage estimator inaccuracy. Our numerical results, on an IEEE-33 network, show that the scheme reduces the share of bus-timesteps voltage violations from 30\% to below 3\%, while staying within 1\% of a centralized benchmark computed with full network knowledge. We further quantify how the sparsity of the communication graph affects both the optimality gap and the residual violations.

AI.tldr: 提出无需协调者或完整电网模型的共识经济调度方法，兼顾社区用能成本与电压约束。
AI.motivation: 本地能源社区需在未知电网拓扑与参数时，自主协调能源计划并满足电压限制。
AI.method: 用稀疏组LASSO学习电压代理模型，将其用于局部电压惩罚和通信图构建，并推导最优性损失界。
AI.result: IEEE-33节点实验中，电压违规占比从30%降至不足3%，目标值与全信息集中式基准相差不足1%。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法可在缺乏完整电网知识时实现近最优调度，通信图稀疏度影响最优性差距与残余违规。

title: The Silent Cost of Conversation History in LLM Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) in multi-turn information systems accumulate their own earlier replies and a growing task state. We asked whether this conversation history lowers accuracy, and whether process-level quality metrics warn before it does. Each analysis was fixed before its outcomes were computed. In Study 1, on 48 sharded math tasks, retaining its replies lowered final success by 0.21 for GPT-4o-mini and 0.29 for Mistral-7B (Holm-adjusted p = 0.026 and 0.004); Llama-4 Scout showed the same direction, not significant. Study 2 introduces CDR-Stream, 100-turn state-tracking dialogues with an exact answer per turn and per-model difficulty calibration. With the full history, accuracy fell from about 0.6 to 0.1 within twenty turns at matched difficulty, whereas a solver-verified state summary kept it 0.52-0.59 higher (Holm-adjusted p less than 0.001). Consistency and logical coherence fell far less than accuracy, and stability rose. None of these metrics, a paired readiness measure or calibrated single-stream drift detectors gave robust, model-general early warning, although in Study 2 the repeat-based metrics were complete only for GPT-4o-mini. In the monitors we tested, a single 100-turn stream had power only for very large drops. Systems built on LLMs should keep task state outside the transcript and monitor across sessions.

AI.tldr: 保留对话历史会削弱大模型多轮推理准确率，而常见过程质量指标难以提前预警。
AI.motivation: 研究模型累积自身回复与任务状态是否降低准确率，以及过程指标能否提前发现退化。
AI.method: 预先固定分析方案，开展分片数学任务实验，并以百轮状态追踪对话比较完整历史与经验证的状态摘要。
AI.result: 两模型数学任务成功率分别下降0.21和0.29；状态追踪准确率约由0.6降至0.1，状态摘要显著缓解退化。
AI.conclusion: 应将任务状态保存在对话记录之外，并跨会话监测，避免依赖缺乏稳健预警能力的单流指标。

title: Prompt Re-Specification and Target-Mask Availability in Mask-Conditioned Visual Reinforcement Learning for Moving-Platform Landing
summary: Visual reinforcement learning (RL) policies that land a drone on a moving platform can fail when the landing pad looks different from the one used in training. Using binary target masks as the visual input removes most pixel-level appearance information while preserving the spatial representation of the target, and lets a text prompt specify the target. In simulation, we test whether a frozen (fixed-weight) mask-based DrQ-v2 policy can handle a new pad when only the prompt of its fine-tuned SAM 3 detector changes. A banana-themed pad lowered landing success from 75.6% to 12.0%, and SAM 3 rarely detected it under the original prompt. A revised prompt, chosen after testing several candidates, restored success to 68.4% with no weight updates. In a separate experiment with a policy trained on ground-truth masks, filling in masks that were missing while the pad was visible helped landing far more than the tested mask-centroid and area corrections. Tracking the pad over time supplied masks more often and also kept producing them after the pad was confirmed absent from the rendered image, but it did not establish a reliable improvement in landing success. Whether a usable mask reaches the policy at all thus appears to be an important limiting factor for this approach.

AI.tldr: 仿真中仅修改目标检测提示即可显著恢复无人机对新外观平台的降落能力，掩码可用性是关键限制。
AI.motivation: 移动平台外观变化可能导致视觉强化学习降落失败，需检验掩码输入与提示调整能否提升适应性。
AI.method: 冻结基于掩码的DrQ-v2策略，仅修改微调SAM 3检测器的提示，并分别测试掩码补全、校正和时序追踪。
AI.result: 新外观使成功率由75.6%降至12.0%，修改提示后回升至68.4%；补全缺失掩码比所测位置与面积校正更有效。
AI.conclusion: 无需更新权重的提示调整具有适应潜力，但策略能否获得可用掩码仍是重要瓶颈，追踪未显示可靠收益。

title: SGIP: Learning Scene-Grounded Interaction Priors for Scene-Aware Human Motion Prediction
summary: Human motion prediction (HMP) aims to forecast future movement from an observed motion sequence, and recent methods have incorporated 3D scene geometry and object semantics to improve long-term plausibility. However, the destination of future motion remains ambiguous in cluttered scenes: the same observed motion can lead to different interaction targets or navigation modes. Existing methods either handle this ambiguity implicitly or rely on auxiliary signals like gaze that are hard to obtain in practice. To address this, we propose SGIP, which explicitly predicts where in the scene future motion will be grounded across both objects and open navigation regions, and uses it to condition future trajectory and full-body pose prediction. This scene-grounded interaction prior is learned via intent distillation: at training time only, a teacher model scores candidate scene regions by combining an LLM prompted with a textual description of the person's intent with geometric motion-scene features. A student model learns to reproduce these scores from only the observed motion and 3D scene, making intent and LLM unnecessary at test time. Across multiple benchmark datasets, SGIP outperforms prior scene-aware baselines on both trajectory and pose accuracy in a realistic deployment setting where neither gaze nor intent is available at inference, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed framework. The project page is available at this https URL.
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: SGIP通过蒸馏场景交互意图先验，在推理时无需视线或意图信息即可改善人体运动预测。
AI.motivation: 杂乱场景中相同观测动作可能对应不同目标或导航方式，现有方法难以显式消除这种歧义。
AI.method: 训练时结合大模型意图评分与几何特征蒸馏场景区域先验，学生仅凭动作和场景预测先验并引导轨迹与姿态。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上，SGIP在推理无需视线或意图的条件下，轨迹与姿态精度均优于既有场景感知基线。
AI.conclusion: 显式学习场景交互先验可提升部署条件下的运动预测，且无需在测试时使用大模型或意图输入。

title: Infrastructure-Based Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Attention for Highway Ramp Merging
summary: On-ramp merging is a typical safety and throughput problem on highways. Without proper coordination, human drivers and self-interested autonomous vehicles may make risky manoeuvres and cause accidents or congestion. With recent advances in connected autonomous vehicles (CAVs) and multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), vehicles can be trained to coordinate for safe and efficient merging. However, in dense traffic, forming an effective observation of the traffic state is challenging. For example, observing only the neighbouring vehicles may lead to locally optimal decisions, while observing the entire traffic can introduce much irrelevant information. In this paper, we propose a transformer-based MARL vehicle control model to address these problems. A roadside infrastructure controller receives the states of all CAVs via vehicle-to-infrastructure (V2I) communication and sends control commands back to them. An attention-based observation encoder is designed where each vehicle can filter the relevant vehicle information from the global traffic state. The proposed model is evaluated in SUMO against three baselines: a model that observes only the neighbouring vehicles, a model that encodes the global traffic information, and the rule-based SUMO model. The results show that our model achieves the highest traffic flow, safety and smoothness. Furthermore, in a four-hour simulation with dynamic traffic demand, our model successfully avoids traffic jams, while other baseline models fail at high traffic flow. We also show that our model remains effective when human-driven vehicles are present. We further show that our model, trained in ideal communication conditions, can still remain collision-free and maintain throughput under realistic V2I communication errors. Finally, we visualise the relevance weights that an ego vehicle assigns to other vehicles in multiple traffic situations.

AI.tldr: 基于路侧设施与注意力的多智能体强化学习可提升高速匝道汇入的流量、安全性与平顺性。
AI.motivation: 密集交通中，仅观察邻车易陷入局部最优，而直接使用全局状态又包含大量无关信息。
AI.method: 路侧控制器通过V2I收集车辆状态，利用Transformer注意力筛选相关车辆信息，并向车辆发送控制指令。
AI.result: SUMO实验中流量、安全性和平顺性均优于三类基线，动态需求下避免拥堵，通信误差下仍保持无碰撞与吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: 注意力全局协调在混合交通与现实通信误差下仍具有效性，为安全高效的匝道汇入提供方案。

title: Does Learning Order Explain Forgetting? The Lie Bracket as an Early-Warning Signal for Catastrophic Forgetting Without Old Data
summary: A network trained on task A and then task B ends at different weights than one trained on B and then A. To leading order this gap is set by the Lie bracket of the two tasks' gradient fields, and Dherin (2023) conjectured that a non-vanishing bracket may be linked to catastrophic forgetting. I test this conjecture empirically. Across Split MNIST, Split Fashion-MNIST and Split CIFAR-10, the forgetting of A is almost exactly the difference in A's loss between the two training orders (Spearman rho = 0.96-1.00). I then ask whether the bracket can predict that forgetting early in training on B and without any of A's data, using only a small summary stored when A finishes: its gradient and its top 20 Hessian eigenpairs. When the old task is well learned and forgetting is slow (task-incremental), this stored bracket ranks forgetting with rho = 0.70-0.81, against 0.33-0.58 for the penalty of Elastic Weight Consolidation, and matches or exceeds re-evaluating A on its own data. When forgetting is fast (domain-incremental), the stored summary goes stale and the EWC penalty is as good or better. The bracket fails outright when the old task is only half learned; I trace this to a residual gradient on A an order of magnitude larger, which makes first-order (slope) damage matter. The bracket is therefore a useful early-warning signal for the quiet kind of forgetting, under a clear condition.
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures. Code and results: this https URL

AI.tldr: 存储旧任务梯度与曲率信息得到的李括号，可在旧任务充分学会且遗忘缓慢时提前预警遗忘。
AI.motivation: 检验任务梯度场的李括号是否关联灾难性遗忘，并能否在不访问旧数据时提前预测遗忘。
AI.method: 在三个拆分图像基准上比较训练顺序，并仅保存旧任务梯度与前20个Hessian特征对来估计李括号。
AI.result: 遗忘与训练顺序损失差的相关系数为0.96—1.00；缓慢遗忘时预警相关系数为0.70—0.81，快遗忘时优势消失。
AI.conclusion: 李括号适用于旧任务已充分学习的缓慢遗忘场景，快速遗忘或旧任务学习不足时不可靠。

title: See the Lives of Stars in a Handful of Light
summary: Galaxies evolve over hundreds of millions of years, and no telescope has ever watched one move. Cosmological simulations make this evolution visible as a sequence of multi-view images, inviting the question of whether a galaxy can be recovered in four dimensions from its images. This setting defeats existing dynamic scene methods, since millions of stars span only a few pixels each, faint populations blend into diffuse light, and free deformations reproduce the images without obeying gravity. We present Cosmos4D, which rests on two components. Gravitational 4D Gaussian Splatting represents each star as a self-luminous Gaussian whose motion is integrated through a gravitational potential and a low-dimensional force field shared by all stars. Luminosity-stratified dynamics give bright stars individual orbits supervised across image scales and carry faint populations with a velocity field estimated from optical flow. We further build a 4D dataset of eight galaxies from four cosmological simulations, on which Cosmos4D outperforms dynamic Gaussian baselines in both photometric quality and physical accuracy. With these advancements, we glimpse eight hundred million years of a galaxy's life in ninety-six frames.

AI.tldr: Cosmos4D以引力约束和亮度分层动力学，从多视角图像序列重建星系的四维演化。
AI.motivation: 恒星尺度小、暗弱星群混叠，且自由形变可能违反引力规律，使现有动态场景方法难以重建星系演化。
AI.method: 以自发光高斯表示恒星并积分引力运动，为亮星学习独立轨道，为暗弱星群使用光流估计的速度场。
AI.result: 在来自四个宇宙学模拟的八星系数据集上，光度质量和物理精度均优于动态高斯基线，并以96帧呈现八亿年演化。
AI.conclusion: 引力约束与亮度分层建模提升了星系四维重建的视觉质量和物理准确性。

title: Latent World Modeling for Point-Cloud Video Pretraining
summary: Masked modeling is the dominant self-supervised paradigm for point-cloud videos. However, it leaks the information it is meant to predict, whether it reconstructs masked points as in MAE-style methods or predicts their latent features. Because point-cloud tokens are anchored at points sampled from each frame, querying a target at its own position reveals where its geometry has moved, in reconstruction and latent prediction alike. For latent predictors, random spatio-temporal masks introduce a further shortcut, as visible frames on both sides of each target allow interpolation rather than forecasting. The pretext task thus reduces to completion. Once the target positions are withheld, a masked latent predictor performs only slightly better than copying the last frame. To remove this leakage, we propose PointWM, a latent world model that turns completion into forecasting by predicting the features and geometry of future frames from strictly earlier context. Each target is queried only with its last-seen position and timestamp, while a latent action learned without annotations is meant to capture the part of the future that the past leaves undetermined. On HOI4D action segmentation with a P4Transformer backbone, PointWM improves F1@50 over training from scratch by 24.9 offline and 29.1 under strictly causal inference. These results show the promise of latent world models as a leakage-free pretraining paradigm for point-cloud this http URL code is publicly available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: PointWM通过严格基于过去预测未来的潜在世界模型，避免点云视频掩码预训练中的目标信息泄漏。
AI.motivation: 现有点云掩码建模泄漏目标位置，且双向可见帧允许插值，使预训练退化为补全而非预测。
AI.method: 仅用过去上下文及目标最后可见位置和时间预测未来特征与几何，并无监督学习潜在动作以表征未来不确定性。
AI.result: 在HOI4D动作分割与P4Transformer骨干上，相比从零训练，离线和严格因果推理的F1@50分别提高24.9和29.1。
AI.conclusion: 潜在世界模型展现了作为无信息泄漏点云视频预训练范式的潜力。

title: Geo2Gcode: From 3D Geometry to CNC Programs through Structured Machining Primitives
summary: Turning a 3D shape into a Computer Numerical Control (CNC) program is still largely manual. For every part, a machinist chooses setups, tools, step-downs, and toolpath patterns. We present Geo2Gcode, which converts a target mesh directly into standard G-code through structured machining primitives. Each primitive couples an indexed machining direction, a closed per-view reconstruction of the target, and explicit tool-radius, layer-height, and clearing-pattern parameters, and compiles deterministically into layerwise toolpaths via signed-distance queries. Most of the fidelity comes from this compiler. A lightweight selector trained with a voxel stock simulator fills in primitive parameters without per-part manual settings, approaching the finest fixed setting at about a quarter of its toolpath length. In simulation on ABC parts, Geo2Gcode reaches roughing fidelity comparable to an expert-tuned commercial CAM setup with a moderately longer toolpath, and clearly improves on a default CAM configuration. Generated programs run in a commercial G-code simulator, and one part is machined on a physical CNC mill. These results demonstrate that roughing programs can be generated directly from geometry without per-part CAM tuning.

AI.tldr: Geo2Gcode通过结构化加工基元将三维网格直接转换为无需逐件调参的CNC粗加工程序。
AI.motivation: 从三维形状生成CNC程序仍依赖人工选择装夹、刀具、切深和刀路模式。
AI.method: 将加工方向、逐视图重建和刀具参数封装为基元，以符号距离查询编译刀路，并训练轻量选择器配置参数。
AI.result: 仿真中粗加工精度接近专家调优商业CAM但刀路稍长，且完成商业仿真验证与一个实物零件加工。
AI.conclusion: 结构化基元与确定性编译器可实现无需逐件CAM调参的几何到粗加工程序生成。

title: FRAAC: A French Multimodal Large Language Model and Dataset forPictogram-Based Augmentative and Alternative Communication
summary: Pictograms are a core modality in augmentative and alternative communication (AAC), yet recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) cannot reliably interpret or produce pictogram sequences. Two obstacles explain this gap: the absence of a standardized pictogram grammar and the scarcity of parallel text-pictogram data. We introduce Retrieval-Augmented Pictogram Selection (RAPS), an annotation method that refines a rule-based transcription system's output with LLM-based concept extraction and retrieval over a pictogram vocabulary, handling cases where hand-written rules fail (named entities, numbers, polysemous words) without requiring new rules. Applied to French, RAPS yields a synthetic corpus of 1.4 million parallel pairs, of which 300k are publicly released. In a human ranking study where annotators order four pictogram transcriptions of the same sentence, RAPS outperforms the rule-based state of the art. Moreover, we show that standard reference-based metrics separate systems of clearly different quality but fail to rank strong systems against each other. Finally, we build an instruction-tuned model that supports interaction in several AAC modalities: it accepts pictogram or text input and answers in pictograms, speech, or text.

AI.tldr: 研究提出法语象形图转写方法RAPS、平行语料及支持多种辅助沟通模态的指令微调模型。
AI.motivation: 象形图缺乏标准语法和平行数据，导致多模态大模型难以可靠理解或生成象形图序列。
AI.method: RAPS结合规则转写、大模型概念提取与象形图检索，构建语料并训练支持象形图和文本输入的模型。
AI.result: 生成140万平行样本并公开30万，人工排序显示RAPS优于规则基线，但参考指标难以区分强系统。
AI.conclusion: 检索增强标注改善了法语象形图转写，并为象形图、语音和文本形式的辅助沟通提供支持。

title: High-Throughput Serving of Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe with Regime-Aware Megakernels and Kernel Fusion
summary: Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe ranks first among open-weight models on the Hugging Face Open ASR leaderboards. Serving it efficiently takes more than fast operators: continuous batching changes the amount and mix of work at every iteration, and the best fusion granularity changes with it. We present a serving engine that, for every pass, chooses between persistent megakernels and chains of fused kernels at crossovers measured offline. On an H100 SXM GPU, throughput of our accuracy-preserving serving peaks at 4,345x real time, 1.39x the peak of tuned vLLM, and is up to 4.39x faster at low concurrency; on B200 it peaks at 6,367x, 1.64x vLLM at the highest concurrency we measured. Word error rate (WER) is 1.91 to 1.93% against 1.88 to 1.93% for vLLM. Within a 400 ms budget for p95 end-to-end completion time, it serves 8x as many concurrent requests. Choosing per pass beats either level alone: 23% higher throughput than always using megakernels at 128 concurrent requests, and 9% higher than always using fused kernels at 8. Opt-in switches, including greedy MoE layer skipping, add 13 to 16% throughput on B200 for offline jobs that can accept higher WER.

AI.tldr: 研究通过逐轮切换持久化巨内核与融合内核链，提升Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe的推理吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 连续批处理使每轮工作量和组成不断变化，固定内核融合粒度难以保持高效。
AI.method: 服务引擎依据离线测得的性能交叉点，为每轮执行选择持久化巨内核或融合内核链。
AI.result: H100和B200峰值吞吐分别达实时速度的4345倍和6367倍，为调优vLLM的1.39倍和1.64倍。
AI.conclusion: 按运行负载动态选择融合粒度可在保持识别精度的同时提高吞吐量，并改善延迟约束下的并发能力。

title: A Geometric Observer for Visual-Inertial Odometry using Optical-Flow Constraints
summary: This paper presents a geometric observer for monocular visual-inertial odometry driven by individual optical-flow constraints. For each tracked point, the bearing and its rotationally compensated derivative give a depth-free homogeneous constraint on the body-frame velocity. These constraints enter the innovation of an observer on the gravity-augmented group $\mathbb{SE}_3(3)$ through a Riccati gain, without estimating depths or reconstructing the direction of motion. The auxiliary gravity state makes the six-dimensional body-frame velocity-gravity error dynamics independent of the attitude correction, and their uniform observability is shown to be equivalent to persistent excitation of a matrix formed from the inertial bearings and their derivatives. Under this condition, the body-frame velocity and gravity errors converge globally and uniformly exponentially, and a gravity-based attitude correction renders the combined velocity, gravity, and reduced-attitude error almost globally asymptotically stable and locally uniformly exponentially stable. Simulations illustrate the excitation condition, recovery from initial errors, and sensitivity to perturbed measurements.

AI.tldr: 研究提出利用单点光流约束的单目视觉惯性几何观测器，无需估计深度即可获得速度与重力。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在利用光流直接构建视觉惯性观测器，避免深度估计和运动方向重建。
AI.method: 将去除旋转影响的光流约束经Riccati增益注入重力增广群观测器，并加入基于重力的姿态校正。
AI.result: 持续激励下速度与重力误差全局一致指数收敛，联合约化姿态误差几乎全局渐近稳定且局部一致指数稳定。
AI.conclusion: 光流约束与辅助重力状态支持具有明确可观测性和稳定性保证的视觉惯性估计。

title: EgoSwarm: Learning Decentralized Robot Swarm Intelligence from Human Swarm Demonstrations
summary: Advancing from individual embodied intelligence to swarm embodied intelligence is a key step toward scalable, general-purpose embodied intelligence. Complex tasks often require multiple agents to divide responsibilities, coordinate handovers, and manipulate shared objects collaboratively. However, existing robot learning methods rely primarily on individual demonstrations, which provide limited supervision for modeling dependencies among agent actions, while collecting multi-robot demonstrations at scale remains difficult. Human egocentric demonstrations offer a scalable alternative, yet distributed observations from multiple participants cannot directly supervise decentralized policies. We introduce EgoSwarm, the first robot learning framework for learning decentralized multi-robot collaboration from human swarm demonstrations. EgoSwarm collects more than 50 hours of collaborative experience using a robot-free multi-person egocentric system. We introduce the Swarm Interaction Packet (SIP) and Swarm Interaction Token (SIT) to recover cross-agent interaction relations from distributed observations and transform this experience into local supervision consistent with deployment-time information constraints. We further propose SwarmVLA, which transfers knowledge of swarm behavior to decentralized policies conditioned on local observations, local history, and limited neighbor messages. SwarmVLA achieves a mean success rate of 72.2% across three categories of multi-robot collaborative tasks. Project page:this https URL.
comment: 22 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Includes supplementary materials. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: EgoSwarm从多人第一视角协作示范中学习分散式多机器人协作策略。
AI.motivation: 单体示范难以监督智能体间依赖，而大规模多机器人示范难以采集，多人观测也不能直接监督分散式策略。
AI.method: 采集逾50小时多人协作数据，以SIP和SIT提取交互关系，并训练依赖局部观测、历史及有限邻居消息的SwarmVLA。
AI.result: SwarmVLA在三类多机器人协作任务上的平均成功率为72.2%。
AI.conclusion: 人类群体示范经交互关系恢复和局部监督转换，可用于学习部署信息受限的分散式机器人协作。

title: Trading Parameters for Accuracy in MambaVision for Chest Radiograph Classification
summary: MambaVision, a hybrid state-space and attention backbone, places most of its parameters in its widest, fourth stage. We quantified what that stage contributes to multi-label chest radiograph classification. The fourth stage was replaced with lighter single-scan state-space blocks adapted from Spatial-Mamba, with multi-scale dilated depthwise convolutions applied to the scan output; the first three stages were retained. Tiny, Small, and Base models were evaluated across nine dataset-scale combinations drawn from two source cohorts: the National Institutes of Health ChestX-ray14 archive (full ChestMNIST and a high-resolution subset) and Indiana University Open-i. At the Tiny scale, replacement reduced parameter count by 35.7% and increased graphics processing unit throughput by 19.3%; the savings came from the stage's dense projections, not from removing quadratic attention. Without distillation, the mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve on ChestMNIST was 0.004 lower than the baseline (95% bootstrap confidence interval, 0.002 to 0.006), and 0.003 to 0.006 lower across all nine combinations. Knowledge distillation from an unreplaced teacher narrowed the gap to the undistilled baseline to 0.001-0.002 and met the equivalence criterion on ChestMNIST, but distilling the baseline with the same recipe improved it by 0.001-0.003, so a gap of 0.002-0.005 persisted under symmetric training. At the Base scale, the unreplaced Small model was both smaller and more accurate. Fourth-stage replacement is a useful trade-off only for Tiny and Small models. These measurements let developers of chest radiograph screening tools weigh model size and speed against a quantified loss of diagnostic discrimination.
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables. Submitted to an IEEE journal

AI.tldr: 以轻量状态空间模块替换MambaVision第四阶段可减少胸片分类模型参数，但会带来可量化的精度损失。
AI.motivation: MambaVision参数主要集中于最宽的第四阶段，其对多标签胸片分类的贡献尚需量化。
AI.method: 保留前三阶段，以带多尺度空洞深度卷积的单扫描状态空间模块替换第四阶段，并评估九种数据与规模组合。
AI.result: Tiny参数减少35.7%、吞吐提升19.3%，未蒸馏AUC下降0.003至0.006，对称蒸馏后仍有差距。
AI.conclusion: 第四阶段替换仅对Tiny和Small构成有用权衡，开发者需在体积、速度与诊断区分能力间取舍。

title: Making Preemption Productive in Long-Output LLM Serving
summary: Reasoning LLMs generate long outputs whose key--value (KV) caches occupy GPU memory for minutes. When memory fills, the server preempts requests, and a preempted request can repeatedly lose and recover its state while producing little new output. We call this behavior KV thrashing. In certain cases, existing systems leave more than a fifth of requests stalled for over a minute. Because preemption cannot be avoided without delaying admission, we ask how to make it productive. We present Stint, a serving system that preserves a preempted request's work, bounds how long it waits, and gives it fresh output after it returns. Stint stores fixed-length KV snapshots in a contiguity-first CPU pool with an exact-extent allocator, and moves them with fused K/V gather/scatter kernels and double buffering. Age-based readmission brings stalled requests back, and protection gives them a turn of fresh decoding before another preemption. Remaining-length estimates from decoding hidden states guide victim selection. On olympiad-math replays with Qwen3-32B on H200 GPUs, no request pauses for more than 50 seconds under Stint and p99 time per output token falls by 50.7\% relative to recomputation in the same engine. The replay as a whole finishes 10.7\% sooner (12.0\% higher throughput), because the requests that baselines starve no longer finish last.

AI.tldr: Stint通过保存KV快照、按等待时长重新接纳和恢复后解码保护，缓解长输出大模型服务的KV抖动。
AI.motivation: 长输出请求长期占用显存，反复抢占与状态恢复可能使请求长时间停滞而几乎不产生新输出。
AI.method: 在CPU连续内存池保存固定长度KV快照，融合搬运内核与双缓冲，并结合年龄调度、解码保护及剩余长度预测。
AI.result: Qwen3-32B回放中所有请求暂停均不超过50秒，p99每输出词元耗时降低50.7%，整体完成时间缩短10.7%。
AI.conclusion: 保护被抢占请求的已有工作并保障恢复后的解码进展，可同时减少长尾停滞和提升整体吞吐量。

title: SAFER: Navigating the Exploration-Exploitation Dilemma in World-Model-Based Planning for Autonomous Driving
summary: An autonomous vehicle must foresee the consequences of its actions, especially in the rare, time-critical situations where crashes happen. A world model offers this foresight, but only within the coverage of its training data, which poses an exploration-exploitation dilemma. Within this coverage a planner can hardly improve on the data, and beyond it the model's errors mislead it. Logs of competent driving rarely contain the failures that would widen the coverage, and agents that learn from interaction gain them only by failing themselves, without being shown what to do instead. We propose SAFER, a framework that learns offline from failures that others make, judged by an expert, and keeps learning online from its own driving. Offline, partially trained agents and scripted, recoverable perturbations Stage failures in simulation, and an expert Annotates every visited state with its action and value, so that much of what the planner explores is covered before it drives. In planning, a chunked latent world model Foresees the consequences fast enough for real-time use, and a risk-aware sampling-based planner Evaluates candidate maneuvers by their return minus a bounded collision penalty. Online, a loop continuously Refines the model wherever this driving leaves the coverage of the offline data. In closed-loop evaluation against the compared methods, SAFER reaches the highest route completion and reward per step on the CARLA Leaderboard routes, 0.95 and 0.77 from a privileged bird's-eye view, and the highest episode reward in MetaDrive, 53.4 in regular and 49.0 in safety-critical traffic. Project page: this https URL.

AI.tldr: SAFER结合专家标注失败数据、世界模型规划和在线更新，改善自动驾驶的探索利用权衡。
AI.motivation: 世界模型在训练覆盖外易误导规划，而正常驾驶日志缺少失败案例，交互学习又需亲自承担失败。
AI.method: 离线模拟失败并由专家标注动作与价值，结合分块潜在世界模型、风险感知采样规划及在线模型细化。
AI.result: 在所比较方法中，CARLA路线完成率0.95、每步奖励0.77最高，MetaDrive常规与安全关键场景奖励达53.4和49.0。
AI.conclusion: 利用他人失败的专家监督并持续在线学习，可扩展世界模型覆盖范围并提升闭环驾驶表现。

title: MT-RGCN-DTI: A Multi-Task Relational Graph Convolutional Network for Drug-Target Interaction Prediction
summary: Prediction of drug-target interaction (DTI) has become a very crucial part of drug discovery. With the increase in the data volume, it has become very important to improve prediction accuracy by integrating multiple data sources. In this regard, utilising multiple resources in the form of heterogeneous information network to address DTI prediction can be rewarding. In this work, we propose a heterogeneous information network based multi-task DTI prediction model which leverages the advantages of relation graph convolutional network (RGCN). To achieve this, the model employs drug-target interaction network, drug-drug similarity network and protein-protein similarity network to construct a heterogeneous information network. Moreover, we use a knowledge graph embedding scoring functions to model interactions between drug and targets, specifically DistMult and ComplEx as decoders over the learned node representations. We performed extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets and compared with state-of-the-art methods. We observed that the proposed model shows competitive performance, thereby confirming the effectiveness of our approach. The codes and datasets are available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 提出基于关系图卷积网络的多任务药物—靶标相互作用预测模型，融合多源关系信息。
AI.motivation: 药物发现需要整合不断增长的多源数据，以提高药物—靶标相互作用预测准确性。
AI.method: 融合药物—靶标交互及药物、蛋白质相似性网络，以RGCN编码并用DistMult或ComplEx解码。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上与先进方法比较，所提模型表现出竞争力，但摘要未给出具体指标。
AI.conclusion: 实验支持异构信息网络与关系图卷积结合用于药物—靶标相互作用预测的有效性。

title: When Valid Decisions Are Not Enough: Evaluating Structural Constraints in Knowledge-Guided Generative Systems
summary: Knowledge-guided generative systems use explicit domain constraints to improve decision consistency and alignment with human-created solutions. However, locally valid decisions do not necessarily preserve contextual relationships in human decision-making. This paper examines when structural constraints improve or degrade agreement with human reference solutions. We introduce HARMONIX, an experimental framework using automated musical harmonization as a controlled testbed for knowledge-guided decision-making. Four configurations share the same Viterbi-based optimization mechanism: a baseline, repetition constraints, functional constraints, and their combination. Experiments cover 19,745 records and 143,634 motif pairs across training and validation partitions. Combined constraints improve reference root-interval agreement by approximately five percentage points in stable structural contexts but reduce it by nearly nine percentage points in contexts involving transposition tracking. These opposing effects are consistent across both partitions, while overall exact chord agreement changes only marginally. Contexts are identified retrospectively using reference annotations; no adaptive constraint-selection mechanism is evaluated. The findings demonstrate that interpretable constraints can introduce systematic context-specific failures concealed by aggregate accuracy metrics. They highlight the need to evaluate relationships between decisions and the contextual applicability of constraints in knowledge-guided generative systems.

AI.tldr: 音乐和声实验表明，结构约束可改善或损害特定情境下的人类参考一致性，而总体指标可能掩盖差异。
AI.motivation: 局部有效的决策不一定保留人类决策中的上下文关系，因此需要检验结构约束的适用情境。
AI.method: 构建HARMONIX框架，在相同Viterbi优化机制下比较无约束、重复约束、功能约束及组合约束。
AI.result: 组合约束使稳定结构情境的根音音程一致率提高约5个百分点，却使移调跟踪情境降低近9个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 应评估决策间关系和约束的情境适用性；研究仅事后识别情境，未验证自适应约束选择。

title: Washout-free synchronization, parameter estimation and uncertainty quantification of echo state networks
summary: Echo state networks (ESNs) forecast chaotic systems for several Lyapunov times. Like all recurrent networks, ESNs require a washout before forecasting, i.e., a phase in which the full state drives the network until the reservoir state synchronizes with the system. At deployment, however, sensors measure only part of the state, with noise and at a lower sampling rate than the training data. We propose a washout-free deployment of ESNs via ensemble data assimilation. In closed loop, the ESN is a Markovian dynamical system; hence, a sequential filter can correct its reservoir state whenever data are available. The filter synchronizes an ensemble of reservoir states, drawn from the training data, with the system, and quantifies the forecast uncertainty. We extend the method to parametric ESNs, to infer physical parameters, and to parallel ESNs with localization, to forecast high-dimensional systems. We test the method on the Lorenz-63 and Lorenz-96 systems. First, the filter synchronizes the ESN with a fraction of the data of a washout. Second, the filter deploys one full-state ESN from a subset of its components, which a washout cannot do. Third, the filter estimates a forcing that is not in the training data, and the estimated forcing lengthens the forecast. Fourth, localization synchronizes a parallel ESN with eight times fewer members than the global filter. Fifth, the ensemble spread signals, without the true state, when the ESN synchronizes and when the filter fails. This work enables the deployment of ESNs from partial, sparse and noisy observations.

AI.tldr: 通过集合数据同化实现回声状态网络免预热部署，并支持参数估计和预测不确定性量化。
AI.motivation: 传统预热依赖完整状态观测，而实际部署通常只能获得局部、稀疏且含噪的传感数据。
AI.method: 以序贯滤波修正储备池状态集合，并扩展至参数化网络及采用局地化的并行网络。
AI.result: Lorenz系统实验中，该法用更少数据实现同步、估计训练外强迫参数，局地化使集合成员需求降至八分之一。
AI.conclusion: 该方法支持从局部、稀疏和含噪观测部署回声状态网络，并利用集合离散度指示同步与滤波失效。

title: A plug-in energy-balance freezing module for transformer frost nowcasting without leaf-sensor inputs
summary: Frost protection requires local warnings where leaf-sensor inputs are unavailable. In the frost literature we surveyed, physics entered machine-learning models through inputs, numerical-model coupling, or losses, rather than model structure. We develop a transformer-compatible module that embeds leaf energy-balance physics in freezing-probability forecasts: an energy-balance temperature reference and a learned residual predict leaf temperature, which drives a multiplicative gate imposing a temperature-dependent probability cap. We mathematically prove conditional monotonicity and an alarm boundary, and test whether placing the same information in the output pathway or in attention yields different benefits. We evaluated 12 hourly leads at 19 Korean stations over five frost seasons, with and without leaf-sensor inputs. In the 2025-2026 hold-out season without these inputs, our time-token transformer (PET-E) achieved a lead-mean critical success index (CSI) of 0.516 versus 0.478 for fixed-configuration, joint-lead LightGBM, with significant gains at all 12 leads, and the fraction of alarms at observed leaf temperatures of at least 2 degrees C fell from 0.087 to 0.051 relative to the unmodified backbone. Across the hold-out and a retrospective 2024-2025 evaluation, the module reduced Brier scores and warm-surface alarm fractions in both the time-token transformer and iTransformer, with no significant CSI decrease at any lead. At held-out stations without static or leaf-sensor inputs, both module-equipped backbones exceeded LightGBM at all 12 leads (CSI 0.468 and 0.467 versus 0.437). In the time-token backbone, the temperature pathway reduced this alarm fraction in all four settings, whereas the attention prior increased CSI in three. These findings link an explicit temperature-dependent probability cap to improved forecasts and distinguish output-side from attention-based embedding.
comment: 45 pages main text + 19 pages supplementary material

AI.tldr: 将叶片能量平衡与温度相关概率上限嵌入Transformer，可在无叶片传感器时改善霜冻临近预报。
AI.motivation: 霜冻防护需要缺少叶片传感器时的本地预警，而既有机器学习方法较少将物理规律嵌入模型结构。
AI.method: 结合能量平衡温度参考与学习残差预测叶温，再用乘性门限制冻结概率，并比较输出端与注意力端嵌入。
AI.result: 无叶片输入的留出季中，PET-E平均CSI为0.516，对照为0.478，暖叶误警比例由0.087降至0.051。
AI.conclusion: 显式温度概率上限改善预报并减少暖表面警报，且输出端与注意力端物理嵌入具有不同收益。

title: Sequential Semantic-Non-Semantic Watermarking: Robustness Against UnMarker Attacks
summary: Advancements in artificial intelligence (AI) have accelerated digital content generation and intensified concerns around fraud, misuse, counterfeiting, and content provenance. Defensive image watermarking provides a practical mechanism for identifying and tracing digital content, but recent watermark-removal attacks challenge its robustness. This study investigates Sequential Semantic Non-Semantic Watermarking (SSNSW), which combines HiDDeN and StegaStamp as complementary non-semantic and semantic watermarking schemes. Using 50 images from MS-COCO and CelebA-HQ, both embedding orders are evaluated, followed by UnMarker's non-semantic and semantic attacks applied individually and sequentially. Results show that both watermarks remain highly decodable after dual embedding, with only limited embedding-order effects. Under individual attacks, one watermark generally remains strongly decodable: StegaStamp under the non-semantic attack and HiDDeN under the semantic attack. Sequential attacks are therefore required to substantially reduce both watermark signals, while attack order has a limited and configuration-dependent effect. The semantic attack also shows a broader effect across the two watermark types than the non-semantic attack. LPIPS remains relatively low in several settings, although qualitative inspection reveals noticeable distortions, particularly in selected facial images, indicating that LPIPS should not be used alone to assess visual quality. Overall, the findings show that combining complementary watermark types can increase robustness against single-stage removal attacks and motivate broader multi-layer watermarking, stronger perceptual evaluation, and further study of sequential watermark-removal strategies.
comment: 13 pages, 16 figures. Preprint based on this http URL. thesis research

AI.tldr: 顺序叠加语义与非语义水印可增强对单阶段去水印攻击的鲁棒性，但顺序攻击仍能削弱两者。
AI.motivation: 生成内容的溯源需求日益突出，而近期水印移除攻击对防御性图像水印的可靠性构成挑战。
AI.method: 在50张图像上按两种顺序嵌入HiDDeN与StegaStamp，并测试UnMarker的单独及顺序攻击。
AI.result: 双重嵌入后两类水印仍易解码，单次攻击通常保留其中一种，顺序攻击才显著削弱两种信号。
AI.conclusion: 互补水印组合有助于抵御单阶段攻击，但仍需研究顺序移除策略，且不能仅以LPIPS评价视觉质量。

title: Locational Marginal Pricing of Compute: Co-optimizing Compute and Energy for Transparent Data Center Flexibility
summary: Demand from data centers and AI compute is growing rapidly and is increasing stress on the power grid. This load could be flexible through user adjustments and provide relief during energy scarcity events, yet today its flexibility is provided through utility call-ups or system-operator load shedding, and is invisible to the users whose workloads are being curtailed. In this work, we propose to quantify and couple the prices of compute and energy in a single optimization problem. The resulting compute price reflects the marginal cost of the binding constraints and decomposes into components indicating which grid, power, hardware, or service requirement causes a price surge. The economic interpretation updates the price with real-time conditions and gives users a signal for potential flexibility provision. The co-optimization ultimately connects compute and energy markets while providing a signal for relief of stress on both the grid and the compute resources.

AI.tldr: 提出计算与能源联合定价优化，使算力价格反映资源约束并向用户传递灵活调整负载的信号。

title: CECAR: Cache & Expert Co-Aware Routing Accelerates On-Device Inference of MoE LLMs
summary: Despite growing interest in on-device LLM deployment, large-scale Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models remain impractical on resource-constrained devices, as sparse expert activation still requires all expert weights to be memory-resident. To address this, we identify three key observations for on-device MoE inference: (a) cache hit rates are fundamentally bounded even under Belady's optimal policy; (b) these bounds are insufficient for low-latency on-device inference; and (c) prior cache-aware routing based on binary cache presence can induce routing instability. Based on these insights, we propose CECAR (Cache & Expert Co-Aware Routing), a MoE inference system that jointly considers expert routing and cache management. Unlike prior cache-aware routing methods, CECAR uses an ML-based cache policy to predict the expected reuse distance of each expert and prioritizes routing and execution toward experts with smaller predicted reuse distances. On the Qwen3-30B-A3B model, CECAR achieves 12.5 tokens/s on a consumer-grade GPU with only 16 GB of VRAM, where non-resident experts are fetched from SSD, delivering a 4.5x speedup over conventional MoE inference and exceeding the decode speed of baselines that keep the entire model fully resident in DRAM. Code is available at this https URL.
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. 24 pages, 5 figures, 19 tables

AI.tldr: CECAR联合优化专家路由与缓存管理，使大型混合专家模型能在显存受限设备上高效推理。
AI.motivation: 专家缓存命中率存在上限，且仅依据缓存是否命中的路由可能不稳定，难以满足端侧低延迟需求。
AI.method: 采用机器学习缓存策略预测专家的预期重用距离，并优先路由和执行预测重用距离较短的专家。

title: QA-CMIF:Accurate and Lightweight Cross-Modal Latent Imputation and Fusion for Fault-Tolerant sEMG-Inertial Hand Gesture Recognition
summary: Fusing surface electromyography (sEMG) with inertial measurements is widely used for myoelectric prosthesis control and wearable human-machine interfaces. In daily wear, however, socket micro-displacement, electrode lift-off, and wire failures often corrupt an unknown subset of sEMG channels through burst artifacts, lift-off shocks, or open-circuit dropouts. Existing fusion networks mix all channels in the first convolutional layer, so a few corrupted electrodes contaminate the entire latent representation, whereas gate-only attenuation of corrupted channels discards the co-activation cues needed to separate fine-grained gestures. We propose QA-CMIF, a quality-aware cross-modal latent imputation and fusion framework that encodes each sEMG channel independently, scores its reliability with a soft gate, and protects intact channels via a confidence-weighted residual bypass, while a cross-attention imputer repairs degraded channels in latent space using the inertial stream and remaining reliable sEMG channels under a bad-channel alignment loss. Across within-subject evaluations on 29 participants from Ninapro DB3, DB2, and DB5 spanning 17-52 gesture classes, QA-CMIF outperformed the gate-only baseline under 50% channel corruption by 1.29-2.65 percentage points, denoted pp, across all three 17-class cohorts with paired-t Holm-adjusted p<0.002, widened this margin to 2.59-4.15 pp on the 40- and 52-class tasks, and surpassed corruption-augmented conventional fusion by 4.61-19.85 pp. Requiring only 0.175-0.185M parameters and 2.45-2.63M multiply-accumulate operations across the 2000 Hz and 200 Hz setups, QA-CMIF saves 46%-55% in parameters and 72%-81% in compute over recent baselines with a 1.44 ms 99th-percentile single-thread CPU latency.

AI.tldr: QA-CMIF通过质量感知的跨模态潜变量修复，实现轻量且耐受肌电通道损坏的手势识别。
AI.motivation: 少量肌电通道损坏会污染融合表示，而仅门控衰减会丢失区分精细手势所需的协同激活信息。
AI.method: 独立编码肌电通道，以软门评估可靠性并旁路保护完好通道，再利用惯性与可靠肌电信息交叉注意力修复。
AI.result: 50%通道损坏时，17类任务较仅门控基线提高1.29—2.65个百分点，CPU延迟第99百分位为1.44毫秒。
AI.conclusion: 跨模态潜变量修复兼顾故障耐受与轻量化，较近期基线减少46%—55%参数及72%—81%计算量。

title: Aerial Person Detection under Edge Constraints: Held-Out Evaluation and Edge-Ground Verification
summary: A search drone sees a missing person as a few pixels, carries a small computer, and shares a narrow radio link. We study person detection under those limits; the primary evaluations were declared before they ran, and later analyses are marked exploratory. In an exploratory comparison, holding out recording blocks inferred from thermal frame identifiers cut recall at a fixed false-alarm target from 32.7% to 12.3%. With nothing tuned on test blocks, a 46,000-parameter detector gated by a contrast cue finds 10.4% of people against 5.7% for the same network applied everywhere. A standard detector, YOLO11n, trained under the same folds finds 54.5% at a similar false-alarm rate for about eleven times the arithmetic, and on our 4K field footage at 117 m has a walking person among its top 16 detections in up to 92% of frames against 74% for our board. Run alone, YOLO11n's thresholds set at one location overshot their false-alarm target 1.7 to 3.4 times at new locations, and its best configuration at altitude cost 4 to 24 standard passes per frame. Re-scoring its 16 best crops (154 KB per frame) with an 842,000-parameter ground model, thresholds frozen on a validation location, raised recall from 44.9% to 53.7% against the same 16 crops with YOLO's own scores; in a post hoc paired analysis over 15 test locations the gain was +8.8 points [+2.4, +12.5]. Pooled false detections fell from 0.86 to 0.64 per frame, but that paired change was not distinguishable from zero. Coverage of a still person in earth tones was very low for both detectors in the clips we flew.

AI.tldr: 研究无人机边缘算力与通信受限下的人员检测，发现地面模型复核可提高召回率。

title: Can decision models extract clinical data from cancer pathology reports? An evaluation of accuracy, calibration, and failure modes
summary: Decision models are a new class of language model that, instead of generating text, choose one option per question from a fixed list and return a probability for every option. They have not yet been evaluated on clinical text. We evaluated two open-weights decision models, Nimble 9B and Tev1 4B, for extracting 25 fields from 1,113 oral cavity cancer pathology reports from a single centre, against a prospectively maintained clinical database. We compared them with two generative models: Qwen3.5 9B, run locally, and GLM-5.3-flash, run through a cloud API. Tev1 reached a mean field accuracy of 0.917 (95% CI 0.913 to 0.920), the same as Qwen3.5 9B (0.918; p = 0.26), and was four times faster (15 s against 61 s per report). Nimble reached 0.862 and GLM-5.3-flash 0.986. Both decision models matched GLM-5.3-flash on simple dichotomous categories. They were weak on measurements binned into categories, on fields whose correct answer was not reported, and on some complex decisions (e.g. involved margins). We found that the main cause of the inferior performance of Nimble's came from asking 25 questions in one request: with two questions per request, its accuracy improved. Pooled over fields, the returned probabilities were well calibrated (expected calibration error 0.022 and 0.026), but they did not flag systematic errors within single fields. A simulated strategy of sending answers with a probability below 0.94 to GLM-5.3-flash raised Tev1's accuracy to 0.982, with 38% of answers escalated. Decision models can extract explicitly stated findings from pathology reports quickly on local hardware and return useful probabilities. They should be validated in the configuration in which they will be used, restricted to the fields in which they are reliable, and combined with other methods for numeric values.

AI.tldr: 决策模型可快速提取病理报告中的明确发现，但复杂字段仍需验证及其他方法辅助。
AI.motivation: 决策模型能返回固定选项及概率，但其临床文本提取能力尚未得到评估。
AI.method: 以单中心1113份口腔癌病理报告的25个字段，比较两种决策模型与两种生成模型。
AI.result: Tev1准确率为0.917且速度约为本地生成模型的四倍，模拟低置信度转交后准确率达0.982。
AI.conclusion: 应按实际使用配置验证决策模型，仅用于可靠字段，并结合其他方法处理数值。

title: CapCover Filter: Semantic Approximate Membership Queries over Embeddings
summary: Determining whether an embedding is sufficiently similar to any vector in a vector store without performing a nearest-neighbor search can substantially improve query throughput in vector-store systems. We study Semantic Approximate Membership Queries (SAMQs), which allow queries to be rejected when no indexed vector meets the requested similarity threshold, while guaranteeing no false negatives. We introduce CapCover Filter, a geometric data structure that summarizes a set of embeddings using spherical caps. Its representation is independent of the query threshold, allowing a single filter to support arbitrary thresholds without reconstruction. We evaluate alternative construction and quantization methods, compare CapCover Filter with competing filters, and measure its impact on query throughput. Across five real-world datasets, at a cosine similarity threshold of 0.95, CapCover Filter eliminates approximately 20--100\% of index accesses while using only 2\% of the raw (FP32) embedding memory. When placed before a FAISS flat index, it improves query throughput by up to 382\% and by approximately 116\% on average across the five datasets, while returning the same range-search result. We also evaluate lower similarity thresholds. Our results show that CapCover Filter can substantially improve vector-store throughput when similarity thresholds are tight, retrieval is expensive, and indexed embeddings are highly clustered. We release an optimized implementation of CapCover Filter and its evaluation framework.

AI.tldr: CapCover以低内存过滤无匹配嵌入查询，在保证无假阴性的同时提高向量库吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 若无需近邻搜索即可排除不存在相似向量的查询，可减少向量索引访问开销。
AI.method: 用球面帽概括嵌入集合，构建独立于查询阈值的过滤器，并评估构建与量化方案。
AI.result: 五个数据集上，0.95阈值时仅用原始嵌入2%的内存，吞吐量平均提升约116%。
AI.conclusion: 在相似度阈值严格、检索昂贵且嵌入高度聚集时，该过滤器可显著提高吞吐量。

title: Cleanly-DINO: Efficiently Learning Visual Task Spaces for Robotics
authors: José Arce y de la Borbolla
summary: Learning manipulation tasks from few demonstrations requires abstractions that capture the changes relevant to task completion, such as object poses in rigid-body manipulation. However, tasks such as cleaning are defined by changes in visual state rather than object pose, making the choice of task representation less clear. In this work, we propose Cleanly-DINO to learn visual task spaces from few demonstrations. Given a mask of a task-relevant region and frozen ViT features, Cleanly-DINO fits a projection to isolate a task space and fit a progression metric to it. We train the model on diverse cleaning examples and evaluate its ability to localize incomplete task regions and transfer across visual domains. We also study its utility for robot learning by using it as an observation encoder and reward signal in a reinforcement learning setting. Finally, we deploy our fitted model within a real-world robotic wiping pipeline to evaluate its use in guiding task execution.
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, accepted at COMPOGEN Workshop CoRL 2026, Austin, USA

AI.tldr: Cleanly-DINO利用少量示范学习视觉任务空间，用于表征清洁进度并支持机器人操作。
AI.motivation: 清洁任务依赖视觉状态而非物体位姿变化，适合少量示范学习的任务表征尚不明确。
AI.method: 结合任务区域掩码与冻结的ViT特征拟合投影和进度度量，并开展迁移、强化学习及实机评估。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体结果。
AI.conclusion: 该研究探索将学习到的视觉任务空间用于未完成区域定位及真实机器人擦拭引导。

title: Can AI Judge You? An Empirical Audit of Deployment Readiness in LLM-assisted Hiring Systems
summary: Delegating resume screening to large language models (LLMs) requires organizations to establish whether they can distinguish candidates by relevant qualifications while allowing only authorized users to change screening rules or approve exceptions. To this end, we develop a system architecture that separates candidate evidence, evaluation, permission controls, and assessment record, and empirically examine two complementary dimensions of its deployment readiness. First, we assess its operational readiness on four LLMs using a controlled experiment on 210 resumes across 14 job roles and six decision interfaces. Second, we assess its compliance readiness by testing how it handles unauthorized user requests and instructions embedded in resumes. We find that operational performance depends on the choice of evaluation interface: scalar scores generally distinguish qualification changes better than simple pass/fail judgments, while comparative judgments are sensitive to presentation order. Explicit permission rules and separation of resume content from instructions reduce unauthorized compliance, to a varying degree of effectiveness across LLMs and usage contexts. Finally, we find that LLM evaluators often diverge between their decisions and offered justifications. Going beyond simply evaluating LLMs for hiring tasks, our framework supports an audit of a fully configured resume evaluation system to enable its deployment decision.

AI.tldr: 招聘大模型系统的部署就绪程度取决于评估接口、权限控制及决策解释的一致性。
AI.motivation: 自动简历筛选既需辨别相关资质，也需确保只有授权用户能修改规则或批准例外。
AI.method: 分离候选人证据、评估、权限与记录，在四种模型上测试210份简历及越权请求和嵌入指令。
AI.result: 标量评分通常比通过与否判断更能区分资质，比较判断受顺序影响，权限隔离可减少越权服从。
AI.conclusion: 部署决策应审计完整配置系统，并关注权限防护效果及模型决策与解释之间的偏离。

title: HEAMS: Holistic Evaluation of Agent Memory Systems
summary: Memory systems allow AI agents to persist information across interactions, making them more personalized and more capable on long-horizon tasks. This persistence introduces new risks: stored information can be disclosed in inappropriate contexts, resist correction or deletion, be retained beyond what users desire, or be poisoned to influence later agent behaviour. Yet memory systems are typically evaluated on task performance and efficiency alone. We argue that a memory system should instead be understood as the custodian of its user's persistent information, with responsibilities that extend beyond helping an agent complete its tasks, and that it should be evaluated holistically against all such responsibilities. We present Holistic Evaluation of Agent Memory Systems (HEAMS), an open-source framework for evaluating agent memory systems in this way. First, we state the responsibilities of agent memory systems as explicit behavioural desiderata spanning performance, efficiency, security, privacy, and user sovereignty. Second, we assemble a benchmark suite that covers these desiderata and acknowledge the gaps that remain. Third, we develop MilaMem, a prototype memory system, and a governance layer that can wrap any memory system, enabling controlled study of memory system design choices. Fourth, we compare memory systems across the full HEAMS benchmark suite. We find that no memory system leads every performance benchmark, and strong performance scores may coexist with poor privacy, user-sovereignty, and security scores. Governance strongly influences results: recall policies can reduce inappropriate disclosure at a cost in helpfulness, while both recall and retention policies improve poisoning resistance. Performance and efficiency benchmarks alone therefore cannot reveal how well a memory system meets its responsibilities. Code: this https URL
comment: 69 pages (26 main text), 6 figures, 29 tables. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: HEAMS全面评估智能体记忆系统，揭示高任务性能可能伴随隐私、安全和用户自主权缺陷。
AI.motivation: 持久记忆存在不当披露、难以更正删除及投毒风险，仅评估性能与效率不足以反映其责任。
AI.method: 建立涵盖五类责任的开源基准，开发MilaMem与通用治理层，并比较不同记忆系统。
AI.result: 没有系统在所有性能基准领先；召回策略以部分帮助性换取披露减少，召回与保留策略均增强抗投毒能力。
AI.conclusion: 记忆系统应接受覆盖性能、效率、安全、隐私及用户自主权的全面评估。

title: Symmetry Fingerprinting with Geometric Learnable Invariants Transformers
summary: Geometric deep learning has made available a large variety of structurally equivariant neural network architectures, meaning a particular transformation of their input causes a predictable transformation of their output. But structural equivariance is a very strong inductive bias that can limit performance if chosen poorly. In contrast, choosing an architecture with low geometric bias necessitates data augmentation to obtain correct behavior; extending the training process. We propose a novel neural network architecture that is soft equivariant; we select a set of symmetry groups and during training the network will become equivariant only to those symmetry groups that are appropriate given the training data. After training we can inspect the network to obtain a symmetry fingerprint that will tell us exactly which symmetries ended up being relevant and to what degree. We show how our architecture and the fingerprinting process work in the case of an image classification task.

AI.tldr: 提出软等变网络，从数据中学习适用的对称性，并以对称性指纹展示其相关程度。
AI.motivation: 固定结构等变性可能因归纳偏置不当限制性能，而低几何偏置架构又依赖额外数据增强。
AI.method: 预选一组对称群，让网络在训练中学习适用的等变性，并在图像分类任务中展示指纹提取。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体结果。
AI.conclusion: 该架构旨在兼顾可学习的几何偏置与可检查的对称性表征。

title: Risk-certified prompt optimization for LLM-as-a-judge guardrails
summary: LLM-as-a-judge guardrails are often controlled primarily through system prompts, yet standard prompt optimization methods target average performance rather than explicit safety constraints. This paper studies system-prompt selection as a constrained optimization problem: maximize benign pass rate while keeping the missed-attack rate below a user-specified level {\alpha} with finite-sample statistical control. The framework combines LLM-based judging, automatic prompt generation, and distribution-free risk certification. This work instantiates it in two procedures: CPS and CRISP. CPS generates a fixed pool of prompts from training data, then certifies candidates on a held-out evaluation set using simultaneous upper confidence bounds and selects the certified prompt with the highest benign utility. CRISP instead integrates risk feedback into an adaptive search, using hard example-guided rewriting and a reusable-holdout interface to steer generation toward the feasible utility frontier.
