Experiments on four datasets covering prompt injection, system-prompt leakage, and sensitive-information disclosure show that risk-certified selection consistently respects the target missed-attack level on heldout tests, while utility improves as the permitted risk is relaxed. CRISP is especially useful when fixed-pool search fails to produce certifiable high-utility candidates.

AI.tldr: 提出风险认证的护栏提示优化，在控制漏检攻击率的同时提高正常请求通过率。
AI.motivation: 现有提示优化侧重平均表现，难以满足具有有限样本统计保证的显式安全约束。
AI.method: CPS用同时置信上界认证固定候选池，CRISP结合风险反馈、困难样例改写与可复用留出集自适应搜索。
AI.result: 四个数据集上，认证选择均满足测试集目标漏检率，放宽风险可提高效用，CRISP有助于突破固定池局限。
AI.conclusion: 风险认证可将护栏提示选择转为受统计约束的效用优化，自适应搜索有助于获得可认证高效用候选。

title: Kernel-Guided Learning of Lifted Sparse Polynomial Models of Nonlinear Dynamical Systems
summary: Polynomial models of dynamical systems enable constructive analysis via sum-of-squares programming. Yet, many physical systems involve non-polynomial nonlinearities which for certain classes of systems may be inferred from the underlying physics even when the exact dynamics are unknown. We show that fitting lifted polynomial models directly to lifted data is problematic, since the exact lifting constraints render the lifted derivatives linearly dependent. Instead, we learn the dynamics in the extended state, i.e., the state together with the known nonlinearities, and obtain the dynamics of the nonlinearities via the exact lifting relations. To avoid the combinatorially large libraries that sparse regression requires when the polynomial degrees are unknown, we propose KINDy, which selects the degree of each component by kernel ridge regression before applying sparse regression to the correspondingly reduced library. We prove that, for sufficiently small noise and regularization, provided the data satisfy a rank condition, the selected degree never underestimates the true degree. On the cart-pole system, KINDy recovers the true degrees at low noise levels and achieves speedups of up to 8.5 over sparse regression on the full library, while in almost all cases yielding models that are at least as sparse and have lower or equal test errors.

AI.tldr: 提出KINDy，通过核引导的次数选择高效学习非线性动力系统的提升稀疏多项式模型。
AI.motivation: 直接拟合提升数据存在导数线性依赖，且未知多项式次数会使稀疏回归候选库组合爆炸。
AI.method: 学习扩展状态动力学并利用精确提升关系求非线性项导数，再以核岭回归选次数后进行稀疏回归。
AI.result: 满足秩条件且噪声与正则化充分小时所选次数不低估真实次数，倒立摆实验最高加速8.5倍。
AI.conclusion: KINDy可缩减候选库，且实验中几乎始终获得至少同等稀疏、测试误差不更高的模型。

title: Cross-Subject Priors for Maximum a Posteriori Estimation of Latent Structure Influence Models in Motor-Imagery EEG With Few Trials
summary: Coupled hidden Markov models such as the latent structure influence model (LSIM) describe how the sensorimotor rhythms of the two hemispheres evolve and interact during motor imagery, but subject-specific maximum likelihood (ML) estimates are unstable when few trials are available. This paper derives a maximum a posteriori (MAP) estimator for the LSIM whose conjugate prior equals the expected statistics of $\lambda$ pseudo-trials from a population model fitted to other subjects. The M-step remains in closed form, expectation maximization keeps its monotone ascent, and ML ($\lambda=0$) and the population model ($\lambda\to\infty$) are limiting cases. The prior strength was selected on 35 subjects of the PhysioNet EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Dataset and applied unchanged to 70 held-out subjects and to BCI Competition IV-2a. With $\lambda=1$ the held-out log-likelihood exceeded that of ML in 61 of 70 subjects (Holm-adjusted $p=9.1\times10^{-8}$) and in all 70 subjects with five training trials per class. A prior learned only from the PhysioNet data improved the held-out likelihood of all nine BCI IV-2a subjects at five trials per class and reduced the error of the joint transition matrix by 61%. Decoding accuracy did not improve ($p=0.17$). Cross-subject priors therefore stabilize few-trial dynamic models of motor-imagery EEG, but they do not improve decoding, which in these data relies mainly on structure shared across subjects.

AI.tldr: 跨受试者先验可稳定少试次运动想象脑电的潜结构影响模型估计，但未改善解码准确率。
AI.motivation: 训练试次较少时，描述双侧半球节律交互的潜结构影响模型最大似然估计不稳定。
AI.method: 由其他受试者群体模型的伪试次期望统计构造共轭先验，推导保留闭式更新的最大后验估计。
AI.result: 先验强度为1时，70名受试者中61名的留出似然提高，外部数据联合转移矩阵误差降低61%。
AI.conclusion: 跨受试者先验改善少试次动态建模，但解码主要依赖受试者间共享结构，准确率未显著提升。

title: Weights & Caches: LLMs Can Program Tabular Foundation Models
summary: Neural networks are typically programmed through optimization, rather than by explicitly specifying their computations. Recent work on weight-space programming suggests that large language models (LLMs) can instead reason about and manipulate neural-network weights directly. In this work, we show that LLMs can directly program statistical computations in tabular foundation models (TFMs), whose parameters enable inference across different datasets. We investigate three complementary settings using GPT-6 Astra, without gradient-based optimization. First, Astra directly programs nanoTabPFN from zero-initialized weights, achieving a mean ROC AUC of 0.849 across 20 TabArena datasets, compared to 0.876 for a pretrained baseline. Second, Astra diagnoses and repairs a signed-product regression failure in pretrained TabPFN-3.5, restoring near-perfect predictions on held-out synthetic datasets while preserving performance on TabArena-Lite, with only a 0.08% average relative increase in error. Third, it writes KV-cache-editing programs that steer TabPFN-3.5's predictions on unseen synthetic datasets, demonstrating transformations such as reversing linear trends and converting sine waves into approximate square waves, without modifying model weights. Together, our findings suggest that LLM-driven programming could complement gradient-based optimization across TFMs' development and usage, while offering a new way to investigate and intervene in their internal computations.

AI.tldr: 大语言模型无需梯度优化即可通过编辑权重或缓存，为表格基础模型编程、修复和操控预测。
AI.motivation: 探索大语言模型能否直接操作神经网络内部计算，补充传统依赖优化的模型开发方式。
AI.method: 使用GPT-6 Astra开展零初始化权重编程、预训练模型故障修复和KV缓存编辑三类实验。
AI.result: 零初始化编程的平均ROC AUC达0.849，修复后合成数据预测近乎完美，原基准平均相对误差仅增0.08%。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型驱动的编程有望补充表格基础模型的梯度优化，并支持内部计算分析与干预。

title: Phase Transitions in Heavy-Tailed Mean Estimation under $\ell_p$ Norms
summary: We study the problem of estimating the mean of a random vector in $\mathbb R^d$ under $\ell_p$ norms, assuming only the existence of a covariance matrix. In the Euclidean norm, the sample mean is already optimal in expectation, and robust estimators are usually needed only to obtain high-probability tails. Our results show that this picture changes for $\ell_p$ norms with $p>2$: robustification is already necessary even for the expected risk. We prove that the minimax risk exhibits a sharp phase transition, controlled by the interaction between the sample size $n$, the dimension $d$, and the norm parameter $p$. In the large-sample regime, the classical Gaussian rate remains achievable. In the complementary regime, heavy-tailed distributions create a genuinely non-Gaussian obstruction. Furthermore we show that the simple estimator: coordinate-wise median of means whose number of buckets chosen according to the geometry of the loss, optimally tracks this phase transition in its expected risk minimax. We also show that natural projection-based median-of-means estimators for general norms, despite achieving the optimal confidence trade-off relative to the sample-mean benchmark of Lugosi and Mendelson (Probab. Theory Relat. Fields, 2019), can be polynomially suboptimal for $\ell_p$ norms even in the constant-probability regime.

AI.tldr: 仅假设协方差存在时，重尾均值估计在p大于2的ℓp范数下呈现极小极大风险相变。
AI.motivation: 欧氏范数下样本均值的期望最优性，不能直接推广至p大于2的ℓp范数。
AI.method: 刻画样本量、维度与范数参数共同控制的风险，并按损失几何选择逐坐标中位数均值估计的分桶数。
AI.result: 大样本区间可达高斯速率，另一阶段存在非高斯障碍，逐坐标中位数均值估计可最优追踪相变。
AI.conclusion: p大于2时，即使只关注期望风险也需稳健化，常见投影式中位数均值估计可能多项式次优。

title: UrbanROI: Causal Modeling for Regional ROI Forecasting under POI Entry
summary: As urban commercial environments continue to evolve rapidly, accurately modeling the economic impact of point of interest (POI) entry is essential for supporting data-driven advertising allocation, merchant onboarding, and regional business decision-making. Existing return on investment (ROI) prediction methods mainly focus on individual ads or merchants, overlooking the interaction effects among POIs and failing to capture the causal influence of structural changes in urban commercial ecosystems. In this paper, we introduce a novel research problem -- regional ROI forecasting under POI entry, which aims to predict the future ROI trajectory of a commercial region after the introduction of a new POI by modeling temporal ROI evolution and competition-driven interactions among surrounding POIs. To address these challenges, we propose UrbanROI, an intervention-aware causal forecasting framework for region-level economic outcome prediction. UrbanROI leverages an Interaction-aware Regional Graph Module to explicitly model competitive relationships among POIs based on user request contexts, spatial proximity, and request-level commercial signals, and constructs structurally aligned treatment and control graphs to simulate factual and counterfactual regional states. Extensive experiments on large-scale real-world POI and advertising datasets demonstrate that UrbanROI consistently outperforms strong baselines in post-entry regional ROI forecasting. The results demonstrate its effectiveness in temporal economic modeling, inter-POI interaction representation, and intervention-aware forecasting, providing support for regional economic analysis and business decision-making in dynamic urban commercial systems.

AI.tldr: UrbanROI通过建模兴趣点竞争与进入干预，预测新增兴趣点后的区域投资回报轨迹。
AI.motivation: 现有投资回报预测偏重单个广告或商户，忽略兴趣点交互及商业结构变化的因果影响。
AI.method: 利用请求上下文、空间邻近和商业信号构建交互图，并以结构对齐的处理与对照图模拟事实和反事实。
AI.result: 在大规模真实兴趣点与广告数据上，UrbanROI的进入后区域投资回报预测持续优于强基线。
AI.conclusion: 干预感知的区域交互建模可支持动态城市商业环境中的经济分析与业务决策。

title: GeoReVis: Learning Selective Revision and Evidence Consolidation for Remote Sensing Segmentation
summary: Recent methods try to inspect and revise masks to mitigate referential ambiguity and localization errors caused by complex spatial relations in language-guided remote sensing segmentation. However, these solutions often lead to Revision Degradation: revising missing regions may introduce errors into previously correct ones. Even a globally better mask can omit correct regions found in inferior masks. We term this Evidence Fragmentation: correct target evidence is scattered across imperfect masks. All masks generated by the model at this time are suboptimal. We propose GeoReVis, which unifies revision guided by execution feedback, Candidate Selection, and Cross-Mask Evidence Consolidation. It learns fine-grained revision from real actions that improve segmentation when executed and learns to select a better mask through quality comparisons between actual candidates, reducing the risk of degradation during revision. The selected whole mask can still discard useful regions. GeoReVis therefore retains all candidates across rounds, partitions their spatial disagreements into composable regions, and jointly reconstructs regions conditioned on the full instruction and context. This makes complementary and fragmentary evidence reusable regardless of its source candidate's overall quality, yielding improved segmentation. We further build a data pipeline to generate fine-grained multi-round segmentation trajectories and derive supervision for revision actions, candidate selection, and region composition from the model's own outputs, extending training beyond whole-mask IoU supervision. We also propose ReVis-Eval, a benchmark protocol evaluating multi-round revision and cross-round evidence consolidation accuracy. Experiments on ReVis-Eval and 5 benchmarks for remote sensing reasoning and referring segmentation demonstrate the effectiveness of GeoReVis.

AI.tldr: GeoReVis结合选择性修订与跨掩码证据整合，改善语言引导的遥感分割。
AI.motivation: 掩码修订可能破坏已正确区域，且正确目标证据常分散于多个不完善候选掩码中。
AI.method: 结合执行反馈修订、候选质量选择及跨轮区域重组，并从模型输出构建多轮监督和ReVis-Eval评测。
AI.result: 在ReVis-Eval及五个遥感推理与指代分割基准上的实验验证了GeoReVis的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 保留并重组不同候选中的互补证据，可缓解修订退化和证据碎片化。

title: RoboKit: Accelerating Parallel Differentiable Optimization for Robot Learning
summary: We present RoboKit, a high-performance, general-purpose toolkit for parallel differentiable optimization in robotics, built on three principles: (i) Performance and flexibility: GPU-parallel multi-seed solvers pair sampling with versatile optimizers, running 2-60$\times$ faster than task-specific baselines across seven tasks; (ii) Geometry, rendering and physics: hybrid and coarse-to-fine representations accelerate collision, differentiable rendering and simulation, optimizing 4096 grasps in 2.97 s; (iii) Integration with learning: costs are differentiable and simulation is parallel, so RoboKit both distills optimization into policies and trains RL; distilled policies run 9-240$\times$ faster at comparable accuracy, and RL reaches a GPU baseline's scores up to 2.1$\times$ sooner on the same simulator.
comment: Accepted to CoRL 2026. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: RoboKit以GPU并行可微优化工具链，加速机器人优化、策略蒸馏与强化学习。
AI.motivation: 机器人学习需要兼顾性能、灵活性以及几何、渲染、物理仿真与学习的高效集成。
AI.method: 结合GPU并行多初值求解、采样与优化器、混合粗到细表示，并提供可微代价和并行仿真。
AI.result: 七项任务中优化加速2至60倍，蒸馏策略加速9至240倍，强化学习达标时间最高缩短至约原来的1/2.1。
AI.conclusion: 统一的并行可微优化与学习接口可在保持相近策略精度的同时显著提升机器人计算效率。

title: Cyber-Secure Wearable, Ultra-Low-Power Networked Sensors for Soldier Health Monitoring: Insights from the CAPSARII project
summary: The CAPSARII project advances a cyber-secure, ultra-low-power wearable platform and Internet of Battlefield Things (IoBT) framework to support real-time monitoring of military personnel and data-driven decision support. The architecture integrates smart-textile sensing, a body/squad area mesh, edge-deployed AI on secure RISC-V microcontrollers, and cloud/federated analytics for cross-mission learning and comparative studies. Two representative use cases--pilot fatigue and warfighters operating in harsh environments--guide requirements, validation, and interface design (including HUD and haptic feedback). As an initial step toward embedded models, we benchmark stress classification on a public wearable dataset: tree-ensemble baselines achieve state-of-the-art performance for accuracy and F1 (e.g., XGBoost: $\mathrm{Accuracy}=0.901\!\pm\!0.023$, $\mathrm{F1}=0.920\!\pm\!0.019$), while a feature-based Transformer attains the highest AUC ($0.963\!\pm\!0.025$), informing feature-engineering and compression choices for edge deployment. Building on these results, CAPSARII employs HW/SW co-design, model compression (pruning, quantization, distillation), and precision tuning to meet stringent energy and memory budgets; it further investigates Processing-in-Memory accelerators for future efficiency gains. A structured gap analysis highlights the remaining challenges: establishing validation standards for physiological signal quality and textile durability; achieving low-latency, scalable BAN/SAN communications under mobility and interference; and deploying hybrid lightweight/post-quantum cryptography with robust device identity and side-channel resilience on constrained endpoints. By consolidating these elements into a coherent, secure IoBT stack, CAPSARII delineates a practical roadmap from laboratory baselines to mission-ready soldier monitoring in both training and operational scenarios.

AI.tldr: CAPSARII整合安全低功耗可穿戴感知、边缘智能和联网分析，规划军人健康监测平台。
AI.motivation: 实时军人健康监测需同时满足严格能耗与存储预算、复杂环境通信和端点安全要求。
AI.method: 融合智能织物、体域与小队网状网络、安全RISC-V边缘智能及云端联邦分析，并探索软硬件协同压缩。
AI.result: 公开可穿戴数据上，XGBoost准确率达0.901、F1达0.920，特征式Transformer的AUC达0.963。
AI.conclusion: 初步分类基准为边缘部署提供依据，但走向任务应用仍需解决传感验证、通信及受限端点安全问题。

title: GlyphAtlas: Disentangling Stroke Detail from Layout for Scene Text Synthesis
summary: Scene text synthesis requires stroke-accurate characters rendered in a specified layout, as well as visual coherence with the surrounding scene. To achieve this, existing methods commonly pre-render the target text at its intended locations to form a glyph image that jointly specifies layout and glyph structure. However, this representation ties the resolution of each glyph to its target region, limiting fine-grained stroke guidance for small, densely packed, or structurally complex text. To tackle this, we propose GlyphAtlas, a scene text synthesis framework that retains the glyph image as a spatial anchor and supplies fine-grained stroke references through a dedicated glyph atlas. The atlas renders and encodes each character or word in a separate cell, decoupling reference resolution from target-region size. We further introduce atlas-anchored attention, which lets each text region retrieve stroke detail only from its corresponding atlas cells to refine the coarse glyph structure provided by the glyph image. This coarse-to-fine conditioning simplifies stroke rendering while preserving explicit layout correspondence. We optimize GlyphAtlas with a mask-weighted flow matching objective and a timestep-weighted text perceptual loss for writing accuracy and background consistency. Random resolution augmentation of atlas cells supports adjustable atlas budgets at inference. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GlyphAtlas achieves stroke-accurate synthesis of small, dense, and structurally complex text, zero-shot transfer to languages unseen during task-specific training, and leading performance in scenes with many text regions. project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: GlyphAtlas通过解耦笔画细节与空间布局，提升复杂场景文字合成的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有字形图将字符分辨率绑定目标区域，难以为小尺寸、密集或复杂文字提供精细笔画指导。
AI.method: 以字形图锚定布局，独立字形图集提供高分辨率参考，并结合图集锚定注意力与加权训练损失。
AI.result: 实验显示，该方法能准确合成小尺寸、密集及复杂文字，零样本迁移至未见语言，并在多文本区域场景表现领先。
AI.conclusion: 将笔画参考分辨率与目标区域大小解耦，可兼顾精细笔画生成和明确的布局对应。

title: How Specification Explicitness Shapes Failure in LLM-Generated Code
summary: When LLMs turn requirements into code, every underspecified constraint becomes behavior that the model must decide during generation. We test when specifications move beyond structure and begin to control generated behavior. In a controlled experiment, 72 participants implemented and revised Python tasks with an LLM under three levels of specification explicitness. The results show a clear break between lightweight structure and explicit behavioral obligations. Lightweight structure reduced hidden-test failures by only 8.7%. Requiring participants to specify constraints, invariants, negative requirements, edge cases, tie-breaking rules, and exception handling cut failures by 47.2% and reduced the number of distinct failure modes by 20.5%. The largest drops were in failure modes tied to implicit obligations. Invariant violations fell by 66.1%, and unsupported assumptions fell by 59.5%. After a requirement change, specifications with explicit behavioral obligations produced regressions in more submissions, but each affected submission lost less previously correct behavior. Explicit specifications also changed how developers judged generated code. Without explicit obligations, participants overestimated generated-code correctness by about 23 percentage points. With explicit obligations, they produced better code but judged it more cautiously. Thus, the lesson is sharper than "better specifications help." Lightweight structure barely helped, while explicit behavioral obligations nearly halved failures, made regressions shallower, and improved calibration.

AI.tldr: 显式规定行为义务比轻量结构化需求更能减少大模型生成代码的失败，并改善开发者判断。
AI.motivation: 未明确的需求约束会迫使模型自行决定行为，因此需检验何种规格明确程度能有效控制代码行为。
AI.method: 开展72人受控实验，比较三种需求明确程度下使用大模型实现和修改Python任务的表现。
AI.result: 轻量结构使隐藏测试失败减少8.7%，显式行为义务则使失败减少47.2%、失败类型减少20.5%。
AI.conclusion: 显式行为义务能显著减少失败、减轻单次回归损失并改善正确性判断，但需求变更后出现回归的提交更多。

title: DoF-Query Transformer for Adaptive Fusion of Egocentric Vision and Forearm HD-sEMG in Continuous Hand Kinematics
summary: Continuous and accurate estimation of human hand kinematics is important not only for intuitive human-machine interaction, but also for capturing fine-grained human manipulation demonstrations that can provide action supervision for embodied-intelligence datasets and dexterous robot learning. However, individual sensing modalities may be insufficient for reliable estimation under varying operating conditions. We present a finger-unencumbered multimodal framework for continuous regression of 20 hand joint angles from egocentric RGB images and 128-channel forearm high-density surface electromyography (HD-sEMG). The framework combines a Vision Transformer-based visual encoder, a Transformer-based EMG encoder, and a degree of freedom (DoF) query Transformer fusion decoder. To account for the varying informativeness of visual and EMG cues across joint DoFs and input conditions, the decoder assigns a separate learnable query to each DoF, enabling DoF-specific and context-adaptive fusion of the two modalities. The framework was evaluated on synchronized multimodal data from 10 participants. Averaged across participants, the proposed fusion model achieved a mean coefficient of determination ($R^2$) of $0.88$ and a mean absolute error (MAE) of $2.80^\circ$, compared with $0.82$ and $3.21^\circ$ for the vision-only model and $0.68$ and $5.13^\circ$ for the EMG-only model. It also outperformed the evaluated representative unimodal baselines and alternative fusion designs. DoF-wise analyses showed larger fusion gains for visually ambiguous joints and viewing conditions, while synthetic visual occlusion demonstrated greater robustness than vision-only estimation. These results highlight the complementary value of egocentric vision and forearm HD-sEMG for capturing fine-grained human hand kinematics, with potential applications in human demonstration acquisition and dexterous robot learning.

AI.tldr: 按自由度自适应融合第一视角视觉与前臂高密度表面肌电，可准确连续估计20个手部关节角。
AI.motivation: 单一传感模态在不同关节和观测条件下可靠性不足，限制精细手部运动捕获。
AI.method: 结合视觉与肌电Transformer编码器，为每个自由度设置可学习查询，实现上下文自适应融合。
AI.result: 10名参与者中，融合模型平均R²为0.88、绝对误差为2.80°，优于单模态模型且更耐视觉遮挡。
AI.conclusion: 第一视角视觉与前臂肌电具有互补性，可支持人体示范采集和灵巧机器人学习。

title: DAPPT: Domain-Aware Policies from Procedural Trajectories for Sim-to-Real Dexterous Tool Use
summary: Sim-to-real RL has achieved impressive results in dexterous manipulation but remains limited to tasks with accurate rigid-body simulation. However, these methods cannot be applied to skills that involve deformable and particles, with which the simulation speed will become too slow for large-scale RL learning. We present DAPPT, a sim-to-real framework for end-to-end dexterous tool-use manipulation skills, e.g., sand scooping, play-dough rod-rolling, without simulating non-rigid materials. Our method learns a domain-aware RL policy by tracking procedural trajectories parameterized by domain parameters, and distills it into an end-to-end domain-aware sensorimotor policy. Furthermore, explicit domain represen-tation enables fast selection of domain parameters that can maximize downstream task performance. We evaluate DAPPT end-to-end on six dexterous manipulation tasks, including sand scooping, play-dough rod-rolling, sand scraping, mouse-wheel scrolling, dispenser pressing, and spray triggering. Our method achieves 1.5-3.8x in task metrics through the best domain parameter and transfers zero-shot to the real world.

AI.tldr: DAPPT无需模拟非刚性材料，即可学习并零样本迁移涉及此类材料的灵巧工具操作。
AI.motivation: 可变形材料和颗粒的仿真速度过慢，限制了大规模强化学习在相关操作技能中的应用。
AI.method: 训练领域感知强化学习策略跟踪参数化程序轨迹，再蒸馏为端到端感知运动策略并选择领域参数。
AI.result: 在六项灵巧操作任务中，选择最佳领域参数可使任务指标达到1.5至3.8倍，并实现真实世界零样本迁移。
AI.conclusion: 程序轨迹与显式领域表示可绕过非刚性材料仿真瓶颈，支持灵巧工具操作的仿真到现实迁移。

title: Radar Panoptic Transformer: Semantic-Guided Mask Queries for Dynamic Scene Understanding
summary: Automotive radar provides long-range sensing and direct Doppler velocity measurements, but its sparse and non-uniformly sampled point clouds pose significant challenges for panoptic segmentation. Dynamic objects often yield only a few detections amid a dominant static background, providing limiting the geometric cues for separating object instances. We propose \emph{Radar Panoptic Transformer (RPT)}, an end-to-end point-based network that incorporates radar-adaptive feature extraction with semantic-guided mask prediction. Its backbone aggregates pose-aligned temporal context through grouped vector attention and learns per-point neighborhood radii conditioned on range, azimuth, and radar cross section (RCS). Point-wise semantic predictions initialize queries at likely foreground detections and guide masked cross-attention through query-point class agreement, producing instance masks without geometric clustering. An auxiliary RCS-consistency loss matches instance-level statistics between predicted and annotated instances. RPT achieves state-of-the-art performance on RadarScenes with $71.6\%$ mIoU and $82.2\%$ PQ. We further evaluate RPT on MAN TruckScenes, where it outperforms the evaluated baselines in a long-range, full-surround radar setting with sensing ranges up to $230\,\mathrm{m}$. RPT achieves real-time end-to-end inference at $31$\,Hz on RadarScenes, exceeding the sensor frame rate.

AI.tldr: RPT利用语义引导的掩码查询，实现稀疏汽车雷达点云的高性能实时全景分割。
AI.motivation: 雷达点云稀疏且采样不均，动态目标检测点少，导致实例分离缺乏充分几何线索。
AI.method: 结合时序注意力、自适应邻域、语义引导查询与掩码交叉注意力，并加入雷达散射截面一致性损失。
AI.result: RadarScenes上mIoU为71.6%、PQ为82.2%，推理达31Hz，并在MAN TruckScenes上优于所评基线。
AI.conclusion: 雷达自适应特征与语义引导掩码预测可兼顾全景分割精度、远距离适用性和实时性。

title: Paying Creators for Training Data Can Increase AI Displacement
summary: Generative AI increasingly competes with creators while using their content as training data. In response, policymakers have called for platforms to compensate creators for training data use and allow opting out. We study how such policies affect creator displacement in a model of a platform where creators choose whether to contribute training data and consumers choose between purchasing from creators and prompting generative AI trained on their content. When compensation is required, the low-quality creator chooses to remain solely as a training data supplier while AI fully displaces her demand, despite AI quality and the price the platform charges for AI-generated content being identical with and without compensation. Without compensation, the risk of losing creators and their training data constrains the platform to set the price of creators' content to preserve their demand. This constraint also prevents further AI displacement as AI improves, with the platform raising AI prices while keeping creators' prices and demand unchanged to prevent exit. Compensation increases creators' payoffs and total surplus but reduces consumer surplus. Our findings highlight how compensation policies for training data can shape creators' economic roles in a future with more capable generative AI.
comment: 53 pages, 6 figures. Previously circulated under the title "Platform Design When Creators Train Their AI Substitutes"

AI.tldr: 理论模型表明，训练数据补偿虽提高创作者收益，却可能加剧生成式AI对其市场需求的替代。
AI.motivation: 政策倡议要求补偿训练数据使用并允许退出，但这些措施如何影响创作者被替代尚需分析。
AI.method: 构建平台模型，分析创作者的数据贡献选择及消费者购买创作者内容或使用生成式AI的选择。
AI.result: 补偿下低质量创作者仅供应训练数据，其需求被AI完全替代；创作者收益与总剩余上升，消费者剩余下降。
AI.conclusion: 训练数据补偿可能削弱平台为防止创作者退出而保留其需求的激励，改变创作者的经济角色。

title: AstroPIE-53: Towards Understanding Failure Modes of Human Pose Estimation in Space
summary: Reliable monitoring of astronauts is essential for safety, situational awareness, and autonomous assistance in space missions. While modern computer vision enables accurate human detection and pose estimation on Earth, its robustness in space environments remains largely unquantified due to limited data availability. We present AstroPIE-53, a pilot dataset of 53 annotated astronaut videos collected from publicly available mission footage. To respect copyright restrictions, we release video identifiers, reconstruction scripts, and dense annotations rather than raw videos. The dataset includes bounding boxes, challenge classes, and human-annotated pose failure tags. We benchmark state-of-the-art person detection and pose estimation models under realistic zero-shot deployment conditions and perform the first systematic failure analysis for astronaut monitoring. Our results reveal substantial performance degradation caused by occlusions, unusual body orientations, low contrast, and microgravity motion patterns.
comment: 4 pages + references, 4 figures. Published in the Proceedings of SPAICE 2026 and i-SAIRAS 2026

AI.tldr: AstroPIE-53以53段宇航员视频揭示地面人体检测与姿态估计模型在太空中的失效模式。
AI.motivation: 太空数据稀缺，使人体检测和姿态估计在真实航天环境中的鲁棒性缺乏量化评估。
AI.method: 整理公开视频并标注检测框、挑战类别及姿态失效标签，在零样本部署条件下评测先进模型。
AI.result: 遮挡、异常身体朝向、低对比度和微重力运动模式均导致模型性能显著下降。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集与系统性失效分析为评估和改进宇航员视觉监测的可靠性提供基础。

title: SWE-CoWork: Benchmarking Coding Agents as Digital Employees in Organizations
summary: A coding agent working within a software organization must establish what to build, collaborate with colleagues, and verify what it delivers. We introduce SWE-CoWork, a benchmark comprising 101 development assignments across 101 real repositories, 11 programming languages, and 12 application domains. Each assignment places an agent in a simulated engineering organization with 26 colleagues who have distinct responsibilities, bounded knowledge, and controlled collaboration behavior. Starting from a brief handoff, agents must recover requirements distributed across colleagues and workplace records, reconcile conflicting evidence, and implement changes evaluated by private executable tests. We evaluate eleven models and find a substantial gap between partial implementation and complete task delivery. The two leading models satisfy approximately 63% of fail-to-pass (F2P) tests but complete fewer than 8% of assignments. Providing complete requirements upfront improves F2P by approximately 16 percentage points for Seed Evolving and GPT-6 Astra, yet leaves complete task success unchanged. Requirement-level trajectory analysis reveals failures throughout the delivery process: Claude-Opus-5.5 directs a mean of 93% of first questions about queried cards to their accountable owners across runs but obtains only 64% of colleague-held requirements. Deferred questions go unfollowed, implementations remain incomplete even after requirements are acquired, and 31% of requirements reported as completed fail their tests. These findings highlight sustained requirement tracking, from clarification through implementation, verification, and handoff, as a key challenge for reliable autonomous software engineering.

AI.tldr: SWE-CoWork显示，编码智能体在组织协作中能部分实现需求，却很少完整交付任务。
AI.motivation: 组织中的编码智能体不仅要写代码，还需澄清分散需求、协调同事并验证交付成果。
AI.method: 构建覆盖101个真实仓库的101项任务与26名模拟同事的组织环境，以私有可执行测试评估11个模型。
AI.result: 领先两模型通过约63%的失败转通过测试，但完成不足8%的任务；预先提供完整需求也未提高完整成功率。
AI.conclusion: 从澄清到实现、验证和交接的持续需求跟踪，是可靠自主软件工程的关键挑战。

title: Ocular Recognition: Interoperability, Multi-Resolution, and Spectrum Challenges
summary: Ocular recognition is typically developed under controlled acquisition conditions, limiting its use in semi-controlled and on-the-move scenarios. A key obstacle is the lack of representative data spanning real-world capture conditions. At a border checkpoint, for example, images may range from low-resolution visible-light periocular crops (RGB) to high-resolution near-infrared iris images (NIR). Using this heterogeneous evidence raises three questions: whether resolution-specific processing improves recognition, how to compare templates from different processing routes, and how to allocate training data across resolution specialists. We investigate resolution-specific processing and parameter sharing using three AdaFace-based architecture families: fixed-resolution specialists; Independent Backbones with Shared Heads (IBSH); and models with resolution-specific front-ends for 40x40, 80x80, and 160x160 inputs, followed by a shared identity trunk and embedding projection. We evaluate each architecture with route-specific training subsets and with a full-pool strategy, in which every specialist uses the complete selected training set. Results reveal a trade-off among same-resolution specialization, cross-resolution interoperability, and common-route re-extraction. Route-specific training produces distinct performance profiles across routes, whereas full-pool training makes route performance more uniform and primarily benefits the 160x160 route. Thus, adding training data does not improve all resolution routes equally.
comment: Paper submitted to IEEE journal in revision process. Abstract reduces to 1920 characteres

AI.tldr: 研究眼部识别中的分辨率专用处理，揭示同分辨率性能、跨分辨率互操作与统一路径重提取之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 真实场景的眼部图像跨越不同分辨率和光谱，受控采集下开发的识别系统难以直接适用。
AI.method: 比较三类基于AdaFace的分辨率专用及参数共享架构，并分别采用路径专属子集和完整训练集训练。
AI.result: 路径专属训练使各路径性能分化，完整训练集使性能更均衡，且主要改善160×160路径。
AI.conclusion: 增加训练数据并不能同等改善所有分辨率路径，需权衡专用处理与跨路径兼容性。

title: Feasibility certificates for DeePC: A set invariance approach
summary: DeePC is posed on a window of past inputs and outputs, so its feasible set is a set of histories and is not available in closed form. We write the DeePC solution as an implicit ReLU network whose weights are built from Hankel matrices and whose activation patterns are the critical regions of the underlying quadratic program. This gives, directly from the Hankel matrices, the feasible set of DeePC as a polyhedral projection, its explicit piecewise-affine control law, and an exact linear model of the history window. We compute three invariant sets of histories: the maximal positively invariant set of the unsaturated linear branch, the region of recursive feasibility of DeePC without terminal ingredients, and the maximal control invariant set of admissible histories. We show these sets are nested and provide numerical examples.

AI.tldr: 通过隐式ReLU网络和集合不变性，为数据驱动预测控制DeePC构建可行性证书。
AI.motivation: DeePC的可行集由历史输入输出窗口构成，缺乏闭式表达，难以直接分析可行性。
AI.method: 以Hankel矩阵构造隐式ReLU网络，推导可行集、分段仿射控制律及历史窗口线性模型，并计算三类不变集。
AI.result: 证明未饱和线性分支的最大正不变集、递归可行域和容许历史的最大控制不变集具有嵌套关系，并提供数值示例。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可直接从Hankel矩阵获得DeePC可行性与历史动态的结构化描述。

title: Streaming across viewing conditions - The effect of viewing distance and display luminance on video quality
summary: The visibility of streamed video distortions is affected by the user's display and viewing conditions, such as their display's luminance or the viewing distance. Distortions become less visible at lower luminance levels or farther viewing distances. However, most image and video quality metrics assume fixed optimal display and viewing conditions, making them insensitive to the viewing conditions. In this work, we demonstrate how existing metrics can be adapted to account for both factors and compare such an adaptation with the metrics that natively model viewing conditions. First, we collected a new video quality dataset, HDR-VDC, which contains streaming distortions in 4K HDR videos. The dataset consists of 12 4K and 4 FHD HDR source video content, each distorted with AV1 encoding and Lanczos upscaling from a lower resolution. The quality loss due to the distortions was measured at two viewing distances, corresponding to 60 and 120 pixels per visual degree, and two display mean luminance levels, varying by a factor of 8 in terms of luminance. Next, we developed a pre-processing framework that lets us adapt many quality metrics so that they can evaluate content across the viewing distances and luminance levels. The framework employs a display model and perceptually uniform encoding, PU21, to account for the effect of display luminance, and perspective projection scaling (PPS) to account for the effect of viewing distance. We used the framework to compare the performance of 35 state-of-the-art metrics. This allowed us to identify a selection of existing quality metrics that can be effectively adapted to account for the viewing conditions.

AI.tldr: 构建HDR视频质量数据集与预处理框架，使现有质量指标能够考虑观看距离和显示亮度。
AI.motivation: 多数视频质量指标假设固定的理想观看条件，无法反映距离与亮度对失真可见性的影响。
AI.method: 采集HDR-VDC数据集，结合显示模型、PU21编码和透视投影缩放，在两种距离与亮度下比较35种指标。
AI.result: 识别出一组选用该框架后能有效适应观看距离和显示亮度变化的现有质量指标。
AI.conclusion: 通过感知预处理适配现有指标，可将实际观看条件纳入视频质量评估。

title: A Matrix with Steps: An Episodic and Procedural Memory Method for Tool-Using Agents and Robots
summary: Agents that call tools and robots that execute tasks are challenged by two shortcomings: they repeat what failed before, and they learn from runs that they only believe succeeded. We describe the construction of a memory that addresses both, built for a production agent platform. Every run is recorded as an episode, and only an outcome confirmed by an external check, a test, a tool result or a person counts; the agent's own claim never does. What is learned from episodes is kept in a memory with two parts: an associative matrix, written with the delta rule, which finds the procedure that applies to a situation; and a section of ordered, addressable step records that answers what comes after a given step, where a step is a goal of the agent, not a motion. Because the matrix sums its associations, it keeps no order and cannot return or delete a single one; it serves as the finder, and order, outcome counts and deletion live in the records. We describe how execution outcomes are stored, how episodes are recalled and used for solving tasks, and the file format that stores the memory. In simulation, a robot that judged its own success and stopped when it believed it was done reported $96\%$ of its tasks as done and solved $35\%$; with external verification it solved $79%$. In a store of $100000$ synthetic episodes ($457$MB on disk), the oldest episode was still found first, no episode from another person's memory was returned, and a success vouched for only by the model was never recalled; a lookup took $16$ms on a laptop and $40$ms on a server node (median). Task outcomes were measured up to about $10000$ confirmed records, where the exact records solved every revisit at the first attempt.

AI.tldr: 提出结合外部结果验证、关联矩阵与有序步骤记录的记忆机制，减少智能体重复失败和误学成功。
AI.motivation: 工具智能体与机器人会重复既往失败，并从未经验证的自报成功中学习。
AI.method: 将运行保存为情节，仅认可外部验证结果，以增量规则关联矩阵检索程序，并用可寻址记录保存步骤顺序与结果。
AI.result: 仿真中外部验证将实际成功率从35%提高至79%；十万条情节的检索中位耗时为笔记本16毫秒、服务器40毫秒。
AI.conclusion: 将程序检索与有序记录分离，并依据外部确认学习，可支持可靠的任务记忆复用。

title: EvoMem3D: Adaptive-Depth Temporal Representation Memory for Multi-Camera 3D Detection
summary: Modern multi-camera 3D detectors increasingly rely on large Vision Transformer (ViT) image encoders, making repeated full-depth encoding a dominant inference cost even though adjacent driving frames are highly redundant. We present EvoMem3D, an adaptive-depth temporal framework that caches the most recent full-depth detector-interface appearance representation as a read-only anchor and combines it with policy-selected partial features from the current frame. A lightweight pre-encoding controller chooses among semantic encoder exits before image processing, allocating shallow computation to stable frames and deeper computation when the visual state changes. To reuse appearance without carrying stale geometry, we decouple temporal appearance from geometric alignment: current-frame calibration defines the decoder geometry at every timestamp, while a motion-conditioned positional adapter accounts for anchor-to-current ego motion. On nuScenes, EvoMem3D achieves 61.50 NDS and 52.76 mAP while reducing end-to-end latency from 364.4 to 168.7 ms (x2.16) relative to standard dense DETR3D. With StreamPETR, it reaches 61.36 NDS and 52.55 mAP at a x1.92 speedup. Controlled studies isolate the effects of current evidence, temporal reuse, memory correction, and adaptive routing, while our audit confirms that the policy learns to distinguish semantic driving regimes.

AI.tldr: EvoMem3D通过自适应编码深度和时序表征缓存，降低多摄像头三维检测的推理成本。
AI.motivation: 相邻驾驶帧高度冗余，但大型视觉Transformer仍重复进行全深度编码，造成高推理开销。
AI.method: 缓存最近的全深度外观表征，由轻量控制器选择当前帧编码出口，并以当前标定和运动条件适配器处理几何对齐。
AI.result: 在nuScenes上取得61.50 NDS和52.76 mAP，延迟由364.4降至168.7毫秒；结合StreamPETR实现1.92倍加速。
AI.conclusion: 将时序外观复用与当前几何对齐解耦，并按场景调整计算深度，可实现高效三维检测。

title: Markets for Compute and Inference: Structure, Financing, and Risk Transfer
summary: Capacity to run large language models is rented by the accelerator-hour, and their output is sold by the million tokens. Both goods now have published price indices, an over-the-counter forward has traded on one, a perpetual future on one is listed offshore, and CME and ICE have specified futures on rental indices that await the United States regulator. We ask what in these two markets can be hedged, by whom, and at what price. Three findings stand out. First, the price that exchange contracts settle on is not the price that drives operators' revenue. Every contract references the published short-dated rental rate, while most revenue, and with it credit quality, comes from private multi-year contracts whose prices are largely undisclosed. Second, the token price and the rental rate are linked by an identity through throughput and margin, but they are different exposures, so a hedge on the rental rate does not hedge the cost of inference; at the measured capability of GPT-5 the cheapest list price fell by a factor of 17 in twelve months, and by far less at lower capability. Third, the demand for hedging already sits in credit agreements, as the years by which operators' debt outlives their contracted revenue. Filings cannot measure that gap, because debt is scheduled year by year while contracted revenue rarely is, and the one loan that prices it settles the risk by cash prepayment against a model only the parties see. We design a reverse convertible note through which leveraged operators could buy protection against falling rental rates. Its coupon depends steeply on the annualised volatility of the rental rate, which the two public indices put between about 5% and 89% according to how each is built and the horizon measured; across that range the fair one-year coupon runs from 4.1% to 31.5%.

AI.tldr: 分析算力租赁与推理市场的对冲错配，并设计保护运营商免受租赁价格下跌影响的反向可转换票据。
AI.motivation: 算力衍生品结算价格与运营商收入来源不一致，租赁价格、推理成本及债务期限风险也难以统一对冲。
AI.method: 分析公开价格指数、合同与信贷披露，区分租赁和推理风险，并为反向可转换票据定价。
AI.result: 公开指数对应年化波动率约5%至89%，使票据公平一年期票息从4.1%变至31.5%。
AI.conclusion: 租赁价格对冲不能覆盖推理成本或长期合同风险，风险转移工具定价高度依赖波动率测量。

title: Right Goal, Wrong Body: Re-grounding Frozen VLAs under Actuation Shift
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are capable of producing desired robotic behaviors in ideal settings. However, they often fail when the robot's actuation changes at deployment. For example, remounting, mechanical wear, or command latency changes can lead to failed tasks and unsafe behaviors. To address the inevitable actuation shift, we propose ReGround, an inference-time method that keeps the VLA frozen and re-grounds its intended motion. ReGround learns the deployed robot's dynamics from task-agnostic motor babbling, and then tracks the policy's intended motion while staying close to the policy's own plan. ReGround activates only upon detecting a shift, and needs no rewards, demonstrations, or retraining. We show via two VLAs, eight LIBERO tasks, and five shift settings that ReGround can restore near-oracle success, such as raising $\pi_{0.5}$'s success from 0.16 to 0.90 under 400 ms latency, while remaining safer than a linear-calibration baseline. Project website and open-source code: this https URL.
comment: Accepted at the SPAIS Workshop at CoRL 2026

AI.tldr: ReGround在冻结视觉语言动作模型的情况下，通过推理时运动重落地应对机器人执行机构变化。
AI.motivation: 重新安装、机械磨损和指令延迟等部署变化会使视觉语言动作模型任务失败并产生不安全行为。
AI.method: 利用无任务目标的电机探索学习部署动力学，仅在检测到变化时启动运动跟踪，同时保持接近原策略计划。
AI.result: 在两种模型、八项LIBERO任务和五类变化中恢复接近理想条件的成功率，400毫秒延迟下成功率由0.16升至0.90。
AI.conclusion: 无需奖励、示范或重训练即可缓解执行变化，且比线性校准基线更安全。

title: TileCache: Serving Multi-Round Diffusion Image Editing with Compressed Activation Caches
summary: Multi-round diffusion image editing can reduce computation by reusing intermediate activations, but retaining these activations across editing rounds introduces substantial memory and bandwidth overheads. Compression can reduce these overheads, but efficient cache construction is challenging: compressing only after editing requires buffering over 100 GB of activations per request. Moreover, the compressed cache must support selective reuse, as future masked edits require only a subset of the cached activations. It also exposes a scheduling challenge, as cached edits are faster than initial generations, causing naive policies to severely delay either initial generations or editing requests. In this paper, we aim to address both challenges through compression-informed serving. We develop TileCache, a serving system for multi-round diffusion editing. It compresses reusable activations and incorporates a scheduler that balances both edits and initial generation requests. Compared with the state-of-the-art image editing baseline, TileCache sustains over 2x the request arrival rate at 90% SLO attainment. It completes edits 2.4-4.5x and initial generations 1.3-2.2x faster than the baseline, while preserving image quality.

AI.tldr: TileCache通过压缩激活缓存与协调调度，提高多轮扩散图像编辑服务的吞吐量和响应速度。
AI.motivation: 跨轮保存激活带来高内存与带宽开销，而编辑和初始生成耗时不同，容易造成调度延迟。
AI.method: 压缩可复用激活以支持后续掩码编辑的选择性复用，并通过调度器平衡编辑与初始生成请求。
AI.result: 在90%服务目标达成率下支持超过两倍请求到达率，编辑加速2.4至4.5倍，初始生成加速1.3至2.2倍，且保持图像质量。
AI.conclusion: 压缩感知的缓存与调度协同设计，可在保持图像质量的同时改善多轮编辑服务性能。

title: Contraction Analysis and Control of Polynomial Dynamical Systems
summary: Contraction analysis has found broad applications in synchronization, tracking, observer design, and nonlinear feedback control. However, establishing contraction conditions for polynomial dynamical systems remains challenging due to their state-dependent Jacobians. In this article, we develop a tensor-based framework for contraction analysis of polynomial dynamical systems by exploiting the structure of orthogonally decomposable (odeco) coefficient tensors. By transforming the dynamics into modal coordinates, we derive necessary and sufficient semicontraction conditions and characterize state-dependent semimetrics. We establish fundamental limitations on exponential contraction and prove polynomial decay of differential displacements on forward-invariant regions. To accommodate more general polynomial dynamical systems, we extend the framework to include linear dynamics and non-odeco tensor perturbations, deriving computationally tractable contraction certificates with explicit robustness guarantees. We further develop convex feedback synthesis conditions based on linear matrix inequalities for general input matrices. We demonstrate the effectiveness and computational scalability of the proposed framework through numerical experiments on both synthetic systems and nonlinear elastic relaxation models.

AI.tldr: 提出张量化收缩分析与控制框架，为多项式动力系统提供可计算证书及鲁棒性保证。
AI.motivation: 多项式动力系统的雅可比矩阵依赖状态，使收缩条件的建立具有挑战。
AI.method: 利用正交可分解系数张量和模态变换推导收缩条件，并通过线性矩阵不等式设计反馈。
AI.result: 推导半收缩充要条件，证明微分位移的多项式衰减，并以数值实验展示有效性与可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架揭示指数收缩的局限，并可扩展至含线性动力学和非正交可分解扰动的系统。

title: Integrating Latent Block Models into Variational Autoencoders for Disentangled Representation Learning
summary: We introduce LBM-VAE, a novel framework that integrates Latent Block Models (LBMs) into Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) to jointly cluster observations and latent dimensions. Beyond its clustering capabilities, LBM-VAE provides a block-structured latent representation that naturally supports disentangled representation learning. In contrast to conventional approaches that associate each factor of variation with an individual latent dimension, our framework allows factors of variation to be encoded across groups of latent dimensions. Experimental results demonstrate the promising clustering performance of LBM-VAE, while achieving competitive results in disentangled representation learning. LBM-VAE highlights the potential of combining co-clustering and variational inference to learn structured and interpretable latent representations.

AI.tldr: LBM-VAE将潜在块模型融入变分自编码器，以联合聚类学习块结构解耦表示。
AI.motivation: 传统解耦方法将每个变化因子对应单个潜在维度，限制了更灵活的结构化表示。
AI.method: 联合聚类观测与潜在维度，允许变化因子由多维潜在变量组共同编码。
AI.result: 实验显示，LBM-VAE具有良好的聚类表现，并在解耦表示学习中取得有竞争力的结果。
AI.conclusion: 结合共聚类与变分推断，有望学习结构化且可解释的潜在表示。

title: Deep Sequence Model for Genome Wide Discovery of Coding and Regulatory Element Signatures
summary: Interpreting deep neural networks for genomic sequence classification remains challenging despite strong predictive performance. We develop a lightweight CNN with post-training gradient-based analysis to identify which sequence positions drive coding versus intergenomic classification. Applied to the standardized demo_coding_vs_intergenomic_seqs dataset, our model achieves 91.87% validation accuracy while revealing interpretable patterns: nine hot spots with consistently high importance, clear class-specific separation at positions 20-100 (coding) and 150-190 (intergenomic), and a strong mean-variance correlation (r = 0.530) indicating robust discriminative features. Gradient-based importance analysis shows that the model implicitly learns biologically meaningful sequence distinctions without explicit annotations. This work demonstrates that neural network interpretability and accuracy can coexist, providing a framework for understanding genomic sequence classification and enabling biology-driven hypothesis generation.
comment: 4 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Accepted at CVIS 2025. A shorter 3-page version was published in the Journal of Computational Vision and Imaging Systems, Vol. 11, No. 1 (2026)

AI.tldr: 轻量卷积网络结合训练后梯度分析，实现基因组序列分类并揭示关键序列位置。
AI.motivation: 深度网络虽具有较强的基因组序列预测能力，但其分类依据仍难以解释。
AI.method: 在标准化编码与基因间序列数据集上训练轻量卷积网络，并以梯度分析位置重要性。
AI.result: 验证准确率达91.87%，发现九个高重要性热点及类别特异位置，重要性均值与方差相关系数为0.530。
AI.conclusion: 模型无需显式注释即可学习具有生物学意义的序列差异，兼顾准确性与可解释性。

title: Continuous-Time Stochastic Contraction Induced by Common White Noise
summary: This paper studies contraction properties of stochastic dynamical systems governed by Itô stochastic differential equations. We consider two trajectories driven by a common noise process and measure their separation using Finsler distances, which encompass Riemannian and norm-induced distances. Two notions of contraction are then investigated: $L^p$-contraction, defined by exponential decay of the $L^p$-norm (or the $p$-th moment) of the distance, and almost sure contraction, defined by exponential decay of the distance along almost every sample path. Each notion is characterized by a differential condition that is necessary and sufficient for contraction under mild hypotheses. Relations between contraction notions and an associated incremental input-to-state stability result are also established. As an illustration, we apply the established theory to analyze noise-induced synchronization and quantify its robustness with respect to parameter perturbations.

AI.tldr: 建立共同白噪声驱动的随机系统收缩理论，刻画矩收缩与几乎必然收缩。
AI.motivation: 需要刻画共同噪声下随机轨迹的距离衰减，并分析噪声诱导同步及其鲁棒性。
AI.method: 使用芬斯勒距离度量伊藤系统轨迹间距，分别研究L^p收缩与几乎必然收缩。
AI.result: 在温和假设下给出两类收缩的微分充要条件，建立其联系及增量输入到状态稳定性结果。
AI.conclusion: 该理论可用于分析噪声诱导同步，并量化其对参数扰动的鲁棒性。

title: Tight Bounds for Non-Monotone Submodular Maximization under a Cardinality Constraint with Constant Recourse
summary: We study the maximization of a nonnegative submodular function under a cardinality constraint when elements arrive one at a time and an algorithm must report a feasible set after every arrival. The recourse of an algorithm is the largest number of insertions and deletions that it makes to the reported set at a single arrival. For every $\epsilon>0$, we give an algorithm with recourse $O(\epsilon^{-2})$ whose reported set has, at every time, expected value at least $1/4-\epsilon$ times the largest value of a feasible set of arrived elements. The algorithm evaluates the function polynomially often, and only on sets of arrived elements. We also show that no algorithm with constant recourse achieves a ratio above $1/4$, even if it knows the function and the arrival order in advance and has unlimited computation, and that any fixed ratio above $1/4$ requires recourse that grows as a positive power of the cardinality budget. Thus $1/4$ is the optimal limiting ratio with constant recourse. The previous best ratio with constant recourse was $3-2\sqrt2\approx0.172$. Our algorithm assigns selection probabilities of at most one half and maintains, as elements arrive, an inequality bounding the value of every feasible set by a multiple of the expected value of a random set drawn with these probabilities; the reported set moves to a rounding of these probabilities through gradual replacements. The upper bound uses a weighted directed graph whose vertices arrive in groups of decreasing sizes.

AI.tldr: 证明基数约束下在线非单调次模最大化在常数调整次数下的最优极限近似比为1/4。
AI.motivation: 研究元素逐个到达时，如何以有限插入删除次数持续维护高质量可行解。
AI.method: 维护至多为1/2的选择概率及价值界，通过渐进替换舍入，并用加权有向图构造上界。
AI.result: 算法以O(ε⁻²)调整次数实现1/4−ε期望近似比，且任何常数调整次数算法均无法超过1/4。
AI.conclusion: 该结果将此前约0.172的常数调整次数近似比提升至紧界，并证明突破1/4需随预算增长的调整次数。

title: Microfitting: Continual Learning via Cached Test-Time Training
summary: Continual learning is a promising approach to specialize language models to an organization's private data. However, current methods exhibit a number of drawbacks including catastrophic forgetting, where new training updates overwrite prior knowledge. We present microfitting, which trains and caches a small adapter for each document. Each adapter is trained once, offline, on synthetic questions targeted at demonstrated base-model shortcomings and reused whenever that document is queried. This method borrows from test-time learning literature and sidesteps the problem of continual learning through parameter isolation, allowing the system to specialize on new data without overwriting prior knowledge. The process that generates adapter training data also improves over time, revising its recipe from previous outcomes and fresh examples of the target workload. On DeepSeek V4 Flash, microfitting substantially improves accuracy over the base model. In Enterprise Document Operations (EDO), an open-book Q&A environment over real-world enterprise documents, our method achieves a 38.2% relative improvement over base-model performance. Microfitting makes continual specialization practical and cost-efficient: a frozen model can adapt to an evolving private corpus overnight on local hardware, without modifying the base model or previously cached adapters.

AI.tldr: Microfitting为每份文档离线训练并缓存独立适配器，实现不覆盖旧知识的持续专门化。
AI.motivation: 语言模型适应组织私有数据时，持续训练可能引发灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: 针对基础模型薄弱点生成合成问题，训练文档级适配器供查询复用，并持续改进训练数据生成策略。
AI.result: 在DeepSeek V4 Flash上显著提升准确率，在企业文档问答环境EDO中相对基础模型提升38.2%。
AI.conclusion: 参数隔离使冻结模型可在本地硬件上适应持续更新的私有语料，无需修改基础模型或已有适配器。

title: Scaling large language model-assisted line-of-therapy adjudication with human-in-the-loop evidence-calibrated selection
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have enabled the ability to scale clinical adjudication tasks traditionally dependent on exhaustive manual review. Line-of-therapy (LoT) adjudication, a major bottleneck in oncology cohort construction, is a prime example. Line boundaries must be inferred from longitudinal treatment histories according to nuanced, study-specific definitions, at every regimen transition for every patient. LLMs can apply this adjudication at scale, but their reliability varies across patients. Treatment histories differ in complexity, and ambiguous or atypical patterns depend on expert clinical judgment. Reliable automation thus requires verified support for model assignments and the ability to identify cases that warrant manual review. Here, we present evidence-calibrated selection (ECS), a human-in-the-loop framework for scaling LLM-assisted LoT adjudication. ECS derives confidence from observed clinician adjudications, prioritizes patients with the least-supported assignments for follow-up review, and returns completed adjudications to the model as precedent. As the evidence base grows, ECS continuously calibrates confidence to estimate residual error, thus enabling more efficient use of clinician time. In simulations on 136 clinician adjudicated patients with multiple myeloma, ECS achieved a residual error of 5% after review of 44.6% of patients, compared to 62.2% when review was directed by LLM self-reported confidence and 81.9% under random sampling. These results support a scalable approach to study-specific LoT adjudication, using clinician evidence to inform automated predictions, minimize error, and reduce review burden.

AI.tldr: 证据校准选择框架利用临床专家判定校准模型置信度，减少肿瘤治疗线判定的人工复核负担。
AI.motivation: 治疗史复杂且研究定义各异，模型可靠性因患者而变，需要识别应交由专家复核的病例。
AI.method: 根据已有临床判定估计置信度，优先复核证据最薄弱的患者，并将完成的判定作为模型先例。
AI.result: 136例多发性骨髓瘤患者模拟中，残余错误率达5%时需复核44.6%，低于自报置信度的62.2%及随机的81.9%。
AI.conclusion: 以临床证据持续校准自动判定，可在降低错误的同时提高专家时间利用效率。

title: Estimating Outpatient Visit Prices from Hospital Price Transparency Data using Large Language Models
summary: Objective: Hospital care prices in the United States have increased substantially, yet patients lack effective tools to access and compare costs. We aimed to develop and evaluate an LLM-based approach for improving access to and use of hospital price transparency (PT) data. Materials and Methods: To estimate visit prices, we used a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) framework to analyze PT files from three major hospitals in Maryland and the surrounding region. We compared BM25, OpenAI embedding models, and a GPT-BM25 hybrid against a no-RAG baseline for cost estimation of individual procedures and procedure groups, then evaluated the best approach for symptom-based visit cost estimation using synthetic simulations. Results: Across hospitals, the GPT-BM25 retriever achieved the best performance, with average price MAPE of 19.44% for individual procedures and 4.90% for groups, compared with 147.98% and 82.82%, respectively, for the no-RAG baseline. In simulations, our framework correctly identified approximately 50% of reference procedures and reduced MAPE relative to the LLM-only baseline at two of the three hospitals, while achieving comparable performance at the third. Discussion: Our framework uses RAG to improve care price estimation in real-world settings. Compared with the no-RAG baseline, it substantially improved cost estimates for both individual procedures and procedure groups. Improvements were smaller in synthetic simulations, likely because inferring procedures from clinical information is more complex. Practical challenges remain, including heterogeneous PT file formats, unexplained duplicate entries, and limited availability of insurer-negotiated rates. Conclusion: LLMs that effectively integrate PT data show strong potential to provide patients with more accessible and accurate healthcare cost estimates.

AI.tldr: 利用检索增强生成整合医院价格透明数据，改善门诊诊疗项目及就诊费用估计。
AI.motivation: 美国医院费用显著上涨，但患者缺乏有效获取和比较价格的工具。
AI.method: 分析三家医院价格文件，比较BM25、嵌入及GPT-BM25检索，并以合成模拟评估症状驱动估价。
AI.result: GPT-BM25对单项及组合项目的平均绝对百分比误差为19.44%和4.90%，无检索基线为147.98%和82.82%。
AI.conclusion: 整合价格数据可提高费用估计准确性，但症状推断项目、文件异构及协商价缺失仍构成挑战。

title: Three-Dimensional Impact Angle Control Guidance Law with Field-of-View Constraint
summary: This paper presents a novel impact angle control guidance law to address the challenge of achieving any desired impact angle while satisfying the seeker's Field Of View (FOV) limit and maintaining acceleration continuity. The guidance problem is decomposed into two two-dimensional (2D) engagement planes. In the first plane, a pure proportional navigation guidance (PNG) law is employed toward a virtual target to align the missile velocity vector with the line-of-sight (LOS) to the target. In the second plane, a two-stage time-varying biased PNG (TVBPN) strategy is utilized to accurately shape the trajectory and achieve the desired terminal impact angle while maintaining compliance with FOV limitations. The position of the virtual target point ensures a smooth and continuous lateral acceleration at the transition between the first and second stages. The effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed law were validated through numerical simulations.

AI.tldr: 提出兼顾导引头视场限制与加速度连续性的三维撞击角控制制导律。
AI.motivation: 在满足导引头视场限制并保持加速度连续的同时，实现任意期望撞击角。
AI.method: 将交战分解为两个二维平面，结合虚拟目标比例导引与两阶段时变偏置比例导引。
AI.result: 数值仿真验证了所提制导律的有效性与可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该制导律可通过虚拟目标与分阶段轨迹整形协调撞击角、视场及加速度连续性要求。

title: GNN-Based Deep Reinforcement Learning for Coastal Emergency Response under Extreme Water Levels
summary: When a storm surge approaches a coastal town, the emergency plan must be put into action quickly using water-level forecasts, flood extent, road access, vulnerable residents and shelters. Bringing this information together under time pressure is slow and depends on the duty officer's expertise. This paper is one step in a wider research line from data to safe decisions: machine learning to understand the hazard, reinforcement learning and planning to choose actions, large language models (LLMs) to explain and cross-check them, and an assurance layer that keeps people in charge. Here we address the action step on a real place. We ask whether a policy can learn the timing of emergency actions from decades of real events. Lido di Venezia is represented as a heterogeneous graph built from public elevation, road, building and census data and driven by hourly tide-gauge records from 1983 to 2024, with seven actions taken from the municipal emergency plan. A PPO policy is trained on this graph and compared, on storm windows unseen in training, with a rule-based system simulating the officer's discretionary decisions. On 18 historical test scenarios, PPO achieves a similar reduction in population exposure to the rule. With uncertain forecasts and limited protection it again performs similarly but does not outperform the tuned rule, and removing graph message passing does not substantially reduce performance. PPO therefore learns an effective protective response from an outcome-based reward alone: it is given the plan's actions and when each is allowed, but not the thresholds that tell the comparator when to act. Next steps test harder edge cases, move closer to a digital twin of the territory, and replace the simulated officer with assessment by emergency-management stakeholders, supported by LLM-based interpretation of each recommendation.
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Accepted at the Tackling Climate Change with Machine Learning workshop at NeurIPS 2026. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: 基于真实潮位与城市异构图训练的强化学习策略，可学得与调优规则相当的应急响应。
AI.motivation: 沿海风暴潮应急决策需快速整合多源信息，而人工判断耗时且依赖值班人员经验。
AI.method: 以威尼斯丽都异构图及1983至2024年潮位记录训练PPO，并在未见风暴场景中对比规则系统。
AI.result: 在18个历史测试场景及不确定预报条件下，PPO与规则表现相近，移除图消息传递影响不大。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭结果奖励即可学得有效防护响应，但尚未超越调优规则，仍需边界场景与利益相关者评估。

title: Self-supervised learning for zebrafish embryo phenotype evaluation: Systematic comparison of algorithms, label-efficient classification, and transfer learning
summary: Zebrafish embryos are a prominent model organism for image-based phenotyping and especially suited for large-scale imaging studies, for which machine learning (ML) models can automate evaluation. However, training ML models usually requires large labeled datasets, and differences in imaging conditions often impede reuse across laboratories. Self-supervised learning (SSL) addresses both constraints by learning transferable representations from unlabeled images. Yet central aspects like the choice of algorithm remain underexplored for domain-specific applications. To close this gap, we benchmark popular SSL algorithms on the public EmbryoNet dataset, explore label-efficient learning, and test transfer to an unseen setting. Using representations from our strongest model, a ResNet50 network trained with SwAV, a simple linear classifier reaches 86.4% accuracy and a non-linear classifier 87.1%, rivaling the fully supervised EmbryoNet model (87.1%). The SwAV model decisively outperforms supervised training from scratch when labels are scarce (70.2% vs. 45.7% accuracy with 5% of labels). On a three-class problem (normal, dead, falsely cropped) with a small, previously unseen zebrafish toxicity dataset, recorded in a different setting, our model reaches 81.3% accuracy without retraining, while EmbryoNet achieves 75.9%. Overall, self-supervised models for zebrafish embryos seem to mostly facilitate label-efficiency and transfer to new settings rather than improving supervised results.

AI.tldr: 斑马鱼胚胎自监督学习主要改善标签效率和跨成像环境迁移，而非提高充分监督下的准确率。
AI.motivation: 胚胎表型自动评估依赖大量标注，且成像条件差异限制模型跨实验室复用。
AI.method: 在EmbryoNet上比较自监督算法，并评估最佳SwAV模型的少标签分类与未见数据迁移。
AI.result: SwAV非线性分类准确率为87.1%，仅用5%标签达70.2%，跨环境无需重训达81.3%。
AI.conclusion: 自监督表征可在保持充分监督性能的同时，减少标注需求并改善新环境泛化。

title: DexFormer 2.0: Towards a Cross-Embodiment Foundation Policy for Dexterous Grasping
summary: Dexterous grasping policies are usually trained for one arm paired with one hand. Every new pairing then needs its own policy, and the number of policies grows with every arm and hand added. We ask whether a single policy can control many arm-hand combinations and transfer to pairings and hands it has never seen. This is hard because robots differ in the number, layout, and dynamics of their joints, so their observations and actions share no common interface. We present DexFormer 2.0, a single reinforcement learning policy for cross-embodiment dexterous grasping. It maps every robot to a canonical joint interface with validity masks, encodes each joint's morphology with attention biased by the kinematic tree, and uses a Transformer-XL memory to infer embodiment-dependent dynamics from recent interaction. Trained on 18 combinations of four arms and six hands, it reaches 89% stable success on seen combinations and 51% on six held-out arm-hand pairs, outperforming GRU and DexFormer 1.0 baselines. Without fine-tuning, it also grasps with four new hand types and, through retargeting, with parallel grippers. Ablations show that memory, the kinematic-tree bias, and broader pairing coverage each matter for transfer. On a physical Flexiv arm, distilled students transfer zero-shot from simulation with two hands, including a held-out pair. Project website: this https URL.

AI.tldr: DexFormer 2.0以单一强化学习策略实现跨机械臂与灵巧手组合的抓取及零样本迁移。
AI.motivation: 机器人关节布局与动力学差异导致每种臂手组合通常需要独立训练抓取策略。
AI.method: 采用带有效性掩码的统一关节接口、运动学树偏置注意力及Transformer-XL交互记忆。
AI.result: 已见与留出组合稳定抓取成功率分别为89%和51%，并实现新手型及实体机器人零样本迁移。
AI.conclusion: 统一接口、形态编码与交互记忆支持跨构型抓取，记忆、运动学偏置及组合覆盖均有助于迁移。

title: Beyond AUC: Do Mammography Risk Models Predict When Cancer Occurs?
summary: Longitudinal deep learning models for mammography-based breast cancer risk prediction output either per-year cumulative risks or a discrete distribution over the year of diagnosis, from which cumulative risks F1,...,F5 are derived. These models are evaluated almost exclusively with year-wise AUCs and the concordance index. We show that these metrics are largely insensitive to when cancer occurs: they can be high even for a model that carries no information about the year of diagnosis. We re-evaluate two recent longitudinal models (OA-BreaCR, LMV-Net) on CSAW-CC with a 5-year horizon using timing metrics computed on cancer cases only. Despite C-indices up to 0.75, neither orders cancer cases by time to diagnosis significantly better than chance (c_time 0.51 and 0.55, both 95% CIs covering 0.5). Weighted absolute timing error favours a constant "year 3" prediction over both models, so we use c_time as the primary timing metric. For Mirai's additive-hazard head, also used by LMV-Net, we analyse how per-year increments passed through a ReLU can collapse under severe class imbalance. We also propose a breast-level, two-stage model that separates whether from when. It matches LMV-Net in discrimination (C-index 0.745 vs. 0.746) but orders cancer cases better (c_time 0.58 vs. 0.51, paired 95% CI of the difference 0.01-0.13), on par with Mirai's published weights (0.57).
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Submitted to ISBI 2027

AI.tldr: 乳腺癌风险模型的高AUC或一致性指数不代表能预测确诊时间，分离是否患癌与何时患癌可改善排序。
AI.motivation: 现有乳腺影像风险模型评估主要关注区分能力，可能掩盖对癌症发生时间预测的不足。
AI.method: 以仅针对癌症病例的时间指标重评两种纵向模型，分析风险头退化并提出乳房级两阶段模型。
AI.result: 两原模型时间排序接近随机；新模型保持相当区分能力，将时间一致性指数从0.51提高至0.58。
AI.conclusion: 风险区分与确诊时间预测应分别评估，两阶段建模可在不损害区分能力的情况下改善时间排序。

title: The Manifold-Index Model: provably and efficiently avoiding the statistical and computational curse of dimensionality
summary: We study vector-valued regression with predictors filling a tube around an unknown $m$-dimensional manifold $\mathcal{M}$ in $\mathbb{R}^D$. In the Manifold-Index Model, the mean response is $F=f\circ\Pi_{\mathcal{M}}$, where $\Pi_{\mathcal{M}}$ is the nearest-point projection onto $\mathcal{M}$ and $f:\mathcal{M}\to\mathbb{R}^p$ is a possibly non-injective link function. Multiscale ANisotropic lOcal Regression (MANOR) estimates tangent planes by multiscale PCA of predictors with similar responses, then refines them by pooling outer products of local slopes. The neighborhoods narrow tangentially while retaining complete normal fibers. We assume a Lipschitz link differential and bounded response noise. For $p\ge m$, under our geometric and sampling conditions, $n$ independent observations give mean tangent-space error of order $n^{-2/(m+4)}$ and integrated squared prediction error at the $m$-dimensional nonparametric rate $n^{-4/(m+4)}$, up to logarithmic factors. In a scaling regime with fixed intrinsic dimension, model and scale parameters, and ratio of manifold volume to the $m$-th power of its reach, the required sample size grows polynomially in $D+p$, and computation is polynomial in $n$, $D$ and $p$. Numerical experiments on curves with non-monotone links and surfaces with vector-valued responses compare observed convergence rates with the theoretical bounds; a Langevin dynamics example tests prediction of hitting probabilities under an approximate manifold-index model.

AI.tldr: 流形索引模型与MANOR在特定条件下实现依赖内在维度的回归收敛率及多项式计算复杂度。
AI.motivation: 高维回归面临统计与计算维度灾难，需要利用未知低维流形结构降低复杂度。
AI.method: 以最近点投影定义流形索引模型，通过多尺度局部主成分分析及局部斜率外积估计切空间。
AI.result: 在给定条件下，切空间误差与预测误差分别达n^{-2/(m+4)}和n^{-4/(m+4)}量级，忽略对数因子。
AI.conclusion: 在固定内在维度及规定尺度条件下，样本需求与计算量均为多项式，可规避相应维度灾难。

title: Visual Marking as a Native Reasoning Capability for Multimodal LLMs
summary: Visual reasoning often requires maintaining intermediate spatial states that are difficult to express in text. Existing approaches either rely on external drawing tools or image generators, or encode these states in latent tokens without explicit spatial correspondence to the input image. We introduce SelfMark, which enables MLLMs to construct and use visual marks directly in their native visual feature space. By treating the visual token grid as a canvas, SelfMark establishes explicit spatial correspondence between marks and images. This is achieved through a locate-mark-read procedure, where the model identifies relevant locations, constructs task-dependent mark features, and reads the resulting visual features to guide its reasoning. We jointly train a single model on spatial planning, dense counting, high-resolution VQA, and line tracing. Across six benchmarks, SelfMark outperforms state-of-the-art MLLM-based methods specialized for individual tasks. These improvements also persist with a stronger backbone, demonstrating the effectiveness of visual marking across different model capabilities. Overall, SelfMark provides a unified approach to visual reasoning by integrating spatially grounded marks directly into the visual feature space of MLLMs.

AI.tldr: SelfMark让多模态大模型直接在视觉特征空间生成并读取空间标记，以统一支持视觉推理。
AI.motivation: 视觉推理需要保留难以用文本表达的中间空间状态，而现有方法依赖外部工具或缺乏显式空间对应。
AI.method: 将视觉词元网格作为画布，通过定位、标记、读取流程，并联合训练空间规划、计数等任务。
AI.result: 在六个基准上超越面向单任务的先进多模态大模型方法，且在更强骨干模型上仍保持改进。
AI.conclusion: 将具有空间对应关系的标记融入原生视觉特征，可形成统一且适用于不同模型能力的视觉推理机制。

title: CiGS: Conduction in Gaussian Splats for Interior Temperature Field from Thermal Images
summary: We present a method for inferring the interior temperature distribution of a solid object from registered multi-view visible-spectrum and thermal images, even when the thermal views cover only part of its surface. We formulate steady-state heat conduction as a Laplace boundary value problem and solve it with a direct boundary integral equation discretized over a point cloud: a Gaussian reconstruction of the visible-spectrum images supplies the boundary geometry, and the thermal images supply the boundary data. We do not build surface or volume meshes at any stage in our method. Instead, we sample collocation points from rendered depth without the pixels at depth discontinuities, and use a density subtraction that keeps the interior evaluation accurate up to the surface. The whole chain is differentiable, and we use it to recover the pose and depth of heating pipes, insulation defects, and the shape of cracks from thermal images. We validate our method through experiments on boundary value problems with Dirichlet-only and mixed Dirichlet and Robin boundaries, using synthetic and real captured data on scenes with challenging topology. These experiments show that our method matches analytical solutions and has better accuracy than FEM solvers.

AI.tldr: CiGS利用多视角可见光与热图像，无需网格即可推断物体内部稳态温度并反演隐蔽结构。
AI.motivation: 希望在热图像仅覆盖部分表面的情况下恢复固体内部温度，避免构建表面或体积网格。
AI.method: 由高斯重建提供边界几何、热图像提供边界数据，在点云上求解可微分的拉普拉斯边界积分方程。
AI.result: 合成与实拍实验中，结果吻合解析解且精度优于有限元求解器，并可恢复热管、保温缺陷和裂缝信息。
AI.conclusion: 可微分无网格热传导求解支持从部分表面热观测推断内部温度，并用于隐蔽结构反演。

title: Protecting Safety during Reasoning Training with Low-Rank Fisher Regularisation
summary: Large language models are trained to have safety guardrails, but these can be compromised while fine-tuning for new capabilities, such as reasoning. One way to mitigate this degradation is to modify the fine-tuning objective to preserve safety behaviour, but doing so effectively and efficiently remains challenging. We revisit Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC), which penalises parameter updates based on sensitivity estimates from the diagonal of the Fisher information matrix (FIM). While EWC provides some protection, the diagonal approximation ignores interactions between parameters. We address this limitation by exploiting recent findings that safety-relevant behaviour is located in a low-rank subspace within models. Our method, Subspace-Projected Elastic Weight Consolidation (SP-EWC), projects gradients onto this subspace to capture non-diagonal curvature efficiently. We investigate three different ways of identifying the safety subspace: through safety fine-tuning updates (LoRA), safety-related activations (ActSVD), and contrastive representations of safety and utility data (cPCA). We find that this choice substantially affects performance, with SP-EWC using cPCA comparing favourably against existing methods by better maintaining safety guardrails without introducing excessive over-refusal.

AI.tldr: 提出低秩子空间正则化方法SP-EWC，在推理微调中保护模型安全行为。
AI.motivation: 新能力微调可能破坏安全护栏，而传统EWC的对角近似忽略了参数间相互作用。
AI.method: 将梯度投影到安全子空间以高效捕获非对角曲率，并比较LoRA、ActSVD和cPCA三种子空间识别方式。
AI.result: 安全子空间的选择显著影响性能，其中cPCA版本能更好地保留安全护栏且不过度增加拒答。
AI.conclusion: 利用恰当的低秩安全子空间可在能力微调中更有效地维持安全行为。

title: Benchmarking LLM Inference on Desktop-Scale NVIDIA Grace Blackwell Clusters
summary: Two NVIDIA DGX Spark GB10 systems connect directly over 200 GbE to serve larger language models and increase inference capacity, but the benefits depend on how they are deployed. We benchmark 17 open-weight checkpoints spanning dense and mixture-of-experts architectures, 8B to 235B parameters and four weight precisions on one and two RDMA-connected systems. Using vLLM, we compare tensor parallelism (TP=2), pipeline parallelism (PP=2) and a two-replica baseline at concurrency 1 to 64, with three independent launches per configuration. TP=2 delivers a median 1.59x peak-throughput gain over one Spark, versus 1.39x for PP=2 and has higher throughput in 93 of 96 matched comparisons with separated 95% Welch intervals. It reduces unloaded inter-token latency to 0.52x to 0.73x of one Spark, whereas PP=2 provides little reduction. TP=2 also achieves the highest goodput under a strict 100 ms inter-token latency objective wherever both strategies are supported and the objective is met. For models fitting on one Spark, TP=2 generally favors low-concurrency serving, while replication offers higher throughput at high concurrency. One Spark uses less GPU energy per output token at matched concurrency. Across three precision ladders, NVFP4 reduces unloaded latency more than adding a second Spark at BF16. NCCL microbenchmarks and comparisons with an earlier TCP campaign suggest that collective communication overhead contributes to the advantage of TP=2. These results provide deployment guidance for desktop-scale inference.
comment: 24 pages, 16 figures, 8 tables. Code and data available at this https URL Copy

AI.tldr: 评测双机DGX Spark语言模型推理，揭示张量并行、流水线并行与副本部署的性能取舍。
AI.motivation: 两台Spark可扩大模型容量和推理能力，但实际收益取决于并行策略、并发量与权重精度。
AI.method: 使用vLLM在单机及RDMA双机上测试17个模型、四种精度和1至64并发，每种配置独立启动三次。
AI.result: 张量并行的峰值吞吐增益中位数为1.59倍，流水线并行为1.39倍，且前者显著降低低负载逐词延迟。
AI.conclusion: 低并发通常宜用张量并行，高并发可优先考虑副本部署，而单机在相同并发下每输出词元耗能更低。

title: Causal Discovery for Resiliency-Prioritized Transmission Expansion Planning in Power Systems with Grid-Forming Inverter-Based Resources
summary: Transmission planners at regional transmission organizations (RTOs), independent system operators (ISOs), and NERC-registered entities have limited analytical resources for exploring expansion options that improve resiliency for withstanding and recovering from fault conditions in electric power systems that are dominated by grid-forming (GFM) and grid-following (GFL) inverter-based resources (IBRs). Conventional existing TPL-001 contingency analysis will assess if a performance benchmark is violated. However, it will not identify which dynamic states and inputs caused the violation, nor how much a protective action will avoid propagation into a cascading outage. This paper proposes an analytical method that combines time-series causal discovery using the Peter and Clark Momentary Conditional Independence (PCMCI) algorithm with right/left eigenvector participation-factor analysis of validated small-signal state-space models. Synthetic data are generated from linearized models derived from substation phasor measurement unit (PMU) data. This includes node-breaker topologies under alternative transmission switching configurations. GFM and GFL inverter controls including phase-locked loops (PLLs) and fault ride-through logic. A planning index referred to as the Resiliency Causal Contribution Index (RCCI) is defined that weights PCMCI-derived causal effects on a TPL benchmark quantity by modal participation. The planning procedure iterates contingency categories, measures margins to RTO/ISO benchmarks for transient voltage recovery, oscillatory damping, inverter ride-through, and TPL-008-1 extreme temperature. The process infers automatic protective actions and repeats until a cascade is ruled out or confirmed. A simplified case study illustrates the entire process for considering the options in transmission expansion planning.

AI.tldr: 提出结合因果发现与模态参与分析的输电扩建规划方法，以评估逆变器主导电网的韧性。
AI.motivation: 传统故障分析能识别性能越界，却难以解释动态成因或量化保护动作对级联故障的抑制作用。
AI.method: 结合PCMCI与左右特征向量参与因子，构建韧性因果贡献指数并迭代分析故障及保护动作。
AI.result: 简化案例展示了该方法用于比较输电扩建方案的完整流程，摘要未提供具体量化结果。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为面向韧性的扩建规划提供因果归因与保护动作分析流程。

title: Model-Free Stealthy Attack on Vehicle Systems and Its Implications for ISO/SAE 21434 Risk Assessment
summary: This paper investigates a model-free stealthy adversary targeting in-vehicle networks and its implications for automotive cybersecurity risk assessment. Conventional stealthy false-data-injection (FDI) attacks often assume privileged knowledge of system dynamics, estimator parameters, or detector statistics, understating the feasibility of adversaries with limited system information. We develop a model-free FDI attack that uses a Vector Autoregressive model with Exogenous inputs (VARX), identified from passively recorded nominal measurements, to characterize a compromised channel and construct attack sequences within a data-calibrated residual envelope.
