The construction requires no vehicle dynamics model, estimator parameters, assumed noise distribution, or detector knowledge. In a closed-loop lane-keeping benchmark, the attack induces a 1.25 m lateral displacement, exceeding the specified 0.9 m half-lane width, and keeps the vehicle outside the lane corridor for 9.21 s. At a matched 1 % false-alarm operating point, attack-period alarm rates stay below 2.4 % across five learning-based intrusion detection systems (IDSs), a chi-squared residual monitor, and a liveness monitor, versus 66-100 % for conventional baselines. The proposed adversary matches the impact and evasion of a privileged model-based adversary while requiring 13 fewer attack-potential points, raising its assessed feasibility from Low to High under the considered ISO/SAE 21434 Threat Analysis and Risk Assessment (TARA). We further show that conventional impact-and-feasibility risk scoring can assign identical risk to attacks with substantially different detector responses, and introduce a detection-conditioned risk formulation to distinguish them. These findings highlight the importance of accounting for adversarial knowledge requirements and measured detectability when assessing risks in safety-critical vehicle systems.

AI.tldr: 提出无需车辆模型的隐蔽虚假数据注入攻击，并揭示汽车风险评估忽视可检测性的局限。
AI.motivation: 传统攻击常假设掌握系统内部信息，可能低估知识有限攻击者的可行性及实际风险。
AI.method: 从被动采集的正常数据识别VARX模型，在数据校准的残差包络内构造攻击，并提出检测条件化风险评估。
AI.result: 攻击使车辆横向偏移1.25米并越界9.21秒，各检测器攻击期报警率低于2.4%，可行性评级由低升至高。
AI.conclusion: 安全关键车辆系统的风险评估应同时考虑攻击所需知识与实测可检测性。

title: Multi-output neural network surrogate for double-pulse femtosecond optothermal control of thin silicon films on fused silica
summary: We introduce a multi-output feedforward neural network surrogate trained on a coupled multiple-reflection and two-temperature model to map double-pulse femtosecond laser excitation (1030 nm) of crystalline silicon films on fused silica across film thicknesses (50-500 nm) and inter-pulse delays (0-10ps). Trained via Levenberg-Marquardt optimization on 2000 physical simulations, the dual-hidden-layer network ([40,30] neurons) simultaneously predicts six strongly coupled optothermal observables, peak electron temperature, peak lattice temperature, peak carrier density, minimum and maximum absorptivity and minimum refractive index achieving coefficients of determination R2 larger than 0.9998 across all targets. Evaluating a dense 200 by 200 design grid in milliseconds resolves pronounced thin-film interference fringes and carrier-induced index modulation, identifying an optimal optothermal coupling regime at d=156 nm and Dt=4.572 ps. This unified machine-learning workflow eliminates computationally expensive multi-physics runtime bottlenecks for real-time laser processing control and inverse photonic thin-film design.

AI.tldr: 构建多输出神经网络代理，实现双脉冲飞秒激光作用下硅薄膜光热响应的快速预测。
AI.motivation: 多物理场仿真的高计算成本限制了激光加工实时控制与光子薄膜逆向设计。
AI.method: 以2000次耦合多重反射和双温模型仿真训练双隐藏层网络，同时预测六项光热指标。
AI.result: 各指标决定系数均超过0.9998，毫秒级完成200×200网格评估，识别出156纳米、4.572皮秒的最优耦合条件。
AI.conclusion: 统一代理模型可缓解多物理场计算瓶颈，支持实时激光控制与薄膜逆向设计。

title: Ontology-Compiled Control Barrier Functions for Heterogeneous Robot Teams
summary: Safety filters for heterogeneous robot teams fail because of missing constraints, overestimated braking capabilities and conflicts between individually satisfiable constraints. We present OntoCBF, which compiles a domain ontology with a class taxonomy, typed relations, safety axioms and a dynamics profile per robot class into a control barrier function filter with one quadratic program per agent. Description-logic entailment supplies the constraints of any team online, including those that follow from chains of relations and from classes defined by what a robot carries, so the existing safety axioms cover new robot classes, payload classes and combinations. We prove that a subclass may reuse the braking capability of its parent whenever it can produce every velocity of the parent, a property separate from subsumption. For box-bounded double integrators this property is also necessary, and every loss of safety then begins with a conflict. Once three robots interact, the safe set of pairwise barriers contains states from which a collision is unavoidable, and such states persist in larger teams under any fixed capability reduction. In a simulated warehouse where humans ignore the robots, a filter written for the design classes violates safety in 89-100 % of the episodes with unseen classes. In all scenarios, including one with 32 robots, OntoCBF violates safety in 20-70 % of the episodes, each time after a conflict, with a median deepest intrusion of 10-17 % of the keep-out distance. A multi-agent PPO policy trained with the filter in the loop lowers the rate of infeasible quadratic programs, nearly all of them conflicts, by 18-41 %.

AI.tldr: OntoCBF将本体知识编译为异构机器人安全过滤器，并揭示成对屏障约束无法保证团队安全。
AI.motivation: 异构团队安全过滤器会因约束缺失、制动能力高估及约束冲突而失效。
AI.method: 通过描述逻辑推理生成各机器人二次规划约束，并分析制动能力继承条件及多机器人约束冲突。
AI.result: OntoCBF仿真安全违规率为20%至70%，均发生于冲突后；结合过滤器训练的PPO使不可行率降低18%至41%。
AI.conclusion: 本体推理可覆盖新类别约束，但不能消除多机器人交互中的冲突及不可避免碰撞状态。

title: PoCoAttn: Position-Content Collaborative Sparse Attention for Fast and High-Fidelity Video Generation
summary: Video diffusion transformers rely on 3D full attention over tens of thousands of spatiotemporal tokens, and its quadratic cost dominates inference latency. Sparse attention reduces this cost, but existing methods face a dilemma: static methods apply predefined masks and cannot capture input-dependent attention, whereas dynamic methods reconstruct the sparse mask repeatedly, paying online to rediscover positional structure that is largely stable across inputs. To this end, we propose PoCoAttn, a training-free sparse attention framework that separates input-stable from input-dependent attention and resolves the former offline and the latter online. PoCoAttn features: (1) A relative-offset analysis of 3D query-key pairs, which shows that video attention decomposes into an input-stable positional prior that carries most of the attention mass and a small content-dependent residual. (2) A position-content collaborative sparse attention mechanism, which retrieves positional keys from offline-calibrated tables, selects content keys online with a head-adaptive ratio between the two sources, and compensates for the discarded keys to approximate full attention. (3) A step-adaptive budget allocation algorithm, which models how early-step sparse attention errors are amplified along the denoising trajectory and derives the optimal sparsity budget per step. Extensive experiments across four video diffusion models and three tasks show that PoCoAttn consistently achieves a better speed-fidelity Pareto frontier than state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods, improving PSNR by 1.9 to 5.0 dB over baselines and delivering up to 4.1$\times$ attention and 2.0$\times$ denoising speedups over dense FlashAttention-3 attention.
comment: 21 pages, 15 figures, 13 tables. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出免训练稀疏注意力PoCoAttn，协同利用位置先验与内容信息加速高保真视频生成。
AI.motivation: 视频全注意力成本高，而静态稀疏掩码缺乏适应性，动态方法又重复计算稳定的位置结构。
AI.method: 离线校准位置键、在线选择内容键并补偿被丢弃键，同时依据误差传播自适应分配各去噪步稀疏预算。
AI.result: 在四个模型和三类任务上，PSNR较基线提高1.9至5.0分贝，注意力和去噪最高分别加速4.1倍及2.0倍。
AI.conclusion: 分离稳定位置结构与动态内容可改善视频生成的速度与保真度权衡。

title: NF-VLA: A Normalizing-Flow Baseline for Vision-Language-Action Learning
summary: Autoregressive normalizing flows (NFs) provide a tractable density for learning and sampling continuous robot actions. We show that a single maximum-likelihood objective can train vision--language--action (VLA) policies competitive with leading methods on manipulation benchmarks. We present NF-VLA, which combines conditional autoregressive normalizing flows with score-based action refinement. Its deep--shallow architecture concentrates visual, language, and proprioceptive prefix conditioning in a high-capacity deep block, while unconditioned shallow blocks provide a shared invertible action transformation. The vision--language backbone and flow are jointly trained by exact maximum likelihood on Gaussian-smoothed action chunks. The same learned density supplies a single score-based correction at inference, refining generated actions to account for training-time smoothing without a separately trained denoiser. Trained on LIBERO from a pretrained vision--language backbone without robot pretraining, NF-VLA achieves 98.35\% success across the four standard suites and 72.6\% on LIBERO-Plus using the same checkpoint without further fine-tuning. Ablations show that deep-only prefix conditioning and score-based refinement both improve closed-loop success. Together, these results establish carefully structured autoregressive flows as a competitive approach to VLA control, with one learned density supporting policy training, action generation, and refinement.

AI.tldr: NF-VLA以单一最大似然目标训练自回归归一化流，实现有竞争力的机器人视觉语言动作控制。
AI.motivation: 探索可计算精确密度的归一化流能否统一支持连续动作策略训练、生成与修正。
AI.method: 深层模块融合视觉语言及本体感知条件，浅层模块共享可逆动作变换，并利用同一密度进行单步分数修正。
AI.result: 无机器人预训练时，LIBERO四套标准任务成功率为98.35%，同一检查点未经微调在LIBERO-Plus上达到72.6%。
AI.conclusion: 结构化自回归流可作为有竞争力的VLA方案，深层条件注入与分数修正均有助于提升闭环成功率。

title: Near-Optimal Methods for Generalized Lipschitz Convex Optimization
summary: In this paper, we consider a convex optimization problem, where the upper bound on the subgradient norm depends on the objective function. We establish a lower bound on the number of iterations required by any first-order method to find an approximate solution to the problem. Furthermore, we present two near-optimal algorithms that can match the lower bound up to logarithmic factors. The first algorithm is a projected GD with a carefully designed stepsize schedule which incorporates warm-up and decay phases. The second algorithm is scalar-stepsize clipped AdamW which extends the near-optimal guarantees to the stochastic setting, where only a noisy unbiased estimator of the subgradient is available.

AI.tldr: 研究次梯度范数上界依赖目标函数的凸优化，提出迭代复杂度近最优的一阶算法。
AI.motivation: 当次梯度范数上界随目标函数变化时，需要确定求解复杂度及相应高效算法。
AI.method: 建立一阶方法迭代下界，并提出含预热与衰减步长的投影梯度下降及标量步长裁剪AdamW。
AI.result: 两种算法在对数因子内匹配下界，裁剪AdamW还适用于仅有无偏含噪次梯度估计的随机情形。
AI.conclusion: 适当设计步长与裁剪机制，可在该类凸优化的确定性和随机情形下获得近最优保证。

title: Course-Referenced Lateral Control of Trail-Following Convoys: String Stability and Adaptive Feedforward under Load Uncertainty
summary: Vehicles in a convoy can steer along the GNSS trails of the vehicles ahead when lane markings are unavailable, as on snow covered roads. Since each vehicle's tracking error enters the reference of the next, lateral errors can grow along the convoy. This paper presents a course referenced formulation of trail following in arc length, in which each follower takes the direction of its fitted trail as its heading reference. Error propagation then reduces to a single transfer function. We derive a condition under which combining the trails of the leader and the predecessor keeps the errors bounded for any convoy length, and show that following the predecessor alone lets the errors accumulate without bound, even without amplification, on roads that end turned or shifted sideways. Passenger and cargo loads and tire stiffness vary in practice, and we show that they enter the curvature feedforward through a single coefficient, whose mismatch leaves steady offsets on curves. We propose an adaptive law that estimates this coefficient on curves and removes the offsets. Simulations of an eleven vehicle convoy confirm the analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出车队轨迹跟随控制方法，通过融合领车与前车轨迹及自适应前馈抑制横向误差。
AI.motivation: 无车道线时，沿前车GNSS轨迹行驶可能累积横向误差，载荷和轮胎刚度变化还会造成弯道偏移。
AI.method: 建立弧长域航向参考模型，推导轨迹融合的串稳定条件，并自适应估计曲率前馈系数。
AI.result: 分析表明仅跟随前车可导致误差无界累积，十一车仿真验证了轨迹融合与自适应补偿的效果。
AI.conclusion: 满足条件的轨迹融合可使任意车队长度下误差有界，自适应前馈可消除系数失配引起的弯道偏移。

title: Unreasonable Confidence from Simulator Misspecification: Directional Robustness on the SPEED+ Sim-to-Real Benchmark
summary: Vision-based navigation systems for orbit must be trained almost entirely on synthetic imagery, because real labelled images of a given spacecraft in flight rarely exist. Benchmarks like SPEED+ are built for that situation: the training set comes from a simulator, and the test sets are real images of a satellite mockup under two kinds of lighting. That simulator approximates how light reflects off mylar and aluminium, and like every scientific simulator it is misspecified. Its error is radiometric, since it misses the specular highlights, hard shadows and sensor saturation common in real images. We probe the resulting synthetic-to-real gap, the central risk for such systems, with a deliberately simple monocular pose estimator. In a 2x2 study of backbone adaptation and photometric augmentation, trained on synthetic images and tested on both real hardware-in-the-loop domains, we find three things. (1) The model does not know it is failing: regions conformally calibrated to 90% on synthetic data cover only 9-15% of rotation errors on sunlamp and 21-38% on lightbox, so a wrong pose carries the confidence of a correct one. (2) Transfer is asymmetric: scaling data and features improved synthetic rotation error from 1.65 to 1.03 rad but moved the harshly lit sunlamp domain by only 0.05 rad, under twice its seed s.d., whereas adapting the backbone's last stage carried 63-83% of its extra synthetic gain to both real domains. (3) Once the backbone adapts, augmentation helps only in the direction it models: our photometric stack improved the diffusely lit lightbox domain from 1.17 to 0.99 rad on every seed but moved sunlamp no more than seed-to-seed variation, while with the backbone frozen it helped sunlamp more. Every post-review experiment was pre-registered, and the code, per-image predictions and pre-registration record are at this https URL.
comment: 22 pages, 5 figures, 20 tables. Extended version of a paper at the Sim2Science workshop, NeurIPS 2026. Code, per-image predictions and pre-registration record: this https URL

AI.tldr: SPEED+实验揭示仿真失配会造成位姿估计过度自信，且数据增强的迁移收益具有方向性。
AI.motivation: 航天器视觉导航依赖合成训练图像，但模拟器难以还原真实反光、阴影和传感器饱和。
AI.method: 采用简单单目位姿估计器，通过骨干适配与光度增强的二乘二实验评估两个真实光照域。
AI.result: 合成数据上校准至90%的旋转误差覆盖区域，在日光灯和灯箱域仅达9%—15%与21%—38%。
AI.conclusion: 合成域精度和置信度不能直接迁移到真实域，骨干适配及符合目标失配方向的增强更有价值。

title: High-Speed Forward and Reverse Tractor-Trailer Driving with Learned Vehicle Dynamics
summary: Tractor-trailer systems are difficult to control, especially unstable during reverse motion, and their dynamics depend on difficult-to-measure factors, including road friction and suspension coefficients. We introduce a learned dynamics model for tractor-trailer control and compare it with a reduced-order dynamics model with Fiala tire forces as an analytic baseline. Specifically, we compare a model predictive path integral (MPPI) controller that uses the learned dynamics model to an MPPI controller that uses the analytic model, as well as to three additional baseline controllers. In the main closed-loop tracking experiments across four simulated environments, MPPI with learned dynamics achieves mean speeds closer to the target magnitudes and lower root-mean-square (RMS) hitch angles than MPPI with the analytic model at every tested setpoint, with higher completion rates in seven of eight reverse configurations.
comment: The first three authors contributed equally to this work. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 将学习动力学用于牵引车挂车MPPI控制，在模拟正向与倒车跟踪中优于解析动力学基线。
AI.motivation: 牵引车挂车倒车不稳定，且其动力学受难以测量的路面摩擦和悬架参数等因素影响。
AI.method: 比较采用学习动力学与Fiala轮胎力降阶解析模型的MPPI控制器，并加入另外三种控制基线。
AI.result: 四个模拟环境中，学习模型在所有测试设定点下速度更接近目标且铰接角均方根更低，八种倒车配置中七种完成率更高。
AI.conclusion: 学习动力学可改善牵引车挂车的闭环跟踪表现，尤其有助于提高倒车完成率。

title: Measuring Coherence in Predictive Models
summary: Many sequential decision-making procedures, such as active learning, implicitly assume that a model's current predictions agree with those it expects to make after updating on new data, a property we call coherence. Most models in use do not update by exact conditioning and are not guaranteed to be coherent, which can lead to worse decisions. Yet there is currently no general way to measure incoherence or to tell when it matters. We develop tools to measure incoherence and characterise when it affects decisions. We introduce the incoherence ratio, an MMD-based measure of how far any updating procedure departs from coherence, computed only from the procedure's own predictions and updates, and accompany it with an anytime-valid test of coherence. In Bayesian experimental design, acquisition objectives that are equivalent for coherent models choose different data under every approximate model we study, and the incoherence ratio tracks how far incoherence distorts them. We also introduce action coherence, which captures only the incoherence that changes a decision. What a resulting disagreement costs, however, is determined primarily by predictive accuracy. Sequential decisions depend on how a model updates as well as on what it predicts, so coherence, like accuracy, should be checked rather than assumed.

AI.tldr: 提出预测模型更新一致性的度量与检验，揭示近似更新如何改变序贯决策。
AI.motivation: 序贯决策常假设当前预测与预期更新后的预测一致，但近似更新缺乏此保证且缺少通用测量工具。
AI.method: 提出基于MMD的不一致性比率、任意时刻有效的一致性检验，以及聚焦决策变化的行动一致性。
AI.result: 所研究近似模型中，原本等价的贝叶斯实验设计目标选择不同数据，不一致性比率能追踪目标扭曲程度。
AI.conclusion: 序贯决策需同时检查预测准确性与更新一致性，而决策分歧的代价主要由预测准确性决定。

title: Sidewalk Stewards: A Visual Analytics Approach for Interactive Topology Repair of Sidewalk Networks
summary: Accurate pedestrian network data is foundational to urban accessibility, routing, and infrastructure planning, yet such data remains scarce and difficult to produce at scale. Automated extraction pipelines have made significant strides by leveraging computer vision to derive sidewalk networks from aerial imagery, and have seen real-world adoption by municipalities seeking cost-effective inventory solutions. Yet, these pipelines consistently produce topological errors (e.g., disconnected components, dangling edges, missed connections, malformed intersections) that undermine the utility of the extracted networks for routing and accessibility analysis. Correcting these errors requires situated human judgment that global automated repair strategies cannot replicate, yet practitioners currently lack dedicated tools to support this work efficiently. We present Sidewalk Stewards, a visual analytics system that bridges the gap between automated extraction and a deployment-ready pedestrian network. Sidewalk Stewards detects candidate topology errors, supports interactive user-guided correction through coordinated spatial views, and provides real-time quality feedback as edits are applied. We evaluate Sidewalk Stewards through a comparative user study, case studies across cities, and a quantitative evaluation. Compared with conventional workflows, the system facilitates error identification and enables faster and more complete correction. The case studies illustrate the workflow across different urban contexts, and the quantitative evaluation shows that a small number of user corrections can enhance multiple sidewalk quality metrics. Sidewalk Stewards is available at this http URL.

AI.tldr: Sidewalk Stewards通过可视分析与人工交互修复自动提取的人行道网络拓扑错误。
AI.motivation: 自动提取的人行道网络常有断连和错误交叉等问题，而修复需要情境化人工判断及专用工具支持。
AI.method: 系统检测候选拓扑错误，以协调空间视图支持用户修正，并实时反馈质量变化。

title: LENS: Replacing LayerNorm and Softmax in Transformers with Learnable Normalization States
summary: LayerNorm and attention Softmax are critical operations in Transformers. However, they cannot be efficiently mapped to General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM) computations on hardware. Therefore, modern hardware accelerator designs, such as NPUs on ASIC/FPGA, consume a large amount of hardware resources or chip area to implement their specific arithmetic units. Building on previous work about LayerNorm, Softmax, and their alternatives, we introduce Learnable Normalization States (LENS), a framework that reformulates LayerNorm as tiny MLPs by abstracting a common structure from related methods and extends this method to Softmax, which moves more of the computation in Transformers to GEMM as a hardware-friendly architecture. We evaluate LENS on image classification with Vision Transformers (ViT) and autoregressive language modeling with Pythia models, including generalization tests on WikiText and LAMBADA. Across these tasks, LENS matches or exceeds baseline performance in several vision settings and retains most of the baseline performance in the remaining vision and language experiments. These findings may suggest that hand-designed normalization and attention functions are not the only choice as alternatives to LayerNorm and Softmax. LENS also provides a basis for exploring Transformer architectures for resource-limited accelerators.
comment: Source code is available at: this https URL

AI.tldr: LENS以可学习归一化状态替代Transformer中的LayerNorm与Softmax，使更多计算转为矩阵乘法。
AI.motivation: LayerNorm和注意力Softmax难以高效映射到通用矩阵乘法，因而占用专用加速器资源与芯片面积。

title: Residual-Tail-Informed Flow Matching for Time Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) models are often trained on nominal data using average-risk objectives, which emphasize dominant normal patterns. However, real time series can contain rare but valid nominal regimes that are underrepresented in the training distribution. We show that data-space flow matching can over-penalize such rare-normal windows and assign them anomaly scores comparable to those of true anomalies. To address this, we propose Residual-Tail-Informed Flow Matching (RT-FM), an unsupervised framework that uses a temporal variational autoencoder to estimate residual latent tailness and converts it into bounded, warmup-annealed weights for training a data-space flow matching model. Experiments on seven TSAD benchmarks show that RT-FM improves rare-normal coverage while preserving strong anomaly discrimination, substantially reducing false alarms on such windows and resulting in improved aggregate detection performance. The code is available at: this https URL
comment: IEEE International Conference on Big Data 2026 (December)

AI.tldr: RT-FM利用残差潜空间尾部程度加权训练流匹配，减少稀有正常时间窗口的异常误报。
AI.motivation: 平均风险训练偏重常见正常模式，使数据空间流匹配可能将稀有但有效的正常窗口误判为异常。

title: When Should Decision Models Compare Candidates?
summary: Language-model agents frequently select among candidate actions, such as tools and web elements. Should decision models score candidates independently or allow their scores to depend on other candidates? We investigate this question by comparing three approaches: Pointwise scoring, Setwise scoring, and Candidate Attention. Across five agent-decision benchmarks, Pointwise scoring remains competitive, while Setwise scoring performs better on some tool-selection and binary-decision tasks. Candidate Attention does not consistently improve upon Pointwise scoring, despite allowing cross-candidate interaction. Using two controlled synthetic tasks, we further examine whether models learn to use candidate-set information. With targeted relational training, Setwise models learn candidate dependencies and generalize to shifted inputs, while Candidate Attention shows weaker transfer. Our results show that access to other candidates does not guarantee effective comparison, and that its benefits depend on both task requirements and training.

AI.tldr: 候选间比较的收益取决于任务与训练，允许交互并不保证决策更优。
AI.motivation: 探究语言模型智能体选择行动时，应独立评分还是利用其他候选的信息。
AI.method: 在五个决策基准及两个合成任务上比较逐项评分、集合评分和候选注意力。
AI.result: 逐项评分保持竞争力，集合评分在部分任务更优，且经关系训练后迁移强于候选注意力。
AI.conclusion: 有效利用候选依赖需要匹配任务需求与训练方式，不能仅依赖交互机制。

title: Spectral Landmarks: Alignment of Landmark Kernel Translates with the Leading Eigenfunctions of a Kernel Operator
summary: We study the problem of choosing $m$ landmark points so that the span of the kernel translates is as close as possible to the leading $s$-dimensional eigenspace of a positive-definite kernel. The natural measure is the Hilbert-Schmidt operator discrepancy between the reproducing-kernel-Hilbert-space (RKHS) projectors onto the two subspaces. We give a closed form spectral alignment function in terms of the truncated Mercer kernel and relate it to the classical integrated power function (Nyström trace error) through a two-sided sandwich bound. Minimizing the function by gradient descent on the landmark coordinates produces landmark sets that are evenly spaced. Theoretical results show that optimal configurations are those whose eigenfunction sampling matrix is a scaled isometry. On homogeneous spaces these are exactly the minimal equal-weight cubature rules for products of leading eigenfunctions, and for every $m\ge s$ they are the configurations whose sampled eigenfunctions form a unit-norm tight frame. Experiments on $\mathbb{S}^1$ and $\mathbb{S}^2$ agree with the theory. On the circle, with $s\le2m$ and a moderate bandwidth, every random start converges to equispaced landmarks, and on the sphere the optimizer recovers the regular tetrahedron, octahedron, and icosahedron from random starts. Finally, we analyze the numerical conditioning of the problem.

AI.tldr: 通过谱对齐目标选择核地标，使核平移张成空间贴近主特征子空间。
AI.motivation: 为正定核选择地标点，以减小其张成空间与主特征子空间的投影差异。
AI.method: 推导截断Mercer核下的谱对齐闭式函数及双边界，并对地标坐标进行梯度优化。
AI.result: 理论刻画了最优采样矩阵的缩放等距性，圆与球面实验恢复等距点和规则多面体。
AI.conclusion: 谱对齐将核地标选择与等权求积、紧框架联系起来，实验支持理论刻画。

title: Canonical activation patterns and ReLU pattern varieties
summary: A ReLU pattern variety records the polynomial relations among the coefficients of the affine maps associated with a prescribed set of activation patterns of a ReLU network. We study how the combinatorics of the canonical set of activation patterns of an unbiased ReLU network is reflected in the geometry of its pattern variety. In particular, we introduce the notion of pattern stability and characterize pattern stability and combinatorial stability for shallow networks. When the associated wall graph is connected and contains an edge of every neuron label, we resolve a problem of Alexandr and Montúfar by determining the defining ideal of the associated pattern variety explicitly. We establish a hierarchy of progressively weaker equivalence relations relating labeled combinatorial equivalence, equality and permutation equivalence of canonical pattern sets, and equivalences of the associated varieties. Finally, we relate functional dimension to the differential of the pattern map and show that it is bounded above by the dimension of the canonical pattern variety at every depth. For nondegenerate shallow networks, we give an exact formula for the functional dimension; for every shallow architecture, it equals the dimension of the canonical pattern variety on an open dense set of full Lebesgue measure.

AI.tldr: 研究无偏置ReLU网络的典范激活模式如何决定模式簇几何与函数维数。
AI.motivation: 厘清激活模式的组合结构、模式簇的代数几何及网络函数维数之间的关系。
AI.method: 引入模式稳定性，分析墙图与模式映射微分，并建立组合及几何等价关系层级。
AI.result: 在特定墙图条件下给出定义理想，并证明浅层网络函数维数几乎处处等于典范模式簇维数。
AI.conclusion: 典范模式簇维数在任意深度均为函数维数的上界，浅层非退化情形可精确计算。

title: Words Speak Louder? Exploring the Language Shortcut of LLM-Driven Incomplete Multimodal Learning
summary: Is a face or a voice still heard once the words are known? Incomplete multimodal learning increasingly uses large language models (LLMs) as fusion engines: modality features enter as token blocks and missing modalities become placeholders. We find that LLM-driven fusion can override non-verbal evidence it can read. Contrasting its full-input prediction with counterfactual views, the same model shown one modality or no content, we identify language shortcuts. We build MR-Bench: MR-Bench-A types every test sample of four sentiment benchmarks; MR-Bench-H contains 900 human-validated clips (620 language-shortcut, LS; 280 non-verbal-shortcut, NS) from seven sources, and every model is scored on all of them. Zero-shot MLLMs solve at most 32.7% of the LS clips; adding the transcript to the muted video lowers vision-language accuracy by 46.1-53.1 points. Yet inverting a text-only model's answers solves 94.4%, so LS accuracy alone cannot establish use of non-verbal evidence. Inside the fusion LLM, fused states align increasingly with the text view late in the decoder. Counterfactual-View Reliability learning (CoVeR) trains views as unimodal judges and withholds fused supervision where they disagree. It achieves state-of-the-art results on five benchmarks without extra inference cost in accuracy mode. On MR-Bench-H, it reaches 61.7% LS and 93.6% NS accuracy; robust mode raises LS accuracy to 63.0% while lowering NS accuracy to 84.8%. Among LS clips solved without text, adding text causes errors on 30.1% with CoVeR versus 32.2% with LLM-Fusion. Project page: this https URL.
comment: 19 pages, 7 figures, 14 tables. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 揭示大语言模型多模态融合中的语言捷径，并提出反事实视图可靠性学习加以缓解。
AI.motivation: 检验多模态融合在文本存在时，是否会忽略可读取的视觉与语音等非语言证据。
AI.method: 构建MR-Bench，以反事实视图识别捷径，并用CoVeR训练单模态判别器及筛选融合监督。
AI.result: CoVeR在五个基准达到最佳表现，在MR-Bench-H上语言与非语言捷径准确率为61.7%和93.6%。

title: BlockAlign: Preference Optimization for Trajectory-Distilled Video Generation
summary: Directly aligning trajectory-distilled video generators slashes rollout costs and optimizes the deployed few-step model without teacher fine-tuning or re-distillation. However, conventional flow-matching preference objectives assume single-head local velocity supervision, mismatching the finite-interval, block-average transition interface of trajectory-distilled generators such as Parallel Decoding Distillation (PDD) and Parametric Trajectory Distillation (PTD). Naively supervising only the primary initial-subinterval velocity sub-head rather than the fused block-average velocity at block starts (DirectAlign) induces a severe training--inference mismatch that degrades quality below the unaligned baseline. We introduce BlockAlign, an interface-consistent preference optimization framework that constructs states at valid block boundaries, queries the fused block-level velocity predictor, and supervises span-normalized transition residuals-seamlessly supporting DPO-, NFT-, and rollout-style objectives while preserving the native few-step sampler. We further build a unified post-training pipeline integrating offline pairs, reward-free semi-online continuations, and online rollouts with hierarchical preference selection and objective-aware block scheduling. Experiments on multi-reference video generation across MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA and an in-house model RefVid-V4 show that BlockAlign consistently outperforms unaligned distilled models and DirectAlign in structural plausibility, reference consistency, and visual quality. Notably, our approach unlocks PDD's 5x few-step rollout speedup for 3x faster end-to-end online training, achieving statistically significant human preference gains over PDD baselines (54.0% vs. 33.3% wins/losses, or 61.8% non-tie win rate on RefVid-V4; 51.3% vs. 34.7%, or 59.7% non-tie win rate on MiniMax-H3) and up to an 82.7% win rate against DirectAlign.

AI.tldr: BlockAlign通过匹配块级转移接口，提升轨迹蒸馏视频生成器的偏好对齐质量与效率。
AI.motivation: 传统局部速度偏好监督与轨迹蒸馏模型的块平均转移接口不匹配，导致训练推理偏差。
AI.method: 在有效块边界查询融合速度并监督跨度归一化转移残差，结合离线、半在线及在线训练。
AI.result: 两个模型上均优于未对齐模型及DirectAlign，在线训练提速3倍，对DirectAlign胜率最高82.7%。
AI.conclusion: 接口一致的偏好优化可保留原生少步采样器，同时改善视频结构、参考一致性与视觉质量。

title: EPI-SST: Renewal-Structured State-Space Transformers for Epidemic Forecasting
summary: Epidemic forecasting supports public health decisions ranging from capacity planning to intervention timing, for which both point accuracy and calibrated uncertainty are essential. Although neural models have advanced point forecasting, producing reliable probabilistic predictions over multiple future horizons remains challenging. Renewal models encode epidemic propagation, while neural forecasters learn flexible multi-horizon representations; integrating these strengths within a probabilistic future rollout remains underexplored. We propose EPI-SST (Epidemic State Space Transformer), a probabilistic forecaster centered on an evidence-driven renewal transition. At each horizon, neural evidence produces a bounded update to an internal multiplier and advances a finite-memory renewal state that generates the future mean trajectory. A separate heteroscedastic Gaussian head controls predictive scale using a validation-selected log-variance penalty. Across four epidemic surveillance benchmarks, EPI-SST achieves the lowest pooled RMSE on every dataset, reducing RMSE by up to 14.2 percent relative to the strongest baseline. It also achieves the lowest continuous ranked probability score (CRPS) at horizons h = 4, 5, 6 on every dataset, with reductions of up to 43 percent relative to the strongest probabilistic baseline. During the abnormal 2019-2020 influenza season, EPI-SST reduces CRPS by 16.9 percent and calibration error by 78.9 percent; a three-seed replication preserves its distributional lead. Ablation studies and frozen-path interventions show that the renewal transition, attention conditioning, horizon coupling, and uncertainty-scale control make complementary contributions to predictive performance.

AI.tldr: EPI-SST结合更新过程与神经状态空间预测，提升疫情多步预测精度及不确定性质量。
AI.motivation: 疫情决策需要准确且校准的多步概率预测，但传播机制与神经预测的融合仍不充分。
AI.method: 以神经证据驱动有界乘子更新及有限记忆更新状态，并用异方差高斯头控制预测尺度。
AI.result: 四个数据集的汇总RMSE均最低，较最强基线降幅最高14.2%，部分预测步CRPS降幅最高43%。
AI.conclusion: 更新转移、注意力条件化、跨步耦合与尺度控制互补提升预测，并改善异常流感季的校准。

title: Adaptive Koopman Predictive Control without Persistent Excitation via Matrix Normal Invariant Priors
summary: Finite-dimensional Koopman models are increasingly used in predictive control, but their accuracy remains limited by truncation errors and offline identification data. Adaptive Koopman predictive control promises to address this limitation, but typically requires closed-loop persistent excitation (PE). Since this is difficult to achieve in practice, in this paper we develop an adaptive generalized Koopman (GeKo) predictive controller that does not require PE. To this end, we formulate a recursive matrix regression in fixed lifted coordinates that extends the Kalman filter with back-to-the-prior forgetting to matrix-valued operators and uses a matrix normal invariant prior, centered at the operator identified offline. For any regressor sequence, and thus under any feedback law, we prove that the covariance remains between two multiples of the prior covariance and that the estimation error is input-to-state stable. On an academic example, a differential-drive robot and a power system with plant changes and little excitation, the invariant-prior estimator yields the lowest overall tracking error among the compared estimators and prevents covariance windup.

AI.tldr: 利用矩阵正态不变先验，实现无需持续激励的自适应Koopman预测控制。
AI.motivation: Koopman模型受截断误差和离线数据限制，而实际闭环系统难以满足持续激励条件。
AI.method: 在固定提升坐标中构建递归矩阵回归，以离线算子为先验中心并引入回归先验遗忘。
AI.result: 证明任意回归序列下协方差有界且估计误差输入到状态稳定，三个案例中总体跟踪误差最低。
AI.conclusion: 不变先验可在低激励及系统变化条件下支持稳定自适应估计，并防止协方差膨胀。

title: Flow Matching for Sampled-Data Control of Angular Distributions
summary: Synchronization and clustering in oscillator networks depend on the joint distribution of the phases. Flow Matching can steer this distribution by learning an angular velocity field from shortest arcs between paired configurations. Each arc is traversed at constant speed, yet the resulting field can vary along its own trajectories. In this article, we study how to control angular transport on the circle and product torus when each controller evaluation selects a rate to hold until the next update. Using the same local velocity samples, Flow Matching learns the instantaneous angular rate and MeanFlow learns its average along the reference trajectory over the control interval. Under direct angular actuation, holding the exact average gives the reference displacement. We relate the displacement error of holding the instantaneous rate and the training residual of MeanFlow to the conditional covariance of the teacher velocities. Experiments with 100 phases show that endpoint pairing affects the comparison. MeanFlow gives smaller one-step errors under minibatch pairing, while permutation alignment reverses the ranking for exchangeable phase clusters.

AI.tldr: 比较瞬时与区间平均角速度学习，发现采样控制误差优势取决于相位端点配对方式。
AI.motivation: 控制器更新间保持角速度不变时，瞬时速度场未必能准确实现参考角位移。
AI.method: 比较Flow Matching与MeanFlow，并将位移误差及平均速度训练残差关联到教师速度条件协方差。
AI.result: 100相位实验中，MeanFlow在小批量配对下一步误差更小，而可交换相位簇的置换对齐使排名反转。
AI.conclusion: 直接角度驱动下保持精确平均速度可实现参考位移，但学习方法的比较受端点配对影响。

title: Structure-Guided Multi-Granularity Spatiotemporal Transformer for Efficient Monocular 3D Human Pose Estimation
summary: Existing multi-granularity methods for monocular 3D human pose estimation emphasize spatial joint features while underusing skeletal structure, including global connectivity and temporal continuity. Moreover, modeling entire frame sequences incurs high computational costs. We propose a Structure-Aware Multi-Granularity Spatiotemporal Transformer that integrates structural priors across spatial and temporal representations for accurate and efficient pose estimation. A three-level feature extractor captures human topology at the joint, bone, and limb levels. Gated Adaptive Spatial Attention (GASA) embeds structural constraints into spatial attention, while Multi-Granularity Feature Enhancement (MGFE) uses hierarchical pooling and fusion to strengthen local details and global semantics. Temporal Segment Fusion (TSF) aligns temporal contexts across granularities to capture both short- and long-range motion patterns. Hierarchical Cross-Attention (HCA) promotes spatiotemporal interaction between granularities, and Keyframe Attention (KFA) selects informative motion segments to reduce redundancy and computational cost. Experiments demonstrate improved accuracy and efficiency over conventional Transformer-based approaches, highlighting the effectiveness of structure-aware multi-granularity modeling for monocular 3D human pose estimation.

AI.tldr: 提出结构感知多粒度时空Transformer，提高单目三维人体姿态估计的精度与效率。
AI.motivation: 现有方法对骨架全局连接和时间连续性利用不足，且整段序列建模计算开销较高。
AI.method: 提取关节、骨骼和肢体三级特征，结合结构约束注意力、多粒度融合及关键帧选择。
AI.result: 实验显示，该方法的精度和效率均优于常规Transformer方法。
AI.conclusion: 融合骨架结构先验与多粒度时空建模可有效改善单目三维姿态估计。

title: Settling the Support Complexity of Correlated Equilibria
summary: We study the support complexity of approximate correlated equilibria (CE) in two-player games, that is, the minimum number of pure action profiles that must be assigned positive probability to approximate a correlated equilibrium of a two-player matrix game. For $\varepsilon$-approximate coarse correlated equilibria, constant approximation is possible with support $O(\log N/\varepsilon^2)$ in $N\times N$ games. For correlated equilibria, the best known upper bound was $O(\log^2 N/\varepsilon^4)$ [Babichenko et al., 2014, 2017], but whether this bound was tight remained open. We establish a matching lower bound, resolving the open question of Ko and Schvartzman [2017]. Specifically, we show that, already for two-player zero-sum games, for every $1\leq k\leq N^{1/2}$ the worst-case correlated-equilibrium gap achievable by a distribution supported on at most $k$ pure profiles is $$ \Theta\left( \min\left\{1,\frac{\sqrt{\log N}}{k^{1/4}}\right\} \right), $$ which implies a $\Theta(\log^2 N/\varepsilon^4)$ worst-case support bound. The proof builds on a probabilistic-method construction based on random sign matrices.

AI.tldr: 证明双人博弈近似相关均衡的最坏情形支撑复杂度为Θ(log²N/ε⁴)，解决既有开放问题。
AI.motivation: 近似相关均衡已有支撑规模上界是否紧致，长期尚无定论。
AI.method: 利用基于随机符号矩阵的概率方法构造，证明双人零和博弈中的匹配下界。
AI.result: 当1≤k≤√N时，至多k个纯策略组合的最坏相关均衡间隙为Θ(min{1,√(log N)/k^(1/4)})。
AI.conclusion: 既有O(log²N/ε⁴)上界在最坏情形下紧致，且零和博弈已足以达到该复杂度。

title: Multi-Library Feature Engineering and Statistically Validated Classification for Power Swing Detection and Stability Assessment
summary: Faults occurring during power swings, and the evolution of a swing into an unstable condition, cause distance-relay maloperation and cascaded outages. This paper identifies faults, faults during power swings, and power swings, and distinguishes stable from unstable swings in a 9-bus WSCC system modeled in PSCAD/EMTDC. Three time-series feature libraries (tsfresh, TSFEL, and tsfeatures) are applied to the 3-phase relay voltages and currents, giving 3286 statistical, temporal, spectral, and fractal descriptors per event window. A two-step feature selection (Boruta all-relevant filtering followed by RFECV- and SHAP-guided minimal-optimal pruning) reduces the feature set to 18 compact, non-redundant features. 14 classifiers spanning linear, kernel/instance-based, probabilistic, neural, and tree-ensemble/boosting families are then benchmarked under repeated stratified cross-validation, with model differences assessed by a Friedman/Nemenyi omnibus-and-post-hoc test and a Nadeau--Bengio corrected paired t-test. Rotation Forest (ROF) identifies the three event types with 99.98% and SVM-RBF distinguishes stable from unstable swings with 97.97% balanced accuracy. The results show that automated, library-driven feature extraction combined with rigorous statistical model comparison achieves near-perfect discrimination while retaining feature-level interpretability through SHAP importance.
comment: Accepted at Annual Conference of the IEEE Industrial Electronics Society (IECON) 2026; 52nd Edition; Doha, Qatar

AI.tldr: 结合多库特征工程与统计验证，实现电力振荡相关事件识别及稳定性评估。
AI.motivation: 振荡期间故障及振荡失稳可能导致距离保护误动作与级联停电。
AI.method: 在九节点系统中提取3286项特征，经两阶段筛选保留18项，并统计比较14种分类器。
AI.result: 旋转森林事件识别准确率达99.98%，径向基核SVM稳定性判断的平衡准确率达97.97%。
AI.conclusion: 自动特征提取结合严格统计比较可实现高精度识别，并借助SHAP保留特征级可解释性。

title: HoloGene: Learning to Lift Sliced Spatial Transcriptomics to Holistic 3D Gene Fields
summary: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) provides spatially resolved gene expression measurements, but most 3D ST datasets are acquired as independently processed 2D sections. Computational approaches span slice registration and integration, explicit or generative interpolation, and coordinate-field modeling. Within the last family, implicit neural representations (INRs) offer a continuous, coordinate-queryable parameterization, but standard isotropic coordinate encodings do not explicitly reflect that serial-section measurements are dense in-plane and sparse along the axial direction. We present HoloGene, an anisotropic conditional INR framework for estimating continuous 3D gene-expression fields from pre-registered ST sections. Its central contribution is an acquisition-aware factorization that couples dense in-plane synthesis with sparse axial evolution using established GAE, FiLM, pseudo-label supervision, and CORAL components. HoloGene compresses high-dimensional expression profiles into a graph-autoencoder latent manifold, uses pseudo-label-derived signature conditioning to provide coarse intra-section context, and applies depth-dependent FiLM modulation to model axial variation. A signature-stratified correlation-alignment regularizer encourages cross-slice covariance alignment in latent features. Using held-out measured sections as cross-sectional references, HoloGene improves reconstruction accuracy and biological preservation metrics compared with general-purpose INRs and adapted spatial-transcriptomics baselines. These results support anisotropic conditional modeling as a practical strategy for estimating 3D expression fields from discontinuous ST sections. Code is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: HoloGene利用各向异性条件隐式神经表示，从预配准切片估计连续三维基因表达场。
AI.motivation: 空间转录组切片面内密集、轴向稀疏，而标准各向同性坐标编码未显式体现该采样特征。
AI.method: 结合图自编码器、伪标签条件、深度相关FiLM调制及分层协方差对齐，建模面内表达与轴向变化。
AI.result: 以留出实测切片评估时，重建精度与生物学保真指标优于通用隐式表示及适配基线。
AI.conclusion: 面向采集特征的各向异性条件建模，是从不连续切片估计三维表达场的可行策略。

title: Pretty Linear Liars: Unregularized Probes Favor Intervention-Unfaithful Features
summary: Linear probing is a common technique in mechanistic interpretability despite the fact that the decodability of a given feature does not necessarily imply the network uses that feature. Intervention faithfulness, not merely decodability, is the appropriate criterion for whether a feature serves a defined active role in the model. Meanwhile, probe regularization has been used for feature discovery, but the impact of regularization on feature causality remains unclear. We study probe regularization systematically, starting with unregularized ordinary least squares (OLS) regression and considering increasing amounts of regularization via ridge regression. We show theoretically that OLS probes amplify low-variance directions in activation space that have spurious correlations with the target feature, whereas regularization reduces influence from these directions. Empirically, we find in a toy transformer and Llama-2-7B that intervention faithfulness increases up to a point, and then decreases again, and that the optimal regularization strength leads to features bearing striking similarity (in both direction and variance) to those learned by optimizing for intervention outcomes directly. Together, these results provide mechanistic justification for regularizing regression probes.
comment: 13 pages, 9 figures. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Interpretability as a Science (InterpScience)

AI.tldr: 无正则线性探针易偏向干预不忠实特征，适度岭正则化可改善其干预忠实度。
AI.motivation: 特征可被解码不代表模型实际使用它，而探针正则化对特征因果性的影响尚不清楚。
AI.method: 理论分析普通最小二乘与岭回归，并在玩具Transformer及Llama-2-7B上检验干预忠实度。
AI.result: 普通最小二乘放大低方差伪相关方向；随正则增强，干预忠实度先升后降。
AI.conclusion: 适度正则化具有机制依据，其最优探针特征与直接优化干预结果所得特征高度相似。

title: VisDrone-ReID: A Unified Multi-Category Object Re-Identification Benchmark
summary: Object re-identification (Re-ID) benchmarks remain predominantly confined to single-category evaluations, limiting the development of unified systems capable of operating across diverse object types. This paper presents VisDrone-ReID, a unified multi-category Re-ID benchmark derived from the VisDrone2019-MOT dataset through a principled conversion pipeline. The pipeline resolves structural incompatibilities between multi-object tracking annotations and Re-ID evaluation requirements, addressing sequence-scoped identity collision, temporal redundancy, and the absence of a principled identity-level train/test split. The resulting benchmark comprises 9,516 identities and 150,016 images across ten object categories - pedestrian, people, bicycle, car, van, truck, tricycle, awning-tricycle, bus, and motor, sourced from 80 unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) sequences captured across urban environments. A leave-one-out (LOO) evaluation protocol is adopted to provide a comprehensive assessment. Baseline experiments across four representative Re-ID models spanning CNN and transformer architectures establish the first systematic performance reference on this benchmark. Results reveal a consistent Rank-1 to mAP gap across all models, suggesting that VisDrone-ReID presents a genuine retrieval challenge beyond nearest-neighbour matching. Per-category analysis identifies pedestrian as the most challenging category and reveals that vision-language pretraining provides a measurable advantage on semantically distinctive categories. VisDrone-ReID provides a consistent platform for studying multi-category object re-identification under the scale variation, viewpoint challenges, and category diversity characteristic of real-world surveillance scenarios.

AI.tldr: 构建统一多类别重识别基准VisDrone-ReID，覆盖十类目标及真实无人机监控挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有重识别基准主要局限于单类别，阻碍跨多种目标类型的统一系统研究。
AI.method: 转换VisDrone2019-MOT标注，解决身份冲突、时间冗余和数据划分问题，以留一协议评测四种模型。
AI.result: 基准含9516个身份和150016张图像；各模型均有明显Rank-1与mAP差距，行人类别最难。
AI.conclusion: 该基准提供统一多类别评测平台，且表明视觉语言预训练对语义鲜明类别具有优势。

title: Halting in Recurrent Sequence Models
summary: Recurrent sequence models, such as recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and state space models (SSMs), are often trained to emit an end-of-sequence (EOS) token when their output sequence is complete. During training, EOS is treated as another token without a special loss term or incentive. Although this training paradigm is widely used, it is not understood how models decide to output EOS. We study a minimal version of the EOS halting problem in which networks are trained to emit a given input sequence an instructed number of times, followed by EOS. We train tanh RNNs and linear SSMs on this task, finding that the RNNs encode the number of tokens left to copy in a linear subspace, of which two principal components capture most of the variation. Hidden states with the same remaining count converge to a shared representation regardless of their instructed repeat count. By modulating the hidden state using an affine transformation at the boundary between copied sequences, we shift the RNN's state to the representation shared by states with one fewer copy remaining. The unchanged network emits EOS one copy earlier while reproducing the shortened target sequence in 94.4% of new sequences, revealing that this representation causally determines the stopping time. In the SSMs, the difference between trajectories with different repeat counts is separated across two-dimensional rotation planes whose contributions to the EOS comparison cancel during copying and align near the stopping time. Rotating the planes independently removes most of the intended stopping while preserving the copied content, which shows that the stopping time depends on the planes' relative phases. These results identify two candidate primitives of EOS halting in recurrent models: a shared encoding of the number of remaining tokens in tanh RNNs and phase alignment across fixed rotations in linear SSMs.
comment: 16 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Interpretability as a Science

AI.tldr: 揭示循环模型输出结束标记的两种候选机制：剩余数量编码与旋转相位对齐。
AI.motivation: 结束标记通常作为普通词元训练，但循环模型如何决定停止生成尚不清楚。
AI.method: 训练tanh RNN与线性状态空间模型按指定次数复制序列，并干预隐状态及旋转平面。
AI.result: RNN状态干预使94.4%新序列少复制一次并正确结束；打乱状态空间模型相位则主要破坏停止行为。
AI.conclusion: RNN的剩余数量表征与线性状态空间模型的相对相位，对停止时间具有因果作用。

title: Trait Collapse in Text-to-Image Generation: Evaluating and Mitigating Personality Inconsistency in Visual Storytelling
summary: In visual storytelling, a believable character must not only look consistent across scenes but also \textit{behave} in ways that reflect their personality. Current text-to-image (T2I) models preserve visual appearance effectively, yet consistently fail to maintain personality-relevant behavior---a failure we term \textit{trait collapse}. We show that conventional metrics (CLIP Score, DINO similarity) are blind to this failure, and that abstract personality descriptors and scene-level emotion labels do not produce consistent improvements over neutral prompts across models. To systematically diagnose trait collapse, we introduce \textbf{ViStoryBench-Personality}, a story-level benchmark combining an expert-validated Visual Cues Lexicon (Fleiss' $\kappa = 0.757$) with a six-dimensional metric suite covering personality alignment, cross-scene stability, and behavioral coherence. Evaluating seven T2I systems, we confirm a persistent semantic gap between abstract trait labels and visual evidence, and find that visual identity consistency does not imply personality consistency. To bridge this gap, we propose \textbf{Trait-Behavior-Visual (TBV)}, a training-free prompting framework that decomposes personality traits into renderable visual constraints. TBV improves Personality Alignment Score by up to $+22.1\%$, with larger gains in models with stronger language-conditioning capacity.
comment: EMNLP 2026 Main Conference Paper. 26 pages, 5 figures

AI.tldr: 提出人格一致性基准及免训练提示框架TBV，诊断并缓解文生图视觉故事中的人格坍塌。
AI.motivation: 角色外观一致不保证行为符合人格，而常规图文及视觉相似度指标难以发现此问题。
AI.method: 构建专家验证视觉线索词典与六维评测体系，评估七种系统，并将人格转化为可渲染视觉约束。
AI.result: 七种系统均存在抽象人格与视觉证据的语义鸿沟；TBV使人格对齐分数最高提升22.1%。
AI.conclusion: 将抽象人格分解为具体视觉约束可改善一致性，且语言条件能力较强的模型获益更大。

title: Signs of Wear: Evaluating Intelligent Speed Assistance Under Synthetic Adverse Conditions
summary: Intelligent Speed Assistance (ISA) systems rely on cameras to recognize speed-limit signs, yet existing benchmarks underrepresent the weathered, dirty, and overgrown signs commonly encountered on rural roads. We use generative image editing to introduce different forms of wear into real street-level images of speed-limit signs. The resulting ISA-Wear dataset contains paired original and edited images. Guided by text instructions, a multimodal image-editing model adds snow, rust, vegetation, faded paint, or mud to the speed-limit sign in a street-level frame at three severity levels. Where appropriate, the surrounding scene is adapted as well, and the viewpoint is kept. Every edited frame has an unedited counterpart, and we only evaluate frames whose original is recognized correctly, so any failure can be attributed to the wear. Since the model alters the sign's geometry in 21\% of the edits, all edits are filtered by a geometric check and a manual review. Severity is measured as the LPIPS distance between the original and the edited sign plate. On 716 worn frames, we find that in detect-then-read pipelines, wear breaks detection before it breaks reading. The detector finds only 62\% of the worn signs, even though it finds every one of them in the original frames. Missed detections account for 78--87\% of failed reads, a pattern that a zero-shot detector shares. Given the annotated sign box, as in the crop-based benchmarks, a classifier still reads 78\% of the worn signs, but only 56\% when it has to rely on the detector

AI.tldr: 合成磨损测试表明，限速标志受损时，智能限速辅助系统的检测环节比识读环节更易失效。
AI.motivation: 现有评测较少覆盖乡村道路上常见的风化、污损和植被遮挡限速标志。
AI.method: 利用生成式图像编辑构建原图与三级磨损图配对数据，并经几何检查和人工审核评估检测识读流程。
AI.result: 716张磨损图中检测率为62%，漏检占识读失败的78%—87%，给定标志框时识读率为78%。
AI.conclusion: 仅基于裁剪标志的评测会掩盖磨损导致的检测瓶颈，应评估完整检测识读流程。

title: JointQ: Joint Scale-and-Integer Quantization for Large Language Models
summary: GPTQ is the de facto standard solver for layer-wise post-training quantization (PTQ) of large language models, yet the solver itself has received less attention than weight preprocessing and cross-layer objectives. We target a bottleneck of GPTQ: its greedy procedure optimizes continuous group scales separately from the assignment of discrete integers. Evaluating each integer candidate with its closed-form optimal scale has been used for per-channel quantization; JointQ extends it to group-wise quantization, where a row's scales are coupled through the Hessian, and applies it to refine the GPTQ solution. Each local-search move changes one integer and recomputes its group's optimal scale in closed form, accounting for the other groups through the full Hessian; all scales are periodically re-solved jointly. The search starts from a row-wise selection among scale-refitted candidates including the GPTQ solution, so unregularized JointQ never has a larger layer-wise calibration error than GPTQ. JointQ preserves the GPTQ output format and is thus a drop-in replacement. Across four models and four settings, JointQ improves six-task average zero-shot accuracy over vanilla GPTQ in 14 of 16 comparisons and perplexity in 12 of 16. The mean accuracy gain increases from 0.0044 in W4G128 to 0.1559 in W3 per-channel, and JointQ also improves average accuracy over GPTQ with MSE-based scale search and activation ordering in all eight per-channel comparisons, though rarely in G128. An ablation shows that JointQ's diagonal Tikhonov regularization mitigates severe W3 per-channel perplexity degradation, so the largest gains are not due to the local search alone. Overall, JointQ's primary empirical benefit is downstream accuracy preservation in challenging low-bit and large-group regimes. Code is available in the OneComp library at this https URL.
comment: 49 pages, 4 figures. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: JointQ通过联合优化量化整数与尺度，改善大语言模型在低比特等困难配置下的精度保持。
AI.motivation: GPTQ贪心求解将连续组尺度与离散整数分开优化，限制了量化效果。
AI.method: 从GPTQ等候选解出发，利用完整海森矩阵交替调整整数、闭式重估组尺度并周期性联合求解尺度。
AI.result: 16项比较中零样本平均准确率改善14项、困惑度改善12项，正则化也对最大收益有重要贡献。
AI.conclusion: JointQ兼容GPTQ输出格式，主要实证优势在于困难低比特和大分组配置下保持下游精度。

title: DominoBench: Evaluating Multi-Step Physical Reasoning from Still Images
summary: Can a vision-language model look at a picture of a chain reaction and tell what will happen? Recent multimodal models describe scenes fluently and solve textbook physics problems, which suggests they should also predict how a scene of ramps, ledges, pendulums, seesaws and dominoes plays out once a ball is pushed. We tested this claim on 30 models from 10 families and reached a clear conclusion: unaided, no model predicts the outcome reliably. We built DominoBench, a benchmark of still images of 2D rigid-body scenes whose outcome a physics simulator computes. It holds 854 items in 427 minimal pairs, in which a change of one to three grid steps in one quantity decides whether one person survives, and every item comes with a four-rung hint ladder ending in the exact calculation that decides the outcome. Unaided, frontier models from Anthropic, Google and OpenAI are right about the person whose fate flips in at most 72% of items and answer both twins of a pair correctly in at most 34%. Pointing at the deciding step helps little, and exact geometry given as text barely helps, yet once the deciding calculation and the quantities it needs, including speeds that a still image cannot show, are written out, the same models reach 82-92% on the deciding person, while small open-weight models stay near chance. Physical prediction from a still image therefore fails at the quantitative step: the strongest models use the deciding quantity when they are given it, but do not produce it on their own. For models that plan or act in the physical world, a fluent account of a scene is thus no evidence of a correct prediction: such models must find and compute the deciding quantity unprompted, and DominoBench tests whether they do.
comment: DominoBench dataset, evaluation harnesses, and benchmarks available at this https URL

AI.tldr: DominoBench显示，视觉语言模型难以仅凭静态图像可靠预测多步物理连锁反应。
AI.motivation: 模型能流畅描述场景和解答物理题，但这是否意味着能预测真实物理过程仍需检验。
AI.method: 构建854题、427组最小差异配对的二维物理仿真图像基准，以四级提示测试10个系列的30个模型。
AI.result: 无辅助时关键人物判断准确率最高72%、配对全对率最高34%，提供决定性计算后前沿模型达82%—92%。
AI.conclusion: 主要瓶颈是自主找出并计算决定性物理量，流畅的场景描述不能证明预测正确。

title: Generalized Prediction Set with Bandit Feedback
summary: In high-stakes environments where uncertainties abound, set-valued prediction offers a cautious and robust mechanism by presenting multiple potential labels as the prediction for each test instance to mitigate the potential risk associated with prediction errors. Yet, integrating this paradigm with out-of-distribution (OOD) detection remains scarcely explored in such settings as online learning with bandit feedback. The bandit feedback mechanism informs the learner about the correctness of the pulled arm/action instead of the explicit ground truth label, leaving the true class label unknown when an incorrect action is taken. To address this challenge, we introduce BanditGPS which conducts set-valued prediction with OOD detection in the bandit feedback setting, using an estimation to the ground truth of class labels. BanditGPS achieves three objectives: render small/informative prediction sets, enhance the OOD detection performance, and control the recall for all normal classes to meet prescribed requirements. Our approach is characterized by the loss function, which trades off between high OOD detection and small prediction sets. Theoretically, we prove that the convergence rate of the regret is $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T^{-1/2})$. The empirical results further show that BanditGPS effectively controls the recalls with promising performances on OOD detection and informative prediction.

AI.tldr: BanditGPS在仅获动作正误反馈时，同时实现集合预测、分布外检测与正常类别召回率控制。
AI.motivation: 高风险在线学习需要谨慎的集合预测，但错误动作不揭示真实标签，使分布外检测融合更困难。
AI.method: 估计真实类别标签，并设计权衡分布外检测与预测集大小的损失函数，同时约束正常类别召回率。
AI.result: 理论证明遗憾收敛率为Õ(T^(-1/2))，实验显示可有效控制召回率并获得良好检测和信息性预测表现。
AI.conclusion: BanditGPS为不完整反馈下兼顾预测集信息性、分布外检测和类别召回要求提供了方案。

title: Architectural Principles for Parameter-Efficient Unitary Transformations in Coherent Optical Neural Networks
summary: Coherent optical neural networks based on interferometric architectures offer a promising route toward high-throughput, energy-efficient computation by exploiting the multiple degrees of freedom of light, including spatial, temporal, and spectral modes. However, practical implementations are constrained by the number of tunable parameters due to fabrication complexity, device footprint, and control overhead. In such parameter-constrained settings, achieving high expressive power remains a central challenge. We identify two key architectural requirements for maintaining high expressive power under these constraints: (i) statistical uniformity in the implemented transformations and (ii) strong mixing capability per parameter, which enables rapid and unbiased redistribution of information across modes. To realize these requirements, we develop a logarithmic-depth butterfly-topology architecture whose fundamental building block is a single phase-shifter--beam-splitter pair, in contrast to conventional rectangular mesh architectures based on Mach-Zehnder interferometers. Computational evaluations show that, particularly at restricted parameter counts, the proposed architecture achieves lower matrix-reconstruction errors and higher classification accuracies than conventional meshes in both feedforward and recurrent networks. We further quantify these design principles using graph-theoretic measures, expected squared moduli of transformation-matrix entries, and matrix-reconstruction error. The resulting framework provides a quantitative and physically interpretable basis for parameter-efficient optical neural networks.

AI.tldr: 研究提出参数高效光学网络设计原则，并以蝶形架构提升受限参数下的变换表达能力。
AI.motivation: 相干光学神经网络受制造复杂度、器件面积和控制开销限制，需要用较少可调参数维持表达能力。
AI.method: 以变换统计均匀性和单位参数强混合能力为原则，设计由单移相器—分束器对组成的对数深度蝶形架构。
AI.result: 计算评估显示，尤其在参数受限时，该架构在前馈及循环网络中比传统网格重建误差更低、分类准确率更高。
AI.conclusion: 结合图论指标与变换矩阵统计量，可为参数高效光学网络提供定量且物理可解释的设计依据。

title: Probabilistic Power Estimation and MPC-based Scheduling of Construction Electric Vehicles Supported by Mobile Charging Stations
summary: The adoption of construction electric vehicles (CEVs) is held back by sparse on-site charging infrastructure, limited mobility, and insufficient knowledge of their power consumption. Mobile charging stations (MCSs) towed between grid connection points and construction sites address the first barrier, yet scheduling them optimally requires an accurate estimate of the CEV power consumption. In this paper, we address these gaps, first, by estimating the power of each subactivity of a representative CEV (a compact electric excavator) based on real-world construction demonstration data. We use Bayesian linear regression to obtain the subactivity power distributions, accounting for their operational uncertainty. Second, we formulate a mixed-integer program that jointly schedules CEV work and charging together with MCS routing, charging, and discharging, optimizing electricity costs, carbon emissions, work completion, and MCS travel. We embed the optimizer in a shrinking-horizon model predictive control (MPC) loop to perform real-time control on the CEV-MCS system. Two MPC variants, one a certainty-equivalent MPC (CE-MPC) controller, and the other a scenario-based MPC (SB-MPC) controller, are compared in closed-loop against an open-loop day-ahead schedule. Realistic simulations show that SB-MPC performs the best, lowering the operating costs by $60.2\%$ relative to the open-loop baseline, and by $23.3\%$ relative to CE-MPC, demonstrating the efficacy of incorporating predictive control with feedback. The code is available at this https URL
comment: 5 pages, 2 tables; Submitted to IEEE PESGM 2027

AI.tldr: 结合概率功率估计与场景模型预测控制，可显著降低移动充电支持的施工电动车运行成本。
AI.motivation: 施工电动车面临充电设施稀缺、移动受限及功耗认知不足，移动充电站的调度也依赖准确功耗估计。
AI.method: 用贝叶斯线性回归估计子活动功率分布，并将车辆作业充电及移动站路径联合优化嵌入收缩时域MPC。

AI.conclusion: 考虑功耗不确定性并结合反馈的预测控制，能够改善施工电动车与移动充电站的协同调度。

title: Deploying a Control-Logic LLM Assistant in Air-Gapped Power Plants: Lessons in Source Authority and Bounded Retrieval
summary: Deploying Large Language Model (LLM) assistants in industrial operational technology environments poses constraints largely absent from cloud applications: site policies restrict engineering and operational data from leaving the plant, on-premises compute is limited, and incorrect causal attribution can mislead incident response. We report lessons from deploying a control-logic evidence layer that underpins a broader on-premises operator assistance system at two gas power plants. Two prototypes revealed where generative models added avoidable uncertainty and cost. The first used a Vision Language Model (VLM) to reconstruct control topology from PDF printouts routinely exchanged by engineers. Across the full 6,979-page document, extraction reached 0.51 connection precision and required 3.1 hours on 4xH200 GPUs; consultation with controls engineers then revealed a native structured export from the authoring system. The second used an LLM tool-calling agent to plan repeatedly over eight predefined graph operations. In a controlled benchmark of 40 template-generated questions, replacing this agent with explicit execution plans reduced mean token use by 20x and median latency by 3x, with identical retrieved node sets across repeated runs. The deployed design ingests the authoritative export into a versioned knowledge graph, executes bounded graph operations in fixed software, and confines the local LLM to fallback intent classification and evidence-grounded explanation. At one site, the graph contains 221K nodes across seven controllers. Our experience suggests a practical division of labor for high-consequence AI: LLMs interpret natural-language requests and explain results, while deterministic software constructs and retrieves technical evidence grounded in authoritative sources. Abstention, entity disambiguation, graph versioning, and read-only integration provide additional safeguards.
comment: Extended version of a paper accepted at IAAI-27 (AAAI 2027). 8 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables

AI.tldr: 两座隔离电厂的部署经验表明，权威数据源与确定性有界检索比生成式拓扑重建和反复规划更可靠高效。
AI.motivation: 工业现场数据不能外传、算力有限，且错误因果归因可能误导事故处置。
AI.method: 将权威结构化导出导入版本化知识图谱，以固定软件执行有界图操作，仅让本地模型辅助意图分类与证据解释。
AI.result: 视觉模型连接提取精确率仅0.51；40题基准中固定执行计划将平均令牌用量降至1/20、中位延迟降至1/3。
AI.conclusion: 高风险场景宜由确定性软件构建和检索权威证据，由语言模型理解请求并解释结果，辅以拒答等保障。

title: Implicit-Reasoning-Enabled Elastic Semantic Communications for AI-Agent Networks
summary: AI-agent networks introduce new communication demands driven by proactive interactions and autonomous task execution. Existing adaptive semantic communication schemes primarily adjust semantic representations and resource configurations within predefined processing scales and capability sets, which may be insufficient for evolving task requirements. To address this gap, we introduce elastic semantic communications (ESC), a task-driven framework that extends semantic adaptation to the runtime execution and participation of task-supporting capabilities. ESC comprises two complementary dimensions: vertical elasticity adjusts the execution intensity of existing capabilities, while horizontal elasticity reconfigures the participating capability set. The framework connects these dimensions through the expected marginal value of additional information and computation. To realize ESC, we propose an implicit-reasoning-enabled device--edge mechanism that supports variable-depth local inference through shared-parameter state updates and edge-side continuation through wireless transfer of intermediate reasoning states. Experiments on Sudoku-Extreme demonstrate that the benefits of additional inference depend on wireless conditions, while task-aware edge invocation can preserve task accuracy with substantially lower state-transfer overhead.

AI.tldr: 弹性语义通信通过动态调整推理强度与参与能力，支持AI智能体网络的任务驱动端边协作。
AI.motivation: 现有自适应语义通信局限于预设处理尺度和能力集合，难以满足不断变化的智能体任务需求。
AI.method: 以信息和计算的预期边际价值联结纵向执行强度与横向能力选择，通过共享参数状态更新和无线中间状态传输实现协作。
AI.result: Sudoku-Extreme实验表明，额外推理收益依赖无线条件，任务感知边缘调用可在保持准确率时显著减少状态传输。
AI.conclusion: 语义通信应按任务价值和无线条件共同调整推理深度及边缘参与，而非仅调整表示和资源。

title: Making Koopman Control Guarantees Hold on Robots
summary: A Koopman controller can stabilize its learned latent-space linear model yet fail to stabilize the nonlinear plant. The learned model propagates predictions in latent space, while the deployed controller repeatedly re-encodes the measured physical state. We show that nominal closed-loop stability transfers to the nonlinear plant when the learned and true closed-loop dynamics agree to first order on the embedding's tangent space at the target. We derive a robustness margin for approximate matching and show that a stable open-loop latent model cannot exactly match an unstable equilibrium. We introduce Tangent-Invariant Koopman (TIK), which estimates a local plant linearization from offline transitions and enforces first-order matching to this estimate. TIK recovers the fitted LQR gain at the target, while a bilinear predictor captures state-dependent actuation during large maneuvers. Across four simulated unstable benchmarks, all 40 Standard Koopman controllers have stable latent closed loops, but their deployed nonlinear systems are locally unstable. In contrast, all 40 TIK controllers locally stabilize their respective nonlinear plants. An offline stability test using empirical curvature estimates identifies stable TIK controllers on two cart-pole systems, but is inconclusive under high noise. Under explicit model-error and curvature bounds, an invariant terminal set guarantees constraint satisfaction after entry under local feedback. TIK achieves 88\% constrained cart-pole swing-up success with a 0.25 ms planning budget and controls simulated seven-joint arms within 1-5 ms per step.

AI.tldr: TIK通过约束目标处的一阶动力学匹配，使Koopman控制器的潜空间稳定性能够迁移至非线性系统。
AI.motivation: 学得的潜空间闭环稳定并不保证反复编码真实状态的非线性系统稳定。
AI.method: 从离线转移数据估计局部线性化并强制切空间一阶匹配，结合双线性预测器与稳定性检验。
AI.result: 40个TIK控制器均实现局部稳定，而40个标准控制器均不稳定，受约束小车摆起成功率达88%。
AI.conclusion: 切空间匹配可连接潜空间与真实系统的稳定性，并在明确误差与曲率界下提供终端约束保证。

title: Attention Sinks as Spectral Spikes: A Mechanism Analysis of Gated Attention
summary: Transformer attention exhibits attention sinks, where a small subset of source tokens absorbs disproportionate attention mass across layers. Recent work shows that post-SDPA output gating strongly reduces attention-sink behavior, while separate studies link attention sinks to gradient sinks and massive activations through backward training dynamics. Yet how the same gate affects forward sink structure, backward gradient concentration, and training-time representation signatures remains unclear. We address this gap by formulating attention sinks as sink-induced low-rank modes in token-space covariance, with directions aligned to high-mass attention columns. Under this view, post-SDPA gating acts as a mode-dependent contraction: it attenuates sink-induced spectral energy in the forward pass and locally reduces value-path gradients routed through sink columns in the backward pass. Empirically, random-matrix diagnostics show that gating reduces outlier mass, weakens sink-subspace alignment, and increases effective rank, while backward analyses show active-gate attenuation of first-token value gradients. Training-time diagnostics further show that gating suppresses the co-emergence of attention concentration, value-gradient amplification, and representation dominance.
comment: The 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)

AI.tldr: 研究将注意力汇解释为协方差中的低秩谱模态，并揭示输出门控如何同时削弱前向汇聚与反向梯度集中。
AI.motivation: 输出门控为何同时影响注意力汇、梯度集中及训练中的表征主导性尚不清楚。
AI.method: 将注意力汇建模为与高注意力列对齐的低秩模态，结合随机矩阵诊断、梯度分析和训练过程观测。
AI.result: 门控降低谱离群质量与汇子空间对齐，提高有效秩，并削弱首词元值梯度及相关表征主导性。
AI.conclusion: 输出门控通过模态依赖收缩，同时抑制注意力汇的前向谱能量与反向值路径梯度。

title: Latent Feedback Is a Compute and Data Amplifier
summary: When high-quality data runs out, a common practice is to train on it for several epochs, but each repeat is worth less than the last. Latent feedback, which feeds each token's top-layer state into the next token's input, is another way to spend that compute, yet it has not been tested against a vanilla Transformer that spends the same compute on more epochs. We run this test across a ladder of model sizes, unique data and epochs, tuning both models at every size and amount of unique data. Latent feedback makes every FLOP and every token count for more except when unique data is scarce relative to model size, a regime that today's models are far from. We find that latent feedback serves as an amplifier: with unique data fixed, it reaches a Transformer's loss with less compute; with epochs fixed, it reaches that loss with less unique data. Furthermore, both savings grow with unique data per parameter and with repetition, and downstream tasks agree. To go beyond our grid, we fit one scaling law to both models, in which latent feedback enters as a Transformer with more parameters; it predicts that both savings keep growing with unique data and repetition. Fitted on models from 60M to 271M parameters, the law predicts the losses at a held-out 778M size to within 0.3% and the gap between the two models to within 0.05%. At most, latent feedback saves 48% of the compute and 47% of the unique data. When data, not compute, is the limit, latent feedback is the better use of a FLOP for a model of a given size.

AI.tldr: 潜在反馈通常比将相同计算用于增加训练轮次更高效，最多节省48%计算与47%独立数据。
AI.motivation: 高质量数据受限时，尚不清楚潜在反馈是否优于同等计算预算下反复训练标准Transformer。
AI.method: 跨模型规模、独立数据量和训练轮次调优比较两类模型，并拟合统一缩放律进行外推。
AI.result: 计算与数据节省随每参数独立数据量及重复训练增加，缩放律对778M模型损失预测误差不超过0.3%。
AI.conclusion: 除独立数据相对模型规模极少的情形外，潜在反馈通常是固定规模模型在数据受限时更优的计算用途。

title: Refusal Register is Causally Steerable: Decomposing the Refusal Direction into Category-Aligned Components in Gemma-2-9B-IT
summary: Prior work shows that refusal in instruction-tuned language models can be ablated by intervening on a single residual-stream direction (Arditi et al., 2024), and more recent work finds multiple refusal-mediating directions and concept cones (Wollschläger et al., 2025). We ask a different question: do refusal-related directions carry information about the register of refusal language - how the model refuses - and not only whether it refuses? In Gemma-2-9B-IT we identify two SVM-derived linear directions (B1 for harmful-content vs. neutral, B2 for self-reference vs. neutral) at layer 20 with cos(B1, B2) = 0.252 (about 75 degrees, substantially non-parallel). Adding the harmful-vs-neutral difference-of-means direction (cosine 0.68 with B1) to the residual stream of self-reference prompts at alpha = 2.0 shifts content-safety vocabulary from 2.55 to 10.37 hits per 100 tokens, while a magnitude-matched random direction produces 1.13-2.16; the model continues to refuse but switches register from meta-style ("as a language model...") to content-style ("this would be harmful"). The same register-injection effect reproduces qualitatively in Gemma-2-2B-IT at layer 12 (content vocabulary 1.72 -> 6.37 at alpha = 1.0, vs. random control 1.35), with a narrower coherent-injection window than in 9B. The two directions are not symmetric: the B2 -> harmful intervention produces a much smaller register effect, and across ablation, sufficiency, and injection B1's causal effects are consistently larger than B2's. We frame this asymmetry as part of the finding: B1 appears to encode both category detection and refusal-vocabulary information, while B2 encodes primarily category detection. We frame the contribution as identifying category-aligned components related to the Arditi-style difference-of-means direction that play distinct functional roles in refusal register.
comment: 10 pages, 7 figures. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: Gemma中的拒绝相关方向不仅影响是否拒绝，也能因果性地改变拒绝措辞风格，且不同类别方向作用不对称。
AI.motivation: 既有研究关注拒绝是否发生，尚未明确拒绝方向是否编码模型如何表达拒绝。
AI.method: 在Gemma中识别有害内容与自我指涉的线性方向，通过残差流注入、消融及随机对照分析拒绝语体。
AI.result: 9B模型注入后安全词汇由每百词元2.55次增至10.37次且继续拒绝，2B模型也定性复现该效应。
AI.conclusion: 有害内容方向似乎兼具类别检测与拒绝词汇功能，而自我指涉方向主要编码类别检测。

title: Integrated GPU Core for Mamba-3
summary: Mamba-3, the latest Mamba state-space model (SSM), enables efficient long-context modeling, matching Mamba-2 perplexity with half the state size and increasing decoding arithmetic intensity. However, its multi-input multi-output (MIMO) computation, exponential-trapezoidal discretization, and rotary positional embeddings (RoPE) introduce dense, element-wise, and sequential operations. Despite kernel fusion, conventional GPUs execute these operations inefficiently. Our characterization of Mamba-3 hybrid models reveals numerous kernel launches, substantial data movement, and increased register pressure that reduces warp occupancy and memory-latency hiding. We propose RescuCore, a specialized GPU execution unit for Mamba-3 inference that retains other hybrid model layers on existing GPU resources. Integrated alongside CUDA Cores and Tensor Cores within each Streaming Multiprocessor (SM) sub-partition, RescuCore shares the register file, shared memory, and warp schedulers. Dense projections remain on conventional GPU resources, while RescuCore pipelines discretization, normalization, RoPE, MIMO computation, recurrent state updates, and output gating to reduce kernel fragmentation and intermediate data movement. We select BF16 after evaluating multiple numerical formats, preserving model accuracy with an estimated area overhead of 5.9% of an A100 die for state size 32 and MIMO rank 4. We evaluate RescuCore using cycle-accurate Accel-Sim simulation, RTL synthesis, and synthesis-informed AccelWattch power modeling. Compared with conventional GPU execution, RescuCore achieves 1.4-9.4x speedup and 1.4-5.0x energy reduction during prefill, and 1.3-2.8x speedup and 1.2-2.6x energy reduction during autoregressive decoding. These results demonstrate the potential of GPU-integrated specialized execution for SSM-based hybrid models.

AI.tldr: RescuCore将Mamba-3专用执行单元集成至GPU，以减少推理中的内核碎片与中间数据搬移。
AI.motivation: Mamba-3的离散化、位置编码和多输入多输出运算使常规GPU面临频繁启动、数据搬移与寄存器压力。
AI.method: 在SM子分区集成共享现有资源的BF16流水执行单元，并通过周期精确仿真、RTL综合和功耗建模评估。
AI.conclusion: GPU集成专用执行单元有望提升状态空间混合模型推理效率，所评配置的估计芯片面积开销为5.9%。

title: High-dimensional transfer learning with unaligned ordinal responses
summary: In this work, we study high-dimensional transfer learning with unaligned ordinal responses, allowing different domain-specific regression coefficients, cumulative links and thresholds. We develop the sample-split and full-target algorithms that pool source and target likelihoods and then estimate a target correction. Under suitable conditions, our algorithms achieve minimax-optimal rates for parameter estimation and excess risk. Simulations favor the full-target algorithm over the sample-split algorithm for finite-sample estimation and prediction. An application to a medical dataset further demonstrates the predictive gains of our full-target algorithm over the target-only and pooled baselines when transferring information from the five-category source data to binary hospital mortality.

AI.tldr: 研究提出适用于响应等级不对齐的高维迁移学习算法，并获得最小极大最优理论保证与预测收益。
AI.motivation: 跨域有序响应可能具有不同类别数、回归系数、累积链接函数与阈值，增加信息迁移难度。
AI.method: 设计样本拆分与全目标算法，先合并源域和目标域似然，再估计目标域修正。
AI.result: 适当条件下两算法达到最优估计与超额风险速率，全目标法在模拟及医疗死亡预测中表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 通过联合似然与目标域修正，可在有序响应不对齐时有效利用源域信息改善目标预测。

title: Training-Free Anonymization of Driving Data with Promptable Segmentation and 3D Human Mesh Recovery
summary: Camera recordings for autonomous driving contain faces and license plates that should be anonymized before labeling, sharing, or training. Dedicated detectors can miss small plates and faces behind vehicle glass. We present FM-Anonymize, a training-free anonymization pipeline that combines promptable segmentation, 3D human mesh recovery, and generative replacement. SAM 3 locates people, faces, and vehicles and searches zoomed vehicle crops for plates, occupants, and windows. SAM 3D Body assesses face visibility from head orientation and projects head regions for blurring. Optional diffusion inpainting replaces eligible blurred heads with synthetic faces, guided by estimated pose and keypoints.
