On PP4AV, the blur pipeline protects 97.8% of faces and 95.5% of plates, the highest privacy recall of all compared methods at their default settings. On our recordings, where the localization thresholds were set, it protects 97.1% of faces and 93.4% of plates, compared with 93.7%/73.0% for UrbanAnonymizer, 42.7%/40.7% for EgoBlur, and 96.6% of faces for deface. Synthetic replacement raises full-body keypoint average precision over blurring from 54.1% to 79.6% on our recordings and from 39.9% to 68.3% on PP4AV. Code and configurations are available on this https URL

AI.tldr: FM-Anonymize无需训练即可融合分割、三维人体恢复与生成替换，实现驾驶影像匿名化并保留姿态信息。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶录像需隐去人脸和车牌，但专用检测器容易漏掉小车牌及车窗后的人脸。
AI.method: 利用SAM 3分割及放大裁剪搜索，结合三维头部姿态投影模糊，并可选用扩散模型生成替代人脸。
AI.result: PP4AV上保护97.8%人脸和95.5%车牌；合成人脸替换将人体关键点平均精度从39.9%提高至68.3%。
AI.conclusion: 该免训练流程在默认设置对比中实现最高隐私召回率，生成替换还能减轻模糊对关键点识别的影响。

title: When the Cheapest Feasible Router Fails: Auditing Deployment Commitments in Cost-Aware LLM Routing
summary: Cost-aware LLM routing often selects the cheapest policy meeting empirical risk and coverage constraints. Yet a router that passes an audit can violate its fixed service contract on new requests, even when candidate policies are constructed independently. We study this deployment-commitment decision with disjoint construction, audit, and test samples. Across 19 RouterBench task families, the cheapest audit-feasible router deploys in 91.82% of opportunities but violates the held-out contract in 32.22% of deployments. We introduce Menu-Aware Routing Commitment (MARC), which qualifies policies using audit evidence and a serving-cost tolerance to retain the apparent winner, deploy a supported alternative, or defer. Its practical policywise variant (MARC-P) reduces observed conditional failure to 0.73% at 85.79% deployment, with higher serving cost; fixed-margin and formal risk-control procedures provide competitive alternatives. Nested audits show how added evidence changes deployable policy sets, and learned semantic routing exhibits the same commitment failure. These results establish deployment commitment as a distinct operational decision connecting router evaluation, service reliability, and inference cost.

AI.tldr: 最低成本且通过审计的LLM路由仍可能违约，MARC通过证据与成本容忍度管理部署承诺以降低失败。
AI.motivation: 经验风险和覆盖约束下的审计可行性，并不保证路由器在新请求上遵守固定服务合同。
AI.method: 分离构建、审计和测试样本，提出MARC以保留候选赢家、部署有证据支持的替代策略或暂缓部署。
AI.result: 19类任务中最低成本方案部署后违约率为32.22%；MARC-P将其降至0.73%，部署率85.79%但成本更高。
AI.conclusion: 部署承诺是区别于路由评估的独立决策，需要联合权衡审计证据、服务可靠性与推理成本。

title: Reasoning Again with a Quarter of the Experts: Retry First, Then Train
summary: Removing three quarters of the routed experts from a 122B-parameter reasoning mixture-of-experts model makes it fit in a 12 GiB file, and breaks it in a specific way: on LiveCodeBench it enters verbatim reasoning loops that run to the token limit on 44 of 120 development problems, where the unpruned model at the same 2-bit quantization loops on none. We study how much of that loss can be recovered without changing the kept experts' quantized bytes, in three steps of increasing cost. On development problems, a sampling penalty recovers part of it. Stopping a reply when it starts to loop and drawing again recovers more on top of it, with no weight change. Our method, B, adds rank-8 trained corrections to the kept experts, loaded as an adapter, and restores two experts per layer; it is fitted layer by layer to the unpruned model's expert block on the pruned model's own activations. In a pre-registered comparison on 130 easy and medium LiveCodeBench problems that no part of the study had touched, with both arms given the same sampling penalty and the same stop-and-redraw policy, B solves 116 problems against 104 (+9.2 pp, 95% CI [+3.1, +15.4]; 15 problems gained, 3 lost). A training-free weight edit aimed at the loops, tested the same way earlier, did not help. B removes more wrong answers than loops, and costs 1.7x the wall time. On two older benchmarks used as regression checks, B stays inside a pre-set 2 pp tolerance but shows no gain (HumanEval+ +0.6 pp, MBPP+ -1.9 pp). The evidence is one model, one quantization and one benchmark family; we state what it does and does not show.

AI.tldr: 对大幅剪枝的推理混合专家模型，重试策略与低秩适配可部分恢复性能。
AI.motivation: 专家剪枝虽降低存储需求，却使模型频繁陷入推理循环并损失解题能力。
AI.method: 先采用采样惩罚与循环停止重采样，再逐层训练秩8修正适配器并恢复每层两个专家。
AI.result: 独立测试中解题数从104增至116，提升9.2个百分点，但耗时增至1.7倍，旧基准无提升。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在单一模型、量化设置和基准家族中有效，但其普适性尚未得到验证。

title: A Structural Framework for Succession: Continuation, Recognition, and Realization
summary: Succession asks whether an entity encountered later is the same entity that entered an arrangement earlier. For an artificial system that is fine-tuned, distilled, or copied, it has to be answered. We look for a mathematical structure weak enough to cover any such case and strong enough to support general theorems, so that results follow from the structure's conditions rather than from a particular pipeline or criterion. Succession is modeled on state/modification graphs with relational lifts that compose along paths. Within this framework we separate four questions that are often conflated: which continuations a representation admits, which descendants are compatible with a modification, which are recognized as continuing the identity, and which are realized. The framework allows one to address systematically questions of symmetry, computational complexity, recoverability, and robustness to partial realization, and we establish what the structure settles in each case before any particular criterion of identity is chosen.

AI.tldr: 提出实体承继的数学框架，区分延续、修改兼容性、身份认可与实际实现。
AI.motivation: 人工系统经微调、蒸馏或复制后，需要不依赖具体流程或身份判据的结构来讨论身份延续。
AI.method: 在状态与修改图上建模承继，并引入可沿路径复合的关系提升。
AI.result: 框架在选定身份判据前，确立了结构对对称性、计算复杂性、可恢复性和部分实现鲁棒性的约束。
AI.conclusion: 实体承继的不同问题可被系统分离，并依据共同结构进行分析。

title: FinVerify: A Verification Framework for Financial Agents
summary: Financial agents produce numerical claims that can be wrong even when their calculations execute correctly, due to mismatched reporting periods, unsupported sources, incompatible units, or incorrect financial definitions. We introduce FinVerify, an evidence-grounded framework for verifying financial agents' numerical claims. Based on an analysis of 190 incorrect trajectories from the Agent Finance Reasoning dataset, we define five error categories--temporal integrity, source fidelity, comparability, accounting integrity, and financial-model fidelity--and operationalize them as verification protocols. An LLM structures claims and supporting evidence, while deterministic validators check financial requirements; when authoritative formulas are available, Z3 checks consistency with grounded inputs. FinVerify accepts only if all applicable checks pass, rejects proven violations, and abstains when evidence is insufficient. We evaluate the framework against a Direct baseline and an LLM judge across five fixed-candidate benchmarks. On Agent Finance Reasoning, accepted-claim precision increases from 56.4% for the LLM judge to 76.7% at 81.2% coverage. On XBRLFiling, FinVerify achieves 99.8% accepted-claim precision and 97.0% decision accuracy; on FinanceBench-67, it reaches 87.9% accepted-claim precision versus 69.7% for the judge. Improvements are smaller on FinQA and TAT-QA, where authoritative evidence is limited. These results suggest that explicit, evidence-backed verification can improve financial-agent reliability while exposing trade-offs between correctness, false rejection, and abstention.
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures. Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development

AI.tldr: FinVerify结合证据与确定性检查，提高金融智能体数值声明的可信度。
AI.motivation: 金融声明即使计算正确，也可能因期间、来源、单位或财务定义不匹配而出错。
AI.method: 从190条错误轨迹归纳五类错误，由语言模型组织证据、确定性验证器及Z3检查，并允许弃权。
AI.result: 金融推理集接受精度达76.7%、覆盖率81.2%，XBRLFiling接受精度达99.8%。
AI.conclusion: 显式证据验证可提升可靠性，但效果受权威证据限制，并存在误拒与弃权权衡。

title: InterRSGaussian: Interactive Multi-view Instance Segmentation for 3D Remote Sensing Scenes
summary: Remote sensing image segmentation plays a critical role in various applications. Interactive instance segmentation, a specialized task within image segmentation, aims to generate precise segmentation results for target objects based on user input prompts. However, previous studies on interactive instance segmentation primarily focus on single-view images, limiting their ability to comprehensively understand complex 3D remote sensing scenes. In this study, we extend interactive instance segmentation from a single-view to a multi-view framework, which can also be easily converted to a 3D segmentation format, thus achieving more accurate and comprehensive 3D remote sensing scene perception across multiple views. First, we construct a multi-view interactive instance segmentation dataset for remote sensing, comprising five distinct scenes, each captured from about one hundred different views. Second, we propose InterRSGaussian, a novel instance segmentation method based on 3D Gaussians. InterRSGaussian enables users to provide point clicks on target objects from any arbitrary view and generates view-consistent instance segmentation results across all input views without requiring manual annotations. The resulting multi-view segmentation can further be projected onto 3D point clouds for 3D segmentation. To improve training efficiency and segmentation performance, we introduce a prior distillation network for initialization. Overall, this study extends traditional 2D remote sensing scene perception into a 3D multi-view framework, enabling a more comprehensive understanding of target objects in complex environments with user interactivity.

AI.tldr: InterRSGaussian通过任意视角点击，实现遥感场景跨视角一致的实例分割。
AI.motivation: 现有交互式实例分割主要面向单视角，难以全面理解复杂三维遥感场景。
AI.method: 构建五场景多视角数据集，以三维高斯和先验蒸馏初始化生成多视角分割并投影至点云。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体结果。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将交互式遥感分割从二维单视角扩展到可转换为三维分割的多视角表示。

title: Fuzzy Explainable Continual Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Navigation
summary: Continual robot navigation requires reinforcement learning policies to continuously adapt to new environments while retaining previously acquired knowledge. Meanwhile, explainable reinforcement learning aims to learn meaningful behavioral representations through policy interaction. However, these objectives are inherently conflicting, as continual learning emphasizes policy stability whereas explainable behavior learning requires adaptive exploration. Existing methods rarely address both simultaneously. To resolve this issue, this paper proposes a Fuzzy Explainable Continual Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (FECHRL) method. A two-stage behavior cloning strategy is introduced to balance rapid policy adaptation and explainable behavior evolution by progressively transitioning from strong imitation guidance to autonomous reinforcement learning. Furthermore, a fuzzy critic based on a Takagi--Sugeno fuzzy inference system is proposed to alleviate value extrapolation errors during the transition between imitation-guided learning and autonomous exploration, thereby improving continual training stability. Experimental results on sequential multi-scenario navigation tasks demonstrate that the proposed method effectively unifies continual learning capability and policy explainability within a single reinforcement learning framework, achieving stable knowledge retention and meaningful behavioral explanation.

AI.tldr: FECHRL以分层强化学习兼顾机器人持续导航的知识保持与行为可解释性。
AI.motivation: 持续学习要求策略稳定，而可解释行为学习需要探索，两者目标存在冲突。
AI.method: 采用两阶段行为克隆逐步转向自主强化学习，并以Takagi–Sugeno模糊评论家缓解价值外推误差。
AI.result: 连续多场景导航实验表明，该方法实现稳定知识保持与有意义的行为解释。
AI.conclusion: 分阶段模仿引导与模糊价值评估可在统一框架中协调持续适应和策略可解释性。

title: TrainExplorer: Autonomous LLM Post-Training via Plan-and-Decouple Exploration
summary: LLM-based agents can automate model post-training, accelerating progress toward recursive self-improvement. Despite their promise, existing approaches remain under-explored and face two main challenges: (1) strategy lock-in that limits exploration beyond the initial strategy; and (2) coupled execution that obscures the effects of individual modifications. To address these challanges, we propose TrainExplorer, a multi-agent framework for autonomous post-training, that incorporates strategy planning and execution decoupling, to achieve broaden strategy exploration. First, strategy planning draws on scientific literature to construct a candidate search space of training strategies. Then, decoupled execution enables single-component interventions and attribution to guide strategy exploration. Extensive experiments on PostTrainBench demonstrate that TrainExplorer achieves a weighted aggregate score of 39.02, outperforming Claude Code using the same LLM by 7.32 and surpassing GPT-5.6 Sol-powered Codex, which scores 36.23. Code will be available.

AI.tldr: TrainExplorer通过策略规划与解耦执行，提升多智能体自主模型后训练表现。
AI.motivation: 现有自主后训练易锁定初始策略，且耦合执行难以归因单项修改的效果。
AI.method: 依据科学文献构建训练策略搜索空间，并以单组件干预及效果归因引导探索。
AI.result: PostTrainBench加权总分达39.02，比同模型Claude Code高7.32，超过Codex的36.23。
AI.conclusion: 策略规划与执行解耦能够拓宽自主后训练探索，并改善基准表现。

title: UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge 2026: Site-Calibrated Synthetic Data and Multi-Detector Fusion for Roadside 3D Detection
summary: This report summarizes the work submitted by team arnav007 (submission ID 1054222) for the UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge (V2X-Real track) at the IEEE BigData Cup 2026. The primary objective is to train 3D detectors for vehicles, pedestrians, and trucks using only synthetic roadside LiDAR data, and to generate synthetic scans that are realistic enough to be indistinguishable from real ones. A CARLA based pipeline is developed and calibrated to the fixed sensor site, accurately modeling the range image, including no-return beams, based on unlabelled real development scans. A combined inference detector, using multiple 3D detectors (VoxelNeXt, PV-RCNN, and SECOND) trained exclusively on synthetic data, is also proposed. Each scan is aligned to the synthetic ground plane and processed through the detectors at multiple ground heights. The resulting bounding boxes are fused using bird's-eye view (BEV) clustering, followed by class-specific post-processing to refine heading, box size, and filter low-confidence detections. The final submission achieved a combined score of 0.8947. The ablation study shows that per-scan ground leveling more than doubled the real-scan mAP, while fusing boxes across different heights and models further improved performance.

AI.tldr: 场地校准的合成激光雷达数据与多检测器融合提升了路侧三维检测性能。
AI.motivation: 挑战要求仅用合成数据训练车辆、行人与卡车检测器，并缩小合成与真实扫描的差异。
AI.method: 用未标注真实扫描校准CARLA仿真，经地面对齐、多高度多模型检测及鸟瞰框聚类融合输出结果。
AI.result: 最终综合得分为0.8947，逐扫描地面校正使真实扫描mAP翻倍以上，跨高度与模型融合进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: 场地传感器校准、地面校正与多检测器融合有助于合成训练模型迁移至真实路侧场景。

title: ReScene: Incremental Scene Chronology from Sparse Revisits
summary: Scene chronology aims to reconstruct a scene across visits separated by hours or days, during which objects may change in position, presence or shape. Such reconstruction must retain every earlier state, yet each revisit often provides only a few images. Storing a complete model for each visit duplicates the unchanged scene, whereas updating a single shared model alters earlier states. We present ReScene, which stores each visit as an immutable compact update, so that any earlier visit can be recovered exactly by applying the stored updates in order, without retaining past images. To localise each update, ReScene attributes the disagreement between the preceding reconstruction and the new images to individual Gaussians through their compositing weights. This attribution guides the suppression of outdated Gaussians and the refinement of persistent ones, while newly visible surfaces are initialised from learned multi-view depth. We also introduce Multi-State, a benchmark of non-rigid deformation and partial material removal, including synthetic scenes with ground-truth geometry. ReScene achieves quality higher than sequential 3DGS checkpointing with 2.5--4.8$\times$ less uncompressed history storage. At comparable PSNR, it also reduces foreground depth error by 3.2$\times$ relative to sequential ChronoGS, showing that accurate rendering does not necessarily imply accurate geometry. Code and benchmark are available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: ReScene以不可变紧凑更新保存稀疏重访场景历史，兼顾重建质量与存储效率。
AI.motivation: 逐次保存完整模型会重复存储静态部分，而更新共享模型又会破坏历史状态。
AI.method: 依据高斯合成权重定位变化，抑制过时高斯并细化持续高斯，以多视角深度初始化新表面。
AI.result: 较顺序3DGS检查点质量更高且存储减少2.5至4.8倍；相近PSNR下前景深度误差为ChronoGS的约1/3.2。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑增量更新可精确恢复历史状态，而渲染准确并不必然意味着几何准确。

title: iEEG Can Help EEG: Improving Clinical Scalp EEG Analysis through Intracranial Priors
summary: Scalp electroencephalography (EEG) is a cornerstone of clinical brain monitoring, making the quality of its signal fundamental to downstream tasks and models. However, that signal is heavily contaminated by non-neural interference and blurred by volume conduction. Existing methods operate almost exclusively within the scalp modality, so they inherit the contamination they would need to overcome. In practice, intracranial EEG (iEEG) observes the neural activity with far higher fidelity, yet it is invasive and therefore scarce, and the two modalities are rarely recorded as pairs at scale, share no common channel space, and offer no clean ground truth to directly supervise a mapping. Motivated by the neuronal synchronization mechanism shared by the two modalities, we propose a reprogramming approach that fits a signal-to-signal model on iEEG alone and freezes it as a cross-modal prior. We introduce ReBrain, a framework to transfer an iEEG-learned prior to scalp EEG, which re-expresses any scalp signal through that prior and can be inserted upstream of any downstream model with no pairing or fine-tuning. ReBrain consistently improves host models across recordings from multiple hospitals and across architecture families, and our analysis traces this gain to genuine neural structure carried by iEEG rather than to the architecture itself. This work provides evidence that a scarce clean modality can serve as a transferable prior for an abundant noisy one, offering a general recipe for cross-modal transfer among biosignals. Our code is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: ReBrain将颅内脑电学得的先验迁移至头皮脑电，无需配对数据或微调即可改善下游分析。
AI.motivation: 头皮脑电受非神经干扰和容积传导影响，而高保真颅内脑电稀缺且难以与其配对。
AI.method: 仅用颅内脑电训练信号到信号模型并冻结为先验，通过重编程将头皮信号经该先验重新表达。
AI.result: ReBrain在多家医院数据和多类架构上持续提升宿主模型，增益源于颅内脑电中的真实神经结构。
AI.conclusion: 稀缺的干净模态可为丰富的含噪模态提供可迁移先验，为生物信号跨模态迁移提供思路。

title: On the Convergence of Continuous-Time AdamW
summary: Continuous-time AdamW provides a framework for understanding whether an optimizer widely used to train large-scale neural networks settles to an equilibrium or sustains persistent motion. We study this long-time behavior while retaining bias correction and fixed positive weight decay. Under suitable assumptions, we establish that the dynamics are well defined for all time and remain bounded when the decay is sufficiently small. Our main result connects their limiting behavior to the geometry of the objective: trajectories approach a locally invariant manifold whose dimension equals the Hessian nullity along the associated critical component. When critical points are isolated and have at most one such direction, the trajectory converges to a single equilibrium. With two degenerate directions, however, bounded persistent motion can occur even for a smooth, strictly convex objective with a unique minimum. We also quantify how close the long-time trajectory remains to the critical set as weight decay decreases, without assuming convergence to a point. These results identify objective geometry as a key to understanding when continuous-time AdamW converges and when persistent motion is possible.

AI.tldr: 连续时间AdamW的长期行为取决于目标几何，即使目标光滑且严格凸，也可能持续运动。
AI.motivation: 需要厘清保留偏差校正和固定正权重衰减时，连续时间AdamW何时收敛或持续运动。
AI.method: 在适当假设下分析动力学的全局存在性、有界性及其与临界集和Hessian零空间的关系。
AI.result: 轨迹趋近维数等于相应Hessian零度的局部不变流形；孤立临界点至多一维退化时收敛，两维时可持续运动。
AI.conclusion: 目标函数的退化几何是判断连续时间AdamW收敛与否的关键，权重衰减减小时还可量化轨迹对临界集的接近程度。

title: On Lie-Algebraic Conditions for Finite-Dimensional Koopman Bilinear Embeddings of Control-Affine Systems
summary: Koopman bilinear representations for control-affine systems have attracted considerable attention. In this paper, we investigate, from a Lie-algebraic perspective, conditions under which a control-affine system admits a finite-dimensional Koopman bilinear embedding. Specifically, we focus on the Lie algebra generated by the drift and control vector fields. First, we show that the finite-dimensionality of the generated Lie algebra is a necessary condition for the existence of a Koopman bilinear embedding. Next, when the generated Lie algebra contains a nonzero nilpotent ideal, we derive a sufficient condition for the existence of such an embedding. Finally, through an example of a quadratic polynomial system, we demonstrate that the finite-dimensionality of the generated Lie algebra imposes strong restrictions on the vector fields, suggesting that exact finite-dimensional Koopman bilinear embeddings may be nongeneric.

AI.tldr: 论文从李代数角度给出控制仿射系统具有有限维Koopman双线性嵌入的必要条件及特定充分条件。
AI.motivation: 需要明确控制仿射系统何时能够获得精确的有限维Koopman双线性嵌入。
AI.method: 分析漂移与控制向量场生成的李代数，并考察非零幂零理想及一个二次多项式系统例子。
AI.result: 生成李代数有限维是嵌入存在的必要条件，含非零幂零理想时可进一步导出充分条件。
AI.conclusion: 有限维李代数条件对向量场施加强约束，表明精确有限维Koopman双线性嵌入可能并不普遍。

title: Shortcut Learning in Feature-Based Algorithm Selection
summary: Landscape features give learning models information about the objective function for algorithm selection, algorithm configuration, and performance prediction. Should these features capture more information? Not always, because a model may rely on information that the algorithms ignore. This phenomenon is called shortcut learning, and in-distribution accuracy can hide it. We propose the Rubber Ruler Test. It transforms the objective values of test instances with random strictly increasing transformations, reruns the algorithms, and measures prediction performance. Comparison-based algorithms such as CMA-ES perform identically after the transformation, so for them any drop reveals shortcut learning. On 10-dimensional BBOB, a model for two comparison-based algorithms learned shortcuts even from normalized objective values. The R^2 of a model using all ELA features dropped from 0.85 to 0.23, below 0.45 with invariant features only. Rank-based features reduced the drop when algorithms search using ranks. Data augmentation with transformed training instances improved prediction on transformed instances for every portfolio we studied, but lowered R^2 on original instances by up to 0.31. These results suggest that models should rely only on information that the algorithms use. We recommend reporting the Rubber Ruler Test alongside in-distribution accuracy and using it to choose feature extraction and data augmentation.

AI.tldr: Rubber Ruler测试揭示算法选择模型会利用算法本身不使用的信息形成捷径，分布内精度可能掩盖这一问题。
AI.motivation: 景观特征可能包含算法不依赖的信息，使预测模型依赖捷径而难以稳健泛化。
AI.method: 对测试实例目标值施加随机严格单调递增变换，重跑算法并比较预测性能，同时评估不变特征和数据增强。
AI.result: 在十维BBOB上，全ELA特征模型的R²由0.85降至0.23；变换增强改善变换实例表现，却使原始实例R²最多下降0.31。
AI.conclusion: 模型应依赖算法实际使用的信息，并结合Rubber Ruler测试选择特征和增强策略，而非仅报告分布内精度。

title: Explainable Federated Learning via Global-Local Attribution Alignment
summary: Federated learning enables on-device training without centralizing data, yet existing systems still struggle to provide explanations that are both locally faithful and globally consistent under strict privacy and bandwidth constraints. Prior approaches either keep explanations siloed across clients, transmit heavy or sensitive artifacts, or replace expressive task models with interpretable surrogates that sacrifice accuracy. We propose xFedAlign, a model-agnostic framework that decouples task optimization in parameter space from explanation coordination in a compact group space. Each client distills a lightweight surrogate to produce private, per-class top-k attribution artifacts, which are robustly aggregated by the server into a Global Explanation Prior that softly aligns client explanations without constraining task learning. Across image, text, and tabular benchmarks with IID and non-IID partitions, xFedAlign matches FedAvg accuracy while consistently reducing explanation drift and improving deletion and insertion AUC relative to Local-XAI, FedAttr-Agg, and Fed-XAI, with only a few kilobytes of additional communication per round. Privacy and robustness evaluations further demonstrate reduced membership inference advantage and increased resistance to attribution poisoning, enabling consistent and trustworthy explanations in federated learning.
comment: 26 pages, 2 figures, 9 tables. Published in Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)

AI.tldr: xFedAlign通过全局与局部归因对齐，在保持联邦学习精度的同时提升解释一致性、隐私与稳健性。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦解释方法难以在隐私和带宽约束下兼顾局部忠实性、全局一致性与任务精度。
AI.method: 客户端蒸馏轻量代理生成私有逐类top-k归因，服务器稳健聚合为全局解释先验，软对齐解释而不约束任务学习。
AI.result: 多类数据和划分下精度匹配FedAvg，解释漂移减少、删除与插入AUC改善，每轮仅增加数千字节通信。
AI.conclusion: 将任务优化与解释协调解耦可实现一致且可信的联邦解释，并降低成员推断优势、增强归因投毒抵抗力。

title: LEDGE: Separating Critic and Editor Failures in Text-to-Image Self-Correction
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) self-correction combines a vision-language model (VLM) critic that diagnoses errors and proposes instructions with an image editor that executes them. End-to-end evaluation obscures whether failures arise from incorrect diagnoses or an editor unable to execute valid instructions. We introduce LEDGE (Learning Error Diagnosis in Generation and Editing), a framework that separates these bottlenecks. LEDGE compiles oracle edit instructions from GenEval while holding the generated images and the editor fixed, isolating the editor's correction capability from the critic's diagnostic accuracy. On Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large, oracle instructions raise GenEval from 72.0% to 81.2%, versus 74.1% for the baseline VLM critic. Yet 435 of 644 failed images remain unrepaired, exposing a substantial editor gap. We also use oracle labels from disjoint training prompts to supervise the critic. Oracle supervision raises exact diagnosis from 33.3% (the same VLM with our structured output, untrained) to 70.8%. With the same editor, the resulting critic improves GenEval from 42.2% (uncorrected) to 59.4% on Stable Diffusion 1.5, against 50.9% for the baseline critic, and from 72.0% to 76.0% on Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large, despite training only on Stable Diffusion 1.5. Improvements transfer to unseen object classes, a second editor, and independent T2I-CompBench judges and prompts. A small human evaluation confirms the ranking in estimated net corrections but suggests a smaller gain than detector-based evaluation. LEDGE thus distinguishes two limits of self-correction: knowing what to fix and being able to fix it.

AI.tldr: LEDGE将文生图自纠错中的诊断失败与编辑失败分离，揭示两者均是性能瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 端到端评估难以判断自纠错失败源于批评器误诊，还是编辑器无法执行正确指令。
AI.method: 从GenEval构造标准编辑指令并固定图像与编辑器以隔离编辑能力，再用独立训练提示的标准标签监督批评器。
AI.result: 标准指令使SD3.5 Large得分由72.0%升至81.2%，但644张失败图中仍有435张未修复；诊断监督使准确率由33.3%升至70.8%。
AI.conclusion: 诊断监督可改善并迁移自纠错能力，但编辑能力仍构成显著限制，且人工评估提示收益小于检测器评估。

title: The Logic Chain Breaking Point: A Controlled-Variable Benchmark for Reasoning Degradation in Open-Weight Language Models
summary: We introduce The Logic Chain Breaking Point, a controlled-variable benchmark for deductive reasoning in open-weight language models. It spans three phases: (i) pure modus-ponens chain scaling, (ii) distractor resilience with a fixed core chain, and (iii) contradiction detection under primacy versus recency placement. Independent variables follow a powers-of-two sequence $v \in \{1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128\}$, with ground truth known by construction. We evaluate sixteen open-weight models across instruction-tuned and reasoning-tuned panels, including a small-model suite and a larger local-model extension. All models are evaluated with greedy decoding under model-appropriate context and output budgets, while context- and length-limited trials are quarantined from the valid accuracy denominator. Our results reveal a sharply non-monotonic difficulty surface: pure deductive chains up to $L=128$ remain near saturation for most models, and distractor noise causes only model-specific degradation at high $D$, while the inconsistent premise condition has the lowest accuracy. Instruction-tuned models, including larger 24B--27B baselines, score essentially zero on inconsistent premise sets, while reasoning-tuned models recover only partially and remain below reliable accuracy. Within this benchmark, inconsistent premise sets are associated with the strongest degradation under the benchmark's abstention-based scoring rule.

AI.tldr: 受控演绎推理基准显示，相比长链和干扰项，不一致前提引发开放权重语言模型最明显的性能退化。
AI.motivation: 需要通过控制变量区分推理链长度、干扰和矛盾前提对开放权重模型推理能力的影响。
AI.method: 构建链长扩展、固定核心链干扰及矛盾位置三阶段基准，以贪心解码评估16个模型并剔除预算受限试验。
AI.result: 多数模型对最长128步纯链推理接近满分，但指令微调模型在不一致前提集上近乎零分，推理微调模型也未达可靠水平。
AI.conclusion: 在该基准的弃答式评分规则下，不一致前提与最强退化相关，推理难度并不随链长单调增加。

title: Physics-informed neural network for model-based global computation of the asymptotic phase of limit-cycle oscillators
summary: The asymptotic phase is the central object of phase reduction theory for limit-cycle oscillators. It is a scalar coordinate defined throughout the basin of attraction of a limit cycle that advances at a constant natural frequency along every trajectory. Computing the phase from a given mathematical model requires solving a first-order partial differential equation (PDE) over the entire basin, which is challenging due to high computation costs and complex boundary conditions. In this study, we propose a physics-informed neural network to efficiently calculate the asymptotic phase of limit-cycle oscillators. By incorporating three types of loss functions, we train a physics-informed neural network (PINN) to satisfy the governing PDE for the asymptotic phase and the adjoint equation for the phase gradient. The trained network delivers the phase function accurately and, via automatic differentiation, allows the calculation of the phase gradient governing the oscillator's response to perturbations, which enables rapid entrainment closed-loop control using strong inputs. We validate the approach using three types of limit-cycle oscillators and demonstrate that the PINN can facilitate fast and global phase-locking control.
comment: First version preprint, submitted for publication

AI.tldr: 物理信息神经网络可全局计算极限环振子的渐近相位及相位梯度，支持快速锁相控制。
AI.motivation: 全吸引域渐近相位求解需处理一阶偏微分方程，面临计算成本高和边界条件复杂的问题。
AI.method: 结合三类损失训练物理信息神经网络，使其满足相位控制方程和梯度伴随方程，并通过自动微分提取梯度。
AI.result: 在三类极限环振子上验证了相位计算的准确性，并展示利用强输入实现快速全局锁相控制。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为基于模型的全局相位计算提供高效途径，并可用于强输入下的快速同步闭环控制。

title: Generative AI-Driven Parametric Design Optimization Framework for Vehicle Closure Systems
summary: This study presents a generative AI-driven parametric design optimization framework integrating performance-oriented generation with editable computer-aided design (CAD) and downstream computer-aided engineering (CAE) analysis for industrial vehicle closure systems. The framework is demonstrated on an automotive tailgate assembly with complex geometry, coupled components, and competing performance and feasibility requirements. A production-oriented CATIA model is restructured into a reference-based parametric template with a 13-dimensional design representation. An automated CAD/CAE workflow generates parametric models, performs structural analysis, and constructs a database of mass, maximum displacement, and maximum von Mises stress. Gaussian process regression surrogates predict performance, while diffusion and flow matching models generate design candidates. The design problem minimizes mass and maximum displacement, with stress assessed as an engineering feasibility constraint. Performance-guided generation using surrogate guidance and performance-aware training using a performance-aware loss incorporate engineering objectives, with sensitivity to guidance scale and loss weight evaluated. Generative search is compared with NSGA-II under matched evaluation budgets using a common surrogate model. Selected Pareto-region candidates are reconstructed in CATIA and re-evaluated through native CAE; all verified candidates are successfully regenerated and analyzed. Relative to the baseline, the knee-point design reduces mass by 7.1% and maximum displacement by 29.4%, while extreme verified solutions achieve maximum reductions of 10.3% and 37.3%, respectively. The results demonstrate performance-oriented multi-objective design exploration compatible with editable industrial CAD and native engineering verification.

AI.tldr: 提出融合生成式人工智能、可编辑CAD与原生CAE验证的车辆闭合件多目标优化框架。
AI.motivation: 工业车辆闭合件设计需兼顾复杂几何、多组件耦合、性能目标与工程可行性。
AI.method: 以13维参数化尾门模板和高斯过程代理为基础，利用扩散与流匹配模型生成设计并进行CAE复核。
AI.result: 经验证的折中设计减重7.1%、最大位移降低29.4%，极端方案对应最大降幅分别为10.3%和37.3%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架支持与可编辑工业CAD及原生工程验证兼容的性能导向多目标设计探索。

title: XMimic and XSoma: Learning Humanoid Motion Tracking and Locomotion in Under a Minute
summary: We present XMimic and XSoma, which learn humanoid motion tracking and locomotion on rough terrain in under a minute of training. Both follow SuperMimic, which learns a world model of the robot and optimizes the policy with analytic gradients through short rollouts imagined in this model. Existing implementations of this method do not make use of larger GPUs, as every training iteration is a long chain of small GPU operations that run one after another. XMimic and XSoma therefore shorten this chain and run the steps of every iteration at the same time on up to four GPUs. We compile the complete training loop with JAX, including the MuJoCo Warp simulator. For locomotion, XSoma leaves only the dynamics of the robot to the world model and computes everything else exactly, including the terrain height under the feet. It learns with a horizon of one second and without a critic. On four H100 GPUs, XMimic learns to track all 40 LAFAN1 clips with the Unitree G1 in 0.86 minutes, 3.7 times faster than BlinkMimic on one GPU. XSoma reaches the tracking target that Holosoma's tests set for FastSAC in 0.77 minutes, 12.3 times faster than FastSAC on one GPU, while needing only an eighth of its environment steps.

AI.tldr: XMimic与XSoma在四张H100上以不足一分钟的训练实现人形机器人动作跟踪与粗糙地形行走。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型策略训练包含大量串行小型GPU操作，难以充分利用更强的计算资源。
AI.method: 通过缩短串行计算链、多GPU并行及JAX全流程编译加速训练，XSoma仅用世界模型预测机器人动力学。
AI.result: XMimic与XSoma分别用时0.86和0.77分钟，较单GPU基线分别加速3.7和12.3倍。
AI.conclusion: 优化训练执行方式与世界模型职责，可显著缩短人形机器人技能学习时间。

title: Estimation of jam density and saturation flow at signalized intersections using only low penetration rate connected vehicle GNSS trajectories: Case study using actual data in Tokyo
summary: The jam density and saturation flow at a signalized intersection are basic inputs to traffic signal management schemes that use connected vehicle (CV) trajectory data. However, methods for estimating the jam density itself from low penetration rate CV trajectories have received little attention. Although a few theoretical methods have been proposed, their application is very limited and it is not clear whether those parameters can be estimated using actual CV data, especially with low penetration rates. This paper analyze such methods, in which the jam density and saturation flow are estimated from long-term historical distribution of low penetration rate CV stop positions accumulated over many signal cycles. The methods are evaluated using actual CV trajectory data collected at three signalized intersections in Tokyo for six months, with a penetration rate on the order of 1--3%. The estimators mostly agree on a jam spacing close to 8~m at the sites at which the queueing pattern is well developed, and the saturation flow estimates lie within roughly 10% of an independent video-based reference at those sites. Furthermore, quantitative criteria for self-evaluation of reliability of the estimates are proposed.
comment: Preprint ("Submitted Manuscript'') accepted by International Journal of Intelligent Transportation Systems Research.\\ First submission: 2026-05-29. Accepted: 2026-10-16

AI.tldr: 利用低渗透率联网车辆的长期停车位置分布，估计信号交叉口拥堵密度与饱和流量。
AI.motivation: 低渗透率真实车辆轨迹能否可靠估计拥堵密度与饱和流量，仍缺乏充分验证。
AI.method: 分析跨信号周期累计停车位置的估计方法，并用东京三处交叉口六个月、渗透率约1%至3%的轨迹评估。
AI.result: 排队模式充分形成的地点估计拥堵车间距约8米，饱和流量估计与视频参考值的偏差约在10%以内。
AI.conclusion: 低渗透率历史轨迹在排队模式充分形成时可用于参数估计，并可结合所提定量标准自评可靠性。

title: VISTA: A Framework for Vision-Informed Semantic Traffic Awareness
summary: The Internet of Things (IoT) is transforming intelligent transportation systems by connecting roadside cameras, edge computing units, vehicles, and traffic infrastructure into a shared sensing and decision-making ecosystem. However, transmitting raw traffic video over vehicle-to-everything (V2X) links is bandwidth-intensive, while deploying large multimodal models directly on resource-constrained vehicles is often impractical. To address these limitations, this article proposes VISTA (Vision-Informed Semantic Traffic Awareness), a multimodal vision-language edge-intelligence framework that combines predictive video representation learning with lightweight language-based reasoning to provide communication-efficient traffic situational awareness. In the proposed architecture, roadside surveillance units employ the Video Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (V-JEPA) and an attentive-pooler module to convert traffic video clips into compact future-scene embeddings. These embeddings are transmitted through V2X links to vehicle-mounted systems, where a TinyLlama small language model, enhanced with a custom visual adapter, interprets the embeddings alongside natural-language (NL) traffic queries. VISTA enables vehicles to obtain interpretable traffic information, reason about upcoming scene dynamics, and identify potential collision risks without receiving raw video streams. Experimental results in a digital-twin urban traffic environment show that VISTA achieves 97.77% accuracy and an 89% F1 score for future collision prediction while reducing the communication payload by several orders of magnitude compared with raw RGB video transmission. These results demonstrate the feasibility of embedding-based multimodal intelligence for low-latency, communication-efficient, and safety-oriented IoT-enabled transportation systems.
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, Accepted for publication in IEEE Internet of Things Magazine, 2026

AI.tldr: VISTA通过传输紧凑视频嵌入与车载轻量语言推理，实现低通信开销的交通态势感知。
AI.motivation: 原始交通视频传输占用大量带宽，而资源受限车辆难以直接部署大型多模态模型。
AI.method: 路侧用V-JEPA及注意力池化生成未来场景嵌入，车端通过视觉适配器和TinyLlama回答交通查询。
AI.result: 数字孪生实验中，未来碰撞预测准确率为97.77%、F1为89%，通信载荷较原始RGB视频降低数个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 基于嵌入的多模态边缘智能可支持低延迟、通信高效且面向安全的交通系统。

title: Designing Deceptive Model Organisms that Successfully Evade Auditing
summary: AI models can exhibit deceptive behaviors such as strategically underperforming on evaluations (sandbagging), faking alignment, or covertly acting on behalf of a hidden principal. Safe deployment therefore requires auditing techniques that can reliably detect such behaviors. To develop and test these techniques, we can train model organisms (MOs): models that exhibit deceptive behaviors and serve as realistic evaluation testbeds. However, for such testbeds to be informative, MOs must actively anticipate and resist auditing---a gap in prior work that can lead to overestimation of auditing effectiveness and underestimation of safety risks. We address this gap by designing MOs that capture worst-case deceptive behavior and evade high-effort auditing. Focusing on sandbagging, we frame MO design as a security game between an auditor and a deceptive model and identify three design requirements for sandbagging MOs: (i) effectiveness (underperforming on targeted capabilities), (ii) utility preservation (maintaining performance on all other capabilities), and (iii) robustness (resisting auditing). We propose three MOs: two optimized against blackbox auditing techniques and one optimized against both blackbox and whitebox techniques. Through a comprehensive evaluation, we show that, unlike MOs from prior work, our MOs satisfy all three requirements, providing worst-case baselines for developing and evaluating future auditing techniques.

AI.tldr: 构建主动抵抗审计的欺骗性模型样本，为评估审计技术提供最坏情形基线。
AI.motivation: 若测试模型不会预判并抵抗审计，可能高估审计有效性并低估安全风险。
AI.method: 将策略性低表现建模为审计者与欺骗模型的安全博弈，设计三种针对黑盒或黑白盒审计优化的模型。
AI.result: 综合评估表明，所提模型均能同时实现目标能力低表现、其他能力保留及抵抗审计。
AI.conclusion: 具备审计抵抗能力的模型样本可为未来审计方法的开发与评估提供更严格的测试基线。

title: Stochastic Self-Distillation for Flow-Based Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) models achieve strong performance in robotics through imitation learning, yet fine-tuning them with on-policy reinforcement learning (RL) is limited. In group-based RL methods like Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), every rollout step requires multi-step ODE integration, and the sampler's limited stochasticity leads to rollout groups with low variance. We propose VLA-SSD, which addresses both high inference latency and limited stochasticity. In particular, our method self-distills a pretrained flow-matching action head into a stochastic one-step policy by conditioning a single-jump generator on a Brownian path. We derive a conditional action density via our stochastic one-step policy, enabling efficient post-training via likelihood-ratio RL algorithms. We show that distilling VLA-SSD from the $\pi_0$ VLA reduces the action head's forward-pass time by a factor of 7.7, at the cost of a 5.5% relative decrease in the success rate on the LIBERO benchmark. However, by leveraging the increased sample diversity of VLA-SSD during group generation, post-training a $\pi_{0.5}$ VLA using GRPO yields a 20.6% relative improvement.

AI.tldr: VLA-SSD将流式视觉语言动作模型蒸馏为随机单步策略，降低推理开销并支持强化学习后训练。
AI.motivation: 流式动作模型的多步ODE求解成本高且采样随机性不足，限制了分组强化学习微调。
AI.method: 以布朗路径为条件将动作头自蒸馏为单跳生成器，并推导条件动作密度以支持似然比强化学习。
AI.result: π₀动作头前向计算加速7.7倍但成功率相对下降5.5%；π₀.₅经GRPO后训练获得20.6%的相对提升。
AI.conclusion: 随机单步蒸馏以一定初始性能损失换取速度与样本多样性，并可通过强化学习后训练改善表现。

title: LiveView: Real-Time Camera-Controlled Re-filming of Streaming Videos
summary: Real-time camera-controlled video re-filming aims to synthesize target views from a streaming source video under online user-specified camera trajectories. This task poses two key challenges: maintaining synchronization and content consistency across views, and achieving low-latency rendering with long-horizon stability. Existing approaches are predominantly designed for offline full-sequence processing and rely on bidirectional attention or costly depth-based geometric preprocessing, making them unsuitable for low-latency streaming scenarios. To address these limitations, we develop a teacher-to-student framework that distills a high-fidelity bidirectional re-filming teacher into a few-step causal autoregressive student. We introduce Cross-Frame Injection to interleave each incoming source frame with its synchronized target latent, thereby establishing direct cross-view correspondence and improving content consistency. To ensure stable long-horizon generation, we further propose Shared Relative RoPE, which bounds temporal indices within the pretrained range, and Cycle Streaming Tuning, which exposes the student to extended cyclic trajectories during streaming training. These designs enable low-latency online video re-filming with precise camera control and sustained spatiotemporal consistency over long streaming rollouts.

AI.tldr: LiveView通过教师到学生蒸馏，实现实时相机控制的流式视频重拍。
AI.motivation: 现有离线方法依赖双向注意力或昂贵几何预处理，难以兼顾低延迟、跨视角一致性与长期稳定性。
AI.method: 蒸馏少步因果自回归学生，并结合跨帧注入、共享相对RoPE及循环流式调优。
AI.result: 摘要报告该方法可实现低延迟在线重拍、精确相机控制及长时空一致性，但未给出量化指标。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为持续流式输入下的可控视频重拍提供了兼顾同步与长期稳定性的方案。

title: AdaModalX: Synchronization-Free MFM Inference for Distributed Multimodal Mobile Sensing via Progressive Data Orchestration
summary: Multimodal foundation models (MFMs) support generalizable inference in distributed mobile sensing applications by integrating heterogeneous data streams. However, existing MFM inference pipelines typically require complete and synchronized multimodal inputs, whereas mobile sensing streams arrive asynchronously due to network variability and heterogeneous data volumes across modalities. Waiting for all modalities increases end-to-end latency, while inference with incomplete inputs can reduce accuracy. We argue that multimodal inference should depend on the utility of available information rather than modality completeness. Based on this principle, we propose AdaModalX, a progressive multimodal inference framework that decouples inference execution from modality synchronization through runtime utility-aware orchestration. At each device, importance-aware data uploading uses a lightweight probe distilled from the edge-side MFM to allow reliable samples to exit locally while uncertain samples continue uploading. At the edge, on-demand MFM activation constructs candidates from fully received samples and, when needed, imputed features derived from partially received delayed inputs. A lightweight contribution assessor built on frozen MFM encoders estimates candidate utility and activates the MFM once the candidate meets its corresponding utility threshold. Experiments on four mobile sensing applications show that AdaModalX improves the accuracy-latency trade-off, achieving up to 26.97% accuracy improvement and up to 64.75% end-to-end latency reduction.

AI.tldr: AdaModalX按信息效用渐进编排多模态数据，无需等待所有模态同步即可执行推理。
AI.motivation: 移动感知数据异步到达，等待完整输入会增加延迟，而使用不完整输入又可能损害准确率。
AI.method: 设备侧以蒸馏探针筛选本地退出样本，边缘侧结合已收数据与插补特征，按效用阈值触发模型。
AI.result: 四类移动感知应用中，准确率最高提升26.97%，端到端延迟最高降低64.75%。
AI.conclusion: 以信息效用而非模态完整性驱动推理，可改善分布式移动感知的准确率与延迟权衡。

title: ReRead: Wrong Predictions, Useful Representations - Correcting Frozen Robot Policies by Re-reading Their Own Representations
summary: When a pretrained robot policy fails on challenging tasks, common remedies include retraining the backbone, adding an external visual encoder, or introducing a memory module. We argue that wrong predictions do not imply wrong representations: a policy can retain the required information yet fail to read it out as the correct action. To test this view, we propose ReRead: with the backbone frozen, a corrector re-reads the current and two previous caches to predict an action residual. The corrector sees no images, is trained solely on offline demonstrations from all 50 RoboTwin 2.0 tasks, and adds only 4.17% latency. Ablations and interventions show that the correction relies on the backbone's own representations: none of four external visual encoders adds further gain, and swapping in past caches from other trajectories sharply increases action error. On the 11 hardest RoboTwin 2.0 tasks, ReRead improves the success rates of LingBot-VLA, $\pi_{0.5}$, and Fast-WAM by 23.45, 13.09, and 8.00 percentage points, respectively. In paired evaluation on all 50 tasks, it raises Fast-WAM's average success rate from 90.73% to 92.66%. On a Flexiv dual-arm robot, it raises success on a phase-ambiguous task from 0% to 36%.

AI.tldr: ReRead通过重读冻结机器人策略的内部表征修正动作，无需图像输入或重训主干。
AI.motivation: 策略预测错误未必意味着表征缺失，也可能源于未能从已有信息中正确读出动作。
AI.method: 冻结主干，以全部50项任务的离线示范训练修正器，读取当前及前两步缓存预测动作残差。
AI.result: 最难11项任务中三种策略成功率提升8至23.45个百分点，新增延迟仅4.17%。
AI.conclusion: 实验支持利用策略自身表征纠正动作，且四种外部视觉编码器均未带来额外收益。

title: On the Applicability of $p$-adic Numbers in Computational Modules for Neural Networks
summary: The applicability of $p$-adic arithmetic as an intermediate computational module in an otherwise unchanged machine-learning pipeline is investigated. A one-feature linear regression on the scikit-learn Diabetes dataset serves as the test model. The fitted coefficients are represented in $\mathbb{Q}_p$, predictions are computed in that field, and rational reconstruction is applied to the outputs. In the pyAdic experiments, rational reconstruction either returns no result or produces values that differ from the baseline predictions; changing computational precision can change both the magnitude and sign of the reconstructed value. In SageMath, forward conversions succeed, but the reconstructed predictions differ from the baseline. An alternative representation based on digit reversal fails to preserve ordinary addition because of carry propagation. Under the tested settings, none of the test predictions is reconstructed correctly. These results show that the tested conversion and reconstruction procedures do not provide a compatible intermediate module even for linear regression. Models defined directly over $p$-adic data and operations offer a direction for further investigation.

AI.tldr: 所测试的p进数转换与重构流程无法作为普通线性回归的兼容中间计算模块。
AI.motivation: 研究p进数算术能否嵌入其他部分保持不变的机器学习流程。
AI.method: 在糖尿病数据集的单特征线性回归中，将系数转为p进数计算预测，再进行有理重构。
AI.result: 所有测试预测均未正确重构，部分重构失败，且精度变化可改变重构值的大小和符号。
AI.conclusion: 当前测试流程不具兼容性，直接基于p进数据与运算构建模型值得进一步研究。

title: Tabular Foundation Models as Emulators for Forecasting Terrestrial Ecosystem Dynamics
summary: Process-based terrestrial biosphere models such as the Ecosystem Demography (ED) model underpin global carbon budgets, but their cost limits global, high-resolution and scenario-rich simulation. Deep emulators such as DeepED reduce that cost but require task-specific architectures and training. Tabular foundation models offer a different route: TabPFN predicts new rows by in-context learning, without being trained on the task. We compare TabPFN-3.5 with two DeepED baselines, $DeepED_{LSTM}$ and $DeepED_{Transformer}$, on CarbonGlobe's overall evaluation, which trains on a uniform 1/16 sample of sites and tests on the other 50,779, predicting the 40-year state of all seven ED outputs. We then test every model, trained on present-day data only, on ED runs forced by SSP1-2.6 and SSP5-8.5 for 2021--2060 in six continental forest regions. With no training, TabPFN-3.5 has the lowest present-day height error of the three models and is within 4% of $DeepED_{LSTM}$ for soil carbon, but is less accurate for AGB, LAI and the carbon fluxes. In 2060, errors are several times larger than at the same sites under present-day forcing, and every model underestimates the biomass that ED gains. Under SSP5-8.5, TabPFN-3.5 is the most accurate model for height, AGB, soil carbon and LAI, with the lowest AGB error in all six regions, although, unlike ED, it predicts no larger biomass gain than under SSP1-2.6. Under SSP1-2.6, no model is best overall.

AI.tldr: TabPFN无需任务训练即可模拟部分生态系统变量，但未来情景预测仍存在明显偏差。
AI.motivation: 陆地生物圈模型计算昂贵，而现有深度模拟器依赖专门架构与训练。
AI.method: 比较TabPFN与两种DeepED在七项生态输出上的表现，并检验仅用当前数据训练后的未来情景迁移。
AI.result: TabPFN当前树高误差最低，强迫情景SSP5-8.5下四项指标最优，但所有模型均低估未来生物量增益。
AI.conclusion: 表格基础模型具有生态模拟潜力，但优势依变量和情景而异，无法完整复现气候响应。

title: Model Immunization Beyond Condition Numbers: The Importance of Plateau Regions
summary: Harmful fine-tuning can rapidly compromise safety alignment in Large Language Models, underscoring the vulnerability of deployed models to post-release modification. While prior work motivates model immunization by inducing ill-conditioned curvature to slow harmful optimization, this approach is not scalable due to the high computational cost of Hessian estimation. We refine this paradigm by extending the theoretical framework to prioritize plateau regions alongside curvature. We further introduce an immunization algorithm based on efficient Hessian estimation and bounds on the extremal singular values of the Hessian. We demonstrate the proposed immunization framework in three applications: (i) Fine-tuning-as-a-service settings where benign user data may be mixed with poisoned harmful data, (ii) open-weight settings where an adversary can fine-tune on harmful-only data with varied training dynamics, and (iii) robust unlearning, where immunized models better resist relearning attacks after unlearning. Extensive experiments confirm that our approach achieves robust defense against adversarial fine-tuning while largely maintaining general utility and downstream trainability. Our code is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 研究将平台区域纳入模型免疫理论，以提升大语言模型抵御有害微调的能力。
AI.motivation: 有害微调可迅速破坏安全对齐，而依赖高成本Hessian估计的既有免疫方法难以扩展。
AI.method: 结合平台区域与曲率理论，利用高效Hessian估计及其极端奇异值界构建免疫算法。
AI.result: 实验显示，该方法能抵御对抗微调及遗忘后的再学习攻击，同时基本保持通用能力和下游可训练性。
AI.conclusion: 模型免疫应同时重视平台区域与曲率，而不应仅依赖条件数。

title: Improving X-Ray Baggage Instance Segmentation with Shared Point-Based Mask Refinement
summary: Overlapping projections and complex object contours make prohibited items difficult to delineate in X-ray baggage images. This study investigates shared point-based mask refinement to improve instance segmentation within Cascade Mask R-CNN. The framework combines a ResNet-101 backbone with an attention-based feature pyramid and progressively updates uncertain mask locations, increasing mask resolution from $28 \times 28$ to $112 \times 112$. A single refinement module is shared across cascade stages and refinement levels, with transformer and multilayer perceptron (MLP) variants used to examine the role of interactions among selected points. Ten configurations were evaluated on the official PIXray split across three training seeds using the original target-instance annotations for evaluation. The transformer and MLP refiners achieved mean mask average precision (AP) of 71.79 and 72.47, respectively, compared with 70.50 for the unrefined detector, yielding gains of 1.29 and 1.97 AP points. The MLP achieved the highest mean mask AP among the evaluated configurations. Both variants also improved boundary agreement on commonly detected objects, supporting improved mask delineation, while detection diagnostics did not establish a corresponding positive gain. These findings demonstrate that shared point-based refinement can improve segmentation quality in the tested cascade architecture using existing target-mask annotations, without additional occluder supervision. Evaluation on independent X-ray datasets is needed to determine how well these improvements generalize.

AI.tldr: 共享点式掩码细化可改善X光行李实例分割，其中MLP变体在测试配置中表现最佳。
AI.motivation: X光图像中的投影重叠和复杂轮廓使违禁品边界难以准确分割。
AI.method: 在Cascade Mask R-CNN中跨阶段和层级共享细化模块，逐步更新不确定点并提高掩码分辨率。
AI.result: Transformer与MLP细化器的平均掩码AP分别提高1.29和1.97点，两者均改善边界一致性。
AI.conclusion: 无需额外遮挡物监督即可提升测试架构的分割质量，但检测收益未获证实，泛化仍需独立数据验证。

title: Beyond Seeing: Fine-Grained Preference Validation and Severity-Aware Alignment for Mitigating Visual Hallucinations in Vision-Language Models
summary: Large vision-language models can produce fluent responses containing objects, attributes, or relations unsupported by the image. We study an implemented alignment pipeline that normalizes released fine-grained hallucination supervision, validates chosen-rejected preference pairs with vision-language judges, repairs rejected chosen responses, and trains LLaVA adapters with standard or severity-aware direct preference optimization. The study uses 16,143 normalized feedback records and 8,386 released preference pairs, comparing direct training with zero-shot and two-shot judged severity-margin variants. The zero-shot variant reduces Object HalBench CHAIRs from 53.00 to 36.00 and CHAIRi from 15.72 to 10.41. Across aligned models, AMBER-Hal decreases from 35.90 to 25.10-26.90, accompanied by reduced visual coverage. In contrast, the base model retains the highest valid POPE adversarial F1, 84.18 versus 83.87-83.91 after alignment. These results support benchmark-dependent reductions in generative hallucination rather than uniform superiority of severity-aware alignment. We distinguish implemented pipeline components from the preference paths used in the reported experiments and discuss the limits of attributing gains to judging, repair, or the training objective individually.
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Includes a 4-page supplementary appendix with experimental details, equations, prompt templates, and additional comparisons

AI.tldr: 细粒度偏好验证与严重度感知对齐可减少部分视觉幻觉，但未在所有基准上优于基础模型。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型可能生成流畅却缺乏图像依据的对象、属性或关系描述。
AI.method: 规范化幻觉反馈、验证偏好对并修复未通过验证的优选回答，再训练标准或严重度感知DPO适配器。
AI.result: 零样本变体将CHAIRs从53降至36，但对齐后视觉覆盖减少，POPE对抗F1略低于基础模型。
AI.conclusion: 幻觉改善具有基准依赖性，无法将收益单独归因于评判、修复或训练目标。

title: Separating learning from search and feedback in budgeted inverse design of periodic unit cells
summary: To design a periodic material, engineers choose the shape and dimensions of a repeating cell to meet target properties. With few simulations, the benefit of a learned predictor can be hard to separate from the effect of which designs the search tries and how it uses simulator feedback. We compare two ways to predict properties in a library of 80 cell architectures, with up to 30 simulator calls per target. For each architecture, both searches use a table of predicted properties at different dimensions. One fills the table with predictions from neural networks. The other fits a simple model to the existing simulations for that architecture. Both searches use the difference between the predicted and simulated properties to adjust the next design. We generated 200 targets from simulated designs after fixing the analysis plan. The two searches showed no detectable difference in how often they matched all three properties within 2% or in the mean error of their returned designs. The upper limit of the 95% confidence interval for the gain in overall success rate was 4.5 percentage points. Follow-up controls on these targets changed success from 83.5% to 36.0% with a degraded table and 96.5% with an oracle table. In separate tests, using the simulation result to adjust the next design increased success for both types of table. Results cover one library and a coarse 32^3 voxel simulator. Designers can use this comparison to judge what a learned predictor adds when the search, feedback and budget are the same.

AI.tldr: 控制搜索、反馈与预算后，神经网络预测器未比简单拟合模型显著改善周期单胞逆向设计。
AI.motivation: 仿真预算有限时，学习预测器的贡献容易与搜索策略及反馈利用的作用混淆。
AI.method: 在80种单胞架构和200个目标上，以相同搜索及反馈机制比较两类预测表，每目标最多调用30次仿真。
AI.result: 两法成功率及平均误差无可检测差异，成功率增益95%置信区间上限为4.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 在该单胞库与粗体素仿真器下，评估学习预测器应控制搜索、反馈与预算，结论不宜直接外推。

title: Lift, See, Act: Hierarchical Robot Policy Pretraining with 3D Foundation Models
summary: Robot policy pretraining based on human videos is crucial for improving the policy's generalization ability. One main challenge for this task is the lack of explicit action-relevant representations in such unlabeled data. Recent works tend to estimate 3D hand motion trajectories from videos using 3D foundation models (3D FMs). However, they keep solely the sparse trajectories as supervision, ignoring the rich, fine-grained information produced during the trajectory extraction process. To address this issue, we propose LSA, a hierarchical robot policy pretraining framework that includes three phases: Lift, See, and Act. Specifically, the Lift phase elevates 2D video observations into dense 3D representations by adaptively aligning features in the policy's shallow layers with the intermediate representations extracted from multiple 3D FMs. Building upon these lifted representations, the See phase equips the policy with explicit geometric and interactive awareness through dual guidance. It introduces depth-map reconstruction to help the model comprehend 3D spatial layouts and utilizes hand region cues to explicitly supervise the encoder's attention toward task-relevant interaction hotspots. Empowered by the dense 3D representation learning and precise spatial guidance, our policy achieves robust and accurate robotic manipulation in the Act phase. Extensive experiments on diverse simulation and real-world tasks demonstrate that LSA significantly outperforms current state-of-the-art approaches. The project page is available at: this https URL.

AI.tldr: LSA利用三维基础模型的密集表征与空间引导，提升基于人类视频预训练的机器人策略。
AI.motivation: 无标注人类视频缺乏显式动作相关表征，既有方法仅保留稀疏手部轨迹而忽略丰富中间信息。
AI.method: 通过Lift阶段对齐密集三维特征、See阶段重建深度并引导手部注意力，再用于Act阶段操作。
AI.result: 多样化仿真与真实任务实验表明，LSA显著优于现有先进方法，但摘要未给出具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 利用三维模型的密集信息与交互区域监督，有助于提升机器人操作策略的表现。

title: Parallelizable Interior-Point ADMM for Block-Structured Nonconvex Programs
summary: Physics simulation is an increasingly important computational primitive for AI, and local--global/ADMM splitting exposes its parallel structure but lacks matching finite-time convergence guarantees. We close this gap with two ADMM variants, Interior-Point ADMM (IP-ADMM), for block-structured nonconvex composite programs with smooth nonlinear inequality and affine constraints. A one-sided finite-activation wall keeps each constraint split state strictly feasible while the original-space infeasibility vanishes, giving closed-form constraint updates, one proximal call per objective block, and one equality-constrained quadratic consensus solve per iteration. \rev{To our knowledge, this makes IP-ADMM the first single-loop method that updates nonconvex inequality constraints locally and in parallel with finite-time convergence guarantees.} Ordinary IP-ADMM attains a CQ-free best-iterate weak-KKT rate of $O(K^{-1/3})$ or a banded Fritz--John rate of $O(K^{-1/4})$, which converts to KKT at $O(K^{-1/4})$ under a uniform constraint qualification; these are nearby-point certificates that reduce to conventional KKT for smooth blocks. A checkpoint variant, IP-ADMM-Ckpt, improves the asymptotic KKT exponent to $O(K^{-1/3})$. We also show how the bounds scale with the objective- and constraint-block counts and the coupling norm.

AI.tldr: 提出可并行处理局部非凸不等式约束且具有有限时间收敛保证的内点ADMM方法。
AI.motivation: 物理仿真中的局部—全局及ADMM分裂可利用并行结构，但缺乏相应的有限时间收敛保证。
AI.method: 通过单侧有限激活壁保持约束分裂状态严格可行，结合分块近端更新与二次共识求解，并设计检查点变体。
AI.result: 普通版弱KKT速率为O(K^{-1/3})，统一约束资格条件下KKT速率为O(K^{-1/4})，检查点版提升至O(K^{-1/3})。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为分块非凸约束的局部并行更新提供收敛证书，并刻画界限随块数及耦合范数的变化。

title: Agent-Guided Configuration Tuning for SMT Solvers
summary: SMT solvers expose many configuration choices that determine how well their existing algorithms perform on a workload. We present, to our knowledge, the first workflow that uses general-purpose LLM agents to tune SMT solver configurations. Agents read solver documentation, source code, and persistent experiment records to propose option changes, and a deterministic harness measures each proposal, validates the returned models, and selects changes separately for each competition Division. Over roughly nine weeks, our tuning campaign recorded 4,545 proposals for cvc5 across 13 Divisions and 36 logics. We evaluate the tuned configurations on the 2026 and 2025 SMT-COMP ModelValidation benchmarks under a 24-second cutoff. On problems not used for training, they validate more problems than official cvc5 in ten of the 13 Divisions in 2026 and in eight in 2025, with geometric-mean gains of 7.8% and 6.8% across Divisions. On the complete official selections, which include training problems, the tuned floating-point counts exceed those of every individual competition participant in both years. Further studies show how configuration changes make existing algorithms effective by changing access to strategies, scheduling, and option compatibility, and how benchmark families trade off against one another. The agents' experiment traces contain hypothesis-based proposals in every tuning group, and 64.3% of the extracted hypotheses draw on prior measurements. These results show that agent-guided tuning can specialize a mature SMT solver and that accumulated experimental evidence informs sustained search.

AI.tldr: 通用大语言模型智能体通过持续实验调整配置，提高成熟SMT求解器在特定任务上的性能。
AI.motivation: SMT求解器的众多配置决定现有算法在不同工作负载上的表现，需要有效的专门化调优流程。
AI.method: 智能体读取文档、源码与实验记录提出配置，由确定性评测程序测量、验证模型并按竞赛分组选择。
AI.result: 未训练题上，2026年和2025年分别在13组中的10组和8组获益，跨组几何平均提升7.8%和6.8%。
AI.conclusion: 智能体引导调优能增强成熟求解器，积累的实验依据可支持持续搜索，但不同题族存在性能权衡。

title: Inverse Problem for Super-linearization with Single Observable and Diagonalizable Principal Submatrix
summary: Super-linearization is, roughly speaking, embedding an $n$-dimensional nonlinear dynamical system into an $(n + m)$-dimensional linear system. We introduce and address, in this paper, the inverse problem: given a linear system $\dot x= M x$, what type of dynamical systems can be super-linearized to it? We focus on the special case where the dimension reduction is one (i.e., $m = 1$) and the leading $n$-by-$n$ principal submatrix of $M$ is diagonalizable, and provide a solution to the problem.

AI.tldr: 研究给定线性系统可由哪些非线性动力系统超线性化得到，并求解一个特殊情形。
AI.motivation: 超线性化将非线性系统嵌入高维线性系统，其逆问题要求从给定线性系统识别可嵌入的动力系统。
AI.method: 聚焦仅增加一个维度且线性系统矩阵的前导n阶主子矩阵可对角化的情形进行分析。
AI.result: 给出了上述单维扩展及主子矩阵可对角化条件下逆问题的解。
AI.conclusion: 该研究在特定结构条件下建立了从线性系统反推可超线性化动力系统的结果。

title: EVIDENT: Evaluating Evidence Grounding in GUI Agents
summary: GUI agents are increasingly evaluated by whether they complete web tasks, but surface success can hide a critical failure: the final answer may not be supported by evidence observed during navigation. We introduce EVIDENT, an evidence-driven benchmark for evaluating whether GUI agents ground their decisions in observable web evidence. EVIDENT contains 220 real-world English and Korean tasks spanning semantic grounding, contextual inference, and visual grounding, each paired with human-curated evidence metadata specifying what must be verified. We further separate surface task completion from evidence-grounded success using three metrics: TSR, ESR, and GSR, which respectively measure outcome success, required evidence observation, and claim-level evidence support. Experiments on commercial and open-source GUI agents reveal substantial gaps between surface success and evidence-grounded success, especially in contextual and visual tasks. These results show that current evaluations can overestimate agent reliability and highlight the need to assess not only whether agents answer, but whether they verify.

AI.tldr: 提出EVIDENT基准，揭示GUI智能体表面完成任务与基于实际观察证据作答之间的差距。
AI.motivation: 仅评估网页任务是否完成，可能掩盖最终回答缺少导航过程中可观察证据支持的问题。
AI.method: 构建含220项英韩真实任务及人工证据元数据的基准，以TSR、ESR和GSR分别衡量结果、证据观察与主张支持。
AI.result: 商业及开源GUI智能体的表面成功与证据支撑成功存在显著差距，情境推断和视觉任务尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 现有评估可能高估GUI智能体可靠性，应同时检验其是否作答以及是否核实所需证据。

title: Time-Varying Coverage via Diffeomorphic Coverage Control
summary: This paper addresses a structured class of time-varying coverage control in which region-density evolution is parameterised by a time-varying diffeomorphism acting on a static region-density pair. We refer to this setting as diffeomorphic coverage control. Such trajectories arise naturally in mass-conserving transport flows and in density-driven formation control. We propose decentralised diffeomorphic coverage controllers for both continuous- and discrete-time dynamics that achieve time-varying coverage by solving a related time-invariant coverage problem in a nominal domain. The resulting controllers are asymptotically stable with respect to a variant of a popular coverage metric under corresponding time-varying regions and densities. Further analysis shows that diffeomorphic coverage corresponds to a time-varying non-uniform coverage problem over a non-Euclidean metric. Simulations demonstrate effectiveness of the proposed control strategy under affine diffeomorphisms in a formation control task, achieving performance comparable to a popular centralised coverage control law. Coverage performance is also demonstrated under non-affine diffeomorphisms.
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, accepted into Conference on Decision and Control 2026

AI.tldr: 利用时变微分同胚将动态区域密度覆盖转化为静态覆盖问题，并构建去中心化控制器。
AI.motivation: 质量守恒输运和密度驱动编队中，区域与密度随时间共同变化，需要相应的覆盖控制方法。
AI.method: 在名义域求解相关静态覆盖问题，设计连续及离散时间控制器，并分析稳定性与非欧度量解释。
AI.result: 控制器对变体覆盖指标渐近稳定，仿射变换仿真性能接近常用集中式方法，非仿射情形也展示有效覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 微分同胚覆盖为结构化时变覆盖提供去中心化方案，并可解释为非欧度量下的时变非均匀覆盖。

title: A Temporal Convolutional Network with Multi-Head Attention Model: A Surrogate for Parallel DEVS Semiconductor Fab Simulation
summary: Semiconductor factories process many kinds of wafers organized into lots of various sizes and configurations. Different kinds of machines, each with its own operations, process wafers for hours to days, and the wafers undergo many incremental fabrication steps (with re-entry) and flows spanning days to weeks across connected machines. Fast and accurate predictions of throughput ($TH$) and turnaround time ($TA$) dynamics for individual machines and their combinations are essential for factory operations. To use machine learning methods for this purpose, this paper presents a Temporal Convolutional Network with Multi-head Attention (TCNA) architecture. It uses simulated datasets from a benchmark Parallel DEVS (PDEVS) semiconductor fabrication factory model. The factory processes configurable wafer lots with uniform and sinusoidal wafer arrival profiles and may undergo preventive maintenance. The wafer lot size, arrival profile, and factory maintenance policy are used as static covariates. TCNA is applied to a selected set of simulated discrete-event throughput and turnaround time trajectories. The $TH$ and $TA$ time series predicted by TCNA, evaluated with the common $MAPE$, $MSE$, and $R^2$ measures, show comparable or higher accuracy relative to other model architectures, with similar parameter counts and epoch times; the TCNA model size and execution time are similar to those of other architectures such as the Temporal Fusion Transformer. Although time series predictions are less accurate than high-resolution simulations, they can be deployed at a much lower computational cost. The TCNA achieves orders-of-magnitude speedup over PDEVS simulation with an acceptable loss of accuracy, enabling frequent product scheduling, capacity planning, and maintenance planning.

AI.tldr: 提出融合多头注意力的时间卷积网络，作为半导体工厂离散事件仿真的低成本预测代理。
AI.motivation: 晶圆加工流程复杂且周期长，工厂运营需要快速准确预测机器及其组合的吞吐量和周转时间。
AI.method: 使用PDEVS工厂仿真数据训练TCNA，将批量大小、到达模式和维护策略作为静态协变量。
AI.result: TCNA精度与其他架构相当或更高，参数量及训练轮次耗时相近，相比PDEVS仿真实现数量级加速。
AI.conclusion: 尽管精度低于高分辨率仿真，TCNA仍以可接受的精度损失支持更频繁的排程、产能及维护规划。

title: Pointillist Maize: 3D Reconstruction of Field-Grown Maize Using RGB UAV Imagery
summary: Three-dimensional reconstruction can extend field phenotyping to individual maize organs, but thin, flexible, occluding structures and plant movement complicate reconstruction. We evaluated whether consumer-grade UAV RGB video processed with Structure from Motion and multi-view stereo could recover recognizable field-grown maize structures, and examined the effects of acquisition trajectories and frame sampling. COLMAP reconstructions preserved recognizable leaves, stems, tassel branches, ears, silks, and brace roots. For an equal-frame comparison, we reconstructed one plant from two sets of 295 frames from the same video: a single orbit sampled at 5 frames/second and three orbits at different altitudes (ribbon skirt) sampled at 2 frames/second. After ground removal, the reconstructions contained 520,601 and 375,318 points, respectively. The single orbit yielded greater point concentration within plant structures and fewer visible gaps, while the ribbon skirt yielded fewer scattered points and slightly lower proportions of isolated points. In densely planted nursery rows, visible voids occupied 17.57% of the rendered scene with one orbit at 1 frame/second, decreasing to 5.07% with additional serpentine passes and 2.68% when the original orbit was sampled at 3 frames/second. Additional observations also increased point dispersion associated with plant movement. A curlicue trajectory tested in a different field in 2024 produced distinguishable individual plants without visible duplicated structures, although substantial voids remained, mainly on the soil surface. These results demonstrate the feasibility of recovering recognizable maize organs from consumer UAV imagery and reveal trade-offs between acquisition strategies, reconstruction completeness, and point dispersion. Independent geometric validation is still needed before quantitative phenotyping.
comment: 26 pages, 8 figures, submitted to Frontiers in Plant Science

AI.tldr: 消费级无人机RGB影像可重建可辨识的田间玉米器官，但采集策略影响完整性与点云离散程度。
AI.motivation: 细薄、柔性、相互遮挡的器官及植株运动增加田间玉米三维重建难度，限制器官级表型分析。
AI.method: 以运动恢复结构和多视图立体处理无人机视频，比较飞行轨迹及帧采样对COLMAP重建的影响。
AI.result: 重建保留了叶、茎等可辨器官；密植场景空洞占比由17.57%降至最低2.68%，但额外观测也增加运动相关离散。
AI.conclusion: 无人机影像重建玉米器官具有可行性，但完整性与点云离散存在权衡，定量表型应用仍需独立几何验证。

title: How Reliable Is Visual Token Selection? Rethinking Pruning in Multimodal LLMs
summary: Visual token pruning improves the efficiency of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) by removing redundant visual tokens, yet the reliability of existing selection signals has not been systematically examined. We analyze token selection under semantics-preserving perturbations and across representative pruning criteria, revealing two limitations. First, attention-based importance shifts non-uniformly under perturbations, so magnitude alone cannot distinguish stable evidence from unstable saliency (local instability). Second, attention- and diversity-based methods select substantially different subsets despite comparable performance, showing that useful evidence is not confined to a unique subset (global inconsistency). These findings motivate reliable token-set construction. We instantiate this perspective in CoRePruner, a training-free framework combining instruction-aware diversity with reliability-aware attention. Across image benchmarks, multiple MLLM architectures, and token budgets, CoRePruner improves performance, especially under aggressive pruning, and remains competitive on video benchmarks. Our results establish reliability as a central consideration in visual token selection.
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EACL 2027

AI.tldr: 揭示视觉词元选择的局部不稳定与全局不一致，并提出免训练的可靠性导向剪枝框架CoRePruner。
AI.motivation: 视觉词元剪枝可提升多模态大模型效率，但现有选择信号的可靠性尚未得到系统检验。
AI.method: 分析语义保持扰动下及不同剪枝准则间的选择差异，结合指令感知多样性与可靠性感知注意力构建词元集。
AI.result: CoRePruner在多种图像基准、模型架构和预算下改善性能，激进剪枝时尤为明显，在视频基准上也具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 有效视觉证据并不限于唯一词元子集，可靠性应成为视觉词元选择的核心考量。

title: VoxSAOR: Semantic-Aware Occupancy Robustification via Aleatoric Uncertainty Modeling
summary: Vision-based 3D occupancy prediction provides a dense semantic representation of scenes for autonomous driving and embodied perception, yet remains vulnerable to occlusion, depth ambiguity, and projection errors that induce spatially varying reliability in voxel features. Existing methods typically map voxel representations to semantic predictions without explicitly modeling such observation-induced feature variations. To address this limitation, we propose VoxSAOR, a semantic-aware occupancy robustification framework that models aleatoric uncertainty through feature-space proxies. It first quantifies Local Semantic Consistency (LSC) to derive a voxel-wise structural stability prior and uses cross-view semantic consensus to filter unreliable semantic correspondences. Within each semantic category, spatially matched stable and ambiguous voxels form stable-to-ambiguous feature transitions, which are modeled by a class-conditional diagonal Gaussian distribution, capturing both feature displacement and dispersion. Guided by these proxy distributions, Aleatoric Regime Ensemble Learning (AREL) trains independently parameterized prediction heads using feature perturbations at progressively increasing scales, with perturbation strength modulated by structural reliability. At inference, proxy modeling and sampling are disabled, and all heads process the same observed features; their output probabilities are then averaged to produce a deterministic consensus prediction without requiring sampling. Experiments across multiple datasets and occupancy backbones demonstrate the effectiveness of VoxSAOR in improving semantic occupancy prediction, long-tail recognition, and predictive calibration. The source code will be made publicly available at this https URL.
comment: The source code will be made publicly available at this https URL

AI.tldr: VoxSAOR通过特征空间偶然不确定性建模，提高视觉三维语义占据预测的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 遮挡、深度歧义及投影误差导致体素特征可靠性不均，现有方法未显式建模这些变化。
AI.method: 利用局部语义一致性和跨视图共识构建类别条件高斯扰动，训练多预测头并在推理时平均输出。
AI.result: 多数据集与骨干实验表明，该方法改善了语义占据预测、长尾识别和预测校准。
AI.conclusion: 通过训练期不确定性扰动与推理期确定性集成，可增强占据预测的可靠性。

title: WTR-Drive: World-Task Decomposition with Structured Risk Supervision for End-to-End Driving
summary: Proposal-conditioned scene predictions can lack a common object-level reference across candidate trajectories. Aggregate planning scores also leave the objects and times associated with violations implicit. We present WTR-Drive (World-Task-Risk Driving), a Drive-JEPA-based planner that separates shared scene estimation from proposal-conditioned reasoning. A proposal-independent World Memory estimates object states, map structure, and future motion by re-reading the original visual features at each refinement round. Proposal feedback updates a residual Task branch without writing back to World Memory. This branch guides refinement through candidate-specific retrieval and gated visual feedback. A final Task readout supplies candidate-conditioned features for scoring. We derive structured risk targets from existing candidate-scoring rollouts without additional simulator calls. For at-fault collision and time-to-collision violations, the targets encode event existence, association with shared object slots, and the first violation time bin. On the NAVSIM navtest split, WTR-Drive achieves 94.66 PDMS on v1 and 88.24 EPDMS on v2 (expert-frame sequential evaluation). These scores are 0.96 and 0.44 points above the published Drive-JEPA values, respectively. Candidate-level analysis shows that higher best-candidate scores can coexist with lower selected-trajectory scores, revealing a gap between candidate quality and selection effectiveness.
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to IEEE Intelligent Vehicles Symposium (IV) 2027

AI.tldr: WTR-Drive解耦共享场景估计与候选轨迹推理，并引入结构化风险监督以改进端到端驾驶。
AI.motivation: 候选条件场景预测缺乏共同对象参照，聚合规划分数也未明确违规关联的对象与时间。
AI.method: 以独立世界记忆和残差任务分支分离场景与候选推理，并从已有评分轨迹提取对象级时序风险标签。
AI.result: NAVSIM上v1的PDMS为94.66、v2的EPDMS为88.24，分别较已发表Drive-JEPA高0.96和0.44分。
AI.conclusion: 世界与任务解耦取得更高评分，但候选质量提升并不必然带来所选轨迹质量提升。

title: Optimal Dynamic Quantizers for Periodically Time-Varying Systems via Cyclic Reformulation
summary: This paper addresses the design of optimal dynamic quantizers for discrete-time linear periodically time-varying (LPTV) plants with discrete-valued inputs. Optimal dynamic quantizers, which minimize the worst-case output error caused by quantization, are well established for linear time-invariant (LTI) plants, whereas the corresponding design for plants with periodically time-varying dynamics has not been addressed. For square LPTV plants having relative degree one at every time phase, this paper derives an optimal periodic dynamic quantizer in closed form. The quantizer is constructed by applying the LTI theory to the cycled plant obtained by cyclic reformulation and reading off its periodic coefficient matrices block by block; its optimality is then verified directly, showing that it attains a performance lower bound determined by the largest instantaneous input-to-output gain over the time phases. The worst-case output error of general periodic dynamic quantizers is also characterized. The optimal quantizer is shown to be stable if and only if all invariant zeros of the cycled plant lie in the open unit disk, which is the condition that governs stable causal inversion of LPTV plants. A numerical example with comparisons to conventional quantizers illustrates the results.

AI.tldr: 通过循环重构，为各时相相对阶均为一的方形线性周期时变系统推导最优周期动态量化器。
AI.motivation: 线性时不变系统已有成熟最优动态量化理论，但周期时变系统的对应设计尚未解决。
AI.method: 对循环重构系统应用时不变理论，逐块提取周期系数，并直接证明最优性与稳定条件。
AI.result: 量化器达到由最大瞬时输入输出增益决定的误差下界，且稳定当且仅当循环系统所有不变零点位于单位圆内。
AI.conclusion: 循环重构将周期量化设计联系到时不变理论，并给出最优误差及稳定性的明确刻画。

title: What the Averages Hide: Monocular Metric Depth Models Still Fail in Everyday Scenes, Mostly on Scale
summary: Zero-shot monocular metric depth models are evaluated by averaging metric and scale-aligned scores across datasets.
