Averages cannot show how many images still have severely wrong metric depth, whether depth is under- or overestimated, or whether different models fail on the same images. We propose an evaluation built on per-image results: the failure rate (metric $\delta_1$ < 0.5); scale-aligned metrics for structure, and the bias, dispersion and absolute error of the alignment scale for scale; and a cross-model comparison that separates shared from model-specific failures. We apply it to 11 recent architectures with and without ground-truth intrinsics (18 model evaluations) on the 7 everyday-scene benchmarks (4,406 images) used by MoGe-2. Metric depth estimation is not solved in everyday scenes, and the remaining difficulty is mainly scale: the best of the 18 evaluations still has a failure rate of 7.7% (datasets weighted equally); pooled over all failures, 78.8% have intact structure, and after scale correction 98.3% no longer fail. Images failed by at least 6 architectures make up 7.3% of the data, concentrated on HAMMER and DIODE; even when selected only by architectures of other families, they hold 34% to 40% of the error of the top 6 models, against 14% to 18% for as many random images from the same datasets. Adding objects reduces the scale error of most models; ground-truth intrinsics and, in most families, larger models reduce the failures but do not remove them. We recommend reporting failure rates, structure and scale separately, and results stratified by how many models fail. We will release the code, the per-image results with shared-failure labels, and two diagnostic sets built from TUM RGB-D.

AI.tldr: 逐图像评估显示，单目度量深度模型在日常场景中仍有明显失败，主要问题在尺度而非结构。
AI.motivation: 跨数据集平均指标掩盖了严重失败的图像数量、尺度偏差方向及不同模型的共同失败。
AI.method: 在7个基准的4406张图像上评估11种架构，分别分析失败率、结构、尺度及跨模型共享失败。
AI.result: 最佳评估的失败率仍为7.7%；全部失败中78.8%结构完好，尺度校正后98.3%不再失败。
AI.conclusion: 应分别报告失败率、结构与尺度指标，并按失败模型数量分层，以揭示平均指标隐藏的薄弱场景。

title: LINK: Lightweight and Inductive Node-to-Node Propagation Rule Learning for Traffic Kriging
summary: Spatio-temporal traffic kriging aims to reconstruct traffic time series at unobserved locations with no historical traffic observations by leveraging spatial and temporal dependencies across the road network. Existing Graph Neural Network (GNN)-based approaches primarily rely on neighborhood aggregation to capture spatial dependencies, thereby modeling traffic interactions implicitly and making it difficult to accurately recover traffic magnitudes at locations without historical observations. To address this limitation, we propose LINK, a Lightweight and Inductive Node-to-node propagation rule learning paradigm for traffic Kriging. LINK introduces three key designs: 1) a propagation-centric traffic kriging paradigm that explicitly learns a shared node-to-node transition rule; 2) a context-aware Spectral Propagation Network that performs traffic-state propagation in both the spectral and time domains; and 3) TraffiKrig, a realistic traffic kriging benchmark that preserves heterogeneous road-segment characteristics and road-specific metadata while enabling systematic comparison of representative kriging methods under a unified metadata-enhanced setting. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LINK achieves strong reconstruction accuracy and computational efficiency. Compared with the strongest baseline on each subset, LINK achieves an average MAE reduction of 54.7% over original baselines. LINK also achieves substantial efficiency improvements, reducing training time by 66.5% and inference time by 86.6% compared with the fastest competing methods. Zero-shot experiments further demonstrate the transferability of the learned propagation rule across regions.

AI.tldr: LINK显式学习可跨区域迁移的节点间交通传播规则，高效重建无历史观测位置的交通序列。
AI.motivation: 现有图神经网络依赖邻域聚合隐式建模交通交互，难以准确恢复无历史观测位置的交通量值。
AI.method: 学习共享节点间转移规则，以频谱传播网络联合处理频域与时域传播，并构建TraffiKrig基准。
AI.result: 平均MAE较各子集最强基线降低54.7%，训练与推理时间较最快竞品分别减少66.5%和86.6%。
AI.conclusion: 显式传播规则兼具重建精度与计算效率，零样本实验进一步支持其跨区域迁移能力。

title: AFRNet: Adaptive Frequency Redistribution Network for Image Deraining
summary: Image deraining aims to recover rain-free images from rain-degraded observations. Recent frequency-aware deraining methods have demonstrated promising performance by removing rain artifacts in the spectral domain. However, since rain artifacts and background textures often appear in several correlated subbands, prior frequency-domain deraining models still enhance frequency subbands separately. Such band-wise processing limits information exchange across subbands. Without context from other subbands, rain and clean content that appear together in one subband cannot be separated. This leads to either residual rain streaks or over-smoothing of fine details. To address this limitation, we propose AFRNet, an Adaptive Frequency Redistribution Network for image deraining. First, we introduce an Adaptive Frequency Recombination Module (AFRM) that performs cross-band modulation among wavelet subbands, enabling information interaction and adaptive recombination of degraded frequency components. We then develop a Subband Compensation Block (SCB) that compensates for decoder subband degradation by leveraging encoder subband features through inter-subband attention in the wavelet domain, alleviating detail loss during reconstruction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AFRNet achieves competitive performance and consistent results across diverse deraining benchmarks.

AI.tldr: AFRNet通过小波子带间自适应重组与补偿，在图像去雨中促进信息交互并保留细节。
AI.motivation: 逐子带独立处理忽略雨纹与背景的跨带关联，容易造成雨纹残留或细节过度平滑。
AI.method: 采用自适应频率重组模块进行跨带调制，并以子带间注意力利用编码器特征补偿解码器退化。
AI.result: 广泛实验表明，AFRNet在多种去雨基准上取得有竞争力且一致的表现。
AI.conclusion: 跨子带信息交互与重建补偿有助于缓解独立频带处理造成的内容分离困难和细节损失。

title: GaugeRoPE: RoPE-Compatible Executable Latent Attention
summary: Latent KV cache compression reduces memory footprint by mapping historical keys and values into compact representations. However, generic compressed key states require reconstruction to native dimension before applying RoPE and computing attention scores, adding sequence-scaling overhead to the decode path. We characterize when a latent KV representation can serve directly as the execution state of pretrained RoPE. For RoPE-based transformers, exact static linear execution of the rotary key path requires the latent-to-native map to preserve the pretrained RoPE action through an intertwining relation, restricting exact mixing to coordinates that share the same RoPE frequency. Guided by this characterization, we build GaugeRoPE, a training-free executable latent KV representation. It combines a RoPE-compatible carrier that preserves the rotary action with an approximate position-independent residual key--value (RKV) correction for complementary key and value information, both evaluated without per-token dense historical K/V reconstruction. On Mistral-7B, GaugeRoPE achieves $5.85\times$ KV compression while maintaining quality close to the full-cache baseline. Additional MHA results validate the construction beyond GQA. GaugeRoPE achieves up to $2.48\times$ the decode throughput of the vanilla uncompressed baseline through direct latent execution.

AI.tldr: GaugeRoPE提供免训练、兼容RoPE的可直接执行潜在KV表示，压缩缓存并加速解码。
AI.motivation: 通用压缩键表示需先恢复到原始维度才能执行RoPE和注意力，带来随序列增长的解码开销。
AI.method: 刻画精确线性执行的交织约束，结合RoPE兼容载体与近似位置无关残差键值修正，避免逐令牌稠密重建。
AI.result: 在Mistral-7B上实现5.85倍KV压缩且质量接近完整缓存，解码吞吐量最高为未压缩基线的2.48倍。
AI.conclusion: 利用RoPE结构约束直接执行潜在注意力，可在保持接近基线质量的同时降低缓存与解码成本。

title: Compositional Data-Driven Small-Signal Stability Assessment of Power Systems via Output Differential Passivity
summary: This paper proposes a compositional data-driven small-signal stability assessment framework for interconnected power systems based on output differential passivity (ODP). Without requiring explicit device models, local ODP matrices and scalar indices are estimated directly from measurement trajectories. When internal states are available, trajectory-based linear matrix inequalities (LMIs) are constructed from input-state measurements to estimate the local ODP matrices and scalar indices. When internal states are unavailable, an extended-state representation is constructed from input-output measurements, enabling the same assessment using only external signals. The estimated ODP matrices are combined with the network coupling matrix for compositional assessment of power system stability, while their scalar indices enable decentralized assessment. To address the computational and numerical challenges of trajectory-based LMIs, we introduce right-inverse whitening (RIW) to remove redundant behavioral coordinates and improve computational efficiency, and apply instrumental-variable (IV) preprocessing to alleviate numerical ill-conditioning and mitigate noise effects. Case studies on a modified IEEE 39-bus power system show that ambient measurements satisfy the required informativity conditions and that both formulations yield estimates close to model-based references under the tested noise levels. The reusable local ODP estimates also enable modular stability reassessment after controller updates.

AI.tldr: 基于输出微分无源性，从测量轨迹估计局部指标，实现无需显式设备模型的电力系统小信号稳定性评估。
AI.motivation: 互联电力系统需要无需显式设备模型、兼顾内部状态不可测情形的可组合稳定性评估方法。
AI.method: 从输入状态或扩展输入输出轨迹构建线性矩阵不等式，结合网络耦合评估稳定性，并用白化及工具变量预处理改善求解。
AI.result: 改进IEEE 39节点案例中，环境测量满足信息条件，两种方案在测试噪声下均得到接近模型参考的估计。
AI.conclusion: 局部无源性估计支持组合式及分散式稳定评估，并可复用于控制器更新后的模块化稳定性重评估。

title: Social Welfare and Equilibrium in Distributed Microgrid Prosumer Coordination Under a Mixed Competitive-Cooperative Setting
summary: Price-based distributed prosumer coordination in distribution networks is fundamentally challenging when the aggregator pursues grid-level goals that couple prosumers' decisions, because the Lagrangian fails to separate and nodal prices are undefined under conventional dual decomposition. This paper develops a novel method that embeds mixed competitive-cooperative objectives exactly into prices, which are split into energy, congestion, and grid-objective components, closing the gap between the social welfare optimum and the competitive equilibrium. To compute the equilibrium, a distributed optimization algorithm is developed based on the projected Arrow-Hurwicz-Uzawa scheme. Explicit step-size rules are developed for the algorithm to guarantee $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{L})$ and $\mathcal{O}(1/L)$ ergodic convergence rates. Simulations on an IEEE 33-bus feeder that is connected to prosumers and electric vehicle fleets validate the accuracy and efficacy of the proposed methods.
comment: This paper is submitted to IEEE transactions on control of network systems

AI.tldr: 通过将混合竞争合作目标嵌入价格，实现分布式产消者协调中的社会福利最优与竞争均衡一致。
AI.motivation: 电网级目标耦合产消者决策，使传统对偶分解的拉格朗日函数不可分离且节点价格无法定义。
AI.method: 将价格分解为能源、拥塞和电网目标分量，并基于投影Arrow-Hurwicz-Uzawa方案设计分布式算法。
AI.result: 显式步长规则保证两类遍历收敛率，IEEE 33节点馈线仿真验证了方法的准确性与有效性。
AI.conclusion: 所提定价与优化方法可弥合混合竞争合作环境下社会福利最优与竞争均衡之间的差距。

title: VAHBench: A Harness Benchmark for Agentic Long-Video Generation
summary: AI agents are commonly used for everyday information retrieval and coding. We ask whether they can also interpret human requests and turn them into complete videos. We introduce VAHBench, a benchmark that tests this ability through five short-drama briefs specifying story, characters, dialogue and duration. Agents plan and carry out production using shared generation tools. Evaluation combines video completeness and basic quality with checks of production reliability and reporting accuracy. Across 240 runs covering 48 configurations of general-purpose and video-specific agents, higher quality scores do not necessarily mean more complete delivery. Missing episodes, repeated footage and static filler reveal gaps between producing a video file and fulfilling the brief. Added composition tools help some agents but do not consistently improve performance. VAHBench measures how well agents translate user intent into finished video content and helps identify where that process breaks down.

AI.tldr: VAHBench评测智能体将自然语言需求转化为完整长视频的能力，揭示画质与交付完整性之间的差距。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体能检索信息和编程，但其能否理解用户需求并完成视频制作仍需系统评测。
AI.method: 以五个短剧需求驱动智能体使用共享生成工具制作视频，并评估完整性、质量、生产可靠性和报告准确性。
AI.result: 48种配置的240次运行表明，高质量得分不必然对应完整交付，新增合成工具也未稳定提升表现。
AI.conclusion: 视频文件生成并不等同于满足用户需求，VAHBench可定位从意图到成片过程中的失效环节。

title: SmoothShift: Disrupting Visual Adversarial Attacks on LVLMs at Test Time
summary: Visual adversarial perturbations can substantially impair large vision-language models (LVLMs) despite introducing only subtle input changes. To understand how these small changes cause substantial errors, we investigate their optimization and propagation through the model, revealing two key findings. First, stronger attacks rely on finer iterative optimization, while subtle input perturbations induce representation discrepancies that are amplified layer by layer through the vision encoder and persist in the language model. Second, disrupting the alignment between within-patch input patterns and the model's computation reduces clean-adversarial representation discrepancies and substantially weakens attacks. Together, these findings suggest that adversarial effectiveness depends on both fine-grained perturbation patterns and their coupling with the model's computation. Motivated by these findings, we propose SmoothShift, a lightweight, training-free defense that combines local smoothing and spatial transformations. Smoothing weakens fine-grained perturbation patterns, while spatial transformations disrupt their alignment with the encoder's patch grid. SmoothShift requires no model updates, auxiliary networks, or additional model inference. Experiments cover three LVLM families on four datasets and robustly fine-tuned Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) models on eight classification datasets. Evaluations across eight attack methods and multiple perturbation budgets demonstrate improved robustness while largely preserving clean performance. SmoothShift also provides robustness gains under defense-aware attacks using mixed-gradient BPDA with EOT.

AI.tldr: SmoothShift通过局部平滑与空间变换，在无需训练或额外模型推理的情况下增强视觉语言模型的对抗鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 细微视觉扰动可经视觉编码器逐层放大并持续影响语言模型，显著削弱模型表现。
AI.method: 局部平滑削弱细粒度扰动，空间变换破坏扰动与编码器图像块网格的对齐。
AI.result: 跨三类视觉语言模型及CLIP模型的评测显示，方法提升鲁棒性且基本保持干净性能，对防御感知攻击也有效。
AI.conclusion: 破坏扰动细节及其与模型计算的耦合，可提供轻量、免训练的测试时防御。

title: A Gaussian Primitive Data Management Framework for Efficient 3DGS Trajectory Rendering
summary: Trajectory rendering, which renders novel views of a reconstructed 3D scene along a camera path, is a core operation in digital twins and autonomous inspection. Structured 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) renders a single view in real time by decoding sparse anchors into Gaussians on demand, but it renders a trajectory view by view: every view projects all anchors to select them, re-decodes anchors already requested by neighboring views, and runs all steps on the GPU while the CPU idles. We treat this as a spatial data management problem, where anchors are spatial objects, views are range queries, and decoded Gaussians are shared derived data, and propose GDM-GS, which removes redundancy at three levels. Within a view, an anchor index and an occluder index answer each view as a holed-frustum range query, so out-of-view and provably hidden anchors are never decoded. Across views, shared materialization decodes each requested anchor once per group of consecutive views while preserving each view's selection. Across processors, a hybrid pipeline balances selections between the CPU and the GPU before grouped decoding under bounded memory. Experiments on large-scale public scenes show that GDM-GS substantially reduces trajectory rendering latency while preserving image quality.

AI.tldr: GDM-GS将3DGS轨迹渲染视为空间数据管理问题，通过多层去冗余降低延迟并保持图像质量。
AI.motivation: 逐视图轨迹渲染反复筛选和解码锚点，且GPU承担全部流程而CPU闲置，造成计算冗余。
AI.method: 结合锚点与遮挡物索引、跨视图共享解码结果及有界内存下的CPU与GPU混合流水线。
AI.result: 大规模公开场景实验表明，GDM-GS显著降低轨迹渲染延迟，同时保持图像质量。
AI.conclusion: 从视图内、跨视图和跨处理器三个层面管理高斯数据，可提高结构化3DGS轨迹渲染效率。

title: RoShift: Lazy Shift and Weight-aware Rotation for Activation Sparsity in LLM Inference
summary: Activation sparsity accelerates LLM decoding by skipping unnecessary weight reads and computation. However, SiLU-based LLMs exhibit little natural sparsity, and imposing high sparsity can substantially degrade accuracy. We propose RoShift, a training-free method that transforms activations into sparsity-friendly representations. RoShift introduces lazy shift, which recenters SiLU activation distributions around zero and defers correction to the end of the FFN to obtain additional sparsity. It also reduces sparsification-induced output error through rotation that jointly accounts for activation and weight information. By fusing the corrections required for shifting and rotation, RoShift translates these gains into decoding speedup. At 50% and 60% sparsity, RoShift improves average accuracy over TEAL by 1.60 and 3.29 percentage points, respectively, across five models. It achieves up to $1.72\times$ decoding speedup over the dense model on an RTX 5090 at 50% sparsity and yields a better accuracy-speedup Pareto frontier than TEAL. Code is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: RoShift以免训练的延迟平移和权重感知旋转提升激活稀疏性，实现更好的大模型解码精度与速度权衡。
AI.motivation: 采用SiLU的大模型天然激活稀疏性低，强制提高稀疏率又会明显损害准确率。
AI.method: 将激活分布平移至零附近并延迟校正，结合激活与权重信息旋转表示，再融合校正操作以加速解码。
AI.result: 五个模型在50%和60%稀疏率下较TEAL平均提升1.60和3.29个百分点，最高实现1.72倍解码加速。
AI.conclusion: RoShift无需训练即可改善稀疏解码，在准确率与加速比之间形成优于TEAL的帕累托前沿。

title: GranularGPT: Natural-Language-Driven End-to-End Discrete Element Method Simulations
summary: Discrete element method (DEM) simulations are widely used to investigate granular and particulate systems, but their application often requires specialized expertise in particle physics, numerical modelling, and simulation post-processing. Large language models (LLMs) offer new opportunities to simplify these workflows by enabling users to interact with simulation tools through natural language. This study offers GranularGPT, an LLM-assisted agentic framework for end-to-end DEM simulation workflows, from natural-language problem descriptions to simulation execution and automated post-processing. The framework enables users to generate DEM simulation cases, execute and monitor simulations, and automatically extract and report physical and process-level metrics. Evaluation across 60 normal-condition cases covering 12 DEM scenarios and parameter variations achieve a simulation success rate of 91.7%. In the error-handling evaluation, all 10 repairable errors are detected and 9 are successfully resolved, while all 5 non-repairable cases are correctly identified and reported. The framework automatically extracts a range of DEM-relevant metrics, including particle size distributions, packing and density measures, velocity profiles, discharge rates, mixing indices, contact force characteristics, and thermal quantities. GranularGPT provides a foundation for improving the accessibility and efficiency of DEM simulation workflows while reducing the specialized expertise required for their operation.

AI.tldr: GranularGPT以自然语言驱动离散元仿真的生成、执行与后处理，降低专业操作门槛。
AI.motivation: 离散元仿真依赖颗粒物理、数值建模和后处理知识，限制了工作流的可及性与效率。
AI.method: 构建大语言模型辅助的智能体框架，将自然语言问题转化为仿真案例，监控执行并自动提取报告指标。
AI.result: 60个常规案例成功率为91.7%，10个可修复错误全部检出且修复9个，5个不可修复案例均正确识别。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为提高离散元仿真的可及性与效率提供基础，并减少操作所需的专门知识。

title: Learning a Task-Adaptive Low-Dimensional Semantic Space for Improved Visual Classification
summary: Semantic visual classification commonly aligns visual embeddings with semantic spaces induced by pretrained text encoders. However, such spaces are typically high-dimensional, weakly aligned with visual feature geometry, and insufficiently discriminative for downstream classification tasks. We propose TaSS, a framework for learning a task-adaptive low-dimensional semantic space that preserves semantic structure while explicitly optimizing class separability. TaSS is constructed through a parameterized geometry transformation of pretrained text embeddings that enlarges inter-class margins via distance reshaping and improves intra-class compactness through prototype-preserving semantic constraints. The resulting semantic space maintains meaningful semantic relationships while producing a discriminative geometry tailored for classification. Frozen visual encoder features are subsequently aligned to TaSS using a lightweight MLP, enabling improved discriminative learning without fine-tuning pretrained backbones. We further provide theoretical analysis showing that TaSS preserves semantic consistency while enforcing enhanced inter-class separation and controlled intra-class variance. Extensive experiments on skeleton-based human action recognition, video classification, and image classification benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over existing semantic alignment approaches, with gains exceeding 3 percentage points on average and up to 8.5 points on challenging datasets.

AI.tldr: TaSS学习兼顾语义结构与类别区分性的任务自适应低维语义空间，改善视觉分类。
AI.motivation: 预训练文本编码器的语义空间维度高，与视觉特征几何弱对齐，且下游分类判别性不足。
AI.method: 通过参数化几何变换扩大类间间隔并约束类内紧致性，再用轻量MLP对齐冻结的视觉特征。
AI.result: 动作识别、视频和图像分类实验均有提升，平均增益超过3个百分点，困难数据集最高提升8.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 无需微调预训练骨干，任务自适应语义几何即可在保持语义一致性的同时增强分类判别能力。

title: AsymEEF: Bimanual Manipulation with Asymmetric End Effectors
summary: Teleoperated demonstrations are costly to collect and rarely reusable across end-effectors with different kinematics and action spaces. This burden grows in bimanual manipulation, where each end-effector pair may require new data. We present AsymEEF, a framework for executable cross-end-effector demonstration generation and unified bimanual policy learning. Given a small source dataset, AsymEEF transfers demonstrations to heterogeneous combinations of two-, three-, and five-fingered end-effectors without additional teleoperation. Kinematic teacher anchors provide geometric supervision, while sparse real-world X-Calib anchors correct discrepancies in grasp execution. A shared encoder maps wrist poses and actuator states to a morphology-agnostic latent space, and a morphology-conditioned decoder reconstructs target commands. Generated trajectories undergo replay filtering for task-level executability. The representation also supports a unified bimanual visuomotor policy trained across multiple pairs. Across four simulated and six real-world tasks, AsymEEF improves replay success over adapted transfer baselines, achieves a mean replay-valid expansion gain of 16.6 times in simulation, and is evaluated through downstream policy training on real robots. Project website: this https URL.

AI.tldr: AsymEEF无需额外遥操作即可跨异构末端执行器生成可执行双臂示范，并支持统一策略学习。
AI.motivation: 遥操作示范采集成本高，且难以跨运动学和动作空间不同的末端执行器复用。
AI.method: 结合运动学教师与实机校准锚点、形态无关潜空间及形态条件解码，并通过回放过滤保证轨迹可执行性。
AI.result: 四项仿真和六项实机任务中回放成功率优于适配基线，仿真有效示范平均扩增16.6倍，并评估了实机策略训练。
AI.conclusion: 共享表示与可执行示范迁移可减少双臂异构执行器的数据采集负担，并支持跨执行器组合的统一视觉运动策略。

title: Vision-Language Grounded Semantic Navigation for Autonomous Mobile Robots
summary: Language-guided navigation enables mobile robots to interpret natural language commands and navigate toward user-specified targets in unstructured environments. However, integrating open-vocabulary visual perception with classical robotics pipelines for mapping and navigation remains a challenging problem. In this work, we present a complete ROS2-based system that combines frontier-based exploration, open-vocabulary object detection using Grounding DINO, depth-based 3D localization, and semantic mapping to enable end-to-end vision-language grounded navigation in simulation. The system accepts natural language commands such as ``go to the yellow box,'' detects candidate objects from RGB images using text prompts, estimates their positions in the world frame, and generates navigation goals executed by the Nav2 stack. In a Gazebo-based indoor environment with a TurtleBot3 robot, the system autonomously explored the room, detected three of the five target objects, and successfully executed both natural language navigation commands tested, without task-specific training. The results indicate that open-vocabulary grounding models can be integrated into classical navigation pipelines, though performance is limited by detection uncertainty, depth-based localization error, and incomplete exploration coverage. These findings highlight both the feasibility and current limitations of deploying vision-language grounded navigation systems using lightweight, CPU-only architectures.

AI.tldr: 提出无需任务专项训练的ROS2视觉语言导航系统，在仿真中实现自然语言目标导航。
AI.motivation: 开放词汇视觉感知与传统建图导航流程的集成仍具挑战。
AI.method: 结合前沿探索、Grounding DINO检测、深度三维定位、语义地图与Nav2导航。
AI.result: TurtleBot3在Gazebo中检出五个目标中的三个，并成功完成两条受测自然语言导航指令。
AI.conclusion: 轻量纯CPU架构可支持视觉语言导航，但受检测不确定性、定位误差和探索覆盖不足限制。

title: One-Shot Calibration via Model Editing
summary: Model editing aims to correct errors in large, pretrained models by replacing model generations with user-provided responses. Existing editors assume a single target answer for each edit. However, many real tasks inherently entail uncertainty, resulting in multiple plausible answers with varying likelihoods in user feedback. Such feedback forms a target distribution to not only correct but also calibrate model generations. We therefore propose SoftEdit, the first model editor to leverage uncertainty in user responses and perform one-shot calibration during editing. To generalize calibration to unseen samples, SoftEdit uses co-plausibility relationships between answers while preserving real distributional shifts, balancing the new distributional generality-locality tradeoff. Across three language models, three vision-language models, and two large datasets, SoftEdit achieves state-of-the-art performance, ultimately showing that uncertainty in user responses enables generalizable calibration of pretrained models beyond single-answer corrections.

AI.tldr: SoftEdit利用用户反馈中的答案不确定性，在模型编辑时实现一次性校准。
AI.motivation: 现有模型编辑仅接受单一目标答案，难以表达实际任务中多个合理答案的概率分布。
AI.method: 利用答案间的共同合理性关系推广校准，同时保留真实分布变化，平衡分布泛化与局部性。
AI.result: 在三个语言模型、三个视觉语言模型和两个大型数据集上取得最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: 用户反馈中的不确定性可使预训练模型获得超越单答案纠错的可泛化校准。

title: Memory-Efficient Speculative Decoding with Quantized Draft KV Cache
summary: Speculative decoding reduces generation cost, but it stores two KV caches: one for the target model and one for the draft model. We reduce this extra memory by quantizing the draft cache. The target cache and verifier remain in BF16, so that compression cannot change the target model's final correction rule. We first study how to divide precision between keys and values. A naive per-token quantizer makes keys appear much more sensitive: splitting a 12-bit budget, K8V4 beats K4V8 in acceptance by 10.87pp. However, with grouped per-channel keys, the gap becomes -0.25pp. A controlled Qwen test confirms that changing only the key quantizer can erase or reverse the preferred bit split. Hence, following KIVI, we propose K4V4 quantization with per-channel keys and per-token values. Across six model pairs, our method reduces draft cache memory by 66.20%, and combined memory across both caches by 23.95%. Mean acceptance drops from 57.93% to 57.14%, only 1.36% relative. Overall, quantized draft caches can make speculative decoding more memory efficient; as a predictive principle for efficient AI design, key and value precision must be co-designed with the quantizer layout.
comment: Accepted at the AXIOM Foundations of Efficient Deep Learning Workshop at NeurIPS 2026

AI.tldr: 量化推测解码的草稿KV缓存可显著节省内存，同时基本保持接受率。
AI.motivation: 推测解码同时存储目标模型和草稿模型的KV缓存，带来额外内存开销。
AI.method: 采用键按通道、值按词元的K4V4量化，并保持目标缓存和验证器为BF16。
AI.result: 六组模型中草稿缓存内存减少66.20%，双缓存总内存减少23.95%，平均接受率从57.93%降至57.14%。
AI.conclusion: 键值精度须与量化布局协同设计，草稿缓存压缩无需改变目标模型的最终纠正规则。

title: Weight-Space Programming Changes How an LLM Uses Python for Computational Biology
summary: Weight-space programming allows a language model to edit another model's weights without gradient-based training. We used Claude Opus 5.5 to edit Qwen3.5-0.8B and investigated how the edits changed its use of Python on computational biology problems. We compared four initial edited checkpoints with the original model on 50 test problems across three test seeds, yielding 600 paired evaluations. Strictly correct answers increased from 44 to 77, and technically correct answers, which included correct final values rejected for formatting, increased from 64 to 100. Repeated Python calls decreased from 1,834 to 1,044. Among the 64 pairs in which only the edited response was technically correct, the original model had already computed the correct value in 36 but did not submit a technically correct final answer. The edited model corrected the computation in 13 of the 64 pairs. With six additional checkpoints on the same 50 problems, technically correct answers rose from 96 to 154 across 900 pairs. We explored three selected problems with ten test seeds for each of ten checkpoints. On the melting-temperature problem, correct Python outputs decreased from 60 to 22 while technically correct final answers increased from 0 to 18. Weight editing changed both the calculations Qwen ran and whether it submitted a correct answer.
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 6 main tables, and 1 supplementary table

AI.tldr: 无梯度权重编辑改变小模型在计算生物学任务中的Python调用及正确答案提交行为。
AI.motivation: 研究权重空间编程如何改变模型的计算过程，以及计算结果向最终答案的转化。
AI.method: 用Claude Opus 5.5编辑Qwen3.5-0.8B，在50道题上跨检查点和随机种子进行配对评估。
AI.result: 初始600组配对中严格正确答案由44增至77，技术正确答案由64增至100，重复Python调用由1834降至1044。
AI.conclusion: 权重编辑既改变计算执行，也改善正确结果的提交，但正确计算与最终答对并不总同步。

title: Calibrated Functional Prediction from Overlapping Nonlinear Observations
summary: We study prediction of nonlinear audit functionals from scalar observations of a shared hidden table state. For Schur-rational operators, local Gaussian projections yield a common sparse kernel for overlapping tasks, repeated row identities, and cross-row dependence. Shared-state residual samples extend this kernel through a positive-semidefinite feature representation. Positive matrix integration and sample-value enclosures connect the original inputs to the actual saved hybrid prediction. A sorted calibration-role perturbation bound then certifies its complete finite-pool pinball risk. Independent complete-loss selection chooses the ridge, score scale, and residual weight, while task-rank calibration supplies an upper endpoint. Evaluation uses twenty new reference contexts per dataset at two task sizes, giving 400 conditions across ten benchmark populations. The mean dataset complete-loss ratios are 0.9977 to the degree-two kernel, 0.9961 to matched complete-MC shrinkage, and 0.9911 to the retrospective minimum over 174 public configurations. The last ratio has a paired reference-bootstrap interval of [0.9898,0.9927]. On 40 profiles at coefficient tolerance $10^{-7}$, Gamma quadrature has a geometric mean cold-time ratio of .0646 to strengthened Arb/Petras integration.

AI.tldr: 提出从共享隐表的重叠非线性观测进行函数预测与有限池风险认证的框架。
AI.motivation: 共享隐状态下的任务重叠、行重复和跨行依赖增加非线性函数预测及校准的难度。
AI.method: 结合局部高斯投影稀疏核、共享状态残差特征、正矩阵积分、独立完整损失选择与任务秩校准。
AI.result: 十个基准群体的400种条件下，相对174种公开配置事后最优值的平均数据集完整损失比为0.9911。
AI.conclusion: 该框架连接原始输入与实际保存的混合预测，并认证其完整有限池分位数损失风险。

title: sqrtVINS-Based 360 Visual-Inertial SLAM Systems: Hilti-Trimble SLAM Challenge 2026 Entry
summary: This report describes our submission to the 2026 Hilti-Trimble SLAM Challenge. The system is a 360-camera visual-inertial pipeline that uses only the provided dual-fisheye image streams and IMU measurements. First, raw images are preprocessed with low-light enhancement and static/dynamic masking, and then fed into a $\sqrt{\text{VINS}}$ frontend as the local odometry, with deep learning-based SuperPoint features, ELSED line segments, and LightGlue matching. The resulting trajectory is refined using a GTSAM-based backend that performs tightly-coupled factor graph optimization with SALAD global descriptor and visual bundle adjustment (BA). The backend performs local-to-global structureless BA, tightly regularized intrinsic and extrinsic refinement, and global scale adjustment supported by the known inter-camera baseline and cross-view constraints. The design targets long indoor sequences with dark regions, repetitive corridors, dynamic objects, and limited geometric parallax, while keeping the pipeline reproducible in the provided ROS2 workspace. Fig. 1 demonstrates that our proposed method aligns well with the floorplan across several indoor sequences.
comment: 2026 Hilti x Trimble SLAM Challenge at ICRA 2026 (2nd Place in the SLAM Category)

AI.tldr: 提出基于sqrtVINS的360度视觉惯性SLAM系统，参加2026年Hilti-Trimble挑战赛。
AI.motivation: 长室内序列中的暗区、重复走廊、动态物体和有限视差给定位建图带来挑战。
AI.method: 仅用双鱼眼图像和IMU，结合图像增强、掩膜、sqrtVINS前端与GTSAM紧耦合优化后端。
AI.result: 摘要中的图示显示，该方法在多个室内序列上的轨迹与建筑平面图较好对齐。
AI.conclusion: 该设计面向困难室内场景，并注重在所提供ROS2工作空间中的可复现性。

title: ToolGraph as a Q-Function for Test-Time Scaling of Tool-Use Agents
summary: Tool-use agents must chain interdependent calls, yet which outputs satisfy which later inputs in a deployed catalog is not something a general-purpose language model reliably infers from tool descriptions alone. We compile that structure once into a reusable external representation. ToolGraph is a directed, weighted dependency graph over a tool catalog: parameter matching and interventional probes, which execute a candidate chain with and without its proposed predecessor, propose edges whose evidence is combined into an edge confidence. Prior work uses such graphs to retrieve tools, search for tool paths, or score the next call. We ask instead whether the same structure can supply a \emph{multi-step} value by composing graph paths into a goal-conditioned action value \(Q(s,a,g)\). We study three estimators (dynamic programming over entity sets, a GraphSAGE estimator distilled from it, and an LLM scorer conditioned on graph evidence) plus a verbalizer that returns action--goal feedback to the agent, which keeps final action selection. Across two tool-use benchmarks and three backbones, we compare value ranking against personalized-PageRank retrieval over the identical graph, and against direct and reflective agents. Composition pays off only when the estimator also reads the concrete state: the LLM estimator improves on PageRank in every benchmark--backbone setting, by \(8.3\) points on average, while the two purely structural estimators fall below it, because a value defined over tool types cannot separate a correct tool called with a wrong argument. Graph construction is a one-time cost; we report it separately rather than assume it amortized away (at our scale it is comparable to request-time cost) and sweep four knobs controlling how much graph evidence to expose against success and tokens.
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: From Pretrained Representations to Acting Agents (PTA)

AI.tldr: ToolGraph将工具依赖图转化为目标条件多步动作价值，以辅助工具智能体决策。
AI.motivation: 通用语言模型难以仅凭工具描述可靠推断调用链中输出与后续输入的依赖关系。
AI.method: 通过参数匹配和干预探测构建加权图，比较三种价值估计器，并向智能体提供动作—目标反馈。
AI.result: 两个基准和三个骨干上，读取具体状态的LLM估计器均优于PageRank，平均提高8.3个百分点，纯结构估计器则较差。
AI.conclusion: 多步价值组合的收益依赖具体状态理解，且需单独计入不可忽略的一次性建图成本。

title: OrthoMark: Place Recognition with Point-Anchored Orthographic Height Mark
summary: LiDAR place recognition provides the loop closures of Simultaneous Localization and Mapping(SLAM). Perspective from Z-axis, a gravity-aligned scan is an orthographic map of the scene, and a revisit from another position and heading moves this map rigidly in the plane, a motion that a polar Fourier spectrum ignores and phase correlation recovers. Along the vertical, the heights of the returns describe the structures, but which heights are observed depends on the range, because the sensor's vertical field of view cuts nearby structures low; height thus misleads a global key, yet is decisive once two scans are aligned and compared cell by cell where they overlap. We present \method, a training-free method built on one principle: two LiDAR scans can only be compared through features computed from the same geometric surfaces in both scans. \method retrieves candidates with a translation- and rotation-invariant polar spectrum of the bird's-eye view (BEV), 1.9,KB per keyframe, and verifies each candidate by estimating its planar pose through phase correlation and scoring it with \emph{point-anchored height columns}: every BEV cell keeps a 16-bit mask of the heights of its own returns; within a session, the score is weighted by the expected overlap of the two scans' sensing ranges, computed from their distance. We show that this vertical link pays off in verification but hurts in retrieval, where what a height slice contains depends on the range to the structure. For single robot, \method has the highest AP of the training-free methods without 3D registration on the KITTI development sequences; across robots, on all multi-robot sequences, it matches or exceeds RING++ at 1/350 of its descriptor size and closes more inter-robot loops than the learned BEVPlace++ on all tests.

AI.tldr: OrthoMark以不变鸟瞰图检索和点锚定高度验证，实现无需训练的激光雷达地点识别。
AI.motivation: 高度观测随传感距离变化，直接用于全局检索易误导，却可在对齐后的重叠区域有效验证。
AI.method: 以极坐标频谱检索候选，通过相位相关估计平面位姿，并用逐格16位高度掩码验证。
AI.result: 在KITTI开发序列的免训练且无需三维配准方法中AP最高，多机器人测试以RING++的1/350描述子大小达到或超过其表现。
AI.conclusion: 地点识别应比较两次扫描共同几何表面的特征，高度信息适合对齐验证而非全局检索。

title: Dynamic Shaping: Acquiring Interfaces and Constructing Execution over Frozen Pretrained Components
summary: We introduce Dynamic Shaping, a method for constructing executable neural arrangements through acquired response and partial-derivative interfaces over frozen pretrained components. The method learns local descriptions of available computation, ranks component rebindings using task-gradient alignment, transports the current interface across a rebinding, and retains changes through behavioral feedback. Continuous interface acquisition uses proximal policy optimization; the source coefficients remain fixed. We derive an exact identity relating transport error in component responses and partials to changes in action logits and their sensitivities. A pixels-only ViZDoom Basic study evaluates first task acquisition without a competent reference controller, demonstrations or intact response targets. Across three initializations and 100 shared held-out game seeds, initial arrangements succeed on 86/300 controller/episode pairs; joint interface-and-binding construction succeeds on 295/300. Fixed-binding interface acquisition also reaches 295/300. Each policy executes four source fragments, with 110 acquired interface values and fixed random visual and action projections. The artifact includes all candidate trials, interventions and costs; all 1,200 recorded initial/retained outcomes replay exactly. The contribution is an explicit profile, rebind, transport and retain procedure and a reproducible reference-free acquisition case over frozen pretrained computation.
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures. Code and complete evidence: this https URL

AI.tldr: Dynamic Shaping通过学习接口与重绑定冻结预训练组件，构建可执行神经系统。
AI.motivation: 探索在无参考控制器、示范或完整响应目标时，如何利用冻结预训练计算获取任务能力。
AI.method: 用近端策略优化学习响应及偏导接口，依据任务梯度对齐重绑定组件，并迁移接口、按行为反馈保留修改。

AI.conclusion: 研究提供了可复现的无参考任务获取案例，但该实验未显示重绑定优于固定绑定接口学习。

title: ExtremeDrive: A Real-World Dataset and Benchmark for Critical Driving
summary: Existing autonomous driving datasets and benchmarks provide extensive resources for routine driving, yet real-world data covering safety-critical scenarios and extreme environmental conditions remain limited. To address this gap, we present ExtremeDrive, a real-world dataset and benchmark covering emergency maneuvers, complex traffic interactions, and adverse conditions such as slippery or snow-covered roads, alongside routine driving. The dataset comprises 589 driving scenes curated from a larger pool of real-world driving recordings, with calibrated and aligned multisensor data and reviewed annotations of road structure and traffic participants. We further establish a benchmark to evaluate planned trajectories through simulated vehicle execution, measuring safety-related metrics and driving performance. Experiments at equal training set sizes show that incorporating critical driving data reduces trajectory prediction errors and improves mean critical-success rates in critical scenarios. ExtremeDrive provides a unified resource for learning and evaluating autonomous driving in safety-critical scenarios and extreme environmental conditions.

AI.tldr: ExtremeDrive提供涵盖常规驾驶、安全关键场景及极端环境的真实驾驶数据集与评测基准。
AI.motivation: 现有自动驾驶资源对安全关键场景及极端环境的真实数据覆盖不足。
AI.method: 整理589个驾驶场景，提供校准对齐的多传感器数据与审核标注，并通过车辆仿真执行评估规划轨迹。
AI.result: 相同训练集规模下，加入关键驾驶数据降低了轨迹预测误差，并提高关键场景的平均关键成功率。
AI.conclusion: ExtremeDrive为安全关键及极端环境下的自动驾驶学习与评估提供统一资源。

title: PerturbJEPA: Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning of Cellular Perturbation Responses
summary: Identifying the drug and dose that produced a cellular response requires preserving treatment effects within each cellular background. A joint-embedding predictor can match its targets while ignoring the intervention if its encoder preserves differences across backgrounds but erases differences between treated and control populations within each one. We call this failure interventional contrast collapse. PerturbJEPA encodes the difference in mean gene expression between treated and control populations as an effect vector. It aligns the displacement between their latent centroids with this vector and regularizes the vectors to preserve variation across population pairs. We show that the measured displacements cannot all coincide within a batch when effect-vector variation exceeds the root-mean-square alignment error. Trained with separate drug and dose ranking objectives, the model predicts candidate responses from a common control population and matches them to the observed response without cell pairing or expression reconstruction. We evaluate 3,592 Tahoe-100M queries on held-out combinations of known interventions and cellular backgrounds, each with over 700 drug-dose candidates in a fixed, background-specific catalog. PerturbJEPA achieves 91.46% macro joint drug-dose Recall@1, exceeding STATE by 3.40 percentage points (95% drug-cluster bootstrap interval of 1.72 to 5.07 points). Controlled diagnostics show that treatment-control differences can shrink even when representations remain globally dispersed. With the drug ranking objective fixed, adding effect-vector regularization to alignment raises joint Recall@1 from 18.57% to 87.47%.
comment: 23 pages, 6 figures, 14 tables. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: PerturbJEPA通过保留处理与对照之间的效应差异，提升细胞响应对应药物及剂量的识别能力。
AI.motivation: 联合嵌入预测器可能保留细胞背景差异，却抹去干预效应，导致干预对比坍缩。
AI.method: 编码处理与对照的平均表达差异，对齐潜空间质心位移并正则化效应向量，分别优化药物与剂量排序。
