AI.conclusion: 显式保留干预效应变化有助于避免对比坍缩，并支持无需细胞配对或表达重建的响应匹配。

title: Language Models Meet Vibration Testing for LEO Constellation Satellites with Calibrated Response Prediction from Few-show Sweeps
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly drive engineering analysis end to end, turning textual records into the inputs of numerical programs, but a plausible and wrong value can pass silently into a decision. We propose deterministic validation gates for LLM-driven engineering analysis, a general paradigm in which a typed configuration produced by LLMs is consumed only after it passes deterministic checks on units, physical consistency, verbatim quotes, agreement between independent models, consistency with measurement exports and the applicability of trained models. The gates target hallucinations from two directions, since quote checking catches fabricated content while agreement between models catches errors of omission that quote checking misses. We instantiate the paradigm on sine vibration acceptance testing for low Earth orbit mega-constellation satellites, where DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Qwen-plus read Chinese test records and extract a configuration of 76 fields. Fact-level F1 ranged from 0.98 to 1.0 on five input variants, with all repairs frozen on development inputs and evaluated on held-out inputs. With all gates, 20 of 20 configurations produced notching results bit for bit identical to the gold run, and all 17 real and injected errors in consumed fields were stopped, of which 16 would have run without gates. Retraining the bound model on a dataset built from an LLM configuration reproduced its results within GPU nondeterminism. We also report a negative result of practical value. Direct LLM curve forecasting only matches linear extrapolation, whereas a small physics-structured network reduces the over-notched bandwidth by 86% to 89% at calibrated coverage c = 0.90, which delineates where direct LLM prediction should give way to a trained model.

AI.tldr: 研究以确定性验证关卡约束大模型工程分析，并在卫星振动验收测试中验证其可靠性。
AI.motivation: 大模型提取的数值即使看似合理也可能错误，并未经察觉地进入工程决策。
AI.method: 对模型生成配置检查单位、物理一致性、原文引文、跨模型一致性、测量导出及训练模型适用性。
AI.result: 全部20个配置的限幅结果与标准运行逐位一致，17个错误全被拦截；物理结构网络减少86%至89%的过度限幅带宽。
AI.conclusion: 验证关卡可约束大模型配置错误，而直接曲线预测仅相当于线性外推，应适时交由训练模型处理。

title: SCoRe: Support-Calibrated Role Fusion for Training-Free Cross-Domain Few-Shot Segmentation
summary: We present SCoRe (Support-Calibrated Role fusion), a framework to utilize two complementary vision foundation model-based (VFM) segmenters for training-free cross-domain few-shot segmentation (CD-FSS). Our approach is based on the observation that current VFMs for CD-FSS possess capabilities where one model locates the correct object, while another model computes the better contour. Our approach uses: 1. a method to identify a VFM segmenter to lead Few-Shot Segmentation (FSS) task for a given concept, 2. a novel deterministic boundary correction method using bands of near- and far-pixels at the lead segmenter's predicted boundary of an object, and 3. a region correction mechanism for the other segmenter to conservatively prune components, fill holes, and bridge short gaps on the lead segmenter's predicted masks to improve accuracy. We evaluate SCoRe using RSRM and FSS-SAM3 across 3,314 matched five-shot episodes from 10 datasets. SCoRe achieves 72.738% foreground mIoU averaged across datasets, a gain of 5.210 percentage points over RSRM (paired 95% CI [4.618, 5.972]), with per-dataset gains up to 8.461 points over the strongest standalone method and the best point estimate on 7 of 10 datasets.

AI.tldr: SCoRe利用两种视觉基础分割模型的互补优势，实现无需训练的跨域少样本分割。
AI.motivation: 现有模型在目标定位与轮廓提取上各有所长，需要按任务融合其互补能力。
AI.method: 依据支持集选择主导分割器，并结合近远边界像素带校正及保守区域修正来融合预测。
AI.result: 在10个数据集的3,314个五样本任务中，平均前景mIoU达72.738%，较RSRM提升5.210个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 支持集校准的角色融合有效改善跨域分割，并在10个数据集中的7个取得最佳点估计。

title: Stability Principle Inherent in Wheel Gait of Planar X-shaped Walker Generated Using Constant Torque Drive and Mechanical Stoppers
summary: Since the late 19th century when the first walking toys were developed, it has been known that mechanical stoppers at the hip joint are crucial for generating stable passive dynamic walking. Recent research on passive-dynamic and limit-cycle walkers has also confirmed that mechanical stoppers at the hip and knee joints are effective for generating stable walking motion, but theoretical research on how this mechanical constraint enhances the overall gait stability remains insufficient. This paper introduces a planar X-shaped walker equipped with mechanical stoppers at the hip joint, and investigates the effect of the mechanical constraint on the stability of the wheel gait generated by constant torque drive on a downslope. By simply falling forward while using the stoppers to constrain itself to the target impact posture, the robot can generate a highly stable wheel gait. We divide the motion of one step into four phases, derive approximate analytical solutions for the state error transition function matrix in each phase using a linearized model, and analyze the increase or decrease in the state error norm using metrics such as its maximum singular value. Numerical simulations demonstrate that while two phases are unstable in terms of the increase in the state error norm, the remaining two phases are stable, resulting in overall asymptotic stability.
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Published in the Proceedings of IEEE ICRA 2026. This author version corrects the author names in one reference; the scientific content remains unchanged

AI.tldr: 研究揭示髋关节机械限位如何使恒转矩驱动的平面X形步行器形成整体渐近稳定的轮式步态。
AI.motivation: 机械限位可稳定被动及极限环步行，但其增强整体步态稳定性的理论解释仍不足。
AI.method: 将单步运动分为四阶段，用线性化模型近似推导状态误差转移矩阵，并以最大奇异值等分析误差变化。
AI.result: 数值模拟显示，两阶段误差范数增长、两阶段收缩，组合后实现整体渐近稳定。
AI.conclusion: 机械限位通过约束目标碰撞姿态，使局部不稳定阶段仍可组成整体稳定步态。

title: JEPTERA: A Platform Agnostic JEPA-Assisted Model Predictive Planner for Urban UAV Navigation
summary: Urban navigation for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) requires planning that accounts for environmental geometry, vehicle dynamics, and moving obstacles. This paper presents JEPTERA, a navigation architecture that integrates a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA), Model Predictive Control (MPC), PID control, and a safety layer. JEPA predicts the UAV's motion response to candidate commands for MPC action selection, while the safety layer checks trajectories against occupied space and predicted obstacle motion. Simulator adapters and platform-specific YAML configurations separate the planning core from simulator interfaces. An ablation study evaluated six configurations across three gym scenarios, totaling 180 runs. The complete architecture achieved the highest aggregate success rate, completing 28 of 30 runs. Additional tests completed one route across three city maps without collisions. Separate integration tests demonstrated operation in Gazebo/ROS 2, MuJoCo, and CARLA without modifying the core planning logic. These results support the feasibility of the integrated architecture for simulated urban UAV navigation and its portability across simulator interfaces.

AI.tldr: JEPTERA融合JEPA预测、模型预测控制与安全检查，支持跨仿真平台的城市无人机导航。
AI.motivation: 城市无人机规划需同时考虑环境几何、载具动力学与移动障碍，并适配不同平台接口。
AI.method: 利用JEPA预测候选指令的运动响应供MPC选择，结合PID与安全层，并以适配器和配置文件隔离平台差异。
AI.result: 完整架构成功28/30次，三张城市地图路线测试均无碰撞，并在三个仿真平台无需修改规划核心即可运行。
AI.conclusion: 实验支持该集成架构在仿真城市导航中的可行性及跨仿真接口的可移植性。

title: Quantum Computing-Based Wasserstein Generative Adversarial Networks for Airfoil Parameterization
summary: Airfoil geometry parameterization is essential in aerodynamic design optimization. Optimization search in the large space suffers from low efficiency and modest feasible region, which could further incur failures to convergence. Generative adversarial networks (GAN), aiming to learn the statistical distribution of existing data, pave a new avenue for shape generation and airfoil parameterization. GAN manages to implicitly reduce design space by generating only smooth, realistic airfoils. Meanwhile, quantum computing has been emergingly exhibiting great potential for achieving superior performance in specific types of engineering problems but has not been introduced to airfoil parameterization. To fill this gap, this work develops quantum computing-based Wasserstein GAN (Q-WGAN) and investigates the performance for airfoil parameterization. The Q-WGAN adopts parameterized quantum circuits as the generator to promote the generative performance, while the discriminator remains classical. The developed Q-WGAN is demonstrated on a dataset of optimal airfoils parameterized by free-form deformation (FFD) control points, resulting from 992 airfoil aerodynamic design optimizations. Results show that Q-WGAN achieves 92.1% mean fitting accuracy on the optimal FFD control points and 99.2% accuracy on airfoil coordinates, comparable with the classical WGAN performance of 92.28% on FFD control points and 99.26% on airfoil coordinates. Q-WGAN achieves lower Jensen-Shannon divergence, Fréchet distance, and Wasserstein distance than the classical WGAN, indicating an improved agreement with the reference airfoil distribution. Therefore, this work presents a convincing evidence that Q-WGAN makes a viable option for parameterizing airfoils and possesses a great potential for other relevant engineering applications.

AI.tldr: Q-WGAN以量子生成器进行翼型参数化，拟合精度接近经典WGAN且生成分布更贴近参考数据。
AI.motivation: 翼型优化设计空间庞大、可行域有限，而量子计算用于翼型参数化的潜力尚待探索。
AI.method: 采用参数化量子电路生成器与经典判别器，在992次翼型气动优化得到的自由变形控制点数据上验证。
AI.result: 控制点与翼型坐标拟合精度分别为92.1%和99.2%，三项分布距离均低于经典WGAN。
AI.conclusion: Q-WGAN是可行的翼型参数化方案，但结果未显示其拟合精度超越经典WGAN。

title: BiGSyn: A Bi-Level Heterogeneous Graph Contrastive Learning Framework for Interpretable Drug Synergy Prediction
summary: Drug combination therapy has become a mainstream of modern medicine, with the potential to enhance efficacy, reduce toxicity, and overcome drug resistance. However, identifying synergistic drug combinations remains challenging, as it requires modeling complex interactions across multiple biological scales---from atom-level molecular structures to entity-level relations in biological networks. Existing approaches typically model these levels in isolation, overlooking complementary signals and long-range dependencies. To address these limitations, we propose BiGSyn, a Bi-level heterogeneous Graph contrastive learning framework for drug Synergy prediction. Specifically, BiGSyn leverages heterogeneous graph transformers to extract high-order dependencies from molecular graphs and biological networks, and introduces a bi-level contrastive learning objective to bridge the cross-level semantic gap. Extensive experiments on two benchmark datasets show that BiGSyn consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. Moreover, its attention mechanism highlights key molecular substructures and biological interactions driving synergy, providing interpretable insights.
comment: 2026 IEEE International Conference on Data Mining (ICDM 2026)

AI.tldr: BiGSyn通过双层异构图对比学习融合分子与生物网络信息，实现可解释的药物协同预测。
AI.motivation: 现有方法孤立建模分子结构与生物网络，忽略跨尺度互补信号和长程依赖。
AI.method: 采用异构图Transformer提取高阶依赖，并以双层对比学习弥合跨层语义差距。
AI.result: 在两个基准数据集上持续优于最先进基线，注意力机制可识别关键分子子结构与生物相互作用。
AI.conclusion: 跨层信息融合提升了药物协同预测性能，并提供可解释的协同机制线索。

title: AdMem: Expectation-Grounded Procedural Memory for Long-Horizon Task-Solving Agents
summary: An agent that carries memory across tasks is only as good as the entries it keeps. We begin from an observation that is easy to reproduce and uncomfortable for the field: naively accumulating cross-task experience can make an agent \emph{worse} than one with no memory at all. On AgentBoard, a workflow-induction memory solves fewer tasks than a memoryless ReAct agent in seven of eight domains, and a per-step procedural store with no surrounding structure loses half of ReAct's completions on Jericho. We argue that the missing ingredients are per-action credit assignment and an explicit life cycle for stored entries, and present AdMem, which supplies both. Before each action the actor commits to an expected outcome; a concurrently running critic scores the realized outcome against that expectation and writes a procedural entry carrying a binary reward and a reflection, so credit lands on the action that earned it and no environment reward is required. Each entry then carries a scalar utility, updated online under a noisy-OR reward model, that ranks retrieval jointly with context similarity and drives eviction and merging, giving the store a forgetting and consolidation policy instead of unbounded growth. Across 707 tasks in eight AgentBoard domains AdMem solves 441 against 388 for ReAct and 312 for the workflow-induction baseline --- a pooled gain significant under a two-sided Fisher exact test, concentrated in the domains that supply transferable cross-task structure. All memory stays human-readable text, which is what makes the failures above diagnosable --- and, as we discuss, also makes the store an auditable but attackable surface.
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: Agents in the Wild: Safety, Security, and Beyond

AI.tldr: AdMem以行动预期驱动信用分配与记忆生命周期管理，改善长程任务求解。
AI.motivation: 简单累积跨任务经验可能损害智能体表现，现有记忆缺乏逐行动信用分配和生命周期管理。
AI.method: 评论器对照行动预期记录二元奖励与反思，再以噪声或模型更新效用，指导检索、淘汰及合并。
AI.result: 在八个AgentBoard领域的707项任务中完成441项，高于ReAct的388项及工作流归纳基线的312项。
AI.conclusion: 精细信用分配与选择性遗忘有助于利用可迁移经验，但文本记忆也构成可审计且可攻击的界面。

title: DNA: A Double-Helix Hierarchical Deep Interaction Network Architecture for Industrial Digital Twin
summary: High-fidelity modeling is fundamental to industrial digital twin, yet a trade-off persists between the physical transparency of mechanistic models and the superior predictive power of data-driven approaches. Existing hybrid methods often fail to bridge this gap, suffering from shallow integration and rigid one-shot modeling strategies that struggle with complex industrial systems. To address these issues, we propose a \textbf{Double-Helix Hierarchical Deep Interaction Network Architecture (DNA)}. Inspired by the double-helix structure of biological \textit{DNA}, our architecture intertwines mechanistic and data-driven modeling strands through two novel interaction strategies, forming a symbiotic architecture in which the two strands mutually enhance predictive capability. Furthermore, the hierarchical structure of DNA allows it to model complex systems in a multi-stage manner through two tailored deep learning frameworks. We evaluate the proposed approach on two distinct industrial systems, where DNA achieves reductions in MAE of 3.704\% and 3.175\%, respectively, compared to the strongest baseline. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of DNA and suggest its potential to provide new insights for the development of industrial digital twins.

AI.tldr: DNA以双螺旋分层架构深度融合机理与数据驱动建模，提升工业数字孪生预测精度。
AI.motivation: 现有混合模型融合浅且建模方式僵化，难以兼顾机理透明性与复杂工业系统预测能力。
AI.method: 通过两种交互策略交织机理和数据驱动分支，并以两个定制深度学习框架实现分层多阶段建模。
AI.result: 在两个工业系统上，相较最强基线的平均绝对误差分别降低3.704%和3.175%。
AI.conclusion: 双分支深度交互与分层建模具有有效性，为工业数字孪生发展提供新思路。

title: Same Papers, Different Verdicts: Tracing Version Drift in LLM Peer Review
summary: Venues and benchmarks read LLM review scores as measurements of a paper, while providers replace their models within months. We audit twenty frontier models from OpenAI, Google and Anthropic on ICLR 2027 submissions while they were under review, with tests registered before the decisions. Between an earlier and a later version of Claude Opus and of Gemini, the share of papers placed on the accept side falls by 52 and 53 percentage points on 183 and 60 randomly drawn submissions, and by 43 to 79 points in six further paired comparisons, with no paper moving up in any of them. Stating a 30% acceptance rate in the prompt leaves a gap of 79 points between the two Opus versions. When score-stripped critiques are swapped between versions, the later critiques alone lower the accept share by 35 points for Opus and 51 for Gemini; for Opus the drop is 35 points under a third-party scorer and 24 after a rewrite that keeps each technical point and removes evaluative wording. On 57 papers, the percentiles of Opus 4.6 and 5.5 correlate at 0.73 while their accept shares differ by 44 points. On 99 to 119 submissions, the self-estimated percentiles of three models correlate with two human reviewers more strongly than a third reviewer does (point estimates 0.17 to 0.21, 95% intervals between -0.04 and +0.42). All twenty models give a 2 or a 3 in 473 of their 475 reviews, against 60 of 72 human reviews. Retrospective tests on decided papers can draw on memory. Claude Opus 5.5 names the true first author of 27 decided ICLR 2026 papers from their titles alone, with no wrong name, and Claude Opus 4.6 accepted all 11 decided papers it said it recognized, against 5 expected. Thresholds on LLM-reviewer scores therefore have to be validated against human decisions for each model version; our tests against the ICLR 2027 decisions follow on 16 December 2026.
comment: 19 pages, 5 figures. Results of the registered tests that need the ICLR 2027 decisions will be added after 16 December 2026

AI.tldr: 大模型版本更新可显著改变同一论文的接收判断，评审分数阈值需逐版本验证。
AI.motivation: 评审基准常将模型分数视为论文属性，却忽略供应商频繁更新模型带来的判断漂移。
AI.method: 预注册审计20个前沿模型，结合配对版本比较、评语互换、人类评审对照及已决论文记忆测试。
AI.result: 两组版本比较中接收比例下降52和53个百分点，另六组下降43至79个百分点，且均无论文上调。
AI.conclusion: 评审漂移涉及评语内容且回溯测试可能受记忆影响，模型评分阈值必须按版本对照人类决策校验。

title: Newton-PINet: A fast physics-informed neural network with Newton linearization for meta-learning nonlinear PDEs
summary: Scientific machine learning has opened new avenues for solving parameterized partial differential equations (PDEs), enabling models to learn a family of PDEs and generalize to unseen instances. In this context, data-driven operator learning methods typically require large training datasets, while physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) suffer from difficult optimization and limited generalization, especially for nonlinear PDEs. We propose Newton-PINet, a physics-informed network enhanced by Newton linearization, offering an effective meta-learning framework for nonlinear PDEs. Newton-PINet (i) employs a physics-informed multilayer network with skip connections, where the output-layer weights are solved by least squares; (ii) adopts a two-stage learning strategy that first leverages gradient-based training to learn robust representations from the available training tasks, and then performs gradient-free fine-tuning on the output layer for fast task-specific generalization; and (iii) incorporates a Newton linearization method to speed up the least-squares iteration for nonlinear PDE problems. On a challenging nonlinear reaction-diffusion benchmark, Newton-PINet achieves up to three orders of magnitude lower relative error than recent neural solvers, while using 16x fewer training tasks and over an order of magnitude less training time (about 5 minutes versus several hours). This work advances the meta-learning of PINNs toward data-efficient, fast, and generalizable physics solvers. The code and datasets are publicly available at: this https URL.

AI.tldr: Newton-PINet结合牛顿线性化与两阶段元学习，实现快速且数据高效的非线性偏微分方程求解。
AI.motivation: 算子学习依赖大量数据，而物理信息神经网络在非线性问题上优化困难、泛化有限。
AI.method: 采用带跳跃连接的网络，先梯度训练表征，再以牛顿线性化加速输出层最小二乘无梯度适配。
AI.result: 在非线性反应扩散基准上，相对误差最多降低三个数量级，训练任务仅需十六分之一，训练约五分钟。
AI.conclusion: 该框架推动物理信息神经网络向数据高效、快速且可泛化的元学习求解器发展。

title: GEAR$^2$: Pruned Experts Live On through Gated Reuse of Activated Experts and a Missing-Mass Residual
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Large Language Models (LLMs) activate only a few experts per token while generally keeping all the experts in GPU memory for high efficiency. Expert pruning reduces this GPU memory footprint cost, yet discards the contribution of pruned experts. Existing remedies either rely on static substitutes, merge experts at the cost of altering their functions, or require costly recovery training. In this paper, we find that the functionalities of pruned experts can be efficiently reconstructed from the activated remaining experts. We propose GEAR (Gated Expert Activation Reuse), which reuses the scaled outputs of reliable activated experts without any training or additional expert computation. In addition, we propose GEAR$^2$ to further recover what reuse cannot express with an ultra-lightweight residual. On five MoE LLMs from 16B to 106B parameters with 25% and 50% of experts pruned, GEAR improves over its training-free counterparts in nearly every setting (up to 4 pp.) in terms of accuracy, and GEAR$^2$ outperforms baseline approaches (up to 2.75 pp.) in every setting on nine zero-shot benchmarks, with larger advantages (up to 2.72 pp. higher) under more aggressive pruning (up to 50%).

AI.tldr: GEAR复用已激活专家输出，GEAR²再加入轻量残差，以恢复专家剪枝损失的贡献。
AI.motivation: 专家剪枝虽降低显存占用，却丢失专家贡献，现有补救方法存在静态替代、功能改变或训练成本问题。
AI.method: GEAR无需训练或额外专家计算即可门控复用可靠专家的缩放输出，GEAR²进一步补充轻量残差。
AI.result: 在五个MoE模型与九项零样本基准上，GEAR几乎均优于免训练方法，GEAR²全部设置优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 复用剩余专家并补偿残差可有效缓解剪枝性能损失，在更激进剪枝下优势更大。

title: From Joint Risk to Decision Invariance: Decision-Preserving Regularization for Exemplar-Free Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Exemplar-free continual learning seeks to minimize joint risk over all seen tasks, yet historical data are unavailable for direct optimization. We observe that, for classification, preserving the model's decisions on previously learned classes helps retain old knowledge. This motivates Decision-Preserving Regularization (DPR). Penalizing changes in all pairwise old-class logit margins reduces algebraically to a centered relative-logit penalty. We further apply spectral whitening to remove the classifier's spectral scale bias. Because the global classifier supplies the decision constraints for the next stage, it must remain calibrated across all seen classes despite the drift of stored old-class statistics during representation updates. We therefore fit a closed-form affine map from paired current-task features to transport old-class Gaussian means and covariances into the updated feature space, then calibrate the global classifier using these distributions and current-task features. Across CIFAR-100, Tiny-ImageNet, ImageNet-Subset, and ImageNet-1K under cold-start protocols, comparisons with state-of-the-art methods show that DPR achieves higher accuracy in most settings while remaining highly efficient. Code is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: DPR通过保持旧类决策并校准全局分类器，提升无样本类增量学习的知识保留能力。
AI.motivation: 历史数据不可用使联合风险难以直接优化，表征更新还会导致旧类统计漂移及分类器失准。
AI.method: 结合中心化相对逻辑值正则与谱白化，以闭式仿射映射迁移旧类高斯统计并校准分类器。
AI.result: 在四个图像分类基准的冷启动协议下，DPR多数设置准确率优于最先进方法，同时保持高效率。
AI.conclusion: 保持旧类决策并修正统计漂移，是高效缓解无样本类增量学习遗忘的有效途径。

title: GPromptShield: Elevating Resilience in Graph Prompt Tuning against Adversarial Attacks
summary: The paradigm of ``pre-training and prompt-tuning", with its effectiveness and lightweight characteristics, has rapidly spread from the language field to the graph field. Several pioneering studies have designed specialized prompt functions for diverse downstream graph tasks based on various graph pre-training strategies. These prompts concentrate on the compatibility between the pre-training pretext and downstream graph tasks, aiming to bridge the gap between them. However, designing prompts blindly to adapt to downstream tasks based on this concept neglects crucial security issues. By conducting covert attacks on downstream graph data, we find that even when the downstream task data closely matches that of the pre-training tasks, it is still feasible to generate highly misleading prompts using simple deceptive techniques. In this paper, we shift the primary focus of graph prompts from compatibility to vulnerability issues in adversarial attack scenarios. We design a highly extensible shield defense system for the prompts, which enhances their robustness from two perspectives: Direct Handling and Indirect Amplification. When downstream graph data contains unreliable biases, the former directly combats invalid information by incorporating hybrid multi-defense prompts to the input graph's feature space, while the latter adopts a training strategy to bypass the invalid components and amplifies valid part. We provide a theoretical derivation that proves their feasibility, indicating that unbiased prompts exist under certain conditions on unreliable data. Extensive experiments across various scenarios of adversarial attacks indicate that the prompts within our defense system exhibit enhanced resilience and superiority. This paper explores a new perspective in graph prompt learning, offering a novel option for robust prompt tuning in downstream tasks.

AI.tldr: GPromptShield从直接防御与间接增强两方面提升图提示调优对抗攻击的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 图提示研究侧重预训练与下游任务兼容性，却忽略下游数据被攻击后可能诱导误导性提示。
AI.method: 在图特征空间加入混合多防御提示，并以训练策略绕过无效成分、增强有效信息。
AI.result: 理论证明特定条件下不可靠数据仍存在无偏提示，多种对抗场景实验显示防御系统提升了鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 图提示设计应兼顾安全性，该防御框架为下游任务的鲁棒提示调优提供了新选择。

title: Example-Based Spatial Guidance for Training-Free Concept Erasure in Diffusion Models
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models often synthesize policy-violating content, necessitating robust safeguards and rigorous evaluation frameworks. However, current approaches remain largely monolithic in both execution and evaluation, limited to coarse-grained categorization within broad unsafe concepts. Such approaches fail to account for the specific constituent factors of a violation, resulting in weak learning signals and allowing model collapse to bypass safety checks. To overcome these limitations, we propose Example-Based Spatial Guidance (EBSG), a training-free method that utilizes user-editable exemplar packs to provide granular spatial guidance for precise concept steering. Unlike existing methods that coarsely steer the entire image away from a broad concept, EBSG decomposes these categories into specific sub-concepts via exemplar text-image pairs, providing explicit, localized steering signals for more robust safety control. Furthermore, we introduce a vision language model (VLM)-based evaluation protocol that provides a fine-grained assessment, avoiding the pitfall of conventional binary evaluators that permit model collapse to bypass safety checks. Empirically, EBSG achieves state-of-the-art erasure performance across diverse safety datasets and concept categories, spanning four nudity benchmarks, seven I2P harmful-concept slices, and four MJA metaphor categories, while supporting multi-concept removal and transferring to a modern backbone, SD3.
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (poster). 51 pages, including references, checklist, and appendix

AI.tldr: EBSG通过可编辑示例提供免训练的局部空间引导，实现细粒度扩散模型概念擦除。
AI.motivation: 现有安全干预和评估过于粗粒度，忽视违规构成因素，且可能让模型崩溃绕过安全检查。
AI.method: 用文本图像示例对将宽泛概念拆为子概念并进行局部引导，同时引入视觉语言模型细粒度评估。
AI.result: EBSG在多类安全数据集上达到最先进擦除表现，支持多概念移除并可迁移至SD3。
AI.conclusion: 示例驱动的局部引导与细粒度评估为扩散模型提供了更精确、稳健的安全控制。

title: ASCG: Adaptive Spatial Classifier Guidance for Surgical Concept Suppression in Diffusion Models
summary: While text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models achieve remarkable quality, they risk producing harmful content. Existing safety mechanisms often rely on indiscriminate, global interventions that induce unintended semantic drift and degrade image quality. To address this, we propose Adaptive Spatial Classifier Guidance (ASCG), a necessity-driven framework that employs probabilistic monitoring to activate guidance selectively upon harm detection. By leveraging Grad-CAM for localized suppression, ASCG effectively removes harmful concepts while preserving superior semantic fidelity compared to conventional methods. Furthermore, we overcome the limitations of traditional metrics like NudeNet---which fails to assess semantic integrity---by introducing a VLM-based evaluation framework to provide a fine-grained, robust analysis of both safety and context preservation. Our results demonstrate that ASCG not only balances safety and fidelity but also exhibits remarkable plug-and-play synergy with existing frameworks to establish state-of-the-art performance.
comment: 9 pages, including references and supplementary material

AI.tldr: ASCG仅在检测到危害时启动局部引导，以抑制有害概念并保留图像语义。
AI.motivation: 现有全局安全干预容易造成非预期语义漂移和图像质量下降，传统指标也难评估语义完整性。
AI.method: 通过概率监测选择性激活引导，利用Grad-CAM定位抑制区域，并以视觉语言模型评估安全与上下文保留。
AI.result: ASCG比常规方法更好地保持语义保真度，并与现有框架即插即用结合达到最先进表现。
AI.conclusion: 按需局部抑制有助于兼顾生成安全性与语义保真度，并可增强现有安全框架。

title: PixelBench: Evaluating Language Models for Pixel-Art Creation
summary: Pixel art is widely used in games and digital content creation, requiring readable forms, coherent spatial relationships, and harmonious colors under limited resolution and palette constraints. Language models show growing promise in visual creation, yet their pixel art creation capabilities lack systematic evaluation. We introduce PixelBench, formalizing text-to-image generation and instruction-guided editing for pixel art and providing a benchmark for these tasks. We further present a creation environment in which language model agents invoke drawing tools through code to generate and edit pixel art. We assess the quality of generated artwork through human evaluation and employ a multimodal large language model as a judge, validating the agreement between its automated assessments and human preferences. We compare language models and configurations across diverse subjects and canvas sizes. In our experiments, GPT-6 Astra achieves both the highest average judge score and the best average human rank, highlighting the potential of general-purpose language models for pixel art creation. We release the tasks, all artworks, the human rankings, and the judge protocol.

AI.tldr: PixelBench系统评估语言模型通过代码调用绘图工具生成与编辑像素画的能力。
AI.motivation: 语言模型展现出视觉创作潜力，但其在分辨率和调色板约束下的像素画能力缺乏系统评估。
AI.method: 构建文本生成与指令编辑任务及工具环境，结合人工排名和经人工偏好验证的多模态模型评分。
AI.result: GPT-6 Astra在实验中取得最高平均评审分数和最佳平均人工排名。
AI.conclusion: 通用语言模型具有像素画创作潜力，公开任务、作品、人工排名与评审协议可支持后续研究。

title: Event-Guided Stereo Video Super-Resolution
summary: Stereo Video Super-Resolution (SVSR) aims to reconstruct high-resolution stereo videos by exploiting temporal cues across consecutive frames and complementary spatial cues between stereo views. However, existing methods struggle to recover high-frequency texture details under rapid motion and complex illumination, compromising reconstruction quality and stereo consistency. Event cameras provide valuable motion and texture cues with high temporal resolution and wide dynamic range, yet their potential for SVSR remains underexplored. To bridge this gap, we present the first investigation of event-guided SVSR and propose a novel framework. Specifically, we develop an Event-Guided Texture Enhancement (EGTE) module that combines bidirectional temporal feature propagation with event-guided texture refinement to restore high-frequency details in complex motion regions. Subsequently, we introduce a Cross-View Texture Interaction (CVTI) module to model cross-view spatial correspondences and aggregate cross-view complementary texture information. With this design, our method effectively integrates event-driven motion and texture information, inter-frame temporal dependencies, and cross-view spatial relationships to recover motion-affected details and maintain stereo consistency. Extensive experiments on both real-world and synthetic datasets demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms existing super-resolution methods in reconstruction quality and stereo consistency. Project Page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 该研究首次探索事件引导的双目视频超分辨率，以改善运动细节恢复与双目一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法难以在快速运动和复杂光照下恢复高频纹理，而事件相机的相关潜力尚未充分探索。
AI.method: 结合双向时序传播与事件引导纹理增强，再通过跨视图纹理交互聚合互补空间信息。
AI.result: 在真实与合成数据集上，该方法的重建质量和双目一致性均持续优于现有超分辨率方法。
AI.conclusion: 融合事件运动纹理、帧间时序依赖与跨视图关系能有效改善双目视频超分辨率。

title: Instructions Before Actions: Prospective and Retrospective Language Supervision for Driving Vision-Language-Action Data
summary: Driving vision-language-action (VLA) models can accept navigation instructions, yet predicting a driver's trajectory does not establish that a model follows the instruction. We study how driving-language supervision is collected and evaluated, distinguishing prospective instructions issued before an action from retrospective labels written after observing it. We develop ADVLAT-Engine to synchronize spoken instructions, road-scene video, and vehicle trajectories, and compare three navigation apps on 48 replayed routes. On 87 maneuvers announced by both Google Maps and a passenger, the passenger uses more scene-dependent language. We evaluate four open driving VLAs before and after fine-tuning on prospective navigation-app drives. Fine-tuning reduces passenger-drive trajectory error by 23-59%, but instruction effects remain inconsistent. At real intersections, counterfactual instructions reveal stronger responsiveness: fine-tuned Alpamayo~2 Super gains 31 and 18 accuracy points at 15 and 5~m, while Qwen-Drive follows alternative maneuvers more reliably with a discrete command than with a sentence. We additionally collected retrospective annotations from four people for the driving recordings and describe controlled comparisons of annotation content, timing, and downstream learning; those analyses are pending. Our findings separate maneuver prediction from instruction-following and establish a framework for comparing prospective and retrospective supervision.

AI.tldr: 该研究区分驾驶前瞻指令与事后标签，表明轨迹预测改善不等同于真正遵循指令。
AI.motivation: 驾驶模型能预测驾驶轨迹并不能证明其遵循导航指令，语言监督的采集与评估需加以区分。
AI.method: 开发ADVLAT-Engine同步语音、视频和轨迹，比较导航应用并对四个驾驶模型开展微调及反事实指令评估。
AI.result: 微调使乘客驾驶轨迹误差降低23%—59%，但指令效应不一致；Alpamayo在两种距离下准确率提升31和18个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 应将动作预测与指令遵循分开评估；研究建立了前瞻与回溯监督比较框架，回溯标注分析尚待完成。

title: Contrastive Activation-Guided Zeroth-Order Preference Optimisation for Memory-Efficient LLM Alignment
summary: Direct Preference Optimisation (DPO) simplifies reinforcement learning from human feedback, but still relies on traditional backpropagation and its associated activation-memory cost. Zeroth-order (ZO) optimisation avoids backpropagation, yet isotropic perturbations can produce noisy updates for preference objectives defined by differences between chosen and rejected responses. We introduce Contrastive Activation-guided Zeroth-Order Direct Preference Optimisation (CA-ZODPO), which constructs a low-rank search subspace from the activation discrepancy between the chosen and rejected responses in each preference pair. Perturbations are restricted to this subspace, while momentum is maintained in low-rank coordinates to preserve the memory advantages of ZO training. On Qwen2.5-1.5B with Anthropic HH-RLHF, CA-ZODPO outperforms common ZO baselines and remains competitive with first-order DPO in pairwise preference evaluation. It also reduces peak GPU memory by about 59\% at a sequence length of 2048 while retaining the sequence-length scaling behaviour of zeroth-order training.

AI.tldr: CA-ZODPO利用偏好响应的激活差异引导低秩零阶优化，降低语言模型对齐的显存需求。
AI.motivation: DPO反向传播消耗大量激活显存，而零阶优化的各向同性扰动容易给偏好目标带来噪声。
AI.method: 由选中与拒绝响应的激活差异构造低秩搜索子空间，将扰动和动量限制在低秩坐标中。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-1.5B与HH-RLHF上优于常见零阶基线，偏好表现接近一阶DPO，2048序列长度下峰值显存约降59%。
AI.conclusion: 对比激活引导可在保留零阶训练显存优势的同时提高偏好优化效果。

title: Counterfactual Feature Steering for Adjacency-Preserving Identity Unlearning
summary: Identity unlearning in text-to-image diffusion models is increasingly important for privacy, safety, and ethical deployment, as it aims to remove the model's ability to generate specific individuals. In this work, we study identity unlearning with \emph{adjacency preservation}, where the goal is to remove a target individual's identity while preserving related non-target identities. We propose Counterfactual Feature Steering (CFS), a method requiring one-time SAE training that performs bounded inference-time concept editing in the latent space of a sparse autoencoder attached to the text encoder. CFS derives a target direction by contrasting forget and retain distributions, then applies a per-token projection proportional to each token's current alignment with this direction, yielding counterfactual representations that suppress the target while limiting collateral damage. To evaluate adjacency preservation, we introduce the Adjacency-Weighted Unlearning Score (AWUS), which measures the tradeoff between target erasure and collateral damage, and extend it to face-specific identity similarity using ArcFace. Across 4,000 prompts derived from Celeb-100, spanning 100 celebrity identities, CFS achieves the strongest evaluated tradeoff between identity erasure of target identities and preservation of adjacent and generic concepts, while remaining stable across intervention strengths where other steering-based methods degrade. Independent ArcFace evaluation and a 10,000-caption COCO study further examine identity and general preservation. Quantitative nudity-suppression benchmarks and qualitative artistic-style examples provide evidence of transfer beyond identities on SD~1.4.

AI.tldr: CFS在擦除目标人物身份的同时保留相近非目标身份，改善身份遗忘中的附带损伤。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型身份遗忘不仅需要移除目标人物，还需避免损害相关非目标身份和一般概念。
AI.method: 一次训练稀疏自编码器后，对比遗忘与保留分布提取方向并逐词元投影，同时提出邻近加权遗忘评分。
AI.result: 在覆盖100位名人的4000条提示上，CFS取得受评方法中最佳擦除与保留权衡，且在不同干预强度下保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 有界反事实特征编辑有助于兼顾身份遗忘与邻近概念保留，并显示出向裸体抑制和艺术风格编辑迁移的证据。

title: Safety-Preserving Medical LLM Fine-Tuning via Bilevel Data Selection
summary: As general large language models (LLMs) are increasingly adapted for patient-facing medical applications, improving medical capability while controlling patient-facing risks remains a critical challenge. Large-scale medical instruction data are essential for acquiring domain knowledge through supervised fine-tuning (SFT), but unsafe responses can undermine existing safety alignment. To address this problem, we propose Scalable Bilevel Data Selection (S-BDS) for safety-preserving medical SFT. By controlling selection-weight concentration, S-BDS enables reliable sample ranking over large candidate pools and identifies training examples that improve medical capability while controlling patient-facing risks. We combine clinician-validated safe data and selected data with unscreened medical instruction data for SFT, and jointly evaluate medical capability and patient-facing safety on HealthBench and PatientSafetyBench, respectively. Experiments across Llama and Qwen models show that S-BDS achieves the highest safe rates among all compared methods, outperforming the strongest baselines by 4.64 and 3.00 percentage points, respectively, while maintaining competitive medical capability. Further experiments show that varying the safety-oriented weight during SFT controls the trade-off between medical capability and patient-facing safety.

AI.tldr: S-BDS通过双层数据选择，在医学大模型微调中提高患者安全性并保持医学能力。
AI.motivation: 医学指令微调虽能增强领域能力，但不安全训练响应可能破坏既有安全对齐。
AI.method: 控制选择权重集中度以可靠排序样本，将筛选数据、临床验证安全数据与未筛查医学数据联合用于微调。
AI.result: 在Llama和Qwen上安全率均居比较方法首位，分别超过最强基线4.64和3.00个百分点，且医学能力保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 可扩展双层数据选择有助于安全保留型医学微调，调整安全权重还能控制能力与安全之间的权衡。

title: Instrumenting Failure: Scoring Language Model Agents at Every Decision Node in Imperfect-Information Games
summary: Agent evaluations report task success and rarely say what an agent did at each decision. We score every decision node of three 12B to 14B instruct-tuned language models (LMs) playing five zero-sum imperfect-information games against four opponents on eight properties from decision and game theory, five of them against a CFR+ equilibrium reference. At each node, the LM also states a belief about the opponent's hidden state in a separate call. Without memory and at temperature 0, stated beliefs sit 0.250 to 0.288 in total variation distance from the equilibrium posterior, and where the action responds to the state its agreement with that belief exceeds chance by -0.04 to 0.19. The two calls frame the opponent differently, so the result is a behavioural inconsistency and makes no claim about internal beliefs. Under one prompt and greedy decoding, the LM's action never varies with the state in 10 of the 38 cells where the reference varies its own. Memory lowers the constant-action share in 9 of 13 testable ladders at temperature 0; at temperature 0.2 the cells at 1 fall from 16 to 5 of the 46 informative cells, while the belief results hold. A gate withholds, with a stated reason, any belief score the run cannot support, and seven of the eight non-zero defect rates are attributable to the instrument, a representation, or the LMs.
comment: Accepted at the Interpreting Agent Behavior (IAB) Workshop, NeurIPS 2026. 26 pages, 6 figures. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: 研究逐决策评估不完全信息博弈中的语言模型智能体，揭示其行为不一致与状态响应不足。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体评估多报告任务成功率，难以解释各决策节点的具体行为。
AI.method: 在五种博弈中评估三个模型的八项决策性质，并以独立调用报告信念、以CFR+均衡作参照。
AI.result: 所述信念距均衡后验的总变差为0.250至0.288，且38个参照动作随状态变化的单元中有10个模型动作恒定。
AI.conclusion: 逐节点评估可定位行为缺陷，记忆能缓解部分恒定动作问题，但行为不一致不代表内部信念。

title: Defect-Aware Masked Autoencoders for Unsupervised Clustering of Steel Surface Defects
summary: Reliable recognition of steel surface defects is essential for automated quality inspection, but supervised methods require manually annotated images that are costly to produce. This creates a need for methods that can learn useful defect representations directly from unlabelled surface images. This work presents Defect aware MAE, a label free masked autoencoder for clustering steel surface defects. Each image is divided into 196 patches, with 147 masked and 49 processed by a Vision Transformer encoder. Texture energy based masking preferentially hides structurally informative patches, while a shallow decoder reconstructs HOG descriptors that capture local texture and edge orientation. Strong augmentation and an intermediate layer readout are used to form the final image features. Pretraining uses no class labels, bounding boxes, detection branch, or contrastive loss. On the held out NEU DET split, UMAP followed by Ward clustering achieves 98.6% Hungarian matched accuracy, 0.968 NMI, 0.967 ARI, and 0.838 silhouette score. Under an identical encoder and training schedule, it exceeds a SimCLR contrastive baseline in accuracy, NMI, ARI and silhouette scores across 5 seeds.

AI.tldr: 提出缺陷感知掩码自编码器，无需标签即可学习钢材表面缺陷的聚类表征。
AI.motivation: 钢材表面缺陷监督识别依赖昂贵人工标注，需要直接从无标签图像学习有效表征。
AI.method: 按纹理能量优先遮蔽信息丰富图块，用视觉Transformer编码并重建HOG描述符，结合增强与中间层特征聚类。
AI.result: 在NEU DET留出集上，聚类准确率达98.6%、NMI为0.968、ARI为0.967，五个种子下均优于SimCLR基线。
AI.conclusion: 缺陷感知遮蔽与纹理重建能有效支持无监督钢材缺陷聚类。

title: Competent Autonomous Driving Through Fine Tuning Vision Language Action Models with Symbolic Traffic Rules
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models offer a unified approach to perception, reasoning, and control for autonomous driving, but accurate action prediction alone does not establish compliance with traffic regulations. This paper presents a rule-guided VLA framework that incorporates symbolic traffic-rule feedback into policy optimisation. The framework combines supervised fine-tuning on expert demonstrations with reinforcement learning (RL) refinement using a reward that encourages encoded-rule compliance while penalising deviations from expert actions. Selected provisions of the United Kingdom Highway Code are formalised as executable first-order logic rules using PyReason, covering speed adaptation, following distance, and road-user priority. A frozen vision-language model extracts scene predicates, which are combined with vehicle-state information to assess the projected consequences of candidate control actions. Offline evaluation on held-out data collected in the CARLA simulator compares three group-based RL methods. The results show improvements in both action prediction accuracy and encoded-rule compliance over the supervised baseline. The best-performing variant increases the overall rule pass rate from 92.9% to 97.6%, with zero observed violations of the encoded road-user-priority check in the evaluated samples. These findings support symbolic rule feedback as a means of improving VLA policy alignment with explicit traffic-rule criteria.

AI.tldr: 将符号交通规则反馈融入视觉语言动作模型微调，提升驾驶动作预测与已编码规则合规性。
AI.motivation: 驾驶动作预测准确并不意味着遵守交通法规，需要将明确规则纳入策略优化。
AI.method: 结合专家示范监督微调与强化学习，利用PyReason执行英国交通规则，并以冻结视觉语言模型提取场景谓词。
AI.result: CARLA留出数据离线评估中，最佳方法将规则通过率从92.9%提高至97.6%，未观察到已编码路权检查违规。
AI.conclusion: 符号规则反馈有助于驾驶策略对齐明确交通规则，但证据限于所编码规则与离线评估样本。

title: RAMP: Rethinking Multimodal Evaluation through Answer Readout Protocols
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are often evaluated by converting model outputs into discrete answers. The conversion protocol determines which scores become predictions and can strongly influence the reported results. We introduce RAMP (Readout Aware Multimodal Protocol), a systematic framework that compares direct yes/no token logits, surface-form scores, and typed or reversed A/B interfaces under fixed model checkpoints and paired visual questions. On 500 POPE adversarial questions, typed versus bare readout changes accuracy by $-20.2$ percentage points for SmolVLM-256M, $-16.4$ for TinyLLaVA-1.1B, and $+1.8$ for Qwen2.5-VL-3B. Paired transitions reveal extensive prediction changes even when the net accuracy difference is small: 79 of 104 binary ChartQA items change correctness for SmolVLM-500M, despite a $+1.0$-point net difference. We further analyze prompt wording, candidate forms, option position, cross-task effects, and calibration. An independent offline replay reproduces 16,140 first-token decisions from saved raw scores with exact agreement. Our findings establish answer readout as a measurable component of multimodal evaluation and provide a reproducible protocol for analyzing model comparisons.

AI.tldr: RAMP表明答案读出协议可显著改变多模态模型评估结果，并提供可复现分析框架。
AI.motivation: 将模型输出转换为离散答案的协议影响预测与评分，却常被评估忽视。
AI.method: 固定模型检查点与配对视觉问题，比较是非词元分数、表面形式及带类型或反转的A/B读出接口。
AI.result: POPE上三模型的类型化读出相对裸读出准确率变化为−20.2、−16.4和+1.8个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 答案读出应作为多模态评估的可测量组成部分，净准确率差异也可能掩盖大量预测变化。

title: Enhancing Mixed Oil Length Prediction through Graph Representation Learning
summary: During the pipeline transportation of refined oil products, the inevitable formation of mixed oil segments poses considerable economic challenges to pipeline networks. Therefore, it is important to accurately predict the length of these mixed oil segments. Although previous methods have achieved relatively accurate predictions by integrating machine and deep learning algorithms, they ignore the statistical dependencies that remain among real-world mixed oil samples, which degrades model accuracy. To address this issue, we propose a novel Sample Dependencies Incorporated Graph Representation Learning (SDI-GRL) model. By representing samples and pipeline features as nodes of a graph, SDI-GRL connects dependent samples through their shared features, allowing message passing to propagate information across related samples. This graph-based framework allows our model to capture the statistical dependencies among samples absent in prior works. A case study on a mixed oil dataset demonstrates that our SDI-GRL model surpasses the strongest existing approach, reducing both the RMSE and the MAE by more than 10%.

AI.tldr: SDI-GRL通过图表示学习建模混油样本依赖，提高成品油管道混油段长度预测精度。
AI.motivation: 混油段造成经济损失，而既有预测方法忽略真实样本间统计依赖，限制预测精度。
AI.method: 将样本与管道特征表示为图节点，通过共享特征连接依赖样本，并以消息传递传播信息。
AI.result: 混油数据集案例中，相较最强现有方法，RMSE与MAE均降低超过10%。
AI.conclusion: 显式利用样本间统计依赖可改善混油段长度预测。

title: ParGLU: Partial Gating Improves Language Modeling in MoE Transformers
summary: Multiplicative gating improves Transformer feed-forward networks (FFNs), but it reduces intermediate representation width under a fixed parameter budget. This trade-off is particularly relevant to Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, where individual experts have limited capacity. We introduce ParGLU, a partially gated FFN that combines SwiGLU and ReLU$^2$ in two parallel branches. ParGLU matches the parameter count and principal matrix computation budget of conventional SwiGLU. We evaluate ParGLU in 30M, 75M, and 152M MoE language models using three random seeds per scale. ParGLU outperforms SwiGLU across all three seeds at 75M and 152M, reducing mean validation NLL by 0.0200 and 0.0249, respectively. Results at 30M are mixed. Controlled ablations show that increasing backbone width or expert width strengthens ParGLU's relative performance. Ablation studies further show that combining SwiGLU and ReLU$^2$ improves performance over either architecture alone. Token-frequency analysis reveals larger improvements on low-frequency tokens. These findings show that fully gated FFNs are not always the most effective use of an MoE expert's parameter budget. Partial gating can improve language modeling in MoE Transformers.

AI.tldr: ParGLU以部分门控兼顾表征宽度与门控能力，在较大规模MoE语言模型中改善语言建模。
AI.motivation: 固定参数预算下，乘性门控会压缩中间表征宽度，对容量有限的MoE专家尤其不利。
AI.method: 并联SwiGLU与ReLU²分支，在匹配常规SwiGLU参数量和主要矩阵计算预算下进行多规模实验。
AI.result: 75M和152M模型三个种子均优于SwiGLU，平均验证NLL分别降低0.0200和0.0249，30M结果不一。
AI.conclusion: 完全门控未必是MoE专家参数预算的最优用法，部分门控尤其有利于低频词元建模。

title: Conditional Diffusion Models for Amortized Bayesian System Identification
summary: Generative diffusion models rapidly solve Bayesian inverse problems, such as image restoration and inpainting, with a single trained model and without retraining for each new observation or task. Bayesian system identification, which typically involves inferring the hidden states and parameters of a dynamical system from measurements, poses a closely related inverse problem. Yet it is often addressed with computationally heavy Monte Carlo methods that must be rerun for every new measurement record. Moreover, these methods are restricted to a single inference task, and their cost grows with the state dimension and the record length. To alleviate these restrictions, we interpret Bayesian system identification in hiddem Markov models (HMMs) as a general Bayesian inverse problem, taking advantage of conditional diffusion models. Specifically, a transformer-based diffusion model is trained once on short segments of simulated trajectories to approximate the joint posterior of states and parameters. Through an attention mask induced by the Markov property and a relative time encoding, it can then be deployed on any new measurement record of custom length. At inference time, the same model can flexibly and rapidly be conditioned for joint state and parameter inference, state smoothing, parameter inference, or reconstructing missing measurements, without retraining. We demonstrate these capabilities on four benchmark systems and examine how the length of the training segments affects state and parameter inference. On records five times longer than the training segments, the model maintains its state accuracy, whereas comparison methods either show a more than tenfold error increase or require ten times as much sampling time.

AI.tldr: 条件扩散模型经一次训练即可快速完成多种贝叶斯系统辨识任务，并适配不同长度的观测记录。
AI.motivation: 传统蒙特卡洛系统辨识需针对每条新记录重新计算，且任务受限、成本随维度和记录长度增加。
AI.method: 在短模拟轨迹上训练Transformer扩散模型，结合马尔可夫注意力掩码与相对时间编码近似状态参数联合后验。
AI.result: 四个基准系统实验中，五倍训练片段长度的记录上仍保持状态精度，而对照方法误差增逾十倍或采样耗时十倍。
AI.conclusion: 该模型无需重训即可支持联合推断、平滑、参数推断和缺失观测重建，提升系统辨识的灵活性。

title: MASTA: A Feedback-Scheduled Multi-Agent System for End-to-End Tamarin Modeling and Analysis
summary: Tamarin-based formal verification of security protocols requires expert-authored multiset rewriting rules and temporal-logic lemmas. Translating a natural-language protocol description into a complete formal model with an LLM is hard because syntactic, reachability, and property-level errors compound across the multi-step modeling process, and a single agent that both authors and self-evaluates cannot reliably localize them. We present MASTA, a multi-agent system that addresses these difficulties through three innovations. First, an operational--evaluative role decomposition assigns rule modeling to an Architect, property modeling to an Auditor, and pure dispatch to a dedicated Arbiter that holds no authoring duties. Second, the Arbiter implements a Tamarin-anchored scheduler that dispatches the next agent based on the latest verifier verdict and routes problem-tagged fixes through a modification list, with a six-class problem taxonomy and an LLM deduplication check preventing routing deadlock. Third, we construct a benchmark of 10 protocols paired with 139 mutation variants and five fine-grained metrics that jointly assess model correctness ($M_1$--$M_3$) and completeness ($M_4$--$M_5$). On this benchmark, MASTA on Qwen 3.5-plus improves over OpenCode on the same backbone by up to $+0.27$ on individual metrics and ranks first on both the correctness and completeness averages, surpassing Codex (GPT-5.5) and Claude Code (Opus 4.7) despite using a weaker LLM. Ablations on five protocols confirm that removing the Arbiter collapses property and verification scores to zero.
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Main Track, poster). 19 pages

AI.tldr: MASTA通过角色分工与验证反馈调度，实现从自然语言到Tamarin模型及分析的多智能体流程。
AI.motivation: 协议形式化的语法、可达性与性质错误会逐步累积，单智能体难以可靠定位自身建模问题。
AI.method: 由Architect建规则、Auditor建性质、Arbiter按Tamarin反馈调度，并用问题分类与修改列表组织修复。
AI.result: 在10个协议及139个变异的基准上，单项指标较同骨干OpenCode最高提升0.27，正确性与完整性均值均居首。
AI.conclusion: 角色分离与验证驱动调度有助于形式化建模，移除Arbiter会使消融实验的性质与验证得分归零。

title: Learning and Verifying Progress: Closed-Loop Agentic Planning with Progress-Enhanced Execution for Long-Horizon Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Long-horizon vision-language navigation (VLN) requires agents to track instruction progress and recover from local errors before they propagate across subtasks. However, executors trained on expert trajectories encounter policy-induced state shifts during deployment, and their stop signals do not reliably indicate subtask completion. We introduce Learning and Verifying Progress for VLN (LeaP-VLN), an agentic VLN system that couples progress-aware execution with independent progress verification through plan--execute--verify--recover cycles. LeaP-VLN leverages progress both explicitly, through a progress verifier that verifies subtask completion before the agent advances and triggers dual-phase recovery upon route deviation, and implicitly, by co-training the executor on progress reasoning and action prediction to enhance the executor's progress awareness and corrective control. To adapt the executor to this closed-loop interface, we propose a two-stage progress-enhanced curriculum: behavior cloning on expert demonstrations, followed by joint training on demonstrations, expert action corrections, and progress-reasoning supervision. Policy-generated trajectories expose the executor to both intra-subtask drift and inter-subtask state shifts, aligning training with the deviations encountered during closed-loop execution. Extensive experiments on R2R-CE and RxR-CE demonstrate state-of-the-art success rates among monocular methods trained without additional navigation datasets, while real-world experiments further validate the effectiveness of LeaP-VLN in long-horizon navigation.

AI.tldr: LeaP-VLN通过进度感知执行与独立验证闭环，提升长程视觉语言导航能力。
AI.motivation: 专家轨迹训练的执行器面临部署状态偏移，且停止信号难以可靠判断子任务完成。
AI.method: 结合规划、执行、验证与恢复循环，并以两阶段课程联合训练动作预测和进度推理。
AI.result: 在R2R-CE与RxR-CE上，无额外导航数据训练的单目方法中成功率领先，实地实验亦验证有效性。
AI.conclusion: 显式进度验证与隐式进度学习相结合，有助于纠正局部偏差并支持长程导航。

title: Tensor-Algebraic Framework for Nonlinear Control: Spectral Stability Analysis and Controller Design of Polynomial Systems
summary: Matrices provide an algebraic foundation for systems and control, whereas an analogous tensor-based framework for general nonhomogeneous polynomial dynamics is still lacking. This paper addresses this gap by developing a tensor-algebraic framework that connects tensor structure, spectral properties, Lyapunov stability, and controller synthesis. We first establish stability conditions based on positive-definite, copositive, and P-tensors for homogeneous and nonhomogeneous polynomial systems. We then introduce an extended tensor-eigenvalue problem (ETEP) for general multivariate polynomials, yielding a spectral-variational characterization of positivity through one interior and two boundary spectral quantities, and consequently a stability test for polynomial vector fields. For controller synthesis, we develop an unfolding-based U-eigenvalue relaxation that combines a positive-definite anchor with a near-positive-semidefinite higher-order part, leading to a convex semidefinite program. The conservatism of the relaxation is explicitly characterized, and an explicit guaranteed domain-of-attraction bound is derived. Numerical examples demonstrate positivity certification beyond direct SOS representations and substantially lower computation time than SOS-based synthesis in the considered example. These results establish a systematic tensor-spectral methodology for the analysis and control of polynomial systems with higher-order interactions.

AI.tldr: 提出连接张量结构、谱性质、稳定性与控制器合成的多项式系统分析框架。
AI.motivation: 一般非齐次多项式动力学尚缺乏类似矩阵控制理论的系统性张量代数框架。
AI.method: 建立张量稳定性条件与扩展特征值问题，并通过展开式U特征值松弛构建半定规划控制器。
AI.result: 数值示例展示了超出直接SOS表示的正性认证能力，且所考察合成示例的计算时间显著降低。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供多项式系统的张量谱分析与控制方法，并刻画松弛保守性及吸引域保证。

title: Room for Supervision: Training-Free Dataset Distillation for Object Detection
summary: Dataset distillation (DD) reduces storage and training costs by compressing large datasets into small collections. Most existing methods focus on image classification, where each image typically has a single category label. In contrast, object detection requires accurate category and bounding box annotations for multiple objects, together with visual content consistent with those annotations. Existing detection distillation pipelines rely on learned models and can alter the spatial relationships between objects and their backgrounds. We introduce GRASP, which packs dense native supervision into limited pixels without network training or inference. GRASP jointly searches over image selections and spatial layouts using convex allocation subproblems that penalize insufficient object resolution, excessive image compression, and padding that source context cannot fill. During composition, each selected image is cropped around all annotated objects and expanded into surrounding context without reducing object scale. The resized regions are then combined into distilled images, preserving the spatial layout within each region and retaining all original class labels and bounding box annotations. We evaluate GRASP on MS COCO and PASCAL VOC with compression ratios ranging from 0.25\% to 2\%. GRASP constructs the 1\% MS COCO dataset in under two minutes. Under a common training protocol using hard labels, GRASP achieves the state of the art with both CNN and ViT backbones. Code is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: GRASP无需网络训练或推理，即可通过保留原生标注的图像拼接实现目标检测数据集蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 目标检测蒸馏需同时保留多目标类别、边界框及一致视觉内容，现有流程可能破坏空间关系。
AI.method: 联合搜索图像选择与空间布局，利用凸分配子问题裁剪并拼接保留目标尺度和上下文的区域。
AI.result: 两分钟内构建1%的COCO数据集，并在统一硬标签训练协议下以CNN和ViT骨干达到最优水平。
AI.conclusion: 密集利用原生监督可在无需学习模型的情况下实现高效目标检测数据压缩。

title: UbiHearo: Bringing Scenario-Aware Sound Guidance to DHH Users with Mobile Agents
summary: For Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing (DHH) users, effective sound awareness goes beyond detecting \emph{what} sound occurs; it requires understanding \emph{what it means}, \emph{how urgent it is}, and \emph{what to do}. However, existing mobile assistants largely reduce acoustic scenes to isolated labels or generic alerts, failing to provide contextual guidance when the same sound implies different risks across scenarios. We present \sysname, a mobile hearing assistant agent that closes the sensing--reasoning--action loop for \textit{scenario-aware} and \textit{personalized} DHH assistance. \sysname adopts a \textit{neuro-symbolic} design that transforms continuous acoustic and physical context streams into structured intermediate representations (IRs) for controllable reasoning and guidance. It introduces three key mechanisms. \textit{First}, a perception-thresholded sensing mechanism enables energy-efficient always-on awareness by activating processing only for perceptually meaningful events while preserving safety-critical cues through deterministic overrides. \textit{Second}, a staged neuro-symbolic reasoning framework performs promptless scenario understanding by conditioning an on-device audio-language model on structured IRs instead of user-authored context descriptions. \textit{Third}, a bounded human-in-the-loop personalization mechanism adapts user-specific guidance through lightweight on-device decision-boundary updates while preserving population-aligned reasoning. We evaluate \sysname on smartphones and in-vehicle systems across diverse scenarios. It achieves favorable accuracy--latency--energy tradeoffs and personalized guidance.

AI.tldr: 提出面向聋人与听力障碍用户的移动听觉助手，提供场景感知及个性化声音指导。
AI.motivation: 孤立声音标签与通用提醒难以解释不同场景下声音的含义、紧迫程度及应对方式。
AI.method: 采用神经符号架构，结合感知阈值触发、结构化场景推理及有边界的人在回路个性化更新。
AI.result: 在智能手机与车载系统的多场景评估中，实现了良好的准确率、时延、能耗权衡及个性化指导。
AI.conclusion: 结合声学与物理情境的感知—推理—行动闭环，有助于提供贴合用户需求的听觉辅助。

title: Rethinking Supervision Scaling in On-Policy Distillation: From Dense Supervision to Stochastic Horizons
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense token-level supervision along student-generated trajectories, yet the learning benefits of longer trajectories may not scale proportionally with their computational cost. We investigate how supervision utility evolves with trajectory length. Controlled experiments reveal diminishing returns from additional supervised tokens, while showing that later positions remain learnable and exhibit substantial cross-position supervision transfer. Gradient analysis further identifies shared update components across response positions and diverse position-specific residuals whose cross-rollout consistency decreases at greater depths. Motivated by these findings, we propose Stochastic Horizons On-Policy Distillation (SH-OPD), which reduces redundant supervision by randomly varying rollout horizons while preserving access to deeper response states. SH-OPD samples a shared horizon for each training batch, enabling efficient parallel generation without per-sequence horizon scheduling overhead. We characterize the resulting reweighting bias and derive a compute-reweighting trade-off under standard optimization assumptions. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation demonstrate that SH-OPD achieves slightly higher mathematical reasoning accuracy at approximately 45% of the per-update cost of standard OPD, while maintaining competitive code generation performance at around 60% of the baseline cost. These results highlight the benefits of efficient supervision allocation across response depths.

AI.tldr: SH-OPD通过随机改变批次生成长度，减少在线策略蒸馏的冗余监督并降低计算开销。
AI.motivation: 长轨迹的额外词元监督收益递减，其计算成本未必带来同比例学习收益。
AI.method: 为每个训练批次采样共享轨迹长度，保留深层响应监督，并分析重加权偏差与计算权衡。
AI.result: 数学推理以约45%的单次更新成本取得略高准确率，代码生成以约60%的成本保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 跨响应深度合理分配监督，可在保留深层学习机会的同时提高蒸馏效率。

title: VIVID: A Visual Harness for Agentic Video Editing
summary: Video editing requires agents to make editing decisions grounded in audiovisual observations and precise temporal localization, and to evaluate their effects in rendered outputs. General-purpose coding agents possess strong comprehension, reasoning, and code execution capabilities, while media interaction and evidence management mechanisms tailored to video tasks can further unlock their editing potential. We introduce VIVID, a visual harness that supports multiple native coding agents in video post-production without additional model training. VIVID provides tools for on-demand video inspection, audio analysis, and transcription, and preserves observations alongside their corresponding media versions and temporal coordinates. Agents can actively retrieve these observations as they reason, perform edits using their native coding and shell tools, and inspect rendered outputs to guide subsequent revisions. On AgenticVBench, comprising 100 tasks across Assembly, Repair, Sequencing, and Repurpose, Codex with VIVID achieves an average score of 58.6%, an improvement of 20.2 percentage points over native Codex. The same harness also integrates with Claude Code and OpenCode, achieving average scores of 55.1% and 37.1%, respectively, both substantially exceeding their native baselines. These results highlight VIVID's potential as a reusable visual harness for extending the capabilities of general-purpose coding agents to video editing.

AI.tldr: VIVID无需额外训练，通过视觉工具与证据管理增强通用编码智能体的视频编辑能力。
AI.motivation: 视频编辑要求基于视听观察和精确时间定位决策，并通过渲染输出检验编辑效果。
AI.method: 提供视频检查、音频分析与转写工具，将观察关联媒体版本及时间坐标，支持迭代编辑。
AI.result: Codex搭配VIVID在AgenticVBench得分58.6%，提升20.2个百分点，另两种智能体也明显受益。
AI.conclusion: 可复用的视听交互与证据管理机制能够拓展通用编码智能体的视频后期制作能力。

title: Distribution-Free Probabilistic Environmental Control Barrier Functions with Application to Adaptive Cruise Control
summary: Safety control under environmental uncertainty is challenging when the uncertainty distribution is unknown and reliable support bounds are unavailable. This paper introduces CPP-ECBF, a distribution-free approach that combines conformal predictive programming with probabilistic environmental control barrier functions. For separable environmental safety functions and i.i.d. uncertainty, CPP-ECBF converts the probabilistic safety condition into a sample-based deterministic control constraint that provides finite-horizon safety with prescribed probability $1-\epsilon$ and calibration confidence $1-\tilde{\beta}$. For adaptive cruise control, an offline conformal uncertainty bound yields an explicit linear upper bound on the ego-vehicle acceleration, which is enforced by a quadratic-programming safety filter. In 10,000 Monte Carlo trials, 99.97% of trials satisfied the finite-horizon safety criterion, exceeding the prescribed confidence of 85%. Moreover, CPP-ECBF reduced the conservatism of worst-case robust enforcement, increasing the admissible acceleration upper limit by $5.90\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ on average.
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to the 2027 American Control Conference (ACC)

AI.tldr: CPP-ECBF以无分布假设的样本约束，在环境不确定性下提供概率安全控制。
AI.motivation: 当环境不确定性的分布未知且缺乏可靠支撑边界时，安全控制难以兼顾保证与保守性。
AI.method: 融合保形预测规划与概率环境控制障碍函数，在可分安全函数及独立同分布条件下构建确定性约束。
AI.result: 万次蒙特卡洛试验中99.97%满足有限时域安全标准，允许加速度上限较最坏情形鲁棒方法平均提高5.90米每平方秒。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在适用假设下提供指定概率与校准置信度的安全保证，并降低自适应巡航控制的保守性。

title: SpeCal: Spectral Calibration for Unsupervised RLVR
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has substantially improved the reasoning abilities of large language models, but its dependence on ground-truth answers or external verifiers limits its ability to exploit abundant unlabeled reasoning data. Unsupervised RLVR alleviates this bottleneck by deriving scalar rewards from the model's own rollouts. However, the reliability of such self-generated supervision varies substantially across rollout groups and individual responses, while existing methods construct or refine their rewards mainly from decoded outcomes and reward statistics. These endpoint signals reveal what answers the model produces, but provide limited information about whether the underlying rollout representations form a reliable structure for learning. Our key observation is that hidden-state spectra offer a complementary view of supervision reliability by characterizing both the organization of a rollout group and the support received by each rollout within that group. Based on this observation, we propose SpeCal, a bi-level spectral calibration framework for unsupervised RLVR. At the group level, SpeCal combines spectral mass with a Gaussian band-pass gate over normalized entropy-based effective rank, favoring rollout groups with substantial representation variation whose effective dimensionality lies in a preferred regime. At the rollout level, the same group effective rank determines how many dominant directions are retained in a leave-one-out spectral subspace formed by the remaining rollouts, within which the conditional support of each held-out rollout is measured. The resulting signals calibrate the original reward-induced advantages at the group and rollout levels without redefining the underlying unlabeled reward.

AI.tldr: SpeCal利用隐藏状态谱在群组与单条生成轨迹两级校准无监督RLVR的学习信号。
AI.motivation: 自生成监督的可靠性因群组和响应而异，仅凭输出答案及奖励统计难以判断表征结构是否可靠。
AI.method: 群组级结合谱质量与有效秩门控，轨迹级利用留一谱子空间支持度校准原始奖励优势。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体结果。
AI.conclusion: 隐藏状态谱为监督可靠性提供补充视角，可在不重新定义无标签奖励的前提下校准学习信号。

title: ARMFUL: Learning Whole-Arm Grasp Configurations for Single-Arm Pickup of Large Objects
summary: Many everyday objects, such as storage boxes, baskets, and chairs, are too large or heavy for a gripper to grasp, yet a single arm can still pick them up by wrapping around and supporting them. Such grasps are hard to learn: wrapping motions are difficult to teleoperate, and existing datasets contain little whole-arm pickup data. We introduce WAG (Whole-Arm Grasp Dataset), the first large-scale dataset for single-arm pickup of large objects, with 1.7~million joint configurations across 793 objects. We sample configurations directly in joint space, execute each through squeeze and lift primitives in simulation, and stress-test survivors under active shaking and external forces. To demonstrate the utility of WAG and accomplish the whole-arm pickup task, we develop ARMFUL, a whole-arm pickup pipeline that pairs a diffusion model trained on WAG, generating whole-arm grasps from the object's point cloud, with a motion planner that reaches them collision-free before the same squeeze-and-lift execution. In simulation, ARMFUL reaches 85.4\% lift success on training and 69.9\% on held-out objects, and it lifts the object in 70 of 100 trials on a physical Franka arm across 10 IKEA objects.

AI.tldr: ARMFUL通过全臂抓取数据集与扩散模型，使单臂能够环抱并托举大型物体。
AI.motivation: 大型物体难以用夹爪抓取，而全臂环抱动作难以遥操作且缺少训练数据。
AI.method: 构建涵盖793个物体、170万关节配置的WAG数据集，结合扩散抓取生成与无碰撞运动规划。
AI.result: 训练与未见物体仿真举升成功率分别为85.4%和69.9%，真实机械臂100次试验成功70次。
AI.conclusion: 大规模全臂抓取数据与生成式规划流程可支持单臂拾取大型物体。

title: Fast at the Frontier, Wrong at the Fallback: A Commit-Level Analysis of Threshold Decoding in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) can write several tokens per forward pass. Open-weight DLMs commit, in any order, every masked position whose confidence passes a threshold. If none does, a fallback commits the most confident one, and the commits are never revised. Wide windows let the decoder commit far ahead of the text, which should speed up decoding but often costs accuracy. It is unclear where the model is confident and which commits cause errors. We trace every commit of four off-the-shelf DLMs on math, code, translation and summarization, and rerun failing answers with one step changed. Most tokens become confident only near the frontier, the leftmost masked position, so committing only there, still several tokens per step, is about as fast as committing anywhere. The accuracy loss comes from committing tokens before the text to their left, and committing one token per step does not reduce it. The worst case is an early end-of-sequence token that cuts the answer short. Fallback commits are 11-35% of commits but start 61-72% of the failures that left-to-right decoding avoids. Changing only the step where such a failure starts repairs it more often than changing a similar earlier step. Committing only at the frontier recovers most of the lost accuracy on all four models. Our code is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 扩散语言模型阈值解码的精度损失主要源于越过文本前沿的不可撤销提交，尤其是回退提交。
AI.motivation: 宽窗口解码虽可并行提交词元，却常损害准确率，其置信度分布和错误来源尚不明确。
AI.method: 追踪四种模型在数学、代码、翻译与摘要任务中的每次提交，并对失败答案进行单步干预。
AI.result: 回退提交占11%至35%，却触发61%至72%的可由左到右解码避免的失败，前沿提交恢复多数精度损失。
AI.conclusion: 仅在最左掩码位置附近提交多个词元，可维持近似速度并减少乱序提交引发的错误。

title: IndustrialKnowEval: A Benchmark for Evaluating Multi-Level Industrial Knowledge in LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly explored for industrial tasks, yet few benchmarks evaluate their mastery of industrial knowledge across different types of cognitive demand. We introduce IndustrialKnowEval (IndKnow), a benchmark for industrial knowledge and engineering question answering. It contains 43,282 samples covering 21 task types across seven industrial sectors, including aerospace, electric power, and metallurgy, organized into four levels of cognitive demand: memory, comprehension, reasoning, and engineering application. Enterprise-based domain specialists and experienced researchers participate in all stages of dataset construction and quality control. We conduct a series of experiments on 18 representative LLMs, with domain experts deeply involved in the evaluation. Building upon IndKnow, we propose the Industrial Cognitive Capability Gap (ICCG) metric to characterize the performance differential between foundational industrial knowledge and higher-order reasoning and application, and we analyze it alongside absolute performance to provide a more complete view of model capabilities. We anticipate that IndustrialKnowEval will support the benchmarking of LLMs in industrial scenarios and promote the development of robust industrial intelligence. Code is available at: this https URL
comment: 26 pages (13 pages of main text and 13 pages of appendix), 11 figures

title: Conic Structure of the Cross-Entropy Loss at the Final Layer and Its Absence in Rectifier Backbones
summary: Slices of the loss along lines and planes in parameter space are widely used to visualize deep networks. They often show a single basin with nearly straight walls, which raises the question of whether such a loss is a cone rounded at its apex, or a lower envelope of several cones that meet along creases. We answer this question for softmax cross-entropy at two levels of a classifier. Over the weights of an affine final layer, the loss equals a polyhedral cone plus an offset that decreases monotonically and exponentially along every ray, towards a limit in closed form. The distance at which the asymptotic wall reaches the height of the starting point, which we call the core radius, equals the mean surprisal of the classes that the direction favours, divided by the slope of the wall. Over the parameters of a rectifier backbone, the loss along a line has a kink wherever the activation pattern of a sample changes. Using the dimension theory of semialgebraic sets, we show that, along almost every line, the samples that switch at one point share an irreducible factor of their pre-activation polynomials. Under a coprimality condition, each kink therefore carries the share of one sample among $n$, so creases comparable to the slope do not form. Measurements on ResNet-18 and ResNet-56 trained on CIFAR-10 illustrate both results, with a test that bounds the size of any crease that sampled loss values can hide.

AI.tldr: 论文刻画交叉熵在仿射末层的渐近锥形结构，并解释整流骨干中宏观折痕缺失的条件。
AI.motivation: 损失切片常呈近直壁单盆地，但其对应单个圆顶锥还是多个锥的下包络尚不清楚。
AI.method: 解析末层交叉熵的射线行为，以半代数集维数理论分析骨干激活切换，并在ResNet上测量验证。
AI.result: 末层损失等于多面锥加指数衰减偏移；互素条件下骨干折点仅承载单样本份额，不形成斜率量级折痕。
