title: STARS: Stage-Adaptive Responsibility Separation for Shadow Removal in Remote Sensing Images
summary: Shadows are a ubiquitous radiative attenuation phenomenon in remote sensing images and can severely affect high-resolution remote sensing interpretation tasks. In shadow removal, although introducing a mask prior provides explicit positional information for the restoration network, it also causes non-shadow regions to be modulated by the shadow prior, producing a systematic brightness shift; notably, this phenomenon is independent of whether the mask is accurate. In remote sensing images, non-shadow regions usually occupy a larger proportion, so a small shift over these regions incurs a much higher cost on whole-image metrics than an equal gain in shadow regions. Adopting a task-decoupling perspective, we therefore decompose shadow removal into two tasks, shadow-region restoration and non-shadow-region identity, within a cascaded architecture, and handle them sequentially. Based on this insight, we propose STARS, a cascaded shadow removal framework that separates regional responsibilities across stages. The method retains the advantages of the shadow mask while resolving the degradation of non-shadow regions, without requiring a complex parallel dual-branch structure. Meanwhile, to introduce large-model prior knowledge into remote sensing tasks, we further design a Feature Selection and Fusion Adapter (FSFA). We conduct extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets, UAV-SC+, ISTD+ and WSRD+ 2026, demonstrating the superiority of STARS. The framework shows that decoupling regional responsibilities can resolve the intrinsic contradiction of mask priors, providing a new direction for image restoration with region heterogeneity.

AI.tldr: STARS通过分阶段分离阴影修复与非阴影保真职责，缓解掩码先验导致的亮度偏移。
AI.motivation: 阴影掩码即使准确也会扰动非阴影区，而其面积较大使轻微偏移显著损害整图指标。
AI.method: 采用级联架构依次处理阴影恢复与非阴影恒等保持，并设计特征选择融合适配器引入大模型先验。
AI.result: 在UAV-SC+、ISTD+和WSRD+ 2026三个基准上的实验显示STARS优于对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 区域职责解耦可保留掩码先验优势并缓解非阴影退化，为区域异质图像恢复提供方向。

title: A First Look at System One Decision Models for Malware Detection
summary: Malware detection needs scores calibrated at a fixed false positive rate (FPR) and decisions an analyst can read: feature-based detectors give the first, large language models (LLMs) on decompiled code the second, through generated text of uncalibrated confidence. System One decision models answer a typed question about a text with a probability over its declared answers in one forward pass. We present the first evaluation of these models for Windows Portable Executable malware detection, analyze how they decide, and propose S1Mal, an ensemble on the typed answers and the embedding of CLM-8B. In an isolated virtual machine, Ghidra and capa decompose each binary, and the host renders the records into a canonical textual state, a digest of headers, imports, MITRE ATT&CK capabilities and strings, optionally with decompiled functions, without class shortcuts. Three readouts score each model on the state: A0, the probability of one verdict question; A1, 32 atomic behavioral questions weighed by gradient-boosted trees; A2, heads on the model's state embedding. S1Mal feeds gradient-boosted trees with the atomic answers and the A2 score of CLM-8B. We evaluate CLM-8B, ten open decision models and two LLMs read through logits on BODMAS temporal splits, SOREL-20M out-of-distribution malware and 14,534 matched benign files. On BODMAS, A0 wastes the static evidence: its area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) spans 0.4025-0.8590 across 13 models. A1 recovers it, raising every model's AUROC by +54.61% on average; A2 lifts CLM-8B by +0.2749 to 0.9943, above a combiner on digest facts (0.9901), and reaches 0.9853-0.9948 on nine open models. S1Mal reaches 0.9946 and detects 93.47% of the malware at a realized FPR of 1.45%, and 59.15% at 0.1% FPR on the test ROC curve, against 46.59% with A2. S1Mal gives analysts calibrated decisions, each with the atomic answers behind it.

AI.tldr: S1Mal融合决策模型的原子行为回答与嵌入评分，实现可校准且可供分析员解读的恶意软件检测。
AI.motivation: 特征检测器可按固定误报率校准，但基于反编译代码的大语言模型文本判断缺乏校准置信度。
AI.method: 将二进制静态证据规范化为文本，比较直接判决、原子问题与嵌入读出，再用梯度提升树集成后两者。
AI.result: S1Mal的AUROC达0.9946，在1.45%和0.1%误报率下分别检出93.47%和59.15%的恶意软件。
AI.conclusion: 相较直接询问恶意性，利用原子行为回答和嵌入能更有效提取静态证据并提供可解释的校准决策。

title: Design of the Secure Smart Scooter with Automatic Lane Detection
summary: The authors present a prototype of an electric scooter that uses computer vision to determine driving lanes and automatically modify vehicle configuration. Scooters steer on sidewalks, bike paths, or car lanes. The government imposes speed limits on the lanes in which electric scooters drive. Featuring computer vision, electric scooters can determine driving lanes and automatically modify vehicle configuration. However, such systems' safety is still a concern, and research into such vehicle systems' safety and security aspects is proceeding. First, we will present our vehicular setup. Then, we will present our implemented scooter with safety constraints. Finally, we present our security prototype for such an electric scooter.

title: Efficient Multi-View Generation with Iterative Global-Local Proxy Attention
summary: Generating consistent multi-view RGB images and normal maps from a single input image provides complementary appearance and geometric cues for 3D reconstruction. However, maintaining cross-view consistency requires information exchange across viewpoints, and dense cross-view attention becomes computationally expensive as the number of views and spatial resolution increase. In this paper, we propose Global-Local Proxy Attention (GLPA) to reduce cross-view communication costs while preserving fine-grained within-view processing. Specifically, GLPA retains full-resolution interactions within each view and uses compact global proxies for cross-view communication. To further leverage the exchanged information, GLPA incorporates iterative proxy refinement, which rebuilds the proxies from updated features and reuses the same attention parameters for subsequent interactions within a single denoising step. We evaluate GLPA on two structurally different diffusion backbones, FLUX and Stable Diffusion. Experiments on FLUX show that GLPA achieves a $2.65\times$ speedup in attention computation per denoising step over dense attention, while improving reconstruction IoU from 0.6849 to 0.7019 and reducing NVS LPIPS from 0.086 to 0.076. Results on Stable Diffusion further demonstrate the effectiveness of GLPA, with a $1.80\times$ attention speedup and improvements across all five quality metrics.

AI.tldr: GLPA用迭代全局代理降低多视图生成的跨视角注意力成本，同时改善三维重建质量。
AI.motivation: 单图生成一致的多视图图像与法线图需要跨视角交互，但稠密注意力成本随视图数和分辨率上升。
AI.method: 保留视图内全分辨率交互，以紧凑全局代理传递跨视图信息，并在单步去噪中共享参数迭代更新代理。
AI.result: FLUX注意力加速2.65倍、重建IoU由0.6849升至0.7019；Stable Diffusion加速1.80倍且五项质量指标均改善。
AI.conclusion: 迭代全局与局部代理注意力可在不同扩散骨干上兼顾多视图生成效率与质量。

title: QASK-Edit: Adaptive Sparse Attention Across Queries and Key Sources for Efficient Video Editing
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have achieved strong performance in generation based video editing, but suffer from high inference latency due to the long token sequences formed by conditioning inputs and generated videos. Although training-free sparse attention reduces this cost, existing methods typically apply a fixed retention ratio or a single threshold shared across all tokens. In this work, we view video editing as conditional generation and identify a key insight: attention demand varies significantly both across different key sources (e.g., source videos, reference images, audio, text, and generated videos) and across queries within each source. Motivated by this, we propose QASK-Edit (Query-Adaptive Sparsity over Key Sources for Video Editing), a training-free sparse attention framework that allocates computation independently for each query and key source. Specifically, for each query, QASK-Edit considers both the attention mass and approximation risk of each block. It then evaluates candidate routing thresholds against each key source's risk budget, choosing exact computation or approximations to dynamically adjust sparsity for each query. Extensive experiments on three video editing models demonstrate that QASK-Edit achieves up to $1.46\times$ end-to-end speedup over dense attention pipeline while preserving both editing quality and unedited region fidelity. Furthermore, QASK-Edit generalizes directly to Reference-to-Video generation, delivering up to $1.36\times$ speedup while maintaining generation quality.

AI.tldr: QASK-Edit按查询和键来源自适应分配稀疏注意力计算，在保持视频编辑质量的同时加速推理。
AI.motivation: 视频编辑序列长、推理延迟高，而现有稀疏注意力忽视不同查询与键来源的注意力需求差异。
AI.method: 无需训练，结合注意力质量与近似风险，在各键来源风险预算内为每个查询选择精确计算或近似。

title: Koopman Temporal Logic and Model Predictive Control of Nonlinear Systems: A Demonstration in AC-DC Power Conversion
summary: This paper proposes a novel temporal logic, which we call Koopman Temporal Logic (KTL), towards a formal method in which Koopman operator theory provides a mathematical way to verify and control systems with nonlinear dynamics. We first review signal temporal logic and then introduce KTL, including its syntax, Boolean semantics, and quantitative semantics. Next, we propose a formulation of Model Predictive Control (MPC) from a control specification described by KTL. Effectiveness and computational efficiency of the proposed MPC formulation are evaluated by applying it to a reliable design of AC-DC power conversion.

AI.tldr: 提出Koopman时序逻辑及相应模型预测控制框架，用于非线性系统的形式化验证与控制。
AI.motivation: 利用Koopman算子理论，为非线性动力系统建立形式化验证与控制方法。
AI.method: 定义Koopman时序逻辑的语法、布尔与定量语义，并由其控制规约构建模型预测控制。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体结果。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将Koopman理论与时序逻辑控制规约结合，并以交直流电能变换设计进行评估。

title: SG-ODOM: Event-Driven Proprioceptive State Estimation with Stability-Gated Contact Updates for Legged Robots
summary: Reliable proprioceptive state estimation for legged robots fuses inertial sensing with kinematic sensing from leg encoders. The latter assumes a foot is stationary during the stance phase; however, physical foot touchdown does not necessarily provide a stationary reference for odometry, particularly during impact and load transfer. Repeatedly applying kinematic corrections throughout the same contact phase can introduce redundant or unreliable information. We present SG-ODOM, a proprioceptive odometry framework that uses stability-gated contact selection to schedule kinematic updates. Following physical touchdown, a stability gate accepts the contact for state estimation only after the foot reaches a sufficiently stable support condition. The resulting validated touchdown event triggers an estimator correction, while additional timeout updates bound the maximum duration of uninterrupted IMU propagation. The framework is evaluated on multiple legged platforms, both quadrupedal and humanoid robots, against representative state-of-the-art proprioceptive estimators. Across the evaluated sequences, SG-ODOM demonstrates competitive or superior estimation accuracy, reducing Relative Pose Error (RPE) by up to 25% compared to the baseline estimator on outdoor sequences from the GrandTour dataset. Source code: this https URL. Video: this https URL

AI.tldr: SG-ODOM通过稳定性门控接触事件调度运动学更新，提升足式机器人本体里程计精度。

AI.method: 触地后待支撑稳定再触发状态校正，并以超时更新限制连续惯性传播时长。
AI.result: 在四足及人形平台上精度相当或更优，GrandTour户外序列相对位姿误差最高降低25%。
AI.conclusion: 以稳定接触而非物理触地安排更新，可提高多类足式机器人本体状态估计的可靠性。

title: AgentFaultBench: State-Verified Evaluation of Tool-Fault Recovery
summary: Does recovery advice help an agent finish a task after a tool fails? AgentFaultBench evaluates LangGraph and CrewAI agents performing specified tasks in an isolated GitLab installation. We inject tool errors and check both the resulting files and issues and the required reads, verification and final response. The prompt supplies the expected issue and report text, so the task tests execution rather than content generation. In the primary comparison of 1,944 planned runs, advice changes success by -8.33, 0.00 and +1.06 percentage points relative to a neutral reminder; missing outcomes leave the latter two comparisons inconclusive. Later experiments test a revised recovery policy. GPT-4o mini improves, while Sol and Claude already complete the recoverable cases. In a separate 624-run study on six related tasks not previously used by that policy, the guided condition records 161 correct final states and one unknown outcome in 192 planned runs, versus 142/192 with neutral feedback. The gain lies between +9.90 and +10.42 pp when missing outcomes are included. Removing issue IDs gives 47/48 successes versus 46/48 with IDs; other execution information remains. A second checker agrees on 1,879 observed primary outcomes and 241 constructed test cases. No human validation was collected. The findings support testing advice against explicit recovery controls rather than assuming it helps.

AI.motivation: 工具失败后的恢复建议未必有助于完成任务，需要显式恢复对照与实际执行状态验证。

title: MSAR: Next-Scale Autoregressive Forecasting for Time Series via Modular Multi-Scale Decoupling
summary: Time series forecasting underpins critical applications in finance, energy, healthcare, and transportation. Although deep models have achieved strong results, most adopt single-scale modeling or restrict multiscale processing to the input side, causing a misalignment between multiscale inputs and single-scale outputs and limiting predictive power. We introduce the Modular Scale-wise Autoregressive Framework (MSAR), a model-agnostic design that forecasts progressively across multiple temporal resolutions. MSAR offers three advantages: (1) scale-wise aligned modeling, which disentangles heterogeneous temporal patterns by aligning inputs and outputs at each scale; (2) scale-wise autoregression, where coarse-scale predictions guide finer-scale forecasting through hierarchical information flow; and (3) a modular architecture, enabling seamless integration with diverse backbones such as CNNs, MLPs, and Transformers. Extensive experiments across a broad set of datasets and forecasting models demonstrate that MSAR achieves consistent improvements in both accuracy and inference efficiency, validating the effectiveness of scale-aligned autoregression for multiscale time series forecasting. The code is available at: this https URL.
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026 main track. 26 pages, 7 figures. Code available at this https URL

title: Calibrate Once, Grow the Vocabulary: Candidate-Independent Scores for Conformal Risk Control in Open-Vocabulary Segmentation
summary: Open-vocabulary segmenters accept class names at inference. Conformal risk control can bound how often their prediction sets miss the true label, but we show that this bound breaks when names are added after calibration. On ADE20K, a threshold calibrated for 10% risk at 150 names reaches up to 15.4% risk at 845 names in released CAT-Seg models. The risk exceeds the target on every calibration split, yet the prediction sets grow far less than the target requires. In SED they instead grow larger than needed. The cause is that pruning, cross-label attention and vocabulary normalisation make each label's score depend on the other requested labels. Scores can move either way, so a threshold recalibrated at a larger vocabulary need not hold at smaller ones. We remove this dependence without training by scoring each label against a fixed reference bank of names. A label's score then stays the same when names are added, so one calibration keeps its guarantee as the vocabulary grows. The guarantee holds whatever names are added, even ones chosen per image after seeing it. On three benchmarks and five segmenters, the converted models meet the target at every vocabulary size we evaluate. For CAT-Seg and SED at alpha=10%, they use at most one more label per pixel than the released models recalibrated at the grown vocabulary. Treating names instead of images as calibration samples also bounds the miss rate of added names. If the annotated names are a random sample of the names in the calibration images, an added name's expected miss rate on those images is at most the target. For harder added names, the excess is at most their gap in mean miss rate. Applied to Grounding DINO, which splits large vocabularies into chunks, the conversion also makes inference about six times faster.

AI.tldr: 以固定参考名称库消除类别评分的词表依赖，使开放词汇分割一次校准后仍能控制扩词风险。

title: TaF-Foundation: Wrench-Grounded Cross-Sensor Tactile Representations
summary: Tactile sensing is essential for contact-rich manipulation, yet heterogeneous sensing mechanisms and observation formats hinder cross-hardware transfer. Since physical contact is governed by Newtonian mechanics, we ground tactile representations in six-dimensional wrenches, establishing a common physical reference across sensing mechanisms. Specifically, we pair tactile observations from all sensors with wrench measurements, enabling shared physical supervision without requiring direct tactile-to-tactile pairing between sensors. To support learning at scale, we develop a dedicated acquisition platform and collect over 100 million paired tactile observations and wrench measurements from 24 sensors spanning four families of sensing principles. Building on this dataset, our framework combines sensor-specific input adaptation with a shared tactile encoder. By learning to reconstruct wrenches, the encoder maps observations from different sensors into a shared, continuous feature space grounded in contact physics. To leverage these representations for manipulation, we introduce TaF-Policy, which integrates tactile features with visual observations and robot states to generate action chunks. We evaluate the learned representations through wrench estimation, cross-sensor retrieval, few-shot adaptation to unseen sensors, and robotic manipulation. On the core benchmark, our method reduces single-frame force RMSE by 17.1% and improves cross-sensor retrieval R@1 by 13.11 percentage points over the strongest baseline. In manipulation experiments, TaF-Policy achieves average success rates of 51.33% across three simulated tasks and 46.25% across four real-world tasks, compared with 47.33% and 23.75%, respectively, for the strongest baselines evaluated on the same task sets. Project page: this https URL.

AI.tldr: TaF-Foundation以六维力旋量统一跨传感器触觉表征，并支持机器人操作策略学习。
AI.motivation: 触觉传感器的感知机制和观测格式异构，阻碍跨硬件表征迁移。
AI.method: 采集24种传感器逾一亿组触觉与力旋量配对数据，以专属适配器和共享编码器学习重建并接入操作策略。
AI.result: 力RMSE降低17.1%、检索R@1提高13.11个百分点；仿真与真实任务成功率分别达51.33%和46.25%。
AI.conclusion: 以接触物理为共同监督可学习跨传感器触觉表征，并改善所评估机器人操作任务的成功率。

title: ACiT: Proprioceptive-Prior Action Chunking with Inverted Transformers
summary: Visuomotor policies condition action prediction on visual and proprioceptive observations. While historical proprioceptive sequences carry rich dynamic priors, current methods treat them as equal to high-dimensional vision, causing the proprioceptive signal to be overwhelmed. To identify what is lost in equal-conditioning fusion, we analyze proprioceptive data and find that strong inter-joint coupling is the key action-determining structure. This finding aligns with the neural sensorimotor loop, in which proprioception first forms a body-centered prior and vision is later calibrated via parietal remapping. Inspired by this, we propose ACiT, Proprioceptive-Prior Action Chunking with Inverted Transformers, which reinforces historical joint-coupling as the primary condition with vision as a later calibration. This design is instantiated through three modules: Inverted State Encoding builds a proprioceptive prior via per-joint tokens and inter-joint self-attention. State-Visual Grounding lets joint tokens query visual evidence, making vision goal- and calibration-only. Inverted Action Chunking decodes per-joint trajectories independently. ACiT improves success rates on most LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world tasks, with the largest gains on those that require dynamics and coordination. The same conditioning design transferred to the VLA backbone pi_0-ACiT yields significant gains with better execution efficiency.

AI.tldr: ACiT以历史关节耦合构建本体先验，再用视觉校准动作分块预测，改善机器人操作表现。
AI.motivation: 视觉与本体信息等权融合会淹没本体信号，损失对动作至关重要的关节间耦合结构。
AI.method: 以逐关节标记和关节间注意力编码本体先验，由关节查询视觉证据，再独立解码各关节轨迹。
AI.result: 在多数LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0及真实任务中提高成功率，迁移至pi_0后也显著改善表现与执行效率。
AI.conclusion: 本体先验优先、视觉后校准的条件设计有益于操作学习，尤其适用于强调动力学与协调的任务。

title: AVD: A Multi-Sensor Teleoperated Wheelchair Platform with Safety-Aware Control
summary: Electric wheelchairs predominantly rely on manual joystick interfaces, which present critical barriers to independent mobility for individuals with severe motor and visual impairments. This paper presents AVD (Autonomous Vehicle Drive), a dependable teleoperation architecture for assistive mobility that unifies perception, communication, embedded control, and remote supervision in a single low-cost platform built entirely from commercially available hardware. The central engineering contribution is a safety-oriented design framework: control authority follows a static hierarchy, a manual emergency stop and the occupant's joystick pre-empt remote commands, and the on-board sensing layer has stop-only authority. The compute design partitions primary and safety functions and specifies a heartbeat-driven safe-state transition for the fault cases considered. The sensing stack this framework depends on is characterized against measured data: per-channel acquisition latency, a 2,025-scan LiDAR degradation campaign spanning five target configurations and a control under water mist, airborne dust, and direct aperture occlusion, and attitude measurements across static inclines to 47 degrees. The lowest pooled environmental-condition mean retained 76.6% of the clear-baseline forward-sector yield, and no scan lost the sector completely. A logged vibration-induced inertial dropout occurred while LiDAR and camera logging continued, illustrating complementary channel behavior. The result is a documented prototype and an explicit validation path for a deployable wheelchair implementation.

AI.tldr: AVD以低成本商用硬件构建安全优先的多传感器轮椅遥操作原型，并开展感知可靠性测试。
AI.motivation: 手动摇杆轮椅限制严重运动和视觉障碍者的独立出行，需要可靠的辅助遥操作方案。
AI.method: 整合感知、通信与远程监督，采用静态控制权限层级、主安全功能分区及心跳驱动安全状态切换。
AI.result: 2025次激光扫描中，最差环境条件的平均前向扇区保留率为基线的76.6%，且无扫描完全丢失该扇区。
AI.conclusion: 该原型明确了安全控制边界与验证路径，为可部署轮椅实现提供工程基础。

title: PEETS: Preference-aware Embeddings with Explicit Tree Structure for Auxiliary Product Bundling
summary: Auxiliary products such as flight protection and flexible-change services are recommended alongside primary travel purchases. This setting creates a granularity ambiguity: SKUs within one product type share semantics but differ in price and coverage, while rejecting one offer does not imply disinterest in the entire type. We present \textbf{PEETS} (\textbf{P}reference-aware \textbf{E}mbeddings with \textbf{E}xplicit \textbf{T}ree \textbf{S}tructure), a training-time framework for auxiliary product bundling. PEETS regularizes an existing click--conversion predictor through two conditional comparisons. Hierarchical Contrastive Loss uses the pair's common ancestor as a reference; Negative Contrastive Loss conditions structural sampling and comparison shifts on logged rejection events. Both act on shared SKU representations during training. This separates catalog relatedness from individual preference supervision and leaves the predictive serving path intact. PEETS achieves 78.20\% AUC, exceeding TWIN V2 by 0.90 percentage points and the matched base model by 1.15 points. In a 14-day online evaluation, gross auxiliary GMV per exposed user-day improves by 8.20\% over Policies, 3.06\% over Base, and 0.84\% over TWIN V2, with all three user-bootstrap 95\% intervals above zero. Bundling rate is 0.51 points below Policies. The cancellation interval's upper limit exceeds the prespecified margin. PEETS adds no auxiliary-loss computation to serving and records 42.1~ms p95 latency, compared with 42.0~ms for Base.

AI.tldr: PEETS通过树结构和拒绝反馈约束商品表示，提升辅助商品推荐收益且基本不增加服务延迟。
AI.motivation: 同类辅助商品语义相近但价格和保障不同，拒绝单个商品不能直接解释为不喜欢整个品类。
AI.method: 训练时以共同祖先构造层级对比损失，并根据拒绝事件调整负样本结构采样与比较，保持预测服务路径不变。
AI.result: AUC达78.20%，14天线上人均曝光日GMV较基座提升3.06%，p95延迟为42.1毫秒。
AI.conclusion: 方法改善推荐收益且服务开销近乎不变，但搭售率低于Policies，取消指标区间上限超过预设界值。

title: Selective Sensor Acquisition for Multimodal Place Recognition
summary: Multimodal Place Recognition (PR) can improve robustness, but most systems rigidly read and process every sensor for every query, even when the primary sensor is sufficient, with implications for energy consumption, second sensor update rate, and domain-specific considerations such as passive stealth. We introduce selective, controllable sensor acquisition, where a user specifies a desired second sensor usage rate and the system acquires the additional sensor only when the primary sensor's estimated performance is sufficiently poor. An online threshold adjustment achieves the requested usage rate by adapting to recent primary sensor performance, directing additional sensing towards queries where fusion is most likely to help without calibration specific to sensor modality, PR method, or environment. The approach requires only a PR method that produces a match score and applies to both single-frame and sequence-based PR. Our system, across multiple datasets, PR descriptors, and sensor combinations, recovers 55% of the available PR performance gain while using the second sensor on only 25% of queries, and 81% while using it on 50%. We further analyse alternative acquisition decision mechanisms and usage-rate control methods, and examine performance when the second sensor is stronger than, comparable to, or weaker than the primary sensor.

AI.tldr: 按主传感器表现选择性启用第二传感器，可在控制使用率的同时保留较多地点识别融合收益。
AI.motivation: 多模态地点识别通常对每次查询读取全部传感器，带来不必要的能耗、更新率及隐蔽性代价。
AI.method: 利用匹配分数估计主传感器表现，在线调整启用阈值以达到用户指定使用率，无需场景或模态专门校准。
AI.result: 第二传感器仅用于25%和50%的查询时，分别恢复全部可用地点识别性能增益的55%和81%。
AI.conclusion: 该策略适用于单帧及序列地点识别，可按需分配额外感知资源并控制传感器使用率。

title: Routing Beyond Task Categories: A Cost-Aware LAB-Bench Study
summary: We tested whether features of biology questions or of a model's first answer can improve accuracy within an inference budget. In a LAB-Bench pilot, we compared a category router with one that adds six structural features. Neither reached the primary 80% accuracy target on development. At the 50% and 60% secondary targets, both chose Haiku for all 120 held-out questions and scored 71/120. We then froze a new comparison before collecting responses on 144 additional questions. Semantic routing scored 86/144. A policy that could defer after reading Haiku's answer scored 87/144. Both stayed within the inference budget of USD 0.678 per 1,000 queries. Against a 95% Haiku and 5% GPT mixture, the accuracy gains were 0.66 percentage points for semantic routing and 1.35 points for deferral. The paired 95% intervals were [-0.28,2.25] and [-0.14,3.47] points. A simple rule that escalated Haiku nonanswers scored 92/144 at USD 0.710 per 1,000 queries, above the budget. A retrospective nonanswer rule with a calibration-selected escalation probability gave an expected 85.63/144. At the learned deferral policy's observed inference cost, post hoc interpolation gave an expected 86.14/144. In a later development check, Astra and Gemini each scored 30/40. The best tested policy in each router family matched that score. The pair covered 33/40 in hindsight. The routers missed the 32/40 criterion, so the proposed 120-question evaluation did not start.
comment: 21 pages, 3 figures. Reproduction archive at this https URL

AI.tldr: LAB-Bench研究发现，预算内语义路由和回答后转交策略仅有小幅且不确定的准确率收益。
AI.motivation: 研究生物问题特征及模型首答信息能否在固定推理预算内提高回答准确率。
AI.method: 比较类别、结构特征、语义及回答后转交路由，并以独立题集测试准确率、成本及配对置信区间。
AI.result: 144题中语义路由答对86题、转交策略答对87题，均满足预算，但相对混合基线的增益区间均包含零。
AI.conclusion: 所测路由未达到预设准确率门槛，简单升级规则虽更准确却超预算，后续120题评估未启动。

title: MemEmo: Evaluating Emotion in Memory Systems
summary: Memory systems address the challenge of context loss in Large Language Models during prolonged interactions. However, as an essential tool for warm companionship and personalized services, the effectiveness of memory systems in processing affective information remains underexamined. To bridge this gap, we propose an emotion-enhanced memory evaluation benchmark to assess the performance of mainstream and state-of-the-art memory systems in integrating and harnessing emotional information. First, we design a benchmark called \textbf{MemEmo} to assess the affective reasoning and tracking capabilities of memory systems across four dimensions: emotional information extraction, emotional memory updating, emotional memory question-answering, and emotional conflict detection. Second, we construct the \textbf{H}uman-\textbf{L}ike \textbf{M}emory \textbf{E}motion (\textbf{HLME}) dataset to provide an empirical foundation for scrutinizing memory systems. Finally, We evaluate five representative memory systems on the HLME dataset, reporting 11 performance metrics across four dimensions. Experimental results reveal that aggregating scores for all tested memory systems is up to 45\%, far below 100\% scale, exposing a profound disparity between memory system and affective intelligence.

AI.tldr: MemEmo与HLME数据集用于评估记忆系统的情感能力，揭示现有系统明显不足。
AI.motivation: 记忆系统支持长期陪伴和个性化服务，但其处理与利用情感信息的能力缺乏系统评估。
AI.method: 构建HLME数据集，从情感提取、记忆更新、问答和冲突检测四维度，以11项指标评估五种记忆系统。
AI.result: 受测记忆系统的综合得分最高仅约45%，明显低于满分水平。
AI.conclusion: 现有记忆系统与所需情感智能之间仍存在显著差距，需要加强情感推理与追踪能力。

title: GainCtrl: Predicting Remaining Gains for Efficient LLM Agent Execution
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used to power agents that interact with tools and environments to solve complex tasks. Repeated attempts improve the quality of tool-using agents, but continued execution incurs additional costs even when it is unlikely to improve the best result ultimately returned. This raises the question of when to stop an attempt to reduce execution cost while preserving task-level Best-of-N quality. To address this question, we introduce GainCtrl, a gain-based execution controller for LLMs. In GainCtrl, a lightweight CPU predictor uses interaction histories to estimate expected positive gains over retained scores, which are then used to guide stopping decisions with calibrated thresholds to limit the loss in mean Best-of-N task quality. We evaluate the controller through trajectory replay across three environments and three LLM actors. Comparisons of interpolated quality-cost Pareto frontiers show that GainCtrl generally uses fewer tokens than baselines at matched target quality. Fixed policies also achieve quality close to that of full execution while substantially reducing token consumption. The predictor runs at millisecond latency on a single CPU thread, supporting repeated monitoring without access to LLM internals.

AI.tldr: GainCtrl预测智能体继续执行的剩余收益，以减少令牌消耗并尽量保持Best-of-N任务质量。
AI.motivation: 工具智能体重复尝试可提高结果质量，但继续执行未必改善最终最佳结果，却持续增加成本。
AI.method: 轻量CPU预测器依据交互历史估计相对保留得分的预期正收益，并以校准阈值决定何时停止。
AI.result: 在三个环境和三种模型的轨迹回放中，同等目标质量下通常更省令牌，预测器单CPU线程延迟为毫秒级。
AI.conclusion: 基于收益的停止控制无需访问模型内部，可低开销监测执行并改善质量与成本的权衡。

title: CLIFT: Contrastive LiDAR Instance Features for 3D Pedestrian Tracking
summary: A social robot has to keep track of the people around it over time to plan its motion, a task handled by 3D multi-object tracking. For the LiDAR modality, trackers usually sit on top of a detector and link its detections across frames with a separate motion model or re-identification network. We instead show how a 3D LiDAR detector itself can be turned into a tracker by adding an instance-level contrastive objective on its intermediate voxel features. Each embedding is read from the voxels inside a detected box, and boxes are matched across frames by cosine similarity and the Hungarian algorithm, without a motion model. The detector backbone is fine-tuned together with this objective, which learns identity-aware features while leaving detection accuracy essen- tially intact. Because the method uses only the voxel features that Li- DAR detectors already produce, it is backbone-agnostic. On the JRDB 3D tracking leaderboard our LiDAR-only tracker ranks first on HOTA (38.58) and IDF1 (37.99), 13.04 and 9.30 points above the next pub- lished method, and second on MOTA and OSPA. Code is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: CLIFT在激光雷达检测器中学习实例对比特征，无需运动模型即可实现高性能三维行人跟踪。
AI.motivation: 社交机器人需要持续跟踪周围行人，而现有激光雷达方案通常额外依赖运动模型或重识别网络。
AI.method: 联合微调检测骨干与体素实例对比目标，从检测框内提取表示，以余弦相似度和匈牙利算法跨帧匹配。
AI.result: JRDB榜单HOTA为38.58、IDF1为37.99，均列首位，分别领先下一已发表方法13.04和9.30点。
AI.conclusion: 复用检测器体素特征可学习身份感知表示，在基本保持检测精度的同时实现不依赖特定骨干的跟踪。

title: Robotic Reward Models in the Foundation-Model Era
summary: Robotic reward models (RRMs) use foundation models to replace per-task reward engineering with reusable, task-conditioned evaluation. Yet under one name, their outputs answer different questions, from whether a task succeeded to which execution is better. This survey organizes 114 methods into five semantic families by the question their native outputs answer: Outcome, Absolute Progress, Relative, Temporal Value, and Hybrid. Within this taxonomy, we review how model design determines what an evaluator can judge, how raw experience becomes supervision, and how existing evaluation practice tests the result. The review exposes a gap: agreement with demonstration order and downstream policy gains do not show whether a reward tracks task fulfillment. We therefore introduce RRM-Bench-1K, 1,117 real-robot videos of closed-loop executions with task-state and camera-evidence labels, and four contrast suites that separate the credited condition from its usual cues. A unified study of 27 evaluators shows that the strongest final scores rank whole executions well enough for selection and filtering. Dense credit, however, follows the progression of an execution more closely than its task state, and no evaluator signals when the decisive view is missing. How much fidelity a reward model needs therefore depends on the decision it drives. We outline directions from real-failure supervision to metrics that separate task state from chronology, and open-source RRM-Hub, a toolbox in which 14 existing RRMs can be readily applied and new evaluators tested on the same capabilities.

AI.tldr: 该研究梳理机器人奖励模型并建立真实机器人评测，揭示整体排序能力与稠密任务状态判断的差距。
AI.motivation: 机器人奖励模型输出语义各异，现有排序一致性和策略收益评估不足以证明奖励反映任务完成程度。
AI.method: 将114种方法分为五类，构建含1117段视频及四组对照测试的RRM-Bench-1K，统一评估27种评价器。
AI.result: 最强评价器能有效排序完整执行，但稠密奖励更随执行进程而非任务状态变化，且均无法提示关键视角缺失。
AI.conclusion: 奖励模型所需保真度取决于其支持的决策，应加强真实失败监督及区分任务状态与时间进程的评估。

title: A Seismic Foundation Model for Dense Feature Extraction
summary: Deep-learning-based seismic interpretation is constrained by scarce high-quality annotations, and most existing models are trained separately for individual tasks. We present SeisDFE, a 7B-parameter seismic foundation model for dense feature extraction, pretrained on 5.34 million 2D images derived from more than 500 seismic volumes. A three-stage pretraining strategy, combining discriminative self-supervised learning, Gram feature anchoring, and multi-resolution adaptation, improves feature discriminability while preserving spatial coherence. With its encoder frozen, SeisDFE supports seismic facies classification, salt detection, fault detection, and relative geologic time estimation. It outperforms existing seismic foundation models on all four tasks and a natural-image-pretrained model on all but fault detection, with the largest gains under scarce supervision: using only two annotated sections of the F3 dataset, it improves whole-volume mIoU by 12-19 percentage points over the baselines. The learned features remain effective with task-specific decoders and extend to synthetic-to-field transfer and sparse 3D geobody interpretation. These results show that large-scale seismic pretraining organizes geological information into dense representations that are directly reusable across interpretation tasks.

AI.tldr: SeisDFE通过大规模地震数据预训练，提供可跨多种解释任务复用的稠密特征。
AI.motivation: 地震解释缺乏高质量标注，且现有模型多针对单一任务分别训练。
AI.method: 以534万张地震图像预训练70亿参数模型，结合判别式自监督、Gram特征锚定与多分辨率适配。
AI.result: 四项任务均优于现有地震基础模型，F3仅用两张标注剖面时全体积mIoU提升12至19个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 大规模地震预训练可形成保留空间结构的地质表征，支持少标注解释及跨域迁移。

title: NL2RCtrl: Risk-Controlled Controller Synthesis from Natural Language Requirements
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have enabled the translation of natural language (NL) requirements into linear temporal logic (LTL) specifications, facilitating controller synthesis for cyber-physical systems (CPSs). However, the reliability of such translations remains a concern in safety-critical applications, particularly when NL requirements are ambiguous. This paper proposes a framework based on Conformal Risk Control (CRC) to provide a statistical guarantee on the risk of issuing a controller that violates the user's intended requirement. Rather than requiring semantic equivalence between the generated and intended specifications, the proposed approach considers language inclusion, a sufficient condition for ensuring that the traces of a controller synthesized for the generated specification satisfy the intended requirement. To account for ambiguity, the LLM is queried multiple times, and the resulting LTL specifications are grouped into semantic equivalence classes and ranked by their frequency of occurrence. Given a prescribed risk level, CRC selects how many of the top-ranked equivalence classes to combine into a single LTL specification, such that the probability of issuing a controller that violates the intended requirement is bounded by that level. A controller is then synthesized for the resulting specification, or the framework abstains. Experiments on a vehicle navigation case study evaluate the proposed approach.

AI.tldr: NL2RCtrl利用共形风险控制，为自然语言需求驱动的控制器合成提供统计风险保障。
AI.motivation: 自然语言需求存在歧义，语言模型生成时序逻辑规范的可靠性难以满足安全关键应用。
AI.method: 多次生成LTL规范并按语义等价类频率排序，以共形风险控制选择合并范围，再合成控制器或弃权。
AI.result: 框架将发出违背用户意图的控制器的概率限制在预设水平，摘要未提供车辆导航实验的具体结果。
AI.conclusion: 基于语言包含关系而非语义等价，可在需求歧义下实现具统计风险保障的控制器合成。

title: Who Benefits from Telemonitoring? Uplift Modelling of a Nationwide Home Blood Pressure Monitoring Programme
summary: Home blood pressure (BP) telemonitoring programmes are being deployed at national scale, yet enrolment resources are finite and the benefit of telemonitoring is unlikely to be uniform across patients. We study the Primary Technology-Enhanced Care for Hypertension (PTEC-HT) programme, a nationwide telemonitoring programme for hypertensive patients in Singapore. Using retrospective data on 16,694 patients registered between August 2020 and May 2024, we first estimate the average treatment effect of the programme on 6-month BP control against a propensity-score-matched non-participant cohort, finding an absolute improvement of 5 percentage points in the rate of BP control (74% vs. 69%, $p = 3\times10^{-12}$), rising to 12 percentage points (63% vs. 50%, $p = 1\times10^{-15}$) among patients with uncontrolled BP at baseline. We then move beyond the average effect and apply uplift modelling to estimate individual treatment effects. Across five uplift learners evaluated with 5-fold cross-validation and Qini curves, an uplift random forest performed best on the full cohort and an S-learner on the uncontrolled-baseline subcohort, although performance bands overlapped across learners. On held-out patients, realised uplift was largest in the top predicted-uplift groups and declined across the ranking. These patients had higher baseline BP grade, more recent hypertension diagnosis and lower medication and diagnosis burden, a profile we offer as hypothesis-generating for targeted enrolment. A handcrafted rule built from these features was competitive with the learned models, outperforming all of them on the uncontrolled-baseline cohort, suggesting that uplift models are useful for discovering heterogeneity that can be distilled into simple enrolment criteria for directing limited care team capacity.

AI.tldr: 新加坡家庭血压远程监测项目呈现疗效异质性，增益建模可辅助发现优先入组人群。
AI.motivation: 全国远程监测项目的入组资源有限，而不同患者获得的收益可能不同。
AI.method: 分析16694名患者的回顾性数据，结合倾向评分匹配、五种增益学习器及交叉验证估计干预收益。
AI.result: 六个月血压控制率总体提高5个百分点，基线未控制者提高12个百分点，简单规则在该亚组优于各模型。
AI.conclusion: 增益模型发现的异质性可提炼为简单入组标准，但高收益患者特征仍属于假设生成性发现。

title: A Lifted Hessian-Riemannian Gradient Flow for LQR Synthesis under Passivity Constraints
summary: The static state-feedback gain that renders a linear system passive at an external port and minimizes a linear quadratic regulator (LQR) cost cannot be computed by convex optimization, since the passivity certificate and the LQR cost are coupled bilinearly through the common gain. A previous indirect approach restricts the gain to a convex inner approximation of the passivity region, which is conservative and whose construction scales exponentially with the number of gain entries. This paper proposes a direct approach. The set of strictly passivating gains is the image of a convex lifted set of inverse storage matrices and transformed gains. We describe this set by a strict linear matrix inequality and an affine equality for every feedthrough matrix with positive semidefinite symmetric part, including feedthrough matrices with a singular symmetric part, and minimize the LQR cost over it by a gradient flow whose metric is the Hessian of a logarithmic barrier. For multi-input systems, this Hessian is singular along gain changes that preserve the storage function, and we complete the metric along these directions by the metric of the gain space. We prove that the flow exists for all times, that every gain along the flow is strictly passivating with an explicit storage function, and that the cost decreases monotonically while the gains remain in a compact set of stabilizing gains. Numerical examples show that the flow attains a lower cost than the indirect approach, that the completion is required for multi-input systems, and that the flow can converge to a local minimizer on nonconvex passivity regions.

AI.tldr: 提出提升空间中的海森黎曼梯度流，直接优化无源性约束下的LQR状态反馈增益。
AI.motivation: 无源性证书与LQR代价通过增益双线性耦合，既有凸内近似方法保守且构造成本呈指数增长。
AI.method: 以严格线性矩阵不等式和仿射等式构造凸提升集，采用对数障碍海森度量并补全多输入奇异方向。
AI.result: 证明流全时存在、保持严格无源性且代价单调下降，数值示例所得代价低于既有间接方法。
AI.conclusion: 该直接方法避免保守内近似，并可在非凸无源增益区域收敛至局部极小点。

title: STA: A Split Temporal Adversary Method for Evaluating Robustness of Multimodal RL-based Driving Policies
summary: Multimodal reinforcement learning (MRL) offers a promising paradigm for autonomous driving by jointly leveraging complementary sensor observations to learn effective decision-making policies. However, its effectiveness critically depends on temporal alignment across modalities, making temporal inconsistency a fundamental vulnerability. Even subtle misalignment or latency can corrupt fused representations and ultimately lead to decision failures. Existing studies have explored adversarial attacks to induce cross-modal temporal inconsistencies, thereby enabling systematic evaluation of the temporal robustness of MRL policies. However, existing methods remain limited in generality, realism, and adaptivity. To address these limitations, we propose the Split Temporal Adversary (STA), which formulates multimodal temporal attacks as a unified decision process that jointly optimizes attack timing and modality selection under realistic policy-aware and budget-constrained settings. STA includes two mechanisms: a) a unified multimodal temporal perturbation mechanism that delays observations via historical states, removing the need for modality-specific noise; b) a split multimodal adversarial decision mechanism that jointly optimizes attack timing and modality selection through adaptive optimization while leveraging the victim policy's clean actions to identify sensitive decision patterns. We provide a theoretical analysis of the induced distribution shift and a modality selection principle. Experiments in the CARLA simulator show that STA more than doubles the collision rate of the strongest baseline against PPO while using 17.8\% fewer attack attempts, and that it generalizes to a VLM-based driving policy. These results reveal temporal consistency as a critical vulnerability, highlighting temporal robustness as essential for safe autonomous driving.

AI.tldr: STA通过联合选择攻击时机与模态，评估多模态强化学习驾驶策略的时间鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 跨模态时间错位会破坏驾驶决策，而现有时间攻击在通用性、真实性和自适应性上受限。
AI.method: 利用历史状态延迟观测，在预算约束下结合受害策略的干净动作，自适应优化攻击时机与模态选择。
AI.result: CARLA中针对PPO的碰撞率超过最强基线两倍，攻击次数减少17.8%，并可迁移至视觉语言驾驶策略。
AI.conclusion: 时间一致性是多模态驾驶策略的重要脆弱点，安全自动驾驶需重视时间鲁棒性。

title: UNITE: Consolidating Embodied VLM Specialists via Shared-Anchor One-Bit Factorization
summary: Embodied capabilities such as visual grounding, spatial reasoning, navigation, and driving understanding are often developed in separate vision-language specialists fine-tuned from a common pretrained this http URL the specialists separately multiplies storage, whereas merging them into one dense model forces conflicting task updates to share parameters and loses part of each specialist's this http URL introduce UNITE, a framework that consolidates such specialists into a compact shared-backbone mixture of experts. UNITE keeps the feed-forward block of each specialist as a routable expert and represents the expert bank through a shared-anchor one-bit factorization: a shared floating-point anchor plus expert-specific, row-scaled binary this http URL anchor is optimized jointly with the scales and signs through closed-form alternating updates, using only source weights and no calibration this http URL adaptation then adjusts token-level expert selection with the backbone and experts frozen, updating fewer than $0.6$M parameters ($<0.01\%$ of the $8.8$B active parameters). Built from four Qwen3-VL-8B specialists, the complete UNITE model occupies $20.3$ GB, $1.16\times$ the storage of one dense specialist and $59.6\%$ below the uncompressed MoE. Across $22$ benchmarks and R2R Val-Unseen, UNITE matches six static merging methods in mean retention of best-specialist performance, leads all of them on Scan2Cap, ScanQA, and all four navigation metrics, and surpasses every source specialist on all five 3D scene understanding benchmarks (up to $+19.1$ on Scan2Cap) and on R2R navigation. Relative to the uncompressed MoE, factorization is nearly lossless on $21$ of $22$ benchmarks; the exception is VSI-Bench, where frame-count experiments suggest impaired use of cross-frame this http URL thus consolidates complementary embodied capabilities near single-model storage.

AI.tldr: UNITE以共享锚点单比特分解，将多个具身视觉语言专家整合为接近单模型存储的混合专家模型。
AI.motivation: 独立部署专家会增加存储，而稠密合并会因任务更新冲突损失专家能力。
AI.method: 保留专家前馈块，以共享浮点锚点和专家二值残差压缩，仅用源权重交替优化，再冻结主体适配路由。
AI.result: 模型占20.3GB，较未压缩混合专家节省59.6%，22项基准中21项分解近乎无损。
AI.conclusion: UNITE能以接近单模型的存储整合互补具身能力，但VSI-Bench表现提示跨帧信息利用受损。

title: Deep Learning for Satellite-Based Mountain Hazard Screening: A Retrospective Failure Analysis on the 2021 Chamoli Rock-Ice Avalanche
summary: The approach utilizes 10 bands from Sentinel-2 imagery, along with terrain information, in a deep learning pipeline to classify potential hazard sources in any given mountainous region. The performance of our model has been evaluated against the data collected during the rock-ice avalanche event in the Chamoli region in the Indian Himalayas on 7th February 2021. U-Net performs segmentation of the detected land surface in the satellite image, detects changes in the identify candidate hazard zones, and then the following steps are performed to calculate the potential energy using the Monte Carlo sampling for steepest descent (D8) flow paths, finding the exposed structures in the downstream locations, and ranking the zones depending on the risk score. In comparison to the simple spectral rule, our approach achieved the higher macro F1 score of 0.648 (as compared to 0.519). But the F1 score in case of rock and soil was low, being in the range of 0.3s. In case of optical change detection in winter, it's only that northeast-facing slope which couldn't be detected, as it was under 73% of shade prior to the incident. The parameters have been set for this particular scene alone and not independently; hence, this is a retrospective test, and this test locates a failure which has occurred earlier. The primary contribution of this paper is locating the pipeline leak.

AI.tldr: 基于Chamoli雪崩的回顾性分析显示，卫星深度学习灾害筛查仍受阴影和地表分类失误限制。
AI.motivation: 山区潜在灾源筛查需要结合地表变化、下游暴露与风险评估，并识别流程中的失效环节。
AI.method: 融合Sentinel-2十波段与地形，用U-Net分割及变化检测定位候选区，再以D8路径蒙特卡洛采样评估风险。
AI.result: 宏F1为0.648，高于光谱规则的0.519，但岩土类别F1仅约0.3，阴影覆盖导致东北向坡面漏检。
AI.conclusion: 场景专门调参使其仅属回顾性测试，主要贡献是揭示流程失效，而非证明前瞻预测能力。

title: Non-Imaging Optical Tactile Sensors for Robotics: Transduction Principles, System Integration, and Robotic Applications
summary: Non-imaging optical tactile sensors encode contact through changes in optical intensity, wavelength, spectra, or photon counts, offering diverse architectures for robotic touch. Their usefulness depends on whether contact variables can be reliably distinguished from coupled mechanical and environmental effects, and whether the resulting information can be delivered in time to guide action. This review develops a unified framework linking mechanical load transmission, optical encoding, readout, and tactile inference to robotic task requirements. It examines reflective and waveguide-based devices, micro/nanofibers, fiber gratings, interferometric and resonant structures, and mechanoluminescent composites. Three considerations emerge across these approaches. First, high optical sensitivity supports accurate tactile estimation only when target variables remain identifiable under the relevant contact and calibration conditions. Second, spatial coverage and feedback timing must be assessed at the system level, accounting for multiplexing, acquisition, demodulation, and inference. Third, device characterization, offline recognition, and closed-loop robotic performance provide distinct levels of evidence and require different evaluation criteria. Representative studies illustrate how these considerations shape force estimation, contact localization, slip correction and distributed interaction. This review concludes with priorities for calibration transfer, reliable interfaces, scalable readout, and task-based validation, providing a basis for selecting and developing non-imaging optical tactile architectures for robotics.

AI.tldr: 综述以统一框架分析非成像光学触觉传感器，强调可辨识性、系统时延与机器人任务验证。
AI.motivation: 光学触觉的实用性取决于能否区分接触变量与机械环境耦合效应，并及时提供动作反馈。
AI.method: 串联机械载荷传递、光学编码、读出与触觉推断，比较反射、波导、光纤及机械发光等架构。
AI.result: 综述归纳三项核心考量：变量可辨识性、系统级覆盖与时序，以及器件、离线和闭环证据的区别。
AI.conclusion: 未来应优先推进校准迁移、可靠接口、可扩展读出和面向任务的验证。

title: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB: An Open and Efficient Small Language Model for Fast Conversational Agents
summary: We introduce Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB, an open and efficient small language model further post-trained from Gemma-4-E4B-it and optimized for speed and intelligence per GB of memory used for fast conversational agents. The model carries forward Gemma's strong conversational capabilities and further improves multi-turn tool use, instruction following, and input grounding for fast, local voice/device assistants, interactive personas, and embedded/Edge interfaces. The model combines natural conversation with multi-turn agentic capabilities to power voice/device assistants, interactive characters and robotic/IoT interfaces running on GeForce RTX, Jetson, and RTX/DGX Spark. Experiments on 21 benchmarks show that Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB achieves the highest average accuracy while generating the fewest output tokens in both reasoning and non-reasoning modes, compared with Gemma-4-E4B-it and Qwen3.5-4B. The model is released with a DFlash drafter. With DFlash, Bolt E4B achieves $2.74\times$ the per-user decode speed of inference without speculative decoding at concurrency~1, and $1.21\times$ the generation throughput of Gemma-4-E4B-it with MTP at batch size 1.
comment: Animated versions of Figure 3 are available in the blog: this https URL

AI.tldr: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB面向快速对话智能体，兼顾准确率、内存效率与生成速度。
AI.motivation: 本地语音、设备与边缘助手需要在有限内存下实现高效对话和多轮工具调用。
AI.method: 基于Gemma-4-E4B-it进一步后训练，增强工具使用、指令遵循与输入依据性，并配套DFlash推测解码。
AI.result: 在21项基准中平均准确率最高且输出最少；DFlash使单并发解码速度达到非推测解码的2.74倍。
AI.conclusion: 该开放小模型为本地对话智能体提供了兼顾智能表现与推理效率的选择。

title: Co-simulation-Based Safety-Assessment of Black-Box Maritime Cyber-Physical Systems
summary: Modern maritime cyber-physical systems consist of tightly interconnected subsystems ranging from multiple engineering domains, making exhaustive safety verification impractical. Simulation-based testing offers a scalable alternative, while co-simulation enables heterogeneous subsystem models, potentially developed by different stakeholders, to be integrated without requiring access to their internal implementations. Adaptive Stress-Testing further improves testing efficiency by formulating failure discovery as a sequential decision-making problem, guiding the search toward the most likely failure scenarios, and giving the counter safety examples using reinforcement learning. However, black-box co-simulation may provide only partial access to the system state required by conventional Markov decision process formulations. To address this limitation, we proposed Event-Based Adaptive Stress-Testing version 2, a co-simulation-based safety-assessment method formulated as a partially observable Markov decision process. This method employs Recurrent Proximal Policy Optimization to exploit observation histories when selecting adversarial actions. The method is evaluated on a ship-in-transit operation in which a collision-avoidance system is stress-tested against multi-adversarial target ships. An extended Intermediate Waypoint Sampling mechanism enables independent multi-adversary trajectory control and supports the generation of realistic collision-inducing scenarios. The experiment demonstrate that the learned stress-testing policy generalizes across different encounter cases, can be further improved through continued training, and can be made effective when the collision- avoidance system under test is replaced by another version. These results demonstrate the method's potential for scalable black-box safety assessment of complex maritime cyber-physical systems.

AI.tldr: 事件驱动自适应压力测试第二版利用部分可观测建模，实现海事黑箱系统的联合仿真安全评估。
AI.motivation: 复杂海事系统难以穷尽验证，且黑箱联合仿真无法提供传统马尔可夫建模所需的完整状态。
AI.method: 将故障搜索建模为部分可观测决策过程，以循环近端策略优化和扩展航路点采样控制多个对抗目标船。
AI.result: 学得的压力测试策略可泛化至不同会遇场景，经持续训练进一步改善，并能适配另一版本的避碰系统。
AI.conclusion: 该方法展现了对复杂海事信息物理系统进行可扩展黑箱安全评估的潜力。

title: EEGProbe: Do Vision-Language Models Really Understand EEG? A Benchmark for Signal-Grounded EEG Signals Evaluation
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown strong multimodal capabilities across scientific and biomedical domains, yet their ability to understand electroencephalography (EEG) signals remains unclear. We introduce EEGProbe, a signal-grounded benchmark for evaluating whether general-purpose VLMs can extract and reason from minimally processed, channel-wise EEG without task-specific feature engineering or EEG-specific adaptation. EEGProbe contains 620 EEG-centered questions across 13 subtasks and three capability categories: EEG Signal Classification, EEG Cross-modal Alignment, and EEG Neurophysiological Reasoning. To reduce shortcut-based answering, EEGProbe preserves the temporal structure of the recordings where possible, minimizes benchmark-induced processing, and applies signal-necessity testing followed by expert verification. We evaluate 11 representative open- and closed-source VLMs under a unified zero-shot protocol. The strongest model, GPT-5.6 Sol, achieves an overall score of only 41.63\%, with cross-modal EEG alignment emerging as a major bottleneck. We further examine model behavior from a neurophysiological perspective and analyze how temporal, spectral, spatial, and physiological EEG structure relates to model successes and failures. Inference-time neurophysiological guidance can reshape model predictions by helping models recognize the neurophysiological patterns present in the input and connect them with relevant neurological knowledge, narrowing the gap between general multimodal competence and EEG understanding. EEGProbe provides a testbed for current VLMs and a basis for developing future multimodal models that can interpret EEG evidence more reliably. The EEGProbe benchmark will be publicly available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: EEGProbe评测视觉语言模型对脑电信号的理解，发现其整体能力有限且跨模态对齐尤为薄弱。
AI.motivation: 通用视觉语言模型能否直接依据少量处理的脑电信号进行识别和推理，尚不明确。
AI.method: 构建含620题、13项子任务的基准，经信号必要性测试与专家核验，对11个模型开展统一零样本评测。
AI.result: 最强模型GPT-5.6 Sol总分仅为41.63%，跨模态脑电对齐是主要瓶颈，推理时神经生理引导可调整预测。
AI.conclusion: EEGProbe为检验与改进模型基于脑电证据的可靠理解能力提供了测试平台。

title: Verification-Guided Safety-Repair of Learned Controllers
summary: Formal verification can certify that a learned controller is safe. But what should be done when verification fails? Simply suppressing actions that lead to unsafe next states is insufficient because the dangerous action that ultimately caused the safety violation might have occurred many steps earlier. Retraining modifies the policy globally, thereby potentially introducing new failures. Instead, we introduce ReachECO, a verification-guided repair procedure that exploits the information of failed multi-step reachability analysis for synthesizing explicit constraints on controller behavior. For Differentiable Weightless Controllers, the repairs compile into exact circuit patches that leave the controller unchanged everywhere outside the targeted policy cells. We prove soundness and termination of the repair procedure for ReachECO, as well as, assuming exhaustive continuation search, completeness relative to the reachability abstraction. Empirically, we demonstrate \method's ability to successfully repair otherwise unsafe controllers in three continuous-control benchmarks: ACC, Docking2D and Car2D.

AI.tldr: ReachECO利用形式验证失败信息局部修复学习控制器，避免全局重训改变无关策略区域。
AI.motivation: 危险动作可能早于最终违规多步发生，单步动作屏蔽不足，而全局重训可能引入新故障。
AI.method: 从失败的多步可达性分析合成行为约束，并为可微无权重控制器编译仅作用于目标策略单元的精确电路补丁。
AI.result: 证明修复过程的可靠性与终止性及条件完备性，并在ACC、Docking2D和Car2D上成功修复不安全控制器。
AI.conclusion: 验证引导的局部修复可在保持目标区域外控制行为不变的同时纠正安全缺陷。

title: ThermoSight: From Appearance to Internal Thermofluid Fields via Physics-Guided Neural Reconstruction
summary: Most neural reconstruction methods focus on reproducing scene appearance, yet inferring physical states from visual observations is essential for machine understanding of the physical world. Reconstructing the internal temperature and soot fields of radiating thermofluids such as flames is challenging yet essential for improving energy efficiency and assessing heat exposure and fire spread. In flames, temperature and soot concentration jointly govern visible emission, and soot self-absorption alters the light that reaches each camera. With limited views, changes in the two fields can offset one another in the recorded RGB images, making temperature and soot difficult to disentangle. ThermoSight, a physics-guided neural framework for scientific imaging, jointly reconstructs continuous three-dimensional temperature and soot volume fraction fields from limited calibrated flame images without field-level ground truth during optimization. A differentiable spectral model links these fields to measured RGB through thermal emission, self-absorption, and calibrated camera responses. Temperature-dependent emission spectra and wavelength-dependent attenuation constrain shared fields across RGB channels, reducing temperature-soot ambiguity. Chromaticity consistency, observation-derived spatial constraints, and soot regularization complement intensity fitting. In a synthetic ablation, wavelength-resolved attenuation reduces temperature RMSE in the hot, sooty region from 234 to 112 K relative to a three-channel approximation, with nearly identical RGB PSNR (65.23 vs. 65.24 dB). Measured data yield coherent fields and competitive RGB reconstructions. These results demonstrate that physics-guided neural fields recover interpretable internal physical quantities beyond visually consistent appearance.

AI.tldr: ThermoSight通过物理引导神经重建，从有限火焰图像联合恢复内部三维温度与烟炱场。
AI.motivation: 温度与烟炱共同影响辐射并可相互补偿，使有限视角RGB图像难以区分两者。
AI.method: 用可微光谱模型连接热辐射、自吸收与相机响应，并结合色度一致性、空间约束和烟炱正则化进行优化。
AI.result: 合成消融中，波长分辨衰减将高温多烟炱区温度RMSE从234降至112 K，而RGB重建质量几乎不变。
AI.conclusion: 物理引导神经场可超越外观一致性，恢复具有可解释性的内部物理量。

title: PhaseCLIP: Phase-Aware Frequency-Domain Adaptation of Vision-Language Models for Few-Shot Remote-Sensing Classification
summary: Remote-sensing (RS) image scene classification aims to assign a semantic category to an overhead image, and in practice must often do so from only a handful of labelled examples, since annotation requires expert interpretation and the resulting labels transfer poorly across sensors and regions. Recent progress has come from adapting vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP, through learned prompts or feature adapters. Although effective, these methods construct their representation entirely in the spatial domain. RS scenes are dominated by periodic texture and regular geometry, which the Fourier spectrum describes compactly through an amplitude component, carrying texture and contrast statistics, and a phase component, carrying spatial structure. Existing frequency-domain adaptation of VLMs either exploits amplitude alone or does not separate amplitude from phase, leaving the structural component unused. In this article, we propose PhaseCLIP, which inserts phase-capable spectral modules and a feature-gating module into a frozen CLIP visual encoder and trains only 1.30% of its parameters. Because the amplitude and phase pathways share an identical parameter layout, a single weight set is learned on phase and transferred exactly to amplitude, giving a two-stage scheme that adds no parameters. Experiments on five public RS datasets, EuroSAT, PatternNet, UC Merced, LSRS and RSSCN7, against eight baselines under a matched protocol, show that PhaseCLIP attains 84.28% mean accuracy and is the best method in 23 of 30 dataset-by-shot cells, with phase contributing 1.93 points overall and 4.36 points on the most difficult dataset. Because the modules act on the spectrum of image patches and transformer tokens and leave the text encoder untouched, the approach can be extended to other RS sensors and tasks, and to other domains in which class evidence lies in spatial structure.
comment: 23 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. Code will be released at this https URL upon publication

AI.tldr: PhaseCLIP利用相位感知频域适配，提升CLIP在少样本遥感场景分类中的表现。
AI.motivation: 遥感标注稀缺，而现有适配方法未充分利用傅里叶相位所携带的空间结构信息。
AI.method: 在冻结的CLIP视觉编码器中插入频谱与特征门控模块，仅训练1.30%参数，并将相位学习权重迁移至幅度分支。
AI.result: 五个数据集上平均准确率达84.28%，在30种数据集与样本数组合中的23种最优，相位整体贡献1.93个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 显式利用相位结构信息可高效增强少样本遥感分类，并具有向其他传感器、任务与领域扩展的潜力。

title: VA-Assembly: View-Aligned Score Guidance for Training-Free 3D Part Assembly
summary: Image-to-3D foundation models have improved 3D reconstruction, but typically produce monolithic representations without explicit part-level structure. Part-aware generation and learning-based assembly methods often require part-level supervision, category-specific priors, or paired part-layout training data. We instead consider a practical but underexplored setting in which independently prepared or generated 3D parts have no predefined inter-part relationships, shared coordinate frames, or consistent scales, and must be assembled into a reference-consistent object from a single image. We present VA-Assembly, a training-free framework for 3D part assembly through part-level transformation estimation using view-aligned diffusion guidance. Given a reference image and fixed 3D part geometries, VA-Assembly optimizes each part's translation, rotation, and scale. We condition a frozen view-conditioned diffusion model on same-view renderings of a reference-derived monolithic 3D representation, producing score gradients geometrically aligned with the part configuration. This guidance provides multi-view structural cues under large initial misalignment. By repurposing pretrained visual-structural priors as transformation-level supervision, VA-Assembly requires no annotated part layouts, predefined part taxonomies, category-specific assembly training, or bounding-box-based layout initialization. Experiments compare VA-Assembly with geometric registration and compositional layout baselines using each baseline's supported transformation components, showing improved part-wise transformation estimation. Ablation studies show that view-aligned conditioning, rather than diffusion guidance alone, is critical for reliable transformation gradients. Updating only part transformations preserves explicit component separability and supports component-level editing, replacement, and reconfiguration.

AI.tldr: VA-Assembly通过视图对齐扩散引导，无需训练即可将独立三维部件组装为符合单张参考图的物体。
AI.motivation: 独立部件常缺少关系、统一坐标系和尺度，而现有组装方法通常依赖部件监督或类别先验。
AI.method: 以参考图生成的整体三维表示提供同视角条件，利用冻结扩散模型优化各部件的平移、旋转和缩放。
AI.result: 实验显示部件变换估计优于所比较基线，消融表明视图对齐条件是获得可靠变换梯度的关键。
AI.conclusion: 该方法无需标注布局或类别专用训练，且保持部件独立性，支持编辑、替换和重组。

title: QTOP: Scaling Humanoid Motion Tracking with Quantile Critics
summary: Learning human motion tracking policies through reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a core capability that underpins a majority of recent progress in humanoid whole-body control. However, achieving generalization to unseen motions at high fidelity requires jointly scaling training to thousands of GPU and dataset hours. This work hypothesizes that motion tracking is inherently compute-bound because training on a diverse set of motions introduces learning interference, similar to multi-task RL. To tackle this, we propose Quantile Tracking Optimization (QTOP), which improves sample efficiency by introducing a distributional advantage estimate conditioned on state and reference pairs. QTOP outperforms on and off-policy RL baselines both in simulation and real-world tracking scenarios on multiple datasets by up to 10\%. Furthermore, we establish a scaling law for QTOP and find that, aside from scaling predictably, dataset size has minimal impact on performance for moderately sized GPU hour regimes.

AI.tldr: QTOP通过分位数评论器与分布式优势估计，提高人形机器人动作跟踪的强化学习效率。
AI.motivation: 多样动作训练存在类似多任务学习的干扰，高保真泛化需要大量计算资源。
AI.method: 提出以状态和参考动作对为条件的分布式优势估计，并分析训练计算量与数据规模的缩放规律。
AI.result: 在多数据集的仿真与真实跟踪中较同策略和离策略基线最多提升10%，中等计算预算下数据规模影响较小。
AI.conclusion: QTOP改善了动作跟踪的样本效率，并呈现可预测的性能缩放规律。

title: TRR: A Thermal Interaction Engine for Robot Simulation and RGBT Data Generation
summary: A robot's actions change the thermal conditions of its next interaction: heat retained after release, carried with objects or stored beneath the surface can change a later contact's outcome despite similar current temperatures. Training trajectories must capture how these effects connect earlier actions to later observations and task outcomes. We present TRR, a \emph{Thermal Robot Renderer} that attaches spatial and depth-resolved thermal state to both contact partners, updates local heat exchange through contact, transport and separation, and generates synchronized RGB--thermal (RGBT) observations and event-local task checks on one execution clock. Controlled interventions show why retained heat, spatial transport and internal storage matter for subsequent contact outcomes. From the same state, TRR produces a paired six-task benchmark of 2,224 static--dynamic pairs, that is, 4,448 trajectories with synchronized dual-view observations, states and actions. Visible thermal history raises safe contact-site selection from 75.0\% to 91.7\% on a dedicated learning corpus, and training on dynamic histories raises simulated transfer completion by 50 percentage points under a new heating procedure with shared feedback execution. We demonstrate RGBT observation adapters on MuJoCo and Isaac Sim, report an engineering inventory of ten prepared robot configurations and six demonstrated camera viewpoints, and describe a developer workflow that carries an existing robot scene to exported RGBT records. The benchmark, the workflow and the platform resources described in Section 6 form the first items of a planned public release. Demonstrations and resource updates are available on the project page.

AI.tldr: TRR通过追踪接触双方的时空热状态，支持机器人热交互仿真与同步RGBT数据生成。
AI.motivation: 机器人先前动作留下的余热、热量迁移与内部储热会影响后续接触，训练轨迹需保留这些历史。
AI.method: 为接触双方建立空间及深度分辨热状态，模拟接触、搬运和分离中的热交换，并同步输出观测与任务检查。
AI.result: 生成4448条六任务轨迹；可见热历史使安全接触点选择率从75.0%升至91.7%，动态历史训练使仿真迁移完成率提高50个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 热历史对后续接触结果具有重要影响，TRR为相关学习与评测提供统一仿真和数据工作流。

title: Regularizing Treatment Leakage for LLM-based Uplift Estimation
summary: Uplift modeling estimates the conditional average treatment effect (CATE) and supports industrial decisions such as promotional pricing. When large language models (LLMs) encode product text, treatment-revealing content can introduce shortcuts that do not transfer to deployment. We propose \emph{LLM-based Uplift Leakage Regularization} (\textsc{LULR}), which uses a CLUB-based penalty on the causal head's trainable shared representation while keeping the LLM encoder frozen. Controlled proxy experiments show a positive ranking-score interaction and higher scores than the tested weight-decay configuration; treatment-dependent evaluation limits their interpretation to exploratory model behavior. Structured-only comparisons provide reference performance, without establishing a general advantage over tree-based estimators. On a million-record industrial pricing RCT, \textsc{LULR} improves offline $\text{lift@}0.3$ in $4/5$ seeds, although the difference is not statistically significant and estimated policy values are near-tied. A separate one-week online A/B experiment records $5.45\%$ higher sales volume and $1.91\%$ higher GMV than the control arm. These aggregate results provide short-term business evidence for the complete deployed pricing policy; they do not isolate the regularizer's contribution.

AI.tldr: LULR通过正则化缓解大语言模型文本表征中的处理信息泄漏，但其独立收益尚未得到确证。
AI.motivation: 商品文本可能暴露处理信息，使大语言模型增益估计依赖无法迁移到部署环境的捷径。
AI.method: 冻结大语言模型编码器，在因果预测头的可训练共享表征上施加基于CLUB的惩罚。
AI.result: 工业随机试验中五个种子有四个离线指标改善但不显著；一周线上试验销量与GMV分别提升5.45%和1.91%。
AI.conclusion: 线上结果仅支持完整定价策略的短期商业价值，不能单独归因于正则项，也未证明普遍优于树模型。

title: Correspondence-Free Camera Pose Estimation by Matching Moments
summary: The blind perspective-$n$-point (PnP) problem is to estimate the pose of a calibrated camera from 2D and 3D point sets with unknown correspondences. We show that, for complete, noiseless observations, fourteen permutation-invariant image moments up to order four identify a fixed camera pose for almost every 3D point set containing at least twenty points. Our learning-free method, MomentPnP, matches these moments between the observed 2D points and the projected 3D points to initialize a camera pose without correspondences and refines the pose and correspondence weights using expectation--maximization. Across the test sets of three benchmarks, our method reduces median rotation error by $5$--$170\times$ relative to the best learned baseline, both with and without outliers. We recover accurate poses even with as many outliers as inliers. On dense ETH3D scans, pose accuracy improves as the point sets grow, even as individual correspondences become harder to resolve.
comment: 65 pages, including references and appendices; under review

AI.tldr: MomentPnP通过匹配置换不变矩，无需已知点对应关系或学习即可估计相机位姿。
AI.motivation: 盲PnP问题要求在二维与三维点集对应关系未知时恢复标定相机的位姿。
AI.method: 匹配最高四阶的14个图像矩初始化位姿，再用期望最大化联合优化位姿与对应权重。
AI.result: 三个基准上旋转误差中位数较最佳学习基线降低5至170倍，且在外点与内点数量相等时仍能准确估计。
AI.conclusion: 完整无噪声条件下，至少20点的几乎所有三维点集可由这些矩识别固定位姿，密集扫描中增大点集亦有助于精度。

title: Sign Primal-Dual Gradient Dynamics for Supply-Demand Coordination under Binary Human Feedback
summary: This paper addresses supply-demand coordination, in which a supplier sets prices to balance the demands of multiple buyers against limited resources. Existing studies typically solve the supply-demand coordination problem with a distributed algorithm called primal-dual gradient dynamics (PDGD), assuming that each buyer discloses the value of its own utility or marginal utility function. In contrast, we assume that each buyer discloses only binary information, namely whether it wants more or less of the current amount, and propose Sign PDGD. Sign PDGD is a PDGD algorithm in which the buyers' update depends only on the sign information. We analyze the convergence of Sign PDGD by interpreting it as a sliding mode control (SMC). For a quadratic cost and linear constraints, we show that under a gain condition, the primal and dual variables converge to the optimal solution. Numerical simulations on a toy resource-sharing problem confirm the two-phase behavior of SMC and show that the primal and dual variables approach the optimal solution.

AI.tldr: Sign PDGD仅依赖买方希望增加或减少分配量的二元反馈，即可在特定条件下实现最优供需协调。
AI.motivation: 现有原始—对偶梯度方法通常要求买方披露效用或边际效用数值，反馈要求较高。
AI.method: 将买方更新改为仅使用符号信息，并借助滑模控制解释其动态与收敛性。
AI.result: 对于二次成本和线性约束，证明满足增益条件时原始与对偶变量收敛至最优解，玩具仿真验证了趋近行为。
AI.conclusion: 二元反馈可在所分析条件下支持供需最优协调，无需买方提供完整效用数值。

title: What Do Digital Traces Predict? Task Effects, Student Differences, and Critical Online Reasoning
summary: Digital assessment traces are increasingly used to predict student performance, often evaluated by correlating predicted and observed scores pooled across tasks. However, such correlations may reflect between-task differences rather than performance differences among students within tasks. To investigate this, we analyzed up to 527 browsing sessions from 424 university students completing open-Internet Critical Online Reasoning tasks and assessed the cross-task stability of their ratings. We evaluated the same out-of-fold predictions within and across tasks, compared three validation tiers up to leave-one-task-out, and tested incremental predictive contributions of consultation order and relational structure against matched permutation and randomization controls. None of the twelve prespecified primary tests was significant: on held-out tasks, consulted-page features showed no significant association with relative student performance, nor did observed order or relational structure add predictive value. Pooling observations across tasks substantially increased correlations, particularly for factual correctness, whose scores showed limited evidence of stable between-student differences across tasks. However, sentence embeddings yielded modest positive correlations with generic response quality on held-out tasks, without establishing added predictive value from observed order or relational structure. Our findings show that pooled predictive correlations may not reflect within-task student differences, highlighting the need for within-task evaluation and criterion generalizability audits.

AI.tldr: 跨任务汇总的数字轨迹预测相关性可能主要反映任务差异，而非任务内学生能力差异。
AI.motivation: 数字评估常用跨任务汇总相关性衡量预测效果，但这可能混淆任务差异与学生差异。
AI.method: 分析424名大学生最多527次浏览会话，比较任务内外及留一任务验证，并以随机化对照检验顺序和关系结构的增量价值。
AI.result: 12项预设主要检验均不显著；汇总任务提高相关性，句子嵌入对留出任务的一般回答质量仅呈温和正相关。
AI.conclusion: 数字轨迹评估应采用任务内验证并审查评分标准的跨任务泛化性，不能仅凭汇总相关性推断学生差异。

title: An Efficient Training Paradigm for Image Restoration via Improved Fréchet Loss
summary: Diffusion-based image restoration achieves strong perceptual quality but typically relies on iterative sampling, leading to slow inference. Existing single-step methods often use diffusion distillation or adversarial training, complicating optimization. To simplify training, we propose FDIR, a framework for training single-pass generative restoration models through regression-style supervised optimization using directly computable objectives. To realize this paradigm, FDIR employs the Fréchet distance to match the feature distributions of restored and real images in frozen representation spaces, providing explicit distribution-level supervision. To better accommodate image restoration, we incorporate local patch features to capture fine-grained restoration discrepancies. Moreover, we introduce instance-adaptive statistics by combining the feature moments of each SR-HQ pair with synchronized historical statistics, allowing distribution matching to incorporate input-specific correspondence while retaining distribution-level context. FDIR optimizes only the LoRA parameters of the restoration backbone. Experiments demonstrate strong perceptual restoration quality and efficient training, suggesting a simpler paradigm for generative image restoration.

AI.tldr: FDIR利用改进的Fréchet损失，以回归式监督训练单次前向生成式图像复原模型。
AI.motivation: 扩散复原的迭代采样推理缓慢，而现有单步方法依赖蒸馏或对抗训练，增加优化复杂度。
AI.method: 在冻结特征空间匹配复原与真实图像分布，结合局部块特征及实例自适应历史统计，仅优化骨干的LoRA参数。
AI.result: 实验显示该方法具有较强的感知复原质量与训练效率，摘要未报告具体量化指标。
AI.conclusion: 直接可计算的分布匹配目标为生成式图像复原提供了更简洁的单步训练范式。

title: Auditing World-Model Explanations in Retail Forecasting: Faithfulness, Accuracy and Price Response
summary: Forecasting models that read the price and promotion plan explain each forecast as a baseline, what would sell with nothing planned, plus the lift the plan adds. We test such explanations with eight checks, six with a pass rule fixed before any result, and find that passing them does not make an explanation right. In generated store data with known effects, a world model passes the checks of construction, stability, price direction and agreement with sales and with LightGBM, yet its lifts are 1.33 to 1.40 times the truth when merchants plan into high-demand weeks, and 1.23 to 1.42 times in eight variants of that world. It still picks the right weeks to promote, but stock ordered to its lift is off by 0.44 to 0.48 of the true lift. Its stated response to a lasting regular-price change is 4.7 to 6.5 times the true -0.5, and only a measured cause finds this. On Dominick's, 38 episodes in which a store's regular prices sat apart from its zone peers give a noisy benchmark: a pooled 8-week response of -0.33 (95% interval -0.68 to 0.01). For the final tuned world models of our companion paper on nine data sets, baseline and lift add up under each model's own plan, but a deeper price cut lowers the forecast in 29% to 83% of item-week steps on Dominick's (23% to 80% within prices seen in training), and the world model and LightGBM both state about twice the measured response. Across 703 configurations from the settings searches, checks passed were not related to forecast accuracy (Spearman 0.02, 95% interval -0.02 to 0.05); with no known answer for those versions, this concerns accuracy, while whether an explanation is right is measured only in the generated data.

AI.tldr: 零售预测世界模型通过解释审计检查，并不意味着其促销增量或价格响应解释准确。
AI.motivation: 将销量预测分解为基线和计划增量的解释可能看似合理，却未反映真实因果效应。
AI.method: 使用八项审计检查，在已知效应的生成数据、Dominick's价格事件及多组模型配置上检验解释与预测表现。
AI.result: 生成数据中增量被高估至真实值的1.33至1.40倍，长期价格响应为真实值的4.7至6.5倍；检查通过数与预测精度几乎无关。
AI.conclusion: 解释一致性和预测准确性不能替代因果正确性，需借助已知真值或实测因果效应验证解释。

title: The Cybersecurity Dataset Observatory: Which Data for AI in Cybersecurity?
summary: AI is increasingly used for cybersecurity tasks such as intrusion and malware detection, in enterprise, industrial, vehicular and mobile networks. Its effectiveness depends on data: models need representative network traffic, both to be trained and to be evaluated realistically. Public datasets of cybersecurity network traffic, however, are scattered across laboratory pages, repositories and aggregators, and are continuously released, corrected and withdrawn: 92 of the 234 datasets we catalog were released in 2023 or later. At this pace, surveys that list them are outdated soon after publication, since they describe the field only as it was when they were written. We present the Cybersecurity dataset observatory, a public and continuously updated catalog of cybersecurity datasets based on network traffic.
