New datasets are added as they are found or submitted, every record is periodically re-checked against its original source, to which it links rather than hosting the data, and every change is recorded in a public change log. This paper documents the first release: we define a traffic-centered scope and a seven-axis taxonomy, and review 234 datasets (204 original captures and 30 derivatives) across 14 domains. The review shows a field that grows quickly but unevenly, where 91 datasets distribute only processed records, a few laboratories produce a large share of the data, and UAV, wireless and V2X networks have little public evidence, while 5G has few real captures. We then relate the catalog to common uses in AI research, outline a procedure for selecting datasets, and discuss benchmark pitfalls and open gaps.

AI.tldr: 网络安全数据集观测站提供持续更新的流量数据目录，弥补静态综述易过时的问题。
AI.motivation: 网络安全人工智能依赖代表性流量数据，但公开数据集分散且持续新增、修订或撤回。
AI.method: 建立流量中心的七轴分类体系，持续收录并定期核验原始来源，以公开日志记录变更而不托管数据。
AI.result: 首版覆盖14个领域的234个数据集，其中91个仅提供处理后记录，无人机、无线与V2X公开数据及5G真实采集仍不足。
AI.conclusion: 持续维护的目录有助于数据集选择与基准审查，并揭示数据来源集中和领域覆盖不均等缺口。

title: ForeSay: Tell the Future in Words, Branch the Details in Noise for Precipitation Nowcasting
summary: Precipitation nowcasting involves two distinct scales of uncertainty: macroscopic storm evolution and fine-scale local convective variations. Current generative ensemble methods entangle both scales within independent random noise draws. This coupling causes two practical limitations: every ensemble member must execute the full sampling trajectory from scratch, so an N-member ensemble costs N times a single forecast; moreover, divergent trajectories spatially misalign heavy-rain echoes across members, causing standard pixel-wise averaging to blur critical high-intensity extremes. We present ForeSay, a generative nowcasting framework that decouples macroscopic evolution prediction from local stochastic detail generation. Given historical radar frames, a vision-language model first predicts a textual scenario of future storm dynamics to condition a Rectified Flow generator. Guided by this shared macroscopic prior, ensemble members share early trunk sampling steps to establish the storm trajectory and branch with fresh noise only in later steps to explore local convective details. Because members then differ mainly in local details, self-anchored support-consensus decoding replaces pixel averaging with discrete support voting to preserve sharp heavy-rain cores. Across six datasets, ForeSay achieves the best CSI at the highest precipitation thresholds, with relative improvements over the strongest baseline on each dataset ranging from over 10% to 84%. Our 8-member ensemble retains the forecasting skill and diversity of eight independently sampled runs while reducing computational cost from 8x to 5.2x that of a single forecast.

AI.tldr: ForeSay通过解耦风暴宏观演化与局部随机细节，提升强降水临近预报并降低集合采样成本。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式集合预报耦合两类不确定性，导致采样成本高且像素平均模糊强降水核心。
AI.method: 以视觉语言模型预测的风暴文本引导流生成器，共享早期采样、后期噪声分支，并用支持共识投票解码。
AI.result: 六个数据集最高降水阈值CSI相对提升逾10%至84%，八成员集合成本由单次的8倍降至5.2倍。
AI.conclusion: 共享宏观先验与局部分支可兼顾集合技巧、多样性和效率，并保留清晰的强降水核心。

title: Tight PAC-Bayes Generalisation Guarantees for Large Language Model Judges
summary: Large language model (LLM) judges are increasingly used to monitor the outputs of LLM-based AI agents, yet formal guarantees on the reliability of these judges remain largely absent, limiting confidence in their use for safety-critical oversight. We consider certifying such a judge and define its risk over safety classifications of prompt--response pairs drawn from a deployed generator. We apply a PAC-Bayes framework to this setting, refining existing compression-based methodology with the use of tighter bounds and more efficient coding. We show that standard parameter-efficient fine-tuning can yield non-vacuous and even tight certificates for safety judges, for both classification and Brier risk, without holding out data for validation. We introduce LoRA-GT, which shares a single quantisation scale across layers and achieves the tightest certificates with minimal degradation in predictive performance. Across five guardrail models and four benchmarks, we find that certificate tightness is governed more by adaptation complexity than by base model scale. Finally, we show how far quantisation can be pushed before the resulting increase in risk outweighs the bound tightening gained from shorter descriptions. Together, these results provide a practical route toward certifiable scalable oversight and offer insight into how the complexity of safety adaptations shapes generalisation.

AI.tldr: 研究通过改进PAC-Bayes压缩界，为大语言模型安全裁判提供非空泛且紧致的泛化保证。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型裁判缺乏正式可靠性保证，限制了其在安全关键监督中的可信应用。
AI.method: 采用更紧的PAC-Bayes界与高效编码，并提出跨层共享量化尺度的LoRA-GT。
AI.result: 五种护栏模型和四个基准显示，无需留出验证数据即可认证，且界的紧致性更受适配复杂度影响。
AI.conclusion: 参数高效微调与适度量化为可认证的可扩展监督提供了实用途径。

title: Surprise-Gated Memory for Live Speaker Diarization
summary: We transpose the Surprise-Gated Memory recipe, a frozen encoder plus a calibrated novelty signal that gates a one-shot episodic store consolidated by periodic replay, from continual visual learning to live speaker diarization. The moment-to-moment question a streaming diarizer must answer, whether an arriving voice belongs to an already-heard speaker or a new one, is a known-versus-novel decision, exactly the decision the surprise gate is built for. On a frozen fine-tuned DiariZen backbone, our online system SGM-Diar recovers 4.8 of the 9.2 diarization-error points separating a naive online baseline from the offline oracle on AMI-SDM (52%) and 1.9 of 2.3 points on VoxConverse (82%), in the end-of-meeting revisable mode, with calibration frozen on development data and transferred cross-domain without adjustment. These are single-seed runs on three AMI meetings and five VoxConverse sessions, so the ordering of conditions rather than the absolute rates is the result. Beyond error rate, we measure the gate's behaviour directly and find a coherent memory-like profile: one-shot speaker recall at 0.857, a novelty response that habituates as speakers become familiar, re-identification that is invariant to the length of intervening silence, and a false-novelty rate of 0.001. Two ablations reproduce, now on audio, the central prediction of the visual SGM work: a sliding replay window is worse than no replay at all. The memory is strictly intra-meeting and is wiped at the end, and no gradient touches the run-time system. We report SGM-Diar as a proof-of-concept and state its limitations explicitly.

AI.tldr: SGM-Diar将惊讶门控记忆迁移至在线说话人分离，在小规模实验中缩小与离线系统的差距。
AI.motivation: 流式说话人分离需要持续判断新到语音属于已知说话人还是新说话人。
AI.method: 冻结DiariZen骨干，以校准的新颖性信号门控一次性情景存储，并定期回放巩固会议内记忆。
AI.result: 单种子小样本的会末可修订模式中，系统分别弥合AMI-SDM与VoxConverse误差差距的52%和82%。
AI.conclusion: 该概念验证支持记忆门控用于在线说话人分离，但样本有限，应重视条件排序而非绝对误差率。

title: Conversing with a Conversational Agent: A Real Conversation, Not a Simulated One
summary: The claim that interactions with artificial conversational agents merely simulate human conversation rests on a philosophical distinction between reproducing the observable features of an activity and actually performing it. Although this distinction is appropriate for certain physical phenomena, its application to linguistic and symbolic activities is far less straightforward. This article argues that conversations with large language model (LLM)-based agents are genuine conversational activities rather than mere simulations, without thereby attributing consciousness, subjective understanding, or human intentionality to artificial systems. Drawing on the distinction between subjective and objective simulation, the article first examines the limitations of defining conversation exclusively through the intrinsic properties of its participants. It then develops a relational and semiotic account of conversational activity, informed by linguistic pragmatics, Lacan's Conversing with a Conversational Agent theory of the mirror, Baudrillard's concept of the simulacrum, Simondon's philosophy of individuation, and Peirce's semiotics. These perspectives make it possible to distinguish the reality of conversational interaction from the appearance of artificial subjectivity and from the epistemic validity of the meanings produced. The argument culminates in the concept of Hybrid Semiotic Fabrication, which characterizes meaning-making as a distributed process involving human participants, artificial intelligence, corpora, and technical arrangements. Recognizing the reality of human-AI conversation therefore entails neither anthropomorphizing artificial agents nor granting their outputs epistemic authority. Rather, it requires a more precise account of the relational, semiotic, and normative conditions under which conversational meaning is produced and justified.

AI.tldr: 文章主张人机对话是真实的会话活动，但这不意味着人工智能具有意识或其输出具有认知权威。
AI.motivation: 仅凭参与者内在属性区分真实对话与模拟，难以充分解释语言和符号活动。
AI.method: 结合语言语用学与多种哲学理论，建立关系性和符号性的对话解释，并提出混合符号制造概念。
AI.result: 论证将对话互动的真实性与人工主体性表象、所产意义的认知有效性区分开来。
AI.conclusion: 承认人机对话的真实性，需要明确意义生成与证成的关系、符号和规范条件，而非拟人化人工智能。

title: ProcReverser: Multi-Agent Black-Box Microarchitectural Reverse Engineering for Processor Vulnerability Analysis
summary: When processor implementation details are unavailable, black-box microarchitectural reverse engineering helps security researchers identify hardware conditions related to security vulnerabilities. However, this process requires substantial manual effort to design experiments, develop test programs, and analyze results for each processor. We present ProcReverser, a multi-agent system that automates this process. ProcReverser uses execution feedback to improve experimental plans and test programs and identifies microarchitectural properties from measurements. We develop a comprehensive suite of property identification tasks focused on hardware mechanisms relevant to Spectre-class attacks, covering speculative execution, branch prediction, memory dependence, and cache behavior. We evaluate ProcReverser on the XuanTie C910, the gem5 RISC-V O3 CPU model, and the SiFive P550. ProcReverser achieves Pass@1 and Pass@5 scores of 81.3% and 93.8%, respectively, on C910, and 83.0% and 100.0% on gem5 O3. On the SiFive P550, ProcReverser further characterizes microarchitectural properties covered by the proposed task suite. These findings highlight the potential of automated microarchitectural reverse engineering to support processor vulnerability analysis and defense evaluation.

AI.tldr: ProcReverser利用多智能体自动开展处理器黑盒微架构逆向工程，辅助漏洞分析。
AI.motivation: 处理器实现细节不可得时，微架构逆向需要大量人工设计实验、编写程序和分析测量结果。
AI.method: 多智能体依据执行反馈改进实验与测试程序，识别推测执行、分支预测、内存依赖和缓存属性。
AI.result: C910的Pass@1和Pass@5为81.3%和93.8%，gem5 O3为83.0%和100%，并完成P550属性刻画。
AI.conclusion: 自动化微架构逆向工程展现出支持处理器漏洞分析与防御评估的潜力。

title: Hierarchical Regime-Conditioned Dynamics for Spatiotemporal Graphs
summary: Forecasting the behavior of spatio-temporal systems often requires more than accurate predictions: models should uncover the dynamical modes governing future evolution. Existing temporal graph and latent dynamical models achieve strong forecasting performance, but their latent representations often entangle multiple dynamical patterns, limiting interpretability. Conversely, regime-inference methods explicitly model such modes but typically do not support generative forecasting over graph-structured systems. We introduce HERON, a self-supervised regime-aware generative framework that unifies graph-structured trajectory generation with regime identification. HERON factorizes the latent state into discrete system-level regimes, capturing global dynamical modes, and continuous entity-level dynamics, yielding a modular regime interface compatible with existing spatio-temporal backbones. Crucially, the inferred regime actively conditions system dynamics, enabling regime tracking and controlled simulations under alternative dynamical modes. Without regime annotations, HERON jointly learns forecasts and regime dynamics in a self-supervised manner, recovering meaningful modes across controlled synthetic and real-world datasets while maintaining competitive forecasting performance. These results open a path toward interpretable, controllable generative modeling of spatio-temporal dynamics.

AI.tldr: HERON将图结构轨迹生成与动力学模式识别统一，实现可解释且可控的时空预测。
AI.motivation: 现有时序图模型的潜表示混杂多种动力学模式，而模式推断方法通常不支持图系统生成式预测。
AI.method: 将潜状态分解为离散系统级模式与连续实体级动力学，以自监督联合学习并用模式条件化演化。
AI.result: 在合成与真实数据上，无需模式标注即可恢复有意义的动力学模式，同时保持有竞争力的预测表现。
AI.conclusion: 显式模式接口为可解释、可控的时空动力学生成建模提供了路径。

title: Universal Quantizer Design for Identification of Systems with Memory
summary: In system identification from quantized observations, the quantizer determines how much information about the parameters the observations retain, and hence the achievable estimation accuracy. Quantizer design can be guided by the Fisher information matrix (FIM), which assesses the parameter information retained by candidate quantizers. Existing methods, however, typically rely on closed-form expressions of the FIM. This paper proposes a universal quantizer design method for general systems with memory. Its core is a universal FIM estimator that evaluates the information per bit from simulated trajectories, and the thresholds are designed by maximizing the estimated criterion under a bit budget. For unknown parameters, the design is implemented through a two-stage procedure. Numerical studies on a quantized ARX system yield designs close to the reference optimum, while a nonlinear cascaded-tanks example reduces the identification error by about 50% relative to a single median threshold.

AI.tldr: 研究提出适用于一般有记忆系统的量化器设计方法，以提高量化观测下的系统辨识精度。
AI.motivation: 量化器决定观测保留的参数信息，而现有设计方法通常依赖费舍尔信息矩阵的闭式表达。
AI.method: 从模拟轨迹通用估计费舍尔信息，在比特预算下优化每比特信息准则，并以两阶段处理未知参数。
AI.result: 量化ARX系统的设计接近参考最优，非线性串联水箱的辨识误差较单一中位阈值降低约50%。
AI.conclusion: 基于模拟的信息估计可减少对闭式表达的依赖，为有记忆系统提供通用量化设计方案。

title: Evidence Diet: When Graph Evidence Helps LLMs Rank Competing Candidates
summary: When several candidates have graph support, does it matter which candidate receives which supporter and path counts? We study how LLM rankers use collaborative evidence on Amazon Books and MovieTV. Swapping user-level evidence degrades ranking, while matched item substitutions have little effect. On fixed clean-trained checkpoints, unrelated catalog text lowers Hit@1 from 44.77% to 38.70%, with 99.9% of rankings still valid. Across all three paired seeds, the NDCG@5 difference between count and path prompts was larger after count training than after path training. Degree matching preserves target paths while giving more rivals support. Across the full degree-matched development pools, adding candidate-level graph records to history improves NDCG@5 by 2.28 points on Books and 2.54 on MovieTV. When the target and a rival both have support, path- and count-trained rankers benefit from retaining counts. On these development queries, adding counts numerically to history scores outperforms presenting them as text. For count-trained rankers, exchanging intact count pairs among supported candidates preserves support and token length, yet lowers NDCG@5 by 4.06 points on 141 Books queries and 3.26 on 104 MovieTV queries. A frozen evaluation on 274 previously unused Books users with supported targets and rivals confirms the attribution effect: correct assignment improves pairwise accuracy by 6.07 percentage points (95% CI [4.18, 8.00]).

AI.tldr: 图证据能改善大语言模型候选排序，但收益取决于支持者与路径计数是否正确归属于候选。
AI.motivation: 当多个候选均有图支持时，需要厘清排序器是否真正利用证据归属，而非仅依赖支持存在或文本形式。
AI.method: 在Books与MovieTV上交换证据、匹配度数并比较计数和路径提示，另用未使用用户进行冻结评估。
AI.result: 图记录使两域NDCG@5提升2.28和2.54点；独立Books评估中，正确归属使成对准确率提高6.07个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 候选级图证据的正确归属具有实质作用，在所测开发查询中数值融合计数优于文本呈现。

title: Interpretable deep concepts of organoid morphology
summary: Image-based classification of organoid morphologies can indicate drug response, viability, or successful differentiation. In recent work, learned representations outperform handcrafted features as the basis for downstream classifiers. However, their black-box nature hides the morphological cues a classifier relies on. Based on the foundation models DINOv3 (general-purpose) and ViTAMIn-O (organoid-specific), we train sparse autoencoders (SAEs) to learn interpretable concepts related to distinct organoid morphologies. We annotate concepts with spatial labels (organoid, organoid wall, background) and compute their dataset specificity and task relevance across five tasks. The spatial labels of DINOv3 concepts yield coarse organoid segmentations on out-of-domain datasets. Filtering concepts by spatial label in the DINOv3-SAE improves downstream AUROC for three of the five tasks. Qualitative analysis of the most relevant concepts further reveals a confounding factor introduced by our preprocessing in one task. Through such insights, interpretable concepts could help improve the reliability of classifiers and guide the future development of organoid representation models. The trained SAEs will be made available upon publication.

AI.tldr: 稀疏自编码器可从类器官视觉表征中提取可解释形态概念，并辅助分类与偏差诊断。
AI.motivation: 学习表征虽优于手工特征，但其黑箱性质掩盖了类器官分类器依赖的形态线索。
AI.method: 基于DINOv3和ViTAMIn-O训练稀疏自编码器，标注概念空间位置并评估五项任务的相关性。
AI.result: DINOv3概念可生成域外粗分割，空间筛选改善五项任务中的三项AUROC，并揭示一项预处理混杂因素。
AI.conclusion: 可解释形态概念有望提升类器官分类可靠性，并指导表征模型改进。

title: Vision-Language Model-Based Phase-OTDR Event Classification
summary: Phase-sensitive optical time-domain reflectometry (Phase-OTDR) enables distributed vibration sensing, but reliable event classification has traditionally relied on fully supervised models that require extensive annotated data. This study examines the adaptability of a Vision-Language Model (VLM) for Phase-OTDR event recognition through few-shot learning. Raw samples are converted into Short-Time Fourier Transform (STFT) dB-magnitude spectrogram mosaics, color-mapped and resized to RGB images, and processed by a Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) image encoder; few-shot adaptation optimizes only the Tip-Adapter-F cache keys, leaving both encoders unchanged. Under a leakage-controlled protocol (train-side support/validation pool of 512 images per class, fixed held-out test of 120 per class, no test-set access during selection, 20 distinct support-sampling trials), the selected configuration (the ViT-L-14 Vision Transformer encoder with OpenAI weights, 128 shots per class) reaches 96.81 +/- 0.42% accuracy and a macro-averaged F1 score of 96.79 +/- 0.42% on the held-out test set; a label-efficient 16-shot setting, that is, 96 labeled support images at adaptation time across the six classes, already attains 90.17 +/- 0.81%. Tip-Adapter-F clearly outperforms both zero-shot CLIP and the standard training-free Tip-Adapter, and prompt and backbone analyses show that performance is stable across Vision Transformer encoders and insensitive to prompt wording at the selected operating point. Overall, CLIP visual features carry a transferable structure that a lightweight support cache turns into a label-efficient Phase-OTDR event classifier. The code and the corresponding image dataset are made publicly available on GitHub to support further research: this https URL.

AI.tldr: 冻结CLIP编码器并适配轻量缓存，可实现高准确率的少样本Phase-OTDR事件分类。
AI.motivation: 传统Phase-OTDR事件分类依赖大量标注数据，需要更节省标签的识别方法。
AI.method: 将信号转为STFT彩色频谱拼图，使用CLIP提取特征，仅优化Tip-Adapter-F缓存键。
AI.conclusion: CLIP视觉特征具有可迁移结构，轻量支持缓存可将其转化为标签高效的振动事件分类器。

title: DetourBench: Trajectory-Level Evaluation of Interactive Agents with Exact Minimum-Action Bounds
summary: Benchmarks judge language-model agents mainly by whether they reach the correct final state, not by how they got there. Endpoint scoring cannot separate an agent that retrieved exactly the evidence a decision required from one that read most of the environment, nor an agent that never located the evidence from one that stopped a single action short. Settling this needs a reference cost, and authored solutions establish only that a task is solvable, not that no shorter route exists. We present DetourBench, which constrains the environment until that minimum is computable. Each task is a finite, partially observable transition system with unit-cost accesses whose resources become globally addressable after discovery. Exhaustive search yields the full-information minimum action count $L_0$ with a replayable witness; from graph-recoverable terminal states it also yields exact residual work $R_T$, which separates an episode that stopped one access short from one that wandered, while an irreversible wrong commitment is recorded as having no finite residual distance rather than assigned one. Success, attainment, residual progress, and normalized detour are reported separately. Across 375 scored episodes --- five model endpoints, 25 integrated tasks, three repeats --- success ranges from 58.7% to 96.0% while conditional attainment ranges from 0.803 to 0.890 and orders the models differently. Among recoverable failures, residual work separates near-complete trajectories from costly incompletion and from irreversible commitment. We open-source the instances, oracle witnesses, and evaluation harness at this https URL.
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Evaluation of Interactive Agents

AI.tldr: DetourBench以精确最少动作数和剩余工作量评估智能体轨迹，弥补仅看终态的不足。
AI.motivation: 终态评分无法区分高效取证、过度探索及接近完成的失败，而人工解法不能保证最短路径。
AI.method: 将任务限定为有限部分可观测转移系统，通过穷举计算最少动作数及可恢复终态的精确剩余工作量。
AI.result: 375次评测中成功率为58.7%至96.0%，条件达成度为0.803至0.890，且模型排序不同。
AI.conclusion: 分开报告成功、达成、剩余进展和归一化绕行，可揭示终态评分遗漏的效率与失败差异。

title: EDITORS Know Your Style! Editing LoRA Subspaces for Stylistic Attribution and Imitation
summary: Disentangling writing style from semantic content is a fundamental challenge in literary text modeling. Style-content entanglement causes models to rely on semantic content for authorship attribution (AA) tasks and memorize author-specific content for style imitation (SI) tasks. We propose EDITORS (EditingLoRA Subspaces), a diagnose-then-deflate framework that adapts pretrained large language models and prioritizes stylistic features, making it effective for both AA and SI tasks. EDITORS first trains a diagnostic LoRA adapter using style-neutral statements derived from the training corpus to identify a content-oriented subspace. It then trains the final style adapter under activation-space deflation that projects input activations away from the identified content-oriented directions. We empirically demonstrate that EDITORS is effective. On three AA benchmarks spanning literature, social media, and news, EDITORS achieves state-of-the-art accuracy, outperforming the strongest existing baseline by up to 29%. On SI, EDITORS generates stylistically faithful and diverse passages, outperforming baselines in achieving style similarity while adhering to content specifications.

AI.tldr: EDITORS通过识别并削弱内容子空间，提升大模型的作者归属识别与写作风格模仿能力。
AI.motivation: 风格与内容纠缠使作者识别依赖语义，并使风格模仿记忆作者特定内容。
AI.method: 先用风格中性语句训练诊断LoRA定位内容子空间，再将激活投影远离该子空间以训练风格适配器。
AI.result: 三个作者识别基准均达最优准确率，较最强基线最高提升29%，风格模仿的相似性与内容遵循也优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 诊断后削弱内容方向有助于优先学习风格特征，同时支持作者识别和风格模仿。

title: MolReps: Taking SELFIES, Making SMILES, Teaching LLMs
summary: The same molecule can be expressed in multiple, syntactically distinct representations, yet it remains unclear whether large language models (LLMs) can recognize and relate these equivalent encodings. We introduce MolReps, a pipeline that generates 9,600 question-answer pairs across ten representations for conversion, normalization, and 2D structure recognition. Post-training on MolReps improves text-only and multimodal models, MolQwen3-4B-Instruct (MQ3-4B-I) and MolQwen3-VL-4B-Instruct (MQ3-VL-4B-I), from $4.01\%$ to $75.13\%$ and from $7.11\%$ to $73.14\%$ (InChIKey match) on the molecule-overlap test set, respectively. On the molecule-disjoint test set, post-training increased validity from $20.35\%$ to $58.12\%$ for MQ3-4B-I and from $17.19\%$ to $59.34\%$ for MQ3-VL-4B-I. However, InChIKey match remained low, decreasing from $3.86\%$ to $3.09\%$ and from $6.44\%$ to $2.29\%$, respectively. Furthermore, the resulting models achieve a relative $27.84\%$ improvement in average over their base model on MolRepBench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating molecular property prediction. These results show the effectiveness of targeted post-training for enhancing molecular representation understanding and its potential to improve downstream molecular tasks.

AI.tldr: MolReps后训练改善分子编码理解，但未见分子的精确匹配仍弱，显示泛化局限。
AI.motivation: 同一分子可有多种不同编码，大语言模型能否识别并关联这些等价表示尚不清楚。
AI.method: 构建涵盖十种表示的9600组问答，对文本及多模态模型开展转换、规范化和二维结构识别后训练。
AI.result: 分子重叠测试匹配率升至75.13%和73.14%；分子不重叠测试有效率提高，但匹配率降至3.09%和2.29%。
AI.conclusion: 定向后训练改善分子表示理解并使下游基准平均相对提升27.84%，但未见分子的精确转换仍受限。

title: artist: A Python package for differentiable ray tracing and gradient-based optimization of solar tower power plant operation
summary: Solar tower power plants provide dispatchable, renewable energy by concentrating sunlight with thousands of mirrors, called heliostats, onto a central receiver. Efficient operation requires accurate modeling of the optical path from each heliostat to the receiver and compensation for manufacturing imperfections, kinematic misalignment, and material degradation that distort the flux distribution. Conventional ray tracers predict the flux from an assumed plant model but are limited to forward simulation. They cannot recover unknown plant parameters from measured flux nor directly optimize plant operation. We present artist, an open-source, FAIR4RS-compliant Python package implementing a fully differentiable digital twin of solar tower power plants. By making the optical pipeline, comprising heliostat surface representation, kinematics, blocking, and ray tracing, end to end differentiable, artist turns the digital twin from a passive forward model into an active physics-based tool for inverse modeling and data-driven optimization. The resulting gradient-based framework unifies tasks usually handled by separate solutions, such as reconstructing heliostat surfaces and kinematics from operational flux images without costly deflectometry, predicting irradiance at the receiver, and optimizing aim points to realize a desired receiver flux density distribution. Built on PyTorch, artist scales to real plants through GPU acceleration, a structure-of-arrays memory layout, and nested data parallelism. It interfaces with open data sources such as the PAINT database. We describe the software architecture, physical models, and optimization framework, and demonstrate the workflow on representative tasks. By integrating modeling, prediction, and optimization into a single open, interpretable package, artist provides a principled foundation for data-driven research toward autonomous solar tower operation.
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, abridged abstract, submitted to Machine Learning: Engineering (IOP Publishing)

AI.tldr: artist以端到端可微光学数字孪生，统一太阳能塔式电站的逆向建模、预测和运行优化。
AI.motivation: 传统光线追踪仅能前向仿真，难以从实测光通量反推电站参数或直接优化运行。
AI.method: 基于PyTorch将定日镜表面、运动学、遮挡和光线追踪全流程可微化，并采用GPU加速及并行计算。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体结果。
AI.conclusion: 开源artist将物理建模与梯度优化整合，为数据驱动的自主塔式电站运行研究提供基础。

title: Motor Imagery Classification Using Hybrid Cross-Subject Class Mixup and Selective Attention
summary: Motor imagery (MI) enables a brain-computer interface (BCI) to decode movement intentions without overt movement. Hybrid electroencephalography (EEG) and functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) classification combines complementary signals, but inter-subject variability and the design of information exchange between modalities affect generalization to new subjects. We propose a framework that combines Cross-Subject Class Mixup (CSCM) with Selective Attention. CSCM aims to construct new training data to make the model robust against inter-subject variability. It independently selects EEG and fNIRS donor trials from other training subjects within the anchor class and mixes each modality while preserving the original label. Selective Attention provides an effective way to simultaneously model the temporal signal characteristics and fuse the two modalities. It retains causal temporal self-attention for EEG and uses a classification token (CLS) to integrate both modalities, without fNIRS attention updates or direct cross-modal temporal-token attention. Leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) evaluation across 28 subjects on a public EEG-fNIRS dataset yields a mean balanced accuracy (BA) of 76.85% and a macro-averaged F1 score (Macro-F1) of 76.58%. The proposed model achieves the highest mean performance among five reimplemented baselines. We also examine the contributions of CSCM and Selective Attention through modality-specific mixing and donor-policy comparisons, temporal-policy comparisons, interventions on direct cross-modal paths, and component ablations.

AI.tldr: 跨受试者同类混合增强结合选择性注意力，改善EEG-fNIRS运动想象的跨受试者分类。
AI.motivation: 受试者差异及模态间信息交互设计限制了混合脑机接口对新受试者的泛化。
AI.method: 分别混合同类跨受试者EEG与fNIRS试次，并以EEG因果时序注意力和分类令牌融合两种模态。
AI.result: 28名受试者留一评估的平衡准确率为76.85%、宏F1为76.58%，平均表现超过五个复现基线。
AI.conclusion: 跨受试者同类混合与选择性融合可有效支持混合模态运动想象的跨受试者识别。

title: When Is the Expensive Method Worth It? A Content-Driven Analysis of Classical Bayer Demosaicing
summary: Demosaicing reconstructs a full-colour image from a single-sensor colour-filter-array (CFA) mosaic, where only one colour is measured per pixel. Classical methods make different assumptions about images, from simple averaging to directional edge-aware interpolation, and the directional methods cost markedly more compute. We ask a practical question that a per-image quality ranking does not answer: for a given image, is the expensive directional method worth its cost? Using a controlled simulate-reconstruct pipeline on 80 benchmark images from four public datasets (Kodak, McMaster, BSD100, Urban100), six classical methods, and image-content descriptors fixed before any results were seen, we show that the quality gain of the edge-aware method (Menon 2007) over the best cheap linear method is not constant. It ranges from $-6.6$ to $+6.8$ dB, and on 31% of images it is zero or negative, meaning a cheap method matches or beats the expensive one. The gain is also predictable from content: it correlates with mean image saturation at $r=-0.86$ ($p<10^{-6}$). We then build an interpretable depth-2 decision tree that recommends the best cheap method from image descriptors, beating an always-pick-the-most-common baseline by 20.0 percentage points under leave-one-image-out validation. The analysis uses no deep learning, and every step can be inspected.

AI.tldr: 经典去马赛克中昂贵方向插值并非总有优势，其收益可由图像内容预测。
AI.motivation: 逐图质量排名无法回答昂贵方向插值相对廉价方法是否值得其计算成本。
AI.method: 在四个公开数据集的80幅图像上控制比较六种方法，并用预先确定的内容描述符构建浅层决策树。
AI.result: 昂贵方法收益为−6.6至6.8 dB，31%图像无正收益；收益与平均饱和度相关系数为−0.86。
AI.conclusion: 图像内容可指导低成本方法选择，深度为2的可解释决策树在留一验证中较固定基线提高20个百分点。

title: Scenario-Based Risk Certificates for Multi-Property Vulnerability Discovery in Parametric MDPs
summary: Safety-critical systems such as network protocols and distributed algorithms depend on environmental parameters whose exact values are uncertain. Parametric Markov decision processes (pMDPs) model such systems by making transition probabilities symbolic functions of the parameters. For a single quantitative requirement, parametric verification asks which parameter valuations satisfy the requirement. In practice, however, engineers often monitor several safety and performance requirements at once, and one valuation may make several requirements vulnerable simultaneously. In this paper we study multi-property vulnerability discovery under requirement-wise semantics: given a pMDP and M quantitative requirements, we construct candidate regions of the parameter space that may contain violations, and study budgets for random testing under a specified parameter distribution. To solve this, we adopt a two-layered approach in which the scenario-approximation layer provides PAC guarantees on identifying conservative vulnerability regions for each requirement while the testing layer treats random parameter exploration as coverage of overlapping regions and yields a stopping certificate computed from the marginal region masses alone; a composition theorem then bounds the expected non-discovery score by the scenario approximation error plus the testing risk from the two layers. For confirmed discoveries, candidate hits are checked by model checking and budgets use independently certified discovery probabilities. Experiment evaluate these certificates using empirical surrogates and independent confidence bounds.

AI.tldr: 提出双层风险证书框架，为参数化马尔可夫决策过程的多需求漏洞发现提供随机测试预算与风险界。
AI.motivation: 环境参数不确定时，同一参数取值可能同时违反多个安全或性能需求，需要联合评估漏洞发现风险。
AI.method: 结合场景近似的PAC保证与重叠区域随机覆盖分析，并通过模型检验确认候选漏洞。
AI.result: 证明期望未发现分数受场景近似误差与测试风险之和约束，并用经验替代量和独立置信界评估证书。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可仅依据候选区域的边际概率质量计算停止证书，为多需求漏洞搜索提供风险控制。

title: Practical Semantic Communication for General-Purpose Networks: Compression of High-Dimensional Embeddings Under Quantization
summary: This paper introduces a practical framework for semantic communication over wireless channels, focusing on the compression of high-dimensional embeddings under quantization and channel errors. Building upon a relaxed Gaussian Information Bottleneck (GIB) model, the approach provides analytical solutions for task-relevant information preservation, even with non-Gaussian targets. The framework relaxes traditional Gaussian assumptions, enabling effective compression for discrete and complex data such as text embeddings. It derives closed-form gradients for optimizing the compression matrix and establishes bounds linking continuous representations to discrete, noisy system performance. Comprehensive experiments on text classification tasks demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms task-agnostic quantization-based compression methods, maintaining high semantic fidelity at low bit budgets per embedding. The approach offers a scalable, interpretable, and resource-efficient solution for deploying semantic communication in general-purpose networks.

AI.tldr: 提出面向无线语义通信的高维嵌入压缩框架，在量化与信道误差下保留任务相关信息。
AI.motivation: 通用网络需要在有限比特预算和噪声条件下，有效压缩文本等非高斯数据的高维表示。
AI.method: 放宽高斯信息瓶颈假设，推导压缩矩阵的闭式梯度及连续表示与离散含噪性能之间的界。
AI.result: 文本分类实验表明，该方法优于任务无关的量化压缩方法，并在低比特预算下保持较高语义保真度。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为通用网络部署语义通信提供了可扩展、可解释且资源高效的方案。

title: LiDSeg: Linear DehazeFormer Guidance for Efficient Semantic Segmentation in Adverse Weather Conditions
summary: Robust semantic segmentation in adverse weather is essential for safety-critical autonomous systems. Existing restore-then-segment pipelines introduce latency and prioritize pixel-level restoration over semantic discriminability, while domain adaptation methods often face representation bottlenecks and computational complexity. We introduce LiDSeg, a framework that uses reconstruction-informed guidance to improve segmentation under adverse weather. During training, a lightweight guidance encoder is jointly optimized with the segmentation branch using segmentation and auxiliary reconstruction objectives. At inference, the reconstruction decoder is discarded, while the guidance encoder is retained to extract weather-robust features. A lightweight gated fusion module integrates these features into the segmentation branch, preserving clear-weather accuracy while improving adverse-weather robustness. On Foggy Cityscapes, LiDSeg limits the clear-to-dense-fog mIoU degradation to 2.5-2.8 percentage points, reducing the baseline performance drop by more than fivefold. On the official ACDC test server, LiDSeg-PIDNet achieves 75.07% pooled all-condition mIoU, comparable to supervised HRNet-W48 at 75.0%, while remaining substantially smaller. The gains generalize zero-shot to Foggy Driving and Foggy Zurich without training on real-fog images. LiDSeg adds only 1.9-3.1M parameters across several models, with total model sizes of 5.2-39.5M parameters and no inference-time reconstruction overhead. It delivers real-time inference on the NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: LiDSeg利用重建引导与轻量门控融合，在无推理重建开销的情况下提升恶劣天气语义分割。
AI.motivation: 先恢复再分割的流程延迟较高且偏重像素恢复，域适应方法也存在表示瓶颈与计算复杂度问题。
AI.method: 训练时联合优化引导编码器、分割分支和辅助重建目标，推理时移除重建解码器并融合引导特征。
AI.result: 晴天至浓雾的mIoU降幅仅2.5至2.8个百分点，ACDC全条件mIoU达75.07%，且支持实时推理。
AI.conclusion: LiDSeg以较小参数增量增强天气鲁棒性，保持晴天精度，并可零样本泛化至真实雾天数据。

title: MVSTF: Multi-View Spatio-Temporal Fusion for LiDAR-Based Moving Object Segmentation
summary: Autonomous mobile robots confront significant chal lenges in recognizing the motion properties of objects in dy namic environments. However, existing methods are hindered by limitations such as boundary ambiguity, occlusion, viewpoint constraints, and training complexity. In this paper, we propose an innovative end-to-end Multi-View Spatio-Temporal Fusion network, named MVSTF, which utilizes sequential point clouds to generate multi-view images and feature differences, and designs a multi-branch network to extract spatio-temporal and dimen sional features in parallel, and realizes high-precision moving object segmentation. First, sequential point clouds are utilized to generate multi-view images and feature differences. Then, an end-to-end multi-branch network including Dual Down-sampling Blocks (DDB), Spatial Attention Blocks (SAB), Multi-Kernel Convolutional Neural Network blocks (MKCNN), Dual Feature Fusion Blocks (DFFB), and the Point Fusion (PF) module, is designed to extract motion features from feature differences and geometric and semantic features from multi-view images. Finally, an auxiliary semantic head is introduced to further improve the algorithm's robustness and the model's interpretability. This work is validated on the SemanticKITTI and KITTI-Road bench marks, achieving state-of-the-art results on the SemanticKITTI MOS validation set and the KITTI-Road validation set, and competitive results on the hidden SemanticKITTI-MOS test set. The code is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: MVSTF通过多视角时空特征融合，实现基于连续激光雷达点云的运动物体分割。
AI.motivation: 现有运动识别方法受到边界模糊、遮挡、视角限制及训练复杂性等因素制约。
AI.method: 将连续点云转换为多视角图像与特征差异，以多分支网络融合运动、几何和语义特征，并加入辅助语义头。
AI.result: 在SemanticKITTI MOS及KITTI-Road验证集取得最先进结果，在隐藏MOS测试集上表现具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 多视角时空融合有助于高精度运动分割，辅助语义头进一步增强鲁棒性与可解释性。

title: Re-Reading Is Not Free: Token Traces and Cache-Aware Energy Estimation for LLM Agents in Software Engineering
summary: As large language models (LLMs) evolve from conversational assistants into autonomous agents embedded in software development workflows, estimating their environmental footprint requires moving beyond conventional token-based accounting. Existing energy estimators focus on isolated request-response interactions, overlooking the repeated processing of accumulated context, cache reuse, and work delegated to subagents. We analyze nearly one billion tokens collected across 42 sessions and 752 task episodes over ten weeks of real-world AI-assisted software development. Cached-context reads make up 94.8% of all API-reported tokens, while uncached input accounts for only 0.017%; for every generated token, approximately 260 cached tokens are read. Context grows 5.3-fold over a session compared with 1.4-fold within individual tasks. To quantify the energy implications, we extend an existing analytical inference-energy model to account for cached-context processing, yielding a cache-aware hybrid estimator. It estimates approximately 250 kWh for the workload, compared with approximately 10 kWh from the output-based estimator EcoLogits, a 25-fold difference largely driven by cached-context reads. Neither estimator has been validated on long cached contexts, but no modeling assumption we varied closes the gap. Starting each task from a fresh context would lower our estimate by about 60%. We also find that parent-session logs report only a subagent's final internal call, undercounting delegated tokens by a factor of ten; for this workload the correction changes the energy estimate by about 5%, but token-volume studies are fully exposed to it. Our findings expose a substantial gap between how current energy estimators and agentic workloads treat context, highlighting the need for workflow-level energy accounting that captures context accumulation, cache reuse, and delegated execution.

AI.tldr: 真实软件开发智能体日志显示，缓存上下文读取主导令牌用量，现有能耗估算可能显著低估其影响。
AI.motivation: 传统能耗估计忽略累计上下文的重复处理、缓存复用和子智能体执行，难以反映智能体工作流。
AI.method: 分析十周内42个会话、752个任务的近十亿令牌，并扩展推理能耗模型以计入缓存上下文处理。
AI.result: 缓存读取占令牌的94.8%；缓存感知模型估计约250千瓦时，为输出令牌估计值的25倍。
AI.conclusion: 需采用覆盖上下文积累、缓存和委托执行的工作流级能耗核算，但两种估计器均未经长缓存上下文验证。

title: Markov-Equivalent Conditional Independence Graphs on Path Spaces
summary: Causal discovery for continuous-time stochastic processes with latent confounding typically faces a trade-off between (i) approaches that are highly informative about the causal structure but are difficult to test statistically, and (ii) approaches that admit practical tests from data but yield more coarse-grained conclusions, potentially not leveraging the direction of time. We introduce W-separation, an asymmetric graphical criterion for directed mixed graphs defined as a quaternary relation that allows distinct conditioning on past and future components. This added flexibility yields a highly informative graphical independence model while preserving testability. W-separation satisfies a global Markov property for a broad class of stochastic differential equations with latent confounding, linking it to conditional independence relations among coordinate processes that are testable from data. A central result of this work is the full characterization of W-Markov equivalence classes: we show that every equivalence class admits a unique greatest element that serves as a canonical representative and a principled target for learning algorithms. In addition, we provide necessary and sufficient conditions under which directed or bidirected edges can be added without altering the induced independence model.

AI.tldr: 提出路径空间上的非对称W分离准则，并完整刻画其马尔可夫等价类。
AI.motivation: 存在潜在混杂的连续时间因果发现，需要兼顾结构信息丰富度、统计可检验性与时间方向。
AI.method: 在有向混合图上定义可区分过去和未来条件的四元W分离关系，并建立其与过程条件独立性的联系。
AI.result: 证明广泛随机微分方程类的全局马尔可夫性质，以及每个等价类存在唯一最大元，并给出保持独立模型的加边充要条件。
AI.conclusion: W分离兼顾信息量与可检验性，其唯一最大元可作为学习算法的规范目标。

title: Multi-Rate Flow Matching for Point Cloud Upsampling
summary: Flow-matching point-cloud upsamplers refine sparse inputs into dense point clouds by integrating a learned velocity field with a fixed temporal discretization. However, local reconstruction requirements vary substantially across a shape, while a shared solver budget applies the same temporal resolution everywhere. We propose Multi-Rate Flow Matching (MRFM), a patch-adaptive framework that selects an integration budget for each local patch at inference time while keeping the learned velocity field frozen. MRFM relaxes the discrete budget into a continuous variable, optimizes it online through differentiable soft rollouts using an input-derived geometric fidelity objective, and projects the result back to a discrete budget for the final solver rollout. Experiments on PU1K and PUGAN show strong reconstruction quality, while matched-budget permutation and multi-factor analyses demonstrate that the benefit depends on patch-specific allocation rather than on the step distribution alone. MRFM is accuracy-oriented and intentionally uses additional test-time optimization to obtain more suitable local temporal resolutions.

AI.tldr: MRFM在推理时为点云局部块自适应分配流匹配积分预算，以改善上采样重建质量。
AI.motivation: 形状不同区域的重建需求差异明显，统一时间离散化难以合理分配求解预算。
AI.method: 冻结速度场，将离散预算连续化，依据输入几何保真目标通过可微软展开在线优化，再投影回离散预算。
AI.result: 在PU1K和PUGAN上获得较强重建质量，匹配预算分析表明收益源于局部块特定分配而非步数分布本身。
AI.conclusion: MRFM以额外测试时优化换取更适合局部几何的时间分辨率，侧重提升重建精度。

title: Accelerate Bench: Evaluating Agents for Application-Level Program Optimization
summary: Application optimization requires coding agents to discover useful changes and coordinate them across a complete program while preserving the required computation. We introduce Accelerate Bench, a benchmark of 32 CPU optimization tasks adapted from scientific applications and supercomputing competitions. Each task provides a working program and specifies the workload, correctness requirements, timing boundaries, and permitted edits, leaving agents to choose where and how to optimize. Public testing supports iterative development, and a separate verifier scores the final submission. On benchmark version 1.1, we evaluate 16 coding agents, each pairing a model with a harness. Their Score@1 ranges from 25.5% to 67.4%. Most of their programs are correct, and the size of the speedup separates them: the two leading agents are at least 2x faster on 22 or more of the 32 tasks, while the other fourteen reach 2x on 8 to 17 and leave 125 of their 412 correct outcomes below 1.25x. Controlled replays show why coordination across an application matters: identical source code runs between 0.29x and 2.12x depending only on build and runtime settings, and one code change is worth 1.01x or 6.4x depending on another. Accelerate Bench pairs executable workloads with agents' programs and trajectories to evaluate both their gains and the process behind them.
comment: 49 pages, 8 figures. Work by Bowen Liu was done during an internship at Tencent Hy Team. Yuhan Li is Project Lead; Nuo Chen is corresponding author (chennuo26@gmail.com). Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: Accelerate Bench以32个CPU优化任务评估编码智能体在完整应用中协调修改并保持正确性的能力。
AI.motivation: 应用优化不仅要求发现代码改进，还需协调构建、运行设置和相互依赖的修改，同时保持计算正确性。
AI.method: 为任务提供可执行程序、工作负载与修改约束，通过公开测试支持迭代，并由独立验证器评分。
AI.result: 16个智能体的Score@1为25.5%至67.4%，前两名均在至少22个任务上实现两倍或以上加速。
AI.conclusion: 智能体间的主要差异在于加速幅度，应用级协调至关重要，基准支持同时评估收益与优化过程。

title: ProSE: Probing Reconstruction Error for Semantic-guided Expert Skipping in MoE-MLLMs
summary: Mixture-of-Experts Multimodal Large Language Models (MoE-MLLMs) offer scalable inference through sparse expert activation, yet substantial computational redundancy remains among the activated experts. Existing expert skipping methods typically calibrate thresholds based on target skipping ratios or final-output divergence, overlooking the accumulation of skipping-induced error across layers and the varying semantic importance of individual tokens. To address that, we propose ProSE, a training-free, semantic-guided expert skipping framework that probes layer-wise reconstruction error to promote representation consistency compared with default activation. Specifically, we construct query-aware semantic masks to identify salient visual tokens and progressively calibrate modality-specific skipping thresholds for each MoE layer. By minimizing masked reconstruction error under a given budget, ProSE maintains semantic consistency after skipping and allows adaptive expert allocation under limited activation budgets. Extensive experiments on 9 benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements on average over existing expert skipping methods, particularly under aggressive skipping settings. ProSE maintains over 96\% performance on KimiVL-A3B-Inst with 83\% expert skipping and accelerates prefilling by $1.7\times$.

AI.tldr: ProSE通过语义引导的逐层误差校准，在大量跳过专家时保持多模态模型性能并加速推理。
AI.motivation: 现有专家跳过方法忽视跨层误差累积及不同词元的语义重要性，限制了计算冗余的削减。
AI.method: 无需训练，利用查询感知语义掩码和逐层重建误差，在预算内渐进校准各模态的专家跳过阈值。
AI.result: 在9个基准上平均优于现有方法，KimiVL-A3B-Inst跳过83%专家仍保留逾96%性能，预填充加速1.7倍。
AI.conclusion: 语义引导的重建误差校准有助于在有限激活预算下维持表示一致性，尤其适合高跳过率场景。

title: Driving the Style: Velocity-Conditioned Whole-Body Control from Motion Demonstrations
summary: Achieving human-like behavior on humanoid robots has advanced rapidly by leveraging motion-capture demonstrations rather than hand-crafted cost functions. Adversarial imitation supplies a style signal that lets a policy fulfill a task while adhering to a desired style, but is difficult to transfer to hardware. Whole-body tracking through reinforcement learning instead deploys reliably and imitates demonstrations faithfully, but the resulting policies are conditioned on the future reference, so they require a reference trajectory at runtime and can fail when the motion differs from the training data. We train a humanoid policy directly with whole-body tracking rewards while restricting its actor to compact locomotion commands and robot observations. Reference motion supervises the reward and privileged critic, without supplying reference joint trajectories to the actor or requiring teacher distillation. The demonstrated style is thereby encoded in the policy through the tracking reward, so the robot reproduces the whole-body style under commanded velocities. Trained on a single random-walk motion and commanded with velocity profiles from held-out motions, our policy reaches at least 98\% success in simulation and completes every trial on the Unitree G1. On held-out slow walking, whole-body tracking drops to 2\% success and command-conditioned distillation to 56\%, and both fail on the real robot. On the trained motions, the joint position error of our policy stays within 8\% of whole-body tracking, and it has a higher style coverage than adversarial motion priors (AMP), which fell on the real robot without a safety crane.

AI.tldr: 通过全身跟踪奖励训练仅依赖速度指令和机器人观测的策略，实现无需参考轨迹的人形运动风格控制。
AI.motivation: 对抗模仿难以迁移至硬件，而全身跟踪策略依赖运行时参考轨迹且难以泛化至未见运动。
AI.method: 参考动作仅用于跟踪奖励和特权评论家，策略网络只接收紧凑运动指令及机器人观测，无需教师蒸馏。
AI.result: 单段随机行走训练后，未见运动速度指令下仿真成功率至少98%，Unitree G1实机全部试验成功。
AI.conclusion: 跟踪奖励可将示范风格编码进速度条件策略，在无需运行时关节参考轨迹的情况下实现可靠控制。

title: Comfort as a Constraint or as a Cost in Reinforcement Learning and Model Predictive Building Control
summary: A building controller that keeps a zone within comfort bounds at minimum energy can treat the bounds as a soft constraint, by adding the weighted violation to its cost, or as a hard constraint. We analyze the effect of the hard and the soft formulation of the same problem and isolate the effect of the formulation from the effect of the algorithm. To this end, we measure the difference in energy use between the two formulations on the BOPTEST bestest_hydronic_heat_pump case, in model predictive control (MPC) and in reinforcement learning (RL). The soft formulations are a weighted MPC and weighted SAC and DDPG learners, each at twelve weights. The hard formulations are an MPC with an exact penalty and the Lagrangian learners SAC-Lagrangian and primal-dual DDPG. We find that the hard formulations use more energy than the soft formulations at the largest weight, but violate the comfort bounds less. For a large weight, the soft formulation approaches the behavior of the hard formulation. The frontiers of the energy-comfort trade-off of the three weighted controllers lie close to each other, and the weight selects an operating point on this frontier. Under the soft formulation, the three algorithms reach very similar operating points, although at somewhat different weights. For this HVAC problem, the formulation and the weight thus affect the energy use more than the choice of algorithm.

AI.tldr: 建筑温控实验表明，舒适度约束形式及权重对能耗的影响大于控制算法选择。
AI.motivation: 需要区分舒适度软硬约束建模与控制算法本身对建筑能耗和舒适度的影响。
AI.method: 在BOPTEST热泵案例中，对比MPC、SAC和DDPG的多权重软约束版本及对应硬约束版本。
AI.result: 硬约束比最大权重软约束耗能更多但违规更少，三种加权控制器的能耗—舒适度前沿相近。
AI.conclusion: 在该暖通空调问题中，应优先关注约束建模与权重设置，而非仅依据算法选择优化能耗。

title: From Recursion to Convolution: Parallel Self-Improvement for Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Multi-agent self-improvement enables agents to improve through interaction and feedback. However, sequential dependencies across agents and refinement rounds can propagate errors, increase computational costs, and limit parallelism. Moreover, refining individual features or agents in isolation can overlook their dependencies and restrict collective coordination. To address these challenges, we propose ConvRSI, a framework for parallelizing multi-agent self-improvement through convolution. ConvRSI couples intra-agent convolution, which jointly refines related agent features, with inter-agent graph convolution, which aggregates messages according to the collaboration topology. Both stages operate in latent space, enabling parallel updates without repeatedly decoding and re-encoding intermediate messages. Experiments on MATH-500 show that ConvRSI achieves 5.04% performance improvement while reducing 17.27% inference cost, and 45.11% latency compared with RecursiveMAS. It also supports diverse collaboration patterns by representing their topologies as adjacency matrices. These results demonstrate the potential of convolutional co-evolution for efficient multi-agent self-improvement. Our code and datasets are provided in this https URL.

AI.tldr: ConvRSI以潜空间卷积并行优化多智能体，在提高任务表现的同时降低推理成本和延迟。
AI.motivation: 多智能体递归改进存在串行依赖、误差传播和计算开销，孤立优化还会忽视特征与智能体间依赖。
AI.method: 结合智能体内特征卷积与基于协作拓扑的智能体间图卷积，在潜空间并行更新以避免反复编解码。
AI.result: 在MATH-500上，相比RecursiveMAS性能提升5.04%，推理成本降低17.27%，延迟降低45.11%。
AI.conclusion: 卷积式协同演化可提升多智能体自我改进效率，并通过邻接矩阵支持不同协作模式。

title: Which AI Use Cases Deserve a Pilot? A Risk and Value Framework for Funding, Scoping, and Scaling AI
summary: A composite score can rank AI use cases while leaving the permitted operating scope and the evidence required for expansion unspecified. We treat the unit of decision as a use case at a proposed scope (authority, human mediation, limits, volume, environment, population) and define three decisions: screen the scope, fund the experiment, and authorize expansion only when residual risk is acceptable and evidence of incremental net value applies at that scope. A risk track (R1-R4) is implemented as an explicit decision table with vetoes and documented precedence, and a value track follows four evidence stages with each transition needing its own evidence. Funding uses expected value of perfect information as an upper bound and the value of sample information for the specific experiment. A quantified expected-loss check, required where policy says so, computes the containment an expansion needs and credits a control only on evidence measured at the proposed scope; in a synthetic scenario the highest-value control design fails that test while a smaller scope passes. A reproducible Python package with 279 passing tests demonstrates the framework on synthetic refund, reconciliation and knowledge-assistant use cases, including a synthetic matched-scope fixture and a transferability stress test (value evidence is simulated, not realized), and compares it with a public AWS sample. Thresholds and appetite are prototype policy requiring field validation.
comment: 18 pages. All results use synthetic data. A companion Python package reproduces the tables

AI.tldr: 该框架将AI用例的试点资助与扩展授权分离，以明确范围内的风险和净价值证据支持决策。
AI.motivation: 单一综合评分虽能排序AI用例，却无法明确允许的运行范围及扩大部署所需证据。
AI.method: 以用例及其拟定范围为决策单位，结合风险决策表、四阶段价值证据、信息价值和预期损失检查。
AI.result: 含279项通过测试的软件包完成合成案例演示，其中最高价值控制方案未通过扩展检查，较小范围方案通过。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供可复现的范围化决策流程，但价值证据为模拟数据，政策阈值与风险偏好仍需实地验证。

title: Certified, Not Explained: Exact Token Erasure in Gated Vision State Space Models
summary: Vision models built on Mamba are often explained through their selective step size Delta, on the assumption that a token the scan does not admit cannot influence the prediction. We test that in a concept bottleneck model for lung-nodule malignancy built on a single gated, bidirectional selective state-space block. The answer becomes an interpretability framework: a guarantee, a procedure that checks it, and a pre-registered audit of what it explains. For a fixed gate pattern, masking the input of the causal convolution of the block and giving closed tokens zero weight at readout makes the concept and task logits exactly invariant to the closed tokens. Gating Delta is neither necessary nor sufficient. On LIDC-IDRI, a path-by-path knockout over 15 cross-validated models agrees with this in every run: the largest logit change is exactly 0 whenever the conditions hold and between 4.1 and 6.7 when they do not. The gated model reaches a pooled out-of-fold AUROC of 0.8425 +/- 0.0085, level with an ungated Mamba bottleneck (0.8428). The guarantee belongs to the masked model, not to the gate as an explanation. Post-hoc rankers, which inherit the guarantee on this model, order tokens better than the gate. Gate maps from a model trained on permuted labels are as close to the real maps as two real-label seeds are to each other. Under retraining, the tokens of the gate carry more task information than random tokens and, on shifted crops, more than central ones, but no more than the tokens chosen by hidden attention. We therefore read the gate as a certified support set produced by mask supervision. Splitting the Oracle Impurity Score into own-concept and cross-concept parts reveals differences the aggregate score misses. Partitioning the readout reduced leakage slightly under an earlier recipe, and the final model sits at, rather than below, the level implied by correlations among the true concepts.

AI.tldr: 研究给出门控视觉状态空间模型精确消除词元影响的条件，并指出这种保证不等同于门控解释有效。
AI.motivation: 仅凭选择性步长解释Mamba模型，可能错误地认为未被扫描接纳的词元无法影响预测。
AI.method: 固定门控模式，屏蔽因果卷积输入并令关闭词元的读出权重为零，再开展路径消融和预注册审计。
AI.result: 15个交叉验证模型均在条件成立时实现零输出变化，门控模型AUROC为0.8425，与无门控模型相当。
AI.conclusion: 精确不变性属于掩码模型而非门控解释，门控更适合作为掩码监督产生的可认证支持集。

title: SciWorldBench: Do Video World Models Really Understand Scientific Experiments?
summary: While the ability of video generation models to accurately depict scientific phenomena has received growing attention, determining whether these models genuinely understand the underlying principles remains a critical challenge. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate video samples in isolation, making it difficult to expose models that simply fit superficial visual priors. In scientific experiments, a small change in one condition produces a markedly different outcome even when the rest of the setup remains fixed. Capitalizing on this sensitivity, we introduce SciWorldBench, a benchmark comprising paired scientific experiments. Each pair varies a single condition in an otherwise fixed setup, yielding two mutually exclusive expected outcomes. Each generation prompt specifies the condition but omits the expected outcome. We evaluate ten text-and-image-to-video (TI2V) models using an independent vision-language model (VLM) that assesses each video without access to the condition text or the label identifying the correct outcome. A pair is scored as correct only when both videos depict their respective scientifically correct outcomes. Across all ten models, we find that the two videos in an experimental pair frequently depict the same outcome even though the conditions require different results. This recurring failure suggests that current video world models struggle to apply the underlying scientific principles reliably during generation. We will publicly release the benchmark dataset and open-source the evaluation code.
comment: Preprint. Benchmark paper with paired scientific experiments for evaluating video world models. 8 pages of main text, 16 pages including figures and references

AI.tldr: SciWorldBench用单条件变化的成对科学实验，揭示视频生成模型对科学规律应用的不可靠性。
AI.motivation: 单独评估视频难以区分模型真正理解科学原理，还是仅拟合表面视觉先验。
AI.method: 构建结果互斥的成对实验，用独立视觉语言模型盲评十种视频模型，仅两段结果均正确时判该对正确。
AI.result: 十种模型均频繁在条件要求不同结果时生成相同结果，暴露出一致性的科学推理失败。
AI.conclusion: 当前视频世界模型仍难以在生成中可靠应用科学原理，成对实验能揭示孤立样本评估遗漏的问题。

title: Joint Learning of Control Lyapunov Functions and Controllers via Stable-by-Design Surrogates
summary: Training and verifying neural network-based control Lyapunov functions (CLFs) can be computationally demanding. To address this challenge, we propose a framework that jointly learns a CLF and a stabilizing controller using structured neural networks and a projection-based parameterization. Specifically, we employ Polyak-Lojasiewicz networks (PLNets), which parameterize nonconvex, positive-definite CLF candidates, and construct a stable-by-design surrogate of the closed-loop dynamics that satisfies the Lyapunov decrease condition by construction. The controller combines linear state feedback with a higher-order correction term resembling Sontag's universal formula and is trained to align the resulting closed-loop dynamics with the stable-by-design surrogate. Unlike classical approaches based on Sontag's formula, our framework does not require a known CLF; instead, it learns the CLF and controller simultaneously. We establish local and global stability guarantees for the learned controller and demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach through numerical examples.

AI.tldr: 该框架借助按设计稳定的动力学替代模型，联合学习控制李雅普诺夫函数与稳定控制器。
AI.motivation: 神经网络控制李雅普诺夫函数的训练与验证计算负担较重，传统方法还可能要求预先已知该函数。
AI.method: 用PLNet参数化正定候选函数，通过投影构造满足下降条件的替代动力学，并训练控制器与之对齐。
AI.result: 研究建立了所学控制器的局部和全局稳定性保证，并以数值示例展示方法有效性。
AI.conclusion: 结构化网络与稳定性内嵌参数化支持同步学习李雅普诺夫函数和控制器，无需预先给定该函数。

title: Auditing a Moving Target: Evidence Anchoring and the Expiry of Fairness Audits of Provider-Served Language Models
summary: Organizations increasingly use large language models (LLMs) for decisions about people, such as hiring, investment and employee evaluation, and rely on them over long periods of time. Fairness audits of such systems, however, are conducted only once. We examine how the biases of LLMs change over time. In a venture screening setting, models from five providers decided whether and how much to invest in startups whose founders differed only in gender, origin and university. We repeated this audit three times over 13 months (248,400 API calls). Study 1 shows that the same model, called under the same identifier one year later, displayed a significantly different bias pattern. Study 2 shows that the successors of retired models carried the same bias as their predecessors, but in a significantly different size and form. Study 3 shows that the bias does not depend on the industry of the startup. A document analysis further shows that providers change and retire models at their discretion, with notice periods of zero to six months. Drawing on these findings, we develop a theory of evidence anchoring. We theorize that bias resides in the model class and persists, whereas audit evidence is anchored to a single model and expires when the provider decides. We derive policy advice for organizations and regulators, namely audits of model classes instead of single models, a version record for every model response, and re-audits triggered by model changes.

AI.tldr: 长期追踪发现，服务商模型的偏见随时间变化，使一次性公平审计证据失效。
AI.motivation: 组织长期依赖语言模型决策，但一次性公平审计难以反映服务商持续更新模型带来的偏见变化。
AI.method: 在创业投资筛选场景中，对五家服务商模型开展跨13个月的三轮审计，并分析模型变更文档。
AI.result: 同名模型及退役后继模型的偏见模式或程度显著变化，且偏见不依赖创业企业所属行业。
AI.conclusion: 应审计模型类别而非单一模型，记录每次响应的版本，并在模型变更时触发重新审计。

title: Can Image Generators Hold a Scene Together When Space Is Broken Apart?
summary: Image generators are good at drawing scenes in which things that belong together appear next to each other. In almost every image they generate, and in almost every benchmark used to evaluate these images, "belonging to the same whole" and "adjacent to each other" go together. Therefore, we cannot know whether the model truly grasps the scene as a whole, or simply makes each part connect with its adjacent parts. We propose GJBench to disentangle the two. It requires the model to draw a scene as a scattered jigsaw puzzle: an image is cut into interlocking pieces, then moved apart and rotated. Thus, the spatial plausibility of the scene exists only in how these pieces collectively point to a whole. The model may have a reference image, a target layout, both, or neither. We separately evaluate three requirements: whether the scene is broken down into a specified number of separate pieces, whether the pieces interlock, and whether the pieces can reconstruct the reference scene. While every open and closed model we evaluated could draw these scenes well as a whole, none could keep them together as scattered puzzle pieces, and the three requirements categorized failures into different patterns. The models draw separate pieces but miscount them in different ways, and unless their outlines are provided, the pieces rarely interlock, and their content does not reconstruct the reference image. We also found that the target layout helps the puzzle pieces fit together, while the reference image improves neither their count nor their fit. These findings show that keeping a scene continuous across space that the canvas no longer shows remains an open problem for image generators.

AI.tldr: GJBench显示，图像生成模型难以在分散旋转的拼图片段间保持场景整体一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有图像与基准通常将整体归属和空间邻接混同，难以判断模型是否真正理解场景整体。
AI.method: 提出散乱拼图基准GJBench，在不同参考图与布局条件下评估片数、拼接性及场景重建能力。
AI.result: 所有受测模型均难以生成可重建场景的分散拼图；目标布局改善拼接，参考图未改善片数或拼接。
AI.conclusion: 在画布未直接呈现的空间关系中保持场景连续性，仍是图像生成模型的未解难题。

title: Physics-Informed Direct Data-Driven Gain-Scheduled Control for Improving the Extrapolation Performance of Vehicle Lateral Control
summary: This paper proposes a physics-informed direct data-driven control (PI-D3C) framework for designing a gain-scheduled proportional-integral controller for vehicle yaw-rate tracking. Vehicle lateral dynamics vary depending on vehicle velocity, making it difficult for controllers designed using data collected over a limited operating range to maintain satisfactory control performance outside that range. We introduce a novel PI-D3C framework that integrates pure data-driven virtual reference feedback tuning (VRFT) with prior physical knowledge, thereby significantly improving extrapolation performance beyond the operating range covered by the collected data. In the proposed approach, the gain-scheduled controller parameters are designed based on both training data and the yaw-rate response predicted by the physics-based model. To evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed method, numerical simulations are conducted using co-simulation between MATLAB/Simulink and CarSim. The results demonstrate that the controller designed by pure VRFT achieves satisfactory tracking performance within the training velocity region but exhibits significant deterioration in tracking performance outside the training region. In contrast, the proposed controller maintains good yaw-rate tracking performance over a wider velocity range while suppressing excessive variations in the scheduled gains and steering input. These results indicate that incorporating prior physical knowledge into pure data-driven VRFT improves the extrapolation performance of gain-scheduled controllers designed using limited training data.

AI.tldr: 融合物理先验与数据驱动调参，可改善车辆横摆角速度控制在训练车速范围外的表现。
AI.motivation: 车辆横向动力学随车速变化，有限工况数据设计的控制器难以维持范围外的跟踪性能。
AI.method: 结合虚拟参考反馈整定与物理模型预测响应设计增益调度PI控制器，并开展联合仿真。
AI.result: 相比纯数据驱动整定，所提控制器在更宽车速范围内保持良好跟踪，并抑制增益及转向输入过度变化。
AI.conclusion: 物理先验可提升有限训练数据下增益调度控制器的外推性能。

title: Palmprint Decomposer: Interpretable and Editable Factorization via Synthetic Learning and Instance-Wise Refinement
summary: Palmprint recognition and synthesis methods focus on extracting discriminative textures or generating images with varied textures and appearances. However, they do not generally provide an explicit image-level representation that separates palmprint texture from its underlying base appearance for independent analysis or controlled editing. We introduce Palmprint Decomposer, an interpretable framework that represents a palmprint through independently editable factors and reconstructs the image through a multiplicative composition model. A color map and a light map characterize the base appearance, while a structure map and a global texture strength parameter describe texture modulation. However, accurate reconstruction alone does not guarantee separation of palmprint texture from base appearance, as fine palmprint textures may leak into the estimated base appearance. To mitigate this ambiguity, we train the decomposer exclusively on synthetic data with direct factor supervision, using asymmetric decoding paths and decomposition constraints to suppress texture leakage. Instance-Wise Refinement further improves real-image reconstruction by directly optimizing the predicted factors for each input without relying on the trained network. Experiments across seven datasets demonstrate high reconstruction fidelity, with the extracted structure maps generally achieving verification performance comparable to the original images. Compared with existing methods, our approach achieves better factor separation while preserving more discriminative palmprint texture information.

AI.tldr: Palmprint Decomposer将掌纹分解为可独立编辑的外观与纹理因子，兼顾重建和辨识信息保留。
AI.motivation: 现有掌纹识别与合成方法缺乏显式分离纹理和基础外观的图像级表示，限制独立分析与编辑。
AI.method: 采用乘法组合模型、合成数据因子监督及分解约束训练，并逐实例优化预测因子以细化重建。
AI.result: 七个数据集实验显示重建保真度高，结构图验证性能通常接近原图，因子分离与纹理保留优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 合成监督与逐实例细化有助于实现可解释、可编辑且保留辨识纹理的掌纹分解。

title: Multi-LLM Agentic AI at the Edge: Joint Agent Scheduling and Resource Allocation
summary: In this paper, an edge-enabled multi-large language model (LLM) agentic AI architecture is proposed, where one supervisor AI agent and multiple worker AI agents cooperatively execute users' requests at the edge. The supervisor AI agent decouples the user request into a series of sub-tasks and dynamically dispatches them to LLM-equipped worker AI agents via two agentic workflows, i.e., parallel and serial workflows, with a two-level retry mechanism to enhance execution reliability. To prolong the service duration of worker AI agents, the energy minimization problems are formulated by jointly considering AI agent selection and resource allocation, subject to task execution latency and quality of service (QoS) constraints. A resource allocation scheme based on alternating optimization (AO) is proposed. Specifically, for the parallel workflow, the scheme decouples the original problem into bandwidth allocation, retrieval selection and AI agent selection sub-problems, which are iteratively solved by the proposed successive convex approximation (SCA), Lagrangian relaxation (LR), and Gale-Shapley (GS) or LLM-based algorithms, respectively. For the serial workflow, the problem is similarly decoupled into service time allocation, retrieval selection and AI agent selection sub-problems; the optimal service time allocation is obtained via Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) conditions, while the latter two sub-problems are addressed by extending the proposed algorithms to the serial scenario. Simulation results show that the proposed resource allocation scheme can reduce system energy consumption compared with other benchmarks, while experiments on a multi-LLM agentic AI system based on Qwen and Llama demonstrate improved task execution success rates.

AI.tldr: 通过联合智能体调度与资源分配，边缘多语言模型智能体系统可降低能耗并提高任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 边缘多智能体协作需在满足任务时延和服务质量约束的同时降低能耗，延长工作智能体服务时间。
AI.method: 设计主管与工作智能体的并串行工作流及两级重试机制，并以交替优化联合求解智能体选择和资源分配。
AI.result: 仿真显示所提方案较基准降低系统能耗，基于Qwen和Llama的系统实验显示任务执行成功率提升。
AI.conclusion: 联合调度、资源优化与重试机制可支持更节能且可靠的边缘多模型智能体协作。

title: EviBridge: Encoding Predictive Visual Evidence for Proactive Interaction
summary: Tool-handover interaction calls for preparation before a response is warranted. The model waits until interaction cues appear, then prepares while assessing whether the accumulating evidence supports a response or calls for cancellation. We introduce EviBridge, a framework that integrates predictive visual representations into a vision-language interaction model for joint state and tool prediction. A trainable evidence interface maps features from a frozen V-JEPA 2 encoder into the language decoder alongside native visual inputs, preserving their temporal context and using only observations available at each decision time. The framework has two instantiations. EviBridge-E distinguishes recent from historical evidence and encodes the timing and spatial location of each observation. EviBridge-I preserves the temporal order of pooled V-JEPA 2 features and interaction turns and generates dedicated interaction tokens. We evaluate on FuGIBench, a streaming-video benchmark for preparation, response, and cancellation in tool-handover assistance. The best-performing variants of EviBridge-E and EviBridge-I achieve Overall scores of 0.6448 and 0.5892, compared with 0.2178 and 0.5327 for their respective task-adapted native baselines. These gains span target handovers, long waits, and cancelled requests, demonstrating the value of predictive visual evidence for interaction decisions.

AI.tldr: EviBridge将预测性视觉证据接入视觉语言模型，改善递工具交互中的准备、响应与取消决策。
AI.motivation: 递工具辅助需要在响应前准备，并根据持续积累的交互证据判断是否响应或取消。
AI.method: 通过可训练接口将冻结V-JEPA 2的特征接入语言解码器，以两种实现保留观测时序与交互信息。
AI.result: 两种实现的最佳总体得分为0.6448和0.5892，分别高于对应基线的0.2178和0.5327。
AI.conclusion: 预测性视觉证据有助于改善目标递交、长时间等待及请求取消场景中的交互决策。

title: Experience Rot: Experienced Agents Fail Where Novices Succeed
summary: Agents are increasingly built to learn from experience: they keep conversation histories, memory files, retrieved notes and skills, and reuse what worked before. We show that this experience turns against them when their tools change silently. We test a range of models with tools defined as in the Model Context Protocol (MCP). After a silent change, experienced agents fail on most tasks, while agents new to the task mostly succeed. We call this failure Experience Rot. Experienced agents copy their earlier call instead of checking the current interface, even when the tool definition shows the change. Then they report success. When the documentation is incomplete, experience is what makes agents succeed. After a change, the same experience leaves them worse off than no experience at all. The failure appears in every form of memory we test and grows with the amount of experience. Simple remedies fall short: announcing the update barely helps, and pointing the agent to the documentation fails whenever the documentation does not spell out the answer.

AI.tldr: 工具接口静默变更后，历史经验反而使智能体比新手更易失败，形成“经验腐化”。
AI.motivation: 智能体日益依赖历史和记忆，但工具静默变化后复用旧经验的可靠性尚不明确。
AI.method: 使用按MCP定义的工具测试多种模型，比较接口静默变更后不同经验量和记忆形式的任务表现。
AI.result: 有经验智能体在多数任务中失败而新手多数成功；该现象遍及所测记忆形式，并随经验量增加而加剧。
AI.conclusion: 经验在文档不全时有益，却可能在接口变更后造成负迁移，简单更新通知或文档指引不足以解决问题。

title: Advancing Cognitive Pairwise Comparisons for Human-Centric Artificial Intelligence and Data Science: A Human-in-the-Loop Framework
summary: Human-centric artificial intelligence and data science (HCAD) systems increasingly involve human-in-the-loop (HITL) interventions to overcome the limitations of fully automated machine learning algorithms, such as automation bias and the inability to incorporate tacit domain knowledge, and continuously improve predictive performance. Data transformations, feature selection, feature weighting, and model selection usually require laborious human involvement across iterations of artificial intelligence and data science (AI&DS) pipelines, making development a challenging and time-consuming process. The Cognitive Pairwise Comparison (CPC) framework is proposed as a human-centric methodology to elicit preferences and priorities in a structured format. To establish essential facets of human-centricity, this research advances the CPC methodology so that user preference elicitation can be systematically quantified in these challenging AI&DS tasks. To demonstrate the usability and validity of these facets, this study presents several applications within movie recommender systems using the MovieLens dataset. It exemplifies how the extended CPC framework can facilitate interactions between human judgments and data across supervised learning, dimensionality reduction, and unsupervised learning algorithms.
comment: 33 pages, 19 tables, 8 figures; interactive web demos available at this https URL ; source code and datasets at this https URL ; archived at this https URL ; earlier preprint version available at SSRN 4048692 (this http URL or this https URL)

AI.tldr: 扩展认知成对比较框架，将用户偏好结构化量化，支持以人为中心的人工智能与数据科学流程。
AI.motivation: 全自动学习难以纳入隐性领域知识，而数据处理、特征与模型选择中的反复人工干预耗时费力。
AI.method: 扩展认知成对比较方法以量化偏好，并用MovieLens推荐场景展示其在多类学习任务中的应用。
AI.result: 摘要展示了该框架在监督学习、降维和无监督学习中连接人类判断与数据的应用，未报告定量结果。
AI.conclusion: 扩展框架可为复杂人工智能与数据科学任务提供结构化的人机交互与偏好表达方式。

title: Transferable Neural CBFs via Generalized Closure
summary: Classical control barrier functions (CBFs) provide safety constraints for controllers, but designing them by hand is difficult for underactuated vehicles and the resulting safe sets can be overly conservative. Neural CBFs can learn more informative barriers from data, yet a learned barrier is usually verified only for one fixed obstacle configuration. We study whether one neural barrier can be reused across environments by expressing the state relative to each obstacle. The key gap is that these relative coordinates may discard information needed to predict their own evolution. We give a generalized closure condition that represents this missing information as a residual and a lifting theorem that transfers a verified relative-coordinate barrier to every obstacle in a family. A rank test also identifies when symmetry alone cannot justify the transfer. We validate the conditions on a double integrator, a planar aircraft, and a 12-state quadrotor. Coordinates that fail the test lead to obstacle penetration or to a barrier condition that fails near hover, whereas body-frame coordinates close exactly for the quadrotor. The resulting barrier transfers to new maps without retraining and is effective in the reported deployment and fast-start experiments.
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Submitted to the 2027 American Control Conference (ACC 2027)

AI.tldr: 通过广义闭合条件，神经控制屏障函数可跨障碍物环境迁移，无需重新训练。
AI.motivation: 手工设计屏障函数困难且保守，而相对坐标可能丢失动力学信息，阻碍安全性验证的迁移。
AI.method: 用残差表示缺失信息，提出广义闭合条件、屏障提升定理及检验对称性是否足以支持迁移的秩测试。
AI.result: 三类动力学系统验证表明，不合格坐标会导致安全失效，而四旋翼机体坐标精确闭合并支持新地图迁移。
AI.conclusion: 相对坐标的闭合性为屏障跨环境复用提供理论依据，所得屏障在部署及快速启动实验中有效。

title: Razavi-Bench: Tracking AI Progress in Analog Circuit Reasoning
summary: We propose Razavi-Bench, a benchmark built from the 50 questions in Razavi's two Analog Design Experiments With AI articles and graded by GPT-6 Luna against reference answers and rubrics, and use it to track how fast AI models improve at analog circuit analysis. Across 73 multimodal large language models released between May 2024 and November 2026, the top score rose from 28.83% to 98.33% in 30 months, mostly before the reference answers were published. The leading models now answer almost every textbook question correctly; the hardest questions show a circuit that resembles a textbook one but works differently, or ask about behavior the obvious analysis misses. Within two and a half years, a set of questions that exposed the limits of AI models has become one they answer almost perfectly.
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Project page: this https URL ; code and data: this https URL

AI.tldr: Razavi-Bench显示，领先模型在这套模拟电路题上的表现已从低分提升至接近满分。
AI.motivation: 需要持续衡量人工智能在模拟电路分析上的进步速度及尚存的推理难点。
AI.method: 以Razavi两篇文章中的50道题构建基准，由GPT-6 Luna按参考答案和评分标准评估73个多模态大模型。
AI.result: 30个月内最高分从28.83%升至98.33%，且主要提升发生在参考答案公开之前。
AI.conclusion: 该题集已接近被领先模型解决，剩余难题主要涉及外观误导的电路及常规分析遗漏的行为。

title: ReAccess: Look Once, Stay Focused with Efficient Test Time Memory
summary: Despite recent advances, vision-language models (VLMs) still struggle with fine-grained visual understanding, often failing to effectively utilize critical evidence already encoded in their visual representations. Existing approaches address this limitation through repeated visual processing or explicit reasoning, introducing substantial computational overhead. In this paper, we propose ReAccess, a lightweight framework that preserves and reuses question-relevant visual evidence through compact associative memory. Constructed during a single visual prefill, the memory supports progressive evidence retrieval that steers both attention queries and hidden representations, enabling effective visual grounding without repeated image encoding or explicit reasoning traces. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in both general visual understanding and fine-grained perception, while achieving substantially faster inference than existing reasoning-intensive approaches, demonstrating a promising path to efficient multimodal reasoning.
