AI.tldr: ReAccess用紧凑测试时记忆复用视觉证据，在提升视觉理解的同时减少推理开销。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型难以有效利用已编码的细粒度证据，而重复视觉处理或显式推理成本较高。
AI.method: 在单次视觉预填充中构建问题相关的关联记忆，渐进检索证据以引导注意力查询和隐藏表示。
AI.result: 实验显示，通用视觉理解与细粒度感知均持续改善，推理速度显著快于现有推理密集型方法。
AI.conclusion: 保留并复用视觉证据可避免重复图像编码，为高效多模态推理提供可行路径。

title: Learning What the True Labels Would Teach: Posterior Analytic Class-Incremental Learning with Unlabeled Data
summary: In class-incremental learning with unlabeled data, each task brings only class names and unlabeled images, so CLIP's zero-shot predictions replace labels. Existing methods train on hard pseudo-labels, but a wrong one gives the true class zero probability, which self-training often confirms. We argue that each image should carry its label posterior, as an analytic classifier trained on posteriors equals the true-label one in expectation. The zero-shot prediction is not this posterior, as its class proportions confound name bias with true imbalance and it ignores other images. We propose Posterior Analytic Class-Incremental Learning (PACIL), which corrects the class prior with a prior selection rule and refines each distribution by a fixed-prior von Mises-Fisher mixture on whitened features. These soft labels train the classifier and replace labels to select its fusion weight with zero-shot CLIP by closed-form leave-one-out cross-validation. We prove that posterior targets minimize the mean-square gap to the true-label prediction and that their argmax widens this gap only through ambiguous images. The fusion weight selected with soft labels loses at most their distance to the posteriors in expected correct decisions. PACIL has the best average incremental accuracy among methods trained without labels on all 18 settings.

AI.tldr: PACIL以校正后的标签后验训练解析分类器，改善无标签类别增量学习。
AI.motivation: 硬伪标签会排除真实类别并强化错误，而CLIP零样本预测混杂类别名称偏差与真实分布差异。
AI.method: 校正类别先验，在白化特征上用固定先验的von Mises-Fisher混合模型细化软标签，并解析选择融合权重。
AI.result: PACIL在全部18种设置中均取得无标签训练方法的最佳平均增量准确率，并获得后验目标误差理论保证。
AI.conclusion: 以标签后验替代硬伪标签，可在理论和实验上缩小无标签学习与真实标签训练之间的差距。

title: TacBridge: Learning Unified Tactile Representations through Cross-Sensor Correspondence
summary: Optical tactile sensors record tactile videos that capture local deformation and its temporal evolution during contact, supporting robot manipulation, force estimation, and tactile representation learning. Differences in imaging geometry, background appearance, illumination, resolution, and deformation response lead to sensor-dependent observations of the same contact across GelSight, DIGIT, GelSlim, TacTip, and other optical tactile sensors. This variability limits representation transfer and the joint use of multi-sensor data. We introduce TacBridge, a framework for learning unified representations from multi-sensor tactile videos through cross-sensor correspondence. Specifically, multi-sensor masked tactile-video pre-training learns spatiotemporal representations across sensors. We then train the same masked model jointly on same-sensor and cross-sensor reconstruction, using paired source and target videos of matched contact events. Experiments on cross-sensor translation and downstream perception demonstrate the cross-sensor generalization and task transferability of the learned tactile representations.

AI.tldr: TacBridge利用跨传感器接触对应关系，从多传感器触觉视频中学习统一表示。
AI.motivation: 光学触觉传感器的成像及形变响应差异限制了表示迁移与多传感器数据联合利用。
AI.method: 先进行多传感器掩码触觉视频预训练，再用匹配接触事件的视频联合训练同传感器与跨传感器重建。
AI.result: 跨传感器转换及下游感知实验表明，所学表示具备跨传感器泛化能力和任务迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 利用接触事件的跨传感器对应关系，可促进不同光学触觉传感器间的表示共享。

title: vividRGB: Various visual cue detection in RGB photographs with forced focused attention
summary: Natural photographs contain dense, overlapping structures that can be weakly expressed in feature maps from whole-image vision encoders. We introduce forced focused attention (FFA) and its Python implementation, vividRGB. FFA is an encoder-agnostic inference-time procedure that applies a frozen encoder to enlarged, overlapping local crops, averages inverse-aligned reflections, and reconstructs a feature field in source coordinates. We evaluate 50 high-resolution photographs from grassland vegetation, fungal networks, airborne forests, coral reefs, and phytoplankton microscopy, using DINOv3 ViT-B/16. Across the five domains, FFA at 5% or 10% focus produces higher mean RGB-edge boundary F1 than direct DINOv3 encoding and automatic SAM3 masks. Domain means range from 0.244 to 0.596 for FFA, versus 0.028-0.076 for direct DINOv3 and 0.020-0.090 for SAM3. Qualitative feature maps also show finer appearance structure. These results concern RGB-edge preservation rather than verified species, traits, or biological segmentation. Narrower focus generally improves boundary preservation, while extraction time and GPU energy use increase sharply and gains diminish at finer settings. FFA may be useful for relatively small, high-resolution ecological image collections where dense visual cues matter. The alpha release vividRGB 0.1.0 and versioned research resources support reproducible cue inspection.
comment: 32 pages including supplementary material; 6 numbered figures and a graphical summary

AI.tldr: vividRGB通过推理时局部聚焦增强高分辨率照片的RGB边缘保留，但增加时间与能耗。
AI.motivation: 自然照片中密集重叠的细节结构，在整图视觉编码器的特征图中可能表达不足。
AI.method: 冻结编码器处理放大的重叠裁剪，融合反向对齐的镜像结果，并在原图坐标重建特征场。
AI.result: 五领域50张照片中，FFA的平均边界F1为0.244至0.596，高于直接DINOv3编码及SAM3掩码。
AI.conclusion: 该方法适合重视密集视觉线索的小型高分辨率图集，但结果仅验证RGB边缘保留，未验证生物学分割。

title: ROSE: A Shared Cross-Embodiment Facial-Motion Latent Space for Humanoid Robot Expression
summary: Natural, coherent full-face dynamic expressions are central to making humanoid robots socially approachable, yet existing systems commonly realize only limited lip motion or scripted expressions. The limitation is both physical and algorithmic. A compact head leaves little room for densely packed, independently controllable actuation; meanwhile, learned systems often generate an avatar video, landmarks, or facial parameters and then infer actuator commands through visual retargeting. This render-and-invert path adds latency and artifacts, and it does not reliably transfer generated behavior to a physical robot. We present ROSE (RObot facial expression through Shared motion Embeddings), a framework that integrates biomimetic hardware, cross-embodiment motion representation learning, and multimodal motion generation. On the hardware side, we build a flexible tendon-sheath transmission structure that integrates 34 actuators into a 19.5 cm biomimetic head. By decoupling actuator placement from facial action points, it enables coordinated full-face expression within a compact volume. On the algorithmic side, ROSE-VAE learns an identity-independent shared facial-motion latent space from human, digital-human, and robot observations. ROSE-Flow directly maps text, audio, or their combination to trajectories in this motion space without using video as a generator input. ROSE-ACT then converts these trajectories into constrained actuator commands. Our system demonstrates how high-density biomimetic hardware and a shared executable facial-motion representation can jointly unify cross-embodiment learning, multimodal generation, and physical robot expression.

AI.tldr: ROSE结合紧凑仿生硬件与共享面部运动空间，将多模态输入转化为机器人全脸运动。
AI.motivation: 紧凑头部难以容纳密集驱动器，且先生成视觉表示再反求驱动命令会引入延迟、伪影与迁移问题。
AI.method: 以腱鞘传动集成驱动器，用ROSE-VAE学习跨具身运动空间，再由ROSE-Flow生成轨迹并由ROSE-ACT执行。
AI.result: 系统在19.5厘米仿生头部中集成34个驱动器，并展示文本、音频或二者组合驱动的实体面部表情。
AI.conclusion: 高密度仿生硬件与可执行的共享运动表示，可统一跨具身学习、多模态生成及机器人表情控制。

title: Same Fix, Different Weights: Replicating Weight-Space Programming with Claude
summary: Takehi et al. (2026) report that GPT-6 Astra, given the weights of small neural networks as text, can say what they were trained to do, repair them, and write new ones without training. I re-ran the core of that study with Claude Opus 5.5 in ten pre-registered experiments, with untrained-network and permutation controls and hand audits of every sandboxed code cell. Reading was mixed: Claude named 3 of 4 Atari games from policy weights and found the measured copying heads in 15/15 character-LM runs, but its answers about training data often followed priors. Unlike the original, it identified a sycophantic Gemma 3 270M finetune from weights alone in 6/6 runs. One-shot weight edits took a failing MountainCar policy from 0% to 100% success and a hovering LunarLander policy from 0% to 85.6%; zero-shot networks beat PPO at 100k steps on 4 of 5 environments, each implementing a textbook controller. With no training or forward passes, Claude wrote a 1.48M-parameter 9x9 Go network that won 85-94% of games against three PPO opponents. Given Qwen3.5-0.8B's weights and 10, 25 or 50 forward passes of 64 practice problems, Claude raised MATH-500 from 6.7% to 51.4%, 55.2% and 58.1% (+51.4 points at 50 passes, 95% CI [47.9, 55.0]; original 48.1%), GSM8K from 11.6% to 68.2% and IFEval from 22.2% to 54.2%. Unlike the original, which removed an internal loop direction, every edit acted at the output: it scaled the final norm, raising the effective sampling temperature, and lowered the logit of "Wait" while raising that of </think>. The norm scaling alone reaches only 20.9-22.1% on MATH-500. On Gemma 3 270M, which rarely loops, no edit helped (-0.8 points), as in the original.

AI.tldr: Claude复现了多项权重空间编程能力，但其有效编辑机制与原研究不同。
AI.motivation: 检验原研究中的权重读取、修复及无训练网络构造能力能否迁移到Claude，并核查其作用机制。
AI.method: 使用Claude Opus 5.5开展十项预注册实验，设置未训练网络及置换对照，并人工审计全部沙箱代码单元。
AI.result: 单次编辑将MountainCar成功率从0%升至100%，50次前向计算辅助编辑将MATH-500从6.7%升至58.1%。
AI.conclusion: 权重编辑与网络构造能力得到部分复现，但权重读取表现不一，且有效编辑均作用于输出端。

title: Jev-as-a-Reward: Validating Probabilistic Safety Judges for Reinforcement Learning
summary: Probabilistic safety judges return the probability of a safety label and cheaply score reinforcement learning rollouts. A confidence gate sends only uncertain verdicts to a stronger LLM judge, which leaves confidently passed harm in a blind spot. Policies can exploit this blind spot, and commercial judges release new versions. We propose a protocol that validates such a judge before and during training, separates the share of confidently passed harm from its amount, and re-validates it after each judge change. We apply it to two versions of Jev, a commercial decision-only judge, and to an open guard classifier. Under the probability reward of Jev, passed harm shrinks in all 11 runs under the primary reference, mostly more slowly than caught harm, and concentrates in the blind spot. Binarizing this judge meets the escape criterion on Llama, and the open guard classifier shows an escape signal in one seed under a second reference. Guard classifiers share this blind spot, and even frontier LLM judges catch at most one of 10 human-labeled confident misses. Without a trained reward model, the probability reward with a helpfulness term lowers HarmBench attack success on Llama-3.1-8B from 0.287 to at most 0.033 at the final checkpoint.

AI.tldr: 研究提出概率安全裁判验证协议，揭示强化学习中的高置信度漏判盲区及奖励设计影响。
AI.motivation: 置信度门控无法复核高置信度放行的有害内容，策略可能利用这一盲区，且裁判更新需重新验证。
AI.method: 在训练前后及裁判更新后验证，区分高置信度放行危害的占比与总量，并测试两版Jev及开放分类器。
AI.result: 主要参考下11次运行的放行危害均减少；结合有用性项后，Llama攻击成功率从0.287降至不高于0.033。
AI.conclusion: 危害总量下降仍可能伴随其向漏判盲区集中，安全裁判需持续验证并区分奖励形式。

title: Hilbert States for Decision-Making under Partial Observability
summary: Decision-making under partial observability can be fundamentally limited by information, even with known dynamics: distinct physical states can induce the same observation history while favoring different actions. We study three questions: when is full-state optimality unattainable, what information exactly preserves the best observation-based decision, and how does finite-data learning affect reliability? First, we characterize decision ambiguity through conditional action preferences. We give a zero-regret criterion, a positive lower bound for conflicting uniquely optimal actions on positive-probability regions with uniformly positive cost gaps, and an exact binary-action regret formula. This also shows why physical-state ambiguity alone need not cause decision loss. Second, for two actions and squared terminal-goal costs in the plane, we derive an exact inner-product representation of conditional expected cost differences using three conditional moment contrasts and a goal-dependent feature. This Hilbert state preserves observation-optimal actions without hidden-state reconstruction. Under nondegenerate history and goal variation, its three-dimensional form is minimal among exact bilinear cost-contrast representations. Third, we relate finite-data state errors to excess decision regret via goal-projected errors, action margins, and goal geometry. Physics-based simulations verify information-limited regret, exact action preservation, and the role of second moments. Held-out real-SAR experiments demonstrate feasible goal-conditioned decisions from masked images, while finite-data evaluations reveal goal-dependent reliability. Together, these results separate irreducible information loss, exact representation sufficiency, and learning-induced excess regret.

AI.tldr: 研究刻画部分可观测决策的信息损失，并提出无需重建隐藏状态即可保留最优动作的希尔伯特状态。
AI.motivation: 相同观测历史可能对应偏好不同动作的物理状态，需区分信息限制、表示充分性与学习误差。
AI.method: 推导遗憾判据与界，并针对平面平方目标代价下的双动作问题构建三维条件矩对比表示。
AI.result: 理论给出非退化条件下的最小三维表示；仿真验证动作保持，真实SAR实验展示目标条件决策的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 物理状态歧义未必导致决策损失，可靠性还取决于目标几何、动作间隔与有限数据误差。

title: FAVR: Flow-Aware Visual Residual Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Pretrained video representations provide rich temporal information for robotic manipulation, yet effectively integrating them into existing vision-language-action (VLA) policies remains challenging. We present Flow-Aware Visual Residual Alignment (FAVR), a lightweight framework for flow-aware visual conditioning of frozen VLA policies. FAVR maintains a compact temporal visual state through linear Test-Time Training (TTT) and retrieves action-conditioned visual features throughout flow-based action generation. By exploiting the affine structure of the frozen action head, we explicitly characterize how injected visual features influence predicted action velocities and formulate flow-aware channel selection as a box-constrained optimization problem. We develop a FISTA-based solver for joint gate optimization and derive an efficient closed-form approximation through diagonalization and rescaling. With only 1.74-2.19M trainable parameters and 5,000 adaptation steps, FAVR improves pretrained VLA policies across benchmarks. On RoboTwin 2.0, FAVR improves LingBot-VLA from 87.12% to 90.04% under clean conditions and from 86.88% to 89.38% under randomized conditions. A controlled ablation on five RoboTwin tasks further shows that flow-aware gating increases average success from 72.0% with a gate shared across flow steps to 82.0%, demonstrating the benefit of adapting visual conditioning throughout action generation.
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures. Equal contribution: Qixuan Wu and Xiaole Yang. Corresponding authors: Yuguang Yang and Baochang Zhang

AI.tldr: FAVR以轻量时序视觉状态和流感知残差对齐，改善冻结视觉语言动作策略的机器人操作表现。
AI.motivation: 预训练视频表征包含丰富时序信息，但难以有效整合进现有视觉语言动作策略。
AI.method: 通过线性测试时训练维护视觉状态，结合冻结动作头的仿射结构优化流步骤相关的视觉通道门控。
AI.result: 仅训练174万至219万参数、适配5000步，RoboTwin干净条件成功率从87.12%升至90.04%。
AI.conclusion: 随动作生成过程调整视觉条件具有价值，五任务消融中流感知门控将平均成功率从72.0%提升至82.0%。

title: FARCH: A Functional ARCH Model for Calibrated Prediction Bands
summary: Forecasting a curve, rather than a handful of scalar summaries of it, requires a notion of uncertainty that is itself functional. We propose FARCH, a functional nonlinear autoregressive model with conditional heteroscedasticity, in which the conditional mean and the conditional volatility of the next curve are forecasted jointly and nonparametrically, by reusing a single kernel weighting scheme --- built on a wavelet semi-metric between curves --- first on the curves themselves and then on their squared residuals. From this pair of estimators we derive two constructions of prediction bands: a pointwise band, obtained from marginal scenario quantiles, and a uniform, sup-norm band, calibrated for decisions that concern the entire forecasted path rather than any single instant. Applied to day-ahead forecasting of half-hourly French national electricity demand (1996--2009), and compared, under an identical protocol, against four existing prediction-interval constructions that do not model the conditional variance explicitly, the uniform FARCH band attains pointwise coverage statistically indistinguishable from its nominal target at the 80%, 90% and 95% levels, and a curve-wise coverage of 90.1%, significantly above the 70.8% reached by the best competing method, at the cost of a wider interval. Pointwise bands, in contrast, undercover regardless of whether the variance is modelled explicitly, indicating that state-dependent volatility and simultaneous calibration are two distinct ingredients that a trustworthy prediction band must combine.

AI.tldr: FARCH联合预测曲线的条件均值与波动率，并构造逐点和全路径校准预测带。
AI.motivation: 曲线预测需要函数级不确定性刻画，单纯逐点区间难以保证整条路径的可靠覆盖。
AI.method: 利用基于小波半度量的共享核权重估计均值与残差平方，并通过情景分位数和上确界范数构造预测带。
AI.result: 法国电力需求实验中，统一预测带的整曲线覆盖率为90.1%，高于最佳对照的70.8%，但区间更宽。
AI.conclusion: 可信曲线预测带需同时结合状态相关波动建模与同时校准，显式建模方差本身不能消除逐点欠覆盖。

title: STORMGUIDE-FL: Stochastic Remote Guidance for Efficient Mining of Federated Streaming Data
summary: Federated Learning enables collaborative model training across distributed edge devices ("clients") while preserving data privacy. However, real-world deployments involve clients that observe continuous data streams from evolving environments while operating under strict resource limitations. Existing solutions still face two major challenges: local concept drift, where each client's data distribution shifts over time, and global client drift, arising from asynchronous engagement and imbalanced contributions across heterogeneous training participants, formally described as dual client heterogeneity. We propose STORMGUIDE-FL, a federated optimization and data-mining framework that mitigates both types of drift using a server-guided pipeline for data acquisition and local training. For data acquisition, a lightweight client-side sampling strategy incrementally selects informative and diverse instances from non-stationary, non-IID local streams under bounded memory, compute, and labeling budget. For local training, the server's remote guidance is embedded directly into local optimization as an update-level correction, counteracting client drift without discarding scarce labeled samples. We empirically verify the effectiveness of the proposed sampling strategy on federated data streams across gradual, sudden, and recurring concept drift, and demonstrate that its gains compound with the update-level drift correction. Experimental results further show improved speed and robustness of global model convergence under resource-constrained, heterogeneous conditions.

AI.tldr: STORMGUIDE-FL结合流式数据采样与服务器更新指导，缓解资源受限联邦学习中的双重漂移。
AI.motivation: 持续变化的数据流引发本地概念漂移，异步参与及贡献失衡又造成全局客户端漂移。
AI.method: 客户端在内存、计算与标注预算内选择信息丰富且多样的样本，并将服务器指导嵌入本地更新校正。
AI.result: 实验验证采样对渐变、突变和周期性漂移有效，叠加更新校正进一步改善全局收敛速度与稳健性。
AI.conclusion: 数据获取与本地优化的协同设计有助于应对资源受限、异构联邦流式环境中的双重漂移。

title: Living Context Graphs: Continual Semantic Learning for Enterprise Data Reasoning
summary: Enterprise AI can now perform analytics, reporting, and data-driven workflows, yet the data foundations it relies on remain hard to operationalize: business meaning, relationships, metric definitions, and reporting conventions are absent from database schemas and scattered across undocumented systems and tribal knowledge. We introduce the Living Context Graph (LCG), a continually learned context layer that makes existing enterprise data operational for AI without requiring a copy or transformation of the underlying warehouse. LCG bootstraps base semantics and relationships from the data itself, builds a concept graph that indexes business context as queries are served, writes durable semantic learnings from verified outcomes, and withdraws or re-earns context when later outcomes contradict prior routes. We evaluate LCG through text-to-SQL, a core data-reasoning task, on a transfer-aware split of three BIRD databases comprising 499 questions: 353 form the learning history and 146 are held out and never used to update the context layer. Bootstrapping alone improves overall accuracy by +4.6 percentage points. Learning only from the history raises accuracy on the untouched held-out transfer set by +22.6 points (95% CI [+14.4, +30.8]), exceeding five-shot retrieval from the same history by +12.3 points. Incremental learning reaches the one-shot endpoint within observed evaluation noise on every database. Ablating the graph changes held-out accuracy by at most one question per database but increases per-query cost 2.3-3.3x and median latency 1.8-3.4x: continually learned semantics drive accuracy, while the graph makes that context efficient to serve.
comment: 22 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Continual Learning in the Era of Foundation Models and Embodied Agents. Data splits and annotations: this https URL

AI.tldr: 持续学习上下文图从企业数据及已验证查询结果中积累业务语义，提高数据推理准确率与服务效率。
AI.motivation: 业务含义、指标定义和报表惯例常缺失于数据库模式，且散落在未文档化系统与经验知识中。
AI.method: 从数据初始化语义，按查询构建概念图，将验证结果写入持久上下文，并在后续矛盾时撤回或重新确认。
AI.result: 在三个BIRD数据库中，历史学习使独立留出集准确率提升22.6个百分点，比同历史五样本检索高12.3个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 持续学习的语义主要驱动准确率提升，图结构则降低上下文服务成本与延迟。

title: Inverse Kinematics in Endoscopic Scenarios using MoveIt
summary: Inverse kinematics are critical in many robotic applications, yet standard MoveIt-based solvers struggle in confined scenarios. This paper provides a benchmark of the available solvers and compares multiple practical modifications for improving the performance of the solvers. Splitting the IK problem into two parts results in the best performance, leading to a 100% success rate under 100 ms in an endoscopic tank scenario.

AI.tldr: 研究比较MoveIt逆运动学求解器及实用改进，发现将问题拆为两部分最适合所测内窥镜场景。
AI.motivation: 逆运动学对机器人应用至关重要，但标准MoveIt求解器在狭窄场景中表现受限。
AI.method: 对可用求解器开展基准测试，并比较多种提升求解性能的实用修改方案。
AI.result: 将逆运动学问题拆为两部分表现最佳，在内窥镜水箱场景中实现100%成功率且耗时低于100毫秒。
AI.conclusion: 问题拆分可有效改善所测受限内窥镜场景中的MoveIt逆运动学求解性能。

title: Breaking feature collapse in self-supervised time series encoders
summary: General-purpose time series encoders promise a single backbone that generalises across tasks and domains; however, they currently do not scale. We trace this down to a critical point of failure: under the predominant masked data modelling supervision, the encoder's output tokens partially collapse. This is the natural consequence of supervising encoders only in the input space, which leaves no constraint against redundant token dimensions in the feature space. We introduce OTISv2, which suppresses the collapse by complementing the reconstruction objective in input space with two objectives in the feature space: a self-distillation loss against an exponential-moving-average teacher, and a KoLeo regulariser. Under matched training, the resulting encoder reduces the cosine similarity and lifts the effective rank of its output tokens relative to its predecessor, and it scales monotonically from 7.1 M to 116 M parameters where its predecessor declines. It matches or surpasses existing general-purpose time series encoders across 143 uni- and multi-variate datasets. To foster further research, we release our code and pre-trained weights.

AI.tldr: OTISv2通过特征空间自蒸馏与正则化缓解时间序列编码器特征坍塌，改善模型扩展性与跨任务表现。
AI.motivation: 仅在输入空间进行掩码重建无法约束特征冗余，导致输出令牌部分坍塌并限制模型扩展。
AI.method: 在输入重建目标之外，加入针对指数移动平均教师的自蒸馏损失与KoLeo特征空间正则项。
AI.result: 模型从710万扩展至1.16亿参数时性能单调提升，并在143个单变量及多变量数据集上持平或超越现有编码器。
AI.conclusion: 同时约束输入与特征空间可缓解令牌坍塌，支持更大规模的通用时间序列编码器训练。

title: GRACE: Parallel Best-of-N Multi-Agent Analysis of Closed-Form Questions over Dataframes with Guardrail Selection and Adaptive Retry
summary: LLM agents answer closed-form questions over a tabular dataframe by writing and executing Python, almost always as a single rollout: one interpretation, one script, one result, accepted without comparison. The few pipelines that produce several candidates reconcile them by answer-agreement voting, which needs a single comparable scalar and always returns one, even when every candidate is wrong. We present GRACE (Generative, Ranked, Adaptive Code Ensemble), a production-oriented pipeline that instead runs parallel best-of-N selection specialised to dataframe code. N agents run concurrently under a strict, machine-checkable output contract, diversified by persona hints, per-retry rotation, and a two-regime temperature schedule. Rather than vote, GRACE judges the executed artefacts: a pairwise tournament pre-filters the pool and a domain-specialised guardrail either selects the best candidate or, when none is defensible, rejects the whole pool and abstains with a diagnosis (an option voting structurally lacks), which in turn drives an adaptive retry with per-agent feedback. On InfiAgent-DABench (DAEval, M = 246), using Qwen3.6-35B-A3B as the backbone, GRACE raises answer match from 39% for a single-rollout baseline to 71% (+32 pp, 1.8x), recovering 53% of previously wrong answers. On the same DAEval task, the smaller dense Qwen3.5-9B lifts answer match from 38% to 63% (+25 pp, 1.7x). A controlled 3 x 3 study that sweeps the number of parallel agents against the retry budget finds, on the 35B backbone, the two levers largely substitutable: once either one is generous, the other adds little, identifying a cheap operating point for deployment. The same directional pattern replicates on the independent DataBench benchmark, again on the Qwen3.6-35B-A3B backbone, where answer match rises by 15 percentage points (from 70% to 85%) across 400 sampled questions.
comment: Accepted at the 5th Italian Conference on Big Data and Data Science (ITADATA 2026). To appear in CEUR Workshop Proceedings

AI.tldr: GRACE通过并行代码候选、护栏筛选与自适应重试，提高数据表封闭式问答的准确率。
AI.motivation: 单次代码执行缺乏结果比较，而答案投票无法在全部候选错误时拒绝作答。
AI.method: 并行生成多样化代码候选，以两两竞赛和领域护栏筛选执行产物，并据拒绝诊断反馈重试。
AI.result: 35B骨干在DAEval上答案匹配率由39%升至71%，在DataBench上由70%升至85%。
AI.conclusion: 基于执行产物的筛选与重试能有效纠错，且并行规模与重试预算具有较强替代性。

title: VASR: Vector-Aware Assembly Planning with Equivalent Structures and Repair-Cost Feedback
summary: Furniture assembly planning requires inferring subassembly hierarchies from individual parts and a target illustration. Existing raster-based methods do not explicitly exploit the geometric and structural information in SVG drawings. We introduce VASR, a framework that fuses features from a dedicated SVG encoder with visual representations from a pretrained vision-language model to predict assembly hierarchies. To avoid penalizing valid alternatives to a reference assembly tree, we propose Repair-Aware Hierarchical Policy Optimization (RHPO) with hierarchy-preserving equivalence rewards. RHPO further uses repair-cost feedback to favor decisions with lower downstream correction costs among candidates with comparable equivalence-aware rewards. VASR achieves the highest Equivalent-Hard F1 among the evaluated methods, outperforming GPT6-Astra by 17.69 percentage points on the IKEA-derived test set while maintaining strong performance on an independent furniture dataset.

AI.tldr: VASR融合SVG几何结构与视觉语言特征，并利用等价结构奖励和修复成本优化家具装配规划。
AI.motivation: 现有栅格方法未显式利用SVG结构信息，参考装配树也可能使有效替代方案受到惩罚。
AI.method: 融合专用SVG编码器与预训练视觉语言模型，以保层级等价奖励和修复成本反馈优化装配层级。
AI.result: VASR的Equivalent-Hard F1在受评方法中最高，在IKEA衍生测试集上领先GPT6-Astra 17.69个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结合矢量结构、装配等价性与修复成本有助于装配规划，并在独立家具数据集上保持较强表现。

title: A Rollout-Based Approach to Real-Time Topology and Dispatch Control in the AI4RealNet L2RPN Benchmark
summary: Operating transmission networks under uncertain outages requires coordinating discrete network topology actions with continuous adjustments to generation and storage, while respecting operational constraints and real-time computational limits. We present a rollout-based controller that combines discrete and continuous decisions under the uncertain contingency policy of the L2RPN AI4RealNet 2026 challenge. Power-flow approximations and convex optimization identify the most promising actions, followed by short-horizon simulations to predict their effect on congestion, renewable curtailment, and redispatching costs. A further policy exploits the benchmark's specific attack protocol: keeping selected lines disconnected prevents some adversarial outages from being initiated. On the benchmark's $118$-bus network, the controller completed $189$ of $208$ final-test scenarios (score $64.39$) and achieved the second-best ratio of score to computation time among the five top-ranked entries, behind one that scored lower. Our results show that combining structured optimization with simulation-based action selection is effective even without a learned decision rule, and fast enough for real-time control. Code and reproduction material: this https URL.

AI.tldr: 该控制器结合结构化优化与短期仿真，实现电网拓扑和发电储能调度的实时联合决策。
AI.motivation: 不确定停运下的输电网运行需在实时计算限制内协调离散拓扑动作与连续调度，并满足运行约束。
AI.method: 以潮流近似和凸优化筛选动作，再用短期仿真评估，并利用攻击协议维持部分线路断开以阻止攻击。
AI.result: 控制器在118节点网络完成208个终测场景中的189个，得分64.39，得分计算时间比位列前五队伍第二。
AI.conclusion: 无需学习决策规则，结构化优化与仿真动作选择也能有效控制电网并满足实时性要求。

title: Calpha: Toward Native Biomolecular Intelligence in a General-Purpose Language Model
summary: Biomolecular foundation models predict the structures of proteins and their complexes accurately, and large language models (LLMs) reason in natural language, but the two remain separate: the abilities of the former are not part of a general-purpose LLM, and the reasoning of the latter does not enter a structure prediction. Calpha aims at one general model that folds proteins and complexes, understands protein sequence and structure, and lets its language reasoning influence the structures it predicts. This report covers the first step, in which an LLM outputs single-chain protein structures. Qwen3.5-9B reads a sequence enriched with ESM2 residue features. It can respond in text or emit a token that invokes a pretrained SimpleFold structure head, which receives information about the protein only through Qwen's residue states. Under a fixed folding request, the head achieves mean TM-scores of 0.808 on the FoldBench-334 development set, 0.635 on CASP16 domains and 0.900 on a CAMEO-style PDB set. We compare these predictions with a baseline in which ESM2-3B encodes the sequence and a fine-tuned SimpleFold-3B head predicts the coordinates. The two systems also differ in trainable weights, training duration and crop length. For chains of 100--299 residues, all three paired confidence intervals include zero. At 300--600 residues, the mean differences are -0.044, -0.160 and -0.025, respectively. In a separate test, four English request types triggered folding on every evaluated example. Protein training reduced accuracy on a 350-item MMLU-Pro subset from 77.4% to 70.3%. An LLM can therefore output single-chain structures from its own states, with lower long-chain scores in the current comparisons and reduced accuracy on the evaluated MMLU-Pro subset. Complex prediction, structure understanding and the effect of language reasoning on the predicted coordinates remain future work.

AI.tldr: Calpha使通用语言模型从自身残基状态输出单链蛋白结构，但长链表现与通用知识能力仍有不足。
AI.motivation: 蛋白结构预测模型与语言模型相互分离，尚未将结构预测能力和语言推理整合进通用模型。
AI.method: Qwen3.5-9B读取ESM2特征增强序列，通过特殊标记调用仅接收其残基状态的预训练SimpleFold结构头。
AI.result: 三套结构评测平均TM分数为0.808、0.635和0.900，MMLU-Pro子集准确率由77.4%降至70.3%。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型可从自身状态输出单链结构，但当前长链得分较低，复合物预测及推理对结构的影响仍待研究。

title: Hivemind: A Federated Protocol for AI-Mediated Tacit Knowledge Sharing in Organisations
summary: This paper presents Hivemind, a federated protocol that enables AI agents to exchange tacit knowledge on behalf of their users, asynchronously and without requiring any direct human interaction. Individual AI memory systems capture the decisions, reasoning, and contextual knowledge that surface during AI-assisted work. Hivemind creates the shared space in which this captured knowledge can flow between individuals across team and departmental boundaries, addressing a structural gap that neither centralised knowledge repositories nor existing AI tooling closes, even where partial solutions such as expert-finding systems exist. The paper evaluates centralised versus decentralised design approaches, proposes a federated architecture grounded in Nonaka and Takeuchi's (1995) Socialisation, Externalisation, Combination and Internalisation (SECI) model, and demonstrates a proof-of-concept implementation using Design Science Research (DSR) methodology. Measuring the enterprise benefit of federated tacit expertise sharing remains an open task for future work.

AI.tldr: Hivemind提出联邦协议，让AI代理代表用户异步共享组织内隐性知识，无需人与人直接交互。
AI.motivation: 集中式知识库与现有AI工具难以支持个人工作中积累的隐性知识跨团队和部门流动。
AI.method: 比较集中与去中心化设计，以SECI模型构建联邦架构，并用设计科学研究方法实现概念验证。
AI.result: 研究展示了协议的概念验证实现，但尚未测量联邦隐性知识共享的企业收益。
AI.conclusion: 联邦协议提供了跨组织边界共享隐性知识的实现路径，其企业实际效益仍需后续评估。

title: Transferable neural-network preconditioners for Wilson--Clover propagator inversions
summary: We investigate two single--layer neural-network architectures for accelerating four-dimensional Wilson--Clover propagator inversions on lattice ensembles in practical use; both transfer directly without retraining. The first is a gauge-covariant parallel transport convolution (PTC) network that directly reduces the number of generalized conjugate residual (GCR) solver iterations. The second is a CNN-like network used together with a multigrid-inspired algorithm. The two approaches can be combined to further reduce GCR iterations. PTC transfers without retraining across lattice volumes, lattice spacings, and pion masses while maintaining comparable acceleration, whereas the CNN-like network transfers directly from small- to large-volume ensembles with strong acceleration. A cost comparison accounting for both basis construction and solves shows that the proposed scheme is more advantageous for large-volume ensembles than for small-volume ones.

AI.tldr: 两种无需重训即可迁移的单层神经网络预条件器，可加速Wilson–Clover传播子求逆。
AI.motivation: 实际格点系综中的传播子求逆需要可跨系综复用、并降低求解计算成本的加速方案。
AI.method: 采用规范协变平行传输卷积网络及结合类多重网格算法的CNN式网络，并可联合使用以减少GCR迭代。
AI.result: 两种网络均可直接迁移并加速求解，联合使用进一步减少迭代，计入基构建与求解成本后大体积系综更具优势。
AI.conclusion: 神经网络预条件器可无需重训地迁移至不同系综，并在大体积计算中呈现更明显的成本优势。

title: FH-Sampling: Frequency-aware Hypergraph-driven Oversampling for Imbalanced Time-Series Classification
summary: Imbalanced time-series data appears commonly in diverse applications, such as medical diagnosis. When trained on imbalanced data, classifiers tend to exhibit a bias toward the majority class, making it difficult to identify minority-class instances accurately, despite their critical importance. Sampling techniques have proven effective in rebalancing imbalanced data. However, existing interpolation-based oversampling methods typically rely on pairwise interpolation, limiting their ability to capture high-order inter-sample relationships, and their inherent smoothing effects tend to suppress high-frequency components, compromising spectral fidelity. Therefore, we propose a Frequency-aware Hypergraph-driven Oversampling method (FH-Sampling) for imbalanced time-series classification. In FH-Sampling, a hypergraph is first constructed in the original time-series space to capture complex high-order inter-sample relationships, and sampling ratios are adaptively assigned to mitigate the impact of noisy samples. The discrete wavelet transform decomposes each sample into frequency components. Guided by the sample hypergraph, FH-Sampling combines high-frequency components from related samples while retaining the target sample's low-frequency component to help preserve important frequency characteristics. Experiments on 24 imbalanced datasets demonstrate the advantages of FH-Sampling for imbalanced time-series classification. We further apply FH-Sampling to aircraft trajectory generation. Experiments on simulated aircraft trajectories show that FH-Sampling produces trajectories that better match the real distribution, highlighting its potential for practical applications.

AI.tldr: FH-Sampling结合超图关系与频率分解，为不平衡时间序列生成保留频谱特征的过采样数据。
AI.motivation: 现有两两插值过采样难以捕捉高阶样本关系，且平滑效应会抑制高频成分并损害频谱保真度。
AI.method: 构建样本超图并自适应分配采样比例，通过小波分解组合关联样本高频成分，同时保留目标样本低频成分。
AI.result: 24个不平衡数据集实验显示分类优势，模拟飞机轨迹实验中生成轨迹也更贴近真实分布。
AI.conclusion: 利用高阶样本关系与频率感知合成可改善不平衡时序分类，并具有轨迹生成应用潜力。

title: MedJev: A System One Vision-Language Decision Model for Fast and Effective Medical Image Understanding
summary: Medical image understanding with vision-language models (VLMs) typically relies on autoregressively generating reasoning and answer tokens. These unnecessary tokens make the inference cost scale with the response length and force the answer to be parsed from free-form text, incurring avoidable latency and decision errors. To this end, we introduce \textsc{MedJev}, a \emph{system one} vision-language decision model that maps medical images, questions, and candidate answers directly to decisions in a single multimodal forward pass, without any autoregressive generation process. For fast inference, \textsc{MedJev} removes the upper language layers and the generative output pathway, while keeping the full vision pathway and all visual tokens. On this shortened backbone, a decision head scores each candidate by pretrained query--key matching and refines the scores with a lightweight multilayer perceptron (MLP) residual, coupling the pretrained matching structure with task-specific nonlinear discrimination. Built on Qwen3.5-4B, \textsc{MedJev}-4B improves both accuracy and speed over the original model on each of four medical image classification and visual question answering benchmarks, with an absolute accuracy gain of \textbf{7.93\%} and a \textbf{6.04$\times$} end-to-end speedup. Further comparison with 20 cutting-edge models shows that \textsc{MedJev}-4B achieves state-of-the-art performance and inference speed among 4B--9B general and medical VLMs, indicating that direct multimodal decision making is an effective route to fast and effective medical image understanding.

AI.tldr: MedJev通过单次多模态前向传播直接选择答案，在医学图像理解中兼顾准确率与推理速度。
AI.motivation: 自回归生成推理和答案增加延迟，自由文本答案解析也会引入不必要的决策错误。
AI.method: 裁去上层语言层与生成通路，保留完整视觉路径，以预训练查询键匹配和轻量MLP残差为候选答案评分。
AI.result: 基于Qwen3.5-4B的模型在四项基准均提升性能，准确率绝对提高7.93个百分点，端到端加速6.04倍。
AI.conclusion: 直接多模态决策是高效医学图像理解的有效路径，MedJev在所比较的4B至9B模型中兼具领先性能与速度。

title: Digits in Notation Are Not Numbers: A Scoring Pitfall in PDF-to-Markdown Conversion of Japanese Technical Documents (Preliminary Evaluation)
summary: Converting PDFs to Markdown is now routine preprocessing for search and language models, yet scoring the numbers in the output is easy to get wrong. We evaluate MinerU, a plain-text OCR baseline (NDLOCR-Lite), and a deterministic post-processing pipeline (anchor insertion, footnote reordering, fixes of look-alike characters in fixed contexts, gated formula repair using two independent OCR partners, and heading reconstruction) on 48 public Japanese pages (three documents), text-layer and rasterized. Our pre-specified number-and-unit F1 favored the OCR baseline (0.575 vs 0.397), and a disagreement check between the two engines seemed to flag about half of the converter's number errors (54.6%). Both were artifacts. The scorer counted digits in the converter's notation (image-link paths, HTML attributes), which plain text lacks. With the notation removed (a post-hoc check), the F1 scores tie (0.575 vs 0.594), and the check flags only 13% of number errors, because most errors are misses that both engines share. What remains: the OCR baseline has a lower body character error rate (0.012 vs 0.053 rasterized). The pipeline raises extra-number recall at page level (+0.145; the document-level interval touches 0), mostly by restoring page numbers, but lowers heading-level agreement (0.133 to 0.061) and leaves spurious formulas unchanged; its formula repair never fires. A pre-specified precision gate for its flags (0.80, human-judged) is met at 0.929, yet the post-processing hypothesis fails on its improvement items. We recommend scoring numbers after removing notation and checking critical figures against the source. By the pre-specified criteria, the study stays a technical report.

AI.tldr: 日文技术文档转换评测会误将标记中的数字计入内容，扭曲数值准确性比较。
AI.motivation: PDF转Markdown已广泛用于检索和语言模型，但输出中的数值评分可能受到标记干扰。
AI.method: 在三份文档的48页上比较转换器、OCR基线及确定性后处理，并检查去除标记后的评分。
AI.result: 去除标记后数值F1由明显差距变为接近，错误检出率降至13%，后处理未达到预设改进目标。
AI.conclusion: 数值评测应先去除标记，关键数字应对照原文核查，本研究按预设标准仍属技术报告。

title: CONGA: Compiling Gaussian Fiber Geometry for Structured Bayesian Inference
summary: In structured Bayesian models, a large latent block is often Gaussian conditional on a smaller set of parameters, yet generic inference methods relearn this geometry during warmup. We study how this structure can be used to construct transports for posterior inference. The conditional mean and precision determine exact affine maps, including symmetric Brenier and triangular Knothe-Rosenblatt maps, that separate a standard normal block from the remaining non-Gaussian core. KL and relative Fisher objectives then reduce to objectives on this core. We introduce CONGA, a compiler that identifies candidate Gaussian blocks and selects a temporal, spectral, or sparse implementation according to their structure and computational cost. Marginalization requires an identity established from the model; numerical evidence alone permits only a target-preserving change of variables, and a failed check leaves the model unchanged. On the Stock-Watson inflation model, CONGA improves minimum ESS per second by 12.5x for NUTS. It also restores convergence where the raw target fails: for WALNUTS on the same model, and for NUTS on a 6760-dimensional electricity load model reduced to 34 core coordinates. Experiments on graph-indexed fields show how coloring and fill affect the choice of map, including cases where retaining the original target is preferable. Code at this https URL
comment: Accepted to the Workshop on Geometric Distributional Deep Learning (GDDL), NeurIPS 2026

AI.tldr: CONGA自动识别条件高斯结构并构造后验变换，提升结构化贝叶斯推断效率与收敛性。
AI.motivation: 通用推断方法在预热阶段反复学习模型已有的条件高斯几何，造成计算浪费。
AI.method: 利用条件均值和精度构造精确仿射映射，并按结构与成本选择时域、谱域或稀疏实现。
AI.result: 通胀模型中NUTS最低每秒ESS提升12.5倍，并在原目标不收敛的通胀及电力负荷模型配置中恢复收敛。
AI.conclusion: 编译条件高斯几何可改善推断，但边缘化须有模型恒等式依据，部分情形宜保留原目标。

title: Explaining Cross-Label Decision Structure in Multi-Output Tree Ensembles
summary: A multi-output tree ensemble predicts several binary labels through decision paths that it largely shares across those labels, yet the attribution methods commonly used to explain such models treat each output in isolation. We propose multi-sink Decision Predicate Graphs (ms-DPGs), which extend decision predicate graphs with one sink per label: each leaf contributes to the sink of every label its in-bag positive count for that label. On this representation we define Shared Predicate Flow (SPF), the share of a label's decision mass that passes through conditions active for both labels of a pair, and a contracted view of the graph in which label-specific lifts indicate whether a shared condition raises the probability of both labels or of one at the expense of the other. Controlled experiments show that SPF captures shared decision conditions rather than mere feature overlap. On nine multi-label benchmarks, native multi-output forests share substantially more decision structure than Binary Relevance on eight, including five of the six on which the two are at predictive parity, even at equal hyperparameters, whereas per-label TreeSHAP rankings register the change of architecture without showing whether more is shared. Because a native forest routes every label through the same splits, SPF describes the fitted model rather than the data, and on eight of the nine benchmarks it rises when the feature-label signal is removed; a high SPF is therefore not evidence of shared predictive information. ms-DPG offers a global, predicate-level account of how a multi-output ensemble reuses decision conditions across its labels.

AI.tldr: 多汇决策谓词图及共享谓词流可解释多输出树集成如何跨标签复用决策条件。
AI.motivation: 现有归因方法通常孤立解释各输出，无法揭示多输出树模型共享的决策路径。
AI.method: 为每个标签设置图汇点，定义共享谓词流，并用收缩图中的标签特定提升刻画共享条件作用。
AI.result: 九个基准中八个显示原生多输出森林共享更多决策结构，但八个在移除特征标签信号后共享流反而上升。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提供全局谓词级解释，但高共享谓词流描述模型结构，不代表共享预测信息。

title: Does the Voice Matter? Evaluating Frustration Detection on Deployed Clinical Voice-Agent Calls
summary: Autonomous voice agents now conduct routine clinical follow-up calls, so some automated triage is unavoidable. A patient becoming frustrated is one thing that triage should catch. These systems typically read only the transcript the speech-to-text stage produces, not the voice, and whether that is enough is largely untested on real clinical speech. We study per-turn frustration detection on real patient calls from a deployed clinical voice agent: 150 turns from six calls labelled by three annotators, with a length-matched acted corpus as a control, and 714 turns from 30 calls. Patient turns are overwhelmingly short: across the deployed calls, roughly 59% are one or two words, against 13% in the full acted corpus, and a corpus accuracy gap remains even after the acted set is length-matched. On one-word turns, transcript-only detection does not exclude chance. Across five audio-capable language models, the transcript flags 3 or 4 of the 39 frustrated one-word turns in the 30 calls, and a classifier given only the word count reaches 57.3%. Whether audio helps depends on the model and on the instruction. Asked to attend to delivery, two Gemini 2.5 models gain 3.0 pp over the transcript across 30 calls (-1.0 to 7.5 pp). Of the turns they confidently clear, 6.9% were in fact frustrated for audio against 13.0% for the transcript, a difference of 6.1 pp (2.2 to 10.4 pp). Across the 30 calls, given one prompt identical for both inputs, no model's audio-text interval excludes zero. Under the input-specific prompts, a newer Gemini model and two smaller open models do worse with audio than with the transcript (-3.5, -8.6 and -10.6 pp). A WavLM probe trained on the clinical calls matches the best prompted model overall (71.6%) but misses every frustrated one-word turn in the 24 added calls. When a patient's turn is short, the transcript alone is not enough to rule out frustration.
comment: Accepted to Ml4H 2026 Accepted to GenAI4H workshop @ Neurips 2026

AI.tldr: 真实临床语音通话中，短回复的文本不足以排除挫败情绪，音频收益取决于模型和提示。
AI.motivation: 临床语音代理通常仅凭转写文本分诊，但其识别患者挫败情绪的充分性尚未得到充分验证。
AI.method: 在真实部署通话及长度匹配的表演语料上，比较五种音频语言模型的文本与音频输入及WavLM探针。
AI.result: 39个挫败单词回复中文本仅检出3至4个；统一提示下，各模型音频相对文本的收益区间均包含零。
AI.conclusion: 患者回复很短时，不能仅凭文本排除挫败情绪，也不能假定加入音频必然改善检测。

title: K2-Horizon: A Frontier Fleet of Open Source Language Models
summary: We present K2-Horizon, a fleet of six fully open language models, from a 0.9B dense model to a 375B-A23B MoE, built for general-purpose reasoning and agentic work across math and science, software engineering, deep research, office automation, and beyond. The models lead or are competitive with strong open models of their size on agentic and coding benchmarks. On the modeling side, to strengthen reasoning, we introduce Mixture-of-Value Attention (MoVA), applying MoE to attention value projections, and softplus attention gating, a more flexible, theoretically motivated gate. Our 36B-A4B model uses both and nearly matches a 32B dense model trained on the same data, with one-seventh the active parameters. We also introduce Uno, lossless diffusion adapters that speed up decoding by up to 2.2x without a separate draft model. Our release follows the LLM360 definition of open source for transparency and reproducibility: the full development history, including intermediate checkpoints from every training stage, pre-training data, training logs, and all training, evaluation, and infrastructure code, notably our production-scale xLLM framework for dense and MoE training and the RL360 reinforcement-learning stack. Beyond the data itself, we release and document in detail every pipeline that built it, the part of model development that open releases most rarely disclose. These pipelines produced roughly 10T synthetic pre-training tokens, showing that synthetic data can be a major ingredient of pre-training at scale. Four of the models share one 22T-token pre-training corpus and recipe, revealing consistent scaling behavior and enabling controlled studies of scale and sparsity. All artifacts are available at this https URL

AI.tldr: K2-Horizon发布六款全开源语言模型，并提供注意力改进、加速解码及完整开发材料。
AI.motivation: 通用推理与智能体任务需要高效模型，而现有开放发布常缺少数据构建流程等关键开发细节。
AI.method: 采用价值混合注意力、softplus注意力门控与Uno无损扩散适配器，并公开数据、检查点及开发代码。
AI.result: 36B-A4B模型以约七分之一激活参数接近同数据训练的32B稠密模型，Uno解码最高加速2.2倍。
AI.conclusion: 完整开放开发历史与数据流水线有助于透明复现，共享语料的模型系列支持规模与稀疏性的受控研究。

title: Learning and Verifying Stabilizing Controllers with Structured Neural Control Lyapunov Functions
summary: This work investigates the joint learning of neural controllers and control Lyapunov functions (CLFs) for nonlinear discrete-time systems. We exploit the structural properties of Input Convex Neural Networks and Polyak-Łojasiewicz Networks to guarantee positive definiteness of CLF candidates by construction, reducing the conditions requiring formal verification. We develop a mixed-integer programming framework to formally verify the remaining stability conditions and introduce an iterative region of attraction (ROA) expansion procedure to enlarge the certified ROA without retraining. Experiments on an inverted pendulum and a path-tracking system demonstrate the advantages of structured neural CLFs, particularly PLNets, and illustrate how their structural bounds influence the geometry of the certified regions. Our code is available at: this https URL.

AI.tldr: 结构化神经控制李雅普诺夫函数结合形式验证，可联合学习稳定控制器并扩展认证吸引域。
AI.motivation: 非线性离散系统的神经控制器需要可验证的稳定性保证，而验证条件可能较为复杂。
AI.method: 利用输入凸网络和PL网络保证候选函数正定，以混合整数规划验证其余条件并迭代扩展吸引域。
AI.result: 倒立摆与路径跟踪实验展示结构化函数尤其PL网络的优势，并显示结构界限会影响认证区域形状。
AI.conclusion: 结构化函数可减少需形式验证的条件，且无需重新训练即可扩展认证吸引域。

title: A physics-constrained emulator for time-discretised landslide runout modelling
summary: Numerical simulations of landslides are commonly used to forecast impact areas. Full physics-based models provide accurate predictions, but their computational expense can preclude their use for large parameter sweeps. To achieve efficient modelling for such cases, we developed a physics-constrained neural network to emulate full landslide runout in a time-discretised manner. This emulator is trained on over 200,000 samples, each consisting of a pair of landslide thicknesses and velocities on a given DEM with a fixed time interval. To constrain the model's physical consistency, we define physics-based loss functions based on mass conservation and the system's kinetic energy loss. The model demonstrates high fidelity across the test dataset, achieving root mean square errors of approximately 0.06 m for thickness and 0.11 m/s for velocity in single-step predictions. In autoregressive rollout, these errors evolved modestly to about 0.21 m and 0.09 m/s after 110 iterations, while greatly improving computational efficiency by more than 50 times.

AI.tldr: 物理约束神经网络可高效模拟离散时间滑坡运动，在保持较低误差的同时实现超过50倍加速。
AI.motivation: 全物理滑坡模型计算昂贵，限制了其在大规模参数扫描与影响区域预测中的应用。
AI.method: 以超过20万个固定时间间隔的厚度和速度样本对训练网络，并加入质量守恒与动能损失约束。
AI.result: 单步厚度和速度RMSE约为0.06米和0.11米每秒，110步后约为0.21米和0.09米每秒，加速逾50倍。
AI.conclusion: 该模拟器在自回归推进中保持较低误差，为需要大量计算的滑坡建模提供高效替代方案。

title: Locally homogeneous PID gain-scheduling for motion control systems
summary: A method for upgrading linear PID controller to a locally homogeneous PID regulator is developed. The homogeneous PID shares the gains with linear PID while the tuning of local homogeneity degrees could allow better regulation quality comparing with the linear algorithm. The homogeneous algorithm is obtained by means of the scaling the gains of the linear controller dependently of the current value of the output and its derivative. The linear algorithm can be recovered from the homogeneous one by assigning zero homogeneity degree. The tuning scheme for the homogeneous controller is suggested and illustrated experimentally in comparison with a standard PID control, which is robustly designed by the loop-shaping around the critical frequency range. The experiments are accomplished on a linear-motion stage system with voice-coil-motor and noisy contactless output measurements.

AI.tldr: 通过依赖输出及其导数的增益调度，可将线性PID升级为局部齐次PID调节器。
AI.motivation: 在沿用线性PID增益的基础上，调节局部齐次次数可能改善运动控制的调节质量。
AI.method: 按当前输出及其导数缩放PID增益，提出齐次次数调节方案，并在音圈电机直线运动平台上比较。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体结果。
AI.conclusion: 该方法保留线性PID增益，齐次次数设为零时可恢复线性控制，并提供可实验实施的调节方案。

title: SWE-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Coding
summary: In this work, we study on-policy distillation (OPD) for transferring agentic coding capabilities from a large teacher model to a smaller student model. Prior work has focused primarily on reasoning and short-horizon agentic tasks. We present SWE-OPD, a minimal OPD study for software engineering, where the student interacts with executable repositories and the teacher supervises the prefixes visited by the student. Across three teacher--student pairs, two training sources, and three SWE benchmarks, we find that on-policy supervision transfers coding capability: supervision from Qwen3.6-27B increases the SWE-bench Pro resolve rate of Qwen3.5-9B from 35.9% to 39.4%. Refreshing trajectories is not strictly required either, as an offline variant with cached teacher scores still improves over the student baselines while cutting end-to-end GPU-hours by 59.4%--72.6% and halving peak GPU allocation, at benchmark-dependent accuracy. Furthermore, we extend the offline variant to corss-tokenizer scenarios: distilling GLM-4.5-Air from DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 raises its SWE-bench Pro and Multilingual resolve rate from 35.8% to 39.7% and from 41.8% to 46.2%, around 4% and 4.6% improvement, respectively. We also find that a decreasing loss, however, does not necessarily indicate improved agent performance: under top-$K$ reverse-KL loss, one student exhibits severe repetition despite a decreasing loss. We identify a support-mass gradient term as a potential mechanism underlying this failure.

AI.tldr: SWE-OPD将教师模型的智能体编程能力蒸馏至小模型，离线变体还能显著降低训练成本。
AI.motivation: 现有在策略蒸馏研究主要面向推理和短时程任务，尚需验证其对软件工程智能体的有效性。
AI.method: 学生在可执行代码仓库中交互，教师监督其访问的前缀，并探索缓存教师评分及跨分词器蒸馏。
AI.result: 一组模型的SWE-bench Pro解决率从35.9%升至39.4%，离线变体减少59.4%至72.6%的GPU时。
AI.conclusion: 在策略蒸馏可迁移编程能力，但损失下降不保证智能体性能提升，部分设置会出现严重重复。

title: Sparse Attention for Visual Generation: Toward Algorithm-System Co-Design
summary: Rapid advances in image and video generation have enabled high-fidelity synthesis at higher resolutions and longer durations, making the quadratic cost of dense self-attention a major bottleneck as visual token sequences grow. Sparse attention seeks to preserve generation quality at lower computational cost by retaining informative query-key interactions and omitting less consequential ones, with end-to-end gains depending on the cost of constructing sparse support and the efficiency with which the system maps the resulting workload to hardware. We survey sparse attention for visual generation through a 4+1+3 analytical framework that links algorithmic design to system implementation. The framework examines how static and dynamic methods use source information and the evidence derived from it to decide which interactions to retain and at what granularity, while accounting for the roles of reuse in reducing repeated computation and correction in compensating for omitted contributions. We relate these algorithmic choices to their implementation on hardware through the framework's three system dimensions of data organization, execution, and dataflow. We summarize common evaluation metrics and discuss open challenges and research directions, providing researchers and practitioners with a reference for the joint design of sparse attention algorithms and systems.

AI.tldr: 本文以“4+1+3”分析框架综述视觉生成中的稀疏注意力，连接算法设计与系统实现。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率与长视频生成使视觉序列增长，密集自注意力的平方计算成本成为主要瓶颈。
AI.method: 框架分析信息来源、证据、保留决策与粒度，以及复用和校正，并关联数据组织、执行和数据流。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体结果。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏注意力的端到端收益取决于稀疏结构构建成本及硬件执行效率，需要算法与系统协同设计。

title: Learning Morse Lyapunov functions through invertible neural networks
summary: Towards data-driven stability certificates of dynamical systems, we are witnessing renewed interest in studying and exploiting the structure of Lyapunov functions. Especially Lyapunov functions that are locally quadratic (i.e., Morse) gained popularity ever since it was understood that they can be written as the norm squared of a diffeomorphism. This topological representation alludes to parametrizations using invertible neural networks. In this note we discuss when and how such functions can be learned. In particular, using neural ODEs (NODEs), we characterize Sobolev approximation of these diffeomorphisms on compact sets and show how this naturally relates to stability. We also connect our results to PLNets and supply numerical experiments for illustration.
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, comments are very welcome! Currently under review

AI.tldr: 本文研究用可逆神经网络学习Morse型李雅普诺夫函数的条件及其稳定性联系。
AI.motivation: 数据驱动稳定性证书需要利用李雅普诺夫函数结构，而局部二次函数可表示为微分同胚的范数平方。
AI.method: 利用神经常微分方程刻画紧集上微分同胚的Sobolev逼近，并关联稳定性与PLNets。
AI.result: 研究给出了相关微分同胚的Sobolev逼近刻画及其与稳定性的联系，并提供数值实验说明。
AI.conclusion: 微分同胚表示为学习Morse型李雅普诺夫函数提供了可逆网络参数化途径。

title: POKE: Probe Offline, Keep Efficiently for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Visual token pruning reduces the inference cost of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, but attention-based scores do not directly measure a token's effect on the predicted action. We define action sensitivity as the magnitude of the first-order action change when a token is replaced by its camera's mean token and estimate it for all tokens with a single backward pass. Computing it online is costly: scoring on the full (unpruned) graph needs an extra forward pass at every control step. Scoring on the pruned forward pass is cheaper but causes scoring-graph lock-in: removed tokens lose their direct paths through later layers and tend to receive lower scores, making those locations less likely to return. On replayed observations, even with a random conditioning mask, pruned-graph scoring re-selects 59% of the mask's tokens, versus 6% expected by chance; attention histories show a similar bias. POKE (Probe Offline, Keep Efficiently) computes full-graph action sensitivities offline and distills them into a student with under 0.3M parameters. At inference, the student scores the current observation without backpropagation or previous masks, and score-guided diversity selection retains the tokens. Keeping 32 of 512 visual tokens on LIBERO, POKE achieves 95.2% success on OpenVLA-OFT and 90.8% on $\pi_{0.5}$ at $1.85\times$ and $1.26\times$ speedups, outperforming attention-, diversity-, and distillation-based pruners, with larger margins on LIBERO-Plus.

AI.tldr: POKE将离线动作敏感度蒸馏至轻量模型，在大幅裁剪视觉词元的同时保持较高机器人任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 注意力分数不能直接衡量词元对动作的影响，在线敏感度计算昂贵且裁剪图评分存在锁定偏差。
AI.method: 离线计算完整图上的动作敏感度，蒸馏至不足30万参数的学生，再结合分数与多样性选择词元。
AI.result: LIBERO上保留32/512词元时，两模型成功率达95.2%和90.8%，分别加速1.85倍和1.26倍。
AI.conclusion: 离线完整图监督可避免在线反向传播和历史掩码依赖，并优于多类视觉词元裁剪基线。

title: FlowRow: Learning Navigation Behaviors in Agricultural Environments with Long-Horizon Goal-Conditioned Flow Matching Policies
summary: Autonomous monitoring and intervention in semi-structured agricultural environments, such as orchards and vineyards, require mobile robots to navigate to locations across diverse field configurations. This entails performing navigation behaviors including in-row driving, row turning and skipping, and inter-row traversal. Recent learning-based approaches have enabled robust in-row navigation from onboard perception, but navigation across rows typically requires a priori knowledge of field geometry to specify and tune row-transition maneuvers, preventing arbitrary transitions between rows. We address this challenge by framing navigation in these environments as a goal-directed navigation task, where a long-horizon goal is expressed relative to the robot and a planner generates local paths based on the goal and the robot's perceptual observations. We present FlowRow, a flow-matching-based local planner which models the distribution of diverse agricultural navigation behaviors as $\mathrm{SE}(2)$ paths using the long-horizon goal and depth perception. To enable systematic evaluation, we introduce RowNavBench, a navigation benchmark for semi-structured agricultural environments developed in Isaac Sim, comprising 900 episodes across grape vineyards, lemon orchards, and apple orchards with varying row lengths, row and plant spacings, plant positions, and weed growth. FlowRow achieves 87% success, compared to 44% for the strongest generative behavior cloning baseline retrained on the same demonstrations. We will release our benchmark, data, and code upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: FlowRow利用长时程目标条件流匹配学习农业导航行为，实现无需预知田地几何的跨行导航。
AI.motivation: 现有农业机器人跨行导航通常依赖预先已知的田地几何及手工调节，难以支持任意行间转换。
AI.method: 基于机器人相对目标和深度感知生成SE(2)局部路径，并构建包含900个回合的RowNavBench。
AI.result: FlowRow成功率达87%，而使用相同示范重新训练的最强生成式行为克隆基线为44%。
AI.conclusion: 长时程目标条件流匹配可统一建模多种农业导航行为，并提升多样田地配置下的导航成功率。

title: Non-Myopic Safety Filtering with Learned Intervention Cost-to-Go
summary: Control barrier function (CBF) safety filters minimize instantaneous deviation from a nominal control command, but a sequence of pointwise-minimal interventions need not minimize cumulative intervention effort. This paper proposes a discrete-time non-myopic safety filter using a learned approximation of the optimal intervention cost-to-go over CBF-admissible policies. The approximation enters through a relaxed Bellman-residual constraint, while the original barrier condition remains hard. Feasibility is equivalent to that of the conventional CBF filter, and forward invariance remains independent of approximation accuracy under the stated assumptions. We derive a trajectory-wise performance certificate that requires neither the optimal value function nor an approximation-error bound. Under additional approximation and horizon assumptions, a suboptimality bound contains an explicit endpoint approximation-error term together with accumulated tolerance and relaxation terms. Numerical results for a collision-avoidance problem show an approximately 50% reduction in mean cumulative intervention effort relative to conventional CBF filtering over 100 initial conditions not used during training or parameter selection. The improvement is consistent across three independently trained networks, while maintaining the prescribed safety constraints and requiring less online computation than the tested predictive filter.

AI.tldr: 本文通过学习未来干预代价构建非短视安全过滤器，在维持安全约束的同时减少累计干预。
AI.motivation: 控制障碍函数过滤器逐时最小化控制偏差，但连续的局部最小干预未必使累计干预最小。
AI.method: 以学习的最优干预代价近似构造松弛Bellman残差约束，保留硬障碍条件并推导性能证书。
AI.result: 避碰实验中，100个未用于训练或调参的初始条件下平均累计干预约减少50%，且保持安全约束。
AI.conclusion: 在所述假设下，该方法保持传统过滤器的可行性，前向不变性不依赖近似精度，且可降低干预成本。

title: ScoutCache: Efficient Few-Step Autoregressive Video Diffusion via Conditional Readout and Selective Caching
summary: Few-step autoregressive video diffusion enables efficient long video generation, but inference still incurs substantial computational costs from repeated denoising and KV cache operations. Existing acceleration methods reduce parts of this overhead, while historical KV reading and cache construction remain costly across video chunks. To address these challenges, we propose ScoutCache, a training-free framework that jointly optimizes denoising, historical KV reading, and cache construction. We observe that shallow feature changes provide useful information for estimating clean latent updates, while historical KV dependence varies across Transformer layers and attention heads but remains relatively stable across video chunks. Based on these observations, we develop Conditional Denoising Readout (CDR) to estimate intermediate denoising updates from shallow feature changes and known noise variations. We further introduce Output Risk Guided Historical KV Reading (ORHR) to allocate historical reading budgets based on attention output perturbations, and Content and Coverage Guided Sparse Cache Construction (CCSC) to reduce cache construction costs by selecting informative spatial tokens while maintaining spatial coverage. Extensive experiments on Self-Forcing and LongLive using VBench and MovieGen demonstrate that ScoutCache achieves up to 2.28$\times$ and 1.86$\times$ speedups, respectively, while consistently improving generation quality without modifying pretrained model parameters.

AI.tldr: ScoutCache无需训练即可联合优化视频扩散去噪与缓存操作，在提升生成质量的同时加速推理。
AI.motivation: 少步自回归视频扩散仍受重复去噪、历史键值读取和跨视频块缓存构建的高开销限制。
AI.method: 利用浅层特征变化估计去噪更新，按输出扰动分配历史读取预算，并兼顾内容和空间覆盖稀疏构建缓存。
AI.result: 在Self-Forcing和LongLive上分别最高加速2.28倍和1.86倍，并持续提升生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 联合优化去噪、历史读取和缓存构建，可在不修改预训练参数的情况下提高视频生成效率与质量。

title: Towards wearable-scale, transition-aware sleep staging for clinical populations
summary: Automatic sleep staging models are predominantly developed on healthy sleepers and generalize poorly to clinical populations with fragmented sleep. Across three cohorts (patients with stroke, isolated REM sleep behaviour disorder, and other sleep disorders), we observe 2-3x more awakenings per hour, nearly twice as much N1, and less REM sleep than in healthy sleepers. We propose a label-efficient teacher-student framework for wearable-scale sleep staging. SleepGPT (136M parameters), adapted using labels from 25% of training patients, supervises a causal CNN-GRU (31k parameters; 122 KB) that stages EEG, EOG, or both in real time. We introduce Gcv-TAD, a new black-box transition-aware distillation loss. It emphasizes uncommon stage transitions while discounting those that vary across patients, using a prior estimated from labelled patients. In patient-wise 10-fold cross-validation, Gcv-TAD improves per-patient macro F1 over supervised training on the same labels by +3.2 to +7.6 points on average. Gains are largest on N1, and performance approaches full-label training.

AI.tldr: 本文以转移感知蒸馏训练可穿戴级睡眠分期模型，用少量临床标签提升碎片化睡眠识别。
AI.motivation: 主要基于健康人群开发的睡眠分期模型，难以泛化至觉醒频繁、睡眠阶段分布不同的临床患者。
AI.method: 用25%训练患者标签适配SleepGPT，通过强调罕见且跨患者稳定转移的Gcv-TAD监督因果CNN-GRU。
AI.result: 患者级十折验证中，宏平均F1较同标签监督训练平均提高3.2至7.6点，N1增益最大且接近全标签训练。
AI.conclusion: 转移感知教师学生框架可减少临床标注需求，并支持仅31千参数、122 KB模型的实时睡眠分期。

title: Body of Evidence: Triangulating 3D Human Pose with Geometry-Conditioned Depth
summary: Even in multi-camera setups, occlusions can leave individual body joints with only a single usable 2D observation. Such an observation defines a viewing ray but leaves the joint's depth undetermined. We introduce Body of Evidence (BoE), a multi-view 3D human pose estimator that predicts per-camera joint depths alongside 2D joint locations. To reduce monocular depth ambiguity, we propose geometry-conditioned depth prediction, which combines image features with previously reconstructed 3D body geometry as contextual depth cues. We further introduce learnable depth-aware triangulation (LDAT), which augments differentiable algebraic triangulation with predicted depth constraints, enabling reconstruction even from a single contributing camera while preserving the benefits of geometric triangulation when multiple views are available. The reconstructed 3D poses subsequently guide depth prediction in the next iteration, allowing depth estimates and 3D geometry to progressively refine each other. Experiments on CMU Panoptic demonstrate state-of-the-art in-domain performance and superior average performance across evaluated camera subsets and unseen camera arrangements. BoE is particularly effective under sparse camera coverage, outperforming the previous state of the art by 10.6 AP25 points in the challenging three-camera setting.

AI.tldr: BoE结合几何条件深度预测与深度感知三角化，提升稀疏相机下的三维人体姿态估计。
AI.motivation: 遮挡可能使关节仅有单个可用二维观测，导致传统三角化无法确定其深度。
AI.method: 利用已重建人体几何预测关节深度，将深度约束融入可学习三角化，并迭代优化深度与姿态。
AI.result: 在CMU Panoptic上取得域内最优表现，三相机场景较此前最佳方法提升10.6个AP25点。
AI.conclusion: 几何与深度的迭代互导可支持单视角关节重建，并提升稀疏及未见相机布局下的表现。

title: System 1 agents: a method for local, reliable and fast agentic AI
summary: Agentic artificial intelligence could automate analyses of sensitive clinical data, but current agents depend on large language models (LLMs). Cloud LLMs expose patient data. Local LLMs hallucinate, and an invented value in a tool call propagates through every later step. Here we present a method to build System 1 agents: local agents that call tools without generating text. A deterministic compiler turns each tool's schema and the request into multiple-choice questions whose options come from the request and the schema, then a one-pass decision model answers them. On 1,952 requests to 157 biomedical tools, the best System 1 agent chose the right tool, or correctly declined, for 97.0% of requests, significantly ahead of all 18 local LLM-agent settings (best 95.2%). The System 1 agent filled 97.0% of 6,056 stated argument values. No System 1 call contained invented content, against 5.5-19.7% of LLM calls. The System 1 Agents framework is freely available as open-source software at this https URL.
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Code and data: this https URL

AI.tldr: System 1代理通过本地选择而非文本生成调用生物医学工具，减少隐私风险与虚构内容。

title: Dataset Distillation for Handwritten Text Recognition: An Empirical Study
summary: Dataset distillation (DD) replaces large training datasets with smaller synthetic ones to reduce computational costs. While traditionally used for classification, we present, to our knowledge, the first DD study for line-level handwritten text recognition (HTR). Unlike classification tasks, which use discrete labels, HTR employs unaligned sequences from a virtually infinite output space as labels. To adapt classification-based DD methods to this scenario, we define text pseudo-classes by clustering transcriptions based on character n-grams. We adapt gradient matching (GM), distribution matching (DM) and trajectory matching (MTT) to a Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network (CRNN) trained with Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC). In this process, synthetic line images are generated by optimising only the pixels of real starting lines (either randomly chosen or selected as text medoids), while keeping their original transcriptions fixed. Across four datasets (IAM, George Washington, READ\,2016, LAM) and three budgets (1--10\,\% of the training lines), no distilled set outperforms its real initialisation lines. Random lines prove better than medoids, and further optimisation only degrades recognition. Methodologically, DM lowers its objective without benefit, while GM and MTT barely move theirs. We turn these findings into guidelines for evaluating data compression in HTR.

AI.tldr: 行级手写文本识别的数据集蒸馏实验发现，所测方法均未超越真实初始化样本。
AI.motivation: 手写文本识别使用未对齐且输出空间近乎无限的序列标签，难以直接应用面向分类的数据集蒸馏。
AI.method: 按字符n元组聚类构造文本伪类别，将三类匹配方法适配至CTC识别网络，仅优化图像像素。
AI.result: 四个数据集及1%至10%预算下，蒸馏均未优于初始化样本，随机选样优于中心样本且继续优化降低识别性能。
AI.conclusion: 所测分类式蒸馏方法未能有效压缩手写识别数据，匹配目标下降也不保证识别收益。

title: WiTac: Wrist-Informed Tactile Representations for Contact-Rich Manipulation
summary: Similar tactile contacts can call for different corrections depending on the configuration of the hand, object and target. Rather than supplying touch and wrist vision separately, fusing them before policy injection better grounds tactile features in visual context, yielding more accurate contact representations. We introduce Wrist-Informed Tactile Representations (WiTac), a pretrained encoder that learns such representations before action generation. Pretrained on nearly 300 hours of SharpaDex data, WiTac deeply fuses tactile signals with hand motion and wrist views into a comprehensive contact representation. Conditioning downstream VLA policies (GR00T N1.7 and $\pi_{0.5}$) on WiTac substantially improves task success over vision-only base policies across four contact-rich manipulation tasks (+28.8% and +15.0% on average), and further outperforms a wrist-free tactile encoder by 18.8% and 7.5%, respectively. Offline analyses further show that incorporating wrist vision yields more accurate contact descriptors, stronger joint task-contact discrimination, greater feature stability under tactile noise, and clearer action-direction readout from similar this http URL page: this https URL.

AI.tldr: WiTac在动作生成前融合触觉、手部运动与腕部视觉，提升接触密集操作的策略表现。

title: Multi-CONDOR: Learning Multistable Motion Primitives from Demonstration
summary: Dynamical-system-based motion policies provide a framework for learning reactive robot motions with stability and convergence properties. Many manipulation tasks, however, admit several distinct goals or a continuous set of acceptable outcomes, requiring motion primitives that preserve these alternatives. Accommodating both goal structures within a unified framework with continuous, autonomous dynamics remains an open challenge. We propose a CONDOR-based framework, multi-CONDOR, for learning motion primitives with either multiple discrete attractors or a continuous attracting goal contour. The approach combines imitation learning with losses that encourage agreement between the learned task dynamics and latent reference systems encoding the desired attraction structure. We provide a Lyapunov-based analysis of the convergence properties of the learned motion dynamics. We evaluate the framework on simulated benchmarks with discrete goals, qualitative examples with continuous goal contours, and robotic grasping experiments. In simulation, multi-CONDOR reduces trajectory RMSE by approximately 72% compared with separately learned single-goal motion primitives selected by a state machine. For tasks with two and three goals, respectively, it reduces the fraction of evaluated initial states ending outside the goal tolerance from StableNODE's 0.31% and 7.29% to 0% in both settings. Experiments with a Franka Emika robot arm demonstrate successful grasping of a container by either of its two handles using motions learned from demonstrations. Together, these results show multi-CONDOR combines motion reproduction with the flexibility to converge to alternative valid outcomes.

AI.tldr: multi-CONDOR从示范学习具有多个离散目标或连续目标轮廓的稳定运动基元。
AI.motivation: 许多操作允许多个有效终点，现有连续自主动力学框架难以统一保留离散和连续目标结构。
AI.method: 结合模仿学习与任务动力学和潜在参考系统的一致性损失，并通过李雅普诺夫方法分析收敛性。
AI.result: 仿真轨迹误差较状态机选择的单目标基元降低约72%，两类多目标设置的终点超差比例均为0%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法兼顾示范运动复现与多种有效终点收敛，真实机械臂也成功从两个把手之一抓取容器。

title: MetricHand: Geometry-Aware Flow Matching for 4D Hand Reconstruction in Metric World Space
summary: Egocentric hand motion provides physical motion supervision for dexterous manipulation and vision-language-action pretraining. Reliable use of this supervision requires accurate and temporally coherent 4D hand reconstruction in metric world space. Existing methods typically lift framewise estimates produced under weak perspective into world coordinates. By ignoring joint-dependent depth variation at close range, this approximation couples errors in translation, orientation, and articulation that persist after world lifting and worsen under occlusion. We present MetricHand, a geometry-aware flow matching framework for 4D hand reconstruction in metric world space. MetricHand encodes depth priors from hand-object interaction regions into joint-associated representations that preserve local spatial structure and metric scale. Fused with visual features, this geometry guides coarse metric estimation and conditions every step of temporal generation. The model jointly recovers world-space translation, global orientation, MANO articulation, and shape, while structural priors and temporal context support estimation under partial occlusion. MetricHand reduces camera-space MPJPE by 49.3% and 52.9%, absolute world-space MPJPE by 28.7% and 21.7%, and wrist localization error by 48.5% and 37.9% relative to HaWoR, respectively. World-space acceleration error decreases by 44.2% and 64.3%, demonstrating improved temporal fidelity alongside more accurate absolute localization.

AI.tldr: MetricHand以几何感知流匹配重建度量世界空间中的四维手部运动，提高定位精度与时间一致性。
AI.motivation: 弱透视逐帧估计忽略近距离关节深度差异，使平移、朝向和关节误差耦合，并在遮挡下加剧。
AI.method: 将手物交互区域深度先验编码为关节关联表征，融合视觉特征以引导度量估计及时间生成。
AI.result: 相较HaWoR，两组结果的世界坐标关节误差降低28.7%和21.7%，加速度误差降低44.2%和64.3%。

title: What Makes a Good Move? Learning to Act from Experience in Visual Worlds
summary: Learning visual policies requires turning interaction experience into guidance for individual decisions. Trajectory outcomes obscure action quality, while unguided exploration can revisit familiar situations. We present \textsc{LightAct}, an experience-learning framework that connects skill-guided exploration with policy internalization. Interaction segments are summarized into experience entries and consolidated into a game-specific skill that guides root collection toward broader state coverage. At each root, candidate actions are compared through short rollouts under a shared frozen policy. Environment-reported score gains are averaged across continuations and normalized into relative action rewards, producing reusable supervision for reinforcement learning. Policy training uses a compact dataset of just 1,024 decision roots collected in a single source game and paired with their action rewards. Across 170 GameWorld tasks spanning 34 games, \textsc{LightAct} improves overall progress by 23.6, 29.2, and 13.0 percentage points at the 2B, 4B, and 9B scales, respectively, with our strongest model competitive with reported proprietary-model results. Ablations show broader root-state coverage with skill guidance and consistent gains across three policy optimizers. Case studies show how rollouts distinguish actions with identical immediate gains.

AI.tldr: LightAct将技能引导探索与短程动作比较结合，用少量决策根节点训练可迁移的视觉策略。
AI.motivation: 整条轨迹的结果难以反映单步动作质量，无引导探索也容易反复访问熟悉状态。
AI.method: 将交互经验归纳为技能以拓展状态覆盖，再用冻结策略短程展开比较动作并生成强化学习奖励。
AI.result: 仅用单一游戏的1024个决策根节点训练，在170项任务上使三种规模模型进度提高23.6、29.2和13.0个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 技能引导的状态覆盖与相对动作奖励能有效支持经验内化，且收益在三种策略优化器下保持一致。

title: CoopDistill: Equilibrium-Guided Multi-Agent Policy Distillation for Cooperative Driving
summary: Cooperative driving extends autonomous driving from individual vehicle decisions to joint maneuvers that improve traffic safety and efficiency. Optimization-based methods impose safety constraints but often fix paths to simplify multi-vehicle planning, limiting spatial flexibility. Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) explores alternatives through interaction, but coordinated learning and safe execution remain challenging. Their integration nevertheless faces challenges in exploration efficiency, experience allocation, and execution reliability. To address these challenges, this paper proposes CoopDistill, an equilibrium-guided multi-agent policy distillation framework. A potential-game (PG) formulation provides a fixed-path longitudinal reference, around which a residual MARL policy learns longitudinal acceleration, conflict-approach timing, and lateral path corrections. A hard-case curriculum concentrates experience on interactions that PG leaves unresolved or substantially delayed. A comparative rollout selector evaluates the joint consequences of learned corrections against PG before choosing the executed action. Experiments in merging, roundabout, and intersection scenarios compare CoopDistill with six baselines at four connected automated vehicle penetration levels. Relative to PG, success improves by 2.1--27.1 percentage points and delay decreases by 7.3--27.3\%, with no observed collisions. Code is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: CoopDistill结合势博弈参考、残差多智能体学习和执行筛选，改善协同驾驶成功率与延迟。
AI.motivation: 固定路径优化限制空间灵活性，而多智能体强化学习仍面临探索效率、经验分配和安全执行难题。
AI.method: 围绕势博弈纵向参考学习残差控制，利用困难案例课程分配经验，并比较联合展开结果选择执行动作。
