AI.conclusion: 均衡参考与残差学习的结合可在所测场景中兼顾协同机动灵活性、通行效率和执行可靠性。

title: Sage S2.1 Flash Technical Report
summary: We introduce Sage S1.5 Flash, a 320-billion-parameter general-purpose mixture-of-experts model designed to reason over scientific evidence and act in interactive environments. Sage Sci-Perception uses dedicated encoders for molecular graphs and biological sequences and represents spectra as ordered patches of measurements. Modality-specific projectors map these representations into the input space of a shared backbone, which processes them alongside text and images. To develop the model's agent capabilities, we construct verifiable environments for tool use, search, and coding, as well as specialized workflows involving machine learning experiments and scientific software. Task completion is checked against execution results, changes in environment state, or submitted artifacts. We evaluate Sage S1.5 Flash on 33 benchmarks across seven domains. In the primary comparison against five baselines, it ranks first on OfficeQA Pro (72.2), MLE-bench Lite (90.3 HumanRank), Harvey LAB, and SpreadsheetBench~2, and second on OSWorld-Verified (85.2), WebArena-Verified (67.6), and DeepResearch Bench~II (54.2). These results show particular strengths in using documentary evidence, producing verifiable workbooks, and carrying out machine learning tasks, alongside competitive performance in desktop and browser workflows that require the model to act on visual feedback.

AI.tldr: Sage S1.5 Flash是面向科学证据推理与交互任务的3200亿参数混合专家模型。
AI.motivation: 旨在统一处理多模态科学证据，并提升模型在可验证交互环境中的任务执行能力。
AI.method: 通过专用编码器接入科学模态，并构建工具、搜索、编程及科学实验的可验证训练环境。
AI.result: 在七领域33项基准上评估，主要比较中四项排名第一、三项排名第二。
AI.conclusion: 模型在文档证据利用、可验证工作簿生成和机器学习任务上表现突出，桌面与浏览器操作亦具竞争力。

title: Finite-Step Algorithms for Input-Constrained Control Barrier Function-Based Safety Filters
summary: Control barrier function (CBF) safety filters commonly rely on quadratic programs (QPs) to modify nominal control inputs while satisfying safety constraints. For safety-critical applications, however, the solution must be computed reliably under actuator limitations and with predictable computational effort. General-purpose QP solvers typically rely on numerical convergence criteria, which do not directly provide finite bounds on algorithmic steps or distinguish solver failure from mathematical infeasibility. This paper considers CBF-QPs with a single affine safety constraint, componentwise input bounds, and diagonal quadratic weights. Exploiting the established scalar dual structure of continuous quadratic knapsack problems, we obtain a necessary and sufficient pointwise feasibility condition and an exact breakpoint-based solution procedure. The algorithm requires at most 2n positive breakpoint events for n inputs, reducing to at most n events when the nominal input is admissible. In the latter case, an exact saturation--redistribution algorithm computes the optimal solution in at most n passes. We further describe how the structured solution can be combined with verified floating-point constraint evaluation to distinguish certified feasible commands, certified infeasibility, and unresolved numerical cases. The resulting framework provides an exact and computationally predictable solution procedure for a practically relevant class of input-constrained CBF safety filters.

AI.tldr: 提出适用于一类输入受限控制障碍函数安全滤波器的有限步精确求解算法。
AI.motivation: 通用二次规划求解器难以保证有限计算步数，也难区分数值求解失败与数学不可行。
AI.method: 利用标量对偶结构推导充要可行性条件，设计断点及饱和再分配算法，并结合验证式浮点约束评估。
AI.result: 对n个输入至多处理2n个正断点；标称输入满足输入界时至多n个事件，饱和再分配至多n轮完成。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为特定输入受限安全滤波问题提供精确且计算量可预测的解法，并支持区分可行、不可行与数值未决情形。

title: Counting What Matters: Reducing Redundant Object Detections in Overlapping UAV Mapping Imagery for Disaster Response
summary: UAV mapping flights enable rapid aerial reconnaissance of large-scale incident sites in civil protection. However, the image overlap required for orthophoto generation causes every physical object to be detected multiple times across images, while dynamic objects may be omitted from or duplicated in the resulting orthomosaic. Analysis based on the orthophoto alone is therefore structurally insufficient. We address this by detecting objects on the individual images and merging redundant detections across them. This task lies between multi-object tracking and re-identification, as mapping flights form temporally ordered but sparsely sampled sequences with object reappearances across flight strips. We fine-tune YOLO detectors on a new domain-specific nadir dataset from real civil protection operations, roughly doubling mAP50 over the previous system, and propose re-identification approaches based on 3D positions from sparse reconstruction, DINOv3 appearance embeddings, and their combination via constrained greedy clustering. %On four manually annotated real-world mapping flights, the combined weighted multi-pass approach achieves the best trade-off between association accuracy and count error. On four manually annotated real-world mapping flights, an association-only evaluation using ground-truth detections shows that the combined weighted multi-pass approach provides the best trade-off between association quality and count error. It is integrated into the open-source web application ARGUS and visualized as verifiable, correctable object groups for first responders. this https URL

AI.tldr: 通过跨图像合并无人机重复目标检测，改善灾害响应中的目标关联与计数。
AI.motivation: 航测图像重叠导致重复检测，且正射影像可能遗漏或重复动态目标，单独依赖正射影像不足。

title: MORE: Merge Once, Route Early for Training-Free Multi-Subject Composition from Large LoRA Pools
summary: Public hubs offer many personalized LoRAs per text-to-image backbone, yet composing two of them in one image remains fragile. In FLUX, keeping a pool of $K=10$ or $20$ subject LoRAs loaded makes their deltas interfere, and even loading only the two requested LoRAs keeps both subjects in fewer than 4% of images: one subject vanishes, the two fuse, or the image splits into a collage. We present MORE (Merge Once, Route Early), a training-free two-stage pipeline for FLUX. Merge once: the whole pool is folded into a single fixed-rank adapter by the subspace-regression router of SSR-Merge, made reliable by ridge, rank and calibration choices, and factored exactly into a shared part and per-subject parts. Route early: during the first 30% of the denoising steps each subject's part is gated to its layout region; a decaying soft attention bias ties every region to its own subject tokens, and a cyclic swap guidance extrapolates away from the prediction with the subjects' regions permuted, which counteracts region homogenization. On held-out seeds, MORE keeps both subjects in 94.2% ($K=10$) and 78.3% ($K=20$) of images, against 50.8% / 35.8% for FreeFuse and 25.0% / 24.2% for LoRAShop, and reaches an ImageReward of 1.32 (best baseline 0.07), while all $K$ subjects stay in one adapter. With layouts inferred automatically it still keeps both subjects in 70.0% / 55.0% of images.

AI.tldr: MORE无需训练即可从大型LoRA池中实现稳定的双主体图像组合。
AI.motivation: FLUX中多个主体LoRA相互干扰，易造成主体消失、融合或图像拼贴。
AI.method: 将LoRA池合并并分解为共享与主体部分，在前30%去噪步骤实施区域路由、软注意力偏置及循环交换引导。

AI.conclusion: MORE在单一适配器中保留全部主体，并在自动推断布局时仍能实现有效双主体组合。

title: SemiNovo: Learning Beyond Search-Identified Spectra for De Novo Peptide Sequencing
summary: Sensitive peptide identification is fundamental to protein characterization and novel protein discovery, for which de novo peptide sequencing (DNPS) from tandem mass spectra provides an important database-independent approach. Although deep learning has substantially advanced de novo sequencing, existing models are predominantly trained on high-confidence peptide-spectrum matches obtained through database search. This search-conditioned supervision excludes a large fraction of unidentified spectra, creating a distribution mismatch between the selectively labeled training data and the complete spectrum stream encountered at inference time, thereby limiting peptide identification performance. To address this challenge, we propose SemiNovo, a semi-supervised framework that learns jointly from identified and unlabeled spectra. SemiNovo first constructs DarkSpec, a large-scale quality-controlled corpus of unlabeled spectra collected from diverse public proteomics projects, thereby extending training beyond search-identified spectra and mitigating the resulting shift in DNPS supervision. It then combines stepwise mass-constrained autoregressive decoding with cumulative path confidence to derive reliable supervision from unlabeled spectra. Moreover, SemiNovo introduces head-wise chemical-evidence gating to improve spectral evidence aggregation under noisy and incomplete fragmentation. Experiments show that SemiNovo performs favorably against state-of-the-art methods on multiple benchmarks. Code and dataset are publicly available.
comment: 13 pages. Accepted as an oral presentation at KDD 2027, AI for Sciences Track

AI.tldr: SemiNovo利用已鉴定及未标注质谱开展半监督从头肽测序。
AI.motivation: 仅用数据库搜索鉴定的高置信谱图训练，会与推理时完整谱流产生分布偏移。
AI.method: 构建未标注谱库DarkSpec，结合逐步质量约束解码、累积路径置信度和分头化学证据门控。
AI.result: 实验显示，SemiNovo在多个基准上相较现有先进方法表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 利用未鉴定谱图扩展监督来源，有助于缓解搜索条件化训练的局限，代码与数据已公开。

title: Think2Listen: Evidence-Centric Learning For Agentic Audio Understanding With LALMS
summary: Recent advances in large audio-language models (LALMs) have broadened audio understanding across speech, sound, and music, with tool-based agents further supporting these tasks by invoking predefined audio tools. However, a persistent gap remains between perceiving acoustic content and using it as evidence for reasoning: recognizing what is audible does not ensure that a model can identify which cues resolve an uncertain decision. To bridge this gap, we propose Think2Listen, an evidence-centric learning framework for agentic audio understanding. Guided by evidence before commitment, Think2Listen couples iterative reasoning with a targeted LALM interaction to actively seek acoustic cues that distinguish competing hypotheses and revise candidate judgments based on the observations returned. It learns what to ask, how to use evidence, and when to stop, using observation-induced changes in candidate-state to inform training credit. Extensive evaluations on two benchmarks spanning seven audio categories demonstrate that Think2Listen achieves (I) enhanced multi-step audio reasoning, with gains in overall accuracy of 5.08%--17.67% over competing audio agents; and (II) improved audio understanding and reasoning across speech, sound, and music, boosting overall accuracy by 2.29%--13.10% over the corresponding baselines. The source code is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: Think2Listen通过主动寻求声学证据提升音频智能体的多步推理能力。
AI.motivation: 识别可听内容并不意味着模型能找到消除决策不确定性的关键声学线索。
AI.method: 交替进行推理与定向音频模型交互，并依据观测引起的候选状态变化学习提问、证据使用和停止时机。
AI.result: 在覆盖七类音频的两个基准上，相对音频智能体准确率提升5.08%—17.67%，相对对应基线提升2.29%—13.10%。
AI.conclusion: 以证据为中心的交互学习可增强跨语音、声音和音乐的音频理解与推理。

title: State-Message Interaction Adapter for Cross-Domain Few-Shot Segmentation
summary: Cross-domain few-shot segmentation adapts natural-image pretrained encoders to medical or industrial domains from a few pixel-annotated support masks. Within frozen DINOv3, intermediate per-head attention messages already carry target-background distinctions that baseline final-layer similarities and predictions do not consistently reflect. We propose the State-Message Interaction Adapter (SMIA) to learn how per-head messages should update each receiving token representation while keeping pretrained attention and FFN parameters frozen. Inserted right after per-head aggregation, SMIA conditions the transformation of each head's aggregated output (message) on each patch's pre-attention feature (state), allowing similar contextual messages to produce distinct or opposing updates depending on the receiving position. Because scarce support masks cover only limited state-message combinations, a shared low-rank bilinear map confines the learned interactions to low-dimensional state, message, and output subspaces. Added before each adapted block's frozen FFN, these updates yield adapted features that are refined by frozen FFNs and deeper blocks for linear readout. With only 0.51M trainable parameters and single-pass, support-free inference, SMIA achieves six-dataset mean mIoUs of 77.40% at 5 shots and 80.99% at 10 shots across 20 medical and industrial tasks, surpassing the strongest prior methods by +3.61 and +3.93 percentage points. In controlled 10-shot comparisons across three benchmarks on the same DINOv3 backbone, SMIA also outperforms parameter-matched AdaptFormer, LoRA, and ParaX with a better precision-recall balance.
comment: 17 pages, 9 figures, 7 tables, including the appendix

AI.tldr: SMIA通过状态与注意力消息交互，实现参数高效的跨域少样本分割。
AI.motivation: 冻结编码器的中间注意力消息含有目标背景信息，但最终层相似度与预测未能稳定体现这些信息。
AI.method: 冻结DINOv3注意力及前馈参数，以共享低秩双线性映射按接收位置状态调整各头聚合消息。
AI.result: 仅训练51万参数，六数据集平均mIoU在5及10样本时达77.40%和80.99%，领先此前最佳方法3.61及3.93个百分点。
AI.conclusion: SMIA支持无需支持集的单次前向推理，并在同骨干受控比较中优于参数量匹配的多种适配方法。

title: Conflict-Aware Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation in Aligned Action Spaces for Cross-Game Generalization
summary: Zero-shot cross-game generalization aims to consolidate accessible source-game experts into a single vision-language model (VLM) that controls unseen games from raw pixels without target-game parameter updates. While multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) mitigates offline exposure bias and single-game reinforcement learning (RL) overfitting, scaling it to autoregressive VLMs faces two bottlenecks. First, token-to-action misalignment from subword length bias distorts discrete action probabilities and uncertainty margins. Second, multi-teacher policy conflict arises as source teachers under incompatible dynamics issue contradictory closed-loop corrections, causing negative transfer. We propose CAMOPD (Conflict-Aware Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation), a post-training framework that resolves multi-teacher policy conflict within an aligned semantic action space. CAMOPD first uses complete-action alignment to normalize command completion likelihoods over each game's legal action set, forming a calibrated categorical policy that provides reliable uncertainty margins for selective on-policy retention and visual specialist probes that can be evaluated across source games. To resolve policy conflict without target-game data, conflict-aware multi-teacher consolidation cross-evaluates these specialists across source games to capture both visual identifiability and inter-teacher compatibility, upweighting compatible teachers while suppressing conflicting corrections. On GameWorld's temporal and directional transfer suites with Qwen3.5-4B, CAMOPD achieves 26/30 (86.7%) and 24/30 (80.0%) Task-1 zero-shot success on unseen GeoDash and Doodle Jump, outperforming prompting, weight-merging, and multi-task baselines.

AI.tldr: CAMOPD在对齐动作空间内处理多教师策略冲突，提升视觉语言模型的零样本跨游戏泛化。
AI.motivation: 自回归模型的词元动作错位及跨游戏教师策略冲突，会扭曲动作概率并导致负迁移。
AI.method: 对合法完整动作概率归一化，并跨源游戏评估视觉专家，以提高兼容教师权重、抑制冲突纠正。
AI.result: 使用Qwen3.5-4B时，在未见GeoDash和Doodle Jump上的任务一成功率分别为86.7%与80.0%，超过所比基线。
AI.conclusion: 无需目标游戏数据或参数更新，动作对齐与冲突感知蒸馏可有效整合源游戏专家并改善迁移。

title: SWE-WhatIf: Simulating Real Users of Coding Agents from Recorded Session
summary: Recorded sessions between users and coding agents offer a way to evaluate how agents complete real-world tasks and interact with users. However, these sessions cannot simply be replayed with new agents, because recorded user replies may no longer apply when an agent takes a different trajectory. We introduce SWE-WhatIf, which replays recorded sessions with new agents by modeling the user's intents, the criteria for satisfying them, and the conditions under which they arise. Using this model, a user simulator generates replies that adapt to unseen agent turns while remaining grounded in the recording. Across 89 real-world sessions, SWE-WhatIf generated the replies most similar to those of real users and matched the strongest baseline when sessions were rewritten. To test adaptation, we replay sessions with agents instructed to avoid or repeat actions that the recorded user pushed back on. SWE-WhatIf produced the highest win rate for avoiding these actions (66.3%), significantly above chance. We further demonstrate its utility by ranking five LLMs as coding agents, where the highest-ranked model depended on how users specified and developed their intents, and a study with 16 users, where replaying their own sessions changed 14 participants' rankings and informed their future agent use.

AI.tldr: SWE-WhatIf依据真实会话模拟用户，使编码智能体沿新轨迹交互时仍可得到贴合原始意图的反馈。
AI.motivation: 新智能体可能偏离记录中的行动轨迹，导致原有用户回复无法直接重放。
AI.method: 建模用户意图、满足标准及触发条件，据此生成适应新智能体回合且扎根原记录的回复。
AI.result: 在89段会话中回复最接近真实用户，避免用户反对行为的胜率达66.3%，16人研究中14人改变了模型排名。
AI.conclusion: 用户意图的表达和演变会影响编码模型排名，会话重放可帮助用户调整未来的智能体使用方式。

title: Inference Equivalence and Quotient Coding
summary: Incomplete observations can admit multiple physical interpretations without making every task conclusion ambiguous. Recovering all compatible scenes is often unnecessary, whereas indiscriminate compression may change which claims are justified. We ask which distinctions among observation-compatible interpretation sets must be retained to preserve every valid conclusion of a specified task. We first define inference validity as truth across all physically compatible states and characterize it, under a closedness condition, by distances to physically realizable falsifying measurements. For a finite semantic claim family ordered by specificity, the Exact Inference Frontier forms the unique minimal antichain generating all valid claims. We then define inference equivalence between compatibility sets and construct a canonical quotient code from their frontiers. Among deterministic codes admitting exact inference decoding, it induces the coarsest partition, minimizing the number of distinguishable code values rather than storage or computation. Finally, we characterize inference errors from learned compatibility sets, derive conditions for exact inference preservation despite set errors, and evaluate an asymmetric learning surrogate under distribution shifts. On a registered finite bank, 145 compatibility sets yield 31 quotient codes with unchanged valid-claim sets. Across geometry, mechanism, and joint shifts, learned estimates exhibit different accuracy-specificity trade-offs. On 1,962 official HRSID test images, 1,913 distinct candidate sets induce only 36 seven-claim inference signatures, while a visual 3-NN baseline achieves 87.31% precision on issued claims.

AI.tldr: 研究以推理等价和规范商编码压缩兼容解释集，同时完整保留指定任务的有效结论。
AI.motivation: 不完整观测虽允许多种物理解释，但恢复所有场景并非必要，任意压缩又可能改变可证结论。
AI.method: 以所有兼容状态上的真值定义有效性，通过精确推理前沿构造商编码，并分析学习误差与分布偏移。
AI.result: 有限库中145个兼容集压缩为31种编码且结论不变，HRSID上1913种候选集仅对应36种推理签名。
AI.conclusion: 该编码在支持精确推理解码的确定性编码中产生最粗划分，但不保证存储或计算最小化。

title: MedicalDPO: Multi-Objective Direct Preference Optimization for CT to PET Translation
summary: CT-to-PET synthesis estimates functional PET images from anatomical CT scans for auxiliary analysis, representation pretraining, and missing-modality completion. Brownian Bridge diffusion models can produce multiple PET candidates of different quality under the same CT condition, exposing an intra-condition quality hierarchy. Candidate quality spans complementary spatial, structural, and intensity dimensions, while DPO-only fine-tuning may compromise absolute synthesis fidelity. We propose MedicalDPO which converts this hierarchy into preference supervision automatically constructed from paired CT-PET training data. Multiple candidates are ranked across the three fidelity dimensions, and strict cross-metric verification retains preferred-rejected pairs with consistent quality separation. Relative denoising-error preference optimization is jointly trained with the original Brownian Bridge objective to anchor the pretrained CT-to-PET mapping, while condition-balanced multi-pair rotation distributes preference supervision across CT conditions. Experiments on BBDM and CPDM show improvements across LPIPS, MAE, SSIM, and PSNR. Further analyses demonstrate metric complementarity and clear pair separation, while ablations show that the original training objective prevents the substantial degradation caused by DPO-only fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: MedicalDPO将多维质量偏好与原始扩散目标联合优化，改善CT到PET合成并避免单独偏好微调的退化。
AI.motivation: 同一CT条件下生成的PET候选质量不同且涉及多种指标，单独使用DPO可能损害绝对合成保真度。
AI.method: 按空间、结构和强度指标筛选一致偏好对，联合优化去噪误差偏好与布朗桥目标，并均衡轮换各条件的样本对。
AI.result: 在BBDM和CPDM上改善LPIPS、MAE、SSIM及PSNR，消融显示原始目标可防止DPO单独微调的显著退化。
AI.conclusion: 多指标一致偏好与原始合成目标结合，可兼顾相对质量提升和预训练映射的保真度。

title: ForceHarness: Turning Force into Action and Physics for Frozen Frontier Models
summary: Frontier multimodal models can now control robots zero-shot from images, yet many manipulation tasks depend on contact forces that images cannot show. Bringing force to an API-only frozen model raises two challenges. First, contact evolves much faster than an API model can decide, so the system must close the loop on force beneath the model. Second, a frozen model cannot interpret raw force streams, so force must be returned in a form the model can reason about. Therefore, we present ForceHarness, a harness that lets frozen models use force without demonstrations or finetuning. After calibrating hand force from a wrist sensor or joint torques alone, ForceHarness addresses the first challenge with self-terminating force primitives that regulate force on their own and return at a contact event. To address the second challenge, a physics translation layer turns each force trace into physical quantities with uncertainty as the tool result. To evaluate ForceHarness against expert force controllers and learned policies under identical conditions, we also build HiddenPhys, a seven-task MuJoCo benchmark with hidden physical variables. On a real arm without a wrist force sensor, ForceHarness raises the zero-shot success rate of GPT-6 Astra from 3.3% to 90.0%. In simulation, it adds 17.5 percentage points on the public ForceBench suite and 34.3 percentage points on HiddenPhys, surpassing force-aware policies trained on demonstrations on both benchmarks and matching hand-written expert controllers on HiddenPhys. Ablations further show that smaller models make significantly better decisions when given physical quantities rather than raw force values.
comment: 31 pages: 8-page main paper, references, and supplementary material. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: ForceHarness无需示范或微调，通过自主力控和物理量反馈让冻结多模态模型利用接触力执行操作。
AI.motivation: 接触变化快于API模型决策速度，且冻结模型难以直接理解原始力传感数据。
AI.method: 校准手部受力后，以自终止力控原语闭环执行，并将力轨迹转换为带不确定性的物理量反馈。
AI.result: 真机零样本成功率从3.3%升至90.0%，仿真在ForceBench和HiddenPhys分别提高17.5和34.3个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 自主力控与物理量表达可有效补足冻结模型的力觉能力，且在基准上超过示范训练的力觉策略。

title: Beyond Family Labels: A Taxonomic Ornstein-Uhlenbeck Prior for Avian 3D Shape Recovery
summary: Recovering 3D pose and shape of birds from single images is bottlenecked by the long tail of avian diversity: out of ~10,000 species, only a few dozen have 3D-labeled training data, and in-the-wild test sets routinely contain species never seen at training. Generalizing across clades is therefore a central problem. The current state of the art, AniMer+, mitigates it with a family-level contrastive loss that conveys only a binary same-family indicator per pair and discards the continuous structure of the species tree. We propose a taxonomic Ornstein-Uhlenbeck prior on the shape code of the AVES parametric bird mesh model: a multivariate Gaussian whose covariance decays exponentially with Linnaean rank distance, with a learnable selection strength and noise scale. The prior generalizes family contrastive into a continuous, generative form, exposing the graded cross- and within-family similarity that a binary indicator cannot, and brings continuous comparative phylogenetics in as a biology-grounded inductive bias for the long tail. Our method improves over AniMer+ on both metrics of the unseen-species CowBird benchmark and on CtrlAVES3D, while remaining comparable on seen-species CUB. A permutation ablation isolates taxonomic structure from generic Gaussian smoothing, and a rank-granularity ablation identifies cross-order distinctions (the structure beyond a family-vs-not indicator) as the dominant source of the unseen-species gain.

AI.tldr: 研究用分类学Ornstein-Uhlenbeck先验建模鸟类形状相似性，提升单图三维恢复对未见物种的泛化。
AI.motivation: 鸟类物种众多而三维标注稀少，现有同科二元约束丢失了物种分类树中的连续相似结构。
AI.method: 为AVES形状编码构造多元高斯先验，使协方差随分类等级距离指数衰减，并学习选择强度和噪声尺度。
AI.result: 在未见物种CowBird的两项指标及CtrlAVES3D上优于AniMer+，在已见物种CUB上表现相当。
AI.conclusion: 分类学结构提供了有效的生物学归纳偏置，消融表明跨目差异是未见物种性能提升的主要来源。

title: GRAZE: Text-Free Grasp Synthesis for Unseen Objects from Human Gaze
summary: Text-conditioned hand-object interaction (HOI) generation provides intuitive semantic control, but language is an indirect way to specify where an interaction should occur on an object. Naming the part to grasp requires object-specific words, and naming the approach side requires a reference frame that a prompt lacks. We propose GRAZE (GRAsp from gaZE), which generates hand-object grasp motion from recorded gaze instead of object and part names. Its Geometry-Aware Gaze Encoding (GeoGaze) maps gaze rays to cues on object geometry, and cross-attention conditions a diffusion Transformer on these cues. We also introduce HOT3D-Grasp, a grasp-centered benchmark with object-disjoint folds built on HOT3D recordings. On unseen objects, GRAZE grasps the target part more often than the strongest text-conditioned baseline (49.3% vs. 43.6%), achieves the highest grasp success (66.3% vs. 46.6%), and transfers without fine-tuning to GazeHOI (45.3% vs. 33.8%). Gaze conveys the approach side: when gaze is rotated around the object, the approach turns with it in 59.1% of cases, against 20.5% for a text model retrained with clock words. On the same backbone, a text prompt names parts better, but gaze adds the approach side. Given both, GRAZE keeps the prompt's part accuracy and follows gaze.

AI.tldr: GRAZE以人类注视替代文字指定抓握位置和接近方向，提升未见物体上的抓握动作生成效果。
AI.motivation: 文字指定抓握部位依赖物体专用词汇，而描述接近方向还需要提示中通常缺失的参考系。
AI.method: 将注视射线编码为物体几何线索，以交叉注意力条件化扩散Transformer，并构建物体互斥的抓握基准。
AI.result: 未见物体目标部位命中率为49.3%、抓握成功率为66.3%，均高于最强文本基线的43.6%和46.6%。
AI.conclusion: 注视可补充文字难以表达的接近方向，与文本结合时能保留部位准确性并遵循注视方向。

title: CivilBench: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models for Multimodal Information Integration in Civil Engineering
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI), particularly large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs), is increasingly applied in civil and structural engineering for disaster assessment, structural analysis, and engineering decision support. However, the extent to which current VLMs possess the reasoning capabilities required for reliable engineering judgments remains unclear. In this work, we introduce CivilBench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating VLMs in civil engineering and disaster-related scenarios. CivilBench covers three major task families: Sequential Reasoning, Image-based Structural Understanding, and Open-world Understanding, encompassing numerical reasoning, structural damage assessment, risk inference, causal analysis, and repair planning. The benchmark is constructed through a systematic pipeline of domain-specific data collection, engineering-oriented captioning, expert annotation, question design, and quality verification. Evaluation of representative state-of-the-art VLMs reveals substantial limitations in domain-specific reasoning, with Sequential Reasoning emerging as a major bottleneck, particularly when models must infer numerical relationships from sparse structured observations. Further experiments show that numerical priors and external knowledge can alleviate these limitations, although their effectiveness depends on the model's ability to reliably interpret and use the available evidence. CivilBench provides a capability-oriented testbed for identifying reasoning limitations and evaluating progress toward reliable AI-assisted engineering decision-making. The benchmark will be publicly available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: CivilBench评估视觉语言模型的土木工程多模态推理能力，揭示序列数值推理等可靠性瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型已用于工程评估和决策支持，但其是否具备可靠工程判断所需的推理能力仍不明确。
AI.method: 经领域数据采集、工程描述、专家标注及质量核验，构建序列推理、图像结构理解和开放世界理解任务。
AI.result: 先进模型仍有明显领域推理局限，序列推理尤其困难；数值先验和外部知识可缓解但依赖证据使用能力。
AI.conclusion: CivilBench为定位工程推理缺陷及评估可靠人工智能辅助工程决策的进展提供测试平台。

title: Source-Free Domain Adaptation for Multi-Label Image Classification: A Framework, Baselines, and Benchmark
summary: Source-free domain adaptation (SFDA) adapts a model trained on a labelled source domain to an unlabelled target domain without access to the source data. Almost the entire SFDA literature assumes mutually exclusive classes, yet many deployed settings are multi-label. This paper formulates SFDA for multi-label classification and establishes the first benchmark for it: five adaptation tasks over six datasets spanning remote sensing, natural, clipart-style and driving imagery, with four single-label SFDA methods extended to provide the first baselines and a published multi-label method run alongside them, over three seeds. The benchmark shows that extending a single-label method is unreliable rather than merely suboptimal: half of the extended baselines fail to improve on the unadapted source model at all, and on two of the five tasks none of them does. The failures are not incidental. Nearest-centroid pseudo-labelling, softmax-based confidence, the diversity term of information maximization and confidence-weighted prototype construction each rely on mutual exclusivity, and each fails differently without it, so replacing the softmax with per-class sigmoids is a valid but insufficient extension. Multi-label Prototype Alignment with Contrastive Teaching (MPACT) is proposed in response, a mean-teacher framework whose objective, prototype construction and alignment term are each reconsidered for overlapping label sets. It attains the best average on every reported metric and is the only method that improves on the unadapted source model on all five tasks. The analysis further introduces a prototype-agreement diagnostic separating feature-space alignment from self-reinforcing agreement with the classifier, and reports a negative result for confidence-based pseudo-label filtering.

AI.tldr: 研究建立多标签无源域适应基准，并提出MPACT，在全部五项任务上均优于未适应的源模型。
AI.motivation: 现有无源域适应大多假设类别互斥，直接迁移至标签可重叠的实际场景缺乏可靠性。
AI.method: 构建覆盖六个数据集的五项任务，并提出均值教师框架MPACT，重新设计多标签目标、原型构建及对齐项。
AI.result: 半数扩展基线未优于源模型，MPACT在所有报告指标上取得最佳平均表现，且是唯一在五项任务均有提升的方法。
AI.conclusion: 仅将softmax替换为逐类sigmoid不足以解决多标签适应，需系统重设依赖类别互斥的学习机制。

title: Searching for Autoregressive Neural Architectures from Fundamental Operations
summary: Expressive Neural Architecture Search (NAS) search spaces are desirable as they do not restrict the space of potential architectures to what is already established. However, few search spaces are expressive enough to represent a broad range of architecture families, and those that are have focused primarily on image classification problems. The task of autoregressive sequence modelling has become ubiquitous in modern machine learning, but no existing search space supports the construction of and search over sequence models from fundamental operations, instead imposing strong inductive biases on the structure of potential architectures. This work describes how the expressive einspace search space can be extended to yield a search space capable of representing autoregressive models using fundamental operations. We perform a series of experiments showing that the novel einspaceAR search space can find capable autoregressive sequence models from scratch--i.e., without imposing strong inductive biases. We believe that our einspaceAR search space will be a useful part of the NAS toolbox and that the techniques described in this work can serve as a blueprint for the integration of autoregressive modelling in other expressive search spaces.

AI.tldr: 提出从基础运算搜索自回归模型的einspaceAR，减少架构搜索中的强归纳偏置。
AI.motivation: 现有表达性架构搜索空间主要面向图像分类，缺乏从基础运算构建序列模型的支持。
AI.method: 扩展einspace搜索空间，使其能够以基础运算表示并搜索自回归序列模型。
AI.result: 实验表明，einspaceAR可在不施加强归纳偏置的情况下从零搜索出有效的自回归模型。
AI.conclusion: einspaceAR拓展了架构搜索工具，并为其他表达性搜索空间引入自回归建模提供参考。

title: Intransigence or compromise: concatenated opinion dynamics with voting feedback
summary: In this paper, we study opinion evolution in a sequence of Friedkin-Johnsen (FJ) models, concatenated so that the final opinions of each model serve as the initial opinions of the next. Each FJ model is followed by a vote, and each agent becomes partially or fully stubborn in the next model, depending on how close its opinion is to the voting result. With the state-dependent switching of stubbornness, the dynamics are not guaranteed to be contractive. We show that, over any fixed strongly connected network, the opinions always converge. A sufficient condition on the initial opinions is proposed, under which consensus is reached exponentially fast. For the complete graph, we further show that, if the agents' stubbornness levels do not differ too much, an agent that is partially stubborn in one FJ model can never become fully stubborn in a subsequent one: once it has started compromising, it keeps doing so.

AI.tldr: 研究投票反馈驱动固执程度变化的串联意见模型，证明强连通网络中的意见始终收敛。
AI.motivation: 固执程度随状态切换会使意见动力学不再保证收缩，其收敛与妥协持续性需要分析。
AI.method: 串联FJ模型，以前轮最终意见初始化后轮，并按意见与投票结果的距离调整固执程度。
AI.result: 证明固定强连通网络中意见总会收敛，并给出指数达成共识及完全图上持续妥协的充分条件。
AI.conclusion: 即使动力学不保证收缩，投票反馈下的意见仍可收敛，且特定条件下妥协具有持续性。

title: VAE Rhythm: Temporal Decoding Traces for AI-Generated Video Detection
summary: Visible artifacts are an unreliable cue for detecting generated videos, because newer generators learn to remove them. We instead detect a trace left by the generation pipeline itself. Most video generators decode latents with a 3D causal VAE that groups consecutive frames in time, so the fidelity of generated frames rises and falls periodically with their position in a group. We call this periodic trace VAE Rhythm. Real videos are captured frame by frame and do not have it. To reveal it without training, we propose a phase scan. The scan reconstructs a clip with an off-the-shelf VAE from successive start offsets and measures the periodicity of the reconstruction error across these offsets. We find VAE Rhythm in most of the 39 variants of 31 generators we test, including the closed-source Sora, Kling 3.0 and Seedance 2.0. We use the rhythm as a zero-shot score, as a plug-in for existing detectors and as a data engine that pairs real videos with their VAE reconstructions to train our detector CaDet. On DF26, the training-free rhythm score outperforms all 15 retrained baselines, and as a plug-in it improves all 19 tested detectors by 6.7% to 23.7% AUROC. CaDet achieves the best AUROC on AIGVDBench, DF26 and three 2026 closed-source models, and its variant trained without any generated video still exceeds 90% on AIGVDBench.
comment: 24 pages, 7 figures. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 利用视频生成过程中的周期性VAE解码痕迹，实现免训练检测并增强现有检测器。
AI.motivation: 生成器不断消除可见伪影，因此需要依赖生成流程本身留下的更可靠检测线索。
AI.method: 通过不同起始偏移下的VAE重建误差扫描周期，并用于零样本评分、检测器增强及CaDet训练。
AI.result: 免训练评分在DF26优于15个重训基线，插件使19个检测器的AUROC提升6.7%至23.7%。
AI.conclusion: VAE节律可跨多种生成器支持检测，CaDet在多个基准及闭源模型测试中取得最佳AUROC。

title: ReuseMem: One Memory, Multiple Goals in Robot Manipulation
summary: Robots that work alongside people should be able to use what they have seen when new requests arise. The same experience may later support identifying an object or returning it to its original location, although these uses were unknown during observation. ReuseMem learns to use one visual memory for multiple later manipulation goals. It records visual features independently of future goals, retrieves complementary evidence for each request, and combines it with the current scene through a lightweight action interface. Retrieval is supervised by how well candidate evidence supports expert-action prediction across different current states, linking memory selection to its use in manipulation. Repeated visual features are stored once, and memory computations that remain unchanged during action generation are reused. Experiments on four simulation tasks and two physical scenarios demonstrate reuse of a common recording across different requests. With matched action adaptation, ReuseMem improves joint goal completion on the benchmark tasks by 24.5 percentage points over uniform memory. These findings show that one memory can support multiple later manipulation goals as the scene changes.

AI.tldr: ReuseMem让机器人复用同一份视觉记忆，支持观察时尚未确定的多种后续操作目标。
AI.motivation: 机器人需要将既往观察用于后来出现的不同请求，而非只为预设目标存储经验。
AI.method: 独立于目标存储视觉特征，以专家动作预测监督证据检索，并复用重复特征及不变计算。
AI.result: 四项仿真任务和两个实体场景验证了记忆复用，联合目标完成率较均匀记忆提高24.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 同一份视觉记录能够随场景变化支持多种后续操作目标，并改善任务完成表现。

title: Out-of-training properties in frozen interatomic potential embeddings are decodable and ordered by physical scale
summary: Machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) are trained on energies, forces and stresses, yet their frozen representations can predict other materials properties. We probe ORB-v3 and UMA-S across layers, read-outs and equivariant channels for nine properties of 154,875 Materials Project crystals. Both models outperform composition-only descriptors on all targets, including five outside their training objectives; errors in physical units help assess potential screening applications. Optimal depth varies by property, consistent with a physical-scale ordering. Random-weight controls reveal strongly property-dependent benefits of pretraining. UMA-S's rotation-invariant angular channels improve crystal-system classification, while higher scores from its full tensor disappear under rotation; matched-model controls do not isolate equivariance as the explanation. Accuracy varies across different probes, but nearest-neighbour prediction often approaches XGBoost performance, even though materials do not form distinct clusters according to their properties. We also test whether a linear predictor trained on one model's embeddings can predict properties using the other model's embeddings after a learned linear transformation. Predictive accuracy is largely preserved, despite differences in which atoms the two models place close together. These results guide the reuse of frozen MLIP representations for materials prediction.
comment: 61 pages (9 main text), 18 figures, 23 tables. Accepted at AI4Mat and AI4Science workshops, NeurIPS 2026. Code: this https URL ; ORB-v3 embeddings: this https URL ; UMA-S embeddings (gated): this https URL

AI.tldr: 冻结原子间势模型的表征可预测训练外材料性质，且最佳层深呈现与物理尺度一致的排序。
AI.motivation: 仅以能量、力和应力训练的原子间势，其冻结表征对其他材料性质的可复用性尚需检验。
AI.method: 在154875种晶体的九项性质上探测ORB-v3和UMA-S的层、读出及等变通道，并设置多类对照。
AI.result: 两模型在全部目标上优于仅成分描述符，五项目标不属于训练目标，跨模型线性映射大体保留预测精度。
AI.conclusion: 冻结表征可复用于材料预测，但预训练收益、最佳层深及旋转相关表现均依赖具体性质与读出方式。

title: The Limits of Closed-Form Couplings for Few-Step Generation
summary: Few-step generators via flow models require complicated technical solutions such as a pretrained flow model or a consistency loss. While rectified flows have gained popularity for their success in few-step sampling, they pay a cost of needing a pre-trained model and sampling a large number of couplings per dataset. Yet for a finite dataset and a Gaussian probability path, the probability-flow vector field of the empirical distribution is available in closed form, so one could use this field as the teacher and skip pretraining altogether. We demonstrate that, surprisingly, this approach is impossible for problems of practical relevance. In particular, the analytic solution of the diffusion process in high dimensions becomes almost a linear transformation. The integration returns the noise vector drawn at initialisation, plus a drift that is empirically a faint copy of the data point, almost independent of the noise. The coupling therefore differs from an independent pairing only through this drift. As a result, training a model on these couplings is almost equivalent to training the model on the independent draws of the noise and the data, which does not provide a useful teacher. We highlight that this is the direct consequence of the high-dimensionality of the data, and that for low enough dimensions or large enough datasets, analytic couplings become more efficient teachers. We quantify this effect by the fraction of endpoint energy carried by the drift, which scales as $\frac{\log N}{d}$ for a dataset of size $N$ in a $d$-dimensional space. Finally, we provide an empirical study confirming all the theoretical results presented in the paper.

AI.tldr: 高维有限数据下，闭式概率流耦合接近独立配对，难以作为少步生成的有效教师。
AI.motivation: 经验分布的概率流场具有闭式解，似乎可绕过预训练，但其教学有效性尚不明确。
AI.method: 理论分析高斯概率路径下的解析耦合，以漂移占端点能量的比例量化效果，并进行实证验证。
AI.result: 高维解析耦合近似独立噪声与数据配对，漂移能量占比按log N/d缩放，实验支持理论结果。
AI.conclusion: 高维性限制闭式耦合的实用价值，而更低维度或更大数据集可提升其教师作用。

title: Human-AI Co-Ideation Across Socio-Technical Configurations: An Interactional Analysis of Planar and Immersive Workspaces
summary: Remote collaborative platforms increasingly integrate generative AI to support group ideation. These platforms are sociotechnical configurations in which spatial mediation, interaction modality, AI output format, and the mechanisms that make contributions visible to a group co-vary as properties of a deployed system. This paper examines how such configurations shape participants' collaboration and their engagement with AI during creative work. We report a comparative study of two commercially available platforms that instantiate contrasting configurations: a planar shared canvas with text-based AI integration, and an immersive virtual reality workspace with concise AI output embedded in the shared space. Fourteen all-women triads completed a structured ideation task consisting of human-only idea generation, AI-supported idea expansion, and group convergence. We analyzed collaboration patterns, selection of AI-generated ideas, perceived idea quality, workload, presence, and their lexical characteristics. The immersive configuration yielded greater spatial presence and introduced a participation paradox, in which spatial freedom enabled exploration and fragmented group coherence; it was also associated with more balanced role distribution during convergence, at the cost of higher physical demand. In both configurations, AI multiplied the idea pool, and ideas groups authored with AI available were rated above participants' own. AI output format: about 21 words per idea on the planar canvas and 3 in the immersive workspace. Tracked how participants evaluated AI-generated ideas and how often they selected them unaltered as finalists. Neither configuration made AI contributions visible or attributable to the group: participants invoked AI individually and asynchronously in both. We derive design implications for AI output format, group-visible AI invocation, and spatial support for convergence

AI.tldr: 比较平面与沉浸式人机共创平台，揭示空间配置对协作、AI使用及群体收敛的影响。
AI.motivation: 协作平台中的空间、交互与AI呈现共同变化，需要从整体社会技术配置理解其影响。
AI.method: 组织14个全女性三人组在两类商业平台完成分阶段创意任务，比较协作、评价及体验指标。
AI.result: 沉浸式平台提升空间临场感并平衡收敛阶段角色，但增加身体负担且分散群体凝聚；两平台AI均扩充创意池。
AI.conclusion: 协作式AI设计应关注输出格式、群体可见的AI调用，以及支持创意收敛的空间机制。

title: IGRecon4D: Dynamic-Object-Aware Feed-Forward Reconstruction of Driving Scenes
summary: Feed-forward 4D driving-scene reconstruction enables efficient modeling of dynamic autonomous-driving scenes, but current methods suffer from two complementary failure modes: semantic leakage of traffic participants into the static representation and geometric drift of Gaussian locations across viewpoints. We propose \textbf{IGRecon4D}, a feed-forward dynamic scene reconstruction framework that addresses these failures with training-time instance-prior distillation and LiDAR-anchored Gaussian positioning. Specifically, an instance-level semantic branch provides a potentially dynamic participant prior, which is distilled into dynamic-mask learning through the Instance-Dynamic Consistency Constraint to encourage high-recall localization of traffic-participant regions prone to dynamic-static leakage. In parallel, sparse LiDAR measurements guide dense depth estimation, and the resulting depths are back-projected to anchor Gaussian positions for improved multi-view geometric consistency. Experiments on the Waymo Open Dataset and zero-shot evaluation on nuScenes demonstrate improved full-image reconstruction on the main benchmark and stronger traffic-participant-region reconstruction under cross-dataset evaluation.

AI.tldr: IGRecon4D通过实例先验蒸馏和激光雷达锚定，改善驾驶场景前馈四维重建。
AI.motivation: 现有方法存在交通参与者泄漏到静态表示，以及高斯位置跨视角几何漂移的问题。
AI.method: 以实例动态一致性约束蒸馏参与者先验，并用稀疏激光雷达引导深度估计及高斯位置锚定。
AI.result: 在Waymo上改善整图重建，并在nuScenes零样本跨数据集评估中增强交通参与者区域重建。
AI.conclusion: 联合动态区域识别与几何锚定可缓解两类重建失效，并提升跨数据集的参与者区域表现。

title: Linglong Agent Service: A Runtime for Centralized Agent Reasoning and Distributed Execution
summary: LLM agents can use remote tools and cloud sandboxes, but integrating reasoning, session state, and heterogeneous execution sites remains a runtime design problem. We present Linglong Agent Service (agentsvc), a self-hosted HTTP service and embeddable Python runtime that treats execution site as a configurable dimension alongside model, tools, and context. A parent service retains inference orchestration, tool descriptions, and conversation history; each inference request selects one child environment for file, shell, terminal, and MCP operations. Direct HTTP and child-initiated WebSocket tunnels carry the same application interfaces, including portable request context and centrally managed updates. The normal core path requires no third-party Python packages, with an optional Windows pseudo-terminal dependency. We further present online_debugger as the process-scale special case of execution-site separation: an instrumented program submits exception evidence, executes session-scoped inspection tools inside the incident process, and resumes the same diagnostic session. Its default prompt requires failing-then-passing reproduction evidence for source changes, while runtime patch activation and failed-call recovery remain unimplemented. We explain the design through constrained expected-utility reasoning, compare concrete mechanisms with Hermes Agent, Pi, Codex, and Claude Code, and report implementation and regression-test evidence. The current evidence establishes executable contracts, not performance advantages, repair accuracy, or production recovery. The source code is open source under the MIT license at this https URL.

AI.tldr: Linglong通过集中推理与分布式执行构建智能体运行时，并以实现和回归测试验证接口契约。
AI.motivation: 智能体的推理、会话状态与异构执行环境仍缺乏统一的运行时集成机制。
AI.method: 父服务维护推理与历史，每次请求选择子环境执行工具，并通过HTTP或WebSocket连接。
AI.result: 实现与回归测试验证了可执行契约，但未证实性能优势、修复准确率或生产恢复能力。
AI.conclusion: 执行位置可作为独立配置维度，但运行时补丁激活和失败调用恢复尚未实现。

title: How to Explain your Unexplainable Video Anomaly Detector
summary: Weakly-supervised Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) models assign anomaly scores from high-dimensional features, and their predictions remain unexplained. Saliency maps show where a model looks but not what it relies on, and the descriptions produced by Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are generated by branches that the anomaly score never reads. To address this faithfulness gap, we propose \textbf{Explain The Unexplainable (ETU)}, a classifier-agnostic framework that audits frozen VAD models through counterfactual interventions in their feature space. ETU maps video features to a discrete dependency graph of agents, actions and outcomes ($A_r \to A_a \to A_o$), regenerates the features by graph-conditioned diffusion with selected nodes of the graph masked, and measures the change in the score of a frozen detector; one set of interventions is applied unchanged to every detector. The generator is trained only to reconstruct the input features, so it cannot learn the contrast it is asked to measure, and we validate the audit with experiments that test every alternative explanation of its results, from the cost of regeneration to random deletions of matched size. On UCF-Crime features obtained from a CLIP encoder, we show that substituting the scene semantics results in the largest drop for most detectors, and that removing the outcome chain of the graph ($\Delta_{rel}$) changes the anomaly score of all six audited detectors far more than removing the same number of random nodes, even though the random deletion perturbs the features about as much. We show that this targeted behavior comes from the divergence objective of the graph embedding. Without it, the two interventions become indistinguishable, and with a divergence objective in the generator as well, the score change of the detector follows the displacement of the reconstruction rather than the semantics that were removed.
comment: This paper has been accepted at the RWS workshop WACV 2027

AI.tldr: ETU通过特征空间反事实干预，解释冻结视频异常检测器真正依赖的语义。
AI.motivation: 显著图和视觉语言描述无法忠实揭示异常评分所依赖的信息。
AI.method: 将特征映射为主体、动作和结果依赖图，遮蔽节点后用图条件扩散重建并测量评分变化。
AI.result: 六个检测器对结果链移除的评分变化均远大于等量随机删点，多数对场景语义替换降分最大。
AI.conclusion: 图嵌入的散度目标是语义定向干预的关键，而生成器加入散度目标会使评分变化偏向重建位移。

title: Region-VAD: Video Anomaly Localization and Detection via Region Selection
summary: Anomalies are local events, yet weakly supervised video anomaly detection scores them globally. Most methods pool an entire frame into a single vector, rank frames by that vector, and derive a location afterwards as a saliency map of the score. Full-frame pooling mixes the anomaly with its background, so a detector can reach competitive benchmark scores from scene context without being able to show where in the scene the anomaly occurs. We introduce Region-VAD, which first selects a region and then detects the anomaly from that region alone. Region-VAD selects an explicit rectangle over the tokens of a frozen foundation model and scores anomalousness only from the tokens inside the box, through attention pooling followed by a standard temporal head. The rectangle is not learned, it is the box in which the frozen tokens change most between consecutive segments, in all four feature projections of the encoder, and it is found by exhaustive search over the rectangles of the token grid. Only the pooling and the temporal head are trained, from video-level labels without boxes, masks or frame-level annotations, and no trained component reads a token outside the selected region. Experiments on five datasets, with one localizer configuration shared by all datasets and backbones, show that Region-VAD achieves state-of-the-art anomaly localization on UCF-Crime and MSAD at competitive detection performance.
comment: This paper has been accepted in the RWS workshop at WACV 2027

AI.tldr: Region-VAD先选择局部区域再检测异常，在保持竞争性检测性能的同时改善定位。
AI.motivation: 整帧池化混合异常与背景，使检测器可能依赖场景上下文而无法准确定位异常。
AI.method: 穷举冻结编码器令牌网格中的矩形，选择相邻片段特征变化最大的区域，仅训练区域池化与时序头。
AI.result: 五个数据集实验表明，其在UCF-Crime和MSAD上实现最先进的异常定位，并保持有竞争力的检测性能。
AI.conclusion: 仅使用视频级标签、且限制训练模块只读取选定区域，可实现有效的弱监督异常定位。

title: Robust Data-Driven Output-Feedback Reference Governor with Quantified Model Uncertainty
summary: This paper constructs a data-driven reference governor (DDRG) from input--output data and supplied deterministic disturbance bounds. A data-consistent model set quantifies the uncertainty remaining in each prediction direction. With exact output measurements, the DDRG propagates output-history uncertainty while retaining exact applied-reference histories and converts the resulting tubes into constraint margins. Under a common contraction condition in a selected history norm, explicit terminal feasibility inequalities certify infinite-horizon continuation under a held reference and yield a closed invariant admissible set. A scalar update selects the largest certified step toward the requested reference, with recursive feasibility and constraint satisfaction from certified initialization. A separate bounded-measurement-noise extension derives the errors-in-variables model set and the additional physical-output margin through a measured-history certificate. On the coupled benchmark, longer nested records reduce one-step prediction disagreement at the probe regressor, and propagation accounts for most of the gap between the tube and true-model envelopes at the reported constraint row and prediction step.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建量化模型不确定性的数据驱动参考治理器，并给出递归可行性与约束满足保证。
AI.motivation: 需要从输入输出数据及确定性扰动界出发，在模型不确定条件下安全调整参考输入。
AI.method: 构造数据一致模型集，传播输出历史不确定性并转为约束裕度，以终端证书确定最大安全参考步长。
AI.result: 耦合基准中，更长嵌套记录降低探测回归量处的预测分歧，传播解释了所报告包络差距的大部分。
AI.conclusion: 在共同收缩条件和认证初始化下可保证约束满足，并可通过测量历史证书扩展至有界测量噪声。

title: Scribble Once, Segment the Sequence: Bidirectional Temporal Consistency for Weakly Supervised Segmentation in Echocardiography Sequences
summary: Temporal medical image segmentation relies on pixel-wise annotations, which are prohibitively expensive for long image sequences. Existing weakly-supervised methods reduce the annotation burden per frame but still require repeated annotations across the sequence. Furthermore, sparse supervision can result in temporally unstable representations. Addressing both challenges requires a model that can leverage strong spatial priors from large-scale pretraining while minimizing reliance on dense annotations. Frozen 2D vision foundation models provide a promising basis for this by offering transferable spatial representations with low trainable parameters. However, their lack of explicit temporal modeling limits their ability to propagate reliable information across anatomical sequences. To address this, we present a weakly-supervised framework for temporal segmentation from a single scribble-annotated frame, with all remaining frames left unlabeled. The framework combines parameter-efficient adaptation of DINOv3 encoders present in the mean-teacher architecture. Furthermore, a set of complementary losses, including a temporal loss helps generate reliable segmentation priors for the unlabeled frames. This formulation decouples annotation costs from sequence length while retaining the transferable spatial knowledge of the pretrained encoder. Extensive experiments on the publicly available CAMUS and CardiacNet datasets demonstrate that our approach outperforms other scribble-supervised methods. These results show that accurate and temporally consistent segmentation can be achieved from extremely sparse supervision, substantially reducing annotation requirements for temporal echocardiographic segmentation and providing a practical framework for scalable clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: 该框架仅需单帧涂鸦标注，即可实现准确且时间一致的超声心动图序列分割。
AI.motivation: 序列逐像素标注成本高，而现有弱监督方法仍需重复标注且易产生时间不稳定性。
AI.method: 在均值教师架构中参数高效适配DINOv3编码器，并结合时间损失等互补损失监督未标注帧。
AI.result: 在CAMUS和CardiacNet上的实验表明，该方法优于其他涂鸦监督方法。
AI.conclusion: 单帧稀疏监督结合预训练空间知识与时间约束，可降低序列分割标注需求。

title: Towards Microphone-Invariant Speech Representations for Transformer-Based Voice Disorder Detection
summary: Automatic voice disorder detection from speech offers strong potential for early diagnosis and continuous disease monitoring. While models based on pre-trained transformers have improved detection performance, their robustness to microphone variation remains underexplored, particularly for consumer-grade devices. To the best of our knowledge, we present the first study of microphone mismatch in transformer-based binary voice disorder detection across 20 smartphone microphones. While most mismatched microphone conditions cause moderate performance degradation, the worst-case condition reduces unweighted average recall by up to 12.53 percentage points. To address this, we introduce a Barlow Twins-inspired module to learn microphone-invariant representations. Our approach reduces the performance gap between matched and mismatched conditions by up to 62%, while maintaining comparable matched-condition performance. Qualitative analysis of the embedding space demonstrates more compact, distinct speaker clusters across microphones. Importantly, results indicate generalisation to unseen microphones across manufacturers, smartphone generations, and release periods, without requiring any inference-time adaptation.

AI.tldr: 该研究量化智能手机麦克风失配对嗓音障碍检测的影响，并学习麦克风不变表征缓解性能下降。
AI.motivation: 预训练Transformer虽提升嗓音障碍检测性能，但其对消费级麦克风变化的鲁棒性尚不明确。
AI.method: 在20种智能手机麦克风上研究二分类检测，并引入受Barlow Twins启发的表征学习模块。
AI.result: 最差失配使非加权平均召回率下降12.53个百分点；该模块将匹配与失配性能差距最多缩小62%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法保持相近的匹配条件性能，无需推理时适配即可泛化至不同厂商和代际的未见麦克风。

title: WinDEX: Metric 3D Hand Motion Reconstruction in the Wild for Dexterous Teleoperation and Policy Learning
summary: Human manipulation data are widely used to train robots for human-like dexterity. However, low-cost, large-scale collection in the wild remains challenging. Existing methods remain limited in geometrically grounded metric-scale reconstruction, real-world generalization and inference speed. We present WinDEX, integrating (1) geometric-temporal optimization for metric 3D hand annotation from in-the-wild egocentric stereo videos, combined with visual-inertial SLAM for world-frame reconstruction; (2) WinDEX-Net, an end-to-end, fisheye-native network combining calibrated stereo, local detail and temporal context, with a data-model flywheel of model-assisted annotation and retraining; (3) distilled models for offline reconstruction and causal streaming, supporting reinforcement learning and teleoperation; and (4) low-cost CyberCap stereo-inertial capture, forming the WinDEX-Hand dataset with 1,000 hours of training annotations and held-out human-annotated in-the-wild 2D and independent optical motion-capture evaluation sets. Offline reconstruction runs at 43.61 FPS and causal streaming at 171 FPS. On held-out data, offline reconstruction achieves state-of-the-art accuracy: 14.5 pixels in-the-wild reprojection error and, with visual-inertial odometry, 37.29 mm world-frame joint error. We achieve 7.6 and 3.6 times the task success rates of reinforcement learning policies trained with WiLoR and HaWoR motion references, respectively, and demonstrate real-time arm-hand teleoperation. Project website: this https URL.

AI.tldr: WinDEX利用低成本立体惯性视频重建真实场景中的度量三维手部运动，支持机器人学习与遥操作。
AI.motivation: 低成本大规模采集手部操作数据仍受度量几何精度、真实场景泛化和推理速度限制。
AI.method: 结合几何时序优化、视觉惯性SLAM、鱼眼立体网络及模型蒸馏，并构建千小时标注数据集。
AI.result: 离线重建达43.61帧/秒、世界坐标关节误差37.29毫米，流式推理达171帧/秒。
AI.conclusion: 所得运动参考使策略任务成功率分别达到WiLoR和HaWoR的7.6倍与3.6倍，并支持实时臂手遥操作。

title: A Hybrid Systems Approach to Parameterizing the PERC1 Model for Data Centers Using Synchrophasor Measurements
summary: The Power Electronic Reconnecting and Ceasing (PERC1) load model represents the timed ceasing and reconnection of large power-electronic loads, including data centers. Voltage thresholds and timers govern its response, with a ramp on reconnection, making it a hybrid dynamical system. This paper formulates PERC1 as a hybrid automaton and uses that structure to identify its parameters from synchrophasor records of grid disturbances. We propose a four-stage identification procedure: mode-sequence identification, estimation of logic parameters from event-time constraints, and joint Gauss-Newton refinement using hybrid trajectory sensitivities and saltation matrices. The resulting salted Fisher information is then used to analyze parameter identifiability. Two structural results are established. The detection and actuation delays are identifiable only through their sum unless a second dip interrupts the reconnection ramp, and a single disturbance leaves one unidentifiable direction in each threshold-delay pair, which two disturbances with different voltage slopes resolve. A case study using synthetic 60 frames/s synchrophasor records demonstrates recovery of the ceasing and reconnection dynamics and identifies poorly observable parameters.

AI.tldr: 该研究将PERC1负荷模型表述为混合自动机，利用同步相量记录辨识参数并分析可辨识性。
AI.motivation: 数据中心等电力电子负荷的停运与重连受阈值和定时器控制，需要适配混合动态的参数辨识方法。
AI.method: 识别模式序列、利用事件时间约束估计逻辑参数，再结合混合轨迹灵敏度和盐跃矩阵进行联合优化。
AI.result: 单次扰动下阈值与延迟存在不可辨识方向，不同电压斜率的两次扰动可消除该方向；合成记录验证了动态恢复。
AI.conclusion: 混合系统结构可揭示参数辨识限制，其中检测与执行延迟通常只能辨识其和，除非二次跌落中断重连斜坡。

title: Model-based neural network for global floodplains analysis
summary: We address the super-resolution of multispectral remote sensing imagery for long-term floodplain monitoring, enhancing Landsat acquisitions towards Sentinel-2 resolution. Exploiting the period during which both missions observed the same areas, we build DLhasa-L2S , to our knowledge the first paired dataset dedicated to multispectral super-resolution for river analysis. It covers the Lhasa River (Tibet), whose strong anthropogenic changes and diverse hydromorphological profiles make it an ideal study area. We developed two model-based neural networks: a forward-backward (FB) plug-and-play scheme and an unfolded FB scheme. We compared them against learned neural networks baselines (SwinIR, RDN) on synthetic data, on real scenes, and through a statistical test over the whole real paired Landsat-Sentinel dataset. The unfolded network achieves the highest PSNR and SSIM on the real RGB components with fast inference, offering the best trade-off between accuracy and computational cost. For NDWI-based water segmentation, its performance shows no statistically significant difference from that of the best methods.

AI.tldr: 构建拉萨河配对遥感数据集并提出模型驱动网络，将Landsat影像超分辨率提升至接近Sentinel-2分辨率。
AI.motivation: 长期洪泛平原监测需要提高历史Landsat多光谱影像的空间分辨率。
AI.method: 利用双卫星同期观测构建DLhasa-L2S数据集，比较前向后向即插即用网络、展开网络及学习式基线。
AI.result: 展开网络在真实RGB影像上取得最高PSNR和SSIM且推理快速，水体分割与最佳方法无显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 展开网络在影像重建精度与计算成本之间提供最佳折中，适用于长期河流监测。

title: Cap-Aware Boosting for Green Day-Ahead Electricity Price Forecasting
summary: Accurate forecasting of Green Day-Ahead Market (GDAM) electricity prices is essential for market participants in the Indian power sector. We present a LightGBM-based forecasting framework for Indian Energy Exchange GDAM prices, which clear in 96 fifteen-minute intervals per day. The proposed system explicitly models price-cap behavior by separating capped-price events from normal market conditions. A classification head estimates the probability of the regulatory price cap (Rs 10,000/MWh), while a regression head predicts uncapped prices in logarithmic space. Final forecasts are obtained through probabilistic blending of these components and are accompanied by nine quantile forecasts for uncertainty estimation. Evaluated on 257 trading days between 1 January and 14 September 2026, the model achieves a mean absolute error (MAE) of 397.9 Rs/MWh and a mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) of 9.57%, substantially outperforming a Chronos-2 baseline (583.3 MAE) and a persistence baseline using the previous day's profile (589.1 MAE). We further introduce leak-safe variants that incorporate real-time market signals, unmatched sell volumes, and solar generation proxies. In a recent out-of-sample evaluation, the quantile-clock variant achieved the best short-term performance with an MAE of 789 Rs/MWh during 25-28 October, while the enhanced capped-price model achieved an MAE of 716 Rs/MWh across 21 evaluation days through 16 November. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of regime-aware probabilistic forecasting for high-volatility electricity markets.
comment: 19 pages, 7 figures. LightGBM forecasts of 15-minute IEX Green Day-Ahead prices, compared with Chronos-2

AI.tldr: 提出显式区分触及价格上限与正常行情的LightGBM概率预测框架，提升印度绿色日前电价预测精度。
AI.motivation: 印度绿色日前电力市场波动剧烈，价格上限机制增加了准确预测与不确定性估计的难度。
AI.method: 分类头估计触顶概率，回归头预测对数空间中的未触顶价格，经概率融合输出预测及九个分位数。
AI.result: 257个交易日上MAE为397.9卢比/兆瓦时、MAPE为9.57%，优于Chronos-2与前日持续性基线。
AI.conclusion: 区分市场状态的概率预测能有效应对高波动电价，融合实时信号的防泄漏变体也显示样本外预测潜力。

title: Edit Recommendation: Can LLMs Anticipate Edit Requests from Users, and When?
summary: After a large language model (LLM) agent generates an artifact, users often send edit requests for it. This paper studies whether an LLM can anticipate these requests before they are sent. Such anticipation is useful in practice because it reduces the effort of user review and feedback. We formalize this task as edit recommendation and build EditRecBench, a benchmark for evaluating the performance of LLMs on this task, from real-world conversation logs in WildChat-4.8M. Through benchmarking and failure analysis, we identify a practical challenge that some cases are inherently difficult to predict in real-world settings. To address this, we introduce decision model-based gating to filter out cases where predictions are unlikely to be correct before they are presented to the user. Our trained model outperforms existing decision models and raises pass@5 among shown suggestions by 12--25 points at a gating threshold. Our code is available at this https URL.
comment: Blog: this https URL, Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: 研究大模型能否提前推荐用户修改请求，并以决策门控提高实际展示建议的命中率。
AI.motivation: 预判用户对生成内容的修改需求可减少审阅与反馈负担，但部分真实请求本身难以预测。
AI.method: 从WildChat-4.8M真实对话构建EditRecBench，并训练决策模型过滤不太可能正确的修改建议。
AI.result: 训练的门控模型优于现有决策模型，在某门控阈值下使展示建议的pass@5提高12至25个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 修改推荐具有实用价值，而识别并隐藏难预测案例是提高展示建议质量的重要途径。

title: When Feature Representation Changes Local Explanations: A Controlled Comparison of SHAP and LIME under Numerical Discretization
summary: Local feature attributions are computed over a feature representation chosen by an upstream data-engineering step, yet they are read as statements about the underlying quantity. We ask how discretizing one continuous feature changes local KernelSHAP and LIME explanations when the classifier is held fixed, and whether the two explainers respond differently. A random forest is trained on UCI Adult and frozen; age is collapsed onto equi-width or quantile bin representatives (k in {3,5,10}) before the model receives it, and the same 120 held-out instances are explained in every condition across multiple seeds. We show analytically and numerically that for KernelSHAP this is exactly equivalent to explaining the unchanged model at the quantized instance against a quantized background, so the comparison is between two effective inputs rather than a pure explainer effect; for LIME no such equivalence holds. Each attribution change is compared with a seed-noise floor from re-running the explainer on the unchanged condition. KernelSHAP's age attribution exceeds its noise floor in all 6 pre-specified conditions (median ratios 2.4-59, all significant after Holm correction); on the raw scale LIME's exceeds its floor in only 2 of 6 and in the rest is no larger than its own run-to-run variation. SHAP's normalized change exceeds LIME's in every condition (rank-biserial 0.81-1.00), while LIME is 2.5-4.6x less consistent across repeats. Predicted classes change for only 0.8-5.8% of instances and held-out ROC-AUC never falls below 0.9097, yet 45-94% of instances show a large SHAP attribution change with no class flip. Feature-importance rankings barely move (median Spearman >= 0.979, top-3 overlap 1.00). The representation change and the change in effective input cannot be separated within a frozen-model design.
comment: 20 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: 固定分类器时，年龄离散化对KernelSHAP归因的影响比LIME更明显，但LIME重复运行的一致性更低。
AI.motivation: 局部归因依赖上游特征表示，却常被直接解读为对原始变量的解释，需厘清离散化造成的变化。
AI.method: 冻结Adult数据上的随机森林，对年龄采用六种分箱条件，比较120个相同样本的归因变化与随机噪声。
AI.result: SHAP年龄归因在六种条件均显著超过噪声，LIME仅两种；45%至94%样本类别不变但SHAP归因大幅变化。
AI.conclusion: 预测与重要性排名稳定不代表局部解释稳定，且冻结模型设计无法分离表示变化与有效输入变化。

title: DRaGAN: Dynamic Graph Attention Network for Multi-Radar Point Cloud Encoding in Automotive Radar Perception
summary: Radar represents a key modality for weather-robust perception. Unlike optical sensors such as camera and LiDAR, radar can penetrate fog, rain and snow due to its longer wavelength, and recent hardware advances have steadily improved its spatial resolution, thus making it increasingly relevant for autonomous systems. While processing raw radar data requires substantial memory computation, most existing work has focused on preprocessed point-cloud data similar to LiDAR. However, the sparse radar points and sensor-relative anisotropy make LiDAR-oriented encoders suboptimal. To address this problem, we present DRaGAN, a dynamic graph attention network for multi-radar point clouds. DRaGAN introduces a sensor-relative Fourier encoding of angle and range to capture fixed-aperture radar characteristics, gated short- and long-range hub nodes along each sensor's line of sight for efficient local-global message passing, and attention-guided dynamic rewiring that prunes weak edges and adds a bounded number of latent connections restricted to two-hop neighborhoods. This reduces the number of processed edges in deeper layers while preserving representation quality. On TruckScenes, DRaGAN improves test NDS by 10.10 points over the evaluated RadarGNN baseline and reduces the reported model FLOP count by 63.7%. This trade-off includes an increase in model latency from 40 to 53.16 ms and in trainable parameters from 1.2M to 1.7M on the evaluated implementations. Code and pretrained models are available at this https URL.
comment: Accepted to 2027 IEEE/SICE International Symposium on System Integration (SII)

AI.tldr: DRaGAN针对多雷达点云设计动态图注意力编码，在提升检测性能和降低FLOPs的同时增加延迟与参数量。
AI.motivation: 雷达点云稀疏且具有传感器相对各向异性，直接采用面向激光雷达的编码器并不理想。
AI.method: 结合角度距离傅里叶编码、视线方向门控枢纽节点及注意力引导的两跳邻域动态重连。
AI.result: TruckScenes测试NDS提高10.10点、FLOPs降低63.7%，但延迟从40增至53.16毫秒，参数量也增加。
AI.conclusion: 该设计改善雷达感知的精度与运算量权衡，但更低FLOPs并未转化为更低实测延迟。

title: Polygraph: Large-Scale Multi-Session Trajectory Optimization using Pose Graphs
summary: Robots, vehicles, and wearable devices often traverse the same environment many times. Each pass produces its own trajectory from onboard visual or visual-inertial odometry. These trajectories are locally accurate but drift over time and live in unrelated coordinate frames. Turning many such independent trajectories into one globally consistent set is the large-scale multi-session trajectory optimization problem. Existing solutions largely work offline. All sessions must be available up front, one session is fixed as the reference frame, and a single fused map is then optimized. This paper presents Polygraph, a multi-session trajectory optimization pipeline that processes sessions online, one keyframe and one spatial cluster at a time, and never builds a 3D map. Keyframes are grouped into local clusters. When a cluster closes, it is matched against every other session through learned image retrieval. Candidate pairs are verified with sparse feature matching, monocular metric depth, and robust pose estimation. A two-tier consensus gate admits a cross-session edge into the shared pose graph only once independent evidence corroborates it. A cheap incremental solve keeps the graph current, and a periodic robust batch solve prunes outliers. We evaluate Polygraph on stereo outdoor driving, HoloLens and iPad indoor traversals, legged indoor locomotion with a Boston Dynamics Spot, and large-scale outdoor vehicle and handheld routes. Against the closest prior work on the same GPU model, using its reported timings, Polygraph runs faster, commits fewer loop-closure edges, and matches or improves on accuracy.

AI.tldr: Polygraph无需构建三维地图，即可在线将多次独立采集的轨迹优化为全局一致的位姿图。
AI.motivation: 多次遍历产生的里程计轨迹存在漂移与坐标系差异，而现有多会话优化方法大多依赖离线处理。
AI.method: 按关键帧与空间簇在线处理，通过图像检索、几何验证和双层共识添加跨会话边，并结合增量及鲁棒批优化。
AI.result: 多类室内外数据上，相较最接近的先前工作，按其报告耗时比较运行更快、闭环边更少，精度相当或更高。
AI.conclusion: 在线聚类与严格跨会话验证可在不建三维地图的情况下实现高效、准确的多会话轨迹优化。

title: Beyond Token Stacking: Multi-scale Visual Modulation and Adaptive Fused-feature Calibration for MLLMs
summary: Current Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have advanced rapidly and follow two main paradigms: one involves concatenating visual and textual tokens for input into Large Language Model (LLM), while the other injects visual knowledge into Feed-Forward Networks (FFNs) of the LLM. However, the former introduces a large number of redundant visual tokens, substantially increasing computational overhead. The latter reduces sequence length but removes images from the input stage entirely, which may hinder the activation of image-related knowledge. Moreover, naively injecting visual knowledge into the FFNs could induce activation distribution shifts due to cross-modal semantic discrepancies. To address these challenges, we develop Beyond Token Stacking (BTS), a novel visual enhancement framework for MLLMs. Specifically, we propose a Multi-scale Visual Modulation (MVM) mechanism that injects multi-scale visual information at the input stage via modulation without increasing the token sequence length. Furthermore, we develop an Adaptive Fused-feature Calibration (AFC) module that performs per-channel affine calibration to decouple visual injection from distribution alignment in the FFN layers, improving multimodal fusion stability while preserving language priors. Experiments show that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: BTS通过多尺度视觉调制与自适应融合特征校准，在不增加输入序列长度的情况下增强多模态大模型。
AI.motivation: 视觉令牌拼接增加计算开销，而仅向前馈网络注入视觉信息可能削弱视觉知识激活并引起分布偏移。
AI.method: 输入端以多尺度视觉调制注入图像信息，并在前馈网络中通过逐通道仿射校准分离视觉注入与分布对齐。
AI.result: 摘要报告该方法达到最先进性能，但未提供具体指标或数值。
AI.conclusion: 联合输入端视觉调制与前馈层特征校准可增强多模态融合，同时保留语言先验并避免增加序列长度。

title: A COMPASS to the Galaxy: Joint nucleosynthetic yield set comparison and parameter inference in Galactic chemical evolution
summary: Galactic Chemical Evolution (GCE) models connect stellar nucleosynthesis to observed abundance patterns, but their interpretation requires simultaneous parameter inference and comparison between competing stellar yield prescriptions. This remains challenging due to intractable likelihoods and growing dataset complexity. Using compass, a novel simulation-based inference framework, we perform, for the first time, amortized joint Bayesian model comparison and parameter inference for GCE models with intractable likelihoods within a unified architecture. Compass employs a conditional score-based diffusion model with a transformer architecture to learn both the posterior and likelihood directly from forward simulations, enabling efficient inference and likelihood-based ranking of competing nucleosynthetic yield sets. In controlled tests, compass identifies the generating yield set and recovers ground-truth parameters with accuracy comparable to existing simulation-based inference (SBI) methods, while reducing computational cost by orders of magnitude. Applied to Milky Way data, the framework favors a hybrid NuGrid + IllustrisTNG yield prescription, confirmed by an independent classifier, and infers an initial mass function slope of $\alpha_{\rm IMF} = -2.65 \pm 0.02$ and a SN$_{\rm Ia}$ normalization of $\log(N_{\rm Ia}) = -2.81 \pm 0.02$, with a systematic spread of $\approx 0.3$ in $\alpha_{\rm IMF}$ between the best-ranked yield sets, consistent with independent constraints. The attention mechanism confirms that the inferred parameters are driven by physically meaningful abundance signatures. By unifying amortized parameter inference, Bayesian model comparison, and interpretability in a single probabilistic framework, compass provides a scalable approach for precision chemical evolution studies with current and forthcoming spectroscopic surveys.

AI.tldr: compass统一银河化学演化模型的贝叶斯产额方案比较与参数推断，并将计算成本降低数个数量级。
AI.motivation: 银河化学演化研究需同时推断参数和比较恒星产额方案，但难以计算的似然与复杂数据限制了现有方法。
AI.method: 采用基于Transformer的条件分数扩散模型，从前向模拟学习后验与似然，实现摊销推断及产额方案排序。
AI.result: 银河系数据偏好NuGrid与IllustrisTNG混合产额，推得初始质量函数斜率为−2.65±0.02。
AI.conclusion: 该统一框架兼顾推断效率、模型比较与可解释性，但最佳产额方案之间仍存在约0.3的斜率系统差异。

title: Scientific Coding with Large Language Models: Evidence from Finite Element Analysis
summary: Large language models (LLMs) offer a potential route to automating scientific programming, but their usefulness depends on consistently producing numerically correct code. We extend FEM-Bench to 17 finite element tasks involving nonlinear and history-dependent mechanics and structural dynamics, and evaluate 15 models on implementation and test generation without execution feedback. The best model succeeds in 87.1% of single-pass implementation trials, but rankings differ between tracks. The leading implementer achieves 49.9% joint test success, while the leading tester reaches 82.6%. For six models, we compare single-pass generation with two agentic harnesses that allow code execution and revision. Agentic execution solves some tasks that never succeeded in single-pass trials and improves consistency on others, but gains vary across models and harnesses, and regressions also occur. Claude Opus 5 with SimpleAgent reaches 96.5% Pass@3, the probability of at least one success in three attempts, but 77.1% Pass$^3$, the probability that all three succeed. No model-harness combination exceeds 78.8% Pass$^3$. To understand why agents submit incorrect code after passing their own checks, we analyze 249 failed agentic trajectories and identify six categories of self-verification failure. The most common are inadequate test coverage (73.1%) and reliance on generic consistency checks (70.3%), and in 28.5% of cases the tests share an error with the implementation. Motivated by these findings, an exploratory configuration with separate coder and tester agents achieves the highest observed scores, with 97.6% Pass@3 and 88.8% Pass$^3$. These results identify consistency across attempts and independent verification as the main obstacles to trusting LLM-generated scientific code.

AI.tldr: 有限元编程评测显示，大模型虽有较高成功率，但跨次一致性与独立验证仍限制其可信度。
AI.motivation: 科学编程自动化要求模型稳定生成数值正确的代码，而单次成功不足以证明可靠性。
AI.method: 将FEM-Bench扩展至17项任务，评测15个模型，并比较代理执行框架及分析249条失败轨迹。
AI.result: 最佳单次实现成功率为87.1%，探索性的独立编程与测试代理配置达97.6% Pass@3和88.8%全三次成功率。
AI.conclusion: 提升科学代码可信度需要加强测试覆盖、独立验证及多次生成的一致性。

title: RAGE: Residual-Adaptive Gating for Flow-Based Image Editing
summary: Recent inversion-free, flow-based image editing methods evolve the source image toward the target via a differential velocity field. We observe that this velocity field does not explicitly account for which regions should be preserved, leading to unintended drift in non-editing regions. To address this, we formulate source fidelity control as a stochastic optimal control problem in which a selective fidelity term on the editing residual is enforced along the editing trajectory. Solving this problem and approximating its solution yields the Residual Gating Principle: each latent component is pulled back toward the source with a gain that decays exponentially with the local residual magnitude, so that small deviations are suppressed while large, semantically meaningful edits pass through unimpeded. The proposed method, RAGE, requires only one lightweight gated interpolation per sampling step, involves no mask estimation, attention maps, retraining, or architecture-specific modifications, and is applied on top of FlowEdit-based editors. On PIE-Bench, RAGE achieves the best overall rank among 17 methods and substantially improves background preservation on both Stable Diffusion 3 and FLUX backbones while maintaining competitive editing quality.

AI.tldr: RAGE通过残差自适应门控抑制非编辑区域漂移，改善流式图像编辑的背景保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有免反演流式编辑的速度场未显式考虑区域保留，容易造成非编辑区域意外变化。
AI.method: 从随机最优控制推导残差门控原则，每个采样步以轻量插值抑制小偏移并放行较大编辑。
AI.result: RAGE在PIE-Bench的17种方法中综合排名第一，并在两种骨干上改善背景保留且维持有竞争力的编辑质量。
AI.conclusion: 无需掩码、重训练或架构专用修改，残差门控即可有效增强FlowEdit类编辑器的源图保真度。

title: TRACK: Tool-Augmented Reasoning over Time Series for Fault Diagnosis in Power Management System
summary: Fault diagnosis in power management systems running multiple loads relies on experts manually inspecting current and voltage waveforms, which fails to scale across deployed units. We present TRACK, which pairs a time series encoder with a Small Language Model to produce structured, physics-grounded diagnostic reports, calling tools for exact, verifiable calculations. It operates on-device, keeping proprietary sensor data local and avoiding expensive API calls.
