We introduce a rubric-based framework that evaluates these reports by scoring structure, signal fidelity, physics reasoning, diagnosis, and actionability through per-criterion verdicts. On a 15-class multi-load simulated benchmark, TRACK achieves over 95% fault-category accuracy and generalizes to out-of-distribution faults, whereas the best encoder-probing baseline reaches only 58% accuracy.

AI.tldr: TRACK结合时序编码器、小语言模型和计算工具，在设备端生成基于物理的故障诊断报告。
AI.motivation: 多负载电源管理系统依赖专家人工检查波形，难以扩展至大量部署设备。
AI.method: 融合时序编码与语言推理，调用工具完成可验证计算，并按结构、信号、物理推理、诊断和可操作性评估报告。
AI.result: 在15类多负载仿真基准上，故障类别准确率超过95%，优于最佳基线的58%，并能泛化至分布外故障。
AI.conclusion: 设备端工具增强诊断可兼顾准确性、报告可核验性及传感数据本地保留。

title: Learning to Clear Peer-to-Peer Energy Markets
summary: Peer-to-peer energy markets are a promising paradigm for integrating distributed energy resources. A large body of work models their clearing as distributed optimization or generalized Nash equilibrium (GNE) problems which let prosumers coordinate trades and local resources without a central operator. Yet, the computational and communication burden of distributed optimization and GNE-seeking algorithms poses a major challenge to deployment at scale. We propose a learning-to-optimize framework for decentralized markets that uses historical data to accelerate clearing algorithms without additional communication. To enforce convergence by design, we train summable augmentations to a baseline algorithm, using graph neural networks to learn permutation-equivariant updates for markets of varying size and topology. We instantiate the framework for computing a variational GNE in the market model of Le Cadre et al. (2020) with a distributed Douglas-Rachford algorithm, but the idea extends to other models and base algorithms. Numerical experiments show improved convergence and illustrate the robustness of our method to out-of-distribution instances.

AI.tldr: 利用历史数据学习可求和的算法增量，可在不增加通信的情况下加速去中心化能源市场出清。
AI.motivation: 分布式优化与广义纳什均衡求解的计算和通信负担阻碍点对点能源市场规模化部署。
AI.method: 以图神经网络学习置换等变且可求和的更新，并在分布式Douglas-Rachford算法上实例化以保证收敛。
AI.result: 数值实验显示，该方法改善收敛表现，并对分布外市场实例具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 学习式增量可兼顾收敛保证与出清加速，框架也可扩展至其他市场模型和基础算法。

title: Determining Concentration from Raman Spectroscopy with Manifold Learning and Y-shaped Conformal Autoencoders
summary: Monitoring of chemical processes is crucial in chemical engineering, motivating sophisticated process analytical technology (PAT). In-line analytics are advantageous, with Raman spectroscopy being an established and reliable tool in various applications, from which many properties can be determined. We recently [Koronaki et al., AIChEJ 2024] proposed determining polymer particle size from Raman spectroscopic data, by combining Diffusion Maps (a manifold learning method) with a Y-shaped Conformal Autoencoder Neural Network. Herein, we extend this workflow to predict liquid concentrations, allowing also for multiple target predictions from the same model. We apply the methods on two datasets consisting of Raman measurements and concentration measurements: one from microgel polymerization and one from citric acid dissociation. The single-target concentration prediction results, where one target is determined from each model at a time, are accurate. Comparing against dedicated methods such as Indirect Hard Modeling (IHM) is not straightforward, due to the different validation strategies and the considered spectra range; nevertheless, it is fair to say that IHM performs slightly better than the proposed workflow. We further compare this approach with other regression methods, such as artificial neural networks, extreme gradient boosting and partial least squares, and the results show that the Conformal Autoencoders achieve higher predictive performance, demonstrating that the workflow can also be used for concentration determination. Finally we find that single-target concentration predictions are more accurate than the multiple target predictions for both case studies.
comment: Manuscript: 32 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Supplementary Information: 22 pages, 20 figures. Submitted to the Journal of Raman Spectroscopy

AI.tldr: 扩散映射与Y形共形自编码器可从拉曼光谱预测液体浓度，且单目标预测优于多目标预测。
AI.motivation: 化学过程在线监测需要可靠的浓度测定方法，并希望同一模型能够预测多个目标。
AI.method: 将扩散映射与Y形共形自编码器结合，在微凝胶聚合和柠檬酸解离数据上预测浓度并比较回归方法。
AI.result: 单目标预测准确且优于所比较的其他回归方法；间接硬建模略优，但验证策略与光谱范围不同限制了直接比较。
AI.conclusion: 该流程可用于浓度测定，但两个案例中多目标预测的准确性均低于单目标预测。

title: Cooperative Mobile Manipulation using Learned Dynamical Systems
summary: Cooperative mobile manipulation requires robots to coordinate their motions while ensuring whole-body collision avoidance and preserving task-relevant behaviors. We propose CALDS (Cooperative Adaptation of Learned Dynamical Systems), a framework that enables mobile manipulators to adapt learned single-agent behaviors for coordinated execution. Building on individual dynamical systems (DSs) learned from demonstrations, CALDS enables cooperative adaptation through two key components: Cooperative Policy Selection, which identifies compatible combinations of learned policies, and Temporal Adaptation, which ensures collision-free cooperation while preserving the spatial structure and convergence properties of the original behaviors. We evaluate CALDS across three diverse scenarios: assistive dressing, restaurant cleaning and serving, and drawer opening and object placement. Quantitative results demonstrate its effectiveness in improving task success and enabling safe, coordinated simultaneous execution while maintaining fidelity to demonstrated behaviors.

AI.tldr: CALDS将示范学习的单机器人动力系统适配为协作策略，实现安全协调的移动操作。
AI.motivation: 协作移动操作需同时满足全身避碰、运动协调及原有任务行为保留。
AI.method: 通过协作策略选择寻找兼容策略组合，再以时间适配实现避碰并保留原行为的空间结构和收敛性质。
AI.result: 在辅助穿衣、餐厅清洁与服务、开抽屉与放置物体三个场景中，提高了任务成功表现并实现安全同步执行。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架能够在保持示范行为保真度的同时，将单体技能迁移至协作移动操作。

title: Hands-On Beyond Classrooms: Elevating Control Engineering Education with Take-Home Labs
summary: This study shows how take-home laboratories can be integrated into control engineering education to strengthen hands-on learning in both introductory and advanced courses. The work provides evidence that a compact experimental platform can support conceptual understanding, student engagement, and course performance in a broadly applicable way. Control engineering courses often rely heavily on theory and simulation, which may limit students' ability to connect abstract concepts with practical implementation. Low-cost take-home laboratories offer a scalable alternative that can help bridge this gap across different educational settings. The curricular change, consisting of the introduction of take-home laboratory kits into the semester projects, was intended to improve students' motivation, deepen their understanding of core control principles, and enhance their performance in coursework and final assessment. Students used the kits for modeling, identification, and control design tasks, while learning outcomes were evaluated through questionnaires, midterm test scores, and final exam grades. Student feedback indicated strong acceptance of the new format and improved understanding of the subject matter. Statistical analysis showed a significant difference between cohorts before and after the curricular change, with modest but measurable effect sizes. The results suggest that take-home laboratories can support both motivation and academic performance, while also improving students' appreciation of the practical relevance of control engineering.

AI.tldr: 将低成本便携实验套件融入控制工程课程，可支持学生动机、概念理解与学业表现。
AI.motivation: 控制课程过度依赖理论和仿真，可能妨碍学生建立抽象概念与实际实现之间的联系。
AI.method: 在学期项目中引入居家实验套件开展建模、辨识和控制设计，并通过问卷及考试成绩评估学习效果。
AI.result: 学生认可新形式并报告理解改善，改革前后群体成绩存在显著差异，但效应量较小。
AI.conclusion: 居家实验可作为可扩展的实践教学补充，增强学习动力及对控制工程实际价值的认识。

title: Decision-Relevant Forecast Calibration for Predictive Control
summary: Calibration evidence for a predictive controller need not remain valid when operating-context frequencies change. We develop an audit and certification procedure for a declared family of context-density shifts, with a frozen predictor/controller and unchanged conditional outcome law. Coverage requires calibrated tests to span density-weighted selected-plan sensitivities. A residual Gram matrix yields the minimum augmentation rank and an optimal test budget for uncovered $L_2$ geometry. This optimum need not minimize bias over probability-feasible conditional means. For finite contexts, an asymmetric absolute-loss dual and directional linear programs enclose the continuous worst-shift feasible bias. Intersecting simultaneous moment intervals with the conditional-mean domain gives a further certificate and a linear program for selecting an operating shift after validation. In a designed 240-context study, two spectral directions remove at least 80.8% of the feasible worst-case bias. For a separate misspecified logistic forecaster, matched sensitivity and generic corrections reduce expected cost by 2.590% and 3.239%, with the generic method winning all 200 refits. On 100,000 new episodes, both corrections certify absolute evaluation bias below the illustrative tolerance 0.04 throughout a declared shift interval, while the base certifies no shift. This outcome is highly predictable under the known synthetic law used for design. The probability-feasible certificate does not improve on the moment rectangle in this sample. The contribution is reusable evaluation and audit capability with explicit geometric and statistical limits, rather than recalibration superiority. Evidence uses synthetic finite contexts, known frequencies and committed plans; evaluation bias, oracle regret, constraint risk and feedback deployment remain distinct.

AI.tldr: 提出面向情境频率变化的预测控制校准审计与认证程序，明确其几何和统计适用边界。
AI.motivation: 运行情境频率改变时，预测控制器原有的校准证据可能失效，需要针对决策相关偏差重新验证。
AI.method: 固定预测器和控制器，结合残差Gram矩阵、敏感度测试及线性规划，界定声明分布偏移下的可行偏差。
AI.result: 合成实验中两条谱方向消除至少80.8%的最坏可行偏差，两种校正均通过偏差认证，但通用校正成本更低。
AI.conclusion: 贡献在于可复用的评估审计而非校正性能优势，证据限于合成有限情境，不能混同于反馈部署表现。

title: Digital Twin Enabled Talkative Power Conversion
summary: Talkative Power Conversion (TPC) is a paradigm in which communication is integrated directly into switched-mode power electronic converters (PECs) by modulating their inherent switching ripple. TPC enables simultaneous power transfer and information exchange without dedicated transmitter-side communication hardware, and avoids additional wiring. This paper combines, for the first time, the Digital Twin (DT) concept with the TPC paradigm. By establishing interaction between one or several physical power converters and their virtual counterpart(s), the DT framework enables enhanced modeling, prediction, and optimization of individual or networked PECs. We distinguish three coupling architectures--embedded DT, remote DT, and networked DT--and demonstrate the added value of combining DT and TPC concepts when the DT and PEC are not co-located. The proposed framework is based on state-space modeling in conjunction with Kalman filtering and facilitates joint treatment of data transmission, parameter estimation, and system operation, thereby improving robustness, adaptability, and power efficiency. The presented approach highlights the potential of DT-enhanced TPC as a key enabler for future cyber-physical energy systems with tightly integrated power and communication functionalities.

AI.tldr: 将数字孪生与通信型功率变换结合，实现功率转换、信息传输与系统优化的协同。
AI.motivation: 通信型功率变换无需额外发射硬件或布线，但仍需提升变换器建模、预测与优化能力。
AI.method: 区分嵌入式、远程及网络化数字孪生架构，结合状态空间建模与卡尔曼滤波。
AI.result: 框架展示了孪生体与变换器异地部署的价值，并提升鲁棒性、适应性和功率效率。
AI.conclusion: 数字孪生增强的通信型功率变换有望支持电力与通信紧密融合的未来信息物理能源系统。

title: BoBDeLaN: Bounded-Bandwidth Context Adaptation for Deep Lagrangian Robot Control
summary: Learned physics-based models provide structure for robot control, but uncertain payloads and unmodeled dynamics limit their predictive accuracy. Context-aware Deep Lagrangian Networks enable adaptation through a latent context inferred from measurement histories while retaining Lagrangian structure for each fixed context. However, this structure alone does not constrain sensitivity to measurement disturbances. We introduce BoBDeLaN, which combines a contracting, gain-bounded Recurrent Equilibrium Network context encoder with stable linear filtering to shape disturbance sensitivity across frequencies. This architecture guarantees exponential forgetting of the recurrent initialization and admits a finite-horizon, frequency-weighted bound on context perturbations, which extends to residual torque prediction under a Lipschitz continuity assumption on the context-conditioned dynamics model. We evaluate a low-pass realization within model predictive control on simulated and real hardware manipulation tasks, together with frequency-sensitivity analysis on real-robot data. Compared with an LSTM encoder using the same input filter, BoBDeLaN exhibits reduced high-frequency context sensitivity, lower residual torque prediction error, and smoother motion, with less degradation under injected disturbances.
comment: Submitted to the 9th Annual Learning for Dynamics & Control Conference (L4DC 2027)

AI.tldr: BoBDeLaN通过有界增益上下文编码和滤波，增强深度拉格朗日机器人控制的抗扰能力。
AI.motivation: 不确定载荷和未建模动力学降低预测精度，而拉格朗日结构本身无法约束测量扰动敏感性。
AI.method: 结合收缩且增益有界的循环平衡网络与稳定线性滤波，并在模型预测控制中评估低通实现。
AI.result: 相较使用相同输入滤波器的LSTM，方法降低高频敏感性与力矩预测误差，运动更平滑且抗扰更强。
AI.conclusion: 该架构提供初始化影响的指数遗忘保证，并在相应假设下约束上下文及残余力矩预测扰动。

title: Teaching Language Models to Adapt Answer Granularity to Their Confidence
summary: When precise details are uncertain, a coarser answer can retain useful information without guessing or abstaining. We investigate whether language models can learn this behavior through model-conditioned supervision derived from consistency across sampled responses and recognition of answers at different granularity levels. We evaluate LFM2.5-1.2B, Ministral~3~3B, Qwen3.5-9B, and Gemma~4~31B on temporal and geographic questions and three generalization datasets. In several in-domain settings, fine-tuning improves the balance of correctness and informativeness beyond coarsening base answers to the best fixed level. Across generalization datasets, all four models produce coarser answers more often at low than high base-model confidence. The three smaller models' answers are also preferred over base responses on held-out relations when correctness and granularity are considered jointly. These findings demonstrate learnable confidence-related granularity adaptation, with benefits varying by model.

AI.tldr: 语言模型可学习在信心不足时降低回答粒度，以兼顾正确性与信息量。
AI.motivation: 精确细节不确定时，较粗粒度回答可保留有用信息，避免猜测或直接弃答。
AI.method: 利用采样回答一致性和多粒度答案识别构建模型条件化监督，微调并评估四种语言模型。
AI.result: 四个模型在泛化数据上均更常对低信心问题给出粗粒度回答，三个较小模型在留出关系上优于基础回答。
AI.conclusion: 与信心相关的回答粒度调整能够通过训练习得，但收益随模型而异。

title: Open-fMIND: A Large-Scale Open-Access fMRI Corpus for Pretraining Brain Foundation Models
summary: Self-supervised pretraining has transformed language and vision, but its application to functional MRI (fMRI) is constrained by data access. The largest standardized fMRI resources are governed by data use agreements and dominated by a small number of acquisition protocols, while the thousands of openly licensed datasets on OpenNeuro are individually small, heterogeneously organized, and unprocessed. We present the first release of Open-fMIND, a uniformly preprocessed, openly accessible corpus of parcellated fMRI timeseries from 322 OpenNeuro studies, comprising 11,379 subjects and 45,731 functional runs. Each run is preprocessed with fMRIPrep and parcellated under 52 atlases spanning 14 families, yielding a massive 2.4 million timeseries. Timeseries are released either denoised with our default pipeline (preproc) or as the fMRIPrep output with its confound files (quasiraw), with functional connectivity matrices, per-run provenance and motion metadata. Open-fMIND is intended as a pretraining resource for self-supervised brain representation learning. Pretraining on it yields downstream performance comparable to that obtained with UK Biobank.

AI.tldr: Open-fMIND提供大规模开放且统一预处理的功能磁共振语料，支持脑基础模型预训练。
AI.motivation: 现有大型功能磁共振资源受访问协议和采集协议局限，开放数据则规模零散且组织异质。
AI.method: 整合322项OpenNeuro研究，经fMRIPrep处理并按52个脑图谱分区，发布时间序列及配套元数据。
AI.result: 语料涵盖11,379名受试者、45,731次功能扫描及约240万条时间序列，预训练下游表现与UK Biobank相当。
AI.conclusion: 统一处理且开放获取的Open-fMIND可作为自监督脑表征学习的预训练资源。

title: MiSTiQ: MicroScaling Trellis Quantization for Extreme KV Cache Compression
summary: Modern large language models (LLMs) increasingly support longer contexts and serve more concurrent requests, increasing both sequence lengths and batch sizes. Both trends increase KV-cache size and memory traffic during inference. KV-cache quantization reduces these costs, with recent approaches using codebook-based vector quantization to achieve extremely low bit widths. However, hardware constraints limit codebook size, and most methods reconstruct the cache in higher-precision floating-point formats for attention, limiting the computational benefits of quantization. To address these limitations, we introduce MiSTiQ, a drop-in replacement for codebook-based vector quantizers that combines trellis-coded storage with microscaling (MX) formats for low-precision computation. We combine trellis quantization with beam search to encode the KV cache over large reconstruction spaces without large codebooks. To support MX computation, we derive MX-Hash functions that generate reconstruction values directly in the target MX element format. These functions use the scale-conditioned marginal distribution of block-normalized Gaussian inputs. On Llama3 and Qwen3, MiSTiQ achieves lower WikiText perplexity and higher GSM8K accuracy than the evaluated baselines across several block-scale formats at approximately 1.25 effective bits per element. With NVFP4, it also achieves the highest LongBench average on both models.

AI.tldr: MiSTiQ结合网格编码量化与微缩放格式，实现极低位宽KV缓存压缩及低精度计算。
AI.motivation: 长上下文和高并发增加KV缓存负担，而码本容量及高精度重建限制现有量化方法的计算收益。
AI.method: 通过网格量化与束搜索扩展重建空间，并用MX-Hash直接生成目标微缩放格式的重建值。
AI.result: 约1.25有效比特下，Llama3和Qwen3的困惑度与GSM8K准确率优于所测基线，NVFP4下LongBench均分最高。
AI.conclusion: MiSTiQ可替代码本式向量量化器，在极低位宽下兼顾重建质量与低精度计算支持。

title: InclusionMed: Benchmarking AI for Inclusive Healthcare
summary: Advancing medical AI for inclusive healthcare requires evaluation across diverse healthcare roles, tasks, and care settings, but benchmark coverage remains uneven. We introduce InclusionMed, an open medical AI evaluation initiative for inclusive healthcare. The InclusionMed Atlas organizes benchmarks across three healthcare roles and three AI capabilities. For the first release, we selected four public benchmarks from 388 candidates through structured audits and independent reproduction. With InclusionMed-DxFiles, our private diagnostic reasoning benchmark, the Atlas contains five benchmarks covering three of its nine role--capability cells. We evaluated frontier large language models on the Atlas and aggregated their results into the InclusionMed Index, with overall scores ranging from 17.5 to 49.1 out of 100. The Index also reports scores by healthcare role and AI capability, showing that a model's rank varied with the role or capability considered. A within-benchmark analysis using task-level tags showed that the ten highest-ranked models in the Index all scored higher on patient communication than on clinical decision-making. Models with similar Index scores also differed substantially in estimated inference cost. These findings highlight the need for evaluation covering more diverse healthcare needs and for context-specific model selection. Through open collaboration and community contributions, InclusionMed seeks to ensure that diverse healthcare needs worldwide shape how medical AI progress is defined and measured.
comment: 31 pages, 8 figures, 10 tables. Project website: this https URL

AI.tldr: InclusionMed以多角色、多能力评测揭示医疗大模型表现差异，推动更具包容性的医疗AI评价。
AI.motivation: 现有医疗AI基准对不同医疗角色、任务和照护场景的覆盖不均衡。
AI.method: 从388个候选基准中审计复现筛选四项，并结合私有诊断基准构建图谱与综合指数。
AI.result: 模型综合分为17.5至49.1分，排名随角色或能力变化，前十模型的患者沟通得分均高于临床决策。
AI.conclusion: 医疗AI评价应覆盖更多样的需求，模型选择需结合具体场景及推理成本。

title: Verifiable Random Sampling of Private Data Without a Trusted Single Party
summary: Problem: When a party supports claims about a private dataset by disclosing a sample, auditors cannot tell whether it was drawn at random or "cherry-picked" to hide flaws in the rest of the data. Solution: The data holder commits to the hashes of every item in its dataset and registers the commitment with independent servers. Selection then waits on a decentralized randomness beacon: a network that jointly emits a fresh random value every few seconds, outside the control of the data holder and the auditors. The value emitted two beacon rounds after the commitment picks the sample. Each server returns a signed receipt, so anyone can later check that the revealed sample is exactly the one that value prescribes. Selection from the committed set stays unbiased as long as the beacon's threshold holds and one required server is honest, and a pre-agreed name, checked with the servers, stops repeated or abandoned draws. We call this protocol NoCherry. Applications: Any audit that spot-checks a private corpus: private AI benchmarks and held-out test sets, dataset quality claims, code and security audits, test-fairness review, vulnerability handling, and compliance sampling. Auditors need not trust the data holder to hand over a representative sample of the committed data, since the protocol proves it, and data holders need not expose their entire dataset.

AI.tldr: NoCherry无需信任单一参与方，即可验证私有数据披露样本是否按随机规则选取。
AI.motivation: 私有数据持有者可能挑选有利样本，审计者难以验证样本是否随机抽取。
AI.method: 提交全体数据项的哈希承诺至独立服务器，以两轮后的去中心化随机信标选样并提供签名凭据。
AI.result: 在信标阈值条件成立且至少一个必要服务器诚实时，抽样无偏，预先约定名称可阻止重抽或弃抽。
AI.conclusion: 该协议支持私有语料抽查，无需公开完整数据，也无需信任持有者自行提供代表性样本。

title: Oriented Semi-DETR for Semi-Supervised Aerial Object Detection
summary: Semi-supervised object detection has recently been extended to DETR, where oriented boxes introduce an ambiguity that does not arise for axis-aligned boxes: the map from parameters to rectangles is two-to-one, since $(c_x,c_y,w,h,\theta)$ and $(c_x,c_y,h,w,\theta+\pi/2)$ denote the same rotated rectangle. Losses and matching costs are computed from the parameters, so two boxes that coincide in space can be far apart in the metric that drives training. A correctly localized student box is then penalized by the regression loss, and the inflated matching cost leads the Gaussian mixture model (GMM) filter to discard it. We propose Oriented Semi-DETR, which removes this ambiguity wherever a pseudo box enters training. Swap-aligned Target Selection regresses towards the encoding closer to the student prediction. A Swap-invariant Reliability Cost minimizes over the two encodings inside the matching cost, so the filter decides on geometry alone. Swap-aware Pseudo-label Denoising starts denoising earlier, ramps its loss weight linearly, and weights each query by the teacher score and encoding margin. All three are parameter-free and require no additional forward pass. Across all label ratios of DOTA-v2.0, Oriented Semi-DETR outperforms DETR-based supervised and semi-supervised baselines, with the largest gains at the strict IoU threshold.

AI.tldr: Oriented Semi-DETR消除旋转框等价编码歧义，提升半监督航拍目标检测性能。
AI.motivation: 同一旋转矩形存在两种参数编码，导致正确预测被回归损失惩罚或被伪标签过滤器丢弃。
AI.method: 采用交换对齐目标选择、交换不变可靠性代价及交换感知伪标签去噪，均无需新增参数或前向计算。
AI.result: 在DOTA-v2.0所有标注比例下均优于基于DETR的监督和半监督基线，严格IoU阈值下增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 在伪框参与训练的各环节处理等价编码，可改善旋转框半监督检测的训练与性能。

title: Investigating the Benefit of Transfer Learning from the Locus Coeruleus for Substantia Nigra Pars Compacta Segmentation
summary: The substantia nigra pars compacta (SNpc) is a small midbrain nucleus that degenerates early in Parkinson's disease (PD). T1-weighted FLASH MRI enables its visualization and may support early detection of neurodegeneration. However, manual segmentation is difficult and time-consuming, and deep learning models often suffer from the limited availability of labeled data. Transfer learning (TL) may help by adapting pre-trained models to small datasets. We investigate whether TL from a model trained on the locus coeruleus (LC), a nucleus with a similar appearance in this sequence, improves SNpc segmentation. Several TL strategies were evaluated using a 3D U-Net. With as few as 5-14 labeled subjects, TL and training from scratch achieved similar performance, reaching a Dice similarity coefficient of up to 0.77, close to reported inter-rater agreement. No TL strategy differed significantly from training from scratch, suggesting that initialization from the LC offers no significant benefit for SNpc segmentation.
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Submitted to IEEE ISBI 2027

AI.tldr: 蓝斑模型迁移学习未显著改善小样本黑质致密部分割。
AI.motivation: 黑质致密部人工分割困难且耗时，而深度学习面临标注数据不足。
AI.method: 使用三维U-Net比较多种蓝斑预训练迁移策略与从零训练的分割表现。
AI.result: 仅用5至14名受试者的标注数据，两类方法的Dice最高均达0.77，差异不显著。
AI.conclusion: 尽管蓝斑在该序列中外观相似，其预训练初始化未带来显著分割收益。

title: A Generative AI-Driven Architecture for Whole-Home Intelligent Services: Edge Models, Memory Management, and Household Applications
summary: Generative artificial intelligence is entering the home. Cloud-based assistants face governance limitations in data transmission, continuous availability, and the reliability of physical actions, which are especially salient in households where devices remain online, data accumulate over time, and commands trigger real-world actions. Using the home local server as a unifying organizing axis, this article develops a design-oriented review framework. Sources from arXiv, CNKI, ACL Anthology, and official documentation were searched through November 2026 and coded into five evidence categories: reviews, system prototypes, benchmarks, HCI and eldercare studies, and official documentation. System designs were mapped onto shared architectural modules, identifying nine recurrent responsibilities of the home local server. Generative models support perceptual interpretation, intent understanding, and candidate planning, while deterministic validation, knowledge-graph constraints, and authorization leases confine candidate actions to an inspectable space. Home control, emotional companionship, and intelligent guarding can be compared within a common framework: they share state and memory but differ in latency, false positive and negative rates, proactivity, and permissions. Existing benchmarks rely on virtual environments and cannot substitute for real-deployment evaluation. Local deployment is not inherently safer, and technical continuity alone does not establish the social or medical effects of companionship and guarding. The article proposes a five-dimensional evaluation framework covering architectural capability, system resources, privacy, safety and reliability, and human experience, together with six design principles and a future research agenda for local-first intelligent home systems.

AI.tldr: 研究以家庭本地服务器为核心，提出本地优先生成式智能家居的架构与评估框架。
AI.motivation: 云端家庭助手在数据传输、持续可用性及实体动作可靠性方面存在治理局限。
AI.method: 检索并编码五类证据，将系统设计映射到共享架构模块并比较三类家庭应用。
AI.result: 归纳家庭本地服务器的九项职责，并提出五维评估框架、六项设计原则和研究议程。
AI.conclusion: 本地部署不天然更安全，仍需真实部署评估及对动作权限和证据边界的约束。

title: A Study on Performance Enhancement of a Webcam-Based Real-Time Eye-Tracking System
summary: This study proposes a real-time gaze-tracking system that uses a standard RGB webcam to estimate screen coordinates. The system combines ETH-XGaze-based gaze estimation with nine-point calibration and polynomial ridge regression. To reduce errors caused by changes in head position, it also applies a conditional residual correction derived from head and pose features extracted with RTMPose. Whether this correction is used depends on the reliability of the detected features and the characteristics of the calibration data. In a preliminary experiment, one participant completed trials at 12 screen targets. The resulting mean screen-coordinate error was 204.24 pixels, which was 35.83% lower than that of xgaze-js and 57.69% lower than that of gaze_tracker. The system produced valid gaze estimates for all 12 targets. These preliminary findings demonstrate the feasibility of combining user-specific calibration with conditional pose-based correction for webcam gaze tracking. Because the evaluation involved only one participant, further experiments with more participants and a wider range of postures are required.

AI.tldr: 结合个体校准与条件姿态校正的普通摄像头眼动系统，在单人初步实验中降低了误差。
AI.motivation: 普通RGB摄像头视线追踪需要减少屏幕坐标估计误差及头部位置变化的影响。
AI.method: 融合ETH-XGaze、九点校准和多项式岭回归，并依据特征可靠性条件性应用姿态残差校正。
AI.result: 单人12目标实验的平均误差为204.24像素，较两种基线分别降低35.83%和57.69%。
AI.conclusion: 初步结果支持该组合方案的可行性，但需扩大参与者数量及姿态范围验证。

title: Language-model agents' beliefs can be manipulated via truthful evidence in open channel
summary: Language-model agents' beliefs can be manipulated through open channels such as social media, even when the information they receive is truthful. When agents fill gaps between fragments with self-induced relationships, they may accept those relationships as established facts and pass the resulting rumours to others. Drawing on cognitive theory of narrative understanding and film theory of montage, we introduce Generative Montage to operationalize this failure, termed narrative overfitting, by coordinating agents to arrange truthful fragments into misleading narratives. Across 1,090 rumour targets from six Twitter events, agents often accepted rumours overconfidently, with overall acceptance exceeding 65 percent in twelve of fourteen models. Acceptance remained above 50 percent after majority voting or review of the same evidence, showing how errors can reach downstream decisions. To explain this susceptibility, fragment interventions identify posts that influence belief within complete narratives. Synthetic controls then show that similar response patterns arise from valid evidence, separating belief influence from evidential support. This distinction motivates Grounded Monitor, a proof-of-concept neuro-symbolic runtime monitor that checks direct evidential support to guide agents' judgements, improving decision accuracy by 5.6 to 29.0 percentage points across original and anonymized settings. These findings expose a cognitive route to rumour amplification and support monitoring inferred relationships before agent-generated conclusions guide public decisions.

AI.tldr: 真实信息片段也能诱导语言模型智能体形成错误叙事，直接证据监控可改善判断。
AI.motivation: 智能体可能将自行补全的片段关系当作事实，从而接受并传播谣言。
AI.method: 提出生成式蒙太奇组织真实片段，以干预和合成对照分析信念，并构建神经符号证据监控器。
AI.result: 六起事件的1090个谣言目标中，14个模型有12个接受率超65%，监控器提高准确率5.6至29.0个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 真实信息并不保证推断可靠，应在智能体结论影响公共决策前检查关系的直接证据支持。

title: How Developer Personality Shapes the Use of AI Coding Assistants
summary: Developers differ in personality traits that shape how they approach software development tasks, yet AI coding assistants either behave uniformly or offer personalization features whose fit with individual developers must be found through trial and error. This is because it remains unclear how personality shapes developers' experiences with AI assistants, and thus which traits personalization should account for. In other words, we provide tools with no underlying theory on what works when and why. We take a first step towards such a theory with a systematic scoping review on how users' personality relates to their perception of LLM-based tools. We identified twelve studies through general search engines, major Software Engineering (SE) venues, AI tooling, and snowballing. They all reported associations between personality and perceptions, particularly perceived usefulness, yet none addressed this in a SE context. Building on these findings, we conducted an exploratory two-wave survey with 29 and 11 developers, collecting first empirical evidence of how developers' personality (measured using the Big Five Model) relates to the perception of AI coding assistants. Higher Extraversion was associated with more positive private-use experiences in both waves, while Agreeableness was associated with negative professional experiences in the first wave and positive ones in the second. These results provide first indications that the personality effects found in the literature extend to developers. Although further studies with bigger samples are needed to build a theory, our work takes the first step towards an empirical grounded theory of developer personality and AI personalization traits.

AI.tldr: 初步研究发现开发者人格与AI编程助手体验相关，但关联仍需更大样本验证。
AI.motivation: AI编程助手个性化缺乏人格影响体验的理论依据，适配往往依赖试错。
AI.method: 开展涵盖12项研究的范围综述，并对29名和11名开发者进行两轮大五人格探索性调查。
AI.result: 两轮调查中外向性均关联更积极的私人使用体验，而宜人性与职业体验的关联方向不一致。
AI.conclusion: 结果初步支持人格效应延伸至开发者群体，但不足以建立稳健的个性化理论。

title: Anytime-Valid PAC-Bayes Certificates for Adaptive Test-Time Scaling
summary: Test-time scaling systems often choose how much to sample, which prompt to use, and which verifier or aggregation rule to trust after repeatedly inspecting a calibration set. Standard validation error bars are not valid after this adaptive selection. We model a test-time scaling recipe as a randomized predictor with a random cost and prove a time-uniform PAC-Bayes certificate that holds simultaneously over all calibration times, all posterior mixtures over recipes, and all data-dependent stopping rules. Thus the same event covers the recipe search that precedes deployment, not merely the fixed recipe finally reported. For a finite grid of budgets and verifiers, the penalty is the familiar $\log M/n$, which in the worst case no certificate valid after selection can avoid, while non-uniform priors and localized posterior mixtures can give sharper certificates for structured searches. We specialize the result to self-consistency and show a complementary margin law: plurality voting improves exponentially in the sample budget only on examples where the correct answer is the generator's unique mode; otherwise more compute can provably amplify errors. The same margin analysis yields an oracle water-filling law for compute allocation. A synthetic audit quantifies the optimism caused by adaptive budget selection, and a 192-example GSM8K audit using gpt-4.1-mini generations illustrates risk-cost reporting for a real inference pipeline. At scale, with two models on GSM8K and MATH-500, selected-best error bars fall below the out-of-split GSM8K risk in up to 22.5% of random splits at a nominal 5% while the certificate never does, and on the full GSM8K test split it tightens to 0.109 (held-out risk 0.039). The results give a lightweight, distribution-free way to report risk and compute claims for adaptive inference systems.
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Xiaoyu Li and Jiangxuan Long contributed equally. 31 pages, 7 figures, 15 tables

AI.tldr: 研究提出任意时刻有效的PAC-Bayes证书，为自适应测试时扩展提供风险与计算成本保证。
AI.motivation: 反复查看校准集后选择采样预算、提示或验证器，会使常规验证误差区间失效。
AI.method: 将推理方案建模为随机预测器，证明覆盖后验混合及数据依赖停止规则的时间一致证书。
AI.result: 标称5%水平下，择优误差界在至多22.5%的随机划分中低于留出风险，而所提证书未出现此情况。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提供轻量、分布无关的自适应推理评估保证，且增加计算可能放大非正确众数样本的错误。

title: Slower but Faster: When Self-Organized Traffic Flows Beat Traffic Signal Control
summary: Urban traffic flow networks are complex adaptive systems, whose variability challenges centralized, top-down control. We study decentralized alternatives in which order emerges from local interactions, comparing the network-wide performance of roundabouts in SUMO against fixed-time and actuated control as well as self-organizing signals on a 4$\times$4 grid and a rewired, irregular variant of it, across demand levels and periodic surge amplitudes. In our computer simulations of the regular grid, converting the single most central intersection already lowers delays by 2 to 3\% relative to actuated control; each additional conversion lowers them further, and full conversion outperforms every signalized alternative under all conditions studied. In the irregular traffic flow network with full conversion of all intersections into roundabouts, this holds only up to a critical load, where traffic flow breaks down sharply, when the time-averaged demand reaches about 3.1 times the base load. Beyond that point, the self-organizing traffic signals show the lowest delay of any network-wide strategy and is nearly insensitive to surges. Interestingly, roundabouts are favorable solutions even at lower speed limits: in the regular grid, compared to the mean speed under actuated control at a speed limit of 50\,km/h, roundabouts match that speed at a speed limit of about 40\,km/h. Compared to traffic signal control, this establishes a slower-is-faster effect. Furthermore, travel times in self-organized traffic flows are more predictable than in networks with conventional signals.

AI.tldr: 交通仿真显示环岛可实现低限速下的效率优势，但不规则路网高负载时自组织信号更优。
AI.motivation: 城市交通的复杂变化挑战集中式控制，需要评估由局部互动形成秩序的去中心化方案。
AI.method: 在SUMO中比较规则4×4网格及重连不规则路网上的环岛与三类信号控制，改变需求及周期激增幅度。
AI.result: 规则网格全环岛在所有测试条件下最优；不规则网约3.1倍基础负载后崩溃，自组织信号延误最低。
AI.conclusion: 环岛优势依赖拓扑和负载，规则网中约40公里时速限速可匹敌50公里时速限速下的感应信号平均车速。

title: Neurosymbolic Synthesis of Contraction Metrics with Certified Verification
summary: We study counterexample-guided synthesis of contraction metrics for continuous-time autonomous systems on compact domains. A learner proposes a metric; a sound verifier certifies its matrix inequality or returns diagnostic points for retraining. The neural extension pairs a learned metric factor with symbolic contraction conditions and rigorous numerical verification; main ablations use polynomial features. We give computable polynomial bounds in arbitrary dimension and outward-rounded verification for polynomial, trigonometric, and neural representations. Loop soundness is separated from conditional finite-grid termination under idealized feasibility assumptions. We analyze why scaling and fixed-margin training can leave valid metrics uncertified. The scaling construction requires a scale-closed family, which the experimental fixed-floor class generally lacks. Verified slack improves the contraction rate and quantifies model-error tolerances using certified residual and Jacobian bounds. Finite-distance conclusions require connecting paths whose flows stay in the verified region. Experiments include controlled ablations, three-dimensional verification, and transfer from a fitted surrogate with known-truth residual certification. A physical swing-model study compares neural learning objectives with shared verification and invariant energy regions. Verified constant metrics certify the polynomial benchmark and smallest swing-model domain; neither result requires neural state dependence. Exploratory refinement certifies additional frozen candidates at a larger verification budget. In matched polynomial operating-grid experiments, trace normalization and margin coupling did not demonstrate a certification-count advantage within the tested budgets. These choices address specific failure mechanisms without guaranteeing optimizer convergence or general empirical superiority.
comment: 30 pages, 10 figures. Code and verified reproduction: this https URL

AI.tldr: 研究提出带可靠数值验证的反例引导收缩度量合成方法，并明确其保证与适用限制。
AI.motivation: 学习得到的收缩度量可能有效却无法获证，需要可靠验证并分析缩放和固定裕量训练的失效机制。
AI.method: 由学习器提出度量，验证器认证矩阵不等式或返回诊断点，结合符号条件与外向舍入数值验证。
AI.result: 常数度量认证了多项式基准和最小摆模型域，匹配实验中迹归一化与裕量耦合未显示认证数量优势。
AI.conclusion: 方法可提供可靠认证及模型误差容限，但不保证优化收敛、普遍经验优势或无条件有限终止。

title: Heteroscedastic Gaussian Process Q-learning for Sample Efficient Experimentation
summary: Self-driving laboratories must learn to control a process from tens to hundreds of expensive experiments, too few for deep reinforcement learning (RL). We learn the Q-function directly with a Gaussian process (GP), which avoids learning the dynamics, and show that the GP posterior supplies the learning rate of Q-learning. If each Bellman target is treated as a noisy measurement of the Q-function, the learning rate that minimises the mean squared error is the Kalman gain, and applying it to every observed transition is equivalent to GP regression. Heteroscedastic Gaussian Process Q-learning (HGPQ) sets the noise variance of each target with a heteroscedastic GP, which learns how unreliable the targets are across the states and inputs. Targets from noisy operating conditions, or from regions where the value function has large gradients, then move the estimate less than targets from low-noise regions, so HGPQ learns quickly where the data are reliable without being misled where they are not. For kernel value iteration with per-target variances that are assigned when a target is collected, we prove a high-probability bound on the error of the value estimate, uniform over the explored region. Pooled over five simulated benchmarks, which include a chemical reactor and a bioprocess, HGPQ approaches the best return found by any method in fewer episodes than GP, kernel and deep RL baselines.

AI.tldr: HGPQ通过异方差高斯过程建模目标噪声，提高昂贵实验中的强化学习样本效率。
AI.motivation: 自驱动实验室只能进行数十至数百次昂贵实验，难以满足深度强化学习的数据需求。
AI.method: 直接用高斯过程学习Q函数，以异方差模型估计贝尔曼目标噪声，并据此调整更新权重。
AI.result: 在五个模拟基准的汇总评估中，HGPQ比高斯过程、核方法及深度强化学习基线更少回合接近最佳回报。
AI.conclusion: 按目标可靠性加权有助于高效学习，且特定核值迭代设置下可获得探索区域内一致的高概率误差界。

title: Stream of Belief: Eliciting Collective Intelligence through Latent Belief Dynamics
summary: In this work, we view multi-agent reasoning as a process of seeking a collective equilibrium of implicit belief dynamics and introduce Stream of Belief (SoB), where agents maintain continuous latent beliefs and iteratively refine them through communication and reflection. Our method seeks a collective belief state of a multi-agent system where further communication induces no meaningful information propagation. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate the generalization of SoB across tasks and model families. More Broadly, our results suggest a new perspective on scaling multi-agent reasoning from belief dynamics.

AI.tldr: SoB将多智能体推理视为连续潜在信念交互并趋向集体均衡的过程。
AI.motivation: 研究希望从隐式信念动态出发，探索多智能体系统如何形成集体智能。
AI.method: 各智能体维护连续潜在信念，通过通信和反思迭代更新，直至进一步通信不再带来实质信息传播。
AI.result: 广泛实验展示了SoB在不同任务和模型家族之间的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 信念动态为扩展多智能体推理提供了新的研究视角。

title: The Price of Choosing Examples: Context Overfitting in Adaptive In-Context Learning
summary: In-context learning is usually analyzed as if the examples in the prompt were sampled before the learner is chosen. In deployed systems they are not: examples are retrieved, filtered, re-ranked, edited, and repeatedly tested after seeing the query and the data store. We formalize this gap by treating prompt construction as adaptive data analysis through a conditional stochastic-kernel calculus. Our main quantity is the context capacity, the mutual information or approximate max-information between the data store and the final prompt transcript. For any frozen in-context learner and any adaptive context pipeline with capacity $\kappa$, we prove a finite-sample context generalization bound of order $\sqrt{\kappa/k}$, where $k$ is the number of selected examples whose losses form the reported score. We prove a matching lower bound, whose constant is exact when $\log k\ll\kappa\ll k$, and derive two PAC-Bayesian retrieval rules: a first-order Gibbs rule that charges data-dependent candidate gates their prior mass, and a self-normalized second-order rule. On Banking77 with 64 retrieval recipes and two model families, the certificates hold in all 24,000 resampled selection events, and from 64 (Qwen2.5-7B) or 128 (GPT-4.1-mini) reused validation queries the Gibbs rule certifies a risk below the zero-shot error in over 99% of validation draws. Finally, we instantiate the theory for Bayesian linear in-context regression, including an order-statistics analysis of query-aligned top-$k$ Gaussian retrieval. The results separate context quality from context certification: longer or more relevant contexts improve risk only when the procedure used to choose them is stable enough for selected-context evidence to transfer.
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Xiaoyu Li and Jiangxuan Long contributed equally. 31 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables

AI.tldr: 研究以信息论刻画自适应上下文选择带来的过拟合，并给出泛化界与可认证检索规则。
AI.motivation: 实际提示示例常在看到查询和数据后反复筛选，违背示例预先采样的常见分析假设。
AI.method: 以条件随机核形式化提示构建，用上下文容量衡量信息依赖，并推导两种PAC贝叶斯检索规则。
AI.result: 研究证明泛化界为√(κ/k)量级且有匹配下界，Banking77上全部24000次重采样选择均满足认证。
AI.conclusion: 上下文更长或更相关并不自动保证可靠改进，选择程序须足够稳定才能使所选证据有效迁移。

title: QuantileGS: Quantile-Based Conformal Bounds on RGB Rendering Errors for Novel View Synthesis with 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Uncertainty quantification for novel view synthesis with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) assesses rendering reliability at unseen viewpoints. This reliability depends on the discrepancy between rendered and true colors, which cannot be measured without ground-truth images. We therefore quantify uncertainty in this unknown discrepancy through upper bounds on per-pixel RGB mean absolute error. However, learned bounds may underestimate these errors and overstate rendering reliability, motivating calibration to a prescribed coverage level. In this paper, we propose QuantileGS, a post-hoc framework that combines learned rendering-error quantiles with scale-normalized conformal calibration to produce spatially adaptive error bounds. The framework comprises three phases. Phase 1, Rendering-Error Computation, measures RGB mean absolute error between observed images and predictions from a frozen 3DGS model. Phase 2, Ordered Gaussian Quantile Fields, learns two scalar attributes per Gaussian to predict lower and upper rendering-error quantiles. Phase 3, Scale-Normalized Conformal Calibration, calibrates the upper prediction on held-out images, using the quantile gap to scale the correction. Under the stated assumptions, the resulting bounds provide finite-sample marginal coverage. At a nominal coverage level of 90%, calibration raises mean empirical test coverage from 69.6% to 89.6% on LLFF and from 80.1% to 92.1% on Mip-NeRF 360. On LF, coverage remains conservative at 96.3% before and 96.4% after calibration. Applications to active view selection, Gaussian pruning, and RGB-D simultaneous localization and mapping illustrate how these bounds inform downstream decisions.

AI.tldr: QuantileGS结合误差分位数学习与共形校准，为3DGS新视角渲染提供逐像素RGB误差上界。
AI.motivation: 新视角缺乏真实图像，渲染误差无法直接测量，而学习得到的误差界可能低估风险。
AI.method: 固定3DGS模型计算观测误差，学习高斯分位数字段，再用留出图像及分位数间距进行尺度归一化校准。
AI.result: 名义覆盖率90%时，LLFF覆盖率由69.6%升至89.6%，Mip-NeRF 360由80.1%升至92.1%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在所述假设下提供有限样本边际覆盖保证，并可辅助视角选择、高斯剪枝及RGB-D定位建图。

title: Continuous Phase-Coherent Readout of a Magneto-Mechanical Resonator Using a Phase-Locked Loop
summary: Magneto-mechanical resonators are wireless sensors that encode a measurand in their natural frequency. Existing systems estimate this frequency from repeated cycles of excitation and ring-down, which limits the precision and bandwidth range. Here, we introduce a continuous, phase-coherent readout based on a phase-locked loop. In a benchtop setup, one record stayed within 4 % of the precision-bandwidth limit over more than three decades of bandwidth, while conventional readouts remained about a factor of 4 above it.
comment: 2 pages, 2 figures, Sensor and Measurement Science International Conference (SMSI) 2027 conference

AI.tldr: 研究以锁相环实现磁机械谐振器的连续相位相干读出，逼近精度—带宽极限。
AI.motivation: 传统读出依靠反复激励与振铃衰减估计固有频率，限制了测量精度及带宽范围。
AI.method: 构建基于锁相环的连续相位相干读出方案，并在台式实验装置中验证。
AI.result: 一条测量记录在超过三个数量级的带宽范围内距精度—带宽极限不超过4%，传统读出约为极限的4倍。
AI.conclusion: 连续相位相干读出可在宽带宽范围内接近磁机械谐振器的精度—带宽极限。

title: ThinkWAM: Rethinking Latent Futures for Action Refinement
summary: World-action models (WAMs) couple action generation with predictions of future states. An initial action chunk may be flawed. A future prediction that is not conditioned on the chunk may fail to reflect the changes that the proposed actions would induce in visual representations, limiting its usefulness for refinement before execution. We introduce ThinkWAM, a latent WAM that establishes bidirectional feedback before execution through a proposal-rethink-refine loop: the policy first proposes a complete action chunk, the proposal corrects multi-horizon future latents through a learned residual, and the corrected latents are injected into a second pass of the same action head, which generates the executable chunk. An affordance-guided observation-action memory and a near-fine, far-coarse multi-horizon prediction scheme, both motivated by predictive coding, support this loop, and all prediction stays in latent space. ThinkWAM achieves 98.70% success on LIBERO, 84.76% on LIBERO-Plus without OOD fine-tuning, 85.75%/65.85% on RoboTwin 2.0 Clean/Random, and 65.17% on RoboCasa24. ThinkWAM achieves 64.4% mean success across three real-world OOD conditions. The mean two-pass inference latency per action chunk is 153.48 ms on LIBERO, 164.61 ms on RoboTwin, and 101.2 ms on the Galaxea A1Z. Ablations show complementary gains from rethinking and affordance guidance. Diagnostics indicate that proposal-conditioned corrections change both predicted futures and action trajectories, showing that the corrected future representations improve the final action.
comment: 21 pages, including references and appendix. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: ThinkWAM通过执行前的动作提议、潜在未来重思考与动作细化闭环，提高机器人任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 初始动作可能有误，而不以动作提议为条件的未来预测难以有效指导执行前修正。
AI.method: 用动作提议的残差修正多时域潜在未来，再送入同一动作头细化，并结合可供性记忆与近细远粗预测。
AI.result: ThinkWAM在LIBERO成功率为98.70%，无分布外微调的LIBERO-Plus为84.76%，三种真实分布外条件均值为64.4%。
AI.conclusion: 消融与诊断表明，重思考和可供性引导具有互补收益，动作条件化的未来修正有助于改进最终动作。

title: Hybrid Optimization-Generative Motion Planning for Multiagent Affine Formations
summary: Formation maneuver control enables a multiagent system to cooperatively navigate through constrained environments in collective motion. While various formation controllers exist, they rely heavily on high-quality and dynamically feasible reference trajectories provided a priori, making formation motion planning (FMP) essential. To address the computational challenges for high-dimensional joint trajectories faced by conventional constrained optimization-based solutions, this paper introduces a hybrid optimization-generative framework with a focus on affine formations, which provide the necessary spatial flexibility. By formulating the planning task as a constrained Maximum-a-Posteriori estimation, we decouple multiagent objectives to leverage pre-trained single-agent diffusion priors for dynamic feasibility, obstacle avoidance, and smoothness. We then interleave the generative process with projected gradient descent (PGD) to strictly enforce affine geometric constraints with safety guarantees. Simulations demonstrate that our framework generates highly smooth, collision-free plans that are readily trackable by common distributed controllers and outperforms state-of-the-art planners in various metrics.

AI.tldr: 研究融合扩散生成与约束优化，为多智能体仿射编队生成平滑、无碰撞且可跟踪的运动计划。
AI.motivation: 编队控制依赖预先提供的可行参考轨迹，而高维联合轨迹使传统约束优化规划面临计算困难。
AI.method: 将规划写为约束最大后验估计，复用单智能体扩散先验，并交替执行生成过程与投影梯度下降以约束仿射几何。
AI.result: 仿真生成了平滑、无碰撞且可由常见分布式控制器跟踪的计划，并在多项指标上优于先进规划器。
AI.conclusion: 生成先验与约束优化的结合可兼顾高维仿射编队规划的轨迹质量、几何约束与安全保障。

title: Quantum-Assisted D-FACTS Scheduling for Moving Target Defense under Switching Limits
summary: Moving target defense with distributed flexible alternating-current transmission system (D-FACTS) devices re- quires activation decisions as operating points change. Switching limits couple these decisions, but period-by-period rankings can overlook combinations needed to complete low-activation schedules. This paper proposes cross-period candidate sharing and schedule-completion evaluation to allocate limited physical checks in quantum-assisted D-FACTS scheduling. The quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA) generates activation candidates, while classical scheduling enforces operating and switching constraints. We also quantify model-based activation requirements and test detection through noisy nonlinear trials. A modified IEEE 118-bus study assesses recovery of reference activation and switching objectives within the evaluated set. Combining candidate sharing and schedule-completion evaluation improves final-budget recovery over period-by-period ranking in the primary operating window for every tested candidate generator. The results show that quantum and classical candidates yield identical recovery curves under combined checking, so the same allocation policy applies to either source.

AI.tldr: 研究通过跨时段候选共享与调度补全评估，改进切换受限的量子辅助D-FACTS移动目标防御调度。
AI.motivation: 切换限制使各时段激活决策相互耦合，逐时段排序可能遗漏实现低激活调度所需的候选组合。
AI.method: 以QAOA生成激活候选，由经典调度满足运行及切换约束，并用候选共享和调度补全分配有限物理检查。
AI.result: 改进IEEE 118节点测试中，组合检查提高所有受测生成器的最终预算恢复率，量子与经典候选恢复曲线相同。
AI.conclusion: 跨时段共享与补全评估改善了有限检查预算的利用，同一分配策略可用于量子或经典候选来源。

title: Conformal Expert Pools: Training-Free Probabilistic Time-Series Forecasting Beyond Seasonality
summary: Conformal Seasonal Pools (CSP) showed that a forecaster with no training at all, built only from past values at the same point in the season and from past forecast errors, significantly outperformed DeepNPTS, Amazon's learned non-parametric forecaster. We propose Conformal Expert Pools (CEP), a training-free successor. CEP replaces the single seasonal-naive forecast by a pool of simple forecasters, builds its predictive distribution from their past forecast errors, and adapts both the pool and the errors to the series being forecast. No model is trained and no parameter is learned across series. On the CSP benchmark of 232 datasets and 24,502 forecast windows, CEP is better than CSP on 78% of datasets by CRPS, on 84% by MSIS and on 83% by Winkler score; on a typical dataset its CRPS is 14% lower and its MSIS 23% lower (both p < 1e-22, paired Wilcoxon test), and coverage of 95% intervals rises from 90.1% to 92.2%. CEP has a lower CRPS than DeepNPTS on 88% of datasets, than NPTS on 89% and than SeasonalNPTS on 83%. The improvement persists on dataset families outside the development set and on 36 additional fev-bench files. We also test the published claims that Laplace, an online ensemble forecaster, "beats (almost) everything" and "beats" CSP. On 228 datasets at multi-step horizons the claims do not hold: CSP outperforms Laplace on 60% of datasets by CRPS and on 64% by interval score, and Laplace ranks sixth of seven methods, with the widest intervals of all (69% wider than CEP's). Its point forecast is biased low and on 54% of datasets is less accurate than seasonal naive, and from a cold start it takes about 7,700 times longer than CSP. CEP is better than Laplace on 82% of datasets by CRPS and on 80% by MSIS, with intervals about 40% narrower, and runs 271 times faster.
comment: 21 pages, 3 figures, 11 tables. Successor to arXiv:2605.03789

AI.tldr: CEP以简单预测器池和历史误差实现免训练概率时间序列预测，在多项指标上优于CSP等基线。
AI.motivation: 单一季节朴素预测难以适应不同序列，需要更灵活且无需训练的概率预测方法。
AI.method: 以简单预测器池替代单一季节预测，利用历史误差构建预测分布，并按目标序列调整预测器池与误差。
AI.result: 在232个数据集上，CEP的CRPS在78%的数据集上优于CSP，95%区间覆盖率由90.1%升至92.2%。
AI.conclusion: 无需模型训练或跨序列参数学习，也能提升概率预测质量，且改进在开发集外数据上保持。

title: In-Context Estimation and Prediction for Parametric ODEs
summary: Transformers have demonstrated the ability to perform in-context learning, that is, to adapt to new tasks from a few examples without updating their parameters. Existing theory has largely focused on emulating gradient-based algorithms for convex statistical problems or establishing general function approximation guarantees without exploiting the underlying statistical structure. We study in-context parameter estimation and trajectory prediction for parametric ordinary differential equations (ODEs), where estimation is generally nonconvex. Under suitable identifiability and regularity conditions, we construct a transformer that estimates unknown system parameters from noisy trajectory observations through a two-stage approximate maximum likelihood procedure: a coarse search provides an initialization within a locally strongly convex region, followed by gradient descent with local linear contraction. For prediction, we compose this estimator with a neural approximation of the ODE solution map. We further show that, through parameter sharing, a single transformer can perform both parameter estimation and trajectory prediction simultaneously. For these constructions, we establish nonasymptotic guarantees and finite-pretraining oracle inequalities that separate errors due to finite pretraining data, finite context length, and finite-sized transformer approximation. Numerical experiments on linear and nonlinear ODEs further show that pretrained transformers can benefit from longer inference contexts without updating their weights.

AI.tldr: 研究构造可在上下文中估计参数化ODE并预测轨迹的Transformer，提供理论保证与数值验证。
AI.motivation: 现有上下文学习理论较少利用统计结构，也难以直接覆盖通常非凸的ODE参数估计问题。
AI.method: 通过粗搜索初始化与局部梯度下降近似最大似然估计，再结合ODE解映射的神经近似进行预测。
AI.result: 给出非渐近保证及区分三类误差的预训练预言机不等式，实验显示更长上下文可改善免更新推断。
AI.conclusion: 在适当可辨识性与正则条件下，单个共享参数的Transformer可同时完成ODE参数估计与轨迹预测。

title: CAE-Bench: Benchmarking AI Agents for Reusable CAE Solver Development
summary: We developed CAE-Bench, a benchmark to evaluate AI agents on Computer-Aided Engineering (CAE) solver development. A CAE solver is more than a PDE solver; it must be able to generalize across various inputs, such as different boundary conditions, geometries, and material properties. CAE-Bench evaluates the generalizability of AI-developed CAE solvers by providing the same task, such as a heat transfer problem, multiple cases, with each case specifying an input. The AI agent develops a solver for a fixed task using only a few public cases, and the resulting solver is then tested on held-out cases, i.e., cases it has never seen before. We evaluate 12 models across a range of reasoning settings on 80 computational tasks. Our experiments show that even if a solver developed by an AI agent performs well on the public cases, it may even get 0 score on held-out cases. For tasks such as fluid dynamics problems, even the solver developed by GPT-6 Astra performs poorly on held-out cases. A data format and an SDK for task registration are provided, so the researcher can use the benchmark on their own infrastructure. We hope that CAE-Bench will help the community to develop AI agents that can develop reusable CAE solvers that generalize to various inputs.
comment: 18 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables. Zhiyu Zhou and Tianyou Liu contributed equally

AI.tldr: CAE-Bench以未见输入测试AI开发的工程求解器，揭示公开案例表现良好并不保证泛化。
AI.motivation: 可复用CAE求解器必须适应不同边界条件、几何及材料，不能只解决少量固定案例。
AI.method: 让智能体依据少量公开案例开发求解器，再用隐藏案例评测，并在80项任务上测试12个模型。
AI.result: 部分公开案例表现良好的求解器在隐藏案例上得分为零，流体动力学等任务的泛化仍较差。
AI.conclusion: 该基准及配套数据格式和SDK可支持可复用CAE求解器的开发与泛化评估。

title: Classical structural priors improve neural molecular representations in molecule language models
summary: Classical molecular similarity is central to chemical information systems, yet molecule-language models trained on paired structure-text data do not necessarily organize molecular embeddings according to graded structural relationships. Here we introduce Structure-Aware Guided Alignment (SAGA), a training-only regularizer that uses Centered Kernel Alignment to align neural molecular representations with fingerprint-based Tanimoto similarity, without adding parameters or requiring fingerprints at inference. In MolCA and Atomas, SAGA improves molecule-text retrieval, shifts non-exact retrieval toward closer structural analogues, and increases average scaffold-split property-prediction performance, while molecular description and text-to-molecule generation are improved or preserved in single-run ablations. These results show that established chemoinformatics priors can make molecule-language representations more chemically faithful while retaining their multimodal utility.
comment: 40 pages. This is the originally submitted version. The final version, revised after peer review, is published in J. Chem. Inf. Model. (2026): this https URL

AI.tldr: SAGA用经典分子结构相似性约束神经表示，改善分子语言模型的化学一致性与多项任务表现。
AI.motivation: 结构与文本配对训练并不保证分子嵌入能够反映渐进的结构相似关系。
AI.method: 训练时以中心化核对齐，使分子表示匹配指纹Tanimoto相似度，不增加参数或推断时指纹需求。
AI.result: 在MolCA和Atomas中，SAGA改善检索与平均骨架划分属性预测，单次消融中生成表现改善或保持。
AI.conclusion: 经典化学信息学先验可增强分子语言表示的结构忠实度，同时保留其多模态用途。

title: PLECTA: Overlap-aware instance segmentation of dense strand networks from binary masks
summary: Many materials and tissues, including carbon-nanotube sheets, collagen and paper, comprise overlapping strands whose arrangement influences their effective properties. Measuring this geometry from micrographs requires individual strands to be traced through crossings and signal gaps, which merge distinct strands or split one strand into disconnected fragments. We present PLECTA (from Latin plecta, a braid), a deterministic method that segments individual strands using only a binary image whose foreground pixels mark strand centrelines. At each junction, PLECTA selects which strand segments continue into one another while allowing segments to terminate. It formulates this decision as an exact maximum-weight partial-matching problem, with an explicit penalty for unpaired segments and no restriction on the number of segments entering a junction. The output permits crossing pixels to belong to multiple strands. On synthetic scenes, PLECTA resolved strand identities more accurately than three released alternatives at every density tested. The same ranking held on an independently published generator run at its own settings. A separate stage uses the corresponding greyscale micrograph to estimate which strand lies on top at each crossing. The complete workflow is demonstrated on scanning electron micrographs of carbon nanotube sheets, from raw images to individual strand instances with estimated crossing order, without manual annotations for training or as pipeline inputs.

AI.tldr: PLECTA仅凭二值中心线图分割重叠细丝，并可结合灰度图估计交叉处的上下顺序。
AI.motivation: 密集细丝的交叉与信号缺口会造成实例合并或断裂，妨碍显微图像中的几何测量。
AI.method: 将交点续接建模为带未配对惩罚的精确最大权部分匹配，允许终止、任意分支数及交叉像素共享。
AI.result: 合成场景各测试密度下的身份辨识均优于三种公开方法，独立生成器验证也保持相同排名。
AI.conclusion: 该流程无需训练标注或人工标注输入，即可从碳纳米管显微图获得细丝实例及估计交叉顺序。

title: The Price of Not Planning: Parallel Sampling Depth Peaks at the Reconstruction Threshold
summary: Masked diffusion models sample the tokens of one round independently. Planned decoders first generate a coarse plan, then fill in the tokens in parallel. We ask when a plan saves rounds, how many it saves, and how fine it must be. We study this on broadcast trees: the leaves are the tokens, the internal nodes are the plan, and the edge correlation $\theta$ sets how strongly tokens depend on the plan. Errors are measured by the forward Kullback-Leibler divergence $\varepsilon$, and the lower bounds hold for every deterministic value-adaptive rule, also with learned conditionals. We show that a decoder without the plan needs of order $\min\{n,(n/\varepsilon)^{\alpha}\}$ rounds below the reconstruction threshold, where $\alpha=\log b/(4\log(1/\theta))$ rises to $1/2$ at the threshold, and that the exponent stays below $1/2$ above it (binary channel: $0.02\le\theta\le0.98$). With the plan, $\log_b n+1$ rounds suffice. In the binary model below the threshold, a plan with units of $m$ tokens needs of order $\log_b(n/m)+\min\{m,(n/\varepsilon)^{\alpha}\}$ rounds, so it gives logarithmic depth exactly when $m$ is logarithmic. A plan therefore helps most near the threshold, and only if its units are small. Exact divergence computations in the Gaussian model with up to $2^{20}$ leaves confirm these exponents below the threshold.

AI.tldr: 广播树理论表明，规划在重建阈值附近最能减少并行采样轮数，但规划单元必须足够细。
AI.motivation: 需要明确先规划后并行生成何时节省采样轮数，以及收益大小和所需规划粒度。
AI.method: 在广播树上以正向KL散度衡量误差，推导有无规划及不同规划粒度的轮数界，并进行高斯模型验证。
AI.result: 有规划时对数轮数足够，无规划的复杂度指数在重建阈值处达二分之一，高斯精确计算支持阈下指数。
AI.conclusion: 规划收益在重建阈值附近最大；阈下二元模型中，仅当规划单元大小为对数级时才能达到对数深度。

title: Compressed Simulation-Based Inference: Neural Posterior Estimation for Massive Data via Low-Dimensional Sketches
summary: Neural posterior estimation (NPE) is a popular Bayesian simulation-based inference (SBI) approach that uses neural networks trained on simulated data--parameter pairs to approximate the posterior given a user-chosen prior. For high-dimensional observations, NPE methods typically approximate the conditional density of the parameter given a user-chosen or learned summary statistic, rather than the entire dataset, due to the curse of dimensionality. However, both approaches face challenges: hand-crafting good summaries for complex models requires considerable effort from scientists, while learning them from massive datasets can be prohibitively computationally expensive. To address these challenges, we propose approximating the conditional density of a parameter given low-dimensional sketches of the data. We show that, for a model with a $p$-dimensional parameter, only $2p+1$ random sketches are needed for posterior consistency. We compare with state-of-the-art embedding networks for NPE, and we find that our method \emph{matches} the best embedding network's performance while \emph{increasing computational efficiency}.

AI.tldr: 利用低维随机草图进行神经后验估计，可兼顾大规模观测的计算效率与后验推断性能。
AI.motivation: 高维数据的手工摘要设计成本高，而从海量数据学习摘要可能计算开销过大。
AI.method: 以数据的低维随机草图为条件训练神经后验估计器，替代手工摘要或学习式嵌入。
AI.result: 对p维参数，仅需2p+1个随机草图即可保证后验一致性，实验性能匹配最佳嵌入网络且计算更高效。
AI.conclusion: 低维随机草图为大规模数据的模拟推断提供了具有理论保证且计算高效的压缩方案。

title: FM-Recon: Exploring Foundation Model Features for Accelerated Cardiac Cine MRI Reconstruction
summary: Foundation models have demonstrated strong feature extraction capabilities across various medical imaging tasks, yet their potential for MRI reconstruction remains largely unexplored, particularly within unrolled reconstruction networks and under artifact-corrupted inputs. In this work, we explore whether and how features from pretrained foundation models can benefit accelerated cardiac cine MRI reconstruction. To this end, we propose FM-Recon, a framework that refines and integrates extracted features from frozen image encoder of foundation models into an unrolled reconstruction network. Through extensive experiments on the CMRxRecon2023 dataset, we systematically evaluate foundation model features across different reconstruction settings. Our results show that foundation models can extract informative representations from artifact-corrupted inputs and improve reconstruction performance, particularly at moderate acceleration factors. These findings demonstrate the potential of foundation model features for accelerated MRI reconstruction and provide insights into their effective integration into unrolled reconstruction networks.

AI.tldr: FM-Recon将冻结基础模型的图像特征融入展开重建网络，改善加速心脏电影MRI重建。
AI.motivation: 基础模型在伪影输入及展开式MRI重建网络中的作用尚未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 提炼冻结基础模型图像编码器的特征并整合进展开网络，在CMRxRecon2023上系统评估不同重建设置。
AI.result: 基础模型能从含伪影输入中提取有效表示并改善重建，尤其在中等加速倍率下表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型特征有助于加速MRI重建，其特征提炼与整合方式值得进一步研究。

title: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Linguistic Annotation
summary: Assessing large language models for linguistic annotation requires task-specific evaluation under documented conditions. We present dhAIBench, a Python benchmarking and annotation tool with a web interface for exploring and sharing results. It records prompts, configurations and predictions, enabling comparisons of annotation quality, confidence calibration, repeatability and estimated cost. We demonstrate the framework and the associated methodology through 293 runs of 48 models on nine linguistic annotation tasks spanning morphology, syntax, semantics, discourse-pragmatics, spelling normalization and learner-language correction. Models achieve high agreement with reference annotations on several tasks, including those on non-standardized, historical varieties as well as requiring contextual interpretation. The results support evaluating models against specific linguistic tasks, rather than relying on general rankings. To this end, we make the current and future benchmarks publicly available at this http URL.

AI.tldr: 研究提出语言学标注评测工具dhAIBench，强调按具体任务而非通用排名评价大模型。
AI.motivation: 语言学标注需要在明确记录的条件下开展任务专属评估，以支持可靠比较。
AI.method: 记录提示、配置与预测，在九类语言学标注任务上对48个模型开展293次运行。
AI.result: 模型在若干任务上与参考标注高度一致，包括非标准化历史变体和需要语境理解的任务。
AI.conclusion: 模型选择应依据具体语言学任务表现，公开基准与完整记录有助于比较和复现。

title: AnachroBench: Evaluating Historical Consistency in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Existing Large Vision-Language Model benchmarks primarily evaluate visual understanding in general everyday scenarios, leaving historical consistency with a specified era and country largely underexplored. To address this gap, we propose AnachroBench, a controlled discriminative benchmark for evaluating historical consistency in visual scenes. It contains 1,600 image pairs from eight countries spanning the late 19th to the early 20th century, each pairing an original historical image with an anachronistic version containing a seamlessly inserted modern object. AnachroBench evaluates three aspects: Inserted Object Perception, which tests whether models detect the inserted modern object; Era-Country Consistency, which assesses whether the scene is consistent with the specified era and country; and Conditional Era-Country Consistency, which measures consistency judgments only when the inserted object is correctly perceived. A false consistency judgment occurs when a model perceives the modern object but still judges the scene as historically consistent. Overall, AnachroBench reveals a gap between inserted object perception and era-country consistency judgments, providing a targeted evaluation of this behavior.

AI.tldr: AnachroBench通过历史图像中的现代物体插入，评估视觉语言模型的历史一致性判断。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型基准主要关注日常场景，缺乏对特定年代与国家历史一致性的评估。
AI.method: 构建涵盖八国、19世纪末至20世纪初的1600对图像，分别评估物体感知和历史一致性。
AI.result: 模型对插入物体的感知与年代及国家一致性判断之间存在差距。
AI.conclusion: 识别出现代物体并不保证正确判断历史一致性，需对两种能力进行针对性评估。

title: Deep Learning for Physicists: From Linear Regression to Reasoning Models
summary: These lecture notes are based on an introductory course on neural networks and deep learning that the author taught in the School of Mathematical Sciences at Queen Mary University of London in 2023/24 and 2024/25. The author, however, is a physicist, and it shows: wherever possible, ideas are explained with physical intuition rather than heavy formalism. Readers with a background in physics or mathematics who want a self-contained, introductory route into modern machine learning may therefore find these notes particularly friendly. The notes start from maximum likelihood, least squares, linear regression and (stochastic) gradient descent. They then cover neural networks, backpropagation, the vanishing gradient problem, batch and layer normalization, overfitting and regularization, adversarial examples, and the kernel method. The second half turns to natural language processing: word embeddings, recurrent networks and LSTMs, the attention mechanism and Transformers, and large language models, including scaling laws, the history of GPT, instruction tuning, reinforcement learning from human feedback, hallucination, alignment faking, chain-of-thought reasoning and test-time scaling. The emphasis on large language models reflects requests from the students. The notes are aimed at third- and fourth-year students in the UK system. Because the course was also taken by students from other departments, very little is assumed: even basic material such as matrix multiplication is explained from scratch, so readers familiar with it can safely skip such parts. No originality is claimed; the aim is a coherent, intuitive path through the material. Developments after spring 2025 are not covered, but the basic ideas emphasized here are unlikely to go out of date soon.
comment: 115 pages, many figures. Based on lectures given at Queen Mary University of London

AI.tldr: 这份讲义以物理直觉串联机器学习基础、深度学习和大语言模型，面向物理与数学背景读者。
AI.motivation: 为具备物理或数学背景的学生提供自洽、直观且先修要求较低的现代机器学习入门路径。
AI.method: 从最大似然、线性回归和梯度下降讲起，逐步介绍神经网络、Transformer及大模型推理。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体结果。
AI.conclusion: 讲义侧重基础思想而非原创成果，不涵盖2025年春季之后的发展。

title: Agent-Native by Design: A Programming Language for Agentic Applications
summary: Building agentic applications requires combining large language model (LLM) operations, workflow structure and application state, and model-guided routing. With SDKs and agent frameworks, developers connect these components through supporting code that prepares model inputs, propagates state, and dispatches model-selected steps. Workflow changes can require coordinated updates to this code, increasing development and testing effort. Splitting execution logic between application code and framework internals also limits compiler visibility into control flow and state dependencies, hindering automatic optimization. We introduce Agent-Native Programming, which unifies these three components with shared execution semantics. We realize this approach in Jac, a Python-superset language, through "by llm()" for typed model operations and tool use, Object-Spatial Programming for workflow structure and state, and "visit ... by llm()" for model-guided routing. The routing construct derives the model's choices from executable workflow steps and schedules the selected steps. This explicit connection between model decisions and program execution gives the compiler and runtime a common basis for dependency analysis and automatic optimization. Across five benchmarks and five baselines, Jac achieves a 1.8-8.7x reduction in AI-integration code relative to the OpenAI SDK, with competitive observed task quality and lower coding-agent development effort. Two case studies demonstrate speculative execution and service partitioning through configuration alone, using program analysis and runtime checks to preserve workflow behavior under stated conditions.

AI.tldr: 研究以Jac语言统一模型操作、工作流状态与模型引导路由，减少智能体应用的集成代码。
AI.motivation: 现有框架依赖大量衔接代码，增加开发测试成本，并限制编译器分析与自动优化。
AI.method: 在Python超集Jac中引入类型化模型操作、对象空间编程及与可执行步骤绑定的模型路由。
AI.result: 在五项基准和五个基线比较中，Jac较OpenAI SDK减少1.8至8.7倍AI集成代码，任务质量具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 统一执行语义可降低开发负担，并在规定条件下通过分析和运行时检查支持保持行为的优化。

title: Turing Agent: Agentic Formal Verification for Mathematical Research
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are rapidly advancing mathematical discovery, moving beyond benchmark-level problem solving to tackle frontier research problems. This progress is ushering mathematics into an era of proof abundance, raising a fundamental challenge: how can we ensure the correctness of the ever-growing volume of AI-generated proofs and transform them into trustworthy, machine-verified mathematical knowledge? We introduce Turing Agent, an agent harness designed to orchestrate end-to-end formal verification of research-level mathematics. Its wo-scale architecture integrates theorem formalization and proof formalization agents, empowered by structured proof decomposition, parallel verification, accumulated proof experience, and selective semantic review. Leveraging our collaborations with theoretical computer science (TCS) researchers, we focus our evaluation on TCS, a particularly demanding domain characterized by intricate quantification, complex dependencies, and stringent semantic requirements. Against direct generation and general-purpose coding harnesses, including Codex CLI and Claude Code, Turing Agent achieves approximately 57-62% faithful formalization success on Formal TCS Bench and 83% overall pass@1 on a TCS-focused subset of RLMEval, using GLM-5.3 and DeepSeek-V4-Pro. Notably, Turing Agent, built on DeepSeek, successfully completes the formal verification of three previously unresolved TCS tasks from OpenAI's October 2026 collection. One particularly challenging TCS problem required about a hundred formally verified auxiliary claims. Moreover, by actively exploring and refining the formalization process, Turing Agent can uncover simpler alternative proofs, expose unnecessary dependencies in original proofs, and generate reusable mathematical knowledge as a byproduct of verification.

AI.tldr: Turing Agent协同定理与证明形式化智能体，实现研究级数学证明的端到端形式验证。
AI.motivation: AI生成证明不断增多，需要确保其正确性，并将其转化为可信的机器验证数学知识。
AI.method: 采用双尺度架构，结合结构化证明分解、并行验证、经验积累与选择性语义审查。
AI.result: 在Formal TCS Bench上忠实形式化成功率约57%至62%，在RLMEval的TCS子集上pass@1为83%。
AI.conclusion: 该系统还完成三项此前未解决的TCS任务验证，并可发现更简证明、冗余依赖与可复用知识。

title: Déjà-Events: Multi-view 3D Geometry with Event Cameras via Sparsity-Aware Adaptive Gating
summary: Event cameras keep capturing structure where conventional cameras blur or saturate, which makes them attractive for 3D perception in fast or poorly lit scenes. Event datasets with dense 3D ground truth, however, are far smaller and less diverse than the image collections behind feed-forward 3D reconstruction models. We present Déjà-Events, an event-only model that predicts depth, camera pose and pointmaps from multiple views in a single forward pass. Rather than relying on scarce 3D labels, we distil it from Déjà View, a feed-forward RGB model that refines its tokens by repeatedly applying one shared transformer block. On paired RGB and event recordings, the event student learns to reproduce the frozen teacher's final tokens, which requires no depth or pose ground truth and trains only about 1% of its parameters. Because events are dense at edges and moving texture but nearly absent in textureless regions, we further introduce sparsity-aware adaptive gating, which adapts the shared block's gates to events and adjusts them per patch by event density, so that accuracy holds as refinement steps are added. Trained only on simulated data, Déjà-Events achieves the lowest pointmap error among the event-based methods we evaluate, on EventScape and zero-shot on the real MVSEC and DSEC datasets. On DSEC it halves the error of the strongest baseline (0.15 vs. 0.30 AbsRel) with about a tenth of its parameters. It also has the lowest depth error on EventScape and DSEC and the lowest trajectory error on EventScape.

AI.tldr: Déjà-Events通过RGB教师蒸馏和稀疏感知门控，实现仅用事件输入的多视图三维重建。
AI.motivation: 事件相机适合高速或弱光场景，但具有密集三维真值的事件数据规模与多样性有限。
AI.method: 无需深度或位姿真值，蒸馏冻结教师的最终令牌，并按事件密度调整共享模块门控。
AI.result: 仅用模拟数据训练，在DSEC上点图误差为0.15 AbsRel，较最强基线减半，参数量约为其十分之一。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在所评估事件方法中取得最低点图误差，并能零样本迁移至真实MVSEC和DSEC数据。

title: Fix, Don't Retake: Physics-Simulated Training for Correcting Patient Positioning Errors in Dental Panoramic Radiographs
summary: Patient-positioning errors can distort panoramic radiographs and lead to repeat examinations. This study investigated artificial intelligence for correcting these errors in existing images. A physics-based simulator generated paired correctly positioned and mispositioned panoramics from cone-beam computed tomography volumes, with controlled individual and combined positioning errors. Five approaches were compared: U-Net, pix2pix, conditional diffusion, an error-conditioned model, and a mixture of error-specific specialists. Evaluation used image similarity and geometric metrics across three test sets. All approaches improved mean image similarity and reduced geometric errors, with U-Net and the two error-aware approaches outperforming pix2pix and conditional diffusion.

AI.tldr: 研究利用物理模拟训练AI，直接校正牙科全景片中的患者定位错误。
AI.motivation: 患者定位错误会导致全景片失真并引发重复检查，因此需要探索现有图像的校正方法。
AI.method: 从锥形束CT模拟正确及错误定位的配对全景片，比较五类模型，并在三个测试集上评估。
AI.result: 所有方法均提高平均图像相似度并减少几何误差，U-Net及两种错误感知方法优于其余两类方法。
AI.conclusion: 模拟训练支持校正既有全景片的定位失真，但摘要未报告实际减少重复检查的效果。

title: High-probability Uniform Mixing via Dobrushin Contraction and Accelerated Hamiltonian Monte Carlo
summary: Hamiltonian Monte Carlo, since its invention and subsequent rise to widespread use, has been motivated by its ability to accelerate convergence to equilibrium compared to diffusive methods, both in terms of dependence on condition number and dimension. In the present work, we establish this acceleration simultaneously in both aspects for critically damped Metropolis-adjusted kinetic Langevin with persistent uniforms.
